title: Restart Mode
description: Restart Mode is a 2D psychological detective about a single day that keeps rewinding to the beginning.

title: Beat:Keeper
description: Vantan Game Academy TOKYO GAME SHOW 2025 Exhibition Match the rhythm of flowing notes, convert beats into power, and defeat your enemies! A psychedelic beat battle to bring sound (freedom) back to the people!

title: Wizard Blaster
description: Wizard Blaster is a top-down time survival roguelite where you play as a wizard. Use magic to fight off hordes of evil. Choose from different characters and abilities to survive.

title: Daisy Goes to Slime Castle for Tea
description:
Everyone's favorite RPG Maker 2000/2003 default priestess actor goes on yet another perilous quest! A princess held hostage in a castle of slimes! A boyfriend who is feeling quite unwell! As the weekend draws nearer, how will Daisy manage to address both of these? And what's tea got to do with all of it?

Made as a part of the 2023 Vextro Slime Wave Jam, Daisy Goes To Slime Castle for Tea is a micro-RPG awkwardly written to be a love letter to VIPRPGs, the loose "Moshimo" canon, and the wider RPG Tsukuru/Tkool/Maker series as a whole.

title: Museum Guard: Exhibit Unknown
description: Museum Guard: Exhibit Unknown is a horror game playable solo or in optional online co-op for up to 4 players. Work the night shift in a museum where exhibits refuse to stay quiet. Patrol halls, investigate anomalies, and decide when to document and when to run.

title: Lucky Pikinini: IMS Intelligence Corp
description: IMS Intelligence Corp is a Large-Scale First-Person / Third-Person Story-Telling Game with a 13-Chapters Story Campaign, 4-Maps Special Missions & 33-Maps Survival Mode. It Happens Same Time As the Events of Super Incursion & IMS Death Squad. You Take Control of IMS Daryl Kalashi.

title: My NEET Life
description: When a business-woman approaches NEET prodigy Akiko with the proposition that could change her life, she enters an entirely bigger world outside of her bedroom, full of work and... well, more work.

title: Tattered Banners
description: Lead your mercenary company in a turn-based tactics RPG set in a living, simulated world shaped by your actions. Raid, bribe, steal, spy, assassinate, lay siege, and more - and watch the consequences ripple through and change a realm at war.

title: Cumbersome
description: This game is a fun and challenging side scrolling adventure game, with vibrant cartoon style graphics providing a visually pleasing experience. Players control a nimble and cute little elf, using the AD key to move left and right, and the W key to jump, in a carefully designed game navigation. This road is full of surprises. However, the road is also filled with obstacles such as turbulent rivers and sharp teeth, which require players to cleverly avoid them. The sound design of the game is excellent, with cool sound effects accompanying every action, greatly enhancing the immersive experience.

title: L.A.T.H.E
description:
After murdering his partner, WS is sentenced to Mental Labyrinth Rehabilitation Therapy, an operation overseen by The Doctor under L.A.T.H.E. (Laboratory for Algorithmic Therapy and Human Experimentation). Officially, it’s treatment; in truth, it’s research. L.A.T.H.E. studies how broken minds reconstruct themselves, turning grief into data and trauma into product.

The crypt WS explores is his own.

And the entities he fights are memories that refuse to stay buried.

title: Bring A Knife To A Gun Fight
description: Bring a Knife to a Gun Fight, or BAKTAGF for short, is a high schooler student project that started at the Becker School of Design & Technology's Next Level Summer Games Studio. It is a 2D sidescroller action platformer in which you play as Bill Hawk (cousin of Tony Hawk), a falsely imprisoned man in a tyrannical regimes prison. Vying for his freedom, he wields a knife with a chain to make his great escape.

title: Monster Under My Bed
description: The monster under Charlie’s bed visits every night.

title: The Last Night: Zombie Attack
description: This game is a tense, atmospheric survival experience built around exploration, pressure, and learning the environment through failure and persistence.

title: Pico-Ball
description: Play solo or together in a mashup of tennis, volleyball, squash, and wallball where the only rule is: two bounces on one side is a point for the other.

title: Kvartirant
description: Eighteen-year-old Maxim Karasev, full of hopes for adulthood, finally left his parents' home. He invested his small savings in renting a modest apartment in an old, somewhat dilapidated neighborhood of the city.

title: Out of the Park Baseball 27
description: 27 years of sports gaming excellence! Out of the Park Baseball 27 is here - officially licensed by MLB, the MLB Players Inc. and KBO! This year's brand new version puts you firmly in charge of your favorite baseball franchise or country. Your team, your way, your rules.

title: The Saplum Cradle
description: A choose-your-own-adventure horror game about using the memories of the dead to scavenge lost civilisations.

title: Ho Ho & Move
description: Collect gifts, and plan the perfect path.

title: Deathmark
description: An occult social‑deduction card game for up to 12 players. Play your cards in secret, find and eliminate the opposing team and avoid the Deathmark!

title: The Devil Card
description: The Devil Card is a card battle game inspired by Final Fantasy VIII’s Triple Triad. Select 5 cards and place them on the Grid. Flip opponent cards to win, collect them, and progress through the story. Defeat the Devil to earn his soul card and complete the campaign, or play with custom rules in Freeplay mode.

title: Resolute Bay
description: Forelegs are better than two as you journey across mountains, thickets and plains in search of your lost herd. Master Fight, Flight and Freeze responses to fend off foes in snappy, turn-based battles of wits, then take in the scenery and have a good roll before trotting on.

title: Fate’s Loop
description: An upcoming souls-like RPG game. It is a stylised medieval fantasy adventure where you play as Thalor, a retired hero who must save their village from a time loop curse.

title: Tong
description: Tong is a PvP game where you have to lick more objects than your opponent!

title: Crave Saga: Master of Bonds
description:
Protect the world through the power of bonds! Here begins the Master's great adventure!!!

Vestria, a parallel world where only men exist. This land, inhabited by a variety of species, is under the control of angels, who are trying to lead humans to a utopia, and demons, who exercise their greed a depravity to their utmost extent. Our protagonist, who was reincarnated in Vestria by the God of Creation and the original God King, Arche, embarks on a journey of salvation as the Master!

title: Dicement
description: Dicement is a minimalistic logic puzzle game where your move, modify and manipulate dices to fit them in corresponding slots with different conditions.

title: Lastlore Saga
description: Select your party in this tactical RPG roguelike. Choose from a list of characters with unique abilities and gear for vast amount of build ideas. Classic feel of old school 16 bit RPG games, updated roguelike gameplay and progression for infinite replayability!

title: Kantmis-Zero
description: "Kantmis-Zero" is a boss rush action game. As the only chosen one on the Kantmis continent, you must follow the divine instructions and complete the trials.

title: A Game About Ramen
description: A Game About Ramen is cozy little game puts you behind the counter of a humble ramen shop. You’ll serve steaming bowls to hungry customers, experiment with ingredients, and keep the shop running late into the night.

title: Gore Sword
description: Gore Sword is a brutal and hilarious medieval combat simulation game driven by real physics! There are no elegant swordplay techniques here—only the most primitive, clumsy, and uproarious physical confrontations.

title: Chromascape
description: Step into a gentle, hand-drawn world in Chromascape. As Luna the hedgehog, you hold the power to absorb and share colors in a land fading into gray. Use warm hues to light fires, cool tones to freeze paths, and restore vibrancy to this heartwarming 2D adventure.

title: Hamish
description: Hamish is a fast-paced, momentum-driven action platformer where every step could be your last. Run, jump, and grapple your way through rising lava, snowy peaks, neon-lit cities, and more, mastering speed and precision while taking down ruthless enemies.

title: Protect the Pit
description: A short incremental clicker game that blends the strategy of tower defense with the depth of sprawling upgrade trees. Build your own winding mazes to repel the oncoming hordes!

title: On Titan
description: There are banana people living on Titan. They regularly hold tennis tournaments without rules for the Saturn Cup. They invite foreign players from all over the universe. Fans have also arrived from planet Earth and are waiting for you as a Player. Dress up in a banana uniform and try it out..

title: Starfox 64: Recompiled
description: Starfox 64: Recompiled is a project that uses N64: Recompiled to statically recompile Starfox 64 into a native port with many new features, enhancements, and extensive mod support. This project uses RT64 as the rendering engine to provide some of these enhancements.

title: Toycrafter
description: You lost your passion for crafting small toys. You shifted your focus to working on larger dolls. Cut, paint and attach doll parts to build unique and unsettling sculptures. Ignore any anomalies you see or hear. Don't forget to lock the door & wishlist before you leave

title: Lost Lures
description: Fishing adventure set in the Finnish wilderness. Learn fish behavior, read the water, and choose the right lure. Progress catch by catch through calm, skill-based fishing. Play solo or head out online with friends, complete shared missions, and fish at your own pace.

title: Over the Tower
description: Over the Tower is a hack-and-slash clicker game where you defeat enemies with simple mouse clicks. Collect coins to unlock upgrades, and equip the items you obtain to grow even stronger. What will you witness at the top of the tower…?

title: Sanctum Push
description: Sanctum Push is a charming pixel art sokoban adventure where you play as a brave paladin pushing enemies into their rightful places to restore peace to a corrupted castle. Every move counts, plan carefully, position your foes, and clear each room to advance through the sanctum’s ever-changing halls.

title: Something to Drink?
description: I'm Tom and I just got a job as a bartender. Now I have to wipe down the same sticky counters where I used to leave my own marks. In this dive, even the rats look like they're hungover. Alright, the boozers won't pour their own drinks - time to get back to work.

title: Incremental Cats
description: Incremental Cats is a short incremental game about befriending cute cats of all rarities, from common to legendary, while generating cosmic amounts of hearts to unlock upgrades.

title: Kodoku
description: Indie horror game inspired by Japanese mythology.

title: Sonic Terror
description:
Sonic Terror is a turn-based tactical RPG where music is brutal magic and the only weapon against a space alien parasite that has turned silence into a new law.
Set in an alternative 1984, Sonic Terror puts you in control of an outlaw rock band on tour through a totalitarian Republic invaded by body-snatching aliens. The only thing they’re afraid of is music—and you’re the last ones to play it.

title: Kickback Clash
description: Kickback Clash is a fast-paced arena shooter where every shot pushes you back. Fly using your weapons, dash through the air, survive vertical arenas with double jumps, and climb to the top of the global leaderboard by outplaying your opponents.

title: Chance
description: The property-trading deckbuilder. Chance is strange, dusty board game where you steal land from the bourgeoisie, bankrupt the proletariat, break the rules with unfair chance cards, and discover strategies worthy of an antitrust lawsuit.

title: Beyond the Illusions
description:
Alright, you absolute legends—or degenerates, depending on the day—welcome to Beyond the Illusions, a 10-minute shitshow where one dude’s birthday goes from “my ex dumped me” to “am I tripping balls or is that lava?” I’m dVlpr, the sleep-deprived lunatic who puked this mess into existence over 55 hours of caffeine and regret, then “remastered” it with 25 more hours of “why the hell am I doing this?” No fancy GITIA VI budget here—just glitchy vibes, broken dreams, and a big ol’ “screw polish” attitude.

Meet Dan, a walking disaster whose day spirals into a fever dream of breakup blues, creepy-ass forests, and lava hops that’d make a platformer pro cry “where’s the save point?” It’s packed with crude quips—pineapple pizza lovers, you’re on notice—and meta bullshit that’ll make you wonder if I was dropped as a baby. Picture dick-shaped caves, hallucinated weirdness, and choices where you’re either a badass or a pussycat whining about your ex. I built this in a haze of free sound effects (wet farts, anime moans, you name it) and my fake band’s tunes, Glitchpocalypse. It’s short, it’s unhinged, it’s got more “WTF” than your last Twitter scroll. Love it, hate it, whatever—just play it, then go hit a bar or rethink your life choices. Mic drop, bitches.

title: Zenteni: Create Creatures
description: Lead your tribe in this turn base building strategy game. Conquer new lands and modify your next generation DNA to make them stronger.

title: Idle Mythical Beasts
description: Auto-battle against mythical beasts to unlock more powerful ones

title: Infinite Monkey Clicker
description: Infinite Monkey Clicker is a clicker game inspired by the Infinite Monkey Theorem. Hire new monkeys typing nonstop on typewriters to generate letters and words and see if they can finally write Hamlet!

title: I Lost My Eggs: Easter
description: Embark on a fun Easter egg hunt! Explore seven enchanting rooms, solve fun Easter trivia, and uncover hidden eggs in the most unexpected places. Can you find them all? The hunt is on!

title: Land Develop
description: An idle game where you develop territory in retro style. Build businesses, expand your land, and watch your wealth grow over time.

title: Nick Logic for Kids
description: Puzzle for children Snap the right blocks to build Nick's path. Help Nick cross the screen to get the ham.

title: We Love Fish Tanks
description: We Love Fish Tanks is a cozy aquarium builder. Kick back & relax, buy, breed, & sell fish (or fish-like things), and decorate your tank exactly how you'd like!

title: Touhou Fantasy
description: "Touhou Fantasy " is a barrage shooting game。"Touhou Fantasy" is a secondary fan-made game featuring Cirno from the Touhou Project as the main character. The game centers around bullet hell combat, leading players into a world filled with fantasy and magical elements.

title: Echoes From Ciudadela
description:
Echoes from Ciudadela is a first-person adventure and puzzle-solving game focused on exploration, environmental storytelling, and narrative discovery. You play as Katari, who follows the trail of his recently dead father after uncovering his journal, that leads him to a sealed mountain known as Ciudadela.

Throughout the journey, your main artifact is a Balearic sling, a tool tied to both the environment and the forgotten technologies hidden within the mountain. As you dive deeper and solve puzzles, you’ll unlock journal entries left behind by Katari’s father. Each revealing pieces of a lost civilization and their connection to time, invention, and legacy.

title: Bubble's Travel
description: It‘s a beautifully minimalist and fun-filled puzzle adventure. You guide a delicate bubble through the hidden dangers of everyday life. By clicking the mouse to create gentle air currents, you must lead the bubble across rooms filled with unique traps—before it bursts or your limited taps run out.

title: Search All: Bones
description: This is a hidden object game in which you need to find all the bones in a large location. The bones will be located in a variety of places, from the most prominent to barely noticeable places.

title: Tic Tac Toe World
description: Jump into the world of Tic Tac Toe World and have endless fun. Enjoy the colorful art style and challenging A.I. while enjoying this classic game.

title: Five Nights at Dream's​
description: An erotic survival game inspired by the classic Five Nights at Freddy’s formula—where tension, fear, and raw lust intertwine in a nightmarishly seductive setting.

title: Robot Mil
description: Robot Mil is a hardcore platformer with a variety of locations and their own unique obstacles. It's time to test your nerves. Good luck!

title: Aye Leon
description: Glide your way to victory in this enchanting 2D platformer. Master your jetpack’s smooth glide through colorful, floating worlds packed with collectables. A full playthrough takes around 20 minutes, perfect for a quick burst of platforming adventure.

title: The Llama
description: Experience a lovely day out walking the beautiful British countryside with your new animal friend Rosie, the llama! Soak in the stunning views of Mortfordshire and relax in the serene peace of nature. Just be sure to stick to the trails and not wander off too far.

title: MoonLost
description:
A cozy, fascinating and thoughtful adventure in the shoes of a young Wizard at the beginning of his journey as an aspiring expert Wizard.
You'll learn the basics of the Magical Arts, Meditation and study of the Ancient Texts. Will you be able to make your way through the pitfalls of this reality and discover its secrets?

title: Princess Lover!
description: Princess Lover! is a visual novel blending romance, drama, and character-driven choices. Players follow a young protagonist drawn into noble society, building relationships with multiple heroines through dialogue choices, branching routes, and emotionally charged scenes that shape different endings.

title: Relirium: Iseki to Deai to Bouken to
description: Whirlpool's 20th anniversary and final project.

title: Hovertron
description: Hoverboard your way through a physics-based platformer. Easy to learn but hard to master; Flow and flip through a series of levels to chase perfect runs. Compete on a global scoreboard, or hunt down the secrets hidden throughout the game.

title: Reigns: The Witcher
description: Adventure as Geralt through the ballads of Dandelion. Swipe right, swipe left, seek glory, find death! Will you hunt monsters, upset the locals, or run a hot bath? Compose an inspiring epic to claim immortality.

title: Suika Monsters
description:
Embark on this addictive adventure inspired by the Suika Game style, where you combine different Monsters to unlock new and surprising evolutions!
A perfect game to rack up points, challenge yourself, and enjoy each new transformation of these creatures.

There are 11 unique Monsters, each with its own charm and personality!

All of this wrapped in a Sewer and Monster theme, featuring a hand-drawn cartoon art style that brings even more life and character to the game.

title: Echoes of Agony
description: A dark turn-based roguelite where you are hunted by your own inner demons. Master the dynamic turn economy, collect loot and push your limits. The more you suffer, the greater the rewards. How much are you willing to endure in the pursuit of power?

title: After the Wane
description: Retracing the footsteps of a mother she never knew, Lena's trying to make it as a dancer in the city. Caught in a quarrel between dance companies, dealing with love and heartbreak and the challenges of young adulthood, she must also cope with the voice in her head commenting on everything she does.

title: Gotogra
description: Gotogra is a tactical roguelike deckbuilder where positioning shapes the battlefield. Choose a weapon for each run and master its unique deck, playstyle, and mechanics. Ascend the dungeons of a cursed castle and uncover the dark veil that overshadows the realm.

title: Sealbreakers
description: A top-down 3D roguelite brawler where a disgraced warrior fights immortal tyrants in a collapsing reality. Break the world back with nothing but fists.

title: Void Light
description: Survive. Endure. Repeat. Avoid creatures and survive as long as possible across various star systems.

title: Every Wednesday
description: When Hideki steps inside for the first time, he does not yet realize that this is where he will finally stop feeling invisible after a long time. Meet new friends alongside him, uncover their stories, and support them through life’s challenges. They might even help you rewrite your own story …

title: Rail Estate
description: Outbid your rivals in auctions for key railway routes, then build and upgrade tracks to dominate the rail economy. Players compete to create the most profitable network, balancing speed, capacity, and maintenance in a dynamic simulation

title: Cambell’s Oddity Box
description: Cambell’s Oddity Box is a collection of fun little experiences. Games, experimental input methods, menu designs, and more. Think of it as an interactive, digital sketchbook.

title: Angel Engine
description: Cage an angel. Ransack Heaven. In a far-flung dystopian future, the Angel Engine Initiative carries on as the last hope for humanity. Seal yourself in your operating room, perform surgery on comatose test subjects, and pray you make it out alive.

title: Forza Horizon 5: VIP
description: Forza Horizon 5 VIP Membership features exclusive rewards that give your game a boost and make you stand out at the Horizon Festival. VIPs receive 3 Exclusive Forza Edition cars, Crown Flair, Vanity Items, Emote and Car Horn, gift Player House, 2x Credit race rewards, weekly bonus Super Wheelspins, and more.

title: Ren & Stimpy Happy, Happy, Joy, Joy Collection
description:
Ren & Stimpy are back!

Ren & Stimpy Happy, Happy, Joy, Joy Collection includes:

The Ren and Stimpy Show: Space Cadet Adventures (portable)
The Ren and Stimpy Show: Veediots! (16-bit/portable)
The Ren and Stimpy Show: Buckeroo$! (8-bit / 16-bit)
The Ren and Stimpy Show: Time Warp (16-bit)
The Ren and Stimpy Show: Fire Dogs (16-bit)

Key Features

Rewind, save everywhere, and other quality of life upgrades! Music player featuring the soundtracks from each game. Museum featuring artwork and classic packaging scans.

title: MLB The Show 26
description:
Step up and take control of how you leave your mark in the most immersive MLB The Show yet.

Discover improved Road To The Show mechanics, deeper Franchise experiences, thrilling Diamond Dynasty modes, enhanced customization options, and true-to-life on-field action.

title: Callus
description: Callus is a short psychological horror walking simulator about cruelty and overprotection.

title: Surreality Check
description: A absurdist, psychological choose your own adventure, Surreality check has the player helping Rowan Roach discover the meaning of his life through therapy sessions with the Universe personified. The Universe being a massive tool doesn't help matters.

title: Wrath of the Arcane Realms
description: Wrath of the Arcane Realms is a hexagon-based, turn-based roguelike strategy game. Assemble a party of 3 from 6 heroes, chart your path across the realms, and craft your own synergies by drafting unique skills. There is no "correct" way to save the Arcane Realms. Don't seek the solution—define it!

title: Silent Still III
description: Silent Still 3 is a first-person psychological horror game that plunges you into a haunting world where the mind becomes the ultimate prison. Caught in the fragile space between consciousness and dreams, every shadow and sound twists reality, leaving you paralyzed with fear. This is a horror that lingers in silence, a tension that builds not from sudden shocks, but from the helplessness of being trapped within your own mind.

title: Wukong Survivors: Begin
description: Rougelite + Russian Roulette, but using a more powerful cannon. Survive and take all the prizes!

title: Hearthstone: Madness at the Darkmoon Faire
description:
Madness at the Darkmoon Faire is Hearthstone's sixteenth expansion, featuring 135 new collectible cards. The expansion was released on November 17th, 2020. This expansion takes place on the mysterious Darkmoon Island, on the fairgrounds run by Silas Darkmoon and his carnies... with four sinister guests from the depths of the Void.

This expansion adds the new Corrupt keyword, which powers up corruptible cards in your hand by playing a card that's more expensive than it. It also features the return of the Old Gods Yogg-Saron, C'Thun, Y'Shaarj and N'Zoth (the latter of which is also now a new Hero).

title: Hearthstone: Fractured in Alterac Valley
description:
Fractured in Alterac Valley is Hearthstone's 19th expansion, featuring new 135 collectible cards released on December 7, 2021. Set in Alterac Valley, the expansion depicts the epic battle between the Alliance and the Horde and concludes the story of 10 mercenaries, who decided to join the battle for honor and shards of a fallen naaru.

Fractured in Alterac Valley features again 10 mercenaries, this time max leveled as hero cards, a new keyword Honorable Kill which triggers its bonus effect when the card deals exact lethal damage to the target on their owner's turn, and Objective spells which have an ongoing effect lasting for 3 turns.

title: The Saint
description: The Saint" is a first-person psychological horror set in eerie liminal spaces with VHS body cam visuals. Explore a decaying dreamworld, solve symbolic puzzles, and escape a nightmare inspired by the dread and mystery of Silent Hill.

title: Helyana
description: A neo-gothic manga action RPG where your choices shape your enemies. Powerful bosses aren’t always foes. Get on their wrong side and they’ll hunt you, understand them and they may stand beside you. Fight through a ruined world with skill-driven combat where every decision has weight.

title: Hearthstone: Voyage to the Sunken City
description:
Voyage to the Sunken City is Hearthstone's 20th expansion, featuring new 135 collectible cards released on April 12, 2022. The expansion depicts an underwater expedition down to the ancient city of Zin-Azshari led by Ambassador Faelin, who hired Sir Finley and Ini Stormcoil to aid him to return to his former home for personal purposes.

Voyage to the Sunken City features 2 new keywords, Colossal and Dredge, a new permanent minion type Naga, as well as bunch of cards with deck manipulation mechanic to take advantage of the keyword Dredge.

title: Hearthstone: Murder at Castle Nathria
description:
Murder at Castle Nathria is Hearthstone's 21st expansion, featuring new 135 collectible cards released on August 2, 2022. The expansion depicts a dinner party in Castle Nathria hosted by Sire Denathrius, where he unexpectedly meets his end. Detective Murloc Holmes has been called to solve the case and determine which of the ten suspects committed the crime.

Murder at Castle Nathria features a new keyword - Infuse - which allows cards to get more powerful as friendly minions die. The expansion also introduces a brand new card type - Location. Locations are played onto the battlefield for an initial cost, and then have an ability that can be activated for free on your turns, each time for a powerful effect.

title: Tom Lander: The Exiled King
description: Pilot wacky aerial vehicles with silly key-based controls through an epic action packed campaign. Struggle to stay airborne while performing deliveries, rescues, firefighting missions, bombing runs, and chaotic dogfights. This game will remind you that flying is hard, but landing is harder.

title: Asterisk 2: Next Now a Day
description: "Asterisk 2: Next Now a Day" is a JRPG created with RPGMaker that blends action elements. It features pixel art graphics, an engaging story, and immersive gameplay. The game offers stunning visuals, compelling characters, and a dynamic world designed to captivate players throughout.

title: Hearthstone: March of the Lich King
description:
March of the Lich King is Hearthstone's 22nd expansion, featuring new 145 collectible cards released on December 6, 2022. The expansion depicts the return of The Lich King, as he leads his Undead army to an all-out assault on the elven city of Silvermoon. The Blood Elves won’t go down easily; they are as thirsty for combat as they are for the magic of the Sunwell that they draw power from.

March of the Lich King introduces Hearthstone's 11th total and second-ever new class, the Death Knight.

The expansion also introduces a brand new permanent minion type - Undead. Undead minions trigger bonus effects if a friendly Undead minion died after the player's last turn. In addition to that, March of the Lich King introduces dual minion types, meaning some minions can have two different minion types. Both Undead and dual minion types are retroactively added to all cards from the past.

Manathirst is March of the Lich King's new keyword. Cards with Manathirst get more powerful once the player reaches a specified amount of mana. Mana isn't required to be spent to power up the cards, but that much mana must be in the player's control. In addition to Manathirst, Reborn from Saviors of Uldum returns as a permanent keyword going forward, and can be seen on Undead minions in March of the Lich King.

title: Hearthstone: Festival of Legends
description:
Festival of Legends is Hearthstone's 23rd expansion, featuring new 145 collectible cards released on April 11, 2023. The expansion takes place in the Thousand Needles, where E.T.C., Band Manager is gathering the greatest musicians from all over Azeroth to put on the biggest music festival in history.

Festival of Legends introduces 2 new keywords: Finale, which allows cards to have bonus effects if playing them spends the rest of your mana, and Overheal, a new class-specific evergreen keyword for priests that allows minions to trigger special effects if they're healed above their max health.

title: Good Human
description: A psychological horror experience about a lonely mind haunted by guilt it can't escape.

title: Azure Archipelago
description: Azure Archipelago is a survival game with 2 core modes, story and sandbox. In sandbox play with modulators, mods, and or friends on servers or local multiplayer. If that doesn't interest you tackle the campaign in story mode to save your friends and company from a frosty fate.

title: El Mono
description: El Mono just as your great-great-great-great-great ancestors intended. It's high pace first-person arcade ape rage where the only limitation is your degenerated Homo sapien bloodline. Come home. Be the monkey they wanted you to be.

title: Barony: Deserters & Disciples
description: The Deserters & Disciples DLC is here to further add to the myriad ways you can approach Barony's deadly dungeons! This time we're bringing FIVE new races and classes, each introducing rich, fun, and unique mechanics to Barony for the first time.

title: Stream Arena RPG
description: Stream Arena RPG is a Twitch-Based RPG in which viewers gain persistent levels and equipment over different streams. Featuring different battle types, viewers must team up together in chat to achieve victory or highscores!

title: Feed Me Now!
description:
The human feeds you at scheduled times.
But You want to eat now.

title: Sugar Orbit
description: A platformer where you play a gummibear jumping between planets to rescue lost gummies, playable at your own pace but built for speedrunners and perfect runs.

title: Horror
description: Horror is a test of your logic in the face of primal fear. You are unarmed. You are vulnerable. All you have is a flashlight with a dying battery and your intellect.

title: Baby Lemonade
description: A non-linear surrealist adventure about a man trapped in his dreams while a company wants to buy them for broadcast. An immersive, open-ended exploration between psychedelic dreamlands and fragmented realities, where you can follow various bizzare objectives, find hidden paths, or try to wake up!

title: Villion:Code
description:
A new school RPG produced by Koji Okada.
Genome editing ushers in a "new era of life."
To live with the burden of karma. —Is there hope beyond that?

“0.0035%” is a mystery & horror game set in modern Japan. Players piece together fragmented clues and items to uncover hidden truths. No flashy action—only a shocking finale and deep, thought‑provoking exploration with multiple endings.

title: Deadlist
description: A psychological survival horror game where you explore a shifting, haunted forest, uncover rituals, and fight to escape before madness consumes you.

title: Hamam: The Steaming Backrooms
description: Step into Hamam — a haunting twist on the Backrooms formula. Tired of the endless yellow walls? Here, every corner is shrouded in steam, echoes, and terror. But beware: this is only the beginning... More chapters, chilling environments, and terrifying updates await with every release.

title: Backrooms: Don't Look Away
description: A terrifying multiplayer horror experience set in the Backrooms. Four survivors against player-controlled mannequins that can only move when nobody is watching!

title: Terminal Lucidity
description: In a concrete slab beneath the earth, a lone technician is sent for routine maintenance on a network of supercomputers. Each terminal operates on its own hidden rules, and the only way to escape is to learn how to speak their language. Crack the code, unlock the truth.

title: Aposis: Infinity Hero
description: A sci-fi roguelike RPG about an agent from the past awakened deep inside the Cradle, a colossal AI-controlled megacity.

title: Tiny Biomes: Cozy Idle
description: Tiny Biomes is a relaxing idle game where animals peacefully produce resources and you gather wood in a tranquil harvesting area. Build small biomes, earn gold, and enjoy steady progress without pressure, timers, or stress. Play at your own pace and unwind.

title: Total Chaos Against Apathy
description: A high-intensity action game, inspired by the feeling of emulating arcade-only action games. Learn a simple-yet-nuanced two button control scheme. Use hitstun, attack chains, grabbing and throwing to crush and control hordes of enemies! Tank controls are awesome!

title: Amer: The Chase Hit and Run
description: Ready to run the streets? In Amer Hit N Run, you’re dropped into an open world where you choose what happens next. Explore a map full of different neighborhoods that looks and plays better than ever on PlayStation with high-end graphics and smooth gameplay.

title: The Alighieri Circle: Dante’s Bloodline
description: The world knows the Divine Comedy as a poem. For your family, it is a prison. As Gabriele Alighieri, you inherit a duty: reseal the gates of Hell. Burdened by fate, you descend into a psychological nightmare where the only escape is to uncover the dark secrets of your ancestors.

title: Cowboys
description: Saddle up for a supernatural wild west adventure! Choose to play as Roland or Robin and investigate a mysterious desert mansion. Master 8-directional shooting as you battle outlaws and beasts through treacherous levels. Discover powerful weapon upgrades, but be warned - death means losing them all! Unravel a dark secret through story-driven cutscenes and face off against challenging bosses in this thrilling 2D side-scrolling shooter.

title: El Capitán Trueno: La Espada del Toledano
description:
Capitán Trueno and his inseparable friends, Goliath and Crispín, have to help Sigrid to recover La Espada del Toledano, symbol of power in the island of Thule. If they do not find the old sword in time, Sigrid's family will lose the control of Thule. Each of the protagonists will have to apply their best weapon in order to resolve the intrigue and follow the track of the sword from the coast of Granada to the icy Viking dungeons. Interrogating smart thieves, escaping from fierce herds of wolves, enrolling in a pirate ship, facing ruthless henchmen are some of the thousand and one adventures that our heroes will live to recover that old relic and presenting it in time in the centennial celebration of the Independence of Thule.

El Capitán Trueno: La Espada del Toledano is the second instalment of the exploits of Capitán Trueno in the world of graphic adventures, with more characters, more dialogues, more special effects, more animations and updated graphics.

title: Shadow Rush
description: Slay hordes of Shadow Demons in this Action RPG with roguelike elements. Fast-paced combat, quick runs, build experimentation, and re-rolling characters. Spells are collectable, equip-able 'Shards' that trigger when you attack. Can you beat the speed of darkness?

title: Rune Crystal: Adventure
description: Rune Crystal: Adventure is a colorful 2D platformer where you play as Joffren, a young adventurer armed with an ancient slingshot that awakens powerful Rune Crystals. Traverse dangerous ruins to activate hidden crystals, using precise run‑and‑gun platforming to dodge traps, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover secret paths.

title: Beautiful Sakura: Surfing Club 2
description:
After graduating high school, Kaito returns to his hometown for one final summer before stepping into adult life.
The ocean that once shaped his childhood memories now calls him back—and so do the two girls he once shared it with.

In Beautiful Sakura: Surfing Club 2, Kaito reunites with his former surfing partners and close friends, Michiko and Yuuki. Once inseparable, the three drifted apart after the events of the first game. Now older, more confident, and carrying new dreams, they decide to revive the Surfing Club for one last unforgettable season.

title: Keypybara
description:
In Keypybara, prepare for a classic 2D platforming experience with precise and responsive controls. You must navigate carefully handcrafted levels (each one a single, challenging "room") filled with deadly traps.

Your mission is clear: collect the key to unlock the exit. To do this, you will need to push boxes and dodge spikes. With instant respawn and 30 unique stages that progressively increase the challenge, the game offers an addictive, smooth, and rewarding gameplay loop with every obstacle overcome.

title: Typeoids
description:
Typeoids is a fast arcade-style typing game inspired by the classic Asteroids.
Wield your keyboard to protect yourself against the incoming asteroids threatening to crush your ship, and get performance statistics and track the progress in your typing journey.

title: Candy Luna Park
description: Harvest candy, build whimsical rides, and design your dream getaway in this cozy theme park builder. Relax as you expand your sugary world and watch your slice of paradise flourish. One attraction at a time!

title: Monster Train 2: Destiny of the Railforged
description:
This exciting new expansion for Monster Train 2 adds a new clan, new artifacts and enemies, and a brand new game mode.

The Railforged Clan
Once, they built the rail and the train itself, now they have taken up their hammers to join the fight! Lead the clan as Herzal, the blacksmith that built the Rail and the Boneshaker. Or lead as Heph, the blacksmith behind the Skullcrusher and the Covenant Outpost!

With their extensive engineering knowledge, utilize their unique Forge mechanic to build up units and equipment. Deploy an army of newly built train stewards, turrets, machines, and assemble equipment and units during combat to add to your army and fend off the enemy!

Soul Savior
Introducing a new type of run! Free powerful Souls from the clutches of the Lifemother and her twisted children who have been trapped within the Soulstream for untold ages. Souls are upgrades that can be equipped to cards and have a huge array of effects. The Lifemother is an unstoppable force of nature so you will need to level up your Souls to gain enough power to take on the challenges found in the Soulstream.

title: Lunar Mystery 2103
description: Lunar Mystery 2103 is a sci-fi puzzle-adventure game originally developed for the Game Boy Color. Explore the cold, mechanical corridors of C01, battling through the Colony's defensive drones, and something more sinister... Solve puzzles, defeat bosses, and unravel the mystery!

title: Sin Return
description: An obscure adventure begins in the Silent Kingdom, a land decaying under the spread of the Sin-fication plague. This dark fantasy turn-based RPG emphasizes exploration. Reclaim lost memories in this sinful land, defeat formidable foes, and piece together the truth behind the catastrophe.

title: LittleRunner
description: Become the ultimate runner in LittleRunner, a challenging 2D platformer! Leap off walls like a ninja, dodge deadly shurikens, and master tricky physics-based puzzles. Navigate through meticulously designed, extreme levels and experience the thrill of a narrow escape.

title: Your Cow
description:
This is the daily love life between "me" and the minotaur girl.

"Your Cow" is a youth love theme Galgame, the game type is a visual novel, players can read the plot text by clicking on the screen to display the dialogue

title: Enlil: Rise Of the End
description: In a stunning open world brimming with high-quality graphics, build your own walls, gates, and traps; gather valuable loot; choose one of five mighty spells to obliterate your foes; command your army—and in a deep, immersive narrative, bring an end to Anzu’s dark reign!

title: Deskworm
description: A tiny desktop worm pet that moves when you type, click, or play. Dress it up with hats and skins, park it in a pocket where its gaze follows your mouse, and let its Anti-Shrimp reminders nudge you to sit up and stretch.

title: Lost Trust: Episode 1
description: After years apart, you visit an old friend for what should’ve been a quiet evening. But you soon realize you’re not alone and a dark betrayal awaits .The game is a first-person, linear PSX-style experience focused on exploration and uncovering secrets.”

title: Maze Art: Red
description: Maze Art: Red - is a minimalist game of simple mazes with relaxing music.

title: WTC: The Manchester Report
description: Manchester, New Hampshire's late-night chat show host Chuck Sterling interviews two people.

title: Room Football: Sun Shrine
description: Puzzle, artillery, casual puzzle video game with realistic physics.

title: Phantom 3D
description: A haunted maze game.

title: Eternal Decay Souls
description: Explore dark places, enemies and traps on a journey of adventure and survival. Collect relics, activate portals and face the Dark Guardian in the last portal.

title: Sad Virus Shitcoin
description: Sad virus is back again. Now in futuristic space land virus must find crypto called shitcoins

title: WheelMates
description: Dive into a 2-player co-op driving adventure with RC cars. With Friend’s Pass, your friend joins for free. Explore the professor’s home laboratory, solve puzzles, find hidden paths, and uncover what happened inside.

title: Population Control
description: The first-ever tower defence with massive physical hordes. Survive the chaotic flow of 10,000+ squishy Jellings. Crack them with towers, physical powers, and broken combos.

title: Paul
description: Experience turn-based, casual combat that blends chess-like enemy prediction with dungeon crawling and exploration. Anticipate enemy patterns, plan your moves, and choose the optimal items to prevail. Descend from the depths of the Nautilus submarine into the petrified insides of an ancient giant.

title: Making Lovely
description: A romantic comedy where you play as a “love advisor” at the counselling office Making Lovely for a group of quirky, romantically challenged heroines. You, The protagonist becomes a “temporary boyfriend”. As you comment on their every move, you help them discover their true charms.

title: A Stupid Game About Pouring Drinks for the P.T.A.
description: The P.T.A. (Parent Teacher's Association) is planning the Summer Fete but they need money to hire everything. Selflessly serve drinks and upsell the heck out of them to gain funds. Dig deep! It's for a good cause, after all.

title: Wukong Survivors: God Slayer
description: Wukong Survivors" is a TPS + ROGUE game where players control Sun Wukong and his friends, sweeping through all visible enemies and rescuing their captured master.

title: Nyx Legacy
description: In Nyx: Legacy, you follow Lyn, the protective older sister, and Nyx, her reckless yet fearless younger sister. Together they fight for survival in a world where danger is everywhere.

title: Froojarspootz! The Cleaning Monster
description: Casual push-and-pull game, cleaning rooms as a hired monster from under the bed.

title: Dr. Moonlight's Happyworld
description:
Fight for your life against vampire fairies and Frankenstein's monsters in the world's most bloodthirsty game show!

One of the games included in 1999: Megallennium 6-in-1 Mega Cart.

title: Tommygun's Frag
description: Born from the hit Rust mod, Tommygun's Frag is a standalone FPS about momentum and domination. Start with a pistol, frag enemies, and race to unlock better weapons. A first-of-its-kind recoil visualization system shows your recoil as you fire, letting you outskill opponents.

title: Owlbears
description:
All Pibi wants to do is eat apples. Instead he must shoot endless waves of oozers, gremlins, and (of course) owlbears in a desperate struggle for survival.

One of the games included in 1999: Megallennium 6-in-1 Mega Cart.

title: QuickCalculation
description: Quick Calculations is a game based on the four operations of math made to test the player's reaction time and ability to quickly reverse calculations.

title: PicOHRoss
description:
Use computer-like logic to conquer fiendish puzzles! Can your soft human brain handle it? Probably not.

One of the games included in 1999: Megallennium 6-in-1 Mega Cart.

title: The Lone Hero
description:
The Lone Hero is an independent PC action game developed by a solo developer.
The game focuses on combat against enemies using three different abilities.
Players can earn in-game currency to unlock new playable characters.

title: Project_8
description: Project_8 is a first-person survival horror and investigation game developed by ZNT Productions. The player takes on the role of Edward Vonthorn, a young scientist, inventor, and traveler who infiltrates the corporation Archange Inc. to investigate suspicious activities, only to become trapped within its underground laboratories. As he struggles to survive, Edward must explore dangerous environments, confront unknown threats, and uncover the secrets behind experiments that have spiraled out of control. The narrative blends tension, investigation, and immersive horror, supported by atmospheric environments and voice acting designed to deepen player immersion.

title: Star Dartle 2000
description:
Lord Shiptaur beckons you to destroy them all. This scrolling shooter challenges your reflexes and counting abilities.

One of the games included in 1999: Megallennium 6-in-1 Mega Cart.

title: Ultra Frontier QQYYZZ
description:
Explore psycho space with your family of clones while dodging obstacles at mach speeds. This game is basically impossible.

One of the games included in 1999: Megallennium 6-in-1 Mega Cart.

title: A Forest
description: A game unlockable in 1999: Megallennium 6-in-1 Mega Cart.

title: Crypts of Carith
description: Explore the village of Carith, dank sewers, forgotten cellars, and ancient tombs, battle deadly creatures, and uncover powerful loot in this classic party-based dungeon crawling RPG built on a familiar D20 system.

title: Parables of the Set Apart: The Pursuit of Wisdom
description: Embark on the journey of the Set Apart One, a faithful warrior equipped with an arsenal of Weapons of Warfare and a divine array of Gifts. Guided by Wisdom, on a quest to battle the forces of darkness, topple the Adversary’s strongholds, and answer the call to be set apart.

title: Sandwich Quest
description: A short point-and-click adventure 20 years in the making. Made by two friends who had originally started working on it in their teens as a personal project but eventually abandoned it. Many years later they got back to it, remade the game from memory, and this time completed it.

title: Black Omens: House of Crimson Silk
description: Black Omens: House of Crimson Silk is a first-person, single-player, escape room puzzle horror game set in a fictional Edo Japan. Assume the role of Idate Chiyo, a paranormal investigator, tasked with investigating an abandoned mansion and unveiling a family's dark and horrifying secret.

title: Utawarerumono: Past and Present Rediscovered
description: Utawarerumono: Past and Present Rediscovered is a role-playing game developed by Aquaplus. It is a sequel to Monochrome Mobius: Rights and Wrongs Forgotten and takes place before the events of Utawarerumono: Mask of Deception. The story follows Oshtor and his allies after their return to Yamato, where new incidents and monster appearances begin to affect the empire. Unlike the main Utawarerumono visual novel/strategy entries, it uses turn-based combat in the style of Monochrome Mobius.

title: Super Astro Space Blast
description: Dodge asteroids attracted to your gravitational pull and use the profits generated from their collisions to unlock a variety of different spaceships with different abilities. Reach for High Scores to unlock unique skins for each ship.

title: Anbar
description: Anbar is a fast-paced multiplayer arena game where two teams clash with opposing goals. Explorers race to build an artifact while Mercenaries use a growing ball combo to disrupt them. Victory depends on speed, timing, and teamwork.

title: Don't Go Up There
description: Don’t Go Up There is a short game about exploring a cave system within an intimidating mountain, Schubert has to avoid shattering into a million pieces, make his way through twisting paths, and talk to various strangers who stand around in caves.

title: Log Riders
description: Join a fun adventure by rolling a log together! In this 2 player co-op platformer, become lumberjacks with your friend and keep your balance while moving forward on a log. Overcome obstacles by moving back and forth, reach the goal, and never give up. Knowing how to get back up matters.

title: Zelene Lux: Spirit Notes
description: Free the trapped souls of your friends from a haunted manor. Solve cryptic riddles, find hidden objects, and restore a sanctuary to banish the cult of Magister Vane!

title: Noneday
description: Grab your notebook and get ready to explore every nook and cranny of the surreal, esoteric adventure game Noneday! Search dreams for clues, solve puzzles, and unlock the secrets hiding within Bow’s own mind.

title: Urban Myth.exe
description: Escape from the terrifying urban myth and strive for survival. Immerse yourself in a heart-pounding and nail-biting escape in this first-person survival horror game.

title: The House on the Hill
description: First-person horror exploration game! You've just moved to a new rural town and you've been tasked with babysitting the neighbor kid. Only, things in this town seem strange. Explore the world and solve the secrets of your neighborhood while still being a half-decent babysitter.

title: Blood Permafrost
description: Suddenly alone in a snowstorm, a camper is haunted by strange visions. A short, cinematic, mind-bending psychological horror nightmare. Beware the rifleman.

title: Calon Arang Nightmare of Revenge
description: A narrative-driven horror game inspired by the Indonesian legend of Calon Arang. Explore cursed locations, uncover dark rituals, and survive psychological terror filled with jump scares, traps, and relentless enemies.

title: Loop the Loop: The Mansion of Gluttony
description: A closed-circle mystery visual novel where twelve people wake up inside a bizarre, impossible mansion—and a string of murders begins. Read from Remi's point of view as you piece together the truth through his thoughts and conversations. Linear, text-focused, Japanese/English supported.

title: Never Ending Corridor
description: A First-person horror game with multiple endings. Endings and Events might change Every time you Replay it.

title: Queen Anne's Lace
description: An anomaly horror game with a big twist: YOU hide the anomalies. As the Night Auditor for the Queen Anne's Lace hotel, your job is to keep your guests checked in. Forever.

title: Guildamation
description: Guildamation is an Idle AutoBattling RPG that let's you build an automate a guild.

title: Camp Buddy: Scoutmaster Season – Side Stories
description:
Camp Buddy: Scoutmaster Season - Side Stories is BLits Games' first-ever DLC, featuring six alternate scenarios with several of the game's supporting cast - including Hyunjin Choi, Lloyd Sirius, Darius Najjar and fan-favorite, Naoto Hamasaki!

Play through the game's main storyline to encounter these special scenarios in place of the normal scenes you might encounter throughout the game. Whether it's hitting the gym with Lloyd and Darius, soaking in the sauna with Naoto, or living out your fantasies with Hyunjin, these are spicy scenarios you don't want to miss!

title: Whodunnit
description:
WHODUNNIT is a comedic mystery visual novel following a man who must answer a burning question: who the hell did he hook up with last night?

Conduct investigations through point-and-click mechanics, interrogate a large cast of characters, and cobble together theories as "regular guy" Howie Falk chases down the ghost of his own gay virginity.

title: Vampir
description: The MMORPG for vampires.

title: River City Saga: Journey to the West
description: River City Saga: Journey to the West is a roguelike action brawler that reimagines the classic Chinese novel with River City characters, casting Kunio as Sun Wukong and other familiar faces as legendary figures. In the turbulent Tang Dynasty, you embark on a pilgrimage to retrieve Buddhist scriptures, fighting through waves of demons and bosses with intuitive, satisfying combat. Every run features different layouts, enemies, and skills, encouraging repeated playthroughs as you grow stronger with each attempt.

title: El Cerro Del Calamar
description: El Cerro Del Calamar is a Squid Game fangame.

title: Pikmin 2D
description: A 2D Pikmin fangame made in 24 hours.

title: Five Nights at Grasos's
description: Five Nights at Momos, also called Five Nights at Grasos's, is a FNAF fangame based on memes.

title: Rodent Company
description:
In this fast-paced action roguelike, play as the Rodent Company, a ragtag team of mice, rats, hamsters, guinea pigs, and others, trying to save their kind from going hungry in the coming winter. Competing factions like pirate roaches, raccoon gangs, heathen lizards, and others stand in your way. Defeat them, loot them, and search for abundant lands and treasures beyond!

In solo or co-op (up to 4 players), use powerful weapons and special, rodent-based, abilities to mow down deadly pest hordes, defeat epic bosses, and make your way to the bountiful lands beyond the borders of your lands.

Build Your Arsenal and Wipe Out Pests!
Wield randomly-generated weapons with different add-on modules like scopes, stocks, under-barrel attachments and magazines with MILLIONS of possible combinations. Find new weapons in chests, loot them from your enemies, or buy them from shops!

Play with friends!
Rodent Company is best experienced with friends! Featuring local co-op up to 4 players, arenas are designed for player counts individually so difficulty doesn't simply scale enemy health and damage - it adjusts battle size too!

title: Tower Shield
description: A shooting game where you play as a tank protecting the Twin Towers from a barrage of airplanes.

title: Washington Prime
description: Step into the shoes of former special agent turned real estate agent Blake Kincaid, dragged back into the game to save a friend. Fight your way through office buildings in downtown Washington D.C., October 1998, and uncover what happened over the course of one long night.

title: Pat Pat Cat
description: Pat your cat, gather endless love, and unlock accessories! Use them to create playful outfits and charming backgrounds! Relax and enjoy caring for your little kitty!

title: Desk Dino
description: Some naughty pixel dinos run around on your computer desktop, being some good accompany while you're working, studying or relaxing. Feed them or play with them, it's on your mark. Don't worry, they won't bite. Enjoy your dino.

title: Where's My Egg?
description: Where’s my egg? A poor chicken dad has sadly lost his eggs. Help him find 62 strange eggs and bring them back.

title: Out of Sight: Stage Fright
description: Uncover the story of a tormented Unseen, a spirit child who reaches out to Sophie for help with their final performance. Together with Teddy, they reveal new perspectives, a chilling history, and a need to overcome their greatest fears.

title: Lost My Collection of Fish
description: Lost my Collection of Fish is a Casual 2D Hidden Object Game with a cute, stylized and relaxing aesthetic.

title: Steel Swarm: Survivor
description: Steel Swarm: Survivor is a fast-paced roguelite survivors game where you obliterate swarms with your drones. Set up formations, upgrade your drones, and overwhelm hordes of metal in each run. Take on enemy waves solo or in multiplayer co-op!

title: The Billion Clicker
description: Could you reach the billion? Idle clicker game with simple goals but very addictive gameplay

title: Idle Game x100
description: Idle game for those who tired of boring and infinite idle games

title: Miner Clicker
description: Miner Clicker is a short idle indie game where you have to click to mine. Click to gather resources, reach new depths, and buy upgrades to dig faster and deeper! Who knows what you might find at the bottom of the mine!

title: Connect Far Away Tale
description: Leap to evade!! Action game!!

title: Village of the Curse
description: Uncover the secrets of an abandoned cursed village. Explore haunted locations, face twisted entities, and perform the final ritual to decide your fate.

title: Haunted Service
description: A chilling psychological horror experience. Alone at home, you receive a cryptic message: "Congratulations! You got a haunted service." What starts as a prank quickly turns into a terrifying night as sinister events unfold. Will you survive until your parents return?

title: Bashers
description: Gather items and kill endless waves of enemies! Level-up, unlock characters with different abilities, powerups, items and locations!

title: Huntdown: Overtime
description: Corporations turned crime-infested streets into profit margins for bounty hunters and John Sawyer is going to make a killing. Hunt, die, upgrade, repeat in this explosive roguelite prequel where every strategic upgrade strips away more flesh and builds a cybernetic fighter one chrome limb at a time.

title: Legionbound
description: Turn a handful of heroes into a massive legion! Legionbound is a casual retro RPG autobattler where you recruit heroes, discover class synergies, forge powerful Ascensions, and battle through hordes of enemies across replayable roguelite runs.

title: Remnants of a Scare
description: Remnants of a Scare is a first-person horror game that protagonizes the player and puts them in a surreal exploratory experience. Relive this loneliness to your heart's content.

title: AGX GP
description: AGX is a heart thumpingly fast, Anti-Gravity racing game. It's lightning‑fast action and Xtreme ability‑based gameplay, will push your reactions and skills to the limit! Welcome To AGX!

title: Garfield Kart 2: All You Can Drift - Garfing Cosmeowtics
description: Get ready to make a splash on the track with Garfing Cosmeowtics! Customize your style with 3 new hats and a rainbow of 8 colors for your vehicle.

title: Gebinden
description: Minimalist Grid-Movement Puzzle Game

title: The Most Difficult Ball Game
description: Getting Over It — but with a ball.

title: The Remains and The Residue
description: The Remains and The Residue is a story-based linear adventure game where you play the stories and the memories of the famous author Janus Brennhart.

title: Salve a Fantasia
description: Salve a Fantasia is a single‑player strategy RPG with exploration and turn‑based combat that blends Active Time Battle (ATB) mechanics and a dynamic agility‑based turn order. Players customize classes freely, build parties, and tackle tactical encounters and boss fights across a 2D medieval fantasy world.

title: Kingdoms Hegemony
description: Reinterpreted a passionate and turbulent world of the Three Kingdoms!

title: Banished Knight
description: The 'Banished Knight' is a 3D top-down action Roguelike game. The story takes place after Ragnarok, where the player, as a heroic knight, must travel to Svartalfheim to battle various types of monsters, collect resources, unlock new weapons,and repair the Valkyrie statue.

title: Echoes of Baikal
description: A journey with your father to Lake Baikal, where a storm and an old photo album revive memories of family, loss, and reconciliation.

title: Flat Galaxy: An Idlemare
description: Flat Galaxy: An Idlemare is a one-button arcade experience set in a surreal sci-fi training simulation. Precision and strategy are key as you guide a robot through six challenging levels, backed by an original soundtrack with live guitars.

title: Lost My Collection of Fish 2
description: Lost my Collection of Fish 2 is a Casual 2D Hidden Object Game with a cute, stylized and relaxing aesthetic.

title: Gorilla Unko
description: A game, keep avoiding the gorilla's UNKO. Avoid as much UNKO as you can. Compete your high score in online rankings.

title: GrimmVeil
description: A dark fantasy multiplayer adventure with one unyielding story. Face Orion Grimm’s creations, complete relentless quests, and survive the shadows together.

title: Coconut CEO Idle
description: Build a coconut empire in this short incremental game! Gather coconuts, hire workers, and buy upgrades to transform your coconut startup into a coconut empire!

title: Tiny Friends Desktop Pet
description: Tiny Friends is an adorable, customizable desktop companion that brings your screen to life with fun interactions and playful charm.Play, interact, and make your screen more fun than ever!

title: Vellum: Raid Night Study Hall
description: Brush up on your fighting mechanics with Raid Night Study Hall - your worry-free guide to boss fights! Learn, practice, and don't stand in the fire! You will be prepared!

title: Doomed Dwarves
description: Doomed Dwarves is an auto battler where you choose 7 dwarves to fight against hordes of enemies. Create a unique group of dwarves, and choose from a variety of upgrades and items to help them survive as long as possible.

title: The Archive
description: Welcome to the Case Processing Unit. Classify forgotten reports, uncover hidden patterns, and discover why this backlog exists, and why you were brought in to handle it.

title: Your Canvas
description: Your Canvas is a Text-Based Psychological Horror game set during three therapy sessions with different time periods where the player will be presented with various choices for deciding the outcome of the story.

title: Insurrectionist
description: Insurrectionist is a Story-Rich RPG where you control Mia, a mercenary forced to survive in a dystopian, hateful world. On one rainy night, she stumbles upon Marcus, a strange man with a case of amnesia. Explore the world together and search for clues about his identity while fighting deadly foes.

title: Predator: Hunting Grounds - Jotun Predator
description: Viewed by his own clan as a bloodthirsty aberration, the Jotun Predator lives for the sheer thrill of the kill rather than the honor of the hunt. He is defined by his brutality and savagery.

title: Balseo: The Sea Beyond
description: BALSEO: The Sea Beyond is a stealth-action roguelite. Upon death, begin your voyage into the beyond. Traverse an ever-changing archipelago, master new skills, and choose wisely whether to face or flee from danger in the mystical southern fog.

title: Pocket Lint Zero
description: Play for free! A deceptively hard little game of deduction. I’m now thinking of a specific combination of pocket items. If I give you hints about what you’ve got wrong, can you guess it in as few guesses as possible?

title: Wasteland Orchard
description: A Survival-Farming-Roguelite Game with Idle elements

title: Rick's Konbini
description: 5 days until the apocalypse... and you finally got a j*b!! The chronically ill rabbit "Rick" Was given an ultimatum by his roommate to get a j*b or get out!! So he puts on his "best" smelling suit and gets to work!

title: Obscure Figures
description: It is a psychological horror game and walking simulator. Only half of the rooms are safe. When you enter an unsafe room, you must leave immediately. Ghosts can be dispelled with a flute or a guitar.

title: Drowned Grave
description: It is a psychological horror game and walking simulator. Get chased by monsters. Monsters jumping towards at your screen.

title: Cursed Toy
description: It is a psychological horror game and walking simulator. Monsters jumping towards at your screen. Do housework. You get haunted by a monsters.

title: Echowood
description: Relax and enjoy the tranquility of Echowood, an adventure farming simulator. The game takes place in a world where humanity has been displaced by nature. Humans have harmed nature too much, and for that, nature has destroyed them. Since then, the world has become calm and peaceful.

title: Kwartikum
description: An atmospheric puzzle adventure about guiding a lone figure through a strange land, discovering new ways to solve box based challenges.

title: Broom Broom
description: Grab your broom, fly over to people in need and brew them potions after a catastrophic snowstorm has hit your village! Talk to your lovely (but mostly grumpy) neighbours as you find your place in this short and cozy adventure.

title: Genigods: Nezha
description: Genigods: Nezha is an ARPG rooted in the chaos of ancient Chinese creation mythology. Play as Spirit Pearl, the first being forged by the Goddess of Creation Nüwa. Dive into iconic Chinese genesis tales, battle Colossal Gods, and experience the unique combat of Chinese-style celestial showdowns.

title: Athar: Echoes of Time
description: Build your deck from legendary scholars, fearless warriors and powerful voices. Follow their footsteps and Forge your path to victory in Athar: the Islamic history strategy game.

title: Kazuma Kaneko's Tsukuyomi
description: Ancient myths awaken in a modern-day Babel. A tactical deck-building tower dungeon RPG from the legendary Demon Artist, Kazuma Kaneko.

title: Snow Bros. Classic Collection
description:
It’s always more fun to throw a snowball than to be hit by one!

Toaplan‘s hit Snow Bros. is back! This arcade-style, fixed-screen platformer follows brothers Nick and Tom through epic levels in the Kingdom of Hottoda to save two trapped princesses, each possessing the magic of snow… and the only hope for the realm. As evil King Atchich seeks to take over the world, the snowmen we love must set out to storm the enemy’s fortress and rescue their princesses!

Shoot snow at your enemies, picking up items to enhance your fighting, from speed enhancements to shot powerups, becoming giant, and more. Each level features not only enemies but a boss fight, with unique characters to size up and snowball!

Whether you have loved them since the 90s or are just discovering the snowy goodness now, Snow Bros. will show you exactly why it’s such a timeless game.

title: Tank Mechanic Simulator: Shermans DLC
description:
Dear mechanics! Get ready for an exciting new DLC that adds 5 new USA tanks from World War II to the base game. We are continuing our goals that we set to ourselves on improving the quality of workmanship.

The DLC includes iconic tanks such as the M4A1 Sherman (Early production), M4 Sherman (Mid production), M4A2 Sherman (Late production), M4A3E2 Sherman Jumbo, and T34 Calliope. These tanks come equipped with new engines, including the Wright Continental R-975-C1, General Motors 6046, and Ford GAA, adding to the authenticity and realism of the game. Additionally, the DLC introduces a new gearbox, the Spicer Synchro Mesh Gearbox, which can be used for all these tanks. Each of the vehicles has been painstakingly recreated on the basis of the collected technical documentation. The interiors have been nicely detailed with radios, dashboards and more removable parts.

Prepare to immerse yourself in the excitement of United States Army's World War II tanks with these new additions to Tank Mechanic Simulator. Whether you're a history buff or just love the thrill of renovating powerful tanks, this DLC is not to be missed.
▶ M4A1 Sherman (Early production)
The M4A1 Sherman (Early production) was a crucial tank used by the United States during World War II. It was a medium-sized tank that was highly versatile and adaptable to different terrains and combat situations. It had a crew of five and was equipped with a 75mm main gun, as well as a .50 caliber machine gun and two .30 caliber machine guns. Its armor was thick enough to withstand small arms fire and shrapnel.

▶ M4 Sherman (Mid production)
An iconic tank from World War II that played a crucial role in the United States' military campaigns. This medium-sized tank was equipped with a 75mm main gun and two .30 caliber machine guns, making it a formidable opponent on the battlefield. Its thick armor and mobility allowed it to traverse various terrains and combat situations with ease. The M4 Sherman (Mid production) was widely used throughout the war and was praised for its reliability and versatility.

▶ M4A2 Sherman (Late production)
A powerful tank used by the United States during World War II. Equipped with a 75mm main gun and two .30 caliber machine guns, this tank was designed for combat and proved to be a formidable opponent on the battlefield. Its improved diesel engine and thicker armor provided superior mobility and protection, allowing it to traverse various terrains and withstand enemy fire. The M4A2 Sherman (Late production) saw action in many significant battles and was highly praised for its performance and durability.

▶ M4A3E2 Sherman Jumbo
A heavy tank used by the United States during World War II. This tank was designed to provide additional protection for its crew with its thick armor and improved gun mantlet. It was equipped with a 75mm main gun. “Cobra King” was the first tank to enter the Bastogne perimeter in relief of the besieged American 101st Airborne Division.

▶ T34 Calliope
Introducing the Calliope, an American rocket launcher tank used during World War II. This unique tank was equipped with a barrage of 4.5 inch rockets mounted on its turret, allowing it to rain down explosive firepower on enemy positions. The T34 Calliope proved to be a devastating force on the battlefield, capable of quickly neutralizing enemy defenses and providing vital support for ground troops.

▶ Second Supply “Shermans” DLC includes 5 vehicles:
M4A1 Sherman (Early production)
M4 Sherman (Mid production)
M4A2 Sherman (Late production)
M4A3E2 Jumbo
T34 Calliope
▶ New engines:
Wright Continental R-975-C1 (Early, Mid, Calliope)
General Motors 6046 (Late)
Ford GAA (Jumbo)
▶ New gearboxes:
Spicer Synchro Mesh Gearbox

title: Tank Mechanic Simulator: First Supply DLC
description:
At the beginning of the work on the new vehicles, we set ourselves a goal of improving the quality of workmanship. Each of the vehicles has been painstakingly recreated on the basis of the collected technical documentation. The interiors have been improved, we have added more details such as radio stations, cables, and more removable parts.

BT-7 (Early 1935)
Soviet light tank produced between 1932 and 1941 and served during the early stages of World War II. Well known for its ability to remove continuous track and change to the wheeled mode which enabled it to travel at high speed on roads.

M18 Hellcat
The fastest and most effective US tank destroyer. It served during World War II. It was perfectly suited for ambushes and quick rushes against the enemy. On a favorable road surface it could reach a speed of up to 89km/h

IS-2
Soviet heavy tank firstly used in early 1944. Its 122mm gun was easily destroying the armor of the iconic German Tiger tanks. By the end of the war, 2,400 of them had been produced.

Churchill Mk III AVRE
Used to protect the engineers on the battlefield. Served during the invasion of Normandy. Firing with spigot mortar, could be additionally equipped with plowshares, a small box grider bridge, or fascines. Its goal was to pave the way for following forces and destroying bunkers.

PzKpfw VI Ausf. B Tiger II (H) “King Tiger”
The successor of the Tiger I. The largest and heaviest tank used in World War II. It weighed up to 70 tons and its length reached over 10 meters with the cannon pointed forward. He served in the final phase of World War II.

First Supply DLC includes 5 vehicles:
BT-7 (Early 1935)
M18 Hellcat
IS-2
Churchill Mk III AVRE
PzKpfw VI Ausf. B Tiger II (H) “King Tiger”

Spring teaches the basics (and introduces muddy mayhem).
Summer brings spinning sheep and bigger levels.
Winter adds teleporters and brain-twisting puzzles!

With easy controls, instant undo, and quick restarts, you can try out all your ideas without any pressure.

title: Bard’s Fault
description: Bard’s Fault is a co-op Action Roguelike where you and your friends fight back-to-back against relentless swarms. Craft new builds, sync your abilities, and break the timeline in this multiplayer bullet heaven. Death is just the beginning, go back to the past and unravel a time-travel mystery.

title: Zombie Emperor
description: A top-down zombie slaughter defense adventure game. Players use skills, talent trees, unique weapons, and weapon upgrades to hold the ultimate defensive line, frantically clearing wave after wave of rotting undead under the blood moon curse. From ordinary Qin soldiers to immortal war gods.

title: Nocan's Quest: Sex Gold Glory
description: An erotic JRPG adventure in the primal wastelands. Barbarian Nocan unleashes sexual demonesses seeking to enslave the world. He fights back by exploring ancient ruins, uncovering lost lore, collecting artifacts, earning gold, and fighting turn-based battles.

title: Bunny Flags 2
description: Subtle mix of shooting and tower defense game, help a rabbit armed to the teeth to protect his flags by repelling successive waves of enemies that will try to take them. By earning experience, you will unlock new abilities as well as various towers to position on the field to secure a larger area. Bunny Flags 2 offers a fast-paced action, many unlockable upgrades and a talent tree, and well-designed missions that make this game very exciting.

title: Freddy's: Reanimated
description: It’s been a decade since Freddy’s closed its doors. Here you are, at that damned establishment. The halls are never empty here. On this cold night you ask yourself; were the grisly rumors true?

title: A Game About Boxes
description: "Boxes are the most wonderful things ever! Truly they are, didn’t you know?" A Game About Boxes is a quirky little adventure that shifts from minimalist aesthetics to uncanny atmospheres, all while you jump around, summon boxes, and slowly learn to love them. :) or else <3

title: Brazzante
description: Featuring a unique doodle aesthetic, this world is entirely hand-drawn. Your goal? Use classic 'Rock, Paper, Scissors' mechanics to survive never-ending rounds.

title: Webscape
description: Webscape is a surreal narrative RPG set inside a deteriorating version of the 1990s internet. Trapped within the World Wide Web, you will make choices, form alliances, and fight your way toward escape through turn-based battles driven by playable micro-games.

title: Bumpers & Dragons
description: Drop balls. Slay dragons. Peggle meets Balatro in a pachinko roguelite where physics meets strategy. Engineer your luck and push deep into procedurally generated dungeons.

title: Covenant of Fate
description: Covenant of Fate is a story driven Chinese horror RPG. Players experience the game through the protagonist’s perspective, taking on various exorcism requests from different clients. During exploration, you may uncover clues that point toward the hidden truth.

title: Lovelace Case
description: Lovelace Case is a Retro Lovecraftian Survival Horror set in the 1900s. Explore the nightmarish Mansion, manage scarce resources and face eldritch terrors where survival means choosing what parts of reality you are willing to lose.

title: Spiredelve
description: Explore the ruins of a great and mysterious tower, shrouded in days and worlds long forgotten in a Doom-inspired FPS classic boomer shooter. Turn adversaries to advantages, and pilfer the coffers of the Editors into scions of wanton killing and discover the secrets that lay beneath the spire.

title: Bargalian Regicide
description: Bargalian Regicide is a stylized fantasy game about a disgraced prince in servitude of an ancient being. Cut through hundreds of soldiers to bring about change in a crumbling empire.

title: World War Z x The Walking Dead
description: A new crossover episode with AMC's The Walking Dead. Battle for survival against the undead as Rick Grimes, Daryl Dixon, Michonne, and Negan in three unique story chapters featuring iconic locations from The Walking Dead. Fight through hordes of dangerous new, slower-moving but no less lethal Walkers across The Prison, Alexandria Safe Zone, and Grady Memorial Hospital with two new melee weapons (Negan’s Bat Lucille and Michonne's Katana), and two new weapon skins (Rick's Revolver and Daryl's Crossbow). But be wary of the new special Zeke: the dreaded Spiked Walker.

title: It Can't Be That Hard, Can it?
description: Follow Amora as they venture through four levels that may or may not be a little difficult!

title: Fulgor: I Hate, Therefore I Am
description: Slay your lover, so that the god of Hatred may be reborn. Romance the invading soldier or the fearsome monster in this mythology-inspired visual novel set in ancient times. Will you return Hatred to your people, or will you be conquered and forgotten?

title: String Zero
description:
String Zero is a linear/kinetic, cyberpunk, and 18+ gay-oriented Furry Visual Novel currently in development.

Set in a future century, in another solar system, String Zero will touch on topics typical of the cyberpunk tradition including: dystopian corporatocracy and class, cultural/international politics, and transhumanism/transformation. It will also includes elements of cyberfantasy and broader science fiction.

title: Noroi no Yakata
description:
This is a homemade game created using the game creation tool "Click & Create." It was released on the Japanese file-sharing site Vector in 1996 and was also featured in the computer magazine "TECH Win" at the time.

The creators are "Sankaku Onigiri & Tomo-chan." Apparently, it was co-created with the author's third-grade son.
