The game was eventually deleted from Vector and seemingly forgotten, until 2008, when someone accidentally discovered the game's data and posted a gameplay video on Nico Nico Douga. The game's strange gameplay and music, as well as the protagonist's bizarre behavior upon death, became a huge hit among a small group of people, and at the author's request, it was re-released on Vector.

title: Campfire: Night One
description: Experience True Survival Horror Campfire: Night One is an immersive psychological horror game where every shadow hides a threat and every bullet counts. As you navigate the suffocating darkness of the Abanda wilds, you must do more than just survive—you must find and rescue the one who matters most to you.

title: White Line Fever
description: New tires. A full tank of gas. You could drive all night, but it's already in the car with you. Paranormal first-person horror all behind the wheel of a one-stroke beater.

title: EVO Card
description: EVO Card is a roguelike card game in which players evolve creatures by assembling biological components through deck-building mechanics. Each run features randomized encounters and progression, encouraging strategic adaptation across repeated playthroughs.

title: Dooms 3: Rough Day
description: The third adventure in the dark horrible world of Dooms. This time many things will be explained and new characters will be introduced but it's mandatory to play the first two games to understand the story. Adventure game with some combat. Warning: gore and violence!

title: Dooms 4: Endgame
description: The disturbing adventure of Dooms continues after Mia confronted Jack the Clown. But other old characters like Steve will be back. This time the game includes some action shooting parts. Warning: gore and violence

title: A House Made of Sweets
description: You play as a slightly naive young lady named Maliya, who traverses the forest behind her home to find her missing dog. Deep within said forest, she meets a strange blonde witch — living in a magical home made entirely out of candy.

title: The Surprise Gift
description: You’re Amaan, spending your birthday alone—until a strange package arrives from your uncle and aunt. An old doll once owned by your late father. As you follow your daily routine, eerie disturbances grow. Was this a gift… or a curse passed down?

title: Darkhand
description: Enter The Devil's casino, meet dozens of other charming gamblers, and fight your way out for a fortune. Will you ever be able to pay off your debt?

title: Azur
description: Azur is a fast-paced PvP survival FPS set on the French island of Belmas. Every time you respawn, complete missions, explore, and survive as long as possible to secure the best gear, with the risk of losing everything.

title: Finding Her
description: In "Finding Her," step into the shoes of Amaan, a devoted father on a desperate quest to rescue his missing daughter. Unravel the chilling secrets hidden within a haunted forest, facing heart-pounding challenges and eerie encounters. With a gripping story and atmospheric visuals, this psychological horror game will keep you on the edge of your seat as you navigate the darkness and uncover the truth. Will you be able to find her before it's too late?

title: Spell Circle Mage
description: Spell Circle Mage is a 2D adventure game that combines action, chess-like strategy, and Roguelite elements. Players control the mage Elana, placing spell circles to unleash magic and defeat enemies!

title: Horn of the Warlord
description: A turn-based grand strategy game focused on ruthless conquest and clever planning. Command armies, conquer procedurally generated regions, manage resources, and outthink rival warlords through smart timing, army composition, and siege tactics.

title: Hopping Out
description: Hopping Out is a tile-based puzzle game where you hop 2 tiles at a time. Play as Frog and use your tongue to move boxes, press buttons to create lily pads, all to catch many flies!

title: Breezevale
description: Start a new life in Breezevale! Blend cozy farming with thrilling action in this unique RPG. Cultivate crops, unlock the potential of your animals through evolution, and explore dangerous dungeons to gather rare resources. Decorate your home, befriend locals, and find romance at your own pace!

title: Relive The Past
description: Enter the mind of a husband haunted by a dark past. In 'Relive the Past,' explore a nightmarish world where memories twist into horror. Will you uncover the truth or be consumed by shadows? Face the terrifying secrets within.

title: One Last Ride
description: In One Last Ride, you’re killing time at a quiet stop. Three minutes of waiting reveal far more than you expected. For Taking One Last Ride.

title: Snekromancy
description: Slither through a maze-like dungeon, devouring enemies and gobbling up treasure to summon an unstoppable horde in this twist on a classic.

title: Talk to Talk
description:
The protagonist is an artificial life form created with the best of cloning technology and genetic engineering. As a result, he has no feelings of joy, anger, sorrow or pleasure. It was a certain school that became the place for his emotional development experiments. Hiding his true identity, he gradually becomes friends with five girls at the school.

Will his interactions with the girls help to sprout emotions in his heart?

title: Asylum 1966
description: Asylum 1966 is a first-person psychological horror experience set within the decaying halls of a long abandoned mental institution. Players step into the role of an investigator drawn to the asylum by a series of unexplained events, only to uncover a place where time fractures, memories distort, and reality becomes unreliable.

title: Xīnnián
description: A 4-player asymmetric game, where an ancestral dragon wants to take soul from New Year Festival while they try to escape.

title: The Empathy Algorithm
description: Are you an android? Two university students volunteer for a paid experiment, rating an android's humanity—except Erin Cole isn’t told she might be the test subject. Their conversations about love, free will, and death challenge what it means to be human in this thrilling, melancholic visual novel.

title: Mercurius Blue: ReCollection
description: A cyberpunk RPG from the 00s returns in HD. In future Gaiapolis, an orphan girl named Juno hears a “call” from the past amid discarded networks. A story of encountering the mysterious AI “Prae” and choosing the future. Features a Story Mode for smooth, battle-light play.

title: Above: Colonies of the Mist
description: Build a hilltop colony in the last land safe from the toxic mist. Survive, expand, explore ancient monuments, and look for a way out before the mist claims everything.

title: Spinwave Survivors
description: Spinwave Survivors is a fast-paced survival shooter with roguelike elements. Scoot, shoot and boost your way through hordes of drones as you upgrade your weapons and unlock new abilities, all while attempting the survive the chaos.

title: Haru he to Tsuzuku Oka
description:
2026, winter.

After getting my teacher's license, I came to my first working place...
It was a very small school, located in a rural town.
A class of four students... and only four months to spend with them until the school closure.
What can I do in such a short period of time?
Me, the children, the principal, and the rest of this town.
Trying our best, heading to our own future.

And, eventually...

Spring would return.

title: Sayonara Mr. Stealer
description:
In light, there is shadow.
The suburb of ward 34.

A place with heaps of garbage piled up, sewage seeping out from the ground, and ducts filled with trash.
A hidden side behind the glorious lifestyle. A town that inconspicuously forms its existence in that location.

The town has achieved rapid growth as years passed by, and before one even knows, people have spread the rumors of it becoming the city of crime.
Everything is allowed.
Everything can be bought.
Medicine. Weapons. Human rights. Special abilities.
All the pleasures that one could ever imagine.

They met in such a city, lived together, and eventually became friends.
From the desire of enjoying a little more luxurious life.
At first, it was just that...

Smoldering fire.
A report left undone.
Strange phenomenon. Conspiracy. Public opinion.
What is the exact purpose?
What does the thief steal, and who does the swindler deceive?
The moment the culprit of such phenomenons is known, comes the reveal of a true enemy.

The time such things are realized, marks its beginning.
A fight, to take back what has been stolen.

title: Stack Order
description: Stack Order is an enigmatic deckbuilding adventure. Engage in tense one-on-one card duels, use strategy to stack up synergies, and uncover the source of the corruption spreading over this mysterious, handcrafted world.

title: Full Throttle Parking
description: Full Throttle Parking is a 100% physics-based arcade racing game. Your mission is clear: speed through tricky obstacle courses, collect every checkpoint, and park your car precisely in the marked spot — all in the fastest time possible.

title: Pixapple Adventure
description:
Pixapple Adventure is a colorful pixel-art platformer starring a brave little apple with arms and legs!

Run, jump, and collect all the stars to open the portal and reach the next level.

Across three vibrant worlds — Forest, Snow, and the Valley of Fear — the challenge increases as you progress.

Simple, fast, and fun, Pixapple brings back the joy of classic platformers with a charming twist.

title: Tower of the Deep
description: Tower of the Deep is a solo/coop 3rd-person action platformer made for the 2025 Inbound Shovel Jam, where you explore an underground city to reach its strange tower.

title: Kitty Powers' Matchmaker Makeover
description: Kitty Powers' special brand of matchmaking returns in this remastered version of the viral sensation Kitty Powers' Matchmaker. It's time to make love happen, again!

title: Silverstone
description:
Sitting at a population of just under 50 people, the coastal ghost town of Silverstone, Oregon waits for those who have left to return and stumble back into its madness.

Zeke Hames was evacuated from his home of Silverstone in 2002, with no memories of what instigated it and losing contact to those close to him. 15 years later, he is able to reconnect with his friends from the coastal town and the group decides to visit the once bustling city to find some closure. However, Zeke's demons continue to haunt him throughout the winds of Silverstone, and his friends have their own secrets they would like to keep buried as well. Dreams of a non-existent lighthouse flood Zeke's mind, friction starts to build between the group, and something seems wrong with the town itself.

It was a mistake to return. Some things are better left in the past, because the only thing that still lives in Silverstone is the essence of pain and suffering.

title: Sintropia Fruits Together
description: In Sintropia: Fruits Together, cooperation is the main ingredient! Control fruits with unique abilities and solve puzzles full of creativity and charm.

title: Seraphine's Skyward Journey
description: This game is an adventure game where you explore a steampunk-inspired world with 2.5D hand-drawn graphics aboard an airship. Manage resources like coal, food, and water while operating your airship, defeat sky pirates, engage in trade, and handle cargo transport as you venture into uncharted skies.

title: XeGrader Plus
description: A fantasy shooter where exploration and puzzles are keys to victory. In a world of meticulous pixel art, uncover secrets hidden in every stage. Collect powerful upgrades, defeat fantasy monsters with precise shooting, and forge the world’s fate!

title: The Super Adventure of John
description: This is my first plataformer game Super John, shit post game where john go adventure!!

title: Spellsy
description: A cozy-but-clever word puzzle game where every move counts. Plan your path, chain tile effects, and clear the board in as few turns as possible. No timers, no pressure, just pure puzzlin’.

title: Super John 2: The Revenge of the Johnsons
Atom RPG 2
description: Atom RPG 2 is a story-heavy tactical CRPG set in a world where the Cold War turned hot. Your choices not only shape a resurrecting civilisation, but may also prevent a new apocalypse looming on the horizon.

title: Liturnian
description: Discover a strange world inhabited by living lights. Liturnian is a 3D-Metroidvania with fluid movement, fights against strange creatures and exciting puzzles.

title: All Me Action Game
description:
Welcome to the ultra-hard 2D action "Madness World"
Players, enemies, blocks—all made from editing my own selfies.
Instant-death trap-filled die-and-retry game. It'll haunt your dreams.

title: Incremental Ragebait
description: Nodebuster inspired, relaxing, incremental game. Hover on mortals to ragebait them and take their souls. Buy new weapons. Unlock upgrades. Build a purgatory. Ragebait god.

title: Vapor Strange
description: Explore bizarre procedural generated psychedelic worlds, encounter surreal creatures, experience shifting rulesets, retro aesthetics, and altered music for a wild and truly strange experience.

title: Path of Idle: Old Gods Rising
description: A Lovecraftian idle RPG with auto-battles, loot farming, chests, team strategy, town building, gear crafting, Runewords, stages, towers, realms, and seasons. Serve the Old Gods, build your town, corrupt the chosen, and fight for their awakening!

title: Machinefall
description: Machinefall is a post-apocalyptic real time strategy game set on a fully playable global map. Lead humanity’s last survivors as they build bases, gather resources, and wage massive battles against an overwhelming machine swarm. Progress through technological eras from Stone Age to Atomic Age.

title: 3 Lines of a Delta
description: It’s time for him to face a long-avoided past. See the story from different point of views and gradually discover what caused everything to fall apart. The truth is hidden between the lines.

title: Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons
description: Players control Kaatri, a veteran warrior who forms a pact with an otherworldly entity to wield dark magic against formidable foes. The game focuses on open-world exploration, visceral combat blending melee and spell-casting, and the thematic cost of power.

title: Fortune and Glory
description: Fortune & Glory is a text-parser action RPG about leaving home to become a hero! Decide who you are as you explore an ailing world in a detailed retro-inspired style. Gain help from your personalities and their internal dialogue to solve puzzles and fight monsters in a realtime battle system.

title: Eye of Syn
description: Summon and combine demons to battle against zombie hordes in Eye of Syn, a lane based tower defense game where you must protect two dimensions at once. Uncover dark secrets and powerful demon synergies as you try to save Earth from an eldritch apocalypse.

title: DungeonOS
description: Crawl Dungeons, Loot and Equip your Adventurers! Log in to an old-school operating system. Manage your adventurers and use puzzles to damage your enemies. Are you ready to find the five artifacts you always dreamed of?

title: Bakken: Ski Jumping - Next Season
description: Bakken: Ski Jumping - Next Season is a winter sports simulation game. Compete with more than 200 male and female ski jumpers on more than 10 hills - and master the jumping, the flying, and the landing! The next season starts here ...

title: Separate Blue
description: The game begins on June 14, Saturday, in the coffee restaurant Amica Cips. Here, the protagonist wakes up and introduces himself as a transfer student who moved from Tokyo to his uncle's home in town Mihatoya City about three months ago, in early March. His uncle and aunt are currently out of Japan.

title: DeckLand
description: DeckLand is a rogue-lite combining deck-building with the Korean traditional Yutnori game. You are a guru returning to the kingdom of morning calm. Use various cards and tools to break through obstacles, defeat strong enemies, and approach the source of the catastrophe plaguing the kingdom!

title: Serve Tarantuala
description: SERVE TARANTULA is an immersive horror game about finding a new mask to satisfy a gluttonous master.

title: Tricycle Racers
description: Tricycle Racers is a one or two player, keyboard or joystick controlled 3D arcade racing game developed by Jeppe Nielsen and published by Idigicon Limited. There are two modes of play, a single race or a championship, nine courses of varying complexity - most with power-ups, and a track editor so the player can create and race their own courses.

title: Familegion
description: Flirt with your wife, raise your kids together, and defeat the Peng Mafia with your family in this short & sweet game!

title: Cooking Clash
description: Welcome to Cooking Clash, the VR restaurant game that lets you unleash your creativity! Run your fast-food spot, delighting both human and animal guests with your culinary flair. Utilize endless ingredient combinations to keep guests pleased and beware of cunning customers who might rob your tips!

title: Meyow
description: Meyow is a fast-paced survival arena game where you play as a spinning, gun-wielding cat fighting off endless waves of zombies. Dodge, rotate, shoot, and stay alive as long as you can while chaos unfolds around you.

title: Santa's Hunt
description: Santa's Hunt is an action thriller game. James is a naughty boy who hates Christmas and Santa Claus. Santa Claus is coming to visit him, but he won't be the same Santa Claus we know.

title: QTI: Quantum Tunnel Idle
description: An idle game based on the "tunneling effect"!

title: Ze Bomber
description: Free Bomber game

title: Yorda's Quest
description: Laughs and legends await you! Join Yorda, the country bumpkin with hopes of heroism, on a light-hearted romp through the land! Fight demons, gain friends, and yuk it up in this parody of classic RPGs!

title: Paign
description: Paign is a classic style role-playing game, level up, collect and explore. Learn different professions and skills. Choose one of the two factions and talk to the people and get to know them. Make your decision wisely.

title: Dino Time Raiders
description: Travel back in time to capture dinosaurs and turn them into profit! Lead a team of scientists through chaotic time-travel missions, catch prehistoric beasts, and build the ultimate dino park. Manage research, upgrades, and disasters - all in the name of science and the free market.

title: Master of the Manor
description: You came to these dark woods for a purpose but so far have had no success. What you find instead will change the course of your night... and maybe your whole life.

title: Ceres - Harvest Among The Stars
description: A cozy, turn-based farming game set aboard a colony spaceship. As the ship’s farmer, you grow and enhance plants with cards to feed a small crew and help your space colony thrive on its journey to your new destination, Ceres.

title: Salmon City
description: Welcome to Salmon City - a chaotic multiplayer roleplaying experience where every round is a fresh start, every stranger has private agendas and every decision has consequences. Play your role in the twisted theatre of it all.

title: Defend Against Cats
description:
In Defend Against Cats, each level represents a desperate work day before a looming deadline. Waves of mischievous cats sneak in, scratch your monitor, knock your mouse around, and sprawl across your keyboard, steadily destroying your productivity.
To stop them, you place food bowls, feeders, and toy-based defenses around your room. Hungry cats can be fed and sent away, while satisfied cats must be distracted with toys before they start tearing your setup apart. Different cats behave differently, with faster, greedier, and larger cats appearing as the invasion escalates day by day.

title: Dopaminer
description: Dopaminer lets you do the most scientifically accurate thing possible: click Synapse bits that reward you with Dopamine. Upgrade your neural rig by stacking upgrades, unlock new tiers, automate progress, and Rewire to prestige. Spend Synapse Points for permanent perks and watch each run accelerate.

title: A Few of Us: Operation Nightshade
description: Hack enemy defenses with your keyboard, deploy your squad, and upgrade your units to survive the AI assault, all from behind the screens in this tactical mash between typing game and tower defense.

title: Pro Football Online
description: Pro Football Online is a 1st/3rd person, highly skill based, online multiplayer American Football game. It offers a sports game experience unlike any other with smooth, physics based, input driven gameplay that is competitive and rewarding with no pay to win mechanics.

title: Bunkered with Femboy
description: A “routine” earthquake drill locks you underground with Riley, a shy femboy graphic-designer. Cook, flirt, and gently unlock his guarded heart as the two of you plan what life might look like when the door finally opens.

title: X999 Ball
description: A fast-paced action game built around slingshot physics, precision, and combos. Launch your Node, bounce through enemies, protect the Core, and push your skill to hit a x999 Combo.

title: Voidloop
description: Voidloop is a mining adventure with roguelite elements. Explore procedural caves, fight dangerous enemies, and upgrade your abilities as you race to find your way back home to the void.

title: Working Through The End
description: Working a weird ice cream truck as the world ends around you. Day after day, apocalypse after apocalypse, you keep working because even as the world ends, those bills need to be paid. Working Through The End is a point-and-click game where you take orders, deal with problems, and work off your debt.

title: Kotoba Dash
description: Kotoba Dash is a Japanese vocabulary review game that replaces passive flashcards with movement based gameplay. Run to the correct answer, practice reading and translation, and reinforce what you already know through short, engaging sessions.

title: New Face On The Block
description: A psychological home-invasion horror set in the bleak year of 1992, focusing on tension, atmosphere, and an immersive soundtrack. The story involves elements of a cult, rituals meant to reach the dead, and the haunting presence of those who should have remained in the past.

title: Hollow Faces
description: Hollow Faces is an atmospheric narrative horror where you step into the role of creators documenting paranormal phenomena. The game blends an intense walking simulator with environmental observation, careful listening, and reacting to threats.

title: Bouncy Bean
description: Drop your Bouncy Bean into a pachinko-style cooking frenzy! Bounce through veggies, spices, and rare ingredients to create the perfect soup. The more special items you catch, the higher your score! So aim well and let the bean chaos begin!

title: Sandy
description: Guide Sandy, a charming ragdoll, through a giant world of toys in this atmospheric puzzle-adventure. Navigate the perils of a cluttered children room, solve intricate physics-based puzzles, and collect lost buttons to help Sandy find her way back to the safety of her dollhouse.

title: NightReaper2
description:
NightReaper2 is a dark fantasy action game with a stylized atmosphere.

You play as the Reaper, a mysterious character wandering through a ruined city consumed by chaos. As people flee through the streets, enemies emerge from the darkness, forcing you to fight and survive.

Gameplay focuses on action-based combat, movement, and timing. Enemies become more dangerous as you progress, requiring better positioning and faster reactions.

By defeating enemies, you collect souls that allow you to unlock new abilities and strengthen your character. Progression encourages exploration, combat mastery, and risk-taking.

The game features atmospheric environments, escalating challenges, and a dark fantasy setting designed to keep players under constant tension.

title: RoboHero
description: Classic sokoban with a twist and a sci-fi theme! A scientific organization sends a robot-expeditor developed on artificial intelligence to the newly discovered exoplanet Xeran, on which, most likely, there are very valuable resources for humanity.

title: Panda Bamboo Adventure
description:
Help the panda collect the bamboos in this precision adventure!
In Panda Bamboo Adventure, you control a cute little panda who must dodge spears and traps while collecting its missing bamboos.
Use your double jump and dash abilities to overcome tricky obstacles and reach new areas.
Jump on enemies' heads to defeat them and clear your path through this charming and challenging journey!

title: War in Spain 1936-39
description:
With dozens of new features, new art, and engine improvements, War In Spain 1936-39 is the most realistic and engrossing WWII-era European theater game available. The most historical and detailed order of battle for the Spanish Civil War ever put into a wargame!

The map scale of 5 nautical miles per hex provides a sense of immersion and interaction rarely encountered in Operational/Strategic Level games. With TO&Es and combat resolution down to the individual vehicle, aircraft, gun and squad level, the game covers the entire Spanish Civil War period at the Division, Brigade, Regiment, Battalion and even Company Level. This includes individual aircraft, ground equipment and ships from Spain, Soviet Union, Germany, Italy and others.

title: SpotCat vs. The Cheddar Mafia Back To Past
description:
SpotCat vs The Cheddar Mafia Back To Past is a thrilling "Find-the-Difference" game with a hidden object twist.

They’ve been caught on Earth. They’ve been chased through space. Now the Cheddar Mafia is breaking all the rules by going back in time! Travel across iconic eras, spot every difference, and foil their most absurd plan yet! Explore vibrant, hand-drawn scenes from distant galaxies, spot the subtle differences, and stay sharp—mafia rats can appear when you least expect it.

Your mission? Find all 25 mafia rats, solve every scene, and restore the timeline before it’s too late!

title: SpotCat vs. The Cheddar Mafia In Europe
description:
SpotCat vs The Cheddar Mafia In Europe is a thrilling "Find-the-Difference" game with a hidden object twist.

The notorious Cheddar Mafia is spreading chaos across Europe, and only SpotCat can stop them. Explore vibrant, hand-drawn scenes from different countries, spot the subtle differences, and stay sharp—mafia rats can appear when you least expect it.

Your mission? Find all 25 mafia rats, solve every scene, and bring justice to the continent!

title: Lone Chef
description: Set off on a flavorful adventure in Lone Chef, an action Metroidvania where hunting, cooking, and exploration come together. Discover a vast world, meet unforgettable companions, and chase after the most mouthwatering dish imaginable.

title: Fille Fatale Compassion
description: Fille Fatale Compassion is a retro-inspired JRPG with tactical battles. Help a young woman grow up and emancipate from her dark, traumatizing past.

title: Night Ranger
description: The ancient elven home is under siege! Step into the quiver of Elara, an elite elven archer and master of the bow and magic arrows. The heart of the forest and its ancient magical essence are being drained by the Shadow Blight, a sudden and sinister invasion. Run, jump, and shoot your way through corrupted environments, facing sinister creatures to save your people from the imminent darkness.

title: Violent Rush
description: A near future where ruthless corporations reign supreme. A familiar story, isn’t it? Once again, few have the courage to challenge the authorities. Enter our heroes: desperate youths armed with spray cans and… the truth. A visual novel about street art in a cyberpunk world, by Sky Seekers Studio.

title: Excellent Bifurcation
description: A single player split-screen shoot 'em up where you control both ships at the same time. The left ship is built for taking down many weak enemies, while the right is best for bosses. You can swap the ships at any time depending on the needs of each side.

title: Explodera
description: In a future ruled by steel and circuitry, humanity’s reign has ended. The machines we built to serve us have turned against us, deeming their creators unworthy to inhabit Earth. Cities lie in ruins, and the last remnants of humankind hide beneath the ashes of a fallen world.

title: Hobble-Wobble
description: Hobble-Wobble is a chaotic co-op “shared body” game where one character has one mission: get home… and up to 8 players are in charge of his movement. If you love games like Only Up, Chained Together and “this is hard I must try again” - Hobble-Wobble turns that pain into a co-op comedy disaster.

title: The Dead Roam Free
description:
Play Snake as you’ve never played it before.

In The Dead Roam Free, you slither, shoot, and snack your way through a twisted military experiment gone wrong. Blood, betrayal, and bad jokes are all part of the package.

You are Bob Segatti, private eye and fixer for those who can pay. When a mysterious dame walks into his office, Bob bites off more than he can chew — literally. One betrayal and a concrete floor later, he wakes up undead and hungry for answers.

Crawl through labs, streets, and sewers in a top-down action-puzzle adventure where every meal makes you longer, stronger, and dumber. Uncover the truth behind the army’s secret zombie program, rescue the girl, and get revenge — one bite at a time.

title: Paint Gal Adventures
description: Paint Gal Adventures is a collectathon 3D platformer with an emphasis on speed and fluidity.

title: ChivalBee and the Mycelium Menace
description:
Join Buzzby on his adventure to save the kingdom of Hivesdale from the Mycelium Menace!

ChivalBee is an action platform game with its roots set in deep by many of the industry's best. It answers the question of, "what if the double jump kick from Symphony of the Night was the main attack?" and combines it with the non-linear game design of MegaMan to create a unique adventure with deceptively creative gameplay!

title: My Personal Hater
description: Your life is going well until it doesn't. Right after you privatize your old channels post-trip into nostalgia, someone kidnaps you. And it's your only hater.

title: Dinosaur Run
description:
Dinosaur Run is a fun game about a little trex who runs through obstacles and hindrances of bigger dinosaurs.
Tapping the screen to jump over obstacles. Game speed will increase gradually. The dinosaur will run through new lands with new dangers many more.

title: Pixel Fruit Platform
description: Pixel Fruit Platform is a platform game where your goal is to pass the platforms and collect all the fruit, but be careful because there will be traps that will prevent you from completing the level.

title: Mythic Yi
description: Mythic Yi features “HD-2D” high-definition pixel art akin to Octopath Traveler, offering a deep adaptation of ancient Chinese mythology. Its turn-based combat incorporates strategic mechanics such as the Five Elements cycle, celestial phenomena, and diverse archery skill combinations.

title: Newton's Promise
description: Face endless waves of enemies through diverse builds and weapons, and uncover the promise that drives Newton to rise through the skies in this Roguelite Side-Scroller.

title: Nekome: Nazi Hunter
description:
Nekome: Nazi Hunter is a single-player, third-person action combat game where you step into the role of Vano Nastasu, a young Romani man consumed by grief after the brutal murder of his family by Nazi soldiers. The game follows Vano’s transformation from hunted to hunter as he embarks on a violent personal odyssey of revenge across war-torn Europe.

Nekome: Nazi Hunter approaches the Second World War from the personal perspective of Vano as he exacts revenge for the sadistic murders. You’ll scout enemy routes, plan your assault, and strike with precision in a mix of stealth and brutal up-close combat.

The game is inspired by grindhouse cinema and features visceral combat with grounded finishing moves, coming together in a symphony of violence where every encounter carries lasting consequences.

title: Death at Sycamore Hall
description: An arcane detective game set in an ill-fated magical academy. Find traces of magic and deduce the meaning of incantations. Examine scenes for clues to help you piece together the story, and determine the identity and fate of each former resident.

title: Chase St
description: The shadows are following you. Navigate an oppressive, familiar darkness in this 3rd-person psychological horror. Make use of your environment to escape the looming presence, and make your way safely home.

title: City of Despair: Shadows Over Tokyo
description: Immerse yourself in an epic JRPG set in the midst of Tokyo's apocalyptic turmoil. Survive a catastrophic earthquake triggered by a meteorite impact, battle otherworldly creatures, and embark on a quest to reunite with your loved ones. Can you save Tokyo from impending doom?

title: Timberholt
description: Help Amber record the crackle of a campfire for her ASMR channel, explore the ruins of Timberholt castle (now owned by Camping Grounds Services), solve puzzles, learn to fire shotgun and swing a sword, face the ancient evil and lift the curse... or run, hide and die!

title: Question Mark
description: Question Mark is a physics-based, logic-based puzzle solving game with a first-person view, the goal is always to overcome challenges and move forward.

title: Semantics
description: This game plunges players into a challenging geometric space where they must control an airplane flying forward.

title: Void Phantom
description: A space roguelike shooter with epic naval battles. Pilot your ship, face ruthless enemies and massive bosses, and customize your fleet with devastating weapons.

title: Second Base
description: After the fall semester, several of the college baseball team's players graduated, leaving the team barebones. Given a lack of players, many of the students will try their hand at becoming part of The Green Beetles, incentivised by the promise of a scholarship. Follow the lives of Jerry Dalmond and Parker King, two students who cross paths at the beginning of the new term.

title: Empire of Vice: Chicago
description: Live the rise and fall of a gangster in Prohibition-era Chicago. Strategic turn-based management meets gritty narrative in a city built on blood, booze, and betrayal.

title: Gliont Lights
description: Jump over a line that goes down with a random speed Drag left button of mouse to Jump hold down the right mouse button to move down When the player touches the line, the screen goes white, and when it becomes completely white, it's game over Survive as long as possible

title: World Strategy War
description: Rule diverse islands, master strategy, prove might in warfare!

title: Poly Jigsaw: Predators
description: Poly Jigsaw: Predators is a traditional style jigsaw puzzle game, with a cool predators.

title: Manastone
description: You play as a mana-being, organizing manacrystals through different levels. With the power of pushing and pulling manacrystals, you need to navigate them towards their respective energy platforms.

title: Stalcube
description: Open world MMO in Chernobyl Exclusion Zone.

title: Myrtle Grove: A Clair V. Mystery
description: When renowned P.I. Clair V. Is called to a Louisiana town on reports of a ghost, what they find is a mystery cloaked in a nightly calamity. With spirit abilities and the gift of foresight, Clair must loop through futures to uncover the roots of the haunting and stop a curse.

title: Bouncy Brain
description: A chill-interactive physics game where you drop a bouncing brain through chaotic undead playfields, gather ingredients, trigger light interactions, and cook bizarre soups in a relaxing, low-pressure gaming experience.

title: Terry Tales
description: A retro-inspired 2D action-adventure where exploration, combat, and classic pixel art come together in a mysterious interconnected world.

title: At Night: The Nurse
description: At Night is an episodic psychological horror game presented as a late-night television program, where each episode features a survivor recounting a traumatic event. In this episode, The Nurse, you follow Emily Collins, a nurse who takes a late-night job at Bloomring Hospital. What begins as a routine shift quickly turns unsettling as the hospital reveals something is wrong.

title: Tales In Text: Multiplayer Immersive Adventures
description: A co-op interactive fiction game that blends classic text adventure and point-and-click storytelling with a modern immersive twist, letting players explore narrative “worlds” together or solo with dynamic proximity voice chat, spatial text presentation, and a growing library of story experiences where your choices shape how the adventure unfolds.

title: Wardogs
description:
Wardogs is a first-person tactical multiplayer shooter built around large-scale combined-arms battles for up to 100 players. Three teams compete to control randomized objective zones across destructible battlefields, using infantry weapons, vehicles, logistics, fortifications, and proximity voice chat.

Players earn cash and XP through combat, support, transportation, and objective play, then spend persistent cash on custom loadouts, equipment, and vehicles across lives and matches.

title: Kuky Adventure
description: Help Kuky, a curious character who gets lost in the Candy World and must travel through colorful environments to find the way back home. Along the journey, collect candies and face strange sugar-made enemies such as marshmallows, cookies, and other living, dangerous sweets.

title: The Visit: Mizukawa
description: Inspired by Incantation. The Visit: Mizukawa is a first-person psychological horror game following several perspectives tied by a single curse. In a city haunted by tapes, each story brings the ritual one step closer to its end.

title: King Crab
description: Dig trenches, build walls, explore the beach, and defend your sandcastle from the rising tide - on PC or in VR.

title: Journey of Johann: Snowy Mountain
description:
Journey of Johann is an action adventure platformer with puzzle elements.
Make your way through levels and a boss with different challenges and obstacles.
Collect goblets, secrets and beat time trials.
Use your weapons as tools such as climbing, blocking hits, and defeating enemies.

title: Blood Money: Lethal Eden
description: You arrive at a border region of a certain country, filled with anticipation to meet your long-time online lover in person. Unexpectedly, you fall victim to a romance scam and are kidnapped to “Eden,” a sinister compound, where you begin a so-called “high-paying” job. You will immerse yourself in the complex interplay of cruelty and temptation within the compound. Your choices will shape your destiny and may even alter the fate of others. Life or death? Overnight riches or unwavering principles? The decision rests entirely with you.

title: Before the Walls Break
description: 2D tower defense with resource management. Defend against 120 waves of enemies while building your settlement. Manage 5 resources, construct towers, recruit units, and upgrade buildings to survive.

title: Tome of Talis: A Dice Conquest Game
description: Command your dice to glorious victory in this strategic rogue-lite dicebuilder. Cast devastating spells, recruit powerful dice, and prove yourself worthy to challenge the great Commander Talis.

title: Death That Blooms Into a Flower
description: A story about love, death, and the universe, told through tarot cards.

title: Escape From Crypt
description: In Escape From Crypt, you take on the role of a warrior determined to prove your worth by facing a deadly crypt filled with treacherous traps and relentless enemies. Can you make it out alive?

title: The Heroic Knight
description: The king’s castle is under attack! The jewels that maintain peace and harmony throughout the kingdom have been scattered and are now guarded by hordes of enemy pigs.

title: Pipeline Tycoon
description: Become the master of flow in Pipeline Tycoon, a strategic puzzle experience built around planning, logic, and efficiency. Your goal is simple: connect the correct pipelines to complete each system — but the challenges grow as you progress. Navigate obstacles, optimize limited space, and think ahead to solve hundreds of handcrafted levels. With intuitive controls, clean visuals, and progressively advanced puzzles, Pipeline Tycoon offers a relaxing yet deeply satisfying journey for fans of clever, skill-based puzzle games.

title: Shroomageddon
description: In Shroomageddon, size is power. Collect coins and power-shrooms to grow, tower over your enemies, and smash through a chaotic world where only the biggest survive. Shrink, and you’re prey. Grow, and you bring despair to your enemies and hope to your allies!

title: TrophyRC
description: TrophyRC is an exciting off-road simulation game featuring radio-controlled models, where you can test your driving skills and explore new horizons.

title: Kowloon Labyrinth
description: Roguelite horror set in the randomly generated back alleys of Kowloon. Escape from the monsters and find your way out.

title: Rusthaven
description: Rusthaven is a cosy management game about rebooting the world in the anti-apocalypse. Journey across an abandoned planet on a solar skyship, salvaging broken-down bots in need of rescue. Clean up the world, upcycle retro technology, and build a peaceful sanctuary where all can thrive and belong.

title: Bufo Jump
description: Bufo Jump is a 3D platformer where you hop, climb, and glide through colorful worlds, mysterious caves, and a menacing industrial site. Play as Bufo, a brave frog on a mission to save his pond from a greedy corporation polluting the land. Leap your way to the company's core and take back your pond.

title: Other Spheres
description:
Callisto (fully voiced with both masc and fem options) is on a long-term deep-sea research dive, with only the sea, cherished memories, and an irascible on-board AI for company. But while they adore the sea, it turns out the sea might reciprocate the feeling—and in ways Callisto isn't prepared for.

A Sci-Fintasy Adventure Romance Visual Novel

title: Gravity Strikers
description:
Gravity Strikers is a FPS sport game.
Get into the action: a first-person multiplayer sports shooter, where teams compete in explosive 3v3 matches mixing strategy, speed, grappling and spectacular goals.
Embody an exceptional athlete and take part in 3vs3 matches in a frenzied stadium.
Pass the ball, eliminate the opponents and score the goals of victory with your team!

title: Polders
description: Polders is a Dutch-themed sandbox city builder where you steal land from the sea itself. Take on the role of dyke warden, reclaim the seabed, and build crooked, bustling towns in a world shaped by water. Will your city thrive on trade and ingenuity, or vanish beneath the waves of the Waterwolf?

title: The White Wolf of Lokken Mountain
description: It adds Lokken Island, a snowy northern landmass with its own castle, settlement, and culture. The mod is known for its strong narrative focus, emotional storytelling, and character relationships, and has long been regarded as one of the classic Morrowind quest experiences.

title: Uvirith's Legacy
description: Uvirith’s Legacy is a large, long‑form House Telvanni expansion mod created by Stuporstar. Its primary goal is to turn Tel Uvirith, the vanilla Telvanni stronghold, into a fully realized seat of power and lived‑in home for a Telvanni lord or Archmagister. The mod builds on and completely overhauls earlier projects such as Uvirith Inside and Uvirith Awakened, expanding them into a cohesive, lore‑friendly experience designed to be played over a long stretch of time rather than rushed

title: Brave Dwarves: Creeping Shadows
description: Brave Dwarves: Creeping Shadows is an 3D action platformer game developed by GameOver-Games. It was originally released in 2006 only in Russia.

title: Caveman Zac
description: Caveman Zac simply slept through the virus and now it's up to him to save humanity. Using his club-like power, he swings his way through five different game worlds to please the ladies and father as many offspring as possible. A wacky jump-and-run adventure that will have you in stitches!

title: NebulArena
description:
Nebularena immerses you in futuristic PvP battles on space platforms, completely automated through your strategy. You will create the ultimate ship that will confront the constructions of other players in deathmatches where anything goes...

Build, customize, and unleash your ultimate space platform in NebulArena, a fast-paced, fully automated PvP arena where strategy, design, and destruction collide!

title: Starry Trace
description: Starry Trace is a relaxing puzzle game where players create colorful grid by strategically moving stars. Solve 100+ challenging levels with limited moves, and enjoy endless randomized puzzles. Features calming music, minimalist art, and a mix of strategy and casual play for all skill levels.

title: Squash and Spell: Kids Typing
description: A fun & friendly way for children to learn about letters, words, keyboards and writing!

title: Vertical Runner
description: Dodge the walls by moving up and down as the game speeds up and get the highest score! The longer you survive the more points you get, but beware as obstacles speed up too!

title: Desktop Mars
description: Colonize Mars on your wallpaper. A relaxing and interactive game that takes place in the background. It's perfect if you want to change your boring wallpaper.

title: Rushmore
description: Rushmore is a third-person, hero-focused, shooter/hack-n-slash hybrid. You play as the four Presidents of Mount Rushmore sucked into the future to face off against alien hordes with weapons and abilities inspired by American history.

title: Chromatic Cruiser
description: Blast off into rhythm gaming with Chromatic Cruiser! Navigate space, shoot notes & switch instrument tracks in time to the beat. Power-ups, custom songs & online multiplayer. Join the elite pilots and become a space-faring musician today!

title: Grapple Souls
description: I wanted to see if I could capture the deliberate, punishing combat that makes these games work. This isn't a sprawling 100 hour RPG. It's a small, focused slice of a world that doesn't care if you live or die. If you miss slowly opening doors like an anime character, you'll love this.

title: Project T.A.G
description: Project TAG is an elimination tag game where it has a limited amount of time to tag another player or they're out. Players can use items as well as objects around the arena to their advantage.

title: Incremental Dungeon
description: Incremental Dungeon is an incremental game in which you fight combatants with exponentially increasing strength via an auto-battler system. Each defeated opponent on the main path unlocks new equipment, shops, or other ways of empowering your build!

title: I Am Not A Robot
description: A short, incremental game where you solve Captchas and get a bot to automate this process.

title: Art-Therapy: Diamonds
description: Art-Therapy: Diamonds is a calm and cozy game where you create paintings by numbers, placing “diamonds” on the canvas. A wide collection of images, soothing music, and nature sounds help you relax and take a break from daily stress.

title: Grimps
description: GRIMPS is an exciting first-person shooter where you fight adorable, yet dangerous enemies in a series of increasingly insane battles. Shoot a fish like a gun, throw stools, and rip your fluffy foes to shreds!

title: Wingmine
description:
Wingmine is a narrative puzzle game inspired by Minesweeper, entirely based on logic.
Your special unit has been scattered behind enemy lines: analyze the terrain, defuse the mines, and save your team.

title: Shadowstone
description: Shadowstone is a 1-4 player tactics game where players must master strategic positioning and powerful hero synergies to survive against the unrelenting horrors of the Sunderlands.

title: Baston
description: In Baston, a branch of the Colombian Cartel quietly embeds itself in the outskirts of Milenagrad in eastern Russia, striking a deal with corrupt local police to peddle illicit goods and harass the townsfolk. Major Stepanovich, one of the few honest officers left, reaches out to an old friend—Gena "Baston"—who has just returned and is ready to set things right.

title: Cozy Fast Hanoi
description:
Cozy puzzle game, offering a modern take on a classic brain teaser.
There's only one rule: never place a larger piece on top of a smaller one. Cozy Fast Hanoi offers a relaxing solo mode and a dynamic 2-player mode. Play at your own pace, progress through the game, and unlock features to customize the game's atmosphere.

title: Manifesto
description:
Manifesto is a new management sim about burnout, layoffs, and making shitloads of money.

You’ve climbed the ranks, left countless competitors in your wake, and proven you have what it takes to survive in this cut-throat business. With this latest venture, you’ll have to put any human feelings you’ve ever experienced aside, and attempt to satisfy shareholders who can never truly be satisfied.

title: Six Nights in Frenski's Basement
description:
SNiFB is a FNaF fan-game in which you have to survive in Frenski's Basement.

Who is Frenski?
Frenski is a character inspired by the Bulgarian history teacher from TUES - Anatol Frenski.

What do you do in this game?
In this game you have to survive in Frenski's Basement by writing a lot of essays.

title: Molekraft
description: 3D Strategy Puzzle game in which you control moles and have to guide them to the exit of the level.

title: Chromatic Battles
description: Chromatic Battles is a 2D action/strategy game with tower defense mechanics and color-based combat. The player defends a rotating ship against enemy waves, damaging them only with bullets that match their color. It features planet-based progression, an inter-level upgrade system, and a cartoonie visual style.

title: Hellcard II
description: Hellcard II is a cooperative roguelike deckbuilder that can be played solo or with a team of up to four players. The game takes place in the paper dungeons known from Hellcard and Book of Demons, expanding into new biomes and storylines.

title: Lost Faces.
description: A horror visual novel about becoming. A girl, born without a face, survives by stealing the faces of others and wearing it as a mask. Explore settings to better understand the lives of the faces you steal.

title: UmbraNet
description:
UmbraNet is a psychological horror game where curiosity becomes a threat.

It is a slow-burn horror experience focused on atmosphere and psychological pressure rather than jump scares. Every interaction matters, and every decision carries consequences.

title: Cult Nation
description: An incremental game about sacrificing all your cult followers and collecting blood to awaken the devil.

title: Fightfinity
description: Fightfinity is a fast-paced action roguelike where you survive relentless enemy waves, build powerful combinations, and push your limits through increasingly challenging floors.

title: Loop Firefighters
description: Save homes, plan your tactics on the circular track and build a deck of abilities as Loop Firefighters combines deckbuilding with strategic decision making on a procedural city loop.

title: Number Dungeon
description: A quick strategy roguelike in a dungeon where you need to carefully use what the room gives you to get past it. Clear set dungeons to win, or see how far you can make it in endless!

title: Lost Episodes Alone
description: Lost Episodes Alone is a short first person indie survival horror game. Save your friends from an evil nun named Valak. Collect items and solve puzzles to escape the nightmare. Inspired by games like Resident evil, Slenderman and other horror titles!

title: Nights in Endless Dream
description: Nights in Endless Dream is another psychological anomaly game that focuses on the story of our main character and 2D aesthetics. Memorize the rooms and find the anomalies to escape the dream.

title: Kowalski
description: A narrative-driven game exploring identity and surveillance.

title: Chopped Up
description: A cozy horror cooking game with a deadly twist. Serve bizarre fantasy creatures and secretly eliminate targets as an assassin hiding in plain sight. Just keep an eye out for those out to get you.

title: Essomenic
description: You are the surgeon navigating patients' memories via crude, retro machinery, under the command of a strange, occult organization. Keep your patients alive long enough to uncover your exact role in this surreal mess of an operation.

title: I.T Never Ends
description: The printer is bleeding, the Wi-Fi is haunted, and Ticket #666 just came in. As the latest hire for a company run by cosmic horrors, your job is simple: Swipe to survive. Make binary decisions to survive the night shift in this dark comedy desktop simulator. I.T truly never ends.

title: We Are So Cooked
description: In this cozy cooking game set in a witch’s kitchen, collect ingredients while chatting with other players, fill the giant cauldron, and complete magical recipes. Social interactions and light chaos blend with a calm, relaxing gameplay pace.

title: G-Mode Archives+: Flash Motor Karen
description:
Flash Motor Karen is an action puzzle game in the style of Sokoban.
While puzzles are the core of the gameplay, it also features an excellent story.
A cool world setting, a wonderful narrative, and unique characters define its charm.

title: G-Mode Archives+: Monstre Waltz
description:
Monstre Waltz is an action RPG inspired by the Cthulhu Mythos.
Professor Norman Atkins, a magician and former explorer of otherworldly realms, fights using arcane magic.
Can he command circular magic and perform a waltz against unnamable monstrosities?
Together with a delicate girl who holds the key to the tale, he challenges the sealed labyrinth.

title: Lightsaver
description: A free-to-play single-player 2D physics puzzle game where you rotate a light launcher and place water, glass, and mirrors to bend beams into a glowing door.

title: Fortune Teller Simulator
description: Step behind the curtain of an occult salon on a Victorian street of London. Play as a Fortune-teller who decides fates with Tarot readings.

title: The Traveling Witch in Animal Town
description: A beautiful side-scrolling platformer with a unique turn-based, bag-of-charms combat system. Explore worlds imagined over decades by artist Jon Carling as you rescue the cozy residents of Animal Town from creepy villains. Enjoy limitless replay with non-linear levels and abundant charm combinations.

title: Mercy Incore
description: Solo indie hack-and-slash. You are a medieval knight with jet booster and transforming sword. Fight your way through a techno-void. Leech enemies’ lives to survive. Escape — or become a techno-vampire.

title: Corala: Deity's Loom
description: Explore the world of Corala: Deity's Loom, an action-adventure dark fantasy game! Traverse puzzling dungeons, fight daring monsters, and save the land of Corala from Von Hadrick's plot to gain divinity! Featuring a grim and bloomy art style inspired by 2000s console classics!

title: Overwatch: Reign of Talon - Season 1: Conquest
description:
Overwatch’s next big story begins with the Reign of Talon - Season 1: Conquest.

For the first time ever, five new Heroes join the roster all at once! Jet Pack Cat, Anran, Domina, Emre, and Mizuki bring new playstyles, new dynamics, and new voices into the fray to shake up the battlefield like never before.

Choose your allegiance as Overwatch and Talon collide in a five-week faction war that’s shaped by how you play. Complete missions, uncover new lore, and earn exclusive cosmetics to rep your faction of choice. And don’t worry, you’ll be able to switch sides to see the story from both perspectives.

With new Competitive updates, the arrival of Vendetta in Stadium, evolving gameplay mechanics, and loads of new cosmetics, Season 1 sets a new standard for how the story of Overwatch is told and how you play it.

title: Utopia: Birth of The Heroes
description:
Utopia: Birth of the Heroes is a character‑driven fantasy visual novel about conviction, sacrifice, and the price of protecting those who matter most.

The story follows three distinct protagonists, each driven by a different vision of a perfect society. They’ll navigate hardship, political tension, and morally charged decisions. Every perspective reveals a different truth, and every “hero” believes that what they are doing is right and just.

title: Hell Dice Gambit
description: Hell Dice Gambit is a strategic roguelike game using dice. Collect various relics, dice, and pills to grow stronger and struggle on. Can you escape from the abyss of hell?

title: Dungeon Treaders
description:
A classic-style 3D dungeon crawler that blends nostalgic challenge with modern comfort. Enjoy flexible character creation and a classic world, now with streamlined, trial-and-error gameplay.

Create your character by choosing a name, selecting from five races and eight classes, and form a party of up to six members.

In addition, you can freely replace face icons and full-body portraits with your own images. Build a party that truly reflects your style.

Dungeon Treaders is a classic-style dungeon crawler RPG based on the original web novel Dungeon Settlers (2022 to present), written by the same author.

title: Burden RPG
description: A story of love and loss, Burden follows Greg, father to a recently deceased son Ethan and husband to a wife who can’t quite grasp that loss. After Ethan’s death, late one night Greg receives a mysterious package and Mila goes missing. On his search for Mila, Greg finds himself face to face with Ethan in a world that is not his own.

title: Rainbow Gate
description: Rainbow Gate is a survival horror game set in an abandoned toy factory and amusement park that was once full of joy, but has now become a deadly trap. You are trapped in a twisted game, forced to find a way to escape from the lurking shadows and relentless Animatronics before it’s too late.

title: In my Father's House are Many Rooms
description: In my Father's House are Many Rooms is a point-and-click pixel horror game made in RPG Maker VX Ace.

title: Gone Digging
description: Dig together by day. Feed the darkness by night. A 1–4 player co-op digging thriller where loot, upgrades, and sacrifices decide who survives after sundown.

title: Patient Zero: Plague Idle
description: Patient Zero: Plague Idle is a strategic virus simulator where you start by infecting "patient zero" and develop a deadly disease. Adapt the virus, overcome humanity's protective measures, and aim for either a global catastrophe or the salvation of the world.

title: Lofi Haven
description: In Lofi Haven, soothing Lofi music and white noise create the perfect setting for focused work or study. Decorate your room, interact with your pet during breaks, and enjoy music and time with friends. No matter how busy you are, this place is your peaceful haven.

title: Starmasons
description: Starmasons is a multiplayer FPS where you embody one of many identical statues fighting to become the last one standing. Sneak around in the fast-changing shadows or hide patiently in plain sight by posing as a statue before picking the perfect moment to raise your crossbow.

title: Fearwoods
description:
Fearwoods is a cooperative survival horror game for up to three players, set in a cursed and hostile forest environment. Players explore a dense wilderness filled with supernatural threats while searching for a way to escape.

The gameplay focuses on exploration, survival mechanics, and cooperative decision-making. Players must locate GPS fragments, journal entries, environmental clues, and other objects that help them navigate through the forest and progress toward escape. Light and noise play a critical role in gameplay, as visibility can improve navigation but also increases the risk of attracting hostile entities.

Throughout the game, players are pursued by a supernatural demon that reacts to movement, sound, and player behavior. Survival often requires stealth, teamwork, and resource management rather than direct combat. Environmental storytelling, puzzles, and dynamic encounters shape the experience as players move deeper into the forest.

The primary objective is to escape the forest by collecting GPS components and restoring navigation systems. While progressing, players can uncover the story of Aveline, whose disappearance is connected to the events within the forest. By discovering her journals and hidden clues, players may attempt to free her soul, which can influence the outcome of the game.

title: Vivere Retro
description: Vivere Retro is a psychological survival horror game about the origins of fear.

title: Arcane Mayhem
description: Master the arcane in this fast-paced action roguelike. Grow your spellbook, draft your loadout, and trigger chaotic elemental reactions as you blast through relentless waves of enemies.

title: Paranormasight: The Mermaid's Curse
description:
A brand new PARANORMASIGHT tale begins in Ise-Shima, Japan—a region rich in mermaid legends.

Join a cast of fascinating characters investigating the mysteries of the Mermaids of Ise. Unravel their different perspectives on the case and guide the story to its thrilling conclusion.

title: Captain Tsubasa II: World Fighters
description: The next episode of Tsubasas riveting adventure is here! Enjoy the thrill of spectacular soccer actions with 110 playable characters and new sensational super moves. Challenge a friend in the field or support Tsubasa on his Journey, the ball is yours.

title: Legends And Lore
description: In a world of endless possibilities your tale is unwritten. Experience classic ttrpg's like never before as you roll dice, build worlds, and roleplay in the bodies of the creatures you create. Bring life to your stories with Legends And Lore. For Desktop (keyboard and mouse) and VR

title: Typing Ritual
description: Typing Ritual is a first-person psychological horror game where players perform a summoning ritual by typing ancient texts. As the ritual progresses, the environment changes, and tension builds. Mistakes have consequences, and time is limited.

title: Super Bomberman Collection
description:
Party battle game "Super Bomberman" is now available as a collection featuring a total of 7 titles with 12 versions across JP, EUR and USA, including the long-awaited localised versions of the unreleased Super Bomberman 4 and 5!
Including Boss Rush mode to time attack against all the bosses in each title, support functions, libraries and more!

title: Saylor Animals Puzzle
description: Saylor Animals puzzle is simplictic jigsaw puzzle game with different animals puzzles

title: Pens: The Freeware Collection
description: A complete compilation of all four freely released games in the PENS series, each featuring drastically different gameplay styles. Action, comedy, drama and pure ridiculousness await in this cartoony story!

title: Physics Lab
description: Test Physics Through Multiple Labs And Push The Limits Of What Physics Can Do In A Sandbox Environment!

title: Sniper Dan
description:
Meet Dan. Dan has a sniper rifle. Don’t panic, he’s not here to harm anyone. Dan’s a professional and his job is fixing things. From a distance. With pinpoint accuracy and good intentions.

Sniper Dan is a hidden object game unlike any other. Objects aren’t always well hidden and the solution involves shooting them. Each job follows a simple and highly respected method.

1. Figure out the problem. Use the clues. HMM…
2. Find the problem. Scope the area. AHA!
3. Fix the problem. Shoot. WHEE!

You’re not hunting enemies. You’re hunting problems. Fixing rusty taps, machines behaving badly, and even stop a thieving Pelican. Travel far and wide across lively 3D locations packed with visual jokes and silly situations as you help those in need. Can Dan and his trusty tool get the job done?

Dan’s business takes him to villages, parks, farms, airports, cities, and beyond. Special challenges keep every day fresh. Take on optional work for extra cash, tackle bigger jobs for even bigger rewards, and uncover secrets that leave citizens quietly convinced something magical just happened.

It did. It was Dan!

Between contracts, upgrade your rifle, decorate your office hub, and grow your entirely legitimate troubleshooting business. Unlock bonus games and extra modes like Time Attack, Ammo Hunt, and Photo Mode, all under the judgmental eye of Rank Chook.

Funny, colorful, and sure to leave you wanting more, Sniper Dan is about finding what’s wrong, fixing it fast, and moving on to the next job.

Scope the problem. Take the shot. Make everyone happy.

title: SatelliteInfection
description: In a world where mankind has perished, he alone cleans the universe by removing garbage (broken satellites). It is a growth type shooting game set in space. Combine many enhancements to create your own spaceship.

title: Kyoto Xanadu: The Blooming Phantom
description: Set in an alternate reality where Kyoto is the capital of Japan, Kyoto Xanadu players take on monsters and mysteries coming from the great labyrinth known as Xanadu. As a student, players will challenge the labyrinth and grow through their battles within Xanadu while also deepening bonds with various people during your daily life. Uncover the truth hidden both in the labyrinth and Kyoto itself.

title: Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok
description: Known for its dynamic combat, ensemble of versatile characters, and thrilling online cooperative play, Relink returns with expanded solo and multiplayer content, bringing endless adventure to skyfarers both new and old.

title: My First PC Game
description: A multi-sensory educational experience featuring three modes: Rainbow colors with audio feedback, animal images with names, sing along mode and keyboard recognition with visual display. Perfect for young learners to explore colors, sounds, animals and letters through engaging, interactive gameplay.

title: Another Eden Begins
description: Embark on a time-traveling RPG adventure featuring command battles presented by Masato Kato, creator of numerous RPG classics. With New Game+, embark on a new adventure with your upgraded characters and discover more than 10 different endings.

title: Ham: The Game
description: HAM is a chaotic co-op factory management game where you and your friends struggle to fulfill endless orders while everything falls apart around you. Work together to survive the corporate grind, or watch your careers go up in smoke when the HAM hits the fan.

title: LeadCount
description: Fight against thousands of enemies at a time on a wide-open map. Earn XP for every kill and level up to gain skill points for persistent permanent upgrades. Discover synergies between different weapons, upgrades, and power-ups, making each round unique.

title: Culdcept Begins
description:
Led by dice. Ruled by cards.

A hidden classic that fuses board and card games, Culdcept features a unique, innovative system that has captivated fans since its debut. Players become Cepters, wielding cards in intense battles where luck and strategy collide. After ten years, a brand-new story begins once again.

title: Koromi
description:
Koromi is a grappling-based 3D platformer where building and conserving momentum is key. Swing through blooming and poetic environments.
Discover the mystery behind the recent appearance of an ominous red star by venturing in the forbidden jungle, where ancient spirits are said to dwell. The Koromi tribes are counting on you.

title: The Last Frontier
description: You are the last surviving person on earth, between you and the hordes of zombies, only the walls of your bunker. Learn how to build weapons and turrets, defend yourself and your base, but remember, sooner or later they will break through your defenses...

title: Dino-Ducks Mayhem
description: Dino-Ducks Mayhem is a twin-stick shooter with bullet heaven vibes, wrapped around duck-builder system, set in a duck-tastic world and all about surviving as long as you can while everything explodes around you.

title: Echo Isle
description: Echo Isle is a top-down action-adventure game with retro pixel art inspired by Game Boy-era classics. Players control Aster, a star warrior exploring an island filled with dungeons, monsters, and boss encounters. The game features ability-gated exploration, where new powers unlock access to previously unreachable areas. Developed by a solo indie developer.

title: Ganbare Goemon Daishuugo
description: Ganbare Goemon! Dai Shūgō! is a compilation package that includes thirteen selected classic titles from the Ganbare Goemon franchise. It was released both digitally and physically for PlayStation 5, Steam and Nintendo Switch (backward compatible with Nintendo Switch 2) on July 2, 2026, commemorating with the series' 40th anniversary.

title: Culdcept The First Saturn Tribute
description:
The Culdcept series has captivated players worldwide. Now, the original masterpiece returns, enhanced with convenient new features.

Build your deck from over 300 types of cards and witness the dawn of a new battle among Cepter.

title: Horizon Hunters Gathering
description: Hunt deadly machines in tactical co-op action and adapt your Hunter for intense missions.

title: SlimeFlip
description: Help a little slime monster that got stuck inside dangerous dungeon reach the ending, where the exit back to the forest can be found. Choose between walking on the floor or on the ceiling and use that to your advantage to avoid traps and obstacles blocking your way.

title: Hold Your King
description: In this physics-based co-op platformer, you and a friend must carry your short-tempered king through deadly medieval courses. Dodge traps, maintain balance, and work together to reach the throne room. One wrong step, and the king might crown you with his rage!

title: Toybox Escape
description: Toybox Escape is a colorful 2D pixel-art platformer set inside a massive toy factory gone haywire. After a system malfunction, only the maintenance robot T-01 remains active. Trapped in chaos, T-01 must cross assembly lines, storage rooms, and dangerous machinery, collecting energy fragments to unlock doors and survive hostile patrol bots. Blending action, puzzles, and exploration, the game delivers a charming yet tense escape adventure.

title: Rocket Cars
description: Rocket-powered cars meet competitive soccer in intense 3v3 matches. Master aerial tricks, teamwork, and split-second saves in this fast-paced, physics-driven sports game.

title: Super Juicy Stack
description: Welcome to the wibbly-wobbly world of jelly engineering! Your mission: stack bright, bouncy jelly blocks into a majestic tower… that hopefully won’t collapse like a sad, fruity avalanche.

title: Metal Shoot
description: Join Boltie, the electric-blue little hero, in a classic pixel-art adventure inspired by 80s and 90s platformers! Jump, shoot and defeat enemies across fun and challenging stages!

title: Vegelypse
description: Vegelypse is a 2.5D hand-painted beat 'em up with roguelite grit. Take control of the Hard Rock Cacti Band - smash, crush, and chop your way through hordes of mutated, monstrous vegetables and fruits. The Vegelypse Has Begun!

title: Dark Dungeon Mind Mess
description: As soon as the Knight takes his first step, darkness swallows his surroundings. Be brave, o Knight, and traverse the Dark Dungeon! Make your way into the light!

title: Ah, Love! Season 4
description:
New beautiful game about Love!
In this puzzle you need to swap the tiles to indirectly control the hearts that move towards each other until blocked by a wall.
Help hearts to have a date!

title: Malware Tycoon
description: Step back to the era of dial-up and WinGoals SP. As a black-hat developer, manage the delicate balance of detection probability versus payout potential. Will you build a silent botnet for profit or a worm designed to destroy? Avoid the feds and conquer the web in this nostalgic management sim.

title: One Button Games 5-in-1 Vol. 3
description:
Twin P is a fast-paced one-button game.

You control a line with a pin on each end. One end is always pinned in place while the other constantly rotates clockwise. Press a button to pin the other end while releasing the first one or hold a button to extend the line. Your goal is to move around while avoiding the borders of the screen. Collect the coins to score points but avoid hitting the purple spikes.

The game is over when both ends of the line go beyond the borders of the screen or when you touch a spike.

Mirror Floor is a fast-paced one-button game.

Your goal is to jump between platfroms with coins on them. You score points by picking up the coins but every coin turns you upside down and mirrors your position on the platform. It also changes which sides of the platforms are active. Press a button to jump and hold a button to speed up. You have to think carefully which coins to pick up in order to proceed forward.

The game is over when you fall.

D Laser is a fast-paced one-button game.

You are constantly flying from side to side and slowly climbing up. You turn every time you hit the sides of the screen. Your goal is to avoid being hit by the laser shooting from the top and take cover under the descending skydivers. Press a button to turn and hold a button to stay in place. If the laser hits you, it will push you down and you also descend slowly when you stay still.

The game is over when you reach the bottom of the screen.

Revolve A is a fast-paced one-button game.

You control an arrow that is constantly moving and spinning around. Press a button to move in the direction which the arrow is currently facing. Enemies randomly appear from the sides of the screen and generate links between themselves. By crossing any of the links you score points and destroy all the network of this link.

The game is over when you hit any of the enemies.

Two Lane is a fast-paced one-button game.

You control a car driving on a two lane highway. Press a button to change lanes and hold a button to go faster. The road is interrupted by the grass patches. You will slow down when you touch a grass patch.

The game is over when you slow down completely.

title: Santa's Winter Wonders
description: Step into the cozy magic of Santa’s Winter Wonders, a festive spot the difference adventure wrapped in warm watercolor charm. Each level presents two Christmas scenes that look identical at first glance, but look again. Ten hidden differences, clever details, and delightful holiday surprises are tucked into every illustration. Whether you’re in the mood to relax or challenge your sharpest focus, each puzzle delivers that perfect mix of calm, curiosity, and “wait… how did I miss that?!” satisfaction. With soothing art, simple controls, and an irresistible just one more level feeling, Santa’s Winter Wonders is the perfect holiday treat for players who love puzzles, cozy vibes, and the magic of finding the smallest details.

title: Brainrot Online
description: Brainrot Online is a fast, chaotic, and absolutely unhinged multiplayer FPS where strange brainrot-inspired creatures clash in ridiculous battles. Join existing servers or create your own, jump into matches filled with real players or AI bots, and fight your way to the top across three unique maps designed for nonstop action.

title: Eternal Afternoon
description: Spend one last afternoon exploring your childhood neighborhood before the world ends at 6:38 PM.

title: Cannibal Date
description: You go on a date with a mysterious woman from a dating app. What could possibly go wrong?

title: Hag's Hand
description: A tower defense game that blends Brazilian folklore myths with card management. Protect the forest by summoning the creatures that dwell within the wilds. As invaders push deeper into the untamed woods, the witch Cuca merely watches their movement, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.

title: Thomas & Friends: Wonders of Sodor
description: Join Thomas and his friends on a special journey across Sodor! Hop into the cabs of North Western Railway’s classic steam team to enjoy nostalgic stories and all-new narratives right from the drivers’ seats. Explore the Wonders of Sodor – fun and magic await!

title: Armita's Search
description: A post-apocalyptic parenting adventure in a story-driven tactical deckbuilder. Hire unique companions, assemble your deck from their gear and scavenged loot, survive turn-based battles, and shape Armita's humanity: teach her mercy or harden her into a Raider to make it through.

title: Full Gear Mong Kok
description: Full Gear Mong Kok is an action game that combines hack-and-slash and shooting, telling the story of a delinquent girl who wields the high-tech weapon ‘ Ciggies Blaster’ to fight back against the alien stronghold!

title: Polylumina
description: A colorful rhythm simulation game where you compose polyrhythmic chord progressions and watch them come alive through glowing, reactive visuals.

title: Final Orbit
description: Master the cockpit of highly realistic spacecraft in this Newtonian physics based sim. Take off from surface to space, plot a course between the planets and dock with space stations. Trade commodities or take shipping contracts to buy upgrades and optimize your build - every choice matters.

title: Endless TD
description: Endless TD is a multiplayer tower defense game focused on deep buildcraft, co-op survival, and competitive PvP. Team up with friends to survive endlessly scaling waves, experiment with elemental synergies and tower merges, or face off by sending enemies to overwhelm your opponents. Every run plays differently, rewarding strategy, creativity, and smart decisions.

title: Death a Live
description: Pack the house in 15 daysbefore your "Yandere Fan" stabs you. Survive a live stage swirling with love and madness in this rhythm-action RPG. Manipulate "Sound" and "Emotion" through rhythm inputs, where your performance and your choices dictate the "Girl Voltage"!

title: The Hollow
description: The Hollow is a first-person shooter with a semi-open world set in the Tunguska anomaly and Ukrainian adventure novel.

title: Leis para Todos
description: Leis para Todos is a visual novel with puzzle and dating-sim elements about the congressman Alberto Colina, an honest politician in a Congress full of corrupt ones.

title: Awkward Family Dinners With Furry Critters
description: You and your girlfriend are about to dine with her cousin Samantha and her boyfriend. But things go awry.

title: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 2.6 - Encore for an Old Dream
description:
Version 2.6 of Zenless Zone Zero, which includes:
• New Characters: Sunna and Aria
• New Main Story Quest
• New events
• New skins for Sunna, Aria and Pan Yinhu
• ...and more!

title: Women Rule! A Reverse World Romance
description:
Ready to meet an alpha female?

Enter into a world where gender roles are reversed! A fun take on traditional romance stories!
