title: Animal Girls Dating Agency
description: Welcome to the Animal Girls Dating Agency where there are three different women to court. Will you go out with Mary; the calm and gentle sheep girl? Or perhaps Freya; a creative and shy rabbit girl? Last but not least is Willow the mischievous fox girl who loves to tease - and who has a mysterious secret…

title: All the Mods 10
description:
The top pack of 2025 with around 500 mods! Tons of quests and a proper endgame.

All the Mods started out as a private pack for just a few friends of mine that turned into something others wanted to play! It has all the basics that most other "big name" packs include but with a nice mix of some of newer or lesser-known mods as well.

The biggest changes this time around are that we are now using NeoForge and we are on the version 1.21. Expect many updates as mods come out!

In All the Mods 10 we will continue the tradition adding many new mods while going for more stability.

Does "All the Mods" really contain ALL THE MODS? No, of course not.

title: Wuthering Waves: For You Who Walk in Snow
description:
Version 3.1 of Wuthering Waves, including:
• New characters: Aemeath and Luuk Herssen
• New story quests
• New echoes, events and more!

title: SunBlockers
description: A survival mini-adventure where the sun has fallen and darkness freezes everything. Stay near the light, explore, and survive as long as you can.

title: Capy Spa
description: In Capy Spa, you help Pipa, a relaxation-loving capybara, push herb buckets into hot springs to prepare the perfect bath.

title: Hummingbird Garden
description: Hummingbird Garden is a charming pixel-art puzzle where you push little pollen nuggets through tight pathways until each flower blooms in a colorful display. It is the perfect mix of calm thinking, strategy, and a touch of natural magic.

title: Cute Astro
description: Cute Astro is a cozy, pixel-art puzzle where you play a rockstar mouse pushing tasty cheese cubes across musical score boards. Each board has score holes that must be filled with cheese to complete the riff and open the way forward.

title: Rabbit & Steel: Extra Mode
description: A free update to the base game featuring new classes, stages, loot, and bosses.

title: Pistonica
description: Pistonica is the pure steam and mechanical factory automation game, challenging your resource management skills. Explore the tropical island first-person, research tech, mine for minerals, build contraptions and trade goods - all because of a strange radio signal.

title: Yurei: Ink of the Damned
description: A third-person graphic adventure in which our protagonist enters a world of Japanese legends, where his objective will be to collect a series of cards to advance through the stories and escape from that world full of nightmares.

title: Prismarch
description: A colorful chess roguelike! Engage in dopaminergic, cinematic strategy while you fulfill a chess power fantasy - your pieces gain abilities as you construct a juiced up roster capable of surviving the onslaught! Only - seven mysterious prismatic kings stand before you and the one true crown...

title: Black Mountain of Tlaltecuhtli
description: Third-person supernatural action-adventure in a living Aztec mountain. Climb collapsing ruins, shift dimensions to fight reality-warped enemies, and navigate Loop Zones where environments reset. The deeper you go, the closer you come to what the Aztecs sealed away.

title: Data Breach
description: Corporate horror for 1-4 expendable robots. Valkyron owns your mind, sets your quota, and drops you into dead facilities to haul out data. Hit quota and catch the train home, or the whole crew gets recycled.

title: Hell Architect: Survivors
description:
A darkly ironic action roguelite set in Dante’s Hell, where sin is power.
Play as a demon architect hell-bent on overthrowing Lucifer, rebuilding the underworld, and unleashing forbidden powers with an unholy arsenal.

title: Screams Echo
description:
Dive into the chaos of an abandoned underground complex, where biological experiments have gone terribly wrong, spawning hordes of mutants and monstrosities.

Screams Echo blends the fast-paced gameplay of Vampire Survivors with the roguelite mechanics of The Binding of Isaac, offering endless build possibilities, hundreds of items, and weapons to create unique survival strategies.

Choose from a diverse cast of heroes, each with their own unique abilities, and descend into the depths as unexpected story twists unfold. Explore procedurally generated levels, fight massive waves of enemies in real time, and adapt to constantly changing conditions.

title: Eco Volunteer
description: A peaceful, cozy game about cleaning up trash and other eco-friendly activities in nature. Embark on a journey through stunning natural landscapes while doing good deeds!

title: Honkai: Star Rail - No Aha At Full Moon
description:
Version 4.0 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New characters: Yao Guang and Sparxie
• New Trailblaze Mission: "No Aha At Full Moon"
• New region: Planarcadia
• New path: Elation
• New system optimizations
• New events
• ...and more!

title: CD-ROM
description: 10 CDs, 10 passwords. Find hidden messages, text, numbers to unlock next CD to continue your steganography puzzle journey.

title: In My Bubble
description: In My Bubble is a 3D action-adventure platformer featuring a child in a cute earflap hat on a quest to save the sheep of the dream world. Explore a world overtaken by darkness, rescue corrupted sheep, and restore the lost morning using the power of bubbles!

title: Devil of the Plague
description:
Devil of the Plague is a 1–4 player co-op horror and survival game set in a dark ritual world.
Play as plague doctors, explore cursed locations, complete rituals, survive infected creatures, and face the ancient demon ASAG. Work together with your team, manage limited resources, and escape before the plague consumes you.

title: Tiny Terra Spaces
description: Tiny Terra Spaces is a cosy, slow-paced builder where you can create your own charming medieval island. Choose whether to design an island from scratch, expand on an existing one, or take on gentle challenges in hop mode to unlock new places. With cosy 3D buildings and a theme inspired by the beauty and history of Scotland, you can build at your own pace and enjoy the process of bringing your world to life.

title: Color Zone
description: Protect your Color Zone against other people!

title: Just Chess
description: Enjoy a pure, distraction-free chess experience! Includes a built-in engine, UCI support, and a Puzzle Arena with 4M+ puzzles. Lichess integration lets you challenge players and watch live tournament broadcasts.

title: Cheliki
description: Colorful 3D Team Adventure! Leap through challenges, crack puzzles and scale peaks together! Enjoy dynamic platforming, hilarious tests and eye-popping visuals!

title: Bip and Bop
description: Help, step on, or sabotage your friend! In this 2-player only puzzle platformer, perfect chemistry is the only way through. Think your friendship can handle it?

title: Practisim Designer
description: Practisim Designer is a sandbox for budding or expert stage designers to create innovative stage designs for the practical shooting sports like USPSA, IPSC, Steel Challenge, IDPA and others. Design stages, play them and export the written stage briefings to PDF.

title: Silver Lines
description: Who's the fannest of them all?

title: The Sushi Bar
description: The Sushi Bar is a Japanese-style horror game where you play as a sushi chef working the night shift.

title: U.N. Owen Was Her?
description: Escape a Scarlet Mansion haunted by U.N. Owen..? Feed or fight roaming entities, solve light and gear puzzles, and use hunger to survive. Explore grand halls and a vast library, descend into a sealed underground, and defeat the original U.N. Owen.

title: HackSociety
description: hackSociety is an immersive MMO hacking simulator. Become part of a living, breathing simulated society in the most thorough and expansive hacker sim ever made. Will you become a legend, or fade into obscurity?

title: A Permanent Echo
description: Uncover Sabotage, Conspiracy and Counter-Revolution in this cyberpunk detective mystery. Using a mind-probing interface, you explore and act within memories, collect facts, meet agents of change and enormous corporations. Build your case against a person torn between idealism and turmoil.

title: The Calamity Trials
description: Complete platform parkour featuring multiple unique weapons and obstacles while IT chases you. These weapons will increase speed, or become another obstacle you must overcome.

title: Archival Anemoia
description: Welcome to Archival Anemoia, an archive of over 30 different games made over the course of around 13 years, all by one girl in her childhood, and all for free!

title: Uninvited: Security Service
description: Uninvited: Security Service is a really simple stealth/exploration game where you sneak around a mansion while avoiding the butler that lives in there. Learn about the foolhardy protagonist and the stupid chain of events that led to the situation that’s happening there.

title: Maid in Grisaille
description: A 2D dating sim in the dark romance genre, aimed at a female audience.

title: RK Override
description: RK Override is an hour-long fully voiced interactive narrative following Chimera, a Mecha Captain fighting in an endless war for their country's future. Fight for control against your Mecha's AI copilot (RK System) as you attempt to end the conflict - no matter the cost.

title: Roadhouse Simulator
description:
Roadhouse is the prelude to Gas Station Simulator where you take on the role of the uncle and explore his humble beginnings. Start as a bouncer at a roadhouse on Route 66 and work your way up to running the entire business.

In this 1st person view simulator game you deal with a multitude of customers and various biker gangs, manage the roadhouse, tend to the bar, master the grill, stock the right supplies and acquire more territories to widen your influence.

title: Spacetime Shooter
description: You are a sniper who controls time and space. Eliminate all enemies with a single bullet.

title: Bus Simulator: World Tour
description: Bus Simulator: World Tour delivers the ultimate bus‑driving experience with realistic mechanics, detailed environments, and a massive fleet of vehicles. Travel the world behind the wheel of 30 unique buses across 14 real‑life inspired locations and complete 140 routes packed with variety and challenge. Customize your ride, explore freely, and enjoy a true next‑generation Bus Simulator built for immersion.

title: Ocean Otter Swim
description: Ocean Otter Swim is a 3D top-down swimming game about making your way back to the sea. Let’s swim with a CUTE SEA OTTER!

title: A Normal Train Game
description: Trapped on a chaotic subway, you must act fast before time runs out. Hurl crying babies out of the car in a frantic arcade rush as difficulty ramps up. Chase high scores and climb the online leaderboard.

title: Skatr
description: SKATR is an inline skating game where you skate fast and do cool tricks. Do advanced tricks for more points and maintain max speed! It's also just fun 2 skate around.

title: Jaden Williams' The Stalking Stairs
description: The city’s under curfew after a series of disappearances and murders. You’re a young delivery driver trying to finish your gig before 9:00 PM. Set inside a decaying apartment complex, every knock on a door brings you closer to uncovering what lurks within its halls, where every delivery could be your last. The Stalking Stairs is a PSX-style psychological horror thriller featuring tense atmosphere, immersive sound design, and full voice acting.

title: Purrfect Ascent
description: A brutal ascent to the top to rescue your frightened kitty. Missed jumps might be punished severely. Do you have what it takes to overcome the challenge? Meow.

title: Drones Drop Bombs
description: An old-school arcade where a single drone is humanity's last chance against robot uprising. Drop the bombs, fire your lasers, destroy robots and protect humanity.

title: Shards of the Heart
description: Shards of the Heart is a story-driven RPG with strong visual novel and dating sim elements. Dive deep into a branching narrative with rich character interactions and emotional storytelling.

title: The Medical Examination Diary: Teamwork in Paradise.
description: "The medical examination diary: Teamwork in Paradise." is a novel game. Enjoy new episodes by the heroines of "The medical examination diary: the exciting days of me and my senpai" and "The 2nd page of the medical examination diary: Another story of exciting days of me and my senpai".

title: Sudoku Dungeon
description: Sudoku Dungeon is a turn-based fantasy tactical puzzle game mixing 9x9 Sudoku logic with dungeon crawling combat. Manage hero abilities, enemy abilities, and more as you navigate through an 80-puzzle campaign. In Challenge Mode experiment with your own team compositions and optimize your solutions.

title: Poker Hands Bullshit
description: Turn-based card game. Raise the bar on the best poker hands you think are present out of all players' cards. Since you can only see your cards, you'll have to take a chance on the cards other players have or lie about your own cards. Bullshit or be bullshit-ed.

title: Oh!Ware
description: Sow the seeds of victory, forge alliances, and carve your own destiny. A spiritual Mancala roguelike where every marble shapes the board and your fate. Every pit is a choice and every marble, a desperate prayer.

title: Llewl and the Lyre of Two Worlds
description: Retro Styled jRPG heavily inspired by the classics of the 90s.

title: Mmnana
description: Mmnana is a 3D adventure featuring 2D pixel art in which, after an accident, you must learn to move from scratch and discover whether you can escape an island by crawling using only your hands.

title: Grid Forge TD
description: An incremental tower defence game where you place tetrominoes to shape the enemies path.

title: Battle for Asciion
description: Battle for Asciion is a classic horizontal shoot 'em up built entirely from real text characters. No sprites. No pixels. No images. Just pure ASCII action, massive bosses, weapon upgrades and retro arcade challenge.

title: TanCrush
description: Harvest resources, fend off incoming enemies, and build your own squad through an endless cycle of combat and progression.

title: HoloType: Treasure Zombie Island
description: Houshou Marine sets sail again, this time with typing! Due to Crazy Ollie's mischief, the captain's precious treasure has transformed into "Treasure Zombies"! Can the captain recover her original, adorable treasure? A typing game like no other, filled with Hololive's most memorable lines!

title: Call the Exterminator
description: When the world’s most dangerous terrorists crawl out of the shadows, there’s only one number the government dials: yours. CTE is classic 90's 2.5D action. Suit up, Light up, its time to Call the Exterminator.

title: Spy's Demise Remake
description: The year is 1982. Sneak your way through the Soviet Embassy in Pyongyang via elevators, avoiding Soviet security on different floors to piece together the encrypted message. This is a platform game. You move from floor to floor avoiding the security that is constantly moving up and down on elevators. As you climb, you will collect all of the pieces that form an encrypted message as you advance to the next level.

title: Rogue Balls
description:
Rogue Balls is a 3D, Top-Down, Bullet-Hell game, in which enemies will chase you and attack from a distance.
Use your projectiles to brutally touch them to death while listening to a new dnb sountrack.
Become more powerful with every level-up and survive as long as possible!

title: Content King
description: Streaming simulator roleplaying game featuring voices from Twitch streamers

title: RatSpiderFrog
description: A cursed auto-battler where you take control of a bunch of rats to fend off enemy attacks. Crossbreed them. Grill them. Feed them. Make them POWERFUL!

title: Treasure Touring
description: Join three cheerful, broke treasure hunters on a journey for legendary riches. Repair your machine as you drive across a vast open world toward the edge of the world — the “Endpoint.” Build your deck, plan your strategy, conquer dungeons, and grow your treasure collection.

title: Vampír: Vengeance
description: Vampír: Vengeance is a fast-paced first-person shooter set in the criminal underbelly of late 90s Europe. Play as a special ops soldier turned vampire, hunting the creatures that made you through a world of crime, corruption, and blood.

title: Alaturka
description: An oldschool open-world action game set in 1970s Bosforus. You came as a döner kebab apprentice to your uncle. Slice the spit, deliver the wraps, and meet locals who offer shady jobs that pay better than honest work. Alaturka captures the chaotic, unforgiving spirit of the classic retro era.

title: Demons' Timeline
description: Cyber Detective L solves Paradoxes—bizarre incidents by supernatural Demons—via the social media giant Parrotter. The Cyber Detective Squad, L and his Demon partner Nyasuteria, wield elite hacking and psychic powers to take on the final Paradox investigation.

title: You Remembered
description: Type letters that fall and become part of the world. Use their shape and attributes to navigate the puzzles and secrets.

title: Hydlide 3: Arranged
description: Remake of Hydlide 3, first released in the "Hydlide 1, 2, 3" collection

title: The Last Cat in the Universe
description: Gather the remains of a dying space station to build a cozy home for the last cat in the universe. A short, narrative-driven incremental game about finding peace in the face of darkness

title: Intimate Massage with Snowleopard Lady
description: Fully animated with Live2D!! Experience immersive interaction with both front & back positions and a variety of tools! Following “The Fox Lady”, this is a seductive furry-touch game made for kemono lovers!

title: MetalMuters
description: Half puzzle, half roguelike, mini-factory game where you turn lead into gold!

title: Fairytale Thief: The Steadfast Tin Soldier
description: A reimagining of the fairy tale in visual novel format.

title: Sifu Kidnapped!: Adventure in the Women's Kingdom
description:
This is the ultimate choice between Buddhist compassion and mortal desire! Assume the role of the protagonist Chen Yi in first-person perspective, making crucial decisions in demon-subduing puzzles and sweet interactions. Every conversation shapes favorability, and every choice alters the fate of the Three Realms. Will you honor the bet between Tathagata Buddha and the Demon King, sever earthly ties, and attain Buddhahood? Or follow your heart and spend a lifetime with your beloved?

Many distinct endings await—from achieving Buddhahood in the West to staying in the Women's Kingdom, from becoming a dragon palace son-in-law to wandering the world. Every step writes your unique time-travel adventure!

title: Late Night Duty
description: A short, linear narrative-driven psychological horror walking simulator set in Malaysia. Play as a traumatized veteran on his first night as a school security guard, where routine patrols quickly reveal that something is wrong within the school.

title: The Last Departure
description: The Last Departure is an atmospheric horror game set aboard the final run of a closing train line. Find your way out or loop forever.

title: Re:Blade
description: Re:Blade is a cursor-driven action roguelike with incremental progression. Control your positioning while attacks fire automatically, shape your build through Awakenings, and face sudden boss invasions.

title: Dead by Daylight: Stranger Things Chapter 2
description: Dead by Daylight: Stranger Things Chapter 2 includes a new Killer, Vecna, The First, and new Survivors, Dustin Henderson and Eleven. Purchasing this Add-On unlocks the Mind Flayer Badge and the Bloody Rainbow Room Banner.

title: Tut Tut Vroom Vroom
description:
Tut Tut Vroom Vroom is a fun and addictive low-poly racing game with sophisticated vehicle physics.

Explore six maps packed with boosts, ramps, traps, checkpoints, loops, and obstacles! Survive the "Boulder Escape" mode, pull off your best drift combos in "Drift" mode, and reach the end of the obstacle courses in "Time Trial" mode!

A sandbox map is also available to test your car's suspension, different surfaces, and of course, the physics engine and collision mechanics.

Remember: don't touch the lava, don't hit the traffic cones and, above all, keep an eye on your fuel gauge!

title: Meaningless Random Numbers
description: Meaningless Random Numbers is an Incremental Horror Game about earning cash through Random Number Generators but be cautious, God is Watching.

title: Rixa
description: Team up with friends as a melee enjoyer or use unethical ranged abilities to fight the alien menace in this Sci-fi meets Fantasy MMORPG. That's right.. Sci-fi MMORPG! Explore the planet of Rixa using a unique NanoBot ability system and a host of weapons at your disposal. For the Queen!

title: Bloodrune
description: Bloodrune is an adventure game where you walk and talk your way in and out of various terrible scenarios. Plunge into Marina's depressing life and do your best to save her from what lurks in the shadows.

title: Birb
description: Start as a humble birb, eat popcorn, and evolve into a cosmic force of nature! Birb blends addictive idle mechanics with active roguelite expeditions. Build your nest, catch rare fish, challenge bosses, and compete on the global leaderboard. How many pecks will it take to rule the world?

title: Remi
description: An action RPG about Remi, the last remaining member of the Vanguard. Engage in challenging combat with the Plagued, mind-controlled enemies to fulfill Remi's oath to save the world from these monsters. A passion project made by a single developer.

title: Don Memo
description: Don Memo is a brave bull who embarks on one final journey across Costa Rica to rescue his granddaughter and confront Pisuicas. Fight against legends and shadows of the past in this 2D pixel platformer, while carrying the legacy of a family destined to protect the world from evil.

title: Perfect Loop: Soleris
description: Perfect Loop: Soleris is a tactical turn-based RPG with two heroes and two progression systems: loot-based abilities for one, deck-building for the other. The time loop resets your loadout roguelite-style, but quest progress carries over.

title: Movie Business: Die Welt der Filme
description:
This game, still in beta, plunges you into the exciting world of the movie industry. You take on the role of a producer or director and manage the entire production process – from brainstorming and casting to marketing. You'll need to manage your finances wisely, cultivate talent, and react to trends to make your film a huge success.

The game is ideal for anyone looking for a glimpse into the complex world of film production – without dry theory, but with a healthy dose of strategy and fun. In the beta, you can already try out different genres and compete against other players, while the development team continuously adds new features.

Whether you're a film buff or simply enjoy virtual challenges, this movie business game combines creativity with management and delivers thrilling entertainment.

title: Stellar Shipyard
description: Stellar Shipyard is a space colony sandbox where you design modular ships and stations, and automate resource production using drones and workers. Let the automated systems fly even the most improvised designs. Face rival factions and threats solo, or alongside friends as allies or rivals.

title: Skulltiverse II
description: Skulltiverse II is 35 map community megawad organized by ViolentBeetle, split across 6 unique themed episodes (Space, Dark Industrial, Corrupt City, Corrupt Ancient, Hell Castles, Space Hell), and uses extensive dehacked support for a custom weapon loadout, 22 new enemies, and 6 custom bosses.

title: White Silence
description: After crashing in the winter wilderness, you wake up in the middle of a blizzard. The forest is dead, the roads are gone, communication is lost. The only chance of salvation is a village hidden in the snow.

title: Haramimura: When a Wife Becomes a Villager
description:
Nagisa and Haruki have a happy marriage. They always get along, Haruki has a great job, and Nagisa is a happy wife. Their only disappointment is their lack of kids.

Together, they move to Haramimura, a rural village known to bless its residents with plenty of children. But it isn't long before cracks begin to form in the veneer of perfection that the villagers try so hard to maintain. Will Nagisa and her husband get to the bottom of Haramimura's many mysteries and build a happy life together, or was leaving the big city the last mistake they'll ever make?

title: Bloomies
description:
Bloomies are cute little creatures born from seeds and eggs, growing while you go about your day on your PC. But peace doesn’t last forever because Shadow Bloomies are waiting for the right moment to invade and take over your taskbar world.
In Bloomies, you plant seeds, grow eggs, and hatch over a hundred unique Bloomies, each with different ranks. Raise them, collect rare Sparkle Bloomies, and watch your tiny companions live their lives.
When Shadow Bloomies attack, your Bloomies automatically jump into battle. Defeat powerful bosses in order to unlock new seeds and items.
Prefer a calmer experience? Cozy Mode lets you disable combat entirely and simply enjoy collecting, decorating, and customizing your Bloomies at your own pace. You can even automate your experience through the skill system.
Bloomies is a cozy monster-collector with light farming and idle elements that runs directly on your taskbar . But it doesn’t have to stay there. Resize it, move it anywhere on your desktop, and create multiple profiles to match your mood. Decorate your world with tons of items, dress your Bloomies with adorable hats, or even turn Bloomies themselves into hats.

title: Edge Of Dread
description: A simple job at the mayor’s mansion turns deadly. Plan an escape attempt through shifting puzzles and locked corridors. Collect tools, create distractions and hide from the relentless monster. Uncover the truth and find one of multiple exits before a mistake foils your plan.

title: Isekai HKV
description: “Isekai HKV” is a 2D top-down pixel-art roguelike themed around VTubers traveling to another world. Players take on the role of the hero “DD,” gain the cheat skill “Unlimited Gacha,” and adventure with VTubers to defeat the Demon King!

title: Mousement
description: Mousement is a simple Game, your Quest is it to move the Red Block by using your Mouse to reach the Finish while avoiding Surikanes and not falling down.

title: Hangler
description:
Hangler is a short survival horror game in which you are tasked with exploring the depths of a long abandoned mine finding the emitter, a strange crystal emitting radiation that's believed to exist at the very bottom of the frozen caves.

You will of course not be alone down here, there's a species of "Hanglers" that have made their home in these tunnels, guarding the emitter. They are usually stationary unless triggered, doing so is not recommended.

Beat seeds, unlock new ways to play, and be fast.

title: Clicky Islands
description: Clicky Islands is a unique blend of incremental gameplay, clicker mechanics, city-builder elements, and resource management. You play as a governor appointed by the king to discover and develop a new island for his future kingdom.

title: Saint George's Tavern
description:
Hilarious tavern simulator set in the early 1800's. Take food and drinks orders, catch and cook the food, pour ales and serve. A cozy game that occasionally ramps up the pace for a short while with tavern fights, drinking games, arm wrestling, happy slaps and many more.
Decorate your tavern ready for Christmas and watch as a choir of chickens sing Christmas carols to entertain your customers.
Earn money, buy new items, hire a worker, and increase your tavern rating. The tavern with the highest rating in London will be hosting King George III for Christmas dinner - guaranteed to be an absolute spectacle!!

title: A Stray Line
description: A STRAY LINE is a point and click Adventure Game with a spoonful of autumnal love and body horror. Explore a strange world, draw to cast spells, and discover what becomes of a lonely little family in the woods.

title: Gensou Makyou Kitan
description: There was a man whose luxury cruise ship sank during his honeymoon, leaving him and his wife stranded on a deserted island. However, his wife fell ill there and passed away shortly after. Unable to bear living in the place where his wife died, he rowed out to sea, and while on the verge of death with no food or water, he was rescued by a passing ship. That ship was en route to an uncharted region on a top-secret mission to search for mermaids.

title: Trolls de Troy: La Cité de la mort rose
description: Trolls de Troy : La Cité de la mort rose on PC is an french exclusive adventure game based on the comic book universe by Mourier and Arleston. You control two little trolls who must fight against humans determined to wipe out your race by sending you to a beautiful, pink world, the complete opposite of your own. With some point-and-click elements, the game maintains the humorous tone of the series.

title: Drudge
description: You are a slave. A collar with three lights hangs around your neck: each one fades and shocks you for mistakes or disobedience. Your life is quotas: sorting waste, growing food, and expeditions into lower levels with zombies. Earn, unlock passages, buy gear, and seek a path to freedom.

title: I Am Coin
description: Life is tough when you're small change. Make every Cent count in this physics-based challenge and Become Savings!

title: Escape From Yandere
description: Yandera has locked you in your house and is asking for a declaration of love. You can stay with her or try to escape. Explore the house, but be careful, Yandera can kill you.

title: Zombie Exodus: Safe Haven - Part Four
description:
Zombie Exodus: Safe Haven — Part Four continues your story as you survive in your new haven, a rural junkyard, in Central Colorado. Continue your story from earlier parts, or skip right to the new chapters with a new original or pre-made character!

With five brand new chapters and another 1,000,000 words, Zombie Exodus: Safe Haven is now more than 2,700,000 words in total! That's 70,000 words each time you play Part Four alone, and more than 210,000 for the full game. Given the number of paths from beginning to end, you can have a unique story every time and still never see all there is in Zombie Exodus: Safe Haven! Also new in this update: full color character portraits!

title: Butcherman
description: Experience the psychological horror of being kidnapped by a serial killer. Driven to escape, explore everything around you, use your wits, uncover secrets, and face the unimaginable dread of being in the victim’s place. Based on a true story.

title: Mia & Mio
description: A witch who lost everything, and an old cat who promised to protect her. Mia & Mio is a hand-drawn visual novel about witchcraft and finding hope in dark times.

title: Chicken Coop Invaders
description: Save the chickens! Help Lucas defend the chickens against a ruthless alien attack in this frantic FPS game with Tower Defense elements! Battle through dozens of levels, make allies, buy and upgrade items!

title: Huglings
description: Huglings is a cozy adventure for 1-4 players where you can help the huglings restore their village, which was damaged by the goblins. Create peace as you farm, craft, and decorate your dream home. No pressure, just a peaceful world to explore and a heartwarming journey of friendship and helpfulness!

title: Drift Market
description: Destroy supermarkets, fight absurd bosses, and turn your trolley into a weapon of mass destruction! Drift through chaotic stores as a furious mutant fruit and unleash over-the-top, physics-driven mayhem in this ridiculous smash ‘em up.

title: Faraway Feathers
description: The sequel to Wanting Wings, which was bundled with it in the English release.

title: Kriegsspiel: 7 Years' War
description: Play as a 7 Years' War General in this real-time wargame. You command huge armies, but depend on couriers to send orders to your troops and to be aware of the situation on the battlefield. Think strategically, and send the right orders to win every battle of the game's campaigns !

title: Monday Meow
description: Cats, a deserted island, and office equipment! A corporate retreat to a deserted island goes horribly wrong, and it's up to little ol' you to find everyone and bring them back to camp.

title: Zone 404
description: Fight against ruthless hordes of zombies, break through infected ruins, collect codes and keys, read notes left in a hurry, and search for clues. Each step may be the last, but it is the only one that brings us closer to the truth about what happened in Zone 404.

title: Snägäri Pinball
description:
Snägäri Pinball is a classic 2D pinball game set in the late-night afterparty world of Finnish snack kiosks. Players control a single hand-drawn table designed around ramps, lanes, gates, ball locks, events, and score-chasing challenges.

The game features multiple visual and rule variations, including Finnish Mode, Over-The-Top Mode, and an Analog Horror Mode with CRT-style effects. Optional seasonal table themes add holiday and national celebration variants throughout the year.

A dedicated Kids Mode replaces adult humour and nightlife references with family-friendly art, music, and separate leaderboards. High scores, achievements, multiball events, and hidden secrets support replayability across different modes.

title: Find All: Valentine's Day
description: Test your attention and go on a look for different items with your loved one. Explore the cozy waterways of the town on Valentine's Day and find all the hidden objects to make the black-and-white picture burst into bright colors.

title: Rise of Atom
description: A retro-futuristic, sci-fi, turn-based management RPG. Become the CEO of an R&D behemoth: hire scientists, woo investors, dabble in corporate espionage, and forge the science of tomorrow. Whether the technological wonders that emerge will save humanity—or doom it—is up to you.

title: Dungeon of Slyn
description: Dungeon Of Slyn is a roguelike role-playing game in which you'll get to explore a randomly generated dungeon with lots of dangers at every corner.

title: Greedy Greedy Gnomes
description: A short incremental game set in a sleepy RPG town. Smash pots, recruit gnomes, raid mines, unlock upgrades, and optimize everything until you’re FILTHY STINKING RICH!

title: BND Legenden: Operation Blackout
description: BND-Legenden: Operation Blackbox ist das erste offizielle Videogame des BND. Das Spiel vermischt Action-Adventure und Stealth mit weiteren beliebten Gaming-Elementen. In einem futuristischen Setting erhält Agentin AJ den Auftrag, geheime Informationen zu einer gefährlichen Cyberwaffe zu beschaffen.

title: BumSlayer
description: BumSlayer is a fast-paced hack’n’slash - action arena brawler where only the toughest survive. Fight through stages, facing waves of dirty street bums and powerful bosses that stand in your way.

title: Fugitive Free Rider
description: The chairman’s daughter ran away without doing her assignment. Join the group project, take down the troublemakers, and capture the chairman’s runaway daughter. A thrilling hack-and-slash “musou” action adventure with a cast of colorful, distinctive characters.

title: Bones and Coins
description: An incremental auto battler dungeon crawler where you build a synergized hero party to slay enemies and loot items. Unlock weapons with unique attack styles. Gear up your hero team and explore new dungeon rooms filled with enemies and legendary drops.

title: Djinn Scrolls
description: Djinn Scrolls is an action roguelike set in a dark world inspired by ancient Jinn folklore. Wield elemental magic and Prime Scrolls that unleash spells through conditional triggers. Craft deadly synergies, adapt your build mid-run, and survive relentless enemies and cursed bosses.

title: Absølve
description: Welcome to Absølve, a dark fantasy based hack-and-slash game, where you fight wave after wave of demons hordes using the chaotic Wheel of Judgement system to try and defeat as many monsters as possible in an attempt to gain absolution.

title: Alchemortis
description: Alchemortis is a roguelike inventory-management auto-battler about alchemy. Transmute and combine items to merge their stats, properties, and forms, then organize your inventory to unlock powerful synergies. Experiment, optimize, and craft the perfect build through the power of alchemy.

title: Ranger
description: Ranger is a short, permadeath adventure game. Armed with only your wits and whatever you can forage off the floor, explore a living and breathing open-world.

title: Escape the Riddlerock Ruins
description: Explore the ancient Riddlerock Ruins with your loyal dog in this first-person escape room game. Solve puzzles, decipher ancient inscriptions, uncover hidden passages, and master ancient mechanisms left by a lost civilization.

title: S-Mail
description: After the death of your lover May, you suddenly receive a new email: she is back, in the form of AI "M". The lover who "lives" in the mailbox, who is strong and eternal, always online, and always loves you. You just need to send letters to her: your choices will affect her and the story.

title: Resultare
description: Drop into the chaotic thrill of Resultare, a pachinko rouguelike where precision and chaos collide! Smash through colorful boards, build powerful combos, and chase high scores as you fight your way to victory one bounce at a time.

title: My Tiny Park
description: A management sim where players build their own parks. Attract animals, manage staff, and create amazing outdoor spaces.

title: La Artesana de Rostros
description: As the "Artisan of Faces", your role is to build a new mask for each spirit.

title: Ruins of Blackspire
description: Ruins of Blackspire is a Rogue-like Dungeon Crawler with RTS Elements. Go through a dungeon and defeat enemies by approaching them tacticly with a wide variety of spells and items at your disposal.

title: Calmed by the Dαrk
description: Calmed by the Dαrk is an open-world Action-RPG where you can explore the fantastical world of Umbra Milenio. You play as John, a regular guy that ends up with the power to change the entire world. Break the rules, unlock new powers, make friends (or foes) and decide the fate of everyone!

title: Stand: Sins of the Immortals
description: Rise as a cursed immortal bound to an endless war against a relentless horde. Witness every drop of blood and shattered bone in brutal 3D combat with realistic visuals. Unlock new powers through real-time skill upgrades. Whether alone or with allies, only one thing matters—how long can you stand.

title: Arcade Shop Simulator
description: Run your arcade shop! Bargain for machines, set them up, and let kids enjoy the fun. Earn money, keep your shop clean, and customize it with stylish accessories. Need more space? Expand your shop and build the ultimate arcade empire, then play your Arcades after hours and compete with other players!

title: Agrocracy
description: A farming management game focused on planning and numbers. This is not a farming sim - no driving, animals, or role-playing. Manage weather, labor, capital, and time on a large isometric map.

title: Cold Rails
description: Cold Rails is a horror adventure set on a cold train. You work as a bartender, serving drinks to passengers and uncovering a story as a mysterious woman in a dress stalks the train.

title: Cursed Meal
description:
You start working at a quiet church.
The halls are empty.
The priest is kind.

Something is wrong here.
And it wants to stay hidden.

title: Rance 01
description: A placeholder page for the censored Steam release of Rance 01: Quest for Hikari.

title: Olga Doesn't Die
description: The imperial family's advisor is a witch, a hag, the devil in disguise.

title: Mortal Kombat 11: Hellspawn Jacqui
description: Play as Hellspawn Jacqui, inspired by the Image Comics character Spawn.

title: Mortal Kombat 11: Time Lord of Apokolips Geras
description: Play as Time Lord of Apokolips Geras, inspired by the DC Comics character Darkseid.

title: Mortal Kombat 11: Cassie Quinn
description: Play as Cassie Quinn, a playable Cassie Cage skin inspired by DC's Harley Quinn.

title: Mortal Kombat 11: War Games Sonya Blade
description: Play as War Games Sonya Blade, inspired by Klassic Arcade versions of this iconic Mortal Kombat character.

title: Mortal Kombat 11: Avalanche Sub-Zero
description: Players who purchase the Mortal Kombat 11 Ultimate Kollector's Edition receive this exclusive playable skin. Inspired by the Ultimate Kollector's Edition Sub-Zero bust statue, Avalanche Sub-Zero will bury the kompetition.

title: AlterMage
description: AlterMage is a first person metroidvania that combines spell-slinging action with a cerebral exploration experience. As an aspiring mage seeking to learn sorcery, you find yourself upon the shores of a forbidden island fortress. Take up your staff and set out on a journey that will challenge your mind, body, and spirit as you uncover the truth behind the citadel's origin.

title: Tamzin Twins: The Tyranny of Tyrek
description: Tamzin Twins is an action-RPG adventure with countless enemies of all sorts, magic spells, sword agility combat, breathtaking locations, tons of loot and miniature baseplates for all characters.

title: The Last Day of Adolf
description: Play as Adolf on his last day in the bunker, the Nazies have lost the war and you get to play out the events that follow with a humorous and dark twist.

title: Father, Son & Holy Guns
description: Holy Guns is a fast-paced roguelite multiplayer game set in a bizarre world where faith fuels firepower and every run tests your sanity!

title: Hinterkaifeck: The Farmhouse Murders
description:
If you enjoy psychological thrillers inspired by real, unsolved cases, this experience is built for you. Hinterkaifeck: The Farmhouse Murder is inspired by the infamous 1922 Hinterkaifeck murders, reimagined as a fictional “what-if” scenario.

This is not a fast-paced action game. It is a slow, atmospheric survival experience driven by tension, limited resources, and the feeling of being watched.

title: Texmaster
description: Texmaster is a cross-platform, free Tetris fan game, that simulates the gameplay of the Tetris: The Grand Master series.

title: Cue Room
description: Cue Room is a rogue-like billiard game. Shop balls with special abilities, pot them, embrace their unleashed chaos and repeat.

title: Dijeweled Remastered
description: Dijeweled is a free Bejeweled fan game, that features gamemodes from all games in the series, playable in multiplayer.

title: Where Winds Meet: Spring's Bliss
description:
Version 1.3 of Where Winds Meet, also known as "Spring's Bliss."

This update includes extra energy rewards and battle pass (Spring Bonus), new challenges (Drunk Martial Artist, Coffin Master, & Taiping Mausoleum), a new sect (The Masked Troupe), fresh character appearances, a 3v3 arena, along with other events, optimizations, and fixes.

title: Necrowhisper
description: A tense investigative horror experience for solo or up to 4-player co-op, where you search for clues in the dark to uncover the truth behind a spirit’s death before something else finds you first.

title: Destiny Worlds
description: An Interegalactic Sheriff needs to solve the mystery of a new terrorist known as the Dragon Whisperer before it is too late. For fans of Science Fiction and Anime, as well as Visual Novel enthusiasts who want to uncover every secret ending there is.

title: The Swashbugglers
description: A cartoon-style 2D roguelike autochess focused on tactical strategy. Recruit insect "heroes" from the forest to form a team. Develop their skills, equipment, and stone inscriptions through battles to defeat the source of chaos within the time limit.

title: Sorter
description: Enter a serene world of falling cubes, mysterious chutes and bright colors. Build solutions, solve puzzles, and unlock new abilities in this chill first-person game where even the simplest task might hold a deeper purpose.

title: Kingfisher: An Autism Tale
description: Experience how people with autism see, feel and interact with the world around them in this thrilling detective adventure, taking place near the Belgian coast and in the woods around a local nature reserve.

title: Prison Fury
description: Prison Fury is a 2 player co-op puzzle platformer game. Pair up across mirrored prison stages to solve interdependent puzzles—door sequences, platform chains, patterns, levers and more. Runs are intense and can take 16–45 minutes.

title: The Kulka
description: One-button bullet-heaven where a single shot mutates into neon chaos. Imagine Flappy Bird colliding with Vampire Survivors. Full version adds online leaderboards, challenges and unlockable gear.

title: DraftPunk
description: DraftPunk is a CCG with a focus on limited draft play. Set up a draft pod and invite your friends, or play against AI bots. Free to play on Steam!

title: Toymaker: Threads of Joy
description: Toymaker is a toy-crafting and store management simulator set in the 1910s Spain. Meet unique customers and colorful locals in a bustling city, and discover a magical story based on a folk legend. Follow two different mythic paths, and change the future of your hometown!

title: Woo Woo
description: Woo Woo is a puzzle-exploratory horror roguelike. Clean up the haunted house by midnight, exploring eerie rooms and their inhabitants, or your dad will eat you!

title: Remote Control
description: Remote Control is a JOI game focused on Femdom / BDSM. Obey your fembot dominatrix by successfully completing her tasks and you may be rewarded. Disappoint her and punishment awaits. Procedurally generated sessions based on your preferences and past performance offer limitless replayability.

title: Leap Frog
description: A lone frog, flushed from its home in the laboratory atop the mountain must make its way home! Climb your way out of the sewer, and up perilous heights to reunite with your friends and family at the peak! Meet new friends along the way, solve mysteries and unlock your full potential!

title: Bound Crystal Saga
description: Bound Crystal Saga is an action RPG where you control one of four unique heroes, each with distinct abilities and personalities. The day and night cycle, as well as the weather, influences events and even the heroes' powers. Bind the crystal, choose your hero, and save the kingdom!

title: Synergism
description: Synergism is a free-to-play Idle game about... well, Synergy! Explore that concept through hundreds of upgrades, many reset layers and probably thousands of hours of content that allows both idle and active play.

title: Colony 28
description: Colony 28 is a raw piece of Czech gaming history. Step into the circuits of a malfunctioning android, defy your alien masters, and fight for humanity's remnants across 8 sprawling levels. Experience an authentic 90s sci-fi classic in its original Czech version.

title: Void Salvage
description: Salvage derelict ships, uncover strange points of interest, and survive hostile ambushes in this incremental auto-combat game. Upgrade your ship, collect loot, stack wild synergies, and become absurdly overpowered.

title: Brotherhood of Pain
description: Bound to the will of the necromancer Zndan, your party is dragged back from death. Conquer cursed dungeons, loot the rarest artifacts, endure resurrections, and fight to reclaim your souls. Welcome to Brotherhood of Pain.

title: Cave! Cave! Deus Videt.
description: Episode 0 of a visual novel made with Ren'Py for Bosch Art Game international competition 2013. Inspired by the works of Jheronimus Bosch.

title: Dragon Quest VII Reimagined: Additional DLC Sets
description: A DLC set that will enhance your adventure, including additional contents, character costumes, and useful items for DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined.

title: Le Petit Raccoon
description: Le Petit Raccoon is a stealth cooking game where you must steal food to cook for your hungry guests! Steal food from the grocery store, but don't get caught! Time is of the essence, and your customers are waiting.

title: Slither Realm
description: Help the snakes rest without disturbing each other by filling up the available space! Use your analytical skills to solve the puzzle and guide the snakes to their perfect resting spots.

title: Entity Research Group
description: First-person psychological co-op investigation horror. Players act as researchers, completing tasks and gathering evidence to identify various entity types.

title: Metal Goose
description: Play as the MG-1 super soldier in this gritty and wacky first-person boomer shooter, and mow down hordes of robotic birds in an endless global war between the Chickens and Geese.

title: Mewts
description: Want to play as something cuter than humans? Play as Mewts! Compete in Football but would you love me if I was a worm. Smash your face into your friends at high speeds! Fight it out in crazy arenas for up to 4 players in a punchable distance or online.

title: OneTry
description: The world we once knew no longer exists, the infected are everywhere. Will you be able to keep your sanity? Among hidden clues and scarce resources, you must find a way to escape. Fight for your survival.

title: Pink World 2
description:
A young girl named Eileen is excited to start her first day as an intern on a farm. However said farm and by extension the world change forever when a flash of pink light hits.
A sequel to the first Pink World Visual Novel
The story takes place parallel to the first but in a different location, showing the vast reach of the new pink sky, where everyone under it is slowly turned into hot studs and sluts, not knowing that their chosen spoken words have huge implication on their transformation.​

title: Pink World 3
description:
Overview:
