title: Idle Demon Summoner
description: A dark yet vibrant idle game featuring creature collecting, tower-defense, and bullet-heaven elements. Unlock new demons and weapons to conquer distant worlds.

title: Party Pong
description: A fast-paced beer pong party game with an action card game twist, make the shot, draw a card, and turn momentum into mayhem.

title: I Am a Rock
description: A rock's solar system odyssey.

title: Loss Prevention
description: Loss Prevention is a 1v5 game where players face off in a supermarket. Some players are Shoplifters who work together to collect all the items on their shopping list before time runs out. The other player is a Shopkeeper, whose job is to catch the Shoplifters and stop them from getting away.

title: Lambda Enigma
description: Lambda Enigma is a unique and progressively difficult mechanical coding puzzle game that requires intelligence, rather than dexterity.

title: Jump to Survive 2
description: JUMP TO SURVIVE 2 is a new universe where you can do what you want, live unique experiences with friends, create what you want, drive without limits, play classic mode and all this in one place and with friends!!! Enjoy all this totally free. Welcome to the new era of JTS.

title: Blood Vial
description: Blood Vial is a retro-inspired FPS with a leaking health bar. Swim through the spilled blood of your fallen enemies to keep your vial full. Grow increasingly powerful with new upgrades and weapons.

title: Forest Of Siege
description: A tower defense game set in a magical forest. Watch out for the orcs!

title: Hang Tight
description: Hang Tight is a darkly charming 2D hangman game that tests your word-guessing powers! Step into a grimly whimsical world where each wrong guess inches quirky characters closer to the gallows.

title: Melted Kingdoms
description: Welcome to the Melted Kingdoms, a desolate world of ruins and forgotten secrets. These lands are filled with unexpected adventures, dangerous encounters, extraordinary creatures, political intrigue, and large-scale conflicts, where every choice you make leads to serious consequences.

title: Possess Squad
description: Possess Squad is a post-apocalyptic survival action game where you battle hordes of infected mutants, protect survivors, and fight for your place in a collapsing world. Solo or with friends in local co-op.

title: Flow State: Max Chill Edition
description: Flow State provides a cozy upgradeable space for you to concentrate and be productive without any interruptions. Launch the game, set your focus, and revel in the calming ambiance.

title: Lullabies Made of Static
description: The world is gone. In the silent aftermath of humanity’s fall, you explore the ruins of a post-apocalyptic megalopolis surrounded by industrial brutalist factories, collecting forgotten cassettes that will reveal what human emotions once felt like long ago.

title: Cosmic Anchor
description: Cosmic Anchor is a post-apocalyptic puzzle game about bending the laws of gravity, black holes and causality to your will. Exploit the emergent nature of the universe, and escape the intricate test-chambers together.

title: Ashore & Away
description:
Ashore & Away is a vibrant open-world adventure that throws you into the unpredictable heart of the Bermuda Triangle.
Uncover a rich mystery and storyline. How and when you engage with it is completely up to you. Sail in any direction, tackle challenges in any order, and discover your own unique way home.

title: Abyss Bistro
description: A restaurant romance simulation set in the shadowed world of the Abyss! As you meet its strange residents and grow closer to them, their hidden stories gradually come to light.

title: Diceaster
description: You won't beat this game — A die that destroys itself to climb. Each face is a hit. Use them all and you become a ball: fast, uncontrollable, doomed. A precision platformer with no checkpoints and global leaderboards.

title: Killing Things With Your Friends
description: Rip limbs off mutants and use them as weapons in this chaotic co-op survival game about dark humour and dismemberment. Hack through mutant hordes, work as a team, and survive lethal challenges for profit!

title: The Recipe for Life. A Journey Through Silent Apocalypses
description: You are a traveler with a cracked soul and a house on wheels. Your mission is to listen to those standing on the edge and find the right words before strangers fall silent forever.

title: No Man's Sky: Remnant
description: Upgrade your Multi-Tool and physically manipulate objects with the Gravitino Coil (gravity gun) module in update 6.2, Remnant! Magnetise, carry, and launch stacks of industrial waste - and transport your haul in your off-road Colossus. Deck out your vehicle with an array of new wheels, cabins and modules, earn rewards, salvage materials, join the community in a cross-country road trip… and more!

title: Less Miserables
description: A point-and-click parody of 'Les Miserables', set in the French Revolution

title: Atlanta TD
description: Atlanta TD is a roguelite tower defense game where the armies of the underworld descend onto the Four Spectacular Realms in waves as it falls unto the remaining Gods to protect the city of Atlanta!

title: Northern Adam: The Saga of Revenge
description: An atmospheric Action-RPG set in a dark fantasy world, where exploration and combat are equally paramount. Begin your Saga. Survive. Avenge.

title: Squirrel Simulator
description: Fight, start a family, upgrade your home, climb and fly!

title: Press A
description: Extremely realistic simulator with unprecedented features that let you finally vent all the anxiety modern world induces in you.

title: Qiybz
description: Qiybz is a cube-filled auto-platformer with randomized platforms and experimental music, respecting skill, precision and a good balance between cautious and reckless behaviour.

title: Magic Tower & Maidens
description: Magic Tower & Maidens is a 2D Magic tower adventure game with innovative RPG elements and all kinds of equipment, items and skills you can use. You will play a brother looking for his sister, "even through time and space, break the tower to save her."

title: Lawnmower Game: Find Trump
description: Lawnmower is back. Now your mission is to drive awesome lawnmower in big open world, collect items and finally find legendary Trump

title: Jump By Coronho: Chapter 2
description: A saga continua. O universo de Jump By Coronho é expandido com novos personagens, mecânicas e histórias em Jump: Chapter 2. O jogador ao longo da gameplay vai pegando itens que o auxiliam na experiência, como gancho e a capacidade de construção.

title: Keks Slot Machines
description: Casino online slots slot machines keks, start the game and enjoy the exciting process of the game. This application will plunge you into the vibrant world of casinos like lucky jet or aviator and not only. Play as if gaminator or vegas casino vivaro

title: The Perdition Man: Interval
description: The Perdition Man: Interval is a side scrolling run n' gun steeped in heavy atmosphere. You are alone on your mission and unable to control what you see and what you are about to do. In this single player campaign you must traverse platforming sections and push on through hordes of haunting enemies.

title: Minigames Master
description: Minigames Master is a action-packed parkour minigame collection where you can play a lot of the arcade modern minigames.

title: Void Diver: Escape From the Abyss
description: Manage 'Balusha' antique shop in an anomalous city. Command 'Divers' into the abyss to recover artifacts from city dungeons. Survive and escape alive in this high-quality pixel art extraction action RPG. Face bizarre threats alone or with friends.

title: HVS: Hitler vs Stalin - Battle Of Moscow
description: Play as Hitler on his mission to assassinate Stalin. Try an alternative history where Hitler actually succed with the Third Reich. Race, shoot and explore the Kremlin in Moscow.

title: Project Rogue
description: Explore the endlessly generated dungeon as you kill monsters, level up, and collect loot in this first-person dungeon crawler. Magic items improve your character's stats so that it's easier to use better equipment and learn better spells. You choose how your character progresses.

title: Xdding
description: xdding is a memory game where you have to make the longest combination and survive so that xdd doesn't become ddx

title: Dodge This!
description: Build your super cute character and put him in-front of a barrage of bombs, spikes and whatever else can kill you.

title: Alice Lorange Adventures Season 1
description: “Alice Lorange Adventures Season 1” is an episodic semi-linear story made in Twine, staring an autistic teenager. After a difficult day at school, and a demented nightmare, Alice Lorange finds herself in a strange house. Will she be able to return to Earth?

title: Saratoga
description: Saratoga is a digital implementation of the Saratoga, Volume I of the Great Battles of the American Revolution wargame published by GMT Games and designed by Mark Miklos.

title: Pecado: SD Card
description: Pecado is a first-person folkloric horror experience set in the “España profunda”. Listen to the word of God.

title: Toy Fight
description: 《Toy Fight》is a fun-filled multiplayer battle game. When several players are sent onto the battlefield at the same time, an amusing 'comedy show' begins! Make good use of the terrain and randomly appearing weapons to engage in a fierce fight!

title: Dawn Awaits
description: The journey of a girl and her toy cat escaping a fractured home into a mesmerizing world of mirrored steps and emotional challenges.

title: Regotown
description: Discover the Dark Secrets of Regotown

title: Indicate
description: This game plunges players into a desert adventure filled with challenges and surprises.

title: Powder Runners: Maze Quest
description: Call your friends and take on this epic challenge, play as a team or alone, to prove that you are the best! But remember: only the fastest will achieve glory. Get ready for chaos, lots of fun and mysteries – the maze awaits you!

title: How Smart Are You? IQ Test
description: How smart are you? Take this IQ test and find out!

title: Together Synergy
description: Together Synergy is a 2 player local co-op game where one player controls the left wheel and the other player controls the right wheel. The two players must work together to complete the levels without falling off the platforms.

title: Tag Online
description: The world's most universal game, but with a unique twist! Play a variation of tag where your choices determine whether or not you can tag other players.

title: Five Nights At Monkeys: Flat Mode
description: Five Nights At Monkeys: Flat Mode is a flat screen horror experience where every night is different. Survive roaming monsters, manage tricky power systems, and face sudden jumpscares across forests, canyons, cities, and dark mines.

title: Fireside Journey: The Creative Path of Fireside Feelings
description: An interactive and poetic journey aboard a train that takes you behind the scenes of Fireside Feelings, through personal stories, unseen artwork, and heartfelt encounters.

title: Knight and Code
description: Delicate pixel heroes perfectly merge with vibrant and fantastical Ghibli-style 3D worlds. Freely switch between two main characters, paired with a deep skills and equipment system, composing your own epic in every battle and exploration.

title: Marshallese Dominatrixes Are the Best
description: Experience a session with Goddess Anja, your sadistic, cruel, spoiled, rich, bratty, tanned Marshallese dominatrix.

title: Micronesian Dominatrixes Are the Best
description: Experience the 11th chapter of your journey to session with a dominatrix of every nationality. Experience a session with Goddess Katty, your upbeat, energetic, hyper-sadistic, tanned Micronesian dominatrix.

title: Palauan Dominatrixes Are the Best
description: Experience the 10th chapter of your journey to session with a dominatrix of every nationality. Experience a day with the upbeat, hyperactive, hyper-sadistic, tanned goddess Piyo in Palau.

title: Bruneian Dominatrixes Are the Best
description: Experience the Sixth chapter of your journey to session with a dominatrix of every nationality, with the secretive and anonymous Goddess Boa.

title: Malaysian Dominatrixes Are the Best
description: Experience the fifth chapter of your journey to session with a dominatrix of every nationality, with the slightly unhinged, cruel, sadistically gleeful Malaysian Goddess Kea.

title: Filipino Dominatrixes Are the Best
description: Experience the fourth chapter of your journey to session with a dominatrix of every nationality, with the cold, cruel, no-nonsense Filipina Goddess Mina.

title: Top Drifters
description: A frantic top-down racer with simple old-school arcade controls, vibrant low-poly graphics, high-speed chaotic races and physics-based, drifting-focused driving. Master 10+ different cars with unique driving stats, tear through unconventional. semi destructible tracks and become the "Top Drifter".

title: Bait & Tackle Store Simulator
description: Run your own fishing tackle shop in this first-person simulation game. Order and stock products, manage prices, serve customers, and expand your store over time through simple shop management and steady progression.

title: The Strange Lights
description: You have arrived in a forest where people are rumored to disappear and strange things happen... Locals often see bright flashes and hear strange sounds...

title: Blue Torch
description: Blue Torch is 2d platformer videogame in development

title: Helldivers 2: Machinery of Oppression
description:
In an unprecedented and unforeseeable event, the Cyborgs have returned to once again threaten the liberty and sovereignty of Super Earth and its inhabitants. This nightmarish turn of events follows the discovery that the Automatons seized the schematics for the Star of Peace with the intent to build one for themselves and use it for their dark and violent purpose. They have been tasked by the Cyborg Legion to carry out these crimes.

The Helldivers have been ordered to take on the dark and grim streets of Cyberstan’s cities and stop this collusion of bots and Cyborgs in its tracks!

title: Dwarven Mining Company
description: Manage your own dwarven mine. Give orders to miners excavating ore and builders providing them with ladders to get deeper and deeper into the underground. Mine iron, copper and even mithrill to satisfy the needs of the dwarven kingdom for the price of a single coffee.

title: FighTurd
description: Become #1 while being a #2! Play as an unlikely hero in this quirky action-platformer! Leap into a humorous adventure through dangerous environments, battle creative foes, and master combat as you search for your missing friends.

title: Mystical Demon Farm
description: Mystical Demon Farm is a cute, cozy, but lively farm game that blends farming simulation, monster collecting, and dungeon crawling. Collect Demons, grow your operation, and build an amazing farm worthy of the Queen’s recognition!

title: Car May Fly
description: Jump your WWII-era car across moving warplanes above the ocean. Spin, boost with nitro, dodge mines, lasers, turrets, tornadoes, and UFOs in a high-speed arcade race where the sky itself tries to stop you.

title: Platera
description: As the land of Platera collapsed, a new world unfolded within the walls. Your expressive movement system puts the power in your hands to explore and hack and slash your way through a gothic voxel world, in this 3D platformer metroidvania.

title: Legatus
description: Legatus is a Roman legion simulator focused on the harsh reality of military life. Recruit and train legionaries, construct fortified marching camps, and manage vital supplies. Lead your men through hostile territories, crush tribal resistance, and secure the frontiers for the glory of Rome.

title: Terra Taker
description: Terra Taker is an open-world survival crafting game where you build megastructures to terraform a fantasy planet. Gather resources, build automated bases, and transform floating islands, tornadoes, snowfields, lava zones, and lightning-scorched lands into a new paradise for humanity.

title: Lord of Undead
description: Destroy the castle on the hill in this grim RPG where you play as the Dark Lord. Collect souls, summon an undead army, master dark abilities, craft powerful gear, build your base, and desecrate the lands of a vast open world.

title: Demonbane: Ascension
description: Master elemental combat and mythic artifacts to slay demons and corrupted immortals in this fast-paced action roguelite inspired by cultivation myths. As the chosen mortal, grow stronger with every death to uncover the truth behind the Blood Moon.

title: The Puppet's Casket
description: The Puppet's Casket is a 2D puzzle adventure set in a mysterious Victorian manor. Navigate among eerie marionettes, solve intricate puzzles, and gather clues to seize the artificial eye and uncover the truth behind the Thorn family's tragic downfall.

title: Essentia: A Monster Catching Adventure
description: Isometric dungeon crawler with procedurally generated levels. A wide variety of cute monster characters to collect. A turn-based battle system with unique mana mechanic. Uncover the secrets of the calamity that has left this world in chaos.

title: Security Breach
description: Monitor the surveillance feeds, log anything unusual, and alert the on-call team of oddity specialists who’ll handle the rest.

title: The Brewline
description: The Brewline is an open world bootlegging simulation. Players build their own alcohol empire through production, trade, and NPC interactions while competing against rival gangs. Manage your resources and navigate a dangerous landscape to expand your illegal operations.

title: Star's Peaces Renai Ouen Tomodachi Kakutoku Keikaku
description: A manga-style visual novel game featuring 30 high school students. Hikari Kamikura races around Heisei High School in an attempt to change her friendless situation!

title: Fear Frame
description: A first-person psychological horror about a young woman whose quiet life collapses when she finds photographs of herself on a client’s film roll.

title: Snedronningen
description: An adaption of Hans Christian Andersen's "The Snow Queen", a narrative experience made in RPG Maker MZ for the "RPG Maker Horror Game Jam.

title: Survivors Guild
description: Survivors Guild is a survivors-like bullet heaven with 1-4 player online co-op. Battle across the realm and take on hordes of monsters! Strategically choose your weapons and items to craft powerful builds, challenge bosses, and complete quests. Unlock new characters and unleash their unique weapons and abilities.

title: Backrooms Lost Dimension
description: Backrooms: Lost Dimension is a single-player horror adventure. Explore unsettling levels, solve unique puzzles, and survive terrifying encounters while following an original story. Free content updates with new levels will expand the experience and keep the nightmare evolving.

title: Diablo II: Resurrected - Reign of the Warlock
description:
Hell rises once more in Reign of the Warlock, a transformative DLC for Diablo II: Resurrected. Rediscover the iconic story, gameplay, and challenge that defined the original, now enhanced with additional content and an expanded endgame. Wield forbidden magic as the Warlock, a new class forged from demonic pacts and Hell itself. Discover new builds with brand new items, sets, and runewords. Explore dynamic Terror Zones, face the Colossal Ancients in ultimate endgame encounters, and experience modernized quality-of-life upgrades.

The age of the Warlock has begun; will you master the darkness or be consumed by it?

title: Diablo II: Resurrected – Infernal Edition
description: Rediscover the dark fantasy classic that defined the modern ARPG genre; fully remastered with a new class, fresh content, quality‑of‑life upgrades, and an overhauled endgame. Chain brutal skill and item synergies, rise in power, and carve through Hell's armies with up to eight players.

title: Teddy Collector
description: Not just luck, a skill-based claw machine with real physics, arcade minigames, and dozens of teddies to collect.

title: Void Sanction
description: A sci-fi action RPG. Battle alien hordes with fast-paced combat, evolving weapons, and a combat drone companion. Upgrade your arsenal, defeat challenging bosses, and explore a hostile alien world.

title: Mine Mine
description: Mine Mine is an incremental game about mining ores, upgrading your equipment, and unlocking better and better quarries!

title: Glass Cannon Defense
description: A short incremental game where you defeat incoming enemies and make a glass cannon increasingly powerful.

title: Card Roguelike of Musou Farming
description: A roguelike game of musou battle.

title: Farming With Lasers
description: Incinerate various pests with your giant laser, as you grow your farm. Purchase incremental upgrades to expedite the process.

title: Lepidarium
description: Relax and collect unique butterflies and moths. Witness the real-time lifecycle from Larva to Pupa to Butterfly. Customize lush greenhouses and discover rare species in this cozy idle game. Let your sanctuary flutter in the background while you work or study!

title: Imry
description: IMRY is an atmospheric isometric RPG set in the 1970s Soviet taiga, where your choices shape a story of survival, identity, and a reality that refuses to stay still.

title: Oathwood Realms
description: Oathwood Realms is a dark fantasy strategy card game focused on careful planning, tactical decisions, and calculated risk. Luck plays a role, but victory favors players who read the board and commit to their choices.

title: Rummy Odyssey
description: Rummy Odyssey combines the mechanics of Rummy and Rummikub with Roguelike and Deckbuilding elements. Defeat chance with strategy, manage your deck, and unleash powerful Jokers. Adapt to shifting rules, manage your economy, and survive challenging Boss Stages.

title: Let's Save Mice
description: Join up to three friends in this mouse-sized adventure! Explore, gather resources, solve puzzles, and battle enemies as you try to bring your kidnapped brothers and sisters home

title: Yokai Return
description: This is a Souls-like action game. You fight by switching between characters equipped with different weapons. You can balance your character build with your desire to use a variety of weapons.

title: Cardtonia
description: This is a deck-building card game that blends a 3×3 board, sacrifice summoning, and "3-point alignment" mechanics. As a challenger, you arrive in Diamond Town, a place gathering master card duelists. Here you will grow, battle formidable opponents, and aim to reach the top of Diamond Town!

title: Demon Lord: Just a Block
description: Reborn as a Demon Lord, seek revenge on the heroes! This fantasy roguelite game features grid-based combat controlled using four directional inputs. The world only moves when you do: you attack when you collide with enemies. Plan your moves step by step or play swiftly with dodges and parries!

title: Hearthstone: Cataclysm
description: Cataclysm is Hearthstone's 32nd expansion, featuring 135 new collectible cards released on March 17, 2026. This expansion continues the story of Across the Timeways, where Murozond refused to accept the defeat from Chromie, smashing the Hourglass of Time and opening a portal to a nightmare timeline where Deathwing never fell.

title: Thekku Island
description: A chilling psychological horror set in 1980s Kerala. After weeks of silence, you arrive on a remote island to search for your missing wife. Explore an abandoned house, uncover local folklore, survive haunting encounters, and unravel the island’s buried secrets.

title: Chronicles Reborn
description: As a sworn protector of the Brightwyn Order, uncover lost knowledge in a world rich with secrets. Gather resources, master ancient skills, and face formidable foes across diverse biomes. Build, craft, and fight your way through a vast land filled with quests, mysteries, and untold adventures.

title: Ships That Fight Underground
description: Experience a 6-degrees-of-freedom ship shooter across pulse pounding single player, co-op, and PvP gameplay. Choose your class and ship then customize and upgrade with unique cosmetics, powerful mods, and class-based tech trees. Level up and light em' up!

title: Detective Bogey
description: Detective Bogey (aka Detektiv Bogey on a run) is a video game published in 1997 on Windows by Loudness, art & play GmbH. It's an action game, set in a shooter, licensed title, platform and tv cartoons themes.

title: Dorobune to Zainin
description: A closed-off ghost town, and the unsolved bizarre serial murders that once occurred there. A “daily life collapse” suspense × death game novel ADV that depicts the obsessive love and revenge of 11 people whose lives were irrevocably shattered by that horrific incident.

title: Nekoclaw: Waifu Catcher
description: NekoClaw: Waifu Catcher is a Claw Machine roguelike strategy game where you catch orbs containing girls who auto-battle to the death. Go on adventures with your squad, collect unique figurines, unlock outfits, upgrade your favorites, and grab orbs faster to claim victory.

title: Die for Pay
description: Die for Pay is a CO-OP Multiplayer action crime game where you try to rise from nothing in a world where riots break out every night. Make money by day, gather your crew. By night, stand your ground with honor, or run. When the siren sounds, there's no mercy.

title: Box or Void
description: Box or Void is a puzzle game about reversing positive and negative space. The obstacles in one space become pathways for the other. Move the characters and push boxes to change the layout of the levels. Master this duality and explore worlds with new mechanics that build on this core idea.

title: Brick by Brick
description: Sort thousands of colorful bricks, organize them onto shelves, build whatever you can imagine, and unleash the occasional earthquake. Play at your own pace alone or invite friends to join you online in this relaxing first-person brick sorting and building sandbox.

title: Northgale
description: Harness the spirit of the Northern Wind in this cozy, physics-based exploration adventure. Soar through a hand-painted Nordic landscape with your kite, rescue hidden gnomes, and unlock new flight abilities to restore your ruined homestead. A peaceful journey inspired by Scandinavian folklore.

title: Mörker
description: An old-school dark fantasy action FPS. Fight cultists, undead, and other horrors in brutal combat where everything wants you dead.

title: Choose Your Own Alternative
description: A text-based adventure about exorcising your friend’s Inner Demon. Analyze objects filled with memories, uncover the reason for her possession, talk with her and figure out which object should be chosen for the sacrifice. Save your friend no matter the cost.

title: Old Magic Grandtower
description: Old Magic Grandtower is a singleplayer or 2 player coop puzzle adventure game, combining tactical floor-breaking combat against fairy-tale creatures with challenging puzzles on every floor.

title: Echoes of Eclipse
description: Echoes of Eclipse is a roguelite shoot ’em up survival game that combines fast-paced combat with strategic skill building. Choose your champion, create your ideal build, and survive relentless enemy waves alone or up to 4 players in local co-op on a constantly changing battlefield.

title: The Whispering Bones
description: The Whispering Bones is a roguelike psychological horror where you gamble with a mysterious stranger in the depths of a nebulous wood. Speak to him, unravel his secrets, make bets and win a chance for a better life.

title: Ecrazeus Castle
description: A 3D action RPG looter with dual-wielding weapons inspired by arcade games! Run, jump, loot, power up, and defeat monsters before time runs out, then prove your might by dethroning the owner of the castle!

title: Unicycle Together
description: Unicycles, a ticking bomb, and sausages struggling to stay balanced! In this 2-4 player physics-based chaos game, cooperate with your friends or blow them up! Reach the mountain peak before the fuse runs out. Don’t fall, don’t explode, and try to stay meaty!

title: The Gardener
description: Solve tile based lawn puzzles. Explore the grounds of a forgotten manor. Discover mysterious flora and figure out their rules. Cut grass and have fun!

title: HumanBloodSandwich
description: China's most controversial game in 2020.In the first week in mainland China.The game gained more than 100 reviews.and became a very controversial issue.Valve directly forbidded selling this game in China On 2020-03-13.Now it's a game that can only be played outside mainland China. Please enjoy it.

title: Caves of Qud: Pets of Harvest Dawn
description:
Roasting tortoise shell under the star-ribboned sky or in the darkling vaults of Qud can get lonely. Thankfully, Pets of Harvest Dawn offers thirteen unique companions to keep you company. From the loyal bark of Hylaeus, to the swooning proclamations of E-Ros, to the terrifying astral gaze of Gloaming, you uttering "live and drink" will never go unanswered again.
Whenever you start a new game, choose one of these 13 pets to accompany you. Some are combat-oriented, some have special utility powers. Some are just a pleasure to talk to.

title: The Smurfs: Dreams - Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
This edition includes:
The game "The Smurfs: Dreams"
The "Thief Costume" skin
The game's digital artbook
The game’s digital OST

title: Mega Custom Night
description:
Mega Custom Night is an Ultimate Custom Night fangame built from the ground up without reusing any original code from the base game.

Featuring 80 unique animatronics spanning the first 6 games in the franchise, each with completely original and innovative mechanics.

title: Moving Day: Make It Home
description: Turn empty houses into cozy homes at your own pace. Complete gentle client requests, unlock items for Sandbox Mode, and capture your finished designs in Camera Mode.

title: Unstimulated Simulator
description: Feeling too stimulated? Then get unstimulated across a collection of 20 ‘minigames’ that turn mundane and anticlimactic tasks into a mundane and anticlimactic gaming experience.

title: Kena: Scars of Kosmora
description: In Kena: Scars of Kosmora, Kena is older and renowned as a Spirit Guide. In hopes of finding answers to the affliction she has endured all her life, Kena travels to the mysterious island of Kosmora. Home to distinct cultures and regions, Kosmora is full of buried secrets from a tragic past.

title: They Will Come
description: Survive a nightmare and save your family. They Will Come is a cinematic steampunk horror adventure set in an alternate 1897. You must avoid detection, solve puzzles, and fight back against mysterious enemies with the help of your powerful robot companion, Talus.

title: Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered
description: Play as the vampire Kain and his betrayed lieutenant Raziel. Wield legendary blades, use supernatural abilities, and battle through a world of conflict, intrigue, and prophecy as their paths collide across the dark world of Nosgoth.

title: Brigandine Abyss
description: The king of Solginat is dead, and a new would-be emperor stands over the corpse. Confront the dark in one of six different storylines as you manage resources, rally your monsters, and stand against the empire

title: Dead or Alive 6 Last Round
description: Fan-favorite 3D fighting game Dead or Alive 6 is back with stylish moves, striking animations, and a cast of colorful characters to go head-to-head in the fighting game world's most extreme battles!

title: Rayman: 30th Anniversary Edition
description: Perform Rayman’s signature punch and helicopter hair glide through colorful worlds, from the Dream Forest and its unforgettable mosquito ride to Band Land’s musical chaos. Rescue the Electoons and save the world from Mr. Dark in a classic platforming adventure that remains as magical today as it was in the 90s.

title: Neva: Prologue
description: Set years before the events of the main game, Neva: Prologue tells the story of how Alba and Neva first met.

title: Yakoh: Shinobi Ops
description: Four Shinobi lurking in the darkness. Silent as shadows, racing through the night. To complete their deadly mission, they master their arts—hiding, sparing lives, deceiving—as they venture toward either death or salvation. Evade the relentless pursuit of immortal Hunters, and only by returning alive will their mission be fulfilled.

title: Metal Gear Solid Master Collection: Volume 2
description: This second installment to the collection features “Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots” and “Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version),” and also a digital soundtrack and "Metal Gear: Ghost Babel" as bonus content.

title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
description: 1499. Paris is engulfed in flames as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows. Trevor Belmont, the hero who defeated Dracula, ventures into the burning streets with his daughter, Rose Belmont. Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, they hunt down the beasts bleeding from the looming castle.

title: Stunt Paradise 2
description: Stunt Paradise 2 - more speed, more explosions, more madness! Jump over ramps, dodge lasers, buzzsaws, and rockets while performing insane stunts. With new traps, improved graphics, and pure arcade chaos - get ready for the ultimate stunt challenge!

title: Rev. Noir
description: Drawn together by chance, Asch and Finé set out to stop the Lightfall, a calamity that brings death to all it touches. As their journey to save the world unfolds, they uncover a fate neither expected... Defy cruel fate in the all-new RPG, Rev. NOiR.

title: One, Two, Death
description: One, Two, Death is a co-op psychological horror where you wake up in a mansion with one other person. Trust your partner to escape together — or betray them to earn your own freedom, while a sadistic creature watches every move.

title: Potion Craft Together
description: Need a break? Open your own fantasy potion shop with your friends! Gather ingredients, process them, brew potions, and cure the troubles of customers visiting your shop. Add Potion Craft Together to your Wishlist and prepare to step into a magical world with your friends!

title: Harukoharu
description: Harukoharu is an adventure and puzzle game. But you don’t have to solve the puzzles.

title: Co-Drive Chaos
description: Co-Drive Chaos is a chaotic CO-OP driving game where two players control a single car together. One managing the left wheel and the other the right. To move effectively, both players must synchronize their inputs and communications.

title: Star and Serpent Solitaire
description: Experience Klondike solitaire through classical Tarot cards. Earn gold, claim treasure, unlock Major Arcana cards and if you win... get your fortune told.

title: My Sliem Gets Stronger After It Dies
description: My Sliem gets stronger after it dies is a fantasy RPG where you play as a weak slime. Through repeated rebirths, you grow stronger to defeat foes and uncover a conspiracy. In its top-down pixel world, you move, dodge, and cast spells—turning each death into power.

title: Platyguard: Swarm Slayer
description: PlatyGuard: Swarm Slayer is a 2D action roguelike platformer RPG set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, infused with biopunk and dark sci-fi flair. Survive the chaos, clash with mutant foes, and explore mysterious sites in this indie adventure!

title: The Last Wizard: A Goblin Detective Mystery
description: Investigate a murder as the first goblin detective in a comedic fantasy world without magic...where a wizard is the prime suspect!

title: Tiny Transit
description: Relive the feeling of playing in your toybox in Tiny Transit. An Isometric Delivery game where you; Drive around, Deliver Packages, Navigate Obstacles, Complete Quests and Destroy Everything to earn as much money as you can. Try out the many game modes to set and beat the highest scores possible!

title: Dragon Guardians
description: Evolve your dragons, build your cave, collect rare power cards, and defeat powerful bosses across dangerous lands. Grow stronger with every battle!

title: Crimson Realms: Relics of the Forgotten World
description: Embark on a colorful adventure in Crimson Realms! Battle creatures with four unique attack styles, defeat powerful demons to claim relics, overcome perilous obstacles, and complete epic missions in a world filled with danger and wonder.

title: A Little Physics Roguelike
description: In A Little Physics Roguelike aim to grab the best equipment, then build your unique board with a variety of item to defeat cute enemies.

title: Banana Chaos Clicker
description: Banana Chaos Clicker — An epic idle sim with resource management, crafting, and creature evolution. Build your empire from monkey to dragon!

title: Clicky & Yo
description: Clicky & Yo is a 2d psychological horror narrative experience where you explore unsettling environments, make subtle choices, and face unpredictable events that distort reality and test your perception.

title: Wannabe Galgame God!!!
description: Those who skip Galgames are mere corporate drones; those who play are the true masters of wealth and power. That's just the way of the world! As an ordinary boy, wager your wildest fetishes and your dignity to reach the summit: Become the 'GALGAME GOD'!

title: Sneaker Store Simulator
description: Create and run your own sneaker store. Discover 100+ hand-crafted sneakers, expand into apparel and accessories, and manage your inventory. Renovate your store, compete in auctions, and grow your reputation to become the city’s top sneaker store.

title: Open Fire: Ready
description: This is a very simple first-person shooter game that you can fight enemies in various game modes and maps, experiencing the thrill of shooting.

title: DishDash
description: DishDash is a single-player time management restaurant game where you prepare meals, serve customers, and manage limited resources under constant time pressure, turning kitchen chaos into smooth rhythm through speed, focus, and smart decision-making.

title: Stranded With You
description: In this survival game, you are stranded on an tropical island with your lovely friend Mitsuki. Explore your surroundings together, build a small shelter, and hunt for supplies. Have fun keeping up with all the heat!

title: Mine of My Mind
description: This is a psychological horror where you play as a miner experiencing a midlife crisis. The final shift before a long-awaited promotion goes wrong: reality begins to warp, turning a workday into a nightmare. Will he be able to escape the depths of his own mind?

title: Bottle It!: Beverage Simulator
description: Create unique drinks by experimenting with ingredients, learn from customer feedback, and grow your business from a small stand into a thriving beverage empire in this flavorful simulation game.

title: Gear Slots
description: Spin the wheels of weaponry to incrementally upgrade your gear while endless monsters are defeated by your idle attacks. Watch your hoard of coins grow and find new ways to spend them to tip the scales of luck in your favor.

title: The Hopeless Few
description: Third-person survival roguelite shooter, where you've got 20 minutes before the infection takes over. Use that time to salvage valuable loot & secure the survival of others.

title: Ajnabee: The Unknown
description: Follow Naina’s daily life as it slowly stops belonging to her alone. 🚪 An unseen presence watches ️, remembers , and interferes ️ as her sense of safety slowly collapses. A deeply atmospheric psychological horror set in India, exploring obsession , fear , and emotional vulnerability.

title: La Cosa Nostra
description: La Cosa Nostra is a story-driven 2.5D side-scrolling action game set in 1920s America. Play as an immigrant navigating the world of organized crime, combining melee combat and shooter gameplay within a gritty mafia-themed narrative.

title: Melody Friends
description: Just drop in your favorite song—done! A cute rhythm game that auto-generates multiple difficulties. Play comfortably with any key and clear a song your way with five friends.

title: Offroad Arcade
description: Offroad Arcade is a retro-inspired arcade offroad racing game with switchable pixel effects, multiple game modes, and progression-based unlocks. Race, explore, and master 20 tracks across diverse biomes.

title: Tales of Medieval Duelists
description: Ditch the animations. In Tales of Medieval Duelists, every swordfight is a unique physics-based clash. Master precise, skill-driven combat where timing a perfect parry is your key to victory. Build your legend with deep progression, gear, and a high-risk win streak multiplier.

title: I Wanna Touch
description: I Wanna Touch is a pixel-art platformer where you play as a gliding bunny carried by a strange wind. Master the airflow, collect carrots, dodge deadly traps, and fly toward your beloved. Danger is everywhere—can you survive the journey?

title: Inquiry Counsel
description: "Hold on!" A court battle game set in ancient China's Song Dynasty! In the government office of Lin'an County during the Song Dynasty of ancient China, many bizarre murder cases occurred! The protagonist engages in intense court battles with the county captain of Lin'an to find the real culprit!

title: Odds at Oddity
description: Odds At Oddity is a blackjack based roguelike deck builder. Manage your power betting deck, create diverse combinations and scale your points as far as you can go!

title: Grind TD
description: The gate is open, but it doesn't go across — it goes below. And something is coming up. As the ruler of a pixel realm, you will command the clash of strategies, dive deep into attack and defense, and experience the purest form of the tower defense world.

title: Don't Pause Game!
description: Break the Fourth Wall! This isn't your average 2D platformer—here, the UI is your greatest weapon! Jump on buttons, drag volume bars to cross gaps, and think strictly "outside the box" in this witty 1-bit adventure.

title: 1000 Score: 2D Platformer
description: Try to safely guide the square to the end of the screen! But beware: no dying! One failure ends the game. Are you brave enough to repeat this challenge 1000 times?

title: Portal Guardian
description: You are a Portal Guardian. It is your job to help protect the secret gateways to the Realm. Your people have been kept safe and unaware for centuries, but something dark and relentless has been stirring... Unleash the fury of your towers and magic to defend the portal and the realm or all is lost!

title: Against Wokou Frontline
description: Amidst the Wokou raids along the southeast coast of China during the Ming Dynasty (1552–1565), lead your troops, fortify your line, and repel the brutal invaders in this heroic tower defense game. Defend the common people and secure the shore!

title: Joexian's Basics In Bowling And Video Making
description: A Baldi's Basics Mod Starring Joexian!

title: Akunin-Akka
description: An interrogation game where you play as the detective in charge of a case and interrogate suspects to uncover the truth behind the bombing. Uncover the weaknesses of the unique suspects and get to the bottom of the case!

title: Mazemerizzz II
description: Moe is napping again and this time, it's a NIGHTMARE! The Watcher has Moe trapped in a massive endless maze filled with danger! Zombies, minotaurs and bone crushing, spikey, gaseous, flame filled traps. Equipped with just a torch, Moe must find a way to wake up.

title: When the Barn Sleeps
description: A cozy animal farm game with seasonal cycles, day and night routines, gentle wolf encounters, and relaxing animal care. Raise rabbits, geese, goats, and sheep, produce and sell goods, and let loyal dogs protect your farm after dark.

title: A Certain Incremental Exoplanet
description: Build. Blast. Prestige. Repeat. An incremental game where you build the most productive exoplanet while protecting your enterprise from space pirates. Automate production, shoot rockets, employ an alien and keep on producing.

title: Ramming Turtleship: 1592 - The Imjin War
description: Command the legendary Turtle Ship in this action roguelite set during the Imjin War of 1592. Ram through waves of Japanese warships, upgrade your ironclad vessel, and defend the ocean. Experience the thrill of naval impact and survival.

title: Drunk Mages
description: Drunk Mages is a co-op game. Players are drunk wizards trying to brew potions. Being drunk makes things a bit harder. Each level has its own unique design and different challenges that must be completed.

title: Pawns Survival
description: Pawn Survival is a turn-based survival strategy game where you command a small community of pawns struggling to survive, send them to gather resources, explore unknown lands, grow your village, and forge powerful equipment to withstand whatever this brutal world throws at you.

title: She Danced in the Wind Like a Holographic Dream Before the World Died
description: A short game poem and interactive fiction about The End. You play the very last flower left on Earth, bringing peace to long dead soil. Explore brutalist ruins to collect memories of a dead world. Maybe your presence can heal what is left.

title: The Ark
description: Exploring the dark and atmospheric environments of The Ark.

title: Jequi's Dream
description: Jequi is a little boy who needs to collect as much water as possible to help his mother Jandira and his younger brother Joel to survive the drought of Jequitinhonha valley. Anywhere Jequi passes through, that place regain health and bloom again, and little by little, the dream of a new valley grow.

title: Banana Party
description: Get ready for lots of bananas and tons of laughter! In Banana Party, you control a bunch of curious little monkeys in wild challenges and chaotic minigames. Whether you’re hopping across moving platforms, throwing poop at your friends, or fighting over who collects the most bananas, every round is an explosion of fun.

title: SacriFrogos
description: A roguelike strategy and survival game where ever-growing sacrifices are required to keep the mysterious Eternal Flame alive. Build a colony of Frogos and create unique builds every run.

title: Alien Apocalypse
description: Alien Apocalypse is an open-world sandbox survival game set after a devastating alien invasion. Scavenge for resources, craft, build defenses, and harness alien technology to fight back. Play solo or in co-op and reclaim what’s left of the planet.

title: Delta Online
description:
Delta Online builds upon and improves the original Gears of War 3 release on the Xbox 360 and brings it to Windows PC's.

It includes higher frame rates, full keyboard & mouse support, a newly revamped horde mode, bug fixes, new maps, improved multiplayer, customisable settings, new characters, new weapon skins & so much more.

title: Racing Royale
description: A racing "battle royale" game based around a toy-box aesthetic. Your objective is to race against friends or bots while trying to outrun Goolagar, the Under-The-Bed-Dweller.

title: Tileweaver
description: A Tile-placer Roguelike with Puzzle elements. Build your board, empower yourself and slay monsters in this dark strategic game. Discover a variety of arcane skills and enigmatic artifacts to control the board and delve ever deeper into the abyss.

title: The Perfect Portrait
description: A short visual novel about a robot running an AI art generator painting the portrait of a narcissistic megalomaniac.

title: Decode
description: DECODE is a minimalist logic puzzle game inspired by classic deduction systems. Analyse clues, break digital locks, and uncover hidden rules through text-based challenges. Every move matters. Think carefully.

title: AutoSquad
description: AutoSquad is a turn-based roguelike autobattler where you build and refine a squad of units, choose their formation and strategy, then watch the battle unfold. Recruit new units, combine them into higher tiers, collect relics, and defeat the final boss.

title: Weather Dragger
description: A chill strategy game about dragging weather across a dynamic, ever-shifting world to keep everything in balance. Shape clouds, sunshine, and storms as your map grows, challenges rise, and new possibilities open up each run.

title: APlaceDominatedByFire
description: APlaceDominatedByFire is a bloody, level-based side-scrolling action game. Lao Yinghua, an archaeology major, was struck by lightning while traveling to the countryside for fieldwork to complete his studies, and thus became entangled in a bizarre series of events...

title: Proceed to ICU
description: Proceed to ICU is a Ruin-esque psychological horror game. As the new triage officer in a sinister hospital, your choices in handling daily incidents over seven workdays will unravel its dark truths and lead to diverse endings.

title: SokoGhost: Unfinished Business
description: Pass through obstacles in this block-pushing puzzle game! Beat all levels of the Box Corp skyscraper and reach for the stars by thinking through the box!

title: Mega Kaiju Boom Ball
description: Mega Kaiju Boom Ball is a giant monster-themed break-em-up developed with retro 8-bit constraints in mind. The game mixes the dynamics of breakout, pinball and legendary kaiju into a unique and action-packed 8-bit experience. Can you save the world from a kaiju invasion using just a ball and paddle?

title: Nulla Via
description: NULLA VIA is a WW2 psychological horror set in a preserved, abandoned war town. Explore silent ruins, bunkers, and mass graves where life was erased. Shadows cannot be killed by bullets alone. Use your camera, your weapons, and your sanity to survive. This town was never rebuilt for a reason.

title: Rogualik
description: Rogualik is a rogue-like dungeon crawler where you uncover dark, scary secrets of a surrealistic sweet-filled world. Use ridiculous makeshift kitchen weapons, upgrade your croissant with "Mise en place" assets and defeat all the crumbs that stand in your way!

title: Spellfall: Mages & Mayhem
description: Spellfall: Mages & Mayhem is a fast-paced, top-down PvP arena brawler where up to six mages compete across seven rounds of magical mayhem. Draft new spells and items between rounds, create increasingly powerful builds, and outlast your opponents as the arena crumbles beneath your feet.

title: Dilemma
description: You don't cure patients; you decide their fate. In this grim medical sim, review records and face impossible bioethical dilemmas. Consult the Medical Bible and choose who gets the bed. Every signature impacts your Ethics, Reputation, and Legal Risk. In a broken system, mercy is a dangerous luxury.

title: Reign
description: A multiplayer political strategy game where players control key roles of the late Ottoman Empire. Manage crises, negotiate, manipulate and work together to keep the state alive for 100 turns against economic collapse, rebellion, coups and foreign threats.

title: Keep It Contained
description: You’re part of a scientific team in a sealed facility, racing against time to keep dangerous anomalies contained. One scientist handles the modules, while others guide them using manuals and procedures. This local co-op experience requires two or more players.

title: BattleBoat X
description: BattleBoat X is a combat roguelike where you command a heavily armed gunship through a chain of hostile islands. Fight dangerous enemies, upgrade your vessel, and save the world from certain doom!

title: Quest-Top
description: Step into the role of a Guild Master! Recruit adventurers, send them on quests to collect resources, upgrade your hideout, and enhance their gear — all while you work, watch videos, or play other games.

title: Dark Fantasia
description: Crush the armies of darkness and rise to divine power. Your goal is the fortress where the Great Demon awaits. But remember — you are not immortal. Dodge enemy attacks, find new weapons and perks — only then will you survive.

title: Trox: The Reversal
description: TROX: The Reversal is a dark, story driven first person survival-horror game set in a world rebuilt on sacrifice. Explore and investigate your surroundings to uncover disturbing truths and survive the psychological toll of a collapsing society.

title: Picto-Cross: 1 Nonogram per Day
description: Picto-Cross is a 2D logic puzzle game with a minimalist style, known as nonograms, featuring a total of 372 puzzles based on historical events or celebrations that occur throughout the year.

title: More Love Yuri
description: Voice actress Lu Xi and writer Shu Yu continue their life together. After the incident, they became a fan-favored “official CP,” forced to act close at events. Sweet days flow on, small ripples appear, and their bond deepens—until the rejected Twin Souls ending unfolds in reality.

title: Find Cats 6
description: Pixel World's Hide-and-Seek Cat Challenge! Eight magical realms hide cute fluffy kittens. Solve interactive puzzles, unlock hidden maps, use your wisdom to bring all the furry little rascals home, and enjoy a healing and stress-relieving cat-hunting experience.

title: Dark Edge
description: DARK EDGE is a medieval-themed action game. As darkness approaches, plagues and zombies relentlessly consume the homeland. Players will manage and build city-states, recruit warriors, investigate plagues, and resist zombies and monsters. The game includes single-player, co-op, and PVP.

title: The Housekeeper
description: The Housekeeper is a psychological horror simulation game where you will work as the new night shift housekeeper at an ominous hotel. As you work through your shifts, you will start to experience strange events. Will these events reveal a dark secret, or will they be the cause of your demise?

title: VitvitDriver 3D
description: a late-90s inspired eclectic delivery driving game. perform tricks, stack combos and complete deliveries to earn points across a set of unique maps.

title: Mewlin the Clicker
description: Click to roll the crystal ball across the table, dodging obstacles and facing bosses while building a deck of cards that completely changes your strategy with every run. Help Mewlin, a very curious orange cat, make a total mess in this magical clicker with deckbuilding elements.

title: Duat Wayfarer
description: Become an ancient Egyptian jeweler in this smart strategy game! Traverse Duat’s 12 perilous underworld gates to uncover a long-buried divine conspiracy. Mix ray mechanics & Roguelike gameplay, craft a unique style with enchanted bookmarks, gems & relics. Prove mortal ingenuity topples divine thrones

title: Project Liminal 2
description: Explore terrifying liminal spaces. Horror walking simulator with reality-bending platforming and supernatural threats. Get lost between dimensions.

title: Cloud Shadow
description: In Yunnan, China, there is a rich variety of mushrooms, and the local people have a culture of consuming mushrooms and "picking mushrooms". When a young boy mistakenly eats a hallucinogenic wild mushroom, he embarks on a series of fantastical adventures.

title: Gorotsuki Paradise
description: Gorotsuki Paradise is an online PvP card game where you build your deck as you battle. Recruit over 150 unique "gorotsuki" (Japanese for gangsters, thugs, and outlaws) to dominate a mad city called Saitama. It’s completely free to play, with no pay-to-win mechanics!

title: Please Don't Shoot the Humans
description: Click with laser-focus to blast zombies while civilians wander in like they missed every safety memo. Stack upgrades, unleash turrets, and watch the numbers explode. See how long you can keep pretending everything is under control.

title: Avernoth
description: Sealed away in an ancient alternate dimension, you must find a way to break free. In this fantasy action rogue-lite, uncover a variety of spells to cast your way through waves of hostile magical apparitions. Discover the secrets of Avernoth to make escape possible. Do you have what it takes?

title: Everfall 2: Idle Dungeon RPG
description: Unique Bosses, Loot Filters, Combat Pets, & Pick Your Team of 4 to Customize with Skill trees, Keystones, Abilities, and Runes in a MASSIVE ENDGAME!

title: Mega Trons Survivors
description: Become insanely overpowered in a Tron-style neon grid where swarms never stop. Stack broken upgrades, melt thousands of robotic enemies, complete high-risk side objectives, and deliberately break the balance to dominate the simulation.

title: Bartender Life Simulator
description: What is a bar owner to you? A manager? A bartender? An interior designer? A psychologist? And what if you had to take on all these roles? Interact with customers, manage supplies, craft cocktails, and redesign the interior to earn the title of the best bar.

title: Crazy Hotel Together
description: Discover Crazy Hotel Together, a hotel management game where you and your friends have to run a rather unusual hotel! Fulfill your guests’ requests and upgrade your establishment to transform it from a low-cost hotel into a palace!

title: Guinea Pig Runaway Together
description: Two guinea pigs. One balloon. Endless chaos. Work together or get nowhere in this physics-based co-op parkour challenge!

title: Sector 13: Haunted Woods
description: Sector 13: Haunted Woods is a 1–4 player co op horror game. You are field agents sent into a cursed forest filled with anomalies. Explore mysterious zones, recover forbidden artifacts, and survive the darkness where every sound you make could mean death.

title: Invocation: Ghost Photography
description: Play as a paranormal investigator and explore dark, atmospheric locations where lost spirits still lurk in the shadows.

title: Idle Quest Simulator
description: No complex operations required! Auto-battle through the Underworld, traverse the Dragon Palace, and retrieve the True Scriptures with full idle gameplay.

title: CyberGhitch
description: CyberGhitch is a narrative puzzle game where players team up with an exorcist trapped in a CD to battle "digital evil spirits" born from internet chaos in hilarious, bizarre adventures.

title: Romeow: Home Sweet Home
description: Help a cute cat in this cozy incremental game! You must catch many rats, build your house, upgrade your equipment, and improve your skills to aid Romeow on his mission.

title: Linkling
description: Linkling is a roguelike deck-building game focused on card-based combat. By building card squads and using a rune system, players trigger combat chains in automated tabletop battles and face progressively increasing stage difficulty.

title: Chronicles Meteorfall
description: A semi-open world turn based RPG with detailed class-based and skill building mechanics, deep worldbuilding and lore, and genuine LGBT+ representation.

title: Deluge: Raintime
description: Some things don't willingly submit to the games of man, but develop a grudge that sleeps under the soil for decades— An interactive visual novel with psychological and lovecraftian undertones.

title: Anomaly Corp.
description: Run. Hide. Survive. A deep single-player pure horror experience where you have to escape from supernatural creatures using nothing but a jury-rigged PDA-turned-flashlight. Learn from your mistakes (and others') and get outside of the Amusden Corp's complex.

title: Hydra Heli 2
description: Hydra Heli 2 is a relaxing incremental game about sinking battleships with an overpowered helicopter. Control a swarm of unstoppable weapons, annihilate armadas, collect shards, and utilize the Depot to boost damage, increase firepower, and unlock new regions.

title: Oceanarium Fishing
description: A relaxing fishing and island life sim where you sail into the ocean, upgrade your boat and rod, and choose to sell your catch or display rare fish in a giant show aquarium on your own island.

title: Scrub Dudes
description: A world built from cardboard, fabric and handcrafted creations. Everything is messy and covered in grime, but the Scrub Dudes team is ready for action. Climb, glide, collect trash, fix things and WASH it all clean. Enjoy this cozy handcrafted world.

title: Intersectio
description: Intersectio is a turn-based tactics game about the fragile balance between body, mind, and soul. It tells the story of a person caught between two abysses — to survive, they must maintain equilibrium.

title: Endstation
description: A classic dice game played in a somewhat grungy subway train late at night - how many trips can you afford, how many dice can you collect?

title: Peasant or Rebel?
description: A chaotic, asymmetrical party game for up to 5 players! One player becomes the Lord, while the others are Rebels hiding among the Peasants. Will the Lord expose them in time - or be overthrown?

title: Dead Bit
description: Fast-paced runner-shooter where every run is a risky raid. Blast through enemies, grab loot, upgrade your weapons and gear, and unlock harder raids with new enemies and tactics each time you reach the end.

title: KunKunNest
description: You accidentally entered Kun Kun Nest, where there is a terrifying demon Kun Kun who loves to scare its prey. If you feel anything unusual in the room, please escape quickly.

title: The White Lamb: No Shelter
description: 《TheWhiteLamb:NoShelter》: Psychological Suspense & Fast-Paced FPS Combat. Control the ego, explore the looping dream of Persona Storm and the traumas of id/superego (Red Cloak/Blue Cloak). Promote reconciliation through words and fateful choices, and uncover the truth.

title: Bullet Chain: Vessels
description: Fast-paced, brutal and chaotic. A "Use Your Enemies", Roguelite, Deckbuilding, FPS. Fight through hordes of enemies, and travel through time, on your quest to kill the last Archangel.

title: Paws Coven
description: These damn cats worship eldritch gods and summon monsters from other dimensions in my backyard again. And now they are- Wait! Why did they stop?

title: Max's Adventures: Summer Edition
description: Max’s Adventures: Summer Edition is a surreal comedy adventure. Play as Max, stranded on a dreamlike beach where nothing is as it seems. Explore strange landmarks, survive bizarre hazards, and uncover the mysteries of this sun-soaked, twisted summer world.

title: Smart Farm
description: In Smart Farm you take over an abandoned farm bought at auction and rebuild it with hard work, smart planning and modern agriculture. Restore fields and buildings, care for animals, process your harvest and turn ruins into a profitable farm.

title: Aelwater
description: Memory has weight. The departed are not gone. Step into a village drowned by flood and memory, and search for the final answer about guardianship and farewell among the shattered past.

title: Don’t Turn off the Light
description: Don't Turn Off the Light is a 5-player asymmetrical multiplayer horror game where one player becomes a demon lurking in the darkness. Survivors must rely on light, teamwork, and scavenged weapon parts to avoid possession, escape captivity, and fight back before it's too late.

title: Cuberio
description: A casual strategy-puzzle game where you guide a cube through 100 handcrafted mazes, avoid moving hazards, collect coins, and unlock upgrades.

title: Dolls Made Here
description: You find yourself alone in an abandoned doll factory, assembling and inspecting dolls because you needed the money. Each order ends with the sense that they should never have been shipped, but leaving is no longer an option.

title: Point Zero: Victoria
description: A multi-perspective narrative game where near-death flashbacks unravel the truth. Return to 1990s Hong Kong and uncover four competing versions of the truth through combat and investigation. Spine-tingling twists! A bloodstained mystery spanning thirty years, waiting to be uncovered…

title: Wings of Aviora
description: Become an aviator on the planet Aviora in this steampunk flight action-adventure. Build unique aircraft. Test them in combat and refine them to perfection. Help the locals and drive back the mechanical beasts rising from the sea.

title: The Day That Wasn't
description: Relive the same day without remembering it. Your choices feed four inner alter egos (Shadow, Mad, Alex, and Bully) — shaping reality, glitches, and one of 16 possible endings. The day repeats. Your mind doesn’t. Or does it?

title: Haze of Lucidity: The Fish
description: A first-person psychological horror game about a child in a broken home. Under the watchful eyes of a strict mother, your only friend is a fish in an aquarium. Do your daily tasks and experience a heavy, emotional story where the only thing you want is to be free.

title: GTJ: Grand Theft Japan
description: Grand Theft Japan is a tribute to GTA and Yakuza, set in Japan. Featuring stories inspired by real events: soaring rice prices, roaming bears, yakuza clans, otaku culture, and shocking political incidents.

title: School's Out
description: Trapped in a mysterious place modeled after an old school, an amnesiac hero joins forces with several enigmatic heroines to confront endlessly looping spaces and terrifying monsters. As they search for escape and the truth behind it all, they begin to break free from the fate that binds them.

title: Spingenuity
description: A relaxing incremental game about spinning a wheel. Use your mouse movement to build momentum and set the wheel in motion. Spend your earnings on upgrades to improve the wheel, spin faster, and earn more money. When progress slows, purchase permanent upgrades through the prestige system.

title: Dungeon-Doku
description: Dungeon-Doku is a rogue-lite Sudoku game where you fill in puzzles, gain treasure and face traps while trying not to take damage by messing up. How far can you make it in the dungeon?

title: Phantom the Huntress
description: Not sword-clanging trash. Not glitter-magic garbage. Bow only. The rest is for peasants. I’m Phantom, elite huntress, eternally exhausted. You’ll track, gather, goblin-slay, babysit dumb NPCs and rank up at snail pace. Wishlist now. I get bonus wine money. Do it or vanish. My patience is dead.

title: Rance 02
description: A placeholder page for the censored Steam release of Rance 02: The Rebellious Maidens.

title: The Sigil Engine
description: A magical automation puzzle game where you program a little shikigami automaton using visual spell blocks - explore, harvest energy, and cleanse corrupted sigils in a cozy fantasy world.

title: Nyra: The Fall of Light
description: NYRA: The Fall of Light is a story-driven third-person Action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Follow Nyra on a mysterious journey featuring combat, exploration, atmospheric environments, and character progression.

title: Midnight Ramen Shop
description: Start a tiny night-time ramen shop, serve warm bowls, decorate your cozy space, and turn quiet nights into a thriving business.

title: Werewolf: The Inner Beast
description: Werewolf: The Inner Beast is a 3D third person survival horror game with a female protagonist. Story driven linear gameplay in a dark, claustrophobic atmosphere.

title: The Zyrdain Sands
description: Visceral twin-stick shooter where desert gods sabotage your run with no-shots, sandstorms, and cursed upgrades while you evolve Zyrd's weapons to save the Sacred Stone.

title: Traders Life Simulator
description: Master the Art of Trade. Buy, Trade, Win! Don't just run a shop, dominate the market! The key is finding the right product at the right price. Buy cheap and wait for the right moment!

title: Upload Aliens
description: The rule: DON'T LET THEM TOUCH GROUND! Become the Cyberpunk Knight and launch aliens skyward. Use foes as missiles to trigger chain explosions in infinite aerial combos. Unleash this pixel-art roguelite spectacle with just three buttons: Move, Jump, Dash.

title: Poker TD
description: The most relaxing, difficult, & satisfying game. Poker TD is a hypnotically satisfying card game with tons of replay value. Every game you play is much different then the last. Create broken combinations and see if you have what it takes to win a game of Poker TD.

title: Silent Numbers
description: A promising facility has fallen to ruin, yet experiments continue to torment. Traverse the depths, restore minds turned into code. Troubleshoot repression, live to see tomorrow.

title: Uknon Jones: Portal
description: In this platform and puzzle game, Elsa LOVELUST is equipped with a gate gun. You must destroy objects or teleport her through the portals to help her cross inaccessible places and reach the flag of the different levels of the game.

title: A Wild Heist
description: A Wild Heist is a game where you and up to 3 friends rob banks as raccoons to pay off a gambling debt to the mob. The game includes fully destructible environments, online multiplayer, procedurally generated maps and more...

title: Astralis: Dawnblades
description: Astralis: Dawnblades is a turn-based tactical RPG that combines stronghold management, dungeon exploration, loot-based equipment crafting, and optional rhythm-based combat tied to an orchestral soundtrack.

title: Ultimate Car Company Tycoon
description: Ultimate Car Company Tycoon is a management simulation where you build, research, and grow your own car company. Design vehicles, manage production, make strategic decisions, and navigate dynamic events to dominate the automotive market.

title: Sync Together
description: SYNC TOGETHER is a parkour game focused on keeping a jet-powered flying vehicle balanced by working together. Use coordination, speed, and teamwork to finish the course as fast as possible.

title: Do a Crime
description: Do A Crime is a casually-chaotic-cozy platform puzzler where you play as a Raccoon - doing crimes! Do A Crime takes the whimsy of being a mischievous raccoon and allows the player to live out their chaos gremlin dreams.

title: Inverted Dreams
description: This dream driven psychological exploration game guides you through shifting landscapes shaped by buried fears, fractured memories and unsettling truths. As the world bends, every shadow becomes a clue, and every step pulls you deeper into the subconscious you’ve tried to forget.

title: Deeply
description: DEEPLY is an underwater adventure about treasure hunting, gear upgrading, and exploring a mysterious ocean. Dive off your raft, gather resources, discover artifacts, upgrade your equipment, and gradually get closer to the legendary ship your father devoted his life to.

title: Slay All Bosses: Idle
description: Slay All Bosses: Idle, is a short incremental RPG. Cut down waves of enemies, defeat powerful bosses, and rapidly grow stronger through character skill trees, weapon and skill upgrades, and equipped passive abilities, all on your path to becoming the ultimate hero.

title: Wong
description: Wong is a 2D platformer designed for speedrunning, where you will clear levels, learn their shortcuts, and compete for the best score in a fluid, precise, and perfection-focused gameplay experience.

title: Hotshots
description: HOTSHOTS — is a dynamic, 2D adventure where the price of error is the complete loss of progress. There is no place for saving here: every run is an intense, separate battle. Your only reward for victory is taking valuable weapons with you to start the next, even more dangerous run...

title: Brawl Party
description: Brawl Party is a 2–8 player multiplayer party game where fast-paced mini-games and competitive Night Game battles turn friends into rivals. Outplay everyone and be the last one standing. Wishlist Brawl Party to follow its development.

title: The Long Way Home
description: You are alone on a drifting starship. No humans, only robots. As Miner 13-553; craft, farm, repair, upgrade skills and find your way home. Fight the machines or choose a peaceful path. Explore the mystery or just focus on the journey. The choice is yours.

title: Zumbi Olé: The Minigame
description: Zumbi Olé is unlike anything you've ever played: an action-survival game where you don't just fight… you OLÉ! Outplay clumsy zombies, dominate infested arenas, wipe out undead hordes and rack up points to show the world your true OLÉ skills.

title: Vironics
description: Control a Nanite body from a space station to gather Nanite resources on Earth, seized by a rogue AI. Build and fortify your dropbase with turrets and defenses, fight waves of robotic enemies, and collect Nanites for extraction, balancing fast FPS combat with strategic tower placement.

title: Second Wind
description: SECOND WIND combines soulslike timing and parry-based combat with roguelite progression in a brutal sci-fi melee experience where every fight is a test of focus, reflex, and resolve.

title: Foundland City Builders
description: Foundland is a strategic city-building and resource management game with defense elements. Expand your lands, establish production chains, grow your population, and protect your city against rising threats.

title: Eggventure
description: Eggventure is a 2D Metroidvania platformer where you play as Egbert, an egg on a mission to rescue his friends from becoming breakfast.

title: Project: Aftershock
description: Project: AFTERSHOCK is a fast-paced arcade hacking roguelite set in a dystopian future. Command a 20-year-old legacy terminal to breach enemy systems, siphon funds, and upgrade your hardware. Use your reflexes to survive the countdown and bring down the very system you created.

title: Smol Toad
description: A tiny toad with a big personality lives on your desktop while you work or play. Interact with him, take care of his happiness, avoid overwhelming him, and collect points to unlock hats and unique styles for your little amphibian companion.

title: Ud Rēa
description: UD RĒA is a retro FPS game that blends classic 90s fast-paced action with mythological elements inspired by Göbeklitepe. Unleash your rage and tear apart every creature that stands in your way.

title: Kisen: Seeker of Aenjan City
description: Tap into the mystery as a stranger in the city — a mild mystery visual novel. Kisen runs a tracing agency in a city far from his home. There, he is asked by a local university student to look for his brother missing from twelve years ago. Investigate what happened back then to uncover the truth.

title: Up-Beat!!
description: Up-Beat!! is an action-packed boxing game heavily inspired by Punch-Out!! - fight through a colorful cast of characters and take your place in history as the WFBA's new world champion!

title: Negative Time
description: Negative Time is a bullet hell rogue-lite shooter where each time you get hit, you are sent further and further back in time, until you are sent into the past they tried so hard to erase. Maybe in there lies the key to your escape?

title: Balikaw
description: A horror adventure rooted in ancient Filipino superstitions.

title: Total Incremental Battle
description: Start with a single soldier, end up with a massive army. Strategize and command your units, or let them grind on their own. Progress through many unique progression systems and conquer all the stages.

title: Super Scary Cylinder
description: In this terrifying true story, you (super fragile capsule) has to collect 10 super standard spheres before the super scary cylinder catches up to you. Can you survive? Can you get 10 Orbs before the Super Scary Cylinder gets you?

title: Kubika
description: Guide charming cubes through a dreamlike world in Kubika, a Sokoban-inspired 3D puzzle adventure. Manipulate gravity to your will to solve thoughtful, elegant three-dimensional puzzles. Bring your vision to life with the built-in Level Editor, and share your creations with the Community.

title: Nightmare Class Project
description: Survive through each day of your scholarship in this PSX-style game. Meet ambiguous people (and creatures), collect cosmetics, slide out of your dorm, uncover the secrets of this place or die trying!

title: Miya Might Break
description: A psychological horror visual novel about Miya, a former prodigy trapped in a decaying home with her unstable stepfather, her talking plush Mopa, and the bystander who hears every step she takes. Walk the ritual loops, and decide who survives Miya’s breaking point across three unsettling endings.

title: The Legend of You
description: Shape a fantasy realm with your words. Choose your hero’s tale, recruit, train, and equip allies, and battle through turn-based encounters of your own design. Each victory writes your legend, each choice brings you closer to the ultimate treasure.

title: Birds of War
description: Birds of War is a 3v3v3 aerial PvP combat game featuring fast-paced bird-on-bird combat, egg-stealing objectives, and proximity voice chat. Players choose from unique bird classes, each with distinct abilities, and battle across chaotic multiplayer arenas. Developed by HexNest Games.

title: Lurk in Abyss
description: After moving to the village, Lurk begins a new, independent life. However, the place turns out to be no ordinary village on the outskirts of the city, but something far more mysterious... Are you ready to dive into this abyss?

title: Witchpop
description: Witchpop is a physics based matching puzzle game where you cook soup by juggling ingredients. Collect curses over time and try to survive as your dish becomes an increasingly chaotic mess.

title: Cardborne
description: A grim single-player card roguelike where every draw decides your fate — fight, heal, or fall to the suits that once ruled the world.

title: The Seven Days I Spent With You
description: With the enigmatic girl who imprisoned you――seven days in an unfamiliar room.

title: Block In
description: Shoot, smack, RUN or metal pipe yourself out of endless waves of enemies. Level-up to unlock weapons, classes and perks to create the most bricked-up build. It's time to Block In!

title: Murderous Sunlight
description: In a dark world where Holy mages rewrite probability and Profane forces trap the dead in eternal patterns, Murderous Sunlight blends exploration, psychological depth, and occasional combat in an unsettling journey. Unravel a linear, character-driven story about trauma, identity, and defiance.

title: Devour the Elixir
description: A dark tactical puzzler where you consume poison to gain power. In a world void of Qi, use [Foresight] to see enemy intent. Outmaneuver foes using [Movement Cards] and lure them into deadly traps. Perfect information, no random dodging. Only pure strategy saves you from death.

title: Gun Nose
description: GUN NOSE is a top-down action-mystery game set in the handcrafted, pixel art city of Ironwood. Play as the titular hero, Gun Nose, a robot detective with a mysterious past and a face that can kill. You’re on a mission to track down your missing creator by investigating a string of violent murders. The culprits? A group of Serial Murder-Bots disguised among the population.

title: Soul Card Duel
description: A deckbuilder where position and direction make combats more tactical. Flank enemies with 8 attack directions and combine cards to win in any situation. Explore procedural maps, create decks and armor to customize your hero, and forge your legend in the region's grand tournament.

title: Crystal Clear, Mail's Here
