description: Crystal Clear, Mail's Here, is a cute gem matching game about a little delivery girl named Ruby.

title: Breakout 71
description: A breakout game with roguelite mechanics. Break bricks, catch coins, pick upgrades, repeat.

title: Poptropica Legacy
description: Poptropica Legacy is a fanmade remaster that allows playing classic Poptropica islands & ad experiences both online and offline. It includes both the AS2 version - the first one from 2007, including the 37 original island quests - AND the AS3 version - also known as the SUI version within the community, including 14 island quests of it’s own plus Poptropica: Realms - with more than a few major changes/improvements.

title: Pawffice
description: Pawffice is a story-driven, strategy roguelike game. Coon, an average college grad. He has to use his unique ability, "Rock-Paper-Scissors" to defeat all sorts of strange enemies. After countless do-overs , can he save himself and his friends, and uncover all the secrets behind Pawffice?

title: Duck Duck Shark
description: Duck Duck Shark is a crowd-play game designed around the classic Hook-a-duck is a traditional fairground stall game****Twitch interactive game and twitch is required to play the game****

title: Uznali? SoglasnbI?
description: uznali? soglasnbI? it's a simple timekiller. Сontrol the ball to reach the end of the level.

title: Weapons Simulator
description: A Realistic Simulation with Manual Bolt Operation, Real Ballistics, High-Technical Fidelity, and Accurate 3D Models. Play freely on the SandBox Shooting Range or follow the Shooting Course on 3 different scenarios (Indoor, Outdoor, and Desert for long-range shooting with wind).

title: Rescue Helicopter
description: Rescue Helicopter invites you to try yourself in the role of a rescue helicopter - of course, not an easy task, but it's definitely worth it! Learn from your own experience how difficult it is to fly a helicopter and save the citizens of the city from the floods!

title: Maze Workout: Urban Lost Solo Car Racer
description: It's a racing car maze game with 52 levels, find the checkpoints and laps to the next level. "check the music in the video".

title: Fuuu...!
description: It's color blindness test fun journey! Follow the path to find your way out, collect the coins through various terrains! Can you see where the road leads and avoid the traps? Play it yourself to find out!

title: Shuttlecock-H: Covered Rematch
description: Shuttlecock-H: Covered Rematch is a second installment of the challenging Bullet Hell for players of all ages. Completely new levels in a pleasant company of three cute girls.

title: Goddess of Strategy
description: Lead mortal heroes on grid-based tactical maps and restore the power of the Olympians. Forge bonds with gods, level up your team and combine the perfect skill synergies. Face limited resources, hard choices, and tactical challenges on your journey to defeat the seven deadly sins.

title: Become
description: Experience life's fantastical journey as one of millions of sperm. Survive the microcosm dangers, wiggle, dash and compete through the human reproductive system and create new life.

title: Alterum
description: Social deduction horror game with voice recognition, full of betrayal and dark rituals. Awaken in a cult of restless souls: spells spoken aloud summon powers - or doom. Alliances or deceit: can you distinguish truth when a word is a curse?

title: Tiny Utopia
description: Wield over 15 unique magical tools and traverse more than 12 vastly different themed worlds in an unprecedented hidden-object adventure. In Tiny Utopia, every click is filled with strategy and wonder.

title: Chrono Spin
description: Chrono Spin is a Roguelike RPG blending Fruit Machine with deep strategy. Manage your mana to place bets, unleash character skills, and challenge legendary guardians from the Misty Forest to the Seasons Temple. Every spin is a gamble between life and death!

title: An Incremental Game About Placing Blocks
description: A short incremental game about placing blocks and filling spaces.

title: DoDoon
description: Defend your castle from approaching monsters! Upgrade your defenses and survive all 30 fast-paced waves in this addictive defense shooter.

title: Robertinho Adventures
description: Robertinho Adventures is a 2D action platform game where you play as Robertinho, a young boy who seeks to save his dog, Caramelito, from a great villain! Travel through the cities of Braçal with your coins, face infiltrated aliens and save his great partner!

title: Just a Simple Turn-based RPG
description: A short and straightforward turn-based RPG where every action matters. Explore, cast spells through quirky enchantments, help the townsfolk, and hunt for treasure, without endless grinding or overcomplicated stories.

title: Rei and the Floating City
description:
Rei is on a journey to become a fully-fledged mage when her airship meets a terrible fate. She and her family crash land in Jupeterno and are nursed back to health by some locals... Except apparently once someone arrives in Jupeterno, they're never allowed to leave. Add in political intrigue and a mysterious, beautiful princess, and Rei's chances of ever making it home are crashing as rapidly as her airship did!

Battle through a magical tower full of monsters to get what you need to escape the country... or give in and resign yourself to your fate. Which will you choose?

title: Stellar Industrialist
description: You are neither a general nor a soldier — you are a Stellar Industrialist. To you, peace is nothing but shutdowns and losses. Venture to the frontlines, strip battlefields for wreckage and salvage, turn spoils into resources, and expand your interstellar arms empire.

title: Choice of Life: Floors
description: Choice of Life: Floors is a psychological horror detective game where every choice shapes your story. An elevator descends through the endless floors of your own home, leading you into a game against your own mind. Each step brings you closer to escape… or to madness

title: The Corner Cafe
description: The Corner Cafe is a cozy(ish) cafe simulator set in a retro futuristic mythical Ireland in the year 2160. Play as Dan, the new owner of The Corner Cafe, the last independent cafe in Galway City. It is up to you to create an oasis of community in this dystopia...

title: By Myself
description: A 2D horror and psychological-horror game based on puzzles and mysteries to uncover the truth about a child left alone. Engaging mechanics, a memorable story, and original soundtracks.

title: What Is Death?
description: A visual novel about death.

title: Vault Vandals
description: Chaotic local multiplayer roguelite for 2-4 players. Command robots through deadly dungeons - but don't control them directly. Issue AI directives, grab cursed treasures, steal from friends, and escape before the Wall of Doom rises.

title: Asterisk
description: What if Asteroids but roguelike? Destroy space rocks to unlock better weapons, abilities, and equipment so you can ... destroy more space rocks. Choose upgrade paths, select sponsors to match your play style, and compete with friends for the high score in this retro-modern top-down space shooter.

title: Reflex Run
description: A fast, unfair 3D troll platformer where a cursed wizard tries to regain his powers. Short runs, changing rules, temporary upgrades, instant retries, and a sarcastic portal that enjoys your suffering.

title: Tiny Cat Fishing
description: Set off on a bright adventure across a magical island Catch fish, unlock adorable animal heroes, collect unique rods, and explore rivers, lakes, and the open ocean. Search for rare species and become the ultimate angler!

title: Pupple Pop
description: Pupple Pop is an incremental game where you pop bubbles to earn money. Buy bigger and better bubbles, unlock upgrades and hire fish helpers to automate the process and take care of all the busy popping work for you. Simple. Satisfying.

title: The Shadow Architect
description: Are new bans coming to your country? You, bring even more. Forget city-building games. You're not a builder, you're a DESTROYER. Use taxes and bureaucracy to collapse a flawlessly functioning dystopian industrial system from within. A card-based ideological collapse simulation game.

title: Hero Link
description: Recruit heroes and build your formation! Harness the unique "Master-Follower Link" system to craft action sequences and coordinate targets, unleashing synergies where 1 + 1 >> 2. Every link is a tactical choice, every formation has its own unique growth path!

title: Doodle Wipeout
description: Doodle Wipeout is an action rougelite - survive waves of chaotic doodles by erasing them. Dodge, upgrade, and clean the canvas before it’s overrun.

title: Petal by Petal
description: Petal by Petal is a relaxing incremental gardening game where mindful movements are rewarded. Water seeds, grow flowers, sell your harvest, and unlock permanent upgrades across a sprawling skill tree.

title: Football Survivors
description: THE FOOTBALL WAR HAS STARTED! Thousands of raging fans are storming the field. Defend against the fan invasion! 50+ unique heroes and abilities, 50+ upgrade items, position your heroes strategically, crush the waves of fans!

title: Racing Manager
description: Manage your racing team: strategy, tires, staff, budget, and real-time decisions. Build the perfect crew and lead them to victory in this immersive motorsport management game.

title: Eve of Cultivation
description: A 1-2 hour survival-horror game about crashing on a deserted island and fighting to live another day.

title: Orso
description: Orso the rabbit is looking for carrots and needs your help! Guide Orso through an isometric landscape, using perspective to solve tricky puzzles and collect carrots.

title: Capsulitas
description: A physics-based gacha meets inventory management roguelike. Insert a coin, organize your backpack, and sell for profit! Multiply items with hammers, upgrade your machine, and survive the inflation.

title: Omoide Cafe
description: Omoide Cafe is a calm café/pastry shop simulation where you develop your own café step by step, unlocking new recipes, equipment, and features with the guidance of Bebii.

title: Girl With Gun
description: A dating simulator, but... The girl has a shotgun, and if she doesn't like how you answer her questions, you die. Your date takes place in a living, watching cave where every element of the environment actively reacts to your tension and tries to break you.

title: Viral Hunters
description: You are trapped in the same facility, aiming to find a way out through the scattered "Vaccine Injectors". The game's core revolves around the crucial vaccines.

title: Underdog Futsal
description: Become the manager of a small neighborhood futsal club, recruit players on a tight budget, and build your tactics. Manage morale through team activities, shift the momentum with substitutions and tactical changes in tense text-based matches, and grow your team step by step.

title: Scicry
description: A first-person sci-fi action-horror. After a catastrophic event, the station’s crew has mutated, turning its corridors into a deadly labyrinth. Explore the station, scavenge resources, and fight monsters to survive.

title: Hunted Within: The Metro
description: Dive into a story-driven horror FPS set in an abandoned metro system: escape underground prison, pilot a survival train through dark tunnels, and venture onto a deadly, frozen surface while hunting for your last friend and confronting the mastermind from your past.

title: Lord of Anatolia
description: A real-time city-building and strategy game set in 1300s Anatolia. Build your settlement, manage resources, expand your economy, train soldiers, research new technologies, and defend your beylik against enemy forces.

title: Regnum Idle
description: Build an unstoppable Viking empire through automated battles. Harvest resources, recruit Vikings, equip them with 100+ weapons and armor, and watch them dominate! Upgrade weapons endlessly, defeat legendary bosses, and unlock powerful upgrades. Your army grows stronger, even while you're offline

title: Where the Hell Am I?
description: Where The Hell Am I? is an atmospheric first-person exploration game. Its diverse locations draw you into an unknown world where every shadow hides a story and every step deepens the mystery. Uncover the truth behind the mystery that started it all. Are you ready to get lost in different realities?

title: Idle Ways
description: An incremental game about building and optimizing your own global transport network. Draw lines, place stations, and unlock new systems as your cities grow!

title: World Without Time
description: World without Time is an atmospheric adventure about a fire alicorn exploring a ruined world, using magic, and confronting their past self. Experience exploration, flight, light combat, and choices that shape the fate of the protagonist.

title: Forthold
description: Hold the fort as a lone archer in this short incremental defense game. Shoot waves of enemies, collect magic and soulshards, upgrade your power, and ascend to push further toward the source of the relentless darkness.

title: Cute Away: Paws Caretaker Simulator
description: Run the town’s coziest cat caretaking home! Renovate and upgrade your house, manage inventory and order supplies online. Fulfill specific feline requests with specialized furniture and engaging toys. Play with cats, keep them happy, and optimize your layout to create the perfect daily workflow.

title: System Overload
description: SYSTEM STATUS: UNSTABLE> System Overload is a resource management sim disguised as a Win95/98 Task Manager. Balance CPU, RAM, and heat while fighting malware across 8 unique endings. Push your hardware to the limit—just don't trigger a meltdown. >DO_NOT_CRASH.

title: Ultratap
description: ULTRATAP is an incremental game about defeating monsters and bosses, getting stronger and enjoying the process. Buy upgrades, complete quests and equip powerful items.

title: Michael Test
description: Michael Test is a point-and-click adventure game where you uncover hidden truths within classical paintings and follow faint traces of sound to deduce and choose the final ‘sin.’

title: Uncanny Tales: The Watcher
description: 2006. You become the new reserve caretaker. Patrol the territory in your rugged 4x4, check the phototraps, and monitor the area using surveillance cameras. But remember: you are not the only one watching.

title: Stella Incus
description: Full game coming January 2027. Try the demo free now! You need to make it out alive before you can even think about revenge! Use Firefighting and Physics to solve puzzles and power up as you explore and solve your way through the emergent chaos.

title: Santa's Burnout
description: Santa has officially quit. The kids are too spoiled, and the magic is gone. This year, the Toy Factory has been converted into a strip mine. Click rocks, crush hope, and manage a cynical coal mining operation in this dark industrial idle game. Your goal? Ensure everyone gets coal for Christmas.

title: Hilarious Delivery
description: Take orders, fire up the stoves! Hilarious Delivery is a single-player and co-op restaurant sim where you run a frantic takeout shop against the clock. Cook dishes, then pull off the perfect handoff to your delivery rider.

title: Unanchored Spaceshooting
description: Welcome to the most counter-intuitive shooter arena! In Unanchored Spaceshooting, your guns ARE your thrusters—dodge left by firing right! Every battle defies physics. Blast enemies, rack up high scores!

title: Twin Balls Journey
description: Live together, die together—bound by a single thread. True companions dare to have their fates tied by a rope. Twin Balls Journey is a two-player cooperative action game. Work in sync, manipulate environmental contraptions, and leverage each scene's unique properties to conquer every level.

title: Fragments of Dread: Late Lines FM
description: Late Lines FM is a first-person, story-driven psychological horror experience. Your night shift at 107.9 FM turns into a nightmare with the forbidden 99.9 frequency. When the cursed song plays, you should cover your ears but to find the radio, you must listen.

title: Dream Village
description: Immerse yourself in the cozy world of village life! Set up your home, buy groceries or order home delivery, cook delicious soups, manage your farm and earn real estate. Dream Village - dreams become reality!

title: Uno God
description: This is not a rogue-like game. Test your luck and bet your life against the gods in a deadly card game. Use powerful relics to outplay immortal opponents — and survive until the last god falls.

title: Sento Survivor: Slip, Grab, and Bathe in Glory!
description: Slide, Shoot, and Send Your Rivals Flying!Chaotic, tumbling shooter battle set in a Japanese Sento (public bathhouse). On these super slippery floors, you'll slide, shoot, and stumble to victory. Defeat your rivals and soak in the sublime bath reserved only for the winner!

title: Defragmenting
description: The outside is being ravaged by a mysterious downpour of a glass, you are forced to take shelter in a seemingly innocuous rundown hotel. Yet, stuck with you are people who you wish you would never see again. What will you do to survive?

title: King of Santa
description: King of Santa is a competitive party action game for up to four players, where players take on the role of Santa, collect presents scattered across the stage, and deliver them to chimneys to earn points and win the match.

title: Kafak
description: KAFAK – Survival Card-Building & Base Management Game Build your deck with 150+ unique cards, upgrade characters and your base, craft Thai dishes, hunt and farm to survive, and face 10+ powerful bosses in a post-apocalyptic world.

title: My Tasty Husband
description: Murders quietly upend May's life. A strange husband, a reckless courier, a dutiful officer—reality and hallucination blur together. In this narrative adventure of food, intimacy, and death, make choices as May and reach her ending. If she can still tell what she's eaten from what she's loved...

title: Pirate's Dual
description: A 2D pixel-art PvP ship battle game where you outplay opponents with smart attack and defense tactics. Climb matchmaking, join tournaments, earn in-game currency, unlock skins, and more.

title: Mars Base Alley
description: Mars Base Alley is a cozy city-builder about creating the perfect little corner of humanity on the red planet—one alley at a time.

title: Beam It Up!
description: Capture monsters from distant planets and add them to your cosmic collection. Upgrade your ship, travel further, and become the galaxy’s top collector.

title: Data Strafer
description: Data Strafer is a chaotic bullet hell shoot 'em up that tasks you with infiltrating a network to destroy forbidden knowledge. Defeat enemies to absorb their power and activate your own upgrades.

title: Sepium
description: Investigate and localize abnormal activities in this 1-4 players survival horror game. Find your way to various locations where something odd is happening, while trying hard to keep your crew alive.

title: Mushroom Nook
description: Mushrooms of all kinds—adorable, quirky, and even some with unique abilities—are spring up randomly on your computer! Collect and nurture them, then decorate with various objects to create your own cozy mushroom haven, keeping you company while you work, study, or simply unwind.

title: Gift Drop Machine: Life Simulator
description: Survive with surprise gifts dropping from the machine! Sell or use them. Maintain the balance between hunger and energy, manage your bank, grow with your credit card, and buy homes and cars. Every choice changes your fate. Survive the roguelike challenge by combining luck and strategy.

title: Maneuver Warfare 2: BTG
description: A simulation of the 2022 Russo-Ukrainian War where the player maneuvers battalion tactical groups on a map and controls assets such as aircraft, special forces teams, satellites, field hospitals, and repair facilities to support these. The player can play single battles or a campaign game.

title: Goob Wants an Android Girlfriend
description: A cute puzzle game about fixing up android girls! Grow your collection of girlfriends and prove your wits by solving clever yet intuitive puzzles!

title: Monster Mine Clash
description: Survive waves of monsters from every direction! Aim with your mouse, defeat enemies, upgrade your weapons, and mine ores to grow stronger. Faster reflexes and smarter upgrades mean longer survival!

title: Commie Block
description: Survive as the newly appointed manager in an expanding communistic regime where our purpose is to produce more and more resources for the glory of motherland! Manage the workforce & optimize output of buildings to survive against unrealistic demands as long as possible in our own commie block

title: Lounge Café
description: Lounge Café is an atmospheric coffee shop simulator where you play as Sara from Lucerne, running a small café in Binoville. Choose beans, craft drinks, and compete in the city’s major coffee tournament to become the best.

title: WomboCombo
description: Fight through hordes of mobs in a roguelike-style challenge by hitting the correct key sequence. Test your reflexes, build your character, and survive the chaos as each stage ramps up. Rack up massive combos and push your limits with every run.

title: Incremental Infinity
description: An incremental game where your size and power grow with your number. Use an infinite, procedurally generated skill tree to defend yourself against ever larger incoming numbers and strive to reach infinity.

title: Undying One
description: Undying One is a tactical action RPG where every defeated enemy can be claimed for your army. Unlock new spells, raise the dead, command your forces, and endure ever-growing waves of power.

title: Farewell Jack
description: Farewell Jack is a fully voiced, story driven, roguelite tactics game with simple rules and a high skill cap, quick-time combat system. Many battles are designed as endless holdout missions that combine tower defense, with army management, base building, recruitment, and asset acquisition.

title: Ctrlsink
description: A submerged post-apocalyptic retro-style FPS set in a world swallowed by the ocean after a human/AI war. Blast through flooded facilities, battle corrupted machines, explore radioactive ruins, and uncover the last buried secrets of humanity’s collapse.

title: Cosmic Rays
description: Jump and shoot in this 2D platformer to destroy the hivemind controlling the aliens that are attacking Earth. Hopefully nothing goes wrong on this mission...

title: Delucid
description: An atmospheric horror game set within an inescapable dream. Trapped in a dark forest, you must explore, forage, and uncover rare ingredients to craft the one potion capable of waking you up.

title: Bootleg Alchemist
description: It's prohibition , time to bootleg like never before. As an exiled Alchemist on your path to redemption.Negotiate contracts from taverns to produce liquor and earn coin. Use your alchemy skills to evade guards , bandits and boost production, Help civilians and regain your status.

title: Grainhold
description: Grainhold is an open world mining game where player build their own settlement, which they must then defend against waves of enemy attacks. To construct buildings, players must gather resources and grow vegetables, which they can sell to buy better equipment from the merchant.

title: Drift Empire
description: Drift Empire is an arcade drift game focused on car collection. Open crates, find rare vehicles, customize your style, and hit the track to prove you are the true drift legend.

title: Dungeon Bomber
description: Dungeon Bomber is a chain-reaction roguelite where you place bombs and blow through the dungeon. Drop a bomb each turn, earn coins, and upgrade your deck. Fuse bombs to boost range and effects. Defeat advancing monsters and destroy the required blocks before your HP runs out.

title: Little Fiefdom: Medieval
description: A medieval sandbox build/war game. Start as a peasant, become a lord, manage your fiefdom. Gather resources, construct buildings, train people & an army to defend or attack.

title: Vampire's Kiss: Time Paradox
description: Vampire's Kiss: Time Paradox - is a romantic anime novel about vampires and the distortion of time. Your choices will determine the fate of the heroine and her chosen one. Meet mysterious guys, uncover secrets, and find your unique ending!

title: Kimbap Heaven Simulator
description: Run your own Korean restaurant in Kimbap Heaven Simulator. Dive into a realistic cooking experience—wash, blanch, and roll your way to success. Satisfy customers with delicious recipes, manage your finances, and expand your business to build a culinary empire.

title: Urban Ascend
description: A casual incremental city builder where growth is constant, production chains expand, citizens thrive, and upgrades push your city toward a bustling metropolis.

title: WonderLang English
description: Learn English through immersive quests, interactive dialogues, and spaced repetition combat challenges. Help a young hero lift a magical curse by mastering English. Customize your learning experience and explore a vibrant world filled with unique characters. Start your journey in English today!

title: Heartlines
description: Heartlines: A choice-driven FPS. Under an angel's threat, you have 10 days to kill the demon hiding among 5 friends. Who is the victim? With 10+ endings, every choice leads to salvation or hell. Will you obey the light or find the truth?

title: DopePie Survivors 3D
description: *DopePie Survivors 3D* is a 3D shooting game with survivor-like mechanics! Countless different little girls, giant corrupted female bosses, and a variety of weapons! Skills! Building! Piloting helicopters and tanks! Gliding through the city! can you lead them to escape?

title: Legend of Asha
description: Enter the Kingdom of Ngoma in the Legend of Asha, a Top-Down adventure set in a unique and vibrant Afro-Fantasy setting. Explore unique and beautiful landscapes, use and upgrade powerful elemental abilities, fight off enemies and defeat Thonarka the Ravager to restore balance to the land.

title: GagImpact
description: Violence-themed,"Conversation & Violence Simulation Game!"As the rowdy lad Mike S Brown,knock the annoying blokes flying! Talk! Spew abuse!What will become of the lad's future as a result...?

title: You All Know! Arm Tank Volley
description: The legendary “You All Know! Arm Tank Volley” is back! Just drop the ball in the opponent’s court—yet it’s deep and addictive. Punch the net for a rocket jump, stand on it, and laugh at physics miracles. Looks dumb, plays god-tier. Can you resist?

title: Knights End
description: Work together to survive the knight shift in this co-op PvE horror game. Serve your villagers’ as a disgraced knight by completing their commands in a cursed kingdom. Reclaim your lost honor to earn items and a chance at your freedom.

title: Tarot Spell
description: A fast-paced typing survival game where every word becomes a Tarot spell.

title: Horizons Scavenger
description: A story-driven sci-fi adventure where you track a rogue android across a colony that should be alive but stands mysteriously empty. Solve physics-based logic puzzles, hack corrupted systems, and fight hostile machines as you uncover what happened to the missing colonists.

title: Trushybin & Removin: What I Couldn’t Delete
description: A cozy and emotive 3D platformer about two tiny PC icons who, with innocence and love, accompany their owner on a journey of emotional healing and memories.

title: Ammo Station Simulator
description: Manage your gun shop in Ammo Station. By day, sell and repair weapons. By night, team up with friends to rob warehouses and smuggle illegal arms. Rise from a respectable shopkeeper to the city's ultimate gun baron in this first-person simulation.

title: Mega Deal Card
description: Mega Deal Card combines the depth of deckbuilders with the tension of gambling games. In this roguelite, your goal is simple: place cards on a 3x3 board to combine shapes and symbols and earn the points needed to clear the level. But be careful: with each victory, the challenge rises and shop prices skyrocket.

title: Delta Light 2
description: Delta Light 2 is my love letter to classic flash games! With new arcade graphics, a fresh engine, and a killer soundtrack. Explore + 35 handcrafted maps in the Campaign. then dive into Infinite Mode. With fruity power-ups and a set of unlock-able characters, this is Delta Light like never before!

title: Suction Bot
description: Suction Bot is unique, mouse only platformer that has you climbing from a sewer to space. As you climb, you'll encounter challenges, such as swinging pendulums, flying pigeons, wrecking balls and more.

title: Crumbs for a Week
description: Crumbs for a week is a non-linear casual adventure RPG about a girl searching for her missing rat. Join Daisy as she explores the town and its hidden spaces for clues. Convince her friends to come along as travel buddies or minigame competitors.

title: Veterans: Napoleonic Wars
description: Command history and turn the tides of war in this real-time strategy experience. Quick decisions and keen tactical formations are the only things that stand between your troops and victory during the Napoleonic Wars. A regiment that survives today is your elite force tomorrow.

title: Wing-It
description: Adapt or crash! WING-IT is a 2.5D shooter where your arsenal is a slot machine. Shoot down drones to trigger the Toy Box Gacha and swap weapons on the fly. Fight through Medy's house, survive the bullet hell, and defeat the mechanical monstrosities ruling the house.

title: Eternal Carnival
description: The god of the Carnival has disappeared and the world has plunged into chaos. You are the Faceless One, a mysterious being without a mask. Explore the Lands of the Axis, gather your team and engage in turn-based battles in a classic jRPG style. Uncover the secrets of the Eternal Carnival.

title: Sad God
description: SAD GOD is a platformer-shooter-roguelike. We invite you to descend into a pit of monsters and traps. Gain strength from coins and weapons from altars. Touch an orb. Then race to the surface before the lava gets you.

title: Pachincro
description: An action-packed pachinko–plinko incremental game with a massive skill tree and tons of upgrades. Drop balls, stack multipliers, unlock new abilities, watch the chaos scale into pure satisfaction, all while trying to defeat the boss and staying alive

title: The Adventure of Natsuki Hinomiya
description: "The Adventure of Natsuki Hinomiya" is an Action RPG that prioritizes the joy of exploration and is designed for short-cycle, repeatable runs.Gather items scattered across the open field, defeat the enemies blocking your path, and empower your protagonist.

title: Mini Up
description: Mini UP is a free parkour game where every second counts. Optimize your movements, perfect your precision, and achieve faster and faster times.

title: Five Dice
description: A deck-building strategy game where you roll FIVE DICE and blend tactics with luck to prevail in battle!

title: Outlanders: Exiles of Veridion
description: Outlanders is a sci-fi open-world survival game set on Veridion Prime. Build your base, fight hostile factions, explore alien biomes, craft advanced gear, and survive deadly environmental threats in a living world shaped by your choices.

title: Aviarium
description: Aviarium is a relaxing sky sanctuary simulation filled with cute birds. Manage your floating aviary with click and idle mechanics, collect resources, and enjoy a pleasant experience in a colorful and peaceful world above the clouds.

title: Dream Corps
description: Surreal horror game. You have been selected by a sinister group to participate in a twisted game of exploration and escape. Walk through dreamy, horrifying places that evoke unease and fear.

title: ODEZZA
description: Chess meets Poker. A high-stakes game where chess battles and poker hands decide your fate. Capture pieces, build hands, and bet your way through the Odysseys.

title: Battery Bash
description: Battery Bash is a fast-paced multiplayer party game where players battle in chaotic arenas filled with dynamic obstacles, power-ups, and unpredictable events. Push opponents, survive the chaos, and be the last battery standing.

title: Sol and Mani the Artifact
description: Visual novel that combines elements of fantasy, romance and adventure. The story of the adventures of one young accidental traveler named Max, told from the perspective of the inhabitants of another world. Сharacters would join a team of adventurers and search for the artifact that grants any wish.

title: Oscillia: The Shattered Planet
description: In this 2.5D shooter/MetroidVania game, explore the different realities of a retro sci-fi universe. Fight, upgrade your equipment, and recruit allies to unravel the mystery of the planet Oscilia.

title: Where Is Lena?
description: To save your wife, you must sneak into a biogenetic research facility, solve puzzles to descend underground, and confront the dark truths the company has hidden. Surviving in this facility, where everything has spiraled out of control, won't be easy. How far are you willing to go to save your wife?

title: Pix Football Manager
description: PIX Football Manager is a nostalgic, casual football management simulator focused on scouting. Set your tactics, find hidden gems, and improve your facilities as you build a dynasty. With no visible player stats, you must spot talent yourself. Grab your clipboard, the game starts now.

title: Reel Tiny
description: Welcome to Critters Crick! Catch fish, upgrade gear, and explore the mountain’s creek in this loveable micro-fishing game! You play as The Shrew, a mammal with a burning passion for fishing. Bask in the variety of rods, lures, reels, and fish that keep folks in this cozy community busy year-round!

title: Holy Nope!
description: A small incremental game about defending Heaven from hordes of sinners who think they deserve a spot in Paradise. Sure, people have a high opinion of themselves, but Heaven is full - and you are the bouncer.

title: Unholy Crimes
description: A cozy haunting sandbox where you’re the ghost causing adorable chaos.

title: Foolhearted
description: Uncover the truth behind the online casino world through the eyes of a delusional fool. Meet the cute dealers, fall too fast, and experience heartbreak in a psychological visual novel about ego, obsession, and self-discovery.

title: Asterobits
description: You've escaped from the galaxy's most secure space prison, and now there's a bunch of angry lawless chasing you. You must survive, fight for your freedom, and outrun these grumpy pursuers. Asterobits delivers a relentless (and slightly absurd) escape in an arcade-style roguelike space shooter.

title: Blockaholic
description: It's a physics-based puzzle that challenges your quick thinking and planning. Shake, spin, and pull the blocks up to put them into a line, but don't let them touch the ground

title: Need: No End
description: Build and upgrade production loops, manage resources and workers, and expand your realm. Trade, adapt and survive hunger, pressure, decay, and threats in a tense, multi-layered strategy game where every choice matters.

title: Mushi
description: Welcome to Mushi! The next-gen Auto-RPG set in a rich fantasy world. This is a feature-packed incremental idle game, meaning that it mostly plays on its own. Your hero will automatically defeat enemies and level up on your screen while you do other things. Begin your rise from level 1 today!

title: Re-Taped
description: You must record your movements and play them back to progress. Use your recorded echoes to weigh down pressure plates, body-block lasers, and trigger springs to launch you across gaps. Master the timeline and complete all 30 time-bending levels.

title: Cinema Owner
description: An inheritance? A cinema? Awesome! But... Can you keep up with the order of this strange new country? Will you manage to expand your theater despite regime crackdowns? The oppressive leader may do his worst, but you are the owner of this cinema. Manage, profit, build, expand, and grow.

title: Hot Meals Fast Wheels
description: A co-op cooking game where small mistakes quickly turn into chaos. Go shopping, cook in your food truck, and drive through the city to deliver orders on time.

title: Dreamstranded
description:
Dive into a survival adventure with a cozy atmosphere! Enjoy gathering, crafting, and building — but beware, monsters lurk in the shadows, ready to challenge you!

At the beginning of the story, you awaken in a mysterious world with your memories lost, and the journey unfolds from there.

First, you must learn to survive — gathering resources, crafting items, and building a camp. You can choose to survive alone or recruit villagers to establish a thriving tribe.

As you explore the wilderness, you will encounter various monsters. Arm yourself with crafted gear, master magic, and defeat them!

Embark on a vast journey, follow clues, and unravel the mystery of why you drifted here. Or, you can simply relax and enjoy the pastoral life. The choice is entirely yours!

title: Dogfight Darlings
description: Dogfight Darlings is a bite-sized, bullet hell boss rush featuring an aviation themed cast of plane girls! Take to the skies, unlock skills, and battle your way to victory through daring aerial combat in this game made entirely of boss fights.

title: MingJiangSha
description: "MingJiangSha" is a multiplayer identity deduction and strategy card game. Players can transform into legendary generals throughout history, play cards, deduce identities, coordinate skills, formulate strategies in ever-changing battlefields, and engage in a thrilling strategic showdown!

title: Chop Chop for the Old God
description: Chop trees, throw logs into a wormhole, unlock upgrades, brew potions, find teleporters, unveil the map, and explore multiple endings.

title: Mask of Soul
description: Mask of Soul is a 2D Metroidvania action-adventure where you play as Cheong-O Chasa, the underworld’s gatekeeper, hunting spirits released under the Red Moon. Master precise parry combat, switch between spirit masks, and explore a dark fantasy world inspired by Korean mythology.

title: Bang Pass Duel
description: Pass the bomb. Unleash terror. Bang Pass Duel — a 2-player deathmatch where countdowns turn arenas into explosive rings. Hunter or hunted? Only those who master explosive art, push limits, and trust survival instinct become Bomb Master.

title: A Color Theory
description: A Trippy Puzzle-Platformer That Literally Plays with Color

title: SolveIt! A Puzzle Solving Simulator
description: SolveIt! invites you into the world of twisty puzzles - from the timeless Rubik’s Cube to unique and challenging shapes. Whether you’re a casual solver or a speedcubing enthusiast, SolveIt lets you practice, compete, and learn - all in one place.

title: Alpha Crisis
description: Alpha Crisis is a fast-paced 2D platformer focused on grappling hook movement and precise platforming, challenging players to descend into a collapsing facility to repair its systems and save humanity.

title: Pet Troll
description: Run cute, jump cute and fall cute. A colorful troll platformer that is absolutely out to get you, where adorable pets get betrayed by every “friendly” object you meet, falling straight into your perfectly timed doom.

title: Don't Panic! It Is Just Turbulence
description: A frantic co-op puzzle game where a Pilot and an Air Traffic Controller must communicate, decrypt, and improvise to save a failing aircraft. Talk fast, solve faster, and try not to crash.

title: Kiosk 199X
description: Run a tiny 90s kiosk in a chaotic Eastern country - Kolkhozland. Serve quirky customers, survive inspections, pick a side in a local power struggle, and uncover a hidden conspiracy - all in a story-driven retro management sim full of humor and choices.

title: Watt's the Limit?
description: Click, upgrade, explode, and repeat. This is your job in an absurd incremental simulation where you stress test lightbulbs. Pull levers and push buttons to find their breaking point, then use profits to buy powerful upgrades, unlock new machinery, and automate the glorious chaos.

title: Darkest Messia
description: Darkest Messia is a dark fantasy RPG with survival and cult-building. Serve one of three ancient gods, build a settlement in a dying world, expose traitors among your people, and decide whether light, darkness, or blood will shape the final fate of humanity.

title: Moonleap GBC
description: Moonleap GBC is a fan-made demake of the indie puzzle-platformer Moonleap, reimagined as if it were a Game Boy Color game.

title: Loot And Defend
description: A short, relaxing incremental game about slaughtering millions of attacking zombies. Take a load off, the end of the world doesn't have to be stressful.

title: Idle Desktop Marbles
description: Marble Desktop redefines the casual form of marble games with three core experiences: "physical excitement + idle development + relaxing decompression!"

title: Blocking Blocks
description: Blocking Blocks is a simple puzzle game where you direct a block from one square-shaped hole to another. The game is all about facing yourself and your own decisions. For example, if you're a casual player, the game is very casual to play; if you're not a casual player, then...

title: Untouchable Ground
description: You are a wandering fox, caught between warring animal clans, forgotten forest gods, and a secret that can unravel the world. The forest watches. Every step, every choice, could be your last.

title: Pressure Protocol
description: A 1-4 player co-op survival horror game set in a collapsing underwater facility where a relentless creature hunts you and your crew through the dark.

title: Shape World Level up Lite
description: A hyper clicker that combines control and strategy! From casual play to extreme difficulty, anyone can take on the challenge. Experience a vast adventure and endless leveling created by a solo developer!

title: Pizza of the Gods
description: A humorous 2D hand-drawn platformer where you’re on a quest to deliver a pizza to Zeus and pursue your dream of marrying your boss’s daughter. Fight funny enemies, switch between two characters to solve puzzles, and explore a world drawn entirely on paper.

title: Simian
description: Every pirate crew has a monkey mascot, but fighting sea monsters and uncovering lost legends isn’t what a mascot normally does.

title: In Trusted Hands
description: Dive into the daily work of a cozy workshop in a big city, accompanied by relaxing atmospheric music. Manage client data, balance energy and stress, and make choices that shape the story and its outcome.

title: The Last Legion
description: The Last Legion is an RTS-RPG hybrid shooter that combines Real-Time Strategy, Role-Playing, and Base Building elements. The core gameplay centers on Desperate Survival and Base Reconstruction: you must unlock and build barracks, R&D facilities, and defenses.

title: Auto Statue Battle: The Forces of Evil
description: Auto Statue Battle: the forces of evil - an exciting and very unusual game, with a variety of different statues. Collect, combine, upgrade your squad to reach and fight the boss!

title: The Industrial Council
description: A cozy AI driven game where you play a journalist in a steampunk fantasy city. Change is coming to Raversul, and with the help of your imp and your newspaper you will play a powerful role in shaping it. Solve mysteries, uncover stories, and shape politics in this revolutionary new game.

title: Breakbox
description: Unleash chaos as battle-ready creatures in destructible arenas. Build mayhem, fight swarms, and claw your way to boss-level glory.

title: The Anomaly Detective
description: Your mind plays tricks on you in this hotel. Is what you see real, or just a hallucination? Close your eyes, take a deep breath, and clear your mind. Whatever remains when you open them is your only truth. Photograph the anomalies, connect the evidence, and solve the mystery.

title: The Vig
description: You'll be "Xie En", infiltrating the traitor's money empire. This urban hunt is a revenge saga where wit is your spear. Return as "Wu Wei," using rules as your shield in a world of grey. Will you choose love or vengeance? This lethal game of cash, betrayal and redemption awaits your move.

title: Pop Balloons and Drop People
description: A short and colorful incremental game about popping different types of balloons and dropping people of all colors.

title: Submerge
description: A deep-sea exploration company sends you and your friends to investigate a research facility that has mysteriously gone silent. Face terrifying events together, survive as a team, and uncover the truth hidden within the depths.

title: Abattoir: Cow Escape
description: The pinnacle of CowGame technology. Cow Escape is a single-player action game set in a dystopian near future. Play as a cow in the resistance against the meat industry. Fight to free calves from the slaughterhouse, survive endless waves in the rodeo and utilize your powers to destroy Cowmen thugs.

title: Untold Cases: Stillwater Lake
description: When Grace Harland mysteriously disappears at Stillwater Lake, her case is quickly dismissed as an accident. As the investigator, it’s up to you to uncover the truth. Explore the shadowy waters, discover lost audio tapes, and reveal the events leading up to her disappearance.

title: Loop of Command
description: ️ Loop of Command is a minimalist automation puzzle where you program obedient robots to survive in a cold corporate machine ruled by the Overseer’s cruel absurdity.

title: Moonshiner Simulator
description: Moonshiner Simulator is an in-depth spirits production simulator. Start from the bottom and build your operation into a thriving empire by mastering the intricacies of the craft and creating unique recipes. But beware there will always be those who want to see you fail.

title: Pictective 2: Around the World
description: Oh nooo!! Oyen escaped again! Help Doma travel across 12 countries to catch him! Match up those little photo pieces and find where Oyen's hiding

title: Chees
description: What if your chess pieces lied to you? In CHEES, rooks crawl like pawns, queens leap like knights, and every game shuffles the rules. Outsmart the chaos in local PvP or challenge the AI. Think you can adapt?

title: Fairy Tale TD:Hero
description: This is a 3D pigeon tower defense game that utilizes resources to build turrets and collaborates with heroes to block enemy attacks.

title: Dakini
description: Trapped in a rain-flooded village, a man searches for someone dear to him. The storm has awakened something far darker, as possessed villagers, haunting whispers, and the legend of the witch Dakini close in around him.

title: Microwave Simulator
description: An absurd sandbox where you put random objects in a oven and see what happens. Heat, melt, explode, or discover the unexpected.

title: What Surrounds Us
description: What surrounds us? Come find out and restore balance to an abstract and colorful ecosystem where every individual maters.

title: Snake Coil: Puzzle Adventure
description: A relaxing 3D puzzle game where you guide a cute forest snake that grows every move and must fill every tile on the grid.

title: Video Editor
description: Video Editor is a puzzle platformer inspired by various video editing software. As a director, you must film 'movements' as clips, adjust them, and collaborate with chroma key tracks to reach the flag—all within a recording time limit! Film short, reach efficiently!

title: Moorage
description: Moorage is a fishing roguelite where you must travel the ocean to find a way off a desolate island. Meet people stranded like you, level up each time you fail, and catch a bunch of fish!

title: Whiskers Tale
description: A cozy cat adventure set in a charming city. Explore rooftops, chase pigeons, help townsfolk, and uncover heartfelt stories at your own pace.

title: Fragile Frontier
description: You're an owl postal worker who just brought the first automobile to Moonperch Island. Drive with packages stacked on your roof, hit a bump, watch them scatter! Triple-jump to glide, help friends recover cargo, upgrade your truck. 1-4 player co-op. But why is the mountain getting warmer...?

title: Buster Breaks Out
description: A block-breaking roguelite where every upgrade helps you smash more blocks and climb to higher floors. Help Buster grow stronger, defeat the wardens, and break free from his prison.

title: The Final Oath
description: Pick a Hero, Build your Battle deck and destroy endless hordes of enemies. The Final Oath is a Deck-building, Rogue-like, Survivor game. Chase your power fantasy by acquiring powerful cards, min-max your stats and destroy everything in your way. Most Importantly, Fulfill your Oath to Protect!

title: Insanio
description: Autobattler where you send misfits into vehicular combat. Your job is to prepare them, deploy them, watch them struggle and finally watch them die or win in massive explosions.

title: Life Sim: Rise From Nothing
description: Life Sim: Rise from Nothing is a realistic and peaceful world for those building their dreams from scratch. Start by setting up a stall at the market, sell your products, and save up money. Then, buy the rundown bakery inherited from your family and restore it to its former glory.

title: Thomas Ireham in Crimson Spotlight
description: A complete time-loop detective story set in the 1940s — solve a case before it even happens in a single, self-contained sitting.

title: Nightlune Rule
description: Play as Izzy, an elf born from the Mother Tree's fruit, in a misty eternal forest. Wield enchanted runes, combine puzzle cards for chain eliminations, collect relics, and resist the Dark Moon's corruption through cyclical trials to uncover the forest's truth.

title: Heyoo 3D Platformer
description: HEYOO is a pure and uncompromising 3D speedrunning experience. Each level is a complex labyrinth suspended in the void, where skill is not only measured by the precision of your jump, but by your ability to maintain momentum and find the optimal route in three-dimensional space

title: 3D Escape Room: Cursed Legacy
description: After waking up in the manor’s basement, you discover that you’ve aged at an abnormal rate. As you fight to survive, clues and records from different eras gradually bring the mystery into focus. When you become young again, you will inherit the true “legacy”.

title: Game.exe 2: Phantom Strike
description: You find an old computer with a forgotten program installed: Phantom Strike. A single server is still online, frozen in time and waiting for someone to finish the match. What begins as nostalgic curiosity becomes a descent into something far stranger.

title: The Bold Club
description: A totally chaotic card game for up to 6 players where you must cheat to win. Match shapes and colors, use special cards, cheat to secretly get rid of your cards and report other players before they do the same.

title: Humanize Robotics
description: Command a robot that thinks for itself. You choose the destination; its neural network battles the physics. Struggle through brutal obstacle courses, evolve your body with collected data, and master the chaos of movement. Lose a leg? Keep crawling. The Company is watching.

title: SkyRen
description: Race, climb, and free-run through dynamic cityscapes! Build your character, master movement, compete with players, earn gear, level up, and climb the leaderboards to become the ultimate free-runner in this anime parkour MMO!

title: Football AFK
description: The football management game that plays itself. It runs at the bottom of your screen while you live your life. Enjoy real team progression, make a few smart choices, and let the rest unfold without demanding your attention.

title: Boing Over It
description: Boing Over It is a challenge to your pride and your sanity. You’re a spring. You jump. You fail. You fall. And you try again… because you can’t stand letting the game win. Can you reach the top without losing your mind? I don’t think so.

title: Joker on the Spring
description: Joker On The Spring - “ Fall. Learn. Jump again ” . Joker on the Spring is a precision platformer where you control a joker with a spring for legs. Instead of walking, you bounce and ricochet, turning every move into a chaotic mix of humor and frustration.

title: Dear Journey...
description: Run your own little travel agency. Plan itineraries with the cards you are dealt. Satisfying traveller moods and needs to help grow your agency’s reputation.

title: Slorbis: Tower Defense
description: Immerse yourself in the cozy, minimalist world of Slorbis: Tower Defense. Build towers with unique roles, buy modifiers of varying rarities, collect money, and face the unpredictability of procedurally generated maps as you defend the king from dark spirits.

title: Is Zombody Home?
description: Upgrade the house, customize the weapon and charge the special attacks, your cute zombie horde is about to attack.

title: Freaking Hallway
description: Freaking Hallway is a single-player horror game about finding anomalies Play as Tayo, a talkative government agent exploring a looping containment hallway.Interact with every object through physics-based mechanics watch for anything unusual and survive the hidden dangers before the hallway traps you

title: Triz | Triangular Dreaming
description: Enter a realm of sacred geometry and digital Zen. TRIZ is a meditative puzzle game where modern art meets logic. Untangle constellations of triangles, discover the harmony of color, and restore order in a universe of pure abstract forms.

title: Mount Noire
description: Get cash, get meds, get home. Survival horror set in a forgotten ski resort.

title: We Need a Doorman.
description: You are the hotel doorman and a demon hunter. Observe the guests, and if you detect an anomaly, exorcise without hesitation.

title: Cyber Saber Pro
description: Become HKKMR-U, the legendary Cyborg Samurai, and test your reflexes in a fast-paced arcade hack-and-slash survival game. Stand your ground, unleash your sword skills, and face wave after wave of mechanical enemies inspired by Japanese folklore.

title: Cypher Dungeon
description: Identifier = ZERO. Localization = unknown system. Objectives = survive, decrypt, escape. Codes are key. Death is protocol. The sequence begins now.

title: Our Brief Eternity
description: In the visual novel "Eternity, Stars, and Everyday Life," you are Lin Xiaocou, an ordinary office worker whose life is turned upside down when two girls from another world unexpectedly move in. Amidst the light-hearted and joyful daily routines, can you discover a unique happiness for everyone?

title: PawnKingChess
description: 'Pawn King Chess' is a roguelike game themed around Chinese chess. The core mechanic of transforming soldier pieces into king pieces, combined with various weapons and 'unique per game' strategy combinations, ensures that each match is a completely new battle!

title: Slice the Crops!
description: Slice, earn, upgrade, repeat. Slice mutant fruits in an addicting incremental game! Annihilate armies of unique mutant crops, dive into a deep talent tree, unlock new levels, and research powerful fruit mutations to maximize your harvest and dominate the farm.

title: Black Border 3
description: The border never sleeps — and neither can you. Inspect documents, expose secrets, and make life-changing decisions in this gripping night patrol simulator where one mistake can change everything. ️‍♀️

title: Wildwars
description: SEND YOUR CREATURES! Build an army of upgradable creatures, hold the increasing amount of lanes and destroy the enemy Portal before you're overrun!

title: Crimson Banner: War of Liberation
description: Are you ready, comrades? You will command the People's Liberation Army, strike a heavy blow against the aggressive Nationalist reactionaries in the War of Liberation, and win the liberation of all of China!

title: Horde of Distraction
description: An incremental game inspired by classic RPGs. Fight monsters, collect rare gear, progress through a vast skill tree, and defeat powerful bosses!

title: Conquerline
description: Conquerline is a real-time strategy and base-defense game where you build and evolve your civilization across eras. Expand your settlement, manage resources, grow your army, unlock new technologies, and use powerful Edicts to shape tactics and secure victory.

title: Excrucia
description: Excrucia is a first-person indie psychological horror game. You play as Chris — a father who returns home only to find everything disturbingly unfamiliar. But what truly terrifies you… is the monster that calls you “Dad.”

title: DunDie
description: DunDie is a dice-based roguelike where you combine Yahtzee-style rolls to attack or defend, explore shifting routes, discover relics that reshape your strategy, and face an eternal cycle that can only be broken by sacrificing your own dice.

title: Brakes? No, Thanks!
description: Feel like a true road outlaw! "Brakes? No, thanks!" is a dynamic, voxel arcade game, combining crazy ride with spectacular mayhem. Rack up your Penalty score, beat survival and destruction records. Unlock new vehicles and tracks to intensify the road chaos.

title: CRT: Corner Right There!
description: CRT: Corner Right There! is a fast-paced, incremental roguelite filled with arcade nostalgia. Don't just stare at the screen waiting for the logo to hit the corner... make it happen! Get resources, fight off glitchy interferences, and stack upgrades in this JUICY quest for the perfect bounce.

title: Dawn of the Dying
description: In a brutal open world, standing still means death. Explore together in a co-op survival FPS where crafting, building, and fighting with friends is the only way forward.

title: Tow the Line
description: Chained together meets tow trucks in this challenging platformer. Play solo or co-op!

title: Survival Log
description: The apocalypse is here, and you saw it coming. Survival Log is an urban survival game about preparation and foresight. Hoard supplies, reinforce your home, and optimize every run before zombies flood the city. Every failure becomes experience. You must adapt and survive this time.

title: Break Shoot
description: Break Shoot blends the precision of billiards with roguelike builds. Combine unique ball abilities and a variety of accessories to unleash explosive scores and push past each round’s target!

title: Hordekill
description: In an unknown realm, you slay hordes of nightmarish swamp monsters.

title: Don't Crack!
description: A chaotic co-op or solo rage platformer about a fragile egg’s dangerous journey back to its nest.

title: Dr.Clone
description: A mad scientist simulation. Combine parts to create absurd inventions and weapons, travel through portals, and fulfill bizarre customer requests across strange worlds.

title: Cat Chess
description: Play the ancient and thrilling game of Chess but with... cats! Lead your furry friends to the Purrfect battle of brains and whiskers!

title: Pachinko Farm
description: Pachinko Farm is a cozy yet chaotic incremental game where you drop balls to grow your farm in a fully physics-based pachinko world. Bonk → Produce → Sell

title: Gnomed
description: Gnomed is a roguelite clicker base defence game where your humble home is the last line of defense. Hold out against 20 chaotic waves of enemies, unlock new abilities, and grow stronger each run!

title: Theme Park Simulator
description: Take over a closed theme park and bring its nights back to life. Operate rides, sell tickets, serve guests, open new booths, hire staff, and grow the park one shift at a time into the city's ultimate nighttime attraction.

title: Hollowreach: Alone
description: A third-person psychological horror focused on exploration and puzzle-solving. Trapped between the dead and his own thoughts, fight to maintain your sanity in a forgotten world. Each day echoes voices from the past — and the line between reality and delusion begins to fade.

title: The Dame
description: A first-person psychological horror where a harmless camp ritual awakens The Dame: a presence bound to mirrors and silence. Break the mirrors before she reaches you.

title: DragonFire: Defense
description: Choose your dragon and defend your castle against endless waves in a systems-driven roguelite. Level up to draft perks, loot chests, and build upgradeable walls as you adapt to shifting enemy compositions and push your run as far as skill allows.

title: BaseStar
description: Dive into a classic grid-based dungeon crawler RPG in a sci-fi setting with unique classes, each offering a distinct playstyle. Immerse yourself in a fully voiced sci-fi story brought to life by two main characters, guiding you through a narrative full of twists and turns with real-time combat.

title: Dopamine Overdrive
description: 【Survivor × Rhythm × Action】 Step onto the Cyber-POP stage of a virtual future, move to the beat, wipe out waves of data noise enemies, and ignite the crowd’s dopamine with sound, light, and rhythm to create your own C-POP live performance.

title: Elemental Witches
description: In Elemental Witches world, you command Fire, Wind, and Thunder to craft unique spells from three elemental orbs. Merge identical elements to summon powerful pets. After each battle, upgrade elements, unlock items, and shape your own playstyle as you face new adventures.

title: Landmark Battle
description: Landmark Royale is a two-player real-time arena game built for streamers, where players battle to capture zones and use skills while viewers can send chat commands or donate to spawn monsters, create events, or disrupt actions, turning each match into unpredictable chaos.

title: Afterdepth
description: Explore, build, and survive in the depths of a forgotten world. Manage oxygen, power, and resources as you uncover the secrets buried beneath the surface.

title: Ephialtes
description: THE NIGHTMARES NEVER END. Survive a series of antagonists that linger in the corners of your mind, each playing by their own rules.

title: Niramare Quest: Saving a World That Loves Hating Me
description: Reincarnate as a man in a misandrist world in this classic turn-based RPG! Meet colorful characters, fight your way through many dungeons, and unravel the mysteries of a story that hides much more than meets the eye. Do you have what it takes to save a world where everybody hates you?

title: Artifact Hunt: Yao
description: Artifact Hunt: Yao is a roguelike deck-building game. Collect various Yao souls, seek out different artifacts, combine diverse inscriptions, and create your unique build to experience this adventure full of possibilities.

title: Blackout Arena
description: Fight, explore, and survive in BLACKOUT ARENA — a cinematic action-adventure set in a city plunged into darkness. Battle through brutal arena trials, uncover hidden secrets, and take on a global journey filled with danger, rivals, and monthly new missions.

title: Decimation
description: Sci-fi tower defense meets ARPG-like hero combat. Build towers then fight alongside them with your hero as you battle through a campaign to uncover the fate of a colonization effort on a distant planet.

title: Escape From Area 51
description: A story-driven sci-fi detective puzzle game where mind reading, shapeshifting, and social roles open different paths through the game. Explore Area 51, use dialogue, avoid enemies, and uncover a conspiracy inside a secret military base.

title: Only Tactics
description: You lead a tactical group in a series of turn-based battles with other groups. A limited number of actions and rules create an infinite number of tactical combinations. The levels are balanced so that the one who finds the right tactics wins. Get ready, that will not be easy

title: Deep Hunger
description: A short incremental game about cleaning the ocean, and feeding the insatiable hunger of a deep sea creature.

title: Water's Way Down
description: After surviving a plane crash, Caspian wakes up with a strange new power— he can turn into water! Determined to learn more about his powers, he sets out on a journey to find others like him... Use his abilities to solve tricky logic puzzles and help him uncover the truth!

title: Switch the Darkness
description: Memorize the room. Spot the anomaly. Flip the switch. If you miss a detail, the loop resets. A psychological horror where your attention is the only weapon against a shifting reality. Can you break the cycle?

title: Peace Dice
description: The post-apocalypse. When some are trying to survive in a new world, others join the detective agency "Peace Dice", which searches for evidence of mutants. Go on a raid and don't come back empty-handed!

title: Secret Perfore
description: A mystery game where you don't know where you are or what you're supposed to do. The only thing you can do is explore, search, and hope for the best.

title: Bunker KYS
description: Survive in a bunker in this intense social game for 4-10 players. Form alliances, manipulate opponents, and vote on who to condemn to certain death. In a stylish low-poly atmosphere, your main weapon will be not strength, but your ability to negotiate.

title: Jump Bunny
description: Jump! Stomp! This is a fast-paced 2D arcade competitive game. Control your character through precise jumping and movement to dodge, stomp and survive in endless enemy waves, constantly challenging yourself to achieve higher scores and rankings.

title: Rec in Peace
description: REC in Peace is a co-op game for 2-6 players, controlled through your camera and microphone. Complete challenges using your voice and gestures. Each round introduces a new mini-game – and leaves fewer players standing. Eliminate your opponents to survive and escape the Maniac’s grasp.

title: Back Pain Delivery
description: Back Pain Delivery is a physics-based chaotic moving game! Empty houses, drag heavy furniture, load it into your vehicle and deliver it to the new home. Play solo or with friends as simple deliveries turn into total disasters.

title: Navy Island Confidential
description: Discover the secrets of Navy Island in this captivating and funny story, and follow the misadventures of Archibald Figg: a slightly clumsy secret agent in this colorful and relaxing point‑and‑click adventure!

title: Don't Drive Dead
description: Drive, shoot, and survive huge zombie swarms in a top-down roguelite where you build a squad, upgrade your car, and create wild hero synergies. Procedurally generated characters, weapons and levels.

title: Fortune Wheel
description: Fortune Wheel is a stylish rogue-lite "Wheel-Builder" game. You'll spin the wheel, add cards, and trigger chain synergies to pay the ever-increasing rent. Your fate is spinning... Can you pay the rent?

title: Spy Drops Gaiden
description: Infiltrate enemy bases and undertake a series of covert ops in thrilling, old school 2D stealth action.

title: When Voices Died
description: When Voices Died is a game of puzzles and silent emotions. Amid distant echoes and broken memories, you rebuild paths that reveal forgotten feelings — and the weight of choices that still echo.

title: Grand Valor
description: Grand Valor is a fast-paced fantasy action platformer featuring a tiny knight on a daring quest, blending swift movement and intense combat as you navigate challenging levels and defeat enemies with agility and skill.

title: Princess Night
description: 一款含有中国传说、玄幻元素的剧情游戏。玩家将以主人翁的视角参与进多个事件，做出的选择或将影响事件后续的发展方向以体验不同的剧情。

title: Halloween Mystery: 100 Hidden Object Fruits
description: Are you ready to get lost in scenes full of mystery? Find 100 hidden objects in black and white gothic locations full of secrets. Silence, mystery, and patience — all waiting for you in this atmosphere. Focus, explore, and uncover all the mysteries!

title: Early Bird Gets the Space Worm
description: Early Bird gets the Space Worm is a small, casual, incremental game about collecting Space Worms. Explore the expansive skill tree to unlock ever larger birds, upgradeable weapons, and destroy all the things.

title: Stickcross Classic
description: To play, move the sticks. Where three sticks cross, stones will fall. To win, clear the bowl.

title: Oh Puck!
description: Compete in the first ever curling party game! Slide, punch, and sabotage your friends in chaotic matches filled with special items. Outplay, outsmart, and out-slide your rivals in the ultimate frozen showdown!

title: Sidyq
description: Sidyq combines monster collection with dynamic turn-based battles. Unleash your tactical creativity and face formidable bosses in a strategic RPG where every decision can change the outcome of the fight.

title: Klitter
description: KLITTER fuses the precision of arena combat with the chaos of glitchcore and the flow of a movement-driven brawler. Every dash, every shot, every kill defines your rhythm - stop moving and you die, flow perfectly and the system collapses. PURE FLOW. ZERO MERCY.

title: The American Dream of Gunther Aims
description: A retro puzzle shooter built around ricochets, where every shot counts. You play as Gunther, a revolver and a family man, in a constrained turn-based system: one action at a time, until it fully resolves.

title: S.N.A.P.
description: A first-person grindhouse survival horror ride where you hunt cursed objects with a paranormal camera as a cannibal family’s dark attraction changes around you. Randomized runs, killer animatronics, and instant-death encounters across three deadly loops.

title: Genetica: Extinction
description: Your goal is simple - prevent total extinction. The ecosystem reacts to every decision you make. Hunger, predators, and climate shifts will constantly test the limits of evolution.

title: Daemon: The Wolf, the Witch, and the Labyrinth
description: Daemon is a third-person action RPG where you explore a shifting spirit realm as a cursed wolf—then instantly transform into a werewolf for ferocious, skill-based combat against corrupted guardians.

title: Ocean Pop!: Calypso Collision
description: Merge cute underwater creatures together in this physics-based puzzle game. Can you complete the sequence to get to the Whale Shark? Can you merge two Whale Sharks? Travel to the ocean floor for a relaxing game with an upbeat calypso soundtrack and test your skills!

title: Warboss
description: Choose your units, place them where it counts and build an army that wins. Deploy heroes with powerful skills to support your units and swing the battle your way. Unite the clans and take the fight to the Dubdals. Warboss is a casual and goofy battle simulator.

title: Distant Visitant
description: Survive the alien arrival in Distant Visitant, a top-down open-world sandbox. Master talents from marksmanship to cooking while managing hygiene and hydration. Adapt to seasons where winter freezes crops and lakes. Craft, build, hunt, and find survivors. Prepare for them, this is just the start.

title: Cards Lie
description: Unmask the demons. Trust no one. You’ve gathered the entire village for a midnight ritual. Among them hide creatures of pure evil — demons disguised as villagers.

title: Peaceful Fishing Story
description:
Relax and unwind.
Enjoy a slow life all your own, spent fishing at your own pace.

title: Solitaire Crime Stories: Chapter 3
description: New Circus is in town and fun is about to start, only to be ruined by the murder. Can you catch the killer?

title: Tail of Glory
description: A charming 2D adventure where a witty thief solves puzzles with knives, potions, and magic books. Light, humorous, and easy to play — a small game crafted with heart and full of unexpected moments.

title: BunnyFlow
description: So many bunnies. So little control. Breed them, protect them, and try not to wonder why the Goddess always needs more. Cute horror for curious minds.

title: Particulitix
description: Pure 2D chaos made of particles. Fight relentless waves, exploit key positioning, do a clever build, and unlock permanent upgrades. ℙarticuliti𝕏 is a survivor action roguelite from a parallel timeline where 2D arcade games never stopped evolving.

title: Yooca: Your Life
description: Build your dream life in Yooca, a cozy multiplayer life sim set in a vibrant online city. Express yourself through deep avatar and home customization, bond with your loyal Yooca companion, and join a heartwarming community. From mini-games to chilling with friends, how will you live your best live?

title: One Tower Defense
description: One Tower Defense is a Roguelike Tower Defense game where you control a single tower. Gather resources, buy weapons and upgrades, and fight endless waves of enemies. Play in single-player mode or in multiplayer mode, where the last survivor wins.

title: Exogenesis: The Erebus Cycle
description: A sci-fi survival horror with cosmic dread. A civilization on the verge of synthesizing human life is drawn to a planet that responds… and traps them like prey. Exploration, environmental puzzles, and heavy, clunky combat where every bullet counts.

title: Curse of the Shadow
description: "Curse of the Shadow" is a BL-themed horror visual novel. Cursed by a "ghost", protagonist Xu finds eerie dark shadows in every photo he takes.Once escaping reality, he’s forced by fate to face fears again.To uncover the curse’s truth, he and two friends embark on a terrifying, unknown journey.

title: Corner Clash
description: Idle auto‑battle game running quietly in your screen’s corner. Upgrade, unlock weapons, and face endless waves of stronger enemies.

title: Donnie's Delicious Nuclear Funeral
description: A point-n'-click choose-your-own-adventure game about Susie, a kind girl in the post-apocalypse who must arrange a funeral for her dearly-departed brother Donnie in the town that hates his stupid, dead guts!

title: Seeking Asylum: The Game
description:
Choose Your Character from a list of The Asylum Members and play as either Emily Elkins, Nepharius, Ethic The God, Lehman, or Maniac and go through each character storyline.

Explore the Seeking Asylum Universe as your chosen character and play through their story, picking up weapons, collectibles, open your inventory, check stats, etc

NPCs react to your whomever you choose. Interact with The Asylum as a whole unit no matter who you play as. Witness events unfold from various perspectives and explore Mania and uncover the secrets of the Seeking Asylum Universe

Attack with combos using various weapons, including Katana, Daggers, Bow and Arrows, Scythes and use various play styles from Samurai and Archer to Summoner and Mage classes!

title: Exit Lab 15 Rooms
description: Welcome to the Exit Lab, where we research your Exit Skill! Challenge countless room escapes and aim for that Master rank!

title: Digimon Story Time Stranger: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
• Digimon Story Time Stranger
• Season Pass
- Additional Digimon & Episode Pack 1
- Additional Digimon & Episode Pack 2
- Additional Digimon & Episode Pack 3
- Season Pass Bonus: Farm Item Golden Moai
• Deluxe Edition Bonus: Costume Cyber Sleuth Set

title: Digimon Story Time Stranger: Ultimate Edition
description:
The Ultimate Edition includes:
• Digimon Story Time Stranger
• Season Pass
- Additional Digimon & Episode Pack 1
- Additional Digimon & Episode Pack 2
- Additional Digimon & Episode Pack 3
- Season Pass Bonus: Farm Item Golden Moai
• Deluxe Edition Bonus: Costume Cyber Sleuth Set
• Costume Pack
- Costume Swimwear Set
- Costume Chosen Children Set
- Costume Digimon Costume Set
• Costume Public Safety Suit & Special Supplies Set
• Cyber Sleuth BGM Pack
• Early Unlock: Special Agumon & Gabumon

title: Jrago III Requiem of the Night
description: JRAGO III Requiem of the Night is a gothic METROIDVANIA action RPG. Play as JRAGO, a demon hunter in an epic battle of spiritual warfare. Slay your way through hordes of demons and monsters to a heavy metal soundtrack! Overcome the forces of darkness to save the world and restore the light!

title: The V Anomaly
description: The V Anomaly is an atmospheric observation game where small changes matter. Search each room for anomalies and choose the correct exit: progress deeper as the Area number climbs or make one wrong call and return to Area 0. Stay sharp. Doubt everything.

title: Cut Content Restored
description: This is a Vanilla SB mod that plans to expand the Pizzaplex Steel Wool left us with, bringing back content from the Pre-Release build, and content from the Pre-Release maps, while still keeping the current SB experience.

title: The White Hell
description: A visual novel game about fate and choice importance.

title: O2Jam: The Beginning
description: O2Jam : The Beginning is the official PC version based on O2Jam - Music & Game, featuring the entire series collection. Enjoy legendary original tracks, overwhelming note impact, and various key modes! From nostalgic classics to new hits, experience the authentic rhythm action of O2Jam.

title: PamPam Kana Students
description: PamPam Kana Students is an educative game to learn and practice Hiragana and Katakana. By using simple kanas or using Diacritics and Digraphs, you will be able to train yourself and play on different game modes.

title: LowPoly 3D Art Paint by Number
description: Collect 3D object by numbers Puzzle for brain training and the development of imagination. A game for all ages, boys and girls. Collect polygons and create fantastic images!

title: Feditor
description: Fast-paced mouse clicker simulator of the daily life of a Twitch and Youtube streamer. Inspired by the content creator Fedmyster, feel the stress of editing, interact with your stream viewers and see how long you can keep them entertained while also maintaining your life and keeping up with your work.

title: Misteri Rumah Pak RT
description: "Misteri Rumah Pak RT" is a horror-themed action-puzzle multiplayer game where players must explore a mysterious mansion, solve puzzles, and escape by finding keys, either alone against a computer-controlled antagonist or with up to 4 players in co-op mode.

title: Monkey King Simulator: Chapter Huaguo Mountain
description: Stories revised from Journey to the West. Souls-like combats; Powerful Bosses; Hundreds of different Weapon&Armors; Super big map to explore; Nothing special? You cut me!

title: TBTE: The Button Tycoon Experience
description: In this game, you will play has UFXOID a simple robot that will fight a giant button to collect coin and upgrade his force power, Will it find its way out of this experiment?

title: The Worst Game
description: Click Big Button. Unlock achievements and waste your time. Rank amongst the top players and stand proud on top of the leaderboard.

title: Sign White
description: "Sign White" is a text visual novel set in a fictionalized medieval era. Send letters from your pigeon house to communicate with people for a limited period of time. Make connections to save people, listen to their worries, and participate in important decisions to change the fate of the world.

title: Trailer Game
