description: Reversing a trailer is tough in real life, this game takes the challenge to the extreme. Traverse tight corners, uneven terrain and narrow bridges in this ultimate test of skill and determination.

title: Card Corner
description: An idle poker game that sits in the corner of your screen while you do other things.

title: Tabletop Shop Simulator
description:
Tabletop Shop Simulator is a business simulation game where players manage a tabletop gaming store. The game focuses on stocking shelves with collectible figures, organizing product displays, setting prices, and serving customers.

Players can sell tabletop miniatures, manage inventory, complete collectible sets, and expand their shop over time. The gameplay combines store management mechanics with collection progression systems, allowing players to grow their business while curating themed figure collections.

The game features a first-person perspective and emphasizes economic management, customer flow, and collection-based progression within a simulation framework.

title: Asteroid Patrol
description: Bang bang! Shoot raining asteroids, dodge attacks of flying insects and battle against huge weird monsters! Gain exp, level up, pick perk and then rinse & repeat. Story? Nobody cares. If you are looking for a difficult and punishing game, don't leave without playing this one.

title: Idle Rat: Island Digger
description: A relaxing pixel art idle digging game. A clever little rat uncovers treasures beneath a tropical island while running on top of all applications. Upgrade your stats, sell your finds, and progress at your own pace.

title: Caravan: The Trade Road
description: Every journey is dangerous and every decision shapes your fate in this 2D pixel-art open-world trading RPG. Start as a novice merchant, level up, build powerful setups, trade wisely, fight bandits and bosses, clear dungeons, and rise as a legend of the trade routes by climbing the leaderboards.

title: Exorcism:Nuo Rituals
description: Exorcism:Nuo Rituals is a horror pazzle game. A late-night delivery goes horribly wrong, pulling you into the city's supernatural underbelly. Saved by Nuo mask, you enter a hidden world where Nuo Masters against unspeakable horrors. But you'll soon discover this mask didn't choose you by accident.

title: All in One
description: ALL IN ONE is a co-op physics game where five players share one body or sometimes, a single object. Control balance, jump, and climb together through our custom physics system. Even simple moves can be a huge challenge so communicate, encourage, and move as one.

title: PawlleyBall
description: PawlleyBall is a cute volleyball game where cats face off in quick 1v1 matches. Jump, dive, and spike to score against opponents on colorful, stylized courts. Simple controls and lively rallies make it fun to pick up and replay.

title: Monster Lily
description: A Deeply Tactical ASCII Roguelike with unique and often surprising mechanics. Explore Hanwu Divinity College and uncover its secrets.

title: City of Stars
description: "City of Stars" is a 2D action role-playing game.You take on the role of a "Human" and journey to "City of Stars" to explore the future of humanity and AI.You must manage your time to enhance attributes, earn gold, and advance relationships with humans and AI beings..

title: Among Paws
description: “Who stole the fish? Guess wrong and the thief feasts, guess right and you grow your belly!” A cozy yet suspicious 4–8 player party game where sneaky cats steal fish at night and accuse each other in the morning.

title: Hidden Tails
description: Hidden Tails is a cozy hidden object game where every squeak tells a story.

title: Memoria Arcana
description: A single-player card game of memory and fate. Reveal cards to form poker-style combos, earn points, and overcome cursed stages that twist your field. Unlock and upgrade Arcana cards to alter runs and reshape destiny with every turn.

title: Mega Load On
description: Ai assitant "Larisa" to Brief you in details 5 different levels with secrets 5 different weapons 4 floppy disks to find for character upgrades Different metal materials to loot 5 different Boss-Fights and Unique story with authors visuals and secret ending.

title: WishPot
description: Korean folklore comes to life in a strategic board game where you chase your wishes! Combine number-and-ability cards to battle, upgrade your deck, and claim territory. Every match feels fresh—and tense—thanks to missions, talismans, sponsorships, and the Read system!

title: Lifecycles of the Traveler Spider
description: The Traveler Spiders are a species unique to their galaxy. A galaxy that is regularly destroyed and rebuilt by the galactic seasons. Ranging from tiny specs to star sized colossi, all the spiders must do their part to restore the natural balance and survive another season.

title: Snack Escort
description: Who would’ve thought that a roguelike, card game, and tower defence could come together over a basket of food? Travel through magical lands filled with hungry creatures, collect cards and artifacts that shape your strategy with every run. Escort your food through this whimsical fantasy world.

title: MioAquaria
description: Build and manage a cozy underwater sandbox aquarium run by cats. Discover fantasy sea creatures, research upgrades, send expeditions, and balance fish, staff, and visitor needs to become the world’s top aquarium.

title: Saccharine Echo
description: Saccharine Echo is a story that walks the line between psychological drama and dark paranormal romance. Your choices will shape the fate of a young woman haunted by an obsessive entity from another world.

title: Tinkering Is Enough
description: Follow a story driven narrative while solving stylistic jigsaw puzzles! Flip, rotate, and rebuild customers treasured items!

title: Viola_
description: Welcome to VIOLA_. In this cybernoir visual novel, you are ELO, a robot tasked with helping the city's police. Investigate unusual crimes, court a colorful cast of teammates, and uncover the secrets of the world of Juniba, the people around you, and your own creation.

title: Nights of Nil
description: Control your villagers one by one in this action-RTS survival game. Build, defend, and survive night after night across procedural islands. Assign tasks, fight off waves, and settle each island to win the run.

title: HiPet!
description: Hi Pet! is a cozy pet life simulation about companionship, everyday moments, and the gentle flow of time.

title: Fearmates
description: Fearmates is a 1–4 player co-op psychological horror game. As a group of friends, you explore locations with paranormal activity and uncover the truth behind the events using your own equipment.

title: Neural Drive
description: Neural Drive is a cyberpunk action rogue-lite. Use acceleration powers to reflect bullets, dodge attacks, and counter enemies. Master weapons and upgrade your skills to overcome relentless enemies and deadly bosses.

title: Death Pong
description:
A brutal beer pong game where losers are getting electrocuted.

A skill-based challenge set in an underground bar full of illegal, deadly matches.

title: War of Chess
description: War of Chess is an online 1v1 chess game featuring animated character pieces, where players compete to climb ELO ranks, earn Gold, and level up

title: Feed the Circuit
description: Feed the Circuit, is a 2D platformer game that provides high stakes action. Varying missions await you as you progress. Customization is key, a personalized arsenal will allow you to uncover the secrets of the circuit. Can you make it through? Not everything is as it seems down here...

title: Honor Mice
description: Dash, slash, and shoot through handcrafted levels across vibrant worlds in a fast-paced action platformer! Stop the forces of evil from stealing your mysterious lunch and uncover the destiny that awaits you!

title: Daily Burden
description: Daily Burden is a chest-opening roguelike parodying mobile games. Experience short runs where you’ll learn to crave ads, build your way out with over 100 items and to keep up with key inflation… but beware of (FAKE) microtransactions !

title: Gallipoli Trenches: The Forgotten Front WW1
description: Amidst the chaos of Gallipoli, a battle-hardened officer vows to protect a lost child. Navigate trenches, solve environmental puzzles, and witness the human cost of war. In this atmospheric 2D platformer, survival isn't just about staying alive—it's about keeping your humanity.

title: Sunsave
description: Sunsave is a relaxing incremental game with a vaporwave and minimalist vibe. Destroy meteors, collect resources, and evolve the Sun with upgrades that unlock new mechanics!

title: Tale of Immortal Ring
description: "Tale of the Immortal Ring": A relaxed, top-down shooter. Use a mystical ring to journey between worlds. Battle monsters, gather resources, repair the ring, and grow stronger. Your final goal? Shatter the heavens and ascend to immortality.

title: Pal Pachinko
description: Your job is boring. Pal Pachinko isn't. Park this idle game in the corner of your screen and watch your balls drop along with your productivity. It's the most efficient way to waste your time. Why focus on one thing when you can fail at two? It's small enough that your boss won't notice (probably).

title: One Mind
description: A 3D puzzle-platformer where you control two characters in different locations, each facing their own challenges. Navigate through obstacles, solve interconnected puzzles, and coordinate their actions carefully — every move to help one could put the other in danger.

title: NPC Simulator
description: NPC SIMULATOR is a game where you can finally become that boring NPC! No swords or spells. Your job is to give out quests, fix crooked textures, and do whatever it takes to keep players from reporting bugs. Hang in there!

title: To Be Connected
description: To Be Connected is a relaxing, minimalist strategy game where you shape the land, connect your sites, and maintain a balanced, harmonious landscape. Build a world that expands forever, or craft real-country layouts by shaping land and connecting important locations.

title: The Ones Beyond
description: A first-person forest horror game where you search for your missing sister while being stalked by a mysterious cult in the darkness.

title: Genome Guardian 2
description: COMBINE WEAPONS in the microscopic shooter with macroscopic depth. BUILD YOUR NANOBOT from hundreds of parts. SURVIVE the microbial onslaught once more in this psychedelic dive to the Abyss, full of mutations, minerals, anomalies and powerup polyps. SHMUP mode turns it into a vertical shoot 'em up!

title: Ghost Restaurant
description: In a melancholic first person narrative puzzle game, you are the Memory Chef of a mysterious restaurant for lost souls. Explore their memories, solve story driven and logic based puzzles, uncover deep regrets, and serve their final meal to bring them peace.

title: Stillwell
description: Minesweeper meets horror. Deterministic grid puzzles with clear rules. Use your lantern, flashlight, and chalk to escape before your oxygen runs out.

title: Fantasy Wars: Endless Heroes
description: Fantasy Wars: Endless Heroes is a turn-based tactical strategy game. You lead a team of mercenaries from different races, each with unique skills. Explore a randomly generated fantasy world, recruit defeated enemies, capture pets, challenge demon lords, or conquer the world step by step.

title: The Martial World of Drinking: Wu Song
description: In Wu Song, you will step into the passionate Water Margin world as the hero Wu Song and embark on a unique card-based strategic adventure!

title: No Pain No Gain
description:
A fun physics sandbox game
Place traps, saws, spikes, and all sorts of weird obstacles.
Every hit gives you coins, which you can use to unlock even more stuff. You can build whatever you want: from simple jump pads to complete obstacle courses full of chaos.
You can just mess around or try to break your own record, it's all about experimenting and having fun.

title: Bid King
description: BidKing: A multiplayer game of strategic bluffing and collectible hunting. Use unique character skills to gain intel in sealed-bid auctions. Analyze behavior and clues to win items cheaplyor bluff to make others overpay. Who will be the true Auction Master?

title: Ming Dynasty: Cards & Court
description: Mandarin Spin: Dynasty's Fate​ combines card strategy with slot-machine thrills for a unique take on Ming Dynasty power struggles. Each card pull is a high-stakes gamble of wealth and prestige—a strategic choice between life and death. Pay taxes, climb the ranks, rewrite history.

title: CoinClave
description: Summon humans through coin tosses and engage in intense battles — a Coin Toss × Card Battle game. Whether you can summon them depends on luck. Manipulate that luck with strategy and seize victory.

title: Terra Division
description: Combine FPS skill and RTS strategy in one game. From the strategic overview of a commander to the focused fire of a frontline soldier, every perspective serves the same purpose: absolute victory. Experience a war where every life has value and every order carries the weight of consequence.

title: Mini Car Coin Collector
description: A fast-paced top-down 2D arcade racing game with endless single-player action and competitive 1v1 multiplayer. Collect coins, upgrade 10 unique cars, chase high scores, and outdrive your opponent in quick skill-based races.

title: Mutagenic 2
description: Mutagenic 2 is an online action RPG of limitless customization, brutal combat, and endless replayability. Forge your character with a massive passive tree and a vast library of skills, supports, and gear — each capable of transforming how you fight.

title: Mixatro
description: Mixatro is a game where you merge Balls and buy upgrades to allow you to score higher and reach higher goals. It blends the simple, relaxing puzzle fun with the exciting, strategic choices of building a powerful deck.

title: Barefort
description: "The fewer defenses you have, the more you become yourself." On the board, the score spreads over time, and corruption erodes. Stack units to create chain effects and turn the tide with minimal placement. Placing too many units will destroy you, while placing too few will prevent you from defending.

title: Ethan's Watch
description: Survive. Protect. Endure. An intense, action-packed survival FPS where you fight through hundreds of zombies, manage scarce resources, and do everything you can to keep your pregnant wife alive.

title: Fishing Inc
description: Fishing Inc is an addictive incremental fishing game! Catch fish, earn cash, and unlock powerful skills. Master new ponds, fill your Fish Log with Legendary catches, and become the ultimate angler.

title: Inkoid
description: Rule the skies and paint the arena in your team's colors! Dive into the vibrant world of Inkoid, a 3v3 hyper aerial shooter where capturing airborne strongholds with your team is the key to victory.

title: The Mortimer Paradox
description: A third-person sci-fi horror game about exploring your grandfather’s abandoned mansion and its interdimensional portals. Solve puzzles, evade monsters, and uncover why Dr. Voss vanished.

title: Teeth Cutter
description: A collection of short horror experiences meant to give you horror, disgust, curiosity, dread and much much more

title: Wish Upon
description: Wish Upon is the debut game from Inchworm Games! It’s ½ part cozy, ½ part art project, ½ part space-frogger-metroidvania-lite that is perhaps way more challenging than we thought it might be...just like math! Head to our website to put YOUR wish into our game.

title: B.I.D.
description: B.I.D. - Boss in Diapers is a competitive card game set in a chaotic daycare! Defeat your rivals to sit on the Boss Chair. Create your Baby Mafia Boss and battle with 2–4 players to rule the daycare.

title: Demigod Islands: A Puzzle to Die For
description: Vicious demigods demand sacrifices! To please them and uncover their secrets, take control of captive creatures, explore Demigod Islands and solve 50+ mindbending puzzle rooms by... killing yourselves. In this puzzle platformer, death is the goal and it can take many shapes and forms.

title: Hotdog Delivery Hotdog
description: Come play as Frank, as you deliver Hotdogs from one side of the mall to another, in the chaos, mayhem, and construction of this mostly abandoned mall. Navigate carefully in this physics-based gameplay environment delivering as many hotdogs as you can.

title: Stupid Spaceships
description: Survive from the deadly space as the Deadly Duo “Toshiro” and “T-su” in their Stupid Spaceship. A 2 player co-op game (Solo is fine) in which you have to control each thrusters to steer the (Stupid) Spaceship to reach the goal before your Stupid Spaceship is broken!!

title: Shoot Till You Meet Death
description: You can’t outrun Death — but you can make him wait. Shoot till you meet Death is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter. Survive endless waves, forge powerful bullet synergies, and push your limits until you finally meet DEATH himself.

title: MechaBlight
description: 《MechaBlight》is a Rougelite 2D platform adventure-action game; you will be searching our ever-changing, futuristic...yet ruined world. Fight, die, obtain resources, unlock gear, and get stronger from each gameplay. Equip yourself with your own style to challenge powerful creatures in this world!

title: Slime Buddy Time
description: Take care of your slime pet in a cozy world! Play minigames, level up, unlock cute items, and customize your buddy and its home. Keep up to 3 fluffy companions while you work or study. Relax, decorate, and enjoy adorable company—you won’t feel alone anymore.

title: Alisa’s Incident Report
description: Nursing student Alisa takes on a part-time job ghosts to pay for tuition. By glimpsing the ghost’s past memories and providing compassionate nursing care, help them rest in peace! A medical and occult RPG made by a REAL NURSE!

title: Ikun Go Go Go
description: This is a 2D platformer with a trainee idol theme, inspired by the classic gameplay of 'NS-Shaft'. You will play as an aspiring idol trainee, proving your skills on 100 challenging stages!

title: Jargon
description: A word-puzzle roguelite where classic word games meet wild, rule-breaking builds.

title: Castles of War
description: A side-scrolling real-time strategy game of conquest, courage, and creation. Raise armies, command formations, and fight across hand-crafted pixel battlefields in a war-torn fantasy world.

title: Multiverse Idle
description: Start from zero and idle-conquer your way across the Multiverse! Train your stats, unlock powerful skills and upgrades, and recruit heroes from every corner of existence to battle ever-stronger (and ever-weirder) foes in fast-paced auto-battles.

title: Berserker 2: The Saga of Hilde
description:
A Father's Wrath. A Sister's Prophecy. A Child Lost to the Shadows.
Step into the blood-soaked boots of Asbjorn, a fallen warrior consumed by vengeance, in Berserker 2: The Saga of Hilde — a brutal side-scrolling action game that blends cinematic storytelling, intense melee combat, and a haunting Nordic world torn by myth, sorrow, and violence.

This is not just a sequel. It’s a reckoning.

title: Tung Tung Together: Online Deathrun Party
description: A multiplayer deathrun party game where you activate traps as Tung Tung, and if someone clears the course, the role switches. Cute characters, online competition, chaos, and fun-filled maps—collect the highest score and dominate the mayhem!

title: Chicken Chicken
description: Enter the brutal pecking order of the wasteland! Chicken Chicken is a party game for 2-6 players. Survive mad mini-games, form temporary alliances, and claw your way to the top. Total feathery anarchy!

title: Gardener Simulator
description: Start your own gardening business. Mow lawns, Trim hedges, blow leaves. Upgrade tools and become the ultimate gardener.

title: Idlemon
description: Idlemon is an idle desktop monster tamer. Played on the side of your screen, your monster will gain experience and collect monster eggs. Upgrade your stats, purchase and collect cards, used to decorate your island.

title: Bulk
description: Collect cards, mix them, watch them rise their rank, sell for gold, and invest in upgrades. Stack, mix, sell and repeat... The machines in this dark fantasy factory keep humming, and the profits are waiting for you...

title: Necro Genesis
description: "Necro Genesis" is an action-packed, dark-humor game where you control a cute zombie girl and mercilessly slaughter humans! It's a 2D top-down action game with simple controls. With runs lasting less than 10 minutes, it's perfect for a quick break or a secondary game.

title: Tiana's Fishing Diary
description: This is a pixel art idle desktop fishing game.Catch fish, place them in your aquarium, and let them generate gold for you.Each fish has unique skills—mix and match to maximize your income.Upgrade, customize, unlock new areas, and collect all kinds of fish!

title: Endless Evolution
description: Absorb the DNA of other creatures to gain their unique abilities. Solve handcrafted pixel-art puzzles. Switch forms strategically, your last DNA is your only power until you die and choose again.

title: Fast & Fractured
description: Step into typical Spanish sun-baked places and prepare for Fast & Fractured experience, a frenetic physics-based driving shooter for up to 8 contenders— in a chaotic multiplayer battle royale. Choose from 4 colorful elderly characters and battle in stereotypical Spanish maps

title: Pharmacy 24
description: Pharmacy 24 is a horror simulator game where you take on the role of a pharmacist, serving customers and taking care of the Pharmacy... Who knows, maybe one day it will accept you.

title: The Long Winter: I Am Not an Animal
description: You inherit your father’s tavern in a small, isolated region.By day, life seems ordinaryBut when night falls, someone always knocks on your door.

title: Topobeam
description: Topobeam is a puzzle game about redirecting lasers in different two-dimensional manifolds. The levels operate on a grid system, but pay attention to how the sides of the grid are glued together as players, objects, and lasers can cross over these gluings to different parts of the level.

title: Farmch Revolution
description: A piglet kidnapped by a vile butcher. Dive into a gory field of vengeance, rescue the piglet, and bring it home!

title: Jimmy Jumps
description: Jimmy Jumps is a throwback platformer that combines the simplicity of classic platformers with the mechanical depth of speedrunning. Compete for high scores in over 90 hand-crafted levels!

title: Nine Skies
description: Nine Skies is a myth-inspired roguelite bullet heaven. As an ancient deity, command auto-firing divine artifacts through the Nine Heavens. Survive hordes of mythical beasts in fast-paced, screen-filling combat where power meets elegance.

title: Alice Landing
description: Alice Landing is a vertical scrolling, real-time reaction dodging game. Control Alice as she lands in city ravaged by totalitarianism and war, dodging obstacles, collecting scattered codons, following Alice searches for her brother, unlocks encyclopedia entries, and unravels the final secret.

title: The Trailer Incident
description: A lonely evening in a RV in the woods. Strange lights appear above the trees. Hide from the unknown and try to survive the night when the sky grows comes too close.

title: Our Metal Bowl
description: Explore, fight alongside your robot companion, solve puzzles, and gather essential nutrients to restore life to an abandoned greenhouse.

title: Shell Increment
description: An active incremental were You Command your Skeleton Pirate crew. Destroy and Loot ships of their precious shells, Buy and Upgrade cannons. Unlock new abilities and Face Powerful Admirals and become the Richest Pirate there is.

title: Signal Hill
description: Signal Hill is a psychological multiplayer horror game blending exploration, teamwork, and survival. Decode signals, uncover the truth, and face what’s waiting in the dark.

title: Side Whoop
description: Arcade racing reborn: side-scrolling, pure zen, pure style. Much retro.

title: Undergone: Before
description: Explore the story of Kale Vortex in a world where nature thrives — until every step begins to change it.

title: SCP: The Beginning
description: A first-person survival horror game set inside a collapsing containment facility. Explore restricted sectors, read unreliable reports, and survive hostile entities where following procedures can be just as deadly as breaking them.

title: The Old Man’s Will
description: Welcome to your grandfather’s old property, a lonely patch of land deep in the woods. Strange creatures roam the area at night, hungry and unpredictable. Watch the cameras, keep them fed, and try to make it through five long nights alive.

title: The Story of Mikagoyama
description: This is an RPG where you explore a mountain called Mikagoyama. The water from this mountain is very delicious.The water from this mountain is very delicious.The water from this mountain is very delicious.The water from this mountain is very delicious.The water from this mountain is very delicious.Th

title: Stratapath TD
description: Design a tower maze, upgrade, change their targeting with layered priorities and customize their abilities with 98 different options to fight against 8 factions each with their own abilities and boss over 16 maps.

title: Freelance Dead
description: A roguelite top‑down twin‑stick shooter. Rain, shine, or zombie outbreak—nothing stops a Courier on a deadline. Shoot, loot, and scoot through hordes of undead with ridiculous item synergies. Earn cash, unlock weapons, and grow from broke gig worker to a walking apocalypse.

title: Shattered Realm Rebirth
description: Multi-world rogue-lite endless challenge. The surface world hides dangers, the inner world overflows with treasure. Transcend worlds and master time through soul transference. Fight your way out and escape this reality. Strategic builds reduce reliance on pure stats.

title: Mystic Tavern
description: Mystic Tavern - co-op simulator tavern and farm with a mystical twist. Build your homestead, explore multiple map regions, harvest and mine resources, cook dishes and brew potions. Customize your character, bond with charming NPCs, and face subtle horror after sundown as you uncover hidden truths.

title: Starburst Fever Night
description: Enjoy fast-paced match-3 puzzle battles! Quickly move star blocks and aim for chain reactions!

title: Grégoire Lefèbvre Investigations: The Vow of Hate
description: Step into a fully voice-acted French detective story — uncover a dark mystery as Grégoire Lefèbvre in a gripping point & click narrative adventure.

title: Runebound
description: Traverse the Nine Norse Realms in this action-roguelike bullet Hel. Loot weapons from your fallen foes, enchant, customize, and enhance them with Runes. Craft the ultimate build to survive and challenge the very Gods...

title: Panic Crew
description: Panic Crew is a chaotic open-world co-op rescue simulator where you and your friends team up as paramedics to save lives. Find patients, stabilize them, and upgrade your ambulance!

title: Vitavania
description: Sandbox Metroidvania. No words. Life and drifting autumn leaves with adorable catgirls! . ݁₊ ⊹ . ݁˖ . ݁

title: Morkull: Ascend to the Gods
description: Play as Morkull, God of Death and Darkness. Aware that he finds himself in a video game once again, you must help him escape so he can carry out his new plan for world domination. To do so, you must defeat an entire pantheon of gods in thrilling boss battles.

title: Oceanside Whispers
description: In Oceanside Whispers, the ocean is your canvas. Build and decorate spaces above or beneath the waves. Arrange rooms, add light, furniture, and cozy details to create calm retreats.

title: When the Moon Falls, We Speak
description: The moon is falling, and the world nears its end. You play as Hill, a museum curator who chooses to stay on Earth. There, you meet 12, a mysterious red-haired woman who keeps you company as the world fades. Through your final conversations, you uncover her secret—and perhaps, the reason you stayed.

title: Jigsaw Jab
description: Jigsaw Jab is a 2D top-down, wave-based action game fused with jigsaw puzzle assembly. Defeat the rogue puzzle pieces and piece everything back together before chaos takes over!

title: Tax Return
description: If the suits at the SRI think they can fleece people's taxes, they'd better watch out for the wolf. Join Swindling Steve as you take back your hard-earned money from the SRI's collectors, but watch out for the high rollers behind the scenes.

title: Robolucion: The Sandwich Conspiracy
description: Robolucion: The Sandwich Conspiracy is a fast-paced first-person shooter set in a post-apocalyptic era, where mind-controlled “sheep” have taken over. Fight your way through hordes of brainwashed citizens, collect the mysterious purple serum, and uncover the truth behind the Sandwich Conspiracy.

title: Colorado Rail Game
description: Experience Colorado by rail in this relaxing travel simulation. Manage your inventory and hunger as you journey across the plains, collecting rare souvenirs and local lore. Meet a cast of diverse passengers to uncover the authentic history and culture of the Centennial State.

title: Hamsteria!
description: "Hamsteria" is a short (~1-2 hours) difficult two player co-op game where you're each a hamster in attached wheels. You can only spin your individual wheel forwards or backwards. There is no jump button, and there is no turn action. To escape, you must work together.

title: Dungeons & Warbands
description: A fast turn-based, grid-based hack and slash Dungeon Crawler in an Open World with many towns, caves, and dungeons to visit or raid. Go solo or lead your warband of allies or monsters. Engage in brutal combat with realistic armor layers protecting against crippling body part damage.

title: Wubbo: PuterPal
description: Meet Wubbo, your cozy desktop companion! Fish, cook, craft, and more together in this relaxing idle RPG for your screen.

title: Quiet in the Library
description: Quiet in the Library is a point and click horror game about working the night shift in a library while danger lurks.

title: EchoChamber: Not Welcome
description: Platform to dodge enemies and reach the end. If only the end didn't echo.

title: The Adventures of R.Sole: Nothing, Nowhere & Not at the Same Time
description: A sarcastic IT guy becomes the universe’s least qualified hero in a crisis he can’t reboot. Surrounded by oddball characters and improbable predicaments, he learns sarcasm really can save the day. A comedy sci-fi point & click where chaos reigns, heroism is optional, and logic is a mere suggestion.

title: Drifting Dots
description: A minimalist physics roguelite where you create a mesmerizing cascade of droplets. Choose from three distinct modes and discover powerful upgrade synergies to master the flow. Calm, complex, and endlessly replayable.

title: Rewind Night
description: What makes a perfect Friday night? For 12-year-old Lucas, it’s cheese-stuffed pizza and a trip to the local rental store, Rewind Video. For just a couple of dollars (of his parents’ money), he can get a whole weekend with a game he’s only ever read about in his favourite gaming magazine, Game/Life. He might even discover a new favourite worthy of adding to his birthday or Christmas lists! Now he just needs to make the difficult decision of which game to pick…

title: Anagramarama
description: Anagramarama is a simple wordgame in which one tries to guess all the different permutations of a scrambled word which form another word within the time limit. Guess the original word and you move on to the next level.

title: Hellhole Game
description: Hellhole is an isometric physics puzzle game for Windows with an ecological message and cool jazz...

title: Razed are the Powerful
description:
Ulrika has come down with a mysterious illness. She has been bedridden for days. Whenever she exerts herself, the pain only seems to become worse. She agreed with her husband Brian -- she should stay home from her late nights fighting in the coliseum until she feels better.

But, she can't help herself. Each night, she sneaks out of their home to try her might against the coliseum's eccentric fighters. Her illness is getting worse, and it's becoming more clear that there's nothing natural about it. Who did this to her...?

Maybe she should listen to Lena and just go home.

title: Opening
description:
OPENING is the first entry in a series of annual abstract virtual art galleries that release on the First Friday of each year.

OPENING features 16 rooms, mostly in random order, that reveal personal and universal truths. Narrative themes include personal growth, commercialization of art, DIY creative community and perseverance.

title: Football Club Inside
description: Lead a small football club through one unforgettable season. Make tough choices, face the media, manage morale and ambition — every decision shapes your story in this cinematic, story-driven football management drama.

title: Hedgeborough
description:
Welcome to Hedgeborough!

An open world game about the city of Hedgeborough, where a newspaper about declining hedgehog numbers kickstarts community action to improve the biodiversity of the urban area, helping to bring the city together to improve public spaces and maybe bring back hedgehogs too....

A game about community conservation, rewilding, speculative urban futures and ultimately... hedgehogs!

title: Lux Muris
description: The rats, whispering in the shadows, spoke in riddles about the unnatural light. A subtle, almost imperceptible hum fills the air. You can feel it watching you, as if it's always there. Before it consumes your mind, gather what you can.

title: Gal Vs Village
description: GAL VS VILLAGE is an GAL like old-school FPS. You play as Kessenji “Blood-sucker” Yui, infiltrate the village, and must bring the situation under control. Move at high speed, swing your knife, blast away with the shotgun, and drive away the supernatural!!!!!!

title: Idle Garden
description: This little garden quietly grows at the bottom of your desktop. With a bit of patience and care, it brings you more delightful plants and decorations. Arrange your desk garden with love, and let it be your gentlest companion through work and rest alike.

title: Swans At The Welkin
description:
Regina awakens after having a disturbing nightmare. She is alone and finds herself on the farmstead of an arcane religious community. How did she got here? She really needs to get her stuff together. Anyway. She can´t remember.

Her husband Erik is missing. Did those strange people kidnap him? Was he deported while the siege of her home town took place? Does the cult of the Swan have anything to do with it?

Regina needs answers. Quickly. Otherwise Erik might be lost forever.

title: Echoes of Pinebridge
description: A slice-of-life college story that gradually develops into a supernatural mystery, all guided by your choices.

title: Balathrone
description: Balathrone is a strategic card-building game where you combine building cards to defend your kingdom. Build by day, survive enemy waves by night! Empower yourself with spells and unleash devastating attacks through endless combinations!

title: Fuck AI
description:
You don't like generative AI? Good, this game is for you!

You were making pancakes with your partner listening to the radio, the speaker announces that ClosedAI will boot its new Artificial General Intelligence. Suddenly the power cuts. That's enough, you have to do something.

Shoot all the AI in your way and try to unplug the AGI.

title: Echo of Humanity
description: A slow, atmospheric horror experience set aboard an abandoned orbital station - the last echo of humanity. Explore cold corridors, flickering terminals, and forgotten logs of a failed salvation program. No monsters. No jumpscares. Only silence, loneliness, and the weight of extinction.

title: ArvusForge
description: Craft your own weapons and carve your path in this fast-paced 3D roguelike action game. Defeat enemies, collect materials, and build powerful gear as you progress through a node-based world. Every run is a new challenge with randomized skills and endless crafting possibilities.

title: Johnny Hardball: The Final Rebound
description: You are Johnny Hardball, a down-and-out dad who just wants his daughter back. To save her, you'll have to ascend the Living Tower, making smart use of your slow-motion abilities and exceedingly bouncy bod.

title: Punch Arena
description: A physics-based arena brawler where elastic punches become projectiles, blending shooter-style spacing with chaotic melee combat.

title: Train Misconductor
description: Train Misconductor is a railroad switching puzzle game, inspired by model railway shunting puzzle layouts like the Inglenook. You operate a modern steam engine on an alien planet, moving cars between sidings, navigating more & more convoluted railyards--all while keeping your conductor sane!

title: Wash & Warm
description: 🧺 A cozy 2D life sim about running a small-town laundry. Wash, dry, and iron clothes for townfolks. Upgrade your shop, decorate your space, and discover heartwarming stories behind every piece of clothing.

title: Slide & Magic
description: An old wizard needs your help to gather all the crystals hidden deep within magical dungeons. Slide every object at once, outwit magical chambers, and crack 200+ puzzles inspired by Sokoban and 2048.

title: VoidReaver
description: Void Reaver is a fast-paced survival roguelite built around explosive power progression and high-intensity combat. Set across corrupted biomes overrun by relentless enemy waves, the game challenges players to survive escalating chaos while crafting increasingly devastating builds.

title: NolyRhythm
description: Get into the rhythm of the music! If you keep getting into the groove, you'll clear the game before you know it! This is the casual rhythm game "NolyRhythm"!

title: Kaibil
description: KAIBIL is a retro pixel-art RPG set in 1524. As warlord and king of the Mam Mayan tribe, Kaibil struggles to unite the warring and fractured tribes to try and resist the armageddon and save his people.

title: Angel's Dreams
description: Angel's Dreams - a roguelike game with horror elements, where your nightmare awaits you at home! Wake up, Explore, Survive, Escape!

title: Skool Days
description: A narrative social simulator set in a high school. Study, make friends, and live unforgettable moments where every decision matters.

title: Star Apoligce: Survivors
description: Deep in the vast galaxy, you are the last survivor. Waves of enemies keep coming, and the universe is filled with unknown dangers. Your only mission is to survive within the limited time. Pilot your spaceship to fight, gather resources, and upgrade your weapons and abilities.

title: Dice Odyssey
description: Dice Odyssey is a text-based RPG about rolling dice and mastering probabilities to defeat a cult and their minions. Can you overcome the odds?

title: Skinwoods: The Full Cut
description: Jack is alone in the woods, a night of camping takes a turn for the unexplainable. What begins as a quiet getaway is interrupted by something that should not exist. A twisted tale where death isn't certain and neither is escape.

title: Birdwatching
description: You came to photograph birds at Kûarasy Park. The deserted park, dead birds, and the locals with secrets suggest something darker lurks in the wilderness. Use your camera to uncover the truth behind the folklore.

title: Cat Adoption Tales
description: Foster and care for adorable hand drawn cats in this cozy 2D sim set to original Lo-Fi music.

title: Idle Sailor
description: Idle Sailor is a relaxing idle adventure where you sail between world destinations, livestream your journey, capture underwater photos of unique fish, and unlock upgrades to make each voyage faster and more rewarding.

title: Edge of Destruction
description: A surreal First-Person Shooter where you destroy the haunting world you created to escape your guilt. Featuring almost full environment destruction.

title: Endless Escalation
description: Endless Escalation is a strategy-driven incremental game where you must carefully choose your army composition, buildings and upgrades to overcome ever-evolving enemy forces.

title: Mall Rivals
description: Competitive mall simulation. 1-8 players open stores in the same mall, fight for customers, crush rivals. Team up or go solo. Fair play or dirty tricks? Your call. Procedural maps, employee system, physical mechanics.

title: BastionOS
description: BastionOS is a chill active incremental game where you command a military terminal to stack ludicrous weapons and upgrades onto a lone tower facing an endless machine army. Destroy a gigantic evolving horde, get destroyed, unlock new tech, repeat, and get strong enough to survive the next level.

title: What Did the Chicken See
description: A short, dark visual novel about a broken world. You are trapped with a cynical narrator who questions everything—school, society, and even you. In this glitchy reality, do your choices really matter, or are you just part of the system?

title: Horny Academy
description: Horny Academy is an adult visual novel that blends interactive storytelling with a deep, branching narrative. Every choice you make leads to steamy animated scenes or unexpected twists within the mysterious walls of the magical Academy

title: A Game About Opening a Chest
description: Open a Chest of infinite loot, collect legendary items, and create game-breaking synergies in this unique incremental roguelike. Grow your fortune, use NPCs to your advantage, and survive the perils of the dungeon in this addictive game of luck, risk, and rewards. When in doubt, open more Chests!

title: Waifu Pogo Club
description: Every fall tests your patience, not your pants. Jump, cling, moan, rage. Waifu Pogo Club will be your sweetest torture.

title: Ludus Magnatus: Gladiator Manager Simulator
description: Ludus Magnatus: Gladiator Manager Simulator is a classic management experience set in an alternate Ancient Rome. Start in Division VII with one of sixteen clubs, recruit fighters, equip them from the market, and climb the ladder through fully simulated seasons and matches.

title: Moon and Fang
description: Unite the strength of the Vampires and the Werewolves and combine their defenses in a unlikely alliance to defend from the humans. Select your moves between playing cards, earning coins or unlocking stronger decks to survive their rampage. Choose your desired rewards and build unique decks!

title: Two Dollar Suits
description: Two Dollar Suits combines the very best of the Action-Strategy genre into a fast-moving criminal playground, where players thrive in creativity and exploration. Complete intricate levels and create your own paths using skill, ingenuity, and raw power.

title: Deprived
description: “Trapped in a loop, you must capture anomalies and find the red door to escape the house. But beware... something else lurks within these walls. Can you break the cycle?”

title: Turleon
description: Turleon is a beat 'em up with platforming sections. Explore different levels, face powerful bosses, and test your skills as you decide what kind of monster... or hero, you want to be.

title: Treble-Basie
description: A throwback to retro collect-a-thon platformers! Treble-Basie features a comprehensive moveset, old-school graphics, nostalgic soundtrack, and much more!

title: Oops! Simulator
description: Oops! Simulator is an absurd slice-of-life game about trying to get home. Ordinary actions lead to unpredictable accidents, strange events, and hilarious outcomes in a world that refuses to stay normal.

title: Working Class Monsters
description: Do you HATE YOUR JOB? Well, these monsters don't have to. Place workers, open packs, make gold pile up. Ultra-casual incremental strategy where failure doesn't exist.

title: Brave Rounds
description: Shoot, punch and get closer through bullets towards enemies in this close range-heavy arcade bullet hell shoot 'em up. A mysterious cult is going to make Mt. Krakatoa explode! By yourself or with a friend, stand your ground; the fate of the world is in your hands...!

title: Starving Merchant
description: Being a merchant is hard enough, but with constant dragon attacks, demon resurrections, and magical wars, it's just about impossible. Nevertheless, it is your dream. Pick your wares, bargain with customers, and communion with the gods. Just don't invest it all in gold right before a kraken awakens.

title: Fire & Crown: A Romantic Tale of the Hundred Years' War
description: A historical visual novel about faith, power, and impossible love. Fire & Crown takes place during the Hundred Years’ War, where you must choose between duty and desire as France tears itself apart. Be the reason someone lives—or dies. History may have never loved anyone, but you still might.

title: Alty's Dinner
description: A rose love game with a thriller and suspense theme. You sensed that your adoptive father was elegant yet strangely sinister. Later, you are invited to Stellan Manor, where you meet various guests with murderous intentions... They all seem to know you.

title: One Hop Ahead
description: Climb the 100-floor Nen Tower as a crazy monkey on a mission for revenge, battling waves of enemies and unpredictable bosses while wielding a rage-powered weapon that constantly mutates and forces you to adapt.

title: The Last Mothership
description: A short incremental game about harvesting planets to feed your mothership. Mine, manage resources, grow your fleet, and unlock upgrades to evolve your species. You are the devourer of worlds.

title: Fragmentary
description: Master your cards and find the ideal strategy to solve puzzles and defeat enemies. Your knowledge and memories unlock new paths forward. Gather items, uncover clues, engage in turn-based combat, solve puzzles and most importantly, learn by making mistakes.

title: SunKong
description: For centuries, the Monkey King has been sealed away, forgotten among ancient ruins. But now, demonic forces have awakened, threatening to consume all.

title: Panic Protocol
description: A 1-4 player co-op horror game, where you guide your friends through a dangerous research facility. Use the CCTV system to observe enemies, set traps and interact with the environment. Extract with the research materials before time runs out.

title: Red the Cook
description: Help Red the Cook chase his dream - quit his dull job and open the best restaurant in town! Balance time and resources, serve delicious dishes to every kind of customer - fluffy or not. Chop, fry, mix, and hustle your way through busy shifts in this cozy cooking simulator with a pinch of humor.

title: Luonnonvoimat
description:
Luonnonvoimat is an atmospheric 2D platformer inspired by the music of ILMU, a Russian folk-trip-hop group performing original songs in the Livvik dialect of the Karelian language. The game is set in a mythological version of ancient Karelia, during an era of raging volcanoes. Players take on the role of a forest spirit born from a fallen meteorite, whose purpose is to bring life to a volcanic desert and transform it into the land of forests and lakes that Karelia is known for today.

Featuring original soundtracks composed specifically for the project, the game blends platforming gameplay with an immersive atmosphere rooted in Karelian mythology and nature.

title: Purgatory Pitstop
description:
Purgatory Pitstop is a fully-voiced, choice-based narrative game with restaurant management elements.

You inherit the only diner on the road to the infamous afterlife gate. Customers arrive at their lowest point, and it's up to you whether to exploit their desperation for profit, try to help them find a better path, or walk an uneasy line between both to keep your struggling business afloat.

TALK TO CUSTOMERS - Raise their spirits with some friendly advice and a warm meal, or beat them while they're down and take advantage of their reliance on alcohol?

COOK COMFORT FOOD - Win over your customers by cooking them a dish that reminds them of a time, place, or person. Be careful though, physics and food are a messy combination!

UPGRADE YOUR DINER - Purchase upgrades that make cooking easier, help you change your morality score, or even assist you in generating more money!

PURGATORY PITSTOP - Shape your story through every interaction with the wonderfully weird and wackily woeful patrons of your diner, each of your choices will contribute to a unique ending, to both your story and those of individual customers.

title: Don't Play This
description: Five scary stories, but they all have the same ending. Can you play it? A psychological horror game from the first person, which few will pass.

title: World of Warcraft: Burning Crusade Classic - Anniversary Edition
description:
Tread once again through the Dark Portal and into the fel-scarred realm of Outland with WoW: Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary Edition, included with WoW Subscription or Game Time.

Join fellow heroes of Azeroth and rally to face the might of the Burning Legion as you adventure across the shattered skies and torn lands of an exiled world. Burning Crusade brings the playable races of Blood Elves and Draenei to World of Warcraft, along with flying mounts that enable you to explore Outland’s most remote and dangerous regions.

Harness the power of the Nether with a Heroic or Epic Pack, which include Burning Crusade-themed cosmetics, mounts, pets, and more!

title: DDD: Demons Double Down
description: Sometimes loneliness pushes us into strange, risky choices. A nightclub that wasn’t here yesterday. Mysterious strangers—each leaving more questions than answers. Just one short night that simply won’t end. What could possibly go wrong?

title: Dwarf Eats Mountain
description: Dwarves hunger for gold, and no mountain shall stand in their way! Mine riches, unearth artifacts, and upgrade your dwarves to devour ever-bigger peaks in this whimsical incremental game.

title: The Second Reality Room: Unspoken Truths
description: You can’t understand them—yet. Decode the “Second Reality” through talk, mind read, and translate in an empathy-driven psychological mystery adventure.

title: Shattered Vault
description: Awaken as the skeleton beside the chest in a darkly comedic, choice-driven mystery. Unravel secrets, face eerie discoveries, and decide whether you’ll escape the vault—or become part of it forever.

title: Phone Flipper Simulator
description: Run a second-hand phone shop, climb from slums to the top. Honest trade or dark paths? Convince customers, invest, take risks. Loan sharks, gambling, luxury stores... Every choice leads to a different ending.

title: Bobanook!
description: A relaxing, idle boba-shop simulator that can accompany you as you work on other things. Sell boba tea, unlock new drinks, and customize and care for a boba pet that lives in the corner of your screen!

title: Detective 26
description: DETECTIVE 26 is a relaxing, turn-based mystery board game for 5-minute investigations. Roll dice and traverse low-poly maps to gather clues. Use logic to unmask the Wanted before turns run out! Level up your rank, unlock new content, and master the art of being a true detective!

title: Matchmaker Simulator
description: Matchmaker Simulator is a narrative game about modern matchmaking. You register clients and pair them, witnessing how romance becomes a transaction. Will this search for optimal genes lead to self-destruction?

title: Around the Block
description: A minimalistic city builder where you can rack up tons of points for your island by strategically placing buildings on blocks around each other.

title: Pirate Ghost Ship
description: "Step into the boots of Jack, trapped on a cursed pirate galleon. Solve dark mysteries, hide from the undead, and survive the wrath of a ghostly captain. Every decision you make determines if you'll find the treasure or become part of the ship's crew forever."

title: Bililitz
description: Bililitz is a vertical roguelike with procedurally generated worlds. Explore mysterious depths, collect items, and discover portals to new challenges. Compete in the global ranking system to prove your skill and reach the top!

title: When We Arrive
description: When We Arrive is a co-op travel game set in a fantasy world, where you and your friends embark on a shared journey. Play as a hunter, mage, or warrior, manage your supplies, discover hidden treasures, and make sure you all reach your destination safely.

title: Degeons Project
description: The abandoned mega-complex of Degeons Laboratory's holds dark secrets. Solve unique puzzles, investigate the cause of the catastrophe, and find out why the mysterious Man in the Crow Suit is watching you. Test your mind in this scientific enigma.

title: CrazyTaiji
description: Crazy TaiJi is a casual card game inspired by traditional Chinese culture. In the game, you will use 64 sword-shaped cards to form combinations and activate spells to defeat monsters. With resources gained from battle, you can improve your abilities and break through to higher realms of cultivation.

title: Roguegg: Hardboiled Survivors
description: Roguegg: Hardboiled Survivors is a top-down roguelike bullet heaven where you play as a brave egg fighting hordes of bugs. Collect upgrades, manage your grid inventory, and craft unique builds to survive the swarm before they scramble you!

title: Dung Battles
description: An action puzzle game where you play as a dung beetle, battling against your beetle peers to create the biggest dung ball. Battle online to test your ball rolling skills, strategically roll up items to win in challenge mode, or follow a young beetle's journey home in story mode.

title: Rise of the Gorecats
description: Welcome to downtown Catsburg: where the streets bleed neon and the critters bite back. You play as private detective Mitch Birman, an ex-Vietnam vet, with a trunk full of guns and a personal vendetta against the little monsters that plague his city.

title: Hover Point
description: Hover Point is a minimalist bullet hell where you don’t need to press a single button. Your movement is your weapon. Experience pure arcade action as you dodge chaotic patterns and auto-fire at swarming enemies. Whether you use mouse, keyboard, or controller. it’s high-intensity survival made simple

title: Blastroid
description: Blastroid is an arcade-style roguelite set in space. Players customize their ships by combining different engine and weapon systems, striving to survive against ever-evolving threats in regions swarming with enemy waves.

title: Vivian Wade: Danger Down the Aisle
description: The night before the wedding, the altar burns down and the wedding planner is injured. The family blames a curse, but she suspects foul play. Play as a college student who goes undercover as her replacement. Can you solve the mystery before the wedding?

title: Dreadnut
description: A cozy horror game where you work the night shift at a donut shop. Prepare the orders and serve them to the customers who arrive.

title: Capyvarias
description: Help Capyshan and Capymay rebuild the Capyvarias empire. Everything is gone. Only these two brave capybaras remain, determined to raise their community from the ashes. Can you click your way to survival, growth, and a future among the stars?

title: Vermis [RPGM]
description: An RPG Maker engine game based on the Vermis book series by Plastiboo, published by Hollow Press.

title: Pawful Dice
description: The cutest roguelike deckbuilder, where you roll your animal dice to win! Add new dice, level them up, pick up items, greed! Every strategy works as long as you can defeat the Mushroom King...

title: Kacau
description: A fast paced Action-Roguelike with unique elemental skills, time shatter abilities, destroyable environments, and epic boss battles against armies of enemies

title: DepraviA
description: In this side-scrolling action game, play as Angelica, an angel on a mission to save humanity. Use various weapons to fight, upgrade your skills with the souls of the fallen, and face the toughest foes ahead as you clear challenging stages! Will you save humanity from the brink of destruction?

title: Nocturne for Cyl-Hestia
description: Play as a memorialist and investigate a dystopian city in this 3D adventure game. Collect memories, unlock visions, hack encrypted data, and expose the truth in the face of a regime that manipulates memory.

title: Memory Draw
description: Dive into the conscious and use your brushes to solve puzzles, reclaim forgotten memories.

title: Test_project
description: test_project is a collection of ideas about mouse, keyboard and window.

title: Frog Up!
description: A retro pixel arcade-style collection game for those who appreciate FROGS! Complete your Frog Log by clicking on the frogs hopping across the screen; unlock different habitat ecosystems with their own unique kinds of frogs & rarities; and get those sweet, sweet Frogbucks!

title: Nitrokill
description: An action-packed futuristic hovercar racing game in the spirit of legendary Hi-Octane with online multiplayer up to 8 players.

title: Can I Not Fall for Idols?
description: You’ve become the manager of a brand-new idol group—only to find yourself drowning in romance flags from the start! Love with idols is strictly forbidden. Can you survive this chaotic, no-love-allowed romcom—the first of its kind in the otome world!?

title: Cook MIX
description: A Cozy Cooking Game. Experiment with Ingredients. Mix, Cook, and Discover New Recipes! Make any combination and GET PROFIT!

title: Withered Haven
description: Withered Haven is a first-person psychological horror game. After the tragic loss of his wife and daughter, a broken man struggles to endure a collapsing reality. Familiar apparitions drift closer, echoing memories that mask a darkness beyond comprehension.

title: Linkies
description: You find yourself all alone in the vastness of outer space! Being alone makes you slow and weak. Take your Linky with you and confront the challenges head-on! Linkies is a co-op game that creates unbreakable bonds and makes you faster and stronger! Can you make it to the end of space?

title: Stalker From Willowfield St.
description: A stalker is terrorizing the neighborhood, and you’re next. Watch for signs he’s been inside your house and make the right choices to avoid becoming his next victim. Test your observation skills in this Exit 8-style game where the threat isn’t supernatural, but a real man and you have three choices.

title: Tune to Win
description: One car. One track. Infinite setups. You’ll be faster next run. Promise.

title: Pursuit of Mercantile Power
description: Pursuit of Mercantile Power is a single-player economic sim with light RPG. No money spawns—money only moves. Control the village’s cash flow, use proposals and loans, buy shares, and take over enterprises to seize GuYuan’s commercial order.

title: A Week in Paradise
description: A Week in Paradise is an interactive narrative mystery. Discover the unusual circumstances of your arrival to a bar called Paradise, and drink through the night with the bar's charismatic regular. Each night, unravel the threads holding back memories in your dreams.

title: Imperfect Smile
description: A cart, a manor, and a family that deserves everything coming to it. The hours repeat. Conversations shift. Lies unravel. Explore, observe, and gamble with what you learn to prevent a murder that refuses to stay solved. Just you, your cards, and a house that would rather you stayed ignorant.

title: Life of Crime
description: Immersive crime sim. Go from nothing to kingpin of the city — from small crimes to big heists. Complete jobs and distribute drugs throughout the city for your gang. Progress and earn respect through missions and crimes.

title: Peckers
description: A short clicker game which you can run in the corner of your screen while pretending to work. Peck into the depths for resources and craft gear adventurers probably shouldn’t trust.

title: MineEngineer
description: Mine. Build. Survive. Engineer your way through the cosmos in this 2D space engineering sandbox!

title: Challengers of the Realm TCG
description: A lore-driven TCG with dynamic resource rolls, directional combat, faction synergy, and epic tactical gameplay.

title: Not A.C.A.B.
description: In the rainy checkpoint of Nerd City, you are a traffic officer racing against time to save your family from the Cartel. Inspect documents and make the call: Issue fines, arrest criminals, impound vehicles, or release the innocent. Every decision shapes your family's fate. The law or your blood?

title: Streetlight Syndicate
description: A casual, story-driven incremental game set in 1920s New York. Build your criminal empire from speakeasies to protection rackets, fight rival hitmen, meet colorful characters, and become the city's most powerful crime lord.

title: Scale2fit
description: A simple puzzle game about scaling blocks to fit them together.

title: LoopMage: The Infinite Trials
description: Fight an endless onslaught of foes in this minimalist wizard survival roguelike. Each loop makes you AND the horde stronger. How many loops can you survive? Ascend the global leaderboards to claim your glory!

title: Between These Two
description: Between These Two is a first-person horror game where you take the role of a man lost in an unknown plane of existence. To find your way home, you will have to explore the environment, hide, jump or run from danger, solve puzzles and confront hostile creatures.

title: Fix and Clerk
description: You work for a device company and your job is to verify paperwork of customers before handing their repaired device to them. Check, interrogate and confirm their identity. Beware of scammers in disguise coming to claim devices that are not theirs.

title: Cleaning Raccrew
description: Cleaning Raccrew is a 4 player party game inspired by sumo, japanese game shows, and silly raccoon images!

title: Merry’s Seven Wishes
description: A touching visual novel about love, loss, and hope. After Merry’s death, Richard’s world turns gray—until her seven final wishes begin restoring its colors. Through heartfelt storytelling, music, and mini-games, every fulfilled wish paints life in new shades of meaning.

title: Stolen Skies
description: Stolen Skies is a top-down scrolling shooter. Fly various fighter jets against hordes of enemies, navigate clouds of bullets, complete objectives, and face off against massive bosses and enemy ace pilots! With several weapon types across 18 original aircraft, there's something for every playstyle!

title: Withdrawals
description: Withdrawals is a VR game about doing drugs, making drugs, selling drugs, drinking and smoking. Basic dope slinger stuff, become the pimp of the entire city!

title: Teryndor: Caelorn’s Quest
description: An Action game with Tower Defense elements where you defend the Protective Crystals of Teryndor! As Prince Caelorn, fight against hordes of creatures to save your kingdom from destruction.

title: As Cores De Ofelia
description: The Colors of Ofelia is an emotional journey through enigmatic rooms. Solve puzzles, confront painful memories, and confront your own shadow to discover how to escape the room.

title: Valence
description: VALENCE is a multiplayer strategy card game where atoms act as resources and molecules become your creatures. Build decks, trade cards with other players, and outwit opponents in tactical battles to reduce their HP to zero.

title: Tidewake
description: Enter the uncharted seas of TideWake in this single player naval roguelite. Explore uncharted oceans and defend your vessel from dangerous foes. Collect and customize your ship with powerful parts and mystical trinkets to become the most powerful pirate in history! Sink into chaos. Rise a legend.

title: HeroTail: Survivors
description: HeroTail Survivors is a run-based roguelike where your heroes form a living chain. Level up, recruit followers, and stack powerful set bonuses while battling through waves of enemies and unlocking permanent upgrades.

title: Squid Arrives II: Make Squid Great Again
description: In XXXX, deep-sea squids receive "nuclear food" from the islands. This unnatural feast triggers their awakening, reviving the lost memory of cephalopod world domination. Note: Inspired by fried calamari. Contains allegory. Don't overthink it! (laughs)

title: Sokogram
description: Sokogram merges Nonogram logic grids with Sokoban box-pushing puzzles. Each level blends both systems into one unified challenge with handcrafted designs that reward deduction over guessing.

title: The Hilarious Three Kingdoms 2
description: This is a traditional turn-based strategy game set in the era of the Three Kingdoms.Control different feudal lords, step onto the historical battlefield, experience the funny plot, strategize and unite the world!

title: In Her Image
description: A psychological horror game about descent through grief. You cannot undo your past but you can confront and work through it.

title: Myth Monkey Card
description: A unique blend of Texas Hold'em poker mechanics and Roguelike strategy. Forge your destiny across four distinct cultivation paths and challenge the gods of the Celestial Court. Will you master Artefacts for precise combos, or rely on the Self for a desperate comeback? In this mythic battle where the world is your card table, victory is yours to define.

title: Sands of Avalon: Forge Your Legend
description: Sands of Avalon is a next-generation ARPG Dungeon Crawler where ancient gods shape your destiny. Master endless dungeons with evolving difficulty, craft powerful builds through a vast skill tree, and pledge allegiance to divine beings whose blessings and curses alter your path.

title: Anomaly Directive
description: Anomaly Directive is a first-person surveillance horror game. Monitor live camera feeds, detect and report supernatural anomalies, and survive an escalating threat from a malevolent entity.

title: Sophia's Path
description: Guided by a glowing pendant, Sophia journeys through whimsical worlds to find her lost father. Solve charming turn-based puzzles, befriend misunderstood gods and goddesses and uncover tales of courage and quiet wisdom inspired by Greek mythology.

title: EpiDexa Racing
description: EpiDexa Racing is an arcade racing game focused on time trials and online multiplayer. Play with keyboard or controller, climb the leaderboards, and prove your skills against friends or players from around the world.

title: Survivors Gate
description: Survivors Gate is a endless runner bullet hell, where your choices can allow you to quickly snowball against powerful monsters and bosses! Collect powerful gates, epic loot and become a true god. How far can you go?

title: Ultimate Janitor Simulator
description: Restore messy rooms to order by washing dirt, wiping windows, collecting trash, and organizing interiors. Each completed job earns money that you can use to upgrade your workspace and unlock new stuff. Clean, earn, upgrade — and enjoy the calm rhythm of a spotless day's work.

title: Logistics Simulator: America
description: Drive across the United States as a professional trucker. Deliver cargo on highways and backroads, manage your fleet, develop your warehouses, and run a realistic logistics business. Plan routes, manage fuel and time, and take on the real challenges of life behind the wheel.

title: MythBeasts
description: Welcome to the world of Mythbeasts, an ambitious creature collection RPG that I'm developing completely solo as an autistic indie developer. Explore this huge world with endless progression and leveling for your mythbeasts

title: Steel Force: Top Down Shooter
description: STEEL FORCE is a top-down shooter. Attack robots, use your shield, and push your skills to the limit. Run, dash, and break through waves of armed machines.

title: Chicks in Trouble
description: A peaceful farm is thrown into chaos when a mother hen's chicks mysteriously vanish! Team up with the brave father rooster and embark on a quirky, obstacle-filled adventure to bring them home. Grab your mouse or gamepad—it's time to save the flock!

title: Retailer
description: RETAILER is a simulation game where you work a growing store of your very own, without the hassle of helping hands. It's stressful, but at least you're self-employed.

title: Entrance No.9
description: A drunk man returns home, but the familiar stairwell turns into an endless, distorted maze. Floors repeat themselves, doors disappear, and every wrong step takes you back to the beginning. Can you make it to your apartment?

title: Cardwheel
description: Endless runs, endless combos — every spin is a new roguelite adventure.

title: FAFO Executive Order Simulator
description: F around and find out! A ruthless no F's given dark comedy where you play the president of the United States of America, abuse executive power, crank up the FAFO meter, deal with robot overlords, alien invasions, drain swamps, flip off allies, crush protests, and destroy all that oppose you!

title: Ball Chasers
description: A goofy 2v2 multiplayer party soccer brawler where classes, crazy abilities, and pure chaos replace rules—score goals, troll opponents, and embrace the mayhem across wacky maps.

title: Meowtabolism: Examining Feline Behavior Within Unicellular Algae
description: Explore the interior of an algal cell on your four paws. Built with experimental data and populated with actual protein structures, Meowtabolism offers a glimpse of the vast world inside the basic functional unit of life.

title: Deg
description: A non-linear pure puzzle game where you solve various puzzles using logical reasoning. Explore unknown puzzles in the game world.

title: Townslife
description: Welcome to Townslife - a game about living in a small town, surrounded by forests and the sea, with the local mine somewhere in the distance. Place stuff around, customize the interior of your house, mine, fight with hostile creatures, talk to the locals and more! All in a nice retro pixel package!

title: FuwaFuwa Survivors
description: Survive with Fluffy Friends! In this 3D Survivor-like Action Roguelite, you Control adorable animals, Defeat swarms of enemies and Tame them to your Royal Companions! Utilize Skill Enchantment system to combine 20+ skills with 70+ Enchantment Cards to forge your unique builds!

title: MysteryJars
description: Team up, scavenge, and defend your base against relentless waves of monsters. Every 10-minute round in MysteryJar is a fight for survival and discovery.

title: Colorboration
description: Without crossing colors, move the blob characters around the field. By pushing boxes, have the blobs interact and together help them reach their goals.

title: Desktop Fishing Cat
description: Here’s a cute, chubby black cat. All it wants to do is quietly go fishing. “Right in the corner of your desktop!” Collect fish to fill up the cat’s encyclopedia, earn money, and dress it up in adorable outfits!

title: Parrot Hero
description: Parrot Hero is a pixel art action-adventure set in a world of birds. Play as 'Star', a human mistaken for a mutant Emperor Penguin, and journey to save a kidnapped friend with a prickly parrot companion. Explore 37+ stages, choose various classes, and upgrade skills to save the avian world.

title: Aquachamber
description: Aquachamber is a mind-bending first-person knowledge-lock puzzle game

title: Colornova
description: A color matching space shooter about saving your home planet from total destruction!

title: Ghosts With Hats
description: Ghosts With Hats is a fast-paced top-down arcade racing game where ghosts compete on dynamic tracks. Collect relics, upgrade your unique character, and dash to victory!

title: Hellrifters
description: Lead a squad of heroes on suicide missions into Hell’s rifts. Face grotesque demons, shatter battlefields and weaponize gore in this squad-based survivors roguelite with physics-driven combat. Upgrade, synergize, survive — every run makes you deadlier. Only the strongest return from abyss.

title: Girl of the Ruins
description: “Girl of the Ruins” is a horror-mystery adventure game set in the future. One day, a girl who looks exactly like you suddenly appears. As you follow this suspicious girl, you will eventually uncover the truth of the world.

title: Stranger Mahjong
description: Stranger Tiles is a Mahjong-based strategy game. Step into a surreal dreamscape and duel against feline opponents. Optimize your tile setup and employ calculated strategies to counter speed with patience. Smash through the dream stages and defeat the Eternal Nightmare!

title: Terrier Manager
description: Rats have infested your farm! Train a team of terriers to hunt them down in this incremental idle game. Breed your dogs to strengthen your team as you hunt down the ten Rat Lords who have taken over.

title: 404 Survivor
description: A deadly virus has plunged the world into apocalypse, turning humanity into bloodthirsty zombies. You, among the last survivors, must build your shelter in abandoned cities, the wild, or derelict military bases. They are coming... You are the final ember of hope. Survival is your only goal.

title: Anomalous Cleaning Detail
description: A first-person cleaning simulator where you scrub, vacuum, and restore a troubled town plagued by supernatural disturbances. Complete contracts and use environmental clues to prepare for the exorcism, because when the mess is paranormal, a standard clean won't be enough.

title: Cat City: A Story About Dreams
description: Cat City: A Story About Dreams is a modern Point N’ Click with Visual Novel elements. The game tells the story of Throy, a dreamless yellow cat who you’ll follow on a self-discovery journey as he tries to find a dream for himself!

title: Orbrix
description: Orbrix is an incremental idle breakout game. Break endless layers of bricks, purchase powerful upgrades, and unlock visual themes. Play actively or as idle as you want. Create a swarm of upgraded bullets to defeat your enemies. Can you grind your way to level 1000 to escape the Orbrix prison?

title: PGA Tour 2K25: Clubhouse Pass Premium Season 6
description: PGA TOUR 2K25 Clubhouse Pass Premium Season 6 unlocks additional quests, boosts, and the ability to earn valuable items not included in the free track. Progress at your own pace—keep playing through existing Clubhouse Pass Seasons even when a new Season is live!

title: PGA Tour 2K25: Clubhouse Pass Premium Season 7
PGA Tour 2K25: Clubhouse Pass Premium Season 8
Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage: 30th Anniversary Bonus
Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage: 30th Anniversary Edition
description:
Celebrate the 30th anniversary of the first 3D fighting series - this edition includes exclusive costumes, pre-production artwork, soundtracks, and more.

30th Anniversary Edition contains:
""Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage"" Base Game
VF 30th Anniversary Swimsuit Costume Set
VF 30th Anniversary Soundtrack Collection
VF Pre-Production Artwork
DLC: Legendary Pack & Yakuza Series Collaboration Pack
VF 30th Anniversary Ranking Titles

title: WWE 2K26: MyRise Boost
description: The WWE 2K26 MyRISE Boost includes 200 Attribute Points to enhance your Superstar. The MyRISE Boost is included as part of the Superstar Mega-Boost which comes with the Attitude Era Edition and Monday Night War Edition of WWE 2K26.

title: WWE 2K26: Ringside Pass Premium Season 2
description: Unleash chaos, charisma, and championship pedigree with Ringside Pass Premium Season 2. Earn Ax, Smash, and Crush of Demolition, plus Kelly Kelly. Plus cross-over playable characters inspired by the Wastelands: Persona Cards, CAS parts, movesets, MyFACTION content, and more.

title: WWE 2K26: Monday Night War Edition
description: Reignite the WWE vs. WCW rivalry with the Monday Night War Edition of WWE 2K26.

title: SnowBot
description: Silence, cold, solitude… What lies ahead? A small atmospheric adventure about a robot lost in a frozen wasteland.

title: The Lone Sword
description: The Lone Sword is a narrative platformer where YOU are the weapon. As a living Sword, embark on a nostalgic journey to find your Maker. Explore the Castle, solve physics puzzles, master the blade with unique mechanics, and reflect on your purpose in this emotionally rich adventure.

title: Codename: Typhoon
description: A spy-themed visual novel produced by Gravity House for the Ryona Yuri VN Jam.

title: The Day I Became a Bird
description: Join Frank, an awkward young boy, as he discovers newfound feelings for his classmate, Sylvia - who only has eyes for birds. Explore, collect, and solve puzzles as Frank attempts to catch her attention with a homespun, feathery transformation in this warm and nostalgic return to childhood.

title: LumenKnight
description: LumenKnight is a roguelike survival game with souls-like combat. Fight through challenging enemy waves and epic bosses. Test your reflexes, timing, and strategy in every fight. One life per run. Step in, embrace the challenge, and prove your skill.

title: RD Racing
description:
RD Racing is a casual combat racing game where speed and firepower decide who survives. Compete in intense top-down races, destroy rival drivers, earn cash, and upgrade your vehicle to dominate the competition.

Inspired by the classic Death Rally game, the game brings back the thrill of arcade vehicular combat — but with a modern twist and colorful 3D cartoon-style graphics. Fast races, explosive weapons, and strategic upgrades create a chaotic and addictive gameplay loop.

Win races. Eliminate opponents. Build the ultimate combat machine.

title: Eternal Dreams: Poker RPG
description: A Rogue AI and alien virus have trapped humanity in a dream-sim. - Craft Poker combos in this Roguelite JRPG; build and BREAK your deck to shatter the illusion. In this Deckbuilder, every hand doesn’t just change fate, it rewrites reality.

title: Lost in Your Eyes
description: Lost In Your Eyes is a 2 Player co-op Puzzle Adventure game where you and your friend face the challenging puzzles to escape uniquely designed levels together. Communication is a key element for every puzzle to be solved but do you trust your friend or your EYES?

title: Twiggle's Grove
description: Nestled at your screen’s edge, a tranquil idle world unfurls as you go about your day. Plant gorgeous trees, look after adorable animals, and mingle with merry goblins - your forest keeps blooming in the background. Get in the grove with Twiggle’s Grove!

title: Istikan Chai
description: Step into the bustling Middle Eastern bazaar as a chai vendor! Serve aromatic tea to impatient customers, upgrade your cart, and keep the crowd happy in this fast-paced, cozy time-management game — Istikan Chai.

title: Scropia
description: Navigate a dystopian city, uncover secrets, and shape your path in this story-driven sci-fi visual novel.

title: Maid Cafe Simulator
