description: Run a maid café with five charming kemonomimi maids! Make drinks, serve customers, and tackle troublemakers in this first-person management sim. Get to know the girls behind the aprons as you turn a rundown café into a thriving business and aim for three Maidchelin stars.

title: StarDrift Delivery
description: Smuggle your way to freedom in this fast-paced space delivery action roguelite where you are in debt to the mob. Blast through asteroids for speed, weave through chaos, and deliver packages to survive. Don't let the debt consume you.

title: Three Jokers
description: A card roguelike inspired by Balatro and Cuphead. Fight duels, play insane mini-games, build Joker City and rise to greatness — in Three Jokers!

title: Order Point
description: ORDER POINT is a horror game about working at a package pickup station. On a winter night, you serve unsettling customers. Mysterious visitors create an ominous atmosphere. Be careful — not everyone can be trusted.

title: Nyanjet
description: "nyanjet" is a precision platformer where the only way is up. Be cautious, be bold, and never fear the fall. Master the simple yet challenging controls of a cat-piloted jetpack.

title: Museum of Sweet Potatoes
description: This museum a gift from HanwenXuMame to Flan Falacci. HanwenXuMame made this museum because they thought Flan might like sweet potatoes and museums. But this is their uneducated gesses. If Flan happen to not like them, HanwenXuMame can give Flan a sticker instead.

title: Quad
description: Guide four quirky mushrooms at once as they struggle to survive in a deadly world where everything is out to get them. Can you keep them all alive?

title: Lines We Draw
description: Lines We Draw is a 3D isometric narrative strategy game set at a tense Cold War border. Inspect documents, interrogate travelers, and manage a shifting checkpoint between rival states. Your stamp decides fates: Will you be a hero of the people, or a tool of the regime?

title: Floating Frontiers
description: A minimalist strategy game about growing your infinite floating town. Combine wacky 3D blocks to optimize synergies, build idyllic scenery, and chase your high score.

title: May the Cards Lay Out a Straight
description: Jack, a winning gambler, is trapped at the gambling table by his angry boss's magic spell. He is horrified to find the dice rushing towards him. Only by gripping his playing cards tightly and shattering all the incoming dice can he hope to escape the table alive.

title: Journey to the King
description: Journey to the King is a 2D pixel art platformer inspired by classic platformer games. You play as a knight on a quest through dangerous lands to reach the kingdom and help the king who urgently awaits your arrival.

title: Rosepine Hotel
description: I thought that hand was pulling me out of a nightmare and back into reality. Soon, I’ll realize—it only dragged me into another nightmare: “Rosepine Hotel”

title: Nobody Hears
description: At first glance, your everyday life with your younger sister seems uneventful—going to school together, chatting, living side by side. But within that endless cycle of calm routines, could those seemingly insignificant actions be quietly changing your fate?

title: Deep Corp
description: Dig mines, extract resources, and produce goods to restore order to the state. Become a successful businessman and an effective state governor in the late Wild West era!

title: Exercise Your Demons
description: Step into the world of Exercise your Demons, a 2d narrative adventure inspired by Irish fairies and folklore. Meet and befriend 5 locals while you work towards settling into the small fictional town called Inishsióg in County Galway, Ireland.

title: Feeding My Ducks
description: Feeding My Ducks is a cozy idle-management game where you raise, train, and evolve a flock of lovable ducks. Feed them, progress their stats, and watch them transform into surprising new forms—all while the game runs peacefully in the background as your productivity companion.

title: Bloomsome
description: Bloomsome is a 2D Make-Over Puzzle Game that reflects upon unfair beauty standards. Who should be the one to define what is beauty? We project our reflections and imaginations upon those floral characters which all shine uniquely.

title: Final Strategy
description: Final Strategy is a serious, modern real time strategy experience focused on large scale warfare and direct unit control. Command elite forces and race against time to stop a rogue nuclear operation built from abandoned Cold War stockpiles.

title: Wagon 00
description: Observation game about anomalies in a train car: spot changes, choose back or forward, advance by a streak of correct choices. No HUD; focus on attention and memory.

title: Sky In Flames
description: Command drones, deploy mobile air defense systems, and conduct tactical air operations. Choose a side - Ukrainian or Russian forces - and protect critical infrastructure in a realistic military simulation on a detailed map.

title: Focus Grove
description: Build your cozy forest farm… while thriving in life. Focus Grove is a mindful game that improves your focus, well-being and work-life balance. Let your Woodlings grow your farm, while you grow in life.

title: Ring Toss Simulator
description: This is a ring-toss game simulator that mimics real-world physics!

title: The Tale of Spring City
description: Ziqing Xu, a young girl from Spring City. Her father mysteriously disappeared soon after. During a strange turn of events, she suddenly gains the ability to see into the supernatural realm—the so-called "Yin Yan." Will she be able to uncover the truth?

title: A Thread Between
description: Welcome, Pilot. The timeline has split. Who do you trust when restoring your fate? Solve 80+ handcrafted levels. 3+ hours. Mechanically dense, consistently fresh.

title: House & Hand
description: Building thriving island cities in this addictive match-3 deck-building roguelike! Place forests, mountains, cities, and more on islands using cards from your deck. Match 3 identical features to combine them into a bigger, better structure that scores you points.

title: Zero Warning: Burnt Out
description: In this anomaly horror game, a boy has been abandoned in a burning train car. Spot the difference, decide when to push forward, and survive long enough to complete the rescue.

title: Rocks Tools Hordes
description: Rocks, Tools, Hordes is a survival crafting game where a brave little girl explores vast caves, builds her base, and battles endless zombie waves. Mine resources, craft gear, and pilot powerful robots to withstand the horde. Robots, rocks, and really rude zombies.

title: Super Candle World
description: An Old-School Collectathon in a cute colorfull world! Leap into this 3D Platformer that rekindles your collect-a-thon nostalgia, and enjoy the bright and light fun of exploration! Run, jump, and fly through this world to gather all the golden cookies for the wicked Candle King!

title: RunGX mini
description: RunGX mini is a prequel to RunGX

title: Shalnor: Silverwind Saga 2
description: An RPG/Action Adventure game. With focus on gauntlet-style combat, traps, boss fights, and beautiful pixel-art scenery. Rynna has arrived on an island plagued by monsters and undead fiends raised by an evil Necromancer. The souls of those who remain cannot be free, until the Necromancer is slain!

title: Gear Number Go Up
description: Build a gear mechanism to create really really big numbers in this incremental / roguelike game. Gears have functions on their teeth that affect other gears. Use them to create number exploding combinations.

title: FuJianStrike
description: Command the deck crew, experience the aircraft carrier deck scheduling process, ensure the smooth take-off and landing of aircraft, and ensure that the aircraft carrier can defeat the endless stream of enemies.

title: Overtype
description: Overtype is a roguelike typing action game set in a neon-drenched post-apocalypse. Type to fight, dodge, and survive against waves of cyborgs and corrupted machines. Every keystroke is your weapon master speed and precision to uncover Zyra’s legacy and type out humanity’s last hope.

title: Wordy Online
description: Rediscover the fun of wordplay in this modern, colorful collection of popular games with fresh ideas! Play through the campaign or a huge dictionary of words: learn, earn rewards, track your progress, and even climb the leaderboards — play solo, with friends, and with players worldwide!

title: Tape Over: Night Shift
description: In Tape Over: Night Shift, you play as a clerk working alone in a convenience store at midnight. With a VHS-inspired visual style and an increasingly unsettling atmosphere, survive as your nightly tasks spiral into unspeakable horrors.

title: All Roads Connected
description: Explore an endless world, build countless settlements, discover lost artifacts, and lead your nation into a new dawn of industry.

title: Yamigatari: For3st
description: Alone in a forest that won’t let her go, Nora is being followed by an unseen entity that draws closer with every step. A 2D psychological horror with seven endings shaped by your choices.

title: Pentimento
description: Cast Into A Boundless White Void. Paintings Hunger For Your Story. What Will You Answer?

title: Haunted Heist
description: Haunted Heist is a 3-8 player round-based PvP horror party game where Heisters find and retrieve gems in a procedurally generated mansion, while Tricksters use chaotic abilities to distress, disrupt, and dispose of them to protect their home.

title: Skijoring
description: Crash into your friends in Skijoring, the unhinged sport of push and pull. Get wild airtime, screen-peek to survive, and embrace co-op chaos in the world's first, best, and only arcade skijorer.

title: Night of Nightmare
description: Every night, the nightmare comes. Your room is no longer safe... The moment you lie down on a strange bed and close your eyes, you are no longer alone. Is this reality? Or are you inside someone else’s nightmare?

title: Under the River
description: Under the River is a romance visual novel set in Ming China’s world of spirits and the strange.As an opera singer,you return to Sui'an County to perform for the River God. However, a strange accident leads you to don a demonic skin, transforming you into a half-human, half-ghost.

title: Maids of Storm
description: Run your own maid café in this charming pixel tycoon! Hire adorable maids with unique personalities, customize your café, compete in the Maid Championship, and enjoy a hilarious story packed with quirky humor and fun mini-games.

title: Pig Commander
description: Pig Commander is a fast paced roguelike RTS where chaos rules every battle. Build improvised armies, pick a commander, and survive unpredictable challenges round after round.

title: Bochi Collection
description: An anthology of short indie games with emotional storytelling and simple gameplay. Discover unique experiences, each with distinct art, music, and tone. Perfect for players who enjoy narrative adventures, hidden details, and bite-sized stories.

title: No Service
description: Uncover, experience, and survive service. Tasked with exploring and reporting any wrongdoing, you are the last train inspector on shift. descend into madness as this surreal comedy sonders your psyche.

title: Make Magic Great Again
description: A Roguelike survivor-style action game of elemental mastery. Harness eight core elements, survive endless demon hordes, and join up to 4 players in co-op to unleash ancient formulas—embark on an epic journey to revive the lost glory of magic!

title: Nano Flat Owner
description: You are a owner of nano flats, responsible for decorating each mini space to attract tenants and earn impressive profits! As your income grows, keep buying more units and gradually expand your rental kingdom, easily stepping toward financial freedom!

title: Ultra0
description: Enjoy a simple, easy-to-play pseudo-3D shooter! Upgrade your character with power-ups and take down the approaching monsters before they reach you.

title: Optasia: The Last Visit
description: A first-person psychological experience set inside a fading mind. Explore an empty asylum, shifting memories, and the quiet weight of promises left behind. No puzzles. No escape. Just one last visit.

title: 2004: Space Becherovka
description: Humorous Czech freeware point-and-click adventure game about guy who fall in love with a girl, but she doesn't want him. Then, he accidentally enters a space ship and experiences intergalactic travels.

title: Gunpoint Gambit
description: Dive into multiplayer arenas where history’s boldest factions clash - from pirates and cowboys to legendary adventurers yet to come, with help from your loyal pet companions.

title: Parkour Assassin: Sprint Run 2
description: A night-crawling ninja steps into a brand-new world, where a fresh roguelike twist makes every run more heart-pounding than the last. Ready to face this ever-shifting challenge? Savor the rush of lightning-fast movement and combat that keeps your pulse racing!

title: Ironborne
description: Ironborne: A mining roguelike bullet hell shoot 'em up. Mine. Upgrade. Fight. Do you have what it takes to reach the bottom?

title: Tied to the Beat
description: A music-driven arena survivor where lyrics trigger effects across the battlefield. Pick one of 8 instruments, fight through 4 themed worlds with more than 50 included songs, or import your own music. Over 1,000 lyric-triggered effects, Steam Workshop support and an interface in 31 languages. Your music. Your weapon.

title: Super Wash Simulator
description: A relaxing open world pressure washing simulator where you explore the city, accept cleaning jobs, upgrade your equipment, and turn dirt-covered places into spotless environments at your own pace.

title: Brainrot Survivors
description: Fight your way through the endless waves of newer-gen memes by using older memes as your weapons. How long can you keep defeating them until your own brain turns to mush?

title: Math Path
description: A maze that can be passed with the help of math.

title: My Waifu Is A Tank Girl!
description: Strap into a war machine piloted by anime waifus and tear through the battlefield. Explosions, chaos, and tactical sass included. You drive, they yell. Everyone else gets wrecked.

title: Area 51: Defence
description: Fight against naruto runners and defence the secret of Area 51 at any costs.

title: Within the Range
description: This game is no longer updated, do not buy!! RTS with physical details. Formulate strategies based on terrain and unit characteristics

title: DownSouth
description: DownSouth is a moral-dilemma platformer RPG where your choices affect your sanity, and your sanity affects how you play.

title: Be Nunner
description: Short romantic comedy VN about a nun, who kisses a succubus, and tries not to go to hell (or not).

title: Fish Market
description: A game made to capture a fear of current young adults. The settling for workplaces that don't align with their long-term ambitions due to the flat-lining of the job-market. Let it be pursuing a degree four years only to struggle to find work, jobs being replaced by AI, a dream position given away due to nepotism… in a parasitic economic climate it's become more often than not for people to be stuck in situations they can't get out of either it be a dead-end job or unemployment, there is little opportunity and an even worse response from the forerunners. How different are we from dead fish soon to be filleted only to be valued for the parts that can be eaten, not admired for the scales they have.

title: Greenfield Valley
description: Build your peaceful farm in a quiet mountain valley. Grow crops, care for animals, complete quests, level up, and upgrade your home. A cozy farming experience with dynamic weather, no timers, and no pressure. Just relax and enjoy farm life.

title: Dive or Die: Children of Rain
description: Every descent is a deadly gamble. DIVE or DIE in the cursed abyss, face Eldritch horrors to uncover the mystery of the black rain. Scavenge and upgrade, recruit and sacrifice. Save your camp... The Flood is coming.

title: Feria 3000
description: Feria 3000 is a fast-paced action roguelite set in a neon Andalusian fairground. Fight relentless waves of AI enemies with precision gunplay, aided by companions that dynamically build a procedural breakbeat soundtrack every run.

title: Laranja!
description: A short adult visual novel that focuses on going on a couple of dates with Laura, a young feline girl with orange fur.

title: Work Till Die
description: A dark comedy visual novel with elements of psychological horror. Stepashka — not just the name of the protagonist, but a whole way of life... But is it a life sentence? That’s exactly what the player will have to decide!

title: Silence, Exile, and Cunning
description: Silence, Exile, and Cunning is a narrative exploration of real geography and fictionalized history. You progress through scenes, interact with unusual characters, and solve puzzles through James’s wit and Nora’s practical sense.

title: Netoo
description: Netoo is a minimalist logic puzzle where you try to place small magnets into their correct spots by rotating transporter magnets with rotators.

title: Purrfect Tanks: The Yarnpocalypse
description: Command adorable cats in chaotic cardboard tanks and battle for the last yarn on Earth! Explosions, lasers, catnip-fueled madness — and lots of cardboard.

title: Miners' Union
description: Miners' Union is an incremental game. Mine coal, upgrade, fight off busters and grow the union.

title: Secrets of Velendar Castle: Escape Room
description: Find your way out of Velendar Castle. Discover why everything was taken from you. In this fantasy Escape room, you will have to solve puzzles to escape the wrath of the king… and find out what he wants from you.

title: Vesper Hotel
description: Explore an abandoned hotel where forgotten rooms hide unsettling memories and shadows whisper of the past. In Vesper Hotel, every step deeper into the halls becomes a struggle for survival against both fear and your own sanity.

title: Checkmate Heroines
description: Anime arrives to chess! And with new technology! Improve your skills with the game analysis tool at no extra cost, and test them against players around the globe and even your friends. Including those who don’t own the game! May your kingdom thrive!

title: The Wrong Floor
description: Trapped in a mysterious hotel, you must observe, decide, and take risks. Use your points and abilities to descend faster… if you dare.

title: Omni Kitty
description: This is an action based flappy game turned up to eleven. In the main arcade mode the player is unlocked and able to flap around the length of the screen dodging obstacles, fighting enemies and engaging a stage boss at the end of every level. This is a fully flushed out flappy game.

title: Captain Speedfin
description: Ahoy, matey! The clock is ticking for Captain Speedfin. Trapped with an hourglass that never stops, this pirate has only one choice: run. Your mission is simple but brutal: navigate 60 intense platforming levels to reclaim your chests before the last grain of sand falls. There are no special powers here—just pure skill. Every jump, slide, and dash is a test of your reflexes. In this world, the slightest mistake is fatal.

title: Rumor Reporter
description: Rumor Reporter is a Golden Age whodunit mystery. Play as senior reporter Veronica Chase as you explore Greyhaven Island in the Celtic Sea, 1920s. Choose where to investigate, who to question, and what to publish. Your report shapes public opinion, drives arrests, and changes the island’s future.

title: Ling and the Corrupted Hollow
description: Explore a mythical world of a lost paradise as you help Ling and the spirits cleanse the home of the Hollow Woods in our third-person puzzle platforming game. With your spirits by your side, find the four soul shards and restore balance to the corrupted hollow.

title: Human.exe
description: An AI has isolated the mind of a philosophy professor to evaluate human morality. Interface with the terminal, type system commands, and channel his responses through impossible ethical dilemmas. Your principles are on trial as every choice is recorded to determine your final profile.

title: Input
description: Control one character with two players. One handles movement, the other handles actions. Precision, timing, and coordination are the only way to overcome challenging parkour platform levels.

title: Trailmarks
description: Inspired by Carmen Sandiego, Trailmarks is a globe-spanning strategy adventure where you circumnavigate the planet as a travel guide fact-checker. Plan routes across 1,200 cities, answer 120,000+ trivia questions, trade souvenirs, and prove your expertise to unlock new countries.

title: Can't Stop Running
description: Dive into this fast-paced precision platformer 2D. Jump, dodge, and teleport to survive in an environment that will do everything it can to stop you. Overcome the challenges to unravel the mysterious plot. Are you ready to never stop running?

title: Plank
description: Plank is a frantic co-op builder where you and your friends race across a collapsing canyon. Place planks, grab upgrades, fight off enemies, and outrun a giant wall of death. Build fast, move smart, and try not to fall before reaching the end!

title: Phantom Smog
description: In a future suffocated by VX-Nebel, the megacorporation NOVA ATMOS controls every breath of the city. You are Kael, the only one immune to the gas — and therefore, the only real threat. Track and eliminate the leaders behind the conspiracy

title: Beltlife: Prospector
description: Beltlife: Prospector is a GUI-based "hard" sci-fi business/work sim with economy simulation and RPG elements. Your focus is on maintaining your ship's systems and your health while prospecting for asteroid claims to auction on simulated markets.

title: Micro Rush
description: A Seconds-Long Speedrunning game about short levels and fast gameplay. The average level only takes a couple seconds to finish, so you can replay and hone your skills to earn higher medal ranks.

title: Horror Scenarios: The Redwood Estate
description: Investigate the Redwood Estate as officers Tim Rieff and Kim Hansbury in this classic top-down survival horror game. Face terrifying creatures, manage scarce resources, and uncover the dark secrets behind the mysterious events that took place within the estate.

title: Push Box 3D
description: 3D Box Pushing Game with 50 Levels

title: Hyper Euphoria
description: The command-selection adventure game that flourished back when PCs were still called microcomputers makes a comeback. Can you withstand the nonstop MAX 264km/h action that comes at you wave after wave!?

title: Magic Tower: Legion
description: "Magic Tower: Legion" is a roguelike Magic Tower-like game. You will play as a legion commander and lead your team into the magic tower. Use each character's strengths to defeat powerful enemies. Remember to plan every step carefully, for all resources in the magic tower are non-renewable.

title: Panic Files: Buried Sanity
description: Your first day at the local mine got a hell of a twist when the tunnels caved in. Can you escape when the only way out is going deeper? Avoid the deadly creatures, push through hallucinations and remember: Don't panic.

title: Posse of 3
description: Posse of Three is an RPG Maker game that takes place in a wild west setting with heavy fantasy elements! You will play as 3 main characters. Sammy a young settler, Ahiga a native man, and Fennic a wild fawn. Expect traditional turn based rpg combat with a gripping wild west story.

title: Pogo Quest
description: Pogo Quest is a 3D platformer set in a theme park for robots. Complete 10 park attraction areas, meet stars of the park, collect everything and solve a mystery that is threatening to ruin all the fun.

title: Brawl Burrow
description: Brawl Burrow is a cozy monster-catching game where you care for your Brawlets, build them a home, battle, and catch new ones while the game sits quietly at the bottom of your screen.

title: MeowSon
description: MeowSon is a fun arcade adventure with simple controls and nice graphics. Jump in four directions, collect coins and find all three crystals in each intricate level. Interesting puzzles, obstacles and enemies await you, which will allow you to always keep your reaction in good shape.

title: Dealmaster
description: DealMaster is a board game where every property is won through auctions. Time your action cards, invest smartly in stocks, build or destroy houses, and strike trades. Master it all across 6 unique roles to outwit your rivals.

title: The Last Market
description: The Last Market is an open-world game set in a post-apocalyptic world where you run your own market in a safe zone for survivors. Fight zombies, collect sellable items, and grow your market by selling them.

title: Give Me Back!
description: 《Give Me Back!》 is a barrage avoidance adventure game. It will take you into a fantasy world. During the adventure, you only need to avoid snowflakes, cross the waves, and overcome many difficulties to survive until the end. Here, reaction speed and calm judgment are the only rules of survival!

title: Hamstory
description: is a 2D pixel platformer with heartfelt emotion and thrilling challenge. Time your jumps to leap forward—falling is okay. Find your route through the paths ahead. Journey to Haessi Star with warm encouragement from animal townsfolk, experiencing a world that transforms with every season.

title: Vault of The Vanquished
description:
Vault of the Vanquished is a rogue-like adventure where you have been sent to the afterlife, after you were killed by the kings orders. You have now been resurrected and now you can collect and unlock hundreds of cards, to vanquish as many enemies as possible and bring peace to your Kingdom.

This game is built on the idea of RNG, bringing you through countless items to collect, and enemies to Vanquish! Push to Vanquish enough enemies to fight the boss of each zone, cleansing them one by one, and bringing peace to the Kingdom.

title: The Qixia Diary
description: The Qixia Diary is an original Visual Novel inspired by the food culture of Hangzhou, China. You play as Sheng Sheng—a first-year art student at Yunqi University. Through her eyes, you'll step into a unique university life brimming with warmth and local charm beside the West Lake.

title: Jump Heat
description: Embark on a fiery adventure in this 2D platformer designed for speedrunning. Discover original levels that will test your speed in this game completed in less than 72 hours.

title: Graveyard Report
description: indie psychological horror game where you use a Instant Film Camera to capture evidence at a "haunted" cemetery

title: Labyrinthesis
description: Navigate your way through floors of enemies and descend deeper into an underground laboratory. Hack your gun to unlock new weapons, and defeat the machine guarding the elevator.

title: Fear of Sleep
description: Fear of Sleep is a retro-inspired sci-fi horror that blends old-school survival horror tension with modern physics and analogue design. Wishlist now and solve puzzles, face grotesque monsters in visceral combat, and immerse yourself a subterranean world torn by war, hubris, and tragic mystery.

title: Setuna: Legend of Hamburger 2
description: All motions, all frames cancelable. The second installment of the ultra-free 3D action-adventure [SETUNA]. Challenge the limits of your skills with a fully professional-grade input system!

title: States of Power
description: Command your nation's armies, economy, and diplomacy in this WWII grand strategy wargame. Easy to start, hard to master and a full match fits in one session. Play singleplayer and multiplayer, or create, play and share your own custom scenarios with the built-in scenario editor.

title: Taromancy
description: Taromancy is a roguelike deck builder blending Tarot-inspired themes with strategic card battles. Craft powerful decks, master the arcana, and navigate shifting realms filled with unpredictable foes. Embrace fate, discover unique combos, and face new challenges with every run.

title: Legends of Wasteland
description: Legends of Wastelands is an idle RPG where you shape your hero's growth. Choose among six classes, master 100+ skills, and combine talents and gems for unique synergies. Idle for rewards or dive into boss fights and shifting wastelands, with pets and gear adding endless build variety.

title: Santa's Legacy
description: Step into Santa's boots and manage the most magical workshop on Earth! Build, craft, and deliver gifts before Christmas morning in this cozy holiday management adventure. The spirit of Christmas is in your hands!

title: You Don't Belong Here
description: "You Don’t Belong Here" is an indie platformer that will take you on a experimental journey through a fading nihilistic world you don't belong to and explore what it feels like not to fit in and to keep going anyway.

title: They Left Us Here
description: A Sci-Fi First Person Horror Game where you explore an abandoned Space Station

title: His World
description: His World is a short visual novel game where you play as a young shy introvert boy and witness his life with his family and get to see his internal world and struggles. You also make a few decisions throughout the game that will decide on one of game's multiple endings.

title: The Wanderer's Rest
description: This game is a traditional Chinese-style simulation building game that integrates efficiency tools. Travel around the world and discover new settlements. Every time you focus on creation with the efficiency tools, it will bring changes to the settlement.

title: Ninjora Echoes
description: Take control of the young ninja Hiko and his shadow clones to solve puzzles, defeat enemies, and save the village from the sinister monk Doku.

title: La Royale: Below Deck
description: Step into the boots of a young Breton sailor at at the dawn of the american revolutionary war and discover authentic life aboard a French warship. An immersive VR experience based on the true history of the Royal Navy.

title: Rapid Puppet
description: Rapid Puppet is a wild mix of various genres that forms a unique and fast-paced gameplay experience. Roguelike action in the ever-changing worlds is designed to test your stamina and reaction speed. A set of upgradable skills and weapons to become an unstoppable Sci-Fi knight!

title: Italian Pizza Simulator
description: Become a true pizzaiolo and bring joy to a small Italian village in Italian Pizza Simulator! Help bring back Grandma’s decrepit pizzeria to its former glory, surrounded by the sun-kissed hills of Tuscany, and serve colorful customers from all over the world!

title: Dungeon Walk 4: Solitary Insect Princess
description: The main character is a card user. defeats monsters and strengthens his cards and aim for the depths of the labyrinth. Even if he is defeated by a monster and dies the hero has the ability to repeat the loop the power of the strengthened card is inherited, challenge the labyrinth again and again.

title: Cauldron Craft
description: Grab your backpack and get ready to explore the seemingly peaceful lands of Cauldron Craft. Explore various areas, gather magical items, and craft, craft, CRAFT.

title: Remains: Echoes of Strength
description: Darius, a fallen gymnast, had his strength stolen by a mysterious hooded man. With only the echoes and remains of his strength, platform through perilous levels, rebuild your abilities, and pursue the one who took everything from you.

title: Friends of a Feather
description: An absurd adventure RPG: ruin weddings, break into dinosaur mansions, and sleep with 3 or 4 opossums.

title: Fright Animatronics
description: Fright Animatronics is a first-person psychological horror game. Welcome to your new job as a night shift guard and technician in our pizzeria. Your task is to repair animatronics, to monitor them and the pizzeria building using video surveillance

title: PsyPro
description: A first-person psychological horror where your own mind is the enemy. Face intrusive thoughts, panic attacks, and distorted realities and fight to keep your sanity.

title: Empty Gauge
description: VHS-style single-player horror part-time job simulator. Endure the night shift at a remote gas station/convenience store, then return home and collect hidden clues. As the days pass, nightmares bleed into reality—and depending on the clues you uncover, the ending changes.

title: Godway: Only Up Simulator
description: A breathtaking run on rails to the heavens! Godway tests you with dynamic obstacles, platform jumping, and escalating difficulty. Fall, rise again, and push your limits to claim your place beside the god at the summit. The path to immortality begins here.

title: Perfect Porcelain
description: A narrative-driven, 3D anime-styled horror game where you influence the fate of girls trapped in the doll-obsessed Raiko’s murder mansion. Explore, survive and uncover Raiko’s twisted mind.

title: TomaDo!
description: TomaDO! is a fast, quirky multiplayer platformer where tomato heroes race through floating obstacle courses, dodge hazards, and respawn at checkpoints. Jump, dash, and explore golf and other modes to reach the finish first.

title: Dollmaker 2
description: DOLLMAKER 2 is an FPS Tower Defense game where you, a lucky Fisher Co. recruit, help develop cutting edge weaponry at the acclaimed Willoughby Headquarters by fighting monsters.

title: Lines: A Gift for Mom
description: I reprogrammed a classic elimination game as a birthday gift for my mom to thank her for family dedication, and to honor all mothers. When moving balls, 5+ same-colored balls in a line (any direction) will be eliminated.

title: First Sino-Japanese War
description: Free and open source game for First Sino-Japanese War, featuring a tactical naval combat system combined with a turn based hex WEGO strategic layer.

title: Beach Ball Bounce Back
description: BBBB is a challenging physics platformer. If you fall down, just bounce back!

title: Ivilyn Kingdoms
description: A fantasy kingdom builder with tactical combat and survival elements. Lead settlers, make event-driven decisions that shape your story, and train armies to fight for survival or raid other players online. Every choice defines your legacy in a wild and unforgiving land.

title: The Curse of Womanland
description: A romance-adventure text-based game themed around the Land of Women. You will travel to the Land of Women, meet the mysterious young lady Jian Ling, and gradually uncover the bloody and dark secrets behind this realm. Death, resistance, or degeneration? Everything depends on your choices.

title: Command Thousands Troops
description: This is a squad-building game set in a medieval fantasy world, blending turn-based development with real-time combat. As the commander of a small team, you will recruit soldiers, acquire skills, strengthen your army, and repel invaders. Write your own legendary story.

title: DJ Life Simulator: From Your Bedroom to the Mainstage
description: Plug in a REAL USB DJ controller or Mouse/Keyboard and learn professional mixing techniques while playing! Rise through a career of epic gigs, and master skills you can use on real decks — the only game where fun truly turns you into a professional DJ.

title: Project Starblade
description: Project Starblade is a first-person action psychological platformer that follows YOU - a participant for a new series of tests that promise to push your body and mind to their limits. But not everything is at as it seems at "Fathom Laboratories"...

title: Pit Pioneers
description: A Lemmings-inspired puzzle game where you guide pioneers through treacherous underground caverns by strategically assigning abilities like digging, building, and blocking to overcome obstacles.

title: Bloomed Ghoul
description: Descend a living dungeon in this ghoulish Action Roguelike RPG. Devour enemies, replace appendages, and use strange upgrades. Encounter powerful foes, uncertain allies, and hidden secrets. Embrace your monstrous nature, or try to resist it.

title: Project Dejavu
description: Blast, dodge, and drift through treacherous 3D mazes in a vibrant, retro-inspired tank platformer! Master twitch-action combat, survive bullet-hell showdowns, and uncover shortcuts to conquer nearly 50 challenging stages. One wrong move, and you're sunk!

title: ExoTrain
description: Build your base on the train. Explore the exoplanet, fight dangerous wildlife, and discover what happened to the human colony on this planet. Upgrade your train and combine gear modules for perfect survival. Play solo or co-op with friends!

title: Project: Purconia
description: Project: Purconia is an RPG with a platforming battle mechanic. Travel across the country to defeat Synax.

title: Experiment 404
description: Room 404 repeats. Identify anomalies, file reports, and stay alive—some anomalies might hurt you. Nurture the plants, listen to the overlord, end the loop, and unlock multiple unique endings.

title: Royal Verdict
description: A medieval court simulation where every verdict matters. Hear cases, uncover lies, and balance the King, the People, and the Church as your reputation shapes the fate of the kingdom.

title: Potion Pony
description: Unravel a new mystery while delivering to your customers in Potion Pony! Craft potions, ride your pony, and manage shops as you gather the ingredients you need to succeed. Take good care of your pony, you'll need to work together to bring alchemy back to the lands of Everwind.

title: Buenos Aires Mirror Line
description: Carefully observe your sorroundings and come back to your reality by finding what doesn't fit. If something's wrong take the bus back from across the street. A game situated in the haze of Buenos Aires.

title: Loopr
description: A fast-paced puzzle platformer where you must loop through variations of the same level in order to win! Collect artifacts to make the previously impossible actually possible.

title: Discount Nightmares: The Gulch
description: The Gulch is a horror, puzzle, adventure! By day you’ll mine, and by night try to survive! Through a unique five senses system, you’ll explore the Gulch in ways most games never attempt. Look, touch, listen, smell, and even taste your way through a landscape of puzzles, secrets, and growing dread.

title: Mewseum: Film Festival
description: Mewseum: Film Festival is a puzzle game featuring famous movie posters in a charming feline universe. Get the museum ready for the big gala night in a relaxing and fun experience! Lights, camera... meow!

title: Burned Horizons
description: A gritty, turn-based tactical sandbox set in 2002. No XP grind. No class rails. No buy-your-way skill trees. // 'They said it wasn't our war. So we made it ours.'

title: Flash and Die
description: You've been hired by a real estate agency to take photos of their listings at night to give them a unique look online. Grab your camera, step into dark, quiet rooms, and capture every shot before the house notices you. Finish the job or never leave.

title: Low Earth Orbit Adventures
description: Low Earth Orbit Adventures is a relaxing space sim set in the near future where the space around Earth has become a frontier of science, commerce and diplomacy. Retrieve the Hubble, rescue astronauts, assemble space stations and many other missions in this realistic but friendly adventure.

title: Night of the Living Bubble
description: NOT YOUR AVERAGE NIGHT SHIFT... When clocking into work, you find that your business has been overrun by monsters borne from the products on the shelves. Constructed by a mad scientist bent on world domination, only YOU can stop them and save the world by shooting monsters with your Nailgun.

title: Rosie's Rampage
description: Angry and out of work, Rosie goes straight to the top to file a complaint in person. Play as an auto mechanic who, after discovering her factory will be retooled for building tanks, decides to tear down the establishment!

title: Shadows of War 2
description: Command one of four armies in Shadows of War II, a side-scrolling RTS with destructible terrain, procedural maps, and four tug-of-war modes. Build armies, call in strikes, and outwit foes in tense 1v1 multiplayer battles.

title: Idle Squire
description: Idle Squire is a desktop idle RPG where every key you press is an attack. Type, browse, or work while your squire clears dungeons, finds loot, and grows stronger. Unlock talents, artifacts, and perks that bring speed, power, and even partial automation.

title: Bhangarh: The Untold Story
description: A story driven survival horror game that puts you in the shoes of a journalist investigating a real-life haunted site, pulling you deep into its cursed corridors as you solve environmental puzzles and struggle to survive the malevolent force that stalks you from the shadows.

title: Cryptic Glaze Mirror
description: "Cryptic Glaze Mirror" is a plot-driven, mildly horror-themed puzzle otome game. You play as Shui Liuli, a newcomer to the workplace, who unexpectedly finds herself trapped in an ancient Western-style mansion.

title: Politiks
description: Political Roguelite Deck-builder with a twist. A card game where your worst build might actually work.

title: Red Tide
description: Radioactive fish? Heavily armed Game Wardens? Exploring a vast open world with a rod in one hand and a rifle in the other? Red Tide is an extraction fisher set in the irradiated wastelands. Scavenge what's left of the former nuclear site among the Calem Islands, alone or with friends.

title: Sleeping With the Phish
description: A comedic office simulation where you’re the intern battling a chaotic inbox. Spot phishing scams, outsmart tricky coworkers, and survive the hilarious madness of corporate email life.

title: Birds Watching
description: You're the last human on earth. You spend your days bird watching. You're not alone on the mountain.

title: Truck License Trainer
description: Drive a simulated truck to gain knowledge and intuition of a real thing while having fun. Challenge yourself with real-life scenarios or almost impossible maps.

title: Anything Simulator
description: A powerful 2D sandbox simulator — physics and magic, characters and animation. Create anything you can imagine!

title: Card Sim: Chinese Restaurant
description: Drag ingredient cards to create mouth-watering dishes and satisfy hungry customers! Earn gold coins to unlock new recipes and ingredients, renovate your restaurant, and turn it into the ultimate gourmet paradise. Embark on your journey to become a culinary master!

title: Whisker Wanderlust: Unwritten Chapter
description: Wait... WHAT?! My human just vanished into a magic portal! The 3rd Whisker Wanderlust adventure begins! Explore a whimsical fantasy world, meet quirky new friends, and follow the clues to bring your owner home. May every kitty be loved! ♥♥♥

title: Starva Saga
description: Starva Saga is an interactive webcomic mixed with a visual novel. Follow Lily and her crew on a bizarre space odyssey filled with shady corporations, unknown planets, and unexpected discoveries. Smooth reading, free to experience.

title: Horrors Above
description: A first-person sandbox roguelike survival game where you survive from increasingly difficult waves of monsters. Dig for shelter, pickup sticks and rocks to craft tools and weapons, unlock new abilities, and inevitably die.

title: Tick Hop 2
description: Leap, climb, and dash at high speed! With enhanced mobility, face tougher challenges and diverse puzzles. Simple mechanics, plenty of items—experience the pure joy of platforming.

title: Brighter Days
description: Fight difficult enemies, explore dangerous locations, and gain strength in this hand crafted world to defeat the evil that lays waste to these Scarred Lands.

title: Ember Island
description: Relive the arcade glory days in Ember Island, a relentless quarter burner where every mistake costs blood and time. Fight through 12 deadly zones as a Knight, Mage, or Rogue. Chase high scores for lives, hit the checkpoints, and use unlimited continues to earn your mastery. Play the demo now.

title: The Spotter: Dig or Die
description: Dig by day, fight by night in this blend of mining and Tower Defense. As the last Spotter at a ruined gas station, hold back mutant hordes, scavenge the wasteland, and repair your receiver to capture the President’s vital message and humanity’s last hope.

title: RageFall
description: RageFall is a post-apocalyptic third-person shooter and Vehicular Combat MMORPG where players explore a world destroyed by a mysterious force called the Signal. They join factions, fight for survival, and uncover the story behind humanity’s collapse. With deep gameplay, and strong lore.

title: Sonki's Lagoon
description: Dive into Sonki's Lagoon, a colorful low-poly high speed 3D platformer, inspired by the classic. Explore a fun world, pull off stylish moves and find all the Johnnies in this indie adventure!

title: Everything Store
description: Everything Store is a game where you can manage your own thrift shop! Buy items, fit them into your store and sell them by negotiating with customers!

title: HeartFix Express
description: Drive the train. Repair the station. Uncover the mystery. HeartFix Express is an adventure/puzzle game in which you pilot a locomotive, tasked with the repair of giant robot, in which you operate from the inside !

title: Flair
description: Flair is a top-down RPG where the world reacts to your words. Build, fight, and explore a shared universe that grows with every player’s imagination - no limits, just pure creativity.

title: Suitcase Stories
description: Suitcase Stories is a short, cozy puzzle game about packing life’s memories. Organize objects into suitcases across 7 chapters, from childhood to adulthood. No timers, no scores just the calm joy of finding the perfect fit for every cherished memento.

title: Flutterdash
description: Flutterdash is a colorful, fast-paced rhythm game where you click notes in sync with the beat. Create your own levels and challenge your reaction speed, timing, and skill across increasingly difficult levels.

title: Business 98
description: A retro Roguelike Deckbuilder & Simulator about being a cashier in the year 1998. Complete payments using cool combos, tons of special cards, and fun strategies. Can you last until the end of the year?

title: Clay Puzzle
description: "Clay Puzzle" is a falling-block puzzle game where you target and break apart falling blocks! As the blocks fall, aim and shoot away the unwanted parts to shape them into a better form! Get ready for a falling block puzzle game that puts your aim and judgment to the test!

title: Rich River
description: Forage the nature for treasures, sell your finds, and use the profits to build a thriving city. Explore, trade, upgrade your tools, and transform the reaches in this cozy clicker life sim.

title: Loot Loop
description: Build a party of heroes and send them into dungeons in this quick incremental RPG. Fight monsters, collect loot, and unlock upgrades. Fast runs, deep skill tree, zero stress.

title: Escape: Immersion
description: Escape: Immersion is a horror adventure inspired by Inside and Little Nightmares. An atmospheric survival adventure with puzzles, platforming, and unpredictable challenges inside a collapsing underwater lab.

title: Spike a Love Story
description: Spike a Love Story thrusts you into the chassis of a lonely spike trap deep in the levels of a long forgotten video game. As its only contact is the rare visits of the game mascot, it has grown a deep attachment to that singular stimuli, with only one direct way of expressing itself: CRUSHING THE MASCOT INTO GOO. A modern resurgence of ironic interest in this legacy game now gives Spike what it's been longing for: endless chances to show its love via VIOLENT SMOOSHING.

title: Sceptorn
description: Vile fiends have stolen your scepter, and locked you away in a deadly prison! What is a wizard to do without their trusty magic stick? Simple! The magic is within you, and now you've just gotta figure out how to let it flow...

title: Children of Birch
description: "Children of the Birch" is a dark fantasy metroidvania inspired by the mythology of various Slavic peoples and combining a sophisticated platformer with a depressing narrative.

title: Miner Man
description: Dig deep, upgrade your gear, and build your mining empire in Miner Man! Mine resources, hire contractors to automate the grind, and unlock new, challenging mines as you grow from rookie digger to legendary tycoon.

title: CrushCrushCrushCrush
description: CRUSHCRUSHCRUSHCRUSH is an interactive abstract horror experience dealing with themes of sexuality, emotional abuse in romantic relationships, religious trauma, and mental health. please take care of yourself.

title: AbsTRace
description:
AbsTRace sets you in a racing simulation.

While the racing simulation itself might seem rather bare bones, other aspects extend beyond the apparent function of the program that seems to be hosting a cast of distraught characters.
The people inside don't seem to know how or why they ended up in there and beyond racing to the first place at the finish line, it is unclear what the goals of it all are.

title: Oops Airlines
description:
Oops Airlines needs your help!

After the terrible ClownShrike virus shut down all of the airport's systems, it up to you, the sole air-traffic controller, to manually direct flights to the runway!

Carefully plan routes for each plane - but watch out! Once a flight path is connected to the airport, it cannot be altered. Plan wisely to guide the incoming flights to safety!

title: You Donut Get It
description: Donut simulator

title: Link Penguins
description: 【max 8P】The title is A life-threatening bridge-building begins.Due to the effects of global warming, Antarctica has been shattered into pieces. Your mission is to LINK the fragmented continents by building bridges between them! Play solo or team up in multiplayer to unite Antarctica once again!

title: Heavenly Guitars
description: Play hits like "Senbonzakura," "Gimme Chocolate!!," and "The Beginning"! Experience the ultimate electric guitar "joy of playing" in this competitive music game. Realistic sound, intuitive controls, and hot online battles. Compete with guitarists from all over the world!

title: Flipper on Recoil
description: Flipper on Recoil is a fast-paced 3D platformer where a fish with legs and a shotgun takes on gravity. Use recoil, power-ups, and absurd tricks to blast through handcrafted levels and chase your best times.

title: Line of Taste: Pizza Crust
description: Line of Taste – Pizza Crust is a pizzeria simulation where you run the restaurant on your own. Place conveyor belts to solve puzzles in your charming kitchen!

title: Exit Plan
description: Grab some friends, set some traps, steal some loot, and hold the regrets. Exit Plan has you race friends in randomly generated dungeons to the exit. Each round creates hilarious physics mayhem where your own genius might be your worst enemy.

title: Frost Loop
description: Frost Loop is a survival city builder set on a train in the snow. Build, Manage, and Pilot the train carrying the last of humanity in a world of snow and storms. Can the warmth of humanity survive on the run? Or is it destined to go cold.

title: Abandoned: A Tale of Forgotten Lives
description: A guy boards an abandoned space station and befriends two androids, who work with him to find a way off the space station.

title: Vizul 1: Empatia - Adventure in Nice Colors
description: bullet hell boss battles; adventure; urban fantasy; 4 difficulty modes; single-player, 2 playable characters; generous save points and checkpoints

title: Wild West Miner Simulator
description: You've become the sheriff of a town that... doesn't exist. Nobody lives here, the governor's stupid joke. It's time to get to work and turn this NOWHERE into a bustling metropolis. Mine coal, ore, and gold. Build houses, find oil, bring in new residents, create a paradise in the middle of nowhere.

title: Shady O'Grady's Overnight Sensation
description: From the developer of the Shady O'Grady's Rising Star series comes a band sim game with more attitude than a teenager hyped up on energy drinks. This roguelike deckbuilder lets you step into the shoes of a startup rock band - write songs, buy instruments, and play gigs from bars to festivals.

title: Chrysanthemum: On the Way to Sweet Dreams
description: A high school senior with superpowers longs to confess her feelings to her chemistry teacher, but the island’s mysterious anomalies turn her world upside down. A non-linear otome visual novel filled with sinister mysteries and complicated choices.

title: Shell of the Coward
description: Shell of the Coward is a turn-based roguelike/RPG where you must escort the Anathema you've sworn to protect through a perilous dungeon without ever looking back.

title: Walto
description: WALTO is a boss-rush game set in the land of rabbits, built around a combat philosophy where evasion and attack happen as one, demanding extreme reflexes. Cut down the encroaching predators and bring this world to its end.

title: Why Elephant Sit on Chair?
description: Why Elephant Sit On Chair? is a game that combines block-clearing with light roguelite elements. Team up with your animal block companions to face all kinds of unexpected challenges. every run is full of surprises! Just a tip: don't step on their tails.

title: City Builder Pro
description: City Builder Pro lets you unleash your inner ruler—design your dream base, prepare for epic battles, and feel the thrill of watching your city grow and dominate. Build smart, strike hard, and rise to power!

title: Coraroc
description: A back-to-basics retro platformer! Waking up alone in a mysterious laboratory, Coraroc must make his way through colorful stages and dastardly enemies to rescue his friends. Can you help Coraroc defeat the Pacicap menace?

title: Celestial Lumina
description: Ascend from the depths as Evan, heir of a fallen underworld, to uncover the truth behind a world stripped of dawn. Celestial Lumina is a 2D Pixel-Art Metroidvania where Light clashes with the Darkness that stole the sky.

title: Rite or Ruin
description: Summon eldritch gods and outwit rival cultists in this online multiplayer game of deception. Shape the Rite, make dangerous bets, and unleash your Patron's wrath. Only one cultist leaves alive.

title: Handgun Football
description: Handgun Football shatters physics: FPS meets soccer brawl. Revolvers, shotguns blast the ball into rival goals. Solo vs AI, slide from chill to hell; .LAN or global 2,3,4-teams,up to 12 players. Classic gravity or zero-g space variants. One shot flips the match.

title: Celestial Drift
description: Celestial Drift is a space-action sandbox game. Play solo or online. Shoot down various enemies to obtain rare and valuable materials. Sell what you find to buy better equipment and ships. Explore sectors to discover hidden paths, and dare to roam places you shouldn't visit.

title: Slorpus Slaughter VII: Singular Shoot Soul
description: Slorpus Slaughter VII: Singular Shoot Soul is a short bullet-hell style single player shooter puzzle game. Blast your way through eight deceptively simple levels, as you attempt to clear all on-screen enemies. The catch? You only have one shot.

title: Papy Panic
description: Papy Panic is an indie driving game where players control quirky vehicles, navigating through chaotic environments with physics-based jumps and obstacles. It includes a standard single-player experience and a dedicated interactive Twitch Mode designed for live streamers.

title: Can I Get an Iced Coffee with Breastmilk!?
description: Visit your favorite Bunny Girl, Muffin, and get the Ultimate Breast Milk treatment for your daily Coffee intake in this first person hentai short story! Make tits expand, make milk flow!

title: Sunshine.EXE
description: The second game of the unofficial prequel trilogy of Sonic.EXE creepypasta. It explains everything that happens before MY5TCrimson's Sonic.EXE game.

title: Insert Coin: Arcade Party
description: Insert Coin: Arcade Party is a chaotic online multiplayer party game packed with 30+ fast-paced arcade minigames. Face friends in rapid rounds of reflex, timing, and word battles. Insert coin. Let the chaos begin.

title: Amato
description:
Welcome to Amato!

Play as a forest spirit able to possess objects and guide kokedamas — small endangered plant spheres — to fertile lands! Tilt the environment, master gravity, and protect nature!

A blend of puzzles and precision challenges
Switch between exploration phases with clever environmental puzzles and skill-based courses where agility and timing are key.

A vibrant, evolving world
Use weather effects, physics, and biome-specific mechanics to overcome obstacles and unravel the forest’s mysteries.

A colorful and relaxing atmosphere
Immerse yourself in a cozy universe inspired by traditional Japan, with warm visuals and a smooth, jazzy soundtrack.

Accessible yet demanding gameplay
Easy to pick up, but offering real challenges for players who seek perfect mastery of every course!

title: Frontline: Afrika Korps
description: Lead iconic WWII forces across stunning desert battlefields. Command, customize, and conquer in thrilling, historically rich campaigns. Outsmart foes with cunning tactics. The sands of Africa await!

title: King of Tokyo
description:
Turn into a kaiju as you destroy everything in your path in this fast-paced dice game! Roll the dice and find the best possible combinations to rule over Tokyo, whether you choose to heal yourself, attack, buy cards or win Victory Points.

Adapt your strategy to become the King of Tokyo at the right moment and attack all your opponents at the same time.

The first player to reach 20 Victory Points wins the game… and so does the last player to stay alive!

title: Ligmanauts
description: Classic platforming action brought kicking and screaming into the voice chat era. Roll, bounce, grab, swing, and boost through compact challenge based worlds with friends online or locally, backed by an original liquid dnb soundtrack.

title: Asistent detektiva Zbyška
description: Czech freeware visual novel, set in Regenbogen, quiet small town, that is protected by brave dolphin detective Zbyšek and his team.

title: Zanerdin: The Unbound
description: A Collectible Turn-Based RPG Gather heroes to face the looming threat and uncover the conspiracy lurking beneath Kalatos

title: Bean Sidhe
description: Bean Sidhe (banshee) is a narrative walking sim through Irish and modern history featuring fully voiced interactions and colorful 3D landscapes.

title: Grumpy Jack
description: A bullethell adventure awaits! Join Jack, a reluctant hero, as he battles bizarre enemies, uncovers secrets, meets quirky characters—and hunts down Death’s missing coffee mug.

title: Pip's Potion Shop
description: With your shop on the line, meet unique characters and craft potions of every flavor in this short, light-hearted game. From giant constructs to quirky little creatures, listen to their troubles and mix the right ingredients to create a potion that soothes their hearts and satisfies their cravings!

title: Angie Magica
description: Unravel the secrets of Lamentia by harnessing the powers of the Wand of the Eternal Smile with skill and wit while you learn delicious recipes in this gourmet adventure. Fulfill the prophecy and reclaim your rightful place as the ultimate magical girl!

title: Ajedrez una tarde de Otoño
description: Ajedrez una tarde de Otoño is a little chess simulator game, a young lady in a wheelchair plays against a man with a cowboy hat. Who will win?

title: Let's Learn Lingít
description: Let's Learn Lingít is an interactive self-study program designed to help those curious about Tlingit and to help them be as familiarized with Tlingit as possible. It includes games, activities, picture glossary, oratory, placenames. Additionally, it includes audio cues to practice and follow along.

title: Rhythm Taichi XR
description: Rhythm Taichi XR is a physical dancing mixed reality rhythm game that turns your smartphone into a motion camera. It is compatible with most custom songs on beatsaver, and requires no specialized hardware. It is also available as a second screen for your phone or as a standalone VR game.

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Puppy Love
description: The 21st free update for Disney Dreamlight Valley brings new content inspired by Disney's Lady and the Tramp - including a new Realm and both titular dogs as Villagers. It also included group mode furniture editing, the end of the Magical Mementos' storyline and the Paw-fect Romance Star Path.

title: SuperJumpWorld Rage
description: Remember Super Mario Bros? Okay so this is game is pretty like the same, but with a twist. Hope you'll find a way out of this place...

title: Emotions: Social MeDie
description: Can't get off the smarthone? Be careful because your every interaction will affect your emotions and if they become too intense they could turn into real demons, which you will be forced to face when display turns off. Can you survive long enough?

title: Salvage Unlimited
description: Salvage Unlimited puts you in the captain’s seat of a small salvage company. Accept contracts, use your boat’s sonar to locate wrecks hidden beneath the water, and bring your finds back to port to complete jobs. Buy, sell, and upgrade your fleet to take on bigger contracts and earn greater rewards.

title: Sheeps
description: Can you count? Are you sure? Earn powerful upgrades in this chaotic counting roguelite to survive increasingly difficult challenges. Meet colorful, totally trustworthy characters and find out why an endless supply of sheep is pouring through a mysterious rift. 1, 2, 7, 56… oh dang it!

title: Oiran Survival: Edo Yokai Rush
description: An alluring oiran dances through the blood-soaked nights of Edo. Where beauty and violence collide — a dopamine-fueled survival action.

title: Sunset Racing
description: Take on friends in a top-down RC racer that incorporates the best of karting games.

title: Jaxx Blorgin's UFO Jam
description: Legendary space-baller Jaxx Blorgin is comin' at you with the only UFO sports title licensed to use his name! Master physics and your UFO to shoot, dunk and defend in this arcade basketball game.

title: Electio
description: Five live rounds, a blank, and a choice. Electio is a short narrative horror game where death carries permanent consequences.

title: Ballatory
description: Ballatory is a short, 100%-able incremental idler where you BUY, UPGRADE, PAINT, and watch your BALLS bouncing around, hitting the cores and earning you money!

title: Chant Wizard
description: Scream to win! Shout over-the-top spells in this hilarious voice-controlled battler. Assemble your magical deck from the five elements for 1v1 duels testing your wits and shame. Warning: Play safely—don't let your roaring summon the neighbors before you beat your rival!

title: Ancient Frontier: Tactics
description: Ancient Frontier Tactics is a turn-based tactical rogue-lite. You command an ever growing fleet on a mission through unknown space. Explore randomly generated sectors filled with enemies and mystery as you expand your ships and crew. Experience the glory of victory or bitter defeat.

title: Untold Memories: Potter's Field
description: Broken by guilt after a fatal accident, Mark accepts a mysterious job. But Potter's Field isn't looking for a guard; it’s looking for a prisoner. Orchestrated by revenge, your shift is a psychological execution. Watch the shadows, face your sins, or join the graves you protect.

title: Nullis
description: Logic puzzle game where you must destroy paths of 0-s from the board. Use logic to complete levels with optimal solutions.

title: ClickTown
description: ClickTown is a minimalist pixel city builder. Place buildings, produce resources, and reinvest your output to steadily grow your city. Unlock new buildings and systems as your town expands over time.

title: Cheater's Table
description: Play fair. Die first. A color-based shedding card game built around bluffing, cheating, and social risk. Simple rules, deadly consequences.

title: Find 100 Ducks and Blast Them...in Space!!!
description: Yes! In this game you must blast 100 toy ducks...IN SPACE! Relax, take aim, and let the feathers fly! With light-hearted gameplay and cute ducks to hunt, it's a casual first-person experience full of wholesome, family-friendly fun!

title: Factory Works Idle
description: Factory Works Idle is a captivating incremental game that puts you in control of an ever-expanding industrial empire. Begin with humble manual labor and gradually build an automated manufacturing powerhouse that spans from primitive stone tools to futuristic singularity technology.

title: Magiclean
description: MagiClean – is a satisfying cozy clicker game where you clean up a Wizarding School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. Click to Clean, Upgrade and Brew potions, Synergize 15+ spells from your toolbelt, collect magical animals, and grow more powerful each second.

title: Looking Up
description: Looking Up captures an emotional story between Emilia and her dad. Explore and experience her discovery of flight by solving puzzles which include butterflies, mythical creatures, and birds! Grow up with Emilia and reach the skies!

title: Kuromaku
description: Kuromaku Is An Indie First-Person Psychological Thriller Experienced From A Child’s Perspective. Complete Chores Assigned By Your Mother, Uncover Hidden Secrets, And Survive Unsettling Encounters. Objectives Must Be Completed To Progress Further Into The Rich, Unfolding Story.

title: The Quiet Days of Dorothy
description: During the 2020 lockdown, Dorothy spends her days caring for jars of sourdough starters. By sharing them with others, she builds unexpected connections and discovers small acts of kindness that bring warmth in difficult times.

title: Voody Hex
description: Voody Hex is a roguelite plateformer. Enter into a voodoo cabaret and curse yourself to increase difficulty. You cannot attack - Your only way to survive is to dodge.

title: Demon With a Candy Crisis
description: A quick and easy 3d platformer playing as a demon that needs to quench its thirst for candy. Travel through hell to get to the surface to find someone's secret stash of candy.

title: Rebellion Princess
description: Raise your favorite characters and have them ready to fight in the next run! Command beautiful girls to defend the castle and princess A non-reset roguelite × tower defense

title: Ghastly Mask Shop
description:
You decided to open up a mask shop in a town populated by ghosts. Why did you do this? Your customers are a little odd, they get up to strange things, and can be picky at times. There are 22 different spirits who want to BUY, so get in there and SELL!

Made in 72 hours for Winter MelonJam 2025.

title: Tank Mechanic Simulator: Cromwell Mk.IV
description: Renovate and build the legendary Cromwell Mk. IV. Experience this iconic tank in all its detailed glory, one part at a time. Put it to the test on the training ground, sell it for profit, or display it in your own museum.

title: BlackSands
description: Trapped in a relentless time loop, fight your way through a mysterious arena. Explore, adapt, and use what you’ve learned throughout each reset to uncover its secrets and reach your freedom.

title: Plush Parade
description: Design and sell your custom plushies in this cozy and creative sim! Mix and match hundreds of pieces to create unique designs and build your own plush collections. Manage your online shop, launch blind boxes and compete with a rival company to become the ultimate plush designer!

title: Back to Drive
description: Back To Drive is a car assembly, driving, and survival simulator set in a cyberpunk world. Start with a rusty frame and turn it into a car where every part affects its performance. Customize it to your liking and embark on a journey through the wastelands. Work, race, and explore the world!

title: Eerie Dossier: The Haunted Apartment
description: "Eerie Dossier:the Haunted Apartment"is a walking simulation game that combines horror and horror elements.You will be trapped in an infinite loop of corridors and rooms, searching for opportunities to escape from this place while also discovering its secrets

title: Hidden Foxes
description: A cozy hidden-objects game where you explore charming dioramas, searching for mischievous little foxes, all while being carried by relaxing music.

title: Network Notation
description: You are a lost artificial intelligence adrift on the internet. Infiltrate abstract computer networks filled with defensive complications to expand your world. Improve your capabilities to overcome ever greater challenges. Learn about the state of the world and what you were made for.

title: Street Soccer Simulator
description: Street Soccer Simulator throws you into chaotic, messy matches where the rules don’t matter. Just you, the ball, and the streets—slide, smash, and score in the most fun and unpredictable soccer brawls you’ve ever played!

title: Peg Solitaire Pro
description: Peg Solitaire Pro offers a relaxing challenge for your mind. Sit back, sip your favorite drink, and enjoy the calm satisfaction of clearing the board one move at a time.

title: Homebound: Escape Room
description: In Homebound, you awaken in a locked house filled with cryptic clues and hidden dangers. Every object hides a secret, every sound a warning. Can you uncover the truth and escape before it's too late?

title: The Stars are Right
description: The Stars are Right is a party based RPG with a focus on PVP.

title: Chief Cenab: Şahmaran
description: Follow Chief Cenab on the trail of the Şahmaran legend. Told in a black-and-white comic book style with color accents unique to each part, this point-and-click adventure draws you into a deep atmosphere and mysterious events.

title: Truck Racing Simulator
description: Truck Racing Simulator puts you in the driver’s seat of pure chaos and control—feel the roar of the engine, the thrill of tight turns, and the rush of leaving rivals in the dust. It’s all about adrenaline, grit, and the joy of heavy-duty speed.

title: Klondike Solitaire Pro
description: Kick back, sip your coffee, and unwind with Klondike Solitaire Pro. Enjoy a peaceful evening of cards, strategy, and satisfying wins—your perfect casual escape.

title: Soccer Puzzle
description: In Soccer Puzzle, every line you draw is a clever shot at victory. Feel the thrill of solving tricky paths, bending physics to your will, and watching the ball roll perfectly into the goal. It’s all about smart moves, sweet goals, and satisfying wins.

title: Remote Life Simulator
description: Work remotely, build skills, earn money, and upgrade your life. Become a professional remote worker in this life simulation game!

title: Toy Car Race
description: Toy Car Race throws you into wild, wacky races where tiny cars zoom, bump, and fly off kitchen tables and living room tracks! It's fast, chaotic, and ridiculously fun—like your childhood toy box came to life with a need for speed!

title: Soccer Penalty Kick
description: In Soccer Penalty Kick, feel the pressure, the roar of the crowd, and the thrill of the shot! Smash in impossible goals, outsmart the keeper, and rise as your team's hero. Every kick counts—become a legend on the field!

title: Billiards Pro Simulator
description: Billiards Pro Simulator delivers a refined, immersive experience—dim lights, quiet focus, and the satisfying sound of a perfect shot. Settle in, line up your cue, and enjoy a relaxed yet competitive game of precision and style, solo or with friends.

title: Asmodeus: Tajemný kraj Ruthaniolu
description: Czech-made mix between adventure game and dungeon-crawling RPG, that was rendered in 3D but each screen was then redrawn by hand. Game setting is fantasy world, that is under the threat of return of ancient devil Asmodeus. Hero embarks on a journey to stop summoning ritual by evil forces.

title: Skelly's Skirmish
description: Arcade platforming action with a spooky theme and a Game Boy aesthetic.

title: Drop Jump
description: A fast-paced 3D rhythm platformer focused on precision and mastery. Play handcrafted levels, build your own, and challenge others through community-created content.

title: House Cleaner Simulator
description: Build your reputation with every perfectly cleaned home.

title: Admnor
description: A puzzle-roguelite where you sort a bizarre variety of items, from a coin-sized black hole to a giant inflatable duck. It doesn't need your brain to overthink, this ritual demands pure intuition. Embrace the absurdity. It simply wants to be ordered.

title: Ink & Cursor
description: Ink & Cursor is a cozy deck builder game in which you need to save animals from the spreading ink and it's monsters. Unlock various biomes with unique floras and faunas. Create the best team to help you progress in the world, and find your path to the source of the darkness spreading in the world.

title: Car Race Pro Simulator
description: In Car Race Pro Simulator, every turn tightens your grip and every straightaway fuels your adrenaline. Feel the thrill of high-speed competition as you push precision and power to the limit in a race to stay ahead of the pack.

title: Car Race Simulator
description: Car Race Simulator puts your feet on the pedal and your heart in overdrive—blaze through tight turns, push past rivals, and feel every second count in a rush of speed, skill, and pure racing adrenaline.

title: Dig for Riches
description: Dig For Riches is a realistic mining simulation. Dig the earth, extract valuable minerals, haul them to the surface by cart and sell them. Use your earnings to upgrade your equipment, dig deeper, and face increasing dangers.

title: Hangman Pro
description: Hangman Pro brings the nostalgic thrill of word guessing to life, making every letter count. Feel the tension build with each wrong guess as you race to solve the puzzle before it’s too late.

title: Buggy Racing Simulator
description: Buggy Racing Simulator is a high-adrenaline ride where you’ll feel every drift, bump, and near miss as you race through dirt, storm, and chaos—fighting to stay in control while the world blurs past you.

title: Bike Stunts Simulator
description: Bike Stunts Simulator is a thrilling physics-based ride where you'll feel the rush of speeding through hoops, landing tricky jumps, and dodging spikes and traps—all while trying to stay balanced and avoid wiping out.

title: Cyber Breaker
description: Welcome to the 'Breaker System'. Fight back against the system through a game of cards and free humanity from its systematic embrace as BREAKER. Combine the use of skill cards and powerful artefacts alongside tactical thinking to best the system and break through the advancing array of robots.

title: All That Time
description: All That Time is a first-person nostalgic adventure where you wander surreal spaces, relive childhood dreams and memories, solve hidden mysteries, and search for your own escape while freeing those who remain trapped.

title: The Newspapers of the Day
description: In 1920s Gyeongseong, the pen is mightier than the sword, but your hand is trembling. As an editor-in-chief, arrange articles, dodge censorship, and manipulate public opinion. Will you wake the people with the truth or yield to survive? Your editorial choices will rewrite history.

title: Axonaut
description: In the final stage of the interstellar war, the Alliance established the secret organization AXONAUT, primarily responsible for handling anomalous zones across post-war regions. As a member, unleash the power of the Alliance to your heart's content.

title: Project Damascus
description: A first person adventure platformer, focused on exploration with time based mechanics and puzzle elements. Enter the ruins of the Kingdom of Pharygia. Swiftly traverse its dillapidated, intricate infrastructure to delve further into the depths of iniquity, in order to cast light on hidden truths.

title: Salt vs. Pepper
description: Salt VS Pepper is a twin-stick shooter where you switch between black and white every 3 seconds, leaving behind an evil clone every time you switch! Use guns, walls, bowling balls, and anything in between as a weapon!

title: Dung Ho!
description: Dung Ho! is a co-op physics game where you and your friends are dung beetles rolling a (dung) ball into a hole.

title: Kingdom Dice
description: Become a lord in a world of feudal greed in the turn-based economic board game Kingdom Dice. Build an empire, buy lands, collect taxes from friends, trade, and bankrupt everyone around you! (ง •̀_•́)ง

title: Another Game About Automation
description: Another Game About Automation is a casual factory-building where you have to generate numbers and combine them with mathematical operations. Upgrade and unlock new mathematical operations.

title: Anaria: Reborn
description: ANARIA: Reborn is a first-person psychological horror where you're trapped in the mind of a mysterious girl, searching for a way out through endless doors and a haunting nightmare.

title: Spori
description: Spori is a short story-driven psychological horror game, where you play as a janitor in the early 2000s.

title: Until North Ends
description: Explore a fantasy themed open world. Together with your friends or alone build your safe haven to craft gear, prepare equipment, refine resources to go on a journey. Visit different biomes, fight enemies, gather resources, plunder dungeons or caves and obtain loot!

title: Chosen Garden
description: In this unique roguelike deck-builder, tend your garden and harvest plants for high scores! 100+ plants, 5 gardens, and a wealth of unique weather, animals, and tools — countless builds await!

title: Spinner Smash
description: Master your spinner in SPINNER SMASH, a 3D Fighting Platformer. Throw, jump, strike, and dodge with your spinner to overcome Aroa’s challenges. Face the leaders of each stage and rise to the top. Give Bart, the school bully, what he deserves!

title: Pocket Flight
description: Fly your own way in Pocket Flight - a cozy endless flight adventure! Explore dynamic biomes, face shifting weather, customize your plane, and take on daily challenges. Relaxing skies, infinite horizons. Ready for takeoff?

title: Centipede Simulator
description: Experience life as a centipede! Munch on crickets to grow longer and evade deadly predators in a frantic struggle for survival across multiple game modes. How long can you last?

title: Chilling Silence
description: Immerse yourself in the gloomy atmosphere of a small northern town at the turn of the millennium, where reality intertwines with the inner demons of the main character, who suffers from a strange form of social phobia. What could have happened in this godforsaken place at the edge of the earth?

title: Rentguessr
description: A guessing game of rent prices in France!

title: Enchant the East
