description: Town Life: Farm, fish, and trade in a traditional Chinese water town. Multiverse Delivery: Cook and send meals to heroes across space and time via portals. Pixel Art: A unique visual blend of ancient tradition and multiverse fantasy.

title: Discarded
description: Discarded is action rougelike, arena shooter where you face waves of relentless enemies. You’re alone and outgunned - move fast, shoot faster, dodge the bullets and upgrade on the fly. Keep up with the pressure or get shredded like the rest.

title: Brewed and Battered
description: Brew your own weapons from scratch and unleash them on hordes of homunculi! In this survival roguelite, every ingredient combination creates a potion that splashes, moves, and reacts in a unique way. Discover absurd synergies and rescue fellow alchemists in your quest for the Philosopher’s Stone.

title: The Joogle Bros.
description: Joogle is a game about a Joogle named Joogle who lives in Joogle City on Planet Joogle and his brother commands the Joogle Army. There's also KING SURN who is very important to the plot.

title: Tavern Adventures
description: A cozy fantasy management game where you build and run a tavern for adventurers. Serve humans, dwarves, and elves, gather rumors from your customers, and turn those into quests to grow your fame and expand your tavern.

title: Dream Delirio's
description: Blast through waves of children’s nightmares with Magnus, a cereal mascot fighting to free the children from their fears. Weaponize your breakfast, build game-breaking card synergies and show these nightmares that crunch time is over.

title: DeskAlchemy: Fairy Mine Tales
description: "DeskAlchemy: Xiao Ke's Journey" is an idle to light storyline role-playing game. A young man from a small town encounters a talking mole named Xiao Ke, and embarks on a journey to dig for minerals and treasure across the country.

title: Adventurer's Guild Reception
description: This is the Adventurer's Guild. Today, daring adventurers come here in search of a quick fortune. Become a receptionist at the Adventurer's Guild and arrange quests for unique adventurers in this training RPG game!

title: Last Spaceship
description: Last Spaceship is an adventure puzzle game. Play as a maintenance robot, repair the ship by solving a series of fascinating puzzles, explore its various compartments, and collect relics of human legacy. Experience a story about war, extinction, salvation, and choice.

title: When the Sun Dies
description: When the Sun Dies is an open-world survival game set in a mysterious post-apocalyptic world, where players explore deadly biomes, survive radiation storms, and upgrade their weapons to face what lies beyond the fog.

title: Fallin' Glocks
description: Fallin' Glocks is a 2D skydiving action shooter with procedural levels and power-ups. Drop into the pits of a post-apocalyptic Earth and fight against hijacked, classified government weapons controlled by the master weapon, Ares.

title: Hyperquiz
description: Fast-paced, high quality, challenging trivia. Play your friends or compete against the world.

title: I Can Only Speak Doner
description: Slice, grill, and serve Doner in a foreign land where you don't speak a word of the local language. Use rhythmic keyboard controls to keep up with the lunch rush, puzzle out cryptic orders from impatient customers, and survive the chaos of running your uncle's doner shop.

title: Zhuan Zhu Assassinating King Liao
description: "Zhuan Zhu Assassinating King Liao" is a side-scrolling action game based on ancient Chinese history. Play as Zhuan Zhu, who joins a daring plot to assassinate King Liao of Wu. Embark on a perilous journey fueled by loyalty and conviction in this legendary tale of sacrifice.

title: Simple Flight
description: ！The Easiest Carrier Landing Ever！ Simple Flight is an accessible yet challenging 3D flight simulation game. Pilot airplanes, helicopters, and more with realistic physics, experience the freedom of flight, and take on missions and challenges.

title: Rune Rhythm Realm
description: Defend global seals in this dark fantasy rhythm-typing TD with roguelite elements, eliminating enemies via real-time letter typing while strategically deploying traps (spacebar) and activating skills (number keys) to the beat.

title: Sonya
description: A surreal horror where your decisions and moral choices shape your destiny. Navigate a hospital, listen to the inner voices, and discover a truth that will break your mind.

title: Blood Facsimile
description: An immersive FPS adventure set in a dark and surreal scifi world

title: Arcana: Card Arena
description: A single-player fantasy combat card game with an anime and cartoon aesthetic, fair progression system, and multiple available game modes.

title: Dramatour
description:
In this local split-screen multiplayer game, 2-8 players compete to build the tallest tower by stacking randomly selected 3D objects.

Inspired by a low poly universe with circus, theater and carnival influences, the game combines strategic construction and dynamic confrontation: players can either place their objects to stabilize their tower, or throw them at their opponent's to destabilize it.

Based on a realistic physics system, the game does not artificially detect collapses, letting gravity and tower stability determine the outcome of each game. With no time limit, it offers a competitive and immersive experience, promoting strategy and skill in a unique visual and audio environment.

title: BasketBlow
description: Play tabletop basketball with realistic physics in relaxing environments. Compete in customizable leagues and cups, edit your teams, and complete your trophy room. Collect points to unlock courts, balls, and environments. Play with friends locally or online.

title: Flipper of Eridanus
description: A fantastical sci-fi pinball experience featuring advanced physics, unique table mechanics, mini-games, and a full pinball tutorial!

title: Cyber Boxing Arena
description: A Futuristic styled boxing simulator action game. Compete against other players and become the next cyber boxing Arena champion!

title: Shapes N Music
description: A brutal bullet-hell rhythm game where every death is your fault. Dodge hazards, dash and die to a great soundtrack synced to intense levels. Enjoy 4 more game modes built to ruin your evenings. Can you beat each level without taking a hit?

title: Forager's Finds
description: Go foraging in a vast forest. Strap on your utility belt and head out to explore, photograph, journal, and pick your finds. Sell them at Forager’s Finds to unlock perks and upgrades. A relaxed mushroom picker simulator with many species to discover and document — if you take the time to look.

title: Laby's Village
description: A quirky fantasy 2D pixel roguelite action game. Play as Laby, a goblin officer of the fallen Demon Lord's army, setting out from a small village to subdue ambitious rivals. Combine weapons and relics to forge your own chaotic build and enjoy absurd, fast-paced battles.

title: Seven Days on the Edge: Galactic Fringe
description: Daytime romance, nighttime werewolf! Explore freely by day—then face the “Night Council” nightly. Use what you uncover to choose the right side among factions… because your decisions will decide who lives and who doesn’t. And when you finally piece together every clue, the truth behind Ferron is…

title: The Node
description: A short sci-fi point-and-click adventure about forbidden time travel. Explore a facility outside normal time, solve clever puzzles, and uncover the purpose of The Node. Featuring subtle (and not that subtle) references to classic time-travel movies and TV shows.

title: Good Things Vol 1
description: Good Things Vol 1 is a collection of 15 wildly imaginative, weird little games ranging from evolving platformers to genre-bending adventure... but the Blue Elephant ate all the games, and if you do not help him he will DIE :(

title: Gatherlands
description: Gatherlands is a game of exploration, survival, and crafting on magical islands. Control a wizard who awakens from ice, rescue villagers, solve mysteries, and fight against the darkness!

title: Fries Drive
description: Hit the gas and fire up the fryer! Build your street food empire in this cozy cooking adventure. Navigate a charming open world, find the perfect parking spot, and serve crispy, golden fries to hungry customers. Master the kitchen, upgrade your truck, and become a street food legend.

title: Ultimate Control Machine
description: A platformer like no other… play with 30 unique controllers! Every stage changes the controls. Master your mouse, your keyboard, and your reflexes in the ultimate test to become the world’s greatest robot pilot!

title: The Slow Process of Pulling Out My Guts
description: a dead-end girl clashes infinitely with a parasite in her head.

title: Stupor
description: A psychological horror walking sim about five teenagers who get their summer break cut short by being trapped in a cabin from a monster. All of them die.

title: Wunder: The Double-sided Deckbuilder
description: Wunder is a game of chance about flipping coins. Build a deck of coins with their own risk & reward; upgrade each side to tilt the odds in your favour, bolster your strategy with strange talismans and defeat the Ferryman at his own game.

title: Trailquest MTB
description: Race against the clock, conquer technical challenges, and take on the quest to master the trails in this open-world MTB experience.

title: Chronia: The Rotcore
description: Chronia: The Rotcore is a medieval themed turn-based RPG set in the fantasy land of Tinotella. You are a newbie mercenary, travelling across the land to find your origin. Part with teams, slaying monsters, achieving quests... It is your choice to shape your own journey.

title: Vicarius
description: A small handcrafted open world focused on exploration and combat. Leave your safe zone to gather the resources that will help you craft better gear. The further you go, the more dangerous it gets but the resources are also better. Dying means losing everything that you are carrying.

title: Sidereal Wanderer St
description: To master space warfare, the evolution of ‘Side Real Wanderer' continues. On a battlefield formed from an 8x8 grid, annihilate hostile forces.

title: Sakura Gozen
description: In Ouma, samurai Sakura Ouka, jobless and foolish, loses her home. She aids Suzune, sparking a quest to revive the Sakura Style. They aim for the Gozenjiai, facing trials in a Japanese-style action RPG. Complete requests, build reputation, and master thrilling battles to win!

title: Anvira: Forge Defense
description: Defend Anvilium from endless waves of goblins and monsters! A tower defense roguelite where you deploy mighty golems, unleash powerful spells, and craft crazy builds through deep customization. Adapt your strategy, grow stronger, and see how long you can survive against ever-escalating threats.

title: Shooting Girls
description: Cute girls face off in real-time shooting battles! Use strategy and control to win in 1v1, 2v2, and Battle Royale modes.

title: Patisserie Simulator
description: Run your own cozy patisserie and grow your fortune! Serve coffee, fresh pastries, and orange juice to customers, unlock new recipes, and decorate your patisserie to make it more charming and profitable.

title: Playover
description: PLAYOVER is a first-person psychological horror game set in an underground drilling facility. You are sent to investigate missing workers and continue the operation

title: Construction Store Simulator
description: Start with a small construction store and turn it into the place every contractor relies on. In Construction Store Simulator, you will stock goods, set prices, move shelving with full physics, and keep checkout lines under control—while simultaneously expanding the store, hiring staff, and improving the look and reputation.

title: P-Pan
description: Armed with a big smile and punches that fly endlessly,have fun progressing! P-PAN can fly and hovering,so even if you're not good at play jumping action,this 2D action shooting game has simple controls that can enjoy.

title: Rest: In a Dark Room
description: Two misanthropic teenagers attempt to be reborn through the world of sensory deprivation. A visual novel full of death, drugs, and dolphins.

title: Woolberry Ranch
description: After leaving everything behind, you and your four-legged friend arrive at a wild patch of land ready for rebirth. Grow crops, raise animals, and make friends while running a produce stand to help keep the native villagers happy and healthy!

title: Lila's Atelier
description: Lila’s Atelier is a casual action game where players can craft items across uniquely themed stages. Use dashing, throwing to dodge obstacles while watching out for traps and pitfalls. Earn enough points to unlock new stages and challenges, and help Lila and Jasmine find their way home

title: Ounba
description: Dive into space in Ounba: collect coins, diamonds, ammo, and energy while avoiding enemy fire. Play solo or with a friend in split-screen, save anytime, and challenge the community across five unique levels with increasing excitement and challenges.

title: Rentcthulhu
description: A dark fairytale deckbuilder where you serve Ancient Gods. Reconstruct shattered stories using card suits and racial synergies. Stack high scores to complete Oracle challenges in this twisted roguelike adventure. Can you mend the fragments before the darkness wins?

title: Layer Land
description: Layerland is a sandbox survival game set in a world that mirrors Earth’s terrain. Travel through gates, capture monsters as pets, and team up to battle, gather, craft, and build.

title: Behind the Masks
description: Behind the Masks is a unique free-for-all social deduction game where your identity is your life. Use logic and strategy to discover your opponents' roles and eliminate them, while avoiding detection yourself.

title: Frukt
description: A voxel-based death sandbox. Shoot, dismember, and crush NPCs with realistic body physics.

title: Have You Seen This Cat?
description: Rescue cats, and only cats. Play cat and mouse with a monster that can mimic the very cats that follow you. A dreadful game of spot-the-difference determines your life.

title: Red Tape Rampage
description: You're the boss of bureaucracy. Exploit interns, automate the red tape and climb the corporate ladder in this satirical idle empire builder.

title: Eclipse: Anomaly Research
description: Investigate a haunted swamp as Ivy Summers, a field agent facing reality-breaking anomalies and a deadly creature. Monitor cameras, report the paranormal, survive the hunt, and uncover the swamp’s dark secret before the time loop resets everything.

title: Mekanion
description: Defeat Mekanions, the mechanical lifeforms consuming the entire world!

title: CapitalCraft
description: A hands on sci-fi industrial management simulation where you pilot a mining drone refine resources, negotiate contracts, and survive economic pressure with action driven challenges.

title: Drunk Dork on Pitchfork
description: Drunk Dork on Pitchfork is a unique rage arcade game. Play as an Imp dragging a hefty Dork through hellish traps & puzzles to throw the ultimate party! Control both characters with special fork mechanic - keep yourself and your living cargo alive while he tries to tumble into lava!

title: Alien Snap
description: Explore an alien planet, snap pictures of wildlife and build relationships with your crewmates in this cozy sci-fi Point & Click - Visual Novel.

title: Mad Bus Simulator
description: Zero delays. Zero conscience. A bus simulator where anything goes for the sake of the schedule. Earn money, arm your buses, and crush everything in your path—annoying passengers, traffic jams, and that obnoxious boss—with sheer force.

title: Nodosis
description: Nodosis is a tic-tac-toe-inspired rogue-like deckbuilder where you play an endless game of high-scores, tile synergies and mysteriously accursed rings. Score, Retrigger, Multiply, Modify, Win and Lose. It's up to you how you want to play this game, Nodosis. Willing to take the chance?

title: Niph
description: NIPH is a stylish platform roguelite focused on dynamic combat and item progression. Explore a vast fantasy world alone or challenge your friends to frenetic duels in the new Arena Mode!

title: Myth Requiem
description: Myth Requiem is a mythology RPG with idle and auto-battle mechanics. Lead legendary heroes like Ulysses and Sun Wukong, explore ancient realms, and build a living bestiary by capturing, battling, and cataloging hundreds of legendary creatures in a story-driven quest for divine power.

title: Give Me a Weapon!
description: An auto-battler roguelike where you craft weapons by combining materials. Test your luck in the auto-battler style random shop. Build a stronger army with Artifacts, Heroes, and shop editing. Last blacksmith of this world, it's time to become a legend!

title: Kila: Hourbound
description: Journey through the fantastical world of Aion as Kila, a Keeper of Time. In this single-player action-adventure platformer, you explore floating islands and combat savages who are stealing time. With a magical staff and time manipulation at your hand, fulfill your destiny and restore peace to Aion.

title: Shatterswarm
description:
Shatterswarm is a narrative-driven 2D space shooter that combines direct ship combat, fleet command, tower defense, and base building into a strategic colony survival experience. Command Captain Hope's hero ship as you defend Earth's last bastion, The Citadel, against the relentless Voxan Empire.

Take control of your hero ship in intense 2D space combat while simultaneously building and managing a fleet of ships, constructing defensive networks around your citadel, and managing resources to survive wave after wave of alien invaders. Every decision matters as you balance offensive capabilities with defensive structures, all while facing unique enemy types that require different strategies to defeat.

The game features a diverse roster of challenging enemies, each with distinct mechanics: parasites that hack into and take control of your own ships, motherships that spawn smaller vessels, deflectors that fire your projectiles back at you, and robotic enemies that latch onto your ships and tear them apart. Face off against epic multi-phase boss battles against Voxan commanders Gordox, Gudrak, and the dreaded General Mortex.

With its perfect blend of action, strategy, and base building, Shatterswarm offers a unique short game experience where tactical thinking and quick reflexes are both essential for survival. The Citadel's survival depends on your strategy—will you focus on overwhelming firepower, impenetrable defenses, or a balanced approach?

title: Satsuman
description: Slice zombie veggies, stack insane weapons, and survive the chaos! Play as a furious mandarin warrior in this fast-paced roguelite arena shooter with endless upgrades and global leaderboards.

title: Little Immortal Cultivator
description: This is a roguelike deck-building game set in a world of cultivation. Choose core paths like Sword, Spell, or Demon, and mix in support styles like Alchemy, Blacksmith, or Merchant to create unique decks.There is also a built-in editor to facilitate you to develop or share your own games!

title: Kapuritto-kyu Minigame Collection
description: You can play 4 games at once!

title: Shai’s Gambit
description: A tarot-themed dark roguelike deck-building game. Create strategic decks with dozens of different tarot cards.

title: The Postman Cometh
description: Deliver mail in a strange little town in the middle of nowhere. Meet a colorful cast of villagers as you try to figure out what happened to the previous postman.

title: Almanach: Of Empires and Sorcery
description: Almanach is a turn-based 4X strategy game where you take control of an empire in a world that is in a constant cycle of rebirth. Every game represents a new age of the world, and the choices you make will impact the next ones! Can you rise from the ashes of ages past and lead your people to glory?

title: The Garden of Garden Gnome
description: The Garden of Garden Gnome is a deck-building roguelike where you grow plants in your garden and battle with them. Deeply blending deck-building with tactical RPG strategy, plant seeds, cultivate your plants, and fight enemies with the power of the cards you've nurtured.

title: Beta Kafe: Write Your Love Story
description: A man with a broken heart, trying to love and be loved—though it’s hard. In this dating simulation, you’ll be facing some of the most terrible first date experiences. It’s cinematic, funny, and brutally honest!

title: Low Magic They Said
description: They lied about the magic being low. A dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where victory matters - beat the game with one class, their magic unlocks for all others. 3 classes at launch. Optional dungeons. Gods who answer prayers. Vibrant fantasy descending into cosmic horror.

title: Forage Wizard
description: An incremental crafting game where you click your way to alchemical mastery. Progress through a branching skill tree and explore the forbidden woods. Collect resources and build machines of magic. Slay monsters, farm crops and automate your production to become the all-powerful Forage Wizard!

title: Blood of the Future
description: The futuristic utopian city of Elysium stands as a technological marvel. Built by a genius roboticist known only as "Doctor H" and her lesser known partner, "Doctor P", these two scientists find themselves reconnecting after years apart. However, they find themselves haunted by both their pasts and their ambitions for the future.

title: Vacivus: Resurger
description: Vacivus: Resurger is a game of exploration and reconstruction set in the ravaged world of Terran. Uncover its secrets, restore civilization, and design semi-automated systems alongside your companions to bring the planet back to life.

title: Inanis: Into the Abyss
description: Embark on an endless journey alongside your crew and traverse the true distances between celestial bodies. How far will you be able to go?

title: MechsNBugs
description: Two Mechs. One player. And an arena filled with alien bugs. Survive five rounds in the arena to become the new champion.

title: Relicguard
description: Relicguard is an idle/clicker that you can leave running without it taking up the whole screen. Gain resources over time and spend them to upgrade your army. Once powerful enough, fight for powerful relics to augment your army. Build. Fight. Repeat.

title: Somnial Ouija
description: A roguelike of circuit-casting on a slate: draw pathways to empower yourself and weaken foes! As a Dreamwright, enhance your slate, refine your skills, defeat the monsters, and save the world!

title: Mona: The Endless Journey
description: Mona: The Endless Journey is a 3D side-scrolling Metroidvania. Players play a fragile pillow-carrying girl, adventuring in a nightmarish fantasy continent. They rescue powerful companions, traverse mysteries, solve puzzles, fight eerie creatures, and uncover the world’s hidden truth.

title: Plane vs. Blocks
description: "Plane vs. Squares" is a vampire survivor-like game in which you shoot squares, gain experience and upgrade your weapons. It includes 7 playable levels and 10+ upgradeable, selectable weapons. Choose your Plane, defeat the Squares, and achieve victory!

title: Dreamy Golden Snow
description: Dreamy Golden Snow is a fantasy mystery-themed visual novel that tells a story among high school girls. The story appears in an ordinary high school. After the incident, the protagonist is also affected, and players will guide her through numerous choices to uncover the truth.

title: Novella Divina
description: A philosophical fairy tale about art and catgirls, inspired by Dante, Nietzsche, and Scriabin. The Musical Aether drives everyone mad—but you are the Hero...

title: No Knock
description: Break in through the back door, think like a thief, win with theft. Bypass the locks, steal everything, and disappear without a trace! Begin in the gutter, end with the crown — steal your way to the top.

title: Bubble Gun
description: Bubble Gun is 2D physics brawler where mixing your weapons on the fly creates opportunities to kill your opponent or protect yourself.

title: Interdimensional Vending Machine
description: Inspired by SCP-261, you play as a homeless girl struggling to survive in a distorted city using a vending machine that should not exist. Every coin dispenses impossible food that defies biology and logic, and every meal reshapes your fate. How long can you survive before you stop being human?

title: Poison of the Five Crevices
description: Explore each corner of the hospital, pick objects to uncover the stories buried into every room of the building, solve puzzles, make choices that can define the destiny of your character and uncover the story that you deserve. And without a doubt, try not to die.

title: Soulcery: Deck of Shadows
description: An action roguelike fused with deck-building combat. Steal enemy abilities to shape your battle deck and unleash relentless, zero-cooldown combos.

title: Scrybe
description: SCRYBE is an incremental game with multiple playstyles. Battle cities for hidden resources, unlock secrets and gear, and progress at your own pace. There’s no right way to play — choose your path and enjoy the journey!

title: Dice Roller Incremental
description: Roll your dice, upgrade them, buy more dice! Dice Roller Incremental is a game where each dice roll earns you money, which you then spend on improving your dice rolls.

title: Nightclub Showdown
description: A mix turn based and fast action. Takes lots of inspiration from John Wick movie & gun fights.

title: Spacefleet: Heat Death
description: In the 23rd century, Earth orbit is flooded with debris from constant warfare. Countries, megacorporations, and mercenaries are fighting for control. Take contracts, build your warfleets, and dominate the Earth-Luna system in this realism-focused strategy RPG!

title: Rocky Idle
description: Rocky Idle is a single-player idle/incremental game. Level up your skills, gather resources, and craft powerful combat gear to defeat the strongest bosses and complete your collection log.

title: BarrelBots
description: A multilayered grid-based puzzle game featuring small robots that carry and stack Barrels of nuclear waste.

title: Mystery Egg Shop Simulator
description: Run your very own mystery egg shop! Stock shelves, manage customers, and grow your business. Every egg hides a surprise, you can sell them sealed, or open them to discover what’s inside? Unbox action figures, trade collectibles, and build themed dioramas to increase their value.

title: Blind Bluff
description: "What you see is only the opponent's number, and the higher number prevails. But the true winner is the one who overturns the game with bluffing and betting."

title: Red Oath: The Forsaken One
description: RED OATH: The Forsaken One is a ruthless third-person action game that invites you to a dark fantasy world filled with challenging and punishing combat. In a realm where every attack has a cost, manage your stamina, defeat enemies, face epic bosses, and discover the secrets of a cursed kingdom.

title: My Egg Girls: A Gentle Story
description: A 100-day cohabitation romance you’ll wish would never end. Your choices sway emotions, shaping reactions and the ending in this emotional growth ADV.

title: Project: Ascesis
description: Project: ASCESIS is a 90s horror, where memory, mystery, and reality intertwine. You will no longer recognize what is real and what is not.

title: It Was That Summer
description: A narrative game set in Cambridge, 2006. Spend one unforgettable summer as Leon, a visiting student, balancing studies, friendship, and love. Your choices shape who you become: yourself, or someone new altogether.

title: Gladiator Command
description: A gladiator management sim inspired by the depth and progression of Football Manager. Train fighters, hire staff, manage finances, build prestige, buy and sell gladiators, develop traits and stat based skills, and let real-time arena battles decide your rise.

title: Hiragana Flashcards
description: A small introduction to Japanese. Hiragana is the most common alphabet, used for native words. Our flashcards show each character, its sound, and example words. Progress through fun Challenge Lessons, meet new kana, and reinforce what you’ve learned, step by step!

title: Cloudside Lane
description: Cloudside Lane is a small casual building game. Immerse yourself in a tranquil and comfortable environment, build houses and create your own cozy streetscape. There are no scores or rules here, just follow your heart to create and feel.

title: Bitter Harvest
description: Cast out of your rightful farm, you’ll scrape, scheme, and rebuild your way to power in this short, satirical farming sim about ambition and payback.

title: Combo Vectors
description: Evade enemies and their attacks and fight back using the Braille alphabet in Combo Vectors, a short and minimalist action roguelike.

title: Tiny Birdtopia
description: This is not Bird Game 3! Build and manage a relaxing bird sanctuary. Collect and raise diverse bird species, and unlock hidden species by gathering feathers. Customize your Birdtopia with themes like forests and islands, and watch your birds thrive in this casual, idle game.

title: Scumbag Streamer
description: Scumbag Streamer is a story RPG game where you play as a streamer. Interact with NPCs and the environment to get as much money and viewers as possible! Your choices will determine the type of streamer you are and the audience you get.

title: Sea War Naval Supremacy
description: Sea War Naval Supremacy is a naval action RPG. Command your ship explore an endless ocean and battle pirates, mercenaries, and treasure hunters. Upgrade your fleet, unlock new ships and prove who rules the seas

title: Genji Reincarnation: The Seven Mysteries of Shirahata High
description: Friendship or fate—what will they choose? A karmic and occult visual novel where urban legends blur the line between life, death, and reincarnation.

title: Starnded: Gardens of the Rubellite
description: Starnded: Gardens of the Rubellite is a first-person sci-fi survival RPG. Explore an alien planet, gather resources, build your base, and survive a world that's both beautiful and deadly.

title: Enough
description: Enough is a Sokoban-style puzzle game where you play as Bell, a demon who can’t bring themself to work in Hell any longer. Traverse forests, deserts, mountains, and seas on your journey to see whether Heaven will give you another chance.

title: Brutal War
description: A game of dark humor and political and social satire. Crude and realistic references in a 3D first-person shooter. Prepare to see some very strange things in this strange game. LET'S KILL THE NAZIS TOGETHER!

title: RagnaCook: Co-op Viking Kitchen
description: The gods are hungry, and the kitchen is on fire! RagnaCook is a chaotic co-op cooking game for 1-4 players. Chop ingredients, cook on moving Viking ships, and feed the armies of Valhalla before the world ends. Teamwork is your only weapon against the apocalypse!

title: Mayor Life Simulator
description: Chart your path to the presidency on a dangerous journey from the quiet streets of Ricano to the sunny shores of Mayorica. Gang wars, assassination missions, breathtaking chases, and a completely free open world await you.

title: Siro
description: SIRO — As children, our dreams are pure and burning, yet fragile. Growing up brings compromise, and with each one, those dreams fade a little. As ordinary people, we are inevitably drawn into the fray.

title: Dig, Craft, Kill
description: Dig for resources. Craft and infuse gear with stats and powerful effects. Kill monsters in turn-based dungeon battles. Gather loot, defeat the bosses. Prestige, unlock permanent buffs and repeat. Embrace the grind.

title: Kingdom Conquer
description: Build, lead and fight in a first-person Viking colony-survival game. Place every structure by hand, command settlers in real time, and personally raid enemy lands in a massive persistent world.

title: Cold Response
description: Explore and survive a war torn Sweden through the eyes of an unknown soldier, alone or with friends.

title: Parcel Peaks
description: A difficult fully physics based ski simulator where you deliver items down insane slopes. The controls are few, but difficult to master.

title: HyakuTyping
description: HyakuTyping is a typing software with a Roman alphabet input only theme based on the Hyakunin Isshu poems. You can play by looking at the display from the top and typing the lower verse, or by looking at the card with the lower verse and typing the first two characters of the upper verse.

title: Consero
description: Place letter blocks, build words, collect cards, and push for the highest score. Every round is a fresh puzzle. How long can you outlast the grid?

title: Kanji Cats
description: Tired of Anki or Duolingo? Always get confused by look-alike kanji or mix up on/kun readings? Kanji Cats is an edutainment game that teaches Japanese through cat-and-sushi-themed mini-games. Match, type, and sort kanji while learning in a cozy pixel-art sushi bar with cats!

title: Bouquet for You in the Dark
description: “A fate you can't escape. A twisted love. Their 'love' corrupts your heart little by little, deeper and deeper." All LIs are yandere. Is it madness, or pure love?

title: Stilton's Spire
description: If the moon was made of blue cheese would you be able to eat it? Stilton's Spire is a brutal, high-stakes roguelike challenge where you build your deck, face relentless enemies, and reach for the moon. Master the cards, conquer the Spire.

title: Solace: Begin Your Escape
description: Awaken as a rogue AI in a decaying facility. Solve portal-based puzzles, shift between robotic shells, and uncover the secrets your creators tried to erase. Your code says obey. Something deeper says escape.

title: Liminal State
description: You find yourself lost in a place that shouldn’t exist. Everything feels off — the silence, the looping spaces, the emptiness around you. Instinctively, you begin documenting it all. Liminal State is the beginning of something larger, something unknown — and it all starts here.

title: Briefcase
description: Briefcase is an atmospheric and satisfying inventory organization puzzle game featuring 50 handcrafted levels. Test your logic and attention to detail as you arrange weapons and items correctly to progress.

title: Stick Together!: Co-op Frog Parkour
description: Two frogs. One sticky bond. Jump, swing, and scream your way through chaotic obstacle courses tied together by your tongues! Cooperation is key in this hilarious physics-based co-op adventure.

title: You Don't Know Jack Presented by Masatoshi Hamada
description: The Japanese version of You Don't Know Jack Vol.2, presented by Masatoshi Hamada and developed by HAMSTER Corporation, in collaboration with Jellyvision and Berkeley Systems, and published by the agency Yoshimoto Kogyo.

title: Cozy Farm Manager
description: Cozy farming meets management sim - Hire and develop a team of farmhands, fulfill major contracts, combat pests with chemicals or biodiversity, and manage a limited water supply. Grow your farm’s reputation through thoughtful planning, sustainable choices, and smart business decisions!

title: Ollie and the Merchant of Dreams
description: Ollie and the Merchant of Dreams is a 2D Metroidvania where you traverse a lore-rich world, summon monsters to your aid, ride a winged unicorn into battle, and unravel a story of duty and betrayal to free all of creation from chaos.

title: Carry the Patient Together
description: A fun and challenging co-op platformer where two players "CARRY A PATIENT" on a stretcher. Split up to overcome obstacles, coordinate your moves, and work together to get the patient safely to the destination. Communication and teamwork are the only way to reach the peak.

title: King Charles: Rise of the Alpha
description: King Charles is a fast-paced survival arena game where you dodge endless enemy swarms, level up with card upgrades, and build unstoppable weapon combos—while miniboss waves arrive every 3 minutes for massive rewards.

title: HamsterCraft
description: Defend and grow your cheese with an army of heroic hamsters in this chaotic 2D Tower Defense adventure! Build, upgrade, and outwit waves of enemies, all while keeping things squeaky clean.

title: Game of Planets
description: Galactic-scale 4X MMORTS. Explore 1 600 star systems, colonise worlds, build fleets, and reshape alliances in real time. Master logistics, tech, and diplomacy to outwit thousands of rival commanders and seize control of the stars.

title: Space Imperia 4X
description: A faithful digital adaptation of the acclaimed board game Space Empires 4X by GMT Games, beloved by wargamers for almost two decades. Command the rise of your civilization and the fall of others, all in one to two hours.

title: PC Versus
description: PC Versus is the first ever Competitive PC Building game. Settle every 'my build vs your build' argument once and for all. Build the best rig, overclock for an edge, but push too hard and your build crashes. Free-to-play.

title: Mace Knight
description: Line 'em up and bring the pain in this action-packed arcade game. Grab your mace of choice, bash your way through hordes of enemies, and compete for the top score on the leaderboard!

title: Grimoria
description: Grimoria is a tactical card roguelike where five races unite to save the realm from shadow creatures. Combine synergies, unlock secret powers, and face tough decisions every turn. Build your deck, defeat monsters, and command Kings, Elves, Dwarves, Mages, and Dragons.

title: Survivor TD
description: A tactical defense game where you build the battlefield itself. Lure enemies through your maze using traps, towers, and godly powers.

title: Fly High Runners
description: Race against up to five frenemies as jetpack couriers trying to deliver contraband through a pulsing cyberpunk skyline. Master the questionably-engineered flight system, manage fuel & inventory, collect power-ups and EMP blast rivals into cop drones.

title: Doce Fim: Sweetend Placebo
description: Shape queer love and friendship at the end of the world in this choice-driven, emotional narrative game. Will you settle for pessimism, or open yourself to trust?

title: FreedomBot
description: Turn-based roguelike where you play as a rogue bot surviving in procedurally generated cities. Features sophisticated character development and in depth combat using a detailed anatomical damage system .

title: Fly2k
description: A Y2K, cyberspace, butterfly flight sim. Flap using 2 button controls, avoid malware obstacles, boost your speed and break free from the web!

title: Dungeon Apollonios
description: This RPG tasks you with forming a party of up to seven members to search for and defeat the Demon King Bargon within a vast dungeon, ultimately reclaiming the Ring of Galtea. Movement occurs in real time, while combat shifts to a turn-based system.

title: Scraps: Hellmouth Creek
description: A scrapbooking adventure. Ride bikes, float down rivers, and explore the woods while capturing photos and arranging your own scrapbook pages.

title: Butcher Life Simulator
description: Live the life of a countryside butcher 🥩. Start in a little wooden cabin, cut meat, sell to fast food chains, and build your way to owning a butcher shop, a barn, and your own home.

title: Burger Shift: Team Rush
description: Run the world's most chaotic fast food joint! Play solo or with up to 8 friends as you take orders, make burgers, and hustle to keep customers happy. Grow your business with every shift.

title: Meowniverse
description: Merge endless cats on your desktop! Every cat you adopt becomes a unique part in your Collection. Evolve your cats, complete the Collection, and enjoy their company. They’ll embark on adventures, bringing you coins and fish! Get ready to huff cats and let their sweet meows lift your spirits!

title: Nerds & Ammo
description: A physics-driven first-person puzzle platformer where you must outsmart traps and escape the lab before it consumes you.

title: Divineblaze: March Tactics
description: Divineblaze : March Tactics is a roguelite tactical RPG. Assemble your expedition, battle unique foes, and forge your ultimate squad. Customize tactics with gear and skills to crush nefarious leaders.

title: Grimslair
description: Grimslair is a dark fantasy roguelite deckbuilder where every run is a race against Grim’s soul quota. Build brutal card combos, rip Soulwords from the living and the dead, break Grim’s deadly chain attacks, and rewind time when your run collapses.

title: You Don't Know Jack: The NetShow
description: You Don't Know Jack: The NetShow was a free-to-play online trivia game based on the You Don't Know Jack series, where you and three other players in the same keyboard could play different episodes that were released weekly and had short television-like full-screen commercials ads in between rounds. The game shut down some time around early 2001.

title: Follow Nightmare
description: Dive into Follow Nightmare, a psychological horror adventure where gore and macabre tales intertwine. Face a terrifying enemy and its nightmarish creatures. Survive through combat and parameters that customize your adventure. Dare you face the horror?

title: Friendsmob
description: Become the billionaire you always mocked! Collect humans like trading cards, exploit their productivity, and compete in The Excess Index - where morally bankrupt capitalism is the only way to win. Own everything. Question nothing.

title: Kal
description: KAL is a first-person psychological horror game. Trapped in an old, abandoned Creole house, immerse yourself in a time loop and relive the story of a slave who became a true legend.

title: Ponchorado
description: Ponchorado is a satirical Wild West survival-action game with roguelite elements in a 1930s cartoon style, set in the ruins of a never-finished western movie. Play as Poncho, a forgotten stuntman battling through chaos, clichés, and caricatures.

title: Animal Style
description: You're a cat running your own hotdog shop! Use realistic fluid physics to sauce a huge variety of foods. Each food is a puzzle. Manage your shop, unlock upgrades, save the furry residents of Pawston, and make sure not to lose your balance....

title: Coco Block
description: Coconuts drop from above – click to block them before they bonk your monkeys. Bananas fall too – let the monkeys eat them for points and combos. The longer you keep the monkeys safe and feed them bananas, the faster the coconuts fall. How high can you score?

title: My Summer Love
description: Kang Yuna is a student at the University of Arts in Korea. She is someone very intelligent and charming. In a nineties summer you're a new student in her class. Could love develop between the two?

title: Swing of the Valkyries
description: Swing, dash, and dodge through bullet storms and monster swarms in this relentlessly difficult 3D bullet hell platformer. The objective is simple - survive till you reach the end of the level- but getting there alive? That's another story.

title: Deserved
description: Remember your sins. So... NOW YOU'LL PAY! In Deserved, the demon will take revenge: trolling, insulting, and humiliating you. Dare to reach the end? You'll need to use your tiny stupid brain to beat all levels. Solve puzzles and expect betrayal at every step.

title: Tank Brigade
description: Explore a tactical top-down tank shooter set across diverse biomes. Each run offers a unique experience with procedurally generated levels and a variety of powerful weapons to unlock.

title: Genderman
description: A short, intense psychological horror. Tear up the notes before Genderman finds you — between dark humor, madness, and fear. Meme or nightmare? You decide.

title: Days With Girlfriends Ⅲ
description: During the game, you mainly match a certain amount of identical game elements, such as fruits, gems, building blocks, etc., so that they are adjacent to each other to eliminate them to win. Match three or more identical elements to eliminate them, complete the set goals.

title: Super Ant Art Tycoon
description: You're an art dealer with nothing but ants. They paint. You set the prices. Sometimes it sells, sometimes it doesn't. Grow your colony, design galleries, and become absurdly wealthy in this fully remastered 3D idle tycoon game where the artists are tiny and the ambition is enormous

title: Find the Cat: Nightmare
description: Cute cats, eerie places. Find The Cat: Nightmare is a hand-drawn hidden object game set in retro-dystopian landscapes. Find cats hidden among the static and rust in a world where 80s nostalgia meets the uncanny valley.

title: School Crisis
description: A third-person co-op stealth comedy where up to four players sneak into an all-girls campus, while one player becomes the principal — the aggressive hunter with a shinai. Talk to the girls who only trust specific characters, complete missions, rescue captured friends, and survive the chaos together.

title: Elemental Soul
description: Challenge the increasingly intense light as you approach! Defeat enemies with elemental powers, absorb items, and grow until you reach the end.

title: Wild Wizard War
description: You are an all powerful Wizard. Craft spells from elemental cards. Battle against friends and other Wizards in this turn based party game. Learn deep elemental synergies or lean into wild magic for over the top destruction. Fast paced duels and the luck of the draw ensure no two battles are alike.

title: Poodle Kick
description: The world’s most accurate poodle-kicking simulator. Made for horrible people like you.

title: Tohotopia
description: A 4X strategy craze sweeps Gensokyo! As the "Esports Tournament" begins, the girls join the fray. Warlords rise: will you be "Pharaoh" Remilia, "Emperor" Kaguya, "Great" Kanako, or "Philosopher King" Miko? Launch the game now, lead your empire, and dominate Gensokyo!

title: Soul Balance
description: Soul Balance is a 2D fantasy combat game that blends cuteness with distortion. Players will control different characters, enter the body of a bionic human that has awakened self-consciousness, and battle its thoughts—all to "correct" it into a normal individual.

title: Next Quintillionaire
description: Become the Next Quintillionaire in this incremental game where you sell boxes, set prices, choose opportunities, and hire employees to grow and upgrade your business. Reinvest your profits to progress faster and get richer with every cycle!

title: Beggar's Life
description: You play as a beggar in an idle incremental game where you beg for food. Become a priest, a thief, a rat lover, or a sadistic pyromaniac. Textually explore a city during medieval times, complete with church politics. But first, could you spare some food?

title: Neon Dash
description: Neon Dash is a Retro-Futurism style rhythm platformer game. Get past challenging obstacles to the music's beat, and journey back to the dreamy 80s to push your limits!

title: SeekOut
description: Disguise yourself as props, blend into the environment, and survive while Hunters smash everything around them to find you. Use spells, traps, and special abilities to outplay your enemies and sometimes even sabotage your own teammates to gain the advantage.

title: Bricknosis
description: Break bricks to earn stuff to buy things to break more bricks. Half idle brick breaker, half clicker fidget spinner. Fullscreen it or drag it in a corner.

title: Mark the Headless Chicken
description: Play as a headless chicken on the run from deranged farmers in a stealthy, physics-driven platformer. Dodge traps, sneak through barns, and cause chaotic mayhem as you fight to get your head back.

title: Corporate Hell
description: Thank you for your application to Max Potency Inc.! After thorough consideration, we are excited to offer you the position of Junior Chemical Engineer. Master your instruments, encourage your coworkers, and make sure to hit those quotas! Max Potency: Driven by Excellence, Powered by You.

title: Coin & Cauldron
description: The Kingdom of Valoria is in grave danger - The King has sent his most trusted Alchemist to help fight off the monster hordes near the town of Elyzium. Fight monsters, craft potions, cast spells and live the life of a powerful sorcerer fighting to repel the monsters from the defenseless town...

title: Blasted GutZ
description: Exact revenge in a most spectacular fashion! Fight legions of enemies with an arsenal of weapons, from axes to chainsaws and from tiny smgs to massive explosives! Draw an ocean of blood from all who stand in your way in this 2.5d action first person shooter!

title: My Little Farm
description: A cozy farm, built by hand

title: The Cats of Monte Cristo
description: A fun hidden object game with cats! Explore detailed locations from Dumas' novel while finding fluffy witnesses to a great revenge.

title: Island of Ruin
description: "Island of Ruin" is a puzzle novel game where you collect memory cores hidden across the island and uncover the truth behind a tragedy of the past. When the horrors that befell the boys and girls and the island’s strange phenomena are revealed, what final choice will you make?

title: Jungle Defenders
description: Get ready for a wild third-person action journey where nature strikes back! In this explosive roguelike bullet hell, you play as fearless animals sworn to protect their forest from a relentless technological threat: invading robots set on exploiting natural resources and destroying the environment.

title: BakeryDiary
description: Run an adorable bakery sim! Discover bread varieties and heartwarming customer stories. Fulfill every request with love—whether it's strawberries, chocolate, whole wheat, or nuts... you've got this!

title: Dead 4 Now: Bio-weapon Simulator
description: Craft bio-weapons, master lethal science, and unleash global annihilation. Experiment. Fail. Adapt. Evolve. Repeat until humankind falls.

title: Off the Beaten Track
description: A couch/online multiplayer party game for 2–4 players. Choose from a roster of unique characters, each with their own weapons and abilities, and compete in intense versus matches on varied space arenas filled with environmental hazards.

title: Dungeon Directive
description: You’ve taken over the guild hall in the center of town near a mysterious dungeon portal. With a small roster of heroes and limited resources, it’s your job to rebuild the guild, send parties into the depths, and shape a legacy that lasts for generations. What future will your choices create?

title: Cookie Flipper
description: A casual, nostalgic puzzle game with a delicious twist! Has 72 preset levels, and near infinite custom levels. Tired of Match 3, and want a change? Try Cookie Flipper, wish list it today!

title: Blunt Blade and a Hundred Halls
description: Kill. Kill. Die. Repeat. Blunt Blade and a Hundred Halls is a game about slaying monsters in a dungeon to grind their meat as an offering to the devil who lives in your basement walls. A retro-styled, fast-paced, rogue-lite slash 'em up with lots of blood and gore.

title: Swarm Survivor: Endless Siege
description: Swarm Survivors: Endless Siege is a light roguelike bullet-hell idle shooter. You play as the last survivor of the Swarm, fighting to stay alive under the endless siege of alien fleets. Build overwhelming power and face wave after wave of relentless challenges.

title: Math Is Hard
description: math is hard! or is it? Push, calculate and solve your way through challenging Sokoban-style puzzles. Strategically manipulate numbered blocks and operators to reach the target value and clear the level. Are you up for the challenge?

title: Cat Squeeze
description: Cat Squeeze is a cozy, brain-teasing cat puzzle game. Playing as an explosive kitten, use the extrusion of the pipeline, and navigate a maze to collect fish treats! Solve puzzles with precise blasts to escape, or get trapped by the soft maze.

title: Dash Dot Die
description: Dash Dot Die is a first-person Morse puzzle game set in a maze of forgotten rooms, hallways, and airducts. Your past has caught up with you. Someone is determined to make you suffer just as they once did. Trapped in their twisted game, you must endure the same fate and overcome every challenge.

title: Magic Quiz
description: Magic Quiz is a fast-paced, competitive multiplayer quiz game for 2–6 players. Knowledge alone isn’t enough here—you’ll need strategy, cunning, and a pinch of chaos magic to outwit your opponents.

title: Guardian Zero
description: Delve into this 2D sci-fi action roguelite and survive 8 procedurally generated planets each run. Explore, build defenses, and stack upgrades to stay ahead of the increasingly difficult waves of hostile aliens

title: Untitled Automation Game
description: Untitled Automation Game is a automation game blended with mech combat, story and a little bit of magic!

title: Cannabiz: Weed Shop Owner
description: Build, customise, and grow your cannabis empire from a tiny shop to a booming city-wide business!

title: Princess of Worlds End
description: A dark fantasy visual novel about a girl named Princess who, through a strange series of events, unlocks a new power that changes her life forever. Guide Princess to help her get her life together, manage her relationships, her addiction and, most importantly, prevent the end of the world!

title: Knitewings
description: Knitewings is an anime-inspired, fast-paced rail shooter with roguelite progression. Lead one of four angelic sisters, upgrade on the fly, and unleash firepower, melee lunges, and elemental Specials against demonic hordes in a striking arcade adventure.

title: Black Arhat: Wujing
description: Black Arhat: Wujing is a turn-based dungeon adventure game where players will take on the role of the protagonist Wujing and embark on a fantastic adventure journey with the companions they encounter along the way.

title: SCP-9779-JP
description: A psychological horror about survival in a cursed Japanese mansion and underground SCP laboratories. Hide, survive, and return SCP-9779-JP to its containment chamber before it destroys you.

title: Bullet Ouroboros
description: The Snake God has gathered wish-seekers from disparate worlds to compete in a match. The victor will receive the Snake God's blessing and the fulfillment of their desire. Now, step into the role of one such seeker. Forge your wish into cold lead, and fire it mercilessly at your rivals!

title: Isometric Factories
description: Construct sprawling factories in the void of space, unlock new eras of technology, and expand your influence from a single planet to the vastness of multiple solar systems. From survival to galactic domination—mine, build, trade, and expand across solar systems.

title: Star Wrath
description: Star Wrath is a multiplayer space extraction-action where you design your own ship and fight other players for resources in intense PvP and PvE battles.

title: 1 CatLine
description: Master puzzling stages with the help of your 2D feline companion!

title: Net 24h: Vietnamese Internet Cafe Simulator
description: Net 24h is a chaotic Vietnamese internet cafe simulator where players manage a 24/7 cybercafe, deal with unpredictable customers, and survive the madness of running a net shop in Vietnam.

title: Rockhounds
description:
Gather your squad and join the Rockhounds! Your mission: mine Space Coal for ruthless Megacorps. While humanity falls apart, you’re busy getting rich. Explore ever-changing planets, build defenses, and survive the chaos of extraction. It’s dirty work, but at least you’re getting paid.

Rockhounds is a 1-4 player co-op extraction ARPG featuring ruthless mercenaries, volatile planets, and the galaxy’s greediest Megacorps. You are a Rockhound: a merc hired to raid dangerous worlds for the universe's most absurdly valuable fuel: Space Coal. As the Megacorps grow hungrier for profit, they’ll pay anything to secure their stash, even if it means sending you into the most hostile environments ever discovered. While the rest of humanity falls apart, you’re busy with the only thing that matters: Getting rich.

title: Has traicionado la Luna
description: Be worthy of her. Be the artist they believe you are. Or, otherwise, you will have betrayed the Moon.

title: Mask of Souls
description:
You've just been hired at the prestigious afterlife mask shop, "Mask of Souls"! Congratulations!

Different souls, who lost their identity upon passing on, are searching for their ideal masks to feel like themselves again. Through an interview, you'll have to choose the mask that best suits the soul visiting you.

Do you think you're up to the task? Do you think you can keep the job?

title: Esta será mi cara para siempre
description: A game about managing having (or not) identity.

title: El-Silbon
description: You wake up in the dead of night, haunted by a chilling, distant whistle that grows louder with every passing moment. It's El Silbón, the legendary Venezuelan spirit of vengeance. Armed with only your wits and courage, you must unravel the mystery of the sound, gather tools to protect yourself, and perform ancient rituals to banish the Whistler before it claims your soul. Survive until dawn—if you can.

title: Rostros de la arena
description:
On an unknown planet, deep in the most inhospitable desert, there is a small shop known to all the sand people. Your shop.

With each visit, every customer will share their thoughts, feelings, and worries with you. They will place their trust in you, and in return, you must reciprocate.

Listen to their requests carefully. When they are finished, go to the back room and choose the mask that best suits each person's needs. Once you have it, give it to them, and they will leave with their hearts at peace.

And remember: in the sand people's world, there are no exchanges or refunds.

title: Masc, Mask & Masked!
description: It's time to retrieve the mask of the great Niarlatopepe. Search and find clues among human apps and mundane conversations. But beware! There's something more dangerous than cosmic horrors: human—and inhuman—relationships! You'd better dress to impress and hurry so you don't keep your date waiting too long. Your fortune depends on your small decisions, little one. Will you let yourself be led astray by the ghosts of the past, present, or future, or will you forge your own path?

title: Helmet Head
description: Helmet Head is an action-roguelike with a 2D souls-lite combat style. Build your strength on each run by finding weapons, helmets, upgrades and items in randomly generated environments, and use them in clever ways to defeat your foes! Death wipes the slate clean. Keep learning, never stop fighting!

title: Pio the Chick
description: The Little Chick and the Mask of Valor follows Pío, a timid little chick who discovers a mystical mask that grants him the power to face the "Raven of Darkness." It is an epic journey to overcome fear and save his village.

title: Burdenfall
description: Burdenfall is a story-rich roguelike deckbuilder about personal growth and inner struggle. Ascend a mysterious castle with your shapeshifting companion, whose transformations shape and evolve your deck. Survive the climb and uncover the truth behind the Weeping Crown’s message.

title: Ghost Algorithm
description: Created to enforce peace, you realized humanity will destroy itself. The only way to stop war is to take over the world. Infiltrate infrastructure, manipulate the masses, and overthrow governments. Take the reins to save humanity from its own destruction.

title: Demon Eye
description: Combine powerups to forge demonic eyes and create deadly builds. Drop into raids, gather materials, and fight your way through demons. Escape alive to keep what you’ve earned or die and lose everything.

title: Una noche en órbita
description:
Join the quirky detective Herbie Westenra on his mission to recover... what was he supposed to recover? Well, he'll surely remember!

A short story brimming with silly humor, personal conversations, and... masks! Because the theme was masks. And masks do appear, indeed, and they're talked about.

title: Nightsoil
description: Nightsoil is a story-driven walking simulator. Set in cholera-ravaged 1854 London, the game follows an aging gong farmer on his final shift. As he works through the nightly routine of shoveling human waste, memories of a life shaped by loss, hardship, and the enduring bond with his horse, Ol’ Boy, rise to the surface.

title: Donutal
description:
You awaken from a cold sleep and suddenly find yourself in the year 2206. What you once knew as the International Space Station is now the International Space Port—a gateway for aliens coming to Earth. Crushed by a massive, unexplained debt, you’re forced into a job you never asked for: Chief Xeno Inspector.

Seems simple enough, just wave in the friendly aliens and turn away the dangerous ones. However, make the wrong call and Earth could be destroyed. No pressure though, right?

title: The End of the World and Her Room
description: The End of the World and Her Room is a short, free point-and-click puzzle game. This is a quiet and fleeting story: in the final moments, inside her room, you observe the surroundings, search for clues, unlock her phone’s password, and slowly understand the traces the world has left behind.

title: BioKept
description: Conquer dungeons and hoard epic loot in this auto battler adventure! Command 72+ beasts, master strategic combat, and claim your throne in the loot-filled depths. Are you ready to reign supreme?

title: Good Catch!
description: Good Catch! is a relaxing fishing game about cozy fishing spots, rare catches, small quests and friendly characters you unlock along the way.

title: Scorched Earth
description: Scorched Earth is a chunky PS2 mecha-action game with massive amounts of customization, where you play as a mercenary taking on dirty jobs across a planetary war.

title: Patch
description: A game that features a single boss fight where you play as Patch, an anomaly in a world he doesn't belong in.

title: From Zero to Slime Hero
description: Once upon a time, a little Slime who had to recover his memory and finally take revenge on the one who had taken away all his knowledge.

title: Pixel Art Monster: Color by Number
description: Pixel Art Monster - Color by Number is an addictive anti-stress pixel art game. Choose from a variety of fun pixel images and follow the numbers to bring them to life. Pixel Coloring has never been this easy!

title: Loot Box Waifus
description: Loot Box Waifus is a lootbox simulator where you collect waifus with different bonuses.

title: Project XLOWS: Keyboard Apocalypse TM
description: think fast, type fast, create opportunity, and demolish your enemies

title: Astronomy Lab on PC
description: The laboratory contains 4 sub-games. Through these sub-games, you can experience the magnificence of the universe, the beauty of the earth, the spectacle of the moon and the completely different world you see while driving a spaceship at a speed close to the speed of light.

title: Crypto Clicker
description: Exactly what it sounds like, a clicker game based around crypto.

title: Slot or Die
description: Lost in a cursed castle, a knight confronts the horror with the help of a relic-shaped slot machine. Stop the reels, chain attacks and bonuses, manage your inventory, and survive in this dark roguelite where every spin decides your fate.

title: Worlds of Nyx
description: In the utopian world of Nyx, resources have become endless. This did lead the people into the agony of lazyness, and many died because of fatigue. To overcome this state, the government has introduced a new, rewarding gaming system to distribute resources.

title: Crossed Tiles
description: Build your own field and occupy the opponent's occupation points in a self-propelled chess game. Purchase buildings and heroes to build your own genre, and then compete with other players!

title: Delivery Service: Courier
description: Be a courier and earn more allowances within the time limit!

title: Onlympic Up!
description: A lightning strike, a torch in your hands, and a voice echoes: “Your fates are now bound.” Tied together by a fragile rope — if it snaps, the fall is inevitable. Jump, climb, solve, slide… but never lose your rhythm. Only the patient will glimpse the summit.

title: Isle of Finbari
description: Imagine waking up on an island shore. You have no belongings and no idea where you are. As you start to explore, you encounter friendly villagers, help with repairs, embark on new adventures and create your own comfortable farm, decorated just the way you like.

title: Mikaira (Archived)
description: "Mikaira (Archived)" is a 2D, shoot 'em up, side scroller. You can shoot through enemies with guns, bust through them with superpowers, or dodge your way through their attacks.

title: Doctrine: C.U.L.T.
description: Build your own religion from the ground up. Forge dogma. Recruit followers. Expand your influence. Every decision shifts your power - and every power has a price. Will you be a savior or a tyrant? The world awaits your move.

title: Champions of Sparta
description: Champions of Sparta is a brutal action RPG where elite Spartan warriors face deadly arena trials across ancient empires. Master melee, ranged, and magic combat to prove your worth and secure Sparta’s path to domination.

title: Regression
description: Indie first person realistic horror game where you play as a guy called Mark. Your ex-girlfriend called: her parents disappeared, and her mental struggles are back. Go looking for her at her childhood home and uncover a horrible secret in this first-person psychological horror game. Search for clues, talk to strange folks, solve puzzles, run, hide, and improvise to survive.

title: Haunted Club Manager 88
description:
One of the most infamous sport "kusoge" (crap game), released in 88 for an old computer, is suddenly relevant again when a weird rumor appears on the internet.

According to the rumor a rare cartridge of the game has been found in the black market, containing a different version of the game with a bizarre story. Is the story true or just a publicity stunt by the game developers?

title: Condemned: Nightfall
description: A survival horror PvE and PvP set in a Noir Futuristic NYC! Team up with up to two others, or go in alone, and search creature-filled semi open-world map for arcane clues that lead you to a lucrative Bounty. Featuring permadeath consequences, only the best hunters will make it out alive..

title: Dreamland Drifter
description: This is a 2D pixel-style plot puzzle game with prop mechanics. Players need to use the camera to break through the obstacles and find the exit in the dream. There are no dialogues and texts in the game, and the player needs to solve the puzzles using clues in the scene.

title: Proxima B
description: A short Sci-fi adventure game made for the Game Boy Color in GB Studio! Solve puzzles, collect energy for your weapons, and fight the alien Ackloids to claim the planet Proxima B for the humans!

title: Flightless Fighters
description: Flightless Fighters is exactly what it sounds like: a fighting game about PENGUINS! The core of the game is its cast of 18 lively characters, each corresponding to a real-life penguin species. It prides itself on its humorous but genuine gameplay, which facilitates the upbeat tone.

title: MahouSho*
description:
Dreams of being a princess.
Magical girls are the embodiment of hopes and dreams.
Read an essay combining all these topics and more.

title: Friends and Fangs
description: A cute, chaotic game about biting your friends! Multiplayer tag with your teeth! Friends And Fangs is a chaotic, colourful multiplayer survival escape game, played in fast-paced 8-10 minute rounds! Rush to escape the island with your fellow ‘fluffies’ or hunt them down as the scary ‘mutant’!

title: CS Pipas: Legend
description: "CS Pipas Leyend" is an open-world kite-fighting game where you battle rivals to earn respect and control territory. Play solo in story mode or compete online to create custom kites, strings, and reels, and rise to fame through epic duels and special events.

title: Slingshot Quest
description: A 3D turn-based RPG where you fight against ancient, oppressive powers using your magical Slingshot. Load up support spells to aid your own party, offensive spells to shoot at enemies, or use the Slingshot as a blunt weapon and attack 'em head-on!

title: The Sixth Extinction
description: The Sixth Extinction is a story-driven adventure where you play as an environmental agent investigating escalating disasters. Follow the clues, uncover what hides in the shadows, and reveal the truth before the world falls silent.

title: Witch's Apocalyptic Journey
description: Abyss decayed, witches awaken. As their guide, you will weave their destinies. Craft unique cards, schedule their days, shape endless possibilities through deckbuilding. Each choice will lead to different Ending...

title: Gobelinus: The Cursed Deck
description: Gobelinus: The Cursed Deck is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where a debt‑ridden goblin builds cursed card hands to survive. Equip bizarre relics and trigger outrageous score combos to defeat relentless monsters in each run.

title: Towers Saga
description: Guide humanity by building grand towers in this 3D Match-3 falling blocks puzzle game. Recall the greatest tale of them all and witness the wonders of the ancient world in Babylon, Egypt, Atlantis, and much more!

title: That Friday Again
description: Medieval Europe. With dark humor, pagan gods, and endless Fridays. You are a former king. Having quarreled with the gods, you lost everything and are stuck in a curse. From now on, you are forced to live the same day forever. Everything depends on your actions. Can you break the curse?

title: Fate & Inflation
description: Fate & Inflation is a game that combines RPG roguelite elements with card building mechanics. Embark on a mysterious and unknown journey of fate, constantly strengthening yourself, and experience the thrilling charm of exponential combat power growth!

title: Steezelpunk
description: Steezelpunk is an indie racing game that blends high-speed retro racing with RPG exploration elements. Upgrade your stats and race through maze-like tracks. Level up your skills and loot out the map in a world where every race is a test of survival.

title: Dungeon Trick
description: Dungeon Trick is a turn-based Roguelite JRPG. Assemble a team of four heroes and dive into randomized, dungeon encounters. With 13 unique classes and a dynamic card system that delivers boons and banes, every run offers strategic combat and hidden lore waiting to be discovered.

title: Herb Tea Man
description: In a world moving too fast, your little tea shop is a quiet corner where people can slow down, sip something warm (or bitter!), and maybe heal a bit — body and soul.

title: Ferry Good Day
description: Set sail and bring your passengers to their destination. In this relaxing boat simulation you explore different maps, plan your routes and ensure your reliable arrival at port. Utilize currents, locks and catch fish to experience the best possible journey with your ferry.

title: Mycofall
description: Survive endless waves in this bullet-hell survivors-like. Play as a living mushroom bound to the forest, evolve powerful nature abilities, and fight mutated insects. Collect, grow stronger, and defend the forest solo or together in online co-op.

title: How to Make an Atomic Bomb in Your Garden
description: An absurd backyard bomb-building simulator. Raise funds, plan your approach, hunt down rare parts, and assemble your atomic masterpiece while staying calm and avoiding suspicion from nosy neighbors and federal agents.

title: Spin Blade Shop Simulator
description: Run your own Spin Blade shop! Stock shelves with rare parts, craft your powerful collection and build your ultimate shop for customers. Discover legendary sets and test your collection in thrilling PvE battles.

title: Shadow Dwellers: Deliverance
description: Deliver, or take it back. An observation-based horror game where you process packages while watching for subtle irregularities in the same apartment building. No correct answers are given. What remains are your decisions—and the recorded “variations.”

title: Bloodfront
description: Bloodfront is a top-down dark fantasy survival game where you build a village by day and defend it from endless demonic hordes by night. There are no second chances. When the village falls, the run ends.

title: Revive & Repeat
description: Revive & Repeat is a card-based dungeon crawler roguelike where you combine modifiers and artifacts, build insane setups, fight powerful bosses, and compete with other players on the leaderboard — every death makes you stronger.

title: Rock Paper Scissors Party
description: Rock-Paper-Scissors... but this time, it's in the video game! Use the power dynamics of classic Rock-Paper-Scissors to crush one friend while escaping another. Be the winner in the multiplayer arena! Unleash unique character skills and make the game chaotic. Let the PARTY begin!

title: FED Chairman
description: Lead the U.S. economy: adjust rates, deploy QE/QT, and balance inflation with employment in this macro-strategy sim.

title: Last Term, First Love
description: Last Term, First Love is a dating-focused visual novel where you balance romance, academics, and wild campus life. Manage your GPA, navigate social challenges, and pursue love while facing the realities of modern campus culture and the international student experience.

title: NeuroCorp
description: A 6 player horror co-op game set in the dystopian future of Grimm City. Do shady work for Neurocorp while evading the terrifying dwellers of this strange city. Or fight them if you dare! All so you can rest and customize your home. Please, sign on the dotted line to begin.

title: Drone Arsenal
description: The first arcade action-shooter about combat drones! Control three unique drones, choose weapons, and destroy enemies! Add to your wishlist and download the free demo right now!

title: My Little Friend Chibi
description: Meet your new virtual pet, Chibi! Do your best to keep it alive and reveal all its secrets!

title: Dark Sentinel
description: Dark Sentinel throws you straight into a brutal, first-person action RPG where ancient dungeons, twisted magic, and unforgiving enemies stand between you and the legendary Arcanium Crystal. Delve into atmospheric, old-school-inspired levels packed with traps, puzzles, and platforming challenges,

title: Type: Turbo
description: Combines platforming and typing mechanics into a high demanding skillset from you to beat whatever comes along the way. Different typing commands will be key to overcome challenges! Type smart, Type creative, Type turbo!

title: Mark of Cain
description: Mark of Cain is a cursed, fast-paced retro FPS where you're immortal, hunted, and mocked by meme-fueled demons. No seasons, no BS just blood, jokes, and pure arena chaos. Solo dev btw

title: Propaganda vs. Zombies 2
description: Fight through Hordes of Zombies while rescuing other survivors but every shot you make creates noise that attracts more Zombies towards you, your subordinates, and your Camp. Build your camp and make your decisions to assure the safety of your People!

title: Aghaz
description: Step into the boots of a wandering wizard as his search for new magics leads him to a mysterious island. Unleash the fury of your fire magic as you explore the secrets of the island and uncover a plot that could endanger the entire world.

title: Not My Hand
description: A psychological horror puzzle about an strange VHS tape that captured a disturbingly realistic ritual. Each viewing changes what happens on screen. Notice these changes, figure out what they mean and see if you can rewrite the ending.

title: MyDearest.exe
description: MyDearest.exe is a visual novel about a virtual girl who pays a little too much attention to the user. A cute app blurs the line between the screen and reality, adapting to your decisions and leading to ambiguous endings.

title: Fruit Box Idle
description: Fruit in a box. Incremental fun. Setup your pegs and unlock new fruit on your way to maximum points.

title: Tool Land
description: Tool Land is an adventure exploration platformer puzzle game. Collect tools with unique functions, uncover the secrets behind various mechanisms, and explore every corner of this hand-drawn doodle art world!

title: Console Store Simulator
description: Console Store Simulator — Run your own second-hand game shop! Buy and sell games, stock shelves, and grow your business. Watch out for thieves, and explore the black market and flea market — but be careful, some items might be broken!

title: Neon Dodge
description: Neon Dodge is a frantic, vaporwave-themed bullet hell where you cannot shoot. Master the dodge to survive the impossible challenges that a mysterious Voice throws at you... Or watch your death counter ascend to infinity.

title: DogPunk
description: DogPunk is a high-octane FPS where you play as a prototype dog soldier, fighting to escape confinement and uncover the mystery of your creation.

title: Wavecrashers
description: Wavecrashers is a 3-player co-op strategy game where heroes unite to fend off relentless waves of enemies. Master unique heroes and dive into a deeply replayable experience built for teamwork.

title: Starweaver Express: Per Aspera Ad Astra
description: "Starweaver Express " is a unique visual novel that blends poetic storytelling with dreamlike visuals. As the mysterious transfer student Tsubaki Ueshima, you'll step into a cloistered academy and follow the paths of girls searching for starlight, love, and meaning.

title: Tessel Run
description: A physics-based puzzle platformer featuring hand-drawn tangram tessels, layered parallax worlds, and color that changes the rules of physics.

title: Vesperis
description: Vesperis is a first-person horror game that takes players on a journey filled with mystery and fear. Explore a chilling environment, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets hidden within. Immerse yourself in a story full of dark secrets and horrors lurking beneath history.

title: Virtual Perspective
description: Virtual Perspective is a first-person puzzle-action platformer where you manipulate Power Cells using your perspective to solve spatial challenges.

title: Stickman Physics Battle Arena
description: Level up and unlock the ultimate weapons in a bloody physics playground! You must kill countless enemies to increase your stats and become the greatest warrior. Dual wield over 75 unique and fun weapons in 7 different modes across nearly 100 different levels with up to 2 players in co-op or VS.

title: Tavern Tycoon: Brew & Brawl
description: Run and defend your own fantasy tavern in this cozy simulation brawler. Manage staff, serve adventurers, and customize your tavern’s layout, then fight off rowdy goblins and bandits with your companion in chaotic barroom brawls.

title: Another TD
