description: You're the Tower Marshal at the Elderglen kingdom, and you have a terrible job. Your king really likes to send letters to neighbours. Ones that make them offended enough to send armies at your castle. They're already on the way, so get back to work!

title: Planet Chyton
description: Crash-landed on a fungus infested planet, Cubit the robot must find its path through fighting alien creatures and navigating through an increasing hostile world with a platform creation gun in sci fi inspired dark but cute Metroidvania platforming game.

title: Silvern Moonrise
description: Capture the wicked and bend them to your will in this turn-based roguelite monster tamer. Use enemies as your servants, sacrifice or empower them to reach new heights. Adapt and augment your abilities as you take control of the ever-changing lands of Restless Hollow.

title: Gigils
description: Gigils is an action packed multiplayer game where players will take on the role of cute alien creatures that bite, evolve, and brawl to capture control points. Choose your class, devour bugs or enemies to unlock powerful abilities, and grow stronger. Alien mayhem has never been this delicious.

title: Falling Light
description: 《Falling Light》is a suspenseful game with Chinese horror. In a remote small village, there stands an evil Buddha statue. To do research for her studies in folkloristics, college student Ruan Qing arrives in this distant village, only to find herself entangled in a series of deadly mysteries...

title: Into the Slimy Mines
description: A roguelike tower defence with a card twist! Protect your mine and rescue your crew after crash landing on a slime infested moon. Buy cards and booster packs, expand your tunnels, find crazy combos and squish those frackin’ slimes. Dig, build defend – and get off this B&*@!n Moon!

title: Techno: 2Kill
description: A hardcore, fast-paced and unpredictable roguelike shooter set in a dystopian future where AI decided to save humanity... by exterminating it. Your body is the ultimate weapon. Liberate Earth and countless other planets from the grip of a deranged AI.

title: Spellmeister
description: Get your wand ready - the battle is sounding! Your spells are fragments of melodies. Compose your own sound and save the world filled with noise! Get into the rhythm and destroy enemies, summon allies and create unique musical compositions! Music is a form of magic!

title: Cosy Housing
description: Cozy Housing is a relaxing game Build and decorate your house in a soothing atmosphere. Explore a large collection of unique furniture and decoration, Give free rein to your creativity.

title: Instantale
description: This is an RPG where the world, dungeons, NPCs, items, and story are all dynamically generated by AI. You create your own character, act freely in your own unique world, interact with NPCs, and take on various quests.

title: Auto Derby Casino
description: 1-4 players gamble on robot horse races at this casino without rules. Sabotage the horses, manipulate bets, or even blow up the track. Outplay your friends, or at the very least make sure they lose too. All that matters is the payout.

title: Crispy Kart
description: Crispy Kart is a pixel-style survivor-like game where players take the wheel of a kart made of cookies and desserts, battling through waves of enemy vehicles to survive—all while uncovering the sinister group sabotaging the races.

title: Project Confluence
description: Jump, jetpack, wall run and grapple your way through 3D environments in a race against time. Swap between parallel worlds to add or remove platforms in your way to reach the goal and complete your simulation of Project Confluence.

title: Primal Survival
description: A realistic prehistoric survival game where you play as Homo habilis or Homo erectus. Craft primitive tools, build shelter, hunt massive beasts, and survive the harsh forces of nature in a vast multiplayer world.

title: Dungeon Gatekeeper
description: Travel to defend each village! As the last defense line, start from scratch—train units, gather tools, build your formation, and stop monsters in the dungeon. Fail, and the village will be destroyed.

title: Anunnaki & the Kingdom of Goku
description: Anunnaki & The Kingdom of Goku is a surreal RTS-TPS game about Goku, the legendary monkey king, who must reclaim his kingdom from the dreaded Illuminati and their masters. Destroy the invaders, reclaim your power, and ascend to the Heavens and stars above. In a dark time, the weapon is hope.

title: Western Justice
description: Western Justice is an action simulation game combining wild west shootouts, town-building, community management, deputy assignment, and prison management. Become a sheriff, bring justice to lawless lands, save your townsfolk from gangs, and build a safe civilization in the old west.

title: Hatters
description: Hatters is a cooperative bullet hell roguelike for up to 4 players. Random spells of five elements, magical artifacts, new heroes and a light story with humor. Chaotic battles where magic and laughter fly everywhere.

title: Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots - Master Collection Version
description:
The extreme tension of infiltrating without being detected.

Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” Immerse yourself in the Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” where you can infiltrate and elude your enemies to complete missions.

The game takes place five years after the Big Shell incident in Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty, in a world where war has become a business.

To stop Liquid Ocelot's uprising, Solid Snake throws himself into his final battle.

The battle against Liquid and the Patriots draws to a close, and the mysteries woven throughout the series are now revealed!

title: Hypnostasis
description: A survival horror game about psychological trauma. You wake up from your room to an unsettling world of disturbing creatures. The world you know has warped into something sinister. Navigate nightmarish worlds, uncover buried memories, and confront the shadows. Will you find the path to salvation?

title: Sanctum Mage
description: 《Sanctum Mage》is a magic-fantasy roguelite action-adventure game. you will: forge dynamic combat strategies, combine randomly empowered arcane blessings, and pilot enchanted war machines to break through swarms of foes.

title: Fluid Drift
description: Fluid Drift is a unique, super-fast, super-technical sci-fi racing game. Experience edge-of-control racing by piloting ultra-manoeuvrable craft through deceptively tricky courses surrounding a long abandoned planet.Challenge yourself, push your abilities and find the perfect flow.

title: Pileus Bad Trip
description: Put yourself in the role of a surviving village mushroom and try to fix what happened while you were asleep!

title: Trade Empire
description: Trade Empire is a medieval trade strategy simulation game. Create your merchant, start trading in your chosen city, and use diplomatic moves to take control of trade across the entire map and eliminate your rivals.

title: Ukrainian Warfare: Gostomel Heroes
description:
Real Time Tactics single player game about events in Kyiv region in february-march 2022.

Highly realistic tactical battles and deep management of your forces on strategic layer.

title: Fortune Fragments
description: In Fortune Fragments, you run your own shop as a ‘Foreteller' and guide your customers' fates by reading their souls! Sink in the unique blend of Visual Novel roleplaying and hex-tile based rune building set in the bustling modern-fantasy city of Clearcastle.

title: Jacmena
description: “Tin bòta, Jacmena!” A strange little girl always out of place and with a special power befriends the old keeper of a cemetery. Experience the story of Jacmena and Zvan in this hand drawn point-and-click adventure that draws inspiration from the legends and traditions of Romagna folklore.

title: Regret
description: Regret is a game about dictatorship and trials. It’s a place where you and up to three friends compete in deadly elimination challenges — until only one remains. You’ll find yourself at the game table, where each round decides who stays… and who is gone for good.

title: Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker - Master Collection Version
description:
The extreme tension of infiltrating without being detected.

Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” where you avoid combat and complete missions while hiding.

The game take place 10 years after Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater.

Amidst the swirling conspiracies behind the East-West Cold War, Snake confronts them while leading a private military force.

This is the story of how one soldier, “Snake”, becomes “Big Boss”.

title: Broken Hearts
description:
Fantasy RPG from Czech Republic. The game follows the fate of Chrono, a soldier from Ishbal, who was raised by a general, but is starting to doubt, if he is on the right side.
The gameplay is similar to early Final Fantasy games. The fighting system is realtime in "arenas".

title: Total War: Rome II - Ultimate Edition
description: Lead Rome to glory or reduce it to ashes in Total War: ROME II - Ultimate Edition. This is the ultimate version of the strategy classic, containing the base game and all DLC. Harness Rome’s power and dominate the map through shrewd diplomacy, economic supremacy, and military might, or command her enemies and crush the republic once and for all.

title: BugAboo
description: Czech action freeware game about Timmy and his friends, who are pulled into the world of nightmares.

title: The Goddess's Will
description: Dive into a 2.5D isometric action RPG adventure inspired by late-90s and early-00s classics. Face cunning enemy factions, explore a layered world filled with vivid characters, mythic stories, and handcrafted environments. Immerse yourself in a dangerous and unforgiving golden age of power fantasy.

title: Curse of Resthaven
description: In this single-player narrative roguelite, govern a cursed island as you investigate your niece’s mysterious disappearance. Interrogate, trade, upgrade, and embark upon card-based expeditions to uncover dark secrets – before the next cataclysm strikes.

title: Cozywood Creek
description: A gentle idle game with a living stream flowing quietly at the bottom of your screen. Terraform the land and watch as animals arrive to make Cozywood their home. Cultivate the surrounding area and bring this cozy ecosystem to life.

title: HuntCore
description: HuntCore is a Monster-Collecting Roguelike. Join the CoreSeekers to fight and catch magical beast called Hunts. A big story awaits you to discover.

title: Ghostforged
description: Guide six heroes to confront a rising darkness before it consumes the world. Immerse yourself in a story-driven turn-based JRPG inspired by classics of the genre.

title: A Fighter’s Nova: Mindara
description: A Fighter’s Nova: Mindara is a narrative-driven JRPG that fuses character-focused storytelling with the intensity and precision of a true tag-team fighting game.

title: Shadow Dungeon
description: Nightmarish monsters crawl forth from the darkness, while the Demon Lord lurks beneath the abyss. Venture into the Shadow Dungeon, carve your way through blood and chaos, and forge your own legendary epic.

title: Horse Riding Classic
description: Experience the classic majesty of soaring through the skies on Horseback. Collect over 99 Apples hidden throughout a Handcrafted 3-Dimensional World, push technology to its limit and Breed the Ultimate Horse, and destroy The Glue Factory and Save Horse Kind.

title: Games of Rome
description: Games of Rome is a 2D top down boss rush game taking place in the Colosseum during the time of the Roman Empire. The player will fight foes all based on Roman history and myth, for the entertainment of the people of Rome.

title: Restless I
description: Restless is a medieval fantasy horror speedrun game where you embark on a thrilling first-person adventure to complete intense challenges.

title: Battle for the Raise
description: Battle For The Raise, a Pokémon-style turn-based battle game with a corporate satire theme.

title: Moonrot
description: MOONROT is a short horror game about piloting a rover across a distant alien moon. Take grainy photos, record crackly signals, keep your battery charged, and uncover the source of the anomaly that led you here.

title: Opus Magnum: De Re Metallica
description: An independent story set before the events of Opus Magnum, De Re Metallica follows a maverick alchemical researcher named Saverio Daas, who believes he can unlock heretofore unknown metallurgical secrets. Includes new puzzles, glyphs, story, music, and even a new Sigmar's Garden variant!

title: Prime Monster
description: A card-based political roguelike about surviving in a parliament of literal monsters. Fight for votes, break rules, weather scandals and force through absurd laws to keep the top job in this democratic dystopia of truly monstrous proportions.

title: But Why?
description: An atmospheric climbing experience for solo players or up to 4 in co-op. A short, minimalist platformer about the cold, isolation, and quiet persistence.

title: IncreKnight
description: A short incremental game about a knight slaying a dragon.

title: Inside Her bedroom
description: Inside Her (bedroom) is a 2D action puzzle game about monster girls' bedrooms. Move two mirrored characters to get items scattered around their rooms. Use their special skills to complete the puzzles and uncover their secrets. Every monster girl has a unique skill like moving through walls, pushing items, etc. Solve the puzzles to increase their desire.

title: Mole Cart Mining
description: Get ready for an underground adventure full of charm and strategy! In Mole Cart Mining, you guide a determined little mole riding a mine cart while rotating tracks on a hexagonal grid to create the perfect route. The goal is simple and satisfying: collect every mineral and reach the exit in style.

title: Lantern Push
description: Light the right path in Lantern Push, a charming puzzle game where you control a red panda pushing paper lanterns onto Magical Ember Seals scattered across the ground. When a lantern reaches a seal, magic happens: it lights up, floats gently, and marks another step toward the perfect solution.

title: Lost & Found: A This Bed We Made Story
description: Lost & Found is a standalone, short story game taking place aboard a 1960s transatlantic ship. Play as Sophie Roy in her new job as a stewardess, and help solve a curious series of thefts in this narrative-driven mystery set after the events of This Bed We Made.

title: Rainbow Billy: The Book of Fears
description: Billy is back for an investigative adventure in Summer camp. Unravel mysterious events in this colorful journey as campers’ worries manifest as Fearlings. Explore the camp, investigate its secrets, and confront those fears through clever puzzles.

title: Chef of Sherwood
description: “It’s like Cooking-Mama meets the Monty Pythons in a Visual Novel!” Cook for your life as the new royal chef of Prince John Lackland and his unhinged family. Befriend Robin Hood and his rebels to get ingredients, prepare amazing meals and manage the pantry in this narrative-driven cooking game.

title: Pirate Chips
description: Pirate Chips is a chaotic multiplayer game where you and your spudmates construct a boatato and fight other pirates in legendary battles.

title: Sisters of Solitude
description: Explore a haunted convent with your EMF detector, tape recorder, and camera. Uncover the fate of four ghostly sisters and the mystery behind the murder they commited. Every room hides a clue, every shadow a warning, and the truth waits for those who dare to seek it.

title: The Caribou Trail
description: The WWI story where your goal isn't to kill, but to survive. In the still trenches, three soldiers learn the harsh truth of war: reckless missions, digging trenches, collecting dog tags and ghostly whispers in the dark. Home before the leaves fall, they thought.

title: Story of a Line
description: A visual lullaby following the life of a whimsical line through four acts of calming visual/audio landscapes. It is an animated experience of 40 minutes so sit back, relax and enjoy. The line is procedurally generated, so each time you run the story you'll enjoy a different experience. Perfect for relaxing and reflecting after a busy day at work.

title: Alien Soda Online
description: An RPGMMO Monster Tamer Game.

title: Through Death's Door
description: A small horror RPGmaker game where you really want to go home.

title: Forsaken Kingdom
description: A dark fantasy roguelite-strategy RPG where you lead a medieval expedition through a world consumed by darkness. Command your squad and manage your field camp, choose your path through perilous lands, face terrifying monsters and powerful bosses in your struggle to return alive.

title: Witherspring Wilds
description: Witherspring Wilds is an open world life sim that goes beyond any you have seen before. With boundless options - farming, mining, crafting, building, combat, exploration, alchemy, creature taming and more - how will you shape the world?

title: Archerio
description: A fast-paced 3D archery roguelike. Clear deadly rooms, stack wild powers, defeat bosses.

title: Aetherica: Echoes of Exodus
description: Aetherica: Echoes of Exodus is a 2D, hand-drawn, metroidvania inspired action-adventure where you follow Floria and Kipp on their journey through an unique and epic journey inside the long lost dystopian civilization: Providence.

title: Second Humanity
description: On the surface, Second Humanity seems like the ultimate school drama in a prestigious Colombian academy. As the new student in Class 02, you are surrounded by prodigies: the conciliatory Eva, the provocative Caelum, and the spectral Isoria. But beneath the marble walls of Humanity School lies a dystopia where survival depends on your ability to exploit the weaknesses of others—or perhaps, finally understand who 'They' truly are.

title: Paranormal Research Society
description: Build a career as a paranormal field researcher in an exciting horror comedy first-person shooter about finally getting a job and gunning down ghosts while performing menial labor for your infuriating boss.

title: Outsiders
description: Set in a progressively changing house filled with puzzles, something is immediately unsettling as you begin to discover a deeper story as things go wrong. Discover the truth behind the Outsiders, and what is really happening in that terrifying house.

title: Mega Man X: Viral Nightmare
description: Developed by Cat Yard Games, Viral Nightmare is a reworked and reimagined take on Mega Man X6 that significantly enhances and expands the original game. It introduces a fully overhauled Nightmare Soul system, mix-and-match Armor parts, redesigned stages (with Blaze Heatnix’s stage standing out as an big improvement -- seriously), new story elements, and more.

title: To the End of Days
description: You are Ace Miller. A man trying to travel cross-country to make it back to his family before a deadly, planet killer comet strikes. Can you survive the apocalypse? Can you make it back to your family in time?

title: Another Late Night
description: You're up late playing video games and messing around on the internet and things take a dark turn...

title: Arcadletra
description: Electronics in an arcade and video rental store begin to come to life in startling ways when a mysterious hole leading to an unknown world is discovered.

title: Cold Pines
description:
A short PS1-style horror experience. Set in a snowy, isolated gas station in America, Cold Pines invites you to explore and... be watched.

What you’ll find in the snow is better left unspoiled..

title: There Is No Next Stop
description: After the announcement "There is no next stop," you are trapped in an endless subway. But you're not alone—the "GUESTS" are hunting you. Trust the "GUIDES" to survive. Or don't.

title: The Diving Bell
description: Isolation takes its toll on even the strongest of wills. Survive the madness, faulty machinery, and the crushing depths of the ocean, and reach your salvation inside the diving bell.

title: Chicken Derby
description:
Chickens are running on the Polygon Blockchain!
Race to win money on your way to podium glory with your NFT Chicken collection.

title: A Baby CEO?!
description: A struggling book company has decided to hire you, a baby, to be the new CEO? All you need to do is manage the budget, keep the company brand strong and make the employees happy. You can't talk? No problem! Give a thumbs up or down and try your best.

title: Solipsis
description: Two astronauts search for geological features beneath the surface of The Moon. They find one.

title: Virtuoso Skins Game
description: What the #$@& is a Skins Game?! High stakes, big bet golf gamblin' with your friends...IN SPACE! Fly out with 3 of your friends online to a futuristic world of high-rolling hi-jinx and compete in off-wall golf tournaments for bragging rights and cold hard cash in Virtuoso Skins Game!

title: Clockfall
description: Master the clock, break the loop. Time is limited and is the ultimate resource in this hybrid Dungeon Crawler packed with phases of village defense. Each run is a fight to earn more time, or unlock new weapons and skills to build your escape.

title: The Thing in the Lake
description: Something horrible is hiding in its murky depths...

title: The Guiding Spirit
description: Mix and match hundreds of traits, flaws, and skills to design unique heroes with complex personalities and ambitions. Watch them love, hate, help, and hinder each other. Roll the dice and become the Guiding Spirit of your group of misfits in this story-rich fantasy campaign simulator!

title: Warp Knights
description: Warp Knights is a 3D tower offense strategy RPG set in a sci-fi world. As the returning Commander, you awaken to operatives inspired by your legend — brave, loyal, and ready to fight. Lead them through tactical battles where timing and terrain decide fate and reclaim the future you once fought for.

title: Zero to Army
description: Command your army from zero to legendary in this roguelite tower defense where every soldier matters. Watch as your humble recruits evolve through combat, climbing military ranks while facing procedurally generated threats across randomized battlefields.

title: The Toy Shop
description: What do you do when you can't trust what you see, hear, or touch? What reality do you chose to be your own? Do you take your fate in to your own hands, or play on as someone else's toy?

title: Alegraz
description: In this card game, you are the creator of your own deck. Alegraz is a roguelite strategy card game where you personally shape your cards in every run. Each run progresses with a deck built entirely from scratch, driven by the choices you make along the way.

title: Charlie Spotlight
description: Meet Charlie, the next King of Comedy! Or at least its' Little Prince. It's a steady grind to get to the top, until on a night like any other, after one of his sets, Charlie is approached by a couple of rather unusual fans.

title: Toad Turf
description: A 3D Platformer Party Shooter inspired by early 2000s console games. No microtransactions, no live service! Free Updates Post Launch. Easy to learn, hard to master, controls are simple to understand for veterans and newcomers.

title: Construction Crew
description: Grab your helmet and fire up the engines! This is raw construction - sweat, smoke, and steel. Operate cranes, loaders, rollers, and more as you and your CREW carve terrain, raise structures, and pour asphalt to finish the toughest jobs together.

title: Pirate Pillage and Plunder
description: PIRATE PILLAGE & PLUNDER is the unique blend of card game and auto battler, wrapped together in a neat roguelike package. Choose your faction, amass an army from thousands of "willing" participants, and lead them to greatness! (or agonizing defeat)

title: Touched by an Outer God
description:
An action-horror FPS where you kill monsters and eat their remains to become stronger.
Randomized enemies that come in several different forms and randomized upgrades allowing for unique builds each playthrough.

title: Undiscovered
description: Undiscovered is a found footage game featuring a unique second-person perspective, It tells the story of two archaeologists exploring a previously undiscovered ancient ruin. Set in the 1940's, explore the cursed eldritch tomb and escape from undead skeletal conquistadors.

title: Bete Grise
description: You play as Pom. A cheery night manager of the Bete Grise hotel. A quiet, lonely shift in a hotel with strange happenings, and peculiar guests. The scene begins at midnight. Make the rounds, checking any left over work by housekeeping. Fold towels, make beds, repair vending machines, check the front desk for requests or notes. There is a mystery here. Will you be ready to welcome tonight’s special guests? An isometric adventure game with 90's style graphics.

title: Plectra Spectre
description: Nadia Svara is an unemployed guitarist who lives alone in a cramped apartment. She used to work in a band, but was unable to keep it together, and blames herself for the way it fell apart. Now at rock bottom, it's up to her to pick up the pieces. Can Nadia live a happy life again?

title: MMO98
description: An incremental game where you go from small-scale MMO development studio up to global market domination. Improve your server infrastructure, address the technical challenges of running an MMO, release new games, and become the world's #1 MMO game studio.

title: Factomancer
description: The Order sends you on a mission. Armed with technology powered by magic, build production chains, plan, transform, optimize, and prepare for the unexpected. In this automation roguelite, the Eye of the Order watches your moves: failure is only a step toward perfection.

title: Dread Eagle
description:
Set in Unitatea 91-C, Dread Eagle places players at the center of a brutal Soviet experiment led by Sebastian Dobrev. As the facility slowly collapses under the weight of its past, players must explore its depths, uncover disturbing truths, and face what remains of the test subjects left behind

The game offers both a singleplayer campaign and competitive multiplayer modes, including 1v1 and 2v2 gameplay. Each multiplayer round begins with a twisted form of Russian roulette, where players are linked to a shared gas system and one pump determines the outcome. Losing the gamble does not mean instant death, but instead sends the defeated player into an execution chamber.

title: Horny Goddesses Quiz
description: This is a quiz game in which you can meet the beautiful 10 ladies.

title: Skills & Raids
description: A party-based RPG with real-time, ability driven combat. Manage cooldowns and react to enemy mechanics. Loot and extract resources to complete quests and craft powerful gear. The world has fallen into the grasp of a corruption spreading creature. Combine skills to create unique builds.

title: Project Blood Sword
description: You are a lone ex-mercenary, turned Demigod, the embodiment of wrath – an unstoppable force seeking revenge on a cult that has enslaved humanity, draining the blood of thousands each day with the means to resurrect the god of hatred.

title: Horror Engine: Tech Demo
description: Horror Engine Tech Demo is a playable demonstration of a horror game design tool available on the Unreal Marketplace under the same name. It allows you to experience various mechanics included in the asset and explore the possibilities of game creation without requiring any coding knowledge.

title: Steeb
description: Steeb is a sci-fi exploration adventure game. You are a bio-robot scout, sent to explore dangerous Earth-like planets. Gain unique abilities by extracting samples from alien organisms. Choose upgrades to progress and survive the planet's threats. Will your discoveries save humanity?

title: SynthEscape
description: A Synthwave bullet hell shoot 'em up where grazing enemy fire charges your bullet-slowing field and builds your score. Play through 5 levels in solo or co-op with leaderboard support. '80s vibes meet precision shmup gameplay. Graze Bullets. Bend Time. Break the Future.

title: Reverse 1999: The Campaign's Tale
description:
Version 3.3 of Reverse: 1999, which includes:
• New characters: Marsha and Igor
• New Garments for Medicine Pocket, Sentinel, Moldir and Bunny Bunny
• New main story chapter: The Campaign's Tale
• New Anecdote for Moldir
• …and more!

title: Mr. Addon Game Maker
description: Haven't had enough of Mr.Addon in Sulpicius Gallus M? Well now, in this fantastic second part, you will be able to create your own levels! Create your own adventure in Mr.Addon Game Maker!

title: Crazy Eights 3D Premium
description: Realistic 3D Crazy Eights simulation with singleplayer, multiplayer and tutorial. With configurable AI strength and many adjustable rule and game variants you can start exciting Crazy Eights and Mau-Mau tournaments - or just play for fun!

title: Ruthless Water
description: Now the game type is terror game, the developers are not going to make, the author give up production

title: Charades Movie One
description: Solve movie charades, guess which pictures represent which movie names

title: RX Racing 2021 Pro
description: RX Racing 2021 Pro is an arcade rallycross game where you can drive the drivers of the year 2021 in different categories. The goal is very simple, you take a driver and try to win the race. But be careful because depending on the driver you take, it will be more difficult to win the race.

title: Metal Force: Tank Games Online
description: Lots of battle arenas in all corners of the world await you! You will have various combat military vehicles in your battle arsenal. Each machine represents a unique tactic, a unique warfare style.

title: LiberationTeam
description: Lead your team on the battlefield for victory and glory.

title: My Home/Zombie Center
description: This is a third-person action game set in a home improvement center. You can use the tools as weapons to defeat zombies. Each weapon in the game has its own unique usability, so players can have fun finding the right weapon for themselves and finding the right fighting style for each weapon.

title: Mystery Solitaire: Grimm's Tales 8
description: The tale continues! Go through the locations of the Brothers Grimm world and collect all the solitaire solitaire solitaire pieces!

title: Bash Moto
description: Tear up the streets in this 90s themed beat'em up motorcycle racing game. Kick and bash your way through a slew of roughneck bikers all trying to claim victory and the cash prize. Take your hard earned cash and buy yourself a new bike to keep up with the pack or leave them in your dust.

title: NH Bid at MSCYPAA: The Game
description: Go to MSCYPAA! Win the Bid!

title: Sex Adventure: The Board Game
description: You want to impress your girlfriend and show her you're a great stallion in bed? This board game takes you in an erotic and playful way to the paradise of lust! Even as a single you should not miss this game to give your darling an unforgettable evening.

title: Dorm Janitor's Revenge
description: Experience an old-school RPG in a female-dominated slice-of-life setting. Live the life of a broke and humiliated janitor living in a girls' dormitory. Interact with the ladies, explore various kinks, exploit, and make choices that lead to your prime goal or an entirely different ending.

title: Micro-Zoo
description: MICRO-ZOO is a Creature Creating, Dungeon Crawling, Base Building, Turn-Base Battler. Create and Evolve your Creatures/Micro-Morphs from Parts that you gather from Rogue-lite Dives. Customize your Base with Decorations to boost your Micro-Morphs to go deeper into the games Biomes.

title: War for Bryndor
description: A fast-paced strategy game where cards offer you strategy and dice determine your fate! Conquer provinces in thrilling battles in an attempt to unite the land. Manage your resources and outmaneuver opponents in quick matches filled with tactical decisions and shifting frontlines.

title: Water Margin Scrolls
description: "Water Margin Scrolls" is a squad-building loot-hunting game set in the world of Water Margin. Collect iconic heroes from the classic tale and challenge other players in strategic battles.

title: CatLands
description: CatLands is a cozy puzzle game about matching landscape elements in a cute cat world. Explore charming scenery and build your own village to attract fluffy folks!

title: My Townies
description: My Townies is an immersive mixed city-building game, you’re not just an overseer. Begin with a modest farm settlement and transform it into a sprawling metropolis, with every townie, building, and resource under your command. Relax watch your city grow and play mini games

title: Zombie Epoch: Deck Apocalypse
description: Zombie Epoch: Deck Apocalypse blends dungeon crawling with strategic cardplay. Explore dangerous ruins, collect cards and items, and build deadly synergies to outlast relentless zombie hordes. Unlock new characters, upgrade your base, and fight to restore humanity！

title: Northern Waters: Fishing & Restaurant Simulator
description: Run your own restaurant in the snowy Alaskan town of Northpointis Bay and experience an immersive fishing and restaurant simulator. Catch fish in first-person, manage your restaurant, cook and sell your catch, and become the town’s top angler and restaurateur.

title: Ritualis: Summoner Simulator
description: An ancient town needs your magic of summoning. Summon bizarre items and creatures to fulfill townsfolk requests. Earn coins and uncover the strange secrets of the locals. Oh, and try to cure your sudden amnesia. It might just save your life!

title: Summer and Score Through the Doors
description: This is one (or more) story of reality, a story of youth, dreams, chains, and rebellion. Step into different lives of 7 ordinary teens through the "Doors", and to rewrite their fate tightly locked with your choices.

title: Pinball With a Gun
description: If you die in Pinball, you die for real! Experience the classic arcade game with a Russian Roulette murderpop twist, and go for the Big Score! Don't worry about getting your head blown off, who even said that could happen?

title: Summoner's Cookbook
description: An incremental, idle, creature collector about summoning creatures and giving them tasks. Craft them using ingredients and fill out your Cookbook with your discoveries. Take on requests, build, expand and let your creatures do the hard work while you discover new recipes or do other things!

title: Fremd Wagen: Mod Chaos
description: Fremd Wagen: Modding Mayhem. The ultimate frustrating mathematical mod simulator. To stop the crashes, ensure your Mod Sum obeys the Rule of 42. Install the bypass fix, clean the DLLs, and solve the equation. Failure results in a 0xC0000005 crash!

title: Blemdeck
description: Ruin your deck to make money and avoid Penalty Points. Start with a deck of playing cards and use stickers and stationary to change the value of your hand. Add effects to make more money or to mess with your opponents!

title: Swifty
description: A fast-paced 2D platformer where speed, precision, and perfect timing are key. Dodge traps, master challenging levels, and become the ultimate "Swifty".

title: Pineapple Legend
description: Find the Golden Pineapple and the crimes against the Mayans. In Pineapple Legend, solve investigations with amusing and humorous situations. Explore the city of Takitani: investigate, solve puzzles, collect cards, equip accessories, fish, garden, fight in the arena, and increase your affinity!!!

title: Bubbo: Adventure on Geralds Island
description: Bubbo is a cuddly character tasked with delivering supplies to Geralds Island. Upon Bubbo's arrival, the adorable animal inhabitants inform you that you'll have to collect the payment from around the main village. As Bubbo's journey takes them further into the heart of the island, a dark secret lurking just beneath the surface is slowly revealed... A 3D platformer in the vein of Super Mario 64.

title: Sato
description: Manipulate space and time in this planetary puzzle-platformer. Learn the rules to unravel more of the world and the secrets within. Do you remember? 183 15.

title: Slash Cash
description: A turn-based simulation game, where you manage a game development company. You can choose to run the company honestly and diligently or resort to some unconventional methods.

title: Draw of Destiny
description: A dark fantasy roguelite deckbuilder where cards evolve as you play. Build lethal synergies, adapt your deck before every battle, and fight through a demon-ravaged world of brutal tactical choices.

title: Northwick
description: Northwick; The main protagonist Chris uncovers an ancient book contained within are relentless horrors. Each night Chris's understanding of the true evil that has been thrust upon him will deepen. Will you have to commit the ultimate sacrifice?

title: Radical Zomboarding
description: Radical Zomboarding is a roguelike snowboarding game that's all about shredding powder and shooting zombies. Do tricks, buy perks, and soak the slopes with blood!

title: BattleSail
description: BattleSail is an action tactical strategy game where you command a fleet in turn-based naval battles. Manage resources, upgrade and outfit your ships, and navigate a richly designed single-player Campaign or jump into fast Arena encounters, or test pure thinking in one-turn Puzzle challenges.

title: DVG Survivors
description: DVG Survivors is a casual idle-roguelike-survival game where you watch your DVG logo bounce across the screen and destroy your enemies with various abilities. Who are your enemies? Well none other than other mixed media from across the ages.

title: The Fruit Merchant's Diary
description: Start as a small fruit wholesaler and earn your fortune! Will you remain honest, or get rich through bribery and risk the wrath of the 'Great Blue Eye'? Spend your earnings on good or evil to shape your Karma. Remember, the Eye only watches the sinners in this narrative-driven economy sim.

title: Descent Into Darkness
description: In "Descent Into Darkness", you must take an elevator down into the depths of a mysterious underground complex, filled with dangers and secrets. Your goal is to find a way out—but with each level, the darkness grows, and the threats become more terrifying...

title: Reveniev: A Day in Nassiriyah
description: Get your revenge in REVENIEV!

title: Staged
description: Staged is a co-op first-person physics party game for 1–4 players. Play mischievous goblins, rebuild stage sets from reference photos, haul oversized props through tight backstage spaces, and get every placement right before the curtain rises.

title: Bobo in Hell
description: Survive hell in this Roguelike Deckbuilder that features card battles with an in-depth auto-battler-esque synergy and combo system. Help Bobo, the little penguin, recruit allies and face the many horrors that await him on his journey to save his friends.

title: Catventure: The Curse of the Dark Tower
description: Catventure is an action roguelike top-down shooter game where you must enter a vampire's tower. Armed with your bow, face hordes of enemies, gain special powers as you level up, buy and forge equipment, and get ready to battle the most powerful monsters in this epic adventure.

title: Black Horizon: Armada
description: Black Horizon: Armada is a digital deck-building card game set in an original sci-fi universe, where your goal is to build the strongest armada.

title: The Gilded Lady: Life and Love in a Cyborg Shop
description: Live a day-in-the-life of a cyborg mechanic in a soft-apocalyptic future where disease is staved off with hard work and metal parts. Choose your person, romantic or otherwise, and walk their unique path through the walled city. Manage the shop and grow your future in one of 6 separate endings.

title: Naval Tactics
description: Naval Tactics is a Stylized, Top-Down RTS focusing on naval combat in the first half of the 20th century. Play against other players in Multiplayer, or get aboard your flagship by yourself in Singleplayer.

title: Nano Squadron
description: Nano Squadron is a top-down space roguelite where your nanobot ship evolves mid-battle. Survive relentless alien waves, stack powerful upgrades, and build a ship capable of defending Earth.

title: Orba
description: ORBA is a fast-paced 2D pixel-art action game where you race a fragile Orb up a deadly tower. Dash through shifting floors, use powerful Lucky Charms to outpace destruction, and push your limits before the Orb shatters.

title: Chip’s Tips
description: Skip and his dog Chip are the stars of everyone's favorite kids’ TV show, Chip’s Tips! As Chip is a dog and therefore incapable of most tasks, Skip has to work alone to has to get everything ready for tonight's Halloween party. Can you help him find everything he needs for the perfect spooky celebration? What could possibly go wrong!? A classic FMV adventure game in the style of Harvester.

title: Pearl Music
description: A musical visual novel where you control the mind of a young composer in love

title: Blacksmith Tales
description: Enter a colourful, anime-inspired realm as a first-person blacksmith. Craft weapons for daring warriors, meet curious creatures, and shape epic battles with your forging skill - or risk dooming heroes to defeat.

title: Take You Home
description: In a strange, monochrome world, swap colors and flip gravity to chase a mysterious black cat.

title: Purr-fect Chef: Cats Can Cook
description: Purr-fect Chef is a cute cats time management cooking game. But instead of running restaurants, your goal as the chef is to pass as many fun stages as possible with changing mechanics and also explore the story.

title: Chumps Chained
description: After a failed phishing scheme, two scam artist best friends are cursed by an evil wizard who permanently chains them together. In this 2D couch co-op platformer, join Walter and Jellybean in navigating through the wizard's mayhem and a surreal world to undo the curse!

title: Guardians of Dao
description: “Guardians of Dao” is a wuxia RPG with real-time tactics × roguelite deckbuilding. Play cards to command heroes, shape your build with divine blessings, and defend Earth.

title: Dig Dig Burrito!
description: You are a burrito inside a burrito digging through all the delicious ingredients inside. Be careful, some ingredients can kill you! You will avoid enemies, Cause massive explosions, Upgrade your stats, Dig through tons of burritos and more!

title: Banana Keeper
description: One Banana Keeper, and up to seven friends as Evil Monkeys hiding among NPC monkeys. A multiplayer hide & seek game about blending in, eating bananas, and avoiding being revealed. Will you fool the Banana Keeper or reveal all evil monkeys around NPCs?

title: Psycho Frogo
description: Psycho Frogo is a fast, addictive “learn the line” speed-runner. Your mission is simple: figure out the best path, then speed run the best path. Every level is designed with the optimal route - work it out to beat the clock and unlock the next level.

title: Pixel Clicker
description: A pixel art-style clicker game where you tap to blast pixels and bosses, upgrade, automate, and travel through diverse biomes, from lush jungles to the far reaches of space, all wrapped in an immersive soundscape. Climb the leaderboard and become the ultimate pixel boss.

title: Ritualist
description: Ritualist is a dynamic isometric action-roguelike set in a unique dark fantasy world. Choose your weapons, master combat style, and face death as you uncover ancient rituals to seal away the Primordial Ones. Will you survive the descent, or will the Abyss claim you?

title: Drifters Don't Brake: Midnight
description: Drift through different terrains and tackle challenges while your car auto-accelerates nonstop.

title: The Bicameral Protocol
description: By all measures Isaac Llewellyn is a success in life. So why doesn't it feel like that? Something is horribly wrong. Join Isaac as he returns to his childhood home to try to make sense of what happened in his youth. To reconcile truth with memory, Isaac must explore a horrifying past.

title: Ehub Cities: Blackout
description: The power grid has failed. You have no phone, no internet. Only the eHUB, your power source for emergencies. Your neighbors are counting on you — but what will you do? The story-driven simulation game “eHUB cities - Blackout” is being developed under the direction of the LOEWE Center emergenCITY.

title: Bait Soul
description: Bait Soul is a top-down Dungeon Crawler Roguelike. It blends dungeon exploration with Survivors-style auto-attacks. Accessible yet deep, it retains the thrill of looting, with unique, game-changing mechanics hidden everywhere.

title: Rod of Asclepius
description: Rod of Asclepius is a historical RPG in 4th-century Pannonia. Play a Roman medicus: investigate symptoms, gather herbs, and perform turn-based treatments. Explore researched sites and make ethical choices that shape your reputation as the empire falters.

title: Trucker 2056
description: Trucker 2056 is a narrative trading RPG featuring a point-and-click driven plot and card-based combat. Heavily inspired by late 80s and early 90s classics by Origin and MicroProse.

title: Misery Nights
description: Co-op horror for 1–6 players. Complete high-risk tasks in a vast shopping mall while evading relentless monsters. Hold the security room - or push out and make it back alive.

title: Boiled
description: America, 1925. A simple errand for an old friend pulls ex-gang leader Dan into a violent smuggler war on the border. A narrative-driven, adrenaline-pumping top-down shooter inspired by Hotline Miami, set in the 1920s Old West.

title: Author Sim
description: Have you ever dreamed of becoming a world-renowned author? Now's your chance! Study masterpieces from other authors, craft breathtaking stories, and maintain a public profile in pursuit of your dream.

title: Dark in Light
description: After finishing work, the protagonist returns home—only to find the city overrun by terrifying creatures. In this survival horror adventure, you must explore ruined streets, collect resources, and fight for your life to save your missing son.

title: Roguefall
description: Roguefall is an action rogue-lite following a lost player guided by the enigmatic Overseer to scavenge a world forgotten by humanity. Fight, explore, collect, and fall until you reach the final machine: 0VR5R.

title: BrawlMart
description: BrawlMart is a fast-paced, physics-driven party game where up to four players crash their carts through a rotating playlist of wild minigames. Every round twists the rules, every arena is unpredictable, and every match is absolute chaos.

title: Pure Domino
description: A 3d Domino online game where players can experience a game like they are playing physically in the same room.

title: Tell Me Owl
description: Embark on an exciting journey in a top-down western shooter inspired by classic NES action games. Battle through handcrafted levels, buy abilities, upgrade weapons to face multi-phase bosses in a world where a man's best friend is his revolver.

title: Problem Solved
description: "Problem Solved, a coop adventure where you and your friends are heroes of every story." You and your friends are the engineers of every solution.

title: Dice & Figurines: Business Life Simulator
description: A shop simulator in which you run a business with warrior and monster figures. Manage your inventory, serve your customers, create a unique atmosphere and organise strategic tabletop games. Grow your business and build the best place for figure lovers!

title: Crash and Conquer
description: A thrilling, Carmageddon/Twisted metal-inspired roguelite game blending high-octane driving and action with strategic elements.

title: Frost: Quiet Light
description: Draw paths to guide the flocking spirits to their home planets. Watch countless beautiful creatures emerge from light, bring balance to a world in constant motion, and solve its puzzles.

title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas - The Nextgen Edition
description: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas - The Nextgen Edition is a total conversion mod for Grand Theft Auto V. It includes every mission and side content from the 2004 original game. Bringing the city, pedestrians, cars and even radio stations to the Rockstar Advanced Game Engine (RAGE)

title: Tiny Monster Village
description: In this cozy village simulation game, you'll help the minions create a unique village and experience a relaxing pastoral life: growing crops, fishing, exploring treasures, and more.

title: Poly Bricks
description: A brick-building puzzle game. Assemble sets of increasing complexity, design your own, share with the community.

title: Nonsense Defense
description: Roguelite tower defense with moveable chaos. Build towers and troops, drag them mid battle, dash through danger, and defend your crystal solo or with up to three friends in online co op.

title: Throw a Life!
description: "Throw A Life!" is a chaotic party survival game for up to four players! Work together to mine, craft, build, and hunt on a dangerous island. Divide roles to survive efficiently—or embrace the chaos and have fun with friends!

title: Eden: Garden of the Faultless
description: Uncover the true nature of the Faultless as you care for them from egg to angel. Help them to reach their true potential through consumables found throughout the garden. Give your Faultless encouragement as they attempt a race through a series of obstacles. Ensure your Faultless is adequately trained in speed, power, and flight, or they may get left in the dust! Compete with your Faultless to discover the true purpose of the “Grand Event.” A monster raising sim with racing minigame.

title: Real Time Chess Roguelike
description: Chess, but instead of taking turns each piece has an individual cooldown. Additional pieces and upgrades can be bought after each battle in the campaign.

title: Storytime Cats: A Twilight Tale
description: Storytime Cats – A Twilight Tale is a hidden object game set in a magical storybook world. Search for playful cats across 7 hand-drawn levels, each brimming with charm and cozy twilight magic!

title: Elton Manor: Requiem of the Cursed Roses
description: At the beginning of the 20th century, a “maid”, Anna, worked diligently every day in a quiet manor. However, in an accident, the gaps in his memory swept over him. Abnormal colleagues, confused gender, vague dreams...While Anna was at a loss, a group of strangers visited the manor, and a long-hidden mystery quietly unfolded.

title: Monster Mending
description: Bash, mix and cook up all sorts of remedies to fix an ever increasing number of wounded monsters. Make use of every piece of equipment you can get your hands on to patch them up and send them on their way as quickly as you can.

title: Grotto Escape
description: You play as a SF character facing Heroic Fantasy creatures in this Dungeon Crawler with Platformer gameplay.

title: Desire's Burgers
description: It’s your first real job—and you get to keep all the profits! But your boss? She’s a seductive succubus who drains your energy at night. Run a cozy burger joint by day, survive her temptations by night, and shape your fate in this rhythm-infused visual novel.

title: State of Affairs
description: State of Affairs is a realistic geopolitical simulator where you lead a nation through pivotal historical moments. Manage legislative bodies, balance factional tensions, and make strategic decisions that shape the political, economic, and social future of your country.

title: Reactonix Sandbox
description: Reactonix is a flexible and enjoyable simulation sandbox where every force is at your command. Create ecosystems alone or with friends, experiment with physics and watch life evolve—or start an apocalypse for the sake of science. Complete freedom to create and destroy is in your hands.

title: Latitude of the Cult
description: Latitude of the Cult blends psychological horror with stealth, combat, and exploration. Face fanatics and unpredictable threats as you fight, hide, and survive across hostile environments where tension, choice, and atmosphere shape every encounter and the reality around you.

title: Code of Shadows
description: Code of Shadows is a fast-paced real-time roguelite where you fight alongside powerful support drones. Pause on demand, evolve mid-fight, and push back relentless rift-spawned hordes across shifting dimensions. Adapt your build, master the chaos, and survive each run.

title: Garden Ink
description: Paint, merge, and explore! Garden Ink is a cozy sandbox/exploration game where you shape and grow your own world. Merging decorations and coloring tools help you customize your world. With hand-painted visuals and a soothing soundtrack, it’s time to discover every cute surprise.

title: Radiotext
description: Radiotext is an interactive story set in the near future, where communication without intrusion requires radio-waves. Dive into a cryptographic radio-net in this text-based rpg, where you need to think carefully before typing your answers.

title: Matter Over Mind
description: The hair product corporation Excès de Confiance has developed the latest and greatest in hair conditioners, Formula 500. Unfortunately due to a key active ingredient being a strange DNA sample harvested deep in the Marianas Trench, Formula 500 is capable of intelligent thought. Unknowing of the danger they are in, the scientists continue to experiment but Formula 500 is waiting for it’s time to strike. A reverse horror about a coconut-and-vanilla-scented blob escaping its containment and hijacking the minds of its prey. An isometric adventure action/adventure game.

title: Cat Chaos
description: Knock things over, spin, play, and nap as a mischievous house cat.

title: Nice Screams at the Funfair
description: It was supposed to be just a regular trip to the local otherworldly spectral Funfair. But changes in management have left the staff short-handed! It's up to you, a complete stranger, to run an ice cream parlor. Everything will be fine as long as you get the coins out of the customers’ pockets and get their orders correct. But don’t get any funny ideas! There’s an ever-vigilant robotic cat that keeps you in check. Don’t pocket the money, serve perfect ice scream experiences, and you might just make it through the day. An ice cream serving simulator with horror themes.

title: Reactor
description: You’ve taken a position at a research station on a remote planet. Your only companion is a computer-controlled robot assistant who does her best to keep you happy. Searching a nearby meteor impact leads to a discovery that complicates this simple relationship. A first-person horror adventure game.

title: Sato Wonderland
description: Sato Wonderland is an Amusement Park created by the eccentric AI pioneer Hidetaka Sato as a showcase for his many beloved characters. The park opened thirty years ago and was an international attraction, even after Sato passed away a few years later. Recently, one of the park’s oldest mascot characters, Kitsuhime-sama, has been acting erratically, culminating in her attempting to grab a child and escape the park with him. The player is sent in as the park’s AI handler to determine what the problem is and if Kitsuhime can be repaired or must be retired. A dialogue matching puzzle game.

title: Soul Waste
description: Within a lifeless wasteland, the city ruins slumber as an immortal hero embarks on their everlasting quest to kill God. You play as an unnamed immortal hero, traversing a ruined city, on their quest to free a god, to end them. What secrets does the world hold? A momentum-based platformer with light combat, and simple enemies. Big jumps, fast movement-based gameplay. A 3D action platformer similar to Sonic.

title: Spookware @ The Video Store
description: An entirely new SPOOKWARE game! Join the skelebros at their Halloween movie marathon with a collection of brand-new blood-pumping horror microgames. Halloween’s coming up and the skelebros, Lefti Midi and Rieti, are looking to do something special. On a drive home they decide to pop into the video store chain (called Spookware) and do a horror movie marathon. Which movies should they watch? Well, why not all of them! The skelebros brace themselves for the longest and spookiest movie marathon of their lives. Will you reach the end or chicken out? A microgame collection within an anthology.

title: Similariddle
description: A word-guessing game in which you have to guess the word with hinted "similarity" value

title: Touhou: Divine Land -Majesty in Game-
description: A Touhou Project SRPG game. Include： 30+PlayableUnits, 100 classes, 100+SpellCards, 100+EnemyUnits, 50+TouhouFanBgm and dozens of terrain types. Make Best Unit by combining class, talent, accessory, and tarot. U can even use SpellCards from other Units: sush as Koishi using FinalSpark

title: Sujefa
description: Sujefa is co-op puzzle platformer where two players can play as Rock, Paper or Scissors. Work together to solve puzzles and reach the end. Play online or locally on a shared screen.

title: Orson, P.I.: Midnight at the Grand Hotel
description: Twelve guests at a Chicago hotel plot to steal millions in jewels. Stop them before midnight strikes.

title: Drift Survivors
description: Top-down car combat meets survivor-style chaos. Drift through neon arenas, delete waves with wild weapons, and upgrade your build to last longer every run.

title: HexBreakerII
description: A supernatural game infused with Chinese-style elements drawn from folklore. This game offers online gameplay for teams of up to 4 players. In a world ravaged by warlords and monsters, you will assume the role of a Taoist, wielding your skills to unveil truths hidden for millennia.

title: Macaronpolis
description: Macaronpolis is a simulation game that creates an efficient and universal process for customers to produce the products they want. You develop sales strategies by predicting customer demand, developing production designs, and sometimes finding solutions to problems faced by neighbors.

title: Nanima
description: Nanima is a physics-based nanomachine builder where creativity drives combat. Loot and add gear to your ship as you go, with full control over how you dish out damage and move through the harsh microbial world that is the human appendix.

title: Banshee Bash
description: Banshee Bash is a local-multiplayer party game. Fight with up to 3 friends (or add bots) to battle as a team, or in an epic free-for-all. Stack spell books to create unbalanced chaos and grab potion bottles to stay in the fight.

title: Draw, Draw, Pass!
description: Create a room or join a party, this game gets more chaotic with more people! Collaborate together on one canvas as artists and the guesser has to figure out the drawing. Will your friends make a masterpiece or a mess?

title: Red Tears: Angola
description: Red Tears is a dynamic Stealth-Action FPS set in a hostile, open-world warzone. Find your own path in brutal, nonlinear faction warfare. Employ guerrilla tactics, strike from the bushes, and endure violent gunfights to survive. Gather intel, loot resources, and fight to turn the tide.

title: I Dream of Demons
description: “I Dream of Demons” is a psychological puzzle platformer, immersing players in a mind-bending sonic odyssey where music, colour, and emotion blend into a trance-like quest of introspection, self-discovery and transformation.

title: EverCastle
description: Evercastle is the story of a young girl who sets out on an adventure to the mysterious castle. In this magical action RPG, you must master various spells to overcome monsters and traps, defeat powerful enemies, and reach the castle's depths to rescue beloved family.

title: Spirit of the Dome
description: Tower defense game where you defend against waves of enemies and dark forces across a decaying world.

title: Echoes of Myth
description: Action Roguelite with a bit weightier Souls-lite combat in a broken world where you're chasing that perfect run. Loot and draw power from relics of vanished gods, forge devastating builds from spell and steel, and crush the wretches in your way!

title: Chinese Strange Stories
description: Step into a living Chinese painting that blends the mystical, supernatural, and the struggles of daily life in the final years of the Ming dynasty. Experience a unique mix of classic turn-based RPG mechanics and dynamic card battling, where strategy and fate intertwine.

title: Runes & Revenue
description: Welcome to the enchanting world of magic retail! Runes & Revenue is a cozy, hands-off management game where you manage your own magic shop. Recruit staff, unlock new mystical services. Strategically purchase upgrades to keep up with customer demand and ensure every adventurer leaves happy.

title: Bark and Catch
description: Bark and Catch - A fast-paced game for 1-4 players where you take on the role of dogs and must complete important farm tasks within a time limit: grow and prepare food, feed the animals, and deliver farm products to their destination.

title: Cat Gladiator
description: Cat Gladiator is a cute yet hardcore 2D Monster Hunter-style action game! Supporting 4-player online co-op,abundant weapons, armors and fun items for arena boss battles. The weapon is "easy to learn but hard to master". Turn into a cute cat gladiator and charge into the arena with partners!

title: Re: Spin. Die. Repeat.
description: You died by misfortune and were reborn by fate. In this medieval slot-machine roguelike deckbuilder with isekai RPG roots, every spin shapes your destiny. Manipulate luck, outwit the Dark Goddess, and stop the quiet spread of darkness. Just when you think you reach the end the wheel spins once more.

title: Carste Magic
description: An ​​engine-building​​ focused strategy card game. Craft unique spell combos by chaining elements to power your staff engine, with dynamic progression in every duel.

title: Steam Revolution: The Age of Rail
description: Build rail networks that link industries in 1844 Europe. Complete levels to expand across nations, and compare the efficiency of your solutions against a leaderboard.

title: Abyss Occult
description: An action-adventure horror experience across eerie, ever-changing spaces. Solve puzzles, uncover clues, and rely on a mysterious phone to push beyond confinement.

title: Wizard Punks!!!
description: WIZARD PUNKS!!! is a fast-paced, spell-slinging 4-player local party game. Create spells by combining the four elements of Air, Earth, Fire and Water, and defeat your fellow wizards with a variety of bombastic magics.

title: Kinny and the Cosmic Cauldron
description: Cook or be cooked! In this cosmic deck-building roguelike, ingredients crash, merge, and react in chaotic ways. As the witch chef of Stewpendous Spoons, craft the perfect stew, master strategic combos, and satisfy bizarre patrons—before you end up in the cauldron yourself!

title: Blaze of Empires
description: Besiege colossal creatures and invoke the favor of the gods in this unique fusion of RTS and roguelike. Build your base, gather resources, and evolve your empire through a dynamic tech tree. Survive epic waves solo or in co-op.

title: CapyBash
description: Jump, stomp, laugh and dominate. Think you can beat your friends in the ultimate capybara showdown? Prove it!

title: Brawl Squad X: Battle Arena
description: Fast-paced top-down multiplayer shooter with offline bot battles and online PvP. Play team deathmatch solo or with friends, unlock weapons, customize loadouts, and enjoy chaotic arcade-style combat with full progression online or offline.

title: Astral Lords
description: Master the core "Combat × Base-Building" loop. Survive intense horde-clearing chaos with agile gunplay, then think like a strategist—build your economy and army in real-time. With diverse Commanders and endless builds, your choices shape each run.

title: Gem Warrior R
description: Fighting + Strategy + Creativity A casual game that blends puzzle and fighting elements, powered by realistic physics!

title: Deck of Treads
description: Deck of Treads is a chaotic 2–6 player tank brawler with a deckbuilding twist. Stack upgrades that transform how your tank looks — and how it fights. Each match spirals into unpredictable mayhem, packed with ridiculous, over-the-top tank builds!

title: Psychic Kung Fu Master
description: CRPG gameplay, turn-based combat, collect martial arts to become the leader of the martial world, recruit disciples, cultivate martial skills, and compete for supremacy in the world.

title: CFS: Chinese Football Simulator
description: Chinese Football Simulator is a management game themed around Chinese football. As both club owner and head coach, you'll develop and manage teams either existing or customimmersed in authentic Chinese football culture.

title: Elmo's Reading Basics
description: Elmo presents 6 reading games at three different levels. Concepts introduced include letters, words, and sentences.

title: CaseCracker3
description: Sift crucial evidence from a sea of data. Reconstruct the case from fragmented narratives. Catch logical gaps hidden between the lines. Unearth the truth from the faintest traces! Youll need sharp logic and keen insight to conquer this fully immersive deduction challenge. Come onIm waiting.

title: JellyStar
description: JellyStar is a cute hand drawn 2D platformer designed for all ages.

title: Knight of Noshland
description: Wield your mighty Crusader blade and defend your kingdom against relentless waves of invaders. Forge powerful defenses and unleash devastating attacks as you upgrade your towers and arsenal. In this fantastical world strategize against a vast array of foes and claim ultimate victory over your realm!

title: Shadow of Ancients
description: Shadow of Ancients is a 3D, Narrative-Adventure game with a stylized and colorful world. You can explore this new world with our main character Aiden, learn its secrets and decide how the world will continue with unique but familiar game mechanics.

title: Akegarasu: Journey to the Underworld
description: An Ultimate-Speed × Hardcore Runner where a jet-black avenger cuts through the darkness. Cut down enemies with fast and thrilling moves like a hero from manga or anime, and rescue your beloved imprisoned in the depths of Yomi.

title: Rollbound
description: Rollbound is a short, experimental clicker set at a lonely tavern table, where a single die decides everything. Earn points and gold to upgrade Attack, Defense, Luck, and Gold gain as the stakes climb.

title: Vampire's Fall 2
description: Rise as a vampire in a handcrafted 2D dark-fantasy RPG. Master devastating powers, confront horrific enemies, and forge your destiny in a world shattered by a brutal civil war between humans and vampires.

title: Horus: Desert Survivor
description: Survive the sands of mythological Egypt in Horus: Desert Survivor, a survivor-like action game with deckbuilding. Build divine weapons, fight corrupted gods and mythical beasts, cleanse the fallen, and unleash godlike power.

title: Aileronia
description: Aileronia: a combat flight game where aviation legends and fantasy heroes, known as Aileronauts, unite. Take on single-player, co-op, and multiplayer missions in a legendary skybound realm.

title: Chicken TD: Defenders of the Coop
description: Chicken TD is a unique tower defense game where you strategically summon and upgrade creature towers to defend your coop from waves of enemies, while also engaging in Souls-like melee combat with a chosen weapon to directly hold the line and collect meta-progression currency.

title: Electronics Shop Simulator
description: Manage your own electronics store. Manage inventory, set prices, sell to customers, repair products, hire staff, and expand your store. Online orders, market dynamics, competition, and more are coming soon.

title: Project DevourSlime
description: A platformer… but you can take the platforms with you!?Control DevourSlime and solve puzzles by absorbing and shooting out the platforms near you.Battle corrupted lab machinery and hostile contaminants, stay ahead of the toxic gas, and rescue your companions.Plan your own unique escape route!

title: Metrocity
description: Play Metrocity, a challenging and innovative city builder game. prove your ability to organize and create the best city in the world. develop your city from 0 to thousands of people only in this game.

title: Bouncing to the Top With Quantum Quacks
description: Bounce to the top with Quantum Quacks! Master the physics of a challenging 2D world, collect hidden ducks, and experience the ultimate rage game. One fall, start over. Are you ready to defy gravity and collect all the ducks?

title: Frenzy Force
description: Choose your champion and fight until your last breath! Frenzy Force is a casual wave-survival game with a diverse set of weapons and unlockable characters, where you must fight through a variety of biomes against hordes of shadowy minions.

title: To Heaven
description: "I promise, I will get you to Heaven!" Earn your afterlife ticket with angel Ariel! Manage schedules and master 3 mini-games: Dog Walking (Action), Playtime (Survivor-like), and Cleaning (Tower Defense). A heartwarming multi-ending visual novel featuring a Monk, Nun, and Pastor helper trio.

title: Stranger Tavern: Brawl
description: Combines auto-chess, cards, and war-chess with PVP. Use 75+ cards and 52 heroes, each with unique skills. Six summoners offer strategic bonuses. Explore 12 synergies and factions with creative tactics like economy or hero devouring. Rise through ranks in PVP with stunning hand-drawn art!

title: Mesoké
description: Mesoké is a poetic and introspective flying game. Glide freely through an ever-shifting inner world, where every movement brushes against memory, emotion, and beauty. Explore, take risks, and collect the vital energy that brings your inner sanctuary back to life.

title: Roster: Alice's White Mouse
description: This is a first-person dark sci-fi game. When the world is no longer habitable, when resources run low, monsters will begin to slaughter each other. And you, the lab mouse just awakened—what path will you take?

title: Rixe
description: Welcome, combatants and spectators! Coop online with up to two friends, survive and defend your base from the trials of the Rixe. Pick your hero, upgrade it along the run your own way, and go as far as possible through the chaotic rounds !

title: Titan Star
description: Battle massive world-threatening giants. Fight alongside powerful turrets and bring the battle to their front door. Stop the giants and their army's advancement in this boss battle meet tower defense action game. Victory for you means survival for all.

title: Trapped in the Omniverse
description: FPS single-player de ciencia ficción con supervivencia y exploración interdimensional, donde combatís criaturas anómalas y luchás por sobrevivir en entornos distorsionados.

title: Pixelarium: Free Lands
description: Pixelarium is an open-world roguelike RPG with deep character building, fluid turn-based combat, rich lore, and ASCII-inspired art. Collect unique items, master powerful spells, and embark on quests as you uncover secrets in the Free Lands.

title: Dawn Girl
description: Dawn Girl is a third person 3D anime beauty girl shooting zombie survival game, which takes you into a world attacked by zombies. Players will play as a lonely girl, searching for hope and survival in this shattered world.

title: Tellus: Echo of the Void
description: Adapt a barren world to sustain human life. Explore, gather materials, and establish your base. Then, manipulate the environment by producing air, warmth, and atmospheric pressure to create a living ecosystem.

title: Juggle Star DX
description: JUGGLE STAR DX is an action game where you are to keep balls in the air using your pointer and dexterity! Juggle multiple balls for ultimate cool points and get through the precision levels and physics puzzles!

title: Dice Goblin's Den
description: Dice Goblin's Den is a 2D side-scrolling Tower Defense Roguelite game where you defend your fellow Goblins from waves of "heroes" who have been given quests at the local tavern to pillage and loot your home! Grow your goblin den and strengthen your economy by journeying to different levels to gather more resources while fending off your enemies!

title: Distant Trails
description: Explore open forest, steep mountains and muddy singletrack in this easy-paced outdoor adventure. Take a crew of trail runners out to remote locations to repair damage, protect nature and investigate unexpected events with only their feet for transport and a backpack to carry supplies.

title: Clover's Quadrants
description: A moderately challenging puzzle game where you are what you eat - and you have four stomachs. Your four directions of movement are also inventory slots, and items in those slots will affect only that direction of movement.

title: Midnight Looters
description: Midnight Looters is a 1-4 player co-op horror game where you and your friends explore mysterious forests to find valuable treasures. Face supernatural dangers, collect items, and upgrade your gear to survive the haunted woods.

title: The Zodiac Mystery
description: Step into The Zodiac Mystery, where a suspense-filled adventure begins! Players are immersed in a complex and bewildering cold case, searching for clues across time and space. Examine crime scenes, review files, and analyze evidence, following the trail concealed within a celestial haze.

title: Circuit Stance
description: Circuit Stance is a turn-based strategy game that blends creativity and tactical depth. Players take on the role of a super AI, programming robot AI chips to craft unique strategies, competing in intense arena battles to secure resources and glory.

title: On the Train
description: In a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies, your only sanctuary is a moving train. Build it into a powerful fortress, gather resources, and survive relentless challenges. Play solo or CO-OP, defend against zombie attacks, endure harsh survival conditions, and face this perilous journey together.

title: Winter Survivor Protocol
description: A multiplayer survival game. Players take on the role of survivors in a dire situation, searching for resources, crafting weapons, surviving amidst zombies and unknown dangers, and uncovering the secrets of the catastrophe.

title: Astra Sentinel
description: Astra Sentinel is a wave-based survival RTS where endless alien hordes relentlessly assault your planets. Build defenses, colonize planets and manage resources under constant pressure. Will you be able to recover the control of the galaxy?

title: Data Fantasy
description: Who are you? Why are you the only one who can hear this world weep? To mend it, or to end it? — The choice is yours.

title: Rules: Motel Horizon
description: Start your job as a night administrator at the mysterious Horizon Motel, where visitors from another world try to pass as ordinary people, and the rules have the highest priority — breaking them leads to… undesirable consequences.

title: Nakamon
description: Nakamon is a fast-paced, strategic creature battler. Build your team of 5 Nakamon and outsmart your opponents in dynamic, speed-based combat. With 16 elemental types and a wide variety of moves, every battle offers unique tactical challenges. Enter the arena and prove your skill!

title: Novel Simulator
description: Novel Simulator is an interactive fiction game blending writing and roleplaying. As both author and protagonist, you explore worlds and unlock "cheats" to craft stories across cultivation, sci-fi, wuxia, and urban settings through dynamic choice-driven gameplay.

title: Sky Scaffold
description: A semi-idle incremental factory game where you tame the void of space. Terraform planets, build a colossal Sky Scaffold, and create a galactic industrial empire. Hardcore sandbox gameplay with a blend of simulated markets. [!!]

title: Redstream
description: A hyper-real bodycam horror mission. Infiltrate a derelict shelter broadcasting gore and snuff for the dark web. Find the missing girl — or become the next stream.

title: They Are Rising
description: They Are Rising is an RTS strategy game set against the backdrop of the apocalypse. Combine skills, build a massive army, establish shelters, and fight against large numbers of enemies. How long can you survive?

title: Light: Path of the Archmage
description: Fantasy RPG: shape your own storyline as a wizard, elf, dragon, and more! Play nice for a cozy adventure, or play hostile for some more action!

title: Desktop Raid
description: Assemble your adventure squad on the desktop! Classic RPG meets idle play—no grind, no stress, just nonstop progress. Your heroes fight, level up, and loot while you work or study. Explore rich classes, powerful skills, and thrilling gear drops. RPG excitement, anytime, anywhere!

title: Tree of Knowledge
description: Tree of Knowledge is a roguelite where you beat trivia questions instead of monsters. By using a combination of powerful artifacts, flexible skills and your own general knowledge; try your hand at climbing to the top!

title: All in Vain
description: In a zombie apocalypse, survival is your main goal. All in Vain offers a unique experience: craft weapons, explore a vast open world, fight hordes of zombies and gangs, complete quests, and uncover the mysteries of a shattered world.

title: Stoplights
description: Stoplights is a strategy simulation game about creating an efficient train network to support the growing needs of your cities. Make connections by building rails, control train routes with traffic signals to get essential resources where they need to be - in time.

title: Spaceborne Fighters
description: Spaceborne Fighters is a dynamic action platformer featuring arena battles against hordes of enemies. Explore 10 diverse maps, develop your character through skill trees, and craft items to face challenges in the most spectacular way.

title: Chuck Bonesteel & the Alien Apocalypse
description: Shoot, loot, upgrade, repeat. Fast-paced, gib-filled, over-the-top arcade shooter with stripped-down roguelike gameplay.

title: Bomberball
description: Bomberball is a sci-fi multiplayer sports-shooter hybrid with class-based loadouts. Run, pass, and throw a planet-killer bomb into the opposing team’s rift. Fight in tightly-crafted arenas, and coordinate formations with your teammates. Experience the fast-paced, strategic combat of the future.

title: Field of Polarity
description: A physics-based puzzle game where you control forces, not objects. Shift global fields to move everything at once. Positive and negative charges behave differently, and through transfer, neutralization, and field interactions, small changes trigger chain reactions that reshape the system.

title: Protagonist Complex One
description: Enter a world of mystery, danger, and lightning-fast action in PROTAGONIST COMPLEX one, a pulse-pounding action game that blends the intensity of razor-sharp combat with eerie atmosphere.

title: Chop Chop Together
