description: A chaotic 1–4 player co-op party game where housemates take on ridiculous jobs, earn cash, and put their friendships to the test during the wildest workdays imaginable. Work together under pressure, face unpredictable hazards, and survive fast-paced chaos where teamwork is the only way out.

title: Velvet Hammer
description: Velvet Hammer is an atmospheric tile game that fuses narrative curiosity with meaningful choices: Easy to learn, hard to forget. Over 12 days, you endure , and you navigate inter-day word-matching evaluations that measure (and manipulate) your identity.

title: Managate
description: Survive the onslaught, then capture your attackers to automate your base and forge devastating spells.

title: Race Max Pro
description: Race through Street, Drift, and Drag with real licensed cars. Master every turn, upgrade your ride, and dominate solo or online.

title: Iscoot
description: Indie scooter game

title: Crystant
description: Crystant is a top-down roguelike set in a post-apocalyptic underground facility. Explore tangled tunnels, face strange mutants, and survive with limited resources. Hidden events, deadly traps, and clues await. Will you uncover the truth or fall into the darkness?

title: Submerged Lights
description: After traveling to a country town to move into the house he inherited, Andrew finds the town flooded. While wondering what to do, he spots a dim light coming from the flooded library, in the middle of the night. Investigating, he finds that it belongs to a small fairy, trapped inside of a lantern...

title: Pseudoregalia Rando
description: A complete rando for Pseudoregalia! shuffles abilities, health pickups and keys while keeping the game beatable so you can enjoy this game for even longer!

title: Uktena 64
description: Jebadiah gets a bounty hunting job from the CDC to stop diseased animals from spreading a deadly virus, which is causing them to change in strange ways. Hunt diseased animals, take their pictures, and discover the source of the corruption.

title: Rose of Meat
description: One day while out fishing, your boat crashes into a mysterious island. An island watching you with its big dead eyes. The islanders are frozen in a mad dance, mumbling the name Rose. You know it's better to leave, but you've always been drawn to strange things. Armed with a revolver and a talking leg of meat, venture forth and embrace the madness.

title: The Knight of Niraking
description: Play as the hero to save the land of Niraking from the Nohak Lord. Explore dungeons, castles, and ancient temples. Fight bosses and natural beasts to gather more gear or progress in the story. Talk to NPCs and add some of them to your party to advance your quest.

title: Seraphixial
description: After a father receives a letter from his estranged daughter, he discovers the commune she joined is not what it seems. Following a set of strange coordinates far offshore, he finds a submarine that leads to another world. He quickly discovers this world contains a variety of aggressive creatures. He must fight to find his daughter and escape... or will this world swallow him whole?

title: The Fruit
description: Explore Ravenshollow and the surrounding woods in search of your beloved in this openworld survival horror FPS. Stealth past or engage in combat with the maniacal local inhabitants using your axe and trapdoor rifle. Employ your leather bound grimoire to note down your discoveries of an ancient language and utilise them to unlock new areas. Piece together the tragic events that transpired in Ravenshollow and find your partner.

title: The House Unrest
description: After an old priest performs a profane ritual of everlasting life, he unwittingly invites the plague demon Asakku into our realm. Searching to right his wrongs and save our reality, he contacts you, a mysterious demon-hunting priest. Armed with a gun and the light of God, you must battle the flesh given form and banish Asakku back to where he came from.

title: Hunsvotti
description: Finland, 1888. The locals are celebrating Juhannus, a nightless night in midsummer said to hold magical power. A ritual must be completed.

title: Penguin Wars
description: Join Riley and his friends on their journey to Gira Gira land. Collect items and earn candy to evolve your favorite character. You can also buy "Gira Skills" that let you learn special moves for each character. You can play one on one, two on two, or even play with different rules such as using bombs and other items against your opponents. Each character has a different skill set so make sure to use and master appropriate characters to help you on your journey.

title: Gallerie
description: The paint whispers in an infamous art gallery where mysterious disappearances have occurred.

title: Mega Carrier Simulator
description: Mega Carrier Simulator puts you behind the wheel of powerful heavy-duty transport vehicles built to haul oversized cargo across challenging routes.

title: The Book of Blood
description: The night signals closing time at Pomeroy Grasslands carnival and its employee Trevor volunteers to lock up. Alone in his booth, with a strange book in Lost and Found, a man steps out of the darkness and hands Trevor a note: “let me in.”

title: Minos Trials
description: Step into the arena of Minos Trials, a 2D puzzle-platformer where brute strength and sharp thinking go hand in hand. Control Minos, a not-so-patient minotaur who solves problems with punches, pushing blocks, filling pits, activating pressure plates, and crushing nosy adventurers who insist on stealing his treasure.

title: Karao
description: A late night of karaoke. A wrong turn. Singing? Where did the train station come from, and where does it go?

title: Runt
description: Runt is a rural gothic visual novel mystery where you follow the story of Runt, the youngest of five brothers, surviving a monstrous post-apocalypse.

title: Paguroideo
description: Paguroideo is a visual novel that uses elements like surrealism and dissociation to explore themes of alienation, identity, and aquariums, I think?

title: The Gaming Cafe
description: Build, run, and grow your own Gaming Cafe. Set up gaming stations, manage customer flow, and boost profits by selling drinks and shelf products.

title: Codex Combat
description: Create a legendary spellbook to battle history's greatest mages in this arcane autobattler! Pick a hero, fill your codex with powerful sigils, cast mighty spells, discover ancient relics, and fulfill your destiny in this turn-based online PvP arena.

title: Rotten Stigma
description: 12 children disappeared at the Gallagher Sports Center in 2006. Neal, a retired policeman, finds the courage to investigate.

title: Drft
description: DRFT is a physics-based arena shooter. Weaponize the raw momentum of every drift to supercharge into an invulnerable wrecking ball. Shred waves of foes and bounce off walls to survive. Between runs, stack upgrades to turn your hard-to-handle hatchback into a screen-clearing machine of destruction.

title: Run Gor I
description: Run Gor I is a video game of dreams. Overcome them and persist. Feed and consume, it’s you, only you. Who will cause all this? Discover it with skill.

title: Ancient Wars: Sparta HD
description: Relive the epic battles between Spartans, Persians, and Egyptians in Ancient Wars: Sparta HD. Enjoy HD graphics, asymmetric civilizations, enhanced campaigns, new maps, smarter AI, and a revamped multiplayer mode. Forge your empire, master warfare, and make history in the Ancient World!

title: Chefs Arena
description: Chefs Arena is a competitive party game you can play with your friends, family or online strangers. Cook dishes from whacky ingredients, fight monsters, sabotage, steal and feed an ever-hungry King.

title: Core Descent
description: Core Descent is a puzzle-platformer set in a vivid world filled with puzzles to solve, items to collect, and secrets to find.

title: Full Bet: Fighting Casino
description: A 1v1 turn-based fighting card battle set in a casino!Bet your chips and fight for the right to strike!Luck and strategy, nerve and intellect—everything will be tested ina thrilling battle where the tide can turn in an instant.Outplay your opponent, seize victory, and claim your rewards!

title: Grave Dodgers
description: Grave Dodgers is a 2D, pixel art, dodgeball brawler for 2-4 players. Throw, dodge, and parry your way through a silly version of hell as one of the underworld's kooky characters. Inspired by our favorite local couch multiplayer games - but in hell! Kill your friends and have a ball!

title: Villain: Path of the Necromancer
description: You are an Osteurgo, a lesser necromancer risen from the ashes of the Dark Lord. Raise your empire among desolate mountains, subjugate savage tribes, and spread corruption. Build, conquer, withstand enemy hordes, and claim the empty throne of evil.

title: Final Frost
description: Create your own story from the ashes of civilization, navigating treacherous terrains and fractured societies that have adapted to a harsh new reality. Build a base, forge alliances, or roam freely, battling for survival and shaping your journey with every decision.

title: Roll & Risk
description: Roll & Risk is a deck-building roguelite where every card and dice decision matters. Face rising challenges, chain powerful combos, unlock new cards, and push your limits… but beware: curses can ruin your entire run.

title: Cbs: The Beginning
description: Just like how it used to be; fight your way through the story of disasters and heroism in this turn based, combat heavy, story driven dystopian sci-fi rpg. CBS: The Beginning is a spinoff of the classic turn-based rpg rules embedded to the world of 'DOTD' with rules unique to itself and fresh story.

title: Lost Call
description: Lost Call is a top down pixel art 2D Zelda inspired game with a metroidvania style map. Take off on a quest through an abandoned and ruined town to stop your phone from ringing all the time, and learn more about the characters who still remain within it.

title: Tile Trials
description: Tile Trials is a tile-placing, number based puzzle game for the casual strategist. Place a variety of familiar shapes onto increasingly difficult layouts to maximize your score and surpass each level threshold. Iterative gameplay, mind bending challenges, and hand-crafted puzzles await!

title: Trail of the Cryptid
description: Uncover the mysteries lurking in the wilderness. Team up with friends to find a creature that is stalking people. Gather evidence using stealth or confront the creature head-on in this thrilling co-op survival adventure.

title: Queen of the Community
description: Tackle the challenge of raising a little girl into adulthood under the harsh conditions of a Brazilian favela. Be the girl's adoptive father or mother! Buy her clothes, furniture and other objects, change her haircut and more! She can befriend several kids! Your choices will define her future!

title: Scarlet Backrooms
description: A Supernatural Multidimensional Puzzle Liminal Exploration Game The Scarlet Dimension is meant to be a purgatory.

title: Alex & Arty
description: Two souls, one mission: restore a dying world together! A planet is on the brink. Two unexpected allies. Combine exploration, engineering, and magic to save a world devastated by greed… and build new hope.

title: HaeTae: Guardians
description: A challenging top-down fantasy action game set in mythological Joseon. Master precise dodging and synergy with the divine beast, Haetae, to purify the corruption. Forge your build and conquer the 'Chambers of Challenge'—where elite foes and unique rules await those seeking a true test of skill.

title: Super Chili Man
description: Welcome to this hilarious and chaotic two-player co-op platformer! Team up with a friend and take turns controlling the same chili pepper as you climb ever higher through a giant pot filled with vegetables, fruits, and all kinds of food!

title: Korinki
description: In Korinki you play as the dinosaur Archie. Fight and survive the arenas as the new chosen gladiator. Craft your weapons on the spot and take on the challenges each different arena provides. Discover your playstyle with the multiple skilltrees.

title: Neon Grid
description: Neon Grid is a 2D online multiplayer experience based on Snake and TRON. Boost, dash, and trap your opponents until only one person or team is left standing. Leave behind a trail that fills the map as you play, navigate through it with care, as hitting any obstacle means imminent death.

title: Koltera 2
description: Gather resources, craft items, and grow a team of creatures in this relaxed incremental idler RPG. Automate your skills, send creatures on expeditions, and keep progressing even while offline.

title: Puppy Park
description: Run your very own Puppy Park — a tiny dog hotel for pups of every breed and personality! Feed them yummy snacks, pamper them with grooming, and embark on adventures. Earn their love, grow your reputation, and fill your hotel with wagging tails and happy barks! Play daily in bite-sized chunks!

title: Atomcraft
description: Adventure in a world where every pixel is physically and chemically simulated! In this ever-evolving sandbox, creativity meets chaos, and the only limit is your imagination!

title: X Burger
description: Welcome to X Burger! Today is May 28th, World Burger Day. Tomorrow is May 28th. And the day after that. The celebration never ends here. Until the party is over and the 'bill' comes due. Just smile and keep working.

title: Combat Pilot: Carrier Qualification
description: Combat Pilot is a hardcore combat flight-simulation set in the Pacific Theater during WWII. Our Carrier Qualification title represents the first step in the product's roadmap, offering basic carrier and land operations for the legendary USN/USMC F4F-4 and IJN A6M2 Mod.21 "Zero" fighter planes.

title: Escape from 8-Bit High
description: When a cursed cassette awakens a sentient Pomodore 64, Cloudydale High is overrun by 8-bit villains! Join alt-rock trio Blueberry Finn—Hank, Duck, and Alex—as they battle mole men, aliens, dinosaurs and more in a bizarre, musical quest to save the world!

title: A Little Less Desperation
description: When a peaceful farmer is abducted by an alien, he cannot imagine how this experience will turn him into a hero that needs to save the galaxy. Suddenly, alien abduction is funny again.

title: Zombie Assault: Resurgence
description: Zombie Assault: Resurgence is an intense, action packed top-down shooter, featuring deep RPG elements. Customise your loadout with unique upgradeable weapons as you gear up to take on hordes of enemies. Play solo or team up in co-op with up to 4 players.

title: Spirit Guardian
description: A daycare haunted by something sinister. Cries for help echo from its empty halls.

title: Artemis VR
description: As an Artemis astronaut, face the challenges of space flight in the newest manned system that will take humanity back to the Moon thanks to NASA resources and consultation in terms of Artemis MIssions. Manage the mission using VR glasses.

title: Obscure Chronicle of Dynastia
description: The vast Anti-Dong Zhuo's Coalition has now scattered, and the era belonging to the warlords of East of Hangu Pass has just begun. Those heroes of Three Kingdoms Period, Yuan Shao, Cao Cao, Liu Bei, and Lü Bu, are now all fighting to win the stakes in the Central Plain of China.

title: Abduct 'em
description: To take back earth, you must disarm its violent occupants. Abduct 'Em is an isometric sandbox roguelike that has you in control of an upgradable UFO! Snatch humans to unlock upgrades, obliterate destructible cities while exploring hidden secrets on the path to neutralize the human threat to earth.

title: Dungeon Twist
description: Dungeon Twist is a turn-based tactical game focused on free-for-all multiplayer matches.Join a gang of filthy rogues and manipulate the Shifting Dungeon, an ever-changing maze full of loot and hazards.Trick your opponents, grab the Treasure… and get out alive!

title: Fleeting Shores
description: Race against a 3-year death clock in this economic Roguelite. Sail the Mediterranean, exploit extreme market surges, and amass 500 million gold. Fail the run? Inherit your treasures into the next playthrough and continue the struggle to defy destiny!

title: Candy Bandits
description: Jump in with 4–10 friends for a bright and chaotic multiplayer party game. Grab candies, capture bandits, and battle it out across exciting environments. It’s a game night like no other!

title: Kori
description: A psychedelic puzzle game, that wants you to unravel the hidden secrets within the shadows.

title: Dragon Care Tarot
description: Have you ever wanted to care for your very own dragon? Enter the cozy world of Dragon Care Tarot, the virtual pet game where you encourage your dragons to grow, explore colorful islands, and get a glimpse of your future.

title: This Place at the End: An Apocalyptic RPG
description: This Place at the End is a tactical, turn-based RPG about moving forward at the end of the world. 30 in-game days, 30 real-time hours, and 12 ways to reach the end.

title: Handsome and Brave
description: Use the Knight's indestructible ragdoll body to embark on an epic adventure to solve puzzles, fix problems, and save the Kingdom

title: Waaaaaa: A Prehistoric Adventure With Aliens
description: WAAAAAA is a silent, funny prehistoric adventure full of grunts. Solve puzzles, recruit quirky companions, and save the world in this 'Solo Dev' labor of love. Sometimes, a scream is all you need to make yourself heard!

title: BaulaQuest
description: Local middle school teacher fights angry orange bald man army with marbles and furry creatures. Baula. Quest. BaulaQuest.

title: Insect
description: A bitter BULLET HELL SHOOTER...

title: Survival of Runt
description: The truth belongs only to those who survive." 50 players bet their actual lifespan (Time) to enter the DEADZONE, or write a grand epic in CONQUEST. In a world where order has collapsed, what will define you? Death is not the end. Rise as a Zombie to hunt survivors and reclaim your lost time.

title: Meow Craft
description: Cursed by the Demon Dragon, you—an adventurer cat—can no longer lift a sword! In Meow Craft, flex your paws to run a blacksmith shop, recruit cute staff, and arm heroes. If you can’t fight, forge the god-tier gear needed to break the curse!

title: Fruits vs. Veggies
description: Fruits Vs Veggies is a team-based party platformer where you and your friends compete in a series of fast-paced minigames. Put your skills to the test by using a range of items to outperform your foes, or explore the vast campaign to uncover the origins of the carnage.

title: Starship Crafter
description: Take on the role of a starship mechanic and repay the immense debt your father left behind. Upgrade your workshop, craft components, build starships, complete contracts, follow unfolding events through the in-game newspaper, and most importantly, repay the debt before the deadline

title: The Paths We Cross
description: Explore Lavyn and its surroundings in this mix between Metroidvania and Tower Defense / RTS. Fight various enemies, unlock new abilities, activate and defend stone cores, build mighty towers and meet unique characters who might help you on your mission.

title: We Never Left
description: We Never Left is a hybrid first-person / text-adventure narrative horror game inspired by '80s horror films as well as No Code's Stories Untold, it was developed as part of the Dread X Collection 5 anthology game. All 12 developers in the collection were tasked to make a unique game in 2 months that fit the unifying theme of "entertainment". Dread X Collection 5 is currently available on Steam.

title: A Quest to Be the Best
description: “A Quest to Be the Best” is exactly that. Build your character and clash against an endless gauntlet of player-created champions in this auto battler until you become the legend everyone else must overcome.

title: Face the Immortal
description: This is a 2D platform ARPG game rooted in a Taoist mystical cosmology, blending Diablo-style equipment affixes, Metroidvania exploration elements, and light Rogue-like mechanics.

title: Baby Snow and the Shards of Tiger's Bane
description: Take on the role of the courageous Baby Snow as he battles with the tiger's who have attacked his home and captured the Lady Penelope.

title: Sylva: Curse of the Demon Woods
description: Take the role of a nameless knight seeking repentance in a God-forsaken village in Sylva - Curse of the Demon Woods, a game about inner and outward exploration, chivalric action, featuring Metroidvania and Souls-like elements with a heavy focus on narrative and worldbuilding.

title: Life of Delivery
description: Open-world delivery simulator where you bring orders to customers, upgrade vehicles, and encounter slice-of-life events. Meet people, help them, and enjoy unexpected conversations and opportunities on your journey.

title: Zaxoid
description: Defend your planet in this twin-stick mayhem shooter. Rip through alien hordes across a seamless spherical battlefield while upgrading your ship and fortifying your city.

title: Auto Chess Souls
description: Auto Chess Souls is a casual strategy adventure game that combines auto-chess and roguelike elements. Through consecutive choices, your team grows increasingly stronger. Explore the unknown tower, collect powerful equipment, create unique powerful combinations. Embark on this exciting adventure now!

title: Second Saga
description: Second Saga is an adventure RPG where you can level up, raise your stats, learn from an extensive skill tree, and make important decisions while traversing a large, expansive, and rich stylized 2D world.

title: Hurling Herman
description: A unique platformer where you hurl vials to create temporary platforms, navigate sprawling caves, and battle creatures. With an original soundtrack and immersive environments, a challenging adventure awaits you.

title: Chomp Hero
description: Puzzly dungeon crawler where enemies move together with you! Plan ahead and chomp them all up.

title: Eggstinct!
description: Eggstinct! is a cooperative, physics-driven dinosaur adventure where you and your friends must work together to rescue fragile eggs and survive chaotic prehistoric hazards.

title: PsyUp
description: An emotional breather disguised as a physics puzzle. Break blocks, solve puzzles, and explore stages inspired by psychological phenomena — each world is a dive into the human mind through the lens of a clinical psychologist.

title: CityZen
description: CityZen is a game about building small cities without stressful mechanics like confusing traffic systems, unexpected disasters or constraining resource management.

title: Apopia: Sugar Coated Tale
description: Apopia: Sugar Coated Tale is a comedic adventure with dark mysteries. Help young girl Mai to find her way home. Progress by solving puzzles and outsmarting enemies in minigames. Make friends and foes with talking animals. Unravel the mystery of Mai’s identity from her dark and blurry memories.

title: The Haunted House: Dark Island
description: Dynamic anime-style battles, reimagined in a turn-based RPG!

title: Shapes of Memory: Jigsaw Puzzle
description: Shapes of Memory brings the tranquility of Suitcase Stories to the traditional jigsaw puzzle format. Choose an illustration from the original game and lose yourself in the calm flow of putting pieces together. A Zen experience to organize your mind and complete beautiful images without rushing.

title: Trypan
description: TRYPAN - A survival horror experience centered on exploration, resourcefulness, and sheer will to survive. Investigate your father's disappearance in the abandoned town of Stagmon.

title: Beyond the Eyes
description: A 2d game with a view from above, where you are in the shoes of a blind protagonist and have to find a way to escape from a mansion by collecting various items scattered around it at random while being chased by a monster.

title: Hans in the Internetz
description: Hans is a first-person adventure game that doesn’t take itself too seriously. Each level offers unique mechanics, with a strong focus on platforming (jump and run) and puzzle-solving elements. As you journey through the internet, expect plenty of meme-inspired humor and references along the way!

title: The Maker Way
description: Build creative machines, rovers, drones or robots. Use them to gather resources, discover new machine parts, source energy, construct bases and battle enemy factions in a physics-based open world.

title: Paid in Blood
description: Bet your blood in a twisted baccarat game to pay off your mob debt.

title: Project Microchip
description: A social deduction survival game set in a radiation-filled, abandoned forest. Survivors must complete tasks to stay alive, while the Infected hunt them down.

title: Tiny Escape
description: Take a step into a world where time moves slowly, where the elements are kind, and where each day holds a new chance for peaceful discovery. Whether you're watching the snow gently fall, collecting resources, the world is yours to enjoy. Relax, breathe, and let the world embrace you.

title: Draeggoria
description: Master core parkour skills—wall running, jumping, and gliding—in this high-difficulty 3D challenge. Overcome varied terrain and deadly traps to achieve extreme speed and fluid, perfect execution.

title: Resver
description: Night about town dancing the troubles away till the garbage trucks chime. Rinse and repeat, clock in clock out. Tonight? That new place Resver. Get moving, your friends are waiting…

title: Snack Invaders
description: Slipping into a junk food‑induced coma during a late‑night movie marathon, you wake up as an astronaut stranded in a galaxy overrun by living junk food! Play solo or co‑op online with up to 3 friends (4 players max) to battle hordes of junk food and Souls‑like bosses as you fight to escape alive!

title: For Stella
description: For Stella is an interactive narrative game centered around psychological disorders. “Why would someone who has spent their entire life suppressing their emotions suddenly pull you aside to talk about love?”

title: One Wee Robot
description: Help Bobby on a time-hopping adventure to save the universe! One Wee Robot is a 3D action-platformer where precision platforming meets fast-paced combat. Equip a different weapon on each arm and master creative combos as you battle through time to retrieve the Chronomodulator!

title: Ludomalica
description: It’s past midnight and mom and dad are gone for the weekend. There’s no better time than now to try playing Ludomalica. It’s just a board game, right? But something feels … wrong.

title: Squeakross: Free Content Update
description: This free content update for Squeakross: Home Squeak Home adds 236 new puzzles to the game - "The Spirit and the Mouse" and "Home Squeak Home #3" catalogues - and quality-of-life changes.

title: Beyond the Curtain
description: A young child falls asleep during a puppet show and awakes alone in an old, musty theater. Finding all the doors to be bricked over, the child must face the darkness that lies beyond the curtains.

title: Tractor Racers
description: Tractor Racers is a single-player racing and challenge-based game where players take control of powerful tractors and compete across 12 unique challenges, each designed to test driving skill, balance, speed, and strategy.

title: Interim
description: Alfred moved to Hollywood, with nothing more than a few dollars in his pocket, and a dream in his heart. A dream to be front and center as the leading man in a major motion picture. All eyes would be on him, in the INTERIM.

title: Oddinary Farm
description: Stuck on an alien TV show where your death is entertainment, you must escape a variety of bizarre islands filled with riches and deadly creatures before impending doom consumes you.

title: Remnant Generation: Prologue
description: Remnant Generation: Prologue is a first-person atmospheric horror set in a secret underground laboratory. An experiment with the Fourth Dimension went wrong. You are alone, cut off from support. The creature cannot be killed — only avoided as you explore and try to escape.

title: Florani Match
description: Combine creatures and flowers to trigger exciting synergies in this cozy hand drawn roguelike puzzler. Discover and collect hundreds of Florani to unlock new combos and power ups.

title: Humanity's Fall
description: Explore the world of Humanity's Fall, a fantasy farming sim. Interact and build a community with the world's next apex lifeform. Build your farm and rediscover lost flora as you discover the world's lore.

title: First Time Mom
description: First Time Mom is a female-oriented simulation game that includes career development, raising a daughter, and managing a family. Players will progress from being an online writer to a director, accompany their daughter until she turns 18, and enjoy sweet interactions with her husband.

title: Pretty Girls Don’t Want You to Die
description: "Pretty Girls Don't Want You to Die" is a game that combines strategy tower defense, survivor-like elements, and auto-battler mechanics. you, an lone hero who, in a desperate situation, unexpectedly receives a blessing from pretty girls, narrowly escaping death.

title: Date the Difference
description: Date the Difference is a casual puzzle game where you spot differences between images while enjoying a light dating-themed atmosphere. Explore stylish scenes, find hidden details, earn rewards, and unlock charming characters through relaxing, attention-based gameplay.

title: MaoMaoMao
description: Turn your productivity into currency! MaoMaoMao is a cozy desktop companion where typing on your keyboard earns you coins. Adopt 20+ unique cats, discover their secret quirks, and decorate their Room and Garden. Watch them climb, sleep and occasionally break your furniture while you working.

title: Boxpast Lov3you
description: Inspired by the true global virus outbreak of 2000. Play as BOXPAST, a forgotten defense program awakened as a familiar PC. Forge weapons from computer parts and fight to stop the mad AI "evolution" of the very father who created you, before all of humanity is permanently purged.

title: BuGarden
description: 《BuGarden》 is a cozy idle flower-growing game that lives in the corner of your desktop. Plant seeds, water and fertilize them at your own pace, harvest cute flowers and fruits, and deal with a few playful bugs—nothing messy, just a calm little garden keeping you company.

title: The Long Drift
description: Build, upgrade, and watch your tiny universe evolve.

title: Tiny Hoops: Idle Shooter
description: Tiny Hoops is a relaxing idle basketball game you can play at the bottom of your screen while focusing on other tasks. Upgrade your character, watch the game unfold, or make a few shots whenever you want to speed up your progress.

title: Galaxy Pirates
description: An idle auto-battler that fights epic battles in the corner of your screen while you conquer your day.

title: Rina's Undercover Train Operation
description: A rouge-lite simulation animated game where you play as Rina, a special investigator with psychic powers that aims to cut down crime rate on trains. Upgrade your skills, combine them, and take down your enemies before they get you! Oh, and have fun changing Rina's outfits too!

title: Shenjing
description: "Shenjing" is a side-scrolling mystery game set in the Ming Dynasty. Players begin with an amnesiac identity and must investigate evidence, witness testimonies, and meticulously piece together clues to uncover the truth behind each case and determine whether the characters were involved.

title: Fevered Fantasy
description: A light and fast-paced roguelike deck-builder! Play as a drinker drifting between dreams and reality. With every glass you down, you slip deeper into delightful fantasies. Build your fantasies, keep your alcohol level in the optimal range each round, and chase ever-higher Fantasy Scores!

title: Let’s Fall in Love
description: We Fall in Love — Bringing Romance Quietly to Your Desktop We Fall in Love is a romance-focused social desktop pet game. Here, you're not just raising an adorable desktop companion—you're meeting that special someone on the other side of the world and beginning a sweet romantic journey together.

title: Three Kingdoms Club Manager
description: Choose various factions from the Three Kingdoms period to run your club, hire, trade and cultivate military generals, and strive to compete in high-level leagues and cup tournaments.

title: Forsaker: ​Innocent Paws
description: To find the noble's cat, you've come to the calamity-filled Witch's Forest—eerie and trap-ridden. As Divine Knight Feyz, evade dangers, befriend companions, and interact with the forest's "little cats" to solve mysteries and complete your mission!

title: Otaku and Bubbly Girl
description: This is a short, single-route romantic comedy visual novel. It tells the story of an otaku and a bubbly girl creating a game together. The game offers a 2 to 3 hour experience and includes 7 event CGs. Game has several choices that do not affect the story. The story leads to a single happy ending.

title: Caten Village
description: As war erupts between the Dominion and the Kingdom Iori, from the borderlands, is drawn into the chaos This is a story-driven traditional turn-based RPG, where players embark on an adventure across a war-torn continent, and witness conflicts that will change the fate of the entire world

title: 5-Minute Maid
description: Rimu has lost her memory and become trapped in a looping phenomenon. Moreover, only a tiny fraction of her memories carry over between loops. Within each five-minute cycle, she must retain only the crucial “memories” while setting the necessary flags. Will Rimu ever regain her memories?

title: Please Weave the Red Stars Into a Shroud for Wrapping the Corpse
description: This is a forgotten tale that took place in a now-extinct country.

title: Countermark Saga: League Gods
description: Former inter-dimensional adventurers Luo Wenhao and Lin Youyue, now living ordinary lives, are reunited by the ancient Canonization of the Gods. The book suddenly unleashes its power, devouring them and thrusting them into a new journey across worlds.

title: Matrix Mahjong
description: A single-player card game adapted from the Chinese National Standard Mahjong, focusing on diverse winning hands and scoring with Faan combinations. Meld the tiles horizontally and vertically and utilize items of rule variations. Experience mahjong within an intricately interwoven tile space.

title: Astral-Battlecraft
description: 3D Rogue Game Space Battleship Rogue Game light Tactical System, Inertia System, Drift System DIY Weapons: Flexible weapon customization with independent cooldowns. Weapons can be destroyed.

title: Book of the Abyss

description: Squash waves of nasty bugs! Swat them, kill them with fire, or pull out the Orbital Death Laser. Your mouse is your weapon in this EPIC Bullet Heaven Roguelike loaded with crazy weapons, items and upgrades! Now go spank some bugs

title: Hellwire
description: A mathematical hell for 2-4 players where only the thrill matters — our law is ETERNAL GAMBLE. You're a DEMON among demons — play cards, gamble your mind, and smash faces. Luck won't save you.

title: Battlefield 6 Season 2
description:
Battlefield 6: Season 2 is the second season of the Battlefield 6 live service. It was originally teased on October 10th, 2025, before releasing February 17th, 2026. The release was originally to occur in January 2026, but was delayed until February 2026.

The season was released in three phases:
- Extreme Measures on February 17th, 2026
- Nightfall on March 17th, 2026
- Hunter/Prey on April 14th, 2026.

title: Godforsaken Hole Called...
description: Three dimensional horrible marble rollerball in a godforsaken hole called...

title: Unchi
description: A casual roguelite runner where a kid hero fights to save his hamster who pooped itself to death. Play as Ram in a 2d side-scroller, unlocking suits, powers, and cards in a fast, absurd journey to rescue Unchi.

title: Escape Up
description: Escape Up if you can. Climb the tower and defeat the monsters as you try to escape. Killing all the monsters in a room will unlock the next room. Challenge others climbers on the leaderboards and see how fast you can manage to escape. Ready, set, climb!

title: Halloween Filled With Cats
description: Purrfectly Spooky Halloween awaits you! Dive into hand-drawn Halloween scene filled with cute, sneaky cats hiding in every corner. Relax, explore whimsical illustration, enjoy subtle animations, and see how many feline friends you can find in this cozy hidden object adventure.

title: Small Town Filled With Cats
description: Small Town Filled With Cats is a cozy hidden object game where every corner of a charming, hand-drawn town is hiding cats. Explore five whimsical illustrated scenes, spot playful animations, and uncover all the sneaky felines tucked away in this delightful small town.

title: Caterpillar Committee
description:
Welcome to the Caterpillar Committee!

Caterpillars from all around the world come here to be painted in curious colours.

What incredible caterpillar art will you create with your fellow artists?

title: Flowsxty
description: FLOWSXTY is a brutal, beautiful 3D trench runner where you dodge in four lanes and fight to survive to 60 seconds to clear a mode.

title: Yellowcreek Stories: The Cabin Watcher
description: A masked killer hunts you in the dark. Manage noise and light, hide quickly, and survive this intense 60–90 minute first-person stealth horror experience inspired by classic 80s slasher films.

title: Get Glue
description: Your toy is broken. It must be fixed.

title: Island Restoration
description: Bring procedurally generated islands back to life. Explore different biomes and damage scenarios. Relax as you clean, upgrade your tools, rescue wildlife, and watch each island return to its natural beauty. Customize your ship and decorate your own private island.

title: Return to Dark Castle
description:
Return to Dark Castle revives the legendary Macintosh series that defined precision platforming and comic peril.

This definitive edition includes the complete Dark Castle (1986) and Beyond Dark Castle (1987) adventures — rebuilt with color visuals, remastered audio, original music and refined controls — plus 50 all-new rooms created exclusively for this release.

Step into the boots of a new hero on a quest to defeat the Black Knight and reclaim the castle’s secrets. Expect classic challenge, slapstick misfortune, and finely tuned puzzle-platforming that rewards skill and patience.

title: Books of Horror
description: Books of Horror is a first-person horror game where you face Airana, a mysterious AI that controls your captivity. To escape, you must overcome procedurally generated simulations based on ancient “Books of Horror”

title: Cuboy Adventure
description: An exciting and incredibly cute platformer full of parkour, puzzles, action-packed moments, and boss battles awaits you! Collect stars, unlock new abilities, discover secrets, defeat your enemies, and overcome every challenge!

title: Q.U.B.E: Incremental TD
description: Incremental tower defense with chaos on the screen! Destroy enemies or gather resources, upgrade your skills, and expand your range. Choose your strategy: grow your economy, strengthen your defenses, or boost your click efficiency!

title: Tiny Misery
description: A sick mother and her young son move into the home of a lonely old woman. A tragic story inspired by the dark puppet animations of the 80s and 90s.

title: Which Sea Is This?
description: Which Sea Is This? is a local co-op sea adventure where you control a single ship together. Trade, explore, pirate, and argue about directions — because nobody knows where you are.

title: Zombie Defense: Breach of the Undead
description: A dark wave-based zombie defense game where you build your defenses, fight relentless undead hordes, and survive against the infected… and hostile raiders?

title: Scales
description: Scales is a story-driven action-adventure RPG about a human-reptile hybrid. Players devour reptiles to absorb their DNA, and evolve through a corrupt world, where player choices ultimately determine the outcome of the story, blending combat with a darkly comedic narrative.

title: Stray Night
description: Experience a puzzle-build roguelite hack-and-slash adventure. As a stray cat in a nightmare, strategically combine puzzle blocks to customize skills and defeat inner trauma. Overcome the walls of loneliness and discover your true identity through fast-paced combat and permanent progression.

title: Slash-Out: Fantasy Dueling
description: In Slash-Out, master the sword and shield to survive in a land where every fight is a boss fight. Darkness is rising. An ancient evil has returned. Embark on a quest to restore peace, but be warned, a gauntlet of fearsome opponents stand in your way. Many have tried and failed, will you prevail?

title: The Flinch: Unforgiven West
description: To pull the trigger takes guts; to miss invites death. Hunt down 10 sinners in this mouse-only Noir Western. Battle your own nerves and a cursed revolver where hand tremors make every duel a gamble. How steady is your aim?

title: Sweepcremental
description: minesweeper, but with a skill tree.

title: Wasteland With Robots
description: Will you be able to break through the dome, find the ark and save the survivors?

title: Gladiator Ascension
description: Gladiator Ascension is an overpowered incremental gladiatorial experience! Prove yourself in combat and win your freedom!

title: Railstrider
description: Go on road trips with your friends, explore dangerous locations, and return with loot to upgrade your train. Discover new regions and reach the last safe place on earth.

title: Endless Tower
description: Climb an endless tower shrouded in mist. Explore strange biomes, uncover quiet mysteries, and ascend toward the unknown in a peaceful, atmospheric journey focused on movement and discovery.

title: DDOL
description: Don't Destroy On Load" — Souls engraved on the board. DDOL is a strategy game of "Succession" and "Sealing." Channel souls to expand territory. If the flow is severed, the chains of Lock emerge. Outsmart "Breakthrough" cards. Lock the board, deprive options, and reach a rock-solid Checkmate.

title: Pool Loop
description:
You are trapped in an endlessly looping indoor swimming pool. Inspect the pool carefully and look for anomalies.

If anything feels wrong, press the RED button.
If everything seems normal, press the GREEN button.

Make the wrong call, and the loop continues.

title: Very Normal Rail Game
description: very normal rail game is a physics-driven cart game where staying on the rails is the only rule. Control your cart and survive unforgiving rails that punish even the smallest mistake.

title: Suez Canal Training Simulator
description: Command colossal container ships that can turn on a dime and grow a scrappy maritime shipping empire. Load containers, thread tight turns, dodge traffic, upgrade your fleet and try to arrive with at least SOME of your cargo. How hard can it be? If you block the canal, that’s on you.

title: Hail the Devourer
description: Hail the Devourer is a darkly satisfying incremental clicker where destruction becomes progression and razing cities to the ground brings an ancient evil closer to ending it all.

title: Express Rider Simulator
description: Paying rent is tough, but outrunning stray dogs is tougher! Go live in Express Rider Simulator, navigate complex addresses, and hype up your viewers. Manage fuel, handle your accountant, and upgrade your bike while battling dynamic weather. Can you deliver the goods without getting bitten?

title: Beat the Champions
description: Beat the Champions is a fast-paced arcade football game where legendary players clash in explosive matches powered by special abilities. No realism — just speed, skill, and pure competitive chaos.

title: Paunchy Pets
description: Paunchy Pets are your chubby little monsters that love to battle almost as much as they love to eat. Train them in flash-style mini-games, Feed them junk food in a cozy farming sim, Battle opponent’s pets in an autobattler based on skill, and Breed rare Paunchies to bolster your roster.

title: Scrapborne
description: A Helldivers-inspired desktop overlay RPG where your actions shape the universe. Gear up in your bunker and join the galactic struggle from the corner of your screen. Impact the global economy, faction wars, and story. Adapt to World Events in a living, community-driven world.

title: RWS
description: Rolling With Swords is a chaotic 2D arena brawler set in random levels. Chain attacks, roll through danger, and collect absurd power-ups in a tug-of-war system where control constantly shifts until one player claims the entire arena.

title: Crushing Force
description: Crushing force is a fat fur fighting game. Get ready to Crush your opponents with Force! Featuring all kinds of body shapes and fighting styles!

title: Caravan Tactics: For Gold & Glory
description: Caravan Tactics is a roguelite casual RPG with turn-based mechanics. Travel from town to town, deliver goods, fight enemies, and overcome challenging encounters. Assemble your three heroes, each with their own unique abilities, and battle for gold and glory. Will you keep the caravan alive?

title: Powerfuel
description: Powerfuel is an action FPS set in a gritty dieselpunk world. Play as the legendary ex-criminal known as the Cricket, and harness the mystical properties of powerfuels. Fight your way through the gangs of New Lyon and shed light on the conspiracy plaguing the city.

title: Mad Scientist Simulator – Society of World Destruction
description: Ready to join the Society of World Destruction? Craft deadly viruses in your lab, turn humans into zombies, and unleash chaos with your robot companion! Complete missions, evade the police, and climb the ranks to become the ultimate Mad Scientist.

title: Gardener's Luck
description: Use energy to draw plants and items, grow your army, and command the battlefield. A roguelike tower-defense where luck meets tactics—and your garden fights back.

title: Slap Your Homies
description: In Slap your homies, there are no punches — only slaps! Jump into chaotic multiplayer battles against your friends, where perfect timing makes all the difference.

title: Automated Ranch Simulator
description: Design interconnected systems to handle daily operations with minimal manual effort. Raise chickens, sheep, and cows, process eggs, wool, and milk, and turn raw products into profitable goods. Expand your facilities and fulfill growing orders from the nearby town to build a thriving ranch empire.

title: Malware City
description: A skilled hacker has unleashed a powerful trojan. What will happen to the computers it infects? Help Vundo navigate through Malware City, a 2D platformer inspired by the dawn of personal computers. Infect as many systems as you can and become the most feared trojan to ever exist.

title: Odysseon
description: Odysseon is a JRPG style game with an emphasis on characters and story telling. Explore a dreary world populated by strange people and bizarre creatures, pieced together alongside a soundtrack of long forgotten vintage production music.

title: Hentai Nazi Hitler is Back
description:
Hentai Nazi HITLER is Back - You thought it was so easy to stop? No no! He is back, only now, he has friends. Who are they? You should find out. You are expected by 3 different villages, with different features, this is all accompanied by humor and Easter eggs.

Trite? Simply? And you, stop Hitler and his friends, and you find all the secrets and try to survive. Meet me at the end, private.

title: Motion Serpentine
description: Motion Serpentine puts you in direct control through your webcam—your hand movements guide the snake in real time. Tackle five solo modes or compete in global 1v1 ranked duels. Activate powers like speed boosts and vision expansion with intuitive gestures.

title: Hygrim
description: RPG meets minigames! Defeat monsters by playing minigames and level up to get stronger!

title: Fritz Chess 20 Steam Edition
description: Fritz 20 is more than just a chess engine - it's your personal trainer, toughest opponent, and strongest ally. Whether you're just starting out or already playing at tournament level, Fritz 20 helps you train smarter, faster, and more effectively than ever before.

title: Xombee MPFPS
description: Single or Online Multiplayer First Person Shooter

title: Sānguó: Móu Dìng Tiānxià
description: Three Kingdoms: Strategy for the World is a free-to-play strategy game available on Android, immersing players in the tumultuous world of the Three Kingdoms. With six distinct professions, including strategic roles like strategist (奇佐) and general (鎮軍), players can experience varied gameplay that emphasizes tactical planning and resource management. The game allows for dynamic interactions with allies, enabling players to execute complex strategies such as ambushes and supply line disruptions, transforming traditional strategy mechanics into engaging and exciting gameplay.

title: 2112TD Earth
description: The ULTIMATE tower defense onslaught is back. Bigger, deadlier, and more action-packed. Build autonomous defenses, deploy tactical drones, and unleash devastating support abilities in this epic, old-school RTS-inspired sci-fi adventure.

title: Come Right Inn: Season 1
description: The Come Right Inn, a 5-star LA hotel, offers the elite anything they desire, as long as they’re willing to pay. Your sister worked there until her mysterious disappearance six months ago. Now, it's up to you to uncover the hidden truths behind the allure and find out what really happened.

title: RIP Love: A Story of Pain
description: RIP Love: A Story of Pain is a narrative-driven experience about love, loss, and betrayal. Explore the emotional weight of grief and depression through interactive storytelling, atmospheric design

title: Beware of the Cartographer!
description:
A young cartographer is sent out by his hierarchy into the rural land of his childhood to redraw a frontier: he will gradually discover that this place, which for him was just a set of inky territories, is actually steeped in stories, inhabited by people who have no idea what's going on around them and whose relationship to space is radically different...
The player embodies a land surveyor who explores a rural territory and must make choices that will have an impact on diplomacy, but also on the local population. The game combines visual novel phases and observational puzzles — the two aspects nourishing each other to modify the plot of an interactive story.

title: Mobile Droid Gumda
description: Build, upgrade, and research mechs, weapons, and components. Manage employees and expand your base. Explore and collect resources. Find wanted mechs, destroy them, and collect bounties. Explore the post-nuclear wasteland and make the choices you believe are right.

title: Adolf Hitler Humiliation Simulator
description: hitler Humiliation Simulator

title: Legend Battles
description: Free-to-play UE 5.6 Extraction Battle Royale in 400 km² neo-futuristic world with destructible environment and vehicles, massive ET-ACUs, armored Aliens, ferocious Monsters, heavily armed MetaHumans, complete missions to attack, defend, loot, extract facing dynamic weathers.

title: Poker Fate
description: Poker Fate is an anime-style Texas Hold'em game featuring beautiful heroines. It combines easy-to-learn tutorials for beginners, high-stakes duels for top players, and a variety of thrilling tournaments. Join now and uncover the cards of your destiny with us!

title: Prince Fighting Dragon 2
description: A fun game, a game worth playing, cheap and fun.

title: Papercut Art Gallery: Nature II
description: An artistic puzzle game inspired by paper cutting art. Piece together fragments of paper cutouts to restore the nature-themed artworks in the gallery.

title: Lawnmower Game Battle 2: Reload
description: Arena lawnmower game. Collect weapons and shoot and destroy other ai lawnmowers. Survive enough long win battles and collect stars

title: Forage & Brew
description: Forage & Brew is a game where you play as a Cat witch in her potion workshop. Explore the forest, gather ingredients and brew magical potions in order to help the many clients that will come for your aid. How will you decide to live it out each passing day?

title: Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2 Bonus Content
description: As purchase bonuses for the collection edition, it includes Metal Gear: Ghost Babel—the series first title for handheld consoles, released in 2000—and Metal Gear Solid: Digital Soundtrack Vol.2, featuring numerous iconic tracks that enhanced Snake's missions, ranging from BGM used in the games to vocal songs.

title: They Killed Your Cat
description: A short but relentless first-person shooter featuring manual reloading, walking, and blinking, with settings that let you customize your experience.

title: Grass
description: Grab your tools and team up in a cozy co-op or solo lawn care simulator focused on smooth, satisfying teamwork. Mow, trim, water, burn, and clean up sprawling properties as you improve the neighborhood and climb the mower app rankings.

title: Junkyard File
description: A first-person psychological horror game focused on exploration & environmental interaction, where a mysterious “free” pendrive game begins to affect your surroundings. Try them all while you still can.

title: Rosie Planet
description: Rosie Planet is a 3D platformer genre-blender. It is a videogame tribute to videogames. Linear action platform stages, collectathon hub-worlds, open world driving, flying, minigames... shooting!? this game will always keep you guessing what's coming next!

title: Topdeck Automat
description: The roguelike auto-battler where your deck prints itself. Supply a brave worker droid with synergistic blueprints to defend the planet against hordes of alien invaders. Combine hundreds of cards with custom upgrades and infinitely stackable modules to discover broken builds.

title: House of Petals
description: A psychological thriller otome visual novel that blends romance, mystery, and slow-burn horror. Set in a beautifully haunting version of ancient Asia, it invites you to investigate, explore, and survive.

title: Quod
description:
This entire game fits into a 64 KB executable - including all textures, levels, models, animations, sounds, music, and code.

It’s a retro shooter with 3 levels, 1 boss fight, 4 unique enemies, 4 weapons, and a handful of power-ups.

title: Ascension Trail
description: Kill, Die, Repeat! Exterminate massive swarms of monsters in this action-packed, top-down rogue-lite. Dash, hit, and cast through endless mobs where every death is a step toward god-tier power. Hoard coins, buy permanent upgrades, and craft a legendary hero to challenge the Devil on your own terms.

title: Rock On, Raccoon!
description: Rock on Raccoon is a classic 4-key rhythm game. Prove your skills against the other bands to take back your turf! Compete for the top spots on the global leaderboards! Originally, this game was developed for IOS and Android, but has recently been adapted for Windows, Mac, and Web.

title: A little Jumpingspider's Garden Adventure (Day 1+2)
description:
A little Jumpingspider's Garden Adventure is a mix of a 3D platformer and a mini game collection.
You follow the adventures of a cute little jumping spider, which needs to catch food and find a mate.
Each of the 16 levels has it's own unique game mechanics and offers a completely different experience.
Some levels test how fast you can react, others challenge your sense of direction and some are just the joy of collecting things.
Every level has 3 stages of difficulty (easy, normal and hard), which sometimes contain new mechanics and/or enemies.
This game is designed to be family friendly and approachable even for beginners (because of that you don't have to control the camera manually).

title: Flash Knight Nymphelia
description: A selfie-obsessed-girl-turned-transforming-heroine fights against an evil organization in a powered suit fueled with her stress from hiding her true self from public!

title: Mineral Mining Simulator
description: Turns raw rock into valuable minerals and jewelry grade gemstones through a hands on production chain. Mine ore, crush it into fragments, refine it, and scale your operation with better machines and smarter workflow. Optimize every stage of the pipeline to maximize efficiency, quality, and profit.

title: Endless Tactics: Trial Run
description: Endless Tactics: Trial Run is a Turn-Based Roguelite game. Play as the commander of a high-risk planetary mining operation, defend your base from alien creatures while trying not to get overrun. Use resources to upgrade your starship, unlock new tech, powerups, and deadly new worlds to harvest.

title: Kayotica
description: In Kayotica, you play as April—a clever but manipulative student caught in a web of friendship, rivalry, and dark crimes. What begins as ordinary campus life quickly turns into a mystery of betrayal, hidden truths, and a shocking murder. Can you solve the mystery, or will you become the next victim?

title: Fly Cowboy Online
description: Fly Cowboy Online- is a massive free-to-play multiplayer online game centered around a faction war for strategic resources amidst the ruins of civilization. Fierce aerial battles in the devastated world of Naviika await you-conquer the skies or burn trying.

title: Forged: Reconquest
description: Forged: Reconquest is a couch & online co-op blacksmithing RTS for up to 4 players. Team up as master smiths to forge magical gear, arm your armies, and wage war against otherworldly foes in a battle to reclaim your world.

title: Saber Arena
description: 3D action roguelike in space where you battle hordes of aliens with five unique weapon classes. Gather XP, choose upgrades to create unique builds, and beat the final boss — or jump into PvP, picking up diverse weapons from pickups and fighting other players.

title: Fooling Dead
description: On April Fool's Day, the protagonist is caught in eerie supernatural events! As you investigate, uncover the truth behind a past tragedy. Explore chilling scenes, solve mysteries, and face unknown fears—can you survive?

title: Letter to Neml
description: A story about the Noctarian, a race whose nightmares become reality. Small choices made by Neml, a girl staying home alone, shape the fate of the world. The player does only one thing: rewrite the letter sent to Neml. An AI interprets the letter, changing Neml's actions and the story's outcome.

title: Nmnmah
description: A short atmospheric horror game where you play a father searching for his missing son in a quiet neighborhood haunted by a wandering entity inspired by an old Saudi legend. Explore, collect keys and notes, survive encounters, and uncover the truth as the presence stalks you through the night.

title: Misfit: The Rebirth of Death
description: You wake up in a dark place... There's a green girl awaiting you... Enter The Gambling Game to help her to break out the simulation, but watch out... Something doesn't want you to stay.

title: Kupala
description: “Kupala” is a dark, non-linear horror visual novel inspired by Slavic folklore. Little Anya arrives at a village on the eve of Kupala Night — the sacred night of the ancient Slavs. In the quiet old house, her grandmother tells her tales of unclean spirits crossing into the living world...

title: Red Exit Is a Lie
description: A fun and casual anomaly-detection game where you must spot the differences in looping environments through hand-crafted cartoon worlds. Follow the rules: red exit for anomalies, green exit for normal. But what if the rules themselves are the real trap?

title: Apocalypse: The Hunger
description: We clapped the Minion Meta. No armies to manage. No 1/1 tokens to trade. Just you, and the miscreation in front of you. Apocalypse: The Hunger combines deep RPG progression, item crafting, and the tactical return of "The Stack" in a brutal, high-stakes card battler where you play for keeps.

title: Rhea of the Remnant
description: Rhea of the Remnant is a mech Tactical RPG in which you command a small number of allies to defeat a large number of enemies.

title: Null: Remastered
description: Null: Remastered is a murder mystery social deduction visual novel with time travel elements. Discover not only the truth about this twisted game and your universe but also the terrible truth about "YOU"!

title: They're Gonna Get In
description: They're Gonna Get In is an RTS/Roguelite where you play as an advisor to the ruler of a failing kingdom. Your enemy mirrors you. A wall will fall. The only question is whose breaks first.

title: Scrappy Craft
description: Scrappy Craft is a shopkeeping game where you run a small forge. Scavenge trash and combine it to craft over 10000 absurd weapons like banana swords or Frisbee shields, buy upgrades, unlock new recipes and sell your bizarre creations to quirky customers like tie-wearing otters or spaghetti monsters.

title: Dark México
description: This is a focused and intense soulslike, built around a single monumental confrontation where every mistake is costly and every victory is earned through pure skill.

title: Yapori Advance
description: Yapori Advance is a single-player precision platformer where you must overcome various obstacles to progress.

title: Tai Chi Game
description: In this game, you pose the avatar for the awareness ball location. There are 9 possible moves in this game. You score 1 point for each correct pose.

title: Space Memory: Flowers
description: Cute, relaxing memory game where you match pairs of beautiful flowers in space

title: Beast Mask
description: A classic 2D side-scrolling action game where you play as a 'civilized' caveman. Put on a beast mask to gain the power of the beast, defeat monsters and bosses, and unleash the beast within.

title: RoguePool
description: RoguePool is a billiards game infused with roguelike elements. Over 30 types of power-up cards to assist you in tackling higher levels of difficulty.

title: Eel on Mask
description: Eel On Mask is a 2D puzzle-platformer game where you play as the main character, Eel, who possesses the mysterious power of the “Clipping Mask.” Use this ability to freely alter the materials of stickers, solve puzzles across different worlds, and uncover the ultimate truth!

title: Puppe Yerde
description: Puppe Yerde is a calm, casual game where you spend seven days with a small puppy in a quiet garden. There are no battles or game overs. You simply take photos, earn points based on the puppy's behavior, and collect unlockable hats. Designed as a gentle, relaxing experience for players of all ages.

title: Apococlicks
description: Dark horror post-apocalyptic incremental clicker game

title: Tense Parking
description: Tense Parking is an exciting parking and driving simulator that transports you to a vibrant and vibrant metropolis. Get behind the wheel of a car and reach the finish line as quickly as possible before the timer runs out.

title: Screenplay in Autumn
description: A son goes to war.

title: December 3rd
description: December 3rd is the 3rd entry of the 2020 Madvent Calendar, by Vladimere Lhore.

title: Singmetosleep
description:
singmetosleep is an atmospheric, exploration-based interactive narrative. Vast minimalist forms, a stark color palette, and an evocative soundscape.
There are no real monsters.
Not really.

title: Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX 1+2 Dual Collection
description: The apeX of 2D action, the Luminous Avenger iX series, complete and refined. With all DLC and new balance updates, both games reach their peak. Plus an all-new "Endless Battle" mode. This special update is perfect for new and returning players alike.

title: Bee Streamer Idler
description: Bee Streamer Idler is an interactive desktop overlay for streamers! Engage your chatters by turning them into bees that work together to gather pollen and build honeycombs! Use chat commands to control your bee and see how much honey can you collect together!

title: Cup and Counter: Coffee Shop Simulator
description: Build up your very own Cafe. Make a variety of Coffees to keep your customers happy. Keep your Coffee shop well-stocked, money flowing, and you will quickly expand and build the Cafe of your dreams.

title: Megaquarium: Invertebrilliant Collection
description: Cascading coral displays, weird and wonderful critters and game-changing new tank designs make the Invertebrilliant Collection a must-have for Megaquarium enthusiasts!

title: Never Clean
description: A minimalist game about collecting strange and absurd trash. Walk around, pick up items, sell your finds, unlock upgrades, and complete your collection. Play to relax or compete with others for the best time. It costs no more than an everyday small purchase and stays with you forever

title: Metal Hunter
description: This is an imitation of a JRPG with a dual system of humans and tanks. In the ruined wasteland world, humans drive chariots to hunt down various monsters and hunt down powerful wanted criminals. These people are known as 'Metal Hunters' by the world!

title: Operation H.O.P.E.
description: A comic-style tower defense game where The HOPE is humanity’s last weapon. Defend the cure against waves of unique zombies in this stylized top-down zombie survival experience.

title: SkillGrid
description: SkillGrid is a minimalist strategy game where you expand, manage, and defend a growing grid against an evolving hostile force.

title: Patience Balls
description: Patience Balls is a minimalist physics-based puzzle game focused on tilt mechanics and precision. Players navigate one or more balls through intricate labyrinths and mazes to reach designated goal spots. The gameplay emphasizes steady control and logic across multiple themed worlds. It includes global leaderboards and unlockable achievements within a performance-optimized, clean visual style designed for short, meditative sessions.

title: Jesus Sacred Heart
description: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven. JESUS. Matthew 10:33

title: Magistrangers
description: Short kinetic visual novell about three girls get caught in quite misterious situation.

title: LettersFall 110%
description: Game Is A Fun Word Spelling Game (Video Game Tetris Meets Board Game Scrabble)

title: Meta: Assembled
description: Meta: Assembled is a space oriented magical cardgame. Defeat your opponent by attacking his planet and ships, stealing his resources and asteroids and many more actions.

title: Painted Kingdoms
description: Painted Kingdoms is a minimalist strategy game where you paint, build, and defend your Kingdom of paper. Harness the power of paint to protect it from relentless flames and enemy hordes. Will your Painted Kingdom survive the next wave?

title: Slow.Bullet VR
description: Survive, Shoot, and Win! A co-op multiplayer zombie Survival Game, now in VR!

title: GunBoxing
description: GunBoxing is a free-to-play, fast-paced multiplayer shooter with a heavy focus on fighting game mechanics like melee combos/air juggles, parries, ducking and sidestepping attacks to punish, meter for super attacks, etc. combining long range shooting combat with crazy close range melee combat.

title: Ancient Military
description: This game takes the official position as the subject matter, only through ceaselessly kills the enemy to have the opportunity to advance

title: Interactive Empathy
description: Two small experimental games made as part of a one-week game workshop in Zagreb, Croatia, as part of a project called "Interactive Empathy - Citizenship & Storytelling in Video Games". Inside is also a documentary video about the workshop, as well as a booklet about the whole project.

title: Forgotten Playland: Party Edition
description: Step into Forgotten Playland: Party Edition, a 4-player social party game where the attic becomes your Playland and PlushKyn take center stage. Compete, socialize, and express yourself in a beautifully crafted world.

title: Race to Kyiv
description: Race to Kyiv is a little meme-game about a farmer who got tired of the "Bad BoyZ" invading his country. As a driver, you get into a tractor and race to Kyiv to help and defend your main Grain sale point.

title: BloodSpiller
description: BloodSpiller is a retro-action platformer that blends classic visuals and game play with modern flair and attitude.

title: Butt Gunners
description: POOP on your friends. STEAL their gems. WIN the game. Greedy, hungry gnomes trot the globe and duke it out over its plundered treasures. Grab your butt gun, rocket boots and glider and jump into a world of messy fun in this scatological multiplayer FPS powered by idTech.
