Join us in an early version of Kindred Fates and explore Amberwood, a bite-size area of Hinterlock, teeming with Kinfolk to befriend and bond with. Complete puzzles found in the world. Build the perfect team, customize their abilities, and control your Kinfolk in real-time combat. Hone your skills to fight other players in several combat arenas. Form lasting bonds with your team members to unlock their full potential.

title: We Were Here Tomorrow
description: You and your partner are taken to a mysterious facility where communication and cooperation are your lifelines. This asymmetrical co-op adventure will have you uncover secrets that will shape the fate of Tomorrow…

title: Stunts Contest Police Car
description: Going on the most dangerous curves, you will really show who is a master in extreme races. With 5 police supercars, decently equipped, you have all the chances to become No. 1 in the stunt contests.

title: M3nticid3: Control Group
description:
Play as INRI, a patient at a mysterious research facility who was robbed of her memories and autonomy. INRI, along with the other patients, are forced to undergo a series of strange psychological tests where they are administered the experimental drug, Ichor.

INRI’s plan to escape is thrown into chaos when she is suddenly moved into a new room with KZKR, FEFO, and OORR. Can the four of them uncover the facility’s secrets and escape with their lives, or will they lose themselves trying?

title: The Homecoming Exhibition
description: A high-fidelity immersive gallery experience that places you into fully interactive 3D world of modern art, sculptures, and culture as you explore the minimalist environment inspired by Hiroshi Senju's Museum. Experience the future of art with groundbreaking work of Nako Baev.

title: Necrophosis: Full Consciousness
description:
The complete experience comes alive in Necrophosis: Full Consciousness, a first-person psychological horror adventure with engrossing puzzles that plunges you into a surreal haunting world where only death endures.

Begin as Consciousness, trapped within an emaciated, decaying vessel devoid of memories. Explore grotesque environments cursed with eternal deterioration to unravel fragments of the truth and learn why you have awakened. Soon your journey descends into the darker realms of the subconscious as you become the guiding hand that navigates its shadowy depths while piecing together echoes of the past.

Long forsaken gods have been left to rot beyond eternity, yet something still calls. Prepare for a dark odyssey where every disturbing encounter and mind-expanding puzzle will draw you deeper into the macabre.

title: Retro Gunner
description:
A retro-style shoot 'em up created with the fantasy console “TIC-80”.

Choose your favorite craft from 4 player characters and 2 bomb types,

and conquer all 5 stages (totaling 15 areas)!

Features ARCADE mode, TEAMPLAY mode and BOSSRUSH mode.

title: Warthog Rally
description:
Start your engines! Prove your driving skills and win trophies in every race track! Unlock all 15 vehicles and customize your experience to your liking!
Warthog Rally is a campaign mod that let's you race against the time to win trophies. You will unlock more vehicles as you win trophies. You can also choose to spawn in a bunch of enemies and add some passengers in your vehicle.

title: Sprawl Zero
description: Sprawl Zero is a fast-paced shooter inspired by the Golden Age of 2000s FPS. Survive a brutal cyberpunk city collapsing under military rule and cult fanaticism. Use your Gravity-Gloves, augments, and an arsenal of over 40 weapons to crush those who stand in your way.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader - The Infinite Museion
description: Delve into a secret vault curated by Trazyn the Infinite himself. Discover Trazyn’s obsession with the Von Valancius dynasty, and choose whether to disrupt or fulfill his plans.

title: Collie Call: The Future Is Calling
description: Collie Call: Sheep Mission in Space

title: LOZT: Legion of Zombie Terrors
description: A military experiment has turned all of the troops into ZOMBIES... With weapons!

title: Echoes of a Thread
description: Echoes of a Thread is a free indie RPG inspired by classic 2D fantasy… with a quiet meta layer that slowly reveals itself. You’ll explore a broken world, face difficult boss fights, and collect journal pages that piece together the truth.

title: Ys X: Proud Nordics - Balduq Mascot Set
description: A set of mascots based on Adol's adventure in Balduq.

title: Ys X: Proud Nordics - Isle of Seiren Mascot Set
description: A set of mascots based on Adol's adventure on the Isle of Seiren.

title: Pale Luna
description: A recreation of the text-based adventure game "Pale Luna" from the creepypasta of the same name, in which the fictional story had the game lead to the coordinates of a burial site upon completion of the game.

title: Ballistic Biscuit
description: Ballistic Biscuit is a Flash game by RocketSnail Games in which you ride on an inner tube being towed by a motorboat and you have the avoid obstacles along the way. The game was later repurposed as a mini-game in Club Penguin called Hydro Hopper.

title: Wonderful Neoran Valley
description:
Wonderful Neoran Valley is a Monster Collector Roguelite experience, in which you will have to convince the creatures you meet to follow you and fight by your side, on your way to uncovering the dark secret that plagues the Neoran Valley.
Yes, you read that correctly: Roguelite!

title: FixForce
description: Leap, climb, and launch your friends in this chaotic co-op extraction platformer for up to 6 players! Use your drill-wrench to build your way across a vibrant post-apocalyptic world, find replacement parts, and fix broken machines. And if you lose your head, don’t worry: it’s all part of the job.

title: Static Condition
description: Static Condition is a psychological horror walking simulator inspired by liminal spaces and the "spot-the-difference" genre. Every run is a test of your focus and your ability to remain calm as the environment twists around you.

title: PABG: Player Anime Battlegrounds
description: PABG: Player Anime Battlegrounds is a fast-paced action shooter! Various maps, many types of weapons, different modes are waiting for you in which teams will come together in a battle for victory.

title: Putin Kills: Coronavirus
description: The end of 2019. A new COVID-19 virus has appeared on the planet Earth. No one attaches much importance to it and it easily takes over the planet. The whole world is in a panic, no one knows what to do. All the world powers are asking for help from the only person who has never been ill...

title: Anjos do Duelo
description: This game have mystical creatures, angels, fairies, demons, dragons and more, protect our warrios from bad forces!!!

title: Alice Lorange Adventures Season 2
description: “Alice Lorange Adventures Season 2” is an episodic semi-linear story made in Twine, staring an autistic teenager. The direct sequel to Season 1. After her return to Earth, Alice Lorange must fight a hornet at her school. Then a strange rift takes her to another planet...

title: Capoo Pals
description: Completely stress-free desktop games, heal your boredom at work and school Let the cute and funny Capoo accompany you every moment of using the computer

title: Supermarket Guard Simulator
description: Play as a supermarket security guard. Build security systems, conduct surveillance, catch thieves, stop criminals, and drive company profits. Use security devices and weapons to bring more value to shareholders. Do your best and grind that promotion!

title: Head's Adventures: Chibichibi
description: A cooperative (maybe sabotaging) platformer that blends action-jumping and physics simulation. You can challenge solo or team up with a friend locally or remotely in two-player mode to unlock even more unexpected ways to play. Healing balloons and time-race to unlock more subsequent levels.

title: I Can't Beat The Beautiful Ones
description: Shi Lei once ruled the underground world and retired at his peak. Years later, unsettling truths emerge, disrupting his peace. Will he resolve old issues or break free from fate to uncover the secrets behind these truths? This time, he won't face it alone; she will help him.

title: My Best Life My Pest Life
description: Your task is to crush the swarming BUGs on screen—lure them with bait, crush them, crush them, crush them, again and again... You must smoke and drink to keep your mind at peace.

title: Adventures of Tara
description: You play as Tara, an elven schoolgirl attending her final year at a university learning different types of magic and interacting with the other students and teachers. She is quite skilled in magic but her personality is, well, a little abrasive...alright, alright, she is a total bitch! However, she will have some experiences in the near future where she will be forced to endure humiliation and sexual encounters. If you don't want to game as a girl being forced to do naughty things...walk away now!

title: Sundered Soul: Chains of the Undying
description: Sundered Soul: Chains of the Undying is a fast-paced twin-stick action roguelite focused on manual aiming, dodging, and skill-based combat. Choose from 9 distinct classes with unique playstyles. Fight to break an eternal curse—where every victory is earned and every mistake is lethal.

title: Snekoban
description: Snekoban is a puzzle game, inspired by Snake and Sokoban. Help Sneko tidy up his space by pushing boxes, eat apples and earn a well deserved sleep on his favorite pillow : his own tail !

title: Mechafare
description: The early stages of an RTS I created in a gap year. Create your loadout, send your mechs to battle, capture objectives and destroy the enemy base

title: Chicken Rescue
description: Retro-inspired 2D platformer packed with traps, secrets, and challenging levels.

title: Pac-Snec
description: Have a nostalgic trip back in time to experience a fresh take on some classics. Eat orbs and extend your Snec to become the longest and coolest in the world!

title: Just Dismantle
description: Relax and unwind as you dismantle entire maps, piece by piece. Gather valuable resources to upgrade your tools and skills while unlocking new areas in this satisfying deconstruction simulator. No rush, no pressure – just pure dismantling.

title: King's Mug
description: King’s Mug is a tavern-management game where players build, decorate, and manage their dream tavern while trading with merchants, brewing beer and cooking dishes.

title: Sonafleki
description: Sonafleki plays like "Flicky" (the Genesis game), meaning that your player is slippery and bounces off of walls. Explore a massive overworld (reminiscent of "Knytt Underground");, collect new double jump types and get lost. Challenge linear levels, each with their own distinct visual style, gimmicks, and music. Play only what you want; you can experience an ending of the game by only playing easy levels and completing easy tasks. For the challengers, extra difficult content is provided.

title: Forgotten Hill Memento: Love Beyond
description: Forgotten Hill residents are not immune to love, but since we are in Forgotten Hill, things don’t go exactly the way you expect…

title: Forgotten Hill: The Wardrobe - Other Friends
description:
Did you believe Forgotten Hill has regular pieces of furniture like everywhere else? Of course not.

This starts a new spin-off series of stories set in Forgotten Hill: The Wardrobe. In this first chapter we’ll find out we should always be careful when choosing who to spend our time with, as new friends could turn out to be Other Friends…

title: Forgotten Hill: The Wardrobe - Two Sisters
description: Here continues the new series of stories set in Forgotten Hill: The Wardrobe. The second chapter, Two Sisters, will teach us that secret worlds, however perfect they may appear, may not be exactly what they seem…

title: Forgotten Hill: The Wardrobe - The Price of a Smile
description: In this installment you’ll grapple with moral dilemmas, face gruesome outcomes, and feel an ever-present sense of dread while you help a desperate soul pay off a huge debt in a world where the cost of a smile more terrifying than you could ever imagine.

title: Forgotten Hill: The Wardrobe - Dark Mechanics
description:
The Wardrobe is about to be reopened, but this time by someone with a plan to stop it. Someone who can master the Dark Mechanics…
Will you finally be able to stop the horror of the wardrobe? And above all, will you survive?

title: Dry Meadow
description: Fight, sneak and scavenge through lands left altered after an unknown catastrophe from the Soviet Union. Light fires to stay warm. Drink vodka to stay sane.

title: D' Mär Lucidium: Grimmgart
description: Begin your journey amid the chaos of the newly reignited War of Divinity and write your own story in this first-person open-world RPG. Express your personality, choose your combat style, and explore the dangerous, living world of Grimmgart.

title: Marsha in the Mysterious Tower!
description: Forgotten by time, forgotten by its architects yet the Tower remains. Marsha must solve various puzzles to uncover where she is and what befell the Tower in its past.

title: Avilion Forever
description: Wild story, simple yet deep turn-based battles! A legendary Japanese retro JRPG is back! Enjoy this solo adventure at your own pace!

title: Meme Exam 2025
description: MEME EXAM: 2025 — Can you prove your knowledge of memes and become a qualified memeologist?

title: 3D Race Game
description: 3D race game is a technical and creative experiment that combines web, 3D and desktop game development.

title: Infinite Bowling
description: This is an infinite bowling lane with one objective, get a new Highscore.

title: Plaser
description: Plaser is an arcade shooter where you aim for the gaps between rotating asteroid belts to destroy planets. With auto-movement, use Dash and Attack to penetrate the debris shield and hit the core. Upgrade your Attack Power and Time Limit to extend your run and master the rhythm of destruction.

title: Sheepfold
description: Herd the right sheep to the right pens in this top-down score-chasing game. Play as a clever shepherd dog, avoid black sheep, survive chaotic obstacles, and push your high score as the world gets weirder and weirder.

title: Click Them Off
description: Click Them Off is a hand-drawn roguelike deckbuilder. Conquer a strict hand limit by refreshing the store to stack identical cards, fusing them into unstoppable power. When nasty humans invade to steal your resources, wield three unique weapons to click them off!

title: Maev
description: A 2D RPG with distinct combat and platforming mechanics to handle at the same time. Explore what Maev has done to the world after humans went extinct, upgrade your weapon and adapt. Through 3 sections of 10 maps, fit for speedrunning or discorvery, collect pieces of lost knowledge, and explore.

title: Hypervox
description: HYPERVOX is a music video game where players perform the vocal melody of songs. When notes reach the judgement line, press the corresponding key to hit the note and recreate the vocal melody in real-time. Aim for the highest score possible by hitting each note with precise timing and accuracy.

title: Tet~Craft: The Fourth Temple
description: Be a young god learning, as you already are - always at least one better, if not me then at least Jesus - and as he advised, re-become childlike with a new digital space Lego(tm)! And no! You *don't* have to clean up after - nor will it hurt your (parents?) feet!

title: Guns & Thorns
description: Fight through hordes of bandits and a powerfull boss in this fast-paced, combat-heavy 2D-Pixel-Platformer. Explore the wild west-inspired world and discover many secrets lying within. Can you do it and regain what was stolen from you?

title: Dino Age: The First Fracture
description: Awake in a prehistoric swamp and discover the primal world of Owen. In this standalone survival-RPG, you craft weapons, master skills like Hatching & Cooking, and battle ‘Corrupted’ dinosaurs. Defeat the Time Fracture Boss to save the Triassic Era.

title: Pelican Deep
description: You’re a grade-schooler at a religious institution where something feels off in this surreal, first-person adventure game. Do your genes make a difference in the outcome of your suffering? Will your faith be enough to shroud your fears? Perhaps you already know the answer.

title: Piece of Ship
description: A chaotic co-op game about fixing a sinking submarine with duct tape, one wrench, and terrible communication. Fix it together or drown screaming.

title: Detective Turtletop: Who Killed Harambe?
description: The first AI detective game that doesn't cheat. Developed by a former Meta AI Engineer. Interrogate suspects using your own words to solve the murder of Harambe. Features procedurally generated cases, consistent hard logic, and a unique stress mechanic. You have 3 hours to find the truth.

title: Cake Maker
description: Match baked goods in a gnome owned bakery to make the most valuable treat of all, the Princess cake. Go for the high score!

title: Galactic Rumble
description: A single-player, arcade-style third-person shooter set in 3D space, focused on fast action and destroying enemy ships by ramming into them or blasting them from a distance-escape the arena before the timer runs out. One life. One chance.

title: No Hesitation
description: A cozy, stress-free driving experience with long roads and smooth traffic. No scores, no timers, no competition — just you, the road, and the rhythm of the drive.

title: Thug Destroyer
description: Horror platformer where you play as a thug trapped in a deranged superhero's simulation. Triple-jump and find 9 thuggies to escape 9 twisted levels. It’s chaotic, it’s unfair, and it’s laughing at you

title: Boom: Defense of Abydos
description:
Boom: Defense of Abydos is a first-person retro-style shooter developed with Godot, and a fan-made game based on Blue Archive.

Set in the world of Blue Archive and inspired by classic DOOM gameplay, BOOM features a campaign lasting approximately two hours, as well as a replayable survival mode.

title: Truck Master
description: Navigate logistic trucks to their destinations. Unload cargo then leave the warehouse. Become a master planner with zero crashes.

title: Truck Manager Australia
description: Build a car-transport company across Australia. Take freight jobs, plan tours, manage trucks, drivers and running costs, track profit and loss, and expand your fleet step by step with a clean desktop UI. Play offline.

title: Dungeon Companion
description: An Idle RPG that turns your real-world productivity into dungeon progress. Work, earn gold, and watch your hero conquer automatically.

title: Itzo
description: ITZO is a retro style scrolling shooter and bullet hell game where you play as the best (and most ruthless) agent in space: ITZO! You have the mission to prevent an incoming interplanetary conflict… How are you going to do it? Easy. With bullets, destruction, chaos and no diplomacy!

title: Ball Rush
description: Smash through shapes to reach the finish line! Only hit your color shapes and watch the fly!

title: Rebooted Fate
description: Qin Nian, who had just graduated when the financial crisis hit and found himself unemployed at home, accidentally obtained a secret manual from an old beggar. Little did he realize that this manual would not only alter the course of his life but also lift a veil on the reality of the world.

title: Hidden Object Greed Collection
description: Play all 3 parts of the "Greed" hidden object collection on Steam... Ger "Greed 1: The mad Scientist" + "Greed 2: Forbidden Experiments" + "Greed 3: Old Enemies returning".

title: Sato & Hama
description: Three Interwoven tales ruminating on beginning and end and everything in-between.

title: Colored Pencil Bakery
description: A bakery management game where I grow wheat, bake bread, and sell it to animal customers. I run a bakery by making bread and selling it to animals in the forest.

title: Crazy Qualle
description: Welcome to Crazy Qualle! The battle game that takes place in Qualle and where weapons fall from the sky!

title: Last Planet
description: Last Planet is a solo sci-fi survival game: explore an abandoned mining base, manage scarce resources, avoid or confront hostile creatures, and uncover the truth to shut down a rogue alien AI before it’s too late.

title: Vindices: Beyond the Walls
description: You are the lifeline of a struggling town. Enter dangerous, ever-changing regions through portals, fight enemies using a strategic turn-based combat system, gather resources, and return home to fulfill requests and help the town survive.

title: Targetshooter
description: Target Shooter is a fast-paced casual shooting game where players dodge incoming missiles and destroy targets to earn points. One hit means game over, creating tense, high-pressure gameplay designed for short, repeatable play sessions.

title: Little Toys
description: What if toys came to life and escaped from our drawers for crazy, over-the-top races? Up to 4 players in local multiplayer, 16 maps, traps, powers, podiums, and LittleFlouz to unlock. Challenge your friends and your family! An explosive, hilariously frustrating couch-party game.

title: Fall With Friends
description: Fall With Friends is a physics-driven multiplayer party game where one player destroys a collapsing tower while the rest fight to stay on top. Dodge destruction, betray friends, and survive the fall. Only one remains.

title: Shoot Pro Wrestling 2
description: Shoot Pro Wrestling 2 puts you in control of your own wrestling federation, in this manager-style wrestling simulation game. You don't just pick winners though, you actually let your wrestlers battle it out in simulated "shoot" matches where every move matters. Can you give the fans what they want?

title: Project - Labyrinth
description: A fantasy turn-based, grid-based dungeon crawler RPG with a blackjack-style card system that drives combat and skill execution.

title: Clash of Builders
description: A party game for up to 4 players. Awaken your inner engineer and construct a tower that can survive brutal challenges, shifting weather, and your opponents' schemes. Adapt, sabotage, and race to the top before anyone else.

title: Tome Transform
description: Solve clue-driven anagrams to uncover iconic quotes from classic books and legendary films.

title: Wraith’s Embrace
description: The newly appointed priest Mior, sent to a desolate village, encounters a mysterious boy named Fei deep in the forest. White hair, red eyes. Smiling in solitude, he felt cold to the touch, yet terrifyingly captivating.

title: Sudoku Challenge Pro
description: Master Sudoku with 27 Steam Achievements across 5 difficulty levels. Features comprehensive tutorials, detailed stat tracking, multiple player profiles, and cloud saves. From casual beginner to hardcore brainiac - challenge yourself!

title: Sticky Limey
description: “Sticky Limey” is a third-person 3D action game where you control a slime and navigate a ruined city using grappling hooks.

title: Hentai Sora
description: Hentai Sora is a sensual puzzle game about a cold yet dangerously attractive girl. Solve levels, unlock explicit scenes, and slowly reveal her desires as the tension rises with every move.

title: Just Chatting
description: Just Chatting is a simple 2d platformer for adults.

title: Object Ward: April Fools' Collection
description: Two silly visual novels involving bisexuals and lesbians, bizarre situations, and even weirder object heads. Therapy not included.

title: LesLove.Club: Jessica and Ashley
description: A relaxing puzzle game for lesbians. Love is Love!

title: Defracted
description: Defracted - The world is set in a fictional sci-fi realm where 2 teams are at war with each other over prosperity in a virtual reality game created by an alien civilization.

title: Polygon Panic
description: Polygon Panic is a fast-paced wave-based shooter where you battle relentless geometric enemies. Survive escalating waves, defeat powerful bosses, and choose from unique upgrades that shape each run. Adapt your strategy, push your limits, and see how long you can last in the chaos.

title: Selective Memory
description: A third-person psychological exploration game where you relive fragmented memories in three distorted variations: idyllic, mundane, or horrific -- before escaping the loop to make a choice that affects more than just the past.

title: Uninstall Simulator
description: You will connect remotely to one client desktop after another, helping users install and remove rogue software. You must identify hidden promotional installers and trap options, while also repairing tampered system settings and abnormal faults within the system.

title: One Turret
description: "One Turret" is a factory-building solo-tower-defense with a large emphasis on large crafting trees.

title: Karakurium
description: A cozy, Japanese-style puzzle adventure featuring 50 types of gimmicks. Explore a vast world made up of 500 stages! Hints available for most stages, and many challenging puzzles await.

title: Idrscape
description: Idrscape is a first-person solo game, search and analyze the clues to find the codes and keys that will allow you to get out of the building as quickly as possible.

title: QA Simulator
description: Step into the meticulous world of a Quality Assurance (QA) Tester with "QA Simulator", an immersive simulation game that offers you a slice of the challenging yet crucial tech industry.

title: The Story Page
description: An independently developed indie game in the genre of online RPG with an open world created by a single person. Create your own character using the editor. Engage in various activities ranging from fishing and farming to managing taverns, castles, and even entire cities.

title: Time Wars
description: Go on a journey through more then 30 levels traveling from prehistoric caves all the way to futuristic lunar bases. Along the way; upgrade, level up, and unlock cosmetics for your Hero. Adapt your strategy to whatever the level requires with more than 100 defense variations & Slay epic bosses!

title: Treemee
description: Treemee is a relaxing, hand-drawn abstract game. In the solo campaign, journey through the untouched land of Medaria. Play as a Gruffo with unique powers, facing Tainted Spirits. Use diverse terrain and trees with distinct traits to your advantage.

title: Backrooms in the Forest
description: Backrooms in the Forest - a horror game where you must escape from a mysterious forest and find your way out of the anomalies!

title: Blossom’s Grove: An English-learning Game
description: A cozy life-sim where farming and learning English grow together. Plant, craft, and explore a vibrant world. Each conversation and discovery naturally builds your language skills. Befriend charming villagers in a peaceful valley.

title: Fractured Rift
description: A strategic, turn-based, auto battler roguelite focused on team building and ability customization. Battle through infinite, procedurally generated floors, earn rare materials, craft equipment, buy upgrades, modify skills with collectible runes. and watch your team grow into an unstoppable force.

title: Slot Cave
description: Spin the slots to build your deck and defeat your enemies!

title: Room 601
description: Room 601 is a 2D pixel puzzle survival game. You'll be a loner, trying to survive in room 601.

title: Rail Fights
description: A fast-paced one-screen arcade shooter built for chaotic couch party matches and score-driven survival runs. Ride the rail, bump and total opponents solo or in teams with friends, or push your limits against ever-stronger AI in endless, leaderboard-focused challenges.

title: Phoenix in Flames: A Fateful Misdressing
description: Phoenix in Flames: A Fateful Misdressing is a historical text adventure. Step into the shoes of a Jinwu Guard during the Tang Dynasty's Shenlong Era. Deeply entangled in the coups following Empress Wu Zetian's reign, your choices will steer the empire and forge your own unique destiny.

title: Project C.U.R.E. Origins
description: A Turn-Based RPG that follows the story of Kin on his journey to discover his past and the mysteries of this world. You, the player, must guide Kin and help him remember who he truly is and complete his mission.

title: Takeover 2
description: Take to the streets solo or with a partner in this fast paced, high-impact arcade beat ’em up. Takeover returns with refined gameplay, upgraded visuals and a pulse-pounding new soundtrack.

title: Warena
description:
WARENA is a fast-paced RTS card-battler where tactical decisiveness meet explosive arena combat.

Blend the real-time strategy with the mind games of a competitive card battler. Draft your perfect deck, manage your mana economy, and destroy the enemy base in intense 1v1 PvP duels or a challenging single-player campaign. You don't micromanage individual troops - you deploy forces, cast devastating spells, and watch the chaos unfold.

title: What Lies Within the Ice
description: Find the ruins and discover what lies within the ice.

title: Stage Tour
description: Stage Tour is a rhythm-action game that blends familiar, accessible note-highway gameplay with exciting modern twists. It’s poised to rekindle the flame of plastic-instrument rhythm gaming with new features and modes, diverse bandmates and instruments, competitive depth, and seasonal events.

title: Mega Man Battle Network 2
description:
The second entry, which introduced the Style Change system. Your battle style will impact MegaMan's abilities, adding another layer of strategy to battles!
With WWW toppled, the Net Mafia Gospel suddenly steps in to take their place, and it's up to our heroes to stop them.

title: Mega Man Battle Network 3 Blue
description:
The third entry in the series, and the first to come in two different versions, Blue and White!
The game sees our heroes take on Dr. Wily and a revived WWW, while also unveiling the past of the mysterious NetNavi, Bass.
Join Lan and MegaMan in their desperate struggle to stave off "Cybergeddon."

title: Mega Man Battle Network 3 White
description:
The third entry in the series, and the first to come in two different versions, Blue and White!
The game sees our heroes take on Dr. Wily and a revived WWW, while also unveiling the past of the mysterious NetNavi, Bass.
Join Lan and MegaMan in their desperate struggle to stave off "Cybergeddon."

title: Toxic Harvest
description: Trapped on Halloween night in a chemical plant after a deadly spill, you're hunted by a mutated creature. Your only escape is blocked, and every push toward freedom alerts your position. Time your movements, manage your stamina, and survive the night.

title: House Builder - Tiny Houses DLC
description: Discover the charms of minimalism and clever design in the new DLC for House Builder: Tiny Houses! Build capsule houses, mobile marvels, and restore a classic camper van. Each project will transport you to a world of smart solutions, mobility, and living in harmony with nature.

title: Rural Cat Trails
description: Explore Nanoha Town, in the Japanese countryside, during the cherry blossom season as a cat. Use unique cat actions like Wall Jump, Dig, Paw Swat and Wiggle Butt Dash to make your way to Sakurana Shrine, a place of memories with your late Grandpa.

title: Mad Mojo
description:
Think Inscryption meets Pokémon.
Mad MOJO is an action-packed monster-catching deckbuilder with a hidden layer of fourth-wall-breaking psychological horror. Hunt for the legendary Prime MOJO using poker-inspired hands, real-time parries, and game-breaking elemental Tokens. But beware of the MOJO hiding just beyond your reach...

title: Lisa: The Pointless - Velvet Collection
description:
A polished, up to date collection of LISA: The Pointless mods like Scholar of the Wilbur Sin, Infinity Unfolds, SOTWS+ and Nerds and Losers.

The main goal of this fangame expansion is to create a unified experience for most major LISA: The Pointless expansions. Some original content may also be present. and to be a love letter to the original fangame (Before MU Update at the time of this fangame release).

title: Health Audit Simulator
description: Step into the shoes of a Health Auditor. FIND, FLAG and RATE potential Risks and Hazards across 20 playable environments, between two differing difficulty variants.

title: UnExist: Yume Kanawanu Douketachi
description:
This game is a fantasy dungeon exploration RPG.
If you just want to clear the game, you might be able to do so by just going through it casually, but whether or not you actually clear it is up to your own discretion.
The difficulty level is relatively high. It's a fairly unreasonable game.

title: Fleshborn
description: Flesh born is a short incremental game where you are tasked to clean a facility by burning down fleshy growths.

title: Little Witch Inuko
description: Join Inuko in this card battle rogue-lite RPG as she tries to conquer the mysterious ruins to earn the rank of a full-fledged witch! Collect and combine a wide variety of cards and equipment to build and personalise your battle deck and blast your way through the ruins!

title: Drive Thru Fast Food Simulator
description: Drive Thru Fast Food Simulator throws you into the fast-paced world of a high-poly, first-person drive-thru restaurant, where you are both a worker and the manager. From prepping ingredients to handing out orders through the service window, every task is in your hands. Can you serve every customer quickly, keep the kitchen running smoothly, and turn your restaurant into the city’s favorite spot?

title: DisGo
description: DisGo is a parkour chase party game where you play as one of four musical animals known as bandimals. Compete to steal the spotlight from one another to prove who’s really the star of the show. Hold the spotlight to become the soloist, and groove along to the sounds of your solo. Literally grab the light from your opponents, and do your best to not let them take it back. Use various Powerups and Parkour Elements to get the drop on your opponents, as whoever plays their solo the longest wins.

title: Funnel Runners
description: Trapped in a doomed city, you and up to 7 friends must scavenge parts, fix your van, and escape the brutal tornado that approaches. A first-person co-op survival game with escalating disasters and total environmental destruction.

title: Veiled Shadows
description: Live a month in a rural mountain town, build bonds, and hunt a mystery across two worlds. Manage your days, explore dungeons, and fight turn-based battles to recover what's been lost.

title: Difference Machine
description: A strange and upsetting autoclicker focusing on making dogs happy.

title: Dead End Streets
description: Dead End Streets – Explore a forgotten street where each house hides a disturbing experiment. Discover VIVARQ's secrets, face what dwells within, and survive a system that never stopped watching you.

title: Double Date Dilemma
description: In this visual novel with E-mote animated sprites by veteran studio ANIM, after trying and failing to have children, the Kajiuras decided to attend a relationship seminar to fix the problem. There they meet the Sonadas and as the sessions continue, their lives begin to entwine more and more...

title: Himawari Aqua After: The Day the Moon Stood Still
description: Fandisc taking place a year after the events of the main game, focusing on Aqua and Cosmos.

title: Timefront
description: Timefront is an RTS game blending battle royale mechanics where you control one of four asymmetrical races in a fight for conquest over an ever-shifting battlefield. Brave the Known World and try this refreshing take on the RTS genre.

title: Sevens
description: Sevens is a competitive multiplayer card experience set in a dark underground club atmosphere. Sit at the table, read your opponents, disrupt their strategy, and fight to control the flow of the game — whether you're playing with friends, strangers, or bots.

title: Phantom Of The Lily
description: Phantom of the Lily is a psychological horror game with a dark narrative. Solve mind-bending puzzles, piece together clues in an eerie atmosphere, and reveal the truth in a terrifying world. Can you preserve your sanity and wake up from this nightmare?

title: Inworld Origins
description: Origins is a playable short created by the team at Inworld AI to showcase NPCs powered by artificial intelligence. After an explosion in Metropolis, you’ve arrived on the scene as the lead detective. Question witnesses, uncover the mystery, and solve the case. From the creator of The Matrix Awakens.

title: Galvan
description: An open world fan-made Ben 10 game where you can play as almost every alien transformation.

title: Chattle!
description:
Chattle! is an interactive 1v1 auto battler with a variety of options to customize your character.

It is meant to be played with the chat members of a streaming service of your choice.
Players get assigned a fighter randomly when they first join. This includes stats, one of 7 classes and 11 weapon types, over 250 visual items and attacks! They then can queue up for battle with other chat members and see whose fighter is the strongest.

While this is an autobattler, meaning the fighters do the attacks themselves, players have some agency over their character by either changing their fighting style to use a specific type of attack more often, or unlock new attacks in different elements. They then can build the perfect loadout that crushes any opponent!.

The game also features cosmetics in different rarities, aquired through random rolls. Who can build the coolest looking fighter? Who gets the first legendary Wodden Sword? Who just wants to look cute? There are near endless possibilities.

title: Bamdmi
description:
Welcome to BAMDMI.

Empty, anxietly place of strange geometry and atmosphere.

All you have is opportunity to explore, build and relax. This game is about some anxiety, exploring and feelings of presence. You can extract piece of world you see and build with it everything. Build whatever you want!

There's so much secrets that wanted to be found. And you can be first who found them. Enjoy!

title: A Short Quest
description: Explore a hand-crafted world, overcome brutally challenging combat, and restore order to a broken kingdom. Discover unique weapons, tools, spells, and secrets in this short game inspired by old school action RPGs.

title: Blood Court
description: Blood Court is a Souls-like action RPG within a dark fantasy, horrifying world. Explore PSX styled Environments, battle blood hungry monsters, and piece together a story told through environments, and voiceless cinamatics.

title: Song of the Wind
description:
Luna can’t speak. She pours her heart through music and writing to her beloved ones. Will she be able to show her feelings to a dear friend? How will she comfort her mother who was in the midst of fear and regrets? Follow her story on Song of the Wind.

Song of the Wind is a short visual novel written in Indonesian, made by Team Loona for April Jam 2023.

title: Hyouhon Hako de Uka wo Matsu

title: Kurage no Gakkou
description: A teacher-in-training is sent to a middle school where all students are jellyfish, except for this one girl.

title: Shimaigusa
description:
During summer vacation, Tsubame returned to his father's parents' house with her family.
In there, she was invited to collect ideas for a horror game production by her childhood friend, Kozaki Hayato.

There's a forest that is forbidden from entering, according to the village convention.
However, it's the best place to find horror materials.
"If this could free me from this boring summer vacation, even just a little bit..."
With that in mind, she decided to accompany him to the forest exploration.

Night falls.
Slipping out of the house without her parents knowing, she starts heading into the forest...

title: Suisaiga ha Suitei ni Shizumu
description: Watercolors Sink Beneath the Surface is a nostalgic pixel-art point-and-click adventure set on Narumi Island, where only an abandoned high school stands. Years later, two girls return to complete a watercolor inspired by their school memories, gathering ideas from the remnants of the past.

title: Colors/Forest

title: Hoshiyomi no Tsumugu Uta
description:
An old street with a sizzling atmosphere, a sea of wheat that seems to last forever, and a lightless business district.
The smell of gunpowder can no longer be felt as of now, but its traces have surely become indelible wounds engraved throughout this world.

In the midst of the seemingly eternal lonely scenery, the two travel to anywhere they want to be, needing nothing but an occasional warmth felt by the other person's touch.

It was a journey that “digs back into the past”.
A boy and a girl with mysterious power - Kamitaira Rei and Inamori Aruru.

They, despite some rebellious moments, continue to move forward
To uncover the history's hidden truth,
To unearth the feelings of people who are intertwined
Eventually, the scattered pieces become one big flow,
Marking the beginning of a new world...

title: Welcome, Dear Human

title: Hardtrace
description:
Hardtrace is a Czech arcade game that defines "couch vs. couch multiplayer." It builds on fifty years of evolution of tron-like and snake-like games, but brings significant improvements and changes in gameplay. Up to twelve players can play on one PC (Windows, Linux, macOS) or up to fourteen over a network. With one click on Steam, you're in the arena, thanks to Steam multiplayer support.

Battles await you, where precise route planning and quick reactions are crucial. You control the Tracer vehicle, which leaves a deadly trail behind it, and a collision means the loss of unsaved points. Portals, acceleration, smashing, chasing teammates, and collecting their points — all this leads to a single goal: victory. In Hardtrace, the entire match is decided in the final seconds...

title: Enigma of Hearts
description: Enigma of Hearts is a short visual novel made for April Jam 2023.

description: Enter a dystopian future where gravity‑defying tracks test every limit of speed and skill. Inspired by the 90s anime flair and classic anti‑gravity titles, Hypersonic GP drops you into the cockpit of one of 32 legendary ships and challenges you to reach the podium at hypersonic velocity.

title: Waifu Match!
description:
Waifu Match! Is a free moving match 3 roguelike waifu collecting game made by a solo developer. A unique blend of several genres with a simple gameplay loop.

But due to dynamic difficulty, various RNG related modifications such as power ups, hurdles, match requirements paired with a skill tree, selectable archetypes, equippable relics there are near countless ways to experience the game.

Collecting waifus works as follows; each run has 8 dates, which each cleared date seeing increased difficulty for the next. Clearing date 3 allows you to count the waifu as MET and unlock her in your gallery with some stats about the version of her you encountered and met. Clearing a full run adds the waifu to collected status, which is the ultimate goal.

Meeting and subsequently collecting a Waifu removes them from the pool of Waifus you can encounter and moves you closer to the goal of collecting each Waifu from that family (there are nearly 30 families of different kinds of Waifus). There is also a high score table connected to the player with the highest number of collected Waifus.

Clearing a run also has a chance to gdrop relics and artifacts. Relics are equippable modifiers to your next run, sometimes useable once and sometimes more. Artifacts are collectibles that have a rarity tied to them, making each drop unique, it's is said that higher rarities can be equipped for special visual effects..

If you love simplistic gameplay with deep randomized elements and collecting beautiful Waifus, you'll love this game!

title: SoulStream Saga
description: SoulStream Saga: Chapter 1 is an old school JRPG in 2D pixel art style, that focuses on bringing back those characteristic feelings of games from the 1990s and early 2000s. Dive into a compelling narrative-driven adventure and utilize the strategic turn based combat system to the fullest extent!

title: Giant's Path
description:
A distress call asking for help has been found in Ambasari, an abandoned city where the death battle between two giants, Kalagigas and Metasakti, occured. As a Civil Rescue Team it’s your job to help them.

Brave the path surrounded by dangerous emergences, dodge incoming hazards, save lives, and unveil the mysteries of the abandoned city.

This game is a part of Toge Greenhouse 2025, an internal game jam at Toge Productions.

title: Echoes Of The City
description: Echoes Of The City is a haunting journey back to San Telmo, where forgotten secrets and shadowed memories linger in an abandoned home. Discover a legacy of mystery and tension, as the past whispers through every dark corner.

title: My Mother's Love
description:
Only one objective: having a serious, final conversation with your mom.

But that path isn't easy. Your progress may be ruined in the blink of an eye. You may go backwards. You may stay attached to your pain. You may cherish some memories to help you move forward. You may give up last minute. You may eventually burn your fears to ashes.

Will this cold forest be easy on you?

title: DataFall
description:
DataFall is a fast-paced cyberpunk action game built around risk, optimization and player decision-making.

While it appears to reward min-max strategies, the game dynamically reacts to over-optimization, forcing players to adapt instead of relying on static builds.

Featuring neon-styled visuals, escalating difficulty systems and reactive mechanics, DataFall challenges players to balance greed, efficiency and survival.

title: Beat Vector
description: Beat Vector is a 360 degree fully immersive synesthetic rhythm game where each beat makes the environment come alive based on the player's performance. Each genre featured in the game has its own unique environment such as the Club for EDM, the Ballroom for Electroswing or the Alleyway for UK Grime that the player progresses through as they clear levels.

description: Bullet Head is a fast-paced arcade shooter built around relentless action, tight combat spaces, and constant pressure on the player. Our goal is to create a pure gameplay-driven experience that rewards reflexes, positioning, and aggression — without unnecessary complexity or downtime.

title: Breaking Point
description: A monotonous daily routine. The mannequin you brought home was more than just a thing. Escape your home while evading the mannequin that stalks you only when you look away. Your choices will define your destiny.

title: Cyber Traps & the Detective Squad
description: Set in a Brazilian school, it is a Point-and-Click game focused on solving puzzles and mysteries concerning the dangers of the digital environment. The plot features anthropomorphic characters inspired by Brazilian fauna, known as the 'Bando Detetive'.

title: Zeri Factory
description: ZeliFactory is a falling-block puzzle × 2D action game where you control both the blocks dropping from above and a freely moving character called Zeli at the same time, clearing lines to earn high scores.

title: Hako Tower
description: Welcome to HAKO TOWER, a physics-based tower builder! Stack blocks, scream as they fall, and dodge obstacles. And... adore Hako. A tiny hamster who just stares at you... He can't help you... He's... just... a hamster, after all. Test your luck and skill!

title: Chamber Shift
description: Race through an infinitely changing dungeon and unleash overwhelming barrages with your own ultimate build in this high-speed roguelike shooting game. Combine weapons like shotguns and burst rifles with upgrades that bounce or explode bullets to create a combat style that's uniquely yours.

title: Jackpot Buffalo Slots
description: Discover the world's best Casino Slots Games! Play slots with unique game mechanics, explore amazing mini-games and master your casino skills!

title: AlienSunny
description: Custom characters, custom maps, planting, raising livestock, chopping trees, weeding, fishing, building houses, constructing bridges, mining, driving away enemies who steal crops, and so on. You can skip tasks if you don't want to do them, and running out of stamina won't cause any loss.

title: The Eternal Night
description: A disgraced knight and a moon priestess must journey across Etheria and beyond, from sacred shrines to forsaken lands swallowed by shadow and only through unity can the Eternal Night be stopped.

title: What’s Father’s Father Called?
description: Welcome to What's father's father called? — a relative relationship puzzle game that has you laughing your head off while questioning life itself!

title: The Girl Walks Back
description: "The Girl Walks Back" is a dark, stage-based monochrome puzzle-adventure played only with the mouse. The girl attempts to return home from a deep forest. No complex controls are needed, but obstacles must be overcome through puzzles or action. Your choices lead to 8 different endings.

title: Circle With a Gun
description: A bullet hell roguelike where you are a force of destruction from the moment you pick up the controls. The endless hordes of Vampire Survivors meets the satisfying micro of Hades, all set to a retro arcade soundtrack that slaps harder than it has any right to.

title: Astrogeo
description: Astrogeo is a fast-paced retro shooter with unlockable ships, strategic weapon swapping, and escalating waves of enemies and bosses. Upgrade wisely and fight for the highest score!

title: Down the Dungeon
description: Descend to the bottom of the dungeon without dying, platforming your way around traps, monsters, and worst of all -- falling to your death. Explore the horrific depths as you gain powerful gear and uncover the dark secrets that await you at the bottom.

title: Natural: Mi mo Kokoro mo
description: "Natural - Body and Soul -" is an 18+ romance adventure game released by Fairy Tail.

title: EOS Black
description: "Eos Black" is a dark fantasy MMORPG published by DiGeam in Taiwan. Set in the wake of a cataclysmic war between ancient gods and the King of Giants, the land is slowly being consumed by lingering hatred and malice. Players will step into the shoes of the "Arcana," individuals gifted with the power of purification, to embark on a perilous journey.

title: SixteenPetals
description: This is an urban theme love interaction + clue puzzle game. You often dream of a woman, in order to find her and memory, you explore the city. You will meet a lot of women and have heart-pounding stories with them. It's possible to find the woman of your dreams and lost memories

title: The Tall Man Tapes
description: The Tall Man Tapes is a found footage inspired horror game. You're a UFO investigator trying to get to the bottom of a mystery. Will you learn the truth and escape with your life?

title: Doppleganger
description:
A mannequin lies disassembled on the bed.

A window is blocked with steel bars.

You must find a way out of the room.

This is a point and click escape room game, around 30-60 minutes long

title: Miautemágica
description: Miautemágica is an educational, local co-op 3D game. Two apprentice cat alchemists work together, brewing magical potions to save the Whisker Kingdom from the terrible Meowdusa. Each potion challenges logical reasoning with fractions and percentages. Collaborate and learn!

title: My Gym Mommy Treats Me Like A Kid
description: Will you become a good little boy for your muscle mommy in this soft femdom visual novel?

title: Heave Ho 2
description: Get a grip, it’s Heave Ho 2! The insane 2-4 player party game sequel takes the couch co-op mayhem online for the first time. Grab what you can and swing to win!

title: Within of Static: Northgate Mall
description: You play as Dylan Miller, a night security guard assigned to watch over the nearly abandoned Northgate Mall. What starts as a quiet shift of cameras and radio calls slowly turns into a night where something inside the mall doesn’t want to stay hidden.

title: Heaven's Door
description: The gates of heaven will only be open to those who prove that they deserve their place in it. Prove your goodness by answering all of the angel's questions right.

title: BullTales
description: You're now the bull 🦬. Step into a provocative realm of cuckold/NTR reimagined with a fresh twist. Get ready to unleash your desire, have a blast, and dominate the scene with undeniable allure.

title: She Plays Dirty
description: t's good to be an obedient puppy: no need to think, worry, fret — just exist. Visual novel with an emotion system instead of the usual choices. Dominating mistress, casino — and a pinch of naive lies.

title: Unauthorised
description:
Unauthorized is a terminal-simulator game that involves uncovering hidden files, cracking passwords, and piecing together an intriguing narrative. The game challenges players to decipher encrypted data and unravel a conspiracy.

Created by Red Indie Games (and POWERHACK), Unauthorized is a love letter to retro computing, cryptography and encryption puzzles.

title: Chromosome Evil Trilogy
description:
Chromosome Evil Trilogy is now complete.

Hardcore Squad-based RTS with a dash of Horror vibe and Lovecraftian theme.

title: Endless Racing
description: Endless Racing is a high-octane, retro-inspired 2D endless runner that challenges your reflexes to the absolute limit. Dodge a barrage of obstacles, manage your speed, and chase the ultimate high score on a stunning pixel highway that never ends!

title: Mole's Best Friend
description: Mole's Best Friend is a cozy, hand-drawn point and click adventure about Topo, a routine-abiding mole, and his best friend Scrunch, a rebellious young beetle. But after an argument, Scrunch goes missing! Topo must face his fears, solve clever puzzles, and venture into the unknown to bring her home.

title: Five Nights at F**kboy's: Sister Location
description:
It's the only way.

Five Nights at F--kboy's: Sister Location is the thrilling conclusion to the Five Nights at F--kboy's: Golden Edition 1 & 2 games... and perhaps the entire Five Nights at F--kboy's universe.

The location: The Pizza Realm. Once a land of debauchery for all and futuristic technology, it now serves as a bunker for the last survivors of a great cataclysm that is ravaging the entire universe.

And now, Baby, dead-set on a mysterious mission, arrives on the scene, and everyone is at risk of succumbing to the cataclysm that claimed so many. Who knows what will happen next? Who knows who will be next?

Could this be the end of the Golden Edition universe?

title: Keep on Mining!: Worlds
description: Keep on Mining! - Worlds is an incremental mining game where you mine rocks, collect resources, and travel through many unique worlds, finding artifacts, crafting pickaxes, and purchasing many permanent upgrades!

title: Haley's Story
description: Love is a tricky thing. Sometimes it can be right under your nose, and you may not even know it. In HALEY’S STORY, that may be the case.

title: Anokye
description: Anokye is a 2D action-adventure platformer where you play as a destined hero fighting to unite the Ashanti people. Battle through villages, forests, and mystical peaks inspired by Ghanaian art and folklore in a journey to restore light to a kingdom in darkness.

title: A Moment of Bliss
description: A harem of desire unfolds within your own home, as every woman around you burns with a sudden, insatiable hunger. With a seductive AI whispering in your ear, navigate this erotic labyrinth and uncover the shocking truth behind their newfound lust.

title: Midgardr
description: A board game where you play as a Duke sent to build and protect a village at the edge of the realm. Every choice you make will shape its future. But be aware: the board itself may not be all it seems... Will your village thrive or crumble beneath truths yet unknown? Are you really just... a Duke?

title: Sunset Summit
description: A co-op group climbing game for 1-8 friends! Head out on a chill but challenging climb with regular checkpoints. Use axes, ropes, pogo sticks, item delivery drones and more to reach the summit. Just remember to watch your step!

title: The Ballad Singer: Knights Templar
description: Manage your own Templar chapter in the Holy Land, engage in strategic combat and complete all narrative paths! A new innovative combat system based on cards and the micro management of the single blows delivered by the warriors.

title: H4CT0PL45M
description: Play as the ghost in the machine and hack your way through the 48 levels of the puzzle-platformer H4CT0PL45M! Use your ability to possess hardware to make your way to the end of each level and complete your infiltration.

title: Hot Property
description: A wild erotic comedy where sex is everywhere, the fun never stops, and your choices truly matter.

title: Remy Raccoon and the Lost Temple: Halloween Hijinks - Volume 1
description: A Halloween special of our cute, Raccoon-based, dungeon-crawling, gem-grabbing arcade game. Join Remy Raccoon in 12 brand new Halloween levels filled with fiendish traps and malevolent creatures. Your adventure awaits...

title: Remy Raccoon and the Lost Temple: Festive Frolics - Volume 1
description: A festive special of our cute, Raccoon-based, dungeon-crawling, gem-grabbing arcade game. Join Remy Raccoon in 13 brand new festive levels filled with fiendish traps and malevolent creatures. Your adventure awaits...

title: Remy Raccoon and the Lost Temple: Festive Frolics - Volume 2
description: Remy Raccoon is back in this festive special of our cute, gem-grabbing arcade game. Join Remy in 11 brand new festive levels filled with fiendish traps and malevolent creatures. Your adventure awaits...

title: Infinity Nikki: Uncrowned Heart
description:
Some say idols are the very definition of perfection. Others believe it's the brilliance of their heart that makes them truly shine.

A grand coronation celebration unfolds for Spira's very own Charisma Star—Angelina Kaleidostar Roucoco!

And yet... is our "perfect idol" truly as perfect as she seems?

title: Poker Monsters
description: A new take on Poker Roguelike. In Poker Monsters, you assemble poker hands on the table one card at a time, with one goal: hunting! Use your party’s abilities, take down huge beasts and power up to face even greater beasts. Become a true Poker Monster!

title: Minecraft: Tiny Takeover
description: The Tiny Takeover drop is an update to Minecraft: Java Edition which adds new designs for all baby mobs in the game, as well as the golden dandelion: a flower that keeps friendly mobs in their baby form forever.

title: The Inexperienced Exorcist
description: A romantic visual novel game for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

title: City God Alice
description: Cursed with only a year left to live, serving her in this City God temple is the only way you can stay alive long enough to uncover the truth behind the curse.

title: Grim Path
description: A card-driven strategy roguelike where every step is a choice. Descend into dark dungeons, battle monsters, face various encounters, and collect powerful items in fast, easy-to-pick-up runs filled with meaningful decisions.

title: Kyuuketsu Hime Yui: Senyashou
description:
Kyuuketsu Hime Yui Senyasyo is a visual novel adaptation of the Vampire Princess Yui manga. Play through branching routes with four main heroines (two initially available), manage a life bar affected by your choices, and unlock multiple endings and gallery images as the story unfolds.
You follow Yui, a half‑vampire, half‑Shi girl with a tragic past, and her protector Nagi as factions hunt and shelter her; narrative choices determine relationships, survival, and which endings you reach.

title: Derace
description: A chaotic racing game for 2-6 players. Hit your ability at the right time, cause mayhem, and hold your line. Create a lobby and let the race begin.

title: AI Protocol
description: AI Protocol is a minimalist strategy game. Control an emerging AI through a single evolving interface. Grow too slowly and you’re left behind. Grow too fast and you’re discovered. Conquer all or lose everything to Detection or runaway AGI. How powerful can you become… without being seen?

title: Stardust Sandbox
description: A creative sandbox simulation where you experiment with physical interactions, build structures, and observe emergent behaviors in a world fully under your control.

title: Tumble Marble
description:
Bring your community into the race! Tumble Marble is an interactive, physics-based racing experience designed specifically for Twitch streamers and their viewers. This isn't just a game; it's a live event where your chat becomes the stars of the show.
How It Works

Your viewers join the race instantly by typing !join in your Twitch chat. Their personalized marble, carrying their username, drops into the arena to battle through a gauntlet of obstacles, speed zones, and physics-defying turns. Who will claim the podium?

title: Angel Garden
description:
Can you feel it? In the depths of winter something stirs.

Something begins to dream of spring.

This is a massively multiplayer asynchronous experience.

A place for wishing and eavesdropping on the wishes of others.

A place where you're protected by benevolent internet forces.

If a Unity 3D world can be a bouquet, I made this to be one.

title: Disillusioned Reunion
description: A romantic visual novel game for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

title: Kiborg: Descent
description: Descend into the tower's forbidden depths. Unravel the Substance's secret, forge uneasy alliances, and escape Omega-201. New floors, bosses, weapons, and a chance to settle the score with Volkov.

title: SpaceShift
description: Save the crew in this 2D puzzle platformer! As a small robot, you manipulate gravity, time, and your size to repair a damaged ship. Use portals to change perspectives, avoid dangerous lasers, and solve creative puzzles in an unstable pixel world.

title: Uncle and His Friend
description: A romantic visual novel game for Windows, macOS, and Linux

title: Get on Slime Level
description:
Don't move through the levels.
Let the levels move through you!

title: Coloring Pixels: Natural Wonders
description: This Natural Wonders book unlocks 20 additional levels for Coloring Pixels. Each image shows a different natural wonder from our beautiful green-and-blue planet! See the wonders of the natural world in this book!

title: Pressing Under Pressure
description:
Pressing Under Pressure is a short puzzle game inspired by classics like The Impossible Quiz. The game was created in 10 days for the 10 day themed game jam with the theme: Ascension.

Test your wits against a series of click-based puzzles... and survive.

title: Idle Battler
description:
Idle Battler is a progression-driven idle RPG focused on forging powerful weapons, battling increasingly difficult enemies, and advancing through a rebirth-based scaling system. Each rebirth reshapes the in-game economy and raises the challenge, rewarding players who optimize their strategy and push further with every reset.

The game features rarity-based loot, strategic progression choices, and evolving balance updates designed to support long-term growth and meaningful advancement over time.

Currently in Beta, the core experience is fully playable and continues to receive balance improvements and new features as development progresses.

title: Lost Friends
description:
"You mustn't look into the face of a Nameless child, as the eyes of a sinner will stagnate your heart—"

For Kirio, a boy living in the solitary valley village of Uruku, there was someone he wanted forgiveness from more than anything.
That person was Hakamori: a boy who, despite being born in the same village, was deprived of his name and exiled as a sinner.

Seeking his forgiveness, Kirio spent 5 years visiting Hakamori--however, one day, upon meeting a creature calling itself Jack, an unexpected turn in events ultimately occurs...

title: Lost Friends 2: Reason for Tears
description:
Ricardo is but a young man who dreams of becoming a splendid gardener.

By day, he works as a helper in a lord's mansion, learning the basics from the gardeners who are his seniors. By night, he heads to a secret place where he deepens his bonds with a peculiar-looking friend. Switching between the normal and the abnormal, he was satisfied with his daily life.

One day, the lord's son singles him out to be his playmate. His enjoyable days as a helper were turned upside down, as he was slowly but surely forced into an uncomfortable life as a boring 'playmate'.

What was gained, and what was lost?
'Friendship' and 'promises' intertwine, and his daily life begins to be encroached on by a fruitless miracle.

title: Lost Friends 3: Never Return
description:
What remains here is only the pitiful result of wanting to take back one's own regrets.

Several years after the end of the war between humans and fairies, while the capital has recovered splendidly, many districts are still in the midst of recovering from the war.
As part of his training, Martin, a young man studying to become a clergy, is traveling from town to town in order to deliver assistance, his friend and companion Chloe in tow.
One day, circumstances brought 'their journey' to an abrupt end.

When they awoke, they were in a cold underground world, as dark as the night.
According to Hugo, a fairy they met there, they were in an alternate dimension known as Rimbus, and the only way to return to the surface was to wait for a large door to open, which only does so on its own accord.

"If you're lucky, you might make it out pretty soon, but if you're not, it may never open in your lifetime.
And once that door is open, 'only one person' can leave."

Martin was at a loss, but in contrast the corners of Chloe's mouth slowly lifted up.
It was a dark and twisted smile that somewhat seemed happy.

title: Overpowered 2: Crux of Fate
description: Press your luck to its absolute limits as you fight for survival in a deadly monster arena!

title: Splash of Color
description: Fill the world with color one puzzle at time!

title: Chwæst: A Creeping Parasite Horror
description:
Chwæst takes place inside a living organism. Passages overgrow, corridors tighten, and the environment reacts to your presence.

At the center lies the Biomass Core (the Core) — the only way forward.

Your goal: complete simple objectives, bring offerings back to the Core, and push deeper until you find a way out.

title: Protestal
description: In "Protestal", The Parents Of Decency is now aimed to cancel the controversial and offensive videogame "Postman V". And to make this happen, they'll be ready to start their violent way from small developers to founder himself.

title: Echoes of the Hollow
description: Echoes of the Hollow is a psychological first-person horror game set in an abandoned forest village consumed by darkness and secrets. Explore, survive, and uncover the truth before the Hollow consumes you.

title: Pennies 12
description: A roguelike coin-flipping arcade machine.

title: Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Version
description: Released in 1998, this was the first 3D title in the Metal Gear series. The game pioneers 3D stealth action against the threat of war and global nuclear weapons, using live action footage, cinematic cut scenes, interwoven with innovative gameplay. The storyline, a whirlwind of intrigue and betrayal, has been hailed as the greatest story of the 20th century and was the third title in the Metal Gear series to become a hit in subsequent years.

title: Metal Gear Solid
description: Metal Gear Solid, original released for Windows PC's in 2000, is based off the Japanese only release, Metal Gear Solid: Integral. While keeping some of the new additions, inducing the bonus VR Missions, Very Easy difficulty and First Person mode, other features were removed, including from the original PlayStation game, due hardware limitations of the platform.

title: Always Together
description: ALWAYS TOGETHER is a 2D side-scroller, created to participate in the RPG Maker Horror Game Jam #5. In this new project, the developers set out to create hand-drawn illustrations and place greater emphasis on the narrative, implementing multiple deaths and some choices.

title: Project Cataclysm
description: Project Cataclysm is an online game set in the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone after a mysterious Cataclysm, crafted in a gritty stalker-like atmosphere. It immerses you in that very Zone—dangerous, grim, and living by its own laws. Every step here is a game with death, and everyone must decide for themselves whether they’re ready to stake their life to get to the truth—and uncover the mystery of the Cataclysm!

title: DarkBazaar
description: A gambling roguelite where you trade illegal weapons on the dark web to pay off a debt... or die.

title: Dremica
description:
Dremica is an immersive MMORPG that integrates blockchain technology to create a unique gaming experience. Players can explore a vast fantasy dystopian world, where they can own, trade and leverage digital assets securely through blockchain technology.

The game is played only 2 hours every week so all the action is packed into those 2 hours. You won't be seeing empty servers but a game that full of life.

title: Beat Weaver
description:
3D multi-track rhythm action with space-time bending mechanics that reward your style as much as your precision. Hit notes and switch tracks to add instruments to the mix. Become a remix machine, enter the flow state and uniquely approach each song of a highly replayable, genre-defying soundtrack.

Each journey through a song creates a unique mix driven by your choices. Improvise new routes and string together perfect combos. Fling yourself across tracks or dare to perform multiple instruments simultaneously.

Groove to a vibrant, eclectic soundtrack (made by humans, not machines) composed & selected for a never before seen synergy between music and gameplay.

title: Ojingeo Project
description:
Do you wish to participate in these games?

Desperate, intrigued, and lured by a chance to change their fates, 100 cash-strapped players accept a mysterious invitation to compete in a series of seemingly innocent games. But what begins as a test of skill, luck, and nerve quickly spirals into something far more sinister — where every victory brings you closer to unimaginable glory… and every failure could mean oblivion.

In this unforgiving arena, alliances will shift, secrets will surface, and survival demands more than strength — it demands heart, wits, and the will to do whatever it takes. When the stakes are life and death, who will rise, who will fall… and who will walk away with everything?

Every game is a test of trust, skill, and luck… but failure is permanent.

Will you outplay, outsmart, and outlast, or will you vanish like the rest?

title: Eye of the Match
description: Yellow Card? Red Card? That's up to you. As a Virtual Referee it is your responsibility to inspect football replays, identify infringements and punish those who are not following the regulations.

title: Shoot The Barrels
description: Addictive incremental game about shooting exploding barrels and upgrading your weapon.

title: Furniture Fu
description: Furniture Fu is a home-makeover, demon-hunting, hoard-fighting roguelike. Lay out furniture strategically to make awesome synergies and cosy houses - all in a day’s work for America’s first suburban ninja.

title: Muffles' Life Sentence: Episode 4
description: EPISODE 4 of Muffles' journey. A darkly quirky RPG set in a prison where inmates are remade to match their crimes.

title: Chronicles of Omniluxia
description:
Chronicles of Omniluxia is a total conversion mod set in the original fantasy world of Omniluxia. Every aspect of the game has been entirely overhauled to fit the new early medieval fantasy setting.

Omniluxia was originally released in 2019 and over the last year we have picked it back up and spent countless hours getting the mod into great shape for release with tons of new content, flavor, bug fixes, and map improvments.

title: Stolen Heart
description: Stolen Heart is a Magical Girl Deck Builder where you choose your hero equipment and spells to beat the Dungeon. The Heart of Magic is guarded by the depths monsters. Become the strongest Magical Girl and follow the right path to retrieve it!

title: Natural Vacation
description:
Kairi stepped out of the air-conditioned bus and had to squint his eyes from the blinding sunlight and summer heat. When he slowly opened his eyes, he saw the sparkling azure ocean in front of him, with the clouds adding pockets of white to the sea of blue, and he smelled the faint scent of the ocean brought in by the gentle breeze. He moved here from the city to live with his grandfather after his parents went abroad for work. The kind townspeople welcomed him to their town, including two girls Haruka and Yuzuki.

Would you like to spend a wonderful summer break together with them in this town?

title: Niizuma Lovely x Cation
description: It’s been a year since Hibiki started working in beautiful Sakuragi, a city of four seasons. He’s gotten used to his new life and everything is smooth sailing, but he started to think about his future when his close friend got married. He realized that marriage was something that doesn’t just happen one day, but it is the culmination of ‘everyday’ actions over a long period. Having made up his mind, before long he fell in love with a girl. It was the first step towards a happy marriage.

title: Last Winter
description:
Maya has been living in an underground bunker since she was a child. Together with her, there are her grandfather Arthur and Sam, the artificial intelligence in charge of the control of the structure.

What happened to the world above? Are they really the last survivors?

The discovery of a strange diary will change her life forever.

title: Monster Ops 16
description: Season 2 of Monster Ops! Black Ops soldiers Wraith and Tide know the world is against them, and they can only rely on each other. Two soldiers, forced to go rogue, with a desperate mission. There's no one left they can trust. A NSFW Gay Visual Novel Dating Sim put out in Monthly Episodes!

title: One Less Choice
description: A Russian Roulette duel twisted with Cards and Rock–Paper–Scissors.

title: Resident Evil: Survive
description: Resident Evil: Survive is a side-scroller action/horror beat em up game developed with the OpenBOR engine and based on Capcom's most iconic survival horror franchise of the same name. The game takes inspiration from The Mercenaries bonus game originally introduced in Resident Evil 3: Nemesis with a retro-inspired look.

title: Welcome to Harmony
description: Build your timeline, execute your plan, and survive Harmony as it slowly slips into something darker in this 3D deckbuilding roguelite.

title: Red Ops: Side Story
description: Dive into RED OPS: Side Story, a continuation of RED OPS: The First Infection. A short story with new mysteries to solve, more “team-building exercises,” and plenty of bonding between the guys—all from the perspective of your favorite operative, Chris!

title: Worlds Upon The Wind
description: Resettle the shards of a shattered world in this peaceful roguelite deckbuilder, covering centuries of classical Japanese art. Nurture communities, befriend animal spirits, and shape a new civilization through choices that echo across generations.

title: Devil Lift
description: Demon hunting is a day job in Devil Lift, a tag battle roguelike deckbuilder. Play as the Lilith Society, a group of underpaid and overworked demon hunters as they protect humanity from the Archbeasts of the Underworld before their shift ends.

title: Presidential Dating Simulator
description: Drumpf: Presidential Dating Simulator is the nightmarishly sexual, adults only dating sim parody THEY don't want you to play— think you've got what it takes to seduce a fat, orange president before it's too late?

title: Succubus of Aphrodisia Chapter One: Ako's First Embrace
description: Follow the lusty succubus Ako on her first foray to the mortal realms, as she seduces her way through the realm of Asteria in this short and sweet visual novel spiced with interactable animated sex scenes.

title: Fetish Locator: S&M Studio

title: Sofia's Dark Fantasies: Episode 1
description: Embark on an unparalleled adventure with Sofia Dark Fantasies, where cutting-edge technology meets immersive storytelling.
