description: Lost at Birth tells the story of an ordinary guy—stable job, nice house, comfortable routine, married—until a young woman turns his life upside‑down.

title: Ashes of Ambition
description: Start from Zero, Rise to the Top. As a fugitive ex-Special Forces op, your freedom depends on one task: eliminating a key target. Build an energy empire to fund your ops, manage resources, craft gear, and explore. Survival is just the beginning; forge your path in high-stakes tactical missions.

title: Hero of Cursed Island
description: In a island fractured by darkness, ancient evil energy pulses beneath the surface, forgotten by time, yet always present. Hero of Cursed Island is a thrilling adventure game where you must journey across a hand-crafted world to collect energy fragments and unlock your potential to defeat evil.

title: Alternate Existence
description: Love & Romance. Sex & nudity. Meet lots of beautiful women and have fun with. But be beware, life isn't just sex and fun there are sinister forces trying to stop you. It's almost as if you have an alternate existence to your current life!

title: Elewder
description: Imprisoned deep within the Succubus dungeon for eons, an opportunity to break free of your shackles presents itself. Rise to power once more, and enact your revenge! Elewder is an erotic top-down, twin-stick shooter with rogue-like elements, can you escape???

title: Dickland
description: Dickland is an exciting pixel 2D platformer with the ability to play together. The main feature is the environment, namely the amazing pussy world with its corresponding inhabitants.

title: Hitler: BDSM Bunker
description: HITLER: BDSM BUNKER is third-person shooter where you have to kill zombies in the post-apocalyptic world. you will meet a lot of bloodthirsty zombies who have only one thing on their mind - to kill you, and you in turn have to kill them all.

title: Snow x Hime
description: Pure boss-fight adult action. Battle unique male and female bosses with distinct weapons and moves. Win to unlock outfits and story shards, fully mix-and-match clothing. Lose to retry or enjoy explicit sex battles, featuring 187 high-quality 3D H animations.

title: Pandora Corp.
description:
Pandora Corp. is a short liminal horror walking simulator. This game offers a terrifying experience thanks to its unique atmosphere and aims to be a tribute to internet horror. Solve the various puzzles and unravel the buried mysteries to understand what really happened in this building.

You are an independent journalist running your own website. The site appears to be in serious trouble, and your freelance work seems to be at risk. When you heard about the mystery at Pandora Corp., where all the employees are said to have disappeared, only one thing was on your mind: to get there first and land the scoop of the year.

title: Algorithm Prescription
description: A "romance x suspense" story set in a fully AI-managed city that is considered the ideal place to live for everyone.

title: Stray Sheep vs. Unreal Killers
description: The first out of 2 volumes of the new Stray Sheep series by MOONSTONE, which is their first new series in 10 years.

title: Stray Sheep and Corpse Love
description: The second and last game in the MOONSTONE's Stray Sheep series.

title: Mitch
description: Mitch just landed! Will you help her begin her new life?

title: Sect Leader's Decree
description: Sect Leader's Decree is a turn-based colony builder focused on resource and time management. Construct buildings, research technologies, gather resources, and train your disciples to guide your sect to prosperity!

title: Quick Brown
description: Quick Brown is a cute and cozy 2d puzzle platformer about a fox trying to collect all 26 letters of the alphabet scattered across a forest. It is the first game of the "Subspace" Franchise created by Subanshh.

title: Gloopalaxy
description: Collect and study strange aquatic creatures in Gloopalaxy! Discover new life forms called Gloops, build the perfect ecosystem to keep them happy, and learn fun facts about each species as you complete a variety of scientific missions.

title: Kittenpire
description: Epic, character-focused tower defense where upgradable cats fight giant, monstrous mice.

title: SportsBlitz
description: SportsBlitz, a retro themed micro game collection of sports games.

title: Dance of Theseus
description: Dance of Theseus is a dress-up life sim set in the glamorous world of monster ballrooms. Craft new body parts, assemble yourself, and outshine everyone at themed events. Fit in. Stand out. Make friends. Fall in love. How many parts will you replace before finding your way back home?

title: Chinese Street Food Legend
description: A heartfelt game where you run a night market stall, cooking kaolengmian (grilled cold noodles). Customers come and go, stopping by to chat and share bits of their lives, joys, frustrations, and everyday struggles. At this little stall, you cook, listen, and keep living an ordinary person's life.

title: Dead Pulse
description: Outnumbered but not out. Build your base, set deadly traps, unleash powerful weapons, and fight through endless waves of the infected in this action roguelike shooter. Every choice matters. How long can you survive?

title: Telluricene
description: Love is deception, germinated in desperation. Fill the role of one of the nation's top researchers. You will have 10 days to study the rapidly spreading and mysterious new species to decide: friend or foe? The coming Telluricene rests in your hands.

title: Gothic Hell: Survivors
description: Fuse brutal synergies and erase the swarm. Slay big bosses. Explore vertical 3D gothic arenas with secrets and objectives. Deep meta, endless builds, tons of loot, fast high-chaos runs. Bullet heaven roguelite horde-survivor.

title: Fresh Squeezed Lemonade
description: Set up your stand, process fresh lemons, scoop ice, and serve the perfect drink to your neighbors. Build your popularity one satisfied customer at a time in this cozy, moderate-paced simulation full of sunny days, friendly faces, and the simple joy of sharing lemonade.

title: Cater Co.
description: Cater Co. is a kitchen management game where you make food and fulfill your customers' orders. Sit back, earn $$$, buy upgrades and optimize your kitchen.

title: My Wet Leto Comic: Fan Anthem of Deduction
description: Play as an idol wota(otaku) and mystery novelist in this pixel world filled with various game memes and joyful daily life. Continuously improve your abilities and befriend wota friends with different attributes, working together to confront a conspiracy hidden within the idol wota world...

title: LouveSystems' Realms
description: Realms is a strategy game where all actions are taken simultaneously then resolved all at once. With up to 8 players, there's no waiting for your turn here. Battle for land and for riches, upgrade your kingdom and follow your strategy to conquer other realms - become the one to rule them all.

title: Socket
description: A first-person psychological horror game where you play as a social worker who obeys a wall socket. Follow its instructions, explore the city’s last inhabited apartment building, and pry secrets from its residents. All to fulfill the terms of the contract.

title: Hands of Hell
description: Gamble your way through the eight Rings of Hell for the fate of your soul in this visual novel deckbuilder. Make friends and allies, build your deck, and maybe even fall in love as you face off against the Demon Lords of Hell.

title: S.P.E.C.T.O.R 01
description: S.P.E.C.T.O.R 01 is a Third-Person SCI-FI action shooter. You are a soldier in the distant future on a solo rescue mission codenamed S.P.E.C.T.O.R 01. Aliens have taken over certain areas around earth and have taken one of your fellow soldiers hostage. Your task is to bring them to safety.

title: Soup for Soul
description: Run a quaint Japanese ramen shop, craft every bowl your way, and shape your guests’ heartfelt stories with your cooking choices.

title: Stika
description: Stika is a single-player stealth horror game steeped in Ukrainian folklore. Navigate the Ukrainian forest, find clues, and solve puzzles to unravel the mysteries of night, all while evading folklore creatures. With multiple-endings, your choices matter — can you survive a night with the Rusalka?

title: I Just Wanted to Talk About Halo
description: You chat with a stranger on an Omegalul chatroom. You both match on the topic of Halo. Surely this will go well.

title: Cozy Game Restoration
description: Cozy Game Restoration is a soothing simulator where you gently bring forgotten video game cartridges back to life. Tear wrapping paper, peel old stickers, lift away grime, and transform dusty relics into cherished collectibles. No pressure or failure, just the quiet joy of restoring memories.

title: Battle Narf
description: An extremely late entry for the Vextro Unplugged jam, strongly inspired by Battle Kid, Fortress of Peril.

title: Enthrallor
description: Enthrallor is a 2D top-down action-adventure puzzle game set in a world scarred by forgotten mage wars. You play as Roland, a young mage trapped inside a sentient, decaying armor called an Enthrallor that refuses to let him go.

title: ToMyX
description: ToMyX is a narrative arcade action game that blends Visual Novel storytelling with fast-paced action, puzzles and emotional confrontations. Inspired by the developer's real past relationships, players must survive a surreal TV game show where memories become gameplay and every chapter ends with a Final Judgment.

title: Echo Zero
description: Descend into a dangerous, procedurally generated sci-fi underworld in this tower defense roguelike. Explore, gather resources, uncover powerful wargear and upgrades, build and defend your base, and battle a mysterious new species on the verge of breaching the surface.

title: Null Anchor
description: Null anchor is a space-sim-lite where you fly, fight, scavenge, steal, trade, refuel, upgrade, repair, evade cops, hunt bounties and run, because you can't hide.

title: Arcane Eclipse
description: Find a way to bring back the sun from this everlasting eclipse.

title: This Night
description: A single-player exploration/scavenger hunt game set in a haunted forest where the player searches for a missing key needed to unlock a remote cabin. The key spawns in different areas each playthrough and roaming spirits must be avoided while discovering landmarks and hidden locations, including an underground cave. Difficulty settings along with tracked run statistics encourage players to improve their times and complete repeated runs.

title: Fulfill Wishes and Save You
description: This is a visual novel game where players play a protagonist trapped in a time loop and break the loop to save the heroine. The game contains suspense, love, and funny storylines. Players need to make the right choices, and there are multiple endings to explore in the game.

title: Basement to the Sky
description: Basement to the Sky is a nostalgic rocket-crafting life simulation that takes you back to the golden days of childhood. Step into the shoes of your younger self: build and launch rockets, earn money by helping with chores, and cook your own delicious meals. Experiment with various parts to soar higher than ever before. Can your rocket truly reach the vastness of outer space? Embark on a journey where a child's dream meets the stars.

title: Witch Switched
description: A "man" is transformed into a woman by a vengeful witch and realizes she likes it better this way.

title: Sotsugyo Omedeto
description: Sotsugyo Omedeto is a graduation exam forced upon students at an all-girls high school. Each round demands choices and judgment, leading to inevitable eliminations. The exam follows strict rules, and every decision carries lasting consequences. In the end, only one student is allowed to graduate.

title: Aurora Hills: Chapter 2
description: Aurora Hills: Chapter 2 is the second part in series of point and click puzzle adventure games. Follow the journey of Ethan Hill, a park ranger tasked with investigating strange disappearances from a national park to uncover the mystery of Aurora Hills!

title: The Factory Must Fall
description: Build a factory, then let it battle other players! Draft buildings from a randomized shop, optimize resource allocation and army composition, then watch your factory crush your friends and foes in this PvP factory-builder.

title: Blood Night
description: (Multiplayer | COOP) THE FOREST IS DEAD. YOU ARE NOT. Survive. Build. Kill everyone. A world where zombies are smarter than they look. Inventory, crafting, and building are your tools in the war for tomorrow.

title: Clicker Kids
description: A clicker / idle incremental game with simple gameplay, deep progression, and endless strategy. Level heroes, unlock powerful upgrades, and watch the numbers go up. Easy to start, hard to stop.

title: Crystal of Death
description: Early 2000s. You are a kidnapped chemistry professor forced to survive a single night. Enemies close in, paranoia rises, every second counts. Cook before time runs out… and maybe, just this once, let him cook.

title: Aenigma
description: Set in the year 4XXX, humanity lives disconnected inside underground megastructures to escape the threat of the ever-expanding silicon-based lifeforms.

title: TheParcelEscape
description: TheParcel-Escape is a first-person psychological horror puzzle-escape game where you explore Chinese Dreamcore memory scenes, solve bizarre puzzles to find the parcel code, and flee the daily eternal nightmare before your Sanity runs out.

title: Field of Heroes
description: Swords, sorcery – and soccer. Assemble your orc players in Field of Heroes, the wildest, most radical online sports brawler ever. Conquer existing fields or create your own – but do it as a team. Sharpen your weapons, focus your spells, and SCORE!

title: Valkeala Climb Race
description: 2d racing game where played drive big car and mission is to find star under 45 seconds and finish levels

title: Seeker 3
description: Seeker 3 is a cozy, story-driven adventure where players take on the role of Alfie, a stranded alien with the ability to fly and shapeshift. As he navigates a mysterious island, he must gather five stars to power his spaceship and find his way home.

title: Toon TD
description: Toon TD is a free to play Tower Defense from Gee Studios. Defend your castle. Explore new environments. Face fierce bosses. Develop new and unique strategies for every level in this next evolution of the Tower Defense genre.

title: Cursed Blight
description: Cursed Blight is a short, single-player, old-school dungeon-crawling adventure steeped in unforgiving darkness.

title: The Double
description: Tarot meets Blackjack with psychological horror inspired by Dostoevsky. A gore card game based on one of the strangest novels. Gameplay with puzzles, dark themes, surreal horror, cards and black humor. Experimental gameplay blending multiple mechanics

title: Killing Momentum: Umbral Moon
description: You are the commander, and your choices define your fate. Lead warriors on a perilous journey under the ghastly Umbral Moon. Defeat brutal enemies in tactical combat where momentum is everything. Brave deadly narrative encounters and manage the volatile bonds of your team of misfits to survive.

title: Shattered Chess
description:
You only have 10 moves. Every capture counts for scoring.
Build huge combo chains, multiply your score, and push your run as far as possible.
Upgrade powerful passives, discover broken synergies, and survive bosses that completely twist the rules of the game.

title: Infinite Ruins
description: An incremental mining game where you manage golems, destroy blocks, unlock upgrades, and descend infinitely in search of ever more valuable resources.

title: Arishihi no Watashitachi he
description: Arishihi no Watashitachi he is a "reversed pastoral adventure" set in a world where only lush nature and remnants of civilization remain. In this world, a boy who has lost his memory and a girl dreaming of adulthood weave their future together.

title: Golf 5 Max
description: Golf 5 MAX is a retro golf arcade with vibrant 80s style, fast-paced matches, and simple controls. Play Arcade, Versus, or Challenge modes, choose from six golfers ️, and aim to become world champion across stylish and colorful courses.

title: Hole Your Horses: Champion Edition
description: A comedic arcade-action game which purports to be a simulation of dressage (competitive horse gymnastics) but mainly involves tossing a flailing horse ragdoll through a hole in a swiftly approaching wall, “Human Tetris”-style. Complete challenges to unlock additional horses and uncover more of this strange horse-oriented world.

title: Fedya Mod
description: Welcome to Fedya Mod. This game is all about your creativity and having fun. Our team is currently developing this game and we will add new features in the future.

title: Happy Harvest
description: A cozy themed, idle incremental farming game.

title: Dyrocraft 2: Reborn
description:
Dyrocraft is a multiplayer sandbox survival game in which players can explore an open world with friends, gather resources, and build their own base. The focus is on freedom and cooperation: players can establish farms, shape their surroundings, and develop their own playstyle.

In addition to building, survival also plays a central role. In the world of Dyrocraft, zombies appear that drop valuable equipment but at the same time pose a constant threat. They can attack and kill players, bringing tension and risk to every gaming session.

The combination of building, farming, combat, and cooperative gameplay creates a dynamic gaming experience that evolves with every decision and progress.

title: Psps Dream Mart
description: Build, manage, and optimize your cozy supermarket where every customer is cute animal and every decision matters. From shelf placement to pricing strategy, your goal is simple: turn a humble mart into the ultimate feline shopping paradise

title: Hungry Snake
description: Hungry Snake is a fast, creepy twist on the classic arcade game.

title: Operation Obliteration 2
description: Operation Obliteration 2 is an old-school FPS stripped to the bone. Play any level in any order. Cut scenes are cut. Filler removed. No hand-holding. No safe spaces. Just weapons, enemies, and unlocked levels built to hit fast & hard. Adapt or die. learn or die again. Fight through a brutal alternate-history WWII campaign where aggression is survival and hesitation means death. Play the campaign straight through—or drop into any mission instantly. Nothing hidden or locked and every level available. All levels can be finished, your are given the resources, find them and use them correctly! Improvise, adapt and overcome!

title: What Happened At Sugar Hill?
description: A First Person Horror Walking Simulator set in a fictional town called Sugar Hill. Play as various characters trying to unravel the mystery of What Happened At Sugar Hill.

title: Euro 3v3
description: Euro 3v3 is a Tactical Team Shooter That is FREE TO PLAY ON STEAM!

title: End of End
description: End of End is a roguelite dungeon crawling auto battler where you fight and loot your way through unique randomized dungeons filled with hand-crafted rooms and encounters. Discover equipment and research abilities to create powerful combinations. Prepare yourself as best you can, and face bosses with powerful abilities. Defeat the threats for as long as you can without running out of torch light, upgrading yourself and your village.

title: Girl in Darkness
description: Traverse horrid ruins and seek opulent prizes. A game about a girl in terrible danger.

title: Gunship Origins
description: Fly combat helicopters solo or co-op multiplayer in the AH-64 Apache, OH-58 Kiowa Warrior, and UH-60 Blackhawk. Dynamic missions including search and destroy, rescue, and more. Pilot progression: get promoted and earn awards.

title: LakeQueen
description: “Don’t get in that damn water.” Resist her call. Evade the hunters. Escape the realm of the LakeQueen before it swallows you whole.

title: Ajisai Shiyou ka!
description:
Sublation.
The moment when the old is negated, giving rise to the new.

Red, yet not red.
Blue, yet not blue.

A love simulation that paints the clash of red and blue, exploring the theme of dialectics in romance.

A pair of lovers living in reality, and two goddesses wandering through dreams.

These two worlds, never meant to intersect, will intertwine through your intervention.

Red and blue.
Knowledge and folly.
Mars and Earth.
Passion and calm.
Dreams and reality.
Truth and illusion.

Thesis and antithesis clash, simulating the process of their sublation.

With dialectics as the core theme, this game is inspired by the In Praise of Folly and Chaos theory.

title: Crocodile Blood: The Final Moments of Kurumizawa Keiko
description: A Silver Case fangame about a woman named Keiko Kurumizawa investigating the 24th Ward and her untimely fate.

title: Dwell
description: DWELL is a first-person psychological horror game where players explore a disturbing environment, uncover hidden secrets, solve puzzles, and survive terrifying encounters. The game focuses on tense atmosphere, exploration, and story-driven horror.

title: Vanguard Of Armor
description: Vanguard of Armor": An adrenaline-packed TPS tank battle game. Includes 5v5 Capture the Flag, ranked matches, and PvE modes, focusing on strategy and teamwork.

title: White City Dating Sim
description: May 6th, 2016. You remember it, don't you? It's time to wake up. Step outside and see what today brings. There are so many different people out there to meet, but what if you had a chance encounter today with someone who will change your life? Trust yourself, have no fear, and I know you will find a new beginning today.

title: Fun Park Simulator
description: Rebuild an abandoned theme park in this first-person simulation. Build rides, shops, and decorations, keep guests happy, earn stars, unlock upgrades, hire staff, stop troublemakers, and turn your park into a famous attraction.

title: The Spooky Island
description: A dark horror game in which the protagonist, Liam, embarks on an expedition to an island to find treasure and earn money. But the island holds secrets and horrors. Over time, the expedition turns into a nightmare from which he must escape...

title: Lost Maria: Namonaki Hana
description:
LostMaria: Nameless Flower is a horror role-playing game set in a world rebuilding after the collapse of civilization. When reports of ghosts emerge from the isolated Beolb Mansion, several characters enter the estate for different reasons. Players switch between protagonists, fight supernatural creatures, explore the mansion and nearby town, and uncover the mysteries surrounding Noah and the region’s paranormal activity.

The game features character-switching mechanics, cooperative support during battles, multiple endings and a progression system in which organs obtained from defeated enemies can be consumed to improve character statistics.

title: Vampire on Trial
description:
A grand drama of Guilt and Justice is now unfolding within the hallowed halls of Our Court. Be sure not to miss it. After all, for this play, the conclusion is yours to decide.
In this short visual novel, you have the opportunity to observe a certain trial from beginning to end, and to reach your own conclusions.

title: LiveStream
description: You are a streamer who entered an abandoned building for hype. But the game quickly turns into a real nightmare — the chat and donations influence what's happening, and you try to survive and understand what's going on.

title: The Guest: Home Alone
description: The Guest: Home Alone is a short psychological horror experience. You play as Tyler, a man who returns home after a long day at work seeking rest — but something feels wrong. Are you really alone?.

title: Les Heures Bleues: Sang sur pierre à Pétrichor
Moon Blue Legend Remake
description: "MoonBlueLegendRemake" is believed to be a childhood memory for many RPG Maker players. In the game, the small-town boy, Lu Weipi, who hunts and teases female villagers every day, gradually uncovers the veil of ancient civilization, which is beyond his imagination.

title: Yuè Lán Chuánqí II: Zhòu Yìn Zú Chuánshuō
description: Set ten years after the first game, you play as Lu Xiaofei — a boy bearing a mysterious mark — who gets swept into a cross-realm adventure after his adoptive parents go missing. Along the way he crosses paths with the feared Cursed Seal Tribe, and three girls who each leave a lasting impression on him. A short but emotionally weighty RPG Maker freeware game from Taiwan with a devoted cult following.

title: Phantom Floor
description: You are trapped on the Phantom Floor. You must find a way to escape, but keep quiet, it's always listening.

title: Fame or Folly
description: In a world where wars are fought on stages, compete for a single royal request from the King. Fame or Folly is a deckbuilder of deckbuilders where you draft a new trouper every turn. Recruit wisely, unlock powerful synergies, and survive the critics in this handcrafted pixel-art strategy roguelite

title: Adventures of the Mysterious World: The Lost of the Hearts
description: "I hate my brother!" "I hate my sister even more!" Have you ever felt that way? The siblings at the heart of this story certainly have. Noki and Eli, a brother and sister, lose their pet bird near a forest and venture deep into its dark depths to search for it. No matter how hard they look, they can't find it — and just as they're about to give up and head home, an accident triggers a massive forest fire. They barely escape, only to find themselves each completely alone in an unfamiliar place. The two set off on separate journeys, searching for one another — and along the way, seeking to reclaim what matters most to them.

title: LoopiaLike
description:
LoopiaLike — A bullet heaven roguelite where spell fusion changes everything.

Choose your wizard, survive endless waves of enemies, fuse spells into devastating combos, and become unstoppable. Every run is different. Every build is unique.

title: Raisin Wordsearch
description: Raisin's Wordsearch is the ultimate engagement tool for live streamers. transform your stream into an interactive game show where your viewers are the players.

title: Go Big
description: A paranormal investigator takes a one way road to Vampire Vegas... What they find; a girl with an appetite for cash. Literally. Luckily, they came prepared...

title: Paper Robot
description: Follow the adventures of the recently reactivated robot D4-BB13 (or Dabble for short) as he travels near and far in his quest for the golden gears needed to repair the legendary Dream Machine. Meet a huge cast of colorful characters, and team up with new partners to explore the lands. Collect modules and items to power up Dabble in this classic turn-based, low-number combat system where every point of damage counts!

title: BASED
description: BASED is a co-op platformer where you combo the Moon to the sky every night. Master movement and weapons to rise the Moon in one piece. Who knows what secrets you'll find on your way up. Join B.A.S.E.D. tonight!

title: Needle Sleep
description: Wind your way through the darkened hallways of Blackburn Surgical Hospital. Are you awake? Asleep? Or something in between? You can search for help, or maybe decide that it's better to be alone in the depths of...Needle Sleep.

title: The Story About Princess 8 Out of 10
description: Once upon a time, there was a perfectly average princess — 8/10 at best. No singing animals, no magical destiny. Just an annoying father-king and a whole bunch of creepy barons trying to marry her off.

title: Noddy and the Toyland Fair
description: In “Noddy and the Toyland Fair”, the player helps Noddy setting up the stands for the Toyland Fair and dealing with Sly and Gobbo's sabotage of the party, through a series of mini-games.

title: Last 4 Days
description: Turn-based tactics meets base building in a desperate battle for survival against a rogue AI army. Five squads. Four days. Each battlefield a vital link in the plan. Manage your units, fortify your position and think ahead, as what you decide today, you may regret tomorrow.

title: Back to Stables
description:
Back to Stables is a cozy puzzle adventure where you guide the escaped horse, George, through a maze of obstacles. You lure George with apples, help him avoid scary forest creatures, and guide him safely to the trailer using as few apples as possible.

The game has a cozy, relaxed atmosphere, with stylized visuals. Throughout the levels, you can unlock customization options for George, from new skins to accessories like hats and bows.

title: Spiritus Sancti
description: Spiritus Sancti is a first-person psychological horror where your voice is your weapon. Speak sacred rites through your microphone to repel, stun, and exorcise the forces of darkness. Every encounter is real-time, every word a test of faith. An experience like no other.

title: Tower vs Goblins: Fight & Defence
description: Defend your kingdom against hordes of goblins in an epic tower defense game with elements of casual shooter and strategy.

title: Postal X: 10th Anniversary Collector's Edition
description: Bundle by Running with Scissors made to promote the Postal 3 and Postal movie release

title: Defense Grid 2: Aftermath
description: Defense Grid 2: Aftermath is the first official expansion to Defense Grid 2 - 10 years after launch. Aftermath adds five large, open-ended story missions that continue the conflict with Fletcher and Governor Tydell right after the last levels in the main campaign.

title: One in One Million
description: Trapped in a small room, four friends must uncover the mystery hidden within its walls while confronting the secrets of an elusive truth. Answers are just a button away. A psychological thriller visual novel packed with dark humor and fascinating facts about raccoons.

title: Cat Cursor by Travellin Cats
description: Desktop cat cursor for Windows: turn your boring cursor into an adorable cat paw. Boop!

title: Soldier
description: Un juego de disparos en primera persona con bombas y zombies ¿A que esperas para probarlo?

title: Random Chaos Dungeon
description: Roguelike where even enemies, bosses, and their attacks are randomly generated. Beat enemies and take the weapons they were using! With 1-4 players, find and beat bosses in the open world and advance towards the source of the chaos! High difficulty, but adjustable. Completely free!

title: Two Rings: Vanquish and Bloom
description: An isometric action game where you wield the power of destruction and creation in your hands, literally. Right hand attacks, left hand regenerates. Ascend through the divine realms through combat that rewards strategic resource management and precise execution.

title: Pixel Art Coloring Book 2
description: Unleash your creativity with Pixel Art Coloring Book 2! Color by number and bring stunning pixel masterpieces to life—from anime and unicorns to retro vibes and pop art! Relax, de-stress, and paint your way through hundreds of dazzling designs. Tap, color, and let the magic happen!

title: Angry Youth
description: An Indie 2D Fighting game that takes place in the mid-1990s, in the city of Sancatown, where six teenagers, influenced by fighting video games, decide to hold a little fighting tournament in the neighborhood where they live.

title: Hoa 2
description: Hoa 2 opens a long, long time after Hoa closed with its emotionally charged ending, leaving fans wondering what happened to the namesake little fairy. The cycle of life brings her back to a homeland reshaped by time, and her old friends have long since passed. Alone in a world both familiar and changed, Hoa must find new purpose in this gentle and heartfelt tale of change, of letting go and moving forward.

title: Veils of the Past
description: A psychological mystery where every clue reshapes reality. Unravel the link between a vanished woman and your missing sister, only to discover four entirely different truths, each revealing a new world, a new enemy, and the price of remembering.

title: Hell of a Bullet
description: Can you dodge all the bullets in this party game? Hell of a Bullet brings fast, bite sized matches where you and up to 3 friends face unique (and strange) attacks in arenas with diverse effects. Use modifiers to tune the game to your liking... Or just embrace the chaos.

title: Gion Corridor
description: Set against the backdrop of a Japanese-style townscape reminiscent of Gion, this exploration-based horror game involves searching for “anomalies” and offering prayers. A work dedicated to those who feel bored with their daily lives.

title: BeastBreak: Monster Horde Shooter
description: Fight for survival in a fast-paced monster shooter focused on intense encounters, powerful weapons, and escalating boss battles. Unlock new gear, master your loadout, and prove your skill on global leaderboards.

title: Truth Universally Acknowledged: Seasilk Heart
description: Truth Universally Acknowledged - Seasilk Heart is a short mermaid dating sim with 2 love interests.

title: Ill Flos
description: A long-form fantasy RPG with turn-based battles, beginning with the legend of the god dwelling in the World Tree and its conflict with humankind.

title: Panic of the Apes
description: Panic of the Apes is a chaotic 1 to 4 player couch PvP game where apes battle to stockpile before a volcano erupts. Grab bananas, pelt rivals to steal theirs, eat for speed boosts, loot chests, and dodge roll to deflect shots. Most bananas at zero wins. First ape to three rounds is King Chimp!

title: Ryzy Nyil
description: Vertical-scrolling 2D shooting game with three types of weapons

title: Mecha Legends
description: As the pilot of a massive mechanical armor, you will face powerful dragons and dangerous creatures dwelling in the darkest corners of the world. Customize your mecha: Change its appearance, weapons, and abilities!

title: Desktop Sex Doll
description: Desktop Sex Doll is a game for those who just want to relax and enjoy a nice and unobtrusive dance of a girl on their computer desktop. You can even make the girl dance on the documents you have just made, without doing any harm to them, but we do not recommend it in the office.

title: Ktrl Smash
description: Ktrl Smash is a fast-paced multiplayer arena game where anything can become a weapon. Pick your fighter, grab bats, baseballs, or even chairs, collect stat boosts, and fight to get the most kills before time runs out. Stay alert, keep moving, and defeat as many players as you can.

title: DFX
description: Three animation-focused games in one, all based on Legacy Dual Family.

title: Rollin Ravioli
description: A physics-based rage game. Control a ravioli can. Fight the physics. Accept the fall. Inspired by an iconic early 2000s ravioli commercial.

title: Upgrade! Inc.
description: Upgrade! Inc. is a satisfying text-based idle game about unlock and upgrade a series of production lines, hire employeesa nd researching for powerful bonuses. Simple, cozy, addictive, and endlessly engaging. Start your empire today!

title: Super Basketball Classics
description: Classic arcade basketball returns with a twist. Super Basketball Classics Featuring the World Famous Harlem Globetrotters combines retro-inspired gameplay, modern upgrades, and Globetrotter flair for the ultimate hoops showdown.

title: Monster Punk
description: Dominate the ultimate motor-sport ritual. Smash, blast, and pull off wild stunts through extreme tournament challenges. Out-score rivals alone or co-op to survive elimination, win the 1v1 final showdown, and earn the cash to upgrade your ride. Rise from "nobody" to arena champion.

title: AfterQuest
description: AfterQuest is a fast-paced roguelite RPG with tactical, turn-based combat. Build your party by choosing three heroes from a growing roster, experiment with endless build combinations, and experience a character-driven story where defeat only makes you stronger.

title: The King is Watching: Crowns of History
description: Play as Cleopatra, Taizong of Tang, and Xerxes, three legendary-inspired rulers with radically different playstyles. Master death and rebirth, dominate with devastating defenses, or risk everything for overwhelming power.

title: Don't Click The Flower
description:
Don't Click the Flower is a narrative personality test where every choice matters.
Answer the questions… but remember the only rule: Don’t click the flower.

title: Thomas & Friends: Wonders of Sodor - James Addon
description:
Join everyone’s favourite red, mixed-traffic tender engine on some extra adventures around Sodor.

Thomas & Friends: Wonders of Sodor – James Add-On is powered by Train Sim World, combining the unparalleled detail and realism of Unreal Engine and Simugraph with accessible controls to create a nostalgic experience that all Thomas & Friends fans can enjoy.

title: Octopinbs
description: A multiplayer action game for 3-10 people. Firefighters (octopuses) must capture the artists (squid) who have infiltrated their ranks! These saboteurs may tell clever tales...but actions never lie.

title: No Wings Required
description: Start your first day at work as an unqualified duck with a balloon and way too much confidence. Wander the Featherfall Islands, help quirky locals, and learn that “winging it” might actually be a real career strategy.

title: Thomas & Friends: Wonders of Sodor - Deluxe Edition
description: This Deluxe Bundle of Thomas & Friends: Wonders of Sodor includes North Western Railway’s Number 5 engine: James! Join everyone’s favourite red, mixed-traffic tender engine on some extra adventures around Sodor.

title: Final Fantasy VII: Regenesis
description: An in progress demake of Final Fantasy VII in the RPG Maker 2003 Engine

title: Cursed Cargo
description: Cursed Cargo is an online co-op comedy-horror where the environment is as dangerous as the monsters. Team up with up to 4 players to transport unpredictable cargo using physics-based tools. Use proximity voice chat to coordinate, but be careful—the entities are always listening.

title: Drift
description: A calm, dreamlike exploration experience set in a procedurally generated world where shifting landscapes and quiet structures emerge from the haze.

title: Void Game
description: Void Game() is a minimalist puzzle game about Death, its many faces, and its inevitable counterpart: Life. Solve text-based puzzles with lite-ARG elements. Good Luck and Have Fun.

title: Desktop Standing Card Plates
description: A brand new version of desktop card, now you can play AFK games on the desktop by clicking on the sword in the upper left corner to enter the game

title: Learnmoor: Kids Academy
description: Learnoor: Kids Academy brings four fun and educational games for kids from preschool to 1st grade! Play exciting mini-games, practice key skills like math and reading, unlock secret characters, and watch your child learn while having a blast!

title: Cactus Simulator
description: Cactus Simulator is a game in which you can become a cactus.

title: Modern Arena
description: Let's go battle. Just enjoy it.

title: My Girlfriend is a Vamp
description: Guide a Vampire Autistic Magic Princess through a 2D narrative adventure where everyday situations are the real dangers. Avoid sensory overload, offer emotional support, and make meaningful choices as you help your VAMP girlfriend return to her castle and strengthen your relationship.

title: Fortnite: Chapter 7 - Season 2: Showdown
description: It’s time to make your choice and take out your rivals… will you side with The Foundation or The Ice King? Settle the score in Fortnite: Showdown.

title: Pizza at Resort 64
description: Welcome to your temporary vacation job! Work for seven days as a pizza chef at a tropical resort that's too perfect to be real. Take care of the pizzeria, explore secluded areas of the island, and gradually realize that something in the routine isn't quite right.

title: Starcrest Saga
description: Starcrest Saga is an action/adventure platformer set in space, developed by Piyoverse Entertainment.

title: Protecting the Diamond
description: Protect the precious diamond for the given time and pass the level

title: IronWood
description: IronWood is a first person shooter that takes inspiration from many of the older games that first popularized the genre, like Blood, Quake, and Unreal. Travel across a variety of levels, find powerful weapons and artifacts, and use them to your advantage against the enemies prevalent in each area.

title: By Sword & Road
description: Minimalistic RTS game about logistics and war! On this battlefield, supply lines are everything - cut them off and your enemies will wither, or use special abilities to gain the advantage. The game features an original story campaign and skirmish challenges. Conquer your enemies by Sword & Road!

title: DotAge: Trade Secrets
description: Village elder, help us! Ride horses, build roads, boats and carts, send pips to explore and trade exotic resources in this new DLC with unique mechanics!

title: Oblako
description: In this relaxing puzzle game, destroy blocks and reach the heart block, which can't be destroyed. Clear tougher blocks and use crystals to break special "domino" blocks. With charming art and a soothing soundtrack, help the main characters meet while you unwind and enjoy the chill vibes!

title: Those Who Rule II
description: When a country cracks, those willing to act will decide its future. From a small militia to a force that shapes a nation, forge your squad, customize builds, and outmaneuver foes in challenging turn-based battles as you shape a gripping story of hope, betrayal, and the price of unity.

title: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
description:
Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis brings a new chapter to the beloved tower defense saga, packed with the charm fans fell in love with.

Journey back to the very beginning of the Kingdom with the mission to rewrite history, and stop young Vez’nan before darkness takes hold!

Return to the original Kingdom Rush lands, at a time when legends were just beginning. Recruit familiar faces, revisit iconic battlefields, and build strategic defenses to outsmart relentless enemy waves through careful planning.

The beloved tower defense gameplay comes back with bold new twists, epic fights, and the signature Kingdom Rush humor. Along the way, you’ll encounter surprising returns, memorable challenges, and the most ambitious Kingdom Rush adventure yet.

Defend the past to change the future.

title: Ready or Not: Boiling Point
description: The relentlessly debased city of Los Sueños faces an existential crisis when a subversive terror attack severs any remaining faith in what's become an ineffective and overwhelmingly militarized city government.

title: Womb of Worms
description: Womb of Worms is a short horror game where a terrifying ancient god manifests itself through worms and maggots, looking to be reborn through someone's body.

title: Frontier Control: Invasion
description: Frontier Control: Invasion is a Real-Time Strategy survival game in which you play the commander of a human space colony under the attack of outer space robots. Build your base, train your colony, and fight herds of enemies and bosses.

title: CAPTCHA Hell
description: CAPTCHA Hell is a pixel art adventure puzzle game where you are just trying to buy a concert ticket, but the CAPTCHAs have other plans.

title: MotoGP 26
description: Live the real MotoGP experience with all the thrills of the Official 2026 Season, renewed physics built around a new rider-based handling system, a more complete Career mode, dynamic Riders Ratings and much more.

title: Soul Reaper: Endless Harvest
description: A fast-paced incremental survival game where you harvest souls, master enemy patterns, and grow permanently stronger in short, intense sessions.

title: Why To JiangHu
description: The author of 'Why to Jianghu' has no intention of writing a story, all he wants to do is create a world where anyone can write their own story, and even he is just an NPC.

title: Ultimate Frolf Chaos!
description: Just an average multiplayer golfing game for up to eight players... with FROGS?

title: Crucifier
description: Crucifier is the worlds most Christian racing game ever developed! Play as a Roman soldier as he completes his day! Compete in 3 races to get on the top score boards! Farm your local fields for crops to obtain enough money to rest comfortably! Talk to lovely locals and battle a crazy time traveler!

title: Magical Psalter: Yù Mó zhī Lù
2D Ver. Mega Man Legends 3: The Prologue!
description: A fan-made recreation of the cancelled Megaman Legends 3 prologue, with the graphics and gameplay of the classic NES Mega Man games.

title: Tropical Lost Island
description: Tropical Lost Island is a treasure hunt that will lead you through exotic places, mystery temples, and caves from New York to the Hawaiin Island. Help the rescue team searching for lost pilot on one small Hawaiian island.... and discover its mystery.

title: Shiokaze no Kieru Umi ni
description: One day, Susumu meets Kousuke on the beach. Kousuke tells Susumu about his plan to salvage a yacht. "I wanna go somewhere by yacht." Susumu agrees to his plan and starts to work with him. Mishio and Rikako join them later on, and co-work together. Susumu gradually feels attracted to Mishio. Will they be able to successfully repair the yacht...?

title: Pest Control Simulator
description: Pest Control Simulator lets you eliminate various pests with a range of tools. Use sprays for small bugs, electric rackets for flying pests, and glue pads for larger ones. Clean the chaos and keep your environment pest-free!

title: 2022 SURVIVAL GUIDE
description: 1.Survival plot puzzle video game 2.Linear game with complete and rich plot 3.Player can choose three different game ways: sneaking, attacking and outwitting

title: No Rest for Lex
description: Neither Rex nor truffle manager, Lex now enjoys a quiet life... No way! Realities have overlapped, everyone talks about a mysterious Loop and Lex, once again must deal with everything. Maybe getting lost is the only way to find his place.

title: Arvoch Alliance SE
description: Advanced First Person Space Flight Combat Simulation.

title: The Experiment: 49
description: The Eexperiment: 49 is a first-person horror game that immerses you in the depths of fear A dangerous experiment that escaped from HelixGen Labs has reached a family home deep in the forest. Your mission is to uncover the secrets hidden within the house, survive, and find a way to end this nightmare.

title: Mosquito
description: Mosquitoes buzzing in your ear? Now you can get your revenge!

title: HWTC: Happy Worker Tool Company
description: In a communist dystopia built on loyalty and fear, every box you pack feeds a dying system. A dark psychological simulation about the cost of staying useful, where routine replaces thought, silence feels safe, and obedience is the only way to survive.

title: Chess Quest: A Cozy Puzzle
description: A relaxing chess-inspired puzzle game. Move your knight through handcrafted levels, solve clever challenges, and enjoy a cozy atmosphere.

title: Gifts, Please
description: Elf Controller, the Christmas fates are in your hands! Review the documents, uncover the tricksters, and give gifts only to the deserving. Your decision determines whether a child gets a celebration or just a lump of coal. This is your responsibility and your magic. Merry Christmas!

title: Mujun's Casefile: The Mystery Mansion
description: Mystery detective with eye-catching pixel art graphics. Gather clues, solve riddles, and collect unexpected and interesting game endings!

title: Maze Workout: Lost Urban Exit Game - Trials2
description: It's Maze Workout trials2 game with more then 70 levels, you are alone, find the keys and the exit. "check the music in the video".

title: Yoshiko, Go to Your Relatives' House!
description: Visiting a relative's house—it is a grand adventure. Presented by Satoru Gobunme, a creator with over 500,000 YouTube subscribers! Control the tragic heroine "Yoshiko Obune," overcome attacking strangers, traps, and exploding pandas to safely

title: Meowgic
description: YapYap X Cats X Harry Potter vibes. A co-op fantasy adventure where your voice is magic. Play as cat wizards, cast spells by shouting into your mic, explore fairy-tale worlds, fight monsters, and return to your hot air baloon loaded with loot

title: Impirical Evidence
description:
A comedy adventure game featuring classic inventory based puzzles. Arthur is a skeptic who dedicated his life to denying the paranormal. Murray is the electric Imp he accidentally summoned. Now Arthur must solve mysteries while bound to the very evidence of the supernatural itself.

Arthur Marley is a professional Paranormal Debunker.

For twenty years he has used science, deductive logic, and a healthy dose of arrogance to prove that every ghost is just a projection and every monster is just a well-made costume. He is a man of facts in a world of frauds.

He was the best at denying the impossible… until he accidentally summoned it.

Enter Murray.

A chaotic, playful, electric Imp. He is bound to Arthur and subject to physics laws, yet he cannot directly interact with it and remains invisible to everyone else.

Now Arthur must continue his investigations while dragging around a supernatural partner he refuses to believe in.

Impirical Evidence is a comedy adventure that blends the inventory-based gameplay of 90s classics with a modern, gamepad-friendly presentation.

title: Another Day As President
description: You are the president. Stay awake, work, survive... Complete your term one day at a time whilst fending off disobedient staff. Juggle tasks, stay alert, and don't miss a shot.

title: Bless: Close Your Eyes,Open Your Mind.
description: The main character left his hometown following his parents job needs. He had to part with a girl who often came to his dreams ever since. Ten years later he returns to this town and tries to find that girl whose image is blurred in his memory. His former friend suggest trying to search for her on the Internet using an online chat "Masquerade".

title: Hexistence
description: Hexistence is a Tower Defense Roguelike Deck Builder based on four universal elements: Matter, Energy, Space & Time. Place powerful towers and play wondrous spells to defend the Hexspire from the waves of Ethereals sent by the Ether...

title: Tokens
description: A deckbuilder roguelike that flips the rules with double-sided tokens. Line them up to trigger powerful Harmonies, forge synergies with Arcanes and Effigies, and face Mister Mirage’s exciting challenges.

title: RIIP
description: Rip through the fabric of space and time.

title: Knight's Fly
description: Soar gracefully through a peaceful landscape.

title: The Arrogance of Man
description: A vehicle shuts down due to shear cold, the flesh follows.

title: Banana Bam
description: You are a banana on a top secret mission to eliminate evil plant monsters.

title: The Family Trip
description: An 13-year-old boy travels with his parents to a cabin in a remote area for a short trip. During their stay, they explore the surroundings, visit a nearby abandoned house, and spend their evenings at the cabin. The trip does not continue as planned.

title: Gardens of a New World
description: The residents of the dead world slowly stumble out of their dying reality and into a new strange one. However, this world is simply a limbo. A place between realms. You may stay for as long as you'd like, there are quite a few things to find. But eventually we all must reach our destination, right?

title: Undead Chronicles
description: A slow-burn FPS survival horror set in 1923 Istanbul. Begin inside the Imperial Ottoman Bank and descend into sealed vaults, flooded cisterns, and foggy streets. Scarce ammo. Methodical gunplay. No arcade action. Face slow, relentless undead where precision means survival. One bite ends it all.

title: The Undermall
description: This is an anomaly game set inside a mall. Currently only one store is available ("Warm Subject") with many more planned. Spot the difference game with a touch of horror / jump scares.

title: Boin
description:
Ichigo always wanted to be a teacher. But he never imagined that his dream would turn out to be like this when he was hired as a teacher for a private academy.

His class turned out to be filled with local women of various jobs (each with her job and her own uniform) coming to him to learn things that shouldn't be spoken in public...

title: Robin Hood: Forest Adventures
description:
Robin Hood: Forest Adventures is a budget platformer.
Designed for kids, controls are limited to the 3 keyboard arrows (down arrow is not used). The game features four levels to explore. Just collect bonuses, get fruits, and jump over enemies to "kill" them since there is no violence. An arch is your only weapon.

title: One Button Games 5-in-1 Vol. 4
description:
Balls Bombs is a fast-paced one-button game.

Your goal is to move forward and avoid the bouncing balls all around you. Hold a button to walk. There are bombs lying on the ground and when you touch one you will turn into a bomb. When a ball hits you while you're in a bomb form, the bomb will explode and destroy all the balls within the radius of its explosion. You score points for each destroyed ball.

The game is over when a ball touches you while you're not a bomb.

Baroll is a fast-paced one-button game.

You are constantly moving forward. Your goal is to avoid being hit by the barrels falling from the top and rolling towards you. Press a button to jump and hold a button to jump and slow down.

The game is over when you get hit by a barrel.

Bamboo is a fast-paced one-button game.

You are constantly running and cutting bamboo that grows in random places. You score points by collecting bamboo. You can run through yellow bamboo to collect it. When bamboo becomes green, you have to cut it multiple times to stop it and you don't get any points from it. Your goal is to stop bamboo from growing and reaching the top.

The game is over when bamboo reaches the top of the screen.

Two Faced is a fast-paced one-button game.

Play snake on two sides of the square. The snake is constantly rotating clockwise and speeding up while rotating. Hold a button to move straight but you will also speed up. Collect the apples to score points and make the snake grow in size.

The game is over when the snake hits its tail.

Light Dark is a fast-paced one-button game.

The screen is split horizontally in two halves: light and dark, and the dark side is upside down. You are constantly moving forward and every time you press a button you switch between the sides. You also jump by pressing a button and can fly some distance by holding a button. Collect the coins to score points and avoid hitting the spikes.

The game is over when you hit the spikes.

title: Square Smash
description: SquareSmash is a modern twist on classic brick-breaking! Experience fast-paced arcade action with roguelike progression. Upgrade your paddle, unlock powerful abilities, and conquer challenging levels in this neon-infused, high-energy retro adventure.

title: John's Quest
description: You are John Appleby, video game historian. Your evil twin, "Evil John," is plotting dark schemes and causing a collision between genres! Only you have the power to restore peace and save gaming...

title: Madame Claudine's Curious Curiousities
description: Earn yourself a christmas present by working in Madame Claudine's magic shop.

title: Guilty as Charged!
description: Set in a dystopian world where even small crimes are punished in permanence, Guilty As Charged! sees 20-year-old Alan Pierce fight for victory in a televised gameshow between 18 criminals where the winner not only keeps their life, but gains a huge cash prize – as well as their freedom.

title: Journey Back to Dreamspace
description: Journey Back to DreamSpace is a quirky top-down, single-player, cyberpunk, adventure game. Interact with angry gangers, crafty corporations and all kinds of strange characters in Port hope. Most of all though, help Jo find a way back to DreamSpace!

title: Receiver 2 & Receiver
description: This bundle contains both games in the Receiver universe!

title: Whismie
description: A 2D psychological horror-puzzle where time moves on its own and the house continues to live without you. Explore, observe, and decide who you are - a therapy subject, or the protagonist of someone else’s show.

title: Silent Harmony
description:
Silent Harmony is an emotional rhythm game where you tribute your late sister's death and try not to let people down, falling into her place in the band upon her death.

Silent Harmony is an emotional rhythm game where you play a virtual clarinet and control your breathing. You pick up your late sister's clarinet and continue her legacy in her old band as Noah Harper, a young depressed teenage boy. While pressure builds up, you struggle not to make Noah feel like he has let his sister down.

title: Mafia Business Simulator
description: Step into the thrilling world of Mafia Business Simulator, a game where crime isn’t chaos — it’s a high-stakes, calculated business. Experience the excitement of running your own criminal empire in modern London, where every decision counts, every move shapes your influence, and every rival is waiting for a mistake. Stylish, immersive, and full of strategic depth, this is more than a game — it’s your chance to dominate the city from the shadows.

title: Quantum Loop
description: Zoom and dodge your way about the quadrant, solving intertwining objectives however you can. Hit an asteroid and the mission resets - but whatever you learn you can exploit in the next loop! Use your wits and precise piloting together to prevent the asteroid crisis!

title: Kings Do Not Fall
description:
When the kingdom needs a legend, you don’t fall... you rise. In a land torn apart, an entire army has fallen. Embark on a classic beat ’em up, just like we loved to play in the 90s.

Players will step into Alden’s boots, battling through six hand crafted levels that culminate in epic boss encounters. With each fight, the stakes rise: every fallen knight fuels Alden’s resolve to “not fall” even when all hope seems lost.
“Fight! Smash! Break through the horde!”

title: Blade Breaker: Sword Taker
description:
Bein' a samurai aint easy when you break every blade you use!

Blade Breaker: Sword Taker is the story of Giri, a young Oni who wishes to become a samurai!
Too bad she's too strong for her own good, every sword she uses just shatters like glass!
Break swords! Take swords! Break more swords!

title: Princess Party
description: Three beautiful princesses are on their way to marry the prince of a certain kingdom. The wedding is political and loveless, but will the help of a magical ring bring their hearts together?

title: Cosmo Cargo
description: Cosmo Cargo is an inventory autobattler roguelite game where you fight to preserve the chaos of the galaxy. Collect and combine items in your ship to gain powerful effects and defeat the Administrators.

title: Magical Psalter II: Féngmó zhī Tú
Take me, Vitaly: Sea Wolf
description: A major story expansion for the Game of the (any) Year — Take me, Vitaly! Make Vitaly gnash his teeth in despair as you hijack his luxurious yacht — all while dressed in a dazzling new outfit!

title: Final Payload
description: Final Payload is a fast-paced 2D action game where you control a guided warhead. Manage inertia and fuel, destroy enemies, avoid guarded zones, and land precisely to complete missions.

title: Is Everyone Mad at Me?
description: Yes.

title: I Eat Paintings When Guards Aren't Looking
description: Find hidden objects in famous paintings… then eat them. Decode bizarre cravings, rip chunks out of Renaissance masterpieces, and snack your way through art history like the absolute menace you are.

title: SVETIK
description:
SVETIK is a top-down dark fantasy adventure RPG where the player explores a world plunged into darkness after the sun has been sealed away. The protagonist, Iskra, awakens in a prison with no memory of her past and encounters Svetik, a living fragment of sunlight that becomes her only source of illumination.

Together they travel through the dark lands of Lucida, facing creatures that lurk in the shadows and discovering the truth behind the disappearance of the sun. Light plays a central role in both exploration and combat, allowing players to reveal hidden paths, weaken enemies, and survive in areas consumed by darkness.

Svetik is not just a tool but a companion with its own personality. The relationship between Iskra and Svetik evolves throughout the journey, and the player's actions influence how the light behaves and responds during the adventure.

The game combines exploration, combat, environmental puzzles, and narrative choices while uncovering the mysteries of a world where light and darkness are deeply intertwined.

title: Into The Mountain
description:
Into The Mountain is a narrative-driven psychological horror experience that begins as a cozy 2D platformer and slowly turns into something far more unsettling.

The game moves between genres and viewpoints, expanding into 3D atmospheric horror as the sense of familiarity begins to crack.

You explore the Peak of Tauema through the eyes of Ed, a 12-year-old boy drawn toward events far beyond his comprehension. As the adventure unfolds the world shifts. Rules change. Spaces transform. What once felt simple becomes ambiguous.

Into The Mountain is built around tension and discovery. The experience unfolds in layers, blending platforming, environmental storytelling, and shifting perspectives to create unease.

The game also uses subtle personalization. Small elements of the world respond to how you play, creating moments that feel intimate and unpredictable without breaking immersion.

title: Warhammer Blood Bowl
description: Warhammer Blood Bowl is the official adaptation of the tabletop game of the same name. Based on the latest official rules of the newest edition, it introduces two new factions, the Tomb Kings and the Bretonnians, and delivers a content-rich experience that will continue to evolve after launch through a seasonal system and a competitive ecosystem culminating each year in a highly contested World Championship embraced by the community.

title: Galdromeda
description: Turn-based RPG with space combat. Assemble a crew, each having their own unique abilities, level up, upgrade your ship and your crew's abilities, collect new outfits for your crew.

title: The Legend of California
description: The Legend of California is an open world, action-survival shooter set on the mythical Island of California during the gold rush era. Explore a vast, untamed frontier and forge your legacy alone or with friends

title: Grand Theft Auto Online: Agents of Sabotage
description:
Go underground with a disgruntled ex-operative and an excitable submariner to steal military secrets, uncover IAA corruption, retrieve stolen art, and bust a billion-dollar enterprise in GTA Online: Agents of Sabotage.

Own a piece of Los Santos history by taking over the Darnell Bros Garment Factory, and employ the latest clandestine technology alongside your criminal know-how to take on The FIB Files — a series of new multi-part scores. Plus, clean up the streets in new vigilante Dispatch Work, and much more.

title: WPCA: World Phasebound Control Authority
description: Step into the city's shadows as defenders against the paranormal. Your mission: Contain the Phasebound Horrors, the manifested fictions encroaching upon our world and the survival of humanity.

title: Grand Theft Auto Online: Bottom Dollar Bounties
description: As the new lead dog for Bottom Dollar Bail Enforcement, link up with the Junior Assistant Bounty Hunter in training — Maude's daughter Jenette — to run this clean-up crew, taking down an assortment of valuable targets, including some of Southern San Andreas' Most Wanted. Become just the type of agent of justice the state needs by tracking down and hauling in these dangerous miscreants — utilizing everything from ruthless intimidation tactics to thwarting further criminal activity — in the latest action-packed addition to GTA Online.

title: Invisum Piscium
description: An atmosphere-driven walking simulator where you explore familiar yet unsettling spaces, interact with fragmented conversations, and influence partial changes in the world through small actions, observation, and quiet choices that shape how the experience unfolds.

title: Chamber One
description: Chamber One is a story-driven 3D puzzle platformer. You wake up in a sterile elevator with no memories. As part of the Rebuild Test Program, you progress through test chambers to uncover the truth about the system and yourself.

title: Skybound Colonies
description: Grow your own kingdom among the clouds. From humble beginnings on a single isle, expand across the skies, balancing harmony and growth as you shape a peaceful empire that floats beyond the edge of the world.

title: Gobble
description: Gobble is a 2D action platformer with eating as its central theme. Venture out into the world searching for your missing family, armed with a “sickle” that devours monsters to get stronger.

title: FramePerfect
description: This is FramePerfect, a simple platforming game with a unique twist! Your character is equipped with a special camera that has the ability to move the bounds of the screen.! Use this ability to make your way through this strange and colorful world.

title: Dino Pet Walker
description: Dino Pet Walker is a Fantasy Casual Game where you realize your childhood dream and play with your dinosaur pet. On this adventure, be ready for solve puzzles and have fun with your and another dino's in a voxel art enviroment, inspired by brazillians biomes.

title: 2152: Pizza Pocket
description:
2152: Pizza Pocket is a short visual novel about finding a pizza pocket.

You play as Jioni, a teenager with an affinity for bad luck, especially when dealing with the different personalities around her in City Two. Jioni must learn to disregard her intrusive thoughts to reach her goal. (That goal is a pizza pocket, of course.) Navigate through this post-apocalyptic city to acquire this processed pizza substitute.

title: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!
description: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!

title: Warp to Sector One
description: Trade, fight, and explore a procedurally generated galaxy in this deep space trading game inspired by 80's sci-fi computer screens and early text based space games. Command fleets, negotiate with alien factions, colonize planets, and forge your legacy across five unique career paths.

title: Not a Crow
description: Not a Crow is a narrative point-and-click adventure. Guide a lonely crow through the remnants of a fallen world as she searches for her place among the ruins.

title: Inken
description: Explore mysterious office building suspended in a desolate world! Inken is a multi-genre roguelike that can be a deckbuilder, topdown shooter, auto runner, puzzler, or idle game! Knowledge is the power that can slay the gods that consumed your world!

title: Noire Police Detective: Gangster Drama Simulator
description: Investigate a deadly conspiracy in Noire Police Detective: Gangster Drama Simulator. Search for clues, sneak through dangerous locations, solve environmental puzzles, and make choices that shape the fate of a corrupt 1950s border city.

title: Ninja Nightfall
description: Ninja Nightfall is a fast-paced platformer where you are the last silent guardian—an elite ninja battling a city overrun by hostile AI. Conquer 10 intense stages filled with deadly robots, hidden zones, and high-security relics. Master stealth, speed, and precision as you navigate neon-lit rooftops and evade traps.

title: Primal Dungeon Adventure
description: Explore dangerous corridors and face unique enemies across 10 challenging platforming stages. Discover hidden areas, avoid deadly traps, and search for the legendary wolf stones. Unlock powerful upgrades like Rock Attack, Fire Rock Attack, and the devastating Wolf Special. Master precision jumps, sharpen your throwing skills, and survive the rising difficulty of this mysterious dungeon.

title: Narcissist Tail
description:
A point and click horror with a bullet hell dodge combat system.

This game is about helping a wolf guy who gets annoyed at his loving family as you explore surreal environments.

title: The War Disorder Hexa
description: War consumes the Kingdom of Node as an empire marches forward. Six protagonists stand on different sides of the conflict, each driven by their own motives, struggles, and paths to survival.

title: Koganei-sou to Konjiki no Agehachou
description: Sprite's 15th anniversary game. A share house receives an odd purchase offer one day and, around the same time, a new girl with suspicious behavior moves in.

title: Tachyon Flow
description: Run around, traverse obstacle courses, and weave through environments creatively in this third person parkour runner!

title: Volvo V70 Racing
description: Volvo V70 R is a small 3D racing game developed by Refraction to promote Volvo's V70 line. Despite being created in under a month, the game features a full 3D environment built using the Refractor Engine. It showcases the excitement and performance of the V70 series in a dynamic racing experience.

title: Gata Guressi
description: Learn to communicate with the people of Hierre by speaking their languages and understanding their cultures in this sci-fi translation game. Use your translation skills to navigate Kallay Tirridor, uncovering its dark secrets while solving the sudden disappearance of your brother.

title: Exponent: The Scaling Tower Defense
description: A roguelite incremental tower defense where expansion is survival. Execute Command Cards from your expanding deck, build towers, and create land tile by tile to defend the last Node in your dimensional bubble. Grow strong enough to find your kin in the void… and merge into higher dimensions.

title: The Garden of Youth
description: "The Garden of Youth" is a visual light novel with a focus on youthful love. The story mainly tells of a group of teenagers and girls suffering from mental illness -" AS "- who are involved in a" box court "experiment.

title: Farm Manager
description: Create and manage your own farm. Strategize, expand, plant, grow and harvest the lands and breed prize-worthy animals in this immersive farm management game. Farm Manager is among the most realistic of the strategy genre - so prove yourself and beat your friends and other real life managers.

title: Delphinium
description: A cozy narrative farming sim set in a hidden mountain village. Grow crops, cook, fish, and build heartfelt relationships as you struggle to find your place among a close-knit community.

title: Car For Sale Together
description: Car For Sale Together is a co-op car trading simulation where you and your friends build a dealership from scratch. Explore the town, find cars, negotiate deals, complete side activities, uncover mysteries, and grow your shared business together.

title: Solo Raid: Mage
description: A single-player dungeon experience built for fans of classic MMORPG combat. Solo Raid: Mage recreates the deliberate pacing, cooldown management, and rotational mastery of old-school raiding — layered with roguelite build progression. Each attempt is a new build, that you must learn to wield.

title: 8:00 AM: Still Morning
description: 8:00 AM – Still Morning is a short narrative exploration game about an ordinary morning and the emotions hidden beneath routine — an atmospheric experience where a familiar day slowly begins to feel different, repeating again and again even when not everyone is ready to wake up.

title: Lint
description: Lint is a minimalist idle game where lint builds up the longer you stay. Collect it, upgrade your production, and turn tiny dust balls into an unstoppable fluff empire.

title: Vlad the Landlord
description: Create a "pantry" of tenants in Vlad's mansion, manage the growing thirst, unlock vampiric powers, avoid the looming sunrise, and ultimately turn Vlad human again!

title: Lilium: Kiss Me Everyday
description: Lilium - Kiss Me Everyday first time on Steam!

title: Rewolborough Vol.1
description: Welcome to Rewolborough, a hard-boiled metropolis whose faceless facade hides the reeking wastes of the human psyche.

title: Oh No, Orcs!
description: Oh no, orcs! is a pixel art archery shooter in which the player needs to stop hordes of orcs that will try to destroy the main gate and invade the fort.

title: And Yet, We Dream
description: a psychological visual novel where you investigate the souls of the dead. spend time with them, analyze their past, file reports to decide their eternal fate.

title: QuantumVR
description: QuantumVR is a virtual reality game that teaches you to solve small quantum algorithms by placing simple quantum gates. In addition, a 2D version is available.

title: Breve Bug: Champions of Destiny
description: Breve Bug: Champions of Destiny is a unique RPG in which you play as a roly poly who lives in a tin can. You have a job as a barista, and your goal is to expand your business across the cosmos. Buy upgrades like lavender syrup and high quality espresso, use dialogue choices to get higher tips.

title: Bleeding
description: A hardcore dieselpunk first-person shooter with a kinetic brute protagonist who tears enemies to pieces with his unstoppable force. Movement is the primary tool of dominance, not escape. Aggression is the key to survival.

title: Iron
description: Wreak havoc on a deep underground military base and uncover what secrets lie beneath. Don't forget to wear your tin foil.

title: Neon Vault Rush
description: Neon Vault Rush is a high-speed 3D parkour game set in a glowing cyberpunk world. Dash through dizzying circuits filled with deadly traps, floating platforms, and pulse-pounding synthwave beats. Master wall runs, double jumps, and acrobatic moves as you race against time and chase your best records. One wrong step — game over. If you crave speed, precision, and the thrill of a digital dreamscape, this is your playground.

title: Brush Burial: Bruiseland
description: You are a hunter of men, and your quarry is numerous, armed, and afraid. Bind and break them. This is a first-person immersive sim with tightly interconnected environments, sleek and sadistic melee combat, and over a hundred cosmetics to unlock.

title: Polter Geists
description: Welcome to Ohm, a dead world where you collect spectral nightmares instead of cute animals. Throw coffins to capture Geists, master deep turn based combat, and explore a beautifully unhinged goth punk RPG where even the skeletons have terrible customer service.

title: Hellscaper
description:
Hellscaper is an occult tiling deckbuilder roguelike, like if Slay the Spire and Dorfromantik had a very weird baby.
Serve your demon lord Balfazor and build him the most fucked up greatest city in the world!

title: Rinthine
description: Brave the depths of an ever-changing labyrinth in search of secrets, treasures—or simply a place to call home.

title: Lonesome Town
description: A short horror experience set in a series of strange locations as our antihero tries to escape from the murder he just commited.

title: Cordura
description: Cordura is a 4-player online co-op psychological horror where sanity is your most scarce resource. Venture together into shifting procedural Victorian labyrinths where the environment is never the same. Lose your sanity and the Night will mimic your team to feed your paranoia. Extract and survive.

title: Thornetica
description: Thornetica is a strategy rpg and slice of life visual novel that revolves around the university’s theatre club. Engage in classic strategy combat, choose who to cast as each role in the play when these kids jump on stage to perform. Take the time to unwind, bond and play minigames in the backstage!

title: ReVamp
description: Rule as Dracula in this castle-defense roguelite. Shape your fortress room by room, command an army of monsters, and step into battle yourself to protect your throne from relentless mortal invaders. A war waged for eternity, for the love you couldn’t save.

title: The 7th Guest Remake
description: The iconic game The 7th Guest has been brought back to life with modern technology, delivering an atmospheric story like no other. Explore a foreboding mansion, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover its dark secrets. The 7th Guest is the ultimate mystery adventure, reimagined for modern platforms.

title: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
description: A kidnapping, a desperate mother, and a shadow from the past. The final chapter of the trilogy reveals every secret behind the series most unsettling icon: the Red Nun.

title: Defender of the Crown: The Legend Returns
description: The legendary medieval strategy adventure has returned - enhanced for a new generation of knights. Conquer provinces, raise armies, storm castles, and influence the balance of power through bold strategy and action moments.

title: Final Stand Waves
description: Defend your tower against endless hordes of zombies in this 2D top-down game.

title: AstroTechs
description: You're an engineer with a gun and a wrench, and you're the only thing keeping this ship alive. AstroTechs is a tactical action game where you fight corrupted machines, weaponize ship systems, and repair the damage — all under fire.

title: The 9th Dragon
description: Fight through the criminal underworld of 1980s Kowloon Walled City: The 9th Dragon is a brutal narrative-driven action game with tactical combat and branching choices, where every decision shapes the fate of the city.

title: Killing Floor III: Operation Deep Freeze
Lights Out, Run
description: A first-person survival horror game where you must cross your house at night while the fears of your childhood become real.

title: Void Hunters
description: Lead fearless rebels in a dark fantasy, turn-based RPG where tactical decisions and strategic squad-building shape every battle against the world-devouring Void.

title: SlashZero
description: SlashZero is a 3D roguelike action platformer. As a Timehacker, your job is to travel across timelines and explore a cyberpunk world, use combat skills and strategies to piece together the truth, and take down the Lord of the Void! Is what you see the truth?

title: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor - Heavy Duty
description: The mines are about to get a whole lot louder.

title: They See You
description: A computer engineer arrives in a remote mountain village, where tech failures and missing residents put him face to face with an unsettling force lurking behind the screen.

title: Alice in Wonder Underland AIWU
