description: This is an exploration-driven adventure game. Alice and Noir Bunny set out on a journey together, discovering strange worlds while searching for a lost voice. Along the way, players engage in puzzles, mini-games, and immersive interactive experiences filled with wonder and discovery.

title: Toro Farcito e la maledizione della Piramide
Apathema
description: Cursed to repair the inner organs of The Chasm, you fight to uncover the secrets of your existence and end a self-devouring cycle of Apathy. Apathema is a grunge fantasy turn-based RPG, inspired by God Husk, Baroque, and King's Field.

title: Blighten
description: Blighten is a survival horror fps set in an abandoned facility overrun by mindless creatures infected by the Blight. Scavenge for resources and do whatever it takes to survive the industrial hellscape you're isolated within.

title: Kira vs. Akira
description: Beat Akira in this chaotic black-and-white volleyball game about cats!

title: Rocket League: Season 22
description: Season 22 helps you perform at your highest level with new training options and UI elements to help you play more strategically. Your matchmaking rating, visible recharge progress for boost pads, and flip reset status are coming.

title: Kicking Upwards
description: Kicking Upwards is an experimental, skill-based physics game where you kick a red ball up a mountain.

title: JSON: VR Sandbox
description: An early sandbox demo for an immersive sim. Use your phone to rewire devices around you and kill dudes.

title: Claim the Forest: Shape of Wolves
description: A Paradise That Fits Perfectly

title: Extremely Cool Downhill Skiing With Jaska
description: Make it down the mountain alive while doing cool flips!

title: Neon Steel
description: Neon Steel is a cyberpunk action beat ’em up set in a futuristic city divided into three distinct zones: the Docks, the Slums, and the Upper City. The game follows Kade Ito, a salvage operator running for his life while using a mysterious mech suit that is bound to him. Its core theme combines corporate control, mechanical warfare, and urban decay within a fast-paced combat driven structure.

title: Meitantei Camazotz Kamigami no Kyousoukyoku: MessengerText
Outbreak Fall: Biohazard
description: When the outbreak begins, survival is the only law.

title: Manic: Unknown World
description:
You play as the same character from MANIC Episode 1.
After the ending of Episode 1, you awaken in a distorted, unknown world, a nightmare realm shaped from your memories, violence, and something darker.
This place isn’t real. It’s the Unknown World — a merging of your mind and Quake’s chaos.

Your skin is gray like the dead, your blood burns like madness, and your only goal remains the same:

Find Him. Kill Everything. Get Your Revenge Back.
Trapped in the Quake World and cursed with unstable powers, you must fight your way through twisted halls, broken memories, and the echoes of your past. The boundaries between life and death blur as monsters, traps, and hidden secrets test your every step.

title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Heartless Symphony
description: Vampire: The Masquerade – Heartless Symphony is an upcoming narrative RPG set in the World of Darkness, developed by Entalto Studios. Expanding on the events of Vampire: The Masquerade – Heartless Lullaby, the game follows multiple characters through a dark urban story shaped by player choices rather than dice rolls. Featuring character customization, skill progression, and branching narratives with multiple endings, the game is expected to offer a 10–15 hour experience with side quests and several playable perspectives. With a hand-drawn art style inspired by Disco Elysium, Heartless Symphony aims to provide an accessible entry point to the World of Darkness for both newcomers and longtime fans.

title: NeNeKoNeKo
description: NeNeKoNeKo is a puzzle game where you use three boxes to fit sprawling, oddly-shaped sleeping cats into place. Don't let the cute looks fool you — under a time limit, you need to quickly figure out the best combinations, making it a surprisingly challenging brain teaser. When time runs out, you get a revival chance with limited moves instead of a time limit, letting you think carefully and discover solutions that seemed impossible. Feel the rush when everything clicks into place!

title: Cats vs Trolls
description: Cats VS Trolls is a humorous and relaxing hidden object game with hand-drawn graphics.

title: Dullahan-san no Atama wo Omochikaeri Suru
description:
Puzzle Game.
Move obstacles to carry Dullahan's head to her body.

title: Slop Simulator
description: Make slop out of trash, junk and pretty much anything and serve it to customers! A chaotic multiplayer first-person fast food simulator with barely any safeguards where you use only "local and fresh" ingredients.

title: Dubspace: Chapter 1
description: Embark on a cyberpunk action-adventure in zero-gravity as brother Mailcom, on a mission to uncover dark conspiracies and determine the fate of Zion space station. Enjoy physics-based movement, environmental puzzles, emergent combat, all set to a mighty dub soundtrack.

title: Method
description: This game transports players into a mysterious and colorful strange space,

title: Kicking Balls World
description: A game about kicking balls.

title: Frog Pond Simulator
description: Frog Pond Simulator is an idle incremental game where you'll see new frogs coming along continuously, each unique, funny looking and unusual. The only objective that matters is to relax and let yourself be transported by the music and the mood. An un-frog-ettable experience!

title: A Dream Within a Dream
description: Explore the mountain up close and personal.

title: Frog Inc.
description: A idle incremental game about a frog.

title: The People's Tree 2021
description: The People's Tree was an app for designing, pinning, and viewing ornaments on a single, shared tree. This web build is now an archival version that contains an interactive timeline tool.

title: The Fan Game - Ghostbusters and The Secret of Monkey Island
Special Force Alpha
description:
SF Alpha is a fast paced online first person shooter built around competitive team play and classic tactical combat. The game focuses on skill based gunplay, strategic movement, and coordinated teamwork between opposing factions.

Players battle across a variety of maps and game modes that reward precision, map awareness, and smart decision making. Each match places players into intense firefights where quick reactions and strong team strategy decide the outcome.

SF Alpha is designed for players who enjoy classic FPS mechanics with a competitive edge. The game supports both casual matches and organized competitive play, allowing players to improve their skills, work with teammates, and climb the ranks.

With a strong community focus, SF Alpha also encourages content creation and streaming, giving players the tools to showcase gameplay, tournaments, and team highlights.

title: Shin Rinkaiten no Azrael: Tenjoukai-hen
description: The sequel to Azrael on the Boundary of Life or Death.

title: Shin Rinkaiten no Azrael: Tenjoukai-hen - Episode:1
Shin Rinkaiten no Azrael: Tenjoukai-hen - Episode:2
Shin Rinkaiten no Azrael: Tenjoukai-hen - Episode:3
Akeiro ni Somaru, Utsukushiki Yashiro de
The Black Whale
description: The factory chip began to malfunction. Your horrible headaches don’t bother anyone in this dystopian world. “Black Whale”, the attractive white powder, is the only thing that can stop the pain. And show you the life without the horrors of harsh reality.

title: RoadCraft: Reclaim Expansion
description: Reclaim Expansion introduces two new large-scale maps, a new class of demolition gameplay, and a deeper sandbox approach to recovery operations. Reclaim Expansion emphasizes player autonomy: there are no fixed paths or prescribed solutions—only the tools, the terrain, and the consequences of your decisions.

title: Oberon's Wake
description: The King of Eldland has fallen. Bath Elfland in the blood of her enemies.

title: Gunshot Bride
description: Chloe Föhn's heart stolen by her would-be husband on their wedding day. She's told she will have to take a thousand lives to get it back.

title: Backrooms: No Way Out
description: Backrooms: No Way Out is a 1-4 player liminal horror game. Explore various backrooms levels, avoid entities, solve puzzles, and search for a way out.

title: Monster Truck Demolition Derby
description: The battle of monster truck and monster car in stunt games begins. Welcome to the Demolition Derby Truck Stunts monster games. Monster truck simulator games are free monster car games. Monster truck games are full of strategy and action.

title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - Layered Armor for Simon: Wind Wyvern's Friend
description: Contains the following: Layered Armor for Simon: Wind Wyvern's Friend Change the Rangers' appearance with layered armor!

title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - Accessory: Gold Circlet
description: Contains the following: Accessory: Gold Circlet A special accessory for the protagonist to wear!

title: Super Holo Wars
description:
Super Holo Wars is about one simple concept: Take the members of Hololive, put them into giant robots and give them a world to play around in.

Super Holo Wars offers a full-length SRPG experience covering the first part of a two-chapter story. Join the members of Hololive as they embark on their quest to protect two worlds from an Alien invasion and the Noise

title: Expandaball
description: Expandaball is a physics-based marble platformer inspired by Super Monkey Ball and Katamari Damacy, where collecting bamboo makes the panda’s ball grow larger, heavier and faster, unlocking new paths and challenges.

title: YEKO
description: Ever said, “Let me finish this hand, then I can die”? We did and took our gaming addiction to the afterlife. Yeko tells the absurd tale of skeletons who couldn't get enough of Okey in life and now set up the table beyond the grave low on calcium, but never on competitive spirit.

title: Tonight's Special
description: Explore Serenpt with 9 love interests in this multi-ending JRPG. You are one of the successors chosen by the influential Godmother, recently entrusted with running a bar and handling Cheleamon’s Family affairs. However, she has set a condition—within six weeks, you must prove that you are worthy.

title: The Narrator Says We're Meant to Be!
Mother Christmas
description: Hidden behind the living room couch, you hope to catch Santa in the act of delivering presents.

title: Good Folk Cafe
description: Forage for wild plants, craft bespoke dishes, and delight your otherworldly clientele in this cosy, atmospheric management game. Hone your craft as you collect special equipment and useful folklore by connecting with the locals or simply relax and seek out stillness in nature.

title: Boss Pit
description: Boss Pit is Punch-Out! with swords and shields instead of boxing gloves. Every fight is a boss fight against a fantasy monster. There is no world to travel, levels to traverse, or trash monsters to grind. Just encounter after encounter of deadly bosses in a Colosseum of death and destruction.

title: Amid the Grid
description: A poetic puzzle journey consisting of maze and jigsaw mechanics embedded in a relaxed surreal 3d platformer with existential tones. Walk, jump, and fly to collect puzzle pieces and maneuver through the grid.

title: Vanguard Valiants
description: Reclaim the lands taken by the Zahar. Build and lead armies to recover the villages seized by the enemy. Acquire better weapons and manage your soldiers throughout the liberation campaign.

title: Don't Touch the Snail
description: You lose forever the second the snail touches your mouse.

title: Slayblade
description: Build your ultimate Slayblade and become King of the Streets! Collect 60+ parts for battle, and combine them for wicked power combos. Skate around the city in all its PS1 glory, making bank on your way to the top. And if you die in the game, you die in real life.

title: 24 Jingles to Bell
description: Santa fell off the waggon, again, so it's now up to Rumbo to save the holidays! Buck around a mysterious island, find Santa's lost gifts and dodge some dangers in this holiday special.

title: Tilde and the 9 Mystical Glorbos
description: You follow Tilde, an average 20-year-old guy living a humdrum life on his own. When one day word spreads of a cluster of so-called "meteorites" that came from the sky in the middle of the night. With nothing better to do he decides to check it out. If only he knew what he would set in motion...

title: URLIRL
description: URLIRL is a SOUP-Like that uses art from old websites that are preserved in the Internet Archive, to try and replicate that feeling of the old internet.

title: Guerilla Cinema // Guerilla Theater
description: A comedy horror indie visual novel about an experimented on silverback gorilla that escapes from a research facility and breaks into a movie theater. The player has to choose between three different items to stop the gorilla and whatever item they choose determines what ending they get.

title: Hop'N'Hoard
description: Hop'N'Hoard is an addictive platform game where your goal is to collect all the coins scattered across the level to unlock the exit. But be careful! Deadly traps are everywhere, ready to stop you from completing your mission. You’ll also need to use all your wits to navigate through mysterious portals and create magical boxes under your feet, allowing you to reach places that would otherwise be impossible to climb. Each level introduces a new wave of challenges that will test your skills and creativity. Are you ready to jump, dodge, and collect as many coins as you can?

title: Dead Vision
description: Dead Vision is a short story-driven horror Audiogame. You play as a character that lost his or her lust for life, but when things go south, you have to concentrate on survival. The premise of the game is that there are no visuals, one must rely on the soundscape.

title: Honkai: Star Rail - Unraveled for Daybreak
description:
Version 4.1 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New character: Ashveil
• New Trailblaze Mission: "Unraveled for Daybreak"
• New events
• ...and more!

title: Pokémon Starwish
description: Pokémon Starwish is a fully voice-acted fangame continuation inspired by Pokémon Emerald, telling a new emotional story about friendship, loss, and the consequences of a wish that should never have been granted.

title: Diviner
description: Diviner, a turn-based tactical dungeon crawler developed by Born of Three. Players will explore dungeons and castles alike after being tasked by the Diviner to gather the scattered organs of a dead lord to raise him from the dead. Make custom builds, acquire gear, and engage in intense turn-based combat in Diviner.

title: Tom Clancy’s The Division - Definitive Edition
Daydream Heartbeat Cure
description: An auto-biographic poetic expression dealing with chronic depression and isolation.

title: Wuthering Waves: Resolution to Illuminate the Shadows
description:
Version 3.2 of Wuthering Waves, including:
• New character: Sigrika
• New story quests
• New echoes, events and more!

title: Please Don't Understand Me
description:
A 500 word kinetic (no-choice) visual novel made for Neo-Twiny Jam 2024. There are no endings. Part 1 of 3 but can be played without the context of the next games Chimera Baloney and Translucent Trails.

Content Warning: references to self-harm and self-loathing. Please take care of yourself.

title: Pro Philosopher 2: Fan Mini Argument: Locke on Property and Labor
description: Created as part of the Pro Philosopher 2 Fan Argument Contest, take a dive into John Locke's philosophy regarding who should own property and especially land! Guided by Pythia Smith, a politician who might agree less with John Locke than she might think.

title: Aoi Tori: L'Oiseau Bleu
description: Main character suddenly leaves his town and returns to his home town Haraiso. There he meets his childhood friend girl Nagi. Together they travel to the dream-like world to chase blue birds of their dreams.

title: Kimi to Koi Shite Musubarete
description: Spring... the season of start. We met again in that season among cherry trees. I wanted to meet you, I wanted to talk to you, I wanted to walk along with you.... One of my wishes has come true. How about others? Our spring has started with full of hopes. Spring... the season of start. Our story starts from here....

title: Leaves 3
description: Dive into the enchanting world of Leaves 3, a handcrafted adventure full of mysteries and wonders. Explore a world crafted with love and imagination, solve puzzles and free the Treefruities.

title: Planet Flipper
description: A short turn-based planet management sim about flipping a world for profit. Balance supply, unrest, famine, and conflict. Or let it collapse and cash out before it’s too late.

title: Gaelic Football Laochra
description: Feel the intensity of Gaelic Football Laochra! From heated county showdowns to the pinnacle of the Irish Championship, every game delivers authentic gameplay, strategic depth, and electrifying action. Every clash is a test of skill, and every triumph brings you closer to glory!

title: Crystal Edge: Retribution
description: Crystal Edge: Retribution is an exciting Hack and Slash that follows the story of Alex, who turns an oppressive & classist government on its head while showing off her ingenuity in this Victorian/Steampunk setting.

title: Everstill Valley
description: Explore a decaying wilderness haunted by silence, hunger, and shadow. Forage by day. Fear the night. In Everstill Valley, something follows.

title: Junk Sec
description: Explore, Fight, Scavenge, Escape. Fight your way out of recently unearthed underground facility teeming with disgusting creatures in a pixelart survival-horror, platform shooter mix. Will you save the rest of your squad, or will you recreate the very disaster that left this place buried?

title: Harvest Reaper
description: Skill based sprite crusher roguelite

title: Eighthwell
description: Welcome to Eighthwell, a story-rich action-adventure game packed with humour and charm. Explore Eighthwell, a quirky town full of strange residents and even stranger secrets. Battle enemies in shooter style combat as you traverse unique dungeons with your new friends.

title: Turret Baffler
description: Flip the stealth script by remaining at a distance and clearing a path for your hacker partner to reach an exposed terminal!

title: Ravel the Frays
description: A sci fi mystery on a ship drifting through space. Solve dialogue puzzles to help the ship's computer AILISH sift through possible timelines to find which one of them can prevent an impending disaster. What disaster? For some reason, AILISH won't actually tell you...

title: They Stare
description: Investigate and unravel the horrors of Clear County. Gather evidence and survive the North Ridge Loop while uncovering the fate of a missing hiker. Explore and escape procedurally generated levels in nightmare mode, avoiding or confronting the dangers within. Do you have what it takes to survive?

title: Build a Bot
description: A top-down shooter rogue-like that sees its player take control of a mechanized weapons platform designed for one thing and one thing only: “Take down the corporation, by any means necessary. . .”

title: War on Wheels
description: War on Wheels is a tactical simultaneous turn-based, physics controlled game of post-apocalyptic vehicular combat, based on a deep, finely tuned and battle-tested rule set which was developed over a 10+ year period with 120,000+ players. It has a single-player campaign and multi-player leagues.

title: ExoDomia
description: Exodomia is a narrative-driven, action-adventure game set on the robotic world of Salakar V! In this fast-paced combat experience, you will encounter many dangerous creatures and enemies as you navigate a story of struggle and survival.

title: Optico
description: Optico is a 2D point and click puzzle adventure game with hand drawn art in noir aesthetics. You need to solve the puzzles to discover the secret, a treasure far beyond your expectations.

title: Deathwish Bloom
description:
Deathwish Bloom is a morally grey romance adventure visual novel set in a soft post-apocalyptic world.
When everyone hides a deadly obsession, can you trust - or love - those who get close? Play as junior researcher Sky. Navigate romance, betrayal, and impossible choices across secret-filled Science City and post-apocalyptic lands. Recreate the lost medicine before your trust costs lives.

title: Kitman
description: KITMAN is a 1-4 player sports management simulator set in the backrooms of a stadium. Run the team by running the locker room. Clean the team’s boots, patch jerseys, mop floors, and when no-one is looking… sneak into the gaffer’s office and fix the game plan!

title: Udder Invasion
description: In Udder Invasion you have been tasked with a mission by a scientific military experiment: Annihilate the enemy, craft new weapons and uncover the mystery of the anomaly. Wielding lethal weapons, various upgrades and your deadly companion BUDDY. Survive the invasion and reclaim your freedom.

title: Five Arcade
description: Shoot to move through the Five Arcade! A fast-paced twin stick 2D arcade physics platformer celebrating Five decades of gaming. Glide, fly, fall and blast through 60 pixel-perfect stages using a cracking selection of guns; from machine guns and flamethrowers to rocket launchers and high-five guns.

title: Seizure
description: What's better than playing an FPS...playing TWO FPS...AT THE SAME TIME!!! In Seizure you will have to switch between two characters to progress them both through their separate levels, while you are focused on one character the other might be about to be ambushed so don't ignore them.

title: Undead Defense TD
description: Zombies are coming! Build your defenses and expand your settlement to create a safe space for humanity. Use turrets, walls and light towers to keep the darkness safe. Expand your settlement to find abandoned settlements and additional resources.

title: Kart Racing Strike
description: Kart Racing Strike is a fast-paced arcade racing game where players race karts through dynamic tracks, beat lap records, and compete for first place. Easy to play, challenging to master, and built for pure racing fun.

title: Ismene
description: The story of Ismene, floating through space with her trusted robot companion, trying to figure out where she is going, and where she came from.

title: RIIIP
description: Rip through the fabric of time and space.

title: B-Day-25
description:
B-Day-25 is an Another World story set in the WithoutEyes series.

It tells the story of someone who wanted to save another person,
and someone who relied too deeply on that kindness.

A destructive brotherhood drama shaped by guilt, blame, and emotional dependence.

title: Maid in the Dark
description: A horror game where the objective is to escape a manor covered in darkness. Every time you play, the structure of the house, the arrangement of items, and the identity of the unborn person will change randomly. The play time for each lap is about 15-30 minutes.

title: Men of Freedom
description:
Men of Freedom is an award-winning first-person shooter game featuring fights between the English forces and the patriots in the south of Iran near the Persian Gulf during WWI (1910-1915). These patriots fought under the leadership of a man called Raiis-Ali Delvari. The Game story is based on real historical events happening during that time.
The game includes 10 big levels with different gameplays (Action, Stealth, Support, Run) in various environments.

title: IGTAP: An Incremental Game That's Also a Platformer
description: Amass an army of clones to follow your tightly-optimised path. Generate massive amounts of power to upgrade your production and movement abilities.

title: A Mad Christmas Carol
description: Naughty boys don't have it easy during the Madvent season.

title: Trashcan Man
description: Recoil-driven platformer where shooting is the only way to move

title: Grand Containment Sector 4
description:
Grand Containment : Sector 4,

"They said it was just a server farm. They lied."

For years, Grand Gaming Technologies Private Limited (GGTPL) has been a leader in virtual entertainment. But rumors have started to circulate on the dark web—rumors of people going missing near their remote "Logistics Center" hidden deep in the forest. They call it Sector 4.

You are a whistleblower who has received a cryptic coordinate. Armed with only a flashlight and a camera, you must infiltrate the decaying industrial complex to find out what GGTPL is really building.

But the factory isn't abandoned. The machinery is still humming, the security protocols are active, and something horrifying is stalking the assembly lines.

Investigate. Survive. Expose

title: Magia Mystica
description: The setting for "Magia Mystica" is modern-day Japan. However, it differs slightly from the real world, as this world secretly contains beings from another dimension called "Spirits." And there are also those who can summon these Spirits and freely manipulate their power.

title: The Love Between Litchis and Elm
description: A high school romance game about love, friendship, and growth. Play as a girl in an international school, bonding with three boys—a cold senior, a kind genius, and a cheerful childhood friend. Your choices shape a nostalgic story with meaningful details and bonus content.

title: Transport Tycoon Deluxe + OpenTTD
description: With the Atari release of Transport Tycoon Deluxe, Atari has required that a bundle be created (or have OpenTTD as free DLC) that combines both OpenTTD and the source files of Transport Tycoon Deluxe. Which is generally required to run OpenTTD.

title: Starshot Idle
description: Starshot Idle is a Retro Space-Themed Shooter Idle that sits on your desktop and runs while you work or game.

title: Shiny Recollection: First Step
description: A doujin dating-sim set in the Idolmaster Shiny Colors universe, which will let you romance Meguru, Kogane, Juri, Rinze and Chiyuki.

title: OverTask
description:
Hello! Are you the new intern?
You're trapped in a chaotic office where every superior tries to dump their work on you. Tasks keep piling up nonstop, the boss interrupts to demand that you deal with their whims, and your stress level rises with every second. You’ll need to move fast, manage the chaos, and find moments to rest while struggling to survive the avalanche of work. Hold out as long as you can... before the stress overwhelms you.

title: Reclaimer
description: Become a class war folk hero in the capitalist hellscape of tomorrow, slashing through hordes of biomechanical robots and connecting the evidence in your quest to reclaim your humanity and save the world.

title: Hive Commando
description: Psychic Firepower and Bug Breeding! Experimental combo between a top down shooty game and a real-time strategy (with pause available to do orders on the in-game map)

title: Help! My Childhood Friend is Now My Boss and He Wants Me To Be His Bride?!
description:
Renji is an ordinary guy living an ordinary life. He works a dull, uninteresting office job, and he hasn't had a serious relationship in... well, ever.

Renji is already thirty-two, but he's been spinning his wheels for years. He doesn't know what he wants out of life or what his future holds, which might explain why he's been daydreaming about his childhood more and more.

As a young boy, at least, Renji was cool. He protected his best friend, Ikue, from school bullies, and he even planned to planned to marry her one day. Ikue, at least, adored Renji, and he basked in her affection...

But, wait! Who is this handsome guy who's just started to work in Renji's department? He says he's Renji's new boss, and his name is Ikki - but why does he look so similar to Renji's long lost childhood friend? What the heck is going on - and how does he know about Renji and Ikue's promise to get married?!

title: The Great Exhibition of 1851 in VR
description:
The Great Exhibition ran from May to October 1851 in London's Hyde Park, in a temporary building known as the Crystal Palace. Six million visitors passed through the turnstiles, to view over 100,000 individual exhibits.

Now, over 170 years later, we are recreating the exhibition as an immersive VR experience. The simulation includes a narrator to describe each of the exhibits and the Crystal Palace building. Fire up your SteamVR system and explore the Great Exhibition...

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Trail to the Heavens
description: The Patch 7.5x series includes a number of new activities and updates for players to undertake, including main scenario quests, the final instalment of the Echoes of Vana'diel alliance raid series, the next update to Occult Crescent, a new dungeon, a new Ultimate difficulty raid, a first look at the new limited job—Beastmaster, and much more.

title: Lull: Rest After Crying
description: A horror action-adventure in which a young girl carrying a baby on her back attempts to escape a mysterious facility twisted by endless renovations.

title: Do Goats Dream of Golden Grass?
description: Climb, fall, and rise again as a determined goat chasing its dream of reaching the top. Jump through frustration, laughter, and endless challenge to taste the legendary golden grass. Will you help the goat achieve its dream?

title: Witchhunter.exe
description: Witches hide amongst the townsfolk and the Devil whispers through your screen. Explore branching paths as you investigate, interrogate, and condemn the guilty. Be warned: the inquisition is not without its horrors.

title: Us Five Forever
description:
Olivia Herrera's closest friend Kyle went missing at a frat house two years ago. A party at that frat house is her chance to investigate what happened to him, and get to the bottom of a strange connection she shares with her former group of friends.

Us Five Forever is the first episode of a narrative mystery game that follows a group of former friends who share a strange connection with each other. Find your missing friend while at a party in the frat mansion he disappeared in, and solve the mystery of your entanglement before the sun rises.

title: Hopfinity
description: Grapple to infinity as Hop! Ascend endless caves, castles & skies, dodging explosive Bombarders in this pixel-perfect vertical action-platformer!

title: Not Us
description: A solitaire style card game where you forage for plants, manage your inventory, and try to stay alive.

title: Welcome to Fredbears
description: After witnessing a traumatic experience William decides to shut down his business and ship off all of his assets to a facility across the country called Storage & Rentals, Utah. 17 Years later the storage facility goes bankrupt and William gets sent a notice to go pick up his assets or he will be fined

title: Bio Sin
description: The year is 2102. 49 years ago the world was cleansed in nuclear fire at the height of its decadence. It's a brutal place but now, at long last, an honest one. Create your character and venture into the ruins of this once formidable nation in this unforgiving post-apocalyptic dungeon crawler.

title: Forsaken Denizen
description: An office worker on a forlorn moon finds her city has been overtaken by cyborg parasites in this text adventure drawing inspiration from classic survival horror.

title: Refrain Blue
description:
Matsunaga Yoshihiro has visited The Dragonfly Coast, a remote sea beach, seeking solitude, but met a girl, a kindred soul of him, instead. Their summer ended in the twinkling of an eye and the girl has dissapeared. "I will wait for you by the sea", were her last words.

7 years later Yoshihiro being a tour conductor is accompanying a group of students and teachers on their 'Summer School', half educational half recreational trip to The Dragonfly Coast. Cherishing a vague hope he steps on that land again, and the ever blue sea is awaiting him.

title: Step Theater
description: Welcome to the "step theater". "Step theater" is a vibrant rhythm game where the story unfolds and the screen comes closer to success with every step you take. Dive in and enjoy this charming, vibrant drama!

title: Five Nights at Frickbear's
description: you play as Billy, a young stickfigure who needs money to buy the complete Family Guy DVD box set, finding himself with a job at Freddy Frickbear's Pizza to get the money. The owner of the place doesn't seem eager to pay him, however...

title: Five Nights at Frickbears 2
description: This time you play as the owner of the former establishment, weaseling his way back in for the job...With some new salvaging duties added on top!

title: Cosmos no Sora ni
description: Time of school festival. While most students are eager to show their spirits, main character who lost his memory in the childhood pays all his attention to five girls with scars on their hearts.

title: Max in Ghostpix
description: Max in Ghostpix, also known as simply Ghostpix, is a homebrew nonogram game made by Marc Robledo for the GamePark 32 handheld console as part of the GBAX 2005 Coding Competition. It later received a full release on December of 2006, along with a port for the GP2X handheld console.

title: Fiets-Together
description: Fiets-Together is a chaotic co-op racing game in which 2-4 players control a bicycle together. Each player controls one shoe on a pedal, together you accelerate and steer the bike. The goal is to chase best times, unlock customizations, and keep your friendship.

title: Sato Killing Time Chat.exe
description: It was supposed to be just a harmless chat to kill time with a stranger named Mina. But from the other side of the browser, the boundary between your reality and the internet is slowly being eroded. This is a desktop-invasion chat horror.

title: SCP-3008: Infinite Store
description: An observation-driven psychological horror set inside an endless furniture superstore. Spot anomalies, choose the correct path, complete your shopping list — and escape the loop.

title: Smile More
description: A short medical simulation horror game with multiple endings where the imperfect are made HAPPY. Perform tasks and operations on sedated patients to fix their defects before submitting your files to the Ministry of Happiness & Peace!

title: Tiny Chills: Not From Ear
description: Short atmospheric Body Horror game in which you clean people's Ears as you uncover a grotesque and unnatural mystery

title: Facada
description: Facada is a fangame inspired by the Scream movies (1996) were you play as the main characters of the first movie and have to survive against Ghostface.

title: Rose Hips
description: Welcome to Rose Hips, a lovely little tea shop with a colorful array of customers — especially on Hearts Day, when it's common to eschew clothing. Play as Papaya the flowercat, equip your fox girlfriend into your miscellaneous accessory slot, and strike up some conversations. Who knows what might happen?

title: Kawaii Survivors
description: Fight endless enemy hordes in a glitched cyberpunk world as Lucy the cosplayer. This bullet heaven roguelite blends kawaii anime aesthetics with intense top-down survivors-like action. Use cosplay powers to battle waves of corrupted enemies. Pure bullet hell chaos with a touch of 90s anime.

title: Unity-Chan: Desktop Companion
description: An AI desktop companion with her own personality and a virtual room to play various mini games with her. "Hi! My name is Kohaku Otori, but everyone calls me Unity-chan! I just found a way to visit you on your desktop, may I come? 🧡"

title: Sys//Purge
description: >SYS//PURGE_ is a free, fast-paced FPS inspired by 90's classics, with roguelike elements. Collect items, stay alive and descend deeper into the facility. You take control of an LN-X unit, a glitch breaks you out of the Overseer's control. Make it burn.

title: Wyldheart
description: Wyldheart, a brand new co‑op action RPG set in a rustic fantasy world.

title: Unit 42: Adrift in Space
description: An incremental journey through space. Manage your ship's capsules, choose your path through the stars, and watch your crew and automation do the rest.

title: Oops! Inc. Emergency Center
description: Run the galaxy’s most chaotic hospital in Oops! Inc. Emergency Center! Play as a diploma-free robot doctor, diagnose bizarre space illnesses, craft the right remedies, and treat patients fast before insurance turns you into a fridge. Funny, frantic, and out of this world!

title: Goblin's Gamble 24
description: An online multiplayer survival card game filled with bluffing, courage, and strategy! There's only one revolver on the table, and you never know what will come out of its barrel. Challenge your opponents, make strategic decisions, and be the last one standing!

title: Service of Five Graces
description: "Service of Five Graces"​ is a romance FMV. You play as Lin Ye. One day, you wake up to find you've become the personal butler to the five ladies!? To repay your father's debts, you have no choice but to step into this mansion, beginning a strange life of being "ordered around" by five young women.

title: Ghost Observation
description: Ghost Observation is a psychological horror anomaly detection game. Monitor cursed locations through a 360° surveillance system, spot environmental anomalies, and report them before they spiral out of control. Survive from midnight to dawn… or face what you failed to notice.

title: Channel 64
description: A short psychological VHS horror about routine tape digitizing, where reality starts to feel more and more strange with each new recording.

title: Revenge of the Silent Dan: New York Criminality
description: His name is Dan, and he's just been fired from the office where he worked as a floor cleaner. Determined not to put up with the situation, Dan embarks on a path of revenge. Dan gets in the way of colorful characters of New York reality. Revenge is coming and he knows it.

title: The Last Kich Of Us
description: You are the LAST slice of quiche! Dive into this survivors-like to pulverize hordes of rotten food with pop culture–inspired attacks while avoiding the putrid fog. Choose wisely: grab upgrades now, or wait for better odds—every second could be your last.

title: Legend of the Coin Knight
description: Hack and slash your way through the apocalyptic awakening with your cat, Kat Knip.

title: Kyokou Eiyuu GinGaia Vol.1
description:
The first out of 4 volumes for Kyokou Eiyuu GinGaia.
This tale tells a story, that of a paternal odyssey, the coming of age into fatherhood.
Kanbara Hideo lived an ordinary life, surrounded by his wife and kids.
However, one day, cast into a world of ruin, a barren wasteland, he encounters a giant kaiju.
Run, Hideo, Run. What appeared infront of him, was a mysterious robot...
Oh how typical! Oh how orthodox. A lovely heroic tale.
But, this was no orthodox hero journey. There was no room for hopes and dreams here...

title: Kyokou Eiyuu GinGaia Vol.2
description: The second out of 4 volumes for Kyokou Eiyuu GinGaia.

title: Kyokou Eiyuu GinGaia Vol.3
description: The third out of 4 volumes for Kyokou Eiyuu GinGaia.

title: Neo Pussy Masters
description: Put a golf ball in your vagina and kegel it out! Neo Pussy Masters is a golfing game about transfemininity. Only on the PICO-8!

title: Kyokou Eiyuu GinGaia Final
description: The fourth and final volume for Kyokou Eiyuu GinGaia.

title: Words from Pluto...
description: An experimental platformer where words are tied to movement. Guide Pluto up the strange mountain and figure out what secrets are held within.

title: Star Fleet Deluxe
description: Command a UGA heavy cruiser against the Krellan Empire. Navigate space, manage resources, and coordinate defense strategies. Use starbases and outposts to protect colonies while engaging in tactical ship combat. Your decisions will determine the fate of sectors in this military space simulation.

title: Karkaba
description: Choose from 10 iconic Middle Eastern fighters and battle across legendary Arab stages. Karkaba is a deep, skill based fighting game where timing, combos, and character mastery decide every fight. Experience smooth 60 FPS combat with friends locally or compete online.

title: Gridlords
description: Gridlords is a strategic async-PvP autobattler set in a fantasy pixel-art world. Build your ultimate castle, command legendary heroes, and outsmart rivals to prove your strategy reigns supreme.

title: The Curse of Eira
description: The Curse of Eira is a metroidvania where the main character is unable to die, but each time she is knocked out she gets back up weaker with slower movement speed small jump heights and smaller attack range

title: Claim thy Land
description: Draft buildings and expand your kingdom year by year in this strategic roguelike auto battler. Master tactical tile placement, build overpowered synergies through spatial control, and defeat rival commanders.

title: Boku no Kokoro ha Ame Nochi Hare
description:
The blue sky stretches on, endlessly——

Gazing up at a sky of pure blue, cloudless and bordering on nothingness, the boy — Mochizuki Sora — lets his mind drift into the past. Over and over he revisits the smile of the one girl he ever wanted by his side, killing something inside himself with the weight of his own sins. Whether from freak weather or some shift in the heavens, the clear skies had already held for a full week.

And yet, he knows — that even under a sky without a single cloud, rain can still fall.
What fills the heavens is a blue so vivid it borders on eerie. What that blue means, and what awaits beyond it — he cannot say. The heart of a boy who has left himself stranded in the past remains imprisoned by the sky.
And then, as he slumps alone on the rooftop, a girl appears before him......

title: Mighty Morpho
description:
Mighty Morpho is an isometric puzzle-platformer inspired by classic games such as Adventures of Lolo. Players control Morpho as they navigate compact puzzle stages filled with enemies, obstacles, and hidden solutions.

Each level challenges players to think strategically, solve environmental puzzles, and defeat enemies while exploring different paths through the stage. The goal is to break the evil QUBO's magic spell and free Flowery Flora and the Florans.

The game features bite-sized levels designed for short play sessions, blending puzzle solving, light action, and exploration.

title: Yet Another Jumping Game
description: A precise game about jumping and finding fun.

title: Payday 2: Restoration Mod
description: The Restoration Mod is a complete overhaul mod for Payday 2 that aims to provide a more engaging and varied experience. It completely overhauls skill trees, perk decks, weapons, enemies, enemy AI, stealth, and virtually every other aspect of gameplay. In addition, the overhaul adds a host of additional content; such as new masks, weapons, enemies, randomized time of day, and heists.

title: Project Hunt: Lone Star Hunting Ranch
description: Step into the wilds of South Texas brush country and experience the true thrill of the hunt!

title: Project Hunt: Trophy Sanctuary
description: Design, display, and capture your trophies in dedicated open-air trophy maps inspired by forests, alpine peaks, savannas, and Mediterranean islands. Build your own outdoor museum for the animals you've hunted in PROJECT HUNT.

title: Outplay
description: Outplay is an online co-op game for 4–8 players where social pressure and risky challenges decide everything. Communication is limited to phone calls, and victory goes to those who can adapt and outplay others.

title: Little Smiles Daycare
description: A short psychological horror experience set inside an abandoned daycare. Explore, uncover hidden notes, solve eerie mysteries, and discover what happened to Little Smiles Daycare, before something finds you first.

title: Hawaii High: Mystery of the Tiki
description: Hawaii High: Mystery of the Tiki is a computer game written and designed by famed comic book artist Trina Robbins. The game, set in Hawaii, is the first video game targeting girls. While the game was not a commercial success, some commentators noted that certain elements later appeared in games targeting girls.

title: The Prince of Tennis: Sweet School Festival 0-40 and more…
description: Originally released on PlayStation 2, the Prince of Tennis game where you play as a high school student preparing for the school festival is being remastered in celebration of its 20th anniversary.

title: Aku no Kyoukasho Textbook of Evil
Lizards VS Humans
description: A multiplayer FPS Sci-Fi game set in an alternate reality where reptilian beings battle humans for control of Earth. Features unique species-specific abilities, diverse weapon systems, and tactical gameplay.

title: Dragon Block C
description: Dragon Block c is an Dragon Ball inspired mod for Minecraft, adding races, transformations and a story mode for the game.

title: The Prince of Tennis: Doki Doki Survival - Eternal Passion! Tie Break Game
description: Originally released on PlayStation 2 as two separate games and later combined into one on Nintendo DS, the Prince of Tennis game where you find yourself stranded on an island on the way to the National Middle School Tennis Championship is being remastered for modern platforms.

title: Graph TD: Cosmic
description: It is a strategy roguelike game. Use cards to form a graph of towers and nodes, tweak heat, power and other mechanics, and minmax what's in your hand. Reverse Earth's fate from the end of time.

title: Soulsworn
description: A roguelike card game where you fuse any two creatures to discover hundreds of secret combinations. Craft a powerful deck, outsmart deadly bosses, and play solo or bring a friend.

title: House in the Woods
description: A short RPG Maker horror game about exploring an abandoned house.

title: Nebula Miner
description: Nebula miner puts you in control of a space mining company. A real time resource management game where you need to explore space to find resources, and then harvest them efficiently.

title: Rain & Sacrifice
description:
Build a functioning society of Aztec Jaguars by sacrificing people to the Gods in order to gain Favor and keep your people alive by summoning Rain and Thunder from the skies. Expand your domain while always being set back by the very forces that will assist you.

Protect your city from evil heretical Aligators, farm the land and provide an equivalent exchange of Death into Life before all falls apart once the Feathered Serpent arrives at the dawn of the 15th day.

title: Sen no Hana, Sakihokoru Shiawase: La Vie en Bouquet Coloré
description: A fan game featuring the idol unit VelvetRose (Chitose Kurosaki and Chiyo Shirayuki) from The Idolmaster Cinderella Girls: Starlight Stage.

title: DDD: Dice, Dungeons, and Drakes
description: A tactical board-game battler inspired by the classic Dungeon Dice Monsters 'Dice-to-Tile' logic. Solo-developed over 12 months, featuring a unique system where your Summon Dice physically unfold to build the battlefield in real-time.

title: Little Secret
description: An fanmade yuri visual novel in the Idolmaster Cinderella Girls universe, depicting a relation between Chieri, who just became an idol, and Kaede.

title: A Toast for the End Times
description: In a blasted world teeming with undead, a barkeep and a young girl run the Time's End Tavern, a lone oasis amidst this barren wasteland. In a desolate landscape ravaged by Zombies and Raiders, that one drink they love, and a few kind words, help everyone remember why it's all worth it.

title: Love WMC
description: Love WMC is a visual novel game based on music games. It tells a series of stories about the protagonist who came to a small county town to study alone due to family conflicts, and accidentally got involved with four female protagonists because of an arcade music game.

title: Kraa
description:
A short atmospheric game about a murder of crows in an uncertain world.

Fly above the landscape, explore, gather all your corvid friends and find a place to rest in safety. And above all, enjoy the view.

title: Shikhondo: Blue Pieta
description: Once more, the hunt for Youkai begins! Across the ocean in a city far, far away, the side-scrolling shoot 'em up action of our two protagonists unfolds! Complete the Pietà of struggle that burns blue with its raging barrage!

title: Exit: Echoes of Insanity
description: Exit: Echoes of Insanity es un juego indie de survival horror en el que estás atrapado en un misterioso edificio lleno de secretos. Explora oscuras estancias, resuelve puzles y esquiva una presencia desconocida que siempre te acecha. Con una atmósfera opresiva y una narrativa intrigante, el juego combina exploración, tensión y supervivencia en una experiencia intensa.

title: Bonehearts
description: In Bonehearts you control two clashing skeletons, one meek - one mighty, who are forced to share a body. Rip off your arm to bonk enemies, throw your head and maneuver it around. Use your skeletal abilities to defeat evil and explore a Halloween-inspired world in this humorous 3D-platformer.

title: Mysarium
description: A cozy sandbox designed to accompany you as you go about your day. Take a break: relax, breathe, and create tiny worlds in glass. Grow plants, unlock new elements, and find secret combinations to summon special guests to photograph.

title: Hands up
description: Hands UP Experience a classic first-person horror in pixel graphics. Use your shovel to clear the debris and reach the lowest level Do not tear wrist tendons.

title: Kimi to Koishite, Soshite Sotsugyou Suru
Pirate Ships
description: Pirate Ships is a PvP game about shipbuilding and naval battles. Embark on an epic journey together with other players and fight monsters, pirates and thieves to become the greatest pirate in all of the Caribbean!

title: Idle Cats Dungeon
description: Recruit different cats, level them up, and gather treasure all from the corner of your screen. Idle Cats Dungeon is an incremental desktop game where adventure runs alongside your daily tasks. Can you slay more enemies than other players?

title: Upcreek
description: A short, cozy experience where you enjoy cleaning a lively nature park.

title: Punk Plush Panic
description: Punk Plush Panic is a free to play chaotic 2.5D platformer in which players swap between 3 characters, using their explosive elemental combinations to fight off waves of gluttonous aliens.

title: Räv Kafé
description: Räv Kafé is a 2D action platformer where you wander around in the world and in order to survive you need to find materials and food. Explore the open world.

title: Mnemosyne's Cube
description: My name is left behind these white walls. In its place, I am left with dozens of questions. I wander aimlessly, though she seems to guide me. I do not feel safe. Twenty-four hours... and everything will fall into place.

title: Octopus Invasion
description: Devour fish, evolve tentacles, and become the ocean’s apex predator in this colorful underwater action adventure.

title: Minesweeper Arena
description: Find all the mines quicker than your friends in the classic puzzle game.

title: LasTar
description: Survive endless waves, stack powerful upgrades, and create broken builds in this fast-paced 2D spaceship roguelike. Unlock permanent progression, experiment with different weapons and amulets, and push your limits against escalating enemy threats

title: Dragon's Delightful Day
description: Today is a delightful day for dragon. What adventures await her?

title: Xiuhcuetzin
description: The Queen and The Fierce Warrior stand before the final battle against the Black Army of Death.

title: A Short Game About Nothing
description: Tired of boring dialogue you don't really care about? Don't want to be invested in cliche backstory and setting? Hate being super serious all the time? You just want to chill? Look no further, this is a game where you don't do anything. There also might be a cute girl involved. No promises.

title: Mother's Eye
description: In this atmospheric psychological horror experience, players take on the role of a son monitoring his mother through a home security system at night. What begins as simple observation quickly spirals into a descent into paranoia. As the house itself seems to shift and invite exploration, you must leave the safety of the monitors to face the unsettling truth hiding behind every door.

title: Light Leak
description: There's a mysterious well hidden in the woods. Something terrible happened here. For some reason a girl becomes attached to this place.

title: Dawn of the Universe
description: One day, the Universe burst into existence. Join our host as they aim to take you on a journey through the Universe!!! (...I think?)

title: Starfield: Terran Armada
description: “Terran Armada” introduces a new questline across the Settled Systems, with new characters, locations, enemies, quests, systems, and rewards. Players get the chance to shape the future of humanity in space as they combat the incursions of the Terran Armada’s robotic forces in this brand new story downloadable content.

title: Food Adventures
description: Finally, Tako is able to visit the themed cafe of her dreams! Come join her and her friend, Tama, as they enjoy various dishes!

title: Waste Water
description:
Clam and skunk.

Waste of water. Wasted water.

title: Zwamman
description: Zwamman is a zero pressure single screen puzzle game in which you have to use your light to help Zwamman find crystals in dark forests and swamps. Use the crystals to light a path to Zwamman's home and reveal the true nature of the scary monsters!

title: Cat Parents
description: FROM STRAY TO HOME: cat rescue simulator. The streets are full of dangers for these sweet, defenseless creatures. Save cats, give them love, care, and a place to call home. Become a true cat parent alone or with your friend. Discover what true happiness feels like.

title: Blanket Cat
description: Blanket Cat is a cozy visual novel about Iggy, a petulant black cat, Baba, a kindly kitchen witch, and Peep, a lost little mouse. Explore Baba's cottage and experience a soothing story about found family, platonic love, and a pastoral life.

title: Pikku Adventure
description: A challenging puzzle adventure about learning an alien language. Explore a strange world and meet its cute inhabitants. Decipher the language and earn their trust. With every word learned, you will uncover more secrets. Can you solve the mystery of this world and decide the fate of the Pikku?

title: Glow of Honeydew
description: Glow of Honeydew is a visual novel about a voyeuristic girl and her roommate.

title: Monopoly: Star Wars Heroes vs. Villains
description: A dynamic team-based twist on the world’s favorite family board game from Hasbro, Monopoly: Star Wars Heroes vs. Villains offers reimagined gameplay with cinematic moments, themed spaces, and dynamic elements so that no two matches are the same. Build teams with iconic Star Wars heroes and villains, each of whom brings unique abilities that can shape strategy and turn the tide in your favor with every roll of the dice. Teamwork and hero combinations play a pivotal role in securing victory.

title: Midwest Drag Racing
description: Midwest Drag Racing delivers semi-realistic drag racing thrills with deep progression, car customization, tuning and painting. Take control in solo or multiplayer races and tournaments as you build, personalize and race your ultimate drag car.

title: Sylph
description: Operate a spacecraft at the edge of a singularity. Use realistic orbital mechanics and Newtonian physics to explore a star system around a black hole and what lies beyond.

title: Geenius: Cupid Dough
description: A fast-paced runner game powered by GEENIUS’s new single Cupid Dough. Run, collect orbs, and switch between five characters to change vocal parts in real time. Earn gold, unlock instruments, and remix the song to create your own version.

title: Doll Date
description: A sweetly innocent puzzle adventure game about a doll being desperate and a little naughty and disobeying her owner in the name of love.

title: Cannibal Court
description: Convince the cannibals not to eat you. Collect knowledge, choose your responses carefully and dig up secrets to pit the cultists against each other. Get wiser, get manipulative and mastermind your way out of being dinner in this trial-simulator set in the snowy Canadian north.

title: Black Parallax
description: An action metroidbrainia set in a dying dwarf galaxy. Scavenge wrecks, meet strange characters, and fight your way through a cold universe to piece together an interstellar puzzle.

title: Finnie's Bimbo Fishing
description: Finnie's Bimbo Fishing is a short, chill fishing game where the titular Finnie catches fishies in order to pay back her crippling BimboDebt! Catch a total of ten (10!) fish and carry them around on your bits to sell and the shop and purchase various unlocks to aid Finnie.

title: Steel Soul Shaper
description: A narrative-driven simulation where you play a highly skilled cyberware surgeon running a secret back-alley clinic in a cyberpunk city. As you modify your clients' bodies, you'll hear their stories, uncover their secrets, and quietly shape the course of destiny in this concrete jungle.

title: W Goblins L Humans
description: A cool game about doing everything you can with your shotgun - kill people, do sick kickflips, travel far distances, etc.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate - Metalhead Character DLC
description:
WEAPONS FULLY CALIBRATED
Play as the loveable, locked and loaded Metalhead! As Splintered Fate's first fully ranged character, he comes with a unique gameplay style to complement the Turtles. Fire his blasters, transform into a spinning missile frenzy, and lob landmines to stop enemies in their tracks. Metalhead has an affinity with our new (free!) Robotics Powers. Fully playable in both the Main Campaign and the all-new Arcade Mode, Metalhead is ready to join you

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate - Alopex Character DLC
description:
She's ready for action...and to get back at Shredder.

Meet Alopex, a mutant arctic fox and ninja assassin who went from being unwaveringly loyal to Shredder to a true friend of the Turtles. Expertly swinging her sickle-like kama, she slices at her foes with ease. Hurling her kunai at close range, she deals a powerful blast of damage. And the best part-- she can briefly become invulnerable while targeting multiple enemies in rapid succession. Ninja powers that modify shuriken also affect her kunai, so try her out with the Ninja, Flame, and Water Powers for maximum impact.

title: Hundred Nights: DIFU
description: Run the Chinese Hell in this cozy management simulation! Design your underworld, staff it with quirky soulkeepers, and punish sinful souls. Meanwhile, build Fengdu City where souls enjoy the afterlife, meet legends from Chinese myths, and explore the worlds above...

title: Mercury Elopement Syndrome
description: A short visual novel. A 24-hour romance at its worst; a 24-hour escape at its sweetest.

title: Miniature Legends
description: Survive in Tiny Lands—alone or with friends! Battle endless waves of creatures in small arenas, collect and upgrade powerful abilities, unlock new legends, and grow insanely strong in this fast-paced, chaotic roguelike board-battler.

title: Guilty Cradle
description:
These dolls are about to explode.
A short linear VN about dolls and identity.

title: Dead Dolls Never Die
description: A linear visual novel about two girls taking a train to "The Last Station" to start a new life away from the curses that have bound them in the past.

title: Fourvive
description: FOURVIVE is an online co-op survival action game where up to four players team up, wield a variety of weapons, and fight off waves of enemies together.

title: Abandoned Stories: Inherited Silence
description: Adopted into a new family, Maria soon realizes she was never meant to feel safe there. Trapped inside a quiet home with something watching you, Maria must uncover the truth behind a growing nightmare.

title: Catmorphosis
description: A supernatural adult visual novel with weird romantic elements, a unique vibrant retro art style, and an abnormal storyline. You're Johann, and one night, you decided to order a cat from shady website. However, when the cat arrives a few days later, it's definitely NOT a normal cat.

title: Sheng Tian: Episode 1
description: Sheng Tian (升天) - Episode 1 is a 3D sci-fi game for learning Taiwanese Mandarin. Characters are also used in Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, Macau, China, and Japan. Pronunciation is common to Taiwan and China. Puzzle your way through 7 environments and acquire 50 terms.

title: WonderLang Mandarin Chinese
description: Learn Mandarin Chinese through immersive quests, interactive dialogues, and spaced repetition combat challenges. Help a young hero lift a magical curse by mastering Chinese. Customize your learning experience and explore a world filled with unique characters. Start your learning journey today!

title: Stalked At Home
description: Stalked At Home is a first-person single-player horror game where you play as a young woman alone in a house. Cook, drive, explore, and live your life—until strange things begin to happen and you're no longer sure you're alone.

title: Modularity
description: Modularity is a resource management builder game where the player stitches together flesh and metal in creative ways to construct bigger and greater amalgamations.

title: GlizzySouls
description: GlizzySouls is the first Quadruple G, Souls-Like, action adventure, RPG, Third-person, buzz word, open super market, game from Solo-Developer Mark W. You play as Glizzyman, as he fights his way through hordes of anthropomorphic food to escape a super market. Oh also, he's a hotdog.

title: The Forsaken Anthology: Obsession
description: The Forsaken Anthology: Obsession, a psychological horror game that explores the dark side of human desire and the lengths one might go to fulfill it

title: Eden: New Dawn - Free Edition
description: Sandbox adventure with big multiplayer worlds, building and community.

title: It's Chopping Time!
description: It's Chopping Time! is a short incremental game about chopping down trees on a secluded island by using the forces of nature: lightning strikes, tornadoes, tidal waves, hail and earthquakes!

title: Gently Packed
description: Gently Packed is a relaxing cozy sim where you step into the shoes of a cashier working in a charming, cartoon-style supermarket! Your main task is to scan products and pack them thoughtfully, considering shape, weight, and fragility. The better you serve your customers, the bigger the tips you'll receive! But that's not all - as the owner of a franchise for a major corporation, you'll also manage your store, upgrade it, and pay off the loan you took to start your business.

title: One Song, One Life
description: “One Song, One Life” is a rhythm adventure game where the music and story change based on the notes you hit. Take control of Sumire Kirishima, a girl striving to become the ultimate net artist and perform alongside her idol. Your performance will shape her destiny—one song, one life.

title: Nakano Jinkaku Ishoku Kenkyuushou
description: "The Nakano Laboratory" is a loop-based mystery 2D adventure game. Within each loop of 15 minutes, you take over researchers' bodies to gather clues around the ship, then present your evidence at the meeting.

title: The Kathy Rain Saga
description: Experience the mystery and adventure of the complete Kathy Rain story with the Kathy Rain Saga Bundle which contains both Kathy Rain: Director's Cut and Kathy Rain 2!

title: Wreck Runners
description: Wreck Runners is a 1-4 player online co-op extraction game set in a haunted and ever-changing Bermuda Triangle. Hired by the suspiciously cheerful Trustwell Corporation, your crew of runners is sent in to recover valuable salvage. We expect you may find far more than sunken wrecks waiting in the Fog.

title: Spirit Reforged
description: A mod for Terraria which adds a variety of areas to explore, items to use, and enemies to encounter.

title: Field of Glory II: Masters Edition
description: Field of Glory II Masters Edition includes: Field of Glory II: Medieval and Field of Glory: Kingdoms

title: Ballerspiel
description: Colorful multiplayer chaos! Battle as wacky clowns armed with crazy weapons and nukes in vibrant, destructible low poly arenas. Ballerspiel is explosive, hilarious, and pure mayhem.

title: The Butler
description:
You play as Deacon, the son of George, a maintenance man who mysteriously disappeared years ago. Driven by years of unanswered questions, you’ve devoted years to finding him. But the deeper you dig, the darker the truths you uncover, secrets you wish you’d never known, and horrors that will linger long after the game ends.

The Butler is a spin-off set in the world of Claire, centered on George—a figure briefly mentioned in the original game. What was once a passing detail now unfolds into a story of its own, revealing events that connect back to Claire in unexpected ways.

title: Dark Scrolls
description: Dark Scrolls is a fantasy-themed action platformer that fuses shmup-style chaos with roguelite progression and is packed with charm, challenge, and secrets.

title: Not My Child
description: A psychological horror where a father returns home, only to find toys and haunting notes that whisper a truth he refuses to face.

title: M.B.E 3: Horror Escape
description: A first‑person psychological horror, focused on atmosphere, sound, and constant tension rather than cheap scares.

title: Plura Ingenia: Patient 16
description: A first-person psychological horror game where your personality shapes the experience. Answer unsettling questions, endure disturbing trials, and survive an evaluation that adapts to how you think and behave.

title: Escape Ruin
description: Death brings you to the Ruin: a shifting limbo ruled by hungry Gods. Build your deck, battle their followers, and decide whether to remain pure or wield corrupted power. Carve your path through the darkness and escape—if you can.

title: Killing Dead
description: Relentless, top-down zombie shooter merges strategic action with endless survival.

title: Umezma
description: Umezma is a first-person horror game based on the story "Rusty Scissors" from the manga "Kami no Hidarite, Akuma no Migite" by Kazuo Umezu. It was released as part of a series of interactive manga called MangaRom.

title: Ushio and Tora
description: An interactive manga based on the Ushio and Tora series by Kazuhiro Fujita. It was released as part of a series of interactive manga called MangaRom

title: Ore Factory Squad
description: Ore Factory Squad is a co-op mining and factory-building game with procedural mining and fun at its core! Play alone or with friends, buy properties, dig deep for valuable resources, complete contracts, upgrade and automate production lines and grow your factory from zero to industry!

title: Jujutsu RBI
description: A Jujutsu Kaisen themed baseball game included with Jujutsu Kaisen: Cursed Clash digital bundles.

title: Plagueborn
description: Plagueborn is a 2D action roguelike where you and your allies battle through plague-ridden dungeons. Explore procedurally generated floors, master a wide arsenal of weapons, forge unique builds, and cut down relentless hordes of darkness.

title: Veiled Vents
description: Keep an ancient megabuilding alive and thriving with the help of Ventba! This game is a semi idle management game with roguelike mini dungeons.

title: Seekers of the Ancient
description:
Step into an open world full of ancient secrets, powerful artifacts, and untold legends.

Become a Seeker, roam the land, fight deadly creatures, help the people you meet, and shape your own playstyle through the weapons you choose. Alone or alongside friends, forge your own path.

title: Swanfield Survival
description: Swanfield Survival is a Post-Apocalyptic Zombie Survival game, with PvE and PvP Elements with Online Co-Op & Multiplayer. You can connect via Dedicated Servers, or host a session with up to 5 friends. Climbing, Swimming, Looting, Crafting, Building, Fishing, Farming are all available from start!

title: Irooni: Color Tag
description: Touch the right color, or die. Trapped in an abandoned night school, you are hunted by a shifting nightmare. To hide, you must follow the rules of a twisted game: touch the correct colors around you to stay invisible. One mistake is fatal. Can you survive the night?

title: Bronzebeard's Tavern 2
description: Bronzebeard’s Tavern 2 is a chaotic co-op tavern manager where 1–8 players step into the boots of a young Papa Bronzebeard and family, traveling across fantasy regions to master unfamiliar cuisines, serve unpredictable customers, and prove yourselves worthy under legendary tavern mentors.

title: SuperEats
description: An action game where you use super powers to fly freely and deliver food at ultra-high speed! In 'SuperEats,' race across Gourmet Island. Hurry, a little destruction is acceptable to get the goods there! Uncover the mystery of the amnesiac hero and become a legendary delivery person!

title: The last fortress
description: Simple strategy game in which you must build and expand your kingdom while defending it from waves of enemies. You will be able to recruit allies and raise defenses, while adversaries become more numerous and evolve over time.

title: Kissrim: Motto Miryoku!? Extra Story
description: A free update for Kissrim, taking place after the main story.

title: Vanishing Starlight
description: Vanishing Starlight is a horizontal action adventure game similar to the Metroidvania. You will play the role of a prisoner who has lost his memory, wading into the sea of ​​stars, traversing rivers and mountains, embarking on a journey in search of memories, old friends and your own destiny.

title: As If Through Glass
description: High school freshman Anise enters her spring semester during an unseasonable, unceasing rain. Girls’* relationships float through the waves of time as it passes with or without them.

title: Overwords: Infinity
description: Overwords is back: Stack, fuse, and expand.

title: Morphos
description: Morphos: a psychological horror. You are a man recently discharged from a psychiatric hospital. Your wife hires you onto her team. Your new workplace is a gloomy underground complex where strange experiments are conducted. Reality begins to blur.

title: Crewcial
description: Join the craziest repair company in the space-time continuum! In this 2D party game, teamwork is everything: fix machines, manage heat and pressure, toss tools around, and climb the leaderboard, without losing your friendship!

title: Idle Library
description: Turn a small reading room into a legendary archive of knowledge in this relaxing idle incremental game featuring research upgrades, prestige progression, and offline growth

title: Jane Doe
description: A short conversation with an artist called Michel Liu.

title: Cyanos: Ao wo Tayutau Nageki no Chou
Tsuka Shikiru ha Yarazu no Ame
KSTG
description: KSTG (KnightSavesTheGirl) - an adventure action game about a knight, made in 3D graphics. The gameplay is about collecting supplies and weapons, choosing the best equipment, as well as completing various quests and battling different types of enemies.

title: Lawnmower Game: UFO Chase 2
description: Sequel lawnmower ufo chase game. Enemy UFO with several weapons like rockets and laser are chasing Lawnmower guy. Cut enough grass and earn stars to unlock new levels and avoid UFO and beware other objects

title: Iintwo
description: Iin Two is a platform puzzle game where you play as a soul controlling cubes, tackling challenges to get them to the altar, which is your goal: saving the planet.

title: X2Roulette
description: x2Roulette - game inspired by roulette. It doesn't matter how much you bet, your odds are always the same. Bets occur in real time, across the entire steam, meaning you bet, win, and lose along with other players.

title: Illumi-Naughty ;): Remastered
description: You are tasked with infiltrating the illumi-headquarters and messing them up big time. or something. #420BLAZEM'

title: Dob
description: dob is a puzzle game where the goal is to get the player to the finish by moving and bouncing off the walls.

title: H+H=H2
description: Sokoban-like, Fake-chemistry, Solitaire

title: WolfTeam: Classic
description: Wolfteam is a game where you can enjoy a variety of team formations and battlefield situations that change from moment to moment, such as humans and wolves, wolves and wolves, through the keyword werewolves, beyond human-to-human

title: Pixel Bombs
description: Pixel Bombs is a high-score chasing thrill ride based upon staying alive while being bombarded with bombs. Use your mouse to click on exploding bombs and keep your lives for as long as possible. It's sure to be an explosively good time!

title: Dahiana (G)
description:
Dahiana (G) is the first entry in the Dahiana saga. The story begins on a fateful night when the evil Dahiana has already conquered the world, imprisoning people in dungeons scattered across the globe. Among the captives is Claudia, who is eventually rescued by a brave young man named Enrique. After failing to contact her family, Claudia sets out on a journey to find out what happened and rescue those in need.

Despite her scattered and clumsy nature, Claudia's strong and determined personality leads her into a massive adventure. Alongside new friends like Neison, Meilin, and Mimi, she will fight to save not only the world but perhaps the entire universe, the heavens, and every known dimension. From distant planets to the depths of hell, players will experience a wild journey through the eyes of the saga's most iconic characters.

Developed by Tatis Sama Games, Dahiana (G) represents an alternative dimension to Dahiana (V) (created by VidaVirix). This unique project features two siblings who developed two different games based on the same premise and characters, allowing for multiple crossovers and interactions between both titles.

The game was built using the RPG Maker 2003 engine and is available for Windows and Linux via itch.io, featuring a full experience in Spanish.

title: Never Forget
description: You're trapped in a repeating basement corridor. Watch closely: objects shift, signs change, and something is always slightly wrong. Detect anomalies, choose wisely, and survive the darkness miss a detail and the loop pulls you back.

title: Astralith
description: Astralith is a multiplayer wizard RPG where every character is truly your own. Collect dozens of spells and weapons, customize your character, and battle against other players to reach the peak of the Astralith.

title: The Distant Circular World
description:
The sequel to Return to Shironagasu Island.
Ikeda Sen, a detective working in New York, is approached by a mysterious woman named Lila.
At the same time, his client Walton entrusts Ikeda with a mysterious device.
Meanwhile, Izumozaki Neneko, who has returned to her everyday life, discovers a decomposing corpse along the Horikawa River on her way to school.
These two completely unrelated stories soon begin to strangely intersect...

title: Pinball FX: Williams Pinball Volume 10
description: Relive the golden age of pinball with Williams Pinball Volume 10! This amazing collection brings together the iconic Diner pinball table with the first ever official recreation of Fire! and Comet.

title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2027
description: Build, repair, and grow your automotive empire — now also in co-op mode! Run a workshop together, fix cars, and expand your collection. Hundreds of configurations, thousands of parts, and full customization await!

title: The Gigglebone Gang: World Tour
description: This is an entertaining companion to teach young children about 10 nations, including Australia, Egypt, Ghana, Peru, and Russia.

title: The Scrolls
description:
This game is about a Kitsune who was sent by the boss on a mission to collect scrolls.
The gameplay consists of dodging enemies and collecting scrolls in order to advance to the next level.
In this game, there are two worlds, each with its own challenges you must face.

title: Pulinho
description: PULINHO just lost all of their money! Help them grab it all back on this puzzle game :D

title: Hoarder
description: Clean. Possess. Control. Hoarder begins as a mundane cleaning simulator which spirals into a submerged nightmare. Pilot a submarine, recover what shouldn’t be found, and uncover the secrets of your new home by night.

title: Fool's Court
description: You are the king. Petitioners bring tales of theft, betrayal, and ambition to your throne. Listen to their pleas, issue your decrees, and watch stability tip, shaping a kingdom of grudges, loyalty, and consequence.

title: The Internal
description: A time-based action roguelike where you battle twisted simulations of your co-workers and climb the corporate ladder before the clock hits 1700.

title: Empyrean Defense
description: Empyrean Defense is a modern military tower defense game where players build, upgrade, and customize defensive sites to repel waves of invading forces. The game features player abilities, skill progression, and resource management systems, including crafting ammunition and gathering resources directly on the battlefield to adapt to evolving threats.

title: Solitaire Nights
description: Solitaire Nights on Steam is a premium, standalone Klondike solitaire game for PC and Mac featuring a "casino-inspired" atmosphere, polished visuals, and ambient music. Designed for focused, ad-free play, it offers a refined desktop experience with smooth, drag-and-drop gameplay and competitive scoring.

title: Happiness Laboratory
description: Happiness Laboratory is a Psychological Horror Visual Novel with 14 Endings!

title: Eros Wept
description:
Revel and writhe in a breathing and shivering homage to the artwork of H.R. Giger.

Eros Wept is an extremely short (30-60 second) interactive experience about industrialized reproduction in an otherworldly Xylem.

title: Carnage Contest
description: Carnage Contest is a free 2D turn-based multiplayer shooter with fully destructible terrain and an insane collection of weapons!

title: Nightbell
description: Nightbell is an atmospheric horror game about a Christmas Eve when a cozy home stops being a safe place.

title: 2TAP
description: 2TAP is a fast-paced competitive multiplayer shooter where two hits are enough to eliminate an opponent; drop into a Battle Royale, loot gear, and outplay other players using precision, reflexes, and strategy in intense real-time combat.

title: SynthwaveZ
description: A fast-paced, wave-based zombie shooter set in an alternate 1980s dystopia. Call in airstrikes, deploy support bots, upgrade wild weapons, and survive the horde—solo or with friends. No grinding. No paid DLC. Just pure, chaotic fun.

title: Tales of the Trade
description:
In Tales of Trade, you are much more than just a shop owner. You manage an economy in a fantastical world where the power of items comes not from the sharpness of a sword, but from the ancient spells imbued within them.
