Use your psychological skills (Sweet Talk, Pressure, Deceive) while bargaining with customers in real time, expand your influence by moving your shop to different cities, and equip persistent adventurers with the most suitable magical items to send them on guild quests.

But be careful; not everything that glitters is gold. Illusions, cursed items, and the dark side of the black market can endanger your reputation and gold at any moment.

title: Murderplanet
description: Fight to the death in the arena-based action roguelike game show, Murderplanet. Craft a build of ridiculous and broken synergies to weave and cleave through hordes of enemies. Survive each wave, stake out Capture Points, earn heaps of cash and further customize your runs for maximum arcade chaos.

title: Leave
description:
"He is waiting for me".

Leave is a short horror adventure game. The playtime is somewhat short.

title: Lured In
description: Run your own cozy aquarium! Travel to different places to catch all types of fish. Bring them back for idle profits, or sell them for instant cash. Unlock research for new upgrades, and ascend for powerful bonuses. Customize your character and tanks, and make your aquarium your own!

title: Storm The House Collection
description: Defend your base, upgrade your arsenal, and survive the siege! The iconic Storm the House trilogy of fixed-position shooters returns from the golden age of Flash, now preserved and better than ever.

title: The Fancy Pants Adventures Online
description: Relive the classic Fancy Pants Adventures with your friends in an epic online arcade. Play through the story, mess around in platforming sandboxes, challenge each other to some friendly PvP, or tour through a round of Fancy Golf together.

title: Amalgamate
description: No meta progression, scoring, simple rules with a LOT of depth, and just condensed decision making. And merging, lots of merging.

title: D-Fencer Vs The Orb
description: D-FENCER VS THE ORB is a short, experimental STG (shmup) made for LÖVE Jam 2023. Use the SURGE WEAPON to be in two places at once. Recover from the edge of failure with the HBT system. THE ORB awaits.

title: Austin Cooper S Racing
description:
AUSTIN COOPER S Racing A class of its own: Austin Cooper S!

In 1959, an automotive legend was born: the Austin Cooper S. Authentically recreated under license and perfectly rendered. Mini style, Mini feel, and Mini driving fun for urban speed junkies! Race street races in several cities that would get you your license in real life. Use the Mini's strengths: It can perform adventurous jumps, squeeze through narrow alleys, side streets, and much more.

For victory, you'd better plan some very special tracks.

title: "Suizokukan Kochira"
description:
You and a girl have come to the aquarium.
Make the most of your limited time here and enjoy the visit.

title: Little Blue Wings for the Blue Girl
description: You are trapped in a pitch-dark, tiny room, with no door or window. You don’t know how long has passed, even though you're never hungry or thirsty either. The only way to keep your sanity is Renee, a mysterious girl who is trapped beside your room and shares an uncertain fate with you.

title: Furnace God
description:
The world has been destroyed.

Anyways, follow Moku's journey to prove that the Sun is the ultimate furnace!

title: Eggs for You
description:
An egg game about an egg man giving eggs to the eggless.

Eggs are hard work. Remember to take breaks!

title: Gabby's Odyssey
description: Embark on a journey through the fantastical world of Larion in this action-adventure inspired by timeless classics of the genre. Solve clever puzzles, overcome perilous dungeons, and unlock new abilities — while discovering that imagination is not a weakness, but a force that can change everything.

title: Cup Or Die
description: Survive in a creepy bar playing beer pong against terrifying opponents in roguelite style. Throw the ball into cups with various effects, collect weird items and passive cards, choose doors, play mini-games. Miss a shot — drink. Every cup you drink can give a bonus or kill you.

title: Senchu
description: The release of 'Perfect Meat' is finally here! This will solve the problem of food shortages. Be sure to pick it up at your local store!

title: The Dunkers
description: Great 1on1 fun! Homage to 2D basketball and keyboards! Dunks, shoots, layups and blocks you will feel! Dunk you very much!

title: Spinbot
description: A roguelite drenched in 00's competitive shooter vibes. In Spinbot, you trade your soul for cheats. Wipe out waves of bots and upgrade your "wordprocessor.exe" with some amazing features.

title: Depleted
description: DEPLETED is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game where sacrifices must escape a ritualist who hunts them down for blood in order to complete the ritual. Use stealth, teamwork, and strategy to survive.

title: Koiken Otome: Revive
description: This is the fandisk for Koiken Otome, focusing on subheroines Chiharu, Shiho and Mari. There are also after stories for the 4 heroines from the original game and an intense episode with the Kotona.

title: Hrana
description: Hidden behind layers of a mural painting is a land of memories, longing and hope. Follow the journey of its terminal guest.

title: Dino Slug
description:
"DINO SLUG" is an action-packed, lovingly hand-drawn top-down adventure. Explore a dark jungle and fight the lurking soldiers of a totalitarian regime and, of course: dinos!

Along the way, you’ll find plenty of firearms, grenade types, and helpful items to collect. Arrange them properly in your backpack inventory to unlock surprising new effects that make mercenary life a little easier (or just a lot funnier)!

title: Final Stepasy
description: Final Stepasy is an online pixel MMORPG built to feel familiar in the best way: explore the world, fight monsters in real time, level up, and keep improving your character through gear, spells, and class progression. It is designed around both solo and social play, with parties, chat, and shared world presence so players always feel part of a live game.

title: Escape Goat: Azuma Eiji no Enzai
description: Escape Goat: The False Accusation of Eiji Azuma is a single-player adventure and mystery game. You play as Eiji Azuma, a former detective wrongfully accused of murder. Using investigation, deduction, and clever strategy, you gather clues, navigate obstacles, and evade capture while uncovering the real culprit behind the crimes. The game emphasizes narrative-driven exploration and puzzle-solving over action.

title: Whispers of the Seasons
description: You have been marked by a monster to be its next prey. Defend your cabin against the beast across the four seasons, listening out for its attacks to stop it before it gets inside. Complete tasks throughout the night in an effort to free yourself from its curse and return to a normal life.

title: Loser Got Isekai’d: Gotta Conquer the Girls Before Conquering the World
description: A mysterious white-haired woman takes your hand and teaches you how to command troops. She wants you to help her conquer the world—and she's even willing to offer her body for the cause!

title: Last Light Left
description: A roguelite in which you fell strange beasts using a slot machine. Manipulate the reels to stack the odds in your favor and conquer the many foes standing between you and a princess begging to be saved.

title: Fortnite Festival: Season 13
description:
The Festival continues with Season 13, now starring Chappell Roan!

Chappell adds “Pink Pony Club” to Fortnite through the Heartcore Music Pass, which you can purchase to access the pink Chappell Roan Outfit with an unlockable red version. Both versions are recreations of her fan-favorite Pink Pony fits on tour. The Pass also includes new accessories like the Midwest Princess Keytar.

title: Things to Forget: Lighthouse
description: Things to Forget - is an episodic horror game that immerses you in a world of the unknown. Each story is a new chilling episode, and there is no mysticism: only real events experienced by people.

title: DVD Survivors
description: YOU are the DVD Survivor! Bounce off walls, collect bytes, stack weapons, evolve your build, close waves of pop-ups, destroy error windows, eliminate bosses (Slippy!), and destroy all the other digital threats! Short runs and ALL THE WEAPONS! This is the final CORNER SLAM!

title: Mahou Shoujo Dai Shippai
description:
This is the Magical Girl Raising Lab!
Choose your favorite girl and attributes and make a magical girl!
But... what? Somehow something is wrong...?

title: Apple Man Sam
description: Apple Man Sam...is a little Apple Man! Shoot your way through hordes of moustached vegetables, as you level up, upgrade your weapons, and obtain items to grow absurdly strong. Defeat the final boss and complete quests to unlock more maps and loadouts, for endless fun!

title: Natsuiro Sail Trim: Sail 1
description:
A visual themed on one type of a yacht race called "sailing".
Set in Enoshima in Shonan area, schoolgirls challenge sailing!

Contains chapter 1-3.

title: Natsuiro Sail Trim: Sail 2
description: The final chapter of Natsuiro Sail Trim.

title: Dangerous Roads
description:
Dangerous Roads is a fantasy tower defense game where players control a party of three heroes to defend trade routes from waves of enemies. Players choose between a knight, wizard, and druid, each with distinct roles and abilities.

The game features 9 levels set across different environments, with multiple waves of enemies per level and increasing difficulty. Enemies attack from multiple paths, requiring strategic positioning and decision-making.

Players earn and manage gold between waves, with unspent resources carrying over between levels. Characters can be upgraded and enhanced with perks to improve performance and adapt to later challenges.

The game focuses on resource management, party composition, and strategic planning as players progress through increasingly difficult encounters.

title: Stellar Freight: Endless Horizon
description: Embark on a Sci-fi Roguelike Turn-based RPG with Tactical combat. Become a Captain of a freight ship, deliver cargo through deep space, manage your crew, upgrade your ship, fight space warships, and build your reputation. Every day brings a new adventure. Space shows no mercy.

title: Splash Divers
description: Immerse yourself in an unforgettable diving vacation! Break free from the limits of air supply and dive into the beauty of the ocean and its incredible marine life. Build your own personalized ocean encyclopedia, make friends with a diverse cast of dive buddies, and savor these moments of leisure.

title: Minecraft Dungeons II
description: Drop the pickaxe, grab a sword, and charge into a thrilling new adventure in Minecraft Dungeons II. Journey through unexplored lands and mysterious locations, in a quest to stop a new evil from causing chaos in not one, but two worlds! Clash with menacing foes in explosive encounters and fight your way through hordes of mobs that will do everything in their power to stop you from saving the day.

title: R.U.S.H.: Rival Ultimate Steel Hand
description: Rival Ultimate Steel Hand - A 3D fighting game inspired by classic Tekken, which emphasises movement and strategy. The game is in early development, but available for anyone to play for free on itch.io, complete with fully functional rollback netcode. Everyone in the community will be able to contribute by helping me play test builds as the game progresses, and providing feedback and suggestions.

title: Fantasy Kingdom Merchant Simulator
description: Fantasy Kingdom Merchant Simulator is a shop simulator where you sell potions, scrolls, swords, and armour to earn money, build your business, and become the greatest merchant of all time.

title: InterFishion
description: A chat‑driven fishing game for Twitch streamers where viewers compete for high scores. Ideal for stream breaks and keeping your community engaged.

title: Rosalie
description: A chaotic 2-player co-op road trip. Share the controls of a pedal car as tourists: sit on the left to turn left, sit on the right to turn right! Coordination is key!

title: Echo Tower
description:
Climb a tower plunged into darkness using the power of echo location.

Echo Tower is an audio action adventure game where your ears replace your eyes. Navigate through the floors, solve puzzles and reach the top to bring back the light to the planet.

title: V Life
description: Live in a miniature garden with your favorite characters! Color your own unique world with blocks and furniture! A VRM-compatible, idle crafting simulation game. The perfect companion for your work, a quick break, or just a part of your daily life.

title: First Made Break Rock
description: This game is a simple shooting game. Break stones to obtain goods and use the goods to purchase and strengthen skills to defeat the boss!

title: Daydream Drifters
description: Dungeons, enemies, items — everything is randomly generated in this roguelike stealth horror. As events occur over time, hiding alone is not enough—you must be ready to fight. Explore three seamlessly connected random dungeons and survive the daydream. And when you awaken, what will you see…?

title: Surface
description: A linear first person exploration adventure. The game is about exploring detailed and creepy liminal environments without monsters or puzzles, you simply walk and look around.

title: Blood in the Panopticon
description: Enter an ASCII-Art bullet hell war-zone! Guide and maintain your android and enact vengeance upon this corrupted world. Upgrade C424, keep her loyal, and use her to paint the Concrete Plains red. But remember: Panopticon always stares back.

title: Rogue Shell
description: Rogue Shell is an atmospheric action roguelike set far into a dark future, where you play as a small robot shell trying to escape the deepest layers of a decaying megastructure. Explore, scavenge, upgrade your equipment, fight to survive - and to uncover the structure's mysteries.

title: ECH8
description: ECH8 is a single-player narrative puzzle game about uncovering the mystery behind the disappearance of an entire species. Communicate with their past to uncover the truth and decide the future of their species. Will you uncover the truth in time, or are you doomed to make the same mistakes?

title: Lost Zion
description: Lost Zion is an atmospheric cyberpunk horror game. Awakened by a faint signal as a service bot, explore the forsaken megacity of Lost Zion. Uncover the Emperor's horrific secrets. Obey your sole command: Activate the Gravity Core.

title: CardBoard
description: CardBoard captures the fun of a board game with the deep strategy of a roguelike deckbuilder. Gather companions or brave it alone. Choose from a variety of characters with unique cards and dice, and battle across dynamic themed boards. No healer required—just a little faith in the cards.

title: Monari Station
description: An ordinary commute becomes a moral crucible in Monar Station, a short psychological horror visual novel. Navigate an extreme situation, make value-defining choices... Discover what lingers after the train moves on...

title: Make Moku Proud
description: Uncover the truth behind a broken ritual in Make Moku Proud... a psychological visual novel where guilt and obedience, and what it means to make Moku proud, shape the fate of a witness watching his companions disappear.

title: Eternal Chrysalis Dream
description: a yume nikki fan game made by shell32224 with programming/music help from catcatcatsix

title: The Legend of Chalkvania
description: A bite-sized retro action-adventure set in a quirky, cursed land. Fight monsters, meet strange characters, and uncover hidden secrets in this fast-paced homage to classic 2D side-scrollers. Choose your path—embrace the light or the curse. Your legend begins in Chalkvania.

title: Project: Catalepsy
description:
Project: Catalepsy is a haunting third-person action roguelike that plunges players into a visceral interpretation of Christian Hell. As a lone wanderer, you must descend through a procedurally generated abyss of 20 unforgiving levels where the only way out is deeper in.

Before every descent, players must strategically architect their build, combining active and passive skills with ancient amulets and risk-reward modifiers. Survival demands mastery of combat and character synergy, with formidable boss encounters guarding every fifth floor. While the abyss is lethal, death is merely a transition: collect Blood Shards to unlock permanent upgrades and return stronger. Experience a fully 3D dark fantasy world where strategic depth meets uncompromising tension, and every run is a step closer to uncovering what lies at the heart of the pit.

title: VPetlings
description: Raise your own virtual pet right on your desktop. Choose your favorite, take care of your companion, play together, train for battle, and help them evolve! They will always be there, keeping you company while you work, play, or browse.

title: Venus in Transit
description: The mother vessel is adrift in space, out of fuel and doomed. Your mission is the colony’s only hope for survival. Will you be able to navigate the claustrophobic canyons when your ship begins to fail?

title: Zookaa Fruits
description: Zookaa Fruits is a physics based puzzle game where you have to drop and merge cute fruits in a big bowl. Chain combinations quickly to increase your multiplier and try to get the best score ! But be careful not to overflow or drop anything outside the bowl !

title: Ugoku Sushi Bar
description:
Become a sushi chef in a cozy Japanese conveyor belt sushi bar!
Prepare sushi on your crafting table, serve quirky customers, learn new recipes, unlock fresh ingredients, upgrade your kitchen, and build relationships with your regular customers.

title: My Idle Witch
description: A little witch companion who brews potions anywhere on your desktop. Watch her work and sell her potions, dress her in new outfits, and decorate her tiny workshop. Stay focused by using productivity tools like checklists and Pomodoro timers.

title: Block Dodge 3D
description: Simple Cube Runner Game

title: WingsSimulations Flight Simulator 2027
description: Fly anywhere on Earth with realistic weather, detailed aircraft, and thousands of airports. Design your own planes, tackle landing challenges, and experience full-fidelity flight simulation without the usual performance cost.

title: Nailhead
description: Winter vacation with friends goes terribly wrong when Jack finds something evil in the cellar.

title: Petra Theos
description: When a lone man searches for his missing dog deep within the snow-covered forest, he finds a mysterious Rock with dark powers.

title: Evitania Online
description: Similar to games such as IdleOn and Maple Story Idle, Evitania Online is a fun little IdleRPG in the making with plenty on content to come!

title: The Knife Sharpener
description: You are trying to make a living in an indifferent city full of freaks, one knife at the time.

title: Serendipity Bookshop
description: You’ve taken over a tranquil bookstore for a friend. In the corner, a girl appears at the same time each day—reading softly, her presence both quiet and captivating. A simple shopkeeper and a customer… or something deeper? The answer lies in your choices.

title: Burning Snow
description: BURNING SNOW is a short atmospheric experience about staying warm in a cold forest and eventually launching a firework. Seek matches and make fire while a mysterious cat companion guides you through the forest.

title: Perfect Tritone
description:
In Man Machine combat, firing the first shot secures the upper hand.

Created for Noise Jam 2, made with much love and perishingly little foresight.

title: Pinch Hitters
description:
Pinch Hitters is a baseball deck-builder built in 2 weeks for the Portland Indie Game Squad's Build Your Own Game Jam 2026.

Form the ultimate team of batters as you face increasingly difficult foes. Will you be able to win all 9 matches and earn the title of the King of Baseball?

title: Escape the Doom
description: Master control of your Hypercraft as you race through time to escape the impending Doom. Fly fast and dodge hazards in this endless runner unlike any other.

title: Unwelcome Guests
description: A Mörk Borg-inspired first-person shooter that combines brutal dungeon runs with narrative progression and a stylized hand-drawn 3D aesthetic.

title: Homonculus
description: Homonculus is a first-person metroidvania boomer shooter that blends classic gothic inspirations with cartoony whimsy! Master intense combat, defeat intimidating bosses, and save the land of Gartvaria from its blight.

title: Silent Ward: Forever Lost
description: The game is built using Unreal Engine 5 with an interactive 3D UI. Players must explore the ward and repair damaged circuits while evading the harassment of the Listener. Along the way, they must locate notes left by other survivors. With the help of the item information, they can leave.

title: Toast Clicker
description: Toast is a simple clicker game where you click on a slice of toast to earn points. Every 30 minutes a new random toast variant unlocks. Collect all 38 unique toast designs.

title: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 2.7 - Champions Never Fall to the Past
description:
Version 2.7 of Zenless Zone Zero, which includes:
• New Characters: Nangong Yu and Cissia
• New Main Story Quest
• New events
• New skin for Nangong Yu
• ...and more!

title: Antlers
description: Time to go take the lives of deer for fun.

title: Occuleye
description: On a casual Saturday, you awake to noises. Loud bangs of wood near your farm vibrate throughout your home. On further investigation, you discover something you wish you hadn't.

title: Hoof & Seek
description: Find all the hidden farm animals.

title: Casual Sport Series: Boxing
description: Casual Sports: Boxing is a fast-paced arcade boxing game where timing, stamina, and smart risks decide every fight.

title: Meow Moments: Celebrating Myth & Machine
description: Join cute cats in a time-travel adventure! Find feline friends and pop balloons as you explore a magical medieval kingdom and a chaotic sci-fi metropolis.

title: Panda Keeper
description: Snack Time!

title: Slide Viking: Treasure's Path
description: Vikings on the Treasure Hunt

title: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales - Digital Deluxe Edition
description: This set is a bundle of The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales game with various adventuring accessories.

title: Horticular: Frozen Frontier
description: The long-lost research world Glacialis has appeared out of nowhere and your trusted council sends you there to establish contact and bring back any findings on the corrupted.

title: Perspectre
description: Perspectre is a Metroidvania and Action Platformer with a perspective-switching core mechanic which allows the player to switch seamlessly between 2D sidescroller, top-down perspective, and third-person 3D gameplay.

title: Harvest Skies: Crop Dusting Simulator
description: Build your crop-dusting empire from a single rusty biplane. Take contracts, mix chemicals, fly through wind and hazards. Then hire pilots, expand to new airfields, and grow your operation. See how far your skills can take you... and your luck.

title: Deirdre
description: Deirdre is an Action Roguelike game where you fight a looping Gauntlet of Bosses.

title: Instruments of Power
description: Build powerful spells in this tactical RPG, then send disposable avatars into battle to unleash them. Explore ancient sites of power, devastate foes with your magic, and acquire forgotten knowledge. But where does true power come from?

title: Pickmos
description: Dive into a vast, uncharted continent filled with ancient civilizations and mysterious creatures called "Pickmon." In this multiplayer open-world survival crafter, you’ll team up with your Pickmon to fight, farm, and build industrial empires while thwarting a shadowy organization's plot.

title: Patlabor the Case Files
description: Relive iconic scenes from "Mobile Police Patlabor" in this 3D console action game. Experience dual perspectives: Main Missions as the SV2, and Another Side Missions as their rivals. Hone your pilot skills in Simulator Mode, featuring shooting ranges and Labor duels.

title: Waddle Dev Vs Kirby Dark Dawn
Dededeball
description: Dededeball is a Boss Battle based on Kirby's Dream Land for the Nintendo GameBoy.

title: Kirby Gamble Galaxy Stories: The Future
description:
Kirby Gamble Galaxy Stories ~ The Future is a parody game made for April Fools 2021.

The tale of a game that never got updated ever again. The Cosmic Fluxbender took over the world, it's up to Kirby to find him and put an end to it all!

title: Hitmaker Tycoon
description: Are you ready to build your dream music studio? Hitmaker Tycoon puts you at the heart of the music production world in an immersive simulation experience!

title: Limb Lobber
description:
Match 3 or more blocks to defeat monsters and help Lak rebuild his best friend!

Meet Lak, the alien who just wanted a best friend. Unfortunately, his pet monsters got really jealous and stole every part to the best friend he was building! Swipe and match 3 or more blocks to defeat monsters and help Lak rebuild his best friend! A match-3 game with challenging levels, a unique art style and harrowing boss fights, Limb Lobber sure is a blast!

title: Log Away: Christmas DLC
description: Wrap your Log Away retreat in a Christmas fairy-tale. Decorate in festive warmth, furnish with cozy, themed touches, and let a gentle holiday soundtrack hush the day. Nothing urgent, nothing loud. Just slow evenings, cozy corners, and a breath of wonder.

title: I'll Be Back to the Future with a Terminator
Log Away: Easter DLC
description: Let your Log Away retreat bloom with Easter warmth. Decorate with eggs, blossoms, and bunny touches, and let a mellow soundtrack bring a hint of new life. Nothing urgent, nothing loud. Just warm corners, quiet breaths, and a sense of renewal.

title: Cargo, Please!
description:
Cargo, Please! is a cozy, high-speed delivery game where you accept take-out deliveries, race across cities, and keep your cargo intact while the cops stay close behind. Drive fast, upgrade your truck, and find your rhythm on the road.

You play as a delivery truck driver taking on shipments across three cities. Each job starts the same way: accept a shipment, pick it up, and deliver it to the drop-off point. The twist is that not every delivery is safe, simple, or legal, and the police are always watching.

The game features replayable, fast-paced driving mixed with a cozy, lighthearted tone. Shipments are smartly auto-generated, so no two runs feel exactly the same. Some deliveries are quick and easy, others are long, timed, or more fragile. As you complete deliveries, you earn money and experience. Over time, you upgrade your truck to handle better shipments, unlock new trucks, access new cities, and expand your list of playable characters.

The world is open, with a full day and night cycle and dynamic weather. Between deliveries, you can switch things up in Taxi Driver Mode for a more relaxed experience.

title: Skipper 2
description: Skipper2 is a chill, challenging, and unique puzzle game with 25+ levels to bend your mind and challenge your problem solving ability, with 1.5 - 4 hours of play.

title: Linsips
description: Divide chaos into order! In Linsips, place two lines to split bouncing balls into four quadrants with the exact same number of balls in each. 20 levels of pure arcade precision with authentic OPL3 FM synth music, MS-DOS aesthetics, all under 600 KB on SteamOS.

title: Immortal Clan: Grandmastery
description: Immortal Clan: Grandmastery is an Eastern fantasy xianxia sim-management game. As founding master, build a sect from scratch. Recruit disciples with unique quirks and personalities. Assign daily tasks, guide cultivation, and lead them from mortal to ascension.

title: Yelling At Cats: The Game
description: A short and silly horror game where you play as a cat with an owner experiencing Coprolalia and must find out what has made them so angry by staring at them long enough without being caught.

title: Whippet At Large
description: Your owner has abandoned you yet again for something she calls a “job.” You must find her quickly before the lack of attention becomes fatal.

title: Ferret Quest
description: Ferret Quest is a charming hand-drawn action game where a brave little ferret hurls acorns at masked woodland foes. Battle through challenging levels, uncover the mystery behind the masks, and take on a climactic boss fight in this adorable forest adventure!

title: Gunja Tteokbokki
description: Orders pouring in, broth bubbling over, and the daily pressure of balancing the books! Manage your ingredients, cook tteokbokki to perfection, and run your very own shop in this culinary tycoon simulation game.

title: Indiana Jones and the Passage of Saints
A Game About Achieving Stuff
description: Cut out the annoying "gameplay" and get straight to what matters: making numbers go up. Walk down identical corridors, hoard useless loot, and perform 200 highly specific, stupid tasks just to make a little notification pop up on your screen. Pure achievement satisfaction.

title: Goblin Quest III
description: After being brought back to life, you become the Warmaster, master of the Eben, and begin your quest to dominate everything. The Forest is just the beginning.

title: R.A.T#200
description: A stealth-based survival thriller where you play as an experimental rat trapped in a laboratory. Hide, observe, and use the environment to escape without being detected.

title: A show she never watched.
description: Clara, a teenager struggling with psychological issues, is visited one night by a mysterious entity through her TV. As she falls asleep, She begins her perilous adventure in her dreams. Will she be able to discover the truth? Or will she continue to dream for eternity?

title: The First Million
description: An idle deckbuilder where you constantly unlock new cards and upgrades and discover one game-breaking strategy after another to make THE FIRST MILLION — and then many more!

title: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions - Enchanted Garden
description: Step into nature and cultivate your green thumb with the Enchanted Garden DLC! This blossoming expansion opens the doors to a brand-new garden area.

title: Lost Entry
description: Lost Entry is a horror game where you search the Deep Web for information while avoiding enemies that adapt to your actions. Your goal is to survive the night and complete the task your employer gives you without getting murdered by a bunch of Deep Web killers.

title: Pleasure Delving
description: Overcome the dungeon's challenges and find comfort alongside alluring allies. Take control with divine incantations in auto-battle combat encounters, navigate random events to find powerful relics and equipment, and plunder the dungeon to reveal all its treasures.

title: Tosbik Around The World
description: Tosbik Around The World is a hand-drawn 2D game where you play as Tosbik, a sea turtle that heroically cleans seas all around the world with magical sea stars and with the help of her friends.

title: Track Star
description:
Track Star is a text-based track and field career simulation. Set in high school, you build an athlete from scratch, choosing your event specialty and allocating stats across eight attributes. Over four seasons — Freshman through Senior — you train weekly, manage energy, compete in regular season meets, and chase qualification for Class, State, Regional, and National championships.
Outside competition, a rivalry system tracks your history against recurring NPC opponents. A world events engine generates training flavor, program news, and breaking headlines that shift week to week. Achievements and milestone unlocks mark career progress. The game ends with an epilogue that reflects the full arc of your four years.
Track Star is a single-player game built for players who want the grind of a career sim without the overhead of a management game.

title: Miko-san Fighter! Ryouko-chan
description:
Ryouko is a shrine maiden who works at a mountain shrine. Apparently there was some bamboozling, because the spirits of the mountain have become restless. Now she must gather the four God Gems to be able to set things right.

The gameplay involves some classic side-scrolling action while you toss your adorable red panda mascot at enemies and have him return back to you like some kind of twisted boomerang.

title: Jumpscare Storey Loop
description: Discover jump scare phenomena and escape the loops of eerie buildings. Observe carefully to uncover the paranormal and cut down those who attack you.

title: Marvel Rivals: Season 7 - The Hunt is On
description:
New York is on the brink. The hunt is on.

Forces from 2099's Nueva York have begun pouring into modern-day New York, turning the city into ground zero for their expansion. As a temporal plague spreads from the Alchemax Tower and martial law tightens across the city, Mayor Fisk is ready to do whatever it takes to restore order

But in darkness, those who navigate the shadows truly shine...

title: Crimson Broadcast
description: Survive against relentless waves of enemies by broadcasting on dangerous frequencies. Evolve, adapt and defend your radio station in this post-apocalyptic top-down survival game.

title: Pokémon Origins
description: Pokémon Origins is a fan game created using RPG Maker XP. It can be played on any Windows computer.

title: Deer Hero
description: 2D action game.

title: Drunk Dad Vs Family
description: A chaotic 4v1 multiplayer game where a family must put their drunk father to sleep before he loses control.

title: The Assault: Survivor
description: The Assault Survivor is an exciting action game that takes you into the world of the apocalypse. You play as survivors, where every step is fraught with danger. You will have to fight mutants, look for resources to level up and try to survive in this cruel world.

title: Wave Gods: Ammo Night
description: In an abandoned world, the silence of death is broken by zombies! Conserve your ammo, team up with friends, and survive the nightmare. Single player or up to 6 players can join the online survival battle!

title: Neon Fantasy: Owls
description: Neon Fantasy: Owls is the perfect puzzle game for a fun and rewarding pastime. Collect pictures, develop your attention, and feel like a part of the beautiful neon world.

title: Big Theft Valkeala 3: Revenge
description: Terentius Duval is dead and his Wife Mary Duval is coming to Valkeala to rob money and finish missions in this third part of third person open world action game

title: TellTale: Casino Murder Case
description: [Telltale - Casino Murder] is a full-voice indie mystery game with the youngest lawyer, Kang Ho-yeon, who reveals the truth of the casino murder case and achieves innocence at trial.

title: Weabot
description: Control a flying drone, possess other robots, and solve environmental puzzles in a mysterious world full of hidden challenges.

title: Meat Train
description: Meat Train is a FPS game where you operate a train thats uses MEAT for FUEL. Explore a wasteland where everything wants you dead, scavenge for weapons and loot. Upgrade the train and attempt to destroy an evil AI megafactory.

title: Stellar Rising
description: Embark on the difficult journey of returning the stars to the sky. Precisely control the stars, leaping from the bottom to the top of each level. Feel the sense of achievement with each successful leap, and enjoy this challenging process. Are you ready for this shining adventure?

title: Resonant Dusk
description: Unravel the secrets of the Bariton mansion! Take on the mantle of detective in the role of Lucas Usher, and solve the riddles plaguing the ghosts of those left behind! Uncover their secrets and help them find salvation … or damnation.

title: Codename Medusa
description: Build a new country, become a billionaire, or dive into our sprawling open-world to learn lore. Dictate the focus of your nation! Be wicked and have fun tormenting your struggling citizens for profit or nice by completing town projects to clean the corrupted area for your fellow deported monsters.

title: Wired Tokyo
description:
— Dive into Tokyo. Dive into the past. —
WIRED TOKYO is a vertical 3D action game where you climb toward the vast skies above Tokyo.
To unlock new abilities, you may have to deliberately “dive” from above.
A climbing game where falling has meaning — that’s WIRED TOKYO.

title: Night Shift Nightmare
description: First-person horror game where you work the night shift at a Mexican convenience store, handling daily tasks while facing eerie and unexpected events.

title: Sashimi Slayer
description: Sashimi Slayer is a casual arcade rhythm game with an open-source IRL sword controller. Prove your sword (and rhythm) skills facing down some crazy sea creatures. Parry their strikes and land the perfect cut!

title: Diggin It
description: Dig, upgrade, and take risky buffs in this chaotic tunnel adventure! Team up with your loyal cat and dog companions, discover powerful upgrades, and decide how far you're willing to push your luck while digging deeper and deeper.

title: Night Errors
description: Your job at Mr. Sandman's Dream Factory is simple: Enter children's nightmares and spot hidden anomalies - known as Night Errors. Make the right decisions to go deeper in the dreams, or start over from the beginning!

title: Sea of Intrigue
description: Sea of Intrigue is a turn-based RPG set in a village facing an imminent siege. Explore with common folk, forge fragile alliances, and fight tactical battles in a world where survival, not heroism, decides how your week ends.

title: Wartales: Contract - Fires in the Capital
description: Isandrin, eternal capital of the Edoran Empire and proud heart of the Legion, has long stood as a symbol of order and dominion. Its banners fly over a city built on discipline, faith, and conquest. Yet even this bastion now trembles from within.

title: Deadvale
description: Deadvale is a free story-driven CRPG combining literary depth and complex morality of 2000s classics with physics, puzzles, and action. A grounded, human journey where each decision matters and maintaining humanity is a constant battle. Can redemption can be found, or is the truth too heavy to bear?

title: Fleshcancer
description: FLESHCANCER is a Fast-paced Boomer Shooter with surreal environments and old-school violence. Fight cannibal cultists, terrorists, grotesque aberrations and more. MAKE IT RAIN FLESH, ORGANS, AND BLOOD LIKE NEVER BEFORE.

title: Flashing Lights: Department of Transportation
description:
Join the Department of Transportation and keep the city running! Help repair vehicles at busy roadsides, install crucial roadside guardrails, repair traffic lights and clear life-threatening debris from the road before disaster strikes.

This DLC includes 5 new vehicles, 5 new missions types, 5 new department locations, and a selection of new playable characters.

title: Age of Mythology: Retold - Obsidian Mirror
description: Ascend to divine power with the Aztec pantheon in Obsidian Mirror. Command new gods, wield fear and illusion, harvest Tonalli, and lead a civilization shaped by sacrifice and myth.

title: Aluminium City
description: Crush empty cans and sell the aluminium, buy upgrades, automatic can presses, and robots to automatize and speed up your process, and pay off your debt.

title: Legend of the Master Baiter Origins: Gills Gone Wild
description: Discover and catch various species of fish as you travel up the Megami River in intense fishing battles, where timing and perseverance are key.

title: EverQuest Legends
description: Step back into Norrath in EverQuest Legends, a reimagined take on the original 1999 EverQuest experience. Designed for solo and casual players, EQL features powerful multiclass characters, iconic races, classic zones, nostalgic visuals, and modern quality-of-life improvements. Legends begin here!

title: The Witch's Disciples
description: After being rescued by a beautiful witch named Mireille, Kyle is lovestruck and decides to become her pupil and learn the ways of magic. Set out for adventure as Kyle with the witch Mireille and go questing in dungeons in this lightweight RPG! Fight monsters, gain experience, learn spells, and use magic to conquer bosses.

title: Fortnite: Save the World
description:
Discover the epic PvE action-building co-op campaign. Take on the monster hordes either solo or with up to three friends as you explore a vast, destructible world, with dynamically created maps where no two games are ever the same.

Build & Defend: Construct elaborate trap tunnels and towering fortresses to protect your objectives from relentless waves of monsters.

Loot & Craft: Scavenge the environment for materials to craft legendary weapons, from neon scythes to heavy-duty rocket launchers.

Level Up: Rescue, recruit and customize a massive roster of Heroes from one of four classes - Soldiers, Ninjas, Outlanders, and Constructors - to suit your playstyle.

The fight is on. Gather your squad, find your favorite gear, and Save the World.

title: Fugitive Flight
description: You find yourself on a ship with three other refugees, fleeing the oppressive regime of your home star system. You're going to be stuck on this little freighter with them for a month while you flee a fascist government, so maybe fall in love with one of them? Or all of them?

title: Salvation Denied
description: Salvation Denied is a chaotic co-op building sim for 1–4 players where a crew of small, yellow, mischievous construction robots attempts to build massive structures with heavy machinery and absurd tools. Physics rules everything. Every block has weight, every mistake shifts the balance, and disasters will push your creation to its absolute limit.

title: Hidden Sheep Puzzle
description: Can you find every sheep and solve the Sheep Puzzle? Looks simple. Isn’t.

title: Sensory Overload
description: A dropper game designed to overwhelm your senses. Twisting tunnels, psychedelic patterns, and breathing walls assault your sense of balance as the chaos escalates with every level.

title: Lusty Bubbles: Animated Edition
description: Experience a seductive bubble shooter with 30 levels of fully animated waifus! No static images here; every girl breathes, moves, and reacts to your skill. Master the puzzle, unlock the heat. Start playing for free and double the fun with our DLCs!

title: Burn the Midnight Oil
description: Solve crimes and steal hearts in this supernatural neon-noir romance visual novel. Featuring six different romance options, some more monstrous than others.

title: Roco Kingdom
description:
Roco Kingdom is a new evolution of open-world creature collecting games, where players become Rocos and set out to meet Jinies, the native creatures living in the continent of Carosia.

Discover 400+ unique Jinies in this living open world. Form bonds with them as you grow together.

title: Zip Up
description: As a stylist working for Hollywood's biggest celebrities, dress up your troublesome clients for their showbiz events and somehow manage a romance with a celebrity in this story-driven dress up game inspired by reality TV & Hollywood culture

title: Atomic Heart: Blood on Crystal
description:
Blood on Crystal, the final DLC, concludes the story of Atomic Heart’s first part on April 16!

P-3 and the Twin venture into the Crystal Complex to face CHAR-les in an all-out bloody showdown against new enemies—Polymorphs—and the most insane bosses of Facility 3826.

title: Bibdu
description: Bibdu is a hand-painted RPG set in ancient Ireland where you unravel myths and legends through open world exploration and strategic card battles.

title: The Entertainer
description: The Entertainer is a minimal, top-down adventure in which you must entertain the masses to survive.

title: Dinosaurium
description: Crack. Hatch. Roar. Extinction was never the end. Hatch and raise hundreds of unique dinosaurs through real-time growth in this cozy idle game. Your prehistoric park thrives with ancient giants, even while you work or study.

title: Boardmancer
description: In Boardmancer, your board is your deck! Roll your dice, reroll your ability tiles, and activate abilities as you battle enemies who transform the board into a battlefield in this unique deckbuilding roguelike.

title: Legion Draft
description: Legion Draft is an async PvP card autobattler where each card represents a troop group that keeps growing. Draft cards, recruit soldiers, and build a legion that surpasses every opponent. Explore fantasy races with different synergies, and become a master strategist！

title: Frog Clan Official Server 24/7 ZK Map
description: This is a game about very carefully descending haphazardly constructed geometry without dying. The movement is pretty technical, being hacked from one of those quake style character controllers. There's bunny hopping and strafe jumping, and also some extra spicy custom crafted momentum mechanics special for this game.

title: Wood Walker
description: It's cold and rainy as dusk falls over the birch tree forest. Keep the campfire alive to make it through the night.

title: Echoes In Static
description: This is an animatronic horror experience.

title: Them's Tale: The Road to Her
description: Them's Tales is a story-driven game series based on Reddit-style storytelling. The stories are written to seem inspired by real events, but they're completely fictional.

title: Chew Your Food
description: It didn't chew you properly. Escape its stomach by crawling, solving puzzles, listening carefully, and avoiding monsters in this horror dungeon-crawler.

title: Guinea Pig Temple
description: You are the hero, and it's time to save your guinea pig friends! Eat food! Squeak! Popcorn! Gather all types of food and friends for a fun temple party. When you've gathered enough friends and resources, the temple's final portal opens for you to join the grand celebration!

title: Mech Jam 3: Encounters on the Red Planet
description: The concept is you pilot a scout ship, that can transform into a mechanised walker when on world, travelling to the 'Red Planet'. The planet is inhospitable filled with acid pools and infested with small hostile aliens.

title: Z-Lestial
description: Reach the end of the track high up in the sky and fly off onto the higher plane! Greatness awaits you!

title: Gridwardens
description: Gridwardens is a turn-based tactics game built for quick, satisfying battles on a grid. Pick your squad, read the battlefield, and outsmart your opponent with clever positioning, timing, and ability combos. Every turn matters, and every unit can swing the match.

title: Sanrio Characters Smash Festa!
description: All your favorite Sanrio characters come together in a fast-paced action sports game that mixes tennis-style rallies with hockey-like speed. Easy to pick up and play, but use stage gimmicks and character abilities to enjoy deeper, more strategic matches!

title: Vlare
description: A supernova, a broken telescope, Lum, and a night full of strange encounters and painful memories. Join Eli on a short, emotional point-and-click journey through the city.

title: Zàijiàn Duàn Dāo
description: The ancient-style suspense and reasoning AVG "Goodbye, Broken Blade" - In an isolated mountain villa, a series of terrifying murders occur one after another. Only through meticulous investigation and meticulous reasoning can a clear right and wrong be determined and justice be restored. However, beneath the truth that is gradually surfacing, there seem to be undercurrents at play

title: Jesus Take The Wheel
description: Online co-op chaos fest, where one player steers the car with limited visibility, while the other player accelerates and brakes. And that’s it. Coordinate perfectly or crash spectacularly. Friendship survival is optional.

title: Gravity Shooter
description:
Control the ball with gravity, destroy approaching enemies, and survive the onslaught!
Gravity Shooter is a sci-fi shooter that incorporates Bullet Heaven elements.

- A fresh shooter experience with gravity manipulation! -
Unlike typical shooting games, your main weapon is a "ball".
Operate the ball using the gravity generation device, "Gravity Shield".
Freely manipulate this ball to destroy enemies, collect items, and obtain further weapons and skills!

- Fight using a wide variety of weapons and skills! -
Level up by acquiring items or obtain equipment capsules to gain powerful weapons and skills.
Combine a wide variety of weapons and skills to survive the ever-intensifying enemy onslaught!

- Conquer diverse stages and enemies! -
Unique stages are available in this game, each with its own characteristic enemies and bosses.
Conquer all stages and defeat the formidable enemies you have yet to see!

title: Cozy Cats Fit
description: A fun cat puzzle game, with music and adorable cats keeping you company.

title: Run Shiba Run!
description: Goma the dog has escaped from their owner’s leash and is running around the park without restraint to eat as many biscuits as they can. Help them fill their stomach before time runs out or choose to explore the park on your terms.

title: Octopticom 3D
description: Octopticom 3D is a major upgrade to your favorite open-ended puzzle programming game about designing and optimizing optical computing devices. Featuring 3D graphics and gameplay, refined ui, rewritten simulation, all original levels and components plus new additions, histograms and more.

title: Sujeto 124: El Hombre de Traje
description: Daniel Arias heads towards a mysterious house that his company bought, investigate the place and solve the puzzles that you will find to discover the terrible truth.

title: The Week With Grugles
description: A Brand New Horror Attraction Is Now Under Your Watch! You are the security guard, and you must use your cameras and close the doors to keep any unexpected guests out of your office!

title: The Week With Grugles 2
description: Grugles Is Back! Make Sure He Doesn't Go Anywhere... Use the cameras and door to see if there are any intruders. But be careful, your power is limited!

title: Brute Battles
description: Fight against other players in this medieval auto-battler! Customize your brute with stats, 45+ traits, pets, and randomly generated weapons. Will you be at the top of the leaderboards?

title: Flutter
description:
Mike's got something important he has to do.

A short experimental narrative, around 10 minutes long.

title: Windwalkers: Below the Storm
description: Lead high-risk surface rescue operations across a storm-scarred Earth. Power your rover, tools, and modular pack with limited energy resources as you recover survivors, salvage critical supplies, and help reclaim the world above.

title: Many Mini Things
description:
Are you ready for bite-sized games and wacky humor, all at the swipe of your hand?

Many Mini Things is a game about just that: many little capsule toys that you win by completing many mini games. Using the motion control capabilities of the Leap Motion controller, you have to move, grab, swipe, and more to complete the series of quick challenges. You’ll experience amazing success – or hilarious failure.

title: Sportia
description: A multi-sport arcade game where you scout athletes in a living hub city, build your roster, and compete in fast, skill-driven matches across different sports — tackles, dashes, and game-changing specials included.

title: Rogue Drone
description:
Rogue Drone is a top-down sci-fi strategy game that blends tower defense, base building, and resource management into a single survival loop.

Gather resources and expand your outpost during the day, then defend it against escalating waves of hostile drones at night. Build and optimize your base layout, manage energy distribution, and deploy defensive systems to withstand increasingly dangerous attacks.

Harvest crystal resources, refine them into higher tiers, and unlock new technologies to strengthen your defenses. Every decision shapes your long-term survival as enemy waves grow in complexity and intensity.

With a focus on planning, automation, and deterministic combat, Rogue Drone challenges players to design efficient systems that can survive without direct control when the night begins.

title: Echoes Runner
description: Echoes Runner is a 2D Platformer where you place memories of your past self called Echoes. They act as a platform that you can stand on to reach higher levels and cross bigger gaps. Try to beat the levels as fast as possible and find the hidden items to customize your Runner!

title: Astra: Ardent Show
description: Astra: Ardent Show is an adult visual novel about a charming but rebellious furry fox princess who escaped her kingdom in search of freedom. Uncover the secrets of the past, meet the island's unusual inhabitants, and make a choice that will determine the fate of the naughty princess.

title: Reclaim ! Azhe-giiwewining
description: Embark on an adventure where every word brings you closer to home! As Miskwaa, forge a path through a forest teaming with spirits, stories, and intricate puzzles inspired by Ojibwe culture and language in this all-new point and click adventure.

title: Trick-or-Treat Adventure!
description: A nostalgic Halloween retro point-&-click adventure game. You must help Little Johnny put a Halloween costume together, go trick-or-treating for all the candies, and defeat the forces of evil!

title: Ausencia de Color
description: A short game about how excitement is seen with colors inside a videogame.

title: Sísifo va lentin
description: A game about pushing a rock climbing a mountain.

title: Riftella
description: Use a variety of mechanical weapons and magical spells to defeat enemies in a dying world stuck in endless looped time in this 2.5D Action Roguelite game.

title: The toilet zone
description: A game about friends, evil and destiny.

title: Akuma Rise
description: A story-driven fantasy JRPG set in the demon realm of Adribune. Follow Kaine, a memory-lost demon, as he joins three demon princesses to battle invading heroes, uncover his past, and save the Shadow Realm through classic turn-based RPG combat.

title: Mushi no Me Matsuri
description:
Nijoukubou and her best friend Sanbara travel to a village found at the very center of Japan to unravel its myths and legends that all focus on insects.

But they both get dragged in a battle royal between 9 people and the insects within them.

Armed with a power that can only allow her to run away, Nijoukubou tries to survive during this game of death.

title: Before You Disappear
description: A visual novel game where you spend an exciting school life in an abandoned school with ghost girls who have regrets and cannot rest in peace.

title: Koyamachou Watch Repair Shop
description: In the corner of an aging arcade lies a watch repair shop. Suddenly thrust into taking over ownership of the shop, as you learn the craft of watch repair you'll deepen your relationship with the customers and people of the arcade. Going over the notes of the prior owner, the old days of the store and area will come back to life.

title: Cuttlebone
description: Shu and his childhood friend Inami take a trip to the beach in the look for cuttlebone on a sunny summer day.

title: Winning Post 10 2026
description: Winning Post is a horse racing video game developed and published by Koei, released in 1993 for PC-98, FM-Towns, Mega-CD, Super Nintendo, and X68000. It was also released for the 3DO. It is part of the Winning Post series.

title: One Last Hand
description: Poker meets Battle Royale in One Last Hand, a 2-6 players chaotic party game where poker gets deadly! Forget fair play: attack your rivals with powerful hands, fight for better cards in secret auctions, and bend the rules with powerful relics in thrilling online multiplayer matches.

title: Nusutto Kouza
description:
A short fantasy RPG about Letto, prince of the Kingdom of Donapart, who dreams of becoming a thief. After the kingdom is destroyed by the Gort Empire, he and his retainer Asa travel to Mist, a city of thieves, where Letto takes a course to become one. However, the city soon comes under threat from the empire. Players can also pickpocket most characters to obtain items and money, though each character can only be pickpocketed a limited number of times.

It won the Gold Award at the May 2001 Internet Contest Park.

title: TanTan Teo
description: Spinoff Rhythm game based on the FinFin virtual pet program.

title: Megaris
description: The core is simple and satisfying: rotate, drop, clear. But the expanding grid changes everything. Strategies that worked five minutes ago fall apart when you're suddenly dealing with 30 columns. Adapting on the fly is the whole game.

title: Swans in the Wallow
description: Swans in the Wallow is a retro-horror-mystery-adventure-game with RPG elements in insane 16 colors!!

title: Blue Horizon: Hibiscus, and the Loved Garden Paths of Raj Rivera
Shin Sangoku Musou 4 Special
description:
Shin Sangoku musou 4 Special is a singleplayer and multiplayer third-person hack and slash game developed by Omega Force and published by Koei and CNEC. It is a part of the Dynasty Warriors franchise within the larger Warriors series.

It was released as a combination of the main game with its expansion pack for Xbox 360 in Japan on December 22, 2005, in which it features better graphics and high-definition display. The PC version however, did not featured high-definition display but still retain the graphic quality of Xbox 360 version, was released in Japan and Taiwan region on June 22, 2006, and in China on November 5, 2008. There was no English version released.

title: Crystal Vein
description: The "Crystallization" a disease where crystalline veins course through the body, eventually encasing it entirely in crystals. A girl, afflicted by this illness, embarks on a journey to find a place of salvation. A 2D action adventure game about loss and coming of age.

title: BubbleBack: The Story of Forward to the Past 2
description: The long awaited sequel to Forward to the Past, featuring music by the award winning Lee Bee!

title: Nemixar
description:
Explore, Compete, and Create in a Digital Universe Beyond Boundaries with Nemixar!

Ready to discover a revolutionary entertainment platform that transcends traditional gaming boundaries? Nemixar delivers a unique digital ecosystem where video games and social networking converge to create something entirely new, accessible directly from the client, browser, or mobile app (iOS & Android).

Nemixar is more than a gaming platform. It's a digital playground where your avatar becomes your gateway to endless possibilities:

Explore Meticulously Crafted 3D Worlds: From realistic environments to sci-fi landscapes, fantasy realms, and dystopian settings. Each world offers a distinct atmosphere and interactive elements waiting to be discovered.

Connect & Compete: Form meaningful connections with players worldwide while participating in thrilling competitions and collaborative challenges.

Attend Virtual Events: Experience concerts, parties, and exclusive gatherings that blur the line between digital and physical entertainment.

title: Come Again, Chachii?
description: Unscramble letters in this word-puzzle game about unemployed extra-terrestrials. Manipulate the environment and decipher clues to make them make sense and land the job.

title: Castle Away
description:
The realm’s surface is cursed by demons. While you are exploring, you discover some sort of crown. As you pick it up, the ground begins to tremble and the surface starts to rise. You find yourself on a massive, floating keep...

Castle Away is a roguelite autobattle castle builder, where you scavenge for goods, slay monsters, and enhance your keep. Adapt your castle's layout to the materials you find and the enemies you face. Try a new build every run!

Features:

Deep Customisation: Find 50 different Structures with 3 upgrade tiers, 30 Banner types and 30 different Boons, all with unique rules to build killer synergies.

Challenging Enemies: Face off against 20 Monsters and 5 massive Demon Bosses.

Encounter Variety: Discover Shops, Henchmen, Shamans, Towns, Cities and more.

5 Distinct Realms: Navigate through five worlds to find all Ancient Seals.

Roguelike Replayability: Random encounters, multiple endings, and procedural loot ensure fresh runs.

title: CliveWareGold
description: A standalone lore drop from the world of Clive is a Good Guy - free, weird, and packed with unstable secrets.

title: Word Charades
description: Single-player arcade-style word puzzle with quick-fire rounds, escalating difficulty, and a campaign-style Road to Scholar mode. Unlock tougher clues, chase high scores, enjoy rotating global holiday events, share the guessing with friends, and keep things fresh with original soundscapes.

title: After the Stream Went Dark
description: Step into the world of Nyx, a VTuber whose online persona begins to blur with something far more unsettling. After the Stream Went Dark is a short psychological horror visual novel exploring identity, self-perception, and the fragile boundary between performance and reality.

title: Team Principal: A Racing Manager
description: A deep yet accessible motorsport management sandbox inspired by the 1990s games of this genre. Manage teams, drivers, finances, engines, and regulations in a fully customizable, ever-changing world where no two seasons play out the same.

title: Purr Bricks
description: Smash through over 100 brick-packed levels in this fast-paced arcade brick breaker! Collect wild powerups, dodge chaotic curses, and build up FURY to unleash devastating board-clearing strikes. Easy to play, hard to master, and packed with mayhem.

title: Rebellious Takeover
description: Rebellious Takeover is a cyberpunk/sci-fi 3D Beat-'Em-Up & Visual Novel hybrid about taking down an evil corporation, Veritas Industries. Join Deren Kael and his chaotic found family as they fight the surveillance state - and hack, slash, and banter their way through the corporate-owned island city of Nexon. Reclaim what was lost. Reclaim Nexon.

title: Minus Nine
description: Secure the vaccine and escape the infested facility! Battle your way from B9 to the surface rescue chopper in this isometric roguelite shooter. Restore power, upgrade your gear with Bio-Samples, and protect humanity's last hope against endless waves of the infected.

title: Mystologia: The Witch & the Noisy Forest
description: Survive waves of relentless bullets and defeat your enemies. Can you resolve this incident in peace and find the colleague you’ve been searching for?

title: Dreams Stories Online
description: Dreams Stories Online is an indie MMORPG where you return from death ️ not as someone who has already triumphed, but as someone who still dreams. Walk through a persistent, wounded, and hostile world, guided by the hope of a great restoration.

title: Gorilla Simulator
description: Gorilla Simulator - Play with other gorillas, explore the map, participate in random events, collect bananas, hats and climb the mountain to collect Pineapple!

title: Dream of YukiHana
description: A fan-made bullet hell shooting game featuring "Hololive 5th Generation" as the main characters, with "Yukihana Lamy" at the center of the story.

title: Hunter: The Reckoning - Deathwish
description:
Vampires, Werewolves, Witches. What if I told you that the things that go bump in the night are real? What if I told you that you could see them?

Awaken to the truth you’re now a Hunter. Build your character, select skills, and work with a team of allies to investigate the monsters hidden in plain sight, to find their lairs, and to eradicate them. All the while, investigating a story that drags up memories from your past, ones that could change how you see the future.

Welcome to the World of Darkness.

title: Ai Kiss FD: Nanase After
description: Ai Kiss 3's after-story for Nanase.

title: Serious Sam: Shatterverse
description: Serious Sam: Shatterverse is a co-op roguelite FPS for 1 - 5 players. Blast through shifting universes, stack wild boons, bend the rules with run modifiers, and hunt Mental's deadliest forces. Fall fast. Come back louder.

title: Alien Deathstorm
description: Explore a devastated off-world colony that is ravaged by a cataclysmic mega-storm and overrun by bloodthirsty aliens in Alien Deathstorm, the new sci-fi action horror FPS from Rebellion.

title: Bluey's Happy Snaps
description:
Explore Bluey’s world like never before in Bluey's Happy Snaps!

Join Bluey and her family in a new photo-powered adventure game. Discover familiar locations, play with loads of toys, and use Bluey's camera to capture and keep all your favorite moments.

title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Cost of Hope
description: The first major expansion for Heart of Chornobyl coming this summer, including a huge new storyline that can take dozens of hours to complete, two new regions, new and returning characters, and much more.

title: Moosa: Dirty Fate
description:
MOOSA: Dirty Fate is a dark action game inspired by Korean history. "MOOSA" meaning is a person who has mastered martial arts and works in that field.

MOOSA: Dirty Fate is an action game based on the story of MOOSAs' revenge, responsibility, and ambition, centered on 17th-century Korea.

Face terrifying monsters, uncover the truth behind a cursed fate, and fight to save your people.

title: Tiles of War
description:
Tiles of War is a turn-based tactics game where players fight for control of a map by capturing territories and defeating enemy units. Each tile on the map can be captured to become part of your territories, and more territories means more money, and more money means better troops to fight your enemies with.

With 18 different commanders of 3 different factions, each faction with their own campaign, you will face challenging battles in a variety of scenarios. And if that's not enough, and you want to prove the world, you are the best, then the competitive multiplayer mode, with an elo ranking system awaits you.

title: Vaunted
description: The score of a lifetime hangs in the balance – can three cut-throat criminals look past their differences to pull it off? A story of bullets, bravado, and brazen lies unfolds across a galaxy of treasure hunters and crime syndicates in this sci-fi tactical RPG.

title: Natsuyume Nagisa
description:
The story takes place on a reclaimed island, where sunflowers are planted all over, beautiful butterflies fly around and stray penguins roam around.

Nagisa is a boy who can't remember his past. One day, he meets some girls. As the story goes, he gradually finds an important person deep inside his memory and true himself. The summer you were there. The summer you weren't there. The summer with you. Through various events with the girls, what kind of memory will he reach?

title: Artificial Detective
description: Artificial Detective is a third-person action-adventure where you step into the shoes of a robodetective in a dystopian city overrun by rogue robots. Lead your underdog team of a military robodog and a human girl, as you fight, hack, and outsmart deadly machines to uncover why humans are gone.

title: Golf Around 2
description: It's time to Golf Around... 2! Golf madness for up to 16 players! Tactically use grenades, weapons, and perks to navigate around crazy maps. Level up and trick out your character. Play custom maps!

title: Forward to the Past
description:
Owing to a misunderstanding relating to the metric system or something, on the first test run Dave & Nate get sucked into the time vortex.

For reasons unknown the only thing that will save the father & son team is collecting 42 MacGuffinanium crystals.

title: One Button Games 5-in-1 Vol. 5
description:
All 5 games are fast-paced and controlled with a single button.

R Wheel Try to survive inside a spinning wheel with spikes. Press a button to jump and hold a button to stay in the air longer. But your jumps release a wave that spawns the spikes. Collect bonus items to release a wave that clears the spikes and score points by clearing them. The game is over when you hit the spikes.

Divarr Your goal is to knock the enemy bombs down and avoid hitting your allies. Press a button to fire and press it again to split your shot in two that will fly in two perpendicular directions each. You can split the shots up to 16 per screen. The game is over when you hit an ally or any of the bombs reaches the ground.

Throw M You are flying on a balloon which is constantly going up and down. There are enemies to the left of you firing darts at you and trying to pop your balloon. Hold a button to aim and release it to throw a projectile at them to knock them off and destroy their darts. The game is over when an enemy dart hits your balloon.

Wiper You are in charge of a wiper and your goal is to clean the windscreen from all the raindrops. The wiper is swinging from side to side and you can swing it from a highlighted side by pressing a button. The game is over when any raindrop reaches the bottom of the screen.

D Missile Your goal is to launch missiles and shoot down enemy projectiles falling from the top. Press a button to launch a missile, you can launch up to 3 missiles at a time. Hold a button to make the launched missiles rotate clockwise. The game is over when any of the enemy projectiles hits the ground.

title: Etrange Overlord: Deluxe Edition
description:
Now you can have your sweets and eat them, too! The Deluxe Edition includes plenty to sink your teeth into, including:

- Etrange Overlord
- Etrange Overlord - Mini Art Book
- Art of Étrange: From Hell to Heaven
- Etrange Overlord - DE Soundtrack
- Étrange Encore LE Original Soundtrack

title: Beautiful Sakura: Volleyball Club 2
description: After walking away from volleyball, Kaito returns to the court with a burning desire to chase his dream once more. This time, he is serious about becoming a professional player.

title: LRDZ: Le roi des Zosties
description:
A colorful score attack game, combining elements of match-3 and FPS. The player must stay on top of the mountain and push down enemies, without being overwhelmed.

Pushing three enemies of the same type will start a combo, increasing the score multiplier and unlocking the player's power.

The game plays in short, fast-paced sessions, and offers three difficulty levels for newer and more experienced gamers.

title: Cool Story Bro!
description: Cool Story Bro! is a chaotic 2 - 4 player party game where you write short stories based on 4 random words. Vote for the most creative masterpiece, sabotage your friends with items, survive unexpected game - changing events… and if you really hate someone’s story? Just... Blow. Them. Up!

title: Midnight Joy Ride
description:
A late-night horror game where every choice leads to one of 26 endings.
Survive 40 minutes in a strange town while a mysterious man watches your every move.

But a lot can happen in 40 minutes...

You might take a different street. You might try to hide. You might run into someone who could help you or make things worse. The choices you make, the places you go, and the people you interact with can change how the night unfolds.

Every decision matters. Small actions can lead to unexpected consequences.

All you have to do is make it through those 40 minutes unless you find a way to get home faster... Turns out there's a lot more to the place than it first seems.

title: Backrooms: Collision Not Found
description: A 1-4 player co-op horror experience. Navigate hyper-realistic Backrooms levels and liminal spaces, survive unique entities, and uncover the dark mystery behind those levels. Extreme visual fidelity meets psychological dread.

title: Chompers Playhouse: Chapter 1
description: Welcome to Chompers Playhouse, a mascot horror game inspired by Poppy Playtime. Here, you will dive within Playhouse Co. and uncover the truth.

title: Hentai Age Scientist
description: Enjoy a relaxing puzzle journey where each solved level reveals beautiful girl artwork, offering calm visuals, gentle gameplay, no timers, no pressure, and a peaceful experience playable anytime for everyone.

title: Jurassic World Evolution 3: Wetlands
description:
Step into the wetlands and unearth three stunning new dinosaur families and a swampy selection of scenery items with the Jurassic World Evolution 3: Wetlands Pack.

Mesmerise your guests with the fierce Irritator, prowling Austroraptor, and rapid Hypsilophodon, each with their own striking family unit. Build misty waterside enclosures with hundreds of scenery items and thirteen blueprints featuring a boathouse, rusty shacks, and wooden pontoons, all inspired by wetland and bayou locations.

title: Project Lexa
description: Project Lexa is a sci-fi language mystery. Crash-landing on a mysterious planet, you find that everything is written in an alien language. Use your handy translator to decipher unknown glyphs, explore a strange world, and – hopefully – return home.

title: Rackpunk: A Wasteland Hustle
description: RACKPUNK: A Wasteland Hustle is a physics-based, roguelike rack-builder where you battle post-apocalyptic gangs in a deadly game of pool. Fill your rack with wild balls and blow stuff up.

title: AquaBall League
description: The Aquaball League is a fast-paced 2v2 water sport and adventurous multiplayer platformer, where players use the natural abilities of marine champions—dolphin flips, squid ink defense, and octopus tentacle passes—to score big!

title: Cohen 1939
description: "Cohen 1939" is a top-down shooter set in Birmingham, England in 1939. Players take on the role of a woman seeking vengeance for her murdered gangster husband . You will be immersed in classic British gangland scenes of the 1930s.

title: Dino-Might
description: Dino-Might is a 2-4 player party fighting game where you control a tiny-armed t-rex in a fierce battle! Use arcade-inspired movement and power-ups to eliminate opponents, all while avoiding hazards. Easy to pick up, hard to put down, and built for all gamers. Only the best dino will survive!

title: Too Many Captains
description: A chaotic cooperative spaceship simulator where you journey through the unknowns of the expanse to find a home. The ship is crowded and space is limited, so you may be difficult to complete your tasks. Careful to not fly straight into a blackhole or steal from the wrong trade station.

title: Crime Scene Cleaner: Biohazard
description: Step into a world of toxic conspiracies and industrial sabotage in Crime Scene Cleaner: Biohazard. An ambitious fuel baron has unleashed a dangerous “miracle” fuel – Chernoxide – claiming it will revolutionize the American fuel market forever. The substance, however, is highly toxic, and when radical eco-terrorists sabotage the baron’s operations, radioactive chaos spreads across the city. Your job is to clean up the aftermath, stop the contamination, and hide the true dangers of Chernoxide from the public before the truth comes out.

title: Spire of Chaos: Arcana Unleashed
description: Spire of Chaos: Arcana Unleashed is a 3D souls-lite action game where you play as Arxis, a magical girl linked to the Tower, a source of chaotic power and one of the most feared arcana of the Tarot.

title: Nocternum
description: A hellish top-down shooter about a young hero and their dog fighting to save a world overrun by demons, while building a cozy home base for their allies.

title: Lucha Loka
description: Go "LOKO" in this Lucha Libre vs Narco smash up! Team up with your pals and take your country back from the grips of greed and corruption plaguing your nation in this epic hand drawn 2D beat-em-up arcade thrill ride brought to you by Game Over Productions Inc! It's Fiesta Time Amigos!

title: APSudoku
description:
APSudoku is an implementation of the classic puzzle game Sudoku, designed to interface with the Archipelago Randomizer program to earn free hints for ongoing randomizer games via completing Sudoku puzzles.

Puzzle solving itself is single-player, though some features can interact with other players connected to the same Archipelago room, such as the "Death Link" feature, which can clear your grid when another player dies- or kill another player in whatever game they are playing when you submit an incorrect puzzle solution.

title: Geometry Attack
description: Geometry Attack is a neon-drenched retro arcade shooter inspired by classics like Geometry Wars. Blast through waves of shapes in VR, on your Steam Deck, or in 2D. Easy to pick up, hard to put down, and perfectly tuned for seated recliner play. Chase the high score from another dimension!

title: Potted Pets
description: Potted Pets is a cozy farming and pet simulator, with an adorable cast of living plant pots. Spend time cultivating a personal garden while growing a personal relationship with your collection of “Potted Pets!” Sit down for a relaxing, customizable experience that brightens up your busy day!

title: SeverSoul Xookeeper
description: Keep the entities fed, pacified and contained every night within a dark decaying facility. Can you survive each shift in this intense point & click horror?

title: Hotel Renovator Simulator
description: Your hotel. Your design. Your rules.

title: The 1% Club World Challenge
description: Do you have what it takes to answer a question only 1% of people get right? Test your brainpower and compete against players worldwide!

title: BK Simulator
description: A simple Idle game, designed specifically for use with the Archipelago Randomizer program. Walk to 'BK' to get lunch, and find random items; either for yourself (ex. to help you walk faster), or for others in your randomizer room (to help them with whatever game they are playing).

title: Miles Between Us
description: Collect stuff and scrapbook in this heartwarming indie game! Set off on a road trip and learn more about your older brother as you go to different locations together. Did we also mention that you’re a raccoon?

title: Oh Apollo!
description: Fulfill your role as the priestess of Apollo's oracle in Delphi and bring the temple back to glory in this cozy narrative management game!

title: Ragnarök Protocol
description: A curse has befallen Midgard, transforming the Realm into a video game. It is up to Grin and his friend Sunny to find Allfather Odin and reverse the curse before it spreads to the other realms.

title: LoCoMo
description: LoCoMo is a relaxing sandbox village builder where tiny villagers live, travel, and react inside the cozy world you create. Build and grow living communities connected by the routes and railways you design.

title: 4 Penny Coffins
description: In 4 Penny Coffins, up to 8 players hunt a hidden murderer through lies, shifting alibis, and hard evidence in our online multiplayer mode. This social investigation game also includes a solo mode for those brave enough to face the fog alone.

title: My Summer Cottage
description: Experience the life of an average Finn in My Summer Cottage. After losing your job, you retreat to your cottage to indulge in booze, hobbies, and questionable activities—all while dodging responsibility and embracing the chaos around you.

title: Panoptic II
