description: Hunt up to 4 of your friends as the godlike Overseer in this tense online, asymmetric VR game. Unleash your new abilities to stamp out the rebellion. Or, as the tiny but crafty Challengers, cooperate, cause mayhem and pull off daring heists as you undermine the power of your oppressive opponent!

title: Infinity Nikki: The Forest Need Not Listen
description:
Tick-tock, tick-tock, tick-tock—
We're late! We're late! For a very important date...
Follow its rules, obey its laws,
How many times must we live this tale? Trapped inside the forest...
Noise! Shouts! Laughter! Cries!
Someone refuses to close their eyes.
Shh—listen... it's her.

title: Snotrocket
description: SNOTROCKET is a retro co-op space game where you and your friends are violently ill and racing to find a cure before the ship explodes. Expect flying snot, projectile vomit, and catastrophic bowel failure at every turn.

title: Echobreaker
description: A lightning-fast precision speedrunner where you pilot an armoured rig that can manipulate time itself. Every second matters, and going faster means risking everything.

title: Where in America is Carmen Sandiego?: The Great Amtrak Train Adventure
description: Where in America is Carmen Sandiego?: The Great Amtrak Train Adventure is a 1998 video game and special edition of Brøderbund's 1996 educational game Where in the World Is Carmen Sandiego?. It was developed by Brøderbund as part of a co-marketing initiative with the American passenger railroad service Amtrak.

title: HiroBot: Clean & Restore
description: HiroBot: Clean & Restore is a relaxing single-player game you can enjoy at your own pace. Clean up dirt, dispose of trash, and restore objects. Reach every nook and cranny with your jetpack, and experience the satisfaction of bringing grimy areas back to life!

title: Thunder Tank: Iron Shield
description: A relaxing strategy idle shooter that blends bullet hell action with backpack-like inventory management. Pilot your vehicle through a desolate, post-modern world, conquer 20 difficulty levels, collect diverse weapons, and build the ultimate firepower lineup to survive the wasteland.

title: Undead Tide: Light's Defense
description: Relaxed strategic bullet hell survival, defending against endless undead legions! A roguelite bullet hell shooter that blends hero development, talent builds, and weapon combinations, supporting multiple playstyles and strategies!

title: Doom Survivor: Horde Rush
description: Bullet hell meets Survivor-like Roguelite! Battle endless zombie hordes as unique heroes. Combine talent trees with 11 weapons (dragon guns, laser rifles) and gear (masks/wings) for explosive fire, lightning, or summon builds. Unlock heroes, master dodge, and dominate the apocalypse!

title: Maruchi Akindo
description: Educational adventure game on which players take on the role of a young merchant who works part-time jobs across a fully explorable 3D town, from a takoyaki stand and cake shop to a butcher and antique dealer. Each job challenges the player with a set of arithmetic problems, blending math practice into a lighthearted story about becoming the best merchant.

title: The Secret Story 1996
description: What begins as a quiet night in an old hotel soon turns into a desperate fight for survival. As midnight approaches, Serena must uncover the truth, face her fears, and decide which path to take.

title: Stickerino
description: Go wild with stickers on your cards to break all the limits and hit totally sky-high scores! Collect snacks and Monstraks, flex your style, and crush the Sticker Wizard’s challenges!

title: Steamy Livestreams with My Girlfriend
description: You and Umi are the office couple all of your coworkers are jealous about. Now that she has to plan for her career, she opens up to you about a desire she has hidden deep within her heart. In order to fulfill her dream, you must start a steamy stream of your passion as a couple.

title: Blue Reflection Quartet
description: Cosmos converge, into one light. The emotional stories of magical Reflectors and the bonds they form. The entire BLUE REFLECTION series combined into one!

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Vegetables 2
description:
Puzzles of Vegetables!

Content: 30 Puzzles in 4 levels of difficulty.

title: HSNU Academy 79th Anniversary
description: "HSNU Academy 79th Anniversary" is a dark, narrative puzzle game set at HSNU. Explore the campus via chat to uncover secrets and reach multiple endings. This 1-hour experience unlocks Free Mode upon completion. Stay tuned for new games in future celebrations!

title: CPU Invaders: Movie Attack
description: A sequel to the Steam Awards finalist top-down shooter. Step into classic movie worlds inside your hard drive and become the hero who destroys the alien virus spreading through the digital realm. It has evolved — and it’s binge-watching your files.

title: Goddess Scroll: Brave Star
description: The story begins in a castle occupied by demons.The goddesses are imprisoned here...Our protagonist, PaiPai, wakes up in the demons' prison.She needs to escape from here and end the demons' control over the goddesses!

title: To the Stars Idle
description: To the Stars Idle is a text-based incremental game about developing your primitive tribe to type-3 galactic civilization. Take control of production, research and battles to advance through the ages and achieve total space domination.

title: There Is No Escape
description: There is no Escape is a storyless 2D side-scrolling puzzle platformer, it was inspired by early to late 2000's flash games of a similar nature. Jump, fail, repeat! Experience the nostalgia of the classic platforming genre.

title: Threadline
description: A clean, rhythm‑infused precision runner where you weave through shifting obstacles with focus and flow. Threadline rewards instinct, timing, and mastery, delivering short, intense runs that pull you into a calm, satisfying state of momentum.

title: Gods of Angling
description: Gods of Angling is a "Tamagotchi-like" Idle Fishing RPG! Create your hero from one of 180 unique options and see if they can ascend from a reel rookie to a God.

title: Angle
description: ANGLE is a psychological horror experience that challenges the boundaries of perception. Developed by C.O.T.E Technology & Development Studios, the game plunges players into a fractured reality where every corner hides a distorted truth. With its atmospheric storytelling and high-tension gameplay, ANGLE focuses on environmental storytelling and the thin line between sanity and fear. Survive the unseen, question your surroundings, and discover what lies at the wrong angle.

title: Celestial Fragments
description: Command your evolving robot army in this turn-based strategy. Collect resources, construct bases, control units and conquer asteroids throughout your journey as you become a critical element in the interplanetary power struggle against the overwhelming Jovian Republic.

title: Subconsciousism
description:
A troubled person has lost access to the center of themself and to linear time. Now they drift through a fractured state where dreams, memories, and reality bleed together into a chaotic, surreal experience.

Subconsciousism is a story-first exploratory game inspired by LSD: Dream Emulator.

title: Marsh Into the New Dimension
description: Delve into a new adventure... and some new dimensions. Marsh Into the New Dimension is a thrilling 3D boss-rush platformer adventure game travelling through brand new worlds and meeting new friends to help you save the universe from unwanted destruction.

title: The Game That Was Stolen From Me at Indiecade2019
Blue Reflection Ray
description:
A condensed game adaptation of the Blue Reflection Ray's anime included in the Blue Reflection Quartet bundle.

Follow Hiori and Ruka as they explore the Common while re-experiencing their memories on their way to confront a girl trying to recreate the world. New short stories expand on the anime’s story, and a new prologue and epilogue connect this entry to the other works in the series.

title: Pick Three!!!
description: The game where you pick from three! Choose your weapon ball and fight others in unstable best-of-3 matches, upgrade your stats, and bounce around the arena until you finally claim victory. Get popular and have your fans assist you, and befriend the Ref to maximize your odds.

title: Onii-chan Continue!: Secret Love With Yuri
description: Yuri lives with her big brother, Hayato. Though she looks like a model student in public, in reality she likes to laze around at home and play video games. Though they sometimes argue, she loves her big brother. As Hayato accepts another game challenge from Yuri, so begins his trouble-filled days...

title: Missing Texture
description: Missing Texture is a psychological horror experience told in chapters. Download the free Launcher and access all main chapters at no cost. The full story expands through additional games.

title: Hypnaborea
description: You woke up on a mysterious island today...

title: Silver State
description:
A noisy, pixellated vampire platformer set in the Nevada desert.

When Ysabel, a vampire living in Reno, finds her brother dead with a strange crucifix-like structure attached to him, she finds herself compelled to take revenge on the humans that murdered him.

title: League of Legends: 2026 Season One - For Demacia
description: League of Legends "For Demacia" is the first thematic season of 2026, launching January 8, 2026, with a focus on the militaristic kingdom of Demacia. The season features a Demacia-themed Summoner’s Rift map, the "Demacia Rising" in-client narrative meta-game, and a visual update for Shyvana in Act II

title: Harem Fantasy
description: Harem Fantasy is a visual novel in which you become a court healer in the Imperial Harem, populated with enchanting beauties and full of deadly intrigues. Treat, seduce, untwine the conspiracies and survive among passion and betrayal in the heart of the Celestial Empire.

title: Cabal 13
description: Welcome to Cabal 13 — an asynchronous roguelike auto-battler built around hero RPG progression! Every run is a fresh adventure, every choice shapes victory or defeat. Assemble your unique squad, clash with rivals on dynamic battlefields, and dive into deep, hero-focused roguelike auto-battler fun.

title: Pro Cycling Manager 26
description: Dive into the heart of cycling management with an ever more realistic simulation. From recruitment and staff, to season planning and race strategy, make every decision and lead your team to victory in the sport’s biggest competitions.

title: Tour de France 2026
description: Take on the best international cyclists with one goal in mind: winning the 2026 Tour de France. Conquer legendary mountain passes, launch your sprints at the perfect moment and emerge triumphant on the Champs-Élysées wearing the Yellow Jersey.

title: Gothic Steel
description: Gothic Steel is a grimdark, retro, survivor-like, wave shooter. Command a heavily armed tank against the horde, assemble your crew, and forge an unstoppable war machine.

title: Linerunner
description: A minimalist time trial game. Race down the straights, weave through the turns, and see if you have what it takes to be a world champion.

title: Praise To The Moon
description: It is a Metroidvania, based on Momodora, Castlevania, and Souls-Like type games, with ARPG systems and rings that have unique advantages and abilities, and a pact system where each pact has its own statistic that can help or harm you.

title: A Dialect for Two
description: A Dialect for Two is a visual novel where two androids try to discover the meaning of love and sex for themselves. They aim to learn how to articulate their desires, and understand which ones are truly theirs.

title: The Harbinger of the Deep
description: Destroy the frustrations of other Beings and befriend them, or ignore them and slay them all instead! Shoot your actions and decide the fate of this submerged world in The Harbinger of the Deep!

title: Arka Kraya
description: ARKA KRAYA is a point-and-click adventure game where you have to solve the mystery of a missing professor. Use your magic powers of words and emotions to explore the forest and discover the secrets of the abandoned temple.Choose your actions carefully, they have a big impact on the story

title: Arknights: Endfield - Update 1.1 - Old Deep Water Dies, by Rising Tide It is Denied
description:
Version 1.1 of Arknights: Endfield, which includes:
• New Operators: Tangtang and Rossi
• New Main Story Quest
• New events
• ...and more!

title: Bommy
description: Bunnies go BOOM. Rebuild. Repeat.

title: Specter Hideout
description: Specter Hideout is a top-down, asymmetrical multiplayer experience for 2 to 5 players. It pits a team of Hunters against one invisible Specter. Whether you are hunting the specter or "haunting the living", every match is a game of cat-and-mouse where one wrong move means the end.

title: Baldr Sky Dive2: Recordare
description: A censored port of Baldr Sky Dive2 bundled with the first game in the international release.

title: Teams War
description: Teams War is a multiplayer online shooter with PvP/PvE modes, focused on quick-start matches and tactical team battles with progression and customization.

title: The Road
description: A co-op horror + driving game for up to 5 players. Explore an anomaly-ridden world, loot buildings for valuables, and drive for your life to escape the creatures that lurk.

title: Expelled from Paradise: The Stellar Angel
description: A brand-new sequel depicting the aftermath of the theatrical anime Expelled from Paradise. The story of Angela and Dingo begins to move once more. This is a full-scale visual novel that weaves a grand science-fiction vision through evocative text and immersive direction.

title: Crimson Desert: Deluxe Edition
description:
Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure game set in the beautiful yet brutal continent of Pywel. Embark on a journey as the Greymane Kliff and restore what has been lost. Explore uncharted lands, fight against threats that stand in your way, and discover the wonders the world has in store.

A plentiful adventure with the Deluxe Pack!
Enjoy a diverse adventure with more armor, horse tack, and cosmetics for Kliff!

[Deluxe Pack]
● Kairos Plate Helm
● Kairos Plate Gloves
● Kairos Plate Boots
● Kairos Cloak
● Kairos Plate Armor
● Balgran Shield
● Exclaire Champron
● Exclaire Barding
● Exclaire Saddle
● Exclaire Stirrups

title: Blue Reflection: Special Event
description:
New events for all characters, including Yuzu and Lime, will be added.
A new resort facility will be added to Hoshinomiya.
This is a new wonderful spot for after school outing.

title: Deep Diver
description: The player controls a treasure-hunting diver exploring the randomly generated depths of the ocean. Their goal is to collect treasures, artifacts, and marine life, upgrade their equipment, and discover new, increasingly dangerous and mysterious locations.

title: Dungeon Rise
description: The kingdom has fallen to the invasion of a malevolent deity, and a blessed knight awakens in the castle’s corrupted bowels with one purpose: to restore its lost light. Carve your way upward using the faint Blessing to find armaments and relics, refining your tactics run after run.

title: Escape from Wormwood
description: Escape from Wormwood is a horror visual novel where you get cut up and eaten by mouse cultists.

title: Blades of Crossed Hearts
description: A dramatic hack and slash character action game about color coded vampires who fight through hell. Inspired by Melty Blood and Devil May Cry

title: Blue Reflection: Seasons Pass
description:
The Season Pass for Blue Reflection contains all the available DLCs.

Contents included:

- Blue Reflection: Sailor Swimsuits Complete Set
- Blue Reflection: Arland Maid Costume for Yuzu
- Blue Reflection: Arland Maid Costume for Lime
- Blue Reflection: Summer Outing Complete Set
- Blue Reflection: Bath Towels Complete Set
- Blue Reflection: Vacation Style Complete Set
- Blue Reflection: Special Event

title: Blue Reflection: Second Light Additional Map - Atelier Ryza Collab Dungeon
description:
One day, the Heartscape of someone unknown to Ao and the girls suddenly appears before them.
Nervous, yet curious, the girls venture inside, only to discover the scattered memories of a certain female alchemist.
By exploring her memories, just what can Ao and the girls gain...?

title: Fap Feets
description: Fap Feets is an erotic game in the genre of "Arkanoid", in which you will have to break the cubes and gradually discover really beautiful and hot images.

title: Too Many F*cking Nazis
description: Time traveling Nazis have taken over the world. No one seems to care. Guess it's up to you. Use inventive weapons. Craft unique builds. Kill them all.

title: Megalophobia
description: Megalophobia is an atmospheric, narrative experience driven by your powerless feeling. You cannot fight. You cannot win. You can only hide in the shadows of colossal, impossible entities that have claimed our world, trying to survive in a landscape that shifts with every deafening footstep.

title: Terrorstorm: Ground Zero
description: Terrorstorm is a single-player FPS action-horror game with strong Soulslike DNA. Prepare to engage in visceral, high-stakes combat against dangerous and terrifying foes, uncover dark secrets hidden deep within, and bring down a horrific underground crime ring. Think Resident Evil meets Dark Souls.

title: Joerick
description:
Joerick is 16 years old and lives in the East Zone of São Paulo with his parents and his younger sister, Alice, who is 13.

From the outside, the house looks normal — simple, typical of a working-class neighborhood. But inside, it’s where the weight of the world falls every single day.

Joerick grows up in an environment marked by constant conflict, with a father lost to alcohol and a daily routine shaped by silence, fear, and survival. Even so, he keeps going to school, trying to seem normal, trying not to break in front of others.

Alice is the small light in the house. Quiet, observant, always smiling even without fully understanding everything happening around her.

The story follows Joerick’s daily life — his attempts to endure one more day, the moments when he nearly falls apart, and the small instances where he can still breathe in peace.

title: Verse Unknown
description: In the necklace dimension of Lehr, not all globes are created equal. Venture through surreal worlds in search of a better home for yourself and your sister. Along the way, you might just re-discover history...

title: Crackheads
description: Build junky vehicles, battle your friends with physics-based weapons, and survive absurd co-op challenges in this chaotic multiplayer sandbox.

title: Project Looking Glass
description: 1963. A classified experiment. A grieving mother. A signal that won't stop transmitting. Step through the Looking Glass — a first-person psychological horror told through the static of a Cold War-era apparatus that peers into places mankind was never meant to reach.

title: Feyhearth: the Art of Handling Extraordinary Clientele
All Hail the Heat Death!
description: All Hail the Heat Death is a 4-player isometric black hole shooter about skeletons that don't exist. Play as one of 4 colourful skeletons in this maybe reality as they desperately kill each-other in the newborn cosmos. Bullets that collide create black holes. Black holes that merge create bigger black holes. The biggest black holes end the universe!

title: Fatal Frontier 1869
description:
Fatal Frontier 1869 is a PC survival and prospecting game set in the unforgiving Alaskan wilderness of the 19th century, gaining attention for its unique real-money gold prospecting system.

Step into the boots of a pioneer and venture into dangerous, untamed territory in search of gold with real-world value. Every run is a calculated risk - face deadly wildlife, brutal conditions, and precision-based skill checks to secure your haul.

The deeper you push into the frontier, the richer the rewards - but the greater the danger. Succeed, and all the gold you find is yours to keep.

title: Ferarum
description: Chat with the ever eclectic Jojo in a rinky dink cafe.

title: Wood'N'Destroy
description:
Wood’N’Destroy is an explosive real-time strategy game where you must build your base, manage your resources, and annihilate your enemies in intense tactical battles.

Chop wood, grow your economy, train your army, and prepare to destroy enemy bases before they destroy yours.

Every match is a fight for dominance: strategy, adaptation, and timing will make the difference between victory and destruction.

title: Monobeno: Happy End
description: A censored version of Monobeno: Happy End, sold as a DLC to the all-ages Steam edition of Monobeno.

title: Dimenseum
description: Help out a struggling museum by visiting a few otherworldly places without ripping reality apart.

title: Alex and Der Murder
description: Immerse yourself in the past and experience firsthand the consequences of the decisions made by the most powerful figures in Central Europe. Witness authentically captured events from the lives of these megalomaniacs in a platformer game featuring logic puzzles.

title: Rolling Star: Tomomi Another Story
description: The protagonist of the previous title Tomomi joins the fight in Rolling Star! A new story unfolds with Tomomi as the protagonist. Why did Riko undergo cryosleep? How did Tomomi get here? What's Laurie been up to? Secrets not found in her story will be revealed here.

title: Silly Linguine Cat Simulator Deluxe Online
description: Silly Linguine Cat Simulator Deluxe Online is a clicker game where progression is replaced with gambling, where the goal is simply to collect the rarest silly linguine cats.

title: Elise and the Spellbinding Marionette
description: Elise is a small-town adventurer making a living completing quests posted in the town tavern. During a routine job, she finds a girl collapsed by the side of the road. Not one to leave a person in distress behind, Elise carries the girl back to town.

title: Kintsugi
description: Take a cinematic adventure through the world of Kintsugi as you use different movement abilities to traverse through its magical landscape and save wounded creatures from the Corruption.

title: Fathom's End
description: Fathom’s End is a first-person lighthouse keeper simulation set far out in the Atlantic. Maintain the light, endure the isolation, and keep the station running through long nights, unpredictable weather and scarce supplies.

title: Anvil Survivors
description: A bullet heaven where your best friend is a cat. Fight through hordes to collect weapons, armor, and scrolls. Reach the Anvil, risk it all to upgrade your gear for god-like power, and let your adorable (and sometimes lazy) fluffy companion handle the looting. Chaos, crafting, and kitties!

title: Sexorcism: Lust Confession
description: An explicit card battler where you fight corrupted nuns, strip them in combat, build your deck, strengthen your character, and unlock the hottest scenes as you progress.

title: Roguefort
description: A deeply simulated turn-based open-world roguelike on a vast magical continent. Explore, dungeon crawl, sail, steal, fish, build, spellcraft, become a vampire, and live out your wildest dreams.

title: Tactical Breach Wizards: Special Edition
description: This is the special edition of Tactical Breach Wizards, which adds developer commentary, special outfits for the cast, the full soundtrack, and an early demo version of the game.

title: Shothop
description: Shothop is a violent retro boomer-shooter blending fast-paced movement mechanics with brutal combat. Utilize movement mechanics, cleanse the robot invasion, and restore the portal defense network. Reboot the grid. Survive the shift.

title: The Abandoned Levels
description:
The Abandoned Levels is an intense single-player survival horror where the line between reality and nightmare blurs.
After a series of personal tragedies, you plunge into the eerie Backrooms – an endless labyrinth of dark corridors, decaying rooms, and deadly creatures that can kill you with the slightest mistake.

title: Escape By Spoon
description: Escape by Spoon is a prison escape game with action and digging mechanics, featuring a 1930s rubber hose animation art style.

title: Smashmak
description: Smashmak is a roguelike brawler inspired by Risk Of Rain 2 and PS1 aesthetic, but with a brutal twist: every skill you unlock is tied to your combo counter. Your flow isn’t just for show—it is your power.

title: Oshaberi King! Komyuryoku Shindan Game
description: A game that tests your ad-lib verbal skills using a microphone. You can test your word power with various subjects, such as handling a bank robbery with just the power of words, or becoming a weathercaster and ad-libbing your way through a weather forecast.

title: Evades X
description: Worlds Hardest Multiplayer Precision Game

title: Pavane: See No Evil
description:
Melody Green saw something she shouldn't have.

A music teacher at a local elementary school finds herself in the midst of something bizarre and unexplainable: an abandoned building, a thick fog enveloping the area, and no wi-fi or phone signal to allow her to call for help.

Faced with strange riddles, eerie messages from her past, and something horrible haunting her from within the screens, Melody realizes that someone or something is calling out to her, trying to show her a truth that could shatter her world and turn her life completely upside down.

title: Secret City: London Calling
description: You might think that you know everything about London, but this city holds a lot more secrets than you imagine. The truth is that powerful magic hides different creatures and magical peoples from the eyes of ordinary humans. There is a peace treaty between those peoples, but it is now in danger. Someone is killing residents of Secret City, and everyone is quick to point their fingers at each other. So now it is your job to track down the killer before chaos overtakes London. You’ve been invited to explore a world completely new for you in this hidden-object puzzle adventure full of twists and turns!

title: Dragon Ball: Xenoverse 2 - Future Saga: Chapter 3
description: The third chapter in the FUTURE SAGA series depicts an unprecedented alteration of history! Includes new Playable Characters, a new Extra Mission, new Parallel Quests, Additional Moves, and Costumes!

title: Boulder Baby
description: Remembering your recursive sleeo paralysis episodes from x-mas.

title: Thy Flesh Consumed
description: Fight your way through the snowy cliffside and find your way into the village.

title: Kozeni Mushi
description: A game about rummaging through vending machine change while worrying about social status.

title: Kaporanga
description: Kaporanga is a local and online party game for up to 8 players of all ages, packed with mini-games set across iconic places in Rio de Janeiro. It’s free and accessible! Grab your friends, cousins, even the parrot — and get ready for some wild fun and friendly chaos. Time to Kaporanga!

title: If You Stay
description: Two girls, Mika and Yara, realizing they’ve been outed by their school teacher to their parents and friends, spend their “final date” reconciling through the pain of hiding in the closet while navigating adolescence. Decide for them if they should run away together or ultimately split up.

title: Hanagane Kanade Gram: Chapter 1 - Kozakura Yui
description: The first out of four Hanagane Kanade Gram chapters.

title: Dead Patrol
description:
Prepare for the collapse of civilization in Dead Patrol, an intense and visceral action shooter where every shot counts. In a city consumed by chaos, you take on the role of an elite patrol officer sent into the most dangerous zones to face relentless hordes of the undead and reclaim overrun sectors.
With fast-paced, tactical combat, extremely responsive controls, and a powerful arsenal, Dead Patrol delivers a brutal and straightforward survival experience. Strategic movement, fluid weapon switching, and smart use of the environment are essential to stay alive amid the urban chaos.

title: Hanagane Kanade Gram: Chapter 2 - Hananoka Sumire
description: The second out of four Hanagane Kanade Gram chapters.

title: Hanagane Kanade Gram: Chapter 3 - Hoshiizumi Kotona
description: The third out of four Hanagane Kanade Gram chapters.

title: Hanagane Kanade Gram: Chapter 4 - Ayase Kanade: Saishuushou
description: The fourth and last chapter of Hanagane Kanade Gram.

title: Witherheart
description: Witherheart is a turn-based roguelike deck-building game with grid-based combat. Build your deck, reposition on the battlefield, and make tactical decisions where every card and every step can turn the tide of a fight.

title: Wandsmith
description: Wandsmith is a magical action roguelike with weapons that change every run. You cast spells that you build yourself, with wands that you are continually upgrading and customizing. Fight through castles of enemies in search of stronger foes and greater rewards.

title: 2025: Mosaic Retrospective
description: 2025: Mosaic Retrospective is a picross/minesweeper hybrid featuring a single ENORMOUS puzzle inspired by global news stories from throughout the year.

title: Yuyukana: Under the Starlight
description: This is the debut title of NanaWind. In the downtown core is an old torii. Through this gate, one would find themselves in the resort island of Aoshima, full of trees and sunflowers and surrounded by the emerald green ocean. Akito lives in this lively city and attends Aohi Academy. One day, a new transfer student appeared in his class. This black-haired pretty girl embraced him, proclaiming that she had always wanted to meet him.

title: Kimi no Nisemono ni Koi wo Suru Asterism
description: A paid remake of Kimi no Nisemono ni Koi o Suru with enhanced illustrations and scenarios, with new sub-characters appearing.

title: Kakegae no Nai Kimi he
description: A remake of Boku dake ga Shitteiru, the sequel to Kimi no Nisemono ni Koi o Suru, bundled in with its remake.

title: Mahou Shoujo wo Wasurenai
description: A new short work related to Kimi no Nisemono ni Koi wo Suru ⁂ and bundled with it.

title: Kazoku Gokko
description: A new short work related to Kimi no Nisemono ni Koi wo Suru ⁂ and bundled with it.

title: Glitchy: Cute Loop
description:
Strange things are happening in the home of the cute little animals. The Ghost Patrol wants to give everyone a donut before bedtime, but they can only do so if everything and everyone is in their proper place. However, the over-eager crew is always trying to prank Glitchy the little ghost, coming up with new tricks every day. They hide, rotate pictures, repaint the room, or rearrange the furniture.

Help Glitchy the ghost find these anomalies! During the game, look around the cute home, check every detail, and find the differences in the level. If everything is correct, help Glitchy by choosing the green door. But if you feel something is wrong, simply choose the red door. If you help Glitchy 8 times without a mistake, you’ve successfully completed the game—and Glitchy will be very happy!

title: Hero's Destiny
description: An adventure and fantasy MMORPG where players explore a vast and mysterious world. Choose from various classes and unique abilities, customize your character, battle magical monsters, gather resources, and engage in dynamic combat. Discover breathtaking locations and epic challenges.

title: Kamikura Hina no Himitsu: Gohoubi ha Watashi no Karada
Shiina Maho no Himitsu: Name ha H de Omoitsukimasu
Bubble de House de OOO: Ofuro Maker no Showroom ga Sharehouse de...
description: Protagonist, a student, moves into a share house that offers discounted rent in exchange for monitoring a famous bath manufacturer's products. He had thought he didn't get the opportunity, but to his surprise, he's accepted at the last minute. After moving in, he realizes that all the other residents are female upperclassmen from the same school. It's time for some heart-pounding, bath-filled, crazy student life with those ladies!

title: Survive the Spin
description: A lone hero faces creatures invading the kingdom on a deadly spinning wheel. Jump on enemies to survive, clear increasingly challenging levels, and enjoy catchy melodies in an arcade adventure with infinite retries.

title: Shíqǔ Bǎoshí Hòu Yìwài Juéxǐngle Fùzhì Mówáng Lìliàng de Nì Tiān Jìnéng
description: A "Tower of Magic"-like Roguelite game that blends strategy with randomness. Players take control of the "Demon Fox," a character capable of beguiling and shapeshifting into various NPCs- and utilize a unique skill to replicate enemies' attack power, alongside other special abilities, to defeat formidable foes and challenge the Demon King.

title: Homestay à la Mode
description:
Three super cute foreign girls came to our school! Long live the exchange student system! I was so excited, but then I found out that their homestay was going to be at my house...

No, no, no, this can't be happening!

On top of that, one of them had to share a room with me!

It was a sudden turn of events, without regard to my privacy. Thus the occasional impure cross-cultural exchange began.

title: Kinguin: Become a Streaming Legend
description: Kinguin is a relaxing idle simulator about a penguin streamer. Leave the game in the corner of your screen while you work, upgrade your setup to turn views into valuable followers and subs, and climb the Global Rank. Dominate the algorithm and become the internet's greatest polar legend!

title: Meowker: Desktop Cat Companion
description: This is a virtual cat on your computer desktop. It needs you to buy items for it. To buy these items, you need to earn coins by "working"—the game converts your detected keyboard keystrokes and mouse movement distance into corresponding coins. (no input information will be collected. )

title: Beat This Game To See Hot Lady
description: This will be one of the worst games you'll have to endure. Are you brave enough to walk down that path?

title: Unbounded
description: A fast-paced top-down bullet hell roguelike where every input matters. Fight, dodge, upgrade, repeat. Push yourself to the limit and see how far you can go.

title: Sycophant
description: This game is a casual treasure-hunting adventure game with a low-poly art style.

title: Purely x Cation
description: Spring is in full bloom in Asahama, a town reminiscent of old Japan. Hibiki found himself moving here due to his parents’ transfer for work. While it was his first time living alone, he was able to make friends and get familiar with his surroundings pretty quickly. Everything was smooth sailing, but he felt like there was something missing in his life. In the middle of his youth which only comes once in a lifetime, his first love may be just around the corner.

title: Still Room: I Miss You
description:
Still Room: I Miss You is a psychological narrative experience that explores the fragile border between reality and illusion through the mind of a person living with schizophrenia.

You play as a man confined to a single room, trying to function as his mental state slowly begins to unravel. Over roughly 90 minutes of gameplay, you go through ordinary daily routines: working on your thesis, staying in touch with a loved one through text messages, and doing everything you can to remain mentally stable.

Your survival depends on managing basic needs such as eating, drinking, sleeping, and taking medication regularly. Neglecting any of them changes how the world is perceived. The room distorts, reality bends, and familiar surroundings become increasingly unsettling.

title: VZones
description: VZones is a 2D virtual world where players can explore, customise their own space, and connect with others. Build and decorate your own turf, collect items, and discover a long-running online world that has been active since the 90s.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: EHEH Airport
description: Take control of Eindhoven Airport (EHEH), a unique mix of low-cost, cargo, and military traffic. Manage busy operations in a compact layout that challenges both new and experienced controllers. A dynamic and fast-paced addition to Tower! Simulator 3. ✈️

title: Sakura Kanji Ketchi
description: Learn Japanese kanji in a fun and engaging way. Catch, train, and battle kanji as you journey through Japan in search of Sakura's missing father. Merge kanji to form new ones and gain an edge in battle. Perfect for anyone looking to learn Japanese or prepare for the JLPT.

title: Dice Heroes
description: Dice Heroes is a turn-based roguelike where every fight is decided by a single die. Roll it, then split its value between Attack and Defense. Collect powerful artifacts, bend the rules, and survive dangerous biomes in a risk-driven journey.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: KEWR Airport
description: EWR is located only 14 miles from Manhattan, serving a critical role for the New York/Newark metropolitan area. The largest airport system in the U.S; made up of the trio of KLGA; KJFK; KEWR. The airport spans over 2,000 acres and has multiple runways, making it a crucial global air travel gateway.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: LFPG Airport
description: LFPG, or Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport, is a complex and busy international airport ideal for simulator games, featuring a realistic model with four parallel runways, three terminals (including the "village-like" Terminal 1 and seven sub-terminals in Terminal 2), and a detailed ground network. Players can use this add-on to practice air traffic control with features like advanced radar systems, accurate taxiway signage, and detailed ground polygons for precise navigation.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: EDDH Airport
description: Take your ATC skills to a new level with Hamburg Airport (EDDH). Whether you’re handling the morning commuter crush, scheduling heavy wide-body arrivals, or juggling tight taxiway jams, this airport offers the perfect mix of realism, complexity and gameplay fun. Add this to your Tower Simulator arsenal and experience one of Germany’s key air hubs in full control.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: KORD Airport
description: Step into the supervising role at one of the world’s most iconic and busiest aviation hubs: Chicago O’Hare International Airport (KORD). Situated on the northwest side of Chicago, this super-hub blends immense scale, varied traffic flows, and full-sized international operations to deliver an ATC simulator experience you’ll never forge

title: Tower! Simulator 3: CYVR Airport
description: Step into the tower at Vancouver International Airport (CYVR) in Tower! Simulator 3 and orchestrate complex west-coast traffic flows. This ultra-realistic airport add-on delivers challenging arrivals, departures, and ground operations for every ATC enthusiast.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: PANC Airport
description:
Step into one of the world’s most unique and challenging aviation hubs with PANC – Anchorage, the latest expansion for Tower! Simulator 3—and the first airport in the series to feature snow environments.

Anchorage isn’t just another airport—it's a global cargo powerhouse and a critical stopover between Asia and North America. With a mix of heavy freighters, passenger traffic, and unpredictable Alaskan weather, every shift becomes a test of timing, precision, and situational awareness.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: EDDB Airport
description:
Berlin Brandenburg Airport (BER/EDDB) is Berlin’s main international airport, located in Schönefeld about 18 km southeast of the city and serving carriers like easyJet, Eurowings, Ryanair, Condor and Sundair.

It replaced Tempelhof, Tegel and the old Schönefeld airports, becoming the single commercial airport for a region of around six million people and ranking as Germany’s third busiest. The airport opened in October 2020 after years of delays caused by severe construction and management issues.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: LGAV Airport
description: Step into the tower at Athens International Airport (LGAV) in Tower! Simulator 3 and command complex parallel-runway operations. This high-fidelity airport add-on delivers realistic traffic flows and challenging ATC gameplay.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: WSSS Airport
description: Take control of air traffic at Singapore Changi Airport (WSSS) in Tower! Simulator 3 and experience one of the world’s most renowned and efficient international airports. Located east of Singapore’s city center, Changi is a major global hub connecting Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and Oceania, offering nonstop action and high operational complexity.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: EDDL Airport
description: Take control of air traffic at Düsseldorf Airport (EDDL) in Tower! Simulator 3, one of Germany’s most important international hubs. Located in North Rhine-Westphalia, EDDL serves as a major gateway for business, leisure, and long-haul travel, offering a busy and varied ATC environment.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: ZSPD Airport
description: Take control of one of Asia’s busiest and most dynamic aviation hubs with ZSPD – Shanghai Pudong International Airport. As a major gateway to China and a critical international crossroads, Pudong delivers intense traffic waves, heavy long-haul operations, and nonstop runway action.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: KDFW Airport
description:
Dallas-Fort Worth International Airport is the fourth-largest airport in the U.S. by operations and the eleventh-largest globally, serving over 40 million passengers annually.

One of the most connected airports in the world. DFW’s central location in the United States has also facilitated international travel to Europe, Asia, and the Middle East. The Dallas Fort Worth International Airport has 191 domestic destinations and 63 international destinations. American Airlines, based in Fort Worth, remains the largest aviation component at DFW.

title: Train Sim World 6: BR Class 90 Electric Freight Loco
description: Introducing modern freight hauling with one of the UK’s most iconic electric locos - the BR Class 90 - take control of pantograph-powered container trains and cruise along the busy WCML. The ubiquitous Class 90 races into service in Train Sim World.

title: Master Alchemist Simulator
description: Build and run your own arcane workshop. Explore a dangerous fantasy world, gather rare ingredients, grow magical crops, craft powerful potions, manage your shop, and fight with blades, bows, and spells—alone or with friends in co-op.

title: Suicide Drive
description: Speed headfirst into oncoming traffic with your eyes closed. For fun.

title: Code My Robot Vacuum
description: Code My Robot Vacuum is a game where you learn to code while cleaning! Program your robot vacuum to solve increasingly complex cleaning challenges. Navigate mazes and upgrade your robot's abilities. Perfect for beginners learning to code and puzzle enthusiasts who love logical problem-solving.

title: Un Paseo Por Villa Tronco
description: "Un Paseo Por Villa Tronco" is an spanish-only narrative experimental game in which you can hang out while listening A Tribe Called Quest and also to what the people living in the trunk have to say to you.

title: Project: Colt
description: Project: Colt is an action game where players take control of a skilled gunslinger navigating dangerous environments and confronting hostile enemies. Using fast reflexes and strategic abilities, the player must survive encounters, overcome challenges, and uncover the mysteries behind the world around them.

title: Freelands
description: Freelands is a kingdom management game with a sandbox structure and RPG elements. Starting your journey by helping in a small and scattered settlement, you gradually gain trust, a voice, and transform an uncertain village into a powerful city, and then into your own kingdom.

title: Fat Fleet
description: Grow in strength and sexy, adorable blubber as you destroy alien cakes in this fixed shooter arcade throwback!

title: Lizard State
description: Lizard State is a stealth action game inspired by the classics. Sneak through the shadows and use your environment to make your way deep within enemy lines, on an island overtaken by a renegade group.

title: Airship 2: Kingdoms Ablaze
description: Command fleets in tactical aerial battles, build trade and industrial networks, and shape diplomacy in this skypunk action simulation strategy game where rival powers clash for control of the skies.

title: Venial Sin
description: About a woman haunted by misfortune.

title: Burning, Crackling
description: Nero is burning his drawings and sketchbooks after he received the news that he failed to enter his dream university. Fortunately, his best friend, Jin, comes just in time to stop his dumbass friend.

title: Narnok
description: Narnok has no attacks. Build your universe and assemble your alien lineup. Battle other players' ghost lineups and gain more Narnok than them. There is only Nar, the essence of good and order. There is only Nok, the essence of evil and chaos.

title: Apex Legends Showdown
description:
Season 26 of Apex Legends

New Content
A new Permanent Mode: Wildcard
Introduction of Elite weapons
These are modified versions of standard weapons from Ballistics Private Collection,
temporarily replacing their base weapon.
The first being the RE-45 Burst, an energy-based automatic burst pistol.
Amps introduced

title: Effeminate Touch
description: Short essay about touching dudes, gender, friendship and playing.

title: I Want To Be A Circle When I Grow Up.
description: Discuss your dreams of circularity with your non-circular friend.

title: Reset Day
description: Vaporwave and robofeels. Slice of life. See the world through the eyes of cool posthuman machines, and effect some change where it's needed. Point-and-click adventure goodness.

title: Obey Me! Sinner's Choice: Lucifer
description: You are the magistrate, and Lucifer stands trial as the defendant. Judge the fallen angel in this dark romance visual novel. Decide whether he is worthy of salvation, or doomed to destruction.

title: My Last Heatwave
description:
Someone is stuck in their apartment during a heatwave.

At least they have Halley-J.

title: Rain Debt
description: A game about a kid who's forced to pay back his debt.

title: Sashinomi Suika-chan
description: “Sashinomi Suika-chan” is a word-play simulation game where you enjoy laid-back conversations with the demon “Ibuki Suika” at a bar -- teaching her new words, listening to her gossip, expanding the bar's menu, and treating her to drinks.

title: Myth of Empires: Throne
description: Myth of Empires: Throne is a free seasonal multiplayer warfare sandbox. Explore vast lands inspired by multiple civilizations, tame creatures, forge powerful weapons, and build your guild. Lead cross-server expeditions, conquer territories, and compete with players worldwide for the ultimate throne!

title: The Hell Provided
description:
Every day is the same.

The weight of your duty grinds you down.

You live for life's sake.

When does it end?

title: Shiosai no Serenade: Episode 1
description:
The first out of 3 episodes for Shiosai no Serenade.

Spring-- The coastland town was bathed in the roar of the nearby sea.
Narahara Kyousuke waited for her on the train platform.
Her name was Yamakami Sakura. Kyousuke's childhood friend.
She'd been away for many years, but returned now to attend high school.
It was the first time home in five years.
Spring-- Kyousuke and Sakura's new friendship begins.

title: Shiosai no Serenade: Episode 2
description: The second out of 3 episodes for Shiosai no Serenade.

title: Shiosai no Serenade: Episode 3
description: The third and last episode for Shiosai no Serenade.

title: Shadow Girls
description: Follow the vengeance-driven Diana as she infiltrates her school’s most infamous clique: the Four Lashes. In order to prove her loyalty to the group, Diana must participate in a series of mentally taxing activities orchestrated by the group’s leader, Sabrina.

title: Kanun 1919
description: Kanun 1919 is an action-adventure set in an alternate reality of the 20th century. You play as a government courier tasked with traveling to the sealed-off city of Turov to investigate the disappearance of a special cargo. The situation is complicated by an epidemic sweeping through the city—an unknown virus that turns residents into terrifying monsters. Fight monsters, survive, help the residents, investigate the mystery of the missing cargo, and don’t lose your mind as you inch closer to the solution.

title: LandScape
description:
A doujin game in the world of Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru.

"...That day, I had an encounter with fate."

The protagonist "Akamine Ichiya" transfers from Tokyo to Habara Middle School, where he meets Koori Chikage and gradually gets closer to her. Before long, he unveils various secrets surrounding Chikage...

title: Kimi Omou Yoru ni Kengeki wo
description:
A doujin game in the world of Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru.

"...That day, I turned to face fate."

Due to a certain reason, middle school student "Michinomiya Sousuke" had come to avoid kendo. But one day, his childhood friend Nogi Wakaba asks him to face kendo once again. As the needle of fate begins to turn, Sousuke turns to face his fate once more...

title: Archangel Demon Rush
description: Archangel fuses action, tower defense, and roguelike into fast runs (20–40 min) where every decision matters: earn rewards by killing enemies, build powerful weapon/turret/ability synergies, and brace yourself for bosses that change the rules of the fight. Dark fantasy, gore, and nonstop dismemberment.

title: Red Meat Radiator
description:
This project is a short 15-20 minute shooter experience :)
It is intended to be difficult!
Do not be discouraged after your first few deaths!
There are small secrets... and a bonus weapon to be obtained...
- Itch.io page

title: Neat
description: Neat is a game about helping people organize their lives by organizing their spaces.

title: Los Reinos de Aethermoor
description:
Welcome to the realms of Aethermoor
An incremental journey through forgotten lands and ancient perils.

In this idle fantasy adventure game, your legend never ends. Your hero will venture into the far reaches of a world filled with magic, treasure, and dangers lurking in every shadow.

title: Tomato Dealer
description: An illegal shop keeping game. Grow tomatoes, dry and sell to customers. Broaden your customer network but be careful, there are undercover cops! Deal with police attention with the help of the mafia.

title: Upgrade It
description: An idle game with 99 generators and a deep prestige system. Unlock 1000+ upgrades, automate progress, and complete all challenges. A full release, ready to play!

title: Space Stone Smashing Simulator
description: Control a mining drone in space. Scan asteroids, extract resources, and manage your equipment. Optimize your workflow and explore a relaxing sci-fi mining experience.

title: Vivisection
description: A survival horror game set in a procedurally generated labyrinth. Every day the layout changes. Leave your small room to scavenge for resources, navigate endless corridors, and evade a relentless crawling abomination. Adapt, run, and find a way to escape.

title: Qwerty Garden
description: Qwerty Garden is a cozy typing game where every keystroke grows flowers on your keyboard. Harvest, sell, and buy rarer seeds to expand your garden, then prestige to earn more from every bloom.

title: Kang
description: This game is a 2D-platfomer with a 90's like experience. The player controls Kang, a kangaroo that punches really hard and has a strong nose. Meet Mat and a mysterious entity that haunts your game. Will you find out what happens by beating the game and checking secrets?

title: The Ghost Of Solaris
description: When a legendary enforcer returns to a city transformed into a corporate prison, he must coordinate a high-stakes revolution to save his family and settle a debt written in blood. Experience a gritty story of betrayal and vengeance across the neon-drenched slums and silver towers of Solaris Bay.

title: Reborn: New Life
description: Reborn is a choice-based visual novel for adults centered on the life of a teenager in college. Become a student at the most prestigious college on the continent and experience all the delights of college life! Sex, humor, romance, drama and deep plot. All this is waiting for you in the game Reborn!

title: Tougen Anki: Crimson Inferno
description: Meet Tougen Anki Crimson Inferno, a 3D turn-based RPG faithfully set in the world of the Tougen Anki anime! Experience stunning skill effects, uncover unique character stories, and enjoy seamless cross-platform play on mobile and PC!

title: Dumpster Dive Live
description: An interactive and cozy raccoon fueled trash digging game for your Twitch viewers. Viewers can dig through your garbage with commands, subs, gift subs, and bit donations. Ideal for keeping chat engaged during content that requires extra attention, or while on long breaks.

title: Racing Life
description: Racing Life is a top-down racing game with an immersive career mode where you start with classic cars and progress to the most advanced open-wheel machines. Featuring multiple categories like Touring, GT, Prototypes, and Open-wheel, along with a variety of tracks worldwide.

title: Cat Minesweeper
description: A casual Minesweeper game with a cat quietly accompanying you.

title: Hidden Portals: Chronicles of the Sunbound - Collector's Edition
description: Uncover hidden objects, solve clever puzzles, and explore a sun-scorched world where ancient portals awaken and every choice shapes your fate.

title: Spire of Ash
description: Spire of Ash is a dark-fantasy run-based dungeon crawler with deep itemization, tactical combat, and escalating key-driven challenges. Build your team, refine your strategy, and push deeper into deadly endgame runs.

title: Ashes of Mankind: Citadels
description: Ashes of Mankind: Citadels is an immersive, tactical FPS set in a dystopian future. Players embody Revenants, elite, genetically enhanced warriors, navigating a world torn by endless wars.

title: ECommerce '99
description:
eCommerce ‘99 is the business simulator that lets you go from zero to CEO. Set just before the burst of the dotcom bubble you start out to create a business empire. A small severance, a garage and your cat Jeff are all you have to get you going but soon you will oversee multiple warehouses and offices filled with your employees.

eCommerce ‘99 takes the simulation genre that has become popular in the last two years to the next level. It lets the player interact with a customer and price simulation not seen in the genre. Using tools like price setting, marketing and their eCommerce website Players can create monopolies or crash the market for each product.

For players more interested in creativity than management the game comes with a plethora of different furniture and cosmetic items that allow for a high level of customization. Not only can you optimize your fulfillment routines but make them pretty too.

title: Towerslam
description: Slam your towers down and conquer endless maps of enemies in this roguelike tower defense game. Level up, earn loot, unlock powerful upgrades and create unstoppable towers!

title: Adventure Card Game
description: A single-player, medieval fantasy deck-builder where you choose a hero—such as a knight, mage, or ranger—then build a customized card deck to tackle scenario-based adventures filled with monsters, exploration, and strategic encounters. Each quest unfolds through structured, turn-based phases that balance attack, defense, magic, and luck, as you fight enemies, explore locations, and complete missions, with multiple heroes and scenarios encouraging replayability and different playstyles.

title: Super Dungeon Scoundrel
description: A super-casual, single-player card battler inspired by the tabletop game Scoundrel, where you fight your way through a dungeon using a deck of cards—equipping weapons, battling monsters, fleeing when necessary, and managing your health as you progress. With simple mechanics and quick decision-making at its core, the goal is to strategically survive each room and make it to the end of the dungeon to claim your reward.

title: Saikiri
description:
Saikiri is a roguelike game inspired by Vampire Survivors and Megabonk, set in a Japanese-style world with unique objectives.

Main objective: Defeat hordes of enemies in Saikiri, a roguelite action game where you loot, level up, unlock characters, and upgrade to create crazy builds every run!

title: Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition - Baldwin & Bullseye
description: Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Editions third DLC, Baldwin and Bullseye, bolsters the base game with two further unique CPU lords, each with their own remarkable playstyles, as well as a fresh nine mission Sands of Time trail to stress your strategic abilities and see their true measure!

title: Draw Steel
description:
A new game for a new age! Draw Steel is the breathtaking new, action-oriented, fantasy RPG from MCDM that’s both fun to play and fun to run!
In Draw Steel, your character grows more powerful over the course of the battle, not less! Characters build heroic resources over the course of the battle so battles get more interesting round by round!

title: Rino Rush
description: Rino Rush is a fast-paced arcade game inspired by the classic Snake formula. Collect coins, grow longer and try to survive as long as possible.

title: Galactic Civilizations IV: Tales of the Snathi
description: The Snathi have finally broken free. Scavenge the wreckage of your enemies and claim your birthright as the true heirs of the Dread Lords.

title: Hibera, Requiem for the Forgotten
description: Follow the journey of two ordinary people as they struggle for survival in a continent shadowed by war. Guide them through strife and turmoil in this Strategy RPG, featuring a grand narrative, engaging weapon triangle combat, and permadeath.

title: Pillars of Pantheon
description: Build a moving Roman engine of war block by block, stacking balistae, spears, and divine powers in this fast-paced mythological horde-survival roguelite. Adapt your playstyle to face iconic bosses and endless enemies solo or in co-op. Sacrifice to the gods and let the chaos unfold.

title: Spa World
description: Spa World is a cosy isometric management game where you design and run your own wellness centre — from a bare concrete shell to a five-star sanctuary. Drag out rooms, lay stone paths, hire staff, and keep your guests relaxed. Every decision matters: a dirty sauna loses reputation, an understaffed changing room creates a queue, and a VIP who leaves untreated can torpedo your rating overnight.

title: Hentai Age Sci-Fi
description: A magical, relaxing puzzle game where you arrange tiles to reveal stunning artwork of lovely girls, enjoy calming music, and progress through increasingly challenging levels at your own pace.

title: Every Step Has a Sound
description: An atmospheric horror puzzle game where an independent programmer answers a request from a gold mining company and finds himself alone inside mysterious caves hiding dangerous secrets

title: Pastry Pile Up
description: Drop and merge pastries to create bigger, more delicious treats! Serve your sweet creations to adorable cat customers to earn coins. Use your coins to fully customize your cozy bakery, and compete on the global leaderboard to achieve the highest score.

title: Rootborn
description: A cozy action-platformer with an open world, nonlinear storyline, filled with battles, building, entertainment, and much more.

title: Corner Wars
description:
Corner Wars is a competitive tower defense game that goes wherever you go. The game runs discreetly in the corner of your screen and is perfect for playing alongside whatever you're doing—whether you're working, streaming, watching videos, or playing other games.

Build powerful towers, create your own custom deck, and send increasingly powerful creeps to pressure your opponents. Every decision matters.

Try the free demo and let us know what you think! Join our Discord, share your feedback, or take a look at the latest ideas from our artist.

We wanted a normal tower. He drew an egg. Now it's in the game.

title: Socrates Ragebait
description: Socrates and his crew are back and they won't stop yapping. Block the doors, survive the philosophical ragebait, and contain these ancient thinkers before they break your brain.

title: Ironfront Express
description: Command the Ironfront Express in this roguelite lane-defense. Build your train car by car with turrets, drones, and abilities, and fight through waves of corrupted mining machines toward the rogue AI core in the planet's depths.

title: Orms
description: Orms follows Sam, a boy lost in a surreal world shaped by his fears. Guided by Kira, he must restore a lighthouse to reconnect with his parents. The game is inspired by Machinarium, but crafted in 3D with expanded locations. It blends emotional storytelling with atmospheric exploration.

title: Burning The Midnight Oil
description: Burn the Midnight Oil is a supernatural neon-noir romance visual novel about monsters, love, and other horrors.

title: Anomaly Department
description: A multiplayer, friendslop hidden object game.

title: Overwhelming
description: Overwhelming is a narrative driven point and click adventure game set in a fictional late 19th to early 20th century London. Players control two characters who are different yet inseparably connected, existing in parallel worlds reflected through mirrors.

title: Rogue Sundown
description: Rogue Sundown is a 3D local splitscreen duel set in a desert village, where players outplay each other using tight gunplay, aggressive melee, and fast movement. Every fight is a test of positioning, timing, and skill.

title: Mawgate
description: Maria Moore is wrongfully imprisoned in the dreaded Mawgate Asylum. To survive she must do things she never thought herself capable of. Fight, hide, solve puzzles, and investigate the illusive dark forces behind the asylum. Maria must escape, or be consumed by the madness of Mawgate…

title: Batara: Fate Unbound
description: Step forth as Moriyan, The Unfated, and battle your way through the shattered lands of Yrdra —inspired by the rich visual culture of Indonesia. Master parry-focused combat, clash with ambitious gods, find beauty in decay, and cleanse this world of corruption.

title: Blacksmith Together
description:
Blacksmith Together is a cooperative blacksmith shop management game where players run their own forge, gather resources, craft weapons and tools, trade with unique NPCs, and grow their business over time.

Players can collect materials through mining, woodcutting, fishing, hunting, and exploration, then use those resources to forge weapons, tools, armor, and custom orders for customers. Different materials affect the quality, appearance, and value of crafted items, allowing players to create unique and customizable equipment through modular blacksmithing systems.

The game features profession-based progression, skill leveling, shop upgrades, town interaction, exploration, and cooperative gameplay. Players can improve their blacksmithing abilities over time, unlock new crafting options, and work together to build a successful and respected forge in a living world.

title: WoofWatch
description: WoofWatch is a high-energy action roguelite where mech-suited dogs battle through a constantly changing Pastel City. Dodge, reload, and unleash chaos with outrageous weapons and gear, from heavy artillery to rubber duck launchers.

title: Witch Dance
description: A fantasy-themed click 'em up in which a young witch dances around an arena and fights summoned familiars. Teleport to attack and strike as many enemies as you can!

title: Gorilla Showdown
description: Step into the arena in this fast-paced arcade shooter where staying on beat matters just as much as taking out your enemies. Fight across themed maps, seize control of the dance pad, and hold the rhythm while everyone else tries to blast you off it.

title: Jeb's Legend of Zelda
description: This is an unofficial fan-made reinterpretation of the original Legend of Zelda for NES. It may appear similar to the original but there's many different surprises to be found here. Think of it like "Super Mario Bros Special" types of modifications made to the original Legend of Zelda, with new enemies, new areas, new secrets and more!

title: SkyChart: Airline Executive
description:
SkyChart: Airline Executive puts you in the CEO's chair of a fledgling airline, competing against 35+ AI rivals across four historical eras (1930–2020). Plan routes between 150 cities across 7 world regions, manage a fleet of 33 historically accurate aircraft from the DC-3 to the 787, and navigate 60+ scripted world events, including WWII, the oil crises, deregulation, 9/11, and COVID-19.

Every era presents a different strategic challenge. The 1930s demanded survival with propeller planes and limited capital. The jet age rewards aggressive hub-and-spoke expansion. The modern era is a cutthroat war of pricing, alliances, and hostile acquisitions.

The game features a fully draggable, resizable window-based UI with a Strategic Advisor that analyzes over 110,000 city pairs, full controller support for Steam Deck and consoles, a built-in music player with Spotify integration, and quarterly financial reporting with route-level analytics. SkyChart combines deep systems with intuitive design — the kind of game that makes you lean back in your chair and think, "I built this network."

title: Heavydelic
description: Heavydelic is a 2D Slavic Synthpunk Platformer broadcasting on dead frequencies. Synthetic psychedelia, comic art, VHS tapes, analog ruins & robots resurrected from Slavic mythology. Every asset is manually drawn by Eniac. Signal lost. Game found.

title: Unreal Hospital 8
description: Nix, the handyman investigating disappearances at an abandoned hospital. This game is inspired by Exit 8 and is an Exit 8-like (Exit 8-esque) game. If you notice anything unusual, shoot and destroy it. If nothing seems amiss, proceed straight to the exit.

title: Vaska
description: Meet Vaska — a cat lost in a strange and dangerous forest... Move quietly, hide, solve puzzles, and find your way home!

title: RuneKeeper
description: RuneKeeper is an Open-World Sandbox JRPG with monster taming elements where you can choose to follow the story, or just simply live in the world with your friends in the world of Rin. It's up to you!

title: Bell Knight
description: Traverse a cave overrun by monsters, strike down malevolent spirits, and uphold the sacred duty of the Bell Society. Praise the Bell.

title: Pierrot
description: Pierrot is a first-person psychological horror set in a twisted theater where a small puppet is trapped in its grasp. Violence is routine and you exist only to obey. Forced to harm others Pierrot dreams of tearing his strings. Even as the curtain falls his role never ends.

title: Balkan Shop Simulator
description: “Balkan Shop Simulator” lets you manage your own store in the Balkans – stock shelves, serve customers, and grow your businesses. From a small local shop to a thriving retail chain, success depends on your skills!

title: Wired 2 Kill
description: Wired 2 Kill is a singleplayer, high action, retro FPS with linear gameplay and a short story narrative. Mow down cyborgs to Intelligent DnB and synth wave music with a selection of 6 weapons, keycards to find and a mission to take down the bot responsible for this city takeover!

title: Easoar
description: The Easoar Corporation has made a horrible discovery, spreading the unending potential of Innaturum weaponry. Radicalize as a wildslinger in this fast-paced, action platformer, RPG. Lay waste as you mix and match all manners of weaponry, becoming a true force of Innature!

title: Null: Initiative
description: Shoot and slash your way through Enemies and Levels while upgrading, in Endless Mode and the Campaign in this fast-paced Hack 'n' Slash. You can even face these challenging levels while playing up to 64 players online!

title: Pest'Off
description: Pest'Off is a student made First-Person Shooter. Mutants are infesting the city and you’re the one paid to clean it up. Play as a Pest’Off employee, take extermination contracts, wipe out aggressive mutants, earn cash, and upgrade your gear. Clock in, exterminate, get paid.

title: Two Beasts Or Not To Beast!
description: This censored port removes the incest included in the original release. The player takes control of Haruki, who prepares for a study date with his crush on Sunday and must resist the lustful temptations of many women for an entire day. The game functions as a simulator with minigames and time management.

title: Night Guard Skull Steve
description: You are a skull night guard at a museum.

title: Santa's Shop
description: Only trust your light.

title: YuleTown
description:
Welcome to YuleTown! You move into a strange little town in the middle of snowy nowhere, and it appears to be populated by Yule legends from all around Europe. The trouble is, you have to get everyone a present for Christmas, and Christmas is tomorrow!!

Wander the town, get to know your new neighbours, help them out, and maybe you won't get eaten by Krampus the next day...

title: Symbolika
description: You are neither a hero nor a mere candidate: you are a variable. Symbolikus chose you because your destiny is blurred. He wants to see if you will be able to transcend classic archetypes (Warrior, Mage, Cyber...) by mastering the magic of Symbols. Your goal? Traverse the 29 Strata of the Arena, Use powerful combinations based on the values and symbols of your cards to deal devastating damage to your enemies, reach the Creator, and prove your worth by leaving an indelible mark on him.

title: Dungeon Blitz R
description:
Dungeon Blitz R is a fan-driven revival of the classic side-scrolling multiplayer action RPG Dungeon Blitz. Rebuilt from the ground up, the project aims to bring back the fast-paced combat, cooperative dungeon crawling, and nostalgic charm of the original experience—now with modern infrastructure and ongoing development.

Featuring real-time multiplayer gameplay, diverse character classes, and skill-based combat mechanics, Dungeon Blitz R focuses on preserving the spirit of the original while expanding it with new systems and improvements.

Currently in active development, the game is transitioning to a TypeScript-based architecture to support scalable multiplayer features and long-term sustainability. Early versions are available to supporters, with a full public release planned alongside the multiplayer launch.

title: Type To Kill
description: An arcade shooting game where you have to type challenges to finish off enemies with your EMP. In between stages, watch live-action full-motion video cutscenes with a full cast of memorable characters and not necessarily the best acting.

title: Freddy Or Not
description:
Five Nights at Freddy's: Freddy Or Not is an unofficial attribute-deduction character guessing game, made to test the knowledge of Five Nights at Freddy's fans.

Inspired by online games like Wordle and Akinator, the premise of Freddy Or Not is simple: Figure out the FNaF character that Archie the Archivist has selected from his archives, by picking someone from a collection of Scott Cawthon's original 7 horror titles and seeing which of their attributes are correct (green), incorrect (red), or partially correct (yellow). Keep going, and see how few guesses you need to get it right!

title: Deeper Club
description: Deeper Club is a visual novel with dating sim mechanics based around sex and vore. The game follows the story of Melo, a mouse who's life is an everyday struggle not to succomb to his own needs or other predators.

title: Noelle's Ark
description: Explore ruin puzzles, talk to new people, explore the island and unravel the secrets both hidden on this island, and about yourself in this semi-open-world puzzle based rpg!

title: Please Fix the Mess
description: Clean up chaotic interiors, remove trash, repaint walls, and redecorate messy spaces, sometimes with a few suspiciously bodies lying around.

title: OpenGoal: Jak 3
description: Fan made PC port of Jak 3, with more options, like the ones added to The Precursor Legacy and Jak II, such as antialiasing, resolution, screen ratios and more to be added.

title: Inside Darkness
description: Inside Darkness is a 2D puzzle-platformer where a young girl must harness the power of light and shadow to transform between human and creature, solve puzzles, and escape a kingdom filled with danger. Explore ancient catacombs, unlock secrets, and master your dual nature in this fantasy adventure.

title: Alice on Delivery
description: This cozy delivery game is inspired by all your favorite fairy tales. Follow Alice on her way to become the best delivery woman in Heartlier. Explore, make friends, and uncover the story one delivery at a time.

title: Harold's Bad Day
description:
A precision puzzle-platformer aimed at speedrunners that turns one of the oldest videogame tropes on its head.

In other games, dying is bad, and your remaining lives are just chances to try again... right? No, not on Harold's Bad Day.

Finish as quickly as possible, while trying to save as many Harolds as you can for a perfect run.

title: Demon Burst
description:
Demon Burst is an arcade action game made for "A Game by its Cover 2019" jam, inspired by games such as Kid Icarus, Castlevania and Ghosts 'n Goblins.

The game's concept and name were inspired by the original artwork of Philip Summers, made for the 2019 edition of My Famicase exhibition.

Game, Art & Sound by Crowno

title: Pac-Man Forever
description:
Ever wanted to play Pac-Man Forever? Well now you can!

Using a modified version of the algorithm developed by Shaun Lebron, Pac-Man Forever generates new Pac-Man Mazes on the fly!

title: Hentai Furry Sheepy
description: An adult interactive game that combines logic puzzles, attention, and a seductive atmosphere.

title: Jackie’s Forest: Outsourced
description: Jackie's Forest: Outsourced is a FNaF inspired game where you will go through 5 different rooms with task-based challenges to get to the end. Just don't let the performers get to you!

title: Bound To Fail
description:
Bound To Fail is challenging physics-based platformer about climbing to freedom while tied to a chair. It might not take you long, but it probably will. Jump and roll while taking advantage of your incredibly grippy feet to overcome obstacles.

You are bound to lose some progress, and perseverance is key. Don't worry there is no time pressure, you can always take a break and pick up right where you left off, even in multiplayer.

title: Rescue the Hostages: Words of Fear
description: Rescue the Hostages: Words of Fear is a dark psychological horror FMV word-search game where players uncover hidden words while progressing through unsettling narrative sequences. Featuring randomized puzzles and cinematic elements, the game blends traditional word gameplay with horror-thriller storytelling.

title: DFClicker
description: April's Fools game, incremental clicker where you click the big DF

title: Cross Helix
description: The giant conglomerate SDI built adult leisure facilities with casinos in several locations around the world. A few years later, they deployed "dolls," artificial life forms that provided sexual services. Coincidentally, this was around the time the United Nations began to take a serious crackdown on prostitution.

title: Micro Mages Maker
description: Micro Mages Maker is a level editor of Micro Mages, a platform game developed for the 8-bit console. Create your own levels, share them with everyone! Contains new levels to play solo or with up to 4 players simultaneously! Includes the original Micro Mages and Micro Mages Second Quest.

title: Deus Exia
description: “Before your planet gets blown into smithereens, take this sword and protect yourself.” Embark on a colorful 2D pixel action adventure in Deus Exia! Slash, parry and combo through four distinct lands. Collect cards and skills to craft powerful builds — then overcome deadly enemies and bosses.

title: Hammer & Harvest: Dwarven Roots
description: A dwarf farm sim! The days of dragons'-fire have ended, and now the Dwarf King has commissioned you to reclaim the ancient halls. Grow crops, harvest crystals, mine ores, and craft works of awe & wonder. Enrich your home beneath the mountains before the Dwarf King returns to judge your progress...

title: Unforsaken
description: A deep fantasy roguelike RTS where you must reclaim the realm from an ancient evil. Recruit immortal heroes, construct bases, command armies and be the last hope for this world. Control over ten powerful heroes and three unique factions in a new take on classical RTS.

title: Cosmic Galaxy Wars
description: Enter the abyss of RPGs. There's nothing else like it—anywhere. That's a promise. At first you'll wonder, “What is this?” Keep going. You might recall a few familiar titles. And then it hits you: this is unlike any RPG you've ever played. The abyss of RPGs awaits.

title: Stack the States
description: Stack the States makes learning about the 50 states fun! Watch the states actually come to life in this colorful and dynamic game! As you learn state capitals, shapes, geographic locations and more, you can actually touch, move and drop the animated states anywhere on the screen. Carefully build a stack of states that reaches the checkered line to win each level.

title: Project Lunky
description: The player is unwillingly teleported into a lab where everything wants to kill you. Get coins, buy upgrades and find the key to escape. Warfstash is there, Lunky is everywhere, there's a vague reference to Damien somewhere.

title: GVD
description: A bouncing DVD logo screensave game, it's an auto battler roguelike

title: DokiDoki Shutter Chance: Koi no Puzzle wo Kumitatete
description: Dokidoki Shutter Chance☆ is a jigsaw puzzle game with a competitive action twist, one of many such games produced by Nippon Ichi. Two players compete to assemble three small picture puzzles as quickly as possible. Placing pieces will earn energy to use items which can help that player or hinder their opponent, and each of the nine playable characters has a different selection of items available. The game includes a single-player story mode in which Shunsuke challenges a series of girls to puzzle matches; if he wins, the girl allows her photo to be taken, which the player can adjust the framing of and save to an album. There is also a two-player versus mode where any character and set of puzzles can be chosen.

title: Grid of Change
description: Grid of Change is an indie strategy board game with active skills, smart moves, and diverse modes from solo puzzles to 8x8 battles with friends

title: Memories Off 2nd: Yuki Hotaru
description: A prequel to Memories Off 2nd.

title: Te Iu ka, Joshi ni Kokuraretan Desu kedo!?
description:
It was mid-July. The first-semester finals were over, and all that remained was to wait for summer vacation.
