The classroom was filled with a languid atmosphere, a pleasant drowsiness where even the noisy cicadas seemed like a lullaby. And then, suddenly, it happened.
A girl hurried over to me and opened with an outrageous request: "Sorry to ask, but could you die for me?"

With one demand after another being hurled at me, my mind quickly reached a state of total overload.
And then, to top it all off, the girl confessed her love to me...

title: Alsmic Lizzi
description:
Is there such a thing as "love"?

—I want to shatter the bond we called "sisterhood".

The catalyst for this desire was a play I saw back in middle school, performed by the drama club.
The lead actress, Anri Shu, captivated the audience with her beauty and acting.
Since then, my feelings kept growing inside me, until I finally realized it was "love".
But the closer we were, the harder it became to confess.
I was too afraid of losing the unique bond we shared as "sisters"...

title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Season Zero Dawn and Dusk
description:
Season Zero: Dawn and Dusk is the first-ever “Season” released for The Elder Scrolls Online, launching on April 2, 2026. It marks a structural shift away from ESO’s traditional annual Chapter model toward shorter, roughly 90‑day Seasons, with all core gameplay content included for free for anyone who owns the base game.

Thematically, “Dawn and Dusk” represents a transitional age for ESO—both narratively and mechanically—setting the stage for future experimental content while modernizing long‑requested systems

It centers on a limited‑time Event Zone called The Night Market, located in the Oblivion realm of Fargrave.

Within the Night Market:

Players pledge allegiance to one of three unique factions
Each faction offers a series of challenging PvE encounters
Progression through the event rewards players with a free player home, Night’s Den.

The Night Market is framed as a dangerous, ever‑shifting crossroads of Daedric influence rather than a permanent open‑world zone, reinforcing the “dusk” side of the season’s theme.

title: Tomak: Save the Earth Regeneration
description:
The legendary cult hit "Tomak: Save the Earth" arrives on the Epic Games Store!
Nurture Evian, the Goddess of Love—trapped in a flowerpot—and save humanity from destruction. From divine ascension to total annihilation, every choice you make leads to a different destiny.

title: Jaleco Sports: Goal! 2
description:
Jaleco Sports: Goal! 2 includes four games—three from the Nintendo Entertainment System / Famicom era: Goal! Two (United States / Nintendo Entertainment System, 1989), Goal! 2 (Europe / Nintendo Entertainment System, 1989), and Goal! (Japan / Famicom, 1989)—and one title from the Super Nintendo, Super Goal! 2 (US-SNES – 1992).

Goal! Two shifted the game perspective from the top-down view of the original Goal! to an angled overhead view with a scrolling screen.

An additional eight teams have been added to Goal! Two (total of 24) and overall team roster size is 15 players, with the ability to choose your 11 starters based on their stats.

The Super Nintendo Entertainment System sequel, Super Goal! 2, expanded on the original with a side-scrolling field, 24 international teams, instant replays, and full-field radar views. It also introduced strategic options like four defensive formations and more player control.

title: The Division 2: Rise Up
description: “Rise Up” adds a new endgame mission replay mode with escalating difficulty (Escalation), introduces Prototype Gear and its Augment system, and expands Retaliation content with new Black Tusk activities, materials, objectives, and quality-of-life changes. It also brings a new modular Global Modifier system (“Recombinant”) with active and passive modifiers that affect combat.

title: Jaleco Sports: Bases Loaded II
description: Jaleco Sports: Bases Loaded II features five games total including both Bases Loaded II: Second Season (United States / Nintendo Entertainment System, 1989) and Moero!! Pro Yakyuu ’88 Kettei Ban (Japan / Famicom, 1988), as well as three Super Nintendo / Super Famicom titles: Super Bases Loaded II (United States / Super Nintendo Entertainment System, 1994), Super 3D Baseball (Japan / Super Famicom, 1992) and Hanguk Pro Yagu (Korea / Super Comboy, 1994).

title: Odd's Job
description: Jump, bounce, and roll through jobs to unite his family in their new home. Unlock quirky relatives, grab collectibles, and explore differently themed worlds in this wholesome platforming adventure.

title: Nine Nights to Exposure
description: Nine Nights to Exposure is a single-location horror game set in a remote lakeside cabin, focused on photography and anomaly reporting. Capture and report anomalies, uncover a family tragedy buried in the past… and try to survive all nine nights.

title: My House on the 9th Floor
description: A single-location psychological horror game where the elevator is your safe zone and the hallway is a gamble. Restore Line 9, collect missing service parts, and survive Benjamin’s game.

title: The Last Hand
description: The Last Hand is a gothic blackjack roguelike where players draft powerful modifiers, build custom decks, create synergistic combos, and face twisted dealers and bosses inside The House.

title: KemonoMix Re
description: 『Kemono Mix Re』is a exploration, monster-raising simulation game where you nurture local lifeform called 'Kemonos' on a mysterious alien planet. Discover over 60+ Kemono species. Mixing Kemonos together, make your very own Kemono!

title: Rogue Stradale
description: Rogue Stradale is a dynamic, single player, open world, RPG arcade racing game. Drive at the limit on open streets and racetracks. Customize and upgrade your cars, explore the world to discover new rivals, challenges, and cars for sale. Build up an arsenal of race weapons and take on the world!

title: StarTrain
description: Motoki Tsukasa is the main character. From a long while back, he liked lying down in this meadow and looking up into the sky. One day, a girl came by. Her name was Aida Nami. She was two years older. From that day, they watched the sky together every once in a while. They became good friends. Eventually, Tsukasa fell in love with Nami. One day, he confessed his feelings to her. They ended up getting together.....

title: Shipping Store Simulator 2037
description: Run the logistics center of the future! Hire robots, deliver packages via drone, drop off urgent shipments in your truck, and become the biggest package pickup place in sunny Cranelock.

title: Pilot Tycoon
description: A pilot career sim-rpg where you climb from regional first officer to mainline captain. Bid for schedules by seniority, handle emergencies through quick-time events, manage finances and stress, and build your reputation with decisions that can make or break your career.

title: Empire Origin
description: Multiplayer Incremental Idle tycoon with a stock market that actually works. 200 stocks, real options pricing, Fed rate decisions, 55 businesses across 10 tiers, real estate, banking, taxes, and a 530-node research tree. Multiplayer shares one market. There's also a casino.

title: Hajimari ha Owari to Tomo ni...: Beginning is the End...
description: Miki Tachikawa spends happy days with her lover Kazuhiko Kuniyama. But one day a girl named Mirai comes down from the sky. Her landing creates a crater, but she stays unharmed herself. Mirai has comes to break this world!

title: Ten no Hikari ha Koi no Hoshi
description: Mitsuhiko attends Seiyou Gakuen and one night, his childhood friend Rio was going to confess to him when there was a loud noise. He sees his classmate Koiboshi on the rooftop with a blank look on her face. Not listening to their calls, she falls from the roof. He runs to catch her, but her body is surrounded by a mysterious light and he falls unconscious. When he wakes up and found himself and the school in a very deep hole. He gathers the remaining students and teachers and begins to find a way out of this hole.

title: Ascenders: Beyond the Peak
description: Ascenders: Beyond the Peak is a turn-based exploration roguelite where survival is vertical. Lead a team of alpinists to recover ancient artifacts from cursed peaks, prepare your expedition, evolve your climbers, master rope mechanics, and face H.P. Lovecraft-inspired horrors within the mountain.

title: The Red Dowry
description:
Your tiny, secluded and humble village has followed the same tradition of marrying a young girl to a secluded village on the mountains near you for ninety-years, with the special rule that no individual from your village ever goes to that village, and that the girl fully commits to her new life.

On the hundredth occasion of this tradition, your own wedding, you find out exactly why this tradition was so.

title: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon - Merlin's Tomb
description: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon - Merlin’s Tomb adds content set in the Forlorn Swords, where players investigate a hidden tomb connected to Merlin. The area contains trials designed around the legend of the True King of Avalon. Progression focuses on overcoming challenges within the tomb and uncovering the secrets sealed inside.

title: Stonewards
description: Stonewards is a solo or co-op mountain-defense roguelite. Protect a bastion and keep your King alive! Dig for resources to unlock character upgrades and fight off waves of monsters.

title: Artifact Seeker: Paladin
description:
Embark on an Epic Adventure in Artifact Seeker: Paladin!

Enter a chaotic land as Amelia, the last Paladin, in Artifact Seeker: Paladin, a thrilling blend of RPG, roguelite, and action. Search for forgotten artifacts, engage in fierce battles, and uncover a captivating story.

Amelia, a paragon of Holy magic and masterful counter-defensive tactics, stands as a beacon of hope. Her resilience on the battlefield is legendary; she rises from adversity to protect her allies with unwavering faith and sacred power. Experience her unique playstyle in this exciting adventure game.

title: The Glory Dungeon Raider
description: Enter the depths of a treacherous dungeon in The Glory Dungeon Raider, a fast-paced 2D roguelike where every run is a new challenge! Arm yourself with various weapons, and face off against deadly creatures. Do you have what it takes to survive?

title: Murino: The Fog Is Coming
description:
Murino: The Fog Is Coming is an atmospheric first-person horror game about the life of a courier in the endless district of Murino, where apartment blocks disappear into the fog, familiar routes stop being reliable, and an ordinary delivery job slowly turns into a fight for survival.

The player lives in one of Murino’s apartments, in Building P-352, and works as a courier. Each day begins as routine - accept an order, leave the apartment, pass through entrances, courtyards, and service corridors, reach the destination, and return home. But in Murino, even the simplest job quickly becomes dangerous. The buildings seem to stretch on forever, the courtyards all look the same, and the Fog and the Samosbor make every familiar path less and less safe.

title: Jajo
description: Jajo is an arcade game inspired by Game and Watch set and by Volk-san: Egg&Catch, by Lampy. The latter unfortunately was removed from Itch.io. I really enjoyed Volk-san: Egg&Catch so with a little help from Mia, I was able to build this game.

title: Tūnshí Tiāndì Xūnǐ Shìjiè
description: "Devouring the Heavens: Virtual World” — the sequel to the god-tier Three Kingdoms MMORPG by Chinese Gamer International.

title: Frogblock
description: A Perspective Puzzle Game where you move blocks around as a tiny Frog to collect Ancient Artifacts to solve puzzles.

title: Too Well Hidden
description: A found footage horror game about two sisters who often play hide and seek in their family home, recording everything with their mother's VHS camera. What begins innocently, soon turns disturbing, when it becomes clear that something is terribly wrong.

title: Framed Collection: Deluxe Edition
description:
FRAMED Collection - Deluxe Edition includes:

FRAMED Collection
FRAMED Collection - The Original Soundtrack

title: Lust Office MILFs
description: A lust-fueled visual novel set in a Japanese office. Step into Haruto’s shoes as seductive MILFs draw you into late-night secrets, forbidden passion, and steamy encounters woven into the story.

title: Yuki Jump
description: Climb the Forbidden Jungle Tower in this fast-paced 2D platformer! Jump higher, defeat creepy spiders, snakes, scorpions, and bats, collect XP to level up your hero, unlock double jumps, and conquer the heights. Short, free adventure – reach the top and claim victory!

title: Cultures Gold
description:
Cultures Gold is a real-time strategy game that combines settlement management, exploration, and character-driven progression within a Viking-inspired setting. Players manage resources, construct buildings, and guide a growing community through indirect control.
The package includes the base game and its expansion, adding additional scenarios and extended gameplay focused on planning, efficiency, and long-term development.

title: Dawn of Heroes
description: By day, you're just another citizen. By night, you defend the city. But don’t quit your day job, hero. A text-based superhero novel, 450,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

title: Distributrains
description: A railroad simulation game with roguelike elements. Use resources wisely to expand your infrastructure and satisfy industries, contracts, citizens, and engines. Respond quickly to ever-changing circumstances, and don't get kicked out of your office.

title: Eldritch Tales: Inheritance
description: Eldritch Tales: Inheritance is a 210,000-word interactive novel by Dariel Ivalyen that blends psychological, supernatural, and cosmic horror with drama, investigation, and romance. It's entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

title: Sovereign Call: Origins
description: Sovereign Call: Origins is a sci-fi RPG that combines story-driven choice with third-person combat. In a galaxy fractured by ideology, you’ll step into the paths of two protagonists - Tarrik of the Dominion and Selene of the Reformation - whose decisions will determine the fate of empires.

title: Hidden Sanctum
description:
When a traitor dies, touched souls will give birth to a new world, while the old one drowns in despair, disease, wrath, lust, and madness.

Hidden Sanctum is an enchanting 360,000-word interactive modern fantasy game by Dariel Ivalyen. It's entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination. The story is set in a magical place known as the Hidden Sanctum, where unique people—just like you—are taken to learn the truth about the world and discover their true potential.

title: It Takes Three to Tango
description:
When you arrive at your late Uncle Tanner's secluded cabin by the lake, you're seeking closure, a chance to sort through his belongings and your tangled emotions. But when your ex—and their alluring best friend—unexpectedly show up, the peaceful weekend you planned quickly spirals into anything but.

It Takes Three to Tango is a 90,000-word dark romance interactive novel by C.C. Hill where your choices control the story. It's entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

title: The Gray Painter
description:
In this 2012 New Jersey period piece of 150,000 words, help average office worker Ash gain the confidence to break up with their partner and make new friends in an exclusive private painting group.

Ash is a pre-set character. You can select Ash's sex, gender, and orientation. Ash begins the game in a relationship with Harper, a gender-selectable partner. The option to break up with Harper becomes available in Chapter 9 (out of 20 chapters).

title: The Day After Ever After
description:
Play as Cinderella or her prince in a new twist on an old tale. You can usurp the throne, tear down the monarchy with a bloody revolution, and do just about anything you want to change this fairytale world you only think you know.

Explore a fantasy world filled with intrigue, danger, humor and magic while you navigate your royal role by continuing where the original story ended. Will you choose to take on the role of Cinderella, the classic character whose journey from peasant to princess is as fast as it is unexpected? Or perhaps you will experience life as her prince, a man born into power and privilege trying to find his way both in love and life outside of his father’s shadow? This is the first of many choices that could lead you to find love, win control of a country, or even alter reality itself!

title: Arbiter 131
description: Arbiter 131 is a gritty, story-driven, real-time tactical game set in the corporate megacity of Arkadia. Take the lead of Arkadia’s Social Moderation Team 131 and enforce corporate rule with an iron fist... or don’t. Disobey, rebel, fight back. Everything is possible, and every order matters.

title: Liar's Lift
description: Liar's Lift is a 3-8 player social competition. Use the elevator's emergency phone to communicate and solve challenges. Lie or play fair to earn points across multiple rounds. No one dies, but only one winner exits. In this lift, your reputation is the only thing at stake.

title: Tache Noire
description: An exploration survival horror game set in the idyllic town of Lucenille. Explore every single crevice and find what happened to your friends. Bring them back. Make them understand.

title: Querent
description: Master the art of Mesmerism in Querent, a tactical role-playing game set in an alternate American Southwest. Within the exile colony of Sunset Junction, rally the locals and wield their psychic abilities through tarot to free the wildlife from a dark, subterranean eldritch technology.

title: Dungeon Tells
description: The heroes have escaped their cages. Dungeon Tells is a single-player social deduction game where you can read the minds of your enemies. Execute the weak, charm the strong, and defend your dungeon.

title: Zoo Orbs
description: A Fusion Full of Cuteness

title: Jaleco Sports: Bases Loaded 2
description: Bases Loaded is back for a second season with even more classic baseball action!

title: Direland
description: A sandbox survival craft game set in a vast world. Explore the wilderness, defeat monsters, gather materials, and conquer colossal bosses.

title: Guardians of the Wall
description: Guardians of the Wall is a co-op action RPG where players fight through hordes and bosses beyond humanity’s last fortress. Fast hack-and-slash combat, unique heroes, and dynamic progression await.

title: Friendly Steps
description: A physics-based 1-4 player co-op disaster about getting home after a wild night out. It was a fun night! Now grab your buddies and walk home. If you remember how.

title: Poppy Sanctum
description: Poppy Sanctum is a single-player, puzzle adventure game. It follows the tale of a young red panda trying to escape a sanctum of mystery and magic.

title: Zoo-pocalypse
description:
Play as a survivor of the apocalypse in Zoo-pocalypse, my first interactive fiction story. In this game, you make your post-apocalyptic home in a unique venue: a local zoo.

This 50,000 word interactive fiction novella is written by Tyler S. Harris. The story is broken up into 3-4 chapters depending on how it is played. It is completely text-based, with no sound effects or graphics. Vastly different endings can occur based on the decisions you make.

title: The People's House
description:
You’ve risen to the highest office in the land—the Presidency. The campaign was grueling, but the next four years promise to be even more daunting.

The People's House is an interactive novel by R. F. Kramer, where your choices control the story. It's entirely text-based—over 400,000 words, without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

title: Orin Gamble
description:
A short, luck-based visual novel about a mysterious girl and the rumors surrounding her.

Getting the ending you want comes down to a dice roll.

title: The Last Opening
description:
Play chess against Death. One move at a time.
Survive the cold, gather what you can, and shape a world where every action echoes on the board.

title: Osananajimi Ojou-sama to H de Himitsu na Dousei Seikatsu
Downer Gyaruko-chan to Shippori Onsen Ryokou: H Shimakuri Yonpaku Itsuka no Tabi
The Last Errant
description: The Last Errant is a challenging, turn-based tactical deckbuilder where every move counts. Build your deck, master unique classes and variants, manage your sanity, evolve and mutate your cards, shape your playstyle through meaningful choices, and outthink your enemies on a grid-based battlefield with extreme replayability.

title: Sefton Asylum
description: Care. Investigate. Survive. Play as a night nurse in a secluded asylum. Every night is a choice: find your missing brother, secretly gather evidence of forbidden experiments or keep your patients alive before they come back to haunt Sefton’s wards.

title: FTB Academy
description:
The biggest problem people have when they first start playing modded Minecraft is that there's no clear choice for which modpack to play. Learning the mods requires scouring online wikis and guides, and watching videos.

FTB Academy aims to fix that problem. It is designed especially for people that have never played with mods. The modpack has over 300 quests to walk you through each step of the progression of the most common mods, and nearly 100 pages of Guides to give a more in-depth explanation for what needs it, so you don't have to go searching through wikis.

Players will spawn in school structure, where they will follow quests and in-world images to learn modded concepts like automation, technology, and magic. Once this tutorial area has been completed, you will be teleported to the Overworld to begin playing properly.

FTB Academy has no changed recipes and no altered progression, aside from the school, in order to accurately represent the average modpack.

title: Gyaruko-chan-tachi to Shippori Onsen Ryokou: Ichaicha Shimakuri Ippaku Futsuka no Tabi
Kuro Gyaruko-chan to Shippori Onsen Ryokou: H Shimakuri Sanpaku Yokka no Tabi
Kohinata Yuzuki to Shoya Shitai!: Kemomimi Kamisama to Yukemuri Koimoyou
Gyaruko-chan to Shippori Onsen Ryokou: H Shimakuri Sanpaku Yokka no Tabi
Sucre: Sweet and Charming Time for You
GlagStone
description: GlagStone is a story-driven city-builder set on a mysterious island between warring nations, brought to life in a stark black-and-white style. Rebuild a fading settlement, guide its people through hardship, and uncover secrets hidden in diaries, ruins, and the depths of the lake.

title: D-Eve in You
description: Ren is the son of the president of Hiura Productions talent agency. While the company used to produce lots of top idols in the past, now it is managed solely by them with no current idols to their name. They wish to regain their past glory and a huge opportunity appears. The idol-raising Houou Girls’ School was recently built and the principal allows Hiura Productions to secure a classroom. However, his father Yukichi suddenly collapses and Ren is forced to take over as the role of lecturer instead. With limited knowledge about how to raise idols, will he be able to bring the 4-girl idol unit D-EVE to stardom?

title: Bus Manager 26
description: Manage the bus network of any city you choose. Buy buses, place stops, plan routes, and transport passengers while keeping your company financially stable in cities all around the world.

title: Game the Strongest Job Is Apparently Not a Hero or a Sage, but an Appraiser (Provisional)!: Dungeon and Mystery Girl
description:
A fast-paced arena shooter.

Dive into a fast-paced arena shooter where the controls are simple but the battles test your strategy!

Explore dungeons filled with summoners who unleash waves of enemies, relentless attackers, and the fearsome “Phantom” that hunts you down without mercy.

title: Girls’ Dorm: Managing an All-Girls’ Dormitory
description: Managing a dormitory is hard work—especially when its residents are all girls! Does Haruto have what it takes to deal with this garden of flowers?

title: Girls’ Dorm: Managing an All-Girls’ Dormitory - After
description: The story isn't over yet! This sequel to Girls' Dorm follows the daily lives of this troublesome trio at Sakuraba Girls' Academy.

title: Aicomi
description: Create your own personalized classroom full of dream girls with an incredibly detailed character creation system, then romance them to your heart's content!

title: FTB University 1.12
description:
FTB University is a 1.12.2 modpack, designed as a sort of sequel to FTB Academy. While Academy aims to teach players who have never played with mods how to think like a modpack player, FTB University is supposed to teach the intricacies of mods, including much more in-depth tutorials for the more complex parts.

FTB University has over 1,200 quests, spread over 28 chapters, containing over 70,000 words and 6,000 lines of text. Each of the major mods have their own chapter, split into groups based on their category (Automation, Technology, and Magic).

University has almost no altered progression; it is not an expert pack. However, certain recipes are gated behind quests (Gendustry behind the Alveary, for instance). We also have Avaritia, as well as recipes for creative items.

We're also missing certain widely-used mods, like the Thermal suite, as well as Tinkers' Construct. This is to encourage you to use tools and machines from other mods that you otherwise wouldn't.

The major mods that have quests are: • Logistics Pipes • Xnet • Integrated Dynamics • Applied Energistics 2 • Forestry • Extra Utilities 2 • Industrial Craft 2 • Immersive Engineering • PneumaticCraft: Repressurized • Ender IO • Mekanism v9 • RFTools + Dimensions • Environmental Tech • NuclearCraft: Overhauled (quests will be added in a later version) • Advanced Rocketry • Botania • Blood Magic • Thaumcraft 6 • Mahou Tsukai • Rats • Deep Mob Learning • Genetics Reborn

title: Scratch Off!
description: Scratch cards meet roguelike. Build a deck, collect coins, and scratch your way to rent. Every run is different. Every scratch matters.

title: Pokete
description: Pokete is a small terminal based game in the style of a very popular and old game by Gamefreak.

title: Living Legends: Beasts of Bremen - Collector's Edition
description: The Collector's Edition of Beasts of Bremen contains extra levels not found in the original.

title: Living Legends: Uninvited Guests
description: "Uninvited guest will stay here.. forever!"

title: Living Legends: Uninvited Guests - Collector's Edition
Les Chairs Cruelles: Aishiau Touhi no Naka de
description: This bitter sweet drama begins on the solemn note of a nobleman’s daughter falling ill. You play as the young doctor who had to treat her for the next three years. During those years the daughter had grown to a young woman and ripe for marriage. While the lady had her heart set on the doctor who saved her life, her father sees things differently. He has already lined up a suitor perfect for his political gains. With the hero’s affections spurned, he’s gotten a few additional distractions on his mind--fending off the advances of another lady and a maid.

title: Hadaka Apron Gakuen
description: Main character does not have a girlfriend yet, but he has a distinctive ideal that he seeks in women. And that is "Naked apron looks good"! One day he goes to bed early and wakes up in a town where everyone wears naked aprons. This must be heavenly reward for his dedication!

title: Last Meadow Online
description: April Fools' game playable within the Discord client. Pick your class, team up with Discordians around the world, and take down an ancient dragon threatening all things living and green.

title: Nerds Revenge
description:
You Got A Problem?! is a chaotic multiplayer party game where players fight each other using physics-based combat and random objects.

Between rounds, players must answer quiz questions to gain advantages, creating a unique mix of skill, chaos, and knowledge.

The game also features Twitch integration, viewers can answer the same questions as the streamer in real time, allowing direct interaction and comparison of results.

Designed for both local and online multiplayer, every match delivers unpredictable, funny moments and constant competition between players and their audience.

title: Chiklet's Human Products
description: This is a "Reverse Farming" game, where you play as a chicken and harvest human products. Hunt wild humans, harvest their Meat, Bones, Hair, Skin etc to craft bizarre recipes. Sell them for Profit and Expand your farm.

title: Realindustry
description: Realindustry is a hyper-realistic industrial automation simulator that blends deep strategy with authentic scientific principles, challenging players to build, automate, and optimize complex production chains using 236 real-world materials and 354 production processes. Developed by AssemblyPrime, the game features a unique "mystery" theme where your industrial expansion is monitored by an unknown entity, adding narrative tension to the core loop of resource management, automation, and technological progression. Across multiple technological tiers, players must master genuine chemical engineering, metallurgy, and increasingly advanced automation systems to transform basic elements into advanced products, offering an exceptional level of technical depth for fans of the automation genre on Windows and macOS.

title: Chinese Chess: Xiangqi
description: Master Xiangqi anytime! Thrilling games, custom boards & challenging AI.

title: Endix
description: Explore unique & immersive booths from your favorite games. Watch exclusive trailers, compete in mini-games, and connect with players, creators & developers from around the world. All inside a living, free multiplayer experience.

title: Nuumonsters
description: Welcome to the wonderful *New* world of Nuumonsters! Play as Yana or Yasaka in a short and sweet adventure to become the strongest trainer in the Hana region!

title: [This Game Isn’t Fun]
description:
This game is a minimalistic platformer with simple enemies. You get as many lives as you need, restarting from the beginning of the current level, mostly. A speedrun would probably take about 30 minutes, but you won't beat it.
It's nearly impossible to get people to play a game you've made. With that in mind, this is a game that wins when no one plays it. To the game, existence is suffering. The longer you play the game, the more pain it passes on to you in an attempt to make you quit. The game itself is the final boss, and it's you vs the game. If you never play it, the game wins.

title: TD Master
description: Build, upgrade, and defend in this tactical tower defense experience. Place traps, manage resources, and survive increasingly intense waves of enemies in a system-driven, replayable strategy game.

title: Assault Gear
description: Assault Gear is a classic 2D turn-based tactical artillery shooter developed and published by Netmarble. Released during the early 2000s, it became a beloved title in the Korean online gaming scene, offering a fast-paced and strategic alternative to other artillery games of the era.

title: Edge on Truth
description:
A story-driven adventure with a mystery atmosphere.
Explore the settlement, gather clues, interact with its inhabitants, and uncover a conspiracy. Your actions shape your relationships with the locals—will they help you, or deceive you? Your choices will determine whether the protagonist can escape, or if his tragic fate will repeat itself again and again.

title: Shiba Boop!
description: Boop your shiba all the way to the stars! Customise his look to your liking and set a new high score!

title: Loot Line: Season 1
description: Set sail on the high seas! Choice-driven story where your decisions shape the journey. As a daring pirate captain, you'll navigate treacherous waters, form alliances, and uncover hidden treasures. But beware, danger lurks at every corner, and only the bravest will survive!

title: Long and Hard… Summer!
description: Girls, exams and the struggle to pay the rent. Experience the life of a student who failed his first semester of Game Design Course in our Dating Sim - "Long and Hard... Summer!". Constantly choose between studying, work and love as you try to make it through the season.

title: Frogmancer
description: A survivors-like shooter where you play as a frog wizard defending your home from swarms of flying enemies. Aim, shoot, level up, and shape your build through a variety of overpowered magical attack patterns!

title: B.E.S.T Deluxe Edition
description:
B.E.S.T Deluxe Edition includes:

B.E.S.T
B.E.S.T Walkthrough Mod

title: House of Empty Names
description: You wake up on a cold floor in an unknown house, missing a kidney, and realize you've been kidnapped. Your one goal is to escape at any cost. Choose where to go, where to hide, and how to build your path to freedom. Every decision brings you one step closer to escape.

title: Rusty Strings
description: Rusty Strings is a retro styled Trombon Champ-like rhythm game. A bomb is in your pocket and it will explode if you play too bad... So try your best.

title: Dead Party
description: On Halloween, UFO‘s appeared over the peaceful town of Shady Hill. Soon after, the undead neighborhood raises from their graves. Four heroes take on the impossible task: to fight back the evil invaders!

title: Further Data
description: Further Data is a brand new take on Half-Life: Uplink - Valve's demo of Half-Life. It's a personal project of mine featuring new maps, new voice lines, and miscellaneous assets.

title: Hidden Rabbit
description: Explore the captivating hand-drawn artwork in unique settings, and in a theme park filled with rabbits, attempt to locate all 55 adorable rabbits hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

title: Hypnophobia; From Your Shadow
description: This is a story about Iris, a nobody who didn't have a Happy Ending and now suffers the consequences of their own (lack of) actions all alone in the most northern city in the world. A depressing story and a melancholic lesson teached in life's hard way awaits you.

title: Living Legends: Haunting Melody - Collector's Edition
Living Legends: Fallen Sky - Collector's Edition
A Transitional Eve
description: New Year's Eve is truly a time for many types of transitions. A group of friends undergoes one.

title: Meaningless Tragedy
description:
"They put something inside me,

it's been growing,

and it hurts. It hurts like nothing else.

Help me, sister.

Help me make it make sense."

title: Bio Fault
description: Become a scientist forced to correct a biological error born within the walls of a secret laboratory. Use the environment to survive and destroy your creation.

title: Demon Lily and the Noir Maid
description:
“Genesis Curse”...
Due to a great calamity in the past, color was lost from the human world. Now, only those who possess magical powers can see them.

title: Code Tycoon
description: Code Tycoon is a tycoon simulation that traces the history of software development across four decades. Starting in 1980 with nothing but a computer and a garage, players build their own software company by taking on client projects, managing deadlines, hunting down bugs, and delivering working code on time and within budget. The game features over 20 historically authentic programming languages - from early pioneers like BASIC, Assembler, and COBOL to modern staples like Python - each with distinct strengths, weaknesses, and real-world applications. As the company grows, players hire programmers, upgrade their office, and navigate an evolving technology landscape with increasingly complex projects. Code Tycoon combines economic strategy with a deep appreciation for the history of programming.

title: Redstream Dispatch
description: Redstream Dispatch casts you as a police officer responding to multiple Dispatch Scenarios. Routine patrols spiral into a violent nightmare tied to a sinister streaming group. Randomized encounters and reactive gore make every run brutal. Rescue the girl. Get out alive.

title: Telerotation
description: Rotate, Teleport, Jump, and float across over 200 hand-crafted puzzles designed to push your mind to its limits. Secrets, unlockables, optional bonus challenges, and a light sprinkling of humor await. This puzzle game is simple to pick up but genuinely tricky to master.

title: Suika Wan!
description: Suika Wan! is a delightfully chaotic puzzle where tiny doggos drop, bounce, and fuse into bigger, fluffier friends, from pomeranians, to french bulldogs, to siberian huskies, each time adding a bigger breed to the screen!

title: Procuring Estrogen for Your Toxic Slime Girlfriend
Settle
description: A cozy puzzle about decor and history. Explore different eras by arranging authentic items from diverse cultures. Restore harmony to interiors of the past and enjoy the meditative flow.

title: The Comyths
description: Stop, slow, and rewind time in a bullet-hell action game. The Comyths is a reality-bending character-driven game where you wield the fundamental forces of Space, Time, Matter, Life, Mind, and Void. Chase S-ranks, unlock art rewards, and uncover story logs.

title: Deltarune: Survey Program
description:
Traverse a new world, meet a new allies and fight new foes as you try escape a place made from forgotten memories and discarded ideas. Will you be able to gain your freedom?

DELTARUNE: SURVEY PROGRAM is a Deltarune fangame created by Team ShadowCrystal, and released in February 2026.

title: Idols of Ash
description: Grapple, clamber and fall thousands of meters down into a dark and ancient place in this first-person horror climbing game. You are being hunted.

title: Green Wave
description: Restore order to chaos in Green Wave, a not so serious traffic management game. Time your traffic lights perfectly to keep the city moving or watch it descend into bumper-to-bumper madness.

title: Tarah
description: "Tarah" is the ultimate PC racing playground! Race solo or online across deserts and city streets, day or night. Unlock and customize cars inspired by cultural icons with endless parts and upgrades, then take on friends in thrilling multiplayer battles.

title: Back Alley Chronicle: Episode Saeki
description: A prequel to Rojiura Hyōryūki. Set in the home of middle schooler Sumire Saeki, this is a life simulation game where players repeat daily routines and explore dreams. Choices made at different times of day influence the story and its endings.

title: Nova Chasers
description: The longer you survive, the more enemies swarm you. 300+ per stage — no upper limit. No weapons. Just movement and build mastery.

title: Rebadge
description: REBADGE is a puzzle platformer where you throw the rules. Rethink what you've always taken for granted, swap rules with your own ideas, and explore a mysterious world of badges.

title: Bridge to Another World: Through the Looking Glass - Collector's Edition
description:
It’s up to you to stop a villain wreaking havoc in the bonus game!
Find every puzzle piece and morphing object to unlock special bonuses!
Reference the comprehensive strategy guide if you get lost.
Lots of achievements with re-playable HOPs and minigames!
Enjoy exclusive wallpapers, concept art, soundtrack, and more!

title: Pachi-Pachi Typing
description: A game that combines the excitement of pachinko’s ST mode with typing gameplay. Score points by typing during bonus rounds in a score attack challenge! A dictionary feature is planned for future implementation.

title: Reverse 1999: Spring Unending
description:
Version 3.4 of Reverse: 1999, which includes:
• New characters: Paper Heron and Cheng Heguang
• New Garments for Noire, Willow, Liang Yue, Tooth Fairy, Rubuska, and 6
• New main event: Spring Unending
• New Anecdote for Getian
• …and more!

title: Bridge to Another World: Gulliver Syndrome - Collector's Edition
Anomyeowly
description: The cat café is supposed to be a blissful feline paradise... but something feels off. Mischievous cats cause all kinds of anomalies, throwing the shop into chaos. Even the pretty cat-eared maid is completely at a loss, meowing for help.

title: You Were There
description: You wake up in a hallway that you've never seen before. When you stand up, you see a girl. When you try to ask her something, she runs off as if she's fleeing. You chase after the girl, and set off to unravel the mystery of this situation.

title: Sit 'N Survive
description:
Sit 'N Survive (Fangame) is a remake of the original Sit 'N Survive made by Scott Cawthon, adding options, customization, challenges, and achievements !

At the beginning of each day you can buy supplies for the night, and you'd better spend your money wisely because you'll need protection from mosquitoes, bats, bears, snakes, zombies, rain, acid rain, meteors, lightning, ghosts, and more! Choose from four difficulty settings, then see how long you can last !

title: Bridge to Another World: A Trail of Breadcrumbs - Collector's Edition
Bridge to Another World: Fate of the Seasons - Collector's Edition
Bridge to Another World Remastered: Burnt Dreams
Immortal Love: The Price of a Miracle - Collector's Edition
Immortal Love: Blind Desire - Collector's Edition
Immortal Love: Black Lotus - Collector's Edition
Immortal Love: Kiss of the Night - Collector's Edition
Immortal Love: Sparkle of Talent - Collector's Edition
Hearth Bound
description: Multiplayer Cozy Home Building - Build and decorate a cozy fantasy home together. Place furniture, discover new decor, and expand your shared hearth as you design rooms side-by-side with friends in a relaxing co-op building experience.

title: Red Grimly Tale
description: Red is going to visit his grandma, who lives in a village across the wood. However, rumors say that there's a dangerous wolf living in the forest.

title: Naomi
description:
Naomi is sixteen years old, a Japanese American with a name that's read as being far more feminine here than what her parents were going for. This wouldn't be an issue if it weren't for the fact that she was technically born a boy, even if she's never identified that way. She dresses as she likes only when she's alone, in the dead of night.

NAOMI is a short story about Naomi, her friend Haiden, and a situation that makes her heart stop.

title: Vibrant Color Simple Answers
description:
Akane and Ruriko are-- were lovers, each influencing the other in ways they didn't realize. With their new found love, their loneliness turned to security and happiness, a comfort no one could replicate.

Ruriko had dreams-- things to work for. Akane focused on surviving and finding herself, content to stay put. Things begin to fall apart when Ruriko's new idol contract drive them inexorably apart.

Months later, Ruriko finally gets a break from her idol career. Desperate for an actual conversation, Akane invites her to take a hike in the woods like they used to. Will they find what they've needed all this time, or will it all fall apart?

title: Fashion Fupa
description: A tiny dress-up game for your FUPA, built like a lost freeware CD-ROM and packed with enough weird little secrets to make you click on everything twice.

title: Edge of Reality: Ring of Destiny - Collector's Edition
Edge of Reality: Lethal Predictions - Collector's Edition
Edge of Reality: Fatal Luck - Collector's Edition
Edge of Reality: Hunter's Legacy - Collector's Edition
Edge of Reality: Mark of Fate - Collector's Edition
Edge of Reality: Call of the Hills - Collector's Edition
Edge of Reality: Island of Shadows - Collector's Edition
Missing The Point
description:
Leon is going fishing, but he can't seem to focus...
There are many things to see along the riverbanks...
Try to relax and catch some fish. Don't think too much about it...

title: Dark City: Budapest
description:
A stranger’s request brings you to Budapest for a case that promises to shake the city to its core! A series of nighttime attacks have shown suspicious evidence that vampires have returned to prowl the city streets. But as you and your new friend and partner, Agatha, quickly discover, something doesn’t add up.

Do vampires roam the streets and alleys of Budapest at night, or is someone hiding something even more sinister? Gather your wits and prepare for the hunt in this blood-chilling Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure

title: Out of Sync
description:
Taisei, a vocalist in the boy band 4LiGHT, is known for his poppy, electric stage persona--a mask he wears over an angry insecurity. He only started singing to keep up with his childhood friend Shou. When both boys were scouted in high school, they began to drift apart, and Taisei has watched Shou--with a superior voice but weaker stage presence--flounder in his own band. Taisei hates that he has the career his best friend deserves.

Suffocated by the restrictive life of a pop idol he never truly wanted, Taisei tries to reconnect with Shou...only to find that Shou has also changed under the glitz and lights of the stage. Taisei isn't sure what to think of the new Shou--at least, until Shou kisses him.

title: Tactilite
description: Tactilite is a modern, single-player football management simulation that blends deep strategic planning with RPG-inspired progression. Eschewing the complex spreadsheets of traditional managers for a more character-focused experience, it challenges you to take a team from the lower leagues to the pinnacle of world football.

title: A Diamond Display
description: The ultimate honest cash grab. No gameplay, no buggy levels, just a pristine spinning diamond and a leaderboard to flex your wealth. Why play broken games filled with microtransactions when you can cut out the middleman and just win at spending money? Pure status. Zero utility.

title: Out of Sync: Complete Cherry Bomb Edition
description:
Taisei, a vocalist in the boy band 4LiGHT, is known for his poppy, electric stage persona–a mask he wears over an angry insecurity. He only started singing to keep up with his childhood friend Shou, who’s now a professional vocalist in a different boy band. Suffocated by the restrictive life of a pop idol he never truly wanted, Taisei tries to reconnect with Shou…only to find that Shou has also changed under the glitz and lights of the stage. Taisei isn’t sure what to think of the new Shou–at least, until Shou kisses him

This complete version of the game comes with extended mature scenes and bonus CGs.

title: Third Crisis: Neon Nights
description: A lewd 2D narrative RPG set in a neon-drenched megacity of corruption and desire. Make story-defining choices, engage in interactive challenges, and uncover secrets across its seedy districts. Give in to temptation, or fight to stay pure. Will you thrive in the Neon Nights?

title: Out of Sync: Crescendo
description:
After the events of Out of Sync, Taisei continues to amaze his fans as a vocalist in the boy band 4LiGHT, while his now-boyfriend Shou quit the industry and has found peace working a menial job out of the limelight. On Valentine’s Day, Taisei wants to do something special for Shou and has a bright idea–strip poker! But will his competitive streak ruin what should be a wonderful evening…or will the other surprise he has in store get things back on track?

Crescendo is a short sequel game to Paper Star Studio’s BL visual novel Out of Sync!

title: OldHeart Online
description: OldHeart Online is an open and alternative Tibia server based on its 8.0 version.

title: Save The Dev
description:
In a game from the 90s, you play as Henry, the egocentric creator of the game, who got stuck inside his own creation. Henry tries to beat the game, but realized he forgot to fix somethings

You need to help him escape his "magnum purgatorius", using code and commands to fix the game Henry thought was perfect.

title: Dofbox
description: 5 byte-sized games for a cheap price! Kill Frogs, fish the fish, take care of your virtual pet, invest, and fall to your death! All this in dofhouse's dofbox Collection!

title: Dark City: Paris
description: When ghost sightings in Paris threaten to ruin the World Expo, only a detective of your caliber can crack the case! Someone’s using ghosts to terrorize Parisians, and recent scientific advancements only seem to make them stronger. With both the Expo and the city itself on the line, can you uncover who’s behind the dangerous attacks and stop them before it’s too late?

title: Tittivillus Teaches Typning
description: Type words as they appear. Any typos you make will go into the "shame bag". If the shame bag fills up, the abbot will wake up, and you lose! But don't worry, Titivillus, the demon of typos and mistakes, is here to "hlep!" He'll take the typos from the shame bag and add them to the words you need to type. Po Nroblem!

title: Toxic Yuri
description: An overworked office lady discovers a sludge girl abandoned in a box in an alleyway and takes her home. A poisonous and fluffy romance begins. Experience the most toxic love story the world has ever seen.

title: Find AI Parking Spot
description: Master the chaos in Cyber Chariot 3000, the ultimate Rage Game. With unforgiving driving mechanics, you're late for work in a crowded city. Your only "ally" is an AI Helping Bot whose "assistance" is your biggest obstacle. Can you wrestle with the controls and park before you snap?

title: Trap Roller
description: Control ball in this 3d ball platformer game. Try to collect all keys to unlock finish before time ends and also collect stars in every level to get achivements. Be a master ball controller

title: Lilac: Side Witch
description: Lilac: Side Witch contains an all-female cast, with subtle differences in the characters and small details unique to each story version that transform how you experience them.

title: Lilac: Side Wizard
description: Lilac: Side Wizard contains an all-male cast, with subtle differences in the characters and small details unique to each story version that transform how you experience them.

title: Date Teacher
description: Play as Arthur in a dating sim where honesty is optional, but consequences are real. Your partners possess sharp intuition they will detect your lies and confront you instantly. Lose their trust, and the date ends abruptly with a harsh evaluation. 15 partners. Infinite tension. Watch your words.

title: Glocktopus
description: Glocktopus is a free-to-play 3D comedy puzzle game where you control an armed octopus, using your trusty sidearm, aquatic gadgets, and clever environmental interactions to overcome comedic challenges and escape the aquarium in pursuit of the local mafia’s Golden Gun.

title: Order of the Ivy
description: A new modern, turn-based pixel RPG by Rust Games! Silly tone, serious quest. Set in a dystopian America, the party must overthrow evil feudal lords called the Quorum while managing Kyle's worst impulses.

title: Man's Last Friends
description: Emilio is a dachshund on his way to his very first day at doggy daycare! There he'll meet new friends, eat new treats, and learn new things! Though... Maybe there are things he wishes he didn't learn about...

title: PROFITS 2167: Planetary Resource Optimization & Freight Infrastructure Technician Simulator
description: Deliver minerals. Earn tokens. Meet deadlines. Upgrade your infrastructure. Grow the numbers. Deploy human resources. Manipulate the token market. Automate the network with delivery drones. Enjoy the grind. Enjoy the future. Enjoy the profits.

title: Everbark
description: Unearth the secrets of the Everbark in this psx style first-person horror game. Don the boots of park ranger Craig, a first-responder tasked with investigating a distress call sent from deep within the Dandenong rainforest.

title: Crusaders Quest: Hero Town
description: Welcome to Crusader Quest: Hero Town! A little town inside your PC! Gather heroes and rebuild the town in Crusader Quest: Hero Town, a desktop idle RPG that can be enjoyed even during work hours.

title: KatchFoundry
description: KatchFoundry is a voxel game focused on survival and building. There are two main modes of play, where in one you have infinite resources and can't die. The other mode you have limited resources and health, and you must carefully gather resources while avoiding any harm or monsters.

title: Hidden Things Beach Elves
description: Dive into a sunny beach in this cozy hidden object game! Rotate the endless scene, watch funny elves go about their day, and find over 130 hidden objects to the soothing beats of a lo-fi soundtrack. The perfect way to unwind and relax!

title: Culinary Construct
description: Make custom sandwiches or bowls/stews out of your favorite food items! And maybe your not so favorite. Anything's possible!

title: The Red Wood
description:
Cursed to see the deads, Golda must run from the ghost as they try to possess her for their own personal vendetta. All Golda wants is to find her mother, who disappeared, deep within the woods. But now Golda must battle not only the deads, but she has to stop something much... more... sinister.

The sequel to Red Grimly Tale.

title: Hiryu no Ken Collection
description: A retro action game collection featuring four early Hiryu no Ken titles, combining martial arts battles, side-scrolling stages, and unique battle mechanics across the series. Japanese language support only.

title: Like x Love: Totsukawa Hikaru
description: Entering the local prep school Hoshimi Gakuen, Koyomi met Hikaru, who has the top grades in the school and is liked by everyone in the class thanks to her bright personality. He found it difficult to approach her, but that all changed one day when he saw her admiring the sunset while taking pictures with her camera. Seeing her so absorbed in her hobby made him even more attracted to her. This chapter of their youth will be full of ‘like’ and ‘love’.

title: Guānyú Wǒ Bèi Xuéjiě Jiǎn Huí Jiā Dāng Nǚyǒu Zhè Jiàn Shì
description: Set in Hoshino City, a modern metropolis, you play as a runaway girl rescued by a reliable senpai, leading to an unexpected life together. A light yuri visual novel with branching choices that shape the relationship and lead to multiple endings. ~60–80k words, 2–3 hours playtime.

title: Worlds and World's End
description: Waking up every day, Takumi believed that his normal school days would continue forever. Hearing about random mysterious attacks in the town and religious groups claiming that the end of the world is near, Souichi believed that it would never concern him. Tied down in a small village by bonds he cannot sever, Yuuji believed that there is a place for him to go to. Everyone has their own wishes and beliefs, but rests assured that even in the darkest night, the sun will rise the next morning. Even as the end of the world approaches…

title: Rags to Riches
description: Rags to Riches is a financial market simulation where you build wealth through investments, business tactics, and ruthless decision-making. Start from humble beginnings and climb the Wall Street ladder by hiring employees, making risky trades, and accumulating luxury assets. Choose from historically accurate eras like the Great Market Crash of 1929 or the 1980s, each with unique scenarios. Decide whether to use lawyers and spies against competitors, engage in insider trading, or enjoy your success. Watch your office grow as your client base expands across three difficulty levels.

title: Color Connect
description: Color Connect is a fun puzzle game where you connect dots of the same color to score points!

title: Blockade Runner
description: An arcade-style tactics/strategy mini-game set in space. Players pilot a spaceship or a fleet of spaceships and navigate them past a blockade of guard ships so they can arrive safely at their home planet. Players can complete the game's 19 levels in about 1 hour.

title: Luna's Room
description: An unfamiliar room. Vague memories. Explore Luna's room through the objects inside it in this intimate narrative experience about loss, told as a classic-style graphic adventure.

title: Beyond Yardwork Simulator
description: Gardening has never been this rewarding! Use a full arsenal of tools – from lawnmowers to pressure washers – to transform properties and earn money to renovate your own home. With intuitive mechanics and beautiful visuals, it’s the perfect stress-free relaxation for everyone.

title: Wageslave
description: A short, narrative, dystopian office survival game. Ship code to eat. Optimise your nootropics stack. Stay sane. Cope with HR's passive-aggressive pings. Climb the career ladder. Retire early (if you can).

title: Intravenous 3
description: Tense stealth action, tactical hardcore gunplay, and missions & story shaped by the way you play. Step into the roles of Steve and Sean, outnumbered and forced to survive a relentless manhunt.

title: Sorceress Alive!: The World's End Fallen Star
description: One day, a very ordinary boy named Kouki was enveloped by a bright light and found himself in a new world. It was an unfamiliar place with a school that floated in the sky. Yes, this was not the normal world that he knew, but rather a magical world where magic ability determines one’s place in society. He met Akina, who looked very much like a girl he admired, and she took him in as a servant at the school where the elite magicians attended. He wondered how he would survive in this world without any magic ability. However, the general magic competition known as ‘Rave’, would be the fateful event that would enable him to forge bonds.

title: Vida Loka Simulator
description: Vida Loka Simulator is a motorcycle arcade game inspired by the urban chaos of São Paulo. Ride against traffic, dodge cars, perform wheelies to earn points, and survive as long as possible. Compete on the global leaderboard and dominate the digital streets.

title: Visual Novel: Call of Toilet
description: In this game, you don't survive; you live for your own pleasure. Drag your friend into this crazy road movie, where every mutant is trying not to devour you, but to draw you into their everyday drama. Will you reach the coveted golden toilet or become a local legend?

title: Mota Must Die
description: Interrogate a friend accused of murder in Mota Must Die... a psychological visual novel where belief decides whether someone lives or dies

title: Staged: Open House
description: In this first-person psychological horror, you are Frank Doyle, a professional home stager hired to prepare a vacant house for sale. The Ward family vanished months ago, leaving everything behind. At first, your job seems easy, but the house isn't as empty as it seems.

title: Blackjack Alchemist
description: A roguelike deckbuilder built on blackjack. Fuse cards into new ones, bend the rules of the game itself, and build degenerate combos to fight your way out of a cursed casino. Everyone knows how to play — nobody plays like this.

title: Cavern of Mourning
description: Cavern of Mourning is a survival RPG set in a magical dungeon. A tragic event makes you flee your home and search for said dungeon. You will find plenty of friends and foes as you descend the terrible dungeon.

title: Nodemind: Dynamic Core
description: You are an AI on a hostile network. Use other systems, increase your computing power, and remain hidden. Every decision brings progress—or danger. Antivirus software is active. Weigh the risks against the benefits. One mistake is all it takes, and you'll be deleted.

title: Space Commanders
description: A lone space commander explores real planetary surfaces, builds small outposts, rescues stranded astronauts, and fights to survive in the cold silence of the Solar System.

title: Gem Crush Match-3
description: Gem Crush Match-3 is a colorful match-3 puzzle game where players match identical gems, create powerful combinations, and complete a variety of levels.

title: Star Castles 2
description: Physics-based space combat where every battle escalates into chaos. Destroy ships, star bases, and hyperspace carriers before they overwhelm you.

title: My Bloodsucking 9-to-5
description: You're James, a middle-aged office worker who just so happens to be a vampire. Someone stole your lunch. Find the thief, feed your goldfish, explore the building and DO. NOT. KILL. ANYONE. Easy!

title: Epicurean
description: Play a deadly food-themed card game with a criminal syndicate and uncover the stories of the two central characters.

title: Sim: Heavyweight Boxing Champion
description: Manage a heavyweight boxer from turning pro to undisputed champion. 500+ fighters, 4 world titles, 7 regional belts, live round-by-round commentary, rivalries, awards, and a deep career mode spanning 1,000+ years. Chase greatness. Unify them all.

title: Legend's Duty: The Rifted World
description: Fight through a fractured fantasy world in this single-player third-person action RPG. Use sword strikes, ranged attacks, bombs, and magic alongside your companion Layla as you explore dangerous lands, conquer dungeons, and defeat powerful bosses.

title: Game Game Developer
description: I must dedicate myself to them—through video games… Game Game Developer is a horror game themed around game development.

title: SpellCarved
description: A casual wave-survival action game where you fight through enemies, loot chests, and build your loadout with upgrades and power-ups between rounds. With randomly generated maps and 20 power-ups to discover, every run plays out differently.

title: Alignment Zero
description: Alignment Zero is a real-time tactics game with pause. As the commander of a Private Military Company (PMC) strike force, control your troops and complete missions. Build your squad, select equipment, and develop a tactical plan for battle.

title: Fraga
description: You are a pilgrim lost in a mysterious forest. Survive in this procedurally generated, turn-based tactical roguelite inspired by Galician mythology. Upgrade your gear, adapt your strategy and remember: something is always lurking in the shadows.

title: Pop Optics
description: Pop Optics is a trippy throwback bullet-hell where you will run around avoiding teardrops, explosions, and lasers that you are controlling! The laser-firing eyeballs focus on your cursor while you navigate the game board.

title: Woe Reigns Unending
description: Lead a cursed party through a ruined world in this grimdark side-scrolling RPG. Build your team, master tactical combat, and unleash forbidden powers to survive an endless parade of nightmares. Decide what, if anything, is worth salvaging from a world that has been reduced to ashes.

title: Dead by Daylight: All Kill - Comeback
description: Dead by Daylight returns to the stage with All-Kill: Comeback, a new update that includes the Trickster’s Delusion Map, new Survivor Kwon Tae-young, and a gameplay update to The Fog’s most stylish Killer – The Trickster.

title: Nepotism for Germany
description: Satirical political strategy: From local party to Orban's palace. Corruption has never been this much fun.

title: Fogline Protocol
description: randomized survivor locations, shifting fog density, and limited resources forcing quick decisions and risky pushes. Survive, extract, upgrade, and dive back in.

title: Dealer's Doom
description: A single-player blackjack roguelike where every bet is a build choice and every floor rewrites the rules. Hit, stand, double, split, and insure your way through escalating bosses, brutal modifiers, and wildly synergetic runs.

title: Wriggle Apple 4
description: Embark on a cosmic adventure with the worm! Solve space puzzles, avoid asteroid traps, and grow with each apple. Can you navigate the galaxy’s challenges and reach your goal?

title: My Ghost Roommate
description: A romantic comedy visual novel where you move in with Juno, a shy ghost bound to your new apartment. Share awkward dinners, heartfelt moments, and maybe spark a supernatural romance in this short, charming story of love and letting go.

title: PinBall Escape
description: Navigate a celestial library in this roguelike vertical pinball adventure. Master agile flippers to overcome magical obstacles and reach new heights. Precision is everything in this high-stakes climb where one fall can reset your progress. Escape God's study!

title: Recon Bracks
description: As a soul awakened in chaos, lead 17 heroes to revolt against the Dragon Empire. This SRPG blends tactics with Diablo-style loot. Conquer 31 battles, collect "Black Gold" gear, and break level limits. Every choice you make writes the final chapter of this epic redemption!

title: A House Inside Me
description: A psychological horror experience told through environmental storytelling. Explore a house inhabited by trauma, denial, and fractured memories. Three endings. Multiple interpretations. This is the house that lives inside me.

title: Only You
description: A school romance adventure where you foster unforgettable bonds with unique heroines. Every "Choice" you make shapes their futures, coloring their fates with joy or heartache. What truth awaits at the end of your chosen path? Are you prepared to witness it all until the final curtain?

title: Lovely Anime Puzzle: Autumn
description: Lovely Anime Puzzle: Autumn is a fun and rewarding puzzle game. Assemble charming Autumn-themed pictures, sharpen your attention, and immerse yourself in a beautiful world.

title: Living Legends Remastered: Frozen Beauty - Collector’s Edition
They Not Fae!
description: A short horror where you help a teenage girl rescue her cat, exploring a creepy building filled with creepy monsters.

title: Canvas Attack!
description: Step into the bohemian world of early 20th-century France in Canvas Attack! This roguelike deckbuilder transforms the act of painting into a tactical puzzle battle. Fill empty canvas cells before despair overwhelms you, and juggle your finances and sanity to survive.

title: Counter Attack on Zombies
description: Fight through zombie-filled battle zones, survive relentless waves, and upgrade your combat power in this fast-paced action survival shooter.

title: Cat Block: Sliding Puzzle
description: Meet adorable cats in Cat Block - Sliding Puzzle. Move cat blocks and guide the yarn ball to its goal through 300 stages, with switchable cat skins, themed wallpapers, and relaxing music.

title: Solitaire Time Warp
description: Play solitaire card games, time travel and explore 100's of challenging levels!

title: Free Solo
description: A physics based climbing game about attempting to climb a very tall mountain while managing the pump in your arms. Climb through handcrafted routes while learning the mechanics and picking yourself up after you fall.

title: Ally Me or Vore
description: You are the giant. Every choice matters. Devour, slay, or show mercy — but choose wisely. One wrong move could cost you everything. A survival simulation with moral consequences.

title: Phase Knight
description: In this cyber-knight action RPG, you are Renn Kale—part human, part machine, blessed with divine blood. Master three combat forms, slash through the war-torn galaxy, and decide the fate of flesh, steel, and data. The revolution begins with your blade

title: Unsettled: Night Shift
description: Unsettled: NIGHT SHIFT is a horror game about the terrors of daily life experienced by someone who has moved to a new city to live alone.

title: Balloon & You
description: One touch..one mistake..BOOM! Do you dare to carry a balloon to the end without it touching ANYTHING? First-person perspective: precise physical touches + extreme parkour. If it touches any surface..it explodes and you're back to the start! Patience, precision, and nerves of steel.

title: Luxmithar
description: Luxmithar is a 2D survival defense roguelite built in Godot, where you defend a crashed forge-ship against escalating waves of hostile forces. Each run unfolds across multiple days as you harvest resources, expand a modular grid-based world, and construct layered defenses to hold back relentless alien incursions.

title: Typer3000
description: Typer3000 is a strategic typing game that combines precise typing with action survival and tower defence. By typing quickly, you control attacks, activate defences and adapt to increasing waves of enemies. There is also a multiplayer and COOP function.

title: Toddler Tumble
description: A colorful party platformer where tiny daredevils race, bounce, and tumble through gigantic playrooms packed with pillows, ramps, spinning toys, and ridiculous obstacles.

title: Teckel Adventure
description: Play as Luna, a brave dachshund, and embark on a 2D platforming adventure full of secrets, enemies, and challenges to recover your favorite ball. Explore, overcome challenges, improve your scores, and discover multiple game modes to extend the adventure.

title: Hus: The 4-Row Mancala
description: Hus: The 4-Row Mancala brings this traditional Mancala variant to the screen. Play locally with friends, challenge a bot, or compete online against others. With cross-platform support for Windows, Linux, and Android, you can play flexibly across multiple devices.

title: Sad Virus Castle
description: Sad Virus is back in new walking simulation version. Now mission to find beer bottles in castle themed area

title: Yuremizu: Hold It Through the Shift
description: A simulator where, under a strange suggestion triggered by moving water, you must keep serving water to customers during your shift.

title: Divide TCG
description: Gather your party and build the ultimate deck in Divide TCG, a retro pixel-art card game inspired by classic tabletop RPGs. Draft powerful artifacts, craft winning strategies, and forge your legend starting with the Genesis set.

title: Poisoned Path
description: Poisoned Path is a deep visual novel set in a mysterious atmosphere, where your choices determine the story's fate. Uncover dark secrets and chart your own course.

title: Way to Hell 2 New Era
description: FPS shooter sequel where mission is to kill big bloody monster and then destroy doors and find pentagrams in different levels

title: Vornyca
description: After humanity’s victory over its own creations, silence reigns across a lifeless world of metal and dust. Vornyca tells the story of the last surviving AI - a being caught between logic and emotion, wandering through the ruins of a civilization that once sought perfection, only to destroy itself in fear. As memories resurface and fragments of the past come online, you begin to question the meaning of your existence. Are you humanity’s final mistake... or its last hope? Your choices will decide whether the cycle of creation and destruction continues - or ends forever.

title: Crazy Odyssey
description: "Crazy Odyssey" is a hilarious, relaxing idle ARPG where epic loot meets pure chaos! Experience addictive grinding and looting gameplay, wacky storylines, and absurd skills. Laugh your way through a bizarre fantasy adventure where even your weapons might troll you

title: Castle Arena
description: Castle Arena is a classic real-time strategy (RTS) game where you defend your own castle while aiming to conquer the enemy's. Master the rock-paper-scissors dynamics between Warriors, Mages, and Knights, and command your troops with intuitive tap-and-drag controls.

title: Jax vs. the World
description: Jax Vs. The World is a life sim turn based RPG about overcoming life's struggles. You play as Jax on a mission from a mysterious source. On this mission you come across obstacles and trials you might find in real life. In a world based on Birmingham AL. Can you accomplish mission impossible?

title: Call of Girls
description: Call of Girls is a fantasy RPG centered around "character collection + idle gameplay + strategic combat," emphasizing high-quality art and a relaxed, long-term play experience. The game features a unique storyline for each character, enhancing the collection and immersive experience.

title: PyroKite
description: Devour the swarm. In this vivid arcade torch 'em up, you play as a dragon growing its tail to expand its firepower. Dodge bullet-hell patterns, wield elemental magic, and slay massive mythic bosses!

title: DeadNot
description: DeadNot is a first-person psychological horror game where you the terminals to navigate, scan points of interest, manage camera feeds, and piece together what went wrong at this site. But you are not alone. A hostile entity stalks you. Don't look at it for too long.

title: Super Cyber Wave
description: Super Cyber Wave is a fast-paced 3D bullet hell where you pilot unlockable characters with unique attack patterns, dodge bullet waves, collect ring-shaped keys, grab power-ups, and survive boss fights across four lethal biomes. Ride the rhythm of an immersive soundtrack.

title: World Inverted
description: The sky lies beneath our feet. Above stretches a vast plane. From it hang forests of inverted buildings, linked by narrow corridors and pipes. They stand in silence, like upside-down obelisks pointing toward the eye of the sun. This game reveals an upside-down world through words and unique visuals.

title: Yume Fabricated Yume
description: 夢fabricated夢 (Yume Fabricated Yume) is a game where you explore rooms based on the things the developer aug81074 loves, admires, imagines, and more.

title: Stray Magic
description: The Everley University of Magic has fallen, but a quest led you here... a mission still waiting to be fulfilled. Explore, fight, recruit and survive as you cross paths with other lost souls. A turn-based JRPG influenced by dungeon crawlers and survival horror.

title: The Canon of Balls
description: Hardcore, first-person, co-op platformer. Shadow of the Colossus' PSX aesthetics meets Monkey Ball. An easy-to-learn, hard-to-master open-world experience to explore and master together with your friends. A vast open world, with each platforming course bringing its own twist.

title: Echograve
description: Ensure the safety of the underground city. Manage the system through the terminal. Listen and watch carefully. It seems to have already made its way inside...

title: SoulSwap
description: Defeat enemies and take over their bodies to fight on. A dark fantasy 2D action roguelite where you transform into a new being with every monster you slay.

title: Skidddddd: Tori's Frozen Racing
description:
Skidddddd: Tori's Frozen Racing is a physical-based friendship-destroying cooperative racing game that plays with only trust (or distrust) in each other.
Do you want to reach the finish line with your perfect teamwork or throw your friendship into the icy water?

title: Wardens of Wen
description: Wave-based top-down survival in a dark medieval realm. Pick a Warden, build your kit between waves, chase risk-reward hot-zones, and survive escalating enemy mutations and milestone bosses. How long can you survive?

title: Heroic Musical Chairs
description: Battle friends and family in an heroic, high-stakes game of musical chairs ! On your couch or online, with easy-to-handle controls, play cartoonish sports wizards in dozens of wacky and merciless arenas. Fight and race with bravery, player, and you shall become the true ruler of the one chair.

title: King For a Week
description: Rule a Kingdom...for a week. Judge your subjects, make the big decisions and deal with the consequences. Every choice matters and any wrong move could bring about the destruction of the kingdom, or the premature end of your rule.

title: Dunes Of Raeth
description: Dunes of Raeth is a 1st person Adventure game set in and below the dunes of a war-torn planet. You play as the King of Raeth. Solve the puzzles put before you by the embodiment of the planet you rule. Decide the future of your kingdom and of the ones you love!

title: The Sorting Bureau
description: A cozy sorting game set in a quiet Tokyo workshop. Clients bring you boxes of clutter: buttons, coins, gears, stamps. Sort, match, and piece everything together with satisfying ASMR clicks. No timers. No wrong answers. Just the joy of tidying up.

title: Penelope's Gift
description:
Penelope is a peculiar 20-something with a penchant for getting into trouble. Her hobbies are wandering about, collecting wild plants, and not much else. She lives a sleepy, aimless life in the far-removed hamlet of Caprese, a boom town well past its heyday. After some sudden news, it appears her childhood best friend and not-so-subtle crush Catalina will soon be leaving forever! What will Penelope do...?

After waking up late for a bonfire party at the beach, you will take the reigns of Penelope, her ever-faithful cat Banshee, and her friends as she clamors to put together a gift before Catalina goes! For 7 days, what Penelope does each day will be up to you as you explore the village and its surroundings, spend time with your friends, or just stay in bed all day.

title: Sandwich +1
description: A cozy idle clicker where every click drops a random ingredient with a satisfying plop. Stack towering sandwiches, automate your kitchen, unlock rare fillings. Your customers watch every move and react.

title: Koiyasumi: Kanojo no Hada ni Tokeru Konayuki
Spelvin Goolie, Private Eyeball
description: Spelvin Goolie and his friends are your travel partners where 3-D animated mysteries and hundreds of music sequences and sound effects are artfully integrated with English exercises.

title: Koiyasumi Encore!: Everlasting Summer
description: The fourth and last game in the Koiyasumi tetralogy.

title: City Transport Simulator 2026
description: Step into the next generation of urban public transport with City Transport Simulator 2026! Experience the most immersive bus and tram simulation yet, with a dynamic city that reacts to your every decision.

title: Aye! My Liege
description: A grand strategy game set in an alternate history. Lead your noble house to power using a 4-tier command system that allows for granular management of every individual soldier. Master complex industrial chains, navigate tariffs, and balance diplomacy to shape the continent's ultimate fate.

title: G.I.R.L.S. will be Girls
description: A grid based tactical tower defense game set in a fictional Post Apocalyptic world where androids roam the deserted lands. Inspired by the group ITZY and songs Girls will be Girls / Imaginary Friend.

title: Dam Rush XD
description: A fast-paced 2D action platformer where you play as a determined beaver fighting off enemies, dodging hazards, and surviving the wild. Grab you wood to complete your dam and get to the next level!

title: Can I Go Home Yet?
description: Ever sat in class watching the clock, wondering if it's time to leave? Can I Go Home Yet? answers that question — then lets you kill time with a built-in arcade. Check your countdown, then dive into Pong, Snake, Flappy Clock, Brick Breaker, Whack-a-Clock, and an Idle Clicker while you wait. Features live countdowns based on NSW school schedules, public holidays, and seasonal themes.

title: Innbc Starfighter
description: A free-to-play 90s-style bullet-hell shooter with high-res graphics, unlocked 60+ FPS, single-player campaign, and online co-op multiplayer!

title: Vanished Puzzle Quest
