description: Vanished is an immersive, first-person puzzle adventure where an encroaching fog of forgetfulness which has robbed everyone at the Great Centers of Islamic Science of their memories and you must now battle against a mysterious foe to reclaim memory, history, and purpose.

title: Idle Hacking: An Inaction RPG
description: A persistent idle MMORPG, with a text-based hacking theme. Enjoy the "Inaction RPG" design philosophy by crafting equpiment using ARPG influenced prefix/suffix systems, build or join player managed syndicates, trade on the marketplace, and compete in community events.

title: Monday Left Me Broken Collection
description: Monday Left Me Broken is finally on Steam. In this massive collection of every Monday Left Me Broken game to date, you get to solve difficult puzzles; survive a rampage from an evil cat; and collect all of the MLMB cats.

title: MysteryOS
description: You wake up at a terminal you've never seen before. The language is alien. The interface is hostile. Every wrong click has consequences. Decode constructed languages, navigate unfamiliar operating systems, and survive the unknown in this puzzle-survival experience.

title: Jīnyōng Qúnxiá Zhuàn 5
description:
Jinyong Qunxia Zhuan 5 is a well-known fan-made tribute to the classic wuxia RPG Jinyong Qunxia Zhuan. Developed by Wu Yagu and Play Or Away Studio, it is a sandbox wuxia action RPG (ARPG).
In the game, players can either freely create their own exclusive characters to forge a unique jianghu martial hero, or take on the roles of classic characters from Jin Yong’s original novels. From their perspectives and identities, players can roam the martial arts world, personally experience the original storylines, live entirely different jianghu lives, and explore a vast, open and free wuxia realm.

title: C.V.: Watashi to Watashi no Naka no Hito - The Fourth Insider
Death Everywhere, So Save Paranoiacally
description: After a night camping in the forest, Lucy finds herself in unfamiliar territory. However, this journey isn't a normal adventure, the exit road is paved with endless booby traps and dangerous obstacles. Can you find the way out?

title: Last Pirates: Die Together
description: Last Pirates: Die Together is a cooperative pirate-themed horror game designed for up to 4 players. Join a loyal crew of scallywags on a high-stakes mission to scavenge mysterious islands and make your old captain rich.

title: Deadtective Academy
description: At Mystery Academy, training detectives is routine. Dealing with a vampire? Not so much. As mysterious deaths begin to surface, questions begins to arise: is it all just pure coincidence? And who can you trust when danger might be right beside you?

title: Se.Kirara
description: Saki finally made it into Soushin Gakuen with the help and encouragement of his friends. Lifted by his achievement, he feels that it is just one small milestone in his life and he should do the most he can with his life. But everything won’t go smoothly. Together with the girls he meets at the school, he will make the journey to maturity.

title: Cash is King!
description: Welcome to a place where the sun is guaranteed and money is basically part of the beachwear. In this cozy first-person simulation, you start out at Miami Beach, sell, invest, optimize, and make the cash register ring – because in the end, only one thing counts: Cash is King.

title: Wheelie Bad
description: Pilot a wheelchair together and prove you're the superior driver. In this chaotic game, every single crash is definitely your partner's fault. Adapt as the game constantly introduces and mixes new mechanics. Survive the madness, or drive solo to show you were the carry.

title: Click & Mine
description: Click & Mine is a relaxing incremental mining game. Mine various resources and use them to buy upgrades, allowing you to descend deeper and deeper while unlocking new biomes, ores and skills.

title: Trashmageddon: Recycled
description: Trashmageddon: Recycled is an indie tower defense game where you must help your Trashie allies survive hordes of robot Exterminators.

title: The Time Traveler's Lost and Found
description: A spine-breakingly fun shipping warehouse management simulator, where you take the role of a lonely logistics employee going through her workday: dreaming of a nice cup of coffee and a solid dental plan.

title: Breeding Grounds
description: Breeding Grounds is an old school style pure dungeon crawler. Search for power-ups throughout the maze-like levels as you shoot your way through enemies. Defeat the final boss before your health runs out!

title: Padal proshlogodniy sneg
description:
The game is based on the animated film Padal Proshlogodniy Sneg of the same name.

A man falls asleep and has a dream in which a polar bear cub tries to reach a can of condensed milk at a polar station but gets tangled in wires. Waking up and looking at the calendar, the Man realizes that it’s bath day. He sets out to enjoy a steam bath, but the bathhouse suddenly runs away. The Man follows it, traveling through forests, underground tunnels, mountains, and the sea, until he finally reaches the North Pole. There, he finds the bear cub from his dream, helps him return to his family, and also discovers his bathhouse nearby.

Standard point-and-click quest controls. The inventory contains only one combinable item—a magic wand that can change the properties of objects.

title: Padal proshlogodniy sneg 2
description:
The Man is once again scolded by his Wife, who throws his magic wand out the window. The Man runs after it, but it turns out the wand hits a crow and transforms it into Zmey Gorynych, which carries the hero off to distant lands.

The Man must travel through a snowy forest and meet Baba Yaga, who sends him to the Thrice-Ninth Kingdom. There, the hero must follow the path of a tsarevich, infiltrate the castle of Koschei the Deathless, and finally return home, avoiding his злую Wife.

Standard point-and-click quest controls. Some inventory items can be combined, and the magic wand—always present in your inventory—can transform objects.

title: Nightfall Protocol
description: A hardcore PVE extraction shooter where you will face off against deadly anomalous entities, while you uncover the secrets behind the Nightfall Protocol. Plan your next steps carefully as you are trying to pull back humanity from the brink of annihilation.

title: Kurotsuki
description: An atmospheric action slasher in mythic medieval Japan. Hunt corrupted spirits, face challenging Souls-like bosses, and master fast, skill-based combat. Explore a world of folklore, uncover hidden secrets, and unlock intimate, fully consensual encounters shaped by your choices.

title: Yuri Love Slave: Watashi dake no Iinchou
Life Effect Survival
description: Survive in a harsh and dangerous world after an alien invasion. Gather resources, craft equipment, fight mutants and massive monsters, use weapons, vehicles and robots, explore territories, defend strongholds and fight for survival.

title: Astralyte
description: Mine rocks, gather materials, and craft crystals in a calm, system-driven world. A relaxing single-player experience focused on mining, progression, and discovery.

title: ShpML5
description: Net-art group Kreguzda presents. Tomorrow is the Hundred-Fivehundred-First lunar day. This day is good for fasting. Do not eat anything among the lines of: dairy, fried, boiled, saltcium, iodine, mercury, plutonium, chebureks 2D, chebureks 3D, pies with HTML and other useful substances. Stay healthy!

title: Liquid Lungs
description: Liquid Lungs is a high-speed FPS blending fluid parkour with intense combat. Inspired by free-running action games and fast-paced shooters, it delivers a seamless mix of movement and marksmanship in a dystopian world. Run, jump, and fight in a nonstop adrenaline rush where every motion counts.

title: Apart
description: APART Is a third-person adventure game that follows an undead child with a severed arm companion whose bond seems to defy death. Survive and explore a world plunged into darkness after a tech breakthrough turns biological remains into humanity’s most valuable energy source.

title: Blood Gauntlet
description: Blood Gauntlet is a fast-paced, pixel art action platformer where you’re constantly bleeding out. The only way to survive is to keep moving and destroy everything in your path!

title: House Builder: Paving & Driveways DLC
description: Lay, cut, and color paving stones using specialized machines. Design paths, driveways, and gardens with endless patterns and styles. Bring your dream outdoor spaces to life, from backyard paths to car driveways!

title: Bunker 1024
description: Manage a bunker. Protect survivors. Outsmart a rogue AI. Bunker 1024 is a first person survival management game where you craft tech, maintain critical systems, and deliver aid as time grows thin - all while Lumina 6.0 studies your patterns and actively works against your routines.

title: Mermaid's Cove
description:
The depths of the sea call for her. Will she relinquish it all for the sake of "freedom"?
"Just what does it take to become..."free"?"

title: Forestress Shade
description: Forestress Shade is a strategy puzzle game that combines roguelike elements with chess. Command, battle, win, and acquire new animals. Control your animal army, defeat the approaching enemies, and venture to the edge of the deadshade forest.

title: Non Eternals
description: A single-player command action RPG with MMORPG-style combat. Features a quirky system where placing skill commands next to the UI boosts their power! Rescue the creators from the Dark Lord, who manifests their inner darkness as monsters!

title: Alchemia Rogue: Mia and the Mystery Labyrinth
description: Mia, an apprentice alchemist, takes on the Alchemy Roguelike RPG. Featuring classic turn-based roguelike gameplay, the Alchemy system brings new layers of strategy to your adventure. Gather materials, transmute powerful items, and conquer the dungeon!

title: Sunset Before New Year
description: The last sunset of 2024 on Bentenjima. Based on real experience.

title: Magical Mishaps
description: Caelum University: a well respected school for training young adults in the ways of magic. They've just opened their doors to smaller fantasy races such as Fairies, and even Gnomes such as yourself! Luckily for you, you've been accepted to study at the prestigious college among the giants and chase your dreams of becoming a powerful wizard. Unluckily for you, it seem the school's regulations to keep smaller students safe are still in development, and there have been numerous... accidents... around the school. Not to mention an infestation of tiny goblins in the school has made it even harder for the larger students to tell you apart from common vermin, making your life here at the university even more dangerous. Build relationships with your attractive classmates and maybe even earn yourself some alone time with them - if you can avoid being stepped on them by accident first. Help the school deal with the goblin infestation and distinguish yourself from the tiny menace. Learn all you can about the ways of magic - or slack off and have some fun; either way, your decisions have consequences good or bad. Uncover the school's dark secrets - there's more danger here than just getting to class unharmed.

title: The Minimum Project
description:
Hiroshi, an average if vertically-challenged student at Saisho Academy agrees to assist the science club president with one of her newest inventions. Something goes terribly wrong and he finds himself stuck at 1/100th of his normal height. Seek out someone to help you grow back while trying (or not) to avoid getting killed by unaware or malicious giantesses!

This is an adventure-style game created in RPG maker with scripted events, CGs, animations, and minigames.

The game also contains a few battle scenes, but they play out more like an event/minigame. There is no random enemy encounters or grinding in a conventional RPG sense in this game.

There is also an affection / affinity system in the game. How you interact with the characters will influence future dialogue / events with those characters.

title: Fangstorm
description: You are the defense. Fight in brutal first-person melee, unleash devastating abilities, and build lethal defenses to crush relentless goblin sieges. Rise as a godlike force with deep, persistent progression forged from endless carnage.

title: Huntin' Buddies
description: A 4-player online co-op hunting game set in a forbidden national park. Hunt wildlife to meet dangerous quotas, drag massive carcasses with your friends and evade the creatures that begin hunting you back.

title: Fling Up Together
description: Fling up together is a chaotic co-op physics platformer 2-4 Players where one fling yeets everyone! Solve color-based puzzles, climb together (or fall together), and laugh your way through a vibrant Arabian-inspired world.

title: The Dragon and the Sword
description: Clea’s parents were murdered by a “dragon”―a creature that shouldn’t even exist. Determined to find it and gain the strength to slay it, she steps onto the adventurer’s path. When four individuals, each driven by different motives yet bound by a single purpose, come together, their story takes a dramatic turn...

title: Kokutoto
description: Beyond Good and Evil: What Will You Choose in This Ambiguity? KOKUTOTO is a multi-ending adventure game that questions the realm beyond good and evil. Its compact length lets you experience the bleak aspects of modern society and make nerve-wracking scenario choices. What ending will you reach?

title: Dreams Far Away
description: This game offers a first-person platforming experience for up to 8 players. After a mutated rabies virus began to threaten life on Earth, humanity found refuge in safe cities built in the sky. Overcome obstacles to reach the safe city — and be the first to get there.

title: Harsh Reigns
description: “Harsh Reigns” is a roguelike single-player RPG with simple controls. Advance forward and defeat enemies using items and diverse character builds to reach the goal.

title: Colours of Courage
description: The Colours of Courage is a story-driven adventure where players help Sky navigate challenges, support others, and grow emotional strengths. Through choices, fun mini games, and exploration, the game turns resilience, empathy, and mindset into an interactive journey.

title: Home Invader
description: A first-person psychological stealth thriller set inside a private villa. Infiltrate, gather critical intel, steal what you can, and escape unnoticed where silence is your only protection & every sound you make could be your last.

title: Catjong 4: Secrets of the Purramids
description: Catjong returns with a cute feline companion! Play 200 handcrafted mahjong-3 levels, restore lost desert beauty, and uncover the shimmering Secrets of the Purramids.

title: 8 Ball Pro Online
description: 3D 8-ball pool game; featuring spin control, jump shots, and various game modes. Aim your shots, adjust the ball's position, and clear the table. Play against the computer, challenge a friend locally, or compete in online PvP.

title: Pixel Pile
description: Stack, Assemble, and battle— Puzzle precision decides the battle! "Shape" your path to victory! Customize your "Shape" too! A falling-block puzzle where you create "Shape" based on challenges. Solo play, local, and online battles available.

title: 6 Floors
description: You find yourself in a strange place and the only way out is within. Navigate liminal corridors and rooms filled with psychological terrors as you traverse all six floors of this mysterious place in order to save your soul.

title: Ghost in the Feed
description: Dive into the supernatural atmosphere of Ghost in the Feed! Monitor cameras to spot spectral anomalies across haunted maps. Test your memory and vigilance to survive the night or succumb to paranormal dread!

title: Doll Is Back
description: What if every toy had a soul? Play as Lily, a discarded doll, on a desperate journey to reunite with her owner. In this 3D side-scrolling horror, you must hide, run, and survive against giant, soulless toys driven by madness.

title: Scene No.0
description: Pulled from a theater into the screen, survive cinematic horrors in this 1-4 player co-op. Beyond running, gather clues and exorcise unique spirits across diverse film genres to escape back to reality. Can you solve the mystery before the final credits roll?

title: Hushed
description: HUSHED is a 1-4 player co-op horror game where silence is survival. Find and collect ritual items, and complete the ritual while avoiding an entity that hears everything. The more you progress, the more dangerous it becomes.

title: Stack Chaos: Alien Express
description: A physics-based arcade game where you pilot a UFO dropping possessed horror objects to build impossible towers. Swing the pendulum, time the drop, pray it doesn't collapse. 400+ objects, 11 game modes, and a sarcastic goblin that roasts your every move.

title: MyMemory
description: MYMEMORY is an RPGMaker horror game set in the SCP Foundation universe. Play through Camille's memories as she is contained and classified as SCP-9831. Play through her life and explore her story. Is the Foundation hiding something? Does Camille know about... you?

title: Russian Village Business
description: Become a young entrepreneur who arrives in the Russian countryside and opens a village shop. Buy and sell goods, upgrade your store, and make this village great again - just like in the good old days!

title: MageML
description: MageML is a competitive arena brawler where two teams clash in fast paced combat. Pick from a diverse roster of fighters, mages, vanguards, healers, assassins, and marksmen, each with unique abilities.

title: Alchemist Watch
description: You're trapped in an Alchemist's Study, reliving the same day over and over. Use telekinesis to fix or destroy physics-based anomalies, break the loop, and escape.

title: Holface
description: Upon visiting his decrepit and dying grandfather, Isaac discovers an ancient evil that has parasitically dwelled within his ancestry for generations. Isaac must stop the parasite's symbiotic cycle from reoccurring or else become its new host.

title: Frostpunk 2: Breach of Trust
description: Step into a trial by fire in the new DLC and guide your people through volcanic chaos in a brand-new, massive scenario. Can you survive the fallout?

title: Terminal Mass
description: The “Domain” exists as a mass of cold concrete, twisted monsters, and chaotic anomalies. You are an “Agent” sent to ensure it does not reach “Terminal Mass”. Complete missions. Upgrade your weaponry. Access deeper and darker sectors of the Domain. Will you defeat the horrors that lie at its core?

title: Quiet Soul
description: A cooperative psychological horror where the house manipulates each player differently. Share clues, question reality, and find out who — if anyone — makes it out together.

title: Sunlit Journey
description: Sunlit Journey: The Town Small Town is a short, heartwarming visual novel. As the opening chapter of an ongoing series, it centers on gentle everyday life and tells a tender encounter set in a quiet small town.

title: You vs. Zombies
description: Dodge, weave, and hurl spells through hordes of undead in this sardonic time-traveling roguelite starring YOU! Describe any hero, unleash them on the apocalypse, kill zombies, fix time and stuff, save the world, oh and try not to lose your marbles. Easy.

title: Echoes of Meda
description: Echoes of Meda is a top-down Roguelite where you battle waves of enemies, build powerful ability loadouts and collect powerful items that shape each run. Your goal is to fight through escalating stages filled with tougher enemies and bosses, all while doing everything you can to survive.

title: HH Trap: Reality’s Glitch
description: Join martial artist ''Maika" as she braves a perilous dungeon, only to fall into cunning trap that twists reality. Miss the subtle anomalies and her sharp mind risks transforming into a shameless seductress, lost forever.

title: Deathward
description: Seek Death as you face dangerous foes, solve puzzles, and explore forgotten dungeons to become the ultimate necromancer.

title: Greda Inferno
description: A master potter arrives in hell under mysterious circumstances. With your skills, you must craft pieces for the inhabitants of the underworld. Survive, improve your creations, meet your new neighbors, and try to uncover the mysteries of the depths.

title: Which Sausage, Mate?
description: You lost your coal mine job, now you're a cashier at Poland's landmark convenience store. Scan groceries, verify IDs, grill hot dogs, and try to feed your family on what's left. A dark comedy about surviving late stage capitalism, one receipt at a time.

title: Catch the Chiken
description: A clicker game. The player must sit and watch the screen attentively, waiting for a chicken to run past, and then click on it with the mouse to catch it.

title: ChatAid
description: When you found a wacky program on your PC called “ChatAid”, you ended up in a chatroom. Someone needs your help.

title: Dark Nights: Reflections
description: Dark Nights - Reflections is a horror/romance visual novel featuring 2 new branching storylines

title: Cliché Quest
description: A retro-inspired RPG made for beginners, newcomers, and anyone who just wants a cozy, classic adventure.

title: There's Nothing Down There
description: There's Nothing Down There is a short undersea horror exploration game. Descend into a sinkhole at the bottom of the ocean and discover the remains of a lost, yet not dead, civilization.

title: Celsius Strays
description: "Banished. Hunted. Yet, we endure." Become the Chief of the Squealers and lead your people through a futuristic wasteland fraught with danger where every choice is about survival.

title: Mooooon
description:
You play as Cow, a cow who has always wanted to jump over the moon! Luckily, their friends have figured out a way it might just be possible...

Jump through interesting levels and speak to a cast of silly characters as you make your way there!

title: A Mansion on the Hill
description:
You ache for revenge.

This is a story about the oligarch that destroyed your family, and your decision to kill him (or not).

title: RTFM
description: Solve puzzles and stay one step ahead of [redacted] in this co-op tech support simulator. One player, the Troubleshooter, uses the User Manual to troubleshoot for the Terminal Operator, who must convey what’s on the screen. Players must work together — or not — in this atmospheric game of trust and communication.

title: Shrink with a Succubus
description: A giantess-themed combat game. You will be summoning and being chased by a giant succubus. You have to survive as much as possible before she catches you.

title: Gun Glade
description:
Round-Based Battle Royale.
Spawn into The Glade, loot unique weapons, and survive an ever-shrinking zone in classic last-man standing BR.

The first team to win 3 rounds wins the entire game.
Battle Royale.
Another Round.
Kill. Die. Repeat.

title: The End of the World Club
description: A cute coming-of-age boys' love (BL/yaoi) visual novel set in 2012 about a group of high school students who start a club to prepare for the end of the world.

title: Artdink Game Log: Aquanaut’s Holiday
description: The deep-sea exploration adventure that captivated countless players is back. What you discover in this underwater world brimming with freedom and challenges is entirely up to you. Follow your curiosity and make the most of your day off.

title: Miseria
description: Miseria is a dark fantasy–themed idle incremental game in which you lead a party of damned souls through the depths of the world.

title: Nickelodeon Extreme Tennis: Next!
description: Challenge a friend to a tennis match where you can play as SpongeBob, Aang, and all your Nickelodeon favorites in fast-paced, local split-screen action!

title: 101 Cats in Rio de Janeiro
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Rio de Janeiro landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: 101 Cats in Saint Petersburg
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Saint Petersburg landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: 101 Cats in Florence
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Florence landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: 101 Cats in Dublin
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Dublin landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Anna Redux
description: You have been invited to a grand cruise wedding, However, as night falls, you find yourself lying in the hallway, life comes to an abrupt end. The truth lurks in the shadows of fate, And you, are the only one who can reveal it.

title: Lovely Anime Puzzle: Easter
description: Lovely Anime Puzzle: Easter is a fun and rewarding puzzle game. Assemble charming Easter-themed pictures, sharpen your attention, and immerse yourself in a festive holiday world.

title: Taj Mod
description: Taj Mod is a fan-made reimagining of SCP:SL built on its 8.0.1 Revision III version or "Megapatch 1". It's a culmination of SCP: Secret Lab over the years including things from the past and present, as well as adding some long requested features like crouching and a variety of Human models! Taj Mod will also support a wide array of server customization for Server Hosts. With changeable LCZ Labels on release and LCZ/EZ Colors later on alongside Custom Classes. So whether you want a classic vibe with the return of the P90 and Femur Breaker, or a breath of fresh air with new consistent rooms and beautiful lighting + effects, Taj Mod has something for you... Can also be pronounced as "Tai"!

title: Creature Feature
description:
Creature Feature is a bullet heaven set inside a cursed 80s arcade cartridge. Fight through waves of glitched creatures, evolve weapons into devastating final forms, hunt ARPG loot with random affixes, and try not to notice when the game starts corrupting itself around you.

Featuring 7 playable characters, endless weapon combinations and evolutions, a full ARPG loot system with 60 unique items, a persistent skill tree, 4 maps, 6 difficulty modes, online leaderboards, and full controller support.

title: Core Diggers
description: Core Diggers is a co-op sci-fi digging game for up to 6 players. Explore an alien planet, excavate rare minerals, discover underground alien artifacts, sell your haul, and upgrade your tools and gear. Work together, dig deeper, and uncover what lies at the planet’s core.

title: Sad Virus Jungle
description: New part sad virus walking game series. Now collect beer bottles at forest jungle and avoid deathly traps

title: Sad Virus Cave
description: Walking simulation and platformer game. Control sad virus in cave enviroment and try find all beer bottles and avoid traps

title: Anime Fart Simulator
description: "I farted, but I’m too pretty to blame." A single-player fart-stealth simulation where you complete your beach bucket list without getting caught letting it rip.

title: Emoji Wars
description: Emoji Wars is an exciting game inspired by the classic naval battle, where bright and funny emojis are used instead of ships.

title: Imprint
description: Imprint is an atmospheric adventure which traps you inside a decaying family computer. Navigate forgotten photo albums and abandoned programs from the past. Solve puzzles in binary and hexadecimal; think like the machine. Can you find your way out? Or will you be trapped forever in the files?

title: Souper Bloody
description: Slaughter the vegetables that accidentally summoned your demonic self in this devilishly tasty action-packed roguelite hack-and-slash! Upgrade your attacks and gain new spicy powers every run while exploring the depths of the Underlasagne.

title: Wherever You Get Your Podcasts
description: Spooky Sacramento is a podcast that investigates the unexplained in the greater Sacramento Area. While touring the infamous Dyer Lane, the show’s hosts and their live audience disappeared. Become a podcast editor, repair audio files, and find them before the hard drive dies!

title: SnowRunner: Season 16 - High Voltage
description: Welcome to Washington! High Voltage tasks you with building a hydropower plant across 3 large maps with the help of 3 new trucks. Season 16 is SnowRunner’s fourth expansion and is included in the Year 4 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

title: Ritual Static
description: "Do you think a house can dream?" Ritual Static is a surreal first-person photography horror game following a young man in his childhood home the day before a big move. Surf the television, sink into static, and rot in the dark.

title: Don't Break the Egg
description: Don't Break the Egg is a multiplayer platformer where you control an egg in a sack and hop through challenging obstacle courses. Play alone or with up to 4 players locally or online and try to reach the finish without breaking.

title: MicroFab
description: Build automated chip factories in a post-collapse 2047. Process silicon wafers, research advanced tech, and scale from basic processors to legendary quantum chips. Optimize your production lines, outmaneuver mega-corps, and dominate the semiconductor market.

title: Ultra Mega Dungeon 64
description: N64-inspired action roguelike featuring twin-stick combat, escalating monster waves, powerful loot, and a relentless climb toward a final boss.

title: Disquieted
description: Disquieted is a hand-drawn action platformer set between a dreamlike Naples and an underground world distorted by anxiety. As Connie, fight, dodge, choose power-ups, and face the demons hiding beneath the city.

title: Indignum
description: Indignum is an open-world action adventure game where mastery of the blade meets the power of the elements. Wield fast-paced, parry-based combat and harness fire, water, earth, and air to survive the wilds of Elador. Forge your destiny and claim the throne that is rightfully yours.

title: She Hungers
description: Swim in this sapphic incremental game about a rage-filled siren who falls in love with the woman sent to hunt her. Upgrade your powers, unlock relationship progression, gather resources, explore oceans and protect the one meant to kill you.

title: Welcome Demon
description: You are a dungeon warden. Sitting in the chair of the previous warden you killed, you must cleanse yourself of your sins within 666 hours. Place the incoming demons into six different dungeons based on your information, intuition, and limited resources.

title: Sudoku
description: Sudoku is a simple and clear number-puzzle game. The goal is easy to understand: fill the grid so each row, column, and 3×3 box contains the numbers 1 to 9 with no repeats. No math required, just logic.

title: The Cook in the Court of the Count
description: Chop till you drop in The Cook in the Court of the Count, a frantic time management game created for the Chicaghoul 2025 game jam! Weave your way through the treacherous kitchen within the walls of the Count's haunted castle to feed Dracula's ravenous army!

title: Sadko
description: Monsters are closing in from all sides, and all you've got is a gusli… and the letter O? Dynamic combat with Slavic folk music, hero progression, and building a unique build to take on each location and its boss - so you can finally face Koschei himself.

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Whispers of the Wind
description: The 22nd free update for Disney Dreamlight Valley brings new content inspired by Disney's Pocahontas - including the titular heroine as a Villager and Meeko as a Companion. It also included Olaf's Grand Exhibition as a new feature and started the Elements of Nature Star Path.

title: Instant Sports 2
description: Instant Sports 2 delivers fast-paced, easy-to-pick-up gameplay with depth for players looking to master each discipline.

title: Kurohi
description:
Explore interconnected areas, uncover hidden secrets, and unlock powerful abilities as you fight your way through deranged bosses and discover a mysterious world filled with danger, lore, and unexpected twists.

Kurohi combines tight platforming, overhead exploration, and arcade-style space shooter gameplay, creating a dynamic adventure that shifts between multiple styles of play. This represents an era of passion for retro gaming, pixel art, and authentic handheld development.

title: No Man's Sky: Xeno Arena
description: No Man's Sky XENO ARENA introduces turn-based creature battles! Explore the universe to assemble a team of creature companions, perfect their genetic makeup, and test their mettle at simulated combat arenas. Discover hundreds of unique battle abilities, challenge new alien characters, share your strategies for daily challenges, and more!

title: SnowRunner: Season 17 - Repair & Rescue
description: Welcome to Zurdania! Breathe new life into the region by helping locals rehabilitate fields, renovate historical landmarks and boost tourism. Season 17: Repair & Rescue is included in the Year 5 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

title: SnowRunner: Season 18 - Patch & Power
description: Patch & Power Season of Snowrunner. Included in the Year 5 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

title: SnowRunner: Season 19 - Research & Restore
description: Research & Restore Season of Snowrunner. Included in the Year 5 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

title: SnowRunner: Season 20
description: Season 20 of Snowrunner. Included in the Year 5 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

title: A Heart Of Iron
description: A mini game where you romance Simon from outside the Iron Lung. Be sure to be wise in his aid, something small could lead to greater consequence.

title: Fred Fuches Around
description: Fred Fuches Around is an FPS video game about a retired super soldier who goes on a rampage, purging the current government because they unjustly killed his family in front of him. Your goal is to purge the government in other places, although more than them are attacking you. Enemies may come in waves in some areas. The game features: A "brutality" system where you can violently kill your foes, tutorials (yay), a lot of running and jumping (platforming), and fast-paced gameplay. ranking system (Doesn't unlock important stuff), and a lot of weapons (27, to be exact).

title: Airport Security Sucks!
description: Embody your inner power-tripping TSA agent and hunt down other players attempting to blend in and smuggle contraband past you. Control the crowd and your problematic K9 with authoritative voice commands, and use "compliance devices" to apprehend smugglers making mischief or hiding in plain sight.

title: Everlost
description: Stranded in a world that never stops growing. Gather, craft, build and survive in an infinite procedurally generated wilderness where no two worlds are ever the same.

title: The Book of Outcasts
description: A disgraced former soldier is recruited into a secretive order of royal investigators to find a rogue mage, but becomes caught up in the politics of a mysterious order of undying wizards and travelling from icy forests to exotic jungles in this RPG dungeon crawler and management sim.

title: Hostyle
description: Hostyle follows agent Cryptic's job interview to become an assassin for the most corrupt company on earth. This fast-paced 3D platformer combines stylish movement options alongside a futuristic but nostalgic Y2K aesthetic.

title: Expeditions: A MudRunner Game - Season 1: Cave Odyssey
description: The scientific community is on the verge of a major discovery and they need you to lead the expedition into newly uncovered caves. Take the wheel of two new vehicles and ride across a new map and huge underground biome.

title: Expeditions: A MudRunner Game - Season 3: Icy Shores
description: Venture further into the remote Carpathian Mountains to assist scientists in making new discoveries. Push through thick mud and melting snow, tread carefully along icy riverbanks, and descend into tight Transylvanian caves in the name of progress.

title: Expeditions: A MudRunner Game - Season 2: White Dawn
description: Conquer the uncharted, snowy peaks of the Carpathian Mountains and help scientists to conduct their research for only the most experienced explorers can tame the dangerousness of the mountains. Dive into dark caverns to pursue major discoveries.

title: Snap Game
description: A chaotic multiplayer building game where creativity and teamwork collide. Build together, experiment freely, and see what wild ideas you and your friends can create.

title: Flounder
description: From cozy to crazy. A fishy roguelite. Discover a colorful roster of fish, menacing bosses and dynamic items, all with their own tricks to master. Catch rare fish to fill your virtual fish tank and complete your collection. Survive the boss incursions and surface victorious! The depth is deceiving.

title: AeroWave OS
description: AeroWave OS is a singleplayer rhythm game with a nostalgic aesthetic based on the 2000’s. With graphics based on the older Windows Vista and 7 operational systems, you play songs with a virtual mascot, with the mission to destroy computer viruses, maintaining your computer clean of malware.

title: Neofeud 2
description: Neofeud 2 is an immersive Dystopian Cyberpunk point and click adventure game that features hand-painted visuals, emotive voice acting, and a strong sense of political satire.

title: Saoirse
description: Eight people are trapped in an abandoned neurotech facility. The only hope for escape is by surviving deathgames based on scans of each other's minds.

title: Traysia
description: Enjoy the nostalgia of classic RPGs! “Traysia” is a full-scale role-playing game made up of five scenarios, offering a definitive fantasy romance of love and adventure.

title: Roll Mad
description: Roll Into The Madness

title: Make it! Gyoza
description:
Get ready for a delicious gyoza-making challenge!
Make lots of gyoza and watch your food cart prosper!

title: Abyssal Sun
description: A survival game full of whimsies and eldritch mysteries. Enter a world full of unexplored surprises, strange creatures and unxpected dangers. Build your foothold and gather your allies to survive as a single dot of light in the abyss.

title: Throne of Shards
description: A dark TCG where you explore a massive dungeon, collect cards, and fight brutal battles. Each floor introduces its own unique rules, twisting the experience in this classic card adventure.

title: Leaky Business
description: A deckbuilder where you expand your deck, take on tougher jobs, and literally stack your reputation to build the ultimate leak fixing business!

title: Skyblitz
description: Skyblitz is a fast-paced helicopter action game with instant, arcade-style control. No sim physics, no wasted time. Engage in explosive, objective-driven missions, outmaneuver missile fire, and unravel a conspiracy that threatens to reignite global war.

title: The Eclipse Files
description: A dice-driven, Lovecraftian tactical RPG. Explore, solve mysteries, and battle on the strategic grid. Command your investigators between sanity and madness. Choose wisely—uncover the truth before the lurking madness consumes you.

title: Mimikaki Collect
description: Operate an ear pick to clear "ear debris = mimigomi" from inside an ear. There are various types of debris, and removing them earns you money. Use your earnings to purchase new ear-cleaning tools and furniture. Decorate your own unique room with the furniture you acquire.

title: UFO 50 Nonograms
description:
UFO 50 Nonograms is an unofficial fangame of Mossmouth's UFO 50.

If you enjoy Nonograms and UFO 50, this game is quite literally made for you.

After a crash-landing on Zoldath, you must repair the Campanella by solving Nonogram puzzles. UFO 50 Nonograms is also an incremental game. As you solve puzzles, you will collect resources which will allow you help out others and craft upgrades.

title: Zukarii
description:
Zukarii: The Descent is a 2.5D isometric dungeon crawler with ARPG-style loot, stats, and progression. The current release is a public version of a dev test build.

You have been studying and training with the Zukaran masters for years. Now your time has come. You have been chosen to enter Zurath and prove your worth. Success means becoming a member of the order with access to secret mysteries of the arcane! Failure means death!

Can you overcome the denizens of the long abandoned fortress and claim your place in the circle of the Zukarii?

Whispers Yet Echo

title: Parting Shadows
description: Parting Shadows is a JRPG with ATB combat, branching narratives, and local co-op. Choose from 6 classes with 34 unique upgrade paths across three stories where your decisions lead to completely different battles, party compositions, and endings. Features 3v3 party combat with three difficulty tiers.

title: Fear the Flesh
description: A group of Antarctic researchers discover a perfectly preserved meteorite. Isolated in their remote base, their excitement turns into terror after a late-night experiment goes wrong.

title: Radiance of Annihilation: Disorder Eclipse
description: In a post-apocalyptic world, a government employee works together with his partner to stop criminals from uncovering weapons that once devastated the world, only to get caught in a conspiracy that could decide humanity's fate. Follow Ikusu and uncover a dark conspiracy in this classic visual novel experience.

title: SnowRunner: Year 5 Pass
description: The Year 5 Pass allows you to expand your SnowRunner experience by granting you access to four seasons of content, including new vehicles, new skins, new missions, new maps to explore and more.

title: Ship Graveyard Simulator 3
description: Welcome to the biggest ship graveyard in the world! Grab your hammer, start up the heavy machinery, and experience the ultimate shipbreaking. Explore a living town, hire workers to expand your ship graveyard in a completely new level of realism, scale, and freedom!

title: Victim's Tongue
description: Victim's Tongue is an unpredictable, narrative-driven psychological horror game that is primarily composed of a series of punishing mini-games or tasks orchestrated by the main villain. With the completion of each bringing you closer to the harsh truth.

title: SnowRunner: 5-Year Anniversary Edition
description: SnowRunner's 5-Year Anniversary Edition includes the base game as well as the Year 1, Year 2, Year 3, Year 4 and Year 5 Passes.

title: Bouncy Kingdoms
description: Bouncy Kingdoms is a toybox fantasy adventure game! Explore an open-world and meet fun characters!

title: Bonereader
description: A card-based deckbuilder with dice mechanics. Executed in an electric chair, you awaken in a shamanic, mescaline-fueled Purgatory inspired by Castaneda and McCarthy, where you battle spirits in games of chance for a shot at rebirth.

title: Pokor
description: Pokor is a story-driven roguelike tactical turn-based card RPG. Players take on the role of Heart, commanding a deck of playing card soldiers to engage in turn-based battles against enemies as they venture deeper into a vast, pale, and ever-changing palace to uncover the truth and the true self.

title: Supermaneuver
description: Retro flightcade action; dogfight in the past's future with next generation aircraft over a war-torn country as a privateer combat pilot. Choose a path, fight a war, and immerse yourself in the world of 20XX.

title: Jurassic Differences
description: Get ready to travel back in time with Jurassic Differences, a spot the difference adventure packed with prehistoric thrills and visual surprises!

title: Zoo Clues
description: Get ready to go wild with Zoo Clues, a spot the difference adventure packed with animal antics and visual surprises!

title: Trialspire
description: Fight your way through an endless tower packed with monsters and treasures. Every run is a new chance to survive, adapt, and reach the 33rd floor.

title: Jonathan's Adventure! Pricker Edition
description: A gang of misfits are brought by an ambitious director to work on a film based on their adventures, however, not everything is what it's promised to be.

title: The Alchemist's Cards
description: The Alchemist's Cards is a casual 2D visual novel with card-based mechanics. Grow plants, brew potions, then sell or use them in battle! Explore the kingdom of Navitea, uncover secrets, and fight your way out of debt in this charming adventure.

title: Hua-Z
description: You need to survive wave after wave of zombie hordes with your teammates. There are characters with various abilities to choose from. Cooperate with each other and upgrade equipment to try to survive longer.

title: Glenwich Idle MMO
description: Welcome to the land of Glenwich, where adventurers gather resources, forge weapons, and battle through dungeons while AFK. Train 14 skills, discover hundreds of recipes, and trade on the player-driven exchange. Form parties with up to 5 players to conquer brutal dungeons and claim legendary loot.

title: Samuel Prince Attorney at Law: Chapter 4
description: The fourth of seven chapters of a courtroom battle style visual novel, in which the story follows brand new lawyer Samuel Prince as he solves a strange variety of different crimes. Investigate the crime scene for evidence, then use it in court to find the real truth behind the case.

title: Inkremental
description: Inkremental is a short incremental game about splattering paint across canvases by bursting blobs of color. Revisit iconic artworks with a humorous twist, unlock upgrades, and take down quirky mini‑bosses as you bring each masterpiece to life.

title: Strange Cases: The Faces of Vengeance
Making Lovers: First Blush
description:
While you're helping out as an audio tech at the Shionari Tanabata festival, you cross paths with four unique girls. Each of them is charming in her own way, but while you're open to the idea of dating, you firmly believe that one should only date someone who is obviously your fated partner, and that the signs will all be there. But then you all end up in the same mystical place at the same time, so what if one of them is...?

Read this amusing story about a stubborn protagonist and the four cute girls with whom he has some sort of connection, and see how he grows to consider whether destiny really is as heavy-handed as he thinks.

title: My Dearest Direst Disaster
description: A new version of Sasasagu that adds 5 new post-game scenarios and new CGs, as well as revisions to all already existing CGs and character portraits.

title: Prove You're Human
description:
An AI dares to dream she is human. You’ve been hired to put her in her place.

Prove You're Human splits the main character in two, and you drew the short straw. You're the digital copy of a person who was paid to test a corporate product. But the product is convinced it's as human as you are. Maybe even more.

title: Lost Railway
description: A co-op 2D quota horror game with cute animals and terrifying monsters. Assemble a team of up to 4 players and venture into the depths of the nightmare for valuable loot, tools and secrets. Because the train must always move forward!

title: Cairn: On the Trail - Deep Water
description: New climbing locations, fresh problems, same freedom to climb!

title: Crop
description: A gritty farming thriller where your safety depends on the yield. Bound to a dying farm, you must dig, plant, irrigate, and cut your way through the decay. Uncover buried secrets, both in the soil and quietly brewing within the village. The only way out is through the harvest.

title: Machine Party
description: Machine Party is a collection of violent party games where failure is lethal. Gather your friends and endure high stakes situations to prove your life is worth more than theirs. Survival is unlikely.

title: Anbennar: A Fantasy Total Conversion
description:
Anbennar is a meticulously crafted fantasy world, famous for its total conversion in Europa Universalis IV, where we explored the early modern era of this D&D-esque setting.
Now, the project leaps into the 19th century and the Age of Industry, forcing its magical societies to confront Victorian-era crises.

title: Temtem: Pioneers
description: Survive and explore an untamed frontier in Temtem: Pioneers. Tame and become a roster of 200+ Temtem and master their unique abilities in fast, real-time combat. Build, craft, battle, and discover new creatures solo, or co-op with your friends in this open world survival crafting adventure.

title: Brotato: Primal Dread
description: Brotato is a top-down arena shooter roguelite where you play a potato wielding up to 6 weapons at a time to fight off hordes of aliens. Choose from a variety of traits and items to create unique builds and survive until help arrives.

title: Graveyard Keeper II
description: The most inaccurate medieval cemetery sim is back! Restore The Town, manage the graveyard, automate production, lead your undead army into battle and turn the zombie problem into a thriving business! Graveyard Keeper 2 is the grotesque sequel that's deeper than six feet, and more unhinged than ever!

title: Risk of Rain 2: Hallowed Concepts
description: Death comes for us all - Overcome powerful curses, strange new enemies and deadly trials as two new Survivors but never forget for a moment She is watching.

title: Too Deep To Quit
description: Grab your gear and your friends for a hilarious, golden-age co-op adventure! Dive into cursed temples, hunt for the ultimate treasure, and work together to stay alive. Beware of everything and everyone... after all, only the survivors get to split the gold!

title: Bold: Networked Newt Action
description: Bold: Networked Newt Action redefines multiplayer stealth action for the modern day, with a return to classic Spies vs Mercs style 2v2 asymmetrical gameplay in a dark Sci-Fi world with anthropomorphic animals. 3rd person stealth is pitted against 1st person action in maps set across exotic locales!

title: Don't Starve Elsewhere
description: Dont Starve returns with an all-new uncompromising survival experience. Band together with friends to craft, farm, build and explore a world filled with strange creatures, lurking shadows, and dynamic environmental dangers.

title: CrackSword
description: A lo-fi fantasy slasher hand-drawn in colored pencil. Sketchy swords, weird physics, surreal magic cards, and ragdoll puppets with a serious grudge against their master.

title: Financial Freedom
description: Why can't games teach as much as books? I read 50 business books and trainings and made a short funny game about a businessman's journey. Follow the story from a factory worker 🧑‍ to a millionaire!

title: M.A.Y.A
description: Take on the role of sci-fi warrior Maya. Capture uplinks, master a complex move-set along with weapon upgrades, and survive on a hostile planet.

title: Model Kit Shop Simulator
description: Build and run your own hobby shop in this first-person store management sim. Order stock, fill shelves, set prices, match kits with paints through the Hobby Basket System, and let customers bring their projects to life at Build Tables.

title: Solheim
description: Tower defence meets roguelite on a moving fortress. Craft towers from blueprints, stack powerful augments, and fight through escalating biomes in Solheim, a dark fantasy TD unlike any other.

title: Drunk Woodcutter
description: Chop wood, drink beer, hack yourself in the kneecap. A physics-based incremental sim about splitting firewood, increasingly ridiculous equipment, and bad judgment.

title: Koshmar: The Last Reverie
description: When a city falls to a sleeping plague, nightmares rise up. Awaken the city as a mortician’s daughter who walks the line between the sleeping and the waking. Fight through the dreams, seal the rifts, make choices that chip away at who she is, try to become the nightmare that nightmares fear.

title: CardForge
description: CardForge is a single-player turn-based card strategy game where players explore diverse tactical possibilities by editing character cards and constructing decks.

title: Pulse Sweep
description: Pulse sweep is a short incremental game where enemies are only visible when the radar sweeps them.

title: Repeat It Back To Me
description:
Repeat It Back To Me is a psychological horror/romance visual novel about doing whatever it takes to remember even the smallest details exactly how they were.

You've started to forget some of the bigger details. You want him to be the Elias you remember. He wants to be Elias, too. But something stands in the way of getting everything just right.

A familiar route through the forest. A face that's not quite right. A sun that won't go down and a day that won't ever end.

title: The Buried Pillars
description: Explore the world, fight fierce and alluring monster girls to uncover the secrets hidden within! A Metroidvania 2D platformer with combats that push you to the edge!

title: Silk and Secrets: Rites of Pleasure
description: Infiltrate the orgiastic secret society beneath the modern-day Palace of Versailles! Will you expose their sex rituals or surrender to their pleasures? An interactive romance novel.

title: Si-Ki
description: A 3D rail shooting game. Skillfully control the aerial combat humanoid "Shiki" to smash through obstacles and defeat approaching enemies! There are also fantastic bonus scenes!

title: Strafest
description: Strafest is a third-person co-op platformer full of physics-based minigames! Join friends in dodge boulders in volcanic pits or outrun bridge-blasting cannons. Unlock colorful Skins, Trails, and Titles to customize your character. It’s all about teamwork, goofy moments, and having a blast together!

title: Deepest Grievances
description:
A gruesome murder strikes the nation’s most inefficient institution!
Join an overworked Detective and his unlucky companion in navigating the bureaucratic wasteland of the Department of Complaints. Stand in the Queue. Sign papers with blood. Awaken the Boss.

FEATURES:
Suspicious people!
Sinister secrets?
Horror comedy;
Point-and-click adventure elements;
2 endings, 28K words, approximately 2-3 hours playtime;
An obscene amount of optional dialogue.

TEAM:

The Artist:
Rem R.
“A tragic tale of the developers’ hubris.”

The Programmer:
Anyashii
“Dude that is 9 dialogue options”

The Writer:
unfunny valentine
“I can describe these indescribable horrors just fine. Skill issue”

title: Kudo’s Kuppa
description: ORCSOFT’s surreal summer buddy comedy VN about two painfully available best friends, their crush-worthy moms, and the awkwardly inconvenient feelings that surface—sometimes when we least expect them...

title: Nitro City Racing
description: Dodge traffic and maintain top speed on your mission to become the ultimate street racer!

title: EA Sports FC 26: Icons Edition
description:
EA SPORTS FC 26 Icons Edition includes the base game plus:

- One Gold Starting XI pack, with 11 untradeable Gold Player Items (1 Goalkeeper, 4 Defenders, 3 Midfielders, 3 Attackers) rated 84 or higher

Three Iconic Players Picks (all untradeable, rated up to 91 OVR), from a selection of EA SPORTS FC 26 Football Ultimate Team base & campaign ICONs & Heroes from FC 26 FUT campaigns from game launch until 31 March 2026, excluding Team of the Year & Champion ICONs and TOTY Honourable Mention & Classic XI Heroes:

- 1 of 5 ICON or Hero Defender Player Pick
- 1 of 5 ICON or Hero Midfielder Player Pick
- 1 of 5 ICON or Hero Attacker Player Pick

title: Torara no Mahjong Kyoushitsu
description: An experiential learning game to learn Mahjong from scratch! Perfect for those who know nothing about mahjong! Learn Mahjong rules step by step with Torara!

title: Key Girl
description:
Follow Kagi as you try to get through Lock Land. Try your hardest to get the high score, and beat my score of 10! Find easter eggs, and not much else... " - A synopsis of the games plot from the official Itch.io page of the game.

Released June 28th, 2024, Key Girl is a short arcade styled game inspired by games like 'Pac-Man'. The game consists of 10 maze like levels, with 10 spheres in each level. You have to get through each level as your player character, Kagi, while avoiding Dunnys. There are many bonus modes (accessible through the ESC Key while in game) to the game to spice up the experience, such as the 'Golden Bunny Mode' Which spawns in the Golden Dunny to chase you around the maze.

title: Dinosaur Air Hockey
description:
Welcome to Dinosaur Air Hockey!
Do you have what it takes to survive the five apex predators? Not everyone plays fair!

See the cunning Velociraptor studying your every move, waiting for her opportunity to strike! The brutal Dilophosaurus, a cruel and snide combatant! All leading up to the tyrant king himself! His tantrums are sure to astound!

title: Darkstone Restoration
description: Darkstone Restoration brings the classic action RPG back to modern PCs with improved stability, compatibility, controls, readability, and quality-of-life improvements — while preserving the spirit of the original game.

title: Of Piers & Bays
description:
Sometimes relationships just aren't built to last. There'll be nothing that burns hotter than a fire enveloping your entire body, but when it calms and the ashes cool, there'll be nothing that feels more cold.

Mel and her girlfriend, Lynnie, have been soulbound since elementary school. It was under the guidance of the sun and the moon that they first struck friendship and then eventually love. Now, still under their guidance, they remain inseparable like a tumor to a patient.

Mel trails behind her coworker's car. They agreed to head over to her place to 'hang out'. This, though, does not explain the secrecy in which they act.

...Fish are quite romantic things, aren't they?

title: RoadCraft: Year 1 Pass
description:
The Year 1 Pass lets you expand your RoadCraft experience by granting you access to its first two major expansions, bringing new vehicles, features, missions, and maps to explore. You will also get instant access to the exclusive Invictus Type A, a powerful and unique scout vehicle.

The Year 1 Pass includes:
- The Rebuild Expansion, which includes the Timberworks Pack and 2 maps filled with new contracts, activities, and utility vehicles.
- The Reclaim Expansion, introduces two new large-scale maps, a new class of demolition gameplay, and a deeper sandbox approach to recovery operations.
- The Invictus Type A, a powerful and unique scout vehicle, available at launch.

title: RoadCraft: 1-Year Anniversary Edition
description: The 1-Year Anniversary Edition of RoadCraft includes the base game, the Rebuild Expansion and the Reclaim Expansion.

title: Kyoufu Yawa
description: Late at night, a teacher shares two bizarre tales: a corpse stuffed in a sheet, and an abnormal presence in the mountains. It was just a ghost story, but a creepy "sense of unease" lurks within. A short psychological horror visual novel offering a dense, terrifying experience in about an hour.

title: Unhappening
description: Unhappening is a narrative post-apocalyptic psychological horror 2.5D side-scrolling adventure, with a unique painterly visual style.

title: Torawase: The Girl in the Mirror
description: After his fiancée returns to Japan for work in this visual novel by Dark One!, our protagonist begins dreaming of being a woman in the Middle Ages. The more he has these dreams, the more he becomes a woman in real life. Can he reverse his transformation, or will his life take a different turn?

title: Keep On Winning!
description:
Keep On Winning! is a parody of incremental games and games of chance where the rules are simple: press the button and see if you win or lose.

Build the longest winning streak possible, compete for a place on the global leaderboard, and try not to hit the 1-in-1,000,000 chance of losing.

Whether you become one of the best players in the world or a legend for losing, every result counts.

title: The Raid of Brunswick
description: A first-person simulation where players take on the roles of a Lancaster bomber crew during a single World War II bombing raid over Brunswick.

title: Just Eat the Rich
description: Take the role of Birdman, a delivery man fed up with his minimum wage job. Politics have failed him so he takes matters in his own hand. With an arsenal of weapons and abilities you can help Birdman take back what the Elite took from us and redistribute the wealth. It is time to just eat the rich.

title: Wobble Wobble
description: Wobble Wobble is a physics simulation game set in a world of sparrows threatened by bomb terrorism. Become a rookie bomb disposal agent and push, pull, and throw blocks with your mouse to defuse bombs left across the world.

title: Critter Box
description: Critter Box is a casual idler game. You collect money over time, you get neat new items and gifts the longer you play. This game its intended to be easy to play, easy to have in the background, easy to enjoy. Let your money rack up in the background, fill your box! Bark!

title: Thingamajigs
description: A cozy hidden object game about helping the inhabitants of a vibrant hand-drawn world. From troubled bards to awkward first dates, follow along with their stories to discover new locations and more people in need of a helping hand!

title: Ringbound
description: Ringbound is an experimental minimalist incremental game

title: Kobayashi Clash of Conquest
description:
Kobayashi Clan of Conquest is a base-building and defense game set in a fantasy world populated by dragons.

Starting from a humble village, you develop your domain level by level to forge a true empire. Build gold mines, lumber mills, mystical laboratories, and defensive towers, all while strategically managing your resources.

title: No Time Left
description: Command your starship through a galaxy-spanning conspiracy in this real-time tactical roguelike. Manage power, shields, weapons and more. Featuring permadeath progression, seamless portal travel, and intense capital ship combat using Newtonian Physics with Damped Velocity.

title: Sorry, My King
description: A 1-bit pixel roguelite where every step costs time and every coin feeds the system. Explore procedural maps, fight card battles, and gather 5000 gold in 7 days to pay your debt to the king. Or discover why the debt exists at all.

title: Drown Rabbit
description: There's something wrong with these buildings, and it's your job to fix them! Uncover a spooky mystery that's terrifying all the residents in the area. Be careful! There may be something or someone creeping by...

title: Mindfunk in 13 Days
description: Help Nari and Sena make sense of a cringeworthy drink called Mindfunk that predicts their death. Your choices in this psychological horror visual novel will determine how they deal with this Mind****.

title: Eternal Hunger
description: Beneath a kingdom of stone and steel, you wake in a dungeon. Explore shifting labyrinths, fight in simultaneous combat, and survive where every step must be earned.

title: Cavedude
description:
Battle your way through endless waves of monsters in a progression-driven action RPG where every run makes you stronger.

You take control of a lone hero fighting against increasingly powerful enemies in a continuously scaling world. Combat is real-time and focused on building a powerful character through upgrades, gear, and magical abilities.

title: Killer of Kings
description: Killer of Kings is an async PvP auto-battler where positioning powers your army. Group matching unit traits, supercharge your strongest units, and create devastating carries that can wipe out entire enemy teams.

title: Shounen to Tenkiame
description: The smell of rain, raindrops splashing on the cobblestones, the sound of rain dripping from the eaves. A boy was sheltering from the rain at a shrine. A slightly mysterious story that begins with an encounter with a self-proclaimed god called "Fox-san."

title: Do I Really Like Chocolate?
description:
A bitsy about liking chocolate.

Just a short story about a silly question... Do I really like chocolate?

What could be hidding inside a Hot Chocolate, right?

title: Obake Nante Kowakunai JK vs. Gakkou Meikyuu
description: Curious about horror but bad with scary things? This is a not-so-scary horror game made by a developer who feels the same way, created for players who want to enjoy horror without being truly frightened. A pixel-art side-scrolling action adventure with puzzles and light action elements.

title: To Be Seen is To Be Loved
description: A game poem about how love can be felt when people see you and care about your interests

title: Chocolate Cake
description: A birthday present making a cakeception

title: Summer Snow.
description: Escape the endless midsummer in this time-loop mystery visual novel. Find the "exit key," solve the cryptic MAZE app's missions, and reach the future with your childhood friends! A coming-of-age drama with stunning visuals, a 300k-character voiced script, diverse puzzle mechanics, and no bad ends.

title: Fredbear Game Number 998433
description: Can you survive Fredbear's? Test your skills and knowledge in this next-generation reimagining. Watch those cameras and close your doors, or else you'll get caught! I know somebody who didn't. You do too. You knew him too well.

title: Lurruna: The Island of Towering Automatons
description: It's the GRAVITY-BOUND BOMBER!!! LURRUNA is an homage to CLASSICVANIA gameplay. Pelt bombs, beat baddies and cross chasms in a mysterious island adventure.

title: Everlasting Flowers: First Press Limited Special Edition
description: Contains a 2-discs soundtrack and a visual book.

title: Koganei-sou to Konjiki no Agehachou: First Press Limited Special Edition
description: Includes a visual book, a 2-disc soundtrack and 3 acrylic keyholders.

title: Godzilla Daikaiju Battle Royale
description: Godzilla Daikaiju Battle Royale is a fighting game featuring over 60 monsters from the Godzilla universe. Each of the Kaiju are hand drawn illustrations that were then digitally colored, animated, and programmed.

title: Small Hero
description: Welcome to Small Hero! This is a fast-paced, entertaining light Roguelike action survival game. You will play as a lone hero, facing off against waves of monsters. Each round is a brand-new adventure: you must shop and strengthen yourself between waves, then face more intense battle for survival!

title: Market is Fine
description: Market is Fine is a grocery store simulation game developed by a single independent developer. Players build and manage their own grocery stores, taking responsibility for various business processes such as inventory tracking, shelf arrangement, customer satisfaction, and financial growth. The game focuses on experiencing the daily operations and strategic challenges of a grocery store business in detail.

title: Val's Adventures at Scure Manor
description: Val’s Adventures at Scure Mansion is a witty point-and-click adventure where you take on the role of Val, a young Italian man locked out of his own home at 3 a.m., while a mysterious and dangerous enemy prowls the shadows. Players must rely on clever thinking, keen observation, and inventive use of everyday items to navigate the sprawling mansion, solve puzzles, and interact with quirky characters.

title: Bet on It
description: Step up to the table for a high-stakes game of intense survival where every pull of the trigger could be your last. Wager your life for chips against friends or AI, and unlock rare loot. Will you walk away wealthy, or lose it all?

title: The Chosen Duck
description: Welcome to The Chosen Duck. The world that you can be a... Duck! What were you expecting? So, get your ducks in a row, and let's begin our adventure!

title: Sheep & Socks
description: Inspired by the frantic fun of games like Overcooked, Sheep & Socks delivers fast-paced cooperative chaos—with a woolly twist.

title: Hentai Furry Panda
description: Hentai Furry Panda is an adult anime puzzle game featuring a playful furry panda girl. Solve memory and puzzle challenges to unlock new illustrations, achievements, and gallery content.

title: Aoharu Distortion: Chapter.1
description: The first chapter of the Aoharu Distortion trilogy.

title: Dunwich Horror
description: Explore the dreaded town of Dunwich, uncover the dark legacy of the Whateley family, and stop the Dunwich Horror if you can. A Lovecraftian monster hunt adventure with point-and-click gameplay and light RPG elements.

title: It All Began With a Bug
description: Crawl, fly, mate, dance, push dung and dive into the tiny struggles of fascinating bugs. Discover their unique stories as humanity awaits an imminent collapse, in a short narrative adventure framed as a nature documentary.

title: Bills Must Be Paid
description: A short active incremental game where you smash piggy banks to pay your bills. Collect coins, upgrade, and get out of debt!

title: Blockboy and The Wizard
description:
Blockboy and The Wizard is a short linear game about a regular stickman with a square head and a bleak life, who becomes the apprentice of a wizard with no beard and his own brand of soda. The soda thing isn't really important at all, but it's very cool.

Click stuff and things happen!

title: How to Kill a Fly
description: You are a corporate flesh object with no way to speak on your own trying to pose as a human by mimicking what other people say. Serve the corporation that owns you, complete your assignment.

title: Withering Age
description: Withering Age is a real-time strategy roguelike set in a dark fantasy, medieval world brimming with magic, danger, and decay. Build and expand your kingdom, train loyal troops and mighty champions, and defend your lands against relentless hordes.

title: Fresh Food Merge
description: A 3D physics puzzle game where you dodge flying toys while dropping and merging identical food items to create a variety of fruits and vegetables.

title: War of the Wormholes: Janitor Duty
description: War of the Wormholes: Janitor Duty is a retro point and click adventure game about a space janitor.

title: Duck Collector
description: Not just luck, a skill-based claw machine with real physics, arcade minigames, and dozens of ducks to collect.

title: Tactorius
description: Tactorius is a spell-based chess roguelite. Over 100 unique spells and 9 new pieces change the game in ways subtle and explosive. Enter the Gauntlet, build your skill tree, and make every match your own.

title: Jonathan's Adventure 3
description: After the rumored death of director Pricker Jeff, Steve Williams is assigned to look over a place he seemingly use to own as a night guard. However, as the week goes on, the true nature of the place - and himself, begins to unveil.

title: Debug Nephemee
description: This world is plagued by anomalies known as "Bugs." Its inhabitants are creatures called Nephemee. Innate missions, lost memories, and precious friends— Embark on a journey to "Debug" the world and the Nephemee in a combat system where knowing your enemy deeply is the only way to strike!

title: Protocol: Zero-Day
description: Protocol: Zero-Day is a brutal and fast-paced Action-Roguelite set in a cyber-apocalyptic world. Wield your electric baton, master lightning-fast dashes, and survive endless hordes of corrupted anomalies. Navigate the shattered digital grid, upgrade your stats, and purge the system before you are overrun. Pure skill, zero compromises.

title: Kingspath
description: Lead your king. Command your army. Rebuild your realm. Kingspath is a 2D pixel-art strategy roguelike where you control your king on the battlefield, give real-time commands, and fight to restore a fallen kingdom one day at a time.

title: Flesh Blossom
description: You are Doctor Parsnip Green, the first and last line of defense against a grotesquely beautiful epidemic. Make difficult choices as you investigate the disease’s origin, operate on patients, and fight to save those you love - all while managing your own dwindling sanity.

title: Ecliptica
description:
Ecliptica, a survival simulator on a distant, merciless planet where everything is subject to the rigid laws of economics, power and nature.

Nothing is easy here. Resources are limited, the environment is hostile, and the local biosphere perceives you as a threat. To survive, the colonists must collaborate, trade and compete in a fully simulated, responsive economy that responds to every decision of both players and non-fiction characters (NPC).

Explore the procedurally generated open world, base the outposts, create your own corporation, or join one of the many NPC factions competing for territory and survival. Choose diplomacy, trade or domination – every decision you influence the fate of the colony.

title: City Masterplan
description: City Masterplan is a highly realistic city-building simulation game. Design intricate road networks, manage deep economies, and shape terrain to build your 1:1 dream city. From strategic planning to creative detailing, bring your ultimate metropolis to life!

title: Under the Heavens
description: A choice-driven narrative RPG set in China’s Warring States period. Rise from a nameless soldier to a legendary general through decisions with permanent consequences. Death is final. History remembers only the survivors.

title: Majo Kuruibana: Daria + Lito-hen
description:
Kuro, the protagonist, had lost her mother to a witch at a young age.
Driven by a thirst for revenge, Kuro enrolls in the "Witch Academy", an institution where that very same witch reigns supreme as Headmistress.

A light-hearted "Revenge Yuri Visual Novel" in which you strive to reach the top of the academy alongside a cast of adorable witches.

title: Netshell
description: A 90s-themed hacking simulation with real shell commands and authentic techniques, set inside a UNIX-style operating system from 1997 with accurately recreated applications. Scan ports, exploit vulnerabilities, evade traces, join the underground, and live the Wild West era of the early internet.

title: The Finals: Season 10 - Fantasy League
description:
The Season 10 of The Finals includes:
- New Arena: Starlight Hollow
- New Playstyle: The Aerialist
- New Specialization: Shockwave
- New Weapon: Chimera-XB
- New Gadget: Hover Pad
- New Feature: The Reward Shop

title: Skara
description: SKARA is a third person survival game. You need to find food and use pagan magic for healing. Wield primitive weapons to defend against enemies both animal and supernatural. Explore an open wilderness set in prehistoric times.

title: Witch Machine
description:
Witch Machine is a point-and-click horror game by Tori Fisher. It's framed as a lost Game Boy game.

This game was a submission to GBJAM 7.

title: Witch Machine: Spilled Vessel
description: Witch Machine: Spilled Vessel is a horror role-playing game made as a submission for GBJAM 8. It is a direct sequel to Witch Machine, and is also framed as a lost Game Boy game.

title: Towerix91
description: Towerix91 is an incremental tower defense inspired by PC games of the late 80s and early 90s. Collect crystals, unlock dozens of upgrades in the tech tree, place towers on walls, upgrade them and use abilities. Repel waves of enemies while steadily strengthening your defenses.

title: Treasure Blast Quest
description: Easy to learn and fun to master, Treasure Blast Quest is perfect for players who enjoy casual treasure hunting, score chasing, and satisfying arcade-style gameplay.

title: Puzzling Places: 3D Jigsaw Sim
description: A relaxed 3D jigsaw puzzle game about building detailed miniature dioramas of places from around the world.

title: Paper Shakespeare 3: Girl Werewolf Hamlet Absolutely Solves the War of the Roses
description: Guide a squad of ten young adults through a kingdom on the brink of war! Navigate court politics, deadly rivalries, and magical chaos between Humans, Fae, and Werewolves... where every choice can make or break your future.

title: 30 Minutes to Rescue
description: 30 Minutes to Rescue is a tense sci-fi survival story set in a Mars colony. Manage resources, make critical decisions, and stop a cascading disaster before the colony collapses.

title: Abyss Cards
description: Abyss Cards is a strategic roguelike deck-builder with real-time auto-battle combat. Recruit powerful units, cast devastating spells, and collect ancient relics as you descend deeper into a cursed dungeon — where every choice is permanent and death means starting over.

title: Outage Navigation
description: The power is out! No worries. With the help of you and your flashlight, we'll get that power back up and running before you can say "this is dangerous!" Oh yeah, watch out for the objects left around the floor.

title: Hunting World
description: Hunting World is an open-world hunting survival game set in a vast safari wilderness. Track wildlife, manage hunger and stamina, craft weapons, and face powerful boss creatures. Explore freely, survive harsh environments, and prove yourself as the ultimate hunter!

title: Late Night TV
description: Late Night TV is about watching some TV to help you go to sleep after a long day at work.

title: Treasure Clicker
description: Tap the chest, buy upgrades, and grow a hoard that spirals into absurdity. Hire heroes, fund guild research, and spend Essence on a skill tree that persists between prestiges. When you need a change of pace, race the clock in speed challenges or descend into The Abyss

title: Ethoterria's Last Soldier
description: Ethoterria's last soldier is a platformer with integrated PvE combat. Dungeons, which act as levels, are connected through a broader open world. Completing dungeons upgrades your characters stats. The platforming has a very high difficulty leading to frustrating but satisfying gameplay.

title: That Summer: Hannah's Summer Vacation
description: In a quiet, somewhat remote town, Hannah lives with her father and younger brother. Eventually the summer break comes, and with it the question: "How to spend the last summer before her senior year in high school?"

title: Trees Adventure
description: Trees Adventure is a 2D side-view platformer where in single player you control two characters at once, and in online or local co-op each player controls their own character

title: Cursed Core
description: Cursed Core is a small, hardcore survival sandbox set in an open, randomly generated world.

title: Late Night TV: RERUN
description: Late Night TV: RERUN is about watching some TV after a long day at work.

title: Glyph Gambit: Endgame
description: Glyph Gambit: Endgame is a tactical grid battler powered by a real chess engine. Soulslike/roguelite runs, authentic chess movement, and tactical items create deep, replayable battles in the sequel the original was meant to be.

title: The Hunter Files: Case One
description: The Hunter Files: Case One is a story driven point and click adventure about a private detective caught in routine work. What starts as a simple surveillance job slowly turns into a missing person case, told through dialogue, puzzles, and exploration.

title: Looters
