description: A couch co-op goblin heist for 2 players. Sneak, stack, and steal your way through a guarded manor packed with enemies, secrets, and loot. Take everything… and get out alive.

title: A Game About Going Up
description: A chaotic third-person precision platformer about climbing to the top of an unforgiving and brutal vertical level. Just go up and try not to fall. Your patience will be tested.

title: Bow and Banister
description: Take control of a struggling violinist as he scales impossible stone staircases toward a fateful performance for the king. No shortcuts — just you, your bow, and the endless climb ahead.

title: Space Salvage Simulator
description: Welcome to Space Salvage Simulator. Saddled with an unfair debt, you're locked in a forced labor camp on the edge of the galaxy. Scavenge and craft from an endless stream of trash to earn an honest living, or bet it all in the underground arena for a quick jackpot. Pay your debt, buy your freedom!

title: The Pissing Game
description: Step into a bizarre world where even taking a piss becomes a quest. Kill bugs, earn Piss-coins, upgrade, unlock hidden areas… and ultimately, flush.

title: All You Can Fish!
description: All You Can Fish is an active, relaxing incremental fishing adventure where every voyage matters, every upgrade counts, and every fish brings you one step closer to maritime legend.

title: Hunt Club On Stream
description: This is a Streaming intergraded game for players of all ages, i have created this game myself, its a simple free to play game for anyone, just to pass time and have some fun. Hunt and collect trophys

title: Killnetic
description: Killnetic is a hyper-fast, chaotic shooter inspired by ULTRAKILL, DOOM, and REAVER. Dive into relentless multiplayer battles with dynamic weapon mechanics, tech-fueled movement, and diverse game modes. Master the chaos, never stop moving, and unleash unparalleled fun on the battlefield!

title: String of Fates
description: Help a guy confess to his sweetheart on Valentine's Day!

title: Babel.exe
description: A modern retelling of the "Tower of Babel." The graphics are inspired by the ZX Spectrum.

title: The Dark Path to the Black Tower
description: Anomaly horror with a dark fantasy theme. Traverse a cursed forest on a stormy night. If you see signs of witchcraft, turn back... Else you remain trapped on the path for eternity...

title: FishPond
description:
FishPond is a pond-building sim where biology actually compounds.

Stock species into a living food web. Manage oxygen, predation, and diversity to keep things alive—then start pushing the system. Breed lineages across 12 inheritable traits. Unlock genetic tools. Automate harvesting. Expand your world.

Every fish has AI-driven behavior, a real genome, and a place in the food chain. Every population shift changes the music in real time. Every upgrade makes the whole thing run a little more like a machine—until you realize the machine is alive.

title: Fetish: Every Second Counts
description:
This is a story about the d'Andre family whose members are all mysterious and have eccentric hobbies. As hobbies supposed to be for your own pleasure, Hexia's and the rest of the family's seem to be a little too unique to be called just a hobby. However, one thing for sure, the consequences of their hobbies appear to be a a tad unpleasant...

You get to play the protagonist, Hexia, the d'Andre family's first born and only daughter.

title: E.S.O: Don't Forget
description: A terrifying test of memory. Escape the creatures and don't forget what door you've been assigned...

title: Fast Mine Sweeping: Skill Awakening
description: 《Lightning-Fast Mine Sweeping: Skill Awakening》 Choose different characters, combine various skills, and quickly complete challenging minesweeper levels. Features classic minesweeper, standard roguelike gameplay, and challenge mode. With 4 characters and over 100 skills.

title: Dice Tavern: Farkle Roguelike
description: Dice Tavern is a medieval Farkle dice roguelike. Roll, lock, and bank through six taverns, from village tables to the King's throne. Collect unique dice, equip badges and coatings to craft your build. Every run is new, every roll a gamble with fate.

title: El Shaddai: Zero Nine Reversi
description: A unique Reversi game set in the world of El Shaddai. Stones have HP that decreases when flipped, adding deep strategy to the classic board game. Unlock 40+ stories, characters, and special rules as you climb the ranks.

title: Hello Kitty Island Adventure: City Town
description: A rainbow metropolis awaits! Collect, create, and customize in this cozy adventure. Run your own personalized Cafe, set up all-new shops with Sanrio friends, and unlock the power of dreams to uncover the City’s hidden wonders.

title: Interdimensional Gas Station
description: Experience a sci-fi narrative where you run a gas station on a drifting asteroid in the infinite void. Service increasingly complex alien ships, upgrade and expand your gas station's operations, and shape the fate of the galactic stage through your choices!

title: Greedy Drivers 2
description: Greedy Drivers 2 takes the high-octane action of the original and cranks it up to the next level. Dive into a thrilling mix of competitive racing and open-world exploration, all set against the stunning backdrop of Ioannina, Greece.

title: Blok
description: Blok is a psychological horror game set in 1990s Poland. You play as a former oppositionist who fled the country during the communist regime in the 1980s. After the system's collapse, a mysterious letter from your mother brings you back to your former home. But you sense something is wrong.

title: Re/sub
description: Slide across boards and find the path to the goal — every tile you cross becomes a wall you can't pass through again. What starts on flat grids evolves into 3D cubes and 4D puzzles. 100+ levels across 8 worlds with teleporters, sticky tiles, keys, resets, and more.

title: Catto Boi Forever
description:
Do you have what it takes to restore peace to the island?

Join Catto and friends as you take down the looming threat and retrieve the Titanium Biscuit!

Do it alone, or do it with friends online, through the Forever Network! There are 6 unique game modes you can play in multiplayer!

Your friends in the village need helping out! There are 5 side quests to complete, along with 11 levels in the main campaign. There are also 12 unique levels for some multiplayer game modes!

With the modding API, the possibilities are endless - one could say they go on... FOREVER!

title: Atrum
description: Atrum is a dark fantasy, third-person roguelike where you play as a powerful mage descending into darkness. Fight challenging enemies and bosses across corrupted realms and collect magical items to shape your build before the darkness consumes you.

title: Deeper Still
description: A really hard immersive sim set in a dystopian and nihilistic world. To complete each level, start with a plan by choosing weapons, paths and abilities. Die. Find a better plan. Die again. Repeat until you finish the level. Then replay the levels to find new creative ways to beat them.

title: Curse of the Mirror
description: Curse of the Mirror is a 2D platformer that features a unique set of mechanics and ideas in each and every level inspired by similar games in its genre, a simple moveset that's easy to learn but difficult to master, and a rich story with fun and quirky characters!

title: Hack Fate
description: Hack Fate is a fast-paced, cyberpunk pixel-style hack-and-slash action game. In a flash of lightning, control time and space, switch identities, and deliver swift, fatal blows to all enemies. But if it's the heavens you're up against? Then you shall hack fate itself.

title: Aliens Go Home ReRun
description: Brick-breaking and SHMUP elements combine in this 2.5D remake of the 2017 title Aliens Go Home Run, with new stages, characters, and more! Play ball... Again!

title: Demon’s Reign
description: Venture into a dark world ruled by demons, overcome the challenges and defeat the archfiends to gain their power. Explore at your desired order and freely build your character to face impossible battles.

title: Gold Rush Ventures
description: Gold Rush Ventures throws you into the gold rush era: explore endless mines, uncover hidden outposts and abandoned structures. Live an adventure where every descent could mean a fortune… or your life.

title: Off Garbage
description: A sleep-deprived scientist must use a broken cleaning robot to contain a biological outbreak he accidentally caused before his wife returns and discovers the chaos.

title: Bang Banger! Aim Trainer
description: Bang Banger! Aim Trainer is an erotic aim-training game where your performance unlocks much more than just points. Choose between the sensual world of hentai, the grandeur of futa, or the intensity of bara and get ready to aim with precision and pleasure.

title: Hijacked
description: Play as a rogue digital parasite, surviving by hijacking the minds of cybernetic soldiers in this turn-based tactics roguelike. Leap from mind to mind, weaponizing their bodies and abilities to wipe out the machine forces hunting you.

title: Obverse
description: Obverse is an immersive first-person action, problem-solving, and exploration game set in a vast underground research facility. Outsmart hostile machines, find creative solutions to every obstacle, and uncover the truth behind a secret experiment that could threaten reality itself.

title: Arm of the Prince
description: Arm of the Prince is a turn-based tactical RPG with a strong narrative focus. Enjoy strategic combat unconstrained by grids, and experience a character-driven story filled with intrigue, oneiric revelations, and morally dubious paramilitary operations. The negotiations must fail.

title: Dungeon4X
description: Dungeon4X is a new type of game that combines 3D dungeon RPG with 4X strategy. As the guild master of an adventurer's guild, you will lead the construction of farms and workshops, build a financial base by selling products, and embark on a grand adventure to obtain the ultimate artifact!

title: Neodrive
description: Tear through a solo time-attack campaign in a 1600HP stick-shift muscle car. Manage nitro and perfect your drift lines to get the author medal on every single one.

title: Icarus-Bolt
description: Icarus-Bolt is a single-player open-world platformer set in on an off world mining colony, where something has gone terribly wrong.

title: Pojangmacha: Korean Street Food Management Simulator
description:
Under a snowy overpass, people gather around warm lights.
In this cozy management simulation game, run your own POJANGMACHA and serve Korean street foods like tteokbokki and ramyun.
Handle quirky events and grow your tiny stall into a street food success!

title: Kagaribi
description: "The fire remembers what you forgot." Reclaim your name in this Taisho Gothic abyss, featuring an EDM Requiem crafted from the developer's raw voice. A psychological horror where emotion meets AI. Let the author's voice pull you into the depths. What is the truth at the end?

title: Vvintercore
description: A visual psychological horror novel set in a winter setting. You have a unique opportunity to explore your relationships with your friends, and then with yourself. But be careful, a blizzard seems to be approaching.

title: I'm Ready for Kindergarten: Huggly's Sleepover
What We Bring
description: What We Bring is a cozy puzzle game about the objects that shape a life. Organize, sort, and pack through the years, choosing what items to carry forward. The items you keep shape the character’s future, influencing the path they take in a branching narrative story.

title: Battle Synth
description: BattleSynth — Tactical Fantasy Warfare Assemble your army, plan your moves, and watch your strategy come alive on the battlefield. In BattleSynth, every unit matters and every choice can lead to victory — or defeat. Smart tactics, wild magic, and a bit of chaos await!

title: The Succubus Trap Island
description:
Leaf, a female knight serving as the princess’s bodyguard, visits the island of Torion — a tourist spot known for its ancient ruins.
However, due to a small mishap and the schemes of the succubi who manage the island, she ends up having to conquer a dungeon filled with traps.

Will Leaf be able to reach Princess Marika, who awaits deep within the island?

title: The Brotherhood: The Way of the Sleeper
description:
You are treading on hallowed ground...
Greetings, stranger. I see that you doubt what the henchmen of the archbarons try to sell you as true and just. You know why. Because it's LIES! They tell you that we worship a foolish idol, that our herb clouds the mind, and that our Templars are fanatical murderers. Don't be deceived by their false words! Witness our hospitality for yourself, taste the calming effects of the herb, and perhaps you will be one of the chosen ones to whom the Sleeper reveals himself in a dream...

In 2012, a small group of enthusiasts founded an RPG about the Brotherhood of the Sleeper in the WorldOfGothic subforum. For two years stories of faith, community and steaming root soup, but also of betrayal and the most heinous treachery, grew. Now you can experience these stories for yourselves. THE PATH OF THE SLEEPER (original title - Die Bruderschaft: Der Weg des Schläfers) accompanies the RPG's original members on their adventures within the Barrier. Will the brothers bring freedom to their community, or will they deliver the entire island into the clutches of a malevolent archdemon's madness? Find out!

title: Rosa Inferna
description: Rosa Inferna is a hard-boiled noir action game where you must break through waves of relentless enemies with overwhelming reflexes.

title: Outer Space Bar
description: Welcome to the Outer Space Bar! You are currently standing at the top of Earth’s most dangerous, highest, and... windiest vertical tunnel.

title: The Bow: Ultimate Weapon
description: A top-down shooter incremental game where you defeat enemies, sell loot, unlock powerful upgrades, defeat bosses for special items, and shape your own combat build through steady progression.

title: Do Not Press Me
description: A strange psychological game where every click matters. Press the button… or don’t — but be ready for the consequences.

title: Elemental Exogear
description: Inspired by a love for arcade games and shmups, Elemental Exogear features five stages of explosive action and a synth rock soundtrack. The game features a scoring system that works by building the Boost Gauge through shooting enemies or picking up a Boost power up. Once the Boost Gauge is full, players can cash in with the Hyper shot that builds up to a 5X multiplier as long as it is hitting an enemy.

title: Jirai-kei Girl: Vengeance
description: “I'll show you what happens when you make me angry.”The heart of Jirai-kei Girl, betrayed by her beloved boyfriend, is torn between love and hatred.Her overflowing emotions eventually take the form of a “revenge drama.”[Take down the other woman and corner the boyfriend who betrayed you!]

title: Once Upon
description: An AI-driven narrative RPG that grows alongside your focus sessions. Set a real-life task, start a 25-minute Pomodoro, and return to a fresh chapter written while you worked. Choose a fantasy cooking journey or a sci-fi survival mystery. Free AI built in.

title: Puzzle Cross
description: Puzzle Cross is a Virtual Reality Nonogram Puzzles game.

title: Knightstones
description: Deploy your armies on a war table in this tactical roguelike! Plan your formations, trigger tons of chain reactions, and invest your rewards to rebuild your fallen Order. Be ready… or perish in the final battle.

title: Tango District
description:
Tango District is a puzzle style cyberpunk city-builder where every move is a balancing act.
Grow your district by buying buildings from powerful corporations, but don’t let them take over as you fight to stay financially afloat.
Shape your city’s identity through smart placement, as buildings adapt to nearby structures, boosting your fame and population in unexpected ways.
Keep citizens on your side by making bold, sometimes outrageous decisions during events, or risk corruption spreading through your streets. In a city where power, money, and reputation collide, every choice defines your future.

title: Fragmented Echoes
description: Explore action-adventure multiverse, blending Sci-Fi, RPG, and Fantasy genres. Restore order from Earth, journeying through multiverses to the divine realm. With top-down and third-person views, experience stunning graphics, thrilling mechanics, and master unforgiving battlegrounds.

title: The Cluster
description: Experience the story of Richard, a poor hunter, and his wife, Lilith. They are fighting to escape their circumstances with high hopes that their hard work is finally about to pay off, allowing them to leave this place behind forever.

title: Ignore the Blackbird
description: Ignore the Blackbird is a hand-drawn watercolor puzzle game. Explore the greenhouse, solve puzzles woven into its surroundings, and uncover what happened to Sonya and her family.

title: Kishin Hishou Demonbane: DX Package Edition
description: Includes Kishin Hishou Demonbane, "City Revival" omake, Original Soundtrack, Art book and playing manual.

title: Project Subathon: Urban Explorer
description:
Project Subathon: Urban Explorer is an atmospheric horror simulation where you play as the chat.

Meet John "PieJaw" Petersky, a washed-up urban explorer willing to risk everything for one last viral hit. He has broken into the cursed mansion, a dark obsession among internet forum dwellers, whispered to contain a tragedy that no camera has ever lived to record.

But PieJaw is blind to the danger. He is distracted by fame, greed, and his own ego. You are his eyes. You are his conscience. You are his Witness.

title: Arena of Trials
description: Arena of Trials is a dynamic 3D game with action/RPG and survival arena elements. You'll find yourself in a variety of biomes, from the scorching desert to the icy wilderness, where every move can be decisive.

title: Hellfire Factory
description: Serve monsters, orcs and demons and solve a mystery in the hellish depths of a factory with gorilla man Alex in this adult gay bara 3d point 'n click adventure.

title: Blessing: Part I
description: Blessing Part I is a 2D pixel style horizontal board action adventure game. Players will take on the role of a swordsman 'Luo' who lost everything in the past and embarks on revenge alone. With only a large sword and flesh and blood, they will fight against the twisted creatures in the darkness.

title: Fatal Research
description:
A rail shooting FPS game based on the SCP universe.

The player is a mobile task force member of SCP and receives a unique mission for each stage.

title: Galactic Seals Survivors
description: Take down the evil carnivorous orcas while you fight your way to their big boss! Galactic Seals Survivors is an arcade game with rogue-like elements and upgrades to give you the power to take on the entire Galactic Orcas empire.

title: Herba Project: Desktop Lab
description: Herba Project: Desktop Lab is a Lovecraftian-themed idle gardening game. Players take on the role of a researcher cultivating various plant species by adjusting nutrient solutions, environmental temperature, and soil moisture. With over 100 unique plants awaiting discovery.

title: Infected Dawn
description: Infected Dawn is a singleplayer 3D point and click game focused on exploration and time management. Explore and scavenge useful items to prepare your hideout for the oncoming zombie horde.

title: Kill The Emperor
description: A traditional RPG with unexpected plot. The female ghost said she would be reborn to revenge, but her memory would be erased before her rebirth. Can she get revenge? You play a college student. You can see things that others can't see and investigate a story of "Southeast the Peacock Flies".

title: Primal Glade
description: A single-player FPS set in a dangerous prehistoric jungle. Collect nests while battling fierce dinosaurs like Dimetrodons, Raptors, and Troodons. Navigate rain-soaked terrain and survive relentless attacks in a thrilling 15–45 minute adventure. Can you escape the mire alive?

title: Nice Pudding World DX
description: Cute pudding casual 3D puzzle

title: Deer Legend
description: Deer Legend is a 2D high-speed chaotic action RPG set in a world consumed by chaos. Control a lone deer, master new skills, and harness elemental powers. Face overwhelming foes, endure countless trials, and carve your legend through perseverance.

title: Reappearance of a Stopped Clock
description:
An Irish tech CEO disappears along with his company's time machine. Three hours later, he's found dead on the opposite side of the world.
Two witnesses to the disappearance start to piece together what really happened.

title: It Breathes
description: First-person VHS horror game set in an abandoned Hungarian hospital. Hide, fight, or flee while working towards your only goal: to escape.

title: Half Left
description: Trapped inside a quarantined research complex, a wheelchair-bound nurse must survive a curse beyond human comprehension.

title: The Aeon Fall
description: Survival breeds threat. The Aeon Fall is a system-driven hardcore defense where growth noise stimulates the swarm. Build and survive an onslaught of 100,000 entities. Master strategic choices that evolve every session.

title: WEJbA: We Exist Just to be Alive
description: An experimental mixed-media game about being bored and wasting time that combines a 3D world with 2D illustrations and photography of handcrafted plushies.

title: Fish House Simulator
description: Catch it, cook it… or sell it under the table. In Fish House, catch fish, cook, and serve customers! Upgrade your gear, catch valuable fish, and grow your restaurant. Not everything is legal—some fish are risky but profitable. Every fish ends up on a plate… some leave through the back door.

title: Quack Hunters
description: Quack-quack! Sounds cool, right? Become a crazy duck and hunt monsters in the wild forest with your friends! Kick enemies with your ducky foot, hide from monsters, gather resources, and explore the world. Bet you won't even last ‘til sunrise.

title: You're Nuts!
description: Escape from a decaying industrial maze where logic is the only way out. Scout for shortcuts, scavenge parts to craft upgrades and make sure to come back to your safety hub each day to protect your cover. A cozy co-op adventure for 1-4 sentient robots. Can you find the key and reach the exit in time?

title: Together We Move
description: WASD… but every key is controlled by a different player. Control ONE character together—sync movement, jumps, and actions to survive chaotic parkour. Perfect teamwork… or total disaster? (Playable with 1–5 players.)

title: Oüba: The Great Journey
description: Oüba: The Great Journey is a tile-matching game, where the objective is to release the Oübas by making horizontal or vertical matches of three or more bricks of the same color, within a time limit. In the main game screen, the Oüba prisoners stand on top of columns made of multicolored bricks. They can only escape when touching the ground, after the removal of all the columns tiles with matches. The bricks can switch position with adjacent tiles and be moved in this way to any part of the grid. Garouba keeps adding new brick rows every few seconds, pushing the pile upwards. If any Oüba dies squished at the top, the game is over.

title: DragonSword: Awakening
description: Explore the anime-style open world of the Continent of Orbis, brought to life with Unreal Engine 5! Recruit unique companions, unleash spectacular Status Ailment tag-team action, and embark on an epic journey to save the world from the threat of a Dragon reawakened after 60 years.

title: Five Faizul Fridays DX
description:
In a run-down high school led by a deranged computer science professor, Dr. F, you must survive twenty-five days until the final exam.

Plot with your fellow clan members, complete Dr. F's tasks, and sabotage rival clan members for freedom. Respect isn't given, it's earned by fighting, vandalising, cannibalising your enemies, whatever it takes to prove you're not to be messed with.

Freedom is the ultimate goal, but only a few will make it out alive.

title: Null Root
description: A roguelite incremental game about protecting a network by destroying the invading nodes, collecting the loot and customizing your build with new skills.

title: Metro 2039
description:
METRO 2039 is the next landmark FPS from acclaimed storytellers, 4A Games. Journey into the dark heart of post-apocalyptic Moscow in a harrowing conflict for the very soul of the Metro.

The year is 2039. For a quarter century, the last survivors of nuclear war have been locked in bitter conflict deep in the Metro tunnels beneath the poisoned city of Moscow.

Now, finally, they have been united by a single leader, a fanatical Spartan known as Hunter. But this is no peace: Hunter’s Novoreich regime rules through propaganda and fear, subjugating the population in the name of a new war for the surface against a dark and terrifying enemy.

In the wilderness beyond the city, the reclusive Stranger is haunted by violent waking nightmares. When the ghosts of his past force him out of exile, he must undertake a harrowing journey into the shattered ruins of Moscow, to the one place he swore he’d never go. The Metro.

Experience the most shocking METRO adventure yet in a powerful single-player story that weaves exploration, survival, combat and stealth across a hauntingly beautiful but deadly world with unparalleled immersion.

Inspired by the worldwide best-selling METRO book trilogy by Dmitry Glukhovsky.

title: Police Chief Simulator
description: Welcome to Winston Springs, Officer! The local police station is in urgent need of a Chief of Police, and you’ve been chosen for the job! Handle incoming reports, renovate and expand the station, solve cases, and fight crime!

title: Escape from Tarkov: Usec - ScavTac
description: A confident attempt to fit in with the locals. Practical set with a street vibe and a touch of irony. Includes ScavTac upper and lower. USEC faction only.

title: Escape from Tarkov: Bear - Three Stripes
description: Three Stripes as a way of life in Tarkov, no other words needed. Includes upper and lower. BEAR faction only.

title: Fight for Olympus
description: This 1-player deckbuilding game features a light Greek mythological theme and over 250 cards to collect by defeating enemy hordes with superior tactics, such as positioning and well-timed spells. Unlock 40 deck types, each with its own strategy and an abundance of combinations.

title: Combolands
description: A mini citybuilding roguelike. Place buildings, stack combos, and master deep strategy in short bursts to create a tiny thriving metropolis!

title: Atmosphere
description:
Doing crimes is hard.

Made by walking away in silence for DOMINO CLUB. Music by Ketsa and Komiku Made with VIDEOTOME

title: Warhammer: Shadow of the Horned Rat (Classic)
description: Halt the tide of evil threatening the Empire in Warhammer: Shadow of the Horned Rat, a classic real-time strategy game where you command a mercenary army against the servants of the Horned Rat.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Chaos Gate (Classic)
description: Command a squad of up to 20 Space Marines and battle the forces of Chaos led by Chaos Lord Zymran. Chaos Gate is a squad-level, turn-based tactical strategy game set in the grim Warhammer 40,000 world.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Fire Warrior (Classic)
description: Become an elite Fire Warrior and fight the forces of the Imperium of Man in an action-packed classic FPS. Experience Warhammer 40,000 from a unique T'au perspective with a story full of twists and betrayal.

title: Warhammer: Mark of Chaos - Gold Edition (Classic)
description: Command the armies of the Empire, the Hordes of Chaos, Orcs & Goblins, and other iconic Warhammer Fantasy factions in massive real-time battles. Warhammer: Mark of Chaos is a classic RTS celebrated for its unprecedented scale and detail for its time.

title: Warhammer: Dark Omen (Classic)
description: Enter the Warhammer Fantasy world in Warhammer: Dark Omen, a classic real-time strategy game known for its tactical battles, atmospheric campaign, and cult-classic status.

title: Loot Dungeon
description: "Loot Dungeon" is a dark fantasy incremental roguelite ARPG where death is progression. Crawl deadly dungeons, collect loot, pick perks, and die... to get stronger. Go deeper, unlock new characters, upgrades and features. Will you make a deal with Death?

title: Pippin Please
description: Immerse yourself in a dramatic yet charming and witty world of evidence-gathering, deduction and courtroom battles in this adventure of mediocre lawyer Pippin Please.

title: Hungerwinter
description:
IT IS THE WORST WINTER ON RECORD. FAMINE GRIPS THE CONTINENT.

Join Ida Guggenhofer and Rosa Huber as they meet their friends, meet their foes and explore the city they hope to save. HUNGERWINTER is a short, linear visual novel set in The Lovely Ladyverse, and is a prequel to the upcoming game Waterhead.

title: Starfield: Free Lanes
description:
Starfield: Free Lanes Update is a content update that expands the game’s space exploration systems with additional navigation and traversal options. It introduces new mechanics and adjustments designed to streamline movement between locations while supporting more flexible route planning.
The update focuses on improving overall flow and accessibility within the game’s open-ended structure, complementing existing exploration, resource management, and progression systems.

title: Assassin's Creed Shadows: Premium Edition
description:
Experience an epic action-adventure story set in feudal Japan! Become a lethal shinobi assassin and powerful legendary samurai as you explore a beautiful open world in a time of chaos.

The Assassin’s Creed Shadows Premium Edition includes:
- The base game
- Sekiryu Gear Set for both Naoe and Yasuke
- Eye of the Dragon Katana
- Claw of the Dragon Long Katana
- Sekiryu Beast Mount
- Dragon Tooth Trinket
- The Claws of Awaji Expansion, which features a new region, a new weapon, new skills, and 10+ hours of content.

title: Project XZ
description: PROJECT XZ is a high-octane fusion of platforming, action, and tower defense strategy. Shoot, brawl, and upgrade your arsenal of skills to tear through anything in your way and decide the fate of the future.

title: Vergessen ist nicht vergangen
description:
As a digger who makes ends meet with construction work, thus avoiding mining, you experience daily miserable wages and humiliations at the hands of the guards. Brabak, their leader, has a particular vendetta against you and has already ensured that your trust test failed in the past. After a particularly painful protection money payment, you realize that things can't continue this way. You're prepared to do anything to climb the pecking order and strike a deal with Diego that lets you do things no digger has ever dreamed of...

Story takes place in the Mining Valley on Khorinis. The story was inspired by the Gothic comic (Gothic: Der Comic). You'll learn what happened shortly before the nameless hero's arrival and why the Old Camp's situation in Gothic 1 is the way it is.

The mod team aimed to preserve the Gothic 1 style. New features were added very sparingly, and those that made it into the mod were heavily adapted to G1. The rough tone between the diggers and the guards was also increased, reinforcing the feeling of a weak and defenseless digger fighting his way through a dog-eat-dog society.

title: Paladin's Horn: The Destiny of the Holy Lance
description: Lance finds himself in a position to help the people in the village of Cotton Hill. In order to help these people Lance will need to defeat foes in turn-based combat, all the while crafting weapons and items to help him survive fighting the monsters within the wildlands he will scavenge items from.

title: Kuitaiyou
description: This is a action game where you have to eat stars so you can grow large enough to Eat the Sun in the End under 60 seconds.

title: Wormies
description: Wormies is a cozy indie game about running your own worm shop! Buy and breed hundreds of different wormies. Get to know your customers and fulfill their wormie orders to progress through different storylines!

title: HackBot Hacking Game
description: HackBot is an addictive and free hacker game simulator with infinite levels of the future!

title: Hex Shop
description: After inheriting your grandmother’s witch shop, buy, craft, and sell apothecary wares while demons slowly consume you.

title: Crimebot
description:
Detective games mystery offline low mb.
Solve mysteries to find out if your suspects are guilty! Detective, can you can you solve all investigations?

title: Rapunzel
description: Surreal adaptation of the Grimm's fairy tale "Rapunzel", with a modern twist. Inspired by anti-narcotics public service announcements.

title: Hypnagogia: Broken Dreams
description: A protector submerged, a mirror shattered, and a dreamscape left severed. Unravel a new, surreal dream mystery as you platform, solve puzzles, meet unique characters, and much more in this first-person exploration prequel to Hypnagogia: Boundless Dreams.

title: Paranoia Vol 1
description: A psychological horror game based on Clark Turner, a student graduate with a dark past now finds himself in a strange facility. With nothing but a stranger on a radio to guide his way, every choice will impact the course of the game as well as his fate.

title: Infinitory
description: Infinitory mixes city-building, automation, and tower defense in a in a rogue-lite top-down game. Expand your base vertically in limited space, a strategic planning challenge. Automate resources to produce ammunition and upgrades, crucial for stopping waves of enemies on procedurally generated maps.

title: Thieves and Tasers
description: Sneak, steal, get tased. A fast-paced PvP heist game where thieves steal loot and scramble for their escape while security hunts them down. Team up, outsmart your friends, and make your escape. Or make sure nobody does.

title: Words for in Between
description: "speak, should the frost grow too bitter for thee to endure."

title: Night Watch at Freddie's
description: The "Night Watch at Freddie's" Series is a re-imagining of the original "Five Nights at Freddy's" games, exploring an alternative timeline where the games took a completely different route! Welcome to the July 5th Archive, where you can explore a recently unveiled prototype of developer Scot Cawthorn's hit indie game. Things are strangely different from the final game people are familiar with, ranging from the gameplay mechanics, to the lore of the game as a whole!

title: Attack on Kiss
description:
A visual novel with characters based on Attack on Titan manga written by Isayama Hajime. This story is all made up by me and has some references of the original so please consider before playing if you don't want spoilers.

Story: You are the protanganist who suddenly gets the super power of kissing. A lot of unexplained phenomenas keep happening around your school. What is your power? What are you gonna do with it? What are those mysteries? Are you gonna find out the truth behind all of those?

title: Dissolving Gallery
description: A submission for the 2019 GMTK Game Jam. Dissolving Gallery is a game built around the Jam's theme of "only one". In this game you explore a long lost gallery putting the pieces of a painting together. The catch, each room can only be visited once before falling apart, so pick your path carefully.

title: Overwatch: Reign of Talon - Season 2: Summit
description:
The fight for a better future pushes even higher during Season 2: Summit.

Our newest Damage Hero is here with the arrival of Sierra. As Head of Security for Watchpoint: Grand Mesa, Sierra takes pride in protecting those around her, and she does so with an arsenal built for controlling spaces, high and low.

Post-Match Accolades are back, giving you the ability to vote for a match’s MVP. And that’s not the only thing returning! Antarctic Peninsula is also back with new pathways and sightlines to help you in battle.

New Battle Pass and Shop skins are also arriving like the new Spring Fairy skins, Panda Jetpack Cat skin, Sakura Bundle, and the new Season 2 Mythics for both Genji and Soldier: 76.

And that’s just the beginning! Enjoy our newest arrival to Stadium with Ramattra, and Jetpack Cat, the start of Overwatch’s 10 Year Anniversary, our latest collaboration and more coming midseason.

title: Evergreen Valley: The Parkour Game
description: Evergreen Valley is a parkour adventure set in a stylized town. Jump, climb, and conquer every obstacle to reach the top! But beware! One fall, and it’s back to the very beginning!

title: One Coin Museum
description: Explore, collect, and curate your very own cozy museum! In One Coin Museum, sail across vast oceans to uncover treasures with your claw. Display them to attract visitors, and grow your reputation. Upgrade your boat to travel farther and discover the world’s hidden wonders.

title: Black Equation
description: Black Equation is a dark fantasy interactive fiction set in the medieval kingdom of Highgard, where a tyrannical king seeks to destroy his own realm and seize a neighboring throne. As magic spreads and political intrigue tightens, three protagonists — a compassionate mage, a drifting young man, and a loyal knight — are drawn into the unfolding collapse. Players navigate branching storylines through text-based choices that shape relationships, reveal hidden paths, and determine which of 12 endings they reach. The game features 7 interwoven love stories, including LGBTQ+ relationships, where romance that saves one character may doom another. A pure reading experience with no action mechanics — only narrative, atmosphere, and consequence.

title: Pure Idle
description: Become the hand of the Creator in search of lost perfection. Collect the light of millions of stars, sending them into the heart of a black hole to find the one — Pure Idle. 505 technologies, production chains, and an endless path to the universe's most beautiful star.

title: Postponed
description: An addictive wave-based arcade roguelite, in which you are the manager of a game development studio. You get a project each week, that your team and you have to work on to get paid. With that money get upgrades, skill your employees and even unlock characters. Ever wanted to lead a game dev studio?

title: Regions of Ruin: Runegate - The Merchant
description: A mysterious Merchant has arrived at the dwarven sanctuary of Rivenbrook Keep, selling 5 novel and perplexing wares. How unexpected, but perhaps these are the perfect tools for an adventuring dwarf rebuilding a home for their fellow kin?

title: Vanisha
description: Vanisha is a sci-fi arcade shooter where you dodge bullet waves, craft builds from collected cards, and climb through six sectors of increasingly dangerous space. Level up, spend skill points, hit shops along the way, and see how far your build can take you.

title: False Echo
description: Inspired by Papers, Please, False Echo is a narrative cryptography thriller set in the darkest depths of the Atlantic, aboard a secret military submarine. Operate the Obscura machine, decode messages, and decide what gets through in a regime where even the smallest mistake means a huge death toll.

title: Town of Cinders
description: You are a witch's apprentice in a small town plagued by a witch hunt. After a devastating event has shaken your life, you must now try to survive on your own in this world where magic is outlawed. Will you manage to make friends and see the end of the witch hunt, or will it be your end?

title: Unbox your Workspace
description: Unpack creativity and build your perfect workspace! Open boxes with furniture and decor, organize your setup, and create a functional, stylish environment that boosts comfort and productivity.

title: Shipyard of Theseus
description: A game about thinking about ships.

title: Polt
description:
Polt is a puzzle game where you are a boy stuck in a strange facility and your goal is to escape by the roof. The thing is that there are monsters in the shadows. You are safe but you can't see them in the real world. Your vulnerable but you can see them whenever you go to the shadow's world.

Defeat waves of enemies and reach the roof to win the game!

title: Warhammer Fantasy Classics
description: Warhammer Fantasy Classics bundle is a collection of some of the greatest titles from the history of Warhammer Fantasy video games, spanning the past 30 years. These games have been brought back to life as a series to celebrate their iconic legacy. Revived in a form that stays close to their original releases. Because of their classic nature, some content may not fully reflect current depictions, lore, or presentation within the modern Warhammer Fantasy universe.

title: Warhammer Classics: Complete Collection
description: Warhammer Classics is a collection of the greatest titles from the annals of Warhammer video game history, spanning the last 30 years, brought back to life as a series to celebrate their iconic legacy. These games have been revived in their original state. Because of their classic nature, some of the content may not accurately reflect current depictions, lore, or presentation within the current Warhammer universes and settings.

title: Corvax
description: Corvax is a space exploration, survival, and RPG simulator built on a high-performance procedural engine. In Corvax, the universe has no limits: every star, every planet, and every asteroid belt is mathematically generated and persists deterministically for an immersive experience.

title: Cool Thief Guy
description: First person simulation game where player mission is to steal as much money, jewelry in different places and avoid guardians and cameras and solve puzzles like lockpicks and hacking safe money boxes

title: Scales of Silence
description:
Clear the couch for co-op snake. A local party game where length is your life: up to 8 players on one shared screen for PvP battles, plus a 2-player co-op campaign.

Every hit costs you tail. Stay longer than your opponent, grind them down to nothing, and rack up +3 points per takedown. Shrink your friends before they shrink you.

Beneath it all runs an ancient war between serpents, and a living darkness feeding on the conflict. The campaign crosses ten biomes that change the rules: forests choke your sightlines, frozen wastes starve you, swamps poison most of your food, volcanoes stay in permanent darkness. Yes, this is a snake game. It just has more to say.

title: Focus Knight
description: Focus Knight is a relaxing focus and productivity RPG. Set a timer, stay focused, and watch your hero automatically explore dungeons, fight enemies, and grow stronger. The longer you focus, the greater the rewards.

title: Crack Mountain
description: You can wish for anything, all you need to do is climb this mountain... By throwing a ball that teleports you... Maybe try climbing too, I don't know I'm not the expert here.

title: Duck Dash Delivery
description: Duck Dash Delivery is a casual life management simulator where you play as a duck working to lift your family out of poverty. Navigate city traffic, avoid collisions, upgrade your scooter, and choose the most profitable delivery orders to save your family from their financial struggles.

title: The Door at the End of the Hall
description: Trapped in a looping hallway, you must study subtle changes to choose the right doors. Each passage resets the hall, but slightly wrong. Observe carefully, make smart choices, and uncover the path that unlocks the mysterious door at the end of the hall.

title: Sweetie Candy Maze: Brown Chocolate
description: Dive into a vibrant candy world! Collect delicious sweets and find your way through playful brown chocolate mazes in this sweet and colorful adventure.

title: My Friend Barrington
description: My Friend Barrington is a psychological 2.5D platformer about 11 year old Jordan escaping a turbulent home through his imagination. Play as a stuffed bear navigating symbolic worlds, FMV moments, platforming challenges, and emotional choices as fear turns into agency in a 15-minute story experience.

title: Sad Virus Military
description: Sad Virus mission to collect beer bottles in this 3rd person adventure game in military based land

title: The Cursed Hotel
description: A short game inspired by 90s horror games where you must escape a zombies infested hotel by using the elevator

title: Mommy Don't Hurt Me Mommy Don't Hurt Me Mommy Don't Hurt Me
description: Mommy leaves at night... over and over... until then I am alone, and as it gets darker... They appear. A table lamp is my only defence, pretending asleep is the only thing I can do. Only You can help me survive these horrific restless nights.

title: Lovely Anime Puzzle: Spring
description: Lovely Anime Puzzle: Spring is a fun and rewarding puzzle game. Assemble charming Spring-themed pictures, sharpen your attention, and immerse yourself in a beautiful world.

title: The Adventures of Graham
description: A sci-fi retro Metroidvania. Help Brigadier General Graham recover his gear, defeat enemies, and complete his mission.

title: Worlds Explorers
description: Explore alien planets with carefully designed ecosystems, weather, resources, dangers and unique phenomena. Hunt animals for food and collect resources to craft equipment and repair devices on your ship. Escape each unique planet and unlock crew members and new ships.

title: Artsec
description: A short, science themed story game about a secret research facility - dedicated to unwrap the mystery behind strange, otherworldly objects. Meet unique characters, prove your worth, work in the laboratories - and lose your mind.

title: Triuno Ascend
description: Triuno Ascend is a roguelike deckbuilder where every card in your hand can define your victory or defeat. Build your deck, create powerful synergies, and master a unique system where winning means emptying your hand at the perfect moment. Every turn is a colorful and strategic puzzle.

title: Dwarven Forge
description: Master the depths in Dwarven Forge. Use your fireball-flinging lantern to clear paths and mine rare ores. Incrementally upgrade your digging power, node yields, and forging skills to craft and sell legendary weapons. Descend, optimize, and unlock the secrets of the ancient mountain.

title: [Redacted] the Safehouse
description: You're a detective. Investigate the haunting events surrounding the murder of Ann Peterson and her boyfriend. Explore an old safehouse for clues, deduce keywords and reveal redacted words as you search Ann's digital journal, and piece together your case report as this unfortunate story unfolds.

title: Vampire Therapist: Couples Therapy
description: Return to the world of the award-winning therapize-'em-up with Vampire Therapist: Couples Therapy! Experience a story of revolutions, relationships, and everyday domestic annoyances as you saddle up once more as Sam Walls, amateur therapist and cowboy vampire.

title: Chrome Carnage
description:
Chrome Carnage is a high-octane vehicle combat game set in a near-future world where corporations have quietly replaced governments and the line between business and crime was erased a long time ago. Strap into an arsenal of weaponised vehicles and tear through brutal multiplayer arenas — or dive into a story-driven campaign where ten corporate criminals are offered something they can't refuse.

Challenge your friends or dive into public lobbies and compete in fast-paced vehicular combat across a growing roster of arenas. Host your own lobby, invite friends via Steam, or jump into an existing session with a join code. Every match is chaos — rockets, machine guns, and boost-ramming all have a place in your loadout. Learn the maps, master your vehicle, and become the last one rolling.

title: Evidence of 96'
description: Experience a dark visual novel from the perspective of a deranged high-schooler who committed a serious crime and must now seek to destroy all evidences that point to him.

title: Before Times
description: Play as caveman with friend or many friend and explore strange new world! Survive against small lizard, big lizard, chicken lizard and big cat to find the Mungo Bungo! That mean great treasure in Unga Bunga language.

title: Bubble Cadence
description: Bubble Cadence is a short incremental game about popping lots of bubbles and gathering musical essence to help the inhabitants of a small island town.

title: Oceanopolis 2000
description: Build the future under the sea in this retro sci-fi city tycoon.

title: Master of Chaos
description: Pulverize your enemies for underestimating this cute little wizard by counter attacks, deflecting projectiles, unleashing face-melting ultimate abilities and building insane combos boosting your power until you are strong enough to beat the boss or break the game - Either way you win.

title: Hunk Empire
description: Kicked out and pulled into his dad’s outrageous adult film empire, a young gay man must build a scrappy new studio. Flirt, film, and manage your way past rivals and wild personalities to turn chaos into your very own gay empire.

title: Rift of the Necrodancer: Undertale - "Spider Dance" - Toby Fox
description: The official Rhythm Rift for "Spider Dance" by Toby Fox fills you with determination. This track is part of the UNDERTALE Music Pack.

title: Inquisitor Simulator
description: Command an inquisitorial monastery where faith, alchemy, and… creative interrogation techniques are your primary tools as an Inquisitor. Contain what can be contained. Purge the rest. Not everything is evil. Not everything is human. No one expects your judgment to be just every time. …Right?

title: Kinetype
description: Kinetype is a minimalist, terminal, ASCII, roguelite where your keyboard is the interface for survival. Navigate procedural terminal grids by typing commands to move and survive. Extract to bank Bytes for permanent upgrades, or lose your streak to the system. The terminal is yours to command.

title: Cardboard Cowboy
description: Cardboard Cowboy, the cardboard Wild West shooter. Blast through handcrafted paper shooting galleries, dual-wield makeshift revolvers and shotguns, and chase high scores across three outlaw-filled regions. Beat timed weapon challenges. Collect tarot cards. Unlock the ultimate cardboard loadout.

title: Los Pilarcitos
description: Los Pilarcitos is a third-person game where the player must complete search missions and help other characters in the city. From a third-person perspective, the player can move, fight in melee combat, and drive vehicles.

title: Kettlebell: Inferno Hotel
description: Kettlebell: Inferno Hotel is a fast-paced 2D platformer inspired by the 16-bit classics of the '90s — packed with humor, destruction, and pure hellish energy!

title: Lufia V: For the Savior
description: A fan-made sequel to the critically acclaimed "Lufia" series, twenty years in the making. Puzzles, battles, and more! Experience the heartfelt fan-made conclusion to the Lufian legend!

title: Takoyaki Run
description: A short game made for a 48 hour game jam. Control an octopus trying to get all its legs back from the evil sushi chef.

title: The Last Inquisition
description: The witch hunt begins. Command your followers in a dark roguelike strategy experience. Evolve spells and units without limits through blood and faith. Shape formations, adapt tactics, and uncover the conspiracy in ever-changing battles.

title: Exobiota
description: Exobiota is a dungeon crawling RPG set in the mouldering underworld of Midsheol, a distant alien planet. Use your bio-alterations to survive exile to a quarantined buffer zone. Will you retain your humanity or relinquish it in the face of a strange powers and exotic creatures?

title: Ward: Descent
description: WARD: Descent is a 2D dungeon-crawler roguelike where you pilot an armored combat suit. Explore an overrun research laboratory, manage your suit's software upgrades, and complete sequences to destroy anomalies. Descend to the bottom, pilot, and complete your mission!

title: Fire Emblem Proto-Rogue
description: A roguelike Fire Emblem fan game where you have to survive as many waves as you can. Build a team with 4 units to survive the onslaught of enemies and bosses! Grab items from the shop or chests to heal, gain temporary buffs to damage or defense, or permanently increase your stats!

title: Elders K.O.
description:
Welcome to Elders K.O., the elderly fighting party game nobody asked for… but everyone secretly needed!

A first-person online multiplayer game where up to 8 elders (or rather, the players controlling them) exchange punches, laughs, magical items, and a worrying amount of digital osteoporosis.

Run, jump, push, dodge, steal, explode, and punch other old folks with boxing gloves.
Yes. Everything is allowed here.
Fast fun, instant chaos, guaranteed laughter.

title: Overdrive Reloaded
description: Drop into a stunning reimagining of Overdrive, built from the ground up with relentless PvE combat, action-packed Arena modes, an open world Survival experience, and all-new skill tree and roguelike progression systems. Prepare for Overdrive, you are cleared for deployment.

title: Discovery 2
description: Build, share & explore! Discovery 2 is a beautiful sandbox game. Now available on Nintendo Switch!

title: Potato Simulato
description:
Welcome to Potato Simulato: Together , a chaotic physics-based platformer where you play as a helpless potato trying to survive a world full of traps, madness, and pure frustration.

Roll, jump, and struggle your way through bizarre obstacle courses filled with spinning hammers, deadly spikes, collapsing platforms, and completely unfair surprises. One mistake… and it’s back to the start.

This game is not about skill alone , it’s about patience, timing, and how much rage you can handle.

title: Witch the Showdown
description: A high-difficulty action game combining parry mechanics and deck-building. Fight your way through and aim to become the champion of the tournament.

title: Ultimate Wizard
description: Destroy thousands of enemies and grow in power in this fantasy roguelite survivor. Find spells and augment them, equip build defining items, discover secrets, level up and set out to become the ultimate wizard!

title: Hand of Daggers
description: The traitorous Royal Courtiers have arrived in the dead of night, daggers drawn! Play a roguelike deckbuilding card game against them, with your life on the line.

title: Unfair War: Survivors
description: This is NOT a "forever" roguelike for thousands of hours. It's a game for a few cozy evenings. Download — launch — play immediately. No skill trees, no boring meta-grind. Just pure co-op action: you're chained together, dodging waves of robots, throwing grenades, and triggering ultimates.

title: Mayfly
description: Mayfly is a story-rich, quiet horror set aboard a narrowboat in Northern England. A short psychological horror experience focused on exploration, story and atmosphere. Search a detailed, highly explorable narrowboat setting that evolves as the mystery unfolds. Uncover clues and memories amidst unsettling shifts in the environment around you. Solve puzzles to guide Caroline on her journey to be reunited with her husband Robert.

title: Banneret
description: Roguelike deckbuilding meets tactical auto-battling in this party building strategy game! Recruit and upgrade fighters, customize your deck, explore treacherous lands and battle fierce enemies.

title: Tokigeon
description: Welcome to Tokigeon. This is a roguelike dungeon crawler game that combines puzzle-solving, deck-building, and auto-battler elements. Strategically combine skill puzzles, build devastating combos, and unleash massive damage to defeat your enemies.

title: Atmos
description: Atmos is a fast-paced action roguelike, where you can shoot, slash, blast, smash, slice, bash and more!.

title: Hecatomb
description: Hecatomb is a mythic deckbuilding roguelike that tests how much you're willing to sacrifice. Every action produces Offerings, which can be relinquished to the Gods in exchange for powerful effects. But which Gods you worship and which you scorn have lasting effects on your journey to the Underworld.

title: Dog in the Machine
description: A tactical roguelite where you help an AutoDog escape a dystopian mecha-city and get back to their exiled humans. Teach the dog custom tricks to tackle strategic challenges through devastating chain reactions. Break the Machine in your path to freedom!

title: House of Heists
description: House of Heists is an action roguelike management game about a family of burglars in a world where furniture fights back. Fight through procedural homes, capture wild appliances, and build, decorate, and upgrade your ever-growing dream house.

title: Bahnfrei
description: Race down icy slopes packed with sharp turns and unforgiving obstacles. A fast, chaotic co-op game built for speedrunners and friendship stress-tests.

title: Pacremental
description: Pacremental is a incremental game about opening packs, unlocking weapon cards, evolve them and automating your progress. Collect rare artifacts, combine them with weapons, and push through increasingly difficult waves. Build tower your own way.

title: Gobstruck
description: You and your friends are goblins on a looting mission. Find a way through chaotic random generated levels and take as many valuables with you as you are able to grab!

title: Country Hopper
description: Delivery Doug drives around the world delivering boxes. Help him find the shortest route from one country to another. Collect pieces of beautiful Jigsaw puzzles and improve your geography knowledge along the way.

title: Spear Leap Saga
description: Embark on a daring journey in Spear Leap Saga! Climb higher and higher through a challenging platforming world, driven by a strong wish. Every leap brings you closer to the night sky, but be careful—one misstep could send you tumbling back down, putting your dream just out of reach...

title: Totenkampf: Anime Waifus vs WW2 Zombies
description: Fight waves of WW2 zombies as an interdimensional magical anime girl, alone, or with a team of up to 6! Customize your waifu's appearance and outfit, and wield a wide array of weapons and powers as you struggle to survive the undead horde.

title: Contract Bridge Solo
description: This game is a single-player game based on the contract bridge rules. Without auction/bidding, it automatically determines how many tricks the declarer should win. You can enjoy playing cards with an extremely intelligent AI partner, against the other two.

title: Dark Engines
description: Choose a juggernaut and tear through a dark fantasy campaign of brutal car combat, bosses, and unlocks. Then bring the carnage online in tight team-based multiplayer where explosives, magic, and heavy metal decide who survives.

title: Diamond Runway
description: "Diamond Runway" is an interactive RPG where you play as Lindsay, an aspiring supermodel. Starting as a novice in a NYC competition, you'll face rivalry, friendships, romance, and growth. Your choices shape relationships, career, and endings in a journey through the glamorous yet dark fashion world.

title: Chuxie2
description: This time the player will play the role of a trainee exorcist,and her first task is to find missing persons.It seems like a simple task,but she has no idea what a terrifying and unimaginable existence she is about to face.

title: The Concrete Sutra #1
description: A post-apocalyptic world. Two friends haven't seen each other for 5 years are heading back home on a bike. The first episode of an epic action jrpg by yeo.

title: Stickman Zombie Shooting 3D
description: The city has been infected! Shoot and kill the zombie stickmen. Fast-paced arcade gameplay through dozens of bespoke levels. The stickman world needs your help - or at least for you not to die too quickly.

title: Don’t Open
description: Don’t Open is a PSX-style horror game about routine that falls apart before your eyes. A normal shift at a taco bar, an empty stairwell, and a persistent knock on the door that's impossible to ignore. Based on real events.

title: Castaway Diary: Portal to the Unknown Isles
description: Castaway Diary is a bright and charming anime-style survival adventure. Are you ready to escape to a relaxing island life with a group of lovely girls?

title: Dead Lasso: Temple Of Shadows
description: Dodge enemies, solve environmental puzzles, and chain your growing moveset in true Metroidvania style as you unravel the temple’s deadly mysteries.

title: Barbie: Horse Ride & Rescue
description: Start your Western horse riding adventure with Barbie at Roaming Hearts Rescue Ranch. Rescue and rehabilitate charming horses, test your riding skills and customize your style as you uncover the mysteries of Moonrise Valley!

title: Deaths of Peck
description: Deaths of Peck is a fast-paced 2D platformer where the only way to WIN is to DIE! Play as Peck, a tiny goblin cursed with immortality. Orcs took your friends. No matter how many deaths it takes to save them, you always bounce back stronger - in this charmingly gory, hand-drawn adventure.

title: Genshin Impact: Augured Homecoming
description:
Version "Luna VI" of Genshin Impact, also known as "Song of the Welkin Moon: Rondo". This update includes:
• New character: Linnea
• New areas: Windrest Peak and Temple of Space
• New story quests for Linnea
• New main event: Where Waves Meet the Reef
• New updates for Miliastra Wonderland
• New QoL, and more!

title: Paw Patrol: Dino World
description: Join the PAW Patrol and Rex on colossal missions across Dino Island. Create roar-some looks, play minigames with friends and more.

title: Kart Soccer Party
description: Drive your kart and smash the ball into the opponent's goal! Packed with fun and fully playable online!

title: Willow Guard: Frostreign
description: The tale of a brave Willowguard continues towards Regnum Polis in preventing another monstrous breakthrough. The journey through frozen Atalaka Mountains can only be safely passed using the ancient portals. Súri, a young wolverine orphan, joins Ghweros in this epic adventure as an unstoppable duo.

title: Grounded 2: Beat the Heat
description:
Beat the Heat Update – Your Lizard Has Arrived

You asked for something bigger than bugs, and now it’s here.

The Beat the Heat update is now live in Grounded 2, bringing a new boss fight, a new buggy progression system, and a wave of content, improvements, and community-requested features across the park.

title: Honkai: Star Rail - So Laughed the Masses
description:
Version 4.2 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New characters: Silver Wolf LV.999, Evanescia, Trailblazer (Elation)
• New Trailblaze Mission: "So Laughed the Masses"
• New events
• ...and more!

title: Euro Truck Simulator 2: Soul of Anatolia
description: Hop into your truck and dive into the Soul of Anatolia! This vast, culturally rich centre of Türkiye is a land of stunning contrasts, where sunlit coasts meet towering mountains and open plains.

title: Ronald's Revenge
description: When Ronald's brother gets scammed, he takes matters into his own hands by hacking into the scammer's pc with a plot to scam the scammer himself.

title: Red World Fan Fork
description:
What if the Soviets Won?

Red World imagines a modern scenario in which the Soviet Union won its cold war against the United States. Despite becoming our globe's sole superpower, the Soviets face the daunting task of maintaining ultimate control.
It seems that in the coming years everything might just be slipping away...

In memory of Kaiser1871, the original creator of Red World and a dear friend to us all. This fan fork will continue to expand and update Red World along Kaiser's intended plans and wishes, making it a fun experience for everyone to enjoy once again to its fullest!

title: ASCII Survivors
description: Everything is ASCII. A survivor-like roguelite where every monster, bullet, and explosion is made of text on a CRT screen. 8 characters, 16 weapons, 6 enchantments, 4 game modes. See how long your terminal holds.

title: Halloween Harem
description: Help Halloween Harlots and Hotties in "Halloween Harem". You've woken up in a strange place with no memory of how you got here. Explore the town and meet new people. Maybe you should help them out and fetch what they need. Even if they act a little crazy... they look kinda hot.

title: Forensic: M.E. Protocol
description: Put on your gloves and enter the crime scene. In this investigation simulator, you will have to solve 9 unique and independent cases full of plot twists. Use drones, robots, and chemical analysis to discover what really happened. Here, you don't shoot the bad guys; you catch them with science.

title: Ritterschlag
description: Ritterschlag is a medieval autobattler: choose from ten classes and defend your hard-earned hop brew for 20 nights against vile rabble. Pick items every night and level attributes to create unique builds with which to smash the bandits' faces in.

title: I Hear Them
description: You hear scurrying in the ceiling. You hear scratching in the walls. Your house is infested with rats, and its your job to get rid of them. Catch rats with the help of your best friend, Lola, and uncover the supernatural mysteries behind their gatherings inside your new home.

title: Three Misses Confectionery
description: On a rainy afternoon, a young man takes shelter in a cute and quiet confectionery. Three sweet chefs welcome him enthusiastically and offer irresistible cakes.

title: Specshong
description: Import any song and turn it into a playable level in this rhythm-based shooter that combines free movement, precision mechanics, and beat-driven gameplay modes.

title: Megapain
description: A dynamic retro shooter with intense arena battles and co-op mode! Gear up with pistols, assault rifles, and rocket launchers to annihilate hordes of mutants solo or with friends. Every arena is a new challenge, every firefight is pure action! Inspired by the FPS shooter legends of the '90s-'00s.

title: Delta Manager
description:
Delta Manager is a hardcore management simulation. Forget arcade driving and 3D graphics: here, the action unfolds through a real-time command interface. Like a true Team Principal on the pit wall, you face a ruthless AI where only your ability to analyze telemetry determines the winner.

Experience the race from the pit wall. In this hardcore management simulation driven by a comprehensive tactical interface, every decision is vital. From R&D to real-time strategy under dynamic weather: analyze the data and lead your team to victory.

title: Grid Crypt
description: Grid Crypt is a grid-based puzzle game where you observe and exploit enemy behavior. Monsters in the dungeon move according to strict priorities and routes. Use their habits against them and clear your path. Just who is the King lurking in the depths of this dungeon...?

title: Final Fantasy Blackmoon Prophecy Remake
description:
A full remake of the 2011 RPG Maker 2003 game, Blackmoon Prophecy, redeveloped in RPG Maker and released in 2026.

Save Gaia from a malevolent evil in this oldschool retro JRPG by traversing the planet to safeguard the Crystals of the Element from harm.

title: Power Pets
description: Collect pets, level them up and power your way through endless waves of enemies. Evolve your pets as the hordes attack you to become even stronger. Customise them with runes, food, items to make your exploration even more powerful!

title: Tyto
description: Take flight and glide through a breathtaking world in Tyto, a gliding-based metroidvania, where you play as a lost owlet searching for its family in a vast and perilous world.

title: Hope 01
description: Hope 01 is a single player extraction survival RPG with multiple endings. Explore, Loot, and Fight your way through the dangers of the hab cluster and solve the mysteries of the legendary HAB 01.

title: Riftborne
description: Riftborne is a classic terminal based, real time, grand strategy game. Construct space ships. Take part in factional warfare. Hire galactic hit-men on your rivals. Raid neighbors for rare resources. Train spies to infiltrate enemy bases for key intel. Grow your empire to dominate the galaxy.

title: The Woman Above
description: The Woman Above — a psychological horror game where, during your vacation, you check into a rented apartment and on the very first night hear strange moans coming from the apartment above. Will you dare to go and find out what’s happening up there?

title: Die DillyBillys
description: Die DillyBillys is an adventure game made for children. It combines pre-rendered 3D environments with hand drawn characters and a live action actress guiding the player. The goal of the game is finding DillyBillys, little fantasy creatures, in a variety of urban locations.

title: The Echoes of Me
description: The Echoes of Me is a first‑person horror experience focused on tense exploration and completing objective‑based sequences under pressure. You’ll move through dark environments, search for key items, and trigger events that push the story forward. Typical gameplay centres on roaming, solving environmental puzzles, and avoiding enemies that react to your presence. Expect scripted scares, dynamic jump scares, a quick‑time event, and a chase sequence.

title: Liminal Sick Pizza Blue
description: Make pizzas and deliver them. The hardest part of running the shop alone is that the delivery destinations are "liminal spaces." A story-driven 3D horror game. There is a kind of worst possible outcome that can only be born in infinite space. Once you understand it, it is already too late.

title: Bow-wow Battle
description: Be a dog. Bark. And win. "Bow-wow Battle" is a 1v1 game where you bark into your mic for real! Steam Online Multiplayer supported! Push the tug-of-war gauge with voice volume and rapid-fire barks! Adorable dogs, Dog Road story mode, and Crab Survival. With friends, family, or your crush — bark out!

title: The Payphone
description: You are an investigator working in a near-bankrupt agency, however a case no-one would take landed on your desk. Disappearances of Ashfield Plains, each case is hauntingly similar, all their final phone calls were traced back to that specific payphone. Short on cash, you took the case.

title: Don't Forget the Phone
description: Experience a point & click time management game that puts your multi-tasking to the test. Complete all of your tasks before sunrise, but watch out for anything that may have escaped the lab below.

title: Forgive or Finalize
description: A short-form psychological thriller. Confront the mysterious Finn through a monitor. No strategy or puzzles—just choices and their consequences. Simply answer his questions and witness the end.

title: Danger Sticks
description: A ruthless, hyper-fast, first-person stickman shooter that channels flash era stick-fight energy. Use Nostalgia to slow time, chain crisp headshots, and flow through dense arenas with a wide arsenal. Instant restarts and tight scoring reward speed, accuracy, and perfect movement.

title: Max Savage
description:
Retro arcade space combat meets action-adventure exploration. Blast through a 90s-inspired sci-fi romp as Max Savage and fight to save the one person she can’t lose.

Wing Commander meets Zelda: jump into retro arcade space dogfights, then land on planets for action-adventure exploration. Talk to NPCs, uncover secrets, and push a story forward across the Kir system.

Play as Max Savage, a Federation pilot stranded far from home after she refuses an order to execute a wounded pirate, Lara. Cast out by a petty superior and stuck in Kir, Max takes mercenary work to rebuild her rank, earn her way off-world, and survive a system crawling with pirates.

Retro-inspired by 90s classics, built with modern amenities: fast to learn, satisfying to master, and designed for smooth play with today’s comforts while keeping that bold, over-the-top 90s energy.

title: DoDonPachi Resurrection Reignite
description: Cave's arcade bullet hell shooter returns as DoDonPachi Resurrection Reignite. New stages, a new character, new music, and other new elements set the stage for a new challenge.

title: Cyber92 Datawar
description: CYBER92 DATAWAR is a Surreal, Retro-Realistic Cyberpunk Shooter blending 3rd and 2nd-Person Combat. Master brutal gunplay, stealth, and time-space distortion. Shift through glitching vision modes, use destructive vehicles, and survive a fractured, twisted reality under constant time pressure.

title: Iter
description: Iter is a real-time souls-inspired action-adventure game. Traverse dungeons, fight your way through a variety of enemies, and customize your loadout with weapons and abilities that you will find throughout the game.

title: Silkroad Project
description: SILKROAD Project blends a dynamic combat system, where players control two characters, with a guesthouse management experience filled with unique activities. Chain spectacular combos, welcome your guests, plan their daily routines, and help your caravanserai thrive.

title: Ass Sniffing Simulator
description: Welcome to Ass Sniffing Simulator - a game where every action becomes a true test of your endurance and stamina. There are no complicated levels or increasing difficulty - just you and a steady stream of unexpected sensations.

title: Folders on the Run
description: Escape the factory reset! Control two adorable folders in a failing OS. Play solo or coordinate your movements with a friend. Master shifting mechanics to survive. Perfect for testing your skills and friendships!

title: Fragmentary Order
description:
200 years ago, humanity was able to stand on the brink of darkness, survive and reverse mutual total destruction. The organization that secretly proclaimed itself the Core was able to gather the remnants of everything human and turn the tide of destruction, convincing and uniting the governments of the world.

People began to explore the solar system, defeated famine and war, praising the savior - the Core. By that time, trust in governments had been completely lost and the world had moved to a corporate system of power controlled by Core structures.

title: Doom ChessMaster
description: The end has come. Who will save us? You are the "Player" surviving in ruins. No chosen heroes—only the strong remain. Gather them, plan carefully, use gear to change fate. Truth lies in the wreckage. Dare you play?

title: Orbitmine
description: Orbit a planet, fire your laser, and mine it to the core. Upgrade your ship and conquer seasonal hazards across four unique zones. A satisfying incremental mining game set in space.

title: Universal Weirdness
description: A 2D hand-drawn puzzle adventure that spans multiple dimensions and universes. Encounter a diverse cast of characters and unravel mind-bending mysteries as you embark on unique adventures across different worlds.

title: Popup.exe
description: A chill idle game in the corner of your screen. Popups spawn. Close them. Earn money. Buy upgrades. Repeat.

title: Lawnmower Runner
description: New part for lawnmower game series. Endless runner game. drive lawnmower collect grass and avoid rocks

title: Project Ants
description: Project Ants is a 3D Metroidvania combining the exploration depth of Hollow Knight with the technical hack-and-slash of Ninja Gaiden. Set in a fractured insect kingdom, a fallen Phragmotic Ant Warrior explores a brutal, layered world to uncover the secrets at its core.

title: Lac-Pochette Centennial
description:
Stories from an outpost of the 19th century doll-logging industry

Hidden in the north woods of Maine stand the ruins of the logging camps at Lac-Pochette, a place afflicted by an everlasting winter that holds a fortune's worth of doll pine suspended atop a frozen river.

Lucy Sargent, the daughter of a poor lumberman, finds it hard to believe such wealth would sit deserted in the forest. Seeking confirmation, she travels to Lac-Pochette, where she instead discovers a runaway girl living in a bunkhouse.

The two of them interface with the dolls they find there — rare Merrymeeting dolls, which evaded their typical fates — that each have a tale to tell about the camp, its inhabitants, and the strange nature of the doll pine itself.

title: White Camellia
description: Everyone knows the Dungeons and Dragons cliché of a first meeting in the tavern, but what happens when the strangers are connected by something else than the passion for adventuring?

title: AAron
description:
The Circuit Realm is in danger!

Generators all around the Realm have shut down, leaving its inhabitants frozen in place…

AAron, a simple battery living in Batteryon, one of the only remaining safe spots, is tasked by the Elder to go and fix Generators to bring back power to the land by using a very special ability... Coming back in a new body after losing power.

Made for the GMTK Game Jam 2025!

title: Scoundrel
description: Scoundrel is an RPG themed Solitaire game. Battle your way through each of the 4 card rooms of the dungeon, fight enemies with weapons or barehanded, while managing your own health, and reach the end to achieve the ultimate high score.

title: Company of Heroes 3: Dare & Destroy
description: Company of Heroes 3: Dare & Destroy is a Battlegroup DLC pack consisting of four Battlegroups for Multiplayer and Co-Op/ Skirmish vs AI.

title: Phazika
description: Click to freeze time. Release to redirect your momentum. That's all you need. Bend time and wrangle physics as you dodge bullets and zigzag through impossible obstacles in the abstract psychedelic worlds of this roguelike/speedrunning joyride.

title: Kitaria Fables 2
description: Team up with new heroes Alice and Dusty as they embark on an epic adventure across the mysterious Arkadera Peninsula. Develop unique combat skills, gather precious materials, forge powerful items, and tend to your growing farm, either alone or with a friend!

title: Construction Simulator: Evolution
description: Dig into the next exciting evolution of the Construction Simulator series and experience the biggest construction playground ever. Control numerous licensed machines, take on manual labor, and master both construction and demolition.

title: Northgard Battlegrounds
description: A city-building auto-battler set in the Viking world of Northgard, where every building you place shapes your clan’s fate. Develop your village, claim the Gods’ blessings, and send your warband to battle against rival players! Every move counts, only one clan will stand.

title: Wall World Strategy
description: Build and lead a colony on the surface of an endless Wall. Manage resources and your people, develop new technologies, defend against relentless zyrex attacks, and send robo-spiders on risky expeditions. Keep the colony from collapsing – in Wall World, it's easy to fall.

title: Hevel Isle
description: Inspired by the book of Ecclesiastes, Hevel Isle aims to replicate and explore the feelings of tension and mystery that comes from exploring the unknown.
