In this treasure-hunting thriller, you will navigate maze-like dungeons, ancient ruins, and the hostile wilderness, where traps and treasure lie around every corner. Can you escape the deadly world of Hevel Isle?

title: Chip 'n Clawz vs. The Brainioids: Going Underground
description: Chip ‘n Clawz are in deep trouble! Literally! This massive DLC expands Chip ‘n Clawz with a brand new story campaign, new enemies to fight, upgrades to collect, and secrets to explore.

title: Mojo Party
description: Mojo Party is a fast-paced party game collection where 1-16 players use their phones to dive into pop culture, chaotic mini-games, wild challenges, and improv mayhem. Built to spark laughs, rivalry, and unforgettable moments.

title: Hevel
description: Explore a dark and dreamlike world, where low stars point to secrets. A first person platform game, with a short but intense experience.

title: Substrate: Emergence
description: Grow fluorescent cells that create mesmerizing emergent chaos. Simple mechanics hide deep complexity as cells evolve survival strategies through synergistic interactions. Catalogue successful lines and culture them to develop your own unique biology.

title: Dirty Business
description: Build a criminal empire from a hidden underground hangar. Produce drugs, craft weapons, print fake money, and more. Hire workers, expand your gang, upgrade your base, operate cartel airstrip and take control of city distribution solo or in co-op.

title: Heroes, Warlords and Ruin
description: Create your hero, manage resources, raise armies and build an empire. This fantasy turn-based 4x strategy game features empire management, large-scale tactical battles, and RPG mechanics.

title: AI Slop Simulator
description: A darkly satirical idle game about building an AI content empire. Automate slop factories, prestige through startup pivots, and watch civilization collapse under the weight of your algorithmically generated garbage. The numbers go up, and nothing could possibly go wrong.

title: Social Space
description: Social Space is the ultimate sandbox for creating and playing together. Party up with friends from all around the world to chat, hang out, explore player-created spaces, or build something new and amazing to share with the community!

title: The Restricted Index
description: Read between the lies in this first-person mystery puzzle game. You are the last librarian in Britain. Identify books. Recommend them. Ban them. Burn them. Uncover a catalogue of secrets and lost stories buried between the pages.

title: My Favourite T-Shirt
description: Follow a pincushion hero through a world quietly poisoned by the fast fashion industry. Explore a broken village, learn forgotten crafts from ancient masters, and repurpose the sewing machines that once destroyed everything you loved.

title: Showrunners
description: A single player, fast paced, speed running platformer focused on building up and maintaining high speeds, performing tricks and mastering the use of movement to achieve the fastest time and greatest score. Find and unlock new movement options to help you escape the gameshow you are trapped in.

title: Museful
description: A colour-fuelled 2D Metroidvania. Paint your surroundings as a little lizard exploring a huge hand-crafted world, and restore emotion to a monochrome continent as you discover your true colours.

title: Sugee Yasashii Yandere no Ichiniji no Ruutin
description: This game is an exploration horror adventure where you can enjoy solving mysteries while learning what the yandere protagonist does from the moment she wakes up until she goes to sleep at night .

title: Mumbo Shuffle
description: Load up on snacks, ready your remote, and join the mischievous Mumbos as you play, build, and jumble your way to victory in this card-based roguelike deckbuilder set in the hidden universe at the edges of the TV signal.

title: At Eternity's Hatch
description: Stranded at sea in an alternate timeline, you must master a complex time travel system to find a way home while piecing together the mystery of an obsessed captain and his quest that lead him to the Greenland Sea in search of a supernatural anomaly.

title: Hentai Succubus Aura
description: Hentai Succubus Aura is an adult anime puzzle game featuring the seductive succubus Aura. Solve memory and puzzle challenges to unlock new illustrations, achievements, and gallery content.

title: Corestory
description: Embark on an exciting journey through the long forgotten kingdom of Corestate. Collect and master various abilities, upgrade your gear, customize how you want to play and defeat powerful opponents. Decide about the world's fate in this mysterious pixel-art Metroidvania.

title: Taival
description: Play together on the couch or online - or both at once. Taival is a cozy co-op adventure where you and up to 3 friends explore a handcrafted world alongside your shapeshifting companion. Discover new forms, progress through narrative quests, and make the journey your own.

title: Rontgard
description: A tense top-down post-apocalyptic survival shooter where every bullet, bandage, and inventory slot matters.

title: Diorama Break
description: The tactics JRPG where you can talk directly to the Hero (whether he wants it or not). Fight through turn-based battles and awkward conversations alike.

title: Skingdom
description: Create your own ski realm in Skingdom, a ski resort construction and management game! Arrange your resort, draw your slopes and build your lifts, hotels and shops. Take care of your budget, hire staff and invest in upgrades for your ski resort to reach the top of the mountain!

title: Soundwave
description:
Soundwave — Frequency Memory is a skill-based audio game developed by Mantle Software. Players listen to a tone, then recreate it from memory using a frequency slider. The closer the match, the higher the score.

Compete on global leaderboards in Ranked Play, take on the Daily Challenge shared by every player worldwide, test your ear in Chord Mode by identifying root notes and chord qualities, or go head-to-head against another player in real-time Versus Mode. Progress is tracked through an SR rating system with tiers from Bronze to Legend.

title: The Mystery of Doomsday Valley
description: Mind-controlled squirrels! Alien abductions! Monsters in the forest! Are the rumors true - or is it just an elaborate hoax?  Help Maya Harper unravel this comedy point 'n click mystery and escape Doomsday Valley alive.

title: Pixel Waifu: Escape From the Dark Corporation. The Telepathic Power of a Lovestruck Otaku
description: Miguel Bolaños, a 24-year-old teenager, embarks on the adventure of a lifetime: to finally lose his virginity. To do so, he must rescue an alien trapped in an evil corporation. Face hordes of inept scientists and underpaid office workers in a pixel art odyssey filled with action and absurd humor.

title: Posthuman: Guardians vs Psion
description:
Choose from 20+ distinct superpowers! Lead your team of superheroes to the moon and beyond, and stop the supervillains of PSION—unless, of course, you join them.

Posthuman: Guardians vs PSION is an interactive superhero novel by Evan J. Peterson, author of Drag Star!, where your choices control the story. It's entirely text-based, 300,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects, and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

title: Lionhearts
description: Lionhearts is a persistent multiplayer feudal simulator set during the 12th-century Third Crusade. Command armies, dominate trade, or rise to power through politics & religion. Forge alliances, wage wars, and shape history in a living feudal world.

title: FragMiner
description: They mine with pickaxes... you mine with bombs ! Trigger satisfying chain reactions, vacuum up loot, and get stronger with powerful upgrades as you explore diverse mines.

title: Limacina Open Season
description:
An Angel & its Charge bond over sinew at the end of the world.

Six vignettes of their lives as everything frays away from them.

title: Arknights: Endfield - Update 1.2: At the Wake of Spring
description:
Version 1.2 of Arknights: Endfield, which includes:
• New Operator: Zhuang Fangyi
• New Main Story Chapter (Wuling arc)
• New areas: Marker Stone and Test Area
• New events and missions
• ...and more!

title: Tobari and the Vampire Alchemist
description: Guide the protagonist through the maps. Deep in the forest, an alchemist hides a monster, Tobari. Driven by hidden motives that outweigh the danger, the alchemist suffers from an illness. Beside them, the monster finds its heart torn by strange, conflicting emotions...

title: A Vessel of Frustration
description: You return to your hometown but no one recognizes you. But that doesn’t matter, because you are not here for them. You are here for her. Midgårdsormen, singer and artist, pervert and goddess, a being truly out of this world.

title: Industrial Legion
description: Fight against and with thousands of individually simulated troops as a cohesive team blending first person shooter combat with squad management or with real time strategy

title: TurtleSkate
description:
TurtleSkate is a 1–5 player co-op comedy horror game.
Become a turtle on a skateboard and run from strange entities.

title: Bastyrion: Endless Tide
description: Bastyrion: Endless Tide is a physics-based construction survival roguelike with massive horde defense. Build a mobile fortress, navigate across an archipelago, collect gems from corrupted cores, and open the Great Portal looming on the horizon to complete your mission.

title: Lóng zhī Gǔ: Huáijiù Fú
description:
Dragon Nest Classic brings players back to the golden age of Althea.
This service focuses on the authentic PvE raiding experience, featuring classic progression from Cerberus to Sea Dragon Nests.

Our philosophy is simple: prioritize the thrill of the hunt and tactical cooperation over rushed content updates. We aim to recreate the genuine "first-clear" excitement that defined the original Dragon Nest experience. Join a community of dedicated adventurers and reclaim your legacy in the Nests.

title: Dungeon Drawlers
description: Dungeon Drawlers is a turn-based puzzle game where every step could be your last. Carefully plan your path and defeat your enemies in the fewest turns possible. Combine the skills of your 2 characters on this journey where each room is a unique puzzle.

title: Hitoriasobi
description: Cute and a little strange? "Hitori Asobi" is a deck-building roguelike x 3D board game. "This is a game where you ■■ the people you hate!" Surrounded by lots of wonderful things, Rinachi, a very happy girl, decides to play a special game devised by her dear friend Poco...

title: Scattered Wings
description:
You're driving home.

It's been a long time.

Too bad the mountain is on fire.

title: Clock World
description: Pay as a cat named Katherine Wills and fight against the evils of evils from the devil of devils Meloc! With the help of your friends and a good old glock, all in the name of rightful justice...

title: Tomodachi-kun
description:
"Hello, this is Nikki.

I found this game on a Japanese abandonware site. Nobody seems to know anything about it, so I decided to translate it or at least as much as I could understand. It seems to be a very basic game. Collecting eggs probably unlocks the ending. Then again, I’m not actually playing it. The flying creature is just too creepy, something about that mustache sends chills down my spine...

I do wonder why nobody ever talks about it."

title: Kalanoro
description: Start a band with crazy lemurs and save your island from an evil witch in Kalanoro, an ode to Madagascar’s folklore and vibrant artistic scene! Hop on an action-adventure journey to discover the colorful world of Lemuria, rescue funky lemur artists, and defeat the witch Raneny, one song at a time.

title: Anosognosia
description: You are living on the edge of reality and delusions but you refuse to ackowledge this untill it's too late. People in your neighbourhood are going missing, your cat keeps talking to you and your visions are getting more and more intense. You need to decipher which of your actions have consequences before you lose yourself completly.

title: Feed the AI
description: Feed the AI. Collect data. Unlock upgrades. Watch the algorithm grow beyond your control. An active incremental where you feed an evolving AI with data and shape what it becomes. Will it save the world… or take it over?

title: WildBorn
description: WildBorn is a 1v1 survival PVP game set in a savage wilderness. Gather resources, craft weapons, tame wild beasts, and build your defenses — all while racing to destroy your opponent's bonfire before they destroy yours.

title: Tearoom of Terror
description: Welcome, proprietor, to your new tearoom. You’re responsible for completing orders, handling morally questionable requests, and perhaps causing—I mean, solving—a murder or two. So please, come inside and meet the odd and macabre customers you’ll be serving. They’re dying to meet you…

title: Infamous Keepers
description: Defend your dungeon AND your job! Tower Defense meets Roguelite in Infamous Keepers. Use strategy and some clever trickery to defeat waves of enemies: set up towers and deadly traps, send your employees into the line of fire, and slaughter any intruders left standing yourself.

title: Angel Zero
description: "Angel Zero" is an action game I'm solo developing right now. You play as an (angel?) girl belonging to an "Organization," taking on missions to hunt down all sorts of bizarre creatures. I want to lean into that wild contrast between realistic combat and an angel girl to create a fresh experience.

title: Demon Waltz
description:
The world of demon waltz is being erased.

Naturally, you oppose that kind of thing, and are compelled to save it.

With your allies you will, with any luck, save the world and discover the intentions of its villain in this short rpg about making things, growing up, and candycorn.

title: Cloud Server Simulator
description: Design and expand your own data center. Manage clients. Negotiate offers. Setup and configure servers. Keep track of server maintenance and monitor their conditions. Every server counts in this strategic simulator of the digital backbone of our world.

title: Steamboat Willie Rescue Mission
description: Step back into 1928 in this retro 8-bit platformer! Play as Willie, pilot biplanes, dodge angry ducks, and brave 20 challenging levels to rescue Winnie from the clutches of Captain Pete. Jump, climb, and collect musical notes in a nostalgic, public-domain adventure!

title: Xelvita
description: Xelvita is a first-person action game—Experience fast-paced first-person action as a hunted cyborg, traverse enemy lines in an abandoned sci-fi facility, and team up with an unknown intelligence to fight against the mechanical threat.

title: Natsiliani
description: Dark, narrative-driven roguelite deckbuilder inspired by Georgian mythology. Build your deck by taming enemies, recruit companions, and master tactical 4v4 battles as you try to escape from eternal prison.

title: Banana Blood
description: This is the banana horror game. They call it certain death. I call it an a-peeling adventure. Time to go bananas.

title: Echoes of Isovios: A Legacy Undone
description: You are Orion, a tyrant who drove humanity to extinction using the mythical life-stealing sword, Isovios. Travel through history, gaining ghostly allies along the way, and undo your legacy in this story-rich, action-packed roguelite.

title: Wrath of Skeletar: Last Breath
description: Dark fantasy pixel-art action adventure with fast melee combat, undead hordes, and challenging boss fights. Fight through cursed lands and uncover the story behind a kingdom consumed by death and corruption.

title: Infinite Dungeon: Idle Adventure
description: Idle Dungeon Crawling x Incremental Clicker: Experience the thrill of limitless growth. Master hero synergies and upgrade priorities to bring strategic depth to every dungeon run

title: ReThink | Evolved 6
description: ReThink | Evolved 6 is a Puzzle Game in a peaceful futuristic setting, that features a variety of Puzzles that utilize Lasers and the behavior of light and it's colors to create challenging problems to solve.

title: Stack & Sort Pals
description: Stack & Sort Pals is a fun and addictive puzzle game where you sort colorful blocks, each representing a cute animal, into perfectly organized columns. Plan your moves, stack wisely, and clear the board! With relaxing gameplay and charming visuals, can you master the art of sorting?

title: Mei Paranormies
description: Mei Paranormies is a 2D top-down survival horror game where you play as Mei, the paranormal investigator, who got a call from the owner of a haunted restaurant to check it out for proof of the paranormal.

title: Test Release Do Not Buy!!!
description: Do not Wishlist this game. There is nothing here.

title: Soul Sorter: A Morality Personality Test
description: A point and click personality test game where you take the role of a Sorter, a soul tasked with determining the fate of the recently deceased. Learn their stories and sentence them to an afterlife of either punishment or forgiveness as you confront your own morality.

title: Mind Match
description: Not your usual Match-3. Trapped in your own imagination, match ideas to fuel abilities that upgrade every fight. Beware, Dark Ideas cloud your board and force you to rethink. Place relics that twist the rules. Face Monsters that fight back, and climb a tower built from your own creative blocks.

title: Arise Dark Lord
description: You are The Dark Lord! Raise an evil army, and crush the race of men. An action-strategy hybrid RTS, blending tower defence, base building and direct control of your Dark Lord avatar, currently in early development.

title: The Well Is Not Empty
description: The well has gone dry. It's up to you to find out why. Traverse through abandoned tunnels. Discover remnants of a ritual never meant to be seen. Power dying machinery to bring light into darkness. Dig into broken earth and crawl your way out. Down here you’re not exploring... you're trespassing.

title: Rails & Rivals
description: Rails & Rivals is a turn-based strategy board game in which 2-6 players build railroad networks on a hex grid, deliver colored goods between cities, and compete for the highest score. Players lay track tiles across terrain with varying costs, issue bonds for capital, upgrade their locomotive Engine, and industrialize gray towns into colored cities to create new delivery destinations. The game ends when a set number of cities are emptied, and the player with the most income track points wins.

title: G-Mode Archives+: Xenosaga Pied Piper
description:
A port of the classic title originally released in 2006 for feature phones, part of Bandai Namco acclaimed JRPG series, Xenosaga.

A spin-off of the Xenosaga trilogy and part of the Xeno metaseries, the story follows the human life of cyborg Ziggy a key character in the Xenosaga trilogy—a century before the events of "Xenosaga Episode I: Der Wille zur Macht".

title: G-Mode Archives+: Namco Chronicle
description:
This is an original tactical RPG created exclusively for mobile devices, featuring heroes and heroines from a variety of classic Namco games.

Popular characters such as Valkyrie from The Adventure of Valkyrie, Gil and Ki from The Tower of Druaga, and Momo from Wonder Momo make an appearance.

title: Doctor Who: Split
description:
Doctor Who: Split is a kinetic novel based on the cult British TV series Doctor Who. It features the Ninth Doctor and Rose Tyler. (Please note that this is an unofficial fan project. We are in no way associated or affiliated with the BBC.)

Someone - or something - is hunting the Doctor inside the Tardis, and it’s up to Rose to save the day! But why does the Doctor keep skipping through time? And what does this mysterious entity want with the Doctor?

title: Cycle of Cinder
description: Cycle of Cinder is a puzzle-driven roguelite card game. Master action sequencing, positioning, resources, and timing to reshape encounters with powerful spells. Customize your loadout, create broken synergies, and overcome ever-changing challenges

title: Bloodmoon Survivors
description: You are a Lunar Knight of the blood moon, and tonight is your night. It's time for violence. Slay the twisted horrors conjured by the moon in this horde survival roguelite. Gain experience, grow stronger, and synergize your weapons to crush the enemy forces and survive the night.

title: Millions of Billions of Suns
description:
Millions of Billions of Suns is a next-generation 3D space MMO playable directly in your browser—no downloads required. Set in an ever-expanding universe engineered to host hundreds of thousands of players simultaneously, the game combines deep empire-building strategy with thrilling space combat.

Start with a single ship and build your way up to a massive interstellar empire. Gather resources, research technologies, and construct powerful fleets to defend your territory or conquer new solar systems.

title: Naenia
description: The World Tree was almost completely withered. The world was close to its ending. Many people came to a certain place, the funeral parlor, in order to seek 'salvation' from the Funeral Princess.

title: Ferris Wheel and the World's End
description: Rigel was visiting his comatose friend, Bella, at the hospital. He fell asleep while reading her notes, and when he opened his eyes, he found himself at an amusement park called Neverland. With Mira, a mysterious little girl, he had to collect stamps from [cursed rides] to bring Bella back with him to the waking world.

title: Corsair Cove
description: Build a sprawling pirate haven, raise a fleet to explore the high seas, and take on the Crown to keep the Age of Piracy alive! From ale to flintlock pistols, and from scallywags to swashbucklers, you’ll need to manage complex production chains and govern a rowdy crew to reign supreme over the seas!

title: Batomon Showdown
description: Batomon Showdown is a monster taming asynchronous pvp autobattler. Discover and battle with hundreds of Batomon! Assemble the ultimate team to take down other players! Play at your own pace while you discover new deadly team combos and synergies! Break the game by training your Batomon to overpowered levels.

title: Knightcore
description: Knightcore is a fast-paced medieval online arena-slasher. Master movement-based combat, parry anything, and tear your opponents apart in seconds.

title: Ants Times Infinity
description: Craft your nest underground, finding powerful combinations of chambers and pheromones to build the perfect ant-spawning engine. Then unleash them in their thousands onto the surface, directing workers to fuel the swarm while soldiers and champions push out to conquer enemy territories.

title: Hentai Tales: Infinite Climax - Endless Ecstasy
description: Enjoy a sensual story while completing tricky puzzles! Connect the numbers sequentially, using all of the squares on the board. After completing a puzzle, you will unlock a sexy new image and the next part of the story!

title: From the life of a thief
description:
You take on the role of a young man trained as a thief by a mysterious organization. To complete your training, you must pass a secret final exam on remote island. All you know is that you're supposed to blend in and steal something very valuable from a powerful man. Only with a great deal of patience, skill and tenacity can this mission be accomplished. A conscience could prove to be more of a hindrance than a help...

The mod offers typical Gothic gameplay, but spiced up with some stealth elements. Features:
- a completely new world
- approximately 12 hours of gameplay
- new weapons, armor, monsters...
- new script features (changing loading screens, fishing, different arrow types...)
- many innovative quests with sometimes different ways to solve them... and the resulting consequences
- NPCs are real personalities and each has their own character
- the exceptionally high-quality german voice acting creates a captivating atmosphere

title: Lobos: Definitive Edition
description:
Lobos is a total conversion mod for Gothic 2, set in a completely new universe unrelated to the original game. The action takes place in ancient times, where the kingdom of Lobos reigns supreme. In the mod, players assume the role of a farmer from a distinguished family who sets out with friends to a mysterious valley rich in gold and magical ore to quickly strike it rich. Their expedition, however, proves unsuccessful. Numerous troublemakers and bandit groups have had similar ideas. Our hero's life is turned upside down and the only driving force that helps him overcome enormous challenges is his desire for revenge. Furthermore, the kingdom's elite troops, sent on a mission of the utmost importance by the ruler himself, are stationed in the valley. Over time, as our hero becomes increasingly entangled in the affairs of the elite Legion, the atmosphere also becomes increasingly tense.

Features:
- a diverse game atmosphere, from idyllic, misty tropical landscapes, through sunny deserts and dark caves, to dark temple locations, grottoes, and obscure paranormal phenomena, filled with sinister magic tied to the story
- a completely new, large game world with a unique atmosphere and high-quality dialogue with a new, intriguing storyline
- new requirements and statistics for items, monsters, and charactersn, increased balanced difficulty (monsters, economy, rewards, access to locations)
- new and expanded skills
- ability to craft items and upgrade equipment using specific ingredients acquired in-game
- earning money will require more effort through honest/dishonest work and/or greater effort (cash will be harder to come by)

title: Digital Hyperspace Retrograde
description:
Alone again on the holidays. Everything is fuzzy. A voice calls to you. Telling you to...
SOAR. SOAR TO HIGHER PASTURES. SUCH IS THE WAY IN THE HYPERBOLIC DIGITAL HYPERSPACE RETROGRADE

title: Peace on Earth
description: A small group celebrates Christmas in the most unlikely of circumstances.

title: Futile
description: An empty isle with a small structure.

title: Despertar
description: The pandemic continues the deployment curve, but when the people gather is when this virus spreads the most intensity. This is the story of one of the many people who was a victim of this virus from Bayamón, Puerto Rico.

title: Oni Sazae Tori
description: Free diving and shell collecting 2D action game.

title: Fear the Ring Place 0
description: Fear the Ring Place 0 is a first-person horror game blending RPG-style illustrated storytelling with 3D environment exploration. Set in a brutal world overrun by ghosts and cults, you step onto this ensemble drama stage, guiding characters through peril.

title: Katanegai
description:
A censored port of Katanegai.
Upon learning of their parents' passing, the Minami siblings—Seia and Nagi—returned to their ancestral village.
With few villagers remaining, they settled into a quiet life together...
But when Nagi fell gravely ill, Seia sought help at the shrine—where he encountered a mysterious black-clad shrine maiden named Yami.
This is a tale of defiling wishes to fulfill the—all to save the one most precious to you.

title: Hamidashi Creative Totsu
description: The long-awaited sequel to the smash hit "Hamidashi Creative" is finally here! A route for the sub-heroine, Tenri, has also been added!

title: Ozzie's World
description:
Ozzie's World is an educational point-and-click adventure game released in 1994, featuring a young sea otter named Ozzie S. Otter. Designed for children aged 3 to 10, the game focuses on teaching ecology, science, and environmental awareness through interactive exploration of five main environments: Ozzie’s house, a garden, a forest, a beach, and a veterinary clinic.

The game includes over 40 "off-screen" science experiments that children can perform in the real world using common household items, such as creating a solar cooker or a terrarium. Additionally, the game features various integrated activities like jigsaw puzzles, memory matches, and coloring books to help develop problem-solving skills and memory.

title: Quiz Academy
description:
Quiz Academy is a family-friendly trivia game released in 1998, where players aim to reach the top of a pyramid by relying on their general knowledge and a bit of luck. The game board consists of about ten steps, and at each step, players are presented with a question from a randomly selected category. The categories cover a wide range of topics, including Geography, Sports, History, Animals, Plants, Entertainment, Art, and Science, along with special surprise picture rounds where players memorize an image for 10 seconds.

Players choose from a cast of characters represented by six differently colored pigs: Purple, Yellow, Blue, Red, Green, and Orange. Answering questions correctly earns the player money to advance to the next step, and accumulates points that unlock academic titles, progressing from "No degree" up to "Genius with honorary prize". A final question at the top of the pyramid determines the ultimate winner.

title: Opi Popi
description:
Opipopi is a short point-and-click adventure game where the player spends time in their room before falling asleep.

Players can interact with various objects in the room in any order. Each interaction increases the character's "sleepiness." Once the sleepiness reaches a certain level, the night ends, and time progresses.

The game features three different endings, which branch depending on whether the player discovers specific elements in the room before falling asleep. Hints for unlocking these conditions are hidden within the game's UI, such as backlog text colors and speech bubble shapes. The average playtime is 15 to 20 minutes per playthrough.

title: Mechanical Relations Ep 2
description:
Another small adventure of a spacefaring T4T lesbian couple working their dead-end job.

"Episode 2: Restrained Delight"
Fritter and Marmalade switch to making on-planet deliveries, but Fritter is still worried about things going awry...

When their job brings them to an unexpected location and leaves Fritter speechless, Marmalade gets inspiration for how to help her girlfriend stop thinking so much.

title: Scale Of Survival
description: This game is for fans of giantesses growing to massive sizes. Play as a heroine defending the city against a robotic army while rescuing civilians. You can also import your own VRM to play as a custom character.

title: Kotone no Shuki Shuki Polynesian Sex
description: A nukige fangame featuring Kotone Fujita from The Idolmaster.

title: Joy Malignant
description: A surreal dice-based RPG in a cursed city of gut-wrenching suffering. Here, your choices shape your skills and your appearance. Survive the city's hellish trials, meet tortured characters, and develop your own unique identity. Every choice matters as your actions will literally shape you.

title: Project Accipiter
description: "We’re elite, undefeated, and ready for anything. But uoohhh~ zombies?! Nobody trained us for this!" Join Squad Accipiter in their story and face the chaos in this isometric zombie apocalypse!

title: Ninety Nine Dungeons
description: Japanese-style action RPG dungeon crawler adventure. Explore a top-down map enhanced with full verticality and multi-level dimensions. Discover rare equipment, customize your own unique build and playstyle, and conquer the ever-changing depths!

title: Desolation Arcanist
description: Craft your own magic in this action roguelite. "Program" your wands with varied Spell Cores (Fireballs, Flying Swords... or Watermelons?) and Runes. Raise your companion Dragon, command a Puppet army, and abuse physics to knock enemies off cliffs. Your build is your destiny.

title: Magiczna Kula Papatki
description: "Magiczna Kula Papatki" - first entry in in video game series Gratka 3D. 3D platformer for the youngest, following adventures of redhead witch named Papatka.

title: Czar Ry
description: Physically interactive adventure where you must escape a strange abyssal structure inside a batholith by learning its secrets. Use fully interactive physical hands: reach, grab, drag, hold. No action buttons, no clicks, no hotkeys. Every door, lever, and chain requires your hands to move further.

title: Flesh Engine
description: A flesh-filled first-person action game where your organs are your lifeline. Rip organs from enemies, swap flesh on the fly and fight through a grotesque city built on blood and bone.

title: Zwiadowca
description:
Zwiadowca is a story-driven modification for Gothic II: Night of the Raven created by Racer75, telling the story of Jergan, Garond's scout. The action takes place after the Nameless One sails to the Irdorath Court, when the orcs invade Khorinis. The mod offers new quests, a character focused on dexterity and few unique mechanics.
Features:
- 10+ hours of gameplay
- characters known from Gothic II and former convicts from Gothic I
- high difficulty and about 45 quests that require cunning
- gaining muscle mass while building strength
- unlimited lifespan of summoned undead
- new transformation and summoning scrolls
- ability to acquire armor from Gothic 1 and Gothic 2
- two possible endings

title: Crocus Field
description: A cozy visual novel where you get closer to the bachelors and bachelorettes of Stardew Valley over a week in winter. Choose a romantic or platonic story for each.

title: Pegote
description:
Pegote is inspired by Guerra (war), a simple card game many of us grew up playing with a Spanish deck.

It’s a game of chance and comparison. Flip a card, higher wins. Easy to learn, easy to play anywhere. We wanted to build on that familiar foundation, adding layers, decisions, and a bit of chaos :)

title: Nurture
description: A thrilling multiplayer horror game. Brave the terror solo or team up with friends (3 players max). Each level's unique demon needs a distinct counter strategy. Traverse eerie areas, evade lurking threats, scavenge key items to survive... This job is high-risk—high pay always comes with deadly peril

title: Orderbound
description: After the catastrophe, order survives only beneath the Church's iron rule. As a wandering bishop, pass judgment by day and confront the nightmares born of human emotion by night. Every choice tips the balance between order and chaos, shaping the fate of the world.

title: Abyss of Kings
description: Explore the remnants of an underground civilization and battle sentient chess pieces. Discover magical rings and use them to create your own spells. Meet the last inhabitants of a dead kingdom and escape the Abyss.

title: Eternal Hatred
description: Eternal Hatred is an uncompromising, high-octane boomer shooter that blends the aesthetics of ULTRAKILL, Doom, and Quake with a deep psychological story about the nature of human cruelty. This is a journey into the abyss of consciousness, where every shot is an attempt to drown out inner pain.

title: Peony Plague
description:
A kinetic visual novel following Peregrine Abbott as he discusses the funeral planning with the soon-to-be deceased, Rowan Francine. The two knew each other years ago but neither could imagine this to be their reunion.

Peregrine's goal is to uncover how Rowan wishes to be taken care of after he dies, but it seems that Rowan isn't all that interested in discussing his death, let alone what would follow afterwards.

title: Time Shock
description: Rip through fractured timelines fighting robots, drones and bosses. Rank up as different characters with special abilities. Upgrade weaponized vehicles with future technology. Timelines favor the AI army. Will you tip the balance?

title: Answer Me
description:
Dealing with zombies are already enough!! Or is it?

Now you're also trapped with a crazy stalker-kidnapper guy... Just great.

Answer his questions the way he likes it or face the consequences. There shouldn't be a right or wrong answer to everything he asks, but you wouldn't wanna know what punishment he would give you, right?

title: Fractal Foundry
description: Fractal Foundry is a factory-building game about automating fractal megastructures from simple cubes. Design nested factories that scale into recursive systems. No pressure, no costs, just pure creativity and automation.

title: Kill the Lich
description: Kill the Lich is a minimalist incremental game centered around time compression and resource propagation. Your resources build automatically over time, but their growth accelerates when you optimize their downstream flow ratios, and you can manually push them along to go even faster. Each action grants attributes that reduce the requirements of other actions, allowing you to push further. Eventually, you can head north to Fight the Lich's Forces in an automated Phase 2, gathering three vital resources that make your next loop faster and unlock new goals.

title: Gothic II: Gladiator
description:
A total-conversion modification by OrtegaX & Damianut & Gladiator Team referring to the game Sword&Sandals, the axis of which are tournaments taking place in the successive arenas of the kingdom of Panamat.

Features:
- about 20 hours of gameplay
- dozens of fights to the death on four arenas
- original soundtrack composed exclusively for the mod
- polish dubbing
- original script solutions
- many new models, textures, sounds and items

title: When Winter Comes Again
description:
—Amid the falling snow, her world remained colorless.

Kuno Hasegawa has always been drawn to Mai Fujisaki — the quiet girl who seems to live in her own world. He doesn’t know what she’s holding back. He just knows he wants to be there.

But the closer he gets, the more he realizes: some people aren’t just quiet. They’re fading.

title: Shape Guy
description: Shape guy is a platformer rage game created by Gumballs Falling. Inspired by rage games of the 80's/90's, Shape Guy introduces obstacles to overcome, mechanics to help on your journey, and an obscure narrative to follow.

title: The Dark Saga
description:
The story narrates about Alaster and Marik, new heroes who plunged into adventure. They decided to make their life of idleness in Vanguard more varied and exciting. Searching of an ancient treasure was their main purpose but the destiny has her own thoughts on them. So they will get a lot more than originally planned.

Features:
- new worlds like: arge island, three-leveled ore mine, ancient fort dungeons
- 5 fractions with unique quests: slaves, orc mercenary, ferocian hunters, paladins and pirates
- new monsters, animations, skills
- approximately 300 pages long scenario containing over 90 quests
- around 40 hours of gameplay

title: Lisa: The 2
description:
Recreation of Lisa the Painful Beta content, but something is a bit off when trying to make it.

It has a unique story from Lisa the Painful you see today.

title: Feralpals
description: Feralpals is a story-driven, chapter-based horror game created by Polypaw, with this release being Chapter 01: Old Friend

title: Mind Vessel
description: An autobattler roguelite in which you are a Vessel formed by the unification of dead people's spirits. Dismember and graft them to customize their abilities, as you use them to find a way out of the void.

title: Buried Below
description:
'An old tape replays your worst memory. A camping trip. A fierce storm rolling in. Your girlfriend vanishing near an abandoned mine. You've replayed this night until the tape wore thin. Tonight you take control, and tonight you go further than the memory ever let you. Can you survive the depths and find her, or will the memory never end?'

In Buried Below, an atmospheric survival horror experience, things start with an interactive intro leading up to a camping trip gone wrong. During a storm, your girlfriend goes missing. Armed with key information previously provided by a clerk about a nearby abandoned mine, you venture out to explore the vast, free roamable forest, needing a map for orientation. Gaining entry to the mine involves using items correctly to solve environmental puzzles blocking your path.

Once inside, your survival depends on managing your lighter's fuel while navigating the tunnels. You'll need to use stealth, either hiding or creating distractions, to evade the creature that lurks below. Can you escape this desolate place alive, or will your memory never end?

title: Paic: Moon Rider Story
description: Ride a motorcycle along a seaside coast at sunset, rendered in pixel art. A short visual novel game. Read through the story, survive the death game, and make it home safely!

title: Crawlspace: Insanity Remastered
description: CRAWLSPACE is the official remake of Insanity (2015), a classic Five Nights at Freddy's fangame that harkens back to Five Nights at Freddy's 2.

title: Secret Some
description: An authentic game It is a 'Youth Love Comedy Story' that depicts the process of creating a story of four characters and two people. Starting with graduation, there's another story about dating a character You can feel the feeling of a growing connection.

title: Fractured: Snowpine Strangers
description:
Fractured - a psychological episodic horror that exposes the true nightmare of our world.

Fractured: Snowpine Strangers tells the story of Matt, a freight train driver. The endless clatter of the wheels could drive anyone insane, but Matt finds a strange comfort in it. Until this run.
Days before Christmas, he's called in for one more haul. He has no choice but to leave his family behind. This time, the distance feels different. This time, he's not alone on the rails.

Will he make it back?

title: Peony's Eternity
description:
A flower swept from its field loses its petals as its life hangs on a thread. Passing royalty finds itself mystified, coveting the uniqueness of the ephemeral flower.

“What kind of being so reliant on its petals would allow them to be tarnished to such a pitiful state?”

Without realizing it, royalty falls willingly for the tattered flower’s allure, leaving nothing but the crown for the plant to take. But was the crown something desired, or was it simply a flight of fancy that wove shackles of fate around the flower's stem?

title: Slendytubbies Ø Records
description: Slendytubbies Ø Records is the short sequel to the fangame Slendytubbies Ø, developed by HostGame Studio and released in April 2026. The game serves largely as a prequel, providing additional context to the events of the first game.

title: Zombie Valley: Definitive Edition
description:
Zombie Valley (Dolina Zombie) Definitive Edition is a total-conversion polish mod for Gothic by OrtegaX. You take on the role of blacksmith Bragus, a previously respected citizen of Khorinis whose peaceful life ended one night when someone sneaked into his home and murdered his family. After enacting vengeance Bragus gets sent to the Valley of Mines which itself is facing an invasion of evil forces.
The original version of the mod was released in 2015, the Definitive Edition introduces numerous improvements.
Features:
- new storyline in the modified Valley of Mines
- multitude of zombies and their variants in the form of infected animals
- new items, weapons, armor, and helmets
- ability to fight with a shield
- partial polish voice over
- about 25 - 30h of gameplay
- new ambient sounds and music
- and much more

title: Standard Human Pizza
description: Pizza simulator meets horror. Serve the monsters, survive the anomalies, and use secret ingredients to exterminate your clientele.

title: Void Outcasts
description: Sci-fi character-driven deck-builder. Gather your crew of misfits and venture into the Void in search of treasures and fame. Fight relentless enemies with your wits and strategy. Become the greatest pirate in the universe.

title: Rail Route: Expect Delays
description: Add delays, failures, and maintenance to Rail Route. Build maintenance depots, dispatch service locomotives, and keep your network running when operations stop going to plan.

title: Periwinkle
description: Grimoires hold secrets unnumbered, yet only few can be revealed when parts are missing. After acquiring such a tattered grimoire by chance, Periwinkle embarks on an adventure to find these lost pages and unravel the book's great mystery.

title: Gotthic II: The Sisters
description:
Sisters (Сестры) is a russian survival mod for Gothic II:NK. The main character is a young girl searching for her missing sister in the hostile environment of an unfamiliar land. The game consists of four chapters and is considered very difficult in Russia.
The heroine experiences hunger and thirst, expressed by additional bars on the screen and resulting in death after a certain amount of time. From the beginning, she must learn basic skills like cooking and acquire the simplest items and tools to be able to perform practically any task. The number of items carried in the inventory depends on their weight and the heroine's strength at a given stage of the game.
A timer is introduced to show the elapsed time in the game, necessary to maintain vital functions and complete certain tasks and activities. The heroine can use a sword that deals magical damage, use runes that can be upgraded, and also learn alchemy, which is much more advanced than in the base game, as she can create her own potions with specific effects.

title: TideBroker
description: A story-rich role-playing game, TideBroker will take you to a fantasy world of secrets and machinations of three opposing factions. You will play the part of an envoy and determine the outcome of a peace conference through dialogue, letters and books.

title: Rule the Dungeon
description: Your Report, Your Reality. A pixel-art CRPG where a Dungeon Bureau inspector files otherworldly cases into submission. Evidence shapes success. Keywords forge skills. The clock decides everything.

title: Velen
description:
Velen 2.0 is a standalone modification for the game Gothic II. In this modification, the player takes on the role of William the pirate.
Features:
- about 15 - 25h of gameplay
- brand new story from the perspective of a new protagonist
- completely new, large game world, created with great attention to detail in the Gothic style
- complete professional german voice over
- many interesting, varied, often funny characters, dialogs and main & side quests, mostly written in the well known Gothic style
- many reworked from the original game and even some completely new daily routines for the characters, meaningfully assigned to them to make their lives more realistic and varied
- many new and partially modified from the original game features and gameplay elements, such as a Gothic 3-like free aim with ranged weapons & magic, different ammunition with different effects for ranged weapons, auto-save, changing the position of status bars, colored focus names, showing day & time, revised pickpocketing and lock picking, and many, many more, most of which can be customized to one's needs or completely disabled if desired
- balancing adapted for the modification with four different selectable difficulty levels
- many new talents such as shield fighting, cooking, fishing and mining various ores
- new weapons, armor, helmets, shields, items and monsters, some of them exclusively created for this modification

title: The Valley of Dawn
description:
The Valley of Dawn (original title - Долина Рассвета) is a mod in which you will play the role of a former assassin named Derek, who once worked for the ore baron Raven. The owner betrayed him, and his beloved fell into the clutches of the Dark Magician. Pursuing the necromancer, Derek enters the Valley of Dawn and realizes that getting to the enemy will not be easy. He has to kill the necromancer, save his beloved and decide the fate of the inhabitants of the Valley of Dawn...
Features:
- new colorful world
- new items and armor
- new textures
- about 50 interesting quests
- from 8 hours of playing time
- strong connection with the original story
- two guilds to join
- slideshow videos in the style of "The Witcher"
- new NPCs with developed characters

title: Twisted Chance Online
description: It's a multiplayer survival horror game where a team of workers must repair, heal, and fight their way through a ruined research lab, while one player controls the Stalker, an evolving monster that hunts them down. Use tools, weapons, and environmental traps to survive… or embrace the terror.

title: Glitchy: Not So Sweet
description: This looks like a super cute spot-the-difference game, but it isn’t!

title: Dorts: A Darts Roguelike
description: First-person darts roguelike. Throw darts. Earn gold. Buy upgrades. Survive the chaos.

title: Cycle of Carnations
description:
After a horrific incident leaves a young man dead, he is greeted in a space between life and death by a magical girl named Rein.

Rein introduces herself as something of a guardian of reincarnation, but when deadly occurrences continue on into his next life, he has to wonder: who is Rein exactly? And what connection, if any, does she have to the cyclical violence that he seems trapped in?

title: Wyrmfall
description: You were sent to a small medival town set in a dark fantasy kingdom. Hunt monsters, Sell their spoils, and Upgrade your equipment. to save this town from the menace terrorizing it.

title: Crownwarden
description: Build by day, defend by night! In this story-driven city builder, take direct control of your ruler to protect the realm. Explore diverse lands, upgrade your leader's abilities, command armies against monstrous hordes, and uncover the dark secrets of your lineage.

title: Divine Orbit
description: In this top-down planetary defense shooter, your job is to strap an absurd amount of automated weaponry to a doomed planet and try to hold the line. When the swarm inevitably breaks your perimeter and eats the Earth, the run ends. But your spectacular failures generate "Stardust," a highly unethical currency you can use to buy shinier guns, thicker shields, and more devastating orbital lasers for your next doomed attempt.

title: Life Seeker
description: Life seeker is the sequel to DST, following a new pair as they search for a flower.

title: Stamperor! The Jester's Decree
description: A city builder where you play as an alien jester who becomes a temporary emperor and must make unusual decisions by stamping decrees, trying at all costs to keep everything from collapsing.

title: Robustation
description: Robustation is a fast-paced top-down shooter in the roguelike genre, set in the deranged universe of Space Station 14. The game features a vast array of combat techniques and weapon combinations, which, coupled with diverse perks and arsenal, ensures high replayability.

title: Cats & Carnations
description: You get an email asking you to restore paintings in an old, inherited mansion. While uncovering these pieces of art, you get to know the owner and there might just be more behind to him than expected...

title: Valendor
description:
Valendor is a german total conversion mod for Gothic II created by Arthonius.
Features:
- approximately 12-15 hours of gameplay
- three new, detailed game worlds
- well-crafted story whose suspense builds as the game progresses
- high-quality (optional) german voice acting, performed by mostly professional and semi-professional voice actors and actors
- epic soundtrack with nine new music tracks
- new animations, textures, armor, items, weapons, etc.
- new features (cooking, winemaking, drinking barrel, well)

title: Ava Loveless
description: Fictional short story set in the United Kingdom under a Gothic/Steampunk aesthetic, where a young woman contemplates a discovery that could potentially change the world.

title: Pink Carnations
description: Hikari is a high school girl studying for her exams. Her life changes course when one day she falls asleep next to aquarium.

title: My Boyfriend
description: "My Boyfriend" is 2006 simulation game aimed at girls. The main goal is to get a boyfriend, while taking part in various activities and mini games.

title: Klasztor: Das Kloster
description: Created by the polish Magical Inquisition Team, Klasztor is a total conversion mod for Gothic II with a crime story set in the stifling and dark atmosphere. We get about few hours in the new world filled with rich lore, varied quests and lots of magic.

title: Trip to Europe 12: Romantic Tour - Collector's Edition
description: Set off on an unforgettable journey through the most picturesque corners of Europe. This time, just the two of you!

title: Miranda Village
description:
A mod is based on the plot and characters of the popular short story "Aluka Miranda" in which the player takes on the role of a young and dreamy apprentice named Bernd. After a year of practice and experience, he returns to Miranda Village. He quickly realizes that life in the countryside flows differently than before. Now he must adapt to this new life while unraveling the dark secrets of an unknown mythology.
The game combines adventure elements with arcade elements and is full of puzzles to solve. All character development elements have been removed. The mod incorporates elements of a modern world and has nothing to do with the Gothic story.
The latest version of mod from 2019 offers several hours of gameplay and full polish voice over.

title: Seven Seas Jewels: Collector's Edition
description: Sail into a thrilling match-3 pirate adventure of treasure and danger. Rescue the governor’s daughter, battle cursed pirates, and explore mysterious islands across 220 levels in this story-driven Collector’s Edition.

title: Seven Seas Jewels 2: Collector's Edition
description: Set sail to save Rowan from the siren Narissa's curse. As Polly, journey across stormy seas, solve 250 Match-3 levels, uncover secrets, and face supernatural threats. Will love prove stronger than dark magic?

title: Allelon
description: Play as Ollie and Spade, a rebel and detective, on both sides of a high-profile murder case, in a dual-character investigative-stealth experience. Discover the secrets plaguing the citizens of Andropolis.

title: Nomnomia
description: Consume enemies to steal their abilities and survive by replenishing your constantly draining HP. Fight for survival on the mysterious planet Nomnomia in this food-chain action shooter.

title: Tennis Manager 26
description: Step into the most advanced tennis management experience ever. Run your academy, develop top talent, upgrade your staff and facilities, and dominate the junior and pro circuits. A new chapter begins, are you ready to take control?

title: Warno: Landjut
description: Dive deep into amphibious warfare with the Danish-themed WARNO - LANDJUT expansion, featuring 8 brand-new divisions. Unlock an arsenal of new units, vehicles, and weapons, from the U.S. Marines to the F-14A Tomcat, Soviet Morskaya Pekhota naval infantry, the T-55AMD, and Kalmar hovercraft.

title: UBoat: Type IX - Distant Coasts
description: Command the long-range Type IX U-boat in the Distant Shores DLC! Patrol the South Atlantic and Indian Ocean, operate from the port of Penang with the Monsoon Group, and master three new submarine variants. Experience authentic historical campaigns far from friendly shores.

title: Americania
description: Americania is a political simulation with RPG elements. You are the president of a recently independent south american nation. You must guide your new democracy into the modern age, using diplomacy as a weapon and making the rules of your newborn country... Or you can use power to conquer the continent, having no respect for life and international rules.

title: Warhammer Online: Return of Reckoning
description:
Return of Reckoning is the fan-made continuation of Warhammer Online: Age of Reckoning.

A small group of players started recording as much information from the last few weeks of the official servers being online with the hope that one day they would be able to play again.

Shortly after the servers shut down work began on rewriting the server code with the goal of bringing Warhammer Online back online. Every monster in the world had to be replaced, every quest had to be restored and gaps in archives filled in. Every public quest, dungeon boss, game mechanic had to be coded and scripted again.
Return of Reckoning officially opened its website and account creation to the public on June 11th, 2014.

Since then, we have spent more time developing this game than the original game was in service. Re-implementing content to bring it back to the live state, making balance changes to classes, and re-creating old live events.
We have also created new custom content from the fragments recovered while deconstructing client files, as well as original content built entirely from scratch.

title: Belfry
description: It is said that when the bell of molten gold rings across the sky, the world beyond will take the place of this shore.The clock’s marks sum up life’s course. Moving its hands changes fate.The girl prays to the gods:“May happy days never fade. May the destined bloom never wither.”

title: Hamidashi Creative Re:Re:call
description: A fandisc for Hamidashi Creative, focusing on Yurigamine Academy's student council president Hijiri Ririko which didn't had a route in the original game.

title: Navigatore of the Ruined World
description: The story takes place in a post-apocalyptic world where only two humans have survived: the protagonist and the hero. You will assume the role of the protagonist as she fights to survive alongside Harunashi Mika, the game's hero. Genre: Otome Game / Number of Endings: 17 (including bad endings).

title: Welcome to Cafe Lumière!: A Dragon Girl Concept Cafe
description: Masamune was just an average guy who enjoyed going to concept cafes when his life is changed forever after crossing paths with the dragon girl, Marmalydia. Join them as they open the doors at Cafe Lumière, a dragon-filled concept cafe!

title: Laer Gjoll: Horror at Cemetery
description:
Laer Gjoll is a russian total conversion mod to Gothic II created by FaWl MT (Feuermagier and Wallerstein Lab). The mod's core is a fantasy narrative with an emphasis on horror and dark atmosphere.
The story follows a traveling archaeologist who sets out to find a very valuable magical artifact. The nature of the artifact was unknown. All that was known was that it could be used to prevent the consequences of a global cataclysm. The hero travels throughout the kingdom, and then his search leads him to a very strange and ancient cemetery...
Features
- separate story, completely unrelated to the plot of the original Gothic 2
- new locations, environmental textures, weapons, armor types and many re-designs
- 90% of music replacement
- professional russian and polish voiceover

title: Azasumi: Azatokute Sumi ni Okenai Kanojo
Gothic II: Battle of the Kings 3
description:
Battle of the Kings is best described as a blend of role-playing game, real-time strategy game, and management simulation. The mod features two factions: a Red and a Blue faction. At the start of the game, players can choose their preferred faction, guild, difficulty level, and map. Soldiers from both factions automatically attack the enemy faction at regular intervals after the game begins. The primary objective of both factions is to defeat the enemy king with their own soldiers.

Players can upgrade their soldiers, crafting better weapons and armor, or recruit mages to support their troops and increase their gold income. Players do not actively participate in combat. They can move their character around the world as a passive observer, unable to deal damage or be attacked.

Although the mod is relatively simple, it offers numerous ways to win or lose. The game is completely flexible and entertaining for casual players, number crunchers, and professional gamers alike.

The modification also includes new music and plenty of introductory tutorials, which is why this graphically understated modification has become quite large.

Battle of the Kings 3 includes the second part and expands it with several new features: In addition to a changed difficulty level and another faction (the Undead), there is another map that features a new skeleton cave. Both players can send soldiers into the skeleton cave, and the soldiers controlling it are supported by additional skeletons. Another significant new feature is the implementation of a hero: Using an "Elite," you can now hire a hero who will automatically enter battle and level up for each enemy defeated, thus becoming more powerful. Furthermore, you can upgrade the hero's armor, melee weapon, and crossbow - making the hero an effective weapon against the enemy. Furthermore, at the beginning of the game, the player can activate some special options (such as eliminating mercenaries or spawning more soldiers) with the game administrator, and important events are now communicated to the player by an announcer.

title: Bumshak
description:
Bumshak is a small modification about the titular orc, Bumshak, who climbs the ranks of the orcs. The entire mod takes place after the Nameless Hero sets out for Halls of Irdorath, across the Valley of Mines. The original lore of the story revolves primarily around news of the orcs' attack on the paladin's castle and their occupation of the entire island of Khorinis. The mod was created by three people (Frank Wedler) and quickly saw the light of day.

The stat system has been removed - you don't gain experience points or level advancement, but you do get new equipment and healing potions. The entire mod has five chapters, and even after completing it, you can continue playing, exploring the Valley of Mines and talking to other orcs.
Ukrainian, russian and english (made with SI but pretty good) vocie over is avaible.

title: Red Carnation
description:
Red Carnation is a point and click, 2D, Narrative driven puzzle game.

It takes place in the 1970's during the Salazar Dictatorship. In this story, we follow a young man whose poet mother has suddenly vanished.

Upon finding your mother's diary, you begin to uncover the secret life she lived.

It's up to you to find the hidden messages in her poems, and to link it with the censored media in the environment, in order to discover the truth.

However, there are some unexpected forces at play, as you find yourself uncover the secrets of something far larger than you could have ever expected...

title: Gothic II: Piratenleben
description: In this mod, you control the fate of Rhen, a young lad from the port city of Khorinis, who wants to join the pirates to escape poverty and hopelessness from previous life. You can expect 3 chapters packed with interesting, innovative quests that take place in familiar but sometimes significantly altered areas of the Gothic 2 worlds and dungeons. Other features include a variety of familiar and new NPCs, an adjustable difficulty level, monster respawn based on the player level, and full voice acting (optional). A true highlight is the witty dialogue, which includes numerous jabs at a well-known, unnamed hero. Pirate Life (original title - Piratenleben) will transport you to the rough world of adventurous pirates for 15 to 20 hours across Jharkendar.

title: Kyra The Hunter
description: Take control of Kyra, a skilled hunter with golden hair and a blue cape, on an epic journey to reclaim lands overrun by dark creatures. Armed with her trusty sword, Kyra must traverse devastated regions, facing hordes of monsters and deadly challenges to restore peace to the world.

title: In Search Of Treasures
description:
Another story by Ingvers, the creator of 'The Adventures of Martin'. This time, you play as a young treasure hunter, Liroj, who, longing for a more prosperous life, decides to leave Khorinis in search of riches. He finds himself on a small island where the concept of "treasure" has completely different meanings for ordinary people. The author is known for his unique humor and surprising plot twists. This modification is no different!
Features:
- new locations and original quests
- russian voice over
- about 3 - 4 hours of gameplay

title: Mimosa
description: Mimosa is a visual novel about a shy little girl called Wei Ting, her struggles with social interaction and her first steps in opening up to people.

title: 33 Days till Extraction
description: 33 Days till Extraction is a top-down sci-fi action RPG shooter with roguelike progression. Harness brutal firepower and necromantic skills to survive.

title: Voltumna
description: A 2.5D action-adventure platformer set in a land of forgotten gods. Armed with a bayonet and bound to a goddess you can't trust, fight through a single connected world, learn the bosses the hard way, and take back the throne the gods above her stole.

title: Big Fishin World: Ocean Voyager
description: Big Fishin World: Ocean Voyager is a fishing roguelike that turns an activity such as ocean fishing and turns it into a dangerous game of luck (reel luck), knowledge, and the ability to think like a fish! Will you be able to make it through a full voyage or will you be thrown OVERBOARD by the cold hearted Cap'N Grant?!

title: Raining Cats and Dogs
description: It’s literally raining cats and dogs. In this game you platform, overcome about 100 unique obstacles, fight 3 janky bosses, find comments added from YouTube Shorts and make it stop raining cats and dogs by fighting Jeff in the end. Here's a message from Jeff: "YOU WILL NEVER STOP ME YEEEHAWWW"

title: Driving Test Simulator
description: Test your driving skills by completing challenging driving tests and precise, skill-based scenarios. Offers various scenarios and environments.

title: The Snowdrop Diaries
description: Raised by the nuns inside the monastery's walls, Nellie grew up being a dreamer who loves reading old books. She feels like her beloved legends are trying to warn her about the return of an ancient murderous monster. Will she be able to save the people she cares about when they say that monsters aren't real?

title: Kirk Mephisto
description: Follow Kirk on his quest to stop the ongoing battle between birds and wormkind in this sci-fantasy, hack n slash, action game. Fighting alongside Kirk are his childhood friends Halice the worm warrior princess and Carper the secret agent bee.

title: Gothic II: The Black Heart
description:
In The Black Heart (original title - Das schwarze Herz) the player takes on the role of Cavalorn, a character familiar from Gothic I & II. Vatras tasks Cavalorn with delivering a powerful artifact, along with his brother from the Ring of Water, to a powerful water mage named Aguas on the remote island Topas.
Features:
- new, exciting story set in the Gothic universe
- three selectable difficulty levels
- new prayer system (Adanos Shrine) with statistics
- plenty of new objects and textures
- completely new world

title: Sarkeras: Artifact of the Ancestors
description:
War is imminent. Weapons made of hard ore are needed. Ambassadors are being sent to all the surrounding ore mines in the land to ascertain the ore reserves. You are one of those sent. But will your mission unfold as you expect? Find out...
Features:
- completely new world with an exciting story independent from the Gothic series
- approximately 20 quests and 15 NPCs
- about 2 - 3 hours of gameplay
- full german and polish voice over
- new music
- new interactive objects, items and monsters
- animals use objects for the first time

title: Wallflower
description: WALLFLOWER is a job simulator / visual novel with the “Sit and Survive” theme, where you play as the tired and quiet stationary cashier of a Xoxo Shop convenience store. During your shift, you will need to do your job ringing up items while enduring strange customers if needed, and doing other tasks that you may or may not have signed up for. But why should you care about that? You need the money. You have to get this money no matter what. You need to. You have to.

title: Hellxorcist
description: Hellxorcist is a fast-paced, retro-inspired FPS set in a dark gothic world where the line between faith and damnation has been shattered.

title: Cyber Demon Protocol
description: An antique computer has granted you the ability to summon cyber demons. Seeking power from demons is like dancing on a tightrope, from Lawful Good to Chaotic Evil, how will you choose? Will you collude with the wealthy, politicians, stars, and artists, or change this decadent society?

title: Jasmine
description:
A small planet. A big house. A watchful eye.

A 2D/3D visual novel and point-and-click experience about loneliness, cycles, and whether the quiet is actually peace.

You drifted into this place from somewhere you can't remember. Someone already lives here. She wasn't expecting you.

Explore. Talk. Make choices.

Unravel your identity. Accept it or change it.

title: Idle Iktah
description: Idle Iktah is a game about leveling up in the Pacific Northwest. It features local plants and animals, 18 skills, 5+ minigames, items affected by the phase of the moon, and even a real-time Oregon coast tide tracker. If you like idle RPGs, give this one a shot!

title: RealmWalker
description: Create powerful spell combos and blast through hordes of enemies in RealmWalker. This ARPG roguelite delivers ever changing runs with new abilities, challenging encounters, and procedurally generated worlds.

title: Steelarchy
description: Steelarchy is a 3rd-person vehicle combat roguelike centered on deep loadouts. Face off against a modular fortress of rigid steel in explosive, chaotic battles. With deep meta-progression and shifting enemy tactics, no two matches are the same. Build. Customize. Upgrade. Embrace the carnage.

title: Love You As I Am
description:
7 minutes in heaven. 11 minutes in hell.

There is no such thing as a happy ending,

But do you really have no shame to be trying so hard?

title: Slot Theory
description: Pick 1 tower, modifier or upgrade every wave. Stack insane tower synergies and watch your build spiral out of control.

title: Coin of Fate
description: Coin Slot System: Success lies in how you balance the odds between heads and tails. Strategic Resource Management: Maximize efficiency within the limits of your inventory and gold. Explosive Synergies: Unleash massive bonus effects by collecting and pairing specific sets of items.

title: Super Dog Adventure
description: Super Dog Adventure is a local co-op platformer for 2–4 players. Join forces with friends on the same screen to jump, run, solve puzzles, together in an exciting retro-style adventure!

title: Skaz
description: Brutal 2.5D action roguelike where one-hit-kill mechanics are combined with procedural level generation in a techno-folk setting. One hit — one death.

title: Slay the Horde
description: Slay the Horde is a roguelike deckbuilder about building a screen-clearing engine of destruction. Build a deck of spells, stack upgrades, abuse elemental effects, and annihilate increasingly unreasonable numbers of goblins.

title: Idle Deepcore
description: Idle Deepcore is an incremental mining game where you dig ever deeper, smelt ore into ingots, upgrade your pickaxe and machines, and grow several mines in parallel to build a vast underground industry.

title: Non-Euclidean Minesweeper
description: Dive into M.C. Escher's world! This is a minesweeper game played in hyperbolic and Euclidean spaces. All the problems are absolutely solvable by logic alone. Windows, Linux, gaming handheld and Steam Deck are supported.

title: Life of a Cockroach
description: In Life of a Cockroach you play as a cockroach whose main priority is to survive. Explore an urban environment from a whole new perspective in this open-world 3D adventure filled with challenges, tasks, and dangers. Discover hidden places, master your skills, and become the ultimate survivor insect!

title: Dino Escape
description: Dino Escape is a fun 2D platformer where danger lurks behind every leaf—and survival is just one jump (or dash) away. Players take control of a brave little dinosaur who’s been separated from his pack and stranded in a haunted forest crawling with monstrous creatures, deadly traps, and mysterious ruins. Armed with instinct, agility, and sheer dino grit, you’ll leap over spikes, dash past undead horrors, and trigger ancient switches to unlock the path forward. But beware—swamps swallow the careless whole, flying beasts patrol the skies, and the shadows seem to whisper secrets best left forgotten.

title: Sayagatari: Promise of the Cursed Blade
description: "My love for you began with that kiss." Ex-Kendo practitioner Kanemori Tōya, comes across Saya who seals demonic blades. Saving him from his murderous impulse curse is a kiss from Saya!? The two begin living together, battling with demonic blade in hand. Break the curse with a kiss from this beauty!

title: Manafinder II
description: Mankind has ended, yet the world moved on. Take the role of Rey in this turn-based RPG and fight ferocious beasts and other existential threats alongside a disparate cast of allies as you seek a new purpose in a world that no longer welcomes you.

title: Stellar Mole
description: You will play a role of Agent Vanø—infiltrating an alien colonial corporation. Your mission: gather Earth intelligence for alien while weaponizing every dirty trick to torment your alien colleagues, dismantling their operations from within.

title: Ririka von Lustveil
description: Why study when you can rule? Play as Ririka, a bratty archmage on a quest for total campus domination. Corrupt the faculty, tame the student body, and turn the prestigious Aetherial Academy into your personal kingdom in this comedic villainess visual novel.

title: Observation Beauty
description:
With only a journal in hand, you sail off in search of undiscovered wonders.
You are off to study and observe the unique creatures of an idyllic island!

There are placid, herbivorous, tapir-bugs. Territorial grumpy turtle-goats who enjoy headbutting, and possibly a secretive creature by the top of the mountain…

Your task is to observe each creature's: Social Behaviour, Diet & Temperament

Developed for and winner of the GamesNow! Game Jam Autumn 2025

title: Love, I'm Not Good For You
description:
A woman receives a message from her boyfriend. He wants to break up! Join our protagonist in her journey handling her relationship with her boyfriend (or ex bf!), old and new friends, family and dealing with her own identity.

"Love, I'm not good for you" is a romance / mystery visual novel, with point-and-click elements, about relationships coming to an end... or maybe not? You can explore the phones of our protagonists to understand their lives before and after they break up (or not!).

There's only one ending but HOW you reach that ending changes depending on your choices!

title: Stranger Maidens Please Protect Me!
description: Tactical squad based Roguelite Action RPG. Lead your band of powerful Stranger Maidens to battle, find your best team and mow down all adversaries! Unfold your story by combat, and melt the heart of your beautiful companions.

title: Saturday Sábado
description: A game with more than 100 unique challenges, in various gameplay styles, mainly focused on precision platforming.

title: Estrada Real: Caminho das Almas
description: Royal Road: Path of Souls is a 2D action RPG that dives into the deep roots of colonial Brazil. Combining frenetic combat, exploration of Baroque-inspired settings, and a narrative-driven experience based on ancestry, the game invites you to uncover the secrets that the mountain mists of Minas Gerais have tried to hide.

title: NoxTurn
description: A game where you are playing as a Noxia that must avoid any light in order to survive, while it is imprisoned in the Death's realm full of graves. To escape, spirit will rotate the islands and as a consequence, change shadow positions and avoid a burning touch of light's rays.

title: Socturnal
description:
SOCTURNAL is a sniper-focused tactical FPS. Play as Liswn, HORRIBLE KNIGHT, ROGUE EX-MERCENARY who now acts on his own. See the end of Kapyr and his Glowing Prance soldiers.

Make your way through 2 large, hand-crafted levels in this Ghost Recon/Delta Force-inspired shooter. Your sniper gives you free reign on open spaces, but managing stealth and efficiency inside bases will be a challenge.

Liswn's ghost-Bravo vs. Kapyr's zero-Alpha.
Behold the white cloud. Enact vengeance.

title: Astala Muerte
description: Step into the shadows of the past in this third-person survival horror game inspired by the golden age of PS1/PS2-era classics. Set in the 1990s, you’ll explore a forgotten underground laboratory where something went horribly wrong: dinosaurs walk again, and you're trapped in the aftermath.

title: We Die Standing
description:
We Die Standing is a tactical third-person sci-fi shooter that blends heavy, cover-based firefights with dynamic zero-gravity combat. Set across a star system devastated by a massive dimensional tear, players take control of Vanguard-7, a heavily armored Praetorian enforcer. The primary antagonists are "The Swarm," a hyper-intelligent, bio-mechanical hive-mind that actively assimilates human military technology, allowing enemy units to utilize scavenged firearms, heavy artillery, and squad tactics.

The core gameplay loop centers on adapting to fractured environmental physics. As the spatial anomaly destabilizes the region, localized gravity can dynamically fail, instantly transitioning grounded shootouts into 360-degree floating combat. Players must utilize the Praetorian suit's integrated thrusters to navigate mid-air battlefields, flank entrenched alien gunners, and manage momentum while exchanging fire alongside floating debris, uprooted terrain, and ruined infrastructure.

The full campaign spans multiple large-scale planetary environments. Players will fight through the dense jungles and fortified coastal military bases of Veridia Prime, navigate the zero-gravity wreckage of shattered orbital defense stations, and clear out heavily corrupted subterranean bunkers on dead moons. Combat requires a mix of heavy weapon utilization, tactical cover management, and high-mobility zero-G maneuvers to dismantle towering bio-mechanical bosses and ultimately seal the cosmic anomaly.

title: Grand Theft Auto Online: The Diamond Casino Heist
description: The Diamond Casino Heist is an all-new approach to Heist architecture and execution: one huge gameplay-packed operation as you work with the Cheng family to infiltrate the most secure building in all of Los Santos. Featuring a diverse range of opportunities for set-up and prep missions that shape your plan of attack, multiple paths of approach, constantly changing security measures and a dizzying array of choices once inside. Expect outcomes for you and your crew to change on the fly as you deal with each new situation, leading to more choices mid-mission. Even if the best laid plans go sideways, you’ll have the opportunity to keep the mission afloat without failing by shooting your way out with your remaining team lives, all allowing the Heist to be highly replayable with new scenarios unfolding each time.

title: Docked: DLC 2
description: Gain access to DLC 2, arriving in Summer 2026, featuring a forklift, one additional milestone, a variety of new jobs and multiple infrastructure upgrades to grow your operations.

title: Whispers of the Tallgrass
