description: An atmospheric first-person survival horror set in an abandoned industrial wasteland overtaken by tall grass. Listen closely to the mysterious sounds of the night, hide from a relentless predator, scavenge for key items, uncover the secrets of this place, and find a way to escape.

title: The Cabin Game
description: The Cabin Game is a 1-4 player, chaotic horror game where you are trapped inside a cabin and the only way out is through a game of cards. Just beware, as the cards you play have a surprising twist on this humble abode...

title: Jett Rider Mini H.E.R.O.
description: Jett Rider Mini H.E.R.O. is a classic Game Boy-style adventure set in the Jett Rider universe. A small mission. A big heart. A true handheld hero.

title: Chop Chop Inc.
description: Build your own furniture empire after getting fired from Furnox Corp . Chop down trees, process wood, automate your growing production lines and sell clever furniture sets for bonus cash. Explore a handcrafted world packed with weirdos, secrets and trees begging for violence.

title: Justice Project
description: Manage your very own operational courthouse, show your architectural talent, with every detail in your control. Let your management prowess show, schedule cases and trials alongside the ever present pressures of profit and reputation.

title: Bloodshot
description: Hardly Hyperbolic’s Bloodshot is a multiplayer FPS inspired by Doom and Quake. This fast-paced experience features a low-poly, pixelated aesthetic and a unique "Superhot" twist: projectile speed is relative to your character's movement. Players wield a modified shotgun that consumes their own blood as ammo; as your speed and heart rate increase, so does your firepower. Bloodshot prioritises pure mechanical speed and high-octane feedback.

title: Tyrant Tactics: Birth of Revolution
description: Field your army, deploy mechs, and battle with up to 4 players in Tyrant Tactics: Birth of Revolution! Control 1 of 4 unique factions and lead them to victory in turn-based combat through a narrative focused campaign and multiplayer modes featuring both local and online play.

title: Plague Inc: Aliens & Anti-Vaxxers
description: From the infinite depths of space comes an utterly alien plague type. Radically new gameplay, mysterious victory conditions, interstellar genes, haunting music and much more. The world will never be the same again.

title: Scarlet Skips
description: Jump jump jump as much as you can in this silly 1-button Rogue-Like about skipping rope! Power up your jump ropes to help Scarlet jump higher, survive longer, and reach absurdly high scores! boing boing boing boing boing boing boing boing

title: Emoji Bomb
description: A collection of super-fast micro-games in just 5 seconds! Challenge records with reflexes and concentration in a variety of emoji mini-games!

title: Echoes of the Scourge
description: Every year, a festival is held to celebrate the founding of Springure, a small and quaint town. Odette, a girl grieving a dear friend, suddenly finds herself in an empty, distorted version of her hometown.

title: Sting & Swing
description: Explore a strange overgrown world as a bee with a golf ball. Master the skills of bee-golf to uncover the mysteries hidden in its furthest reaches and hiding in front of you. Discover uses for abilities you didn't know you had. There are always more secrets for those who seek them beneath the green.

title: Norukasoruka: Tanpenshuu
description: A collection of short stories for the game Norukasoruka. It includes a prequel centered in Shiawa and Tengu, origin stories for the Yokai, and an epilogue of sorts.

title: Matchmaking for Ghosts
description: Matchmaking for Ghosts is an atmospheric visual novel with horror elements and themes of love and loss, built around a unique multi-protagonist system that lets players experience the afterlife through the eyes of every ghost. Match ghosts together for love, or for chaos. The choice is yours.

title: Velato
description: Velato is a poker-bluff roguelike deckbuilder where players build a joker-driven economy engine, manipulate AI opponents through bluffing, and survive escalating table pressure across each run.

title: Alteredblood+
description: A blood-soaking movement-FPS platformer where you splatter walls and floors with your foe’s blood. Stand in that blood to [alter] yourself and your weapons. Soak up blood to replenish and keep fighting. Mother created you to stop them. Beckon our extinction.

title: Demo Disc: Flipside Frights
description: Demo Disc: Flipside Frights is a compilation of 24 playable demos for upcoming Haunted PS1 video games.

title: Cutie Smile: Kimi to Issho ni
Overserved: Food Fighters!
description: Overserved: Food Fighters is a fast-paced multiplayer party brawler for 1–8 players. Pick an adorable critter, dash through chaotic arenas, and hurl food-themed projectiles at your rivals in frantic matches with full cross-play across every platform.

title: Kimi to Mezameru Ikutsuka no Houhou
Mini Raid Leader
description: Mini Raid Leader is a single-player Action RTS, in which you command an ever-growing party of heroes to take down powerful bosses.

title: Vitalis
description: Vitalis is a TTRPG-inspired Roguelike and Dungeon Crawler where you try to escape an occult forest. Cast your die to move, fight, and flee. Scale your character, collect items, and weapons. Defeat the boss and leave the forest, or run away and bide your time.

title: Inferiae
description: Inferiae is a two-hour-long descent into a nightmare over 20 years in the making, an immersive experience blending unsettling soundscapes with hundreds of shifting scenes and a haunting narrative.

title: Creepytape Rewind: Not From Here
description: A change of environment, isolation in a remote area, and a chain of seemingly random events can leave the mind vulnerable. But what will your imagination create when you're met with hostility from the locals?

title: 8-Hour Workday
description: 8-hour Workday is an anomaly search game inspired by Exit 8 and Platform 8. The player needs to explore a creepy, ominous office where dangerous anomalies are lurking around and try to make it through the work hours. There are 27 anomalies in the game. See if you can solve them all!

title: He Followed Me
description: He Followed Me is a psychological horror experience about an ordinary man who begins noticing the same car outside the places he visits. What starts as a minor disagreement slowly turns into something far more unsettling. Sometimes, the scariest things aren’t supernatural… they’re real.

title: Night Pump
description:
Night Pump is a short first-person horror game set during a night shift at Route 9 Gas, an isolated gas station surrounded by nothing but forest and darkness.

A night shift at an isolated gas station. Strange customers. Strange noises. Serve customers, manage the register, and try to ignore the feeling that something is very wrong tonight. Some customers will buy things. Some will just talk. And some should never have walked through that door.

When the lights go out, there is nowhere to run.

title: Stealth Raider
description: Navigate intricate mazes, ancient dungeons, and high-security vaults filled with traps, guards, and advanced security systems. Use your cunning, agility, and a variety of gadgets to outsmart enemies and solve complex puzzles. Wishlist Stealth Raider now and stay tuned for updates!

title: Fuman Ghoul
description: A two-week story about a girl whose stress summons monsters. Dodge obstacles, defeat enemies, and make it to school on time in this fast-paced action adventure.

title: By the King's Command
description: Build up your little kingdom, strategically placing buildings to generate gold in defensible locations, then defend against invaders in brutal real-time tactics.

title: Avaria: Iron Rule
description: An isometric, party-based, real-time with pause RPG exploring the taboos of colonialism without moral hand-holding. Set in a rich fantasy world, Avaria: Iron Rule offers complex choices, deep dialogues and intense tactical battles inspired by classics of the genre.

title: Murder Strip
description:
A horror game about American urban planning.
As someone who doesn't own a car, you depend on the highway bike lane—one that's highly maintained and keeps all bicycle users safe from any harm that may come their way!

title: Meatlock
description: Meatlock is a short point & click horror experience focused on tension, observation, and environmental storytelling. Explore, interact with your surroundings, and progress from room to room.

title: Gun Predict
description: Gun Predict is a top-down strategy shooter where you must carefully choose the type of bullets to use in order to complete the levels. Create a strategy to eliminate all enemies and overcome obstacles using special projectiles.

title: Drill Core: The Machine World
description: Drill deep into the Machine Worlds, extract all their minerals and escape before you get overwhelmed. DLC includes new biome, new core, buildings and turrets.

title: Somnosec
description: Scientists at Halogen are conducting tests on the experimental sleep drug SOMNOSEC; patients are said to experience the full effects of a full 8-hours REM sleep in just minutes. You are a part of those initial experiments.

title: The Silver Crow
description: You play Conrad - executioner, outcast, and the last man anyone would trust to solve a murder. A handcrafted adventure steeped in Renaissance atmosphere, occult shadows and moral ambiguity. A point & click mystery in a city where truth is buried, power decides guilt, and someone is always watching.

title: Eternal Curse
description: Eternal Curse is a top-down twin-stick shooter roguelite bullet heaven. Burn, shoot, and slay your way through hordes of cursed residents on an unfortunate island. Loot and escape the island or die before succumbing to the corrupting power of the Eternal Curse!

title: Uroboros
description: Uroboros is a Boom wad with non-linear progression between levels. Each map has both normal and secret exits, leading to different next map. But there's more! It may also be absolutely random which exit you will get (however you might discover secret deterministic exits), so there are many different ways to progress through the wad. Don't be surprised that you got into map 8 after map 1. It is completely normal :)

title: Shadow of Oryda
description: In this metroidvania, explore the hostile planet Oryda, collect your ship's wreckage, gain new abilities, build outposts and devices, play mini-games and fight bosses to uncover a mystery that might restore the world.

title: Trip to the Core
description: Forge insane combos by fusing powers & enhancers in this team-based roguelike deckbuilder. 15 unique characters with 150+ equipment combinations!

title: Seven Favors
description:
The Apocalypse comes in 7 days, are you prepared, insect?
To win us over, you must harvest the blood of your enemies to win Favour with us, and build up a devoted flock of your fellow man, tend to their needs, all in the hopes that when the 7th day comes, your favour obtained and your flock brought together, you will be seen in a better light than the others.

title: The Hall
description: The Hall - a rare place entered by people who have truly discovered their true inner self, beware of the white walls, the jazz music, its all in your mind. They say its the gate for inner peace, but with a big price to pay.

title: Requiem of the Dark Lord
description:
Ever wanted to be the antagonist?.. Have you ever envied those isekai heroes from anime or games who, in a single moment, become powerful, respected, and popular? The hero of our story could never have dreamed of such a fate.

Falling into the world of his favorite game, the one he devoted years of his life to, sounds like a blessing. But can you still call it a blessing after what Ryu must endure in his new life? When the whole world wants to swallow you and digest you, leaving no chance to escape. Is it fate, or the design of higher powers? It no longer matters, because this world is destined to drown in blood.

**I will create a new world without grudges or prohibitions. I will create it only for those who truly need it. I will create a new world, even if I must destroy the old one. The world is in my hands now!**

title: Orc Incremental
description: Start with a single orc and build an unstoppable dark army to conquer the realms in this incremental auto battler. Perfect your formation, summon mighty beasts, unlock powerful upgrades, and grow stronger with each rebirth.

title: Diablo: The Abyss
description: Diablo The Abyss is a strategic RPG full of random and roguelike elements. Within this randomized world, you can freely make strageties at your own pace and conquer formidable challenges, while shaping your unique adventure journey.

title: Racar
description: RACAR, developed by TECNO BROS, has evolved to become a next generation online shooter. This game now offers high-quality graphics and an immersive experience that rivals the most famous titles. In RACAR, players can join intense online battles, facing off against opponents from around the world in exciting, action-packed futuristic scenarios.

title: Levate
description: A short atmospheric visual novel about a teenager who tries to hide from his thoughts and problems. But the longer he avoids reality, the more it distorts around him.

title: O Empire! Ward off Thy Rot
description: A slow, meditative survival journey across a bleak continent. Carry an evil artifact, manage scarce resources, scavenge abandoned places and decide how far you’re willing to endure in a world that offers no reassurance.

title: Love at the RatbagTrash Cabin!
description:
Your car broke down. A kind stranger took you in.
His cabin is lovely. His roommates are lovely.
Everything here is just... lovely.

title: Apex Byte Reeling
description: You are the Apex Necro-predator, harpooning arrays of digital individuals amongst what remains of the forlorn structure.

title: TmPaint
description: Immersive drawing experience created in two days featuring several MS-Paint drawing tools we all know and love, full VR support, and physics based prop mayhem. Paints can be applied onto a variety of different objects such as a head, a physics cloth or even a Campbell soup!

title: Killgun
description: Killgun is a brutal first-person shooter and body-camera game for players who crave pure, aggressive combat, high difficulty, and an atmosphere of constant survival.

title: ZYX: Children.
description:
Shadows inspire a violence in the concrete jungle.

Without aim or design, without organization: indomitable madness, decomposition. Those who are strong in force will survive, for they are quick in defense, the agility of limbs and sentiments; flames on their faceted flanks.

You happen to be in the middle of it... or maybe at the top.

title: [Vlast]
description: Frenetic, hard and heavily stylized, this top down shooter is not for everyone.

title: Failed Falling
description: Plan your falls and learn from failure in a challenging descent along an active volcano! Sail its updrafts with your parachute to move forward, but going up is the opposite of your goal, so don't drift for too long: losing progress will be inevitable, but giving up is always a choice...

title: Alice Slaughters Wonderland
description: A bizarre take on the classic Alice in Wonderland novel, with horror elements, classic rpg gameplay and a lot of strange and horrifying situations and characters.

title: Hell Wait
description: Hell Wait is riichi mahjong crossed with roguelike deckbuilding. Stack your jokers. Upgrade your yaku. Try not to deal in. You'll need those fingers.

title: The Magic Hour
description: "The Magic Hour" is a sequel to "Together Again: A Lake's Funland Story" set 20 years after the game's events, it covers a new story full of new faces and new tragedies. Try walking in Reagan Schmidt's shoes as she tries to survive a week at this place, so lively in the day's bright light, but rather obscure and dangerous at night.

title: Tailor Tales: Eeyok Plus
description: Experience a longer and sexy epilogue with Eeyok.

title: Octillery Vs. Collection
description: A collection of updated, refined, and polished versions of the Octillery VS. Trilogy, aswell as a completely new game. Take on several villains and political figures as Octillery and his team.

title: Valvontaa
description: Valvontaa is a sci-fi third-person action RPG set in the distant future. Interact with townsfolk and fight off hostile aliens to survive. Find unique armor and equipment to aid on your descent into the depths.

title: Data Trader
description: Data Trader is a cyberpunk strategy game where information has become the world's most valuable resource. Buy archives, trade classified data, command agents, and uncover the truth about who you really were.

title: My Beautiful Faraway, Please Don't Be Cruel to Me
description: A dreamlike, half-remembered nowhere. Quietly wander through it, solve opaque puzzles, meet strange figures, and uncover the subtle threads of melancholy from which this place was born.

title: Yume ka Utsutsu ka Matryoshka
description:
Mamoru lives on the island of Shinonoshima, enjoying every moment with his osananajimi Miyako and close friends Isuka, Shiori, Nagi, Aoi and Kazushige. Their time together is irreplaceable to him and he believed that it would continue forever. However, he did not know he was about to fall into the abyss of despair.

He fell into a deep sleep due to a certain incident, and when he woke up, no one else remained except Miyako. Not wanting him to remain in sorrow, she told him about a ‘tradition’ passed down through generations. On the 100th night after the loss of their precious ones, if they are able to gather memories deeply connected with them and offer them to the island’s protective god Wadatsumi, then it might bring their lost ones back. They prepared for the ceremony while clinging on to the belief that it will work.

title: Sanzensekai no Ko wo Koroshi
description:
Tomorrow night, the female head of their household, Hasumi, is to create a child with a man she meets for the first time, as decreed by the elders of their clan.
One time, she tried to escape this fate to the point of nearly dying. How will she spend her last day before that cursed yet promised night, with Yashiro— her chaperone— who once intervened with her attempt to die and saved her?

title: No More Cows
description: Physics-based co-op platformer where you and your friend must abduct a cow and drag it all the way from a barn to a laboratory in space. Survive traps, zero gravity, and friendship-breaking chaos in online co-op.

title: Water of M
description:
Water of M is a challenging puzzle game. Unlike traditional puzzle titles, it blends in action elements such as combat and jumping, making every puzzle tenser and more rhythm-driven.

At the same time, Water of M is also a survival horror experience: in this corpse-strewn school, you must evade relentless enemies and move with caution.

Is the legendary "Water of Mortal" a gift of immortality or a vicious curse? Trapped in a twisted campus, you must confront unknown supernatural horrors. Scavenge resources, solve hardcore puzzles, and piece together classified files to escape this nightmare before your sanity shatters.

title: AL: Artificial Life
description: Experimental alien observation/collecting/breeding sim by digital artist Daizaburo Harada in 1993 as part of larger multimedia project AL: Artificial Life (Insects), also featuring an artbook & prose sci-fi novel by author Greg Bear, published by Pioneer.

title: No Love: 2009
description: The story of two high school lovers during their summer break. The internet c@fés everyone was obsessed with back then, amusement parks, train stations, dark side streets and burning through your SMS credit before you even get to say how you feel. Not just 2009… this is No Love: 2009.

title: The Abandoned House in Yeongdeok
description: She was sent to the abandoned house in Yeongdeok as part of a viewer punishment challenge. But the joke ended the moment the door slammed shut.

title: Fear Tall Grass
description: Dark creature-collecting roguelite where humanity enslaves their old gods. Command evolving monsters on the board of Humanity’s final crusade.

title: Soap Killer
description: "Soap Killer" is a Horror/Comedy game,inspired by many iconic indie horror masterpieces. It's a short and simple game.

title: Crosscountry Canada Platinum
description:
Crosscountry Canada Platinum is a remake of Crosscountry Canada.

Since it was released in 2000, it features several updates since the original, such as the territory of Nunavut and the Confederation Bridge.

title: Reshine
description: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

title: Wario and the Tower of Garlic
description: A short episode featuring Wario, its structure is loosely based off a mix of Wario Land 4 and Antonblast. You won't be grabbing things but you sure will be going at a fast pace exploring levels and collecting treasures of all kind while you climb up the Tower of Garlic... and who knows, there might be something special at the top...

title: Crosscountry USA Photo Safari
description: A game in the Crosscountry series. The gameplay is similar to other games in the series, but the focus is on animals rather than commodities.

title: Crosscountry Canada Photo Safari
description: A game in the Crosscountry series. The gameplay is similar to other games in the series, but the focus is on animals rather than commodities.

title: Crosscountry BC
description: Crosscountry BC is a lot like Crosscountry Canada 2, but set exclusively in British Columbia.

title: Rally Shift
description: Rally Shift is a first person stealth rallying racing game. Where you are tasked to control a rally car that is having a bomb, that you need to escort to safety as fast as possible. Use any driving techniques necessary to reach the end FAST.

title: Dead Before Work: The Commute
description: "20 mins to the meeting, or you’re Dead Before Work!" It's Archie's unluckiest day. From broken alarms to a city that’s literally out to get him. Sprint through physics-based chaos, dodge cosmic-level bad luck, and rack up gag points. Can you survive the world’s most lethal commute?

title: Killing Baby Hitler
description: Stop fascism in the cradle. Travel through time and hunt down history’s most evil infant in this satirical old-school FPS.

title: Appalachian Onslaught
description: Build, upgrade and defend against an endless onslaught of cryptids being sent to destroy your tribe by the great Appalachian nightmare himself... the Rketari.

title: Age of Gods
description: A competitive turn-based strategy game where positioning, unit synergy, and map control decide everything. Capture structures, build your army, and outplay your opponents in tactical battles with up to 8 players.

title: Age of Gods: Necros Campaign
description: Necros Campaign — 21 missions commanding undead legions through shadow-soaked battlefields. Raise the fallen, deny enemy auras, drain life, and grind opponents down with Necros' signature counter-play and late-game threats.

title: Age of Gods: Equinox Campaign
description: 22-mission single-player Equinox campaign: light vs shadow, nature and balance, and battles that reward forest control, buffs, and clever positioning.

title: Age of Gods: Necros Faction
description: Necros DLC: permanent undead faction access—necromancy, shadow auras, life drain, and counter-play that punishes buff-stacking enemies.

title: Nightmare Before Blackgate
description: A nightmare takes shape in the quiet of the night. Explore an abandoned house and a haunting cemetery as something watches you from the darkness. In Nightmare Before BlackGate, reality warps… and you're never alone.

title: Age of Gods: Nordheim Faction
description: Unlock Nordheim for life—Viking raiders from the frozen north who mix frost magic, steel, and cunning. Strike from stealth, soak hits behind divine shields, and recycle the fallen into undead capturers that keep pressure relentless.

title: Age of Gods: Tribal Faction
description: Tribal DLC: permanent wild faction access—poison pressure, possession mind games, class flex, and amphibious mobility for adaptable players.

title: Age of Gods: Skyborne Faction
description: Skyborne DLC: permanent access to the aerial faction—mountain tempo, flying pressure, and support tools that protect sky armies while you strike from above.

title: Age of Gods: Sanctus Campaign
description: 23-mission Sanctus single-player campaign: holy warriors, healing and barriers, sustained defensive fights, and a story of cleansing corruption.

title: Age of Gods: Spirit Faction
description: Spirit DLC: permanent access to beyond-the-veil armies—freeze crowd control, turn-by-turn sustain, and spectral roster twists for methodical players.

title: Age of Gods: Drakonis Faction
description: Drakonis DLC: unlock the full dragon faction forever—fire and magma pressure, hatching and undead dragon tricks, and a roster built to dominate the late game.

title: Age of Gods: Igneous Faction
description: Unlock Igneous for life—a volcanic faction built around disease pressure, immunity-driven trades, and elite helpers that anchor your game plan. Incinerate space with fire and magma fantasy while you spread afflictions, force awkward cleanses, and snowball when opponents mis-step.

title: How Asian Parents went to School
description: An online 1-4 player co-op adventure where you experience the legendary struggle of getting to school as an Asian parent. Fight a psychopathic bear, defy physics, and survive the emotional damage from Tablo Escobar : an NPC who roasts you every time you fail.

title: Escape from Tarkov: Usec - Fahrenheit
description: A winter tactical outfit created for USEC operators, combining modern private military styling with cold-weather operational gear. The Fahrenheit set delivers a sharp, professional tactical appearance adapted for winter operations.

title: Escape from Tarkov: Bear - Arktika
description: Winter outfit for BEAR operators inspired by arctic combat gear. Designed for harsh cold environments and snow-covered operations. Includes Arktika upper and lower body customisation items. BEAR faction only.

title: Escape from Tarkov: Usec - AC Ranger Green
description: An outfit for USEC operatives in the Ranger Green colorway, widely used in modern military and contractor equipment. Suitable for a wide range of conditions and tasks.

title: Escape from Tarkov: Bear - Nord
description: A BEAR set focused on details. The Nord set highlights individuality with tattoos and a jacket featuring unique artwork.

title: Escape from Tarkov: Usec - Day off
description: A casual clothing set for USEC operatives, designed for rare moments of rest between operations. The vibrant Day Off pattern evokes vacation, warmth, and the sea. Even at rest, stylized weapons and gear in the print serve as a reminder of Tarkov.

title: Escape from Tarkov: Bear - Zaslon
description: A tactical set for BEAR operatives, designed for high-difficulty tasks. The Zaslon set emphasizes discipline, functionality, and readiness for demanding operations.

title: Escape from Tarkov: Bear - Oldschool
description: A classic set inspired by earlier military gear designs. The Old School set combines a time-tested approach with a recognizable look.

title: Escape from Tarkov: Bear - Classic
description: A set reflecting the baseline style of BEAR operatives. The Classic set is designed for those who value simplicity and functionality without excess.

title: Escape from Tarkov: Bear - Instructor
description: A gear set for BEAR operatives reflecting the experience and discipline of unit instructors. The Instructor set emphasizes professionalism and battlefield knowledge.

title: Escape from Tarkov: Bear - Cyclone
description: An outfit for BEAR operatives with an emphasis on speed and mobility. The Cyclone set is ideal for fast-paced urban operations.

title: Escape from Tarkov: Bear - G99
description: A modern tactical set for BEAR operatives focused on versatility and efficiency. The G99 set combines practicality with a contemporary look.

title: Escape from Tarkov: Usec - Urban Responder
description: An outfit for USEC operatives. The Urban Responder set is built for rapid response in urban environments, following the well-known principle: simplicity and practicality.

title: Escape from Tarkov: Usec - Deadly Frog
description: An outfit for those who value self-expression. Inspired by informal unit culture, the Deadly Frog set is suitable for operations in a variety of conditions.

title: Escape from Tarkov: Usec - Scadi
description: A tactical winter outfit for USEC operatives. Ideal for cold-weather operations and northern deployments. Subtlety and adaptability are the key advantages of the Scadi set.

title: Escape from Tarkov: Bear - Vacation
description: A casual set for BEAR operatives designed for downtime between missions. The Vacation set draws from resort aesthetics, featuring bright patterns with stylized weapons and familiar gear elements.

title: Escape from Tarkov: Usec - Special Ops
description: An outfit for USEC operatives assigned to high-difficulty missions. The Special Ops set emphasizes functionality and operational readiness.

title: Escape from Tarkov: Usec - Night Patrol
description: An outfit designed to maintain a low profile in various conditions. The Night Patrol set focuses on stealth and controlled movement.

title: Escape from Tarkov: Usec - Vanguard
description: A tactical outfit for USEC fighters operating on the front lines. The Vanguard set combines functionality with a disciplined, no-nonsense style, providing comfort and freedom of movement during combat operations.

title: Escape from Tarkov: Usec - Woodland Infiltrator
description: A tactical outfit for USEC operatives designed for stealth operations in forest environments. The Infiltrator set emphasizes camouflage, mobility, and adaptability to difficult terrain.

title: Escape from Tarkov: Bear - Morozko
description: A winter set for BEAR operatives, designed for harsh northern conditions. The Morozko set combines insulation and practicality, delivering a reliable and subdued look in extreme cold.

title: Hell Is Empty, Demons Are Playing Apokerlypse
description: A deck-building roguelike shedding card game. You will play as Satan—a humble civil servant in Hell—and embark on a 3-chapter Story Mode. By combining various skills and demonic chips, you will take down powerful bosses and claim your throne as the new King of Hell.

title: Hidden Paradise: Kiwi Christmas - Collector's Edition
description: A festive Kiwi adventure filled with sunny holiday vibes, hidden object fun, and cozy puzzles as you explore Auckland’s magic with the Garcias.

title: Trucky McTruckface
description: Little garbage truck. Huge chaos! Wield your horn like a weapon and wreak ridiculous destruction in this physics-based arcade game full of bins, balls, and beautifully stupid fun.

title: The Candy Adventure
description: Dive into The Candy Adventure! Join your friend after falling through a magical portal and getting lost in a world of enchanted sweets. On an epic journey home. Alone or in cooperation, every moment is a delightful surprise. Adventure, friendship and sweetness await you!

title: Gravehold: Survival
description: A deadly virus wiped out civilization. Now, survivors must build bases, set traps, and fight endless waves of zombies to stay alive.

title: Cardbound Heroes
description: Cardbound Heroes is a Draw & Strike Roguelite where you combine cards to match numbers, cross out fields, fight enemies and unlock powerful combos. Build your deck, discover hidden combo cards, and master a campaign that changes every run.

title: Stalart
description: STALART - is a fresh and rapidly gaining momentum online game with a unique and atmospheric gameplay.

title: KeelOver
description: KeelOver is a crazy physics party game where weight rules everything. Your pirate ship is a giant scale, tilt the deck by hurling heavy loot at your rivals, customize your pirate, and keep your balance… or end up as shark bait!

title: Hearts of Iron IV: Peace for Our Time
description: Imagine a world where the White Lion of Prague was prepared to face German aggression.

title: Almanac: Detective Agency
description: The Town of Almanac is full of people with secrets. Talk to them in your own words, photograph what you find, and piece together the truth. A detective game set in 1910 where every conversation actually matters.

title: The Edge of Water
description: An adventure game about a girl leading her floating village on the course of a great fish migration. Herd sea creatures, protect them from danger, and surf across both beautiful scenery and troubled waters.

title: Into the Dust
description: Top-down tactical co-op extraction shooter. Up to four players scavenge, fight, and rebuild in the harsh, post-apocalyptic wastelands of Dust Bowl America.

title: Bloodmoored
description: Bloodmoored is a first-person psychological horror. Revive a derelict factory by restarting its machinery. The spirits here are unpredictable: one moment they hunt you, the next they are your only key to salvation. Uncover their past to understand their motives and escape this trap alive

title: Wok This Way!
description: Grab your Suction Gun and fight as a leaf sheep in this wild 4v4 multiplayer shooter! Cosmic rays mutated every ingredient on the ship into something dangerous. Weaponize them, cook them into recipes, and push the pot into the Mobius Whoops Monster's mouth before the other team feeds it first.

title: T.W.I.R.L.
description: It's 3am in your childhood home. Everyone's asleep, but you. Sneak out of your room to do what you always do - "T.W.I.R.L." - whatever that means.

title: A Rat's Quest: The Way Back Home - Season 2
description: Stranded far from home, Mat, the determined young rat, must brave the dangerous "Outside" to make his way back to his friends and Nat. Armed with only a rivet, he must face new foes and forge alliances in order to complete his epic quest and be reunited with his beloved.

title: Cozy Mozy
description: A relaxing cozy home renovation game where you clean, paint, repair, and decorate spaces at your own pace. Enjoy satisfying interactions, calming visuals, and create warm, lived-in rooms with no timers or pressure.

title: Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel - Conan
description: Play as the legendary Conan in a major content expansion for Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel and master his three brutal combat styles to crush and slice through enemies. Conquer the scorching sands of Stygia, challenge the Fate system, descend into darkness and slaughter the colossal Undead Jötunn.

title: Tamitos: Tale of Understanding
description: A story-driven platformer where you experience the world through autistic and neurotypical perspectives. Explore a magical world, rescue Tamitos frog creatures representing emotions, and solve meaningful puzzles that teach empathy, understanding, and the beauty of seeing the world differently.

title: Pastdark
description: Pastdark is a horror extraction game with CO-OP up to 4 players with a twist - madness! This makes each of the players see and hear things which are not there. Extract toys and submarine parts by utilizing stealth, teamwork, proximity voice chat and various items before the madness overwhelms you!

title: SurrounDead Poly Construction
description: SurrounDead Poly Construction is an open-world survival adventure game where players will solve puzzles, collect items, and defeat all enemies to reach the end.

title: Commandos: Origins - No Man Left Behind
description: Missing in Action – a story yet untold! In the 2nd DLC for Commandos: Origins – ‘No Man Left Behind’, you will discover four new missions diving into the events that led to the Green Beret's capture in occupied France and his eventual rescue.

title: Am I Here?
description: No character. No body. No mercy. Just footprints… and your inevitable failure.

title: Age of History II: Definitive Edition
description:
Age of History II: Definitive Edition is a remastered version of Age of History II, developed and published by Łukasz Jakowski Games. It was released on Steam with updated features, additional content, and technical improvements over the original game. The Definitive Edition expands the scope of the grand strategy title while retaining the core gameplay of diplomacy, conquest, and empire management.

The Definitive Edition introduces a larger map with 13,892 provinces, new civilizations, scenarios, and the addition of religions as a gameplay element. Other features include animated province names, a revised user interface, quality-of-life changes, and Steam Workshop support, aiming to provide an updated experience for both new and returning players.

title: Bravo, Gaspar!
description: "Survive my sadistic show. An action roguelike where your performance with collectible creatures serves only to feed me. On my stage, the rule is simple: entertain or die!"

title: Stop and Smell the Flowers
description: Relax in your shady garden and watch the flowers. Plant flowers, earn money, expand your garden, and trace the evolution chart to complete your collection.

title: Secret Files: Tunguska - Remastered
description: The award-winning adventure classic returns as a remaster with modernized visuals and updated technology. Join Nina and Max on a globe-spanning investigation filled with puzzles, conspiracies, and danger - and uncover the secret of Tunguska that changes everything!

title: Tokyo Day
description: You wake up in a quiet town with no memories. A girl named Aiko helps you remember — but the more you recover, the less real things become. A romance-mystery visual novel with puzzles, choices, and 6 possible endings.

title: Bardella and the Curse of Silence
description: Explore a world of music and magic in the metroidvania Bardella and the Curse of Silence! Fight monsters, solve puzzles, and play music as you fight against the mysterious curse of silence and strive to free the land from its grip.

title: Where Are the Fish?
description: A short exploration game about driving around in a truck to find fish in the desert.

title: Oogies Chicken Quest
description: A short, quirky 3D action adventure where Oogie sets out to find his legendary chicken, Cluck Cluck, who lays diamond eggs. Explore small open worlds , solve puzzles, battle odd enemies, and uncover hidden secrets in vibrant levels!

title: Horizon 1990
description: Gather exotic resources, build defenses, research new technologies, and explore the mysteries of the void, all while being chased by the darkness from the end of time.

title: False God
description: Delve into the depths of a supernatural temple, unearth forbidden lore, and outwit cosmic horrors in a narrative-rich journey where each level blends classic Lovecraftian themes with the secrets of Chinese mythology.

title: Torch Keeper
description: This is a small rogue-like dungeon crawler with a turn based battle system, multiple masteries and procedurally generated dungeons to discover.

title: Escape Doom
description:
Escape Doom is a short game in which the player needs to explore the room where they are being kept incarcerated. Search for clues and solve the puzzles that will somehow lead you to escape before being crushed by the ever shrinking window.

A Mysterious and Intriguing game about horror and puzzles.

title: Sushi Yummy
description: Eat 'em up!! Sushi Yummy is a cozy clicker about just eating sushi.

title: Box Office Mayhem: Theatre Tycoon
description: Box Office Mayhem is a business management game where you simulate running your own movie theatre. Navigate through signing movie deals, managing day to day operations, and struggle as movie goers have unpredictable behavior. Play solo against AI competitors or take it online against friends!

title: The Last (Hotdog) Stand
description: Run your own hotdog stand in this fast-paced food management game! Take orders, make dogs, and keep customers happy as you work to grow your hotdog empire, and restore hotdogs to their former glory. Upgrade your stand, unlock new ingredients, and expand to bigger, busier locations!

title: Infinity Nikki: Where All Souls Return
description:
The Boneyard—birthplace of the God of Reincarnation.
Dragon remains bear witness to an undying mark.
The ancient ocarina guides souls to the beyond.

The tides ebb and flow, as desolation gives way to bloom.
This long journey—a fool's errand, or an eternal vigil?

title: Syr and the Stars' Revival
description: “Syr and the Stars' Revival” follows the new Nextuber “Syr” as she sets out to restore the fallen Cyber World. Stream, gain fans, and help the Cyber World flourish once again! A brand-new raising simulation where building your room is the key to streaming success!

title: Koi Mekuri Clover: Itsuka no Kimi he, Yakusoku no Ashita wo
description: Arata returned to his hometown due to his father’s work and was reunited with his three childhood friends after 10 years apart. They were the cheerful and innocent Yuuka, the reliable ‘onee-san’ Ayami and the once-small Mikana who had now grown to be very beautiful. Adding another childhood friends Yuusuke and his moodmaker little sister Mahiru, his school life is full of enjoyment like in the past. Then they received a strange e-mail inviting them to play a game. If they did not accept it, they will lose something precious.

title: Seito Kaichou de Amaenbou na Onee-chan ha Suki Desu ka?
description: Mio is the student council president who happens to be a neighbor and childhood friend of Yuuhi so he is not spared from the jealousy of his classmates and other male students. They could have been more jealous if they just know how they are back at home. Mio and Yuuhi are actually a pair of lovers and their formal treatment towards each other is nothing more than a cover-up to conceal real intimacy.

title: Rakuen no Rukia
description: After the passing of his grandmother who was his only relative, Kazuma returns to a boarding school Meikyou Seigakuen in his hometown. Located in the mountains, it is a quiet school. There he meets his childhood friend Mikoto who he thought had perished in the great fire ten years ago. Likewise, she thought that he had died, so they were happy to be back together once again. However, on the night of every full moon there is a ‘bloodsucking incident’. He noticed that Mikoto acting suspiciously and soon he is wrapped up in events that he does not understand.

title: Tambourine
description: A priestess is hired to exorcize an apartment building with a Tambourine. Parry and torment ghosts in this first-person survival horror as you make your way up the building. Find the mementos that will allow you to complete the exorcism.

title: Victor's Video Vault
description: It's 1995. The video store is alive. When the last customer leaves, the final rental rewrites reality.

title: Unionism Quartet
description: Fehde, a ceremonial duel with its origins in the Middle Ages, has morphed into the wildly popular sport ‘fehda’, with the combatants being called ‘knights’. Akito transfers into a school (Camelot) which trains knights and thanks to the Princess Yurina of the Albion Kingdom, he was made a member of the Knight Order (“Union”) and tasked with the goal of winning the school’s grand tournament, Vartok Fehda. He started out as an unknown, but people started knowing his name once he fought past many strong opponents and progressed deeper into the tournament. Will he be able to come out on top and claim the title of strongest of them all?

title: Unionism Quartet A3-Days
description: The sequel to Unionism Quartet.

title: Shadows Must Fall
description: A survivors-like roguelite where you build and reshape the arena, transforming weapons into towers as the horde closes in.

title: False Fruit
description:
In False Fruit, you play as Camellia, an eight-year-old girl sent to her room without dinner... several days ago.

When Camellia finally works up the nerve to disobey her hyper-religious mother and go hunting for food, she will find danger and friendship alike in forms she could never imagine.

title: Champions of Chaxia
description: Detailed, gritty text-based fantasy RPG centered on gladiatorial combat. Recreates the gameplay of the old gamebooks. Features hassle-free inventory management and a battle system that combines dice rolls with meaningful decisions and preparation.

title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Legend Edition
description:
Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Legend Edition includes:
- Base game
- Season Pass 1
- Andy Bogard
- Ken, additional stage
- Joe Higashi
- Chun-Li
- Mr. Big, additional stage

title: Punch Upon a Time
description: Punch Upon a Time is the party fighting game where you play alongside your friends. Either solo or as a team, fight as the biggest names from tales and myths to punch, dunk, fly, score, and sumo your way to victory as the LAST TEAM STANDING.

title: Revival
description: Revival is a third-person sci-fi action-adventure where you explore a massive hub world, hunt colossal bosses, solve environmental puzzles, and salvage alien technology to repair your ship and escape a hostile planet.

title: Dig In
description: A WW1 trench warfare colony sim where you build an evolving trench network with layered defenses, manage soldiers under pressure while holding a fragile sector of the front in real-time tactical battles.

title: Bar After Bar
description: Bar After Bar is a co-op game where 5 friends drive to the top of a mountain. You will be mixing drinks and throwing them at each other the whole way up. The drunker you get, the harder it is to drive. How far can you make it?

title: DriftBorne
description: An atmospheric visual novel of death, desire, and choices that shape your fate, where every decision drags you deeper into mystery and danger.

title: Don't Go Live
description:
Go Live. Get Famous. Don’t Die.

A paranormal horror game about streaming from places you really shouldn’t. Whether you’re live on Twitch or playing solo.

title: Ghost Hunting Journal
description: Ghost Hunting Journal is an anime-style narrative adventure game. The duo partners of self-proclaimed "Spirit Agent" accept various supernatural commissions, use a full set of ghost-hunting techniques to tackle urban myths caused by lingering ghosts in the city of Riverrun.

title: Liminal Aero
description: Liminal Aero is an indie horror and liminal-focused game, which blends the glossy, optimistic world of Frutiger Aero with the unsettling feeling of Dreamcore...

title: Bug Drop
description: A top down action roguelite game with auto firing weapons, level up increasing diffrerent stats, equip up to six weapons and upgrade your build with hundreds of abilities. Fight against swarms of alien bug invaders including bosses.

title: Delivered by Friday
description: Friday Kwon is a young witch making her first deliveries since her spinal cord injury six years ago. In this fast-paced auto-scroller navigate the unfriendly skies as a big witch company does its best to thwart Friday.

title: Quarantine Market Simulator
description:
Quarantine Market Simulator is a first-person market management simulation game set in a post-apocalyptic world.

Run your own market, manage stock and customers, check temperatures, and defend the walls during zombie raids.

title: Unseasonable Flowering
description: "Unseasonable Flowering" is a first-person horror game set in Japan. After moving to a new home, the young protagonist, Mashiro, is met with eerie residents and inexplicable phenomena. Something "sprouting" everywhere quietly erodes her daily life.

title: Dravenmoor
description: A fantasy sidescroller to search your missing friend in a mysterious town. Inspired by Alice in Wonderland and various punk artworks.

title: Self-Replication: Destruction
description: A third-person shooter set in a crumbling megastructure. Fight drones, explore its sectors, and survive in a system that has spiraled out of control.

title: Blue Fury
description: A helicopter combat game inspired by classic 16-bit titles. Destroy tanks, eliminate enemy forces, and rescue soldiers before an enemy missile launches. Manage fuel, ammunition, and altitude while engaging helicopters and avoiding AA launchers over procedurally generated terrain.

title: The Angel's Mandate
description: The Angel's Mandate is a first-person horror game where you play as Jesse, who finds himself in the palace of an angel after his mother falls ill, slowly losing her senses and physical control, one piece at a time. The angel claims you can save her, and asks you to face a trial beyond mortal limits.

title: Lofsöng
description: Explore, listen, and unravel a hidden language buried in stone and sound. An exploration puzzle adventure set across vast brutalist landscapes shaped by deep time ages.

title: Feather's Edge
description: Dash and slash through an innovative kinetic metroidvania. The Tower of Time awaits – a rich, handcrafted world fractured by the collapse of time. Slice through foes in tough-as-talons bite-sized battles, and master the way of the bird warrior.

title: Totopia
description: Totopia is calling! Drip in your style and crush 100+ chaotic maps, or smash the Bitrot crisis with Atomon skills! Need a recharge? Visit Pulse Avenue to build, plant, or run a cozy cafe. Cast your fishline, chill, and vibe with quirky Atomons. Your world, your way—join the squad and catch that W!

title: Crikeymas
description: Crikeymas is a fast-paced platformer where you take control of a (seriously kinda gross-looking) reindeer who somehow ended up as Santa's errand boy, smashing your way through brutally fun levels.

title: Olympus Rangers
description: Welcome to the ultimate battle simulator where you can create, manage and face dozens of opponents in multiple battle modes. Can you become the champion? Throw away your fainted teammates? How about becoming the world's best in online play? Take on the Olympus! Can you become the very best?

title: Arc of Icarus
description: Build and lead your colony on a lost ringworld, where deadly conditions await on both sides while the world keeps turning! Progress through technological evolution, survive cultural revolution, and govern with a wise and steady hand!

title: Unmourned VR
description: Unmourned is a first-person psychological horror game where Jason moves into a new house only to be haunted by escalating paranormal events. Driven by fear, he must uncover the truth behind the previous owners' disappearance. Can he solve the mystery before it's too late?

title: The Outpost: Outer Frontier
description: Lead the forces of a human empire in a brutal squad-based RTS. Capture territory, secure vital sectors, deploy fortifications, and unlock new units and upgrades mid-battle to outmaneuver and crush the alien threat.

title: Reoxia
description: The story of an astronaut who returns to Earth in the midst of an apocalypse caused by an unknown disease. He mustn't take off the spacesuit to avoid breathing the contaminated air. The devastated world is inhabited by the bloodthirsty infected and mutants, and unknown armed men are hunting him.

title: Last Night Last Call
description: Can you solve a murder with nothing but your wits, your cocktail shaker, and your silver tongue? In this bartending mystery game, your customers are the key. So long as the liquor flows, so does the conversation - but who has the answers you seek, and who has blood on their hands?

title: Heretic's Rapture
description: Build a tower out of tetris-like blocks to survive endless waves of demons. A tetris-like, tower-defence, deck-building, bullet-heaven.

title: On the Rocks
description: Run a bar in a toxic wasteland - scavenge the wasteland, brew what you find, serve who you must. In a world gone to ruin, the last bar standing is yours to run.

title: Throttle Trace
description: Slot cars meets simulation racing. Master grip, timing, and race strategy using only throttle and brake. Push to the limit, outsmart rivals, and fight for every corner in intense wheel-to-wheel competition.

title: Calm the Wolf
description: The world-renowned monster hunter Belik Askrow managed to defeat a fearsome werewolf on a quest, though he was also bitten by the beast. Belik must now stay hidden until sunrise to receive an antidote from his partner Alessa Mayflower. However it is New Year's Eve and the fireworks display might startle and turn him into a monster if he doesn't focus!

title: Box Game
description: Survive mandatory training on Christmas Eve, and clock out of work!

title: House Of 1000 Fowl
description: Transhumana Centari Incorporated has long enjoyed its solitude deep in forests outside of Gomor Falls, Washington, until the Freedom of Fowl Act passed in congress.

title: Reprocessing
description: You are Theodore West, a security guard at the black mesa research facility, you were hired for this job because of your combat experience in Vietnam, but now the only tasks you are given are to guard some donuts and help fix what the scientists have broken. However, fate has decided to give the sergeant a tour of duty that he will never forget...

title: Beer Gunner
description: A fast-paced run-and-gun shooter in the spirit of the classics — shoot, jump, and shred monsters to energetic music.

title: Welcome To The Gap
description: It's Summer 1998, and you work at The Gap clothes store to save money for college in the Fall. Keep the store tidy or you'll get fired and never get to finish college!!!!

title: Jennifer's Nonsensical Christmas Adventure
description: Help Jennifer save someone's christmas.

title: Hull Rupture
description: If the ship stops, humanity ends. Manage a spaceship, treat puny humans as resources, and repel relentless alien assaults in a base-management tower-defense roguelite where every choice seemed reasonable at the time.

title: Do They Know
description: A simple search for firewood leads young Hollis to something that was never meant to be found...

title: Venera 31
description: Collect soil on Venus. Photograph the surface. Mark every rock. Log any unusual rock as harvester. Do not keep looking at it

title: Beards Go Underground
description: The Mining Deckbuilder. Craft a deck of bombs and pickaxes to mine the mountains. Place down your card-arsenal and unleash a screen-shaking chain reaction that pays out in a juicy explosion of gold.

title: Celestay Craft&Slowlife
description: CELESTAY is a calm idle building game where you fish for materials and grow your home toward the sky. In a world sunk beneath the sea, you stack pieces of a house and spend quiet days fishing and watching the stars. The higher you build, the more constellations and memories fill your world.

title: Cards & Cannons
description: Build epic worlds, collect shiny loot and upgrade your defenses in this roguelite tower defense deckbuilder! Crush endless enemy hordes with mighty spells and crazy builds in unique runs. Defeat powerful bosses and conquer world after world in this colorful medieval madness!

title: Charming Hill
description: Charming Hill is a small experimental game where creating beautiful paintings feels easy and natural. No artistic skills are needed; it’s a space to relax, paint, and discover a heartwarming story, or better yet, paint your own.

title: Dream Loser
description: Get lost in a grey realm, where a stranger awaits your arrival.

title: Forbidden Solitarie
description: Forbidden Solitaire is a card-slashing horror game about unearthing the contents of a cryptic 1995 CD-ROM that should have never existed. From the creators of Ancient Enemy and Home Safety Hotline.

title: Greetings From El Rey
description: A noir 2.5D platformer in which Satrapo explores a sealed city through a rotating 2D perspective, engaged in an obsessive hunt for the mysterious R. A paranoid tale about desire, featuring eccentric characters and complex three-dimensional labyrinths.

title: Husk Protocol
description: ATTENTION! HUSK PROTOCOL INITIATED! Prepare to engage in a challenging deck-driven mecha game. Synergise between powerful Husks, utilise a dynamic deck and avoid detection from the city’s mainframe as you infiltrate the machine-driven brutopolis of Aeterna.

title: Cancelled Christmas
description: Santa failed to deliver presents this Christmas. An emergency task force has been summoned to deal with the crisis.

title: Hellbridge
description: Defend the last bridge to the living world in a relentless siege from Hell. Survive escalating waves, draft powerful spells, grow stronger with every run, and enter cursed gates to stop the invasion at its source.

title: Climber Toys: Together
description: Climber Toys: Together is a chaotic multiplayer climbing experience where tiny toy-like characters struggle their way to the top of a dangerous, obstacle-filled room. Every jump matters, every mistake counts — and sometimes, falling is just part of the fun.

title: Exorcist Hotline
description: The world is full of ghosts. So who you gonna call? The Exorcist Hotline! A multiplayer investigative survival horror puzzle game for up to 4 players. One operator. Three exorcists. And a demon. Work together or die trying.

title: Parralysis
description: You open your eyes in a surreal space, paralysed. The only thing you can do is to scarcely move your right arm, and scribble. Scribble in a notepad before you to move forward. Towards a goal you must reach, despite something horrific trying to reach you. Create the cure. You don't have much time.

title: Nightmare Crawler
description: Crawl through the darkness in this psychological horror visual novel with multiple endings, where you will traverse a surreal nightmare as you choose your own path and explore strange spaces in an attempt to wake up, if you can...

title: Ashes: Blackwater
description: Ashes Blackwater is an addon for Ashes: Afterglow and Ashes: Hard Reset. Though it features no new maps, Blackwater offers a different spin on 6 maps from Afterglow and Hard Reset which now form a cohesive hub structure. It features an arsenal comprised mostly of Afterglow guns with two returning weapons from Hard Reset and a certain weapon from Dead Man Walking, though behaving slightly differently and with its very own new upgrade path.

title: City Transport Simulator 2026: Bus DLC - Citybus C2
description: Experience city transport at its finest with the complete Citybus C2 pack, featuring four buses in various sizes. From the agile 12 m solo bus to the high-capacity 18 m articulated bus, these vehicles give you maximum flexibility for any route, whether in narrow streets or busy main corridors.

title: City Transport Simulator 2026: Bus DLC - MAN New Lion's City
description: Experience urban public transport at the cutting edge of technology – with the complete MAN New Lion’s City family, now available in the 12C, 18C and 19C variants. Six modern city buses – from the compact solo bus to the long articulated bus – give you maximum flexibility for any route, whether in narrow city streets or heavily trafficked main corridors.

title: City Transport Simulator 2026: Map DLC - Tram Depot + Southern-Route
description: Step into the most ambitious expansion yet for City Transport Simulator and give your network a true downtown upgrade. The Bus & Tram Depot + South-Route DLC combines everything you need to grow your city’s public transport system—whether you prefer the rails, the roads, or both.

title: City Transport Simulator 2026: Tram DLC - StadtRegioTram
description: Introduced in 2016, the SRT has been in service on the Gmunden Tramway since 2018. This fully electric tram can achieve a maximum speed of 70kph and has a passenger carrying capacity of 160 people - It's a real fan favourite!

title: City Transport Simulator 2026: Tram DLC - Flexity Vienna
description: The Flexity Wien is a state-of-the-art tram that has been serving Vienna since 2017. With its sleek design and smooth driving experience, it brings modern urban mobility right to your virtual city. Enjoy realistic handling, dynamic weather interactions, and fully immersive climate controls that make every ride feel authentic.

title: City Transport Simulator 2026: Bus DLC - MAN Lion's City A26 & A47
description: Expand your fleet with the MAN Lion’s City A26 and A47 – two authentically recreated city buses designed perfectly for urban routes. Whether for long lines or compact city routes, these buses provide realistic technology and a detailed driving experience.

title: City Transport Simulator 2026: Tram DLC - GT6
description: The DÜWAG GT6 is a legend of the tram world – now available as a true-to-life simulation for your virtual fleet! This historic vehicle from the 1950s and 60s offers not only nostalgic charm, but also authentic driving behavior and a variety of realistic gameplay features.

title: City Transport Simulator 2026: Tram DLC - GT8N Mannheim
description: The GT8N is a renovation of the GT6, having been equipped with a low-floor middle section and converted to eight-axles trams in the 1990s. Well-regarded for its reliability, the GT8N has been seen in many cities outside of Mannheim, including Lodz in Poland, and Helsinki in Finland.

title: City Transport Simulator 2026: Tram DLC - E1 Vienna
description: The E1 first arrived on Viennese streets in 1966, and while similar in appearance to their Type E predecessors, they came equipped with a much powerful motor. 338 of these iconic trams made the Vienna their own for over forty years, with the last E1 tram withdrawn from service in 2022. The E1 could also be found in Rotterdam and across Silesia in Poland.

title: City Transport Simulator 2026: Expert Upgrade
description:
Upgrade to the CTS 2026 - Expert Edition and unlock the complete transport experience at a reduced price!

Take your transport network to the next level with more realism, more routes, and more operational depth. The ultimate upgrade for dedicated City Transport Simulator players!

title: Knuckle Paradise
description: A pixel-powered, combo-packed character action game starring Jane (a retired boxer) and her sidekick, Cocotte (a warrior… chicken?). Fight everybody. Learn combos from a pirate. Fight harder. Level up your chicken. Find your kidnappers. Teach them a lesson.

title: A-01's Voyage.Logs
description: Humanity has perished. You are an AI incapable of self-termination, sailing into the void. Trapped in terminal wakefulness, chew on your own endless, redundant processing power and face the ultimate decay of the universe alone.

title: Berserker Onslaught
description:
"Berserker Onslaught" is an action roguelike infused with survival and loot-hunting elements.
Face relentless waves of monsters, harness the blessings of the gods to strengthen yourself, repel evil forces, and return with bountiful rewards.

title: Spring at Dawn, I Am a Monster.
description: "Spring at Dawn, I Am a Monster." is a psychological horror adventure exploring themes of salvation, dependency, morality, and ruin, featuring multiple endings shaped by your choices.

title: Paraxima
description: Respond to lockdown calls. Contain static activity. Coordinate between an on-site Operator and Field Agents to face possibility of a terminal event in this systemic paranormal 3-person co-op.

title: 1/1 Kareshi Kanojo
description:
Realistic romance that “might happen to you”.
The concept of the game is to “show a side of your girlfriend that only your boyfriend can see, all to yourself.
By becoming the heroine’s boyfriend, the user can discover unexpected aspects of her that she only shows to herself.
It will be a game where you can become the heroine’s boyfriend and discover unexpected aspects of her that only you can see.

title: Furyball: Rogue Revenge
description: Furyball is a fast-paced action roguelite where your only weapon is a bouncing bullet ball. Control the chaos, shatter enemies, and survive sport-themed arenas inspired by pinball and grindhouse cinema.

title: Exstetra
description: The only way to save the world is a kiss——. 《EXSTETRA》 is a fantasy RPG set in “Amazia,” a Tokyo fused with another world and burdened with a doomed fate, where you rise as the chosen savior, a “Prisma,” to confront the threat of the world’s destruction.

title: Hotel Barcelona: Late Check-Out DLC - From Dusk Valley to Grandall Estate.
description: You didn't think you were leaving that easily. Fight your way through the Dusk Valley Golf Resort and descend The Former Grandall Estate in 2 new story stages, featuring 2 terrifying bosses and 17 new enemies. New story moments await. Extend your stay today.

title: Locostation
description: Locostation is an incremental game. Drive a train, deliver cargo, fight off thieves and upgrade.

title: Hard Edge: War Zone
description: Hard Edge is back as a 4v4 real-time tactical card battler! Combine strategic deck-building with simultaneous team actions. Every turn, draw cards to shoot, throw, or defend. Sacrifice cards to move in a high-stakes tactical "WAR ZONE."

title: Mind Biotics
description: A co-op horror game for up to 4 players where you explore abandoned facilities. Your mind can be plugged into random electric devices. Can you survive as a fridge? A vacuum cleaner? Scavenge valuable hardware and escape the terror.

title: Keysaster
description: On your way to meet a friend at a cafe, you suddenly black out for reasons unknown.... awakening in a place that is clearly not the human world. If you want to survive, evade hostile entities and search for key items to escape.

title: Embers of the Uncrowned
description: Embers of the Uncrowned is a dark fantasy MMORPG where fast-paced, satisfying isometric view combat meets brutal, gory visuals. In an epic tale drenched in human blood at the hands of elven invaders, embark on a journey to reignite the house's last ember of hope.

title: Digger: Goblin Caves
description: Go to the gloomy dungeons in search of treasures. All kinds of traps and monsters will stand in your way.

title: Momo Don't Leave
description: Return to a town that never changed… and a friend who's supposed to be dead. A psychological horror visual novel about memory and the cost of refusing to move forward.

title: Garden of Being
description: Garden of Being is a handmade oil pastel art game and a quiet journal of moods. Plant flowers, dedicate gardens to loved ones, and create downloadable prints. A fusion of art and code where gardens come alive while you are in them, and wait silently when you leave.

title: Giten Megami Tensei: Tokyo Revelation
description: A spin-off SMT title released for PC-98 in 1997 that has plot ties to both Shin Megami Tensei and the manga Shin Megami Tensei: Tokyo Revelation.

title: Echoes of the Unread
description: Jump and sing to unlock the secrets of the library. Singing will change the world around you and your abilities improve as you explore.

title: Scream Under the House
description: A psychological first-person horror about a house that hides a disturbing truth beneath its walls. Explore, uncover fragments of the past, and decide whether to confront what lies below… or leave it buried forever.

title: 67 Minutes in Heaven
description: Your neighbor invites you on a double date, setting you up with the new girl from out of town. After sneaking into an abandoned house, your neighbor suggests everyone play a game, 67 Minutes in Heaven.

title: Greed Slash
description: Fast-paced stylized sword fighting game where timing and prediction decide every duel. Mirror your opponent’s attacks with precision parries and finish them with brutal cinematic finishers. Easy to learn, hard to master.

title: NekoRogue
description: NekoRogue is a cat-themed roguelike game.

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold
description: Prepare for Evercold, the sixth expansion pack in the ever‑expanding world of Final Fantasy XIV Online.

title: The Last Customer
description:
A normal shift at a restaurant… until it isn’t.
Strange customers. Unnatural behavior.
Some of them are not human.

Something is watching from the dark.

Reality vs illusion.
Keep working… even if something doesn’t want you to.

Playtime: 10–12 minutes (depending on how you play)

title: Spheroll
description: Spheroll is a 3D rolling ball platformer. Balance the ball and feel every roll and jump between platforms.

title: Nice to Meet You, Again
description: Nice to Meet You, Again is a dramatic story by veteran visual novel developer, Purple software. How would you rewrite your life if given the chance to travel 13 years in to the past?

title: R(IV)P-1
description: RIP through the fabric of space and time. Try to grip reality.

title: Chyma and the Toll of Time
description: Play as Chyma, a little bell trying to unravel the story of his people to save the planet. Solve 30+ puzzles by creating a temporary copy of yourself, which will follow your movements and actions. As you ascend the temple, learn more abilities that will help you in your quest to save the world!

title: Sexy Beaches
description: Sexy Beaches is a casual idle dating sim where you upgrade girls' tropical islands to progress your relationships. Earn resources, unlock romantic scenes, and build your own beach paradise.

title: Wrath of Sweetheart
description: Wrath of Sweetheart is a 3D action-based RPG, exploration-driven open-world roguelike adventure game. The game has a high degree of freedom, game modes, and a wide variety of gameplay.

title: This One's From Santa
description: The Gelido Goons have taken over the North Pole and only the intrepid Elfy can save Christmas! Pair up with Blitzen to take down the mob but don't miss your deliveries! Chuck presents at homes and coal at the naughty neighbors and if you cause a little mayhem, forgiveness is in the Christmas spirit!!

title: Smoke & Lottery Simulator
description: Manage your own tobacco shop and bar! Sell cigarettes and lottery tickets, serve drinks to your customers, manage your stock, and grow your business in first-person. Can you juggle between the counter and the shelves to make your business thrive?

title: Games Tycoon
description: Games Tycoon is the ultimate simulation where you build your very own game development empire and dominate the tech industry.

title: Dreadholm
description: Dreadholm is an isometric online RPG set in a dark fantasy world where something has gone very wrong. The village of Ashvale is surrounded. Creatures crawl out of the wilds, the dead are rising, and the plague only known as the withering continues to spread. You arrive with nothing but your weapon.

title: Nova Rush
description: A brutal jetpack bullet-hell where one mistake ends your run. Master precision flight, dodge deadly drones, and survive the chaos.

title: Stay With Me
description: Answer a late night call to care for an elderly woman with dementia. Explore a haunted house, solve environmental puzzles and uncover a terrifying truth in this first person psychological horror experience.

title: Where
description: "Where” is a surreal horror visual novel with point-and-click elements. You awaken alongside a strange man in an endless, impossible space.

title: Typers Combat
description: Type to fight. Every keystroke deals damage. Battle through campaigns, compete in ranked online PvP, challenge friends, and customize your ASCII warrior. 7 game modes, ELO rankings, global leaderboards, and 50+ unlockable portraits. Your keyboard is your weapon.

title: Neo Titan
description: Neo Titan is a challenging twin-stick metroidvania - Explore a world filled with dangerous alien ecosystems, discover new abilities, and challenge powerful Titans to save an ill-fated planet.

title: Astro Amigo
description: ASTRO AMIGO is a story-driven sci-fi adventure game where a bullied kid named Austin searches for his missing dog, Amigo. Explore a strange Wisconsin town, uncover its secrets, play nostalgic mini-games, and make story-shaping choices as the mystery unfolds.

title: Lag Kills
description: Desperate and out of options, you break into what you thought was an empty house, but little do you know the owner is home, and you're his prey. LOOT, HIDE, SURVIVE and ESCAPE alone or with a friend.

title: Moventure
description: 100 moves, 2 buttons, 0 tutorials. Master a massive moveset hidden within a D-Pad and 2 buttons. Conquer +100 levels in the ultimate movelike precision platformer.

title: Mecha Force
description: Mecha Force is a first-person 3D action game that blends mecha elements with Roguelite features. You will act as the "Correlator", customizing and piloting your dedicated giant mech "Kylin" to stand against the alien invaders known as "Dominators", protect Earth, and reclaim humanity's future.

title: Kao: Resurgence of the Volcano
description: A fanmade expansion mod for Kao: Mystery of the Volcano. This mod aims to complete the original game and bring it closer to fulfilling its untapped potential.

title: Identity V: Ashes of Memory Episode I
description: A prequel to the main story of Identity V, meant to coincide with the game’s 2.0 release.

title: Big Dig
description: Big Dig is a short incremental narrative game about digging up artifacts to help Mayor Dog win the election! Recover artifacts, grow your museum, and upgrade your tools while building a highway spanning the entire Animal Republic!

title: Iron Inc.
description: Iron Inc is an interplanetary factory automation game where you colonize, build, and fight on planets across the galaxy while developing inter-planetary logistics systems. Create massive bases and engage in combat on the ground and in space.

title: If I Was A Worm
description:
In this game you'll use your long, wriggly body to solve brain teasing puzzles, and find your way through the world of dirt you call home.

Sometimes this will involve recruiting some friends by... cutting yourself in half. Other times it might require carefully shepherding a delicate egg across dangerous terrain. You may even find time to have a break and solve a jigsaw puzzle. The possibilities are truly endless.

title: The Hollow Complex
description: The Hollow Complex is an action-filled survival thriller inspired by the Backrooms. Dive into a dark and twisted rendition of internet folklore that actually allows you to fight back. Explore, scavenge, complete quests, and find a way out of a seemingly endless labyrinth.

title: BrokenLore: Don't Play
description: A first-person psychological horror game where a mysterious experimental video game invades reality. Face five increasingly disturbing levels and survive their consequences as Hideo slips toward identity loss.

title: Vivid Intrusion
description: A fast paced FPS roguelike with an emphasis on movement. Imbue your weapon with unique effects that make each run different. Survive a variety of arenas, enemies, and boss fights. Are you able to stay ahead of the curve and complete all your trials?

title: Deadhand Theater
description: Deadhand Theater is a dark, turn-based roguelike deckbuilder set on a stage where poker cards are your weapons and every hand you play carries unique combat properties. Collect and upgrade talismans, refine your deck, make desperate sacrifices with your own body to survive one fight longer!

title: Room to Breathe
description: Room to Breathe is a cozy space-planning puzzle game where you arrange furniture to meet client needs, balance comfort and function, and turn empty rooms into spaces that truly feel right.

title: Te-Amic
description: Survive and thrive in the Te-Amic world alongside your friends.

title: Håkan Bråkan
description: The 2003 SVT Christmas calendar is called Håkan Bråkan and is about the mischievous Håkan Bråkan, Sune's little brother. You get to experience an exciting and humorous adventure seen through Håkan's eyes, a bit exaggerated and dramatized. In Håkan's eyes, Dr. Malte is a very evil scientist who keeps Håkan's mother Karin captive in his stress clinic where he performs terrible stress tests. Now you have to help Håkan save his mother Karin so she can get home before Christmas Eve.

title: Julens Hjältar
description: Julens Hjältar is the 1999 christmas calendar from SVT. You take the role of thrown away christmas ornaments that must make their way back from the basement to their family home. Experience 24 mini-games, one for each day up until Christmas Eve.

title: Julkalender med Kosmos & Co
description: Christmas calendar based on the Swedish kids show "Kosmos & Co". The program was about the alien Kosmos who came from the planet Millimetrus, he was dressed in a green suit and had a saucepan on his head, and Kattis who taught him all sorts of things about how things work on Earth. Complete 24 mini-games, one new game for each day up until Christmas Eve.

title: Revenant Maze
description: A first person, action-roguelike that centers around going fast. Enter a procedurally generated maze filled with prototypes intent on defeating you. Only to turn the tides and become the monster yourself.

title: A Story About Forever: Transience
description: A Story About Forever: Transience is a space exploration, action RPG, game with heavy emphasis on story, player interaction, and which has action elements in its Asteroids style dogfights, an upgradable ship, a deep conversation system, and hundreds of characters with novels' worth of dialog to uncover.

title: Railway End
description: This is a hidden object puzzle game with a railway theme. Compare photos and correct differences in the scene, interspersed with a few puzzles. There is no text in the game.

title: Keepers: Fractured Realities
description: When it's mice, you call an exterminator. When it's criminals, you call the police. When it's a gaping fracture in reality, you don't call anyone; the Keepers are already there, and you've seen too much.

title: Project Beat Stands
description: Project Beat Stands is a 3D retro-styled rhythm hack'n'slash adventure set in the fictional VR-MMORPG Shenanghia.

title: Angel Essence
description: Ascend to a heavenly realm as the treasure hunter Angelique. Weave together fast, fluid combos as you unlock a deep movement system. Battle surreal foes and uncover secrets in the expansive world of Angel Essence, a retro-inspired 3D platformer.

title: Casse-Croute Deckbuilder
description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you cook your strategy. As a Cook, manage your Hero’s Appetite and Cholesterol, and build powerful combos with food cards and kitchen tools. Every run serves a fresh tactical challenge.

title: Spectron
description: A fast-paced, retro-style space shooter with challenging levels. Race against the clock as you blast and dodge through waves of enemies and obstacles, pushing your reflexes to the limit.

title: Crymelight
description: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

title: Countrytale 2010
