description: Countrytale 2010 is a farming simulation game where players build an agricultural empire from scratch. Buy land, invest in seeds and fertilizers, grow crops across seasons, then harvest and sell produce to earn profits and expand the farm.

title: Asuka Idol Journey
description: This is the RPG of 'Asuka Kagami' and her journey to becoming a top idol. The game begins with the entrance ceremony at an idol academy. Will she be able to achieve her dreams of becoming a top idol through hard work, friendship, and the glory of victory.

title: Pih 2
description: The infamous Pih sequel is here! There's some new angry hawgs coming for you. Ever heard of aPihgator? 🦈Shark-Hawg?🦝 Hogoon? What about a ‍⬛Birdhawg? We also have boats and hot air balloons to help us fight against these ferocious pihs. Are you ready to show them who's the real hawg?

title: Protocol: Requiem
description: Fight through the Hyperstructure in this Turn-based Tactical Roguelike. Using the Energy Deck and complex Characters, you must optimize every turn to have a chance at rescuing the last human DNA sample. Build your party of Replicas, customize them, and use your strategic mind to finish the mission.

title: Panema
description: Build. Roll. Bend Luck. A dice-builder roguelike of blessings, curses, and Yahtzee.

title: Drunken Goddess Reflux
description: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.

title: Lunar Pulse
description: That night, thirteen witches devour each other. "Lunar Pulse" is a single-player roguelite card game. Under eternal moonlight, a ritual for life and death unfolds. Play simultaneously with hands revealed. One move invites instant death—soulslike tension in every card battle.

title: Hyke: Northern Light(s) - A Witch’s Chill Time
description: “A Witch’s Chill Time” takes places after the resolution of the main campaign with the days of fierce battle finally behind them. A period of tranquility settled in—until one day, guided by an invitation from Aurora, Hyke and the group stepped into a mysterious realm. What greeted their eyes there was—none other than a “hot spring.” However, it turned out that during the process of creating this space, Aurora had misplaced the very items needed to fully enjoy the hot spring experience. To recover these lost items, Haiku and the others set out to explore the depths of the mysterious realm. And so, a new adventure begins—one dedicated to bringing Hyke and the group’s “ideal hot spring” to perfection!

title: Kittycat Couture
description: Kittycat Couture is a fantasy dressup game about making outfits for cats. Style island residents, discover new designers, and fill your closet in this cozy game about appreciating fashion!

title: Stellar Wreck
description:
Stellar Wreck is a game where you control a child who must survive in space aboard a partially broken spaceship.

(more content is still in development) You must complete quests and uncover your character's past, but you can also take it slow and build up your ship with beautiful decorations.

To gather decorations, you'll need to arm yourself with weapons and tools to fight strange alien monsters and... actual animals...?

There's a whole range of skills and abilities available!

title: Veritas Tales: Witch of the Dark Castle
description: Once you open this book, you are no longer just a reader. A "reading-style" fantasy adventure in the spirit of The NeverEnding Story — handcrafted over six years by a 30-year veteran from Vanillaware. 100% handmade, from the first page to the last.

title: Hoshiomio
description: Watch the starry sky and ward off looming threats in this fast-paced base defense game. Genre-defying destruction.

title: Arena of Sacrifice
description: A 2D side-scrolling action game where you battle through challenging stages filled with enemies. Master precise combat, avoid damage, and push forward through each trial to reach and defeat the Evil Eye.

title: Beatlow
description: A fast-paced rhythm game where every mistake costs a life. Hit the right keys in time with the music, survive escalating mutators, upgrade your skills, and push your run as far as possible.

title: Zomdied
description: A hardcore top-down zombie survival RPG. Scavenge for supplies, craft essential gear, and fight to survive against an ever-evolving horde that grows stronger and more dangerous the longer you last.

title: Dice Have No Eyes
description: Surreal dice-rolling roguelike about luck and greed. Feed your dice dumplings, collect game bending trinkets, roll too much and lose it all. Or get lucky, unlock King Fetus, meet God and you might just wake up.

title: Star of Games
description: Ever dreamed of creating a genre-defining masterpiece? Star of Games is a next-gen simulation management game centered on game dev. You'll act as an aspiring developer, starting from a humble garage startup and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating classics to forging your own legends.

title: In Us
description: The devil wears a human face. Unmask and exorcise it—with friends. A 4-player co-op horror game where you hunt demons lurking in a village. Observe behavior, detect environmental shifts, and use items to expose the truth. But beware: should you misjudge, the consequences will be severe.

title: Orblins
description: Orblins is a Marble-Matching Roguelike inspired by classic marble shooters like Zuma and Luxor. Create game-breaking builds with endless marbles and upgrades to defeat a host of Orblins and bosses. Choose from a large cast of characters or create your own custom class to personalize your run.

title: Monster Rush Survivors
description: Survive endless hordes in Monster Rush Survivors, a fast-paced roguelite survivor with insane builds! Combine items, upgrade abilities, unlock characters, and destroy thousands of enemies in this intense bullet heaven packed with synergies.

title: Crownseeker
description: Hunt relics by day and night across a fog-shrouded world. Manage hunger. Gear up. Outlast or defeat what's hunting you. Collect all the relics — and the Crown appears. If you survive long enough to claim it.

title: Iconoclast
description:
The Iconoclast is a powerful evil entity that no hunter has been able to kill.
It compromises buildings in the form of natural disasters, then feeds on the victims and creates a "nest" in the place for 88 days.

title: Double or Nothing
description: Build your spinning board, push your luck, and break the House in this high-risk strategy rogue-lite. Add and upgrade segments, manage bets and relics, survive brutal boss rounds, and decide when to cash out or go Double or Nothing.

title: Dreams and Desires
description:
You're the new intern. Nobody knows you yet. That's an advantage.

Nova Prime VR is the kind of place where careers are made fast — and trust is lost faster. Your boss notices everything. Your best friend needs more than you've been giving. The bartender next door sees through people. The woman at the gym doesn't slow down for anyone. You have one shot to figure out who matters — and what you're willing to do about it.

title: Chess Club Manager
description: Tycoon game to build and manage your own chess club from the ground up. Recruit amateurs, train them into champions, expand your facility, and rise to global fame.

title: Finding Polka
description: Set off on a playful search to track down the wandering pup Polka in this game of exploration and serendipity. Meet charming characters, lend them a hand to make new friends, and explore a cozy world sketched in ballpoint pen. You don't need words on this adventure, just smiles and high-fives!

title: YGOMaster-TCG
description: YGOMaster-TCG is a Yu-Gi-Oh! Master Duel mod which allows players to go through a single-player, progressive campaign experience themed around the release of the real-life Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG. From Legend of Blue-Eyes White Dragon to Eternity Code, players will open packs from the DM to VRAINS eras and participate in over 450 Duels.

title: Story of My Life
description: You are a ship driver or something, I don't care. Your parents, and their parent’s parents, were once prisoners. You carry their debt. You must pay back exactly $10,000 by 20:00 (9 PM) or DIE.

title: Off-Road Pumpkin Carriage
description: Control the pumpkin carriage and make your way to the ball. But each wheel must be operated independently! Up to four players can play simultaneously!

title: Trivals
description: A multiplayer sport where the goal adapts to stop you. No aim assist. No randomness. Just ball physics, hero abilities, and a target that gets harder to break the closer you get to winning.

title: Suicide Mr. Fury
description: Suicide Mr. Fury is a Meta-Otome adventure that deconstructs the absurdity of falling for someone who doesn’t exist. Navigate branching paths, meta-narratives, and a multiverse of madness with the overbearing CEO, Mr. Fury, between digital delusion and harsh reality.

title: Get to Work, Gnomes! Christmas Factory
description: Run a chaotic Christmas gift factory with mischievous gnomes! Get to Work, Gnomes! Christmas Factory is a short management game where you prepare gifts for children before Christmas. Package gifts, build production lines, manage gnomes, and assign tasks to turn a workshop into an efficient factory.

title: The Guidelines: Hotel Napoli
description: "High pay. Simple tasks. Room and board included." Monitor "anomalies" through hidden CCTV cameras scattered throughout the hotel rooms. You must accurately judge and report whether a situation requires a mere cleaner, the intervention of law enforcement, or... something far beyond.

title: PipeFlow
description: In the distant but surprisingly "leaky" city of Kranovsk, where every house is a maze of old pipes, unpredictable turns and sudden floods, an era of change is coming. A novice plumber decided to learn pipes and become the greatest plumber.

title: Syntax: Overload
description: Compile. Execute. Overload. A strategic roguelite where Syntax is Everything. Drag & drop modules to optimize your execution queue, install .EXE software to break the rules, and face off against legendary viruses like ILOVEYOU and WannaCry. Can you crash the system and escape?

title: Purchase Express
description: Purchase Express is a moving simulator where you must completely empty this house. If you see it, you can take it. Discover the hidden corners and objects in this crowded mansion, where even the smallest detail will help you complete this adventure.

title: 1000 Animals on an Island
description: A relaxing exploration game for all nature and discovery lovers. Explore, observe, and enjoy — every corner of the island hides a new surprise!

title: Pollo Diavolo
description:
Pollo Diavolo is a fast-paced ARPG roguelike where the Lord of Terror got reborn… in a bloody chicken.

Yeah its kinda stupid. But it hits hard.

You go into dungeons, kill a lot of enemies, get stronger and try to break your build as much as posible. Thats the idea.

title: Butt Brawl: Survival
description: A cheek-clapping, poop-dodging survivors game. For fans of bullet heaven and survivors-likes. Immature humor, retro pixel art and difficulty that ramps through stage progressions. Butt Brawl: the game you play while you sh*t.

title: Squarsenal
description: Squarsenal is a short strategy game with a unique battle system. Defeat enemies and buy upgrades to expand and improve your arsenal of weapons

title: Three The Hard Way
description: Recognized by many as a classic of the RPG Maker genre since its release in 2003, it has 50+ hours worth of content, complex plot and a growth system similar to the SaGa series. A non-direct sequel, called The Queen's Court, was announced in 2007, though it seems to be on hiatus ever since.

title: Fall Again
description: A brutally difficult physics-based platformer designed to test your patience, precision, and sanity.

title: Soldexus
description:
Explore a castle with heavy opposition. Can you survive the difficult road ahead?
An indie metroidvania created using GameMaker released in 2006.

title: Danganronpa: Restrained Nature
description: Danganronpa:Restrained Nature was a fangan that was canceled after Chapter 2 Daily Life.

title: Flowers to Honey
description: A cozy incremental where you choose how your bees evolve, plant flowers, guide your hive, and grow a thriving honey empire.

title: Orbit to Riches
description: Orbit to Riches is a short, relaxing incremental space game where you mine asteroids, upgrade ships, and grow stronger over multiple runs - no timers, no rush.

title: Ultimatum: The Slaughter of Amaranth
description: Hecate and 14 of her fellow classmates awake after being put to sleep inside at Amaranth Academy for Exceptional Minds, an all girls college. Without any memories of ever arriving at the school, most aren't sure about how they got here or what's going on. However, even if she can't remember, Hecate can't ever erase her past, no matter how bad she or anybody else wants to.

title: Danganronpa: Dungeons & Despair
description: Danganronpa Fangame which takes place in the Dungeons&Dragons Universe. This isn’t your average DND Campaign

title: Who Wants to Be an Ultimate? Retake
description: "Who Wants to Be an Ultimate? -retake-" is a free to play one-shot Danganronpa fangame created in RPG Maker MV.

title: Danganronpa: Burnt Bridges
description: 8 university students have been trapped inside Hope’s Peak Academy, with the only way of escape being to commit murder and get away with it in a class trial. Following the aftermath of the first murder and trial, you play as Bernie Stokes, who devises his own murder plan.

title: Lysa Hora: The Haunted Hill
description: A sci-fi horror where ancient rituals intertwine with Soviet experiments. With a strong emphasis on atmosphere, discover a forbidden place inspired by a real location through fortification tunnels, hidden laboratories, and ancient shrines.

title: Menhera Maiden
description: A ‘Landmine × Yuri' Visual Novel. To complete your master's thesis, you are forced to interact with these landmine girls—a decision that may well prove to be the most disastrous of your life. Your dialogue and choices will not only shape your relationships with the heroines, but also your thesis.

title: Debris 32
description: If you love classic arcade games such as Asteroids, you'll love Debris. Clear each wave of space debris by blasting it to bits with your ship's weapons. At the same time avoid colliding with asteroids while collecting bonuses and destroying enemy ships. Your mission is a thankless one, and if a pilot can't handle it, well, he dies alone. Do you have the right stuff?

title: Bomberic
description:
Bomberic is a top-down game inspired by Bomberman. The player is in a labyrinth, and must find and open the exit to enter the next level. Opening the exit requires collecting a requisite number of keys, which are hidden within destructible blocks that can be blown up by bombs or mines. The blocks can also contain a variety of other items, including health pickups and power-ups. The player's supply of bombs is infinite, but the number of mines is limited.

The labyrinth is haunted by monsters which can only be destroyed by damaging them with explosives. Close contact with monsters or getting caught in an explosion lowers the player's health meter.

title: Farming Incremental But With Guns
description: Plant crops and shoot them down with your trusty gun. Earn money, purchase upgrades, and cultivate your farm. Watch your crops physically evolve to gigantic proportions. GROW them. Never stop growing them until their shadows block out the sun forever.

title: Anymaker
description: Embark on your creative journey of vehicle design, as you create and operate vehicles to navigate this dangerous open world. Anymaker is a detailed and technical vehicle building game. Design your chassis, build your engine, connect components and cables, program controllers, and test performance.

title: Entiled
description: Entiled is a spatial tile-clearing puzzle game where every move matters. Remove tiles without collisions, match the active color to build your multiplier, and trigger chain reactions to maximize your score in quick, replayable runs.

title: Love Curse: Find Your Soulmate - Free Epilogue
description:
This free update adds:
- Epilogue contents totalling 70,000 words and 28 new CGs
- More content to Eleanor's base route
- Japanese and Korean translations

title: Find Kittens 11: Dollhouse
description: Explore the wonderful world of dolls, discover cute cats, and color the black-and-white scenes with bright colors.

title: A Place Where Summer Rain Falls
description:
️ “Everyone hides something.”
But when the silence ties to survival, the truth begins to shake.

'A Place Where Summer Rain Falls' is a story-driven visual novel set in a rainy school, where hidden memories and quiet emotions unfold.

The truth isn't always loud — sometimes, it's silent.

title: Love Curse: Find Your Soulmate - Epilogue Update
description: This update adds a new epilogue totalling 70,000 words and 28 new CGs (~30% more content to the base game), new content to Eleanor's base route, and Japanese + Korean translations.

title: Red Door Yellow Door
description:
Red Door Yellow Door is a procedurally generated horror game in which you explore an ever-changing labyrinth, complete tasks, and evade relentless creatures to escape. Each round offers new paths, new dangers, and no second chances.

Immerse yourself in an ever-changing labyrinth that consists not only of rooms—but of your own subconscious.

In Red Door, Yellow Door, you explore endless corridors, open doors to the unknown, and face a world that reshapes itself with every playthrough. No path remains the same. No decision is certain.

title: Human Shaped
description: You work the counter as an unknown presence begins to mimic the local population. Your job is simple, keep the store running. But as the night progresses, the people walking through the doors start to feel... off.

title: Hachishakusama
description: 『She Is Always Right Beside You』 The fate of one summer — a boy beloved by the eight-feet-tall Hachishakusama, the urban legend. A heartwarming yet terrifying Japanese horror game.

title: Gong Go Girl
description: A gentle visual novel that has fun with beautiful girls and no one needs to get hurt.

title: $$$://Somnialys, I Am Tired So I Bought a Couple Dreams
description: Explore the dreams purchased by someone who is bored with their life.

title: Guardian Cry
description: Guardian Cry is an open world action adventure game in the style of the 16-bit era. When invaders from the Venox Empire upset the peace in the land of Ilethia and unleash a corrupting force that drives the once-peaceful creatures into a frenzy, you take it upon yourself to enter the corrupted temples of the four Guardian deities and free them from their affliction. With their help, you may drive out the invading empire and restore peace to the land of Ilethia.

title: MeowRig
description: MeowRig is a mining-themed incremental game. Follow Me(ow) and search for Meow God's great treasure.

title: Gunfire Reborn: Echoes From Primal Grove
description:
Two new heroes [Yoyo] and [Cang Jue] are ready to join the adventure with you.

Before the journey begins, Yoyo's spirit antlers rouse the essence of ancient woods; Cang Jue's battle cry etches primal roars. From the heart of the grove forge four legendary weapons: [Drift Shard], [Armillary Sash], [Viper Sight], [Jackpot].

title: Monster Girl Therapy
description: Save the monster girls! Talk through their issues and face their challenges. Convince them to leave their crumbling fantasy game before it all falls apart! You may yet come to understand them—or even yourself!—in this wholesome mix of playful conversation and minigames.

title: Lunadun: Lunatic Dungeon
description: You choose a favorite and walk beside them. But those you left behind — where do they go while you're gone? Lunadun: Lunatic Dungeon is an emotional VN where choices shape the fate of four characters. 'The ones you loved, the ones you ignored — you don't get to walk away from either of them.'

title: Fellwood
description: Build a wild fantasy lumber empire that bombards a forest across the valley with axes, ballistas, cannons, and magic. Harvest flying logs, stack absurd upgrades, and automate your way to unstoppable woodcutting power.

title: Basil Returns!
description: Basil's off on her adventures again, scattering dandelions and finding butterfly friends.

title: Island God Simulator
description: Gather, build, and grow your civilization. Defend against enemy invasions. Every choice matters. Endless replayability with dynamic islands, islanders, and threats.

title: Epitaph: The Parchment Anthology
description: Text-based horror with meaningful choices: wake up in a coffin, explore the darkness and survive rituals, puzzles and hidden entities.

title: Canvas of Thoughts
description: Canvas of Thoughts is an cozy point-and-click puzzle adventure which invites you into Evi's vibrant but loud inner world. Experience everyday situations through shifting colours, sounds and emotions. Solve reflective puzzles and navigate the world not through words, but through feelings.

title: Onsento
description:
Onsento is a party based roguelike deckbuilder.

Battles
- Party based: Organize your units and use their abilities to attack your enemies.
- Card Battle: Create powerful combos to help your party win the battle.

Quests
- Fight battles and progress in different ways.
- Recruit units and refine your deck along the way to complete the mission.

title: Oh Ship!
description: Oh Ship! is a 1–4 player co-op space survival game where you and your crew coordinate to keep your ship running while space actively tries to destroy it. Salvage wrecks, fix systems, upgrade your ship, and survive the chaos.

title: Pokémon Solar Eclipse
description:
Welcome to the Solaria region, a breathtakingly diverse land where ancient history and vibrant wilderness intertwine across grassy plains, mystical forests, and magical swamps. As a top graduate of Gardenia Academy, you've been honored as a Gym Challenger, embarking on a journey to earn eight badges and claim the title of Solar Monarch alongside your childhood friend Giltbert and rival Diana.

Built with a deep love for the main series—especially the beloved DS era—this adventure pairs that classic spirit with extensive modern customization. Tackle a handpicked regional Pokédex of 427 Pokémon featuring thoughtful rebalances, eliminate trade evolution hassles, and enjoy seamless field moves without HM slavery, all while tailoring your difficulty and tracking stats with modern conveniences like the DexNav and Advancepedia.

title: Hover Tank 3D
description: Hover Tank 3D is a highly customizable 3D action game. Set on the world of Polychron, you use a Hover Tank battle through 5 unique modes, including a story-based Mission mode, Power War, Capture the Flag, Deathmatch, and online Multiplayer Deathmatch.

title: Courier Beware
description: Deliver to haunted places, solve paranormal mysteries, and struggle through the daily grind in this horror life sim adventure.

title: Qianli: The Vastscape Scroll
description: Shape the world to your will in lush landscapes inspired by Chinese watercolors in this Zen hex-tile building game that blends puzzle and roguelite elements with beautiful Asian aesthetics. Befriend mystical creatures in your journey while you make the world come alive beneath your fingertips.

title: Scoundrel's Dungeon
description: Scoundrel's Dungeon is a brutal roguelike card game built on the classic Scoundrel. Each dungeon floor is a deadly hand of cards. Fight monsters with dangerous modifiers, collect powerful items and upgrade your cards to survive. Every floor hits harder. Every decision matters. How deep can you go?

title: Dinah's Dreamwoods
description:
Explore the twists and turns of the Dreamwoods in a puzzle adventure!

After a tiring quest, Dinah the dog falls asleep... and she finds herself whisked away to the Dreamwoods, a forest inside her dreams. But she can't stay too long -- otherwise, who would watch over her clumsy owner, Alice?! She's got to wake up soon!

In order to escape, she must help four friends -- the Scarecrow, the Cat, the Bunny, and the Queen -- solve their problems. With their help, can Dinah find the keys to continue and assemble the four crests to finally leave the forest?!

But all the while, her light is growing dim, and the Ghost threatens to drag her into a nightmare...

title: Print Gallery of an Artist
description: A brief exploration of recursive spaces.

title: Birthday Boy
description: Birthday Boy: A First-Person Psychological Horror Experience

title: Claim the Forest: Settling Peace
description: Capybaras in Harmony in the Forest

title: Keys to Wonderland
description:
Alice is lost in Wonderland! It's up to Alice's loyal pup, Dinah, to find the keys to her cage and rescue her from the Cheshire Cat!

Play as Dinah and explore the dark and dangerous maze that is Wonderland!

The forest is full of chests, keys, and gates... Dinah must use the powers of Big and Small potions to leap over boulders or squeeze into mole holes while she finds her way to her mistress.

But be careful. If Dinah's light goes out, or if the Cheshire Cat catches her, she'll get lost in the dark forest, and lose all hope of rescuing Alice...

A short lock-and-key puzzle game by Madvox Games!

title: Dragon Snack: From Ice to Ember
description: Get ready for an adorably epic adventure in Dragon Snack: From Ice to Ember. Here, a hungry and lovable dragon needs your help to find the safe path back to its nest. It sounds simple, but every trail matters.

title: Stellar Fixer
description: Step into the grease-stained boots of a debt-ridden Patcher in a gritty industrial space station. Diagnose critical failures, strip panels with your automatic vortex drill, and replace complex components to bring massive ships back to life. Restore power, clear the smoke, and pay off your debt.

title: To Farm Lands: Sowing Fields
description: Plant, Fit and Relax on the Farm

title: Kerogen
description: Dredge up corpses from an oil-drenched nightmare. Lost at sea, the small crew of the Atlas calls for aid. Elmsfire dances in the clouds above while black beasts stir in the waves beneath. Take your meds. Hold your breath. The black sea won't let go.

title: Souls Inferno
description: A minimalist soulslike with turn-based combat. Enter a cursed realm, defeat demonic knights, collect souls, and shape your build as you uncover a deeply interconnected world.

title: Reflect Laser
description: Reflect, Direct, and Connect. ReflectLaser is a minimalist logic puzzle game where you strategically place and rotate mirrors to guide a laser beam to its target.

title: Reflections in Amber
description: Reflections in Amber is a mystical detective visual novel. Investigate a mysterious death in a remote village alongside Detective Redbreast, who battles the weight of depression. Use an old supernatural camera to uncover hidden paths. Shape the course of the story with your choices!

title: The Amazing Digital Dating Sim
description:
The Amazing Digital Dating Simulator is a visual novel style fan-game for Glitch's popular hit show "The Amazing Digital Circus".

Taking place in the anime adventure world, spend 5 days helping the cast prepare for the upcoming culture festival. There are 5 romance-able characters: Pomni, Ragatha, Gangle, Zooble, and Jax!

And Caine and Kinger fans, don't you fret! Caine and Kinger routes are currently being written to add to the game at a later date.

title: Metrocraft
description: Metrocraft is a post-apocalyptic online project based on the Metro trilogy of games and developed on the Minecraft engine. Destroy mutants, protect stations from bandit raids, and explore the dangerous surface. Immerse yourself in the world of post-apocalyptic reality now!

title: Metrocraft 2036
description: Atmospheric MMOFPS project based on the METRO 2036

title: FGM Stalzone
description: The entire area is filled with strange, anomalous energy, mutated creatures, and mysticism. The zone is guarded by the military, who are ready to shoot anyone who dares to enter. But what lies within the zone? Some see it as a cancerous tumor on the planet, while others see it as a panacea. Regardless of their opinions, everyone will find something unique within the zone.

title: Scrapbooking Story
description: A 2D puzzle game about cozy scrapbooking as you follow a little girl's life. Solve puzzles to create the correct spreads and make choices that will influence Belle along her journey of growing up and reconnecting with her mother.

title: Literalchemy
description: With a brand spanking new degree in Literalchemy, use your witchy powers to change stories, craft tales, run a bookshop, and even find love in this puzzle, visual novel, shopkeeping sim!

title: Who's My Secret Santa?
description: A shy Secret Santa who I have to take care of, and a secret Secret Santa who surprises me with gifts! In the conflicting Secret Santa games, who will win the rookie's heart?

title: LabyrinTheam
description: Welcome to the Labyrintheam Tavern! Where we serve riddles that will test your wit and ingenuity. In this game, you will team up to escape from rooms filled with mysteries. Use your brains to open the door that will help you escape. Good luck to you!

title: Melancholic Night
description: A visual novel about returning home. That is, trying to get home. After all, your home is no longer there. You could say that it is actually about drinking in a bar and talking to strange people.

title: Sokocat: Castaway
description: Sokocat: Castaway is a 3D Sokoban-style puzzle game with an isometric view, where you control a shipwrecked kitty exploring a mysterious island full of secrets, varied environments, and relaxing brain teasers. No danger, no rush — just clever puzzles and peaceful exploration.

title: Nugatory
description: Trapped in a deadly time loop on a remote research facility, a security officer must expose an alien imposter before the day resets. A tense, fully voiced sci-fi mystery where you are stuck in a cycle of life, death, and wrongful accusations.

title: Dude The Dark Agent
description: Dude The Dark Agent, klasik 90'lar FPS ruhunu modern özelliklerle buluşturan 2.5D aksiyon oyunu. Raycasting motoruyla işlenen yoğun orman haritalarında, düşman askerleri avla, antik heykelleri parçala ve her köşede seni bekleyen tehlikelere karşı hayatta kal.

title: Tower of Square
description: This is a simple puzzle adventure where you play as a triangle-shaped protagonist, moving up, down, left, and right to bravely ascend a 48-story tower, familiarizing yourself with and utilizing the movement patterns of various creatures within the tower.

title: Crazy Roads
description: Crazy Roads is an endless driving game on procedurally generated roads. Drive fast to earn points, unlock unique cars, complete challenges, and travel the real-life distance between countries in World Mode.

title: Running Beehind
description: Run fast, take risky shortcuts, and deliver food across Waspington or choose to rebel against your Hive; after all, nothing says job security like a perfectly timed landing.

title: Beards vs. Claws
description:
Beards vs. Claws is a fun, chaotic first-person sandbox shooter set in a fully destructible world environment where the battlefield is never static, and every match reshapes the map.

Everything in the world can be destroyed, mined, or built upon in real time - from the ground below to the walls and towers above.

Dig tunnels to flank your enemies, carve out trenches for cover, or build bridges and platforms to gain the high ground. The terrain is a tool, a weapon, and a strategy all at once.

As players fight, dig, and build, the environment is constantly reshaped by rocket explosions, bridges and newly carved tunnels throughout the map.

title: Zombeo and Vampireta
description: Zombeo y Vampireta is a short visual novel about impossible love and corpses full of life. Play as a romantic zombie or a foul-mouthed vampiress in a family feud fueled by centuries of resentment—and the stench of death. Discover how far a love story between two hopeful undead can go.

title: Ceraphic Requiem
description: Dive into a ruined world devastated by the gods. Ceraphic Requiem is a hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania with a demanding combat system. Master elemental magic combos, unravel the mysteries of the decay, and impose your will in the final moments of a moribund world.

title: Apotheosis Engine
description: An accident causes a lost space probe to become self aware. Apotheosis Engine is a lore-rich incremental game. Grow from a piece of engineering into a galactic superdeity by navigating an alien OS.

title: Sea Hunter Idle
description: Sea Hunter Idle is an exciting Idle Clicker game where you'll catch sea creatures to earn money and upgrade your fishing empire. From building your house on the coast to exploring space and new dimensions, each click takes you further in your endless fishing adventure!

title: We're in the Same Boat
description: In We're in the Same Boat, guide a quirky crew of animals across rivers, solving riddles to uncover unique rules for each character. Use logic to crack the code and complete increasingly tricky levels. Fun, charming, and brain-teasing!

title: Discovery Islands
description: A cozy hidden-object puzzle game inspired by classic browser games. Explore tiny handcrafted islands, interact with the environment, and uncover cleverly hidden secrets.

title: Trouble in Potion High
description: Something has gone very wrong in Potion High. As an outside specialist for "hopeless cases," you must fight your way through corridors overrun by interdimensional creatures. Restore order using potions and your own pocket laboratory. Can you contain this chaos?

title: White Rooms
description: White Rooms is a first-person puzzle game where every room teaches you a rule... then punishes you for believing it. No combat. No reflexes. Just trust, and the moment it breaks.

title: The Crosley Tower Horror
description: The Crosley Tower Horror is a game heavily inspired by the real life building by the same name (Crosley Tower). This game is an urban exploration with strong horror elements. You will be able to explore 6 available floors of the tower, including the mysterious and closed off 16th floor. To reach the top and steal the D.E.M.O.N. sphere, you must solve puzzles, navigate asbestos filled corridors, and find notes left behind by the scientists. Not everything is as it seems in the halls of Crosley.

title: Market Hours
description: Grow a trading firm from your apartment to a global institution. Hire traders and engineers, research new strategies, negotiate with your competitors, optimize your infrastructure, and build the most successful proprietary trading firm on Wall Street!

title: Hentai Furry Pig
description: Hentai Furry Pig is a puzzle game for those who love logic and a hot atmosphere. Two mini-games in each level: memory matching and a jigsaw puzzle. Unlock explicit biker-girl illustrations, earn achievements, and view unlocked content in the gallery.

title: Underfang
description: Psychological horror game, we go through the dreams of a child. Well, maybe that's what we think at first glance.

title: Mirai's Midnight Training
description: In their fateful battle, the mighty exorcist succeeded in defeating the legendary two-tailed fox spirit, Kanou Mirai. He thought that was the end, but their story...was only just beginning.

title: Silent Castle
description: “My dad was killed by the hero.” A short push-puzzle game about a boy cleaning up the deserted Demon Castle all by himself.

title: SlotsNStocks
description: Rig the market in this deckbuilding slot machine roguelike. Draft hundreds of bearish and bullish symbols into your trading machine, collect powerful relics, and manipulate the odds to hit grueling weekly margin calls and avoid going bust.

title: The Mask of Agnosia
description: The Mask of Agnosia is a surreal 3D narrative RPG. Navigate and map a shifting network of waterways to recover a boat keeper’s memories. Solve matching puzzles to reveal a fallen kingdom, confront specters of time, and collect sacred masks to rebuild an ancient tower before the light fades.

title: Sweetie Candy Maze: Lime
description: Dive into a vibrant candy world! Collect delicious sweets and find your way through playful lime mazes in this sweet and colorful adventure.

title: Color Splash: Fruits
description: Color Splash: Fruits is a charming and relaxing puzzle game that will lift your spirits and take You into the world of adorable fruits and art. Venture into the gallery, where you will find many extraordinary and colorful birds paintings.

title: Futa Zone: Lewd Control
description: Work as a border officer at a secret VIP resort where lust is the real passport. Inspect guests, expose their kinks, and decide who gets in — the obedient, the forbidden, or the ones who turn you on the most.

title: Gem Brawl Duel
description: A gem war testing reflexes, strategy, and hauling! On shared screen, precious gems rain down as you battle for territory. Drag gems to your camp to score, disrupt rivals, and fight for supremacy. Every gem can change the battle!

title: Dead Sector: Outbreak
description: Survive a brutal desert wasteland after a devastating outbreak. Scavenge, build, and defend yourself in a hostile open-world filled with ruins, wreckage, and deadly infected.

title: Isla de la Muerte
description: Isla de la Muerte is an intense survival game filled with mystery and danger. Stranded on a remote island, you uncover the aftermath of a secret government experiment gone horribly wrong. Officially erased from records, the island is now overrun by hordes of relentless zombies.

title: Seeker Shrine
description: Relaxing, cozy and slow paced farm simulator where you collect creatures and build your own ranch. Seekers keep you company while you work, study or just chill on your PC. Collect Orbs to get eggs which hatch new creatures. Decorate the shrine with trees & plants, which offer food for your Seekers.

title: High Rollers: Dice Drop Duel
description: Challenge your friends to high stakes arcade puzzle action in High Rollers: Dice Drop Duel! There's something for all types of players with a variety of solo, multiplayer and online modes.

title: Evanesce Theory
description: You are a criminal negotiator by the name of Ken, sent to investigate a bomb threat at the Sunrise Shopping Centre by a mysterious man by the name of "Mr. Smile," who beckons you to "turn his frown upside down." However, the supposed hostages seem mysteriously unphased with the situation at hand. Needing their knowledge to get to where he's hiding, Ken sets out to fulfil the needs of the clerks, to put the smiling man to justice!

title: Hakoniwa Electric
description: "Hakoniwa Electric" is a cute relaxing puzzle game. Explore adorable isometric stages, solve puzzles, and light them up. Why not spend a leisurely year as Akari, who's taken over grandpa's electronics shop, helping with the monthly troubles from the townsfolk?

title: BBS (Bulletin Board System) Magica
description: Magical Girl Programming ✖︎ auto-battle! An office worker is assigned to manage a fan exchange bulletin board when she was once a magical girl, Become a magical girl in cyberspace and protect the message board.

title: Memolith: Forsaken by Light
description: A turn-based tactical RPG set in a medieval city overrun by horrific creatures, where only your wits and strategies can keep you alive.

title: Murder Mystery Castle
description:
A Twitch Specific Chat integrated Murder Mystery game to play along with your viewers. Requires Twitch streaming to play.
A mysterious portal has just pulled you and 10 of your loyal viewers into a shadowy new realm and one of you is already dead. Welcome to the ultimate Twitch integrated murder mystery. You are the observer, and your chat is your detective agency. Can you deduce who the killer is before the clock runs out? Streaming required. Survival not guaranteed.

title: PlaneWorld
description: PlaneWorld is a 2D pixel art survival and exploration game. Explore a procedurally generated world, face night enemies and defeat 5 legendary bosses.

title: A Todas Las Lagartijas Que Atrapé
MyDear.exe
description: Celebrate love with Ellie and Lucien in MyDear.exe. A short and cute game that takes place in the folders of an old DIY PC. In the shoes of Ellie, play the game offered by Lucien after a long life together. Humor, memories and love are on the menu of this short 2 hour experience.

title: Alchemist's Garden
description: Alchemist's Garden is a cozy and relaxing incremental crafting game. Forage to uncover hidden ingredients across mystical lands. Experiment with them at your crucible to discover potions and items, stock your shop's shelves, and watch your potion shop grow!

title: Ashen Throne
description: A post-apocalyptic 4X strategy MMO. Build armies, forge alliances, raid the Wastes, lay siege to the Citadel. Mobile Crawler base, alliance warfare, fog-of-war extraction, persistent sieges, player-run economy. Closed alpha now. Browser-playable on desktop and mobile.

title: The Hollow Road: Prologue
description: A psychological horror prologue where a strange house, a silent church, and something lurking in the dark pull you into a waking nightmare. Explore, uncover hidden truths, and survive what waits beyond the last door.

title: ADElaide
description:
ADElaide is a weird puzzle adventure game made for the RPG Maker Themed Game Jam #8 and the RPG Maker Horror Game Jam #8.

Adelaide is a young girl imprisoned by the tyrannical Ultraviolet Monarch. She gains the ability to enter others' dreams after consuming a ghost moth.

title: Secrets of the Heart
description: To help her photographer boyfriend, she meets new people and enters different worlds, gradually discovering a hidden side of herself. Her ending depends on the choices you make.

title: Lich of Might
description: In this genre-defying action game you are the boss at the end of the dungeon. An undead lich. Each hero that invades your lair must be mercilessly destroyed using the necromantic power at your fingertips. You are the final test. Your dungeon, their demise.

title: Orbital Traffic Controller
description: Orbital Traffic Controller is a sci-fi spaceship management game set in the Solar System. Become an interstellar traffic controller, directing vessels from planetary holding patterns and warp gates to atmospheric reentry, all while avoiding collisions with other spacecraft and planetary bodies.

title: War Untold
description: War Untold is an RTS wargame spanning both land and air warfare. Employ powerful tanks and devastating airstrikes to punch through the enemy's front line, or dig in with infantry and mortars to withstand an oncoming onslaught. The choice is yours, commander.

title: R-Type DX: Music Encore
description:
R-Type DX: Music Encore features the ultimate mode, Ultimate Challenge, allowing players to battle through both titles seamlessly.
For the first time, this mode includes a full soundtrack.
Arcade-accurate stage themes have been newly implemented — including dedicated tracks for areas that originally shared music — enabling every stage to be played with the same musical structure as the arcade versions.
Experience newly reconstructed sound created using authentic handheld hardware audio.

The original R-Type and R-Type II are also included.
In Classic mode, players can choose between monochrome and color versions, preserving the feel of the original release.

title: Unbreachable
description: Unbreachable is a turn-based PvP strategy game with auto-battler mechanics. Build your own fortress, use synergies and watch it battle against other players to become the ruler of all the lands!

title: Error 2351
description: A 3D first-person horror game of survival and exploration. As a former police officer, you search abandoned halls and buildings, solve environmental puzzles, and evade the horror of scientists haunting Ridgecourt Forest. By uncovering hidden clues, you’ll piece together the truth behind the mystery.

title: Dispersion Storm
description: As the sky consumed by the 'DispersionStorm' how far can you run—and how many can you save—before everything vanishes? DispersionStorm delivers parkour action and combat. Every leap you take shapes the very fate of the city.

title: Music Chase 1: The Music In Me
description: Solve music puzzles as you follow the life of music star Julia from her birth to the untimely end of her career in order to awake her from her cryosleep.

title: Rugrats: Retro Rewind Collection
description:
Hold onto your diapers! Rugrats: Retro Rewind Collection brings together the ultimate collection of Tommy, Chuckie, Phil, Lil, and Angelica’s greatest hits. Curated for fans by the team at Limited Run Games, this nostalgic bundle restores six iconic adventures from the Golden Age of Reptar, now enhanced for modern play.

Whether you're exploring the Pickles' backyard or trekking through EuroReptarland, this is the definitive way to experience the games that defined a generation of Nicktoons fans.

title: Path of The Runecaster
description: Defeat massive hordes of enemies to grow ever more powerful! Unlock new runes and spells to create insane combinations! Gain tons of experience and learn the true meaning of the Runecaster’s path.

title: My Helpers
description: My Helpers is an experimental horror game that hides a group of virtual… "assistants" inside your machine. Find them by combing through your real files, exploring weird applications, and using your computer in ways you may have never expected - and remember: this is just a game.

title: Super Real AI
description: Welcome to Super Real AI, the ultimate AI Simulator where you are the intelligence. Judge, classify, and share your advice—but be careful, your answers for simple requests have super real consequences. Log in today and bring back the intelligence where it belongs: to humans.

title: SandEEE
description: Write code for an alternate universe in SandEEE, just keep in mind "EEE sees all".

title: Video Game Menu: The Game
description: A short game about the very best part of video games: the menus.

title: Database Detective: Minor Crimes Division
description: Solve criminal cases through the power of SQL queries! Help out the city of Los Zorangeles by becoming a Database Detective in this new (unpaid) work from home opportunity.

title: Gloamroot
description: Gloamroot is a first-person adventure set in a small, surreal village. Tasked to finish chores for your sick father, you uncover unsettling details hiding beneath the town’s calm surface. Something else is watching.

title: 3 Sheep Puzzle
description: 3 Sheep Puzzle is a 2D Sokoban-style logic game with remote movement. Guide the sheepdog through the barn to complete each level. A minimalist, relaxing challenge, perfect for quick minds looking to test their ingenuity.

title: God Shot
description: God Shot is a collection of violent party games, one lethal rule that failure is fatal. Get your friends together and risk it all to show your life is the only one that matters. Don't expect to survive.

title: Basement Breakout
description: A simple, short, and hopefully challenging platformer where Tenma Maemi must chase down her Kanpainiki, who have crafted an escape pod to flee from Tenma's basement. Navigate the levels and catch them before they get away!

title: Murder Meet Cute
description: Look, just because I’m paid to fix computers, doesn’t mean I’ll sit here and listen to your life story. So what there’s been murders? Do I look like a detective?

title: The Outer Frame
description: Discover the truth. Bury it better. Decide how before the masses turn on you. A choice-driven mystery where witnesses and evidence are in your hands.

title: ZeroPrompt
description: The internet is dying. You're a verification operator. Filter out AI impostors from humanity's last clean network. Interrogate live LLM agents that think, lie, and bribe in real-time. Use investigation tools to detect deception. Every verdict shapes the internet.

title: Bait Ball Party
description: A real-time billiard brawler for up to 6 players. Play as mini characters to dominate the scoreboard, sabotage your friends with power-ups, and punch them to win.

title: ProTax 98
description: A short 90s bureaucratic horror game where you process impossible tax forms for the living, the dead, and the unborn.

title: Raw Signal: Uncover Gay Hidden Secrets
description: Can you uncover the filthiest secrets and the most unexpected objects during a wild gay party? Step into the role of a private detective in this free hidden object game filled with lust, mystery, and temptation.

title: Rich Flavors
description: Rich Flavors is a game in which you deliver "goods" to "customers" and get paid in "coupons". Can you collect enough to buy your dream cake before your contract ends?

title: Mutiny's Wake
description: A hardcore pirate survival game set during the Golden Age of Piracy. Stranded on a hostile island after a mutiny, you must scavenge, hunt, craft, and survive against pirates, wildlife, and dwindling resources.

title: One More Core
description: One More Core is a 3D incremental game where you carve through planets layer by layer with your flagship, gather resources, upgrade your fleet, and keep advancing until you capture the planet's core. Don't forget to refuel… there's one more core to go!

title: Shot One Fighters
description: Shot One Fighters is a roguelite 2.5D fighting game. Pick your fighter. Build your moveset and grow more powerful. Discover powerful and cursed artifacts. Fight your way out of a universe Paradox is eating alive.

title: Furry College
description: A playful, cheeky visual novel about ambition, fame, and feline charm. Flirt your way through college life and social media drama — every post, every choice, every scandal counts!

title: Difficult
description: Step into a fully 3D medieval world of deception. diffiCULT is a multiplayer social deduction game where you must uncover hidden cultists. Use proximity voice chat, investigate houses at night, survive daily votes, and reveal who is truly on your side.

title: Mega Man DXtreme
description: Mega Man DXtreme is a revamp of Mega Man Xtreme originally released on the Gameboy Color, with a re-imagined story, improved controls, wider screen, reworked weapons and bosses, and lots more ~

title: Stitchlings
description: Stitchlings is a couch co-op action game where the monsters you defeat become parts to stitch onto your character, allowing you to customize your combat style and dress up your Stitchling! Grab a friend and embark on a grand adventure to rekindle a fading world where all you have is each other.

title: Trigonometric Equations
description: Trigonometric Equations is a strict side-scrolling rhythm game. Solve the trigonometric equations to fly through fleeting points and curves perfectly!

title: Puzzlor
description: A strategic rogue-lite puzzle game where you collect and place Tetris-style pieces to defeat fantasy villains, unlock characters and upgrades, and build powerful runs. Focused on replayability, quick sessions, and meaningful strategic choices. Set in a traditional high fantasy world.

title: SlapTrax
description: An aggressively kinetic keyboard slappin' rhythm game. Rhythm without restraint. open palm strike your keyboard to music. Wear gloves. Build calluses.

title: Rotten Chamber
description: Rotten Chamber is a single-player social deduction puzzle game. The player faces a circular council of city officials, each with a unique role and identity. Some officials are corrupt and disguising themselves as honest civil servants. Through reading role-based testimony and applying logic, the player must identify and arrest the corrupt officials without wrongfully accusing the Mayor, whose arrest immediately ends the case. The game features 45 hand-designed levels across 3 acts, an endless mode, custom seeds and 15 unique roles with distinct mechanical and narrative identities.

title: Warota: I Live Next to The Demon King's Castle LOL
description: 【Village-Building Action RPG】 Saved by a goddess, you arrive in a ruined world ruled by the Demon King. Gather resources, build your village, swap hats to change classes and give villagers their roles. But one night, the Idol Demon King holds a Live next door...and monsters come pouring in!?

title: Assassin's Creed Syndicate: A Long Night
description: Bob, the apprentice train driver, is out on a lark when he falls afoul of some rough characters. Jacob needs to track him down and do his best to corral the tipsy Bob (who would much rather sing) and bring him back to the hideout in a fast-paced, wild and dangerous ride.

title: Sirin's Feather
description: The Bird of the Dead has taken your beloved. How many times will you have to die to bring her back? Gather companions, uncover their secrets, and shape the story in a world where pagan myths come alive.

title: Killest Fights Craw-Mech
description: Killest Fights Craw-Mech is a turn based sci-fi RPG about Killest taking his revenge on the RDA (Robot Destruction Agency). Rampage through a robot-filled base, push around a weak-willed supervisor, hopefully run into no barrel puzzles, and face your past head first in this epic onslaught...

title: Tomb Guard
description: Tomb Guard is a real-time pause and play tactics game. You control a band of skeletons as they defend the invading Fiends from their homeland. Focus is key, for facing overwhelming odds is certain. Pause, strategize, and attack to protect Tombstead and defeat The Order once and for all.

title: Eyehold Blocks
description: Defeat the dungeon of Eyehold with the help of the blocks within in a brand new puzzle roguelike. Drop pieces to clear away the damage from the attacks of the monsters within and fight back.

title: Solar Machina
description: Solar Machina is a vibrant 2D pixel art platformer where you control a robot on a colorful journey through tropical landscapes filled with traps and enemies. As you progress, your robotic suit evolves, granting new movement abilities that transform how you play. With smooth controls, distinct biomes, and a nostalgic chiptune soundtrack, Solar Machina offers a satisfying blend of challenge, rhythm, and exploration that keeps engagement from start to finish.

title: Icon
description: A darkness has crept into the rotting marrow of the once glorious Arx Imperium. As the deep places stir and the dead rise from their graves, this ruined world finds itself in need of a hero, a savior, an icon.

title: Ruminant 4444
description: You have 4 days to make things right. Love, nurture, scold, and kill Virions until you’ve made amends: I’m sorry, Laetitia. Each day, you must breed countless cycles of virions. Allow them to go through their full life cycles, to reproduce, and ultimately to meet a natural death.

title: Switcheroom
description: An Ultimate Doom megawad the idea of which was to remake all 36 maps, but as if they had appeared in another episode.

title: Question Roulette
description: Prove your wits and composure in this ultimate fast-paced trivia challenge where knowledge, speed, and strategic risk-taking determine victory.

title: Hoosegow: Prison Survival
description: Hoosegow: Prison Survival is a choice-based survival game with roguelike elements where everything depends on the decisions you make, and the goal is to survive brutal prison conditions. Every choice has consequences, every playthrough is unique, and a single mistake can cost you your life.

title: The Golden Caravan
description: Fight your way up The Golden Caravan Casino in this noir Roguelite where Poker Battles decide your fate. Play bold Hands, gamble for powerful Trinkets and pull daring Tricks to shift the odds in your favor.

title: Pegs X Stickers
description: Pegs X Stickers is a pachinko-roguelite that combines Balatro with the cult-classic Peggle. Build your own boards and purchase stickers to create high-scoring synergies.

title: Geo: The Iron Age
description: A Japan-exclusive top-down dungeon crawler action RPG developed by Bakuretsukoubou and published by ASCII Entertainment in 1999.

title: Life and Lemon
description: Life & Lemon is a cozy fruit farming card game! Grow your orchard business, discover countless combination through card fusing, and make new friends. Learn how to run a successful orchard business and help build a thriving community across a lush, vibrant world!

title: Eyes On You
description: Stealth social simulation game where you eliminate your rivals to win over your senpai.

title: Gene Jackpot
description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you gamble with your own genes. Every card played mutates your body. Every defeat triggers unpredictable mutations. Become a different monster every run. Losing has never been this fun.

title: The Grimwood Hex
description: The Grimwood Hex is a wooden roguelike deckbuilder where time is against you. Place and explore a board of enchanted tiles, craft unique decks and fight twisted creatures in the safety of daylight, rushing back to the town before nightfall.

title: Pretty Magicle: Miracle Heart
description: Chisa Nakazono is an ordinary high school student, who suddenly comes across a strange pill that turns her into a magical girl!

title: Solar Sandbox
description: Solar Sandbox is a game where you can interact with physics in space.

title: Required Synergy Workshop: Deja Damnation
description:
Mandatory orientation at a corporate hellscape. The loop never ends. A psychological horror visual novel where your accumulated choices build a hidden profile and the world around you adjusts accordingly.

Public demo available on Steam. Full release is currently in development.

title: Karma Exorcist
description: The underworld lies in ruins, ravaged by evil karma. In this unknown and perilous realm of the dead, you must fight against demonic forces, collect mystical artifacts, face the Yama Kings and the Ghost Emperors, sever the Karma, and reforge the path of reincarnation.

title: Open For Business
description: Open For Business is a shop management simulator, but not a typical one. This isn’t about selling water, food, or random everyday items. It’s about nostalgia — that feeling you get when you pick up a game, a movie, a cartridge, or a VHS, and it actually means something. In this game, you build your own store and sell games, movies and animated films, consoles, collectible figures, and more — from retro VHS tapes and cartridges to modern entertainment.

title: MFA Prep Course
description:
MFA Prep Course is an artist simulator and training application for those seriously considering advanced degrees in the field of visual arts.

For gallery exhibitions, the game is played with a dual analogue controller. The two arms are controlled with the two analogue sticks respectively. The buttons on the right and left analogue sticks control the picking up and dropping of items for the corresponding hand. The home version uses wasd + space and the mouse.

title: Fake Roads
description: Fake Roads is an observation-based exploration experience where the smallest changes can alter everything.

title: My Fish Friend
description: A gentle, interactive aquarium experience for young children and fish lovers. Watch, feed, and play with beautiful fish in a peaceful underwater world — no timers, no losing, just endless calm and discovery.

title: Pokémon Dark Horizon
description:
Pokémon Dark Horizons is a Pokémon fangame developed in RPG Maker XP using the Pokémon Essentials v21.1 starter kit and MKXP.
The game was created with Gen 4 graphics and includes all Pokémon from the first four generations!
Jump into an unknown adventure full of challenges, secrets to discover and a lot of fun!
Explore the Aurelia Region in over 35 hours of gameplay!

title: Hentai Reina
description: Hentai Reina is an adult game about a sexy police girl. Unlock new revealing illustrations, complete levels, earn achievements, and enjoy hot content in the gallery.

title: Broken Dagger
description: Broken Dagger is a dark fantasy RPG where your decisions truly matter. Solve quests in multiple ways, explore a living world, and forge your own path. Heavily inspired by Daggerfall, it delivers a classic RPG experience with modern design.

title: Theatre of War: Rearmed
description: Command real-time WWII battles across the complete Theatre of War series, unified on the latest version of its original engine. Experience deep tactical combat, realistic ballistics, and over 100 missions, enhanced for modern systems.

title: Stellaris: Nomads
description: In Nomads, you thrive inside colossal Arkships that carry your people, your industry, and your ambition across the stars. Move freely through the galaxy, take on Contracts from settled empires, and leave your mark by building Waystations. Nomads do not own the map. They blaze a path across it.

title: Above Land: Rhapsody
description: A single player or co-op action RPG roguelite set high above the clouds. Wield outrageous weapons, craft wild builds, and dive into chaotic runs where no two adventures are ever the same.

title: Papa's Mocharia Deluxe
description: Create delicious coffee drinks and cannoli in Papa's Mocharia Deluxe! Create stylish layered lattes in the coffeehouse for Papa Louie's loyal customers while earning tips, points, and Special Recipes. Take a trip in the Food Truck to design and serve your own eye-catching creations!

title: Touhou Yukkuri Mountain
description: 3D Puzzle: Take It Easy!!! Touhou Project characters are here in their ""Yukkuri"" forms! Stack up the ""Yukkuri"" and create your very own ""Yukkuri Mountain""!

title: The New Adventures Of Billy The Kid
description: Lonesome Cowboy Faust.

title: Arm the Hero
description: Arm the Hero is a roguelite deck-building game where you play as a dungeon blacksmith. Craft weapons for heroes using your deck. Combine parts to forge unique weapons that match each hero’s fighting style. You’re the blacksmith behind every hero’s victory.

title: Havoc Heirs
description: A fantasy turn-based RPG in a massive interconnected world. Monsters are everywhere, and you may end up being one of them.

title: Suspicious Holes
description: A stylized roguelike card game with horror undertones.

title: Dismal Dreams
description: Dismal Dreams is a gritty, turn-based RPG Maker game, set in a lightless world. All that's left for you to inherit, is a hellscape without answers.

title: Mistworld
description: Mistworld is a fantasy RPG blending classic atmosphere and deep storytelling. Build your party, master strategic combat, and explore a vast world where nations clash and countless destinies intertwine in an epic tale of choice and consequence.

title: Scaledeep
description: Turn-based roguelike dungeon crawler featuring procedurally generated environments, over 200 unique monsters, and dynamic class customization. 20 different storylines. 6 professions. Countless deaths. Play solo or team up in local couch co-op and battle hordes of enemies.

title: Shrouded Lands
description: Lead the Witch, Exorcist and Demonologist across lands conquered by evil. Engage demons and their disciples in tactical combat. Shackle enemies’ minds with Torments, restricting their combat actions. Slay the possessed, or exorcise to free their souls.

title: Calame
description: In this turn-based tactical RPG, renown can change the course of a war. Lead Kenmare and the Panthers against the King of Light, shape the Chronicle through your choices, and wield the Legend to turn battles around.

title: Gestalt: Memoria
description: Wickeina 'Wicke' Gestalt still lives in a haunted house. The sequel title to Gestalt: The Fifth Day, Wicke is forced to confront her past in this point-and-click psychological horror title with multiple scenarios, branching narratives, challenging puzzles and tense situations.

title: Permaban
description: It's 2007. You're a forum mod with dial-up, a rulebook that contradicts itself, and a community spiraling into chaos. Ban trolls, cite rules, survive burnout. Papers Please meets early internet culture.

title: Mind's Edge
description: Leia's 12th birthday turned into a nightmare when masked, unidentified individuals kidnapped her. Following the traces, Vincent and his childhood friend Antonio arrive at an abandoned mansion, where they run across something they never expected.

title: Lost Media Agency
description: A found footage horror game where you need to piece together a timeline in chronological order of a Kaiju incident that occurred.

title: Dust Bunny
description: Dust Bunny is a relaxing cleaning game where you explore a mysterious abandoned mansion. Upgrade your tools, discover strange secrets, and unlock unique areas.

title: Butterfly Girl
description: A puzzle-adventure game blended with visual novel storytelling. A mysterious girl and butterflies appear each time you solve a puzzle inside the room. Who are they? What do they want? Unravel each puzzle one by one — and the truth draws ever closer.

title: Minikin
description: A hidden-object party game for 1 to 4 players. Find the right Minikins before everyone else, challenge your friends or team up with them, and unlock stickers, characters, and more rewards along the way.

title: CitySpotter
description: Spot unique buildings hidden across large procedurally generated cities. Every map is different, with dynamic weather, animated streets, and relaxing sounds. Play at your own pace or challenge yourself to find every target faster each time.

title: Front Page
description:
Front Page is a 1-bit narrative game where you play as the editor-in-chief of an independent newspaper and you are in charge of publishing daily front pages.
Through a story with multiple endings where choices have consequences, you decide the direction your newspaper is taking by picking the articles from a pool that changes every day.

title: Scattered
description: Scattered is a short adventure where you explore a tropical island as a cat in search of a litter of hidden kittens. Discover paths to remote locations, dig up pirate treasure, and seek out perfect sleeping spots. Upgrade your skills and show them the way back home.

title: You Make This House a Home
Stellaris: Willpower
description: Shape Minds, Rule the Stars. In a galaxy defined by borders, belief knows no limits. In Stellaris: Willpower, your Ethics evolve into powerful ideologies that can reshape entire civilizations.

title: Invincible Vs.: Deluxe Edition
description:
Invincible VS is a brutal superhero 3v3 tag fighting game set in the Invincible universe, where you can battle to the death as a team of fan-favorite characters in iconic locations.

Deluxe Edition Includes:
Year 1 Character Pass
Profile Card Cosmetics

title: Blood Mall: Retaped
description: Blood Mall: Retaped is a short first-person dinosaur horror game inspired by creature features of the 80s, and the works of Puppet Combo. Take control of a big game hunter-turned-rookie cop, sent to deal with a prehistoric threat that has turned the Dayton County Mall into a blood-soaked hell.

title: Doomtide
description: Doomtide is a turn-based RPG with city-builder elements set in a flooded world of monsters and ancient horrors. Construct an island town, recruit unique heroes, and venture forth across the seas in search of wealth, knowledge, and power.

title: Static Between Stations
description: Static Between Stations is a narrative-driven RPG in the dying city of Patchwater. Explore, negotiate, scavenge, craft or try your best to avoid conflict. In a fight for survival adaptability is your only advantage.

title: Deckzin
description: Deckzin is a dungeon crawler deckbuilder with roguelike and RPG elements. Play as fantastic heroes, build and refine legendary decks, adapt to encounters and events in fast-paced runs, defeat powerful bosses, and keep the world’s last light alive.

title: Milk Club
description: Milk Club is a third-person shepherd ARPG where you collect and shape a unique flock of biomech NiMALs. Herd them through a polluted paradise, battle rival shepherds, and adapt your flock to survive.

title: Flawdread
description:
You dreamed of a demon and then woke up in a place completely different from your home.

Now you need to go to your birthplace, which would be your true home. Your true comfort from this sudden hell.

title: Be Kinder and, Like, Be a Rewinder, Dude!
description: 1995, Summer. "Get a job or you're joining the military" shouts your dad. Get your ticket to an incremental game where you'll rewind, loan, buy tapes, buy rewinders, buy food, move to better locations, hire your mates and make a mint at Planet Rewind! Video tape rentals will be around forever!

title: Age of Delirium
description:
Age of Delirium is a streamer vs streamer god game for Twitch.

Streamers become gods, and viewers become their followers. Viewers must explore, gather resources, build, and battle each other for the glory of their gods. Streamers try to coordinate their civilizations to work together to win.

In the end, only one god remains.

title: Serious Sam: Realm of Thoth
description:
Realm of Thoth is a huge campaign made by talented SED1 mappers. The project was being worked on for 9 months and the idea was to make a full campaign working as a team.

5+ hours of content
9 beautiful diverse maps to explore
48 secrets to find
4000+ enemies to slaughter

List of participants and maps they worked on:
Wolf - Intro & The Cosmic Egg
Laki - Garden of Thoth & The Way of Knowledge
StormCatcher.77 - Lightbringer
Unserious Dude - The Way of Knowledge
Georgg14 - The Red Pyramid of Sneferu
HoBu4oK - Kingdom of Sebek & Sacramental Path
Maska322 - Hermopolis & The Cosmic Egg

Mapping event hosted by HoBu4oK

title: I Want to Wear Your Wool
description: As spring arrives, Fable the wolf wants to turn over a new leaf and make friends with the other animals in the glade. Along the way, they meet a sheep who is a little too eager to be eaten.

title: Möbius Link
description: First entry in the Möbius Link series, it features a multi-scenario turn-based space fleet simulation game set amid a centuries-long war between two factions: the Empire and the Federation.

title: Crimsooon Sun
description: No choices but deduction. No game over. No multiple endings. A mystery "novel" adventure you can play with the same focus as reading a detective novel. Defy the sun with twenty-six bullets—even if the revolution of the heavenly spheres cannot be stopped.

title: Wonderful Jigsaw
description: Welcome to Wonderful Jigsaw, an enjoyable and captivating puzzle experience crafted for enthusiasts of every age. Immerse yourself in a dynamic realm brimming with stunning visuals, showcasing everything from minimalist designs to complex puzzles. This game strikes the ideal balance, catering to those seeking a serene pastime as well as those craving a stimulating challenge. Discover an extensive array of themed puzzles featuring nature, animals, iconic landmarks, art, and beyond. Every puzzle is crafted to deliver a rewarding and engaging experience, complemented by calming piano melodies that allow you to relax as you enjoy the game. Customize every session to fit your mood, skill level, or the time you have available with a variety of difficulty settings. Wonderful Jigsaw transcends the ordinary puzzle game experience; it invites you on a serene adventure filled with vibrant colors, boundless creativity, and delightful discoveries.

title: Nu: Ron
description:
“NU:RON” is a puzzle game where you push colors.

When you click on a sphere, you can push color into the adjacent sphere
connected by a line.

Clear the stage by matching the colors of all markers
(colored frames) with the spheres.

title: Robbo Millennium
description:
Yes, yes - it's HIM! Your favorite - the legendary Robbo!

The iconic video game hero is back in action and once again has to collect screws!

This time, however, it's not so easy, because they are scattered across over 135 planets!

Without your help, it's probably impossible...

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Adrift in the Sea of Data
description:
Version 8.8 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes
• New Part 2 Story Chapter XII: With You, Whom I Never Knew
• New Astral Op: Bailu Youyun
• New Featured Event: Project Sea of Data: Thesis Crisis
• ...and more!

title: Nonograms Pro
description:
Nonograms Pro is an excellent Windows 10 application to solve logic puzzles also known as Griddlers, Hanjie, Picross, Japanese Crosswords, Japanese Puzzles, Pic-a-Pix and other names.
The goal is to find out the position of black blocks using hints. A correct solution reveals a hidden picture.

title: Murazu 2
description: Fast-paced precision platformer where you help Murazu, a factory android girl, escape a long abandoned facility. Dash through obstacles, launch yourself like a rocket, optimize your movement and route, and reach the finish as quickly as you can!

title: S.O.R.N.
description: S.O.R.N. is a 3rd-person mecha action shooter with fast paced combat and lots of customization.

title: Zero Sievert 2
description: ZERO Sievert 2 is a top-down PvE extraction shooter set in the ruined country of Zakov. Hunt alone or with a crew, face anomalies, bandits, and mutants, and make it out alive.

title: Dune: Awakening - The Water Wars DLC
description: The Water Wars DLC features a cosmetic pack inspired by the Water Shippers and their cartel. Customize your base with 52 building pieces and 18 decorations and feel the aura of the Water Shippers with their armor, weapons, an ornithopter variant, a cosmetic swatch, and 2 emotes.

title: Marblearium
description: Marblearium is a calm physics-based marble adventure where players become the marble itself, rolling through surreal interconnected courses filled with exploration, flow, and oddly satisfying movement.

title: Whatever It Takes
description: Whatever It Takes is a hardcore first-person Action RPG in a dark fantasy setting. As a fallen god, master elemental magic, absorb enemy powers, and engage in tactical duels. Use a harpoon for traversal and shape the Omnisphere’s fate through your choices. Reclaim your throne. Whatever it takes

title: Google.exe
description: Google wants to get rid of everyone that was made by its creators, the creator tries to end it but something is trying to prevent it? Who could it be? and Who are they?

title: Sir, We Have an Orc Problem
description: Incremental style tower-defense game where you face tens of thousands of orcs.

title: Duke Nukem: Zero Hour Overclocked
description: It combines mouse and keyboard movement, first-person perspective and a variety of quality of life improvements to make the game feel like a jank 90s FPS instead of the third-person shooter you grew up with.

title: Truck-Kun Is Supporting Me From Another World?!
description: Your truck is magic and you now owe a soul debt to the buff isekai elf girl living in your head. Run over pedestrians as Truck-kun, make deliveries, and defeat the Skeleton King across two worlds in this chaotic run-based anime driving game!

title: World of Warships X Azur Lane: Quest for Al Avrora
description: A real treat for super fans of Azur Lane, this free DLC will unlock a very special mission indeed. By completing it, not only will you unlock an individually-voiced Commander from the universe of Azur Lane, but you'll also get a Premium cruiser inspired by the very same Commander—Avrora!

title: Mars Colony Simulator
description: Build humanity's first home on Mars. Mine resources in first person, construct life-sustaining domes, grow lush vegetation, and launch rockets to reconnect with Earth in this immersive colony-building simulator.

title: Dark Watching Chapter 2
description: After the door opens, you find yourself in the shopping mall. At first, everything is quiet, but after a while, you discover dead bodies. You ignore them and continue searching for your sister..

title: Arcadia Cafe
description: Arcadia Cafe - domestic horror in early 2000s. Work the night shift as a student at a roadside cafe. Meet bizarre guests, get cash for your job, but beware — homecoming may be much more horrible than you expect.

title: The Guest II
description: The Guest II is a first-person psychological horror experience.

title: Wilderdark
description: Something dangerous is lurking in the wilderness. Wilderdark is a first-person survival horror game where you must navigate a strange island inhabited by ectoparasitic dinosaurs and organisms. You must remain vigilant to stealthily obtain evidence, samples, and craft tools to survive.

title: Farthest Frontier: Cats and Dogs
description: Enrich the lives of your hard-working settlers with the addition of cats and dogs. More than just companions, dogs will protect your crops from deer and the new ravenous groundhogs, and your chicken coops from shrewd fox invaders. They can accompany your hunters to keep them safe from wildlife and help rat catchers sniff out rat infestations. Cats may be their own masters, but they will keep rat populations under control, easing the burden on rat catchers. Villagers gladly take a pause from their busy lives in the frontier to play with their new pets, offering relief from life's hardships.

title: Cloudsphere
description: A roguelike deckbuilder where your ship is your deck. Build modular sky-vessels block by block - every module you install adds a card to your captain's deck. Overclocks, synergies, three layers of cloud-bound world, and the leviathan that destroyed your home.

title: Femboy Futa Mania
description: Turn-based 1v1 wrestling with stats, training, and spicy 18+ vibes. Fight femboys and futa rivals, manage energy, hit the gym, and use seduction skills to climb a no-rules tournament packed with sexy surprises.

title: Lustquake Legion
description: An addictive idle clicker. Become a ruthless gang leader, recruit & upgrade members, seize territories, gather resources, and clash with cops & rival gangs. Strengthen your crew, unlock power, and dominate the city!

title: Steam to Electric
description: Build and optimize your railway network in this elegant voxel rail tycoon. Transport passengers and goods, unlock crazy-but-real historical train inventions, and evolve from steam to electric. Easy to start, deep to master. From the creators of Station to Station and Town to City.

title: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon - Challenge Mode DLC
description: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon - Challenge Mode DLC adds an alternative mode focused on increased difficulty and unpredictability. At key points in the story, players encounter debuffs that make progression more challenging. Rather than strengthening the player over time, the mode increases the challenge by introducing new constraints.

title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Oaths and Ashes
description: Two vampires — an ambitious Kindred and a wretched Thinblood. Their fates clash in this Visual Novel set in the World of Darkness, where your arsenal extends beyond just words — from political machinations to forbidden Alchemy.
