Claw your way to power and leave your bitemarks on Berlin's underworld.

title: Leafborn
description: You are a living storm of a thousand leaves. Burst through enemies and soar across floating sky islands. Every run reshapes how you move, fight, and survive in this 3D fast action game.

title: Yox
description: Minimalist abstract pixel-art roguelike

title: Ubai Again
description: Return to the world of Ubai. Pick between Ryouko or Aina and follow a major turning point in their lives. Make choices that will drastically shape the outcome of their stories in this exciting visual novel. Live through their experiences as you read through their stories and follow the ladies to the thrilling conclusion.

title: Red Rising
description: Fight for dominance with up to 6 players in the official digital adaptation of the award-winning board game. Assemble a hand of followers, chain together powerful combos, and lead your house to victory in this clash of cards set in the dystopian world of Red Rising.

title: Lightfold
description: Play as a cat weaving through light and dark in this minimalist puzzle game. Push light sources and solid blocks to craft shapes from cast shadows. Plan your routes, manipulate overlapping silhouettes, and recreate specific shadow patterns to unravel tranquil puzzles in a serene geometric world.

title: Lexomancer
description: Lexomancer blends the satisfaction of word games with the tension of turn-based combat, wrapped in a stylized fantasy world where language itself is the ultimate magic.

title: Giga Lich
description: This is a single-player PvE extraction dungeon crawler where combat is king, and resources are limited. Explore the dungeon to utilize powerful equipment and souls-like combat to overcome the dungeon's guardians.

title: Dungeonery
description: Crawl your way through the dungeon in this roguelike autobattler. Equip your heroes with epic loot and test their might in battle! Your team might uncover game-breaking synergies and conquer the dungeon… or get wiped out. Probably will, actually. No biggie, there’s always more where they came from.

title: Dirtlight
description: Dig through an odd world full of dangerous creatures. Uncover hidden paths and long-buried secrets. Dirtlight is a metroidvania where the journey runs deep, and offers unexpected ways to explore.

title: Hordestomp
description: A third person survivors like with aiming and shooting. Mow down up to 10,000 enemies on screen at once!

title: Monster x Mediator 404
description: This game violates our content policy, and all information and media have been removed. This entry will be automatically discarded if you contribute to it.

title: The Archives of Trevosa
description: Search through the hidden archives of Trevosa, translate their cultural terms, and uncover the relationships within a complex royal family tree. Can you untangle all seven generations? A challenging narrative deduction game inspired by The Roottrees Are Dead.

title: Ape-tite
description: Cook through the chaos in an ape‑paced co‑op kitchen where space is tight and pressure is constant.

title: Rise of Sorcery
description: A narrative card-based RPG where every choice shapes your destiny. Master magic by assembling occult whispers, but beware: each spell permeates your body. Manage your magical impregnation or risk the Darkism. Balance your power before magic consumes you.

title: Subject55
description: Subject55 follows the story of the 55th reanimation subject throughout this mysterious facility. In this hand-drawn action-adventure through this science center, you'll encounter bizarre anomalies, robots and other creations, and even other reanimation subjects like yourself.

title: Medieval Juice Crafter
description: Craft your special recipe juices and sell them in medieval villages. Expand your business with new recipes, machines, properties, and workers. Play online with your friend or go solo, and enjoy the growth of your business.

title: The Electric Bots
description: Fight as unique combat-ready robots in spear-based melee battles. Experience Story, Quick Game, Training, and Drone Modes. Master skills, spray toxic gas as a drone, and battle through gritty prison arenas with immersive sound and replayable challenges.

title: Lootspire
description: Co-op roguelite dungeon crawler for 1–4 players. Pick a class, choose abilities, gear up, and fight through a procedural spire that gets harder the higher you go. Gear and Hero Level reset every run, but Unlockables persist.

title: Tomb Raider: Side-Scroller Edition
description:
This project reimagines the classic Tomb Raider games through a 2D side-scrolling lens.

Re-experience familiar locations, redesigned with new platforming challenges and traps unique to the side-scrolling perspective!

It features 10 stages, taking Lara Croft across iconic locations such as India, Greece, and Venice!

Hidden throughout the game are 100 optional Golden Crystals for players seeking full completion. A hidden bonus stage is unlocked after completing the game with all 100 Crystals collected!

title: Skyship Quest Story
description: Customize your airship and explore the world above the clouds in this sim RPG

title: Solo Shift!
description: From cash register to fryer—you've got to manage it all! Take on waves of customers all by yourself! Run a convenience store solo in this frantic action game!

title: Regeneration Engine
description: Fall into the engine and try to fight your way back up to the surface in this turn-based RPG. As your companions die, consume their essences to grow stronger. Explore a strange underground world with your party, battle creatures roaming the dark, and discover the mystery behind the apocalypse.

title: Ticket to Heart
description: Ticket to Heart is a short visual novel revolving around Emmy, a young woman trying to reconnect with a long-lost friend. The ride to Mistlefir is long and filled with many surprises along the way!

title: Open Gizmy Zimy
description:
You’re human—unlucky enough to whisper “Open Gizmy Zimy” in front of an abandoned warehouse door. Now you’re trapped inside the Funhouse of Gizmy Zimy, the Comedy Mask King with with a cruel sense of humor.

He’s challenged you to survive four twisted phases and outsmart his “friends.” Make it through, and a grand prize awaits. Fail… and you’ll learn what happens to those who make Gizmy laugh the wrong way.

title: Looplash
description:
Looplash is an arcade action roguelite in which the player is confined within a circular arena while abilities rotate around them in a continuous loop. Skills are positioned along the edge of the loop and are automatically triggered when they pass a fixed marker.

Player movement directly affects the rotation speed of the loop, allowing indirect control over the timing of skill activations. The gameplay focuses on positioning, timing, and managing the interaction between abilities and enemies.

During a run, players can unlock new skills, rearrange their placement on the loop, and acquire upgrades that modify behavior and alter core mechanics. These upgrades can affect both the player and the game’s fundamental rules, leading to varied builds and playstyles.

title: Coffin Valley
description:
The town is Coffin Valley. Tales about this cutthroat place have spread all throughout the neighboring land. The sheriff put out an advertisement looking for a new deputy...who knows what happened to the last one.

Are you brave enough to explore Coffin Valley? Do you have the guts, determination, and willpower to solve what evils lurk within this town. Will you rise up to become the Sheriff's right hand man?

title: Mall Together
description: Run your mall. Open new stores, sign contracts with leading brands, hire teammates, and meet customer needs. Play with friends or go solo, and enjoy the growth of your mall.

title: Raincore
description: A first-person adventure. Explore endless concrete and metal megastructures. Use parkour and guns to fight your way through. Experience deep Immersive in dark, minimalist cyberpunk world.

title: Anno 117: Pax Romana - Prophecies of Ash
description: Settle on the largest island in Latium, beneath a looming volcano. Its eruptions will force you to adapt. On this bountiful new land, discover a rare resource, bargain with a trader, and bow before a new deity.

title: Flaghead
description: Flaghead is an arena shooter roguelite where you play as a country, surviving through history from the dark ages into the cybernetic futures and beyond.

title: Succulent Studio
description: Inherit a small succulent shop left by a friend. Carefully cultivate and crossbreed new succulent varieties, craft uniquely styled succulent arrangements by hand, and respond to each customer's heart with a touch of green.

title: Muse Dash 2
description: Continue the classic gameplay of parkour rhythm games, while adding new rhythm gameplay and multiplayer online mode. Welcome everyone to enjoy a wonderful musical journey in "Muse Dash 2"!

title: Welcome to QiQu Club
description: Tired of a suffocating college routine? Yearning for something more? Join the Qiqu Club! We promise unforgettable experiences beyond your wildest dreams. But beware, our club is extremely exclusive. Only those daring enough to seek adventure will be admitted...

title: Kin and Conquest
description: An incremental / idle action adventure game where you must battle foes, mine rocks, defeat bosses, and grow stronger in your quest to conquer the mountain and defeat the Evil Geomancer.

title: Sphere TD
description: Sphere TD is an RPG tower defense game that combines strategic base defense with deep tower and projectile customization. Players build and upgrade towers, modify projectile behavior through a wide range of systems, and progress through handcrafted stages, endless mode, and a large world map. The game emphasizes experimentation, long-term progression, and replayability through its buildcraft, resource management, and progression systems.

title: Call of Abdulov
description: Old-school brutal first-person shooter in Serious Sam style on the theme of Abduloreligion (famous russian parody religion). Russia was gripped by an epidemic of a terrible virus that distorts the mind and the body of the people, turning them into dumb and ugly monsters. Only you can stop the source of infection and to save the world, not allowing further spread of infection. You have to go through a long and hard way from 30+ levels: to visit the cities filled with evil creatures; stroll along a remote Russian village; to visit the past, and to participate in the Kuril landing operation of 1945; learn the spooky secrets of unit 731 etc. In addition to the regular weapons in the game will also be available and equipment: tanks, helicopters, military robots.

title: Revenant Survivors
description: Revenant Survivors is an action roguelite survival game where players defeat bosses, steal their powers, and create different skill combinations to survive waves of enemies. The game features boss-derived progression, attribute-based combat, and replayable runs with varied builds.

title: BoomScroll
description: Evaporate endless hordes of creatures as you scroll your way to freedom! Grab upgrades, build your arsenal, and scroll at the speed of light to make it as far as you can!

title: Echoes of Sin: Confusion
description:
Echoes of Sin: Confusion is a first-person anomaly horror game where players must observe their surroundings and identify subtle changes in the environment.

The game features a unique anomaly system with randomized events, requiring players to pay close attention to details in order to progress. Some anomalies introduce new mechanics, while others alter the environment in unexpected ways.

The experience is designed to be replayable, with multiple outcomes and hidden elements that are revealed through repeated playthroughs.

title: The World Is Ruled According to Sexual Prowess So I’m Playing Dirty to Get My Harem: Episode 1
description: Having being hit by a truck and dying, the loser man, Mihara Yuji is revived to a world where women are taken possession by men who are good at sex.

title: The Tenth Minute
description: The Tenth Minute is a short emotional visual novel about memory, regret, and the words people fail to say at the right moment. The game focuses on reading, character conversations, and quiet choices that affect how certain scenes unfold.

title: Yume 5: Spring Festival of Lust
description: Step into the world of Yume 5: Spring Festival of Lust, an engaging visual novel where you, a photographer, find yourself intertwined with the captivating Chen Xi, a former national goddess. Experience a narrative filled with romance and desire, set against the backdrop of the Spring Festival and Valentine's Day.

title: Imperialist
description: Can you exploit the New World to control the Old? Lead your nation over five centuries of history in this 4X Strategy game. Build production chains, manage logistics, grow your Empire, and outmanoeuvre rivals diplomatically or on the battlefield, to become history's first Superpower.

title: Dead Spell
description: Dead Spell is an open-world fantasy RPG focused on exploration, magic, progression, and adventure. Explore, craft powerful magical spells, complete epic quests, adventure into dangerous dungeons, battle bosses, and discover rare items!

title: Unhost
description: Unhost is an anomaly-detection psychological horror game. You play as a paranormal detective trapped in an abandoned hospital. During each night shift, you must monitor surveillance cameras, detect anomalies, and capture them using a remote-controlled robot. Stay alert - your attention to detail is your only advantage! Collect evidence, explore your surroundings, make contact with ghosts. Survive seven nights of horror and uncover the truth.

title: Tollway Tycoon
description:
Tollway Tycoon is a chaotic little management sim about running the least glamorous part of the transport network: a toll plaza on a very cursed stretch of highway.

You’re in charge of everything the drivers never think about – staffing booths, keeping the road drivable, dealing with breakdowns, repairing potholes, cleaning up after “incidents”, and trying desperately to keep the cars (mostly) flowing and the money (definitely) flowing.

On paper it’s simple: hire workers, assign them to booths, upgrade your HQ and squeeze a bit more revenue out of each lane. In reality? Cars catch fire, craters open in the asphalt, UFO abductions, zombies, prostestors trying to shutdown your operation and general insanity which keeps your team one step behind the chaos.

Every day (and night) you will be given a fresh challenge to put a twist on things, but this does not slow down the other chaotic events which happen. Even a driver having a bad day can throw your operations completely out and risk bankruptcy.

Tollway Tycoon is about that sweet spot between efficiency and disaster: the satisfaction of a perfectly flowing operation, then the dark comedy when it all goes completely off the rails.

title: 999 Seconds! Survivors
description: Reject boring stat stacking! We've restructured the gameplay with limited talent resources—talent combinations are just as important as character selection! With 200+ items and 40+ pieces of equipment, what insane builds can you create? —Depth! Difficulty! And high replay value!

title: Observation Daruma Log
description: Observation Daruma Log is a roguelite observation sim where you breed darumas, harvest mysterious energy, and escape a collapsing facility ravaged by disasters to unlock permanent upgrades. Zero comfort, zero cuteness—just nonstop tension and brutal choices.

title: Grab 50 Coins
description:
Your goal is to Grab 50 Coins and reach the exit before the spikes crush you! The door will not reveal itself until you Grab 50 Coins!
Time your movements correctly as you'll face spikes, platforms, and holes in the level!
Don't worry if you miss a few - there's always more than 50 in each level!

title: E.C.H.O.S
description: E.C.H.O.S is a narrative-driven first-person sci-fi game. Several centuries after Earth’s civilization was destroyed by an unknown cosmic force, humanity begins to awaken. Journey through virtual and real worlds, uncover the truth of a new age, and decide the future of civilization.

title: Melty Blood: Twi-Lumina
description: Melty Blood: Type Lumina is back and better than ever! Refined battle mechanics! New characters join the fray! A tale of conflict stirs once again within a dream.

title: LDS Gun Dating
description: Glock 17 is your average protag, boring and loveless. That's why he decided to join the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints! But upon hearing scary rumors about the church, he must pick a side. Will our protagonist gun it into the church, or will he dodge a bullet? He's only got one shot!

title: The Comeback King
description: The Comeback King is a light-hearted, mildly satirical retro boxing management game set in the UK in the 1980s. Take on a has-been boxer and manage his career. Decide who he'll fight, train him up and send him into the ring! Can you guide your boxer to a title contest against the division Champion?

title: Alawon: Life of a Game Composer
description: Alawon is a life sim where you manage a game composer career. Rise from game jams to AAA, balancing life and work. Make money, make friends, make love, and make music in Alawon's Digital Audio Workstation — then export and share your creations to make your mother very proud.

title: Forever Gold
description:
Forever Gold is a text-heavy dark fantasy roleplaying game. Assume the life of Duke Quintrell Barghur, a pariah of high birth, and grapple with your unlikely rise to political relevancy as the thriving alliance between Vestur's three kingdoms comes under strain. Achieve, fail, and despair as you navigate the frustrations of the Tri-Kingdom court and negotiate precarious double-binds.

Halfway between visual novel and interactive fiction, Forever Gold is a unique multimedia experience incorporating artwork and writing with RPG mechanics such as skill systems, dice rolls, and lasting narrative decisions. It is intended for mature audiences.

title: Bedrotting Simulator
description: A high-intensity survival horror/resource-management game about late-night calls, desperate defenses, and a collapsing relationship. Argue, comfort, and compromise to keep your e-girlfriend from leaving—then barricade doors, set traps, and fend off demons.

title: Eggworld
description: Adventure RPG with a unique combat system!

title: Cathderal Deer
description:
A game about addiction, religion, dreams.

This is a point and click game, there are three endings.

title: Fabled
description:
An RPG adventure where you make (...or break) friends!

Fabled is an Omori/Deltarune inspired game about exploring a magical world within an old music box.

title: God Give Me One More Chance
description: An experimental horror game about themes like love, religion, drugs, derealisation and mental illness.

title: Project Onne
description: PROJECT ONNE is a horror game made with UNITY that tells the story of Rebecca, a young police officer (Angelina Jolie) who accepts a case in a rather strange industrial city.

title: Digital Processing
description: You're the new hire in a weird office where they just want you to sort numbers in to buckets. Sort numbers, earn employee merits, and manage your own team to prove you have what it takes to reach the top in a mysterious corporate workplace. A short narrative-driven incremental management sim.

title: Plobania 47/B
description: Immortality is not a blessing, it is a burden. As Milton Clarke, you work at the 47/B Mandatory Sleep Hospital, review documents, surf the internet, and decide who will no longer exist. You don’t kill anyone. You only “put them to sleep.” The rules are clear. Every decision has consequences.

title: Department of Missing Persons
description: In this GeoGuessr-like game, work at Mili Co. using GeoFinder to track missing persons. Stay safe inside the office, cooperate with coworkers, and survive in a world where only the workplace offers security.

title: Retro Otrop
description: A struggling writer receives an unexpected call, and his destiny leads him to the small town of Otrop. Now, he must face mysteries that defy life and death in an adventure filled with supernatural fun.

title: Mindseye Blacklisted
description: Step into the role of Julia Black, a world-class assassin deployed by Meridian to Redrock City. In BLACKLISTED, your mission is simple: eliminate two key targets and shut down a deadly deal. But Meridian is under attack from the outside and undermined from within, so every move carries risk. Infiltrate the criminal network, sabotage the operation, and expose the truth.

title: Lumo Idle Park
description:
Welcome to Lumo Idle Park a relaxing idle game with a visual style inspired by the colorful, vibrant world of early 2000s Sega games.

If you grew up with a Dreamcast or remember that golden era of bold, bright arcade-style graphics — Lumo Idle Park was made with that spirit in mind.

title: Titanfall Frontline
description: Step into the Frontier War as the brigade Commander in a fast-paced head-to-head strategy card battler. Enlist familiar Commanders, like Sarah and Spyglass, and deploy your team of Pilots and Titans into combat as you aim to strategically outmaneuver opponents in real time PvP battles. Play burn cards, call down Titans, and experience an expanded Titanfall universe. This Project is being made by the community of Titanfall.

title: Storm Angel
description: An arcade shoot'em up where you're piloting the spaceship Storm Angel, fights against the insidious aliens, shooting them first over the terrestrial colonies, and then over the alien planets. The whole action is divided into 13 levels (4 episodes + finale), at the end of each one, either a boss or just a powerful crowd of enemies awaits. Between missions you can upgrade your spaceship with new weapons and bonuses, like extra lives.

title: Reverse Collapse: F
description: Reverse Collapse: F is a story-focused sci-fi cooperative PvE third person shooter. It was announced during the Girls' Frontline 10th Anniversary event and is planned for 2028.

title: Don't Push Your Luck
description: A hardcore third-person platformer that blends precision climbing with ruthless RNG, where every attempt tests both your skill and your luck as one bad outcome can send you back to the bottom.

title: Half-Life 1 Anthology
description: The Complete Half-Life 1 Collection. Step into the shoes of Gordon Freeman in the original Half-Life or experience different perspectives through the standalone expansions, Opposing Force and Blue Shift. Team Fortress Classic, a popular online shooter that was based on a mod for the original Quake, is also included.

title: Signal Garden
description:
A small dark incremental game set in a deep underground garden within a megastructure.

You grow plants and collect signals from them.
Create chains of plants to amplify signals, unlock new species, and buy creatures to increase their efficiency.

title: Vital Charge
description: Vital Charge is an indie fighting game featuring a revive mechanic, and unique attacks associated with a timer

title: Ophelia´s Paradise
description: Mystical Horde-Survivor. You are the hero who defends paradise against hordes of adversaries. On your journey, you will unleash legendary powers in a mystical world and discover unique items.

title: FinCrementalOS
description: Blast away with a submarine's cannon and sort your desktop for minigames in this incremental fish shooting and simulated operating system hybrid!

title: Midnight Shifts with Femboy
description: In this sandbox visual novel, you must survive your shifts at a convenience store while being watched by an obsessive admirer. Interact with your environment and build a delicate bond with a cute yandere femboy. Your choices will determine if you can help him heal or if his love will consume you...

title: Milf Solitaire: Lust Collector
description: Milf Solitaire is a fresh hybrid of patience card puzzles and romantic choice-driven storytelling. Clear the table, win hearts, and turn every match into a night filled with passion. Play cards smart, charm your way through with gorgeous beauties, and let strategy spark something more.

title: Empty Heaven: Liminal Dream
description: A narrative psychological horror settled in dreamlike spaces. Explore, observe, and listen as strange entities, cryptic clues, and discoveries pull you deeper. Inspired by Backrooms and Dreamcore. No jumpscares or chases, only the empty feeling that the world is a dream that you forgot to wake up.

title: Wheat and Wrath
description: Wheat and Wrath is a fantasy city-builder about straw people transitioning from nomadic wheat gathering to a settled farming village with a patron god. To survive, players must sustain and grow the community, manage wrathful gods, trade for technology, and defend the village from raiders.

title: Headpat Special Taskforce
description: Headpat monster girls to save the day! Join the Headpat Special Taskforce, an organization helping stress-ridden monster girls. Follow monster girls’ cases in comic-style dossiers, dodge their tantrum attacks, and show them the love and support they deserve!

title: Starlit World
description: The heart of the universe is shattered! Join Bo and Kikki to rescue Starlits across mysterious worlds. Master 20 suits to explore and fight. Rebuild your home in this cozy adventure. Save the universe with heart!

title: Harpooneer
description: In Harpooneer, shoot and swing your way to the top of the mountain as fast as possible, while falling as little as possible!

title: O.U.T.T.
description: O.U.T.T. is a Turn-Based Puzzle Adventure set in São Paulo, 22nd century. In a Soul Punk story, as Flavia, an ingenious psy-scientist, you must use your wits to unveil the source of those evil doings on this deep narrative, puzzle game.

title: Shane's Trains
description: Build and manage your own railway empire. Buy trains, create services, expand the network, and grow from a single branch line. Map your own routes, or play across the real UK rail network and beyond.

title: Holy Grail for Dummies
description: Holy Grail for Dummies is a colorful and absurd action-platformer about Buckethead, a hero past his prime, in a world that, let's be honest, has seen better days...

title: Grand Theft Auto Online: San Andreas Mercenaries
description: Team up with some of Los Santos’ most daring guns-for-hire and take back the city in GTA Online: San Andreas Mercenaries. Lead the fight against Merryweather Security’s forces as one of the Los Santos Angels and engage in explosive guerilla operations while conducting high-stakes, high-flying raids all across the state.

title: Grand Theft Auto Online: The Chop Shop
description: Collaborate with illustrious Liberty City real estate mogul and auto enthusiast Yusuf Amir on his newest venture, stealing the most coveted vehicles in Los Santos across a series of daring robberies in GTA Online: The Chop Shop.

title: DiceRogue
description: This is a new type of strategic roguelike where you fight by combining "dice x cards x tiles." You can create your own strategy by linking the "special effects" of the rolling dice with the "cards" that are activated according to the roll.

title: Red Chat Ritual: Tsumimi Time
description: An idol livestreamer is searching for her missing partner. You are not just watching her stream. Interfere with her broadcast, investigate clues on and off stream, and uncover the truth behind her partner’s disappearance.

title: Team Fortress 2: Rebalanced
description: Team Fortress 2: Rebalanced is a community-made mod focused on providing a new take on the TF2 experience by rebalancing and redefining its weapons and classes.

title: Keepy Up
description: Push yourself ever higher in this challenging reimagining of a classic childhood game. Guide your balloon through a vertical gauntlet of seagulls, ghosts, UFOs and more! Your balloon is your only friend, and gravity is your greatest foe. Are you skilful enough to Keepy UP?

title: Would You Love Me If I Was a Snake?
description: A puzzle game where you play as a snake. Push objects, block lasers, teleport, and bite your tail off to escape dreamy puzzle rooms.

title: Hollow Inn
description: Hollow Inn is a single-player inn-keeping and detective simulation game. You play as the owner of an inn on the outskirts of a fantasy world filled with adventurers. While welcoming guests, you must also uncover the "Imposters" hiding among them and expel them from the inn.

title: Knick Knack Stack
description: Knick Knack Stack is a cozy 2D physics-based puzzle game mixed with visual novel elements. Travel the world, build goofy towers in iconic places, take cute memory pictures of your creations and chat with your silly friends! Relax, you have all the time you need to be creative! Balance your way through this wholesome adventure!

title: Color Trigger
description:
You are the red cube.

You can press 1, 2 and 3 instead of ASD if you prefer that. ASD is based on the Qwerty keyboard layout, but the physical keys remain the same regardless of your keyboard layout. You can hold the keys, and you are not punished for holding a key while a color is not colliding with you.

If you see a spike, jump with the spacebar to dodge it.

title: The Crane Rider's Tale
description: Fly passengers around a fantasy town inspired by Chinese folktales and unravel a mindbending, Zero Escape-like mystery.

title: Beast Beat
description: Beast Beat is a 2D animated rhythm game with interactive gameplay, featuring explicit adult content involving male furry characters.

title: Skinator
description: A turn-based combat roguelite where you build a monster from the body parts of your enemies. Create evolving combos, break enemy limbs mid-fight and wear their flesh after you defeat them to grow in power.

title: The Art of Creation
description: This horror based visual novel is a retelling of the story of Adam & Eve in a queer context that strives to eliminate the stigma certain religions can hold towards members of the LGBTQ+ community.

title: R for Revenge
description: R for Revenge is a brutal top-down shooter that fuses gunplay with a devastating combat skill system. Dismantle a criminal underworld as two unique agents, chain firepower with supernatural abilities, and master high-octane encounters where one bullet is all it takes.

title: Step Into the Dark
description: Dive into the grim depths of the underworld, fight with its ferocious inhabitants, and determine your own fate in this classic first-person aRPG with immersive elements, created for fans of the genre.

title: Caravana 2000
description: Choose your almost-famous costume and face the dangers of Brazilian chaotic nights. In this action roguelike, survive hordes, farm aura, wield sinister gadgets, and create insane combinations while dancing in the face of danger.

title: Ribbit Jump
description: A precision platformer where every move counts. Adjust the strength of each jump to progress through an increasingly demanding level design. Conquer 50 obstacle-filled levels and master every leap across diverse environments.

title: Tet Story
description: Relive the 2010s Southern Vietnamese Tet with Tet Story! A 2D point-and-click puzzle journey where you decorate the house, prep Banh Tet, and solve heartwarming challenges. Dive into a nostalgic world of yellow blossoms and red envelopes to celebrate the Lunar New Year!

title: LotS: Light on the Sea
description: Lots - Light on the Sea is a narrative story driven game where you live and work on a small island with a lighthouse. Take care of the facility, check the weather, scout ships, file reports, order needed goods or unravel the story behind the lighthouse.

title: The Trials: Chapter Two
description: A classic 90s choose your own adventure style horror visual novel. Escape the horrors hunting you, make decisions, forge your own path. An original complete story with multiple endings. Choose your own play style with a Text Adventure Mode, sound effects, and an ambient soundtrack.

title: Screensavers VR
description: Screensavers VR is a portal beyond the two-dimensional world of the screen saver. Explore prismatic realms and discover the potential beyond the CRT.

title: End of Starchild
description: A beguiling first-person shooter with more to explore and exploit the further you sink in. You are Elph, and up until this very moment, you've been drifting aimlessly. A voice reaches out through the haze: "rise and shine." It's time to use your faculties to their fullest.

title: Fields of Aaru
description: A cozy life sim set in the mystical afterlife of Ancient Egypt. Farm along the Nile, befriend the locals, and decorate your eternal home. Venture into the desert and discover oases, pyramids, and tombs. Unlock magical powers by restoring ancient obelisks and making offerings to the gods.

title: Zombie Hamsters
description: A 4-player cooperative online game. Escape from a scientific laboratory while playing as zombie hamsters and infect everyone around you.

title: Madden NFL 27
description: Run the league one decision at a time in EA Sports Madden NFL 27, powered by the all-new Persona Engine.

title: Goonect 2
description: "Hold Hands, Reach the End with the Power of Friendship"—GooNECT√2 is a two-player co-op action-adventure game and the sequel to the Japan-exclusive Goonect.

title: World Heroes Perfect
description: One year after both the conclusion of the World Heroes Battle Fest and the defeat of Zeus, invitations has been sent to the 16 fighters by Dr. Brown, informing them of a new World Heroes tournament that'll help finally settle the question of who's the strongest fighter in history. With the 16 fighters preparing themselves in order to finally determine on who's the strongest fighter in history, Zeus seeks to gain his revenge against those who had caused his downfall, but little does Zeus and the rest of the fighters know and realize that an old enemy from the past is also back and that he too has his own personal desire for revenge as well.

title: Rogue Fantasy: Ever-Shifting Worlds
description: A seamless blend of JRPG depth, roguelike unpredictability, and auto-battler strategy. Recruit heroes, forge powerful synergies, and fight to survive in ever-shifting realms. The journey never ends… will you be the one to shape its fate?

title: Yomi No Kuni
description: Yomi no Kuni is an linear action adventure game where you play as a fallen samurai seeking redemption in the Shinto underworld. Face vengeful spirits, master the Death Mark, and fight to purify your soul.

title: Spreadsheets & Dungeons
description: A grid-based turn-based roguelike where you manage a party across a dungeon which is a spreadsheet. Explore each dungeon, level up your heroes, build synergies, scale absurd stats, and survive escalating dungeon pressure through tactical positioning and resource management.

title: Yãkoana: Dreams of Resistance
description: Yãkoana: Dreams of Resistance is a strategy game with roguelite and tower defense elements. Defend your people’s legacy against colonizers, mastering the land and awakening ancient powers in a relentless fight for freedom.

title: Resilient
description: Begin with a handful of survivors after a 17th-century zombie apocalypse and build a growing colony. Shape its organic layout, establish production chains, define ideologies, and pass laws. Thrive by day, defend by night, and test your colonys resilience against the undead.

title: The Kingsward
description: Explore an open-world RPG with isometric ARPG combat, a flexible hybrid class system, and an epic story with satirical humor. Create your own build and seek the legendary Kingsward.

title: Rabauken: Spirit Resort
description: Build a spirit resort. Research. Expand. Idle. Crowd-control spirits. Repeat. An automation game designed to be played on the side.

title: Hollowed Oath
description: Hollowed Oath is a fantasy MMORPG set in the beautiful yet fractured world of Orrathis. Players assume the role of an Oathsworn, choosing three classes to define their own path customizing each ability they choose. Adventure, explore, collect, craft, and battle to uncover the truth behind your Oath.

title: Dome Keeper: The Lost Keepers
description: Discover two new playstyles with The Infiltrator, a nimble keeper moving switfly with a rope; and The Beastmaster, an arcane keeper traversing the mines with agile tentacles.

title: Rat of Infinity: Idle Clicker
description: Click, collect and upgrade your lab. Rat of Infinity is an idle clicker where you obtain vials, gather scientific cards, prestige your lab and chase endless heights!

title: Darkest Path
description: Darkest Path is a 2.5D roguelike FPS that merges a modern-retro aesthetic with cosmic horror. Navigate through shifting nightmare realms, master diverse character classes, and survive the brutal corruption of a decaying world.

title: Mechs V Kaijus 2
description: Mechs V Kaijus 2 is an Hybrid Tower/Base defense, with army vs army (tug of war style) tactics. From the cockpit of a mech, to build a huge base with Reactors, Mines and all type of tower army factories and super weapons.

title: Abracablabla
description: A co-op action roguelike where you cast spells with your voice. Defend fantasy lands from monsters and survive chaotic friendly-fire magic as a wall of death closes in behind you!

title: Rift Wizard 3
description: Rift Wizard is a hardcore combat strategy roguelike and wizard simulator featuring an extremely deep build system. Customize your Wizard with more than 500 spells and magical artifacts. Blast, summon, or enchant your way through 20 levels of pure turn based chaos.

title: Slash Quest: The King Kabbage Mystery
description: Princess and Swordie arrive on an island where nothing is as it should be. Explore a cursed park filled with mysteries: roam its twisted attractions, fight corrupted creatures, and unlock abilities as you rise to uncover what destroyed this place.

title: Galactic Realms: Quest for the Forgotten
description: Magic meets forgotten tech in a first-person, 1-4 player co-op PvE-only extraction RPG and dungeon crawler. Descend into handcrafted, ever-changing dungeons, risk what you bring, claim rare loot, and extract to keep what you earn. No pay-to-win. No microtransactions.

title: AV Sex Manager
description: Run a seductive cam studio with distinct models. Each day, rotating selection criteria - body, hair/eyes, dress or undress, tattoos, hobbies, personality and more - shift what the chat craves. Spot the right matches, go live, earn tips, and unlock explicit, character-tied scenes.

title: Sunbay City Stories: Tina from the Grand Auto Workshop
description: Adult open-world adventure with summer vibes and unexpected twists! Drive your car, fight enemies, unlock interactive explicit scenes, and explore the tropical streets of Sunbay City. Dive into a captivating spin-off story full of surprises and sensual discoveries!

title: Misfit Company
description: Lead a squad of specialists deep behind enemy lines in a gritty, boots-on-the-ground struggle to dismantle the enemy's war machine from the inside out. Face down engines of war, all in an effort to stop the launch of a mechanical abomination that threatens to reshape the continent.

title: Raining Lead
description: Twin-stick shooter meets action roguelike in a quest to burn corporate stocks. Mega Giga Corp takes your city. Their stock keeps climbing but you're the correction they didn't hedge against - A constructor of machines ready to burst their bubble. Destroy, loot, upgrade, repeat and lead the revolt.

title: Memo R.I.P.
description: First‑person psychological horror card game with 900 dynamic scares, real‑time voice multiplayer, a final boss, and progression aboard a cursed spaceship.

title: Thor: God of Thunder
description: Thor: God of Thunder is a third-person beat-’em-up where you battle across realms, climb the frozen mountain, and defeat the Frost King. Unlock new armor and storm powers like Thunder Wave and Loki’s Illusion. Crush Frost Giants, transform into a Titan, and fight to a reactive rock soundtrack.

title: Usurper Reborn
description: Wake with no memory. Descend 100 dungeon floors. Build relationships, start a family, lose companions forever. A text-based RPG remake of the 1993 BBS classic—with a living world and multiple endings shaped by your choices.

title: The Bazaar: Karnok
description: The Karnok DLC adds the playable hero Karnok to The Bazaar alongside over 120 new items, skills, and unique encounters to aid Karnok on his hunts.

title: SpinBound
description: SpinBound is a roguelike deckbuilder wrapped in a slot machine, where every spin is a strategic decision. Craft unique builds. Create exponentially scaling chains, bend randomness to your will, and enjoy how your synergies turn each spin into an explosion of numbers and effects. Good luck!

title: Old World: Empires of the Indus
description: A mighty empire rises across the subcontinent, three dynasties compete to rule its southern extents, and a great tribe builds an empire of its own to the north the stage is set. Lead the people of the subcontinent across 600 years of turbulent history in Empires of the Indus.

title: A Frog's Job 2: Froggina
description: Your life has come to an end, when you find Frog God he seems impressed. Turns out most frog souls need a soul reaper to show them the way to the afterlife. Find out in this challenging puzzle platformer with a unique clock-stopping mechanic!

title: Teddy Is Coming
description: A 1–6 player online co-op horror game where you steal rare medicine from an abandoned children’s hospital while being hunted by a relentless Teddy that grows more aggressive with every passing minute !

title: Tears Apart
description: Tears Apart is an action roguelite built on five consecutive dash attacks called Tears. Equip upgrades to the Tears you choose, master your combat cycle, and carve through the Decay.

title: Reverse Dream of the Menasphere
description: You live a peaceful life alongside your sister Mea, until a fateful meeting with a succubus leads to a life-changing quest you never expected.

title: Star Wars: X-Wing vs TIE Fighter - Balance of Power Campaigns
description:
X-Wing vs TIE Fighter comes to Steam bundled with the Balance of Power expansion.

Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter is the third release of the Star Wars: X-Wing space combat flight simulator series.

The player has the ability to choose for each mission which squadron he or she wants to fly in (e.g. either the Y-wings that disable a ship for capture or the X-wings that support them), his or her specific ship type, and the ship's armaments. Players may choose imperial or rebel fighters depending on the mission.

Balance of Power features a Rebel and an Imperial campaign of 15 missions each. The campaigns supported 8-player cooperative play. Both campaigns revolve around the same series of events, but with alternate endings.

title: Together Again: A "Lake's Funland" Story
description: Winter has arrived in Montreal, another day, another night. Ashley J. Waters, a 17 year old girl in town has gotten a new job as a security guard at Lake's Funland, a magical place, that brings hours of joy and fun to grown ups and children during the day. Smiles and laughter stop once the night falls, and the tense silence makes itself present as soon as the last client leaves, then, darkness takes over.

title: Baseball Mogul 2026
description: The 2026 edition of the long-running baseball sim series.

title: Tindark
description:
Tindark is a loop-style psychological horror puzzle game where players take on the role of a dating-app user tasked with spotting anomalies among their daily matches.

Each day, eight profiles must be reviewed — swipe right on normal profiles, swipe left on anomalies. Reach Day 9 without making a mistake to escape the loop. Inspired by anomaly-spotting horror titles such as The Exit 8, a single playthrough lasts roughly 15 to 60 minutes.

title: Fishing Fever
description: An incremental roguelike fishing game. Start with one tool, end with five. Draft, upgrade and stack them, then hunt 70 species across eight oceans until the whole sea is biting at once. Rivals steal your cards. Something in the dark already knows your name. One more round. Always one more round.

title: President Simulator
description: Become President of the USA: sign absurd decrees and balance your policies to avoid being called a "sellout." Communicate to gain popularity, manage interviews, and face press conferences. Everything falling apart? Press the red button.

title: Turing Sandbox
description: Turing Sandbox is a simulation puzzle game where levels are solved by building turing machines, you can also build them purely as part of the sandbox.

title: 3Chess
description: 3-player chess on a symmetric 127-cell hex board. Three armies — Gold, Azure, Crimson — compete in a game that chess engines cannot solve.

title: Axe And Claw
description: Axe and Claw is a challenging 2D pixel-art action-platformer. Follow the story of Samuel, a father who embarks on a perilous journey to climb an unclimbable mountain in search of his lost son, Jonah. Face dangerous terrains, master the flow of movement, and overcome intense escape sequences in this emotional quest for family.

title: Sushiamo
description: Sushiamo is a roguelike deck-builder where you make sushi to reach absurd scores. Discover unique ingredients, sauces, game-changing tools, and navigate the map to break the game with insane combos!

title: BarGirls
description: Get enough eggs and challenge the interactive experience of finger-guessing with the girls. Win favorability.

title: Lazy Climbers
description: Lazy Climbers is a very difficult platform game with dangers lurking everywhere. You may fall back to the origin at anytime. Can't leap over anymore? Call your friends for help. We have no limit on the number of people online in the room, all your friends can come and suffer together!

title: Rogue 'n' Roll: Dice of Fate
description:
Rogue 'n' Roll: Dice of Fate is a roguelite strategy game that blends dice-based combat with deckbuilding elements. Players roll and manage dice to trigger abilities, build powerful synergies through relics, and face increasingly challenging encounters.

Each run offers randomized events, enemies, and rewards, encouraging experimentation with different builds and strategies. Adapt to unpredictable outcomes, make strategic decisions, and shape your fate one roll at a time.

title: Pathogen: Code Omega
description: Survive on an island overrun by zombies, destroy infected nests with molotovs to collect samples, and signal for rescue before it’s too late.

title: Intelektronica
description: Fight duels to the death in diverse arenas, develop your character, get new weapons, return to your favorite arena, unlock all arenas.

title: Christmas Smash
description: Santa Claus embarks on a mission: defeat Krampus and his army of renegade elves. An explosive, action-packed adventure in a top-down shooter game.

title: Just Dying
description: A 2D action Roguelite where you play streamer parodies and die on purpose. Unlock characters, stack relics, snowball into a screen-clearing menace, then watch it all collapse in 30 seconds. Learn. Die again.

title: Add Flyers To Dreams
description: Would you like to run ads in dreams? “ADD FLYERS TO DREAMS” is a flappy roguelike game where you fly around inside dreams, inject ads, stack up contracts, and earn cookies.

title: Dungeon Killer
description: Dungeon Killer is a fast-paced boss rush shoot ’em up where you play as Astrid, a woman determined to bargain for her husband’s resurrection with the goddess of death herself. Armed with a minigun, you’ll descend into an infernal dungeon and face deadly, unsettling female enemies.

title: U.V.S. Nirmana
description:
U.V.S. Nirmana is an engineering puzzle game from Coincidence, the creators of Kaizen: A Factory Story and the inventors of the Zach-like.

Set off on the Unreturning Void Ship Nirmana as it continues a journey of uncountable eons toward the edge of the universe. Stop by distant worlds and ancient civilizations, helping them as part of your pilgrimage with your companions, the Renunciants.

title: Ice Age
description: As primitive human, in the wild Ice Age prehistoric world, Hunt and tame wild beasts such as mammoths and sabretooth, build homes, and survive.

title: Pemkie Island
description: Pemkie Island is monster taming RPG adventure, in a roguelite format. Travel across the 5 different regions while discovering and taming unique creatures called Pemkies. Master their traits, choose the right skills and build the best team possible to restore balance!

title: Dear Camy
description: Dear Camy is a 2D platform game. The player controls Camy who, with the help of various bonuses and power-ups, must collect all the diamonds in each level. When Camy finds all the diamonds, the next level is introduced. Along the way, the player must avoid or destroy the moving balls. All levels are played in a single-screen environment.

title: Camy 2: The Machine
description: Camy 2: The Machine is an singleplayer platform game developed and published by Gaimplay. It's the second title in a series of Camy games.

title: Find Cats in the Casino
description: Do you think you have good attention to detail? 12 cameras, 100 hidden cats and one shift to find them all.

title: Catx11
description: Catx11 is a short incremental game. Harvest crops, buy upgrades, hire cats, fight bosses, and level up your gear! Many different strategies and ways to play.

title: Shil
description: Shil is a mind-bending first-person puzzle game. A secret door into someone’s imagination. Unscrew your brains from every day logic. Shift your perspective, solve surreal puzzles, fight invisible enemies, explore the unimaginable. Beautiful. Bizarre. Barely logical.

title: Complexia: A Ballet of Blades
description: A manga-stylized, tactical, character action game, where you slash your sword in different directions to activate strings of customizable combos, taking down powerful enemies to save the world from a space cannon that is tearing the planet apart, with friends you make along the way.

title: Library Escape
description:
Library Escape is a 2D platformer set in a mysterious haunted library that appeared out of nowhere. A curious girl enters it to investigate, only to find herself trapped in a series of dangerous rooms filled with unique enemies.

Fight your way through each challenge and reach the CORE Book — the heart of the library — to destroy it from within and escape.

title: Holdfast: American Revolution
description: Fight for freedom in Holdfast: American Revolution - A multiplayer first and third-person shooter set during the American Revolutionary War. Charge into chaotically elegant battles with over 200 players per server!

title: Hyperdimension Neptunia Unlimited
description: Hyperdimension Neptunia ∞ (Unlimited) is an upcoming entry in the series where the world faces an apocalyptic loop triggered by a mysterious “meteorite.” As reality repeatedly resets, Neptune awakens alone in a white void and gains the power to “retry” fate itself. Alongside new allies, she must endure countless defeats, uncover the truth behind the cycle, and challenge the ultimate ending to save the world by venturing into a new spacetime.

title: Alpha Spectrum
description: Alpha Spectrum is a cyberpunk RPG set in a dystopian 2030, where a massive cyberattack pushes humanity into systemic collapse. You are a CIA agent with psionic abilities caught in the chaos. Shape an immersive storyline through choices guided by your playstyle and intuition.

title: Skatebound
description: An action-packed 2.5D skateboarding RPG with stats, progression, and skate spots galore

title: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 2.8 - New Eridan Sunset
description: The new version also introduces a brand-new attribute enemy and a new Vortex combat mechanic: When certain enemies are inflicted with the Wind Attribute Anomaly, applying other Attribute Anomalies will trigger Vortex instead of Disorder, dealing AoE Anomaly damage matching the corresponding element. This adds fresh strategic layers to team building. On new version events, "Marcel Bootopia" lets players control Eous to explore a Bangboo resort island temporarily closed due to an accompanying Hollow, rescuing trapped Bangboos and collecting treasures. Completing the event rewards Proxies with Booltergeist and its Bangboo core. This A-Rank Bangboo can hover in the air and fire lasers in combat, dealing increased damage when specific teammates are present. Other events include the "Ultimate Verdict Trial" where Proxies can fight alongside Promeia, as well as many other activities with their respective Polychrome rewards. The new outfit featuring the classic style of the Hoshimi family, Hoshimi Miyabi: Dignified Blossom, will also be available in the shop after the new version update. As for system optimizations, there will be a new Polychrome Guide feature that helps track limited-time rewards progress. Resource and storage management has also been optimized, with a new auto-delete function introduced.

title: The Wandering Her
description: Stitch delicate threads and solve gentle puzzles while restoring pieces of forgotten embroidery. As old photos, worn fabrics, and unfinished patterns resurface, uncover a quiet story of memories, family, and a secret hidden within the threads of time.

title: Agartha Platform 81!: City of Angels
description: "Agartha Platform 81! - City of Angels" is a roguelike TPS game where you journey through the underground city of Agartha, aiming for the ends of the world.

title: Killflow
description: Killflow is an insanely fast retro-FPS set in a stylish procedurally generating world. Destroy red psychopaths with destructive weapons to save yourself from getting corrupted, and get the high score.

title: HAE Stack
description: HAE Stack is a work-simulation puzzle game set in our current Surveillance Capitalist dystopia. Take on the role of [YOUR NAME], a newly hired Data Analytics Technical Associate at HAE Technologies Inc, one of the world's leading geolocation data brokers. Sell ads, solve crimes, share home addresses, deduce social networks, expose cheating spouses, track down "suspicious individuals", and more! Using HAE's proprietary operating system software (the "HAE Stack"), you have all the tools you need to perform your contractually mandated duties.

title: The End of Warriors
description: This is a strategy round rogue-like RPG. Random maps, random events, free teams, skill matches, and turn-based battles, where players will lead their teams to a magnificent revenge for the justice in their hearts!

title: My Goth Girl
description: Meet Lily! Your very own goth girl that ignores you while you work! For the very first time you can have someone to be lonely with together!

title: Blue Detective: A Hotel in Scarlet
description: As a gothic detective, you solve mysteries with your colorful sidekick. Everyone you meet in this bizarre world has a peculiar disease. A unique talent, or a mere curse? You must get to the bottom of it all. Investigate murders, search for clues and complete the puzzle.

title: Nothing at Stake
description: 7 days. A doomed world destined to be flattened. A cult escapee wanders in obscurity, cultivating the little community that remains. Despite history comprehended and otherworldly horror culled, there remains nothing at stake.

title: Infra Et Intus
description: Explore the hallways of long lost dungeon halls. Solve puzzles and face off against the monsters and horrors that await you below. Collect weapons, keys and secrets. Obsolete code. Forgotten protocols. A maze of questions. Your only option is escape.

title: Meow's Meow
description: Bring adorable chubby cats onto your monitor! Work, study, or enjoy videos and music with them by your side. Feed, pet, and play with toys while watching their lovely reactions. Check your to-dos and program usage time, and fill your daily life with cuteness!

title: Vossarium
description: Escape a twisted facility where reality bends around you. Sneak past The Guardian, use a camera with a reality shifting lens to break the laws of physics, befriend strange entities lurking inside, and uncover the dark truth of Mira Voss's life.

title: Flashes of Chaos
description: A fast-paced roguelike top-down shooter about building brutal guns. Collect ammunition cards, add modifiers, and load them into your weapon of choice to create your own unique experience of pure, adrenaline-fueled destruction.

title: River Drift
description: Paddle in sync or sink together. River Drift is a chaotic co-op rafting game where you and a friend fight wildlife, repair your raft mid-river, and survive deadly branching routes. Teamwork is optional, panic is guaranteed!

title: Hamster Mapster
description: A chaotic multiplayer local party game where adorable hamsters build their own arena and battle for the Golden Nut. Snap map pieces together, uncover surprises, and jump into fast-paced minigames full of laughter and chaos.

title: Win Over That Delinquent Guy!
description:
“Go! Win over that delinquent!”

A violent delinquent has transferred into your class. And your childhood friend encourages you to grow closer to him. Yeah, right! Is a sweet, lovey-dovey school rom-com really gonna happen to you?!

title: Two Types Pollos
description: Co-op management and survival simulator. Run your chicken shop, serve customers, and decorate while manufacturing "sugar" in the back. Fulfill orders to get the medicine that keeps you alive. Cook, manage, and survive alone or with a friend in this intense double life.

title: Warlode
description: Warlode is a next-generation MMORPG set in a dark fantasy universe, offering a highly optimized and visually enhanced gameplay experience. Built with modern performance standards, the game supports large-scale multiplayer environments and delivers fast-paced combat, strategic character progression, and immersive PvP systems. Warlode combines classic MMORPG mechanics with upgraded visuals, smooth performance, and a premium gameplay feel designed for today’s players.

title: Cursedom
description: A bizzare and broken game. This game was never finished and most of the team has disappeared from the internet.

title: I Am Better Than You
description: Prove you're better than the rest by popping balloons with household items! Control your helium-filled robot and make it clear who’s in charge. Wipe out your opponents and the friendship that binds you because only one can win.

title: Mermaid Life
description: Be born a mermaid and learn to live on land, or start as a human and uncover your true destiny. Work, socialize, explore, and customize your character while learning to balance life between two worlds. But beware! Your choices may bring blessings or curses, and the Sea Witch always demands a price.

title: Dungeon!: Order of the Raven
description: Dungeon!: Order of the Raven is a '90s FPS retro-inspired dungeon crawler that combines fast-paced action, treasure hunting, and strategic combat. As a brave adventurer, you'll descend into the depths of a treacherous dungeon, battling relentless waves of beasts and uncovering hidden treasures.

title: The Wizard of Gloss
description: The Wizard of Gloss is a PSX-style metroidvania game with horror elements. Grab your wand and prepare for a bloodbath.

title: Obscuris
description: Co-op horror for 1–6 players set in modern Japan. Play as Japanese high school girls, explore eerie locations (some procedurally generated), collect Obscure at night, meet deadly quotas, and escape before dawn. Customize your character. Story mode not yet available.

title: Dead Ahead: Roadside
description: Dive into a zombie apocalypse where humor meets survival in this quirky adventure RPG! Lead a band of unlikely heroes, make tough choices, and carve your path through a world where danger and dark humor collide. Shape your journey with decisions that alter alliances, endings, and the fate of your crew.

title: Pill After Pill
description: You’re a pill-dependent driver with paranoid schizophrenia, forced to escort a skeletal mafia boss across hostile territory. Your real enemy isn’t the gang chasing you — it’s the fear slowly consuming your mind. Drive, Shoot, Take Pill after Pill after Pill after Pill after Pill after Pill after...

title: Rocksowers
description: Rocksowers is a co-op survival sandbox with challenging bullet hell combat. Explore the surface on a moving base, scavenge for resources, craft and customize gear with many unique modules.

title: The Song Of Will
description: Arise and step into the whimsical, mysterious world of The Song Of WILL, a turn-based, story driven RPG that feels alive!

title: Till Death Rolls Us Apart
description: Till Death Rolls Us Apart is a roguelike dice battler where you collect new dice, stack powerful modifiers, and unleash huge combos in stylish, fast-paced duels.

title: Fallgrade
description: Bend gravity. Twist architecture. Survive the impossible. A first-person exploration game set in an analog concrete nightmare, where reality shifts around you and Karl waits for your next mistake.

title: Poco Loco
description:
Poco Loco is a chaotic racing game for Twitch and Kick streamers. Host your own races, stream them live, and let your viewers join the grid with their own vehicles. Fill the track with up to 500 racers, start the madness from your creator arena, and watch your community battle for XP, standings, and bragging rights.

Engage more with your viewers by turning chat into a full racing grid on your stream. Create a session, fill the lobby, launch the race, and crown the fastest legends when the finish flag drops!

Get ready for fast, furious, hilariously chaotic races for your viewers and you!

title: Everfront
description: Lead a nation through a roguelike strategy campaign where borders grow continuously. Choose your path, unlock technology and push the front.

title: Playrooms
description: Thousands of balls lie scattered across the Playrooms. Someone should put them back, and there's no one else here. Almost no one.

title: Grind X Grind
description: Grind X Grind is a dynamic arena shooter where players control Hiro, a slime on a quest to regain his human form. Battle through six arenas, using a variety of weapons like piercing shots, ricocheting attacks, and melee strikes. Upgrade gear, earn coins, and customize your playstyle!

title: Tire Fire Rally
description: Race through increasingly ridiculous and unsafe tracks as you fulfill your sponsor-inflicted contract at the Tire Fire Rally.

title: Delivery Driver Massacre: Definitive Edition
description: A late-night delivery turns into a PSX nightmare. Trapped in a house with a killer, you must solve puzzles and hide to survive. Multiple endings and authentic VHS visuals. Can you escape the rot?

title: The Old Flesh of Nuraga
description: First person psychological horror game about treasure hunting with Grandpa. Search among the sands of Nuraga to unearth what's driving him mad.

title: One Button Games 5-in-1 Vol. 6
description:
All 5 games are fast-paced and controlled with a single button.

Froooog. You are a frog trying to cross the road. Press a button to jump forward, hold a button to stick out your tongue and jump farther. Score points by going as far as you can while avoiding the moving cars.
The game is over when you get hit.

Snake 1. Play Snake with just one button. Collect coins to score points and to make the snake grow in size. Press a button to rotate 90 degrees. You rotate clockwise initially, but you reverse your direction every time you collect a coin.
The game is over when you hit any of the borders of the screen or the snake hits its tail.

Screen. Your screen is split into halves with enemies falling down on each side. Only one side of the screen is visible at a time. Your goal is to shoot the enemies to prevent them from going down. Press a button to shoot once the trajectory is right. You have 3 shots on each side and you switch sides once you shoot all 3 of them.
The game is over when any enemy on any side reaches the bottom of the screen.

Ball Tour. Your goal is to fly forward and avoid the spikes in the air. There are 2 types of spikes: a standing one, and a moving one. Hold any button to speed up. There are bonuses in the air which add score when you collect them. The score is added using a multiplier, which increases when you collect a bonus by 10 and decreases each second until reaches 1.
The game is over when you hit a spike.

Spearain. You are constantly running from side to side. Your goal is to avoid getting hit by the spears falling from the top. Hold a button to run faster and to slow down the spears. You score one point each time you bump into a wall and reverse your direction. Collect the falling coins to score additional points.
The game is over when you get hit by a spear.

title: Doki Doki: Amor Fati
description: Upon walking in on Sayori's suicide MC passes out, when he comes to he finds himself a week in the past. With his newfound knowledge he makes it his mission to save Sayori, however fate has other plans for him.

title: Green Mist Over Portland
description: A detective noir puzzle deduction game. Explore a non-linear timeline during the cold war on a globe-trotting adventure following a trail of spies from a quiet English harbour town to a frozen Finnish fishing village and the corridors of an intelligence service rotten at its core.

title: No Blink Allowed
description:
Train your timing skills to stop the clock close to zero, collect shards, and spend them on a massive skill tree in this short arcade-ish incremental game.
Struggle with glitching displays, hidden timers, chaotic multi-stops, and other hazards as you improve your accuracy.

title: TicTacToeTwo
description: A new version of tic-tac-toe, with 3 different bot levels for you to play, plus a mode to play against your friends

title: Train to Sachsenhausen
description:
Train to Sachsenhausen is a history-based game that relates the dramatic events tied to the closing of Czech universities in November 1939.

Through the game, you follow several days in the life of a student of medicine during demonstrations against the German occupation. The game covers the funeral of student leader Jan Opletal, arrests made at university dorms, detention at the Ruzyně prison, and afterwards deportation to the Sachsenhausen concentration camp in Germany.

title: Space Hauler
description: Space Hauler is a space flight sim set around Saturn's largest moon, Titan. Fly your spacecraft using realistic aerodynamics and orbital mechanics, take on contracts, and build your career as a pilot-for-hire.

title: The Last Letter
description: The Last Letter is a short VHS-style horror game about a film student who receives mysterious letters containing coordinates that lead to a house deep in the forest, where the truth about his past awaits.

title: Grain Rot
description: Grain Rot is a horror co-op extraction builder set in a scorched wasteland where everything burns. Descend with your friends into shifting ruins, rip out furniture, and scavenge for loot before the Corrupted close in. Make it back alive, then rebuild the Outpost to better your chances for the next run.

title: SCP: Containment Breach 2
description: A multiplayer horror experience set in an SCP Foundation facility during a containment breach. Players take on different roles such as Class-D personnel, scientists, guards, or SCP entities, navigating procedurally generated environments while surviving threats and interacting with others.

title: Indie Hoverboard Racing
description: An advenure racing game featuring colourful open worlds and racing on hoverboards. Single player and for all ages.

title: 101 Cats in Toronto
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Toronto landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick! ⏱️

title: Mogitate: Bearing Fruit
description: You're a spirited young man, ready to make the most of a new start! Meet the colorful cast of townsfolk and live your life to the fullest while making friends with all of the people around you!

title: Anthalia
description: Anthalia is a visual novel by Unknown Developer.

title: Antonio & Anfiloquio
description: Antonio & Anfiloquio is a slow first person horror with lots of visual novel DNA. A story about family secrets and rural mysticism.

title: Sky Up
description: Up to the clouds, fight for survival! Scavenge resources, build your aerial home layer by layer, and become self-sufficient through farming and husbandry to create your own sky sanctuary. Climb ever upward in search of the legendary "Pure Land" above the clouds.

title: Kage
description: Anime MEGABONK with friends. Unleash anime-style techniques — shout them to activate their true power! Fight hordes of enemies, hunt massive bosses, gather rare loot, and craft insane builds in a fast co-op action game for up to 4 players. Upgrade your village. Become a legend

title: L8ve
description: You really love your kid, but can you save her?

title: Mary Wants to Play
description:
Mary wants to play with you but what kind of game is that? Is it even a game ?

Control the poor little doll to her journey, in this house and help her to discover the truth behind everything... or maybe not, just let her to what she wants to do.

title: Hexcon
description: A puzzle game in the form of a single pixel image. You must infer the rules from the image presented and find the single correct solution that draws white and black lines to remove all the colored pixels, without breaking any of those rules.

title: Amazons vs Zombies
description: Lead a squad of elite Amazons in a post-apocalyptic tactical action RPG. Battle hordes of mutated weirdos, recruit and upgrade unique heroines, and uncover the truth behind Virus G in a story-driven survival adventure.

title: Say Goodbye to Your Balls!
description:
This is a horror visual novel that was made for the RPG Maker Horror Game Jam #15: Witching Hour.

It features multiple choices that will lead to different endings, as well as some navigation sections where you will be able to explore different areas.

title: Gambler's Fallacy
description: An isometric action roguelike with light deck building mechanics, set in a high-stakes western casino. Fight your way through rooms of cunning enemies, using strategic card play to escape the gamblers fallacy.

title: Blood Clicker
description:
Blood Clicker is a simple idle clicker game built around one goal: collect as much blood as possible.

Start with a single drop and build your way up by clicking, buying upgrades, and increasing your blood production. As your numbers grow, you will unlock stronger ways to earn more with every click and every second.

Whether you want to play actively or let the game build progress over time, Blood Clicker is designed to be easy to jump into and satisfying to keep growing.

title: Elegy of St. Godhrkar
description: Elegy of St. Godhrkar is an narrative-driven game with a multi-perspective POV system. By uncovering lies hidden within the tale, you gain the power to rewrite characters’ fates and shape the story’s outcome. Where stories lie, the answer waits for your eye.

title: EA Sports College Football 27
description: In EA SPORTS College Football 27, step into the modern era of college football, where personal ambition meets program pride. Balance expectations, identity, and everything Saturday demands while immersed in the iconic traditions and pageantry of game day.

title: Babysitting Is Murder
description:
It's your average Friday night in October, with Sharol enjoying her evening reading scary stories while enjoying junk food. But hark, Mrs. Calamine calls and needs you to keep an eye on little Suzie, as Granny is having a medical emergency. Given the situation, Sharol readily agrees to the emergency job.

However, fate has other plans in store, but at the end of it all a job will still need to be done. It'll be up to the player to see how it all works out in Babysitting is Murder!

title: Summon a Sweetheart
description:
‘Summon a Sweetheart’ is a short visual novel-esque game, about a depressed loser named Penelope. She gets so lonely… that she summons an eldritch monster to be her girlfriend. Unfortunately, she didn’t read the fine print. She needs a gift, and she needs one fast! Surely, her depression cave of a room should have something, right? I’m sure this won’t go wrong at all!

In other words: give the monster lady gifts that suck, and have cruel and unusual things happen to you as a result.

title: Sexual Void
description:
Nothing in here, except Vicky, sexy outfits and a JOI game.

Sexual void includes full nudity and a JOI (Jerk off instruction) game, so you have to follow Vicky's commands in real life and , if you get to the end, you may have an happy ending.

title: Snuff Puppy Shelter
description:
Bad dogs go down the drain
This one is for the girlies

CW: Allusions to snuff, suicide and other similarly intense topics. Nothing graphic though.

title: The Good Dog: Chasing Shadows
description: In The Good Dog: Chasing Shadows, play as a dog defending your family from paranormal creatures. Explore the world and solve environmental puzzles to save your loved ones and uncover the mystery.

title: Cloudrooms
description: You are trapped in a corridor suspended above the clouds. At the end lies a door. Explore the ever-changing environment each time you open it, find anomalies, use the alarm, and break the loop.

title: Paradise Loop
description:
Paradise Loop is a visual novel set within a killing game structure. Twelve strangers wake up in a mysterious hotel called Pandora’s Box with no memory of how they got there, or even who they fully are. Their only instruction comes from a mysterious entity known as the Benefactor: “explore.” However, for two amongst their number, a different purpose is in store.

The player selects one of four characters to play as, with each offering a unique perspective on the same series of events. Depending on the character you choose, you may find yourself as the one doing the killing. For this reason, while the story centers on the 'whodunit' mystery, the actual gameplay focuses on the character drama as you build relationships and keep secrets from the other guests. Each of the four paths is about five hours long, with the choices you make creating a slightly different story each time.

title: Les Schtroumpfs Sauvent la Nature
description: The situation is dire! Every day, storms, tempests, hurricanes, and other severe weather strike the little Smurf village. Where is Mother Nature? The wicked Gargamel has given her a nasty flu. The child will need to use skill and observation to outwit Gargamel's traps and find a cure for Mother Nature's flu.

title: Divider Dave
description:
Why be alone when you can be by yourself?
Dave wakes up in a facility. He can clone himself. A lot of (almost) identical Daves and a way out that requires all of them.

Divider Dave is a slapstick puzzle-platformer for puzzle fans and casual players alike where cloning yourself is the solution to everything. Launch your clones, stack them, turn them into boxes. Every copy of Dave is a tool, a platform, and a potential sacrifice. He doesn't mind. Probably...

title: Ball X Pit: The Shadow Update
description: The Shadow Update is available free for everyone who owns the game, and brings with it 2 new characters, 11 new balls, and a whole lot more besides.

title: HyphoSphere
description: HyphoSphere is a fungal idle game where you build a mycelial empire from a single filament to a cosmic singularity. Players click to harvest nutrients, construct living organisms, and watch their network spread across the planet and beyond.

title: The Freeblades
description: The Freeblades is a Multiplayer Co-Op, Dungeon-Adventure RPG set in a gritty, low-fantasy Medieval world ruled by noble houses, magical cults, and tribal monsters.

title: Tsumamigui 3
description:
A censored port of Tsumamigui 3.
That bittersweet memory in his heart, never fading away— Akihito Natsuki, forced by company circumstances to take a long leave, decides to return to his hometown.

title: Wuthering Waves: Reverbs From the End of Galaxies
description:
Version 3.3 of Wuthering Waves includes:
• New characters: Hiyuki and Denia
• New region: Dimmr Deep, Sealed Fissure, Silent Crag and Solisia Landing
• New story quests
And more...

title: Dead by Daylight: Observation Experiment
description:
Use surveillance cameras to report anomalies and survive until 6 AM.

"Dead by Daylight: Observation Experiment" is a DBD-themed fangame made by Kyto, a DBD Content Creator, and is NOT associated with BHVR Interactive. This game is heavily inspired by the I'm on Observation Duty series as well as Alternate Watch.

There are plenty of secrets hidden throughout this game, so keep an eye out for that! Many ciphers, codes, bits of lore, and more :)

title: The Soul Inside Us
description: In the midst of dark secrets and deadly dangers, do you have the courage to survive and thwart the spirit's plans? Embark on this thrilling adventure with The Soul Inside Us and push your limits!

title: Board Forge
description: Board Forge is a creative board game experience where you design, build, and play your own custom game boards. Place trivia questions, movement traps, and player swap tiles, then challenge friends in local or online multiplayer matches through Steam.

title: Offbeat
description: OFFBEAT is a music-tycoon game where you build the recording studio of your dreams. Collect and upgrade increasingly strange musical objects, complete jobs for cash, and record real, actual music.

title: Clockwork Blackout
description: A megacorporation dominates the city with steam-powered factories and intricate machinery. Rumors suggest the company is secretly developing mutant creatures. The player takes on the role of a lone hacker who must infiltrate the corporation’s headquarters, steal digital evidence, and escape unharmed to expose the truth to the world.

title: Bravion
description: Bravion is a colorful 3D platform adventure where players step into the role of a young hero determined to save his kingdom from a growing monster invasion.

title: King Slime in Cashtle
description: King Slime in Cashtle is a precision 2D platformer where you play as the ruler of the slime kingdom on a very important mission: collect every last tax coin left behind in your own castle. Jump, dodge, and maneuver through dangerous castle biomes filled with traps, challenges, and tight platforming sequences.

title: Hidden Cats in Barcelona
description: Explore Barcelona, with plenty of cats and characters. Enjoy a relaxing, cozy journey—now with bonus stages featuring a new progressive colorization effect that gradually reveals the map’s colors as you play.

title: Anti Terrorist Shooting Game
