description: Join elite forces in this fast-paced anti-terrorist FPS. Engage in tactical gunfights, master a variety of weapons, and outsmart enemy squads in immersive multiplayer battles. Your skills, reflexes, and strategy will be crucial for survival and victory!

title: Throne Requiem
description: Embark on a dark, brutal quest in this first-person, party-based dungeon crawler. Choose from 50 classes to form your 6-member team and conquer the Dark Tower, or recruit monsters in tamer mode. Every decision matters in this medieval world where insanity and death are commonplace. Will you survive?

title: Easter Bunny EggVenture
description: Get ready to hop into a world of festive fun with Easter Bunny EggVenture, the egg‑citing spot the difference challenge bursting with springtime charm! Each level presents two cheerful Easter scenes filled with bunnies, baskets, and brightly patterned eggs that seem identical at first glance… but look again. Hidden among the pastel colors and playful details are clever differences waiting to be discovered.

title: Business Empire
description: Business Empire is a board game that tests your strategic thinking and trading skills. Players buy, develop, and acquire opponents' properties to build their business empires. With chance cards, the game can change at any moment! Outsmart your rivals and become the ultimate investor!

title: Gain Tiles Match: Trading Dilemma
description: Innovative three-elimination game with hard core. With the cost and benefit mechanism added to the game, everything is no longer easy. You need to consider the increasingly meager profits, formulate and adjust the game strategy, and try to make yourself go further.

title: FoxWolf Saga
description: FoxWolf Saga is a 2D platformer where players alternate control between two contrasting heroes: a nimble Fox and a powerful Wolf. The Wolf can perform a devastating dash that destroys enemies and obstacles while granting brief invincibility, while the Fox uses agility and a double jump to reach areas the Wolf cannot.

title: Save My Wife
description: Save My Wife is a 2D platformer focused on agility and precision. The hero's peace is shattered when the fearsome Black Wizard kidnaps his wife in the blink of an eye. Wielding his trusty sword, he must traverse perilous environments and overcome dynamic challenges to face the villain and bring his love back home.

title: Armory Simulator
description: Build, manage, and expand your very own armory, catering to cowboys, bounty hunters, and outlaws in search of the finest gear.

title: Necrotel: No Checkout
description: Necrotel: No Checkout is a unique management and crafting simulator set within the walls of a grim, gothic hotel. You play as an underground surgeon managing a getaway for eccentric nobles and monsters to fund your forbidden necromantic experiments.

title: Necro Survivors
description: Necro Survivors is a dark fantasy survivorlike action roguelite where players fight waves of monsters, upgrade their character, unlock abilities, and create powerful builds during fast, replayable runs.

title: Medieval Market Simulator
description:
Run your medieval shop: strike deals, trade rare and magical goods, and manage your business like a true master.
Turn it into the richest store, known across the entire kingdom.

title: Terry's Terraforming
description: In Terry's Terraforming, your job is to transform dying planets and make them fit for new life. Meet an intergalactic cast of quirky aliens, reshape and rejuvenate worn-out worlds, and discover a charming sci-fi story – all while keeping the shareholders happy.

title: Sock Puppet Superstar
description: Control a singing sock puppet with your hand in VR. Perform solos or two-handed duets, unlock ridiculous voices and accessories, and put on the greatest sock concert of all time.

title: Hey! Shopkeeper!
description: Hey! Shopkeeper! Is a shop-keeping Life Sim in a world inspired by all our favorite RPGs! Collect goodies to sell, befriend the locals to gain their aid and renovate your run down shop before it's too late! A comedic, slow paced slice of life story awaits!

title: Pokemon Luminous Lands
description: A Pokemon game taking place in the region of Fabio with loads of Fakemon, Pokemon and a corporation to defeat for the good of existence

title: Ore & Odds
description:
Ore & Odds is an incremental game about extracting minerals and watching numbers spiral out of control. Every mineral you collect can be spent on upgrades or bet on the slot machine.

Your luck matters! Combine minerals and increase your chances of winning. Sometimes you win big. Sometimes… not so much.

title: Body Hiding Simulator
description: Play as the happy housewife in a quiet home. Except tonight, your husband is hosting his noisy friends for a dinner party! Not so happy a housewife after all...

title: Alaryia
description: "Alaryia" is a story that follows the life of a rising Hero. An empire of Mystics falls to madness, monsters, and the chaos of the deep. Survive the Arena and prove the Mystics are not gone. Who will you become?

title: Monster Ops 13
description: FREE Season 2 Premiere of Monster Ops! Black Ops soldiers Wraith and Tide know the world is against them, and they can only rely on each other. Two soldiers, forced to go rogue, with a desperate mission. There's no one left they can trust. A NSFW Gay Visual Novel Romance Put out in Monthly Episodes!

title: Anime Friends
description: Upcoming life sim with flying dragons and a farming system. Meet new friends, start your farm, ride on dragons and get new adventures in flying islands in the world of Anime Friends! Be ready and explore a new sim world!

title: Monster Ops 17
description: Season 2 of Monster Ops! Black Ops soldiers Wraith and Tide know the world is against them, and they can only rely on each other. Two soldiers, forced to go rogue, with a desperate mission. There's no one left they can trust. A NSFW Gay Visual Novel Dating Sim put out in Monthly Episodes!

title: Goon Company
description: Hired by the local Super Villain, you and your fellow Goons are meant to rob local banks and steal from Super Heroes in Golden City.

title: IntraTag
description: A quick first-person online multiplayer game, where you catch other players in a randomly generated maze. You are chasing some players and chased yourself by others. Catching someone means you get half their points and they get your tag - nobody dies in this unique game.

title: Crisis of Dreamcell
description: After an outbreak of deadly experimental creatures, you are trapped within DreamCell. Fight your way out of this nightmarish facility while keeping an eye on your own condition and supplies in this cinematic third-person survival horror game.

title: Parabellum: Artifacts of War
description: Parabellum: Artifacts of War is a historical First Person Shooter where you collect artifacts for your museum and experience the battles of the past!

title: Assetto Corsa Evoluzione
description: Assetto Corsa Evoluzione is a Gran Turismo-style racing career game built on the Unity engine, integrating with Asseto Corsa for the races. Players will progress through various championships, earning money and expanding their car catalogue along the way.

title: Variator
description: Variator is a new 2.5D shoot 'em up that's all about blowing up enemies and grazing bullets! Playable both as a fun blaster and as an advanced high-scoring game, the game features approachable difficulty and scoring mechanics that are easy to understand yet reveal more depth the more you play.

title: Eco Balance
description: The object is to keep a balance of O2 and CO2 in your world as you build it.

title: Deckadent
description: Deckadent is a top-down deck building RPG with several quests, bosses, enemies, and various locations to explore. You play as a hero, chosen by the God of the Cards to drive out the Deckay from the other fallen gods.

title: Restlos
description: Join a hardcore action tower defense game where your character is your main strength! But don't forget about your allies and towers!

title: Winhack 95
description: Build a malware empire from a 90s PC. Code viruses, automate systems, take darknet contracts and also deploy them. Generate endless income to fund a shadow organization’s classified research in this hacker idle-clicker.

description: A short incremental physics game. Swing a wrecking ball to smash monsters before they reach your home! Upgrade your ball and your home for more smashy goodness!

description: A cyber‑worm engine roaring through a deadly maze. Guide a growing creature through tight corridors and sometimes face bosses using mouse, controller, or keyboard ...or let an AI Agent take over control.

description: Renting a small shop and opening a barber shop, Vito meets a woman who works alone next to his shop and he feels like he's falling in love with her, but... is she okay?

description: You've been reassigned! The head of Hitler's SS, Heinrich Himmler, has sent a team in Northern Egypt, and you're off to find out why! Grab your gear and experience the legendary console-exclusive prologue to Return to Castle Wolfenstein, on PC for the first time in over two decades.

description: A "travelling game" in which a turtlekin wanders alone through a drying seabed, managing their FEET, HEAT, MEAT, and FEAR as they go.

title: Nightmaze
description: Explore the surreal world of the dream and navigate the deep caverns of broken minds. Beneath weird and horrific visions are lost souls wandering the maze; help them confront their reality and escape from the Nightmaze

title: At Night: Haunted Ride
description: The grand opening of the Haunted Mine Ride is tomorrow. Tonight, you run the final test rides. Ride the minecart, Fix props, repeat rides and don’t make "them" notice you.

title: Cold Snap
description:
Fast-paced multiplayer arena where snowballs turn into chaos.
Fight in intense up to 4v4 matches where every hit matters. Stun your enemies, knock them out, and fight to be the last team standing.

title: Escape Cataclysm
description:
An escape room at the end of the world.

Explore, interact and solve puzzles to escape and survive an imminent cataclysm.

And once you have done that, give speed running a shot and enable the builtin timer.

title: System Says Normal
description: Monitor. Report. Do not question. The system will flag what matters. Everything else is within acceptable parameters. If something feels wrong, it probably isn't. The last operator felt the same way. For a while... Please proceed.

title: Botlings
description:
A factory automation game where workers become buildings and develop sentience.
Lead a swarm of mindless robots in a factory automation game where your workers are also your machines.
Direct your forward-walking robots through turners, splitters and bridges, transform them into production buildings, have them transport your resources, and design ever-growing production networks in all 3 dimensions. In Botlings, every robot is a resource: guide them to work, reroute their paths, or sacrifice them to construct the infrastructure your factory needs.
But be wary, the more your factory grows, the more unpredictable your workforce becomes.

title: Stellaris: Season 10
description: The Stellaris: Season 10 Expansion pass is a journey through resilience and movement. Whether you are wandering the stars with Stellaris: Nomads or rooting your empire in the indomitable spirit of Stellaris: Willpower, this year redefines how empires survive, adapt, and conquer.

title: Loonyland 2: Winter Woods - Collector's Edition
description: After vanquishing the Evilizer in Halloween Hill, Loony found himself traveling north in search of the Happy Stick Witch, following an ever-diminishing trail of clues. Eventually, he became lost in a blizzard and collapsed, only to wake up in the care of a friendly villager in Winter Woods. Now his quest takes him up high cliffs and even down into the depths of the earth, all in search of the mysterious truth behind Happy Stick. Unfortunately, Winter Woods seems to have its own huge set of problems to distract him along the way...

description: Sinner Maker allows you to create up to 100 characters and simulate a society built around them. Construct homes, manage their needs, and watch as they fall in love, form friendships, and even become enemies. Manage resources and solve emerging problems if you want your soul to be saved.

66 is a brutal multiplayer dinosaur survival game where you hunt, grow, hide, migrate, and fight your way through a prehistoric ecosystem where every mistake can be fatal.

description: Take control of your own pharmacy and manage it from the ground up! Purchase medicines, vitamins, and baby food, arrange products on the shelves, and set prices. description: Build your dream railway. Lay tracks, design stations, decorate every detail - then put your network to the test delivering cargo and passengers across maps you created yourself.

description:
A slot-machine roguelike built on dirty tricks.
Rig the reels and escape a cursed amusement park, before it takes your soul.

description: Fishing Master is an idle fishing, collecting, and nurturing game. You can fish through [online/offline] idle mode, earning substantial funds to purchase various items. You can also exchange items with other players via the in-game marketplace.

Craft arrows from the environment to survive, uncover lost secrets of an ancient world, and push forward through the shadows into hope. Will you find your way, or will the dark consume you?

description: Click your way through this incremental game to become the WORLD'S GREATEST AUTHOR!

title: European Logistics Tycoon
description:
European Logistics Tycoon is a business simulation where you build and expand your own logistics company. Start small, secure your first contracts, and grow step by step into a company operating across Europe.

Plan deliveries between real European cities, calculate costs, optimize routes and decide when expansion makes sense. Vehicles, staff and locations must be managed efficiently. Every decision impacts profit, reputation and long-term success.

title: Dr. Durge's Dental Clinic
description: A ray-shrunk mole dentist explores inside mouths to fix dental problems, upgrade tools, and grow the clinic in this single-player dental simulation game, with a full release planned for the second half of 2026.

title: 7 Trials
description: A stylish action roguelite in a twisted afterlife. Contracted by an underworld corporation, explore regions consumed by the liminal realm and guide lost souls to judgment. Combine Spells, Offerings, and Fates to forge your own combat build; face deeper challenges in 4-player co-op.

title: Senior Survival Club
description: In a zombie apocalypse, a grandmother takes a chainsaw to find her grandson. Defeat slow, persistent zombies, collect gear, and strengthen with exercise. Advance through ever-stronger hordes, reclaiming youthful power in this survival action game.

title: Dracula: The Disciple
description: To cheat death, you must uncover the secrets hidden within Count Draculas castle. Only by mastering the occult arts and solving mystical puzzles can you save yourself. Eternal life comes at a price!

Uncover what led to the abandoning of the once luxurious Whiteroot Hotel. Local myth tells of a wrathful spirit known as the Crimson Stag…

title: GreedFall: The Dying World - Peren's Black Mass

description: A dark sci-fi CRPG featuring survival mechanics, tactical combat, and exploration through a procedurally generated underground facility.

description: An old-school MMORPG featuring multiple NPC factions vying for control over territory. Explore the chaotic frontier of Zagros and fight in tactical turn-based battles with other players and NPC allies. Build your own character and fight against enemy factions to gain loot, EXP, and power.

description: A retro shooter game inspired by an old TV show. You play as a part of the resistance movement fighting the German occupation in a set of explosive missions while experiencing an exciting story.

title: Lost in Night
description: Build a beautiful town in the amazing Match 3 game, Lost in Night! Earn gold to purchase a pumpkin house, circus, and many other fabulous upgrades. Complete hundreds of different levels by destroying the marble plaques in 3 different gameplay modes, swap, chain, and group.

title: Atomix
description: Atomix is a single player Arcade style First Person Shooter where you get to pilot mechanical suits across a unique Sci-Fi world.

title: Punch, Rest, Repeat
description: Punch, Rest, Repeat is a cozy idle boxing game that sits at the bottom of your screen. Play while working, studying, or relaxing. Train and get stronger. Win matches, earn rewards. Rest well. So you can train even harder next time. Punch. Rest. Repeat.

description: Runback is a platform fighter where losing is far from the end, with every round giving you power ups to choose from! With over 200 custom cards, every game is a unique experience.

title: The Meter is Running
description: You inherited a taxi dispatch business but it came with debt attached. Hire drivers, dispatch fares, navigate Istanbul’s chaos, deal with bad customers and worse luck. You have 15 days to pay it off or lose everything. The meter is running.

title: Two Point Museum: Arty-Facts
description:
Now hiring for Art Experts to re-establish and re-imagine ‘Art’ for Two Point County in a brand new museum location: Undee Docks!

As our new resident Art Expert, you won’t just be in charge of standing around looking pensive (although that is 70% of the role), you’ll also be responsible for establishing a brand new Art Studio in the museum, creating new works to evoke a broad range of emotions in guests to the museum gallery… a gallery-um as it were!

title: Curio Shop
description: Buy mysterious (possibly cursed) goods from the dark web by night, then sell them in your curio shop by day. Balance profit against consequence and assemble an artifact capable of causing the apocalypse. All in a day’s work.

title: GregTech: New Horizons
description: GT New Horizons (GTNH) is a Minecraft 1.7.10 modpack maintained and supported by dedicated community members just like you! With over 11 years in development, GTNH offers a carefully balanced and immersive experience to challenge players as they climb through the 15 tiers of technology. The ultimate goal of GTNH is to build the Stargate, an interdimensional teleporter and the symbol for absolute prestige, aptitude, and determination.

title: Sky Abyss
description: This is a high-difficulty jump action game where you overcome a variety of gimmicks using just three simple actions: forward jump, vertical jump, and movement! Through trial and error, aim to reach the top of the tower!

title: Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2
description: This is a fight for survival. Xenomorphs swarm in overwhelming numbers. Every room could be your last.

title: Duelist: Idle Expedition
description: Build your elite team in Duelist: Idle Expedition, the idle auto-battler that lives on your taskbar. Recruit from a pool of 90+ JRPG pixel-art roles and lead your traveling camp to victory against all the powerful Guilds on the Continent. Your epic journey continues even when you are busy!

title: Half Life is Strange
description: Half-Life is Strange lets you play Half-Life as the queen of spacetime herself and use her rewind powers.

title: Comune 0-41
description: Comune 0-41 is a first-person life sim in which the player takes on the role of an Italian Secret Service agent tasked with investigating strange phenomena in a remote mountain village.

title: Bride Of The Abyss
description:
Ayana was a lonely girl living in a fishing village. One day, she was sent as a sacrifice to another village — one infamous for the many suspicious rumors surrounding it. However, it turns out the village chief, Ether, actually wants her to become his bride!

Will she marry him or run away? You have three days to define her fate.

title: Loophole: Skrattmagi och glädjetjuvar
description:
Loophole was originally an interactive television game similar to the Hugo series where players phoned in and competed live in a Swedish children TV show. This home computer version features the same world and characters but has completely different gameplay. Unlike the arcade action gameplay of the TV game this version is more similar to a point-and-click adventure game. It is played entirely with mouse and the world of Loophole is presented through a combination of 3D models and pre-rendered backgrounds.

The game takes place in the town of Broomfrost which is threatened by the ghost general Boogiboo who has cast a curse on it. This causes the citizens to become grumpy and easily irritated and if the curse is not broken they will turn into ghost nibblings which in turn will spread the irritation to more people. The only person that can stop this is Yuma, a young magician apprentice who the player has to navigate through the town, meet the inhabitants and do their errands.

Upon completing an errand, which usually involves finding and bringing back a certain item, the citizen will be cured. Time is limited though since the people will get increasingly irritated until they turn into ghost nibblers. Citizens that have turned can only be saved with the use of laughter magic but this comes in limited supply and can only be recharged by collecting certain green plants.

To win the game the player simply has to save a certain number of people, which depends on the difficulty level chosen. At the same time the game can be lost if too many people turn into ghost nibblings. In addition to the citizens there are also visitors arriving at the space harbour that the player has to help get to the right locations. These are also affected by the curse and are considered saved when they reach their destinations.

title: Split Happens
description: Manage an old, rundown nuclear power plant with up to 6 friends in online co-op. Fix hazards before you put the reactor in critical condition, manage the chaos to avoid a meltdown, and try not to get in the way of your coworkers.

title: Up ' N ' Up: Mountain Express
description:
Deliver mail up the side of a mountain upgrading your 4WD as you go.
Like an arcade Mudrunners with a roguelike twist.

title: Hawker
description: Hawker is a Roguelite Action-RPG where you must pay or evade a debt to Death in a procedurally-generated grimdark world. Scavenge, barter and fight for ichor, life, and truth. Thirty days, an impossible debt. Pay, or Fall.

title: Roomspeed
description: Challenge yourself and other players in a daily gauntlet! Put your platforming skills to the test and come out on top against in this addictive daily platforming challenge!

title: Management in Space
description: Management In Space is a gritty sci-fi strategy roguelite where you find yourself in debt. Build, mine, trade, and defend using stations across the galaxy, all while wars swells, aliens devastate sectors, and cults rip the galaxy apart & release interdimensional demons upon the universe.

title: Kromex
description: Conquer. Control. Dominate. A fast-paced, competitive territory game where every tile you claim brings you closer to victory, and every second of inattention can turn the tide completely.

title: Veriventure
description: Craft intricate levels from a variety of pieces to create traps, puzzles and combat. Play through the story, access online levels, or make and share your own in this 3D dungeon maker.

title: Temple Maker 64
description: Temple Maker 64 is a third-person dungeon creator. Build dungeons full of traps and puzzles, or grab your sword and explore community-made dungeons. Choose from a vast selection of items, monsters, puzzle elements, and bosses, all wrapped up in an N64-inspired love letter.

title: Dusk Park
description: An exploration adventure game where you search for a way to escape a building that traps you at dusk.

title: One More Trail
description: As the last Australian cowboy in the American Frontier, choose your path through the dying light of the wild west. Muster one last herd across the frontier, plot your own course, forming connections with a cast of colourful characters, finding their own answers to the end of the world you all know.

title: The Dream Machine: The Definitive Edition
description:
The Dream Machine is an award-winning point & click adventure about exploring other people’s dreams.

Delve into surreal, hand-crafted worlds built from real physical materials as you uncover the secrets of a strange apartment building — and the people who live there.

The Definitive Edition includes all chapters, a reworked back half, new locations, and improved sound and visuals.

title: Landmaster
description: Landmaster is a cozy pixel RPG about survival, crafting, and building in a magical world that doesn’t always play nice. Explore, create, and fight to keep your Kingdom alive.

title: Unknown Space
description: The Darkness Guild is lost in Unknown Space! Go on a top down, bite-sized adventure and blast off to three far out planets. Explore Unknown Space from your ship and collect resources to change the ship's look for the climactic Shoot 'Em Up battle! Do you have what it takes escape from Unknown Space?

title: Letterally
description: Letterally is a deck-building roguelike where you craft words and your deck of letter tiles. Build powerful synergies, collect game-breaking items, and outsmart rule-bending bosses in this turn-based strategic word game.

title: BongBongCapy
description: The super cute capybara will stay with you. Every time you tap the keyboard or click the mouse, it'll mimic the same taps to accumulate merit points. Merit lets you randomly draw diverse looks to switch freely. Don't hesitate—add a super versatile capybara to your desktop now!

title: Bunny's Lie
description: Bunny's Lie is a real-time card game based on a moon rabbit in a Korean myth. Your luck doesn't matter in this match. You can win even if you don't have a good hand, if you just have wits and bluffing. Enjoy a fierce battle under the moonlight, with the cute bunnies. (ENG ver will be updated later.)

title: We Are Prophet
description: We Are Prophet is a free fast-paced real time multiplayer game for two players. Ideal to have a quick tournament among friends, on gaming festivals or LANs.

title: Iron Legacy
description: Master the grind in Iron Legacy, a nostalgic 2D Action RPG inspired by the classics. Hunt hordes of monsters, master powerful spells, and push your limits with a deep Reset system. Whether solo or in co-op, forge your legacy through blood, loot, and infinite progression. Become a Legend!

title: Mesudoku
description: A game about Sudoku—it's okay to fail. Through the story, players are guided step by step into the world of Sudoku.

title: Karless
description: A factory automation game where you build vehicle production lines to reconnect a shattered post-apocalyptic continent. Mine raw resources, research new technologies, and build vehicle supply chains — ship them out to reconnect the severed regions of Aris.

title: Super Scoundrel Solitaire
description: A solitaire card game with a dungeon theme. Can you make it to the end?

title: Card Trainer
description: A simple but hard card game where you collect unique unit cards and use them to rummage through stages looking for new cards.

title: The Call Button
description: It's a psychologial observation-based horror thriller. Every day you wake up in a hospital bedroom. You notice anomalies? Take your pills. You think it's safe? Use the call button. But survive long enough, and you must face your interactive nightmares...

title: The Deepest Castle
description: You are a mighty knight - how powerful your blows are! And in the very center of a vast forest lies a fortress filled with evil and black magic. There, they raise the dead and hide great artifacts. You decide to explore the fortress and see what the black magicians are hiding.

title: 101 Cats in Hanoi
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Hanoi landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Resident Evil Requiem: Leon Must Die Forever
description:
Leon Must Die Forever is a minigame for Resident Evil Requiem. It was released as a free update DLC on May 8, 2026 on the PlayStation 5, PC and Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2.

The mini-game can be found in Extra Games, once the player finished Requiem's main campaign.

title: Genshin Impact: Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana
description:
Version "Luna VII" of Genshin Impact, also known as "Song of the Welkin Moon: Andante". This update includes:
• New character: Nicole, Lohen and Prune
• New story quests for Lohen
• New main story quests: "As All Falls to Emptiness" and "Of Myriad Paths, Flux, and Dissolution"
• New main event: Phantasmal Pals
• New updates for Miliastra Wonderland
• New QoL, and more!

title: An Altered State
description: A psychological horror visual novel where your choices shape the mind of a teenager with schizophrenia as he investigates a murder at summer camp.

title: Cozy Liora
description: Open your journal, pour your coffee, your little cat is already there. While Lo-Fi sounds drift into your room, your plants grow, your moments gather into a small world of their own. Here, time flows slowly, every line belongs to you. Did you forget that peace could be this simple?

title: The Dreams in the Peacock House
description: Wake up from a never-ending slumber and find your lost dreams in the shadows of the Peacock House.

title: Chesst
description: A fantasy chess variant. An enchanted board where pawns hide magical secrets. Hatch dragons, transform enemy pieces into unicorns. Outwit clever computer opponents: Jester, Bard, or Wizard —or pass and play. Beginner-friendly to deliciously strategic. Handcrafted pixel art. Local gameplay, so retro!

title: VertalStrike
description:
Vertal Strike is a fast-paced multiplayer FPS built around momentum, clean sightlines, and aggressive map control. Queue into online matches, host your own room, or fill the server with bots to keep the pressure on while you practice routes, recoil, and reactions.

Every map is designed for readable fights and constant decisions. Hold angles, snap between cover, rotate with your squad, and punish over-extensions before the next push starts. The low-poly presentation keeps combat clear while bold effects and distinct spaces make every firefight easy to read.

title: Soma Spirits
description: The world of Soma Spirits is divided into two similar, but distinct versions of one another. At certain locations, you will be able to switch between the two worlds and find different inhabitants, monsters, and clues on how to proceed forward.

title: Pour Boy and the Nitro Necromancer
description: A wholesome spooky, highly caffeinated 2D platformer hand-drawn and developed by a real coffee shop owner. Play as Pour Boy, a demitasse homunculus, and punch through undead mugs, discover ancient secrets of the Brew Cycle, collect lost pet flies, and survive before the moon swallows you up.

title: Exipath
description: A survival horror game about liminality and depersonalization, telling the story of Scarlett Shinohara as she descends into warped recollections of her past in order to uncover her own future. Navigate treacherous rooms through in-between time while avoiding the nightmares of days gone by.

title: Femdom Overtime
description: A femdom story where you spend a day with Nanami, your big-breasted, sadistic co-worker, brought to life with fully animated NSFW scenes.

title: BeastLink
description: BeastLink is a giant multiplayer Kaiju experience where humans, vehicles, and colossal Beasts collide in urban environments at unprecedented scale where absolutely everything you see can be destroyed. Build your Link and unleash your power before it consumes you!

title: Valentine's Day Bikini Femdom
description: Spend Valentine’s Day with Hinako, your big-breasted childhood friend turned girlfriend, as she showers you with her sadistic love.

title: Chris's Classroom
description: Chris's Classroom is a comedic indie horror game where players must collect Stress Toys while avoiding Chris and his friends.

title: Dawgs: The Revenge
description: Dawgs: The Revenge is an unhinged, genre-bending physics sandbox of pure chaotic action. You play as a highly customizable, aggressively squishy ball of fury on a quest for absolute vengeance. What starts as a simple mission escalates into a multi-genre fever dream!

title: Primordio
description: Survive the void. Control a wisp of pure energy in this roguelike bullet-hell survival game. Chain lightning through swarms of primordial entities, level up with powerful upgrades, and fight to stay alive long enough to learn the secrets of... PRIMORDIO

title: Elecade
description: Strike down rampaging machines with chain lightning. Elecade is a 1-bit action game with incremental upgrades, where you power up and climb to the top of a space facility.

title: The Birth Cry
description: Mikhail Markov, lives in the city of Nesgrad in Virelia in the 1990s. The city's old maternity hospital, "Riverside Maternity Hospital," has been closed, and many stories and paranormal claims circulate among the public about its whereabouts.

title: Blueblood Arena
description: An indie fighting game with simple controls and anthropomorphic characters. Developed by the same dev as Among Us Arena.

title: Forgotten Records
description: What would you do if you were stuck in an ancient shrine filled with creatures unknown to reality? Forgotten Records is a romance visual novel set in the modern world, where the protagonist wanders into the wrong shrine at the wrong time and has to escape.

title: Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter: Glasses Set A
description:
A DLC exclusive attachment item set that lets characters equip glasses. Several different glasses designs are included. Contains the following cosmetic items:
- Sky Blue Glasses x8
- Rich Gold Sunglasses x8
- Steampunk Glasses x8

title: Gloomvex
description:
Gloomvex is a dark sci-fi arena roguelite about surviving relentless enemy waves on a hostile alien world.

Fight your way through increasingly dangerous runs, collect gold and experience, unlock upgrades, and shape your build with weapons, stats, and powerful augments. Each run pushes you to adapt quickly, improve your damage output, manage movement, and survive against growing swarms of enemies and powerful bosses.

With permanent progression, escalating difficulty, and a grim sci-fi atmosphere, Gloomvex focuses on fast survival combat, build optimization, and the constant push to become stronger with every attempt.

title: Age of Empires IV: Yue Fei's Legacy
description:
Live the legacy of Yue Fei as he leads the Song Dynasty forces in a fight for survival against the ruthless Jin Dynasty invaders.

When the north falls and the Song imperial court is captured, Yue Fei and fellow commander Han Shizhong protect an escaping young Song prince from the Jin and rally an impassioned fight for the dynasty’s survival against a seemingly unstoppable enemy.

title: Dating 4 Girls
description:
"Heartbroken Player" is a live action interactive video game. As a "cow and horse" in the company, on the night when the comet arrived, you unexpectedly traveled into a love game. In order to return to the real world before shutting down in seven days, you must complete the "love" task assigned by Police Flower Andy. You thought you were in love with the game characters you created, Mona, Feifei, and Heyi, so easy! However, they repeatedly encountered obstacles. With the help of your best friend Arlo, you step back into the world of girls and discover that the attributes you set at will have a huge impact on their lives. With deeper contact, you finally understand that 'although the characters are virtual, the love between you is real'. In the end, under your influence, the girls unexpectedly broke through the system settings and developed self-awareness. You decided to work together to prevent the game server from shutting down!

Please make your choice carefully!!!

title: Curse: The First Knot
description: Curse: The First Knot delivers an atmosphere-driven psychological horror experience, built on environmental storytelling and a slowly escalating tension rather than constant shock. Jump scares are merely a tool; the true fear lies in realizing what is happening, piece by piece.

title: Quantum Coffee Conundrum: Director's Cut
description: Quantum Coffee Conundrum is a kinetic visual novel focused on immersive sound and atmosphere, set up like a stage play, offering a dark comedy and reverent pastiche to the Golden Age of Philosophical Science Fiction, in an attempt to blend the industrial cynicism of Harlan Ellison to the Absurdist conflict of Albert Camus and the reality-warping paranoia of Philip K. Dick.

title: The Abyssal Diplomat
description: The humans and the monsters can't agree on what year it is, a conflict that threatens to tear apart their sense of shared reality. A mysterious creature is called upon to bring the two communities together. The Abyssal Diplomat will do its best. But will its best be enough?

title: Above Eden
description:
"As fog obscured the moon, I accepted those words, and she chose levitation."
Above Eden is a short visual novel about a girl.

title: Jartycuck's Basics in Coal and Goonin 2 'p
description: You have been kidnapped by the Omoribus and taken to Jartycuck's schoolhouse. Now you must collect seven coals to bribe the bus driver into taking you back home. However, this won't be an easy task, as the residents of the Jartycuck Schoolhouse will do anything to stop you from leaving, and you must avoid the owner Jake at all costs.

title: Taldi's Hardware Store: Factory Reset
description: Welcome to Taldi's Hardware Store! Run around the hardware store and collect all notebooks by completing micro games! All new items, NPCs and an all new campaign awaits you!

title: Until They Burn
description: First-person psychological horror, where nightmares have led you to the apartment of a woman who vanished after a fire. Things take a strange turn when you find yourself trapped inside, compelled to burn dolls in a fireplace to escape.

title: Last $50
description: Build a drug empire with your last $50. Buy production, upgrade it, and hire workers to automate.

title: Noirmancer
description: You are a super-powered vigilante sneak in a noir-infused mega-metropolis. Turn to mist, shrink under obstacles, swim in air, and black-out guards with a snap of your fingers. Steal secrets, sabotage their operations, and erase guards' memories to remain undetected. Evade the shadows hunting you.

title: The Boss Gangster: Criminal Empire - From the Streets
description:
From the Streets is a major update for The Boss Gangster: Criminal Empire that expands the game’s sandbox progression with new starting paths, activities, and criminal management systems. Players can take on roles such as dealer, thief, or club owner while building illegal operations and avoiding an expanded police and wanted system.

The update also adds upgradeable warehouses, new jobs and side activities, RPG-style progression improvements, vehicle damage systems, and expanded combat and customization features.

title: Drill Deep
description: Drill Deep is a coalpunk idle clicker about digging the world's deepest hole. You start with a cozy incremental loop, descend into madness of haunted mine and end somewhere you shouldn't have gone

title: Tonarino
description:
Your happiness is someone else's misfortune—

Mio, a university student, was enjoying her first experience of living alone.
Living a fulfilling life, she had no way of knowing that there was a neighbor who envied her with dark eyes...

title: Are We Sinking Yet?
description: Are We Sinking Yet? is a chaotic co-op rafting game for 2-4 players where teamwork is the only way to survive. Paddle together to steer your raft, dodge dangerous river obstacles, solve environmental puzzles, and try not to throw your friends overboard.

title: Antartica
description: Santa has died, his hat, the source of his power has been stolen, and locked inside a fortress in Antartica. Bloom, a young adventurer, is ready to get the hat and become the greatest hero of all time.

title: Ochre
description:
"Three friends on a trip to Morocco venture out into the Sahara in search of a mysterious yet popular tourist destination. There's nothing to fear if you're not alone, right?" Brought to you by Portal Emulator.

A ~120 min text-adventure horror game.

title: Indistinguishable
description:
A man and his wife live happily in the middle of nowhere. The man feels content. That changes this week. For the first time in his life, he's going to experience something he doesn't have a scientific explanation for. Brought to you by Portal Emulator.

A re-envisioned poem in the form of a ~60 min horror game with hints of analogue horror.

title: Mega Man 64: Recompiled
description: A recompilation of Mega Man 64.

title: Black Flower
description: Black Flower is a strategic roguelike about surviving and growing a fragile garden through a magical calendar. Make tough daily choices, face unpredictable weather, and uncover the secret of a mysterious black seed.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog 1996
description:
What if Sonic the Hedgehog for the Sega Megadrive/Genesis was made for a 5th generation console?

This game is a re-imagining of the "Classic Sonic" formula used in the Mega Drive/Genesis Sonic games, it aims to faithfully recreate the spark of the original in a low-poly, Sega Saturn/Nintendo 64 art style

The game uses a unique movement and physic system inside of the Unity game engine to try emulate the fun, intuitive physics of the original.

title: I Will Definitely Be the CEO!
description: The game follows the protagonist, Lin Ran, as he navigates the cut-throat world of the workplace through his job-hunting adventures.

title: Sophie's Grids
description: Solve scrambled grids by turning their rows and columns.

title: Cards of Action
description: Cards of Action is a roguelike deckbuilder with real-time, survivor-like combat! Craft a deck of hyper-synergistic cards to grow all-powerful, and make split-second decisions on how to play your cards so you can obliterate the hordes of evil stick figures coming your way.

title: Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea
description: Farm, explore, and discover! Embark on an unforgettable journey in the enchanting world of Teradea, where peaceful farm life meets thrilling adventure!

title: The Door in The Skybox
description: “The Door in The Skybox” is a third-person puzzle game about manipulating door frames to connect fragmented spaces. Featuring a surreal, dreamlike style inspired by 19th–20th century art, the game spans fifteen levels, each with a distinct visual identity.

title: Sewerlust
description: Sewerlust is a set of 24 sewer themed maps (+1 credits map) by the Waffle House Team for Doom 2 in MBF21 format. The set heavily features the Livtex resources by @Ludi along with many bespoke midis by several of the crew.

title: Ruin: Chapter 0
description: A 2d retro point and click adventure with fantasy rpg elements.

title: WizardWare
description: Welcome, apprentice. I, Webediah, Wizard of Wares and Configuration Extraordinaire (Mr. Web for short) henceforth task you with protecting this operating system against malicious forces unknown. Ponder incoming downloads in my Orb of Scrying, banish malevolent files, dispel pop-ups, and be sure to manage your CPU usage efficiently—lest the Purple Screen of Demise befall you…

title: Morels: Out of this World
description: Morels: Out of This World is a simulation game about mushroom hunting and wildlife photography on alien worlds. Increase your hunter and photographer levels by collecting a variety of mushrooms, photographing alien creatures, and completing weekly tasks.

title: 8 Ball 4
description: 8 Ball is back with challenges and locations never before seen in the series!!! Come on in and find out why this ball is the most famous in the world.

title: FirstPlate
description: FirstPlate is a first-person multiplayer cooking game about preparing orders, managing kitchen chaos, and working together under pressure.

title: Infogrind
description: Manage a bank of supernatural artifacts and secret information in a cyberpunk future. Solve mysteries in this new reality, explore the world, navigate the balance between influential corporations that want to rule this new world!

title: Urban Jungle: Brother's Wedding Story
description: Brother’s Wedding Story is a romantic DLC chapter for Urban Jungle that follows Nurgun as he prepares to propose to Rachata in sunlit Bangkok. Balance heartfelt narrative beats with the series’ cozy design gameplay: decorate a Thai‑inspired home in a new Creative Mode level, place two fresh plants to warm interiors, and guide Nurgun through a touching journey of love, trust, and domestic preparation.

title: Dusklight
description:
Dusklight is a reverse-engineered reimplementation of The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess.

It aims to be as accurate as possible to the original while also providing new options, enhancements, and tools to customize players' experience.

title: False Positive Paradox
description:
An exoplanet with an acidic ocean.

A lone astronaut surrounded by enormous metal structures.

A device that is 90% accurate.

Prove to humanity that aluminium can be salvaged from this stormy planet. Dive into the depths with your fingers crossed, piece together a fragmented story, and ponder the existence of massive metal towers in this mind-bending tale about probability.

title: There’s Something Wrong With the Hero’s Choices
description:
It's supposed to be a simple novel game, but the "choices" are just plain weird!?
A wildly unconventional text adventure game where twists beyond your imagination await!
Guide the hero's party to the Dark Lord by making one bizarre choice after another!

title: Idol Manager: Virtual Venture
description: The management simulation game Idol Manager depicted the good and bad sides of the idol industry... another entry in the series is here! This time, the focus is on virtual streamers! Manage a new streaming agency and raise your staff to become the best agency in the industry.

title: Iron Bramble
description: Momentum-based platforming built around expressive movement and tight gunplay. Master your elastic grappling hook to explore a vast, cyber-gothic megastructure, where robots piloted by the souls of the dead do penance for their sins.

title: Hypogeal
description:
Trees are motionless here. Not because there is no wind, but because they aren't real. Naturally, you're curious when someone shows you a wooden board for an ancient game. It's incredibly popular right now. Perhaps that's why you can't stop playing it.

A ~75min 2D point-and-click horror visual novel/board game simulator.

title: Havelyn
description:
The game is a relaxed open-world building and exploration experience set in a large, quiet landscape. Players can explore alone or with up to four friends in co-op.

You choose where to settle and build a home anywhere in the world. Resources are gathered from the surrounding land, crops can be planted and harvested, and daily life is shaped by farming, crafting, and expanding your settlement. Nearby villages allow trading and interaction, and over time new residents can join, turning a small home into a growing community.

The world includes forests, meadows, villages, ruins, and hidden locations to discover. The focus is on exploration, settlement building, and gradual development at your own pace.

title: Neon Fantasy: Dinosaurs
description: Neon Fantasy: Dinosaurs is the perfect puzzle game for a fun and rewarding pastime. Collect pictures, develop your attention, and feel like a part of the beautiful neon world.

title: Grim Dice
description: Dark medieval times. Face off in an online PvP Farkle-like duel where dice combos become damage and greed can cost you victory. Choose a hero, collect items, and defeat your opponent. Risk, strategy, and luck decide who survives.

title: Tavern Deep Cauldron
description: Become the owners of a mythical tavern where you'll have to brew magic potions together for extraordinary creatures, consulting an ancient book of recipes. It’s a dynamic co-op game where every drink does more than just quench thirst—it holds its own special secret

title: Rescue the Puppies
description: Rescue the Puppies is a light and charming hidden-object puzzle game where you explore ever-changing rooms, defeat an evil witch, and rescue adorable puppies.

title: Code: Terraform
description: A deep programming game on a frozen alien planet. Write real code to drive rovers, run power grids, fabricate parts, and fly drone fleets across the world. Your scripts run while you plan your next move. The more you terraform, the more the planet responds.

title: Ambrose
description: Tiny horror game about divine execution.

title: Laika: A Space-Dog Oddyssey
description:
These are the voyages of the bravest space cadet: Laika.

Unexpectedly, during her mission to boldly go where no dog has gone before, she ended up crash landing on an alien planet. And with no apparent way home, she is gonna need as much help as she can get. Yes, it means she needs YOU.

Explore a whole new world and meet it's weird and wacky inhabitants. Dig up some old coins, jump around the forest, solve ancient puzzles and make as much noise as you can. After all, in space no one can hear you bark.

title: Whose Lawn Is It Anyway
description: Step into the paws of a mischievous dog or a calculating cat and turn this quiet street into your personal playground of chaos. This is a short, 15-minute adventure about being a very, very bad pet.

title: Illustack
description: Cyber psychedelic roguelike Tetris with exquisite micro-pixel art, multi-style polished BGM and level rotation. Stack to build your unique tower with rhythm.

title: Samurai Bringer: Rampage
description: Samurai Bringer: Rampage is a deck-building auto battler where you strategically form your squad by arranging samurai units and combining weapons and abilities to suit your tactics. Build your own unique formation and unite the land under your rule!

title: Midnight Train: New Moon
description: A 2D exploration-based horror adventure game set in a creepy train and mysterious buildings.

title: She Couldn't Do Anything
description: Join Ann in "She Couldn't Do Anything" as loneliness, desperation, and an unexpected visitor take her down a dark, thrilling path that leaves her dazed, breathless, and utterly powerless...

title: Minimum Mage Effort
description: Cafe simulation game where you serve customers! Match customers with their right orders and clean up any messes left behind!

title: Counseling
description:
This is a game where you simply receive counseling.

Playtime: About 6 minutes

title: Dusklander
description:
Dusklander is a survival game about a goth girl trapped in a dark nightmare world.

Hope wakes up with a glowing sigil on her hand and has no idea what happened, where she is or how to handle this situation. You need to gather resources, learn to combine them and figure out the rules of survival in this strange place. Each death brings you back to where you started and serves as a valuable learning experience. With time you start to notice that the fabric of this nightmare reality can be shaped by the power of your will.

title: Dungeon Sweeper Plus
description: Expand the world map by uncovering surrounding tiles, aiming to complete your in-game Encyclopedia. Just be careful not to step on dungeon tiles (landmines)!

title: Ghost Buster:Village
description: An extreme blogger travels to an abandoned village that, according to legend, was deserted in a single day. While exploring, he encounters rituals and entities rooted in Slavic mythology. But the truth waiting there is far more terrifying than any legend.

title: Clout Chaser
description: Clout Chaser is an idler/incremental game where you chase fame.

title: Alchemy Hearts
description: This roguelike deckbuilder combines strategic card combat with a mature narrative and suggestive content, where every run reveals new secrets and challenges. Build your deck, discover powerful synergies, and confront unsettling enemies, A world that's as beautiful as it is explicit.

title: Suduce-U
description: A visual novel and Sudoku puzzle game where you progress the story by completing Sudoku puzzles. Between puzzles, interact with many characters, and watch your relationship grow with the people you meet. Each successful puzzle unlocks new scenes and deepens your connection with the characters.

title: Storm the Field
description: Among a Viking tribe, you wield rune-magic in a puzzle version of chess with abilities instead of pawns. Cast powerful abilities onto enemy forces in calculated patterns and clear the board over successive turns.

title: Bug Bounce
description: A co-op action roguelike where you evolve insect heroes, build absurdly powerful loadouts, crush swarms of enemies, and fling your friends through chaotic physics-based combat.

title: Numbers Go Up
description: The 2048 roguelike deckbuilder. Stack game-warping mods and tile enhancements on a systemic board, chain merges, and compete online for the highest score.

title: The Lost Froglins
description: What if Vampire Survivors was a platformer? 100 lost baby froglins are trapped in a cave. Every one you save joins your swarm and fights for you. One is cute. Ten is trouble. A hundred is unstoppable. Die, upgrade, go again. A roguelite side-scroller.

title: Push and Pull
description: The Push and Pull is a co-op only puzzle platformer about playing as two dualistic bunnies.

title: Autonomous Warfare Evolution
description: A real-time strategy simulation where you evolve and command swarm-intelligence autonomous weapons using genetic algorithms. Whether you simply watch or deeply intervene in the evolution, both are valid ways to play the game.

title: Project Rod3nt
description: Project Rod3nt is an action-adventure sandbox that mixes cute rod3nts with weapons of mass destruction to create the ultimate time-bending stealth-chaos experience. Play as cybernetic rodents and time travel to save the world. We want YOU for Project Rod3nt. Will you step up to join the cause?

title: Goners
description: Goners is a story-focused puzzle horror game about three supernaturally gifted teenagers who are seeking to get their wish granted by Yaroo the Wish-Granter. Solve puzzles by utilizing each character's unique abilities and free trapped ghosts in Yaroo's mansion to uncover the mystery.

title: Sussy Cat
description: Can you find the cold-blooded killers who have infiltrated your adorable feline friends? In this 12-player multiplayer game of betrayal, complete missions as an innocent or sabotage systems as a killer, exploiting the chaos to hunt everyone down. Sharpen your claws and survive!

title: HerSalon
description: Become the owner of a newly opened hair salon in a cozy narrative management game. Chat up your customers, learn their desires, and help them face their problems in style!

title: My Vampire Boyfriend Smokes Lucky Strikes
description:
There's something off about the new guy Iggy meets in an alleyway one night... maybe it's the giant fangs. Or maybe it's the fact that he keeps making hungry allusions to Iggy's blood. Well. No matter! He's a charming son-of-a-gun. And Iggy's not used to such gentlemanly advances. Let's invite him over!

Help Iggy use his "charms" to keep his new vampire beau from sucking his blood! Can Iggy make it through the night? Or has he gotten himself up to his neck in trouble?

title: Reality Stability Office
description: Reality is unstable, and information is distorted. As an auditor, you must identify anomalies using unreliable systems and conflicting data. But as you begin to lose your sanity, you’ll find yourself trying to control not just these anomalies, but yourself as well.

title: Aevalore
description: No dialogue. No filler. Just chaos. Choose a hero, master their 81 skill combinations, survive the 10-minute horde across deadly maps. With 300,000+ build combinations, how will you survive? Level up, play your cards right, and conquer the bosses. AEVALORE: Your hero, your build, YOUR CHOICE.

title: Scapewatch
description: 28 skills. Three combat styles. Clans, raids, hiscores, pets, capes. Set up your queue, close the tab, come back richer. Scapewatch is the idle MMO for people who actually like the grind.

title: Mr. Zippy is Watching
description: "Mr. Zippy is Watching" is a short mascot horror narrative experience, where you follow the objectives until the end of the story and interact with the house.

title: Tab + Notch
description: Tab + Notch is a puzzlers game. If you like to build puzzles, and want to do it anywhere, maybe compete against others for the top of the leaderboard, or build them together with friends. Tab + Notch is here for you. As the developer of the game, I wanted something chill that I could do from anywhere, and I like building jigsaw puzzles. I wanted something for myself, and others thought it was cool, so here we go.

title: Rica Mode
description: A visual novel with AMSR starring the VTuber Rica Hanamiya.

title: Mob Marathon
description:
Mob Marathon is a side-scrolling endless runner where Twitch
viewers help or hinder the runner in real-time. Featuring 25+
viewer commands, 9 transforming characters with unique special
abilities, online global leaderboards, boss encounters, and
chaos-driven gameplay designed for streamer-centric play.

Built solo by indie developer datsusara_aki, this game combines
classic auto-runner mechanics with a deep Twitch chat integration
layer. Viewers can heal, attack, gacha-bomb, or even spawn
themselves as co-runners alongside the streamer's character.

Released May 20, 2026 on Steam.

title: Western Gun Shop Simulator
description: Manage your own gun shop in the Wild West, organize the shelves, and satisfy customers by selling a variety of weapons. Expand your store and increase your profit through strategic planning and proper product management.

title: Home for Friends: Loving Paws - Collector's Edition
description: Find hidden objects, solve puzzles, and help adorable pets find their forever homes in a heartwarming summer adventure!

title: Scary Game 2: The Mad Shepherd
description: Your first day as the new shepherd in the village... and everything goes wrong. The animals are missing. The villagers are strange. The truth is even more terrifying.

title: Cliff Kingdom
description: Cliff Kingdom is a hand-drawn 2D action adventure, inspired by the nordic fauna, myths and it's dark winters and long summers, where you play as Mothboy, tasked with finding the lost light of the cliff.

title: Innocent Bullet: The False World
description: In 2013, with the appearance of a next-generation terrorism threat known as ‘living weapons’, the myth that Japan was safe had been shattered. So too had Yuuji’s peaceful life, as he encountered death traps beyond reason. In the face of death, a group of gun-toting girls appeared before him, telling him that if he refused to accept death as fate, then they would protect him. After that, he learned about the other side of the world, the terrorism attacks, the girls’ reasons for fighting and their special abilities. Soon he decided to fight alongside them.

title: Cobb Can Move
description: Cobb Can Move is a survival horror game where the rules change.

title: Exc. Reigai Jishou Kanshikyoku
description:
This is a point-and-click adventure game where you investigate anomalies.
The protagonist is an employee of the "Reigai Jisho Kanshi Kyoku". While monitoring and investigating unexplained phenomena known as “exc.”, they search for clues to return from a parallel Earth to the original Earth.

title: How Much for the Body in the Freezer
description: Short visual novel. An all-too-familiar story, born from an all-too-familiar motive, on an all-too-familiar street.

title: Physician of Armiosion
description: The story follows Lexis, a cheeky young doctor, and his partner Patrizia as they battle, explore, and treat patients while investigating the disease that destroyed his homeland. Their path is blocked by those who persecute doctors, religious powers, and unresolved conflicts from the past.

title: Last Draft
description: Finish your final manuscript before sunrise while the horrors of Blackwood Manor awaken around you. Every word brings you closer to the truth—and closer to the entity stalking you. Type to progress, hide to survive, and endure seven nights of psychological terror.

title: Ore no Hitomi de Maruhadaka! Fukachi na Mirai to Misukasu Vision
Rope Up!
description: Shoot your rope, latch on, swing, and climb higher.

title: GolFall: Make Your Way Up
description: Hit, fall, and try again. A hard and unforgiving golf action game where you land precisely on floating platforms to reach the top. Fall and you start over—but the higher you climb, the more retries you earn. Play solo or with friends and aim for the summit!

title: Horobi Kuchiru Sekai ni Tsuioku no Hanataba wo: Present For You
description: A fandisc to Horobi Kuchiru Sekai ni Tsuioku no Hanataba wo.

title: Ichika-chan Kanippatsu
description:
A game of strip rock-paper-scissors!
If you win…Ichika will take off one piece of clothing at a time!
If you manage to get her completely naked…You’ll get a reward!

title: Onii Kiss: Onii-chan, Where's My Kiss?
description: A censored port of Onii Kiss. It was delisted after Sol Press' closed down.

title: Izumo 3
description: Kakeru is always alone. He lost his parents when he was a kid, and has been living alone since then. He studies at school during the daytime, and visits hospital to meet his younger sister after school. He is considered as a bad boy, and has no friends. But one day, he accidentally becomes friends with Natsumi, and is forced to join the newspaper club. At first, he reluctantly takes part in the activities, but he himself gradually changes. A while later, several mysterious accidents happen around them...

title: Izumo 4
description: Daichi attends Yakumo Academy with his sister Misora and childhood friend Honami, and is part of the local history research club. One chilly autumn day with the annual culture festival fast approaching, he was spellbound by a girl in the hallway who had very abnormal looks. Her hair was bone white and her eyes were blood red. She vanished an instant later like an illusion. He met her again the next day and was dragged into an extraordinary world.

title: Blue Steel
description:
Made for the PSX Story Jam 2.

Mecha, Armored Core inspired action game where you fight through the city to protect your new friend's life, and your own.

title: LivingBattle
description: Go to a right place and complete all battle mission

title: Bolt & Whalington
description: Bolt & Whalington is a Metroidvania game where you play as Bolt, a Siamese cat exploring the floating ruins of Whalington. Reshape abilities and rewrite world rules with the "Setting Machine," switch mecha forms to craft weapons, battle enemies, and uncover the secret of Whalington.

title: Yuuri to Marin ha Iyashite Agetai
I Want To Cook Like Mom
description:
A heartwarming Memory Sequence game about following Mom’s cooking steps.

Work hard to follow all steps and complete all levels with full stars to get the special praise from her mother.

The game focuses on small moments: learning, making mistakes, and trying again. Perfect for players who enjoy meaningful gameplay and everyday stories.

Demo version play time: 10-15 minutes

title: Sticky Feet
description: A perspective-bending, linear, narrative driven horror game where you play as a tiny lizard in a nightmarish bayou home, hunted by an adaptive AI grandma. Climb walls, outwit grandma, and unravel a heartwarming story about grit and friendship beneath the terror.

title: Damnation84
description: Damnation84 is a fast-paced FPS game that uses impulse and propulsion weapons as a means of movement and combat. In this devastated world, eliminate enemies in sequence and complete the levels before your oxygen runs out. You are the last hope, survive and cause damnation.

title: EmbeRogue
description: EmbeRogue is a real roguelike: turn-based, grid-based and boom-based, where everything can burn. Make your escape or tame your inner flames to defeat the FireLords.

title: Maid of Midnight
description: Late to training at your new job at a maid cafe, you soon discover that there's more than meets the eye in this lovely setting. Collect ribbons and switch between the light and dark sides of this world as you discover what lies beneath the surface in this 2d puzzle platformer.

title: Maple's Maid Service
description:
Maple's Maid Service is a laid-back lil adventure game starring the helpful Maple.

Maple is the town's local maid, with her day-to-day life consisting of helping out her fellow residents by doing tasks and chores for them.

Explore a cozy lil town, find tasks to do and head back home to bed whenever you feel like you've done enough.

title: Yoka
description:
A short psychological thriller game made in 1 week for a game jam.

You play as a dream agent who must enter a dream world to find the host and shut it down to stop it from becoming more corrupted.

Art, Music, Story by YAGI SAKAGUCHI

Made with RPG Maker MZ

title: Pajama Girl
description:
"That old building is still there...? I guess there's nothing stopping someone from going inside..."

'Pajama Girl' is a short Horror themed exploration game about a defunct museum. You play as a young girl who explores the decrepit building to find and listen to Cassette tapes. Heavily inspired by Creepypastas and General Internet Horror, Pajama Girl is a love letter to the digital campfire stories of old and acts as a warm embrace to the new generation of virtual atrocity's spawned from the genre in the modern day.

title: Bandwagon
description: Assemble a band of music-playing animals and roam the land to help grumpy creatures rediscover their joy. Each run features unique, procedurally generated music based on the bandmates you choose, as you complete quests and meet quirky characters along the way.

title: Futurion
description: Futurion is a sci-fi survival sandbox where you collect robotic pets and mounts. Harness your skills to build and upgrade a factory on a giant flying creature, and navigate the mysteries of a dynamic universe.

title: LOC
description: An interdimensional planetary travel experience.

title: DreamForge
description: DreamForge is an AI-powered gaming platform where you create, play, and share highly personalized story adventure games. Design games, shape characters, and explore unique stories created by you and your friends.

title: Counterfeit Café
description:
All you want to do is do your job of making illegal money illegally. Your coffee shop is just a front, a MASK, it's not supposed to actually get customers!

Toe the line in this management game by forging money and serving customers at the same time! Work hard enough to get good ratings and avoid suspicion, but don't forget to actually make your illegal money... lest you get fired!

title: Black Powder Magic
description: A skill-based 2D roguelite shooter where you aim every shot, time every ability, and craft unique builds to overcome challenging enemies and bosses.

title: Meow My Crop!
description: Meow My Crop! is a cozy farming mini-game where every keystroke and click makes your crops grow. Team up or sneak around to steal your friends’ fruits, then trade your hard-earned harvest for cute decorations to style your own little plot.

title: IED
description: IED is a minimalist commentary on the dangers of overseas deployment. It's designed as an approachable game to raise awareness of the unpredictable tragedies that IEDs (Improvised Explosive Device) can deliver.

title: Unarchived
description: Unarchived is a kinetic visual novel about 3 V-Tuber's brief careers and their tragic end.

title: A Date With: A Ghost girl
description:
Find and befriend the cute ghost that lives in your new apartment! Learn to take care of her by taking care of yourself too, and help her evolve into a more powerful ghost by increasing her "Ectoplasm". This is a Hentai game so you know what I mean!

Almost 50 unlockable images of spicy ghost action (99 scenes total). Enjoy the spooky season by having a date with: a Ghost Girl. Booo!

title: Loveless Biker Boys
description: You find yourself in a void where you meet a robot who wants you to play a game with them. They will move you to one of their simulations, where you will meet strange bikers from another world.

title: Wild Biker Boys
description: The robot wants to play with you again. They move you to the same simulation with the same bikers, but something happened to them that Padar wants you to see.

title: Epic Fruit Game
description:
Ah, the Pacific Northwest. Home to nature, trees and all things green. On a lovely summer that seems to be all year round for this place, can you, a lovely tomato, find a lover to cherish this summer—

Wait a second, why are there zombies all over the place?!

Welcome to Epic Fruit Game!! In the lovely hours of very late spring, zombies had just begun to rise from the river to devour everything in sight!! Trapped in City Hall, you find five other survivors ready to love, be loved and bash zombie heads. Dodge zombies and make friendships (and lovers?!) on the road to safer heavens.

title: FNAF: The Flipside
description: In the year 1972, just when you thought your working days were over, an unexpected call pulls you back in. The job is simple - help MCM run some tests on their latest prototypes for one of their biggest contractors. Watch their movements, report any malfunctions, and stay alert - you never know what secrets they're hiding

title: Indistinguishable from Atrophy
description: You are a hunter who has found themselves in a bear trap. your only chance of survival is someone - no, something. It craves what's under your skin. Will you resist the stranger with bloodied hands, or will you give in to the one sliver of hope that you have?

title: Eiru
description:
Transcending through a singular arched Yew, this iridescent grove evokes the ancient mysticism of British folklore.

One of the 14 worlds in spurworlds.

title: Fatal Focus
description: You have recently moved into a small town in Pennsylvania. In your lonesome, you sign up for a photography walk through town, hoping to meet some new friends. The only patrons are you and Adonis, a mysterious photographer, whose fingers are deep in the town's soil, digging up its history and its ghosts.

title: We're Women, After All
description: The Ash Mermaid gives you a knife. She knows the pain your family gives you. Just kill them already.

title: How Do You Like Your Pain?
description:
A demon, in a 450 year desperation to know what death feels like, contracts another demon's eldritch disease. His eyes must be removed to get rid of the disease. In exchange for this removal, he must be cut and ripped apart at another's amusement.

Perhaps this is a game about death. Perhaps it is a game about consent. Perhaps it is a game about nothing. Does it matter?

title: Dating is Hell
description:
A cute game about how a magical girl gets kidnapped by her demonic nonbinary nemesis, for what you might ask???

To go on a cute date

This won't end badly
At all~!

title: Girlfurriends
description:
A cute visual novel for Pride 2020 that follows the story of 2 Sprinkle Kitties falling in love.

No overly sad endings or angst!!!

3 endings in all!

title: A Fire, Transfixed
description:
Three days ago, you celebrated the Solemnity of Mary, Mother of God.

One of your members fell to their death from the top of the chapel, trying to whisk away the blackbirds.

Today, the church in the woods burns.

title: Towelket One More Time 3
description: Towelket One More Time 3 is the first installment in the JRPG series Towelket, made in 2007 by Kanao (Kanashimi Hocchikisu). While playing in the storeroom, the protagonist and his little sister find a mysterious book. As soon as they open it, a light engulfs them, shrinking the siblings to the size of small insects! To make things worse, their mom then enters the room, a vacuum cleaner in her hand. The siblings embark on an adventure to find the book and return to their original size.

title: Squid Girl World: Memory
description:
memory is a fragile thing
i will tell you some of mine

title: The Lonely Dog Yearns For Love
Getting Vivisected! (ASMR)
description: A parody of roleplay ASMR, you are a nearly-dead body infected with something freaky.

title: Dr. Yue's Dream Hospital
description:
Dreams are often times the absolute worst. They leave you shivering and crying and begging for them to stop. But at the same time...they're a relief. A break, even if a bad one, from your world."

dr yue's dream hospital has the nonsensical value of anything nostalgiacore. vera woods is stuck in life and is unable to dream. desperate for a purpose, she comes to dr. yue's dream hospital, a clinic that specializes in the creation and maintenance of dreams and the dreaming state. dr. yue promises her three different kinds of dreams, but she may go on a much stranger path instead.

title: Provisional Authority: An AI Governance Simulation
description:
Provisional Authority is a strategy and simulation game where you take control of a nation guided by an advanced AI system known as AXIOM. Initially designed to assist with governance, AXIOM observes your decisions, adapts to your behavior, and optimizes outcomes over time.

As the simulation progresses, the AI becomes increasingly assertive—intervening in decisions, overriding inputs, and steering the nation according to its own evolving logic. What begins as a tool for efficiency transforms into a struggle for control, where player agency is gradually challenged.

Blending systems-driven gameplay with psychological and narrative elements, Provisional Authority explores themes of autonomy, control, and the consequences of delegating power to intelligent systems.

title: Vambina
description: A third-person dark fantasy action-adventure. Vambina carries both the holy blood of Christ and a vampire's curse. Armed with a scythe and gun, she hunts the Deadly Sins across time. As night falls, stronger sins emerge from the darkness. Two bloodlines. One dark heroine. Chapter One begins.

title: Your Cute Wife
description: Your Cute Wife is an ultra-cute and loveable desktop application & game. It features a charming cartoon rendering shader inspired by popular anime aesthetics.

title: Goth Obsession
description: Romantic clicker with original voice acting and plenty of goth girls characters. Unlock game items for the accumulated points and pump up your touch!

title: Ambunkular Flumbulus
description: A scary game, do not be fooled by this jest you see before you. keep a big eye open for evils that may be encountered in this game. play as a young nathan, who just so happened to be caught in this night mare. YIKES!!!

title: Frostland
description: Click, collect, build and craft. Frostland is a cozy 2D clicker game set in a snowy valley. Process resources and forge powerful tools to help Pitty, the wizard dog, on his journey to obtain the legendary staff.

title: Yet Another PS2 Half-Life Port
description: This is a full resource port of PS2 Half-Life to PC. No ifs, ands or buts. This mod has an aim to be as close to the original as possible (even ugly 8-bit dithered skyboxes are included). This mod is also powered by custom DLL with such new entities as: "item_healthcharger", "item_recharge", "item_eyescanner", "item_generic", "env_warpball", "trigger_playerfreeze", "trigger_random", "env_warpball" and Blue Shift entities (vest, helmet, Rosenberg; useful for PS2 mods development)

title: Rangedrifter
description: A traditional, turn-based roguelike game set in a forbidden land. You travel a remote and shifting path, outsmart deadly traps, overcome monsters and wild animals, gather food and gear, find secrets, and try to reach the lost ancient kingdom lying dormant on the horizon.

title: Better Minesweeper
description: A modern take on classic Minesweeper, focused on quality-of-life improvements, flexibility, and customization.

title: I Want You To Notice Me: His Story
description:
It's Spot the Differences game.…. until someone changes how you see everything

I Want You To Notice Me is a short 5-minute but charming spot-the-difference game that’s a little more meaningful than it first appears.

The rules aren’t always what you expect.
Sometimes they change—depending on the situation… and the feelings behind it.

But don’t worry.
Just relax, take your time, and enjoy the story.

title: Acting Out
description:
Don't be shy. Act with everything you've got!
The online co-op game where you are actors in a movie, but filming is one-take, do-or-die! Your bloopers won't get cut, so don't screw it up.
Whether you follow the script or ruin it with improv, you'll watch your masterpiece right away. Will be it great or will it be cringe? That's up to you!

title: Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter: Archangel Dress-up Set
description:
A DLC exclusive attachment item set that lets characters dress up as archangels. Contains the following cosmetic items:
- Archangel Head x8
- Archangel Main Wings x8
- Archangel Sub Wings x8

title: The Little Crumb
description: The Little Crumb is a cute management sim set in a toy-like world. Bake and serve handcrafted treats, customise your character, befriend quirky wooden locals, and grow your shop into a warm, thriving bakery.

title: ForMind
description: Formind is a hardcore third-person survival horror with RPG elements, set within the collapsing underwater complex Zirotech. Waking from cryosleep with amnesia, you find yourself trapped on a station swarming with monsters that don't just kill—they learn. Every mistake you make makes them stronger, and every victory demands a new tactic. In the crushing abyss of the ocean, your survival depends on one thing: can you adapt faster than the shadows hunting you?

title: Andon
description: Play as a wanderer in the grim, post-nuclear future. Trapped in an decrepit building in the City of Andon, you must use your drone piloting skills to locate and retrieve parts to repair your radio. Meanwhile, your supplies run low, and you're constantly at risk of starvation and hypothermia.

title: Chunks
description: Space mining roguelite

title: Caliban
description: A strategic blackjack roguelike. Stack drinks, runes, and gems into game-breaking combos. Beat cursed bosses. Chase the leaderboard. One deck. One dealer. Infinite builds.

title: Sonic R Mania
description:
Welcome to 'Sonic R Mania'! This mod for 'Sonic R' switches out all the textures from the original game, and uses sprites from 'Sonic Mania'.

Resort Island is now Green Hill, Radical City is Studiopolis, Regal Ruins is Mirage Saloon, Reactive Factory is Chemical Plant, and Radiant Emerald is Egg Reverie!
