A ton of effort went into this mod, converting all sprites over was a LOT of work. This also includes switching over most of the sound effects, all the music, and also including Snow and Rain versions of the stages too!

title: Halo: Doom Evolved
description: Halo Doom Evolved is a TC-lite weapon mod project that aims to bring Halo's classic sandbox themed gameplay, while doubling down on the more retro aspects of it's design. Boasting over 54 weapons, 3 spartan classes with their own unique gameplay styles, 6 different spawning presets based on the different halo games, and many more settings to make the ultimate custom halo experience. Halo: Doom Evolved is compatible with most addon mods, further allowing you to customize your experience. It's able to run most monster mods with little to no issues.

title: Block Witch
description: Strategically place magical blocks, solve puzzles and defeat enemies in this narrative puzzle adventure. Help seven witches as they embark on the journey to unravel the mysteries of a great magical disturbance.

title: Remagotchi
description: Remagotchi is a virtual pet simulation and productivity game where players take care of a digital companion while managing real-world tasks and habits. The game combines idle mechanics, customization, progression systems, and daily activity tracking, allowing players to unlock items, improve their pet’s environment, and maintain routines through interactive gameplay.

title: SU-93 Survivor
description: A fast-paced survivor-like where you clear rooms, defeat bosses, and build powerful synergies between temporary weapons and permanent passive items.

title: Alley 19 Bowling
description: Alley 19 Bowling is a happy-go-lucky bowling simulation which features an atmosphere of 1950s America. The theme, music, sound effects and graphics take you back to the time when jukeboxes played your favorite rock and roll tunes and the jitterbug was the hottest dance craze.

title: Change the Formality
description:
Are you tired of your life? Of everyday unfairness? Of bad luck? Maybe your crush doesn't like you back, or your favorite chips aren't on the market now, or you're destined to die? If that's true - this game provides a solution to all the problems.

A short story-based game about adventures of Camiel and Alister.

title: The Last Prayer
description:
The Last Prayer is a first-person psychological horror game.
How much can a game truly affect your real life?

Set within a realistic home environment and inspired by real events, this story places you in the middle of terrifying moments beyond imagination. As you confront the darkness lurking within, the line between reality and nightmare slowly begins to fade.

title: Dead Gods Realm: Morar
description: The game is visual novel/interactive book about a man known by the name of Morar, set in a world of dark fantasy inspired by Celtic myths, works of H.P. Lovecraft and European history. The game is framed as a fictionalized biography of the protagonist divided into several chapters. Each chapter contains numerous quests, which you must resolve by making a choice. Every quest offers at least three options to choose from. Consequences of your decisions will bring you to one of several story routes, each showing Morar's story from a different angle.

title: Sever
description: Down to your last $100, but flesh has value. Trade pieces for cash and gamble with your very life. Will you make it out rich… or become part of the collection?

title: Puzzle Park II
description: A new adventure awaits you in a beautiful park filled with puzzles related to finding patterns in the amazing world of the game. Engage your logic and carefully examine your surroundings to find clues to solve the riddles and mysteries of this place.

title: The Doom Brutalist Community Project
description:
Rejoice! Lovers of All Things Grey!

Welcome to D.B.C.P. or the Doom Brutalist Community Project, inspired by Quake community's Quake Brutalist Jam, it is an community project where we seek to bring brutalism to the colourful world of good o' Doom. Venture through twenty-eight maps of different mapper's interpretation of brutalism and their implementation in Doom, whether it is a grey desolate mega structure, an aftermath of socialist brutalism, or an abandoned cement city which had become mother-nature's lush garden.

title: The Quiet Pelagian
description: The method was that taking and bending of materials and people to one purpose, the outlook that everything could be used in the fight; that nothing could be excluded, that everything was a weapon, and the ability to handle those weapons, to find them and choose which one to aim and fire; that talent, that ability, that use of weapons...

title: BugDive Complete
description: Plummet down a massive hole as you collect 40 unique bugs hidden amongst the falling objects in this fully realized ultimate edition of the 2021 Ludum Dare 48 classic, "BugDive". Holy freaking crap. Includes a full scene creator mode, two bonus games, and a look back through BugDive's history.

title: Control, I'm Not Coming Back
description: Control, I'm Not Coming Back is a short and emotional narrative game about a lost astronaut searching for a reason to keep going forward while facing the emptiness of space. Inspired by the Hopecore aesthetic, it’s a story about positivism, friendship and our human connection with Voyager 1.

title: Enihcam eht ni tsohg
description: Yu opens the front door of his apartment and finds himself in a liminal network of the same room of his with no escape. Explore this surreal world and help him find a way to break out of the loop.

title: A Ghost and a Snail
description: It all started with a stupid bet from Michael. An abandoned building from the 60s, boarded-up windows, and the pungent smell of damp and oblivion. Will you explore the darkness emanating from the closed doors? Will you run for your life from the unknown? Or will you decide that a red-eyed specter is the ideal candidate for an unexpected romance?

title: FNAF All-Stars
description: FNaF All-Stars is a bite-sized Fnaf experience that aims to be on the short-but-sweet side of things, featuring 5 main nights, 5 challenges, a custom night, an endless mode and a few achievements to get!

title: Total Victory
description: A grand strategy World War II wargame engine. The main scenario is World Conflict 1939-1945. Players get to play any combination of the big 8 major powers during World War 2.

title: Waifu Cam Girl
description: Build your own streaming empire! Help your charming waifu cam girl attract viewers, collect likes, and become more and more successful with clever upgrades.

title: Bongo Waifu
description: This is a casual interactive game inspired by Bongo Cat. Every keystroke transforms into an "intimate interaction" with your desktop girl. Typing is no longer boring—let her climax to your rhythm! Featuring deep Steam Inventory integration, you can collect over 360 accessories just by playing.

title: Carnholt
description: Craft a deck of wild creatures and powerfull spells, fight in tactical battles and kill a God that refused death. Carnholt is a deckbuilder roguelike where victory will only come to those ready to bargain with ancient powers.

title: Desol
description: Cross an ominous desert as a lone traveler searching for a mythical Sea you have only seen in dreams. Gather water, follow fragmented clues, and learn the patterns of colossal Cube Monoliths that reshape the sands. There are no quest markers or checklists. Only your curiosity can guide the journey.

title: KingFish
description: A 2-player asymmetric co-op game where a King and a giant Fish, a living island, build a city, travel between islands, and defend their kingdom together. One plans from above. The other fights on the ground. Together they stand.

title: Deflate
description: A 4-key vertical rhythm game featuring two chart types: rhythm-focused Drum Mode and melody-driven Melody Mode. Developed by the Chinese indie music platform dizzylab, with a large and continuously expanding music library！

title: Jinx it
description: A dice roguelike deckbuilder where the House always wins… unless your build breaks the odds. Roll, split, and bend your dice, stack lucky charms, and build absurd combos to pay your debt and defeat the Lord of Misfortune.

title: The Journey of the Gnomes: The Battle of the Elder Isles
description: The Journey of the Gnomes is an atmospheric, arcade fantasy roguelite survivor. Stand as a beacon against the shadow horde, master elemental magic, and protect the ancient light of the Gnomelands.

title: Doom Brutalist Community Project
description:
Rejoice! Lovers of All Things Grey!

Welcome to D.B.C.P. or the Doom Brutalist Community Project, inspired by the Quake community's Quake Brutalist Jam! It is a community project where we seek to bring brutalism to the colorful world of good o' Doom. Venture through twenty-eight maps of different mapper's interpretation of brutalism and their implementation in Doom, whether it is a grey desolate mega structure, an aftermath of socialist brutalism, or an abandoned cement city which has become mother-nature's lush garden.

title: Exit, Seriously?
description: An observation horror game by a student dev and a tired AI. Observe the hallway carefully: if you find an anomaly, turn back; if not, keep going. No saves, just pure student-made

title: Turbo Rivals
description: Turbo Rivals is a high-octane arcade racer where speed is a currency and every corner is a battlefield. Master the art of the perfect drift to charge your turbo, outmaneuver aggressive AI rivals who adapt to your every move.

title: The Curse 404
description: The Curse 404 is a psychological horror puzzle game set inside a mysterious house trapped in a repeating time loop. Each time you awaken, the environment resets but the clues you discover remain.

title: S.E.X. Project: Simulated Emotional Xenotech
description:
Step into the world of the S.E.X. Project, an experimental program in which multiple androids explore the boundaries of emotion, desire, and connection. Each synthetic companion has a unique personality, story, and path to uncover. Some seek love, some crave freedom, and some may hide dangerous secrets. Your choices will define their evolution and your fate.
Will you fall for them, help them, or lose yourself in simulated affection?

title: Shadow Rose
description:
Shadow Rose is a stylish puzzle adventure about two mysterious phantom thieves, Mysterious Mask X and Masked Beauty Z, infiltrating the Black Rose Auction House. Outsmart each room, manage your limited moves, uncover hidden treasures, and escape with elegance as the secrets behind the auction begin to unfold.

Play as Mysterious Mask X and Beauty Mask Z as they infiltrate an illegal auction to recover stolen and illegal treasures and relics. Plan every move carefully. One wrong step can make your escape impossible!

title: Holy Moonlight
description: Holy Moonlight is a single "speed map" Focusing on fast paced combat, and chill music.

title: Afternoon Affairs & Helpless Housewives
description: Takumi Nakama is out of luck. He failed his college entrance exams and doesn't have the motivation to look for a job. After his parents give him an old, run-down apartment building to manage, he meets two ladies living there, both with troubles of their own...

title: Echoes of the Flame
description: Two parties. Alternating perspectives. A story-driven 2.5D turn-based RPG. Master strategic combat with flexible ability builds, unravel the world's deep lore using "Key Words" you discover, and see their fate unfold.

title: Hell Hold'em
description: Hell Hold’em is a dark turn-based RPG where every encounter is a battle of strategy, manipulation, and survival. Descend into the underworld to rescue an unjustly condemned soul. Face demons in twisted turn-based duels where every hand is a trap. To survive, you'll have to cheat better than they do.

title: Noir Bloom
description: Noir Bloom is a high-octane 2D Gun-Fu action game, where adrenaline-fueled gunfights and skull-crushing close combat collide in a neo-noir rhapsody. Embark on a deadly rampage to honor the vow—strike, disarm, and turn foes into weapons. Every move is a calculated ballet of bullets and blood.

title: Hell Is Other People
description: A psychological horror adventure game about social anxiety.

title: Airskipper
description: Run through stages in this fast-paced action precision platformer. Rack up a combo and maintain it throughout the stage to score big at the end, or create your own stages and share them with others!

title: Thornspell
description: Embody a magical florist by placing plants strategically in your garden, and watering them to score points. Thornspell is a garden-building roguelike where you will create and unleash chains of magical effects, dispelling the corruption spreading through your home.

title: Dive Tactics
description:
A turn based exploration game made during the Black&White game jam n°11.

Command a squad of submarines through a network of caves and mines in a desperate attempt to rescue your former coworkers.

title: After Hue
description: After Hue is a charming puzzle platformer starring an adorable chameleon on a grand adventure! Shift colors, phase through obstacles, and unravel the mysteries hidden within every hue!

title: Mouse: P.I. For Hire Story DLC
description: A brand new adventure for Jack Pepper awaits in the first Story DLC for MOUSE: P.I. For Hire…

title: Idolaters
description: Simple deckbuilding game made using megaman level structure. Challenge 10 AI Deck, steal their power after each battle, lose some of your own deck along the way.

title: One of Everything
description:
One of Everything is an MBF21 project where the mappers had to fulfil increasingly growing demands for the industrial mapping machine. The requirements start simple, but get progressively more complicated and involved. And here is the twist - the requirements are cumulative, so with each map a new requirement is added, but all the previous requirements still stay.

Did the mappers succeed or are they getting fired from the omnipotent mapping factory? It is up to you to decide.

title: Heathen
description: Enter the keep and hunt down the fallen lord who took everything from you. As you descend, a deeper evil reveals itself—an ancient horror never meant for mortal eyes. Heathen is a dark fantasy dungeon crawler inspired by classic ARPGs. One town. One dungeon. A descent into madness.

title: DraBot
description: Help lil’ DraBot dispose of his irritating archnemesis, Van HelBot! Naïve vambot hunter expects our hero’s batteries to run dry real soon, but he underestimates DraBot’s energy sucking abilities. Shall we see who ends up out of juice first?

title: Salty Dogs
description: 2D underwater physics-based action co-op for up to 4 players. Crew a submarine, harpoon loot and drag it back before oxygen runs out. Deeper the dive – higher the stakes and darker the horrors. All wrapped in an absurdly cute deep-sea exploration vibe with unforgettable chaotic dogs.

title: Insert Coin
description: Experience the most important cases of Bell, a private investigator. Discover the moments of his deepest regrets or the remnants of his joy – you decide. Anything could happen in a world where to live longer you'd only have to... insert coin.

title: Lost in Damnation
description: A story-driven, multi-act campaign with several levels, a large UAC base hub, NPC dialogue, and tons of monsters to shoot, all crammed into a single map.

title: Split Brain Samsara
description:
You and your friend are locked in the same body!
In this co-op adventure, learn to control the same character, venture into your spiritual realm, and unravel the machinations of the Samsara megastructure!
Communication will be key!

title: My Coworkers Are Made Of Static
description: A horror game, where you found yourself trapped at your job. Just keep doing your job. And remember - The Spider is watching.

title: Outbound: School Bus Adventures
description:
Get ready to hit the road with the School Bus Adventures DLC, where the trusty Schoolie becomes your new playable vehicle! Explore the wilderness in style and transform this iconic school bus into a fully customized camper van. Outfit and personalize every corner as you venture off the beaten path, turning the Schoolie into your perfect home on wheels.

Designed for big adventures, the Schoolie offers generous interior space for building and creativity. It features a large sliding door, a smaller passenger-side entry, and a rear door that lets you move through the entire vehicle with ease. A ladder-accessible rooftop rack opens up new possibilities for expanding your base above the bus. Please note that you select your vehicle at the start of your adventure.

title: Dendron 64
description: With the help of a custom emulator, a lost 90s puzzle platformer game has finally been restored. Explore the secrets of the dam, find out what happened to your friends, and save the valley from the monster lying in its depths.

title: Trail & Error
description: A chaotic co-op survival game for 1–8 players where you travel the trail, manage supplies, survive disasters, and argue with friends. Work together to keep the wagon moving, adapt to random events, and try to make it to the end in one piece.

title: The Talos Principle III
description: The Talos Principle 3 is the last chapter of the thought-provoking first-person puzzle series, taking you on a cosmic journey across more than a dozen worlds and testing your mind with all-new challenges.

title: Company is Watching
description:
Dear new employee, we are thrilled to welcome you to our production line. Here, your mission is simple, repetitive, and essential: maintain our quotas. Let yourself be lulled by the routine. Obey the instructions. Screw, clean, and destroy what you are told to destroy.

Optimization is our priority.

title: Vectronic
description:
Vectronic was developed by reepblue and is the successor to the original PUNT mod for Half Life 2. Rebuilt using Alien Swarm as the foundation, and leaving the Punt gun behind in favour of different game mechanics - powerballs!

It initially released in an incomplete state on February 5th, 2018 free to download for the public.

title: Minimo
description: Minimo throws hundreds of players into a shared world for a fast, unpredictable roguelike adventure. Every run is different. Every session is a race against the clock. Team up, explore, and see how far you can push in just 30 minutes. Fast adventures. Massive parties.

title: Remain At Your Desk
description: Incremental hacker about faking productivity while stealing from your employer. Sell intel for credits or keep it and raise suspicion. One bad audit and you’re back to Intern.

title: Paw Alliance
description: Become the universe's deadliest and most adorable special agent in this high-octane 2.5D roguelite action game! Mow down hordes of mutant creatures, discover a vast arsenal of items and skills to craft your perfect build, and uncover the shocking truth behind the catastrophic Swarm!

title: Go Up Frog
description: Falling isn’t the end. In this 2D precision platformer, you must keep climbing upward. Small mistakes lead to big falls, but every challenge can be faced again. How far can the frog go?

title: The Endless Village
description: Automate your growth, uncover a gorgeous city, and chase the ultimate metric: Liveliness. This cozy idle clicker lets you unlock passive income boosts and powerful minigames to rapidly scale your empire. Attract every unique citizen and claim your spot on the global leaderboard!

title: Get Rid Of Those Corners
description: Clear all sides of the shapes inhabiting this geometric incremental game to trigger unpredictable physical chain reactions, powered by over 130 upgrades available in your skill tree.

title: Angel's Return
description: Kill the returning angels, parry their shots, And enter a state between world to allow yourself to revive

title: Kilira's Descent
description:
Kilira Cooper wakes up trapped in an old, abandoned hospital, with no idea how she got there. She quickly realizes the place is much more than just an empty building: voices echo, doors close by themselves, and disturbing visions haunt every room.

Her only goal: ESCAPE.

But the hospital seems intent on holding her back. Every step toward the exit reveals new mysteries, blurred memories... and hostile entities ready to prevent her from escaping.

title: Unanswered
description: Unanswered is a first-person psychological horror experience where observation and resource management are your only way out. Trapped in an environment that distorts your memories, you must explore every corner looking for vital tools to progress. Use a flashlight to pierce the darkness of the hallways, and switch to your UV flashlight to reveal invisible clues, hidden trails, and messages that the human eye cannot perceive on its own.

title: Broken Lamp Records Secret Santa 2025
description: BLRSS2025 is a compilation of 17 gift maps by Broken Lamp Records, a mapping team of mainly weird transfems/enbies/therians with a bunch of eclectic tastes in doom. Each mapper posted a prompt of what they like in a map, then were arranged in a loop and had to map for the next person down based on their prompt, while being secretly mapped for by the next person up.

title: A Tale of Fortunate Lust
description: A cute and explicit anime-style visual novel. You are the protagonist, and each episode depicts erotic events that unfold throughout your life. The story is linear, and as you progress, you'll encounter sliding puzzle games. Along the way, you'll have sex with various characters.

title: Hentai Tales: Triangle That Wants Me All
description: Enjoy a sensual story while completing tricky puzzles! Connect the numbers sequentially, using all of the squares on the board. After completing a puzzle, you will unlock a sexy new image and the next part of the story!

title: Gridiron Masters '98
description: Gridiron Masters '98 is an American Football presentation sim that places you in an alternate universe that encompasses college and pro football. Create your coach and see where their career takes them while looking through the lens of the late 90s.

title: Gather CCG
description:
Gather CCG is a turn-based online card game where players take on the role of Alchemists, competing to master elemental powers and outsmart their opponents through clever strategy.

Build and customize your deck with units, spells, and weapons powered by the five elemental forces — Fire, Water, Earth, Air, and Darkness.
Each match is a test of your strategy and timing as you summon powerful units, cast devastating spells, and unleash explosive elemental combos that can turn the tide of battle.

Climb through the ranked ladder, collect new cards, and expand your collection to strengthen your deck.
Refine your playstyle and rise to become the ultimate Alchemist.

Whether you enjoy tactical battles or creative deck-building, Gather CCG offers a vibrant and competitive online experience that rewards both strategy and imagination.

title: Kick Buds
description: This is no ordinary soccer game. It’s a chaotic survival battle where the goal is to outlast your opponents in a free-for-all with wacky rules! Roll with the kicks to come out on top!

title: Corridor 13
description:
Corridor 13 is a first-person psychological anomaly horror game set inside an endless, abandoned school corridor. Players awaken as a young girl trapped in a looping hallway where every detail may be a warning, every sound may signal danger, and every wrong decision sends them back or kill them.

To escape, players must carefully observe their surroundings and decide whether to continue forward or turn back. If everything appears normal, they move on. If something is wrong, they must retreat. Reaching Corridor 13 requires twelve correct decisions in a row — but as the loop progresses, the anomalies become increasingly dangerous.

Unlike traditional “spot the difference” horror games, Corridor 13 introduces hostile paranormal encounters, environmental traps, chase sequences, unsettling audio cues, and escalating supernatural events. Whispering children, flickering fluorescent lights, flooded rooms, mirror-based anomalies, and humanoid figures lurking in the darkness turn the familiar school setting into a place where memory and perception can no longer be trusted.

Built in Godot by a solo developer from Germany, Corridor 13 is designed for fans of psychological horror, liminal spaces, anomaly games, Backrooms-style atmosphere, and tense first-person horror experiences. The game features 40+ planned anomalies, randomized progression-based anomaly pools, and Endless and Hardcore modes.

description: A deep biological network automation game where you grow a living mycelial network across an alien planet. Consume the local flora and creatures, build biological production chains, and evolve from a tiny spore into a cosmic entity that consumes worlds.

title: Necrofall
description: Necrofall is a brutal medieval first-person melee roguelike where every swing matters. Rise as an undead skeleton, parry and backstab your way through ever-changing dungeons, and evolve your build with powerful, run-defining upgrades.

title: Infinity Ship
description: Combine cards, pilot unique ships, and survive cosmic chaos. A frantic space roguelite where every fusion makes you an unstoppable force. Defeat colossal bosses and prove your worth as the Guardian of the Universe.

title: Dream Doctor
description: Dream Doctor is a platformer BOSS RUSH where you take on the role of a "psychologist", capable of entering your patients' dreams to confront their worst nightmares through brute force.

title: Warlords III: Frontier
description: Warlords III: Frontier is a mod intended to serve as an unofficial expansion for Warlords III: Darklords Rising, adding 16 additional units and 3 new campaigns, along with changes to game balance.

title: ORE x TRACTOR
description: ORE x TRACTOR is a short, incremental game about demolishing space rocks with a variety of weaponry.

title: The Infinite Grimoire
description: Build your magical academy, produce arcane tomes, merge them into stronger forms, train students, and expand your influence across the world. An idle management game where your spellcraft grows even while you're away.

title: Pétanque 2026
description: PÉTANQUE 2026 is a modern and immersive pétanque experience. Play solo or with friends locally or via Steam Remote Play Together, and rediscover all the precision, strategy, and conviviality of this iconic sport.

title: Forza Horizon 6: Treasure Map
description:
Need some help finding all of the Bonus Boards, Barn Finds, Regional Mascots, Treasure Chests and Treasure Cars hidden around Japan?

Get the Forza Horizon 6 Treasure Map today to reveal the exact location of these collectables in the main game and Expansions, once they become available.

title: Forza Horizon 6: VIP Membership
description: Forza Horizon 6 VIP Membership is your permanent ticket to even more rewards at the Horizon Festival. Enjoy a 2x Credit boost to race rewards, 3 VIP-Exclusive Forza Edition cars, a weekly bonus Super Wheelspin, and special Vanity Items including the Crown Flair, Emote and Car Horn. You’ll also be handed the keys to the lavish Tokyo City House, a classic Japanese home in the suburbs that includes a Customizable Garage with a space to show off your favorite cars. Forza Horizon 6 VIP Membership can be purchased separately and is included with Premium Edition and Premium Upgrade. This lifetime membership is a single purchase and will always be yours to enjoy in Forza Horizon 6. Join the Horizon VIP Club today!

title: Cold City
description: Cold City is a surreal narrative-driven psychological horror game about a city at war and a girl in danger.

title: Pit Panic
description: Escape the sinking Aztec temple in this cartoonish rogue-like arcade platformer. Dig your own path up, jump and climb in blazing speed, hoard loot, trade lives for god-like powers, beat bosses, master 1000 handmade levels and humble other players in daily leaderboards.

title: The Northsong Rift
description: Project made with RPG Maker Unite for the RPG Maker Themed Game Jam #6: Journey to the Underworld.

title: Mushroom Simulator Co-op
description: You're a mushroom. Your friends are mushrooms too. Grow big, enjoy the rain, watch out for worms and the forager with a basket. No quests, no bosses. Just you, the forest, and that worm that crawled up at the wrong moment again.

title: Ashihara no Anima
description: This is a narrative-driven adventure game in which you dive into another’s nightmare and intervene in the source of the anomaly. As Homura, a hunter, you explore the dreams of a girl who has lost her memory, and experience a story where nightmares and reality begin to overlap.

title: Red Spider 2: Exiled Remastered
description: A cinematic Hong Kong Noir visual novel. In 2007, an assassin defies orders to kill her savior and becomes a fugitive. Explore her fate through 1,000+ visual cuts and 6 branching routes.(Full story is free via the demo version. This paid edition supports Steam Achievements and the creators.)

title: Exuvia
description: Exuvia is a surreal, fast-paced, FPS action roguelite set in the center of a dimension left forgotten. Clear rooms of enemies, obtain unique items, and break out of the exuvium.

title: 100 Hidden ASCII Cats
description: A cozy hidden-object puzzle set in massive worlds drawn entirely from ASCII text. Grab your magnifying glass and find 100 kittens hiding between the characters.

title: Welt der Wunder: Eine Insel in Gefahr
The Vaults Below Durn: A Field Study
description: Three Doors. One Safe Path. Observe the signs, learn the patterns, and uncover the fate of the explorer who ventured before you.

title: Drivionline
description: An online, free-to-play multiplayer driving and racing game where players can customize cars, roam freely, create their own servers, and make mods.

title: I Hate This Place: Deluxe Edition
Starshard Brigands
description: Starshard Brigands is a first-person dungeon crawler with grid-based movement, where shifting loyalties and hard choices shape your fate. As a nameless mercenary in a fractured world, decide where you stand—or stand alone.

title: SOE 64
description: A retro-inspired WWII FPS built in the spirit of 90s console classics. Operate behind enemy lines, from Alpine railways to undercover dinner parties; shoot, explode and dismantle the German war effort one mission at a time. Work alongside the resistance and unlikely allies as you liberate Europe.

title: Leon&Suharto
description: An interactive dramatic thriller novel with immersive elements. Immerse yourself in a dark tale of revenge, where you must find those responsible for the horrors of the Kapella Estate, survive despite your own fears, and face the irreversible consequences of your choices.

title: Hotel Paraíso
description: Explore a surreal hotel overrun by ghosts in this mellow yet haunting 2.5D RPG. Battles play like tactical puzzles: match colors, chain combos and stop the ghosts before they cross the board. Meet its animal guests and uncover what tore the worlds apart.

title: Adventures of Robbo
description: Robbo is a puzzle game for everyone, regardless of gender, age, or background. By solving puzzles alongside a robot in a world consisting of 60 levels, you’ll sharpen your reflexes and logical thinking skills. Hours of fun guaranteed!

title: Rift of the NecroDancer: Spin Rhythm XD - "The Magician" - Seejay
description: Feel the magic of the official Rhythm Rift for "The Magician" by Seejay. Free to download!

title: Rift of the NecroDancer: VA-11 Hall-A - "Yliad" - Garoad
description: Be the star that always shines in the dark night sky in the official Rhythm Rift for "YLIAD" by Garoad. This track is part of the VA-11 Hall-A Music Pack.

title: Rift of the NecroDancer: Friday Night Funkin' - "Dad Battle" - Kawai Sprite
description: Get funky with the official Rhythm Rift for "Dad Battle" by Kawai Sprite. This track is part of the Friday Night Funkin' Music Pack.

title: Rift of the NecroDancer: Friday Night Funkin' - "Ugh": Kawai Sprite
Rift of the NecroDancer: Friday Night Funkin' - "Stress" - Kawai Sprite
description: Get funky with the official Rhythm Rift for "Stress" by Kawai Sprite. This track is part of the Friday Night Funkin' Music Pack.

title: Rift of the NecroDancer: Friday Night Funkin' - "Darnell" - Kawai Sprite
description: Get funky with the official Rhythm Rift for "Darnell" by Kawai Sprite. This track is part of the Friday Night Funkin' Music Pack.

title: Rift of the NecroDancer: Unbeatable - “Worn Out Tapes [Tally-Ho Version]” - Peak Divide ft. Rachel Lake
description: Destroy the stage with the official Rhythm Rift for “Worn Out Tapes [Tally-Ho Version]" by peak divide ft. Rachel Lake

title: Rift of the NecroDancer: Friday Night Funkin' - "Senpai": Kawai Sprite
description: Get funky with the official Rhythm Rift for "Senpai" by Kawai Sprite. This track is part of the Friday Night Funkin' Music Pack.

title: Rift of the NecroDancer: Friday Night Funkin' - "Blammed" - Kawai Sprite
description: Get funky with the official Rhythm Rift for "Blammed" by Kawai Sprite. This track is part of the Friday Night Funkin' Music Pack.

title: Bring The Rift
description: Bring the Rift is a competitive color-matching puzzle game that blends frantic strategy with visual novel-style storytelling. Master unique abilities to warp reality, launch attacks against rivals, and unravel the mystery of the portals in story mode, or enjoy local multiplayer.

title: Rogue Reunion
description:
Rogue Reunion is a 2.5D pixel art roguelike that brings together every character from across the Quiet Terminal Interactive catalogue for the very first time. Heroes from different universes find themselves sharing the same dungeon, old rivalries left at the portal.

Fight through procedurally generated floors, gather loot from fallen enemies and hidden chests, and invest your gold in a persistent tech tree that carries across your run. Then face the arena — five waves culminating in a multi-phase boss — before you can descend deeper.

The dungeon doesn't care where they came from. It only cares whether they make it to the next floor.

title: Terraclysm Survivors
description: Terraclysm Survivors is a fast-paced action roguelike sidescroller. Earth is in peril, jump and attack through treacherous stages packed with enemy hordes while building the ultimate loadout. With up to 8 players online, defeat the invaders and survive in this apocalyptic and chaotic challenge!

title: Sinners Landing: Bane of Passion
description: Sinners Landing: Bane of Passion continues the story of rogue mage Tristan Lamprey in a world of danger and divine temptation. Battle new monsters, explore new dungeons, and fall for new lovers while collecting art, unlocking scenes, and diving deeper into the seductive chaos of Sinners Landing.

title: Please Protect My Secret
description: Step into Detective Kazuo Kurosawa’s role. Uncover mysteries involving eight enigmatic women. Choose to aid or save them.

title: Moss: The Forgotten Relic
description: Moss: The Forgotten Relic is an enhanced compilation of Moss and Moss: Book II that replaces the use of virtual reality in those games with a new cinematic camera system. The game is an emotional and atmospheric adventure set in the pages of a living storybook, brimming with myth and ancient magic. Guide a tiny but determined hero on a heartfelt journey of challenge, courage, and connection.

title: Gigantic Maidestruction
description: A giant maid wreaks havoc on the city under the pretext of defeating enemies! Gigantic Destruction Action Game!

title: Forward Toward Uranus X
description: Forward Toward Uranus X is a community project consisting of 40 Maps (35 + 5 Stoppers) utilizing the Back To Saturn X Textures.

title: Build the Great Temple: Dora Dora Land
description: "Build the Great Temple: Dora Dora Land" is a short rogue-lite simulator that combines deck building, resource management, and personnel management.

title: Wrispell
description: Wrispell is a side-scrolling 3D magic action game where players combine runes to create spells. Play as the apprentice mage Lirabera, explore a collapsing world, collect runes, battle magical disasters, and solve puzzles. Discover new spell combinations and develop your own unique magic style.

title: The Fallen Castle: Chapter 1
description: The equilibrium between the living and the dead has been shattered in the kingdom of Selestia. Play as Victoria, a young soldier tasked with stopping a supernatural invasion. A narrative-driven RPG with dark comedy elements, exploring themes of grief, resilience, and personal identity through a psychological journey where time is limited.

title: Legion of Honor
description: A WWII action-adventure FPS with powerful gunplay. Fight through operations across occupied Europe, blending fast-paced combat with the spirit of classic war stories! Featuring splitscreen and online multiplayer modes.

title: Godzone 6
description: Build your own mutant! Each one must find their own unique way to escape the Godzone in the world's first first-person mutator - from the creators of Void Bastards and Wild Bastards.

title: Tower of Baby
description: Stack babies high into the sky to get your paychecks! Avoid going more than $10 into debt and make sure the babies don't hit the edges!

title: Ozera
description:
"Welcome to Ozera. " ─────

"Here, all your needs are within reach."

Everything is just as it seems.

Just keep farming.

There must be a way off this island.

title: Stellaris: Season 09
description:
The Stellaris: Season 09 Expansion Pass is your gateway to an entire year of cosmic evolution, psionic mysteries, and blazing ambition. With instant access to the exclusive Stargazer Species Portrait, this expansion pass delivers three major content packs that will redefine the Biological and Psionic Ascensions and the most ambitious species pack so far!
Purchasing the Expansion Pass grants access to all four DLCs as soon as they become available:

● Stargazer Species Portrait
● BioGenesis
● Shadows of the Shroud
● Infernals Species Pack

With Stellaris: Season 09, the future of the galaxy is in your hands. Whether you master genetics, uncover the secrets of the Shroud, or command the flames of the Infernal species, this expansion pass delivers a year of unprecedented depth and galactic storytelling.

title: Gord: Ultimate Edition
description:
Items included:
- Gord - Base game
- Gord - Digital Artbook Strategy
- Gord - Chronicle
- Gord - Hold Your Ground
- Gord - Original Soundtrack
- Gord - The Alliance

title: Vendir: Plague of Lies + Vampire's Fall: Origins
description:
Vendir: Plague of Lies + Vampire's Fall: Origins includes:

- Vendir: Plague of Lies
- Vampire's Fall: Origins

title: Union of Gnomes: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition bundle contains a copy of the game and a digital artbook from developers, Hoolignomes. The Artbook is available in two languages – Russian and English.

Reveal how the Union of Gnomes visuals were made, meet the heroic gnomes, learn about their ruthless oppressors, and get inspired to lead the great gnomes' revolution!

title: Flint: Treasure of Oblivion - Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
Included in Flint: Treasure of Oblivion - Digital Deluxe Edition:
- Complete game
- Captain James Flint - 3D print file
- Digital soundtrack (composed by Winifred Phillips)
- Dioramas (x5) (in-game)
- Digital artbook
- Character sheets (x5)

title: Oversynth
description: Welcome to OVERSYNTH, AKOD for short. A game about rending robots apart with a sword, which is still in alpha. But there is already an infinite mode, three different testing polygons, 5 different enemies and, of course, EXPLOSIONS!!! And... Well... Ummmm... COOL EXPLOSIONS!!! YAY!

title: Stellaris: Starter Edition
description: The Stellaris: Starter Edition is crafted to guide you through your first steps in the Stellaris universe, giving you the tools to explore, expand, and conquer.

title: Playblades
description:
Playblades is a multiplayer simulation game where viewers join matches through chat by typing "!play" and watch their spinning blades automatically battle in an arena. Players' chat appearance determine their look in game.

The game features automated arena combat where blades collide and compete based on physics-driven interactions. Matches include randomized power-ups that alter movement, strength, or combat behavior. Gameplay is driven by live chat participation and real-time simulation outcomes.

title: Starry Station
description: Adventure through a newly abandoned space station called "Starry Station", a station that once took children to space. Journey through this place to find a way to space while trying to find the reason for its closure with your new pal Cosmo Paw. Be careful some things in here do tend to bite.

title: Xylometazoline
description: Immerse yourself in the depths of addiction and explore the surreal world of Xylometazoline.

title: Umineko: When They Cry - Saku
description:
Umineko: When They Cry - Saku is a collection of three official fan discs from the original Umineko series, released for the first time in the West by MangaGamer. This edition includes:
- Umineko: When They Cry - Tsubasa
A set of 15 short episodes originally distributed as a small booklet at Comiket, now adapted into visual novel format.
- Umineko: When They Cry - Hane
Features the stories Jessica and the Killer Electric Fan and Forgery No. XXX.
- Umineko: When They Cry - Saku
Includes the stories Our Confessions and Last Note of the Golden Witch, in which a new witch named Piece declares war on Battler, Enju, and Beatrice.

As with other MangaGamer releases, this version of Saku features newly drawn character sprites to match the upgraded Steam visuals, with the option to switch between them and Ryukishi07’s original artwork.

title: Ultimate Level Builder
description: Make Epic Levels using a sophisicated level editor and play levels from other people!

title: Veg Slop
description:
The big northern family gathering simulator.

Explore family gatherings over multiple years through the eyes of a child in northern England. Navigate through the same home as the family comes together year after year for different events, evolving over time.

Short experience, takes about 10 minutes to complete.

title: Consumption Model
description:
You've just driven to a new area of the city.

You're desperate to find evidence of others. Others also wanting to persist.

Interactive worlding experience created to encourage players to think and assess the current technology landscape and digital oligarchy. Revolves around Feenburg’s 2012 paper Re)Inventing The Internet : Critical Case Studies discussing the different models of the internet, in particular the consumption model, and themes of digital oligarchy, trans-humanism and cyborgs (Haraway, 1985). A world where these themes where these themes manifest is created.

title: Aunty Jam's Birthday Cake
description: Play as Maude, a kid living in a solarpunk future, as you help your neighborhood prepare for your Aunty Jam’s birthday party. Discover all the elements of a solarpunk world through the low-stakes and joyful practices of interacting with your neighbors, helping with tasks, and exploring your environment. Aunty Jam’s Birthday Cake is a relaxed look at the importance of communities sharing workloads, centering ecological resilience, and celebrating together.

title: Move, Move, Melon!!
description: You’re Melon, a tiny hamster with a huge goal. Collect mix-ins, roll fast, and build momentum to churn the biggest ice cream scoop ever in this whimsical, on-rails runner.

title: Peerless Heart
description: A 5 minute experience that could save your life. A short walking simulator. You will speak with creatures and move towards a large landmark with a mysterious prize inside.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails Beyond the Horizon - Complete Launch Edition
description: The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon Complete Launch Edition bundles the full JRPG experience with extensive cosmetic, audio, and gameplay add-ons. Alongside the base game it includes multiple character outfits and costume packs, BGM collections, Starter and Advanced gameplay packs, survival items, and art/music extras—offering deep customization and convenience while you explore Zemuria’s story-rich world.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails Beyond the Horizon - Ultimate Edition
description:
The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon - Ultimate Edition includes:

Base game
The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon - Zemuria BGM Collection
The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon - Marduk Survival Kit
The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon - Rean Schwarzer’s instructor Apparel
The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon - Silver Xiongshou Garb
The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon - Black Mask & Rosenberg Dress
The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon - Altina’s Travel Outfit
The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon - Agnes’ Pink Lapine Attire
The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon - Costumes & Colors Vol. 1
The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon - Costumes & Colors Vol. 2
The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon - Costumes & Colors Vol. 3
The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon - Accessories Pack
The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon - 4SPG UNITED Attire Set
The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon - BGM Pack

title: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon - Excalibur Edition
description:
Excalibur Edition bundles the complete Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon experience—base game, expansions, and extras—into a single collection. Play a mature, first‑ and third‑person open‑world dark fantasy RPG inspired by Arthurian myth, explore 50–70 hours across vast zones with branching narratives and deep side quests, and expand your journey with the Sanctuary of Sarras story content (new regions, 20+ dungeons, epic bosses, 100+ items, and a flexible three‑tree progression system).
The edition also includes the Supporter’s Pack (soundtrack, digital artbook, Golden Horse Armor) and free bonus DLC with new item sets and alternate character looks, offering a fully loaded, lore‑rich adventure with extensive customization and replayability.

title: Etrange Overlord: Launch Edition
description:
Even hell can't stop you from enjoying Etrange Overlord's launch edition!

Not only will you receive the base game, but this time-limited offer also includes a 12-page mini art book, which offers a sneak peek into the Netherworld and its quirky cast of characters.

If that wasn't enough, you'll also get a soundtrack with 11 tracks of iconic music from the game!

title: Vampires: Bloodlord Rising - Ultimate Edition
description:
The ultimate experience for veteran Vampires contains Vampires: Bloodlord Rising and everything else Sangavia has to offer: Exclusive outfits, the Original Soundtrack, Official Companion and a unique Cookbook.

Contains:
Vampires: Bloodlord Rising
Vampires: Bloodlord Rising - Moonweaver’s Pack
Vampires: Bloodlord Rising - Original Soundtrack
Vampires: Bloodlord Rising - Official Companion
Vampires: Bloodlord Rising - Official Cookbook

title: Vampires: Bloodlord Rising - Moonweaver's Edition
description:
Enter the world of Sangavia in style with Vampires: Bloodlord Rising and the exclusive Moonweaver’s Pack DLC, which contains a custom outfit for Dragos, available for both hunter and aristocrat forms.

Contains:
Vampires: Bloodlord Rising
Vampires: Bloodlord Rising - Moonweaver’s Pack

title: Junkyard Stories: Rebirth
description: A dystopian sci-fi adventure where you're a broken robot carrying the consciousness of a legendary hacker. Cross landscapes shaped by war, scavenge supplies, hack systems and solve puzzles as your battery drains. Infiltrate Block-07 to find the person who can save your mind before it's lost forever.

title: Super Bomba League
description: Make the ball hit the floor on their side...by any means! Throw axes, invade their field, or zap anyone in your way! 2v2 online & local matches full of chaos, explosive balls, and feisty bunnies.

title: The Starlit Escape
description: A Game Boy style Metroidvania about exploring a haunted space station and meeting ghosts along the way! Made in the month of October for Halloween!

title: Forgotten Depths
description: Forgotten Depths is a PS1-inspired stealth-horror game. You find yourself trapped within ancient catacombs, but escaping won't be easy... you have awakened the CURSED PRISONER of these depths.

title: KimiNozo Duelist
description: The spirit of Hotaru asks high-schooler Takayuki to save his future self from a parallel world by using the power of the Rumbling Angel trading card game. Fandisc for Kimi ga Nozomu Eien.

title: Ayu Mayu Alternative
description:
Ayu Mayu Alternative is mainly about the events taking place around Daikuuji Ayu and Tamano Mayu, the two waitresses from Sky Temple.

It is inspired by the anime Ayu Mayu Gekijou which had its fourth episode as a parody of Muv-Luv Alternative.

title: Brothel Virgin: The Crimson Reverie
description: Your first night in a brothel. Nervous? Excited? You’ve got one night to pick your companion — or unlock a hidden VIP experience. Animated scenes, wild choices, and more secrets than you can handle.

title: Asema
description: Build a space factory. Mine, harvest, exploit. Manage logistics with railguns, ballistic payloads and gravity-bending haulers. Fight gravity with Focus, climb the tech tree. Expand and explore the solar system in this Newtonian automation sim. Everything is a potential resource - even the Locals.

title: Kusari Doi: In October The Rain Never Stopped
description:
Jin Kinoshita spent the following eight years of his life in the shadow of the day he desperately hoped would not come to pass... The death of his best friend. Slaving for minimum wage at a rundown fast food restaurant to barely be able to pay rent, Jin's dream of becoming a professional artist died a slow death. Completely devoid of purpose, Jin allowed all of his talent to slip away from him like sand in an open palm.

The early October rain washed up a flood of memories into the forefront of Jin's mind. With encouragement from a past he had tried to forget, he resolved to take a chance on his dream once more. In the process of picking up the pieces of his life, spurred on by friends both old and new, they all decide tread the waist deep water together through their journey to recovery.

title: Curse You, Hospital!
description: Saskia starts her first day (or rather night shift) at the Hospital Ultra Plus. Why is the staff understaffed? Why have stations been closed? And why are there two Onis in the canteen? Find out what dark secrets are hidden behind the scenes while you take care of the patients.

title: Hidden Weekend: The American Getaway - Collector's Edition
description: This is your chance to escape the hustle and bustle of city life and spend your weekend exactly the way you want.

title: The Last Ladybug
description: Fly forward and save your swarm in THE LAST LADYBUG - a rail shooter set in a colorful world where the skies are ruled by mechanical monsters and the lands are scorched by destruction!

title: N.E.R.D
description: N.E.R.D is a story-driven escape room puzzle game, brought to life as a gripping interactive movie.

title: Grid Tactics: Duel
description: Grid Tactics: Duel is a competitive card game built on an 8×8 grid. Every move is about positioning, timing, and resource trade-offs. With limited resources, choose when and where to play—set up or apply pressure. Each placement reshapes the board. Win through deckbuilding and precise execution.

title: Konayuki Fururi: Yuzuhara-chou Curling-bu
description: There is a small town located in the country. Tetsuya lives a boring life there. One day, he is appointed to a coach of a curling team. He doesn't want to do that, but he reluctantly accepts it. His players are all pretty, but older than him. Also, they are beginners like him. Like this, his busy life begins....

title: Konayuki Fururi: Yuzuhara-chou Curling-bu Gaiden - Saeko no Kayoizuma Nikki
description:
Konayuki Fururi's fandisc.
The main character starts to live with Saeko. At first the two friends are shy about holding hands and going on their first date, but soon their flirt is noticed by the acquaintances, so their relations continue openly though not without teasing. This is a happy couple communal life diary.

title: Mushrooms vs Engineers
description: Mushrooms vs Engineers is a top-down bullet heaven/hell where you are The Engineer, armed with your trusty nail-gun battle the hordes of Mushrooms over 20 waves until you face the final boss. The enemies you face are affected by your own choice of upgrades in the shop.

title: Open Waters
description: Open Waters is a first-person ocean survival horror game. Stranded in a small boat, you must navigate treacherous waters, evade creatures of the deep, and find your way back to safety before the ocean drags you into its depths.

title: Furry No Revolution
description: A game created by Oscar12345 using the MUGEN engine. The game takes inspiration from Fatal Fury and has a cast consisting of furry characters.

title: Kint
description:
Kint is a modern version of the classic MUD RPGs. Set in the fictional world of Seram, players are researchers tasked with exploring and learning all they can about the world and it's mysterious kilns.

Players collect lore fragments, which often contradict which each other and the established canon and must submit and vote what should be marked as the truth each week.

title: Depth-Bound
description: A physics-based underwater 2D platformer. Propel yourself out of the water, chain trajectories, and dive always more deeply. Photograph strange creatures and follow an expedition whose outcome remains uncertain.

title: Seekers Alliance: Hero's Journey
description: Seekers Alliance: Hero's Journey is a role-playing card game set in the Seekers Alliance universe. Venture into the mysterious Sovereign's Island with a diverse cast of Heroes, strengthening your decks through battles and encounters; confront powerful foes and uncover the Island's hidden secrets.

title: A.R.A. Astro Rescue Alliance
description: At the heart of a sci‑fi world awaits a series of logic puzzles that reward prudence, perseverance, and ingenuity. Skills you hone here prove useful in everyday life. No violence — just thrilling, high‑stakes challenges. Curious how it works? Play!

title: Pilgrim Alliance
description: PILGRIM ALLIANCE is a "Journey to the West" survivor rogue-lite. Lead your team through the "81 Tribulations" to reach India. Defeat and recruit Demon Kings to your squad! Mix teammates to create diverse builds, break through enemy swarms to defeat bosses, and craft your own legendary pilgrimage.

title: Taleweavers Alliance Anthology
description: A linear visual novel featuring five different Ontario (Canada) youths' stories. Each story has a different art style and subject matter, and we worked closely with the storytellers to ensure their voices come through authentically. Indigenous & LGBTQ2S+ are major themes.

title: Kingdom Rush 5: Alliance TD - Dragon Wars
description: The Cloud Realms are under siege! An ancient dragon has stolen the Queen's last egg to claim its power. Fly into forbidden skies, battle corrupted draks, and stop the Dragon Wars before they consume Linirea.

title: Space Alliance: Frontier
description: Get ready to protect the entire solar system from an unprecedented threat - the D'Ahari, a race of insect-like aliens. Control an entire fleet of spaceships, trade with other races of an Alliance, and develop your own space station.

title: Project Rabbit
description: Reimagining Alice in Wonderland as an East-meets-West dark fantasy enriched by a proven Webtoon IP, it builds a unique universe for global audiences.

title: Cure for Danmaku Synd
description: Parry action only top-down shooter! Explore body and destroy pathogens!

title: Content Moderator.
description: To pay for your mother's surgery, you take on a shady part-time job: "content moderator" Your task is to delete the "forbidden images" that must never see the light of day. Survive the creeping curses of this abnormal office.

title: Firefighting Simulator: Ignite - Blackout Truck Edition Skins DLC
description:
Want a great, new look for your fire trucks? Then look no further. The Blackout Truck Edition Skins DLC includes the new blackout vehicle skin for your complete fleet. As reliable as ever but with a very distinct look, the Blackout Truck Edition Skins DLC makes your fire trucks truly beautiful in every situation. With this DLC you will be able to blackout the fire trucks expanded bumpers, the cab steps, the rims, the pump panel as well as the tailboard.

The Blackout Truck Edition Skins DLC includes:
Blackout vehicle skin (for all fire trucks)

title: Firefighting Simulator: Ignite - Parker's Story DLC
description:
Experience tense firefighting action in Parker’s Story DLC – a test of leadership, trust, and teamwork.

Parker's Story DLC includes:
2x new narrative missions

title: The 60 Second Syndrome
description: You will die in 60 seconds. This is a single-player horror escape game in which a man trapped within a 60-second time loop must escape from a sealed room. Inside the locked room, time resets every time you die. Observe repeating phenomena, remember the changes, and break free from the loop.

title: Death Standing
description:
Death Standing is the first of its kind 'Stand' type of game, where the player has to do nothing but hold still for a set amount of time. It's a meditative endurance challenge game where you have to hold the left mouse button without moving the mouse itself.

Who's going to give up first? Will Kojira-san drop the baby? Or will Death wrap it up for the day and go home?

title: Catjong 5: Paw Canyon
description: Embark on a cozy mahjong-3 adventure with your playful cat! Solve 200 fun levels and build a charming Wild West town in a warm, sunlit canyon.

title: Catjong 2: Pawprints in the Snow
description: Catjong 2 is a mahjong-3 game with a playful cat! Enjoy 200 winter levels and build your cozy Alpine fair with Pawprints in the Snow.

title: Cyber Units
description: Generate. Upgrade. Optimize. Build an infinite production protocol in a futuristic incremental experience where every click fuels exponential growth.

title: Age of Legacy
description: Age of Legacy is an unforgiving roguelike RPG with intense turn-based 1v1 combat. Step into a world where survival is earned, not given. With no allies to assist you, every battle is a high-stakes duel, testing your build optimization and tactical foresight to the limit.

title: Anomaly Jobs: Data Center
description: You work the nightshift at Data Center DC4-31. Something is off this time. Spot the anomaly, take the correct exit multiple times in a row and finish your shift.

title: New Adventures of Robercleiton: The Turbo Rebirth - Complete and Remade Edition
description: This game is a Brazilian comedy game, an RPG produced in RPG Maker. Its is an turn based combat, with many simple side quests. The game tell the history of Robercleiton that wants to be more than an non playable character, like a hero, gain level and save the world from darkness, or not...

title: CrazyDish
description: CrazyDish is a relaxing dishwashing simulation game where players clean dozens of objects, upgrade tools, complete missions and enjoy a cozy atmosphere.

title: Deltarune: Soulblazers
description: A fangame based on the Sword Route MANTLE Sequences in CHAPTER 3. As the SOUL, you hold the power to command the heroes to solve puzzles. At any time, you can eject yourself from your current vessel (like how Kris removes the SOUL themselves) and enter a different one. Using the power to swap characters, puzzle your way through 7 dungeons, including fully realized versions of both the Ice Palace and ROOTS, in a complete story campaign! Face challenging bosses, use SOUL Modes, and escape from this strange, pixelated hellscape, with Kris by your side.

title: The Grove
description: Scout out an uncanny pine grove for hidden artifacts and discover the fate of the children who went missing from a quiet town in Indiana.

title: Scriver: A Word Game
description: In this word-crafting roguelike deckbuilder, you buy, sell, and arrange art in your gallery strategically to build synergies and impress the colorful cast of characters. Every piece of art, gift shop item, and critic can drastically change the course of each run.

title: Kill -9
description: Cyberwarfare-inspired Roguelike Deckbuilder

title: Almost Nearly Borderline Perfect
description:
a girl forms a crush on an older woman in the middle of an alcoholic spiral

Adelaide has been alone for a long time and values privacy above all. Her peaceful life is interrupted when she has a one night stand with an employee who seems to care about her a bit too much.

title: Fireboy & Watergirl and Friends
description: Fireboy & Watergirl are back with 3 new friends! In this platformer game you have to control multiple characters with your keyboard. Play alone or with a friend to solve the puzzles and get to the finish doors of each level.

title: Stellaris: Stargazer Species Portrait
description: Dream of the stars with this exclusive portrait, available immediately upon purchasing Stellaris: Season 09. Featuring three phenotypes and unique animations, the Stargazer Species Portrait is perfect for players who seek to embody the spirit of cosmic curiosity.

title: Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss - R'lyeh Edition
description:
Your descent into madness has only just begun. With Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss - R'lyeh Edition, horror reaches new dimensions. Enhance your experience with the following exclusive content:

- The Shining Trapezohedron side quest
- An official scenario for the Arkham Horror role-playing game
- The Art Pack: capture your descent into madness with this exclusive digital pack, containing the non-Euclidean artbook and the eldritch soundtrack.

title: Ys X: Proud Nordics - Deluxe Edition
description:
Ys X: Proud Nordics - Deluxe Edition contains:

Ys X: Proud Nordics
Ys X: Proud Nordics - Costume Pack
Ys X: Proud Nordics - Sandras Pack
Ys X: Proud Nordics - Starter Pack

title: Ecos da Mata
description: Ecos da Mata is a top down action-rpg game about preservation, colonialism and folklore. The story takes place in a fantasy setting inspired by Brazilian history and folklore, taking on its themes and characters. Play as Aiyra and uncover the mysteries of the Snoring Woods

title: Spell Alchemist
description: Spell Alchemist is a short incremental resource-gathering and crafting game about digging for resources and processing them into powerful spells. Craft the most powerful healing spell to cure humanity of a mysterious disease.

title: Nubert's Stand
description: Nubert's Stand is a Deltarune fangame with a joke premise that takes place near the game's end. While the game's premise and involvement with the character Nubert is largely comedic, it also contains many headcannons from the creator, causing it to be much more serious and in-depth than most comedic or parody fangames.

title: Summer's Gone: Season 2 - Constellations
description: The story continues. The characters you've grown to know are back and now with more punch than ever. Relationships move forward. Some turn intimate, others grow tense. New bonds form, old ones shift, and rivalries begin to take shape.

title: Sinisistar 2
description: Step into a beautifully somber pixel art world of decay filled with grotesque, writhing abominations... A dark action RPG that follows the journey of a demon-slaying nun who must resist destruction and despair while purging the corruption from this world one boss after another!

title: Passion Bay
description: Become the ruler of your own paradise where a tropical island is filled with irresistible girls. Experience a captivating idle clicker as you restore and develop your island, grow your business, earn resources, and unlock new areas while deepening relationships with the beauties around you.

title: Operation Scorched Earth
description: Operation Scorched Earth is a 3 level unit for Quake II.

title: Operation Scorched Earth III
description: Operation Scorched Earth III is a 3 level unit for Quake II.

title: Marvel Rivals: Season 8 - Sins of Alchemax
description:
The Gilded Saint may have purged the Time Plague from Lower Manhattan, but the root of the rot remains. Alchemax Headquarters stands defiant, shielded by a mysterious crimson Chronovium — fueled by a dimension of pure, kinetic force.

The stakes have never been higher. Prepare yourselves - the Alchemax conspiracy goes deeper than we ever feared.

title: Luminous Jigsaw Puzzles
description:
Step away from the noise of the world and enter the enchanting realms of Luminous Ages. This isn't just a puzzle game; it’s a journey through a vibrant multiverse brought to life by the breathtaking, hand-illustrated gallery of renowned fantasy creator Anthony Christou.

Wrap yourself in a cozy atmosphere of magic and myth. Whether you are piecing together a majestic dragon or a celestial horoscope, you’ll find a serene sanctuary designed to spark wonder. From the first piece to the final click, experience the satisfying glow of vibrant colours and hidden details emerging under your fingertips.

title: Soothe
description: You awaken at the bottom of a rusted pit, another forgotten machine amongst a pile of those who came before. On your right, an extendable grappling claw, and on your left, a melted screen. You are given only one goal - reach the light above.

title: The Case of the Cryosleep Killer
description: A hard sci-fi murder mystery in space. Scour the bowels of the Ark ship for tactile clues, uncover hidden connections, and unlock the secrets of the sleeping passengers.

title: Xray Customs
description: Xray Customs puts you in the role of a customs inspector with one clear responsibility: don’t let anything dangerous slip through. Using an Xray scanner, you search through bags, spot prohibited items, and clear each checkpoint by finding everything that doesn’t belong. Whether you prefer a calm, methodical experience or the thrill of racing against the clock, Xray Customs rewards sharp eyes and attention to detail. It’s easy to pick up, satisfying to master, and turns the simple act of scanning luggage into an engaging and addictive puzzle challenge.

title: Curious Copy Cats
description: Get ready to flip your perspective with Curious Copy Cats, the purr-fect puzzle adventure that keeps you on your toes! Each level presents two adorable cat-filled scenes that may look identical at first glance… but there’s a twist, the images are mirrored, turning familiar details into a clever visual challenge.

title: Coffee Talk: Tokyo - Deluxe Edition
description:
The Complete Coffee Talk Tokyo Experience!

This Deluxe Edition bundle includes:
Coffee Talk Tokyo (Full Game)

Deluxe Edition Upgrade Items
Seattle Prologue Chapter
10-track City Pop Album
Digital Artbook

title: Tales of Arise: Beyond the Dawn - Premium Edition
Coffee Talk: Tokyo - Deluxe Edition Upgrade
description:
Deluxe edition features:

- Seattle Prologue Chapter
- 10 Additional in-game City Pop tracks
- Digital Artbook

title: Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok: Emote Expansion Set: Let's Chat
Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok: Special Edition
description:
Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok: Special Edition includes:
Granblue Fantasy: Relink
Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok Upgrade Kit
Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok Special Pack
Includes special character colors for the captain, Id, and Sandalphon. Also comes with useful items for unlocking Seofon, Tweyen, and Sandalphon.
• Concept Art Color Pack
- The Captain (Gran/Djeeta)
- Id
- Sandalphon
• Azurite's Splendor x 5
• Canaan Whitebloom x 3
• Supreme Weapon Essence x 6

Granblue Fantasy: Relink DLC Collection
This is a collection of previously released downloadable content for Granblue Fantasy: Relink. It includes useful items for making upgrades, 5 sets of colors for characters, and 3 sets of emotes.
• Ignition Pack
- Weapon: False Sword of the Apocalypse
- Glittercrystal x 30
- 500 MSP
- Fortitude Crystal (S) x 50
• Color Packs 1-5
• Emote Expansion Sets: Let's Chat, I Work Out, Grab Bag

title: Ragnarok Origin: Classic
description: "Ragnarok Origin: Classic" is an MMORPG game published by Gravity Game Vision. Serving as the "green nostalgic version" of "Ragnarok Origin", it primarily features a fair monetization model and a simplified progression system.

title: The Last Camp: Dawn
description: The Last Camp is a post-apocalyptic world-themed game. It utilizes high-quality graphics, a rich weapon and item system, and a vast world map to create a cross-generational twin-stick shooter, bringing a feast to hardcore shooter players.

title: Blinded I
description:
Control Esclera in this graphic adventure where you'll need to get the stuff necessary for the escape. Talk to the odd people trapped here, and use the items you take to solve all the puzzles you'll find on the way.

Hope the eyes don't see what you're doing...

title: Sunset Vector
description: Sunset Vector is an Indie dev boomer shooter rogue lite wherein you fight waves of robots in a simulation military skirmish.

title: Yodelee Golf
description: Yodelee Golf is a cozy open world multi-player co-op game of the craziest golf ever, with motorbikes, boats, gondola, secret mountain caves, monsters, rubber duckies and a single golf ball. Ray-traced proximity chat adds to the fun and the chaos, climb a mountain and shout Yo-delee-oh!

title: Dissolution of the Silent Union
description: Dissolution of the Silent Union is a short, narrative-driven visual novel where you accompany Vera, who is trapped on the last day of school, toward her inevitable date.

title: Trust Your Gut
description: A rogue-lite roulette game. Born unlucky; your life is tied to this game. To survive, buy mementos you want, bend the odds, and return to each spin a little stronger.

title: Monsters are Coming! Corrupt Edition
description: Experience everything Monsters are Coming! has to offer with the Corrupted Edition. This shiny bundle contains the base game, a Tower-Survivor rogue-lite where you protect an ever-moving city from unrelenting hordes, as well as the Power Corrupts DLC, containing a new biome, hero, town halls, monsters and more.

title: Monsters are Coming! Power Corrupts
description: Battle through the Road of Clovers in “Power Corrupts”, a DLC filled with shiny treasure and corruption alike. From a new biome and townhalls to “corruption” effects on buildings, there are a bunch of goodies to sink your teeth into, like a leprechaun’s pot of gold at the end of the rainbow.

title: X-Ray 2D
description: A fast-paced and challenging 2D platformer where precision, reflexes, and exploration are essential to overcome traps, obstacles, and secret-filled levels.

title: Red: Flame & Fable
description: Will you succumb to the darkness or cleave through it with your lantern? Red: Flame & Fable is a handcrafted 2D platforming action-adventure which follows the story of Red. Red must defeat terrifying creatures, find her family and fight back against the darkness imbued by the flower curse.

title: Lost Totem Trajipon!
description: Capture, command, and sacrifice occult mutants in a delightfully desolate, ultra-morbid turn-based RPG! It'll take a true Minion Master to unravel the treachery that's tying up Trajipon in this entirely above-board ROM we found at a garage sale!

title: Toss
description: Toss is a psychological tabletop horror game where every coin toss decides your fate. Kidnapped and forced to gamble for your life, you must earn enough to escape, knowing that luck can turn against you at any moment. One mistake, one bad toss, and everything you've fought for could be lost.

title: Feed the Forest
description: A short, innocent incremental forest-builder. Unlock snail powers to spread life in a barren desert. Feed the mysterious Forest with juice. And remember: Blood is a type of juice.

title: Bean Meets Paw
description: Build your dream cat café! Design cozy spaces with cute furniture, bake cat-themed treats, and hire fluffy staff (baristas, bakers, cashiers). Grow from a small shop to a feline empire by unlocking bakery equipment and decorations. Attract unique cats to be your café's star attraction!

title: Mouse Saving Simulator
description: Save tiny mice using your mouse! Guide, push, and carry them through fiery mazes and return them safely to their mothers using precision, timing, and clever movement.

title: Bible Quiz: Trivia Game
description: Race the clock across hundreds of Bible trivia questions! Test your knowledge of scripture, famous figures, miracles, parables, and more. Perfect for faith communities, trivia fans, and anyone curious about the world's most read book.

title: Rabbit Runner
description: This is a minimalist arcade game about a rabbit collecting flowers on the lawn. The time for collecting is limited, and each flower collected adds seconds to your timer.

title: LaVonne's Lemons Idle
description: Grow an ultimate empire in LaVonne's Lemons Idle! Click your way from a single citrus to deep cosmic automation. Unearth ancient Artifacts, build out the Endless Research Lab, "feed" (click) your screen pet monkey, and prestige into the stars in this deeply strategic resource management clicker!

title: A Game About Creating The Universe
description: An idler game where you get to build up the universe from scratch. You are a part of an advanced space civilization that builds universes.

title: Putrid Snow 2: House of Yule
description: Trapped alone in a mansion with relentless holiday monsters, you must scavenge for presents to find weapons and traps. Outsmart the AI, manage your inventory, and turn the holiday hunter into the hunted. Free to play!

title: Blue Reflection Quartet: Premium Box
description: Contains a B3 poster, a character visual book and a download code for costumes.

title: Can Deliver? Survival Kit
description: A car simulator where the player needs to deliver items from one end of the map to the other.

title: CPU Invaders: 3i Atlas
description: The sequel to the Steam Awards finalist, invaders are living inside your computer again — but now their source is the mysterious interstellar object 3i Atlas. Interact with your desktop while playing, watch Youtube videos, chat with your friends and more!

title: Pioneers of Pagonia: Builder's Edition
description:
This digital Builder’s Edition of Pioneers of Pagonia contains the following:

- The Game
- Exclusive Decoration: An exclusive statue depicting the founder of Pagonia
- The Soundtrack
- The Guidebook
- Wallpaper Pack

title: Night Pump: A Horror Game Remake
description:
Night Pump: A Horror Game Remake is a first-person psychological horror game where you play as Nick, a young man working the night shift at an isolated gas station surrounded by fog and woods. What starts as a monotonous shift turns into a nightmare when the lights begin to flicker and a distorted voice through the radio warns you: the killer is already inside.
Inspired by classic indie horror titles like Cry of Fear, this remake expands the original with a revamped atmosphere, immersive sound design, and a story as cold as it is personal. Your choices matter — but your fate may already be written.

title: Pioneers of Pagonia: Meadowsong
description: Experience the story of the island Meadowsong. Once known for their thriving agriculture, the harvest of Meadowsong is haunted by a mysterious Withering destroying everything. Build new production chains with fruits, wine and livestock and help to solve the mystery of the witches' coven!

title: I Hate Snake
description: Hardcore retro snake game with 80 high-difficulty levels. Features escalating speed, shrinking space, and an algorithm that reacts to player mistakes. Includes a classic high-score mode and customizable 2000s-style phone shells with authentic monochromatic LCD aesthetics.

title: Forza Horizon 6: 1990 Nissan #12 Skyline GT-R (BNR32 Gr.A) JTC
description: 1990 Nissan #12 Skyline GT-R (BNR32 Gr.A) JTC

title: Redacted by the Sadistic Princess from Another World?!
description: Socially awkward game developer Yaemori Nowa receives more than she bargains for when two characters she created for her indie smash hit eroge, Utter Obedience: Conquered by the Sadistic Princess, appear in her apartment. What's a hopeless lesbian to do?!

title: Campfire Harmony
description: An adorable fox lives on your desktop, reacting to your typing to keep a campfire burning. Earn coins, upgrade, and decorate a lakeside camp in a transparent overlay. Cozy, zero-stress companion for work or study.

title: Tokyo Walled City
description: Mercenary Reiko Kimura is trapped in the neon-lit, mysterious, maze-like streets of Neo-Tokyo. A section of the city has been walled off under unexplained circumstances. Tokyo Walled City is an immersive sim survival horror set in a retro-cyberpunk world, inspired by neo-noir anime classics.

title: Fading Haven
description: Two friends fall into the criminal world of cyberpunk in 1988 megacity. Drowning deeper into violent mafia showdowns, politics and corporate affairs, they are trying not to lose themselves. FADING HAVEN is a dark comedy neo-noir story-driven top-down action shooter with stealth elements.

title: Falling Apart
description: Falling Apart is a disturbing point-and-click puzzle adventure about a man descending into his own fractured mind through hypnosis.

title: Lemegeton
description: As a hero branded by demons, fight to save your brother and confront the nightmares consuming Nebraknok Island. In Lemegeton, an action roguelike where perilous choices and the lure of demonic power test you at every moment, can you preserve your humanity?

title: Heart of Gold
description: A gun toting cowboy filled rpg chain game made by the Charas Project.

title: Hungry Chicks: Battle Farm
description: Lead your chicks from the barn into battle and defend your farm against endless waves of hungry enemies. Combine strategy, action, and humor in a charming comic world, level up your units, and defeat powerful generals in thrilling boss fights.

title: Combat Survivors
description: A 3D top-down action survival game where you fight randomly spawned monsters. Kill them for rewards that boost your attributes and prepare for each wave. Choose various weapons to change your combat style. The goal is to survive and defeat as many monsters as possible!

title: Olivia
description: Once a family home, now stands silent. The past still whispers through every room. You are looking for inspiration for a film, but you will find much more than just a story. Whether the lights are on or off... it doesn't matter. Olivia will find you.

title: Lavalads
