description: A chaotic local multiplayer brawler where up to 4 players duel on a shrinking lava island. Play free-for-all or in teams, draft powerful spells, and knock rivals into the flames to be the last standing Lavalad.

title: Scanner Force
description: ​Pulled into a digital world of neon and sound, you must scan and blast your way out. Master iconic classical masterpieces with your high-tech Rhythm Scanner and prove you’re a true "Gosu" by hitting perfect streaks. Create your own rhythmic gauntlets in the Custom Stage Editor!

title: Crown's Trial
description: Crown's Trial is a fantasy souls-like boss rush where you step into a different world with each battle, fighting against legendary heroes from across time.

title: Deep Panic
description: An online co-op underwater horror game with up to 4 players. Pilot a submarine, explore the open ocean and descend into the depths while you fight monstrous threats and scavange its treasures.

title: Serpent Squad
description: Serpent Squad is a bullet‑hell roguelike game where you control a snake‑shaped squad of heroes that automatically attacks nearby enemies. Combine different heroes to unlock class bonuses and create unique builds, guiding your unstoppable squad as it sweeps through endless waves of enemies.

title: Damn Love
description: You flirt with absolute confidence, trying to decode her completely illogical reactions. You say one thing, she hears another. Love doesn't run on logic: the same sentence can make her laugh, get mad… or unlock the “happily single” ending in the most painful way.

title: Cielle Is Not Happy
description: Cielle Is Not Happy is a psychological horror RPG that redefines the adventure genre through a deep, haunting narrative and unconventional combat mechanics, delivering a masterfully immersive experience.

title: Welcome, [Employee Name]
description:
Welcome, [Employee Name] is a satirical Papers, Please-like game set in a space station control room. You will experience being an employee of a giant corporation (HonkyTonk inc.) that controls everything entering and leaving the space station, sometimes to the detriment of its occupants...
Discover their secrets, help the people trying to make a difference, or not... your choice!

Control and cross-reference: Open manuals, read instructions, compare documents, this is your job!

Multiple story paths: Truck drivers have hearts too, and it seems like the company you work for has some... issues...

Choices have consequences: You have the power to make a difference, or to keep your head low in this big corporation. What choices will you make?

title: Summer Sisters
description: It's been years since Yuu last visited the countryside, and this summer, he'll finally be reunited with the sisters Hana, Rina, and Hina! Unfortunately, his mom has to hurry home, so he'll be staying with the three of them for a while. Find out what fun awaits him in Japanese countryside!

title: Bag Fight
description: Pack your bags! Adventure awaits!

title: Isekai Villain
description:
An ordinary young man is reborn into the world of his favorite comic—only to find himself as a bit-part villain doomed to die. To escape his fate, he must rise as a true villain, gathering allies, defying heroes, and carving a new destiny in this dark fantasy isekai JRPG. Experience a story of survival, betrayal, and ambition where good and evil clash in a pixel-art world.

Fight strategic turn-based battles that blend classic RPG command systems with modern mechanics. Exploit enemy weaknesses, trigger chain attacks, and unleash powerful break attacks. Earn notoriety through misdeeds to rank up and unlock unique arts via a skill tree. Explore dungeons, gather resources, and develop your own evil base with a smithery, lab, smuggling, and more. Packed with pixel-art charm, immersive story, and tactical depth, this parallel world RPG is a must for fans of JRPGs, anime-style games, and fantasy adventures.

title: Angel in Inferno
description: A visual novel that depicts the trials of four young girls who committed crimes during their lifetimes and have since passed away.

title: Trash Goblin: The Artist of Brimhaven
description:
The Artist of Brimhaven is the first official expansion for cosy shopkeeping game Trash Goblin. This expansion adds a whole new district to visit, and brand new ways to interact with it.

Use your recolouring tool - plus all your old tricks of the trade - to bring life back to an abandoned slice of Silver City, and change lives in the process.

title: Echoes of the Museum
description: "Echoes of the Museum" immerses you in a first-person psychological horror set inside a corrupted museum. You are Alicia, a restoration student drawn into a nightmare where collecting souls opens sealed paths, but slowly erodes your sanity and distorts reality.

title: The Occultist: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition of The Occultist contains:

-The Occultist game
-The game's complete Soundtrack
-The Occultist Artbook with over 200 pages of behind-the-scenes material

title: Regions of Ruin: Runegate - Deluxe Edition
description:
What better way is there to adventure as a dwarf than with the Regions of Ruin: Runegate - Deluxe Edition, filled with heroic tales, powerful wares and inspiring tunes.

In this traveler’s bundle, you receive:

- The Runegate experience with explorations across Otam and Ealam, the restoration efforts of the dwarven people, and satisfying RPG hack-and-slash combat against goblins and sandworms alike

- The Merchant DLC with perplexing and powerful wares that provide exceptional boons and unusual side-effects

- The Original Soundtrack that boasts 19 tracks that are perfect for taking your dwarven adventures wherever you go

title: Sorry We're Closed: Deluxe Edition
description:
Sorry We're Closed - Deluxe Edition includes:

- Sorry We're Closed
- Sorry We're Closed Soundtrack

Sorry We're Closed is a nostalgic, single-player survival horror game with rich lore, deep characters and multiple endings. Explore unsettling locations with fixed camera angles, while being haunted by the chilling tracks created by C.Bedford, Okumura, Devix and Catton Arthur.

title: Sorry We're Closed: Perfect Combo Edition
description:
Sorry We're Closed - Perfect Combo Edition includes:

- Sorry We're Closed
- Sorry We're Closed Soundtrack
- Sorry We're Closed Art Book

Sorry We’re Closed is an eccentric story-driven survival horror game about demons, angels and what happens when both sides collide. The Perfect Combo includes the game, art book and soundtrack.

title: Middle Earth Open World game
description: A new open world rpg set in the world of Middle Earth.

title: Heave-Ho: Uphill
description: A punishing physics-based co-op game where you and your friends must push a vehicle to the top of the world. Coordinate your moves and overcome brutal obstacles. With no checkpoints, one wrong push means starting over. Are you ready to reach the peak or lose your friends trying?

title: Rising Spirit
description: A brutal boxer life simulation, from zero to the top. Train, manage your weight, make a living, and fight for one goal: to become the World Champion. From delivery jobs to illegal fights, every punch and every penny will bring you one step closer to the peak.

title: Furniture Assembler Simulator
description:
In Furniture Assembler Simulator, you assemble furniture for a living.
You start small and poor, with cheap tools, and take on simple orders to pay the rent.
As you go, you build your reputation, skills and income, unlocking better tools and orders.

title: Seraphim Flame
description:
Astarot, the Grand Duke of Hell has captured the Prince of the Seraph Angels
Without their leader, the Seraphs are weakened.
Only the outcast Serafin has the strength to fight, but can he break into Hell and save his race from annihilation?

title: Punishment 2: The Punishing
description: Punishment 2: The Punishing is an infamously brutal 2D platformer developed by Messhof. Players are tasked with climbing a relentlessly difficult, 10-screen-high vertical tower using slippery controls, tiny platforms, and locked doors that require a main switch to be flipped back at the ground level after each level.

title: Handwalk
description: Handwalk is a difficult physics-based rage game where you control each hand separately to climb a mountain on your hands.

title: Train Sim World 5: Pfälzische Ludwigsbahn: Mannheim - Kaiserslautern
description: Embark on varied passenger services along the scenic Pfälzische Ludwigsbahn in Train Sim World 5! From local S-Bahn to meandering ICE traffic, enjoy a mixed pace on the rails between Kaiserslautern and the busy hub of Mannheim.

title: Train Sim World 5: West Coast Main Line: Preston - Carlisle
description: Tap into the nostalgic 1980s and run up Just Trains' stunning and immersive West Coast Main Line: Preston - Carlisle in Train Sim World 5. Drive the iconic AC electric Class 87/0 and embark on InterCity passenger duties on TSW's longest UK route to date!

title: Three Kingdoms: Bond
description: From Legendary SEGA Japan producer Yasuhiro Nishiyama, Sangokushi Bond is a fast-paced deck-building army battler built for strategy experts, not fast fingers. Recruit from 100 legendary Three Kingdoms warlords, create devastating team synergies and watch your tactics unfold in the chaos of battle.

title: O.B.O.L
description: Gamble your life on a coin flip against a mysterious old man sent by the CORPORATE to decide whether you keep your job. Trapped in a claustrophobic collapsing metal coffin deep under the ocean, you'll slowly lose your sanity in this eldritch, Lovecraftian horror.

title: Haunting of Mageburrow
description: A cozy lovecraftian horror retro RPG. Become a paranormal investigator & explore an open world. Solve a criminal conspiracy of the occult. Investigate & battle monsters.

title: Deck'n'Bag
description: Collect items, craft powerful gear, and fight tactical card battles in a deckbuilding RPG full of risky events, tough choices, and rewarding victories.

title: CheatCheat
description: A co-op exam cheating game where you and up to 5 other students explore schools filled with teenage hijinks ran by a demonic faculty. Steal answers, bully nerds, pray to a magic 8 ball - develop your cheating skills all so you can pass the impossible year-end exam by any means necessary.

title: Forbidden: A First's Obsession
description: Meet Nemesis; Ascendent being and terminally bored. Until the shimmer at the end of Creation, known as the Void, becomes her fixation - and her undoing. A short linear visual novel with gorgeous hand-painted illustrations; a mythic tale of curiosity and consequences.

title: Maxo Scringle's "Human Rocket" Mini-Type Rocket Golf
description:
Created for game-a-week 2026, week 5 (theme: "risk and reward")

Maxo Scringle's "Human Rocket" Mini-Type Rocket Golf is the premiere 3-d hypersimulation of mini-type rocket golf!! world famous akronite "human rocket" maxo scringle himself has sponsored this game, lending his iconic look and advice for aspiring rocketeers!

title: Detective R & Prophet J
description: Gather evidence and uncover the truth through your interactions with others in this mystery adventure game about a case where past and present collide.

title: Timing X
description:
Created for game-a-week 2026, week 4 (theme: "tides and cycles")

Timing X puts you in the seat of a mech in a footrace. Sprint around a course, utilize the raising and lowering tides and get a good time. Made in UZDoom.

title: Dragon and Mahjong
description: Dragon & Sparrow is a mahjong-combat roguelite. Play as three unlikely heroes, escape the endless exploitation games, and fight the goblin corporation that owns the city — across three timelines, all to break free from the Debt of Fate.

title: Lucky Punk
description: Lucky Punk is a roguelike deckbuilder where every turn comes with one simple decision: DRAW another card and push your luck – or STOP and play it safe. Where most card battlers hide randomness or over-use RNG, Lucky Punk always shows you the odds. In a game where every choice matters, every decision in Lucky Punk is transparent, every risk is yours, and well, every failure? Completely deserved.

title: The Azure One
description: Follow the young boy Qiuxu to meet the girl who always sprints in the sunshine, and get to know three other girls with distinct personalities. In the daily life of the Second Municipal High School, you will witness a youth that cannot be turned back — a story destined to go somewhere.

title: Shape Together
description: Shape Together is a factory-building game: lay mines, belts, and machines, automate shapes, and use them to defeat monsters and bosses. Hold back waves, grow stronger over time—solo or with friends on Steam.

title: Suprotyv
description: Suprotyv is a survival game set in controlled regions of Ukraine, where every step matters. Gather resources, interact with civilians, and make smart choices to survive. Dynamic weather, day-night cycles, and detailed locations create tension and immersion in a world full of unseen threats.

title: Global Football
description: Global Football is a multiplayer football game focused on real skill, teamwork, and identity. Here, each player controls a single athlete on the field — not an entire team. No pay-to-win. No scripts. Victory depends solely on your game awareness, technique, and team chemistry.

title: Mystery Adventure The Maid Did It
description: The culprit is—the maid. And the protagonist. your mission is to strike down six unsuspecting guests, one by one. But beware—you must never be suspected before your plan is complete. To escape suspicion, engage in heated debates and refute your opponents. Hide your true identity at all costs.

title: Nurny Battles HD
description: Nurny battles HD is a little indie PvP auto battler with pre-rendered 3d visuals and gimmicky characters that can be played ONLINE or locally. it's also accessible to people with poor internet or ability to use controls

title: Terrain Defender
description: Pass the spherical pointer over the different bags to increase points at the cost of increasing the time in departure.

title: Community Button
description: A global multiplayer idle clicker where every player contributes to a single evolving number in real time. Gain EXP, level up, unlock milestones, and watch the world change through a live heatmap. Compete, contribute, and shape the outcome—together. How high can it go? Will you press it… or watch?

title: Billion
description: A global clicker where every player contributes to 1,000,000,000 clicks.

title: Greed Champions
description: In Greed Champions you will be harvesting the 10 different biomes for loot while grinding and bulking up your hero... The game doesn't have a story and it doesn't need one... This game is about letting your character collect loot and xp while you do something else.

title: Satisfactory 1.1
description: Update 1.1 for Satisfactory includes controller support amoung other features suchs as the new Personnel Elevator and Crash Site Dismantling.

title: Satisfactory 1.2
description: Satisfactory update 1.2 brings back Weather to the game! And big changes to wheeled vehicle pathing

title: House Flipper 2: Co-op DLC
description: It's high time to invite your friends to Pinnacove! Our free Co-Op DLC now allows up to four friends to play simultaneously! Together you can uncover the tales of House Flipper 2 in story mode, or unleash your creativity in sandbox mode. Whichever you choose, Pinnacove's tranquil atmosphere awaits!

title: MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries - Chaos Reign
description: MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries - Chaos Reign brings new campaigns and questlines, new mechs and variants, new weapon types, ground vehicles, and battle armor join the battlefield.

title: MechWarrior 5: Clans - Trials of War
description: Challenge your friends in PvP Arena Mode, battling with your Star across 10 unique arenas in customized Omnimechs. Team up in co-op Horde Mode to survive as long as possible against relentless waves of enemies, with new challenges unlocked through campaign progression. Enhance your arsenal with 12 powerful Omnimech variants, featuring customizable Omnipods and unique skins. Compete, cooperate, and conquer like never before.

title: Zyndeck VX: Card Battler
description: Zyndeck VX: Card Battler is a fast-paced tactical RPG that fuses real-time grid combat with deck-building strategy. Dash through bullet-hell arenas, build a unique loadout from over 150 VX-Cards, and master positioning to survive. Reclaim Eden in this cyber post-sci-fi adventure.

title: Terraforming Mars: Colonies
description: Establish outposts and trade with them to secure your hold on Mars in the Colonies DLC.

title: The Red Weight
description: A story-rich mystery on Mars. You play a geologist in a habitat, on a world that has been silent for two billion years, investigating an ancient secret that has stayed ten thousand years patient. How much weight will you carry for another?

title: Trapped: Forced To Kill
description: Trapped: Forced to Kill is a psychological horror with multiple endings. Ciara Mori awakens in a strange Retreat under a cruel, cunning kidnapper’s control. To survive his deadly games, she must make difficult choices and face the unnerving tension that draws her closer to danger…and him.

title: My Music Label
description: My Music Label is a music management and simulation game where you take full control of your label. Discover young talents, manage legendary artists, and shape the evolution of the music industry. Every decision influences careers and music history.

title: Go Go, Groove Ghoul!
description:
Go Go Groove Ghoul is a bombastic arcade game where you play as a ghost! You must possess the enemies in every level and try to get them to kill themselves with any nearby hazards in order to progress in each level. Rack up big combos, beware the timer and fly through the air with style!

There are 5 levels here to playthrough currently, each with unique theming and mechanics. There's also a "secret" hardmode that can be activated via pressing the 9 key in the level select, which adds an extra layer of chaos to the stages. You can also pimp out your ghoul in the shop with several skins to purchase!

I started with project all the way in December last year, with me wanting to get it out within December/January. However I kinda fell off the project and then worked on it very inconsistently until like September and August. Now it's finally here for October! How fitting given the ghostly theming of this project! Happy Halloween, fellas!!!

title: Flail
description: FLaiL is a difficult platformer by Maddy Thorson. The overall objective of each level is to touch the floor under the red beam of light to finish the level. In addition to this, to unlock additional zones and levels, points must be collected in each level by finishing the level as quickly as possible, and by touching bonus point icons in the levels.

title: Heroes of the Triangle: Mask Rush
description: Grab the mask and run! In this chaotic party platformer with accessible combat, up to 4 players compete to see who can hold the sacred Lunara Mask the longest. Move fast to outmaneuver your rivals, sabotage their attacks with precise parries, and try to complete this unpredictable ritual.

title: Psyhonds
description: A satirical mental hospital survival simulator: control four unstable characters, craft from junk, forge dubious alliances, communicate with patients and staff, and choose between a quiet life in a ward, a riot, or a risky escape to freedom.

title: Starpath
description: Build your starship alone or with friends and explore a seamless universe. Plot a course, burn your thrusters, and chill out in your retro tech ship while you play games and drift through the dangerous vacuum of space. Approach orbit around distant worlds to discover whether we are truly alone.

title: Immortal Wayfarer
description: Immortal Wayfarer is an endlessly replayable dungeon crawler RPG where layouts, monsters, and traps change with every run. Make clever use of items, rewind time when danger closes in, and if you fall, simply recover and upgrade your gear to set out once more!

title: Dr. Oops!
description: Become an unlicensed doctor at a shady hospital, diagnose bizarre patients for fun, and struggle to pay off your debt in this medical adventure game!

title: Metaxia
description: Descend into the monolithic, spiral-shaped hole where Hungary stood. Explore, hide or fight, evolve your body, scavenge the ruins and uncover the mysteries of the Final World War.

title: Janitorial Escapism
description: You play as one of the Cleaners/Maintenance team members at the Black Mesa Research Facility. After the resonance cascade occurs, you are forced to make you way to the surface and escape.

title: Tideborne Haven
description: Tideborne Haven is a cozy, story-driven pixel art life sim set on a fragile tropical island on the brink of collapse.

title: Angels Online Global
description: Angels Online Global is a charming 2D fantasy MMORPG featuring flexible builds, faction warfare, and deep customization. Enjoy 4× leveling, expanded inventory, real-time chat translation, and dungeon-earned outfits with fusion upgrades!

title: Addie Shen
description: Addie Shen is a math based puzzle shooter. Play solo, team up in co-op, or practice your skills to stop the evil PEMDAS minions. Can you save the world with math?

title: Bytes and Knights Adventure
description: Bytes and Knights is a full-scale digital TCG set within an RPG world, packed with deep strategy and unique mechanics. Explore the streets of your new city, collect cards, build your own deck, and battle increasingly challenging opponents. Each new card unlocks new playstyles and brings you closer to uncovering what really lies hidden beneath the city.

title: Cogito: Requiem
description:
Cogito: Requiem is a 2D action game where you dash freely through a harmony of music and sound effects.

The setting: a world where humanity has migrated into the digital realm and vanished, leaving behind only the SI—artificial intelligences who once had humans as their masters. As Cogito, you race through this world where their remnants linger, set on "ending" the SI that have fallen into error.

title: Synthaly Universe
description: A vast world waiting to be uncovered. Step into Synthaly Universe, where every path hides a secret and every ruin tells a story. Explore, decode hidden lore, and uncover mysteries woven deep into the world. Built for curiosity and discovery, this adventure rewards those who look closer.

title: Conductus
description: A rhythm game where you conduct the world with dynamic hand movements! Using a specialized controller and advanced tracking technology, you become the conductor of the world

title: Gutsy Grid
description: An Action Deck-builder. Battle through enemy encounters with your trusty Gutsy Bit console. Collect abilities through Carts and Console Mods. Wield the power of the Gutsy-Bit to stop a sinister plot threatening two worlds and have the raddest summer vacation ever.

title: Handlime
description:
Forget the keyboard! All you need are your hands.

Meet the protagonist of our 2D action-puzzle game "Handlime"—a quirky, hand-shaped slime! Using a webcam, the game tracks your hand movements in real-time, perfectly syncing them with the slime on the screen.

The controls are completely intuitive. Walk by wiggling your fingers as if "tickling" the ground, tilt your hand to move, or make a fist to punch and blast objects away!

title: Hermit Computer
description: Hermit Computer is a horror-puzzle game set in 2001. Deep within the Hermit Kingdom, you play as an outsider tasked with extracting critical intelligence using a secretive state-controlled computer operating system.

title: Iced Fish
description: A fishing horror game about fishing in the snow.

title: Jigenro
description:
"JIGENRO" is a 3D color-matching puzzle game.

Click to grab and move panels on the field.

If you can connect all panels of the same color, you clear the stage.
Some stages feature fields with side walls or fields with elevation changes.

title: Unbeatable: Breakout Edition
description:
The Breakout Edition includes:

- The base game! Imagine if it didn’t

- FOUR brand new exclusive songs created in collaboration with Jamie Paige, Lena Raine, MEMODEMO, and past remixers DOG_NOISE, SoundCirclet, and Lumena-Tan

- A bunch of extra back catalogue songs from UNBEATABLE director rj lake including tracks from I AM YOUR BEAST

- That’s not even all the songs

- 20+ additional arcade mode titles

- 1 exclusive menu palette

title: Soulstation
description:
A visual novel between fear and love. Follow Kin as it falls deeper into a rusty world that will one day eat it whole. Will you get on board?

An atmospheric audio-visual narrative of a child who boards a train to the afterlife.

Will you give in to reality? Or crawl your way out? In this beautiful dusk, you need only open your heart.

title: Final Fantasy XVI Demake
description: The critically acclaimed Final Fantasy XVI, reimagined and transformed into a SNES-style JRPG. This fangame of the free demo of FFXVI features new chiptune arrangements of 18 tracks from FFXVI's first chapter by xvibit, as well as a mix of modified SNES FF SFX and sprites, original pixel art, and tilesets by artists from the itch community.

title: Amanatsu Adolescence
description:
At Kazamitou Gakuen, students are free to do as they choose and the light music club which Akira is part of is actually the most ‘free’ rock band! Following the motto of enjoying everything in the world, he partook in the club activities as a bass player with guitarist Ryou and vocalist Natsu. That was until the club was disbanded after setting the auditorium on fire with a flame-throwing guitar.

Akira was put into the science club and remained melancholic even while being comforted by his classmate Amane. However, when he returned home, he was greeted with the sight of a beautiful and naked silver-haired girl. Sasha is a Russian girl who will be staying at his place due to his parents’ arrangements. Together with the former light music club members, Sasha and Amane, he works towards the upcoming Amanatsu Music Fest and the Russian rock festival Вторжение.

title: Jack The Mime
description: You are Lorina and after suffering a very serious damage wake up in a kind of old house with many corpses to the developer so you have to escape as soon as possible, but be careful as someone will take care that you never wake up again

title: Gyaru x Ota: Orikawa Kirara wa Osewa Shitai
Lovers’ Fun!
description: Play as Souta in this heart-warming simulation game where you live with your boss that suddenly proposed to you. You accept the marriage, even though you’ve spent zero seconds dating each other, but everything actually turns out well. All that’s left to do is get to know her better and enjoy life.

title: Warband
description: Warband is a wave-crusher, boss-rusher and mystery-busting roguelite. Choose your commander, recruit for your warband and stock up at the shop to create unique combinations every run whilst fighting off waves of enemies and bosses a plenty. Can you turn the tide and get Thornhallow back on its feet?

title: Te to Te Try on!
description: There is a high school located in the country. The school is full of equipments created by the newest technology. However, almost all of functions stop when a typhoon comes and system troubles happen one by one. There is no electricity and water. Students have no time to study, but they somehow enjoy their school life. Shinichirou is a transfer student and joins the School Retrieval Committee. Their mission is to repair system troubles for other students.

title: We Are Live Momora!
description: We are live Momora! is a 3D Orthogonal Platformer with inspirations of weird games like FunnyPizzaLand or Harold's Walk to make a fun weird experiment.You control Momora, a half ""human"" half peg-top, protagonist of the best show of G.O.D television enterprises!, Please G.O.D so he doesn't punish you and create the best show ever seen!

title: Conan Exiles Enhanced
description:
Conan Exiles Enhanced is an Open World Survival game set in the mythical lands of Conan the Barbarian. In single-player, co-op, or persistent multiplayer, you must learn to survive the wilds of Hyboria before building your own home or even a shared city. Survive freezing cold temperatures, explore loot-filled dungeons, develop your character from scavenging survivor to mighty barbarian and powerful sorcerer, and fight to dominate your enemies in epic siege wars.

Conan Exiles Enhanced includes a free Unreal Engine 5 upgrade that offers enhanced visuals, improved performance, and a more integrated world.

After Conan himself saves your life by cutting you down from the corpse tree, you must quickly learn to survive. Weather scouring sandstorms, shield yourself from intense temperatures and hunt animals for food and resources. Explore a vast and seamless world, from the burning desert in the south to the snow-capped mountains of the north.

Forge the legacy of your clan as you fight to reclaim and dominate the Exiled Lands. Use the powerful building system to create anything from a small home to entire cities piece by piece. Wage war using swords, sorcery, bows, and siege weapons, even taking control of giant avatars of the gods to crush the homes of your enemies in epic battles.

title: Crewed
description: Crewed is a 2–6 player cooperative spaceship management game. Players take on the role of corporate workers operating a fragile, poorly maintained spaceship for a megacorporation. The objective is to keep critical ship systems running, repair dynamic disasters, and complete procedurally generated missions while coordinating with the crew.

title: Puber Lario Mand
description: Puber Lario Mand is a joke game developed by Supernova as a Secret Santa 2014 gift for LangtonSoft.

title: F Fanatic
description: Horror visual novel set in England.

title: Escria
description: ESCRIA is a dark fantasy 2D adventure where players explore the final moments of a dying world. Players take control of Astro, a silent boy who awakens in a tree house and journeys through forests, ruins, caves, castles, and cursed lands. The game features exploration, challenging enemies, boss encounters, hidden secrets, multiple equipments, relic collection, armor upgrades, and multiple weapon types with unique abilities. ESCRIA focuses on atmospheric exploration, dark fantasy environments, and build variety.

title: Yurikago yori Tenshi made
description:
This fully voiced battle ADV is the first title by a revamped Akatsuki Works Black team. Hiro spends his days attending school without a goal in his life. Two years ago, he inherited an unworldly object known as the knight frame, which can cause great destruction at a whim. He is determined not to use these powers because they would be a disturbance to everyone else. Even though he hates himself, he believes that this is the best thing to do.

Along the way to school, he looks around after sensing a warning from the knight frame. There he saw a girl with a carefree smile, who quickly vanished before his eyes like an illusion. He then found himself in another world with a battle about to begin.

title: Empulse
description: Empulse is a fast-paced 6v6 movement shooter where movement is the weapon. Outmove and outgun your opponents across the post-utopian streets of Freehold, chain wall-runs into grapple swings into mid-air kills, and fight for Crews to control mechs for the ultimate power spike.

title: Frost Kin
description: Frost Kin is an arctic survival tragedy: armed with only a spear and the lingering soul of your twin brother, you must bind his spirit to wild and ancient beings to survive. But life is fleeting — every transfer chips away at his humanity. This is not an open world. This is a closing wound.

title: Retail Rivals
description: Build your retail empire inside a shopping mall. Open multiple stores, sabotage rivals, and play solo or with up to 8 players. Choose different match objectives or play endless mode and compete for retail domination.

title: Ake no Yosuga: Twilight Loop
description:
This is a loop-based psychological horror visual novel.

Every day at 5 PM, a girl named Akane dies.
The protagonist, Keita, becomes aware of this loop and struggles to change her fate.
However, no matter what choices he makes, her death is inevitable.
As the story unfolds, a shocking truth emerges—
Akane has been dying repeatedly to protect Keita.

title: Sonnet
description: Transport a magical flower across scenic lands, encounter strange travelers, and uncover the kingdom’s secrets in this sprawling medieval roadtrip.

title: 93, Kuindzhi
description: Kuindzhi, 93 is an atmospheric first-person narrative vignette about an 18-year-old boy from Donbas. The story takes us to March 2022, when the world changed forever — into a space where the past, fears, and doubts find their voice.

title: Mel-Practice
description:
Mel-Practice is a point and click adventure game where you must find a way to kill yourself within a dream in order to escape. Only thing that can properly end you in this world is one particular individual, who you must track down throughout the whole game via talking to and helping others within the dream world. Explore wacky worlds, talk to... interesting characters, play minigames, and take in the vibes!

This game was made as part of a 8 month project for my college animation class. It was meant to release as a full game but I got too ambitious during its conception. So now, you just get a demo! However there is a very good chance that I don't work on this project anymore afterwards from losing interest in it over the project's duration. Though I may return to this project at some point or in some alternative way. I did take the time after the project ended though to touch up anything I wanted to either look better or weirder.

title: Over Sand
description:
A roguelike steampunk shooter with a unique upgrade-building system: create custom weapon and turret abilities by combining modular cards. Thousands of possible combinations make every run play differently.

Take control of the ship’s main turret and get ready to aim, track, and tear through waves of mechanical enemies. Assemble powerful synergies, adapt your combat style, and turn your turret into a devastating war machine.

The Gatling overwhelms with raw fire rate, the Railgun pierces heavy armor, and the Gauss Cannon devastates crowds with electrical splash damage.

There is no running — only your turret, your choices, and your hunger for victory decide whether the sands claim your ship.

title: Ichizu na Kanojo to Koi Shitai
InVein
description: Traverse this never-ending hospital as you discover clues of where and who you are. As each day passes by, the world around you decays, and you can’t help but wonder what is real. Utilize your time and resources as you roam these collapsing halls, but be careful; you may not be alone after all...

title: A Playground Afternoon
description: A 3D platforming party game, play with your friends in a colourful environment and enjoy yourselves!

title: Canine Derby Manager
description: Manage your dog racing kennel in this management sim. Carefully craft you routine for training , hire the best staff and work your way from bottom of E-Rank to Champion status!

title: ISO/2004
description: A Filipino psychological horror experience where a photographer’s camera reveals what his mind refuses to remember. As hauntings intensify, an unresolved case resurfaces and exposing denial, guilt, and a love that never left.

title: Cute Diana
description: Cute Diana is a desktop companion game focusing on deep cultivation and interactive companionship. More than just a static decoration, Cute Diana is a virtual partner with an independent attribute system, a career path, and a life full of details.

title: Cart Panic! OS: E-Commerce Tycoon
description: Run an online store inside a chaotic operating system. Hackers attack, viruses pop up, customers rage, and a card game tempts your profits.

title: Maokatsu!: Maou to Yuusha no Idol Seikatsu
Digital Defender O.R.C.
description: In the dark cyber future of 200X, monsterkind needs YOUR help! As the Overseer of Retaliatory Combat (O.R.C. for short), you must protect monsters from digital assassins! Coordinate monster units and place obstacles & traps to stop the slaughter of the innocent in this tactical tower defense game.

title: John Fury’s First Fury
description: John Fury’s First Fury is a 2d adventure game. Your adventure will bring you across the landscapes of Russia to make it to a secret communist lab where they're conducting dangerous experiments. You'll have use what you find to help you along your journey against many different enemies and bosses.

title: Ironblood
description: Run a dark fantasy fighting promotion. Sign gladiators, book matches across five weight divisions, negotiate contracts, and stage Blood Nights. Champions die, legacies rise and fall, and rival promotions hunt the same talent. A living dark fantasy MMA management sim.

title: ARB: Anomalous Research Bureau - Museum
description: Investigate a mysterious old museum as an agent of the Anomalous Research Bureau. Identify strange anomalies, file accurate reports, and endure the nights until your investigation is complete.

title: Half Blood
description: You, known as The Player. The only True Saint, a Half Blood is tasked with killing & liberating heaven from the Demonic Invasion by slashing your way through the final gate, where you have to defeat the All-Father who is possessed by Satan. Pro Deo et Patria

title: Drowned Caves
description: Atmospheric, short, and simple adventure puzzle game that gives the player freedom in finding the solution to the obstacles they encounter along the way in the drowned caves.

title: Skollorn
description: Sköllorn is a fast-paced, minimalist RTS where the map itself is your weapon. Sever supply lanes, forge new fronts, and wield one of five asymmetric commander doctrines across procedurally generated galaxies. Solo or up to 8-player skirmishes — no two wars are ever the same.

title: Borrowed Light
description: Armed with curses and guided by a Saint, you bleed Light to escape Purgatory in this hack & slash roguelite of non-linear progression where every interaction matters.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector - Ultramarines
description: The Ultramarines have arrived in Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector. This legendary Chapter brings a massive roster of eighteen new units to the battlefield, embodying tactical perfection and unwavering discipline.

title: Willow: The Last Archivist
description:
An action roguelike and bullet heaven where you play as Willow, a gifted Archivist who has the gift of time, allowing her to live many lives in different Eras. Her goal is to preserve history in Time Crystals, which allows the world to never forget the evils of the past. Her Crystals have been stolen and shattered.

Travel through different Eras and reclaim the crystals, while fighting off hoards of enemies. Play as 5 different classes, and use over 80 Heirlooms to create powerful builds!

title: Total War: Warhammer III - Bhashiva
description: The Bhashiva Character Pack introduces Bhashiva, The White Tiger, as a new playable Legendary Lord alongside a deadly company of mercenary Tiger Warrior units for the armies of Grand Cathay.

title: Rogue Quest
description:
RogueQuest is a roguelike deck-building card game set in a dark fantasy world. Players build poker hands — pairs, straights, flushes, and more — to deal damage to enemies across procedurally generated dungeon floors. Each run features card drafting, loot rewards, and a branching map with combat, shop, rest, and event nodes.

Choose from five character classes (Warrior, Rogue, Wizard, Paladin, Warlock), each with a unique starter deck and playstyle. Collect and equip up to five passive power cards that trigger special effects during combat. Enhance your deck at the Forge between floors, and invest in persistent town upgrades that carry across runs.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine II - Purgation Update
Warhammer 40,000: Darktide - Skitarii
description: The Adeptus Mechanicus will not see the secrets of Hive Tertium fall into the hands of heretics, the Skitarii Alpha Primus are elite operatives devoted to serving the will of the Omnissiah. They will annihilate all who stand in their way.

title: Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster
description: Play a sneaky & brutal Skaven Assassin in this new, refreshing but gritty take on the 2D Action platformer genre.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Chaos Gate - Deathwatch
description: Command the Imperium’s most elite alien-hunters in a brutal, turn-based tactical RPG. As an Inquisitor of the Deathwatch, every squad you build and every decision you make shapes the fate of a sector under siege from Genestealer Hivecults, Orks, T’au, and the forces of Chaos.

title: Re:Rite
description: Transform from a tiny, scrappy survivor into a skyscraper-sized Kaiju, as you fight through swarms of enemies in this chaotic PvE game. Hack-and-slash through hordes of spider-bots, clear through crowds with bullet-hell ranged weapons, and even team up with up to 3 friends in online co-op.

title: Wagee
description: Climb the corporate ladder in WAGEE! WAGEE is a roguelike deckbuilding game where you play cards and roll dice from your desk to reach increasingly difficult score quotas. Buy powerful items at the shop, merge cards to discover new ones, and upgrade your cards to create the strongest deck possible!

title: The Marvelous Raincaster of Yell Holler
description: A time-looping puzzle ballad of Ozark folk superstition. Reorder events in time to unravel the legend of a weather-making rooster.

title: Flip-Flop Fury
description: Smack deserving targets with flying footwear in this fast, projectile-steering arcade game. Short, replayable runs with tons of challenges, instant restart, bullet time, unlockable footwear, and juicy, reactive physics.

title: Kindred [SnowBound]
description: n this dark romance, horror visual novel, a brutal attack on your village leaves you stranded and vulnerable. Making matters worse is your run-in with the beast of the nearby woods. Will you find a way to escape your demented captor, or will you earn his trust? Choose a side; Don't look back.

title: Station Command
description: A strategy RPG autobattler with branching story set in a far future corporate dystopia

title: Whistle1
description: Whistle1 is a retro football manager in the style of the 90s. Take charge of a club in Germany, England, Turkey, Italy, France or Spain and lead them to the top of European football.

title: Tank POV
description: You play as a little tank in a psychological horror game set in a bizarre world where tanks can devour each other, and are even treated as meat. Grilled, cooked, and served like ordinary food.

title: Membrillo Hid My Socks
description: Membrillo Hid My Socks is a silly point & click hidden object game about finding your missing socks after your mischievous cat went on a rampage.

title: Rootnote
description: Your mission in this singleplayer adventure-survival game is to restore the forest's decaying life force. Cleanse the infested root by uniting the powers of the guardians and using their music. Build a boat or swing with your vine to discover new places.

title: Anomalith
description: “ANOMALITH” is a survival third-person shooter set in Japan, steeped in the atmosphere of liminal spaces and Showa-era retro aesthetics. To search for her missing friend, a girl steps into a world writhing with anomalies.

title: The Particle of Infinite Free Will
It Takes a War: Demo Drills - Director's Cut
description: A short 3–5-minute experience that is unique unto itself. It is a self-contained prelude to what's to come in the full game.

title: Samurai of Hyuga Book 6
description: Return to Hyuga just in time for the new semester! Sword fights, love confessions, demonic rituals—nobody said graduating was going to be easy! A text-based novel, 300,000 words and hundreds of choices, without animations or sound effects.

title: Songs of Silence: Crownless King Expansion
description:
A rogue and his ragtag family of troublemakers carve out a cozy life on the edge of the Silence-ridden Midlands. But comfort rarely lasts... When hungry kingdoms move to feast on what remains of the realm, sharp tongues, light fingers, and highly questionable honor unexpectedly become the Midlands’ last hope.

Join Thorn's lot in both campaign and skirmish, with this Songs of Silence expansion!

title: Noskovrazdor
description: Noskovrazdor is a humoristic incremental game. Player takes a role of unnamed operator in goverment structure, and is blocking the outer web.

title: Line Forge BlackSmith
description: A blacksmith shop with a "line" of unique adventurers! Use your memory and timing mini-games to quickly identify each customer's preferred weapon and forge it. In the Battle Phase, your armed customers fight. Power up your regulars (MVPs) and defeat the bosses. Become the busiest blacksmith!

title: Broken Crown
description:
Broken Crown is a fantasy real-time strategy game built for players who miss the depth and intensity of classic RTS titles — reimagined with modern systems and large-scale battles.

Build your base, gather resources, recruit armies, and command your forces in battles where formations, positioning, and decision-making truly matter.

In a world shattered after the fall of the Crown, factions rise from the ashes.
Only those who master economy, technology, and battlefield control will survive.

title: RPG Maker U2U
description: Add 3D depth and rich effect expression to conventional 2D maps! By adopting a fixed perspective similar to the classic 2D RPG Maker view, you’ll draw players deeper into your imagination than ever before.

title: Psalm 2
description: First-person psychological horror where the elevator is the only safe place. Each floor is a new reality. Each floor has a new inhabitant. Find it to continue your descent downward.

title: Spellhook
description: Master the art of the hook in Spellhook, a dark fantasy retro fever dream where high-momentum platforming meets chaotic 1-hit-kill combat. Battle friends in 4-player arenas or brave a brutal singleplayer roguelite. Build your tower, craft powerful ability shards, and prepare to hunt a fallen god.

title: Wheel Make It
description: One wheelchair. Two players. Infinite chaos. Solo or co-op physics-based game about teamwork, clumsiness, and the unstoppable power of friendship.

title: Architects of Giants
description: Architects of Giants is a co-op, base building survival game where players embark on an epic journey aboard a colossal walking robot. Team up online and form your unique squad of squirrels engineers, tasked with constructing and guiding your giant on a grand pilgrimage to save a withering world.

title: Dig Too Deep
description: Throw goblins at all your problems in this Action Tower Defense Roguelite. Craft upgrades. Choose Perks. Build defenses. Defend your Base! Angry baddies want to turn you to pulp! Stop them the only way you know how: throwing goblins! Don't miss.

title: Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy: Immortal Phoenix And Lunarian Princess
description: Cirno, the Hero of Ice, treks into the depths of the Bamboo Forest of the Lost in search of a legendary treasure, but unexpectedly gets dragged into a local rebellion. The stringent Lunarian Princess, ruler of the rabbits, crosses swords with the recalcitrant Immortal Phoenix, leader of the rebels. As an outsider, what sort of choice will Cirno make...?

title: Nightmare Journey 1135
description: A horror adventure through wandering nightmares “The escape game is over.”

title: Factory Balls Go!
description: In this clever logic puzzle, craft each ball using the right tools. Yes, the classic Factory Balls puzzle game is back with fresh ideas. And this time, the balls might even have arms and legs, welcome to Factory Balls Go!

title: Veil of Mist
description: Veil of Mist is a first-person atmospheric horror adventure set in a shifting, logic-defying afterlife. Stay hidden from a deadly, perceptive entity, explore an ever-changing world, piece together fragmented memories, and face moral choices that shape your fate.

title: Dusk Hunters
description: Dusk Hunters is a dark fantasy roguelite action RPG where you battle relentless forces of darkness in brutal skill-based combat. Wield powerful abilities, craft devastating builds, and challenge ruthless bosses at the end of every run.

title: Emergency Riot Response
description: Take control of police forces during an international, high-profile conference, and prevent protesters from getting into the head conference building where the negotiations are being held.

title: Elyndor
description: Elyndor is a 1v1 online PvP card game set in a dark fantasy universe where five factions battle for the Heart of the Void. Build a 15-card deck, master faction synergies, and outplay your opponent in tactical turn-based duels. Choose from five unique factions — Ka'runa, Ybyrá, Ferrovéu, Anhangá, and Orun — each with distinct mechanics and lore. Fair progression with no pay-to-win on functional cards.

title: The Kaiju is My Childhood Friend
description: A high schooler's life takes a crazy turn when he is reunited with his childhood friend who, occasionally, turns into a 300-ft tall kaiju.

title: Special Force Remastered
description: Special Force Remastered is a modernized, team-based tactical first-person shooter (FPS) developed by DRAGONFLY GF CO., LTD. that officially launched in Early Access on March 24, 2026. Rebuilt completely in Unreal Engine 5, the game serves as a faithful visual and technical upgrade to the iconic 2004 classic military shooter Special Force 1. It preserves the nostalgic combat flow, precise skill-driven movement, and distinct gun recoil of the original while adding modern matchmaking, structural gameplay balance, and tactical progression layers.

title: Thornhold
description:
Thornhold is a forest-defense autobattler where water is your most powerful weapon, and you choose where it flows. Shape the forest and protect the Great Tree from lumber-hungry orcs.

Route a river across a grid, place tree structures and troops, and survive waves of escalating orc hordes. Every cell you connect, every terrain you activate, and every card you play shapes the battlefield.

The River Changes Everything. The path you carve determines which bonuses fire, which groves you awaken, and whether your Forest Core gets the power it needs to survive.

Seasons Shift and the Map Transforms. Every few waves, the season changes, and all terrain bonuses rotate. Adapt your strategy to survive.

Draft. Grow. Fight. Draw from a pool of 20+ cards - structures that auto-attack, troops that march into battle, and mutations that stack bonuses.

title: Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX 3
description: The speedy and stylish action of the Luminous Avenger series is back! Our hero Copen must use his new "Divide Edge" energy swords to protect his home from otherworldly invaders! His trusty partner Lola is there to support him with evolutionary new modes!

title: Winter Whiskers
description: In this cozy snow-cleaning adventure, help bring Winterlight Harbor back to life after a sudden blizzard! Vacuum up snow, turn it into steam, and power the town. Melt icy paths, help your neighbors, and prepare for the Winter Festival!

title: Junk-o-Tron
description: A fast-paced match-3 block puzzle game. The scrapyard is filling up! Help your robot team refine and recycle everything so we can warp it out of here. Hone your skills to clear everything fast and get the maximum score!

title: Dawn of Kagura: Natsu's Story
description: Vanquish and recruit youkai in randomized dungeons in Dawn of Kagura: Natsu's Story, a replayable roguelike RPG! The goddess Natsu descends from her shrine to fight evil and free the nearby village.

title: Unforgettable Love
description: You survived a drowning accident but lost all your memories. As “Pe Luem,” you must slowly piece together your past. Along the way, you will meet five women with their own dreams and secrets. Build relationships and uncover the truth, Who is the one that still remains in your memory?

title: Airship Climber
description: Become king... if your friends let you. Scramble through chaotic airships and floating debris to claim the crown, then survive one minute of bombs, panic, and betrayal before returning as an angel or devil spectator.

title: Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss - Shining Trapezohedron Quest
description: Search for fragments of the shining trapezohedron and learn more about this ancient artefact through puzzles that will test your perception and your sanity.

title: Idle Chapel
description: A dark-fantasy incremental game about confronting a rising cult. Seek out worshipers who turned to darker gods and smite them back to the light. Harness their devotion to grow stronger and purge the land of evil - one click at a time.

title: Ano Hi no Kimi wo Furimukasete
description:
One day, the protagonist, Naomichi, realizes that he’s time-leaping.
He doesn’t know why, but this must be a chance given to him by God!
He remembers his many failures and the girl he likes, Yuu.
If he corrects his mistakes one by one, maybe he’ll be able to “fall in love” with her!?
Thinking this, Naomichi begins to revise his future little by little.
However, he always ends up returning to the same day after about a month.

title: Yatte mo Derarenai Heya ni Tojikomerareta no de Hikitsuzuki Motto Yaru Hanashi
Ryou-ude ga Oreta no de H na Osewa wo Sareru Hanashi
description:
To save his landlord daughter who was about to be run over by a truck, the protagonist makes a dangerous dash!
…As a result, he ends up getting both his arms run over and suffers a fracture that requires several months to heal.

His parents are away on a long-term business trip overseas. Going back to his family home won't help,so she has decided to take care of him for the time being...!

title: Pokémon Edición Sombría: Vientos del Pasado
description: It is a fan game conceived as a successor to Pokémon Shadow Edition and a reimagined spiritual sequel to the events following Pokémon HeartGold and Pokémon SoulSilver. The project combines the classic essence of the series with modern mechanics and elements inspired by other RPGs, without compromising the original identity of Pokémon. Furthermore, it places a strong emphasis on expanding the lore and on a deeper, more cohesive narrative within the Pokémon world.

title: Space Kitten
description: In Space Kitten, time is your greatest enemy. Take control of an adorable space feline and navigate the interconnected rooms of your spaceship with one simple, unforgiving rule: you have exactly 10 seconds to survive each challenge.

title: GearDude
description: GearDude is an ordinary plumber, working day in and day out just to make ends meet. When he gets a routine call to fix a pipe deep in the city sewers, it sounds like just another dirty job.

title: I Wanna Be Car
description: In his craziest dreams, Carl is a car! Accelerate and use ramps to jump through 10 dreamy levels in this inventive fusion between 3D platformer and kart racing game.

title: Silent Stay
description:
Dive into the unsettling world of Silent Stay, a narrative horror game with psychological elements.

You step into the role of Alex Miller, a writer who has rented a remote cabin in the woods to finally finish his book. The cabin seems perfect: far from the city, no neighbors, just you and your thoughts. But after just a few days, strange events begin to accumulate that make you question your sanity.

title: The Pactmaker
description: You are a professor who forged pacts with otherworldly entities to save your daughter. Dive into the memories of others, alter reality, and use your new supernatural abilities to uncover the truth in this dark point-and-click thriller.

title: That’s An Order Ensign
description: Complete a slew of mundane and dangerous tasks, Do it quick or you're dismissed! Try to stay alive, but do your job. Because after all... That's an order, ensign!

title: Ashes of Holloway Bay
description: Immerse yourself in a chilling, interactive cold-case investigation. Review crime scene photos, decrypt restricted hard drives, compare evidence, and deliver your final report in Ashes of Holloway Bay, a dark, atmospheric detective experience where every detail matters.

title: Castlevania: Order of Shadows - Golden Belmont
Logbook: Beneath the Storm
description: A narrative deduction game where you uncover a dark maritime mystery by piecing together clues and hidden connections. Step into the role of a detective, reconstruct past events, identify those involved, and reveal the truth behind a series of grim incidents at sea.

title: The Incentive Program
description: The Incentive Program is a match-3 roguelike about a surreal corporate job that’s hiding something. You’re paid to play, but you won’t win. So rig the odds, exploit the rules, and escape the program.

title: Wyrmspan
description: Wyrmspan is an engine-building, card-driven strategy game for 1 to 5 players. Play as an amateur dracologist discovering a world of dragons. Excavate caves and explore your sanctuary. Entice dragons and chain their abilities to create powerful combos.

title: Touhou Momogetsushou: Pitch Peach Paradise
description: Touhou Momogetsushou: Pitch Peach Paradise is a single-stage Touhou Project fangame by disfact.

title: Concrete Abyss
description: Concrete Abyss is an atmospheric first-person action game set within the vast substructure E-01 — a dead concrete-metal world where surveillance systems still operate and system units perceive you as an anomaly.

title: Biotone
description: A pitch-controlled brick breaker where you move the paddle with your voice. Travel through 8 biomes brought to life with retro-inspired sound and visuals.

title: Corocoro Friends
description: Roll, stick, and carry everything. "Corocoro Friends" is a chaotic physics puzzle action game where you roll a sphere, cling to objects, and solve challenges in creative ways. Play solo or with a friend—cooperate or sabotage your way to the goal.

title: Signal Pit
description: A fast-paced monster arena roguelite where every beast has unique passive traits, active skills, and powerful overclock abilities. Build your mutation loadout, survive deadly fights, and evolve between runs.

title: Loot Gobblin' Together
description: An online co-op game where you and your friends play greedy gobblins invading human houses to steal and gobble loot. Climb, stretch, and manage your stamina to survive chaotic heists and feed your Gobblin King.

title: Cake Studio
description: Cake Studio is a sandbox-style cake-decorating game with no objectives or timers. Explore an extensive catalog of decorations to create the cake of your dreams.

title: Tactics Wanderer
description: A classic SRPG featuring 40+ classes, deep tactical combat, and a gripping narrative.

title: Profit Sea Incremental
description: A short incremental game about fishing, earning gold, and unlocking powerful upgrades to dominate the waters.

title: Ward X
description: Ward X is a indie horror puzzle game set inside an abandoned hospital that should have stayed forgotten. Navigate twisted halls and solve puzzles as you search for a way out.

title: Colorace
description: It will be an extraordinary ride! Drive your car through walls made of colored blocks, collect useful power-ups, dogle obstacles on the road, and compare your skills with other players.

title: Rival Roads Car Racing
description: Rival Roads Car Racing is a fast-paced top-down single-player racing game where you navigate challenging tracks, outmaneuver rivals, and prove your skills to become the ultimate racer! Upgrade your car, master tight turns, and dominate every race in Rival Roads Car Racing!

title: Terminal Cursor
description: Terminal Cursor is a fast‑paced reflex arcade game where you dodge evolving bullet patterns and survive as long as possible. Every movement matters. Features intense runs, rising difficulty, high‑score focus, and an original soundtrack by David‑Ștefan Horecica.

title: Dread Trials
description: A century of war between two great kingdoms has bled the lands dry of men. Conscripted to fight, they have all but perished on the battlefield.Now, with no one left to defend their homes, the women must take up arms and carry on the fight...

title: King's Lynn Leisure Farm
description: King's Lynn Leisure Farm is a farm idle game with racing driver theme. Here, you can collect a variety of cute animals, play with them, feed them, and send them out to work. You can also collect various vehicles to decorate your farm. Enjoy your time on the farm with your little animal friends!

title: Mahou Shoujo: Magical Shota
description:
Shota is a typical high school student living a normal life. One day, while he was walking home, he encountered a monster! Luckily, when the monster was about to attack Shota, he was unexpectedly saved by a mysterious magical girl! He was in awe as he got to know this girl, Asuka. Although she seemed strange at first, he soon grew to trust her and appreciate her presence. Over time, Shota's bond with her grew stronger and he began to develop feelings for her. From then on, he begins spending time with her and getting to know her.

Will Shota be able to win Asuka's love and live happily ever after? Find out in this cute story of love and magic!

title: Super Meme Clicker
description: This is a clicker game where you click the meme to gain click currency! The more clicks you have, the crazier your clicks will become! Every click you make has a chance to change the meme - how many clicks will it take you to get the rarest one?

title: Under a Groove
description: 'Under A Groove' is a rhythm game that's fun just to watch, even if you're only playing the music video. A stylish rhythm action game where visuals and music sync perfectly—simple to play, deeply satisfying to master.

title: MAPS (My Apocalyptic Plan for Survival)
description: Rendered in breathtaking cinematic pixel art, MAPS blends the intimate tension of classic survival games with the strategic depth of a sidescrolling colony builder. A deeply diegetic world keeping you immersed in every moment with its tragic beauty.

title: Sanctum Ruins
description: A strategic roguelike deck-builder. Build your deck, master 8 unique classes, and conquer the Sanctum in quick sessions. Free to play.

title: Max Gentlemen: Escape From Moriarty Mansion
description: Join nine absurd Victorian characters invited to a mysterious and remote mansion. Solve devious puzzles, explore the mansion and try to keep everyone alive. Friends or Foes: it's up to all of you to discover Professor Moriarty's secrets and defy his murderous game.

title: A Game About Sucking (Up Ghosts With a Vacuum)
description: A short, active incremental game about sucking up a range of cute and mischievous Ghosts with a Vacuum and harvesting their Ectoplasm.

title: Sill Cats
description: Tiny cats have moved onto your desktop. They walk along windows, play with your cursor, curl up and sleep, and may suddenly sprint around at 2 a.m. Includes 2 cats for free.

title: Mekururi: Dizzying Witch
description: A mysterious adventure game where you spin the witch's eyes round and round to unlock secrets. Escort her without hesitation through fantastical puzzles and action.

title: Moto Trial Turbo
description: Moto Trial Turbo is a physics-based 2D arcade motorcycle trial game. Players can look forward to exciting tracks, devious traps, secrets, and even player-created levels! Complete challenging tracks against the clock and compete with players from around the world on the leaderboards.

title: Nexus Code
description: NEXUS CODE is a 3D programming battle game that reimagines the excitement of the "hobby anime" and "competitive toys" that captivated many children in the 90s and 2000s, using modern programming elements. Build your own unique character and challenge rivals with logical thinking as your weapon.

title: Capybara: The Great Journey
description: 4-player co-op farming adventure. Play as a capybara and your animal crew to save your home from bankruptcy! Plant, repair, upgrade, work and explore from the forest to the city to pay your farmer's debt.

title: Ninja or Die 2 Die
description: In a nutshell, it's a high-speed game where you defeat enemies by jumping. The goal is to defeat as many enemies as possible while your soul inhabits another person's body for a limited time, during which the body gradually decays even if you do nothing.

title: Own Time Own Target
description: Own Time Own Target drops two players into a divided battlefield in a pure 2D 1v1 where reading the environment is just as important as outgunning your opponent. Easy to pick up, impossible to put down. Friendships not guaranteed.

title: Sodomy Fatale
description: By Jamsanppoid (From Madness with Love), Sodomy Fatale lets you run a totally normal vampire gay bar! Craft custom "blood drinks" (Hematels), chat with quirky patrons, and attract VIPs. Vibe to original tunes and build your dream bar!

title: Lordress
description: Rhiannon was born into honor — and cast into chains. Some are born to wear a crown. Others must take it.

title: Smile Muscle Trainer
description:
Smile, and jump.

A game where your face becomes the controller.

title: Hyperspin
description: Spin to win!

title: The Possession Experiment
description:
A short survival-horror game, where you're a Scientist controlling Human Test Subjects to help you try and escape a bunker overrun by a hostile Entity.

The Game can be viewed as a hybrid of Classic PS1 Horror Games like Silent Hill and Resident Evil and modern horror games like Five Nights at Freddy's.

title: Sushi Lick
description: One lick away from a lifetime ban. Sushi Lick is a licking and chaos simulator about trading your dignity for viral views. Upset the customers and lick the sushi while dodging the chef’s sharp eyes. Be fast, because being caught means your fame ends in an instant.

title: The Way of Ping-pong
description: A roguelike bullet-hell shooter where table tennis meets ancient mythology. Wield your paddle to strike enemies with bouncing balls, retrieve them to attack again, and craft powerful builds through strategic upgrades.

title: Syndream
description:
The game consists of an ADV section where you advance the story by choosing dialogue options, and an action section where you explore a dream world.

As the story progresses in the ADV segment, new dream worlds are unlocked.

By exploring the dream world and utilizing action mechanics, players uncover the truth behind the dreams, which reflect the inner lives of each chara

title: Librarian of Aquademia: The Forbidden Grimoire
description: An auto-2D side-scroller shoot'em up game that aims to be beginner-friendly for someone who has never experienced a shoot'em up bullet hell game before.

title: Type & Magic
description: Type words to shape your path, solve puzzles, and explore the ruins of a dead wizard's castle. Find artifacts to uncover the castle's dark mysteries. Report everything you saw to your master. Or… don't.

title: Weatherium
description:
You play as a little god who can control weather elements such as temperature and wind.
Warm the air, and convection will begin, eventually giving birth to clouds.
Carry rain clouds on the wind, and new water sources may spread across the land.

title: Paskahousu
description: A traditional Finnish folk card game, brought to Steam. Shed your cards, nuke the pile, bluff your friends — don't be the last one holding.

title: Consorts of the Emperor
description: Win the heart of the Emperor by presenting the best gifts and outplaying your rivals in this digital version of the boardgame Consorts of the Emperor!

title: Cubounce
description: CUBOUNCE is a high-speed physics-based platformer. Players control their character to soar through levels with extreme momentum, using bounces and grappling hook swings to overcome challenges.

title: Regulea
description: A turn-based strategy card game about infections and antibiotics. Build a deck from 119 cards, spread infections to pressure your opponent, or use the right antibiotics to recover. Correct choices alone are not enough to win; timing and strategy matter. Simple rules, short battles, replayability.

title: Rue Valley: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
Rue Valley Digital Deluxe Edition includes:

- Rue Valley
- Rue Valley - Digital OST
- Rue Valley - Digital Artbook
- Rue Valley - Supporter Pack

title: Oddsparks: An Automation Adventure - Ultimate Edition
Hiteneiro: Astronomical Few Minute.
description: Hiten'eiro: Astronomical Few Minute. is a Touhou doujin fan game by disfact.

title: Lucky Swirl Island
description: Therapy homework for Lucky featuring Lucky Swirl!!!! Every island is random so you'll just have to get lucky.

title: Farm Manager World: Africa
description: Agriculture in Central Africa faces numerous challenges. Poor soil fertility, an unfavorable climate, and a lack of sufficient funding are just some of the obstacles you’ll have to overcome in this region.

title: Bunbun Shinbunbu: You are Newspaper!
description:
Bunbun Shinbunbu: You are Newspaper! is a Touhou Project fangame created by disfact.

It was created to promote the character Aya Shameimaru in the 6th Touhou series popularity poll.

title: Knock on the Coffin Lid: Complete Edition
The Rake Sees You
description: Alex and his friends set out for a camping trip deep in the forest. What starts as a fun escape quickly turns into something far darker. This forest hides secrets… and something is always watching. Survive. Escape. Don’t look back...

title: Animaly Bar: No Humanity!
description: Run your bar as a gorilla and hunt down the humans in animal costumes hiding among your customers. Observe them closely, spot the clues that give their disguises away, test their slogans, and blow the imposters away with your shotgun. Choose your targets wisely... or become the hunted.

title: Fossilfuel 3
description: Navigate an open-world Siberian island overrun by dinosaurs. They brought them back, you’re here to put them down for good in the terrifying third act of the Fossilfuel series!

title: Koi Suru Amairo Homestay: Ryuugakusei ha Wanko-kei Osananajimi
Koakuma Nurse no Itazura Karte: Kangoshi Kanojo to no Dousei Seikatsu
Healing Days: Toshi no Sa Kanojo to no Ama Ama Seikatsu
description:
The protagonist (name customizable) is a salaryman working in a provincial city.
One day, after a work-related mishap, he drowns his sorrows in alcohol and passes out on the street.
When he wakes up, he finds himself in an unfamiliar living room, being cared for by the heroine, Uesaka Shiori.
Shiori had taken pity on him after finding him passed out on the street and brought him home.
Touched by her kindness, the protagonist begins to pursue her. Shiori doesn't seem entirely opposed, but...
And so begins a sweet, slightly unconventional romance with an older girlfriend.

title: General Practice
description: Diagnose and (mis)treat patients to meet tight deadlines and high expectations in this wacky medical co-op adventure. Wear many hats, master numerous tools, multitask, manage the chaos: all while trying to do no harm! Play solo or enjoy the tomfoolery with up to 4 players, locally or online.

title: Oshikake Kanojo ha, Ore no Sewa wo Shitai
Kanojo to Ore no Koisome Dousei
Boku to Kanojo no Gohoushi Dousei
description: Satoshi lives together with a housemaid in a Western-style building while his wealthy father is away on business. One day, she got in an accident and was hospitalized. His classmate Shino was at the scene of the accident and felt partially responsible for the maid’s injuries. She proposed that she will take over the maid’s duties until she recovered. That’s how a girl that he was a bit interested in at school ended up being his maid. It was the beginning of heart-throbbing days living together with his classmate.

title: Choppy Waves
description: Choppy Waves is an online co-op party game for up to 4 players where you run a floating bar on the open ocean, mixing drinks and serving customers while waves send everyone sliding across the deck.

title: Highland Haven
description: Discover your own private haven in the Scottish Highlands and bring this once thriving home for hairy “coos” back to life. Craft goodies to sell, optimize your farm, and grow a pasture of cute highland cows roaming free on the bottom of your screen in this relaxing idle game.

title: Jack Bonecroft 4
description: An outsider. A different world. A warrior who isn't finished yet. Lunara Mistwalker is thrust into a realm of secrets and ancient powers. Four kingdoms. One mission. Jack Bonecroft 4 is a story-driven action RPG. Based on true events witnessed during my business trip to this sector.

title: Deathly Delights
description: Forge new friendships, banish the darkness, and illuminate your surroundings as you unravel the truth behind a town stuck in Limbo during Hallows Eve.

title: Arkan Solas: The Haunting of Ashfell Manor
Dead Rig
description: Dismember relentless biological horrors, scavenge for resources, and fight your way through intense, short campaigns with randomized elements in this brutal sci-fi survival horror where your only goal is to survive... and escape the station Resurrection_426.

title: Mystery of Myths: Whisper of Depth - Collector's Edition
description: Uncover impossible deaths in a hidden object adventure filled with myth, mystery, and puzzles. Explore eerie locations and face a legend rising from the deep!

title: Honkai: Star Rail - The Lethe Below the Living
description:
Version 4.3 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New characters: Mortenax Blade
• New Trailblaze Mission: "The Lethe Below the Living"
• New events
• ...and more!

title: The Rebirth Tale of Broken Horn Demon Lord Alice
description: To exact revenge on the Brave, the reckless Demon Lord Alice, after her rebirth, decides to proceed cautiously, step by step. To weaken the brave's forces, she must defeat the Four Sages and expand her territory.

title: The Dark Field
description: After receiving a strange message, Ahmed Raked finds himself at a remote farm with nothing but his phone to guide him. What starts as a simple job slowly twists into a dark, personal mystery—one that may be rooted deep in his past. Some jobs are more than they seem.

title: Unsung Cascade
description: Unsung Cascade is an indie role-playing game developed by Lostforge Softworks. It features a stylized 2.5D/3D environments. Gameplay focuses on exploration across connected open areas using a world map with points of interest, alongside a party-based battle system that includes skill usage, Boost mechanics, Guard actions, and ultimate abilities known as Cascade Drive.The game is currently in active beta testing.

title: AI Apocalypse
description: A cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder. Fight the AI apocalypse with melee, magic, or rifle — 3 weapon classes, 9 build paths, 120+ cards. Every run is a new tactical puzzle of stance, distance, and deck synergy.

title: Kyen: The Skeleton Amulet
description: Kyen - The Skeleton Amulet is a short adventure showcasing the engine of Bylina - Lure of the Sorceress. It is an old-school fantasy hack ‘n’ slash role-playing game, with turn-based tactical combat, glorious 16-colour graphics, and a simple one-hand interface.

title: Help me Cleaner Sama!: I Got Isekai'd to Clean Monster Girl Basements
description:
This is a comedic fantasy puzzle game that follows an overworked cleaner transported to another world and tasked with clearing dangerous basements for a cast of eccentric monster girls. The story blends absurd humor and visual novel-style dialogue with satire about work, responsibility, and everyday frustrations.

Gameplay focuses on grid-based, turn-based puzzles where players manage limited movement, avoid hazards, and solve stage-specific challenges that vary by character. The game also includes mature themes, unlockable animated scenes, and a gallery mode.

title: Shinsoudenki Arithmetica
description: Shinsoudenki Arithmetica is a shoot 'em up doujin game by disfact.

title: Fleet Hunters
description: Find and sink battleships in a fast grid-based duel with real-time firing and retro visuals.

title: What You Don't See
description: What You Don’t See is a first-person paranormal horror game with narrative elements supported by environmental and character-driven storytelling. The player takes on the role of a paranormal investigator and communicates with the ghost of Irene - the spirit of a murder victim, with fragmented memories who is trapped in a liminal space— find closure about her cause of death.

title: Touhou Sorayumebako: Gift from the Gods.
Foreign Rim
description: A rich Turn-Based Strategy with deep mechanics, big armies and complex balance. Lead an expedition to explore the vast desert expanses. Play campaign, custom game, PvP, or create custom experiences with built-in scenarios and map editors!

title: Grip 2: Combat Racing Evolved
description: GRIP 2 is a fast and futuristic combat racing game with rocket-powered, flippable vehicles. Race with unique movement tech and use powerful weapons and abilities to beat your opponents to the finish line. Sequel to GRIP, a spiritual successor of the Rollcage games.

title: Treasure Island: Abandoned Enigma
description:
Based on a real story, this game takes place on the famous Treasure Island abandoned resort owned by Disney. Can you survive the twisted memories of your childhood?

You survived the animatronics, but...

title: Aporia Aegis Antechamber
description: Aporia Aegis Antechamber is a High Fantasy, Lite-RPG Dungeon Crawler set in the fictional world of Viridia, populated by humanoid sentients named Lanir and many other creatures. There exists a labyrinth hidden in a clearing deep within a notorious forest, having caught the attention of adventurers from far and wide due to its reputation of never having been conquered, none even knowing its creator or purpose. In this game, you must brace yourself as you take 100 steps within the maddening labyrinth. Control Sybil and his loyal servant Elohi as they venture into it thanks only to Sybil's hubris.

title: Before Close
description: Before Close is a VERY SHORT indie horror experience where you play as Jared, a janitor arriving for his usual night shift at a small laundromat. It’s a quiet job. The kind of place where the machines rattle a little too much, the tile floors are always a bit damp, and nothing ever really changes.

title: Late Night DJ
description: Play as a late-night radio host whose quiet shift becomes a horror. Inspired by a chilling, now-deleted Reddit post, Late Night DJ lets you experience the terror firsthand, giving you a chance to survive. Will you take it?

title: Night Shift: Security
description: Step inside the forsaken corridors of Sinar Media Harindo, an abandoned corporate tower where silence echoes too loudly and every shadow conceals a story best left untold.

title: MindFall: Cedar Grove
