description: In MindFall - Cedar Grove, you play as Lara, a young woman who accepts a babysitting job in the quiet town of Cedar Grove. What begins as an ordinary night slowly turns into something disturbing as strange events start unfolding around her.

title: Project Manager Sim
description: Manage the most unpredictable resource - people - in this WASD tycoon! Plan projects, hire a dream team, assign tasks to specialists, and monitor the budget while upgrading your office. Balance between team burnout, complex contracts, and the wrath of upper management.

title: Neverness to Everness: Dreamwalk Corridor
description:
Version 1.1 of Neverness to Everness, which includes:
• New Characters: Lacrimosa and Chaos
• New Main Story Chapter
• New areas: Sunward Island and Corridor of Echoes
• New events and game modes
• ...and more!

title: Cliffside Cafe
description: Cliffside Cafe is a casual point-and-click cooking game where you play as a barista running your very own cafe! With tons of recipes, ingredients, and upgrades to unlock, will you become the ultimate barista?

title: Hangover Gallery
description:
A game about throwing individuals down a pit.
Made in under 72 hours for a game jam.

title: Hentai Tales: The Gyaru's Secret Hobby
description: My life as a loner takes an unexpected turn when I discover the gorgeous gyaru girl from my class has a secret hobby—she's a passionate AV connoisseur just like me. What starts as awkward encounters after school soon evolves into a relationship that goes far beyond just watching adult films together.

title: Slight Mechanical Destruction
description: Slight Mechanical Destruction is a 6 level unit for Quake II, based on Lazarus.

title: Crimson Loop
description: Fight your way through waves of increasingly frenzied hordes of monsters! Earning upgrades, powerups, and abilities. All in a mysterious yet satisfying adventure! To uncover the mysterious story behind your origins, The Loop, and much more.

title: Crucible United Between Eons
description: Enter the Crucible United Between Eons and unearth impossible strands of future.

title: Improvise, Adapt, Overcome
description: Improvise, Adapt, Overcome is a 2 level unit for Quake II.

title: Before They Wake
description: Before They Wake is a third-person horror game set in the 1980s. Play as Alfred Baptiste on a desperate quest to find a cure for a mutating virus that has temporarily left him paraplegic, impairing his mobility. Can you help him find solace and a cure before it’s too late?

title: Reservoir Stroggs
description: Reservoir Stroggs is a large singleplayer level for Quake II.

title: Quake 30th Anniversary Jam
description: Map-Center's Quake 30th Anniversary Jam contains 30 maps.

title: Mym's Sword
description: Defeat powerful foes and discover a colorful world full of mystery and wonder in this exploratory action platformer! A wandering beast discovers a magic sword, but can she uncover the truth of its origins, and resist the powers that created it?

title: Lethargic
description: Welcome to the Wonderful World! You will step into this open scene that combines fantasy and crisis. In the screen, there are quaint wooden houses, lush forests, and lush grasslands. The falling pink petals add romance, yet hide unknown challenges.

title: Goth Clicker
description: A minimalistic gothic clicker: click, collect Souls, upgrade your abilities, and unlock new stages by reaching the goals.

title: Treetop Trials
description:
Treetop Trials is a 2D hand-drawn platformer where you can walk on walls and ceilings using your gravity boots! Your mission is to fix the treetop security systems to protect everyone from the gnomes's magical mischief.

Play through 40 colorful mind-twisting levels inside the trees in a forest. You'll need spacial awareness and platforming skills to overcome the ever-increasing challenges each level presents!

title: HolyBattle
description: Bible trivia for twitch chat browser based game.

title: AFK Tactics
description: No level ups. No brainrot progression. AFK Tactics is a strategic autobattler where choices matter. Your party grows through adaptative synergies, skills & items, not XP bars. 200+ heroes with unique passives, traits & classes, 30+ factions with differents playstyle, mecanics. Theorycraft, conquer.

title: Under the Eye
description: The world and regime you once knew is crumbling day by day. The Major won't let you go until you've beat her at her own twisted card game. Bid, cheat and bend the rules to see another day, or die and be forgotten.

title: Puss in Box
description: Puss In Box is a cozy cat search simulator with puzzle and pet care elements.

title: Move Together
description: A cooperative game for 5 players! Pack items into car trunks across various locations, solving puzzles. All items must fit so the doors can close. Hunt for secrets, race against time with friends or solo, and become the best!

title: The Second Sight: The Devil and the Wheel
C.A.B.A.
description:
C.A.B.A. (Center of Anomalies of Buenos Aires) is Hypnos Team's interpretation of the subway level in the Backrooms universe, a short, first-person survival horror set on a ghost station that doesn't appear on any map. Presented as found footage, with retro game references and lighting that shouldn't work this well.
You can't fight what's down here. You can only try to escape. Inspired by genre classics like PT, Outlast, and Amnesia, C.A.B.A. focuses on stealth, exploration, and environmental puzzles. Includes full VR mode on Steam VR, Meta Quest, and PS VR2. Approximately 30 minutes long, with multiple endings.

title: The Second Sight: All Hallow's Eve
Box Game: Showdown
description: Box Game: Showdown is a fast-paced 2D multiplayer platformer where you and three other players must race to outrun a deadly hazard wall while making moral decisions that determine the fate of both you and your friends!

title: 1492: Anno Domini
description: 1492: Anno Domini is an 8 level unit for Quake II, featuring new weapons and enemies.

title: Last Day on Stroggos
description: Last Day on Stroggos is a 9 level unit for Quake II.

title: Laser Guy
description:
Laser Guy is a comedic twin-stick anti-shooter where you play as a stressed developer whose anxiety triggers uncontrollable laser beams. Navigate chaotic studios, solve explosive puzzles, and reach safety without hurting anyone.

Because in this industry, there's always a risk of getting fired.

title: Abyss Runner
description: Meet Lily, the Queen of the Underworld. She possesses incredible magic abilities, but to be honest, she's a bit of an airhead... She tried to pull a prank on an adventurer using a monster-filled pit, but fell into it herself... and now she's stuck. Just how will she get out of this one?!

title: Shipolis
description: Shipolis is a cozy minimalist city builder and resource management game. Sail and explore archipelagos with your ship. Build cities and expand in several regions. Manage production lines and automate with trading routes. Will you build great wonders and uncover all the mysteries of this world?

title: Yogenkyo
description: Here’s your chance to become a young ninja of the Beasts Ninja Squad 4! Roam the stunning hand-drawn 2D bustling metropolis glowing with endless neon hues. Step forth fearlessly to battle vicious yokai gangs, and swear to defend peace and serenity across the city called YOGENKYO!

title: Touhou Sorayumebako Gaiden: Konohana no Sorayume
description: Touhou Sorayumebako Gaiden: Konohana no Sorayume is a Touhou Project doujin fangame by disfact.

title: Lost Paradise
description:
You've slept through the end of the world. The last thing you remember is the kidnapping.
As you wake up from cryosleep, you find yourself in a bunker, seemingly the last human on earth. A note from your captor encourages you to seek the tower, where you will find your answers. Now you're on your own.

Explore this desolate world ruled by machines as strange as they are deadly. Find new abilities to carve your own path through obstacles and reveal secret passageways. Learn what happened to you and to the world as you seek salvation at the top of the tower. If there's any hope left for mankind, it's you.

title: The Undead Lawyer
description: A hyper-movement, action puzzle game where you speed through the world to save the souls of the damned, reviving them and executing them in specific ways decreed by the gods as fast as you can!

title: Template!!: An Angel’s Gift
description: The 4K Ultra HD Remaster of "Template!! An Angel's Gift"—a hilarious slice-of-life visual novel—is now on Steam! Follow Sakura Sora, whose bizarre new condition makes ridiculous "classic tropes" real, sparking a twist-filled daily comedy with unique companions.

title: Deadwave
description:
Deadwave is a classic stylized third-person shooter with Ancient themed maps. Built by a solo indie developer, it drops you into striking locations from Egyptian sands to crumbling temples, where every fight turns into a desperate, chaotic last stand.

Along the Zombie game mode also resides typical multiplayer modes. In these Prop-Hunt shines with amazing party gameplay but if you want to get competitve, you can 1v1 your friend, play free-for-all or team deathmatch.

title: Gecko Shuffle
description:
Gecko Shuffle is a simple game that tests one's reflexes. The player is presented with three tiles, two of which are empty and one of which has a gecko depicted on it. When the gecko is clicked, the three tiles are reversed and then re-arranged; the player then has to click on the tile which, in his opinion, is the one with the gecko. The tiles are then revealed again, and the player can see whether his guess was correct. A successful guess gives 10 points. The game can be played at one of the 10 levels - the higher the level, the faster the tiles move.

There are two game modes: the "Single Level Shuffle", where the player chooses the level he wishes to play on, and has an opportunity to make 20 guesses (correct or not) before the game ends; and the "Progressive Level Shuffle", which is based on the same rules, but the level increases with each successful guess and decreases with each failure.

After each guess, the player can see an instant replay of the tiles re-arranging, but in slow motion and with the tiles revealed.

title: Kaze no Tayori
description: Kaze no Tayori is a Touhou Project doujin fangame by disfact, described as a communication simulator experimental game.

title: Michikusa Wanderer
description: The Demon Lord and the Hero are gone. With no mission to fulfill, no world to save, you hunt as you please, eat as you please, and travel as you please. It’s an RPG where you are free to do anything.

title: Yuletide Machine
description:
Yuletide Machine is part of the 2023 HauntedPS1 advent calendar.

Somewhere on the North Pole, work in a dodgy factory and synthesize fuel for Santa's sled. A combustion engine rips through the night. Headlights bleed through dirty windows.

Run machinery and work through the night before the arrival of Santa.

title: Distant Paradise
description:
Sent from Earth to scout the outer reaches of space, you crash-land on the planet Soror. Under its dead black sky, you find a mysterious temple built by an ancient civilization. Explore it! It may hide the key to your survival...

Explore the mysterious temple and its surroundings to find new movement abilities that will allow you to reach more places. But be careful, many monsters roam these halls... Can you find your way out? And can you uncover the secret purpose of this place?

title: Crate Beyond
description: It’s just like Crate Expectations, only deeper, greater, darker and crater.

title: A Match Made In Hell
description: You died! In less fortunate news, it's Christmas! You've been taken under the literal wing of Aple, West Avernus' matchmaker extraordinaire and self proclaimed Party Crow. As her apprentice, you've been tasked with pairing some local holdouts before Hell begins its yearly freezing over!

title: RuneCipher
description: RuneCipher is a tactics RPG that combines turn-based strategy with active combat. Recruit unlikely allies, explore long-forgotten ruins, and uncover the secrets of an ancient magic to save your guild in this Strategy RPG inspired by genre classics.

title: Last Monday
description: A psx horror game where on a spooky monday night, your forced to wash your clothes because your E-Girls are refusing to talk to you due to the pure filth on your clothes, so you decide to take a trip to the Laundery Mat, little to your knowledge, this trip takes an unexpected turn...

title: Rosa's Quest
description:
An indie platformer game made as a final project by a group of high schoolers.

Steam description: The ocean attacks! Aquatic creatures have seized control of the planet. Cities are in ruins, suburbs are flooded, and humans have not been seen since. In ROSA's Quest, take control of a Rescue Operations and Safety Android, destroy the leaders of the oceanic army, and recover what was lost.

title: Indigo Park: Chapter 2
description: Your adventure in Indigo Park is only beginning! Now that Rambley has informally hired you on to the company's staff, you'll use your new Rookie Rangler status to explore and repair Oceanic Odyssey, one of the newer additions to the park. Featuring exciting new characters, environments, and story!

title: The New Me
description: The main character is a young special forces soldier, who has been fighting the drug cartel for a long time. During the regular mission, everything went wrong...

title: V.A.U.L.T Protocol
description: Vault Protocol is a 1–6 player co-op horror game focused on extraction, communication, and chaos. Every run is different, every sound matters, and survival depends on your team.

title: Return To Castle Arbeitsamt
description:
The year is 2012. The republican army lost the civil war. Megahitler is about to take power.

In this investigative thriller you'll need your wits about you to survive the tests of Castle Arbeitsamt. Prevent Megahitler's electoral victory!

title: Cozy Campfire Club
description: Go camping with other players and setup a cozy campfire. Chat and make friends as you relax by the campfire, customize your campsite, forage in the forest, and cook up different foods in this cute hangout game.

title: Quack Quack Up
description: A voice-controlled party game that will have you and your friends screaming until you pass out! Drop the controller and use your vocal cords to herd a flock of ducks to the finish line—or watch them all yeet off a cliff because someone yelled a bit too loud!

title: Banquet of Nausea
description: Banquet of Nausea is a dark fantasy RPG made in RPGMaker. You will play as Liya — a girl on an epic quest to find her lost kin. Explore sacred ruins, purge festering abominations, and forge bonds with survivors whose fates lie in your hands.

title: Celestial Temple
description: Celestial Temple is a narrative action-adventure game from Ursa Majeur. Become Curiosity, uncover who and where you are, and journey through a dreamlike mythic odyssey across ages, facing enemies with your own face while seeking a sliver of light in self-made darkness.

title: KochiKame: Ryo-san's Billion-yen Beat
description: KochiKame comes to life as a simulation game! Ryo-san runs wild to save the shopping district! Build an anything-goes shopping street and aim to become a billionaire!

title: Idle Colors
description: Strategize with 8 unique currencies, each with upgradable production chains. Master triple prestige systems, evolve your economy, upgrade generators tiers, optimize through conversion, and dominate leaderboards in this deep idle experience.

title: Ariadne's Tale
description: Ariadne's Tale is a 3D first-person puzzle adventure. Play as Ariadne, use a magical thread, navigate ancient traps and unravel the secrets of the Labyrinth to rescue Theseus. Myth, cunning and biting humor around every corner.

title: Nightfall Empress
description: A 16‑bit dark fantasy action adventure with metroidvania‑style maps, RPG growth, and hidden secrets. Lead the Nightfall Empress through a mature journey suspended between the sacred and the profane.

title: Swallowtail: Ano Hi, Ao wo Koete
Days of Reckoning: Last Battle
description: A turn-based strategy where modern military forces face an unknown, unnatural enemy. Command elite units, manage morale, and survive in a world where the rules of war no longer apply.

title: Battle Magi
description: Summoned from across time and space, the greatest mages battle for respect and dominance. Use a voice-driven magic system, combine spells and power-ups, and fight in chaotic PvP arenas designed for FFA and team combat.

title: Silent Paradise Anthology
description: Discover 4 short metroidvania sci-fi adventures! Explore a submerged city, a lost world reclaimed by machines and a mysterious temple on an alien planet. Unlock new abilities to reach more places and battle deadly foes. Piece together the story of those places and discover how they’re all connected.

title: Switch Blasters
description: In a world overrun by a rogue AI powered by unstable energy cores. To stop it, three heroes were created—each with unique abilities and combat styles. Alone they are strong, but only by switching between them and combining their powers can they overcome the challenges imposed by the machines.

title: Gravebound Dash
description: A kid enjoying Halloween was suddenly sent to the underworld, the land of the dead, and their ghost costume became the real deal! To avoid getting stuck in the underworld as a ghost forever, the kid mustgather 999 sweets and win the Trick or Treat.

title: Deep in the fields
description:
First-person walking simulator
Inspired by Argentine folklore and rural legends
Simple interactions that reveal the story
Atmospheric experience focused on narrative

title: Scorchy Sky Trials
description: Scorchy, a fearless young hatchling with a heart hotter than his flames, must face the legendary Sky Trials to earn his place among the great dragons. Soar through the clouds, unleash blazing fireballs, and show the world that even the smallest dragon can burn the brightest!

title: Never / Together
description: A chaotic and exhilarating 2D co-op shooter where two friends in parallel universes must share a single weapon while a deadly split screen line is trying to take them out

title: Kumari Samsara: The Living Goddess
description: A narrative-driven 3D puzzle-adventure, set in a post-apocalyptic future of floating cities where climate change has erased history, the game breathes new life into the mystical cultural heritage of Nepal.

title: Full Belly Breakout
description: Navigate the hidden dangers lurking within a wide variety of dishes, savor every bite, fill your stomach, and escape from a terrifying cell. An overwhelming dining experience where eyeballs crawl out of plain rice, sharks burst from soup, and entire universes unfold upon your plate.

title: Embers of the Empire
description: An all-new, original Imperial campaign for X-Wing Alliance set in the Star Wars Legends timeline, taking place shortly after the events of Vision of the Future by Timothy Zahn. As a conscript from Parshoone, Janz Gaaland is thrust into the ranks of the battered Imperial Remnant, fighting not for conquest—but for survival—in a fractured, post-treaty galaxy. With the Empire weakened, divided, and surrounded, every battle matters. Every decision carries weight. And for the first time in years...the Empire may finally have a chance to rise again.

title: Dust & Letters
description: Alice has moved into an old house and must clean and organize it to turn it into a home. Along the way, she’ll uncover memories of the previous resident, as well as a somewhat... unusual companion.

title: Hamb: Rotari
description: Hamb: Rotari is a short, tactical auto-battler developed by Surillyacom Entertainment. It's part of the broader Hamb franchise and the game focuses on preparation an action loop which automatically executes those actions, to fight against an opponent, who repeats your same actions - but reversed.

title: Take Care Of The Dog
description: It's time to play! TCOTD is a short story about... taking care of a dog! Play around, follow him, find items, and a lot more!

title: For the Fish in the Bottle
description: In the vast desert, you discover a tiny fish sealed inside a small bottle. It seems to want something. Solve the puzzles to collect the items the fish desires.

title: Torima Headbang
description: You are a badass bird thug with a sick crest. Strap on your HMD, throw your sanity away, and blast through the concrete jungle BACKWARDS on a mini-skateboard. The better you match the rhythm, the more wind you blast — and the faster you RIDE!

title: Tiny Mage in Puzzle Land
description: Tiny Mage in Puzzle Land is a 2D pixel art puzzle game inspired by sokoban with unique twists! Help the frog mage solve 40 challenging puzzle rooms using his three magical abilities to cross gaps, build bridges on lakes and navigate objects from one point to another!

title: Bandits On West
description: After a group of bandits breaks out of prison, the sheriff must chase them down, restore order, and bring justice to the Wild West.

title: Countryside Farm Clues
description: Countryside Farm Clues is a cozy spot the difference game that turns peaceful farm life into a satisfying test of observation. At first glance, every scene looks perfect, but subtle changes are hidden everywhere, challenging players to slow down, focus, and spot what others might miss. With relaxing countryside visuals, quick “just one more” gameplay, and both timed and stress-free modes, it’s the perfect blend of calm and challenge. Players will care because it delivers that rewarding “I found it!” feeling again and again, whether they want to unwind or sharpen their attention to detail.

title: Ocean Oddities
description: Ocean Oddities is a relaxing spot the difference game that transforms mysterious underwater worlds into a captivating test of observation. At first glance, each ocean scene appears serene and unchanged, but subtle differences are hidden among coral reefs, drifting sea creatures, and sunken treasures challenging players to slow down, focus, and notice what others might overlook. With soothing aquatic visuals, satisfying “just one more” gameplay, and both timed and stress free modes, it strikes the perfect balance between calm and challenge. Players will care because it delivers that rewarding “I found it!” moment again and again, whether they’re looking to unwind or sharpen their attention to detail beneath the waves.

title: Wish You All the Best
description: On a winter afternoon, she sees that familiar face again. But what does it matter? He was never hers to keep...

title: VampireBlaze
description: VampireBlaze is a classic platformer. Fight through over 10 stages - or take an alternate route - as you make your way to the demon lord. It offers a challenging, retro-style action experience focused on precise controls and skill-based gameplay.

title: Laid-Back Camp: Camping Cook-Off!
description: Team up with the Laid-back Camp crew for camping & cooking fun! A wacky 1–4 player action game where you set up tents, cook meals, and cooperate to complete camping tasks. Enjoy both solo challenges and fun multiplayer chaos in the great outdoors!

title: Cube Jump Game
description: A Challenging, 2.5D platformer Where you Climb to the Top! Master Tight, Physics Based Controls, and recover from every fall - DLC Including a Fully Custom Level Editor and Online Browser!

title: Infernal Battles
description: A strategic autobattler where you assemble a powerful army and buy upgrades to enhance it. Balance your resources wisely between miners and units. Refine your tactics to defeat the King and improve your high score!

title: Clan and Crown
description: The game is a strategy simulation game where you start a family, raise children, infiltrate various industries in the city (13 industries, 70 professions), run for mayor to control the city's destiny, manufacture weapons to wage city wars, and ultimately establish your family empire.

title: Friendship vs The World
description:
A wholesomely chaotic 1-4 player co-op game! Craft your friends into HEROES and deploy them into battle against increasingly bizarre waves of enemies.

It's you and your friends against the world... Prove that the POWER OF YOUR FRIENDSHIP can overcome anything!

title: Warno: Gold Edition
description:
Warno: Gold Edition includes:

- Base Game
- Expansion Pass
- Digital Guides
- Reinforcement Packs #1-7

title: Blasphemous 2: Complete Sacrament Edition
description:
Blasphemous II is the critically acclaimed second installment in the brutal side-scrolling metroidvania series.
Blasphemous 2 Complete Sacrament Edition Includes:

- Blasphemous II
- Mea Culpa Expansion
- Blasphemous 2 Digital Artbook
- Blasphemous 2 Original Sound Track

title: Tread Heavy
description: Tread Heavy is a Twin-Stick Tank Shooter. Use your main gun, dash, and your expanding series of upgrades to blow up waves of robots. Battle across your arena to collect XP from defeated enemies and return to the centre console to upgrade your tank further!

title: Arai-san Mansion Exploration Game: Incarnation
description: “Arai-san's Apartment Exploration Game” is an indie game released on Steam on May 24, 2026.

title: Only Humans On Board
description: Buy supplies and manage your resources. Serve customers quickly from your trolley, but stay sharp: be aware of the unknown. Some passengers are only pretending to be human...

title: My Time At Portia: Swimwear
description: This is a DLC for My Time at Portia. It contains one sun hat, one set of swimwear, and one pair of sunglasses. You can claim these items in your mailbox ahead of your workshop.

title: Dream Pinball 3D: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
The Digital Deluxe DLC expands Dream Pinball 3D with a rich collection of exclusive digital extras for pinball enthusiasts and fans of game art and design.

Included Digital Deluxe Content:

18-page Pinball Magazine (PDF) in English, German, and Russian, featuring:
A complete pinball lexicon from A to Z
Background information on the history and creation of pinball machines
Tips and tricks from professional players
36-page Sketchbook (PDF) showcasing detailed sketches and design studies from all six pinball tables
25 Full HD wallpapers
Trilingual glossary in English, German, and French
Double-sided A1 poster (PDF, 59.4 × 83.9 cm) with pinball cover artwork and detailed table descriptions

title: Boxville 2: Collector's Edition
description:
This Boxville 2 Collector`s Edition contains:

Boxville 2 Game
Boxville 2 Soundtrack
Boxville 2 Artbook and Wallpapers

title: Near-Mage: Deluxe Edition
description:
Level up your Near-Mage experience with this deluxe bundle! Includes:

The full Near-Mage base game
Original Soundtrack – magickal music from Transylvania
Digital Artbook – behind-the-scenes art and lore
Cosmetic DLC – stand out at the mage school in style!
Whether you're already enrolled or new to the Transylvanian Institute for Magick, this bundle gives you the best value.

title: Sword & Siege Crusades: Book II
description: Continue the struggle for the Holy Land in Crusades: Book II, a tactical medieval wargame covering the Third and Fourth Crusades between 1149 and 1204. Command the Crusader Alliance or the Anti-Crusader Alliance across 102 historically accurate scenarios and four branching campaigns.

title: Mark of the Deep: Deluxe Edition
Dome Keeper: Deluxe Edition
description:
Defend against waves of alien monsters in this unique roguelike action mining game. Use the time between attacks to dig beneath the surface in search of valuable resources and relics – deliver them back to your dome to unlock powerful upgrades and useful new gadgets.

But it won’t be long until the relentless monsters return - do you risk delving deeper into the mine? Or return to base and prepare for imminent attack? The choice is yours, but make it quickly!

Included in Dome Keeper Deluxe Edition:

Dome Keeper - Defend against waves of alien monsters in this unique roguelike action mining game.

Dome Keeper: Engineer Pack - includes two cosmetic items for the Engineer Keeper: a Hardened Suit and Vigilant Owl pet.

Dome Keeper: Assessor Gear Pack - includes two cosmetic items for the Assessor Keeper: an Arcane Cloak and Baby Sea Dragon pet.

title: Planet Zoo 2
description: Build a wilder world in Planet Zoo 2. Create distinctive zoos around the globe filled with awe-inspiring animals, including fully aquatic and flying species, before taking your experience beyond the zoo to release your animals into expansive Wildlife Reserves.

title: Princes of Qing
description:
Can you survive the imperial palace without being exposed?
Princes of Qing is a palace intrigue roleplaying game where two street thieves infiltrate an imperial marriage selection.
You play as one of them.
If your lie is exposed, you die.
Rise from nobody to palace power through deception.
Every choice reshapes your fate.

title: Livora
description: Livora is a browser-based life simulation strategy game about trying to build a stable life under modern pressure. Players choose a starting life and manage money, rent, bills, work, health, energy, relationships, family obligations, and long-term consequences. Every choice has a cost, and not every cost is money.

title: One Dumb Wizard
description: One Dumb Wizard is an action roguelike where you play as a wizard hell-bent on getting their money back from the Bartender. Find charms to power up your wand, parts to craft new wands, and strategically sling spells in your singular mission to get your money back.

title: Noods
description: Feeling unproductive? Lock in with NOODS and bring functional desktop companions to your computer! These buddies react in real-time to your desktop activity to bring fun into your workspace. Featuring built-in productivity tools to keep you on track, turn your lonely grind into a cozy work session!

title: Pachinko Life
description: A pachinko roguelike where every run is a life. every country, class, and choice changes how the board plays.

title: Monster Mercs
description: Transform into the monsters you slay and unleash new spells and abilities. Team up with up to 3 friends, take on unique contracts to get paid, upgrade your character and gear, and unlock powerful transformations in this fast-paced co-op action RPG.

title: Candy Box U
description: The remake of the classic 2013 Incremental game Candy Box 2. Enter the world of Candy Box U, collect different kinds of confectioneries, find secrets, slay monsters, and maybe, just maybe, become the Candiest Person In The WORLD? A mix of Point n' Click, 3D Autobattler, and 2D platforming.

title: Motorcycle Girl
description: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

title: Ultra Void
description: Ultra Void is a short, narrative-driven incremental mining game about humanity facing the heat death of the universe.

title: Crystal Chaser: Tenkuu no Masuishou
description: For a long time, five magical crystal orbs have been protecting our universe. One of them was hidden on the Earth. But there was a young woman who desired too much power, and she came to the Earth in order to harvest the power of its crystal for her selfish purposes. The only ones who can stop her are Takanoshin, the son of a samurai warrior, and the young girl Noichigo, who teaches little children. Together, they embark on a long and perilous journey through the land of Japan...

title: The Larper
description: The Larper is a short Incremental game about auto-clicking on keys and solving passwords. Buy Upgrades and unlock Secret Key Combinations, while listening to Classical Music and generating Beautiful Paintings in the background!

title: Starcult. Night: Twisted Age
description:
Starcult. Night: Twisted Age is a dark fantasy visual novel with romance and horror elements, set in a mysterious world on the brink of catastrophe.

Explore the life of Silviya, newly married into the noble House of Nebula. Silviya is an Artist, but in this world such skills reach far beyond pastels and paints. Hoping for a different life, she marries the young head of the House, Hans.

The story begins with the brutal murder of her husband by an unknown monster shortly after their wedding. Silviya calls for a detective to investigate the mysterious crime. But who is the real monster?

Use Silviya’s Emotion Palette to read the true feelings and intentions of friends and enemies, influence their actions, and try to escape countless death endings.

Shape your relationships and their nature, create your own cult, and make meaningful choices leading to multiple endings, including Detective, Hedonist, Mystic, Nihilist, Ascended, and hidden endings waiting to be discovered.

title: Rift Investigations
description: Investigate procedurally-generated noir mysteries in a post-apocalyptic world where reality fractures and truth is subjective. Question suspects, search crime scenes, and deduce the truth from lies in this AI-powered detective game where every case is unique.

title: Crystal Chaser: Tenkuu no Masuishou - R
description: A special updated version of Crystal Chaser released via Project EGG. The original staff expanded the story from 7 chapters to 9 and updated each one. Many new elements have been added, including a completely new chapter, a full remake of the final chapter, new characters, and "Intermission Theater R," which offers mini-episodes of the characters.

title: Layermask
description: Save yourself from being stuck behind layers of enemies, platforms, and hazards in this puzzle platformer all about getting to the end of a colorful journey!

title: FD 27: Direct Your Football Club
description: A football management game where you're not the coach, you're the club owner. Hire and fire the coaching staff, sign players, negotiate with sponsors, manage the finances, and build a winning organization from the boardroom.

title: The Cloudberry Abyss
description: Hunt down 10 jewels in a haunted pastry shop, while terrifying creatures start to hunt YOU. This Point-and-Click Survival Horror Game is like FNAF meets "Emily Wants to Play" meets iSpy.

title: Ship Miner
description: Relaxing mining experience that merges combat elements and 1-bit pixel art aesthetics. Collect minerals from procedurally generated asteroids, improve your ship and survive The Anomaly, an unknown entity threatening The Galaxy. Can a simple miner stop The Anomaly and save everyone?

title: The Last Tale
description: Embark on an odyssey through Northern realms in this 2D couch co-op adventure. Play as siblings Torsten and Annika, using gifts from the gods to avenge your village and hunt the mysterious Ivar. Combine axe, bow, and magic to overcome mythological beasts and puzzles to save the world from darkness.

title: Lost City
description: A noir metroidvania adventure in a mysterious Lost City spiced with souls-like gameplay systems. Multilayered 2D world design with intricate spatial depth. Equipable trumpets, guitar and guitar pedals.

title: Echoes of Stella
description: Echoes of Stella is a first-person horror adventure built around a unique echolocation device. Use it to navigate a distorted mirror world, revealing your surroundings in brief moments of clarity. Time your scans carefully, or risk exposing yourself.

title: The Membrane
description: Shoot, slash and slay the enemy hordes erupting from the jungle’s Membrane in this action survival roguelite. Hold the encircling trenches, fortify them, choose your build and rise from loinclothed-servant to unstoppable Amazon king.

title: Warehouse 30
description: Take on your father's job as a warehouse clerk, inspect each shipment note carefully and direct them to where the corresponding warehouse. Stick to the rules, avoid making mistakes and subsequently fines to make enough money to help your family get through this rough patch.

title: PeeWee Purpdrank's Foenem Clicker
description: The Official PeeWee Purpdrank Video Game. Double Tap the Foenem button in this wacky and hilarious idle-clicker.

title: The Wreck That Should Not Be
description: When the mysterious Doctor Hoffmann hires your submarine to explore the east Caribbean sea, you accept, unware of the danger he is leading you into...

title: Road to Empress II
description: Play as the protagonist in this live-action interactive palace survival drama! Take a dynasty's fate into your own hands in Road to Empress II, the upcoming new content of a global hit. Defy fate, navigate intrigue, and claim the throne of power. You decide it all!

title: Velanit: The Forgotten Cottage
description: Velanit: The Forgotten Cottage is a 2D top-down life simulation game set in a 1540s Mediterranean coastal town. Players restore an abandoned cottage, gathering resources, crafting supplies, and befriending villagers in the nearby town. As the renovation progresses, players uncover letters, hidden objects, and puzzles left behind by the cottage's previous owner, gradually piecing together a mystery about him. The game combines cottage restoration, resource gathering and crafting, detective-style puzzle solving, town interaction, farming elements, and decorating.

title: The Little Land
description: The Little Land is a strategy god-sim where you play as a god worshipped by the Littles. Command the forces of nature, protect them from danger, and help their village survive for as long as possible!

title: Dial M for Machina
description:
After nuclear war, the remaining survivors of humanity are secluded to bunkers deep down the Earth, and you are one of them. Using only retro technology, you must connect with other survivors and help them stay alive.

You must solve puzzles, decipher cryptic broadcasts and uncover strange incoming messages. Every action you take through these systems has consequences.

Handle 5 days of underground isolation and help as many people as you can.

title: Penis Simulator
description: Master the ancient art of the dongercopter, precision stream physics and defend the Porcelain Throne from escalating threats.

title: My Life in a Monster Girl Paradise
description: Explore the island, meet 14 sexy monster girls, and let their charms pull you in. Build your harem and take things further. maybe impregnate them!

title: Funkin' Remnants
description: Funkin' Remnants is a remix mod directed by SPG64 themed around the Funkin' Remnants Twitter account, an account dedicated to archiving and showing off old or unused concepts (in other words, remnants) from Friday Night Funkin'. The mod utilizes a minimalistic art style, contains references and nods to early base game content.

title: Spooker
description:
A roguelite pool-like game where you play for your freedom against your host and lightly cursed ventriloquist dummy, Ralphie. Steady your shots, build your combos and rack up enough points to make your escape.

This is pool, but… wrong. Enjoy tight, skill-driven shotmaking, high-risk scoring, and roguelite progression that changes every run and every table. The deeper you go, the more the speakeasy twists and changes. There is always another table, and it keeps getting darker. Will Ralphie ever let you leave?

title: This Short Indie Game Made Me Miss My Friends: Rainy Plays Lonely Game Livestream
description: Tidy up after a sleepover birthday party by finding a home for each decoration and belonging in this story-rich, fully narrated, block-fitting puzzle game. Play alongside a commentating vtuber as you delve into their experience with loneliness evoked by this cleaning indie game.

title: Calling
description: A short sci-fi adventure where an astronaut struggles to decipher a "mysterious voice" through a broken communication device. Using only distorted visuals and flickering audio as clues, you must unravel the true feelings hidden behind the transmission. As the messages arrive in real-time... will you be able to hear them out until the very end?

title: Welcome to Elite Cafe
description: A heart-pounding café management game! Serve customers, cook meals, and invent new menu items — Elite Cafe is busy again today! You can even make your own cookies and drinks. Change outfits and your favorite character becomes the manager?

title: Fortnite Festival: Season 14
description: Two-time GRAMMY-winning artist Laufey is Fortnite’s latest Icon. She’s bringing her mesmerizing blend of classical, jazz, and pop to the Fortnite Festival stage along with brand new Mic Vocal and Pro Drum charts!

title: Kaze no Tayori 2
description: Kaze no Tayori 2 is a Touhou fangame by disfact, and a sequel to Kaze no Tayori.

title: Puzzle Photographer
description: Puzzle Photographer is a puzzle RPG Touhou doujin fangame by disfact.

title: Vanished Maiden
description: Vanished Maiden is an RPG Touhou Project fangame by disfact.

title: Kipi Oppi
description: kipi oppi is a tiny first-person shooter where you juggle a ball in the air with rockets.

title: Puzzle Photographer 2: Fairy Vacation
description: Puzzle Photographer 2: Fairy Vacation is a puzzle RPG Touhou Project fangame by disfact.

title: JKRobots
description: A real time strategy game, push the robots off the map to win, but they push back.

title: Uchi No Heya!
description: Run a sumo stable! Recruit rookies, drill their stats, cook chanko nabe, and steer them through six grand tournaments a year. Climb the banzuke from Jonokuchi to Yokozuna while juggling injuries, rivalries, and an empty bank account. Work hard to make your heya legendary!

title: Astreia's Gift
description: The people of the lunar planet have disappeared! Embody Astreia, a being of light from the solar planet, and try to find them. By opening portals between these two worlds, explore the abandoned living city, but be aware, it will not let you pass so easily….

title: Kunugi's Life is a Mess!
description: In this roguelike, turn-based dungeon-crawling RPG, play as Kunugi, a homeless girl driven by a pursuit of vengeance after her former bully ruined her life. Dive into dungeons, defeat your enemies, learn new skills, and gear up. Don’t let the bullies gain the upper hand over you!

title: Agraria
description:
Agraria is a single-player farming simulation game in which players become a Shared Land Agricultural Engineer for Agraria Inc. Starting with a small plot of land, players cultivate crops, manage soil conditions, harvest produce, expand their farm, and develop increasingly efficient agricultural systems.

The game features seasonal crop planning, orchards, beekeeping, livestock, irrigation, fertilizers, market tracking, contracts, production recipes, and farm automation. Players can process goods through canning, dehydration, brewing, and factory systems while working toward higher ranks and larger plots within Agraria Inc.’s shared-land program.

Designed with an emphasis on farming and production management, Agraria focuses on planting, harvesting, upgrading, and optimizing the farm rather than social obligations or town-life schedules.

title: Battleship Command
description: Command the mighty Scharnhorst in this immersive WWII naval simulation. Walk her decks in first-person, control gunnery, radar, and navigation, and lead your fleet through the Atlantic, Arctic, and Mediterranean. Battle convoys, outwit enemies, and survive the stormy seas of war.

title: Infiltrating Roudille
description: A retro-style JRPG dungeon crawler. Play as an elite knight and confront a perilous mission where success is the only option. Alone and deep in enemy territory, you must succeed at all costs.

title: Hue Factory
description:
Hue Factory is a minimalist automation game about color theory. It’s just you, some conveyor belts, and a stream of colorful boxes waiting to be sorted.

Find Your Flow. Start with simple inputs and route them to their destinations. As your factory grows, new colors appear, and your factory will need to evolve.

title: Grundschule Lernspaß mit Hexe Lilli: Mathematik Klasse 1+2
Stick N' Sheep
description: Join the woolly madness! A chaotic 2 to 8 player party game where an avalanche of crazy minigames awaits you. In a colorful cartoon world, push, betray, and survive to become the smartest… or luckiest sheep!

title: Mouse n' Chase
description:
"Mouse n' Chase" is a racing and action game inspired by the classic cartoons of the 1920s to 1940s. Join Mickey Mouse 1928 in a police chase, featuring obstacles, power-ups, and high-speed action.

Join the Chase: Dive into the world of "Mouse n' Chase" and experience a game inspired by classic cartoons. With its monochromatic visuals and simple controls, get ready to race, dodge obstacles, and catch criminals. Make lots of career points, and your life will become colorful.

title: Billionaire Simulator
description: You are poor. You have no money. Life is unfair. Until you discover a mysterious software on your computer that allows you to make money by just clicking your mouse. The more you click, the more you make. Pretty soon, you're wealthier than you could have possibly imagined... And yet you want more.

title: World of Radiance: The Girl in the Shadows
description: “World of Radiance: The Girl in the Shadows” is a visual novel featuring beautiful girls. Players take the role of Aguang, a gloomy young man, and experience his life at a prestigious school. The story advances through interactive choices that the player clicks to proceed.

title: Office Hours
description: Sort forms, get to know your mysterious new collegues & unravel mysteries they're trying to cover up as you step in to replace the previous RH at this mysterious pharmaceutical company.

title: The Immortal Is Watching
description: Players will take on the role of a little flower fairy and tap on wish plaques to send blessings. Each character’s story will unfold differently based on your choices. Once all wishes have been fulfilled, she will also experience different endings depending on your decisions.

title: MoonNight Shift
description: MoonNight Shift is a first-person psychological horror game where you play as Conner Anderson, a 46 y/o former surgeon who resigned from his post because of his drinking addiction, now runs a super mart, working the night shift as a distraction.

title: Slimper
description: Help Watermelon to climb up to the cable car! Slimper is a hand-drawn precision platform adventure, where your precision and patience will be measured, as one mistake can be a big fall.

title: HoRoyal: Hololive Battle Royal
description: A fan-made action game based on Hololive! Turn your brain off and enjoy some silly fun! Powerful voice clips cheer your exhilarating battles!! Experience the same sense of immersion as a collab livestream!

title: Blackfire Crusade
description: Experience a hardcore dark-fantasy RPG where tactical mastery is your only hope. Recruit legendary heroes, brave perilous dungeons, and challenge the very gods who forsook this world.

title: Super Waifu Tsunami
description: The anime waifu platform-fighter you never knew you needed!

title: Crescent Roll
description: The all-in-one, super-sweet, physics-based, gravity-altering, action-packed, fully-customizable, bite-sized 2D marble racing game.

title: Pokémon Platinum Version PC Port
description: A full PC port of Pokemon Platinum.

title: Moonlight Motel
description: A distant motel. A string of murders. Use your wits to investigate a series of unexplained deaths in this murder mystery job simulator. Welcome to the Moonlight Motel.

title: Archivist: Tidy Up & Sort
description:
Cozy Archivist Simulator is a first-person organizing simulation game set in an archive. The player works with piles of document folders, reads filing instructions, and places files on shelves according to archive rules.

The gameplay focuses on sorting and arranging documents by parameters such as category, subcategory, date, number, and other filing criteria. Tasks include processing incoming boxes, finding requested files, checking records, cleaning up workspaces, correcting misplaced documents, and restoring order to archive rooms.

The game features Sandbox Mode with selectable levels and archive tasks, and Campaign Mode structured around a series of working days with different assignments.

title: Orbfall
description: Orbfall - Reclaim the Planet is an upcoming action-packed sci-fi adventure currently in beta development. It is set in a shattered world devastated by the impact of mysterious orbital objects, players explore dangerous environments, gather resources, battle hostile alien factions, and fight to reclaim the planet from chaos. Featuring detailed base building, team-based PvE combat across multiple maps, and a dark atmospheric setting, Orbfall delivers an immersive blend of survival, exploration, and intense futuristic warfare as humanity struggles to rebuild its future. (Still in development though)

title: Incremental Retro Racing
description: Earn more and more stars by driving faster and faster in Incremental Retro Racing. Accumulate and unlock 70+ vehicles, upgrades, track generation options, and more. Includes unlimited tracks and customizable CRT filter for that old school retro feel.

title: Memories: Silenced
description: A first person psychological horror experience set in a quiet suburban home. Witness a violent crime, uncover unsettling events, and endure a night where fear slowly takes over familiar spaces. Explore a grounded environment where tension builds through atmosphere and subtle storytelling.

title: Epic Balls Smashing
description: Create a deadly spinning war machine, merge chips, forge fusion weapons, and dominate a chaotic physics-based autobattler arena.

title: Super Marshmallow Kingdom
description: Super Marshmallow Kingdom is one toasts battle against the evil forces of marshmallows, cats, tarts, pigs and more! Sent from king marshmallow who is upset after you ate his muffin. With explosions galore dodge your way through 10 action packed levels while upgrading your crumby abilities.

title: Poly Fighter
description: Poly Fighter is a single-player roguelike fighting game. Learn new moves from every opponent you defeat to build your fighter’s unique style. Battle through tense retro-arcade duels with a choice of simple or motion inputs to master your moveset and claim your title!

title: Ropeman
description: A two dimensional platformer where you throw a knife into a wall, attach your rope to it, and swing like a pendulum. With only your rope swing skill, you must keep climbing upward until you finally reach the moon.

title: ServiceIT: Microcontroller DLC
description: ServiceIT: The Microcontroller DLC lets you build your own microcontroller-based devices. Use GSM modules, temperature sensors, and much more to create devices designed to meet your customers' needs.

title: Guns & Dragons
description: Guns & Dragons is an outrageous co-op roguelite where up to 3 players grab their increasingly over-engineered weapons to fight enemy hordes and gather resources. After each run, build your base and power up your weapons for your next attempt. No two runs are ever the same!

title: Demonic Gauntlet
description: I am a solo developer that has worked in the games industry for decades. I had the idea of making this game. It is just a christian demonology treaty converted into a game. There is the famous Ars Goetia, part of the Lemegeton that catalogs 72 demons with their names, ranks, seals and powers.

title: Swevens
description: Your friends are all you have left, travel a monochromatic battlefield till salvation finds you. Swevens is a game about a boy named Sherriff living in an otherworldly realm nothing like our own. The monorealm is one of many small universes utilized by the Noctivians, a community of humans and creatures who follow Noctivox, the God of Nightmares.

title: Lang Ops: Corrupted Files
description: Malicious virus attacked your PC which contained all your files! During the recovering process, file code showed as letters in different languages. Therefore, you've created special forces of cursors to counter the corrupted files!

title: Lang Ops: Blank Canvas
description: The road to efficiency leads through repetition. In Lang Ops: Blank Canvas you're typing your own vocabulary! Features prepared tests and a lot of different statistics for your convenience!

title: F.R.A.X: Blackout
description: F.R.A.X: Blackout is an open-world zombie survival game with visual novel-style storytelling. Half exploration, half immersion in a deep story set in a falling Tokyo. Brutal combat, limited bullets, and a charming cast wrapped in a gritty anime aesthetic.

title: Vahnora
description: Vahnora is a free-to-play 2D MMORPG with real-time combat, faction warfare, and a player-driven economy. Pick from 7 classes, capture relics across faction frontlines, climb the endless Infinity Tower, lay siege to the castle every Saturday, and forge your name into the leaderboards.

title: Captain's Call
description: Captain's Call is a live community strategy game built for Twitch, where every stream becomes a shared adventure. Viewers rally behind their Captain to build an army, deploy units, and overcome battles together in ongoing campaigns. Matches run on a regular schedule, giving your community something to anticipate while you focus on creating content. Earn rewards, recruit new units, customize your forces, and work together to conquer increasingly difficult challenges.

title: Inner Growth
description: In this game you will follow around our protagonist Thalna, who spent most of her time in the underworld and because of some implications is now forced to go to the human realm. Decision making is a focus of this game. Actions will have consequences and result in different outcomes in every version.​

title: Where Giants Fall
description:
Where Giants Fall is a 3D top-down fantasy bullet-heaven action roguelite with survivors-like build growth, movement-first combat, and the thrill of turning a fragile run into overwhelming power.

Every run moves through a structured sequence of regular stages, Ritual Sieges, boss-biome encounters, and an Endless Mode finale. Auto-fire weapons keep the pressure constant, while active abilities, upgrade drafts, items, and level-10 weapon ultimates give you the timing decisions that decide whether a build stalls out or becomes unstoppable.

Survival is not just about stacking damage. You need to move well, read telegraphs, create space, and choose when to spend your strongest tools. The screen fills with enemies, projectiles, and effects, but attacks are built around readable danger patterns so you can react instead of guessing.

title: Battleborn: Oscar Mike vs. The Battle School
description:
Oscar Mike vs. The Battle School is the third Story Operation Gearbox released post-launch to add new content to their game Battleborn. This story operation takes you on a journey that gives you more info about the Mikes.

Oscar Mike vs. The Battle School is released on January 19th, 2017.

title: Battleborn: Montana and the Demon Bear
description:
Montana and the Demon Bear is the fourth Story Operation Gearbox released post-launch to add new content to their game Battleborn. This story operation takes you on a campfire adventure with Montana.

Montana and the Demon Bear is released on February 2nd, 2017.

title: Battleborn: Phoebe and the Heart of Ekkunar
description: Why would the Battleborn venture into dangerous Aztanti ruins? FOR SCIENCE! Phoebe and her crew set off to Ekkunar to investigate what exactly is keeping this shattered planet together. What they find creates more questions than answers. Join the Battleborn in unlocking the mysteries of the Varelsi, the ancient Aztanti and the place beyond the portals in the fifth DLC Story Operation “Phoebe and the Heart of Ekkunar.”

title: Pinup
description: The fairies of this wood are no stranger to erotic encounters with all sorts of strange and wonderful creatures. But when Lee is caught by a human entomologist studying the breeding habits of his species, the little sprite realizes that the situation might be bigger than he can handle.

title: Paradox Tower
description: Explore Paradox Tower and save your future. Only your wits and your loyal demon cat are able to throw down the Coven. Grow stronger, pick your battles, and make smart moves. And if you don't? Travel back in time!

title: Raging Skies
description:
Take on the role of young Cliffton Spoon as he makes his mark as a bounty hunter in the skies of a war torn future Earth.
Immerse yourself in a fun fast paced shoot em up match against the Talon Lords and their countless squadrons.
Laugh as you send your enemies screaming to an explosive death.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Songs of the Past
description:
Songs of the Past is a brand-new full-fledged expansion to The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, one of the most acclaimed role-playing games of all time.

Created in partnership with Fool’s Theory, a team comprising veteran The Witcher 3 developers, players can once again take on the role of Geralt of Rivia and embark on a brand-new adventure before heading out on the Path as Ciri in the upcoming The Witcher 4.

title: Obsolete Friends
description: Obsolete Friends is a story focused semi-horror RPG Maker game where you play as Luna, a Moon Guardian bunny, in their everyday routine of helping out their neighbors. Help them bring kindness and hope in a world that has been consumed by darkness, get to know your strange but friendly neighbors and be the best friend you can be! Just try to not think about what's missing...

title: Sokobum
description: A fart-powered sokoban puzzle. Dive into the STINK platform and explore legendary titles like Duper Fartio, Indanus Blows, Lethal Rear Gassy, and more! Push rolls, sneak quietly, and reach the toilet before it's too late. Available now on STINK!

title: Online: 404
description: An open-world survival simulator where even seasoned veterans of the genre will have to rethink their typical survival approach and how they interact with the world around them. Play solo or with friends, follow the story or simply explore — just don’t forget your most important gadget.

title: Lily: Shiroki Yuri no Otome-tachi
description: Lily: Shiroki Yuri no Otome-tachi is a strategy RPG by disfact.

title: Mystina: Remaster Online
description:
Subverting the famous figures of Eastern history

Combines many famous historical figures of the East, allowing you to experience the dream moment of being like-minded with the heroes.

Play card combinations and hero summoning

Summon heroes, collect cards, cultivate heroes, and add skill cards and equipment cards to hero cards to strengthen their abilities, making the game rich and diversified.

The Funny Riding System

Discover the Funny and Cute Riding System in the history of the game! Whether it's a red rabbit horse, a water dragon head or a panda head, choose your favorite horse and ride around the world to maximize your ideas!

Unique A.RPG Battle System

“Mystina : Heroes Online” adopts a closed real-time battle system, with random access to the battlefield, completely real-time battles, and A.PRG battles that can show a variety of attack strategies.

title: Pizza to Osake to Suika-chan to!
description: This game is a fan-made work based on the Touhou Project.

title: Human Host
description: Human Host is an open-world zombie survival crafting game. In this endless procedurally generated world, terrain, buildings, trees, rocks—everything is destructible! Build massive mobile bases, dig deep underground, construct trap-filled fortresses, scavenge supplies, and survive as long as you can!

title: Dodgebrawl
description: An FPS reimagining of the best gym class sport, DODGEBRAWL is a transformation of iconic shooter game modes into the context of an athletic activity. It's a multiplayer PvP dodgeball-themed FPS, full of maps, game modes, equipment, and chaos.

title: Match Day & International Match Day
description:
Originally released in the mid 1980s for home microcomputers, Match Day boasted unprecedented ball control for a football game, along with a unique side-view '3-D' simulated pitch. Now, relive those days in this remastered emulated version.

Contains the ZX Spectrum, Amstrad CPC, and Commodore 64 versions of Match Day, plus the 128K ZX Spectrum exclusive International Match Day, which featured enhanced audio, a new international league, and a unique crowd celebration.

title: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World
description: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the Dragon Quest series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

title: Little Sheep Valley
description: Tend to a flock of sheep and build your perfect Mediterranean farm in this cozy ranch-builder! Decorate, expand, and create the perfect home for your fluffy friends. Yes, you can cuddle them.

title: ToyBoxers!
description: Punch, Shoot, Or Explode your friends to be the last toy standing in this fast paced physics PVP party game!

title: Sad Virus Asia
description: Sad virus back again in this third person platformer simulation game where mission to find beer bottles in Asia place

title: Major's Heart
description: A sci-fi detective game where you interrogate the brain scans of crime victims. Uncover the hidden truth behind the dystopian regime by any means necessary.

title: My Eggduck
description: Eggduck is a silly duck that lives on your monitor. Click to lay eggs (even golden ones!) and collect tons of cute skins for a new look every day. Perfect for multitasking, enjoy it as a clicker or an idle game. (Warning) Everything is random, so beware the addictive rush of DuckPamine!

title: Raccoon Packer
description: Mischievous raccoons bring you the weirdest items to pack. Fit everything perfectly, add the right stickers, then ship it off. A cozy, satisfying packing experience with a touch of chaos.

title: Hidden Raccoons in Asia
description: Hidden Raccoons in Asia is a cozy hidden object game set in handcrafted pixel art scenes inspired by Asian aesthetics. Discover intricate environments, slow down, and find every raccoon hidden within.

title: Hidden Raccoons in Summer
description: Hidden Raccoons in Summer is a cozy hidden object game set in vibrant summer themed pixel art worlds. Take your time, explore sunny environments, and find all the raccoons at your own pace!

title: The Art of Tortoise Walking
description: A walking simulator with a deep sense of zen. Embody a tortoise on a desolate island, independently controlling each of its four limbs with a controller. In every clumsy step, rediscover the instinct of walking.

title: Dankenstoned’s Bongster’s Gram Smoker’s Stankula
description: With every boomer shooter fan's favourite weapon, the mighty stake gun, wreak havoc in classic FPS combat in Cork City, Ireland, pinning vampires to walls, all while listening to new music from Dankenstoned’s Bongster.

title: Kobold Delvers
description: Guide small kobolds through dangerous caves in a 2D puzzle game built around simulated materials. Dig, burn, freeze, melt and combine sand, water, lava, wood, vines, dynamite and more to create safe paths and solve each level.

title: Lovely Anime Puzzle: Winter
description: Lovely Anime Puzzle: Winter is a fun and rewarding puzzle game. Assemble charming winter-themed pictures, sharpen your attention, and immerse yourself in a beautiful world.

title: Periodic Lottery
description: “Periodic Table Lottery” combines lottery-style gameplay with the periodic table. Place bets, earn rewards, complete level objectives, and see how far you can go!

title: Remake Lover
description:
If you can bring back your passed lover, would you change her ?

This is a short Visual Novel

A reconstructed lover awakens within an unfamiliar underground facility.

You will accompany her as she explores the silent structure, uncovering videotapes, journals, and experimental records.

Behind every door at the end of the corridor lies the existence of another “her” — identical in appearance, yet fundamentally different.

As she opens each room one by one,

the two of you will piece together everything that happened between them.

This is a story about love, obsession, identity, and the self.

About four reconstructed selves, and an experiment of love that could never be stopped.

title: No Man's Sky: The Swarm
description: A new danger has appeared in the No Man's Sky universe. Something terrible hangs in the sky: a huge, foreboding Hive-like ship, unlike anything we've seen before. It has nigh-on impenetrable defences, not least a swarm of smaller and nimbler battle drones which must be neutralised to get close enough to target its primary weapon systems, notably the biggest laser cannon our universe has ever witnessed.

title: UTXMP
description: UTXMP is a remake of Unreal II: Expanded Multiplayer in Unreal Tournament 2004.

title: Tevi: Fauna Arcana
description:
After tireless investigation, Tevi has followed a crucial lead and set out once again! This time, their destination is Rabina Island — a mysterious land far beyond the borders of Az.

In "TEVI: Fauna Arcana", Tevi travels to this enigmatic island to search for a missing companion. Along the way, players will reunite with allies to confront the threats lurking on the island and gradually unveil the secrets of an ancient holy land...

Vena has officially joined the battle! She will be fighting side-by-side with you against powerful foes—and perhaps... even joining you on the rest of your journey?!

title: Cataract: Autobattler Roguelite Deckbuilder
description: Experience JRPG-inspired autobattles featuring unique combat mechanics. Recruit characters, level them up, choose their skills, loot monsters, and achieve perfect synergy to finally free the realm from the Allseeing's gaze.

title: The Traveller's Sight
description: Vincent Dumas, an investigator with supernatural powers, is sent to a small town in France with a murky history to uncover the truth behind the death of Laurène Delgado. Using his ability to communicate with the dead, he sets out to find clues that will lead him to the killer.

title: Cartefact
description: Cartefact is an automation card game. Craft, automate and manage resources all through cards Play as a young explorer who lands on a distant alien planet to uncover its mysteries and find a way to solve humanity's energy crisis.

title: Crown of Hispania
description: Rewrite the Reconquista in a grand strategy game set in 11th-century Iberia, where population, religion, and war evolve dynamically based on your decisions. Move armies freely across 300 hand-built provinces, manage a deep medieval economy, and face an AI that actually fights back.

title: Out of Range
description: Play as a dissident robot who tries to flee a spaceship as other robots thinks you're a menace. Gather new weapons and power-ups to travel through enemy-filled arenas in this 15 minutes action-packed twin-stick shooter adventure

title: Eye Juice
description: This WAD is themed around urban environments: large and small cities and suburbs, industrial facilities, shops and malls.

title: Feed the Giants
description: You are a giant guiding a group of lost children through a hostile world. Help them… or sacrifice them to entertain your kind, who watch the spectacle from above. Some want to see them thrive, others crave their suffering. Every choice has its price.

title: Craving Wisps
description: Slide in the walls, possess your enemies, and discover a mysterious world threatened by wicked spirits! This short adventure, full of action and humour, will please platformer fans and players looking for an original experience!

title: Rogue Company: Season 14 - The Winter Warfare
Mega Man W
description: Explore eight New Levels with an array of new Robot Masters! Augment Mega Man, and even Robot Master weapons, with different properties to suit your gameplay style! Collect CDS, earn Trophies, and fill out an Bestiary of enemies made by our development crew! Enjoy amazing original Compositions by MinobiVW, Marley Juaz, 40Nix, BastyArts. A Challenge Mode awaits with over 80+ challenges, and an all new endless mode where you can mix and match utilities from Mega Man's past adventures!

title: Tiebreakers
description: A SHONEN RUN N' GUN! Show your skills and save the world. Make your shots explosive. Make your parry intense. Even when your inner weaknesses come up, only you can do it.

title: Ex Libris
description:
Ex Libris is a library-crawling RPG adventure set in a 16th century monastery, inspired by the writings of Umberto Eco, Francois Rabelais, and Clark Ashton Smith.

Built using FromSoft's Sword of Moonlight RPG toolkit (based on the King's Field engine), Ex Libris is a unique retro literary adventure. Explore the monastery and its ruins, learn ancient tongues, uncover lost texts, and unravel the strange threads that bind the obscure history of Theleme and its inhabitants, including yourself.

title: Aim Trainer X
description: Aim Trainer X is a challenging aim training assistant that helps you improve your reactions, reflexes and all-around aiming.

title: Rogue Company: Season 1
description: Rogue Company’s Season 1 launched on February 3, 2021, marking the game's first official season. The 96-day season introduced the game's first Battle Pass with 50 tiers of cosmetic rewards, the new duelist Rogue Kestrel, the Jackal's Hollow map, and a revamped Ranked matchmaking system.

title: Sealed Fortress
description:
Sealed Fortress is a dungeon-crawling RPG in which you take a party of 3 through the treacherous halls of a castle corrupted by wild magic.

Facing dangerous monsters, finding treasure and sharing soup together are all part of the adventure!

title: Paper Mario ReCut
description: Paper Mario ReCut is a native Windows PC recompilation project for Paper Mario on Nintendo 64.

title: Slime Clime
description: A simple, short adventure platformer about a young slime saving the magic.

title: Nullbreak Protocol
description: A sci-fi arcade roguelite of fast, escalating runs. Launch your core, shatter every block, survive what the room fires back. Draw stacking protocols to build your run, push deeper into the system, and beat your record — the descent never ends.

title: Protocol: Bullet Hell
description: Survive a 2D bullet hell. Master devastating builds in the Old West, then conquer new eras of chaos—from feudal Japan to neon space zones—in an ever-expanding roguelite universe.

title: (You're Not) Welcome to Rennville
description: (You're Not) Welcome to Rennville is a cozy, pixel art platformer with an emotional dialogue-driven story. Explore the town of Rennville and it's surroundings, complete mini games, and talk to quirky characters, on a sentimental journey filled with humor and heart.

title: Dread Disc
description: A strange game disc appears at your door. Every difference you spot changes your apartment while something unknown tries to find a way inside.

title: The Outbound Ghost: Reborn
description: The Outbound Ghost: Reborn is a turn-based Creature Collector where the monsters you use are ghostly figments of your imagination. Experience a new supernatural story with overhauled gameplay in this sequel to The Outbound Ghost.

title: Safe at Home
description:
☆ Amy wants to go outside, but she needs to finish her chores first! ☆

☆ Will you help her with that? ☆

title: Dressed For Work
description: Get dressed for your first day on the job and take care of a goat.

title: Something Rush
description:
You're a detective on a case involving three murders in one night.
The police are clueless about the killer,
is it a lone madman, or the gangster, or else?

title: Counting Sheep
description: Separated from her new born baby, a homebound woman begins to notice odd discrepancies in both the population count and the caretaker of her only child.

title: Let's Cook It!
description: Let's Cook It! is a restaurant management game where you scavenge for ingredients and cook them into tasty dishes with up to four players. You work together as a team to manage your build and get out of debt.You can decorate, unlock upgrades, and recruit NPCs!

title: Steampunks vs. Skeletons: Adventure Puzzle Park
description: Play a Beautiful and Atmospheric Steampunk Arcade Adventure to collect the Gears, PowerUps, Treasures and Secrets, Solve Progress Puzzles, and Respawn the Humourous Skeletons & Spinning Sprits out to suck your lifeforce!

title: Abdomen Expansion
description: Abdomen Expansion is a minimalist inflation pregnancy clicker game where you click and click until her belly grows. Keep clicking and upgrading your clicks until her abdomen expands to proportions beyond realism and reality.

title: You Broke Me
description: You Broke Me is a narrative driven, zscript heavy mod for Doom 2. A deeply personal mod, using zdoom modding as a canvas to explore a very emotionally difficult year of the author's life.

title: Defi's Devotion
description:
Enter into a dark and ominous world has the form hand of an inspiring lich. The last step of your ritual is to claim your power and become immortal. With various powers at your disposal and more to claim, you will infect the living, corrupt their structures, and bring ruin to their world.
The folks of this land are guarded by a powerful Overseer who uses the simulated economy's output to summon heroes and protect the people. You must keep your phylactery safe while you feed it corpses and the very buildings they call home. Turn villagers to zombies, take direct control of them, and

title: LookFoorMe
description: On an ordinary night, I met “her”… “LookFoorMe” is a modern-day horror game.

title: Sunken Cathedral
description: Sunken Cathedral is a single MBF21 map, taking its name and central theme from the Claude Debussy solo piano piece.

title: Infinity Nikki: Until Tide Ends
description:
As the Ferry Song rises, who lingers, gazing toward the past?
Night descends, yet time has never promised the coming of dawn.
And still, it is steadfast hearts that have carried the darkness through to light—
So let all burdens drift away, and step lightly into a new dawn.

title: Octillery Vs. Xi Jinping
description: It was just a normal day in China... Until Octillery, John Xina, and The Wock suddenly decided to finally rebel against Xi! You'll have to fight and protest against p.a.p officers and tanks and take down XinniePooh once and for all... there are also alot of secrets, one being more important than you'd expect...

title: Pegfinity
description: One shot can trigger a massive chain reaction. Launch, bounce, and break the board in this physics-based incremental. Upgrade your build, stack combos, and push every run further into chaos.

title: OpenMadoola
description: Free software (GPL v2.0 or later) reimplementation of "The Wing of Madoola" with bug fixes and optional gameplay enhancements. OpenMadoola was developed so people who own "The Wing of Madoola" on cartridge or on Steam can have more fun with their game. OpenMadoola is not a standalone game and will not function without externally supplied game data

title: Deets
description: Deets is an extremely serious rogue-like survival horror game. Run around the maze, collect what's necessary, and stay away from the horse.

title: Lands of Fury
description:
Fight your way up a brutal mountain. Combine weapons, cartridges, runes, and companions to create devastating combat builds and carve through relentless enemies in this combat-driven roguelite ARPG.

You crash at the base of a Metra mountain that does not let you climb it quietly. Your goal is at the peak.

Each run takes you through a mix of explorable areas, tight paths, and brutal arena fights. One moment you’re scouting ahead and choosing your route — the next you’re locked in, surrounded, and forced to fight your way out.

Shape your play-style through the gear you find and the combinations you create — from controlled, precise combat to overwhelming, screen-filling destruction.

Fight alongside companions you can actively command, turning every encounter into a mix of action and control.

You don’t pick a class. You build one.

title: Another Zombie Shooter
description: Every shot counts. A real-time accuracy tracker keeps you honest, rewarding precision over panic. Bullet spray, shell casings, muzzle flash, and tracer rounds bring every firefight to life. Headshots are rewarded. Missed shots are punished. Clear every wave to win. How long can you last?

title: InCowMental
description: InCowMental is a cute and absurd incremental game where you build a dairy empire from a small countryside field. Milk your cows, grow your wheat, age your cheese, set out to conquer the world and boost your production with mini-games.

title: Catnip Cosmos
description:
A short incremental shooter.
Shoot. Upgrade. Incrementally progress further. Pilot cat-operated spaceships on timed Zoomies runs in this space shooter. Combine pilots for powerful synergies, defeat boss challenges to unlock new weapons and improve exponentially.

title: Choo Choo Defenders
description: Build your track, assemble your train and deliver cargo and carnage in equal amounts in this on-the-rails take on tower defense!

title: Gearplexed
description: Enjoy playing with gears? Gearplexed is a constructive problem-solving game with a variety of gear-based puzzles ranging from opening gates to building factories. Build gear trains to get the right amount of speed and torque to the target gears and be careful not to lock up your gear train.

title: Fortnite: Horizon'd Wrap
description: Let your gear know: a brand new wrap is on the horizon'd.

title: Snaptic
description: SNAPTIC is a physics-based puzzle-platformer that takes place in an offline laptop, and it's up to you to remember the Wi-Fi password.

title: Salmon
description: SALMON is a speedrunning platformer game with ridiculously satisfying movement that really shouldn’t be possible for a salmon.

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
description: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is a first-person shooter and the follow-up to Modern Warfare III (2023), continuing the rebooted Modern Warfare storyline. The campaign is set during a North Korean invasion of South Korea and features dual perspectives: a young South Korean soldier named Private Park facing his first combat deployment, and Captain Price operating outside official channels on a personal mission. The game also includes multiplayer with 6v6 core maps, large-scale vehicle combat maps, and a dynamic map system called Kill Block that reshapes layouts between rounds. A DMZ extraction mode is also featured. The game is released exclusively on current-generation platforms and PC.

title: Fonsermónique’s Culinary Diary
description: Fonsermónique's Culinary Diary is a short, linear narrative game where cooking becomes a bridge to the soul. As you prepare different recipes, you'll gather feedback that accompanies Fonsermónique on her personal journey, while you explore the temple in search of ingredients and of the dragon, gradually uncovering the peculiar relationship that binds them through small moments connected to the past.

title: Dittori
