description: Deep beneath the world, an ancient god stirs. Master the forbidden power of Dittori, discover its secrets, and use it to bend reality to your will. Herald the end of all things.

title: Aether-07
description: Aether-07 is a space-bending, first person puzzle game set in a retro-futuristic sci-fi universe. Solve challenges with dual-purpose puzzle elements while uncovering the mystery plaguing the Aether mission.

title: Red Frame
description: A first-person exploration puzzle game in which you navigate the sprawling rooms of a hyperreal mansion buried beneath the earth. Solve intricate puzzles shaped by those who once lived there, and discover the mechanism preserving a family's legacy.

title: Sokogeek
description: Sokogeek is a block-pushing logic game with electrifying mechanics. Help Flux, a robot vacuum cleaner, escape each level by building the energy circuit that powers the exit. The complexity of the puzzles will test your spatial awareness, abstract thinking, and analytical skills to their limits.

title: Deductopia
description: Explore the scenes, find clues, and sort out people, pets, and belongings in this cozy slice-of-life detective puzzle game. Fans of Duck Detective, Little Problems, and The Case of the Worst Day Ever will enjoy this new deduction game for all ages.

title: Point in Time
description: Use time travel to cooperate with your past self and conquer seemingly impossible puzzles. Can you craft the perfect timeline without altering history? Design your own escape.

title: Lock In
description: An escape-the-room puzzle game. Solve locks to unlock locks. Unlock locks to unlock more locks. Lock in.

title: Polly's Puzzle Box
description: As a small flea, explore a mysterious puzzle box filled with shapes and secrets. Gather strange items with hidden abilities, and unravel a trail of clues as you attempt to escape.

title: Mimic Meadows
description: Mimic Meadows is a puzzle game about transforming into animals by mimicking their movement. Discover creative ways to wield this power while solving mind-bending puzzles. And attempt to unearth the many secrets of the meadows.

title: Some Puzzles
description: A surreal, FMV puzzle adventure. "It's got some puzzles."

title: Twofold Tower
description: Solve 1000+ handcrafted puzzles, and ponder a philosophical narrative set in the ruins of a broken fantasy world. Outwit monsters, manipulate time and space, and transcend your all-too-human limits – or go mad trying…

title: Access Acquired
description: Censorship, corruption, and exploitation. Fight for the future of the citizens of Mendax and riot against the totalitarian government. Step into the shoes of Punkbot and fight enemies with tight and energetic combat in the 3D hack and slash game Access Acquired.

title: Earths Edge
description: Earths Edge is a fast co-op movement FPS for 1–4 players. Enter the battlefield from the flying hub with your own fully customizable mech and pilot. Smash through destructible environments, enemy factions and mutated monsters. Double jump, slide, wall-run and shoot your way through Earths Edge.

title: Lane-4: A dystopian Programming Thriller
description: An open-ended programming game in which you optimise 4-core assembly code to maintain a 1990s alt-history dystopian megacity's infrastructure. Take jobs from middlemen with hidden agendas and uncover the chilling consequences of your "routine" fixes in this assembly language puzzle thriller.

title: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight - Deluxe Edition Upgrade
description: The Deluxe Edition Upgrade is for existing owners of LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight. Upgrade your experience and suit up with new gear, vehicles, and more, with the Deluxe Edition Upgrade.

title: Please, Spin
description: The wheel of fate roguelike where you spin for your life. Customize your wheel, discover game-breaking relics, survive twisted side events, and outsmart rigged bosses to beat the lunatic host and escape the broadcast!

title: My Type of Goblin: A Climbing ASDFenture
description: Use the whole keyboard to climb, slingshot, and slide your way up a mountain. Collect bizarre accessories on your quest to become the most gorgeous Goblin. But one mistake can send you tumbling back down.

title: Synthwave Show Dawn
description: Synthwave Show/Dawn est un jeu de tir compétitif en Alpha ouverte sur PC à la troisième personne mêlant hero shooter et jeu de rythme. Pour attaquer, il faut être raccord avec le rythme tout en accomplissant l’objectif de la capture de base. On y incarne des stars ayant chacune un style de musique, jouable en arène en 4 contre 4 dans un monde light cyberpunk.

title: Brimvahl Crown
description: Brimvahl Crown is a narrative driven action RPG that follows the story of princess Kazmiel, a legendary seraph that was exiled from her kingdom. Now that the dark rises, Kazmiel must return to action. Dodge, Parry, and strike enemies down and save the world from the might of the Deathless King!

title: Dark Bros
description: A chaotic online multiplayer arena brawler focused on physics-driven combat, bizarre abilities, and fast matches with friends.

title: Capybara Zen
description:
Capybara Zen is an indie narrative game that blends humor, adrenaline, chaos, mystery, and a touch of urban adventure, featuring immersive cutscenes, a complete story mode, and a frantic arcade mode.
You follow an ordinary capybara trapped in an empty, meaningless routine, until a visit to an old place turns its life upside down.
On the way to a job interview, the capybara observes abandoned streets, dirty alleys, closed stores... a city without color, without life, without anything. Along the way, it discovers that the old CapiGames, an arcade abandoned for years, has reopened downtown.
Upon entering and trying to turn on one of the arcade machines, the capybara is suddenly sucked into the game itself.
After a wild interdimensional journey, it awakens as Zen, a stylized, confident, and aggressive version of itself, trapped inside an unstable urban arcade world filled with obstacles, dangers, and unpredictable situations.
The game progresses with an arcade-paced rhythm, featuring constant challenges, money collection, and continuous progression. To free the capybara from this world, the player must reach increasingly higher stages while surviving an environment that grows progressively more chaotic. The story unfolds through cutscenes that can be replayed from the main menu after completing the story mode progression.
Capybara Zen is a frenetic experience that combines fast-paced action, storytelling, and an urban atmosphere. A game about persisting, moving forward, and trying to escape when everything feels out of control.

title: Tierra de Gigantes
description: Malmark has returned and he has made Alejandro and his friends very tiny. Alejandro escapes from the cage and he's near the castle, but he will have to face bugs and dangerous animals.

title: Signalfall
description: Crash-land on a hostile planet and build automated extraction outposts to survive. Defend your operations, manage power networks, and send resources to orbit to unlock new technologies.

title: Revenger3
description: The third installment in the Revenger series, a retro RPG from the Japanese feature phone era.

title: Lavender's
description: A small cutesy game where you provide magical potions to a variety of strange characters.

title: Union Max
description:
Union Max is a Gay Adult / Yaoi Visual Novel that features the adventures of Max, the unlikely hero chosen to become the next Light of the Kosmos!
Join Max on his journey across the Realms of the Kosmos, gathering the sparks of Romance, Desire, Angst and Happiness.
Reclaim the lost sparks – together as one!

title: Pottering
description: Casual multiplayer gardening game. Invite friends to restore a garden to its former glory. Unlock more areas as you go and uncover secrets along the way, or just play the trumpet and hit each other with spades. Its up to you.

title: Wild N Chill
description: Wild n Chill is a laid-back wilderness escape where ya forage, hunt, and craft the off-grid cabin of your dreams. Far from the noise and nonsense, its just you, your trusty companion, and a pal or two.

title: Fables of Dwale
description: Forage, barter and explore a world that lives on after fairy tales end. Harvest fruits of the forest and engage with peculiar fairy folk and characters of folklore, as you uncover the secrets behind a dreadful illness that's fallen over the enchanted lands.

title: Animal Rescue Network
description: Animal Rescue Network is a cozy sanctuary life simulation centered entirely around animal care, healing, and compassion. You arrive in the storm-torn town, where the beloved local sanctuary has collapsed, and the community is struggling to recover.

title: Bloomino
description: A cozy game about running your own little flower shop Place flower tiles, create charming bouquets and brighten your customers’ day. Decorate your shop, unlock new flowers and discover a variety of beautiful combinations.

title: Ham Hole
description:
a peculiar and repulsive puzzle.

an elemental meat mystery.

an irritating insect infestation.

title: Totally Safe Moon Project
description: Breaking news! A giant asteroid is about to destroy the Earth! The Moon is your last hope. Work together with friends to build a fragile tower from everyday objects.

title: Everything Is Gun!
description: Dominate in a brutal, lightning-fast old-school FPS. Modify yourself into the perfect weapon, unleash mass destruction, conquer runs, invade others, and ascend to global supremacy. Prisoner #11 18 1978, you now belong to A1KTRZ. Your survival is broadcast to billions. What will remain of your soul?

title: Mingo's Boring Room
description: Walk around your room over and over and over.

title: The Stinky Adventures of DungDung
description: DungDung, a martial arts dung beetle, sets out to defend the kingdom from Princess Petunias creeping corruption...only to discover that he's inside a glitching videogame! He must master poojitsu. Hell harness glitch powers. Can you save the realm and the game in this love letter to the classics?

title: Malice in Wonderland
description: Tear through Wonderland and break free of The Hatter's control in this fast-paced action roguelike. Augment your abilities to destroy your foes and escape before you're out of time!

title: Terminal War
description: Terminal War is a grounded, team-based third-person shooter set in a fractured America during the late 1990s. Engage in intense combat across war-torn cities, forgotten towns, and contested territory where every bullet, every strike, and every decision counts.

title: Dicetris
description: Dicetris is a falling-block puzzler with depth. Stack dice in columns, sum to hit the target, combo colors to clear overloaded stacks. Twist your strategy around special dice and rule-bending map conditions. Easy to learn. Built to master.

title: Carrier Cuties: Pets in Mechs!
description: Carrier Cuties fast-paced 3D arena fighting game where Pets in Hu-Mechs battle in highly interactive and destructible environments using the surroundings to fight. Battle with a partner against two opponents to win all the glory and treats!

title: Bargoer
description:
Head to the bar, get a drink, make some friends, have interesting conversations, meet someone special.

Exit at the door when you are ready to leave.

Announced as part of the 5/28/2026 Shovel Direct.

title: Take That Mainstage!
description: It's 1992 in Emerald City. The world screams for change. You made the leap, now fulfill your destiny and change the world. Build your band, write real music you perform, manage relationships, and reach the top of the charts. In this hybrid life sim, be the one to Take That Mainstage!

title: Blobby's Big Blobventure
description: Short free getting over it style 2d platformer.

title: Gabha
description: The town is under siege and it's up to this little smith to keep the guards armed!

title: FPBI Test Program
description: A personality test. As seen on Shovel Direct 2026. By keV.

title: Crystal Project II
description: Crystal Project II is a non-linear JRPG with a seamless open world and telegraphed tactical combat. Find new classes, learn new abilities, and collect powerful equipment to customize your party and uncover the mysteries of the land. No random encounters and no permanent missables.

title: Thermocline
description: A BLIZZARD RAGES. Lone survivor, you are STRANDED upon a FRIGID CORPSE-PLANET. THEY seek your warmth, sucking Soul from the shadows. AND TONIGHT, THE WIND IS YOUR CLOSEST SEMBLANCE OF A FRIEND.

title: Seed of God
description: Seed of God is a epic scale turnbased Battle 2D/3d JRPG with a characterdriven story that will take you on a unforgettable journey in the style of FinalFantasy. Face choices that define your morale (Good/Bad) and change events as you explore a fantasy world and unfold this epic saga

title: No One Returns
description: Have you ever wondered what happens if you wake up and everyone is simply gone? No One Returns is a third-person survival horror game. Play as Denis, search a chillingly silent city for clues about your missing family while fighting the frightening zombies swarming the streets.

"Who do you want to save? Or rather... who are you prepared to abandon?" A midnight "Unsend" trapped them in a rift in time, and awakened the dead "You." Become a "Ghost" inhabiting screens and surveillance feeds. Pry into perfect disguises and rotting hearts.

title: Kryva Hora
description: Kryva Hora is a survival horror game in a found-footage style. You've just found a tape taken in 1987 after the tragic explosion in Chornobyl. You have to survive and escape from the mutants and the hostile environment to finish your mission and close a portal to an alien world.

title: The Solyani's Code
description: A Sci-Fi story set on the moon Selene, featuring LUMA, a glowing companion that assists you with unique abilities.

title: Kooo to Jump!
description: A hardcore, voice-controlled precision platformer where you crow to jump! Sustain a continuous 'KOOO' to scale a brutal, foddian-style map. Scale 60 camera zones, conquer a massive world, and lose your dignity in this unrelenting rage game. Includes controller support and Practice Mode.

title: Can't Hold My Feelings
description:
Monica is eagerly looking forward to a fun-filled weekend at Alistair's mansion, together with her friend, and favorite person in the world, Jacob. Despite having a big crush on him, she hasn't managed to win his heart yet. However, an unexpected twist of fate this time might bring them a golden opportunity to elevate their platonic relationship to the next level...

Join Monica on an entertaining, heartwarming, and steamy adventure as she tries to capture the heart of the ever-elusive Jacob. Will her efforts finally bear fruit?

title: Nameless Lady
description: It happened in a certain mansion. Five men, appointed to the task, arrived there. Each discovered a “woman who was not human.” Five minutes until reinforcements arrived. They had to keep watch over them.

title: Hug Factory
description: An incremental/management game about hugging people to generate profits and the neverending pain of inflation.

title: Mama
description:
An emotional narrative point-and-click about a daughter caring for her mother as dementia reshapes their bond. Explore heartfelt conversations, fragmented memories, and story-driven puzzles on a journey of caregiving and learning to let go.

Love is heavy. Care is relentless. Watching someone you love fade is a quiet, piercing heartbreak you can’t prepare for. In this game, you step into the shoes of a daughter, moving through a world shaped by dementia - not to solve it, not to fix it, but to live it, feel it, and carry it alongside the one you love. Every gesture, every pause, every choice matters.

Gameplay isn’t a distraction - it is the story. Simple, deliberate interactions and inventive puzzles put you inside moments of tenderness, confusion, and heartbreak. Seven chapters guide you through caregiving’s emotional terrain: the exhausting patience, the fragile joys, and the quiet sorrow of learning when to hold on - and when to let go.

Dementia is at the heart of the experience, shaping every conversation, memory, and interaction. Each day reveals shifting moods and fractured recollections, blurring the line between truth and misremembering. As the mother’s world becomes more fragile and uncertain, the gameplay mirrors her fading clarity — guiding you through moments of confusion, tenderness, and the quiet heartbreak of watching someone slip away.

title: Harvest of Names
description: Harvest of Names is an RPG of mythical investigation set in a UK university. Navigate student life and face monsters haunting your community. Ideals you choose will define your options in combat and your personality in conversation. Shape your own self!

title: Spellblade: Vengeance of the Witch Sisters
description: A retro-classic fantasy RPG inspired by Ultima, Might & Magic, Wasteland, and other classic CRPGs of the 80s and 90s. Featuring a branching narrative, non-combat skills and puzzles, turn-based combat, character customization, and dynamic NPC interactions.

title: Necrophosis - Subconsciousness
description: Descend deeper into the world of Necrophosis. Subconsciousness is a new story chapter that explores unseen layers of the self through new surreal environments and narrative encounters.

title: Rodent Rooms
description:
Rodent Rooms is a game about memories. And cheese! You are a rodent: small enough to slip through tiny gaps, sharp-toothed and stubborn enough to chew through anything.

Explore a series of giant dioramas—reconstructions of times past. Find pieces of cheese along the way to unlock special upgrades that aid your exploration.

title: Fossara
description: A short collectathon. Collect creatures in a red lake.

title: The Hidden Library
description: The Hidden Library is a 2D puzzle adventure, where you will immerse yourself in worlds forbidden by authority, awakening the imagination and guiding you through a forgotten literary past.

title: Pigeon's Untitled Screenplay
description: Pigeon is screwed! The studio is expecting the screenplay, but it's still not done. Find inspiration in the cafe and finish the screenplay before eternity ends.

title: Hyve
description:
The First and Only 2v2 Digital Card Game
Combine cards with your teammate in real-time to create powerful synergies and defeat your opponents in fast-paced 2v2 matches.

title: They Can't Hear You
description:
This dying star may kill you.

Something went wrong and your capsule was shot into the void of space during a Supernova blast. Now, your only hope of survival are your drones. Can you triangulate a rescue signal through the surrounding debris before your oxygen runs out? It's the only chance you've got.

title: Egg Related Videogame
description: A game based on hatching eggs in order to collect creatures.

title: De-Limited
description:
It's a game about pew pew-ing bad guys. So expect a lot of pew pew.

Created for Ludum Dare 54.

title: Gibber Babel
description: A puzzle game where a new language is about to take over. Learn as many terms as possible and save the language!

title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Tyrant God
description: Slay waves of monsters with your mouse, collect coins, buy permanent upgrades, and grow stronger round after round in a compact incremental action game.

title: Knockout Battle
description:
Knockout Battle is a chaotic and fun multiplayer party game where up to 8 players clash in fully interactive sandbox arenas. The objective is simple yet endlessly entertaining: knock your friends out and hurl them into the void to secure victory!
Unleash absolute mayhem with an arsenal of wacky weapons and gadgets. Throw TNT across the map, blast fireworks and rockets into your rivals, or smash them with Thor’s hammer. Pull out blasters, revolvers, and all sorts of outrageous guns, or go full sci-fi and deflect attacks with a lightsaber.

Potions add another layer of madness, letting you grow huge, shrink tiny, run faster, or hit harder — flipping the fight in unexpected ways.

Every map is a sandbox of destruction, packed with hazards, traps, and interactive elements you can turn against your opponents. From launching rivals sky-high to chaining explosions together, no two matches ever play the same.

Whether you’re dodging rockets, spamming explosives, or laughing as your friends fall into the void, Knockout Battle guarantees non-stop action, hilarious moments, and pure chaos. And of course… expect a ridiculous amount of explosions and rockets.

title: Guns, Princess and Braves
description: Fast-paced Roguelike: inventory management meets tower defense. As a princess in love with a dragon, strategically layout weapons in limited space. Take direct control in battle to crush "righteous" braves with flashy bullet!

title: Ratalorica
description: Follow GRATS on its journey even while you work or play on your computer. Every click. Every key press. Every action you take fuels GRATS' power.

title: Aker Fern 2
description: Take on the role of Dan Tern, a young man in whom the consciousness of Mikołaj Fern—a man from five hundred years ago—has awakened. Discover the mysteries of the past, confront the curse that haunts him, and conclude a story that never reached its end.

title: Abandoned Car
description: Trapped in an endless dream, it seems there's no way to wake up. You find an car that's been abandoned for a long time. Will you solve all the puzzles to figure out what happened here before?

title: The Dogs
description: The Dogs (formerly Dog Simulator) is a simulator that allows players to immerse themselves in the world of dog life. The game offers unique features and constant updates, making the gameplay interesting and varied.

title: Abjure
description: Win by emptying your hand. Abjure is a roguelike deckbuilder where the 2 of Spades reigns supreme — draft cards, stack relics, and outplay every opponent in a strategic twist on the Big 2 card game.

title: Deadly Shaft
description: Deadly Shaft is a claustrophobic survival horror experience where you are held prisoner on the isolated island of "Veilshore". After the mysterious "Hausherr" (master of the house) has stripped you of your supernatural powers using a serum, you must maintain your cover within the villa to survive. Utilize targeted meditation in secret to gradually regain your abilities and uncover the dark secrets of the estate. Your intellect is your greatest weapon as you must master stealth and strategic time management to escape the relentless grip of the master of the house.

title: Rayman Origins: Enhanced Edition
description:
When the Glade of Dreams is overrun by “nefurrious” Darktoons, the Fairy Council summons Rayman to save the day. Joined by his best friend, Globox, and two crafty wizards, the Teensies, this unlikely team must restore balance before their world fades away like a bad dream.

Enjoy Rayman Origins like never before with 4K resolution, 60 FPS, and modern enhancements, including new quality-of-life features. Discover 60 hidden Relics across the adventure and track your progress in the Snoring Tree.

title: Builder Stimulator
description: Builder Simulator is the perfect game for those who want to build a house, from the ground up, one brick at a time. On easy, the game will guide and teach you by showing you full instruction, but on hard you will get no help - instead rely on your builder skills and make everything yourself.

title: Crown Chaos
description: Crown Chaos is a multiplayer party game where you try to gain points by being the only one in the zone while everyone else is trying to shove you off. Every time the zone moves, the game slows down and you pick an upgrade that changes how you play.

title: Truck Clash Duel
description: In limited-round battles, drive your war machine and crush all! Truck Clash Duel is a fast-paced shooter for 2-player split-screen duels. Control your unique vehicle, build momentum with every kill, and crown the points champion!

title: Fortune Mill
description: An incremental game where you must make $1,000,000 in each room to advance. Throw darts, play scratch-off tickets, unlock automation, and choose upgrades carefully as each room affects all the others. Can you escape the Fortune Mill?

title: The Magician's Hand
description: Set in Victorian London, this moody atmospheric puzzle platformer, you play as the severed hand of the mysterious Magician Fabrizio. Waking up with no memory, only a nagging urge to uncover the truth. Brave, curious, and drawn to adventure, hand grows along the journey, discovering his inner strength and a few unexpected gifts. Embarking on this adventure with perspective-shifting mini games and distinctive boss battles. You need find Fabrizio before it is too late!

title: Seventh Mansion: The First Escape
description: Escape an eerie mansion where death resets everything. Solve puzzles, evade the Wicked Nuns, or use a camera to survive in this psychological horror experience.

title: Call of Elmore
description: Call of Elmore is an experimental arcade-styled action-adventure game with a unique blend of top-down and sidescrolling gameplay. Acquire a larger arsenal, explore the region, and survive while figuring out how a simple Lighthouse flame has laid waste to the colony.

title: Rough Night at Home
description:
Rough Night at Home is a psychological First-Person horror game where you play as 25-year-old Jacob Sagespark.
For generations, the Sagespark family made a dark pact with a demon sacrificing one of their own every 20 years in exchange for unimaginable wealth, luck, and power. But the price was far greater than they ever imagined.

The curse won't end until the entire bloodline is wiped out.

Jacob, the last surviving Sagespark, is determined to break the sinister cycle and end the family’s deadly legacy once and for all. But can he escape the fate that’s claimed so many before him?

This First-Person game blends immersive storytelling, challenging puzzles, and nostalgic mechanics for a unique thrilling experience. Your ultimate goal is to break a long-standing family curse, with the story and solutions unfolding as you explore and uncover secrets throughout the gameplay.

title: Heavy Knight
description: When Dent's friend Harold attempts to become the next Archwizard Regent of the Land of Magicia, he is instead kidnapped by the Dark Wizard Darallo! It becomes Dent's quest to unite the heroes of the realm to aid him in tracking down Darallo and saving both his friend and the land!

title: Type or Die
description: In the heart of a medieval manuscript, a horse takes up arms to avenge its fallen master. Type to attack, collect cards, explore a living board, and survive in a roguelite where every word becomes a weapon.

title: Sky Sword Strategy
description: An RPG adventure with strategic gameplay. Recruit an army to repel invaders in a war-torn land. Reunite with your family and help people along the way. Survive long enough to unlock your special abilities. Awaken the power of the Sky Sword.

title: Indigo's Dreams
description: A mixed-media video game of a Wonderland. Play as Indigo, a young girl trying to find her way back home after her dreams take her to a land unknown. Traverse through abandoned beaches, hidden forests, a cloud town, and more. Discover newfound purpose along your way.

title: Tomb Busters
description: The horror extraction genre finally comes to your phone, and it's finally fun for everyone. No hardcore grind. No steep learning curve. Just you, your friends, and a cursed ancient ruin full of things that want to eat you. Drop in with up to 4 players, loot cursed tombs, and extract before ancient horrors end your run. Go deeper for rarer relics, but push too far and you lose everything.

title: Beavertale
description: Help Gus, a brave beaver fighting to reclaim his forest from an evil corp. Build useful constructs, chop trees, destroy machines, and execute precise movements to overcome obstacles in this puzzle-platforming adventure. And remember, managing your resources is almost as important as using them.

title: Crazy Localization
description: Crazy Localization is an exploration-based interactive story adventure game themed around game localization. In a game world gradually descending into chaos, Fanfan wields her localization expertise as a weapon to set things right!

title: 1,000,000,000 Spells
description:
1 Billion Spells is an Arena Survival game where you fight off hordes of enemies by making your own spells from simple components. No more levelling up fireball from level 7 to level 8! Magic should be expressive, free, intense and chaotic.

Play as a new student of a modern magic academy and master diverse magic styles. Create the most creative, weird and overpowered spells ever!

title: Muchi Muchi Pork! & PinkSweets Boosted
description: With this collection, you’re not just getting one fantastic shoot ’em up, but two! This Boosted re-release features a fully arranged soundtrack with brand new tracks from a fresh lineup of arrangers. (These differ from the 2011 console version.) In addition, you get several different game modes, including Arcade and Arrange, Online Rankings that let you compete with players worldwide, and Local Replay Support where you can save your best runs for review. A tasty deal indeed!

title: Path of Exile 2: Return of the Ancients
description:
Wraeclast lies in ruin after a devastating cataclysm, consumed by a creeping corruption that gnaws at all it touches. Guided by Doryani, the Vaal thaumaturge, you must seek out the makers of the Third Edict, the Precursors, and uncover what path remains.

Reach the fortress by traversing forsaken maps, and unseal its ancient gates.

title: Path of Exile 2: Runes of Aldur
description:
Farrow, a seeker of runes from the eastern reaches of Ezomyr, has uncovered markings that should have remained buried. Each rune he unearths does more than grant power; it reveals fragments of a forgotten bond between Ezomyte tradition and the forbidden craft of the Kalguurans.

With the aid of the Kingsmarch crew, delve into relics long entombed which include ancient treasures, buried truths, and some things best left undisturbed.

title: Gladiator 3D
description:
Gladiator 3D is a fast-paced arcade arena fighter where you create a lobby, challenge your friends, or battle solo against AI.

Block, parry, kick, and strike your way through flashy gladiator duels where every fight is about timing, mind games, and claiming GLORY OVER YOUR ENEMIES!

title: Umineko: Golden Forgery
description:
fan mod for Umineko Golden Fantasia that aims to rebalance and overhaul characters to create a game with new things, while still feeling like Golden Fantasia. adding
-New moves for every character in the roster
-Entirely new moveset for Black Battler. He’s not just Battler but Black anymore
-Two new color palettes for every character
-Rebalanced framedata and hurtboxes for the existing cast

title: Silent Noise: Prologue
description: Silent Noise is a psychological horror experience by MSP Games, built in the Godot Engine. The prologue demo introduces players to its atmospheric design, emotional depth, and psychological tension—favoring immersion over jump scares.

title: Spin Cycle
description: A roguelite strategy game where you keep the books for the criminal underworld. Take contracts from cartels and sanctioned regimes, route money through 20+ jurisdictions, play the market of sanctioned coins. And don't poke Interpol.

title: Flux Ascendant
description: A fast-paced bullet-heaven roguelite where you tame the four elements. Draft cards, fuse them into game-changing builds, and survive endless waves across Fire, Lightning, Water and Earth, then face the chaotic Finale. Made by one developer, balanced by thousands of test runs.

title: The Labyrinth on Burrow Hill
description: Unravel a thread of riddles and mystery as you progress your way through the atmospheric halls of a dazzlingly large, long-deserted labyrinth. Explore the vistas of spectacular rooms and the hidden challenges within. Do you have what it takes to find what lies at the labyrinth's centre?

title: Chesstro
description: Enter Chesstro, the digital roguelite chess empire ruled by TRO. Engage in intense duels against the AI and fight in hopes of one day escaping the digital prison.

title: Sovereign's End
description: Feel invincible. Until you're not. A 3D space survivor-like with deep build-crafting, auto-firing abilities, and one Sovereign at the end of every run. Few will reach it.

title: Night Lurker
description: You witnessed something you shouldn't have, and now you need to guide this anthropomorphic fox out of the city in this atmospheric adventure game.

title: Galaxy Grudge
description:
Galaxy Grudge provides classic arena combat with smooth multiplayer, modern graphics and strong community involvement.

It's a fast-paced, free-to-play arena shooter inspired by the golden age of competitive FPS games. Experience fluid movement, inventive weapons, and intense multiplayer battles across a range of dynamic maps and modes. The game is based in a dystopian world where blood-sports are televised for a fanatic fanbase.

Join our development community to brainstorm ideas, provide feedback, participate in game tests and become a part of the next great Arena Shooter!

This game is currently in development. It contains one working Game Mode (Deathmatch), with Team Deathmatch and Capture The Flag coming soon. Ten powerful weapons, based on the classic Arena Shooter standards. (Pistol, Chainsaw, Sniper RIfle, Rocket Launcher, Blaster etc)

We currently have two full maps developed, with more coming soon.

Full settings menu with custom controls, graphics, player settings and sound settings.

Full multiplayer support with solid netcode for all game elements.

Highly dynamic movement with a range of unique movement abilities. Dodging, sliding, zero-G skating, and the ability to launch booster pads for bouncing players and projectiles.

title: Sunyata CCG
description: Set in Earth’s magical future, Sunyata is a tactical, action‑packed collectible card game where you command fantastical creature and castle abilities. Ride dragons, summon the undead, and evolve magical beasts in duels that reward creative deckbuilding and adaptive strategy.

title: Frame of Suffering
description: Master both man and machine to escape the Ancient Temple. Customize your Hero and a modifiable Combat Frame to slay hordes and gatekeepers. Scavenge tech, uncover the Temple's history, and evolve your build in this Sci-Fi ARPG Roguelite. You're a prisoner - freedom lies at the heart of the Temple.

title: Kopernicus: Incremental Suffering
description: Incremental suffering. Experience the 2-bit terror of the sole SSC KOPERNICUS survivor. Expand your base, construct weapons and face nightmares while trying to EXTRACT forgotten memories. There is no escape from THE THINGS you love.

title: Bowled
description: BOWLED is a game all about bowling! *Receives note Oh uh, It's a game about bowling, time trials, stress tests, shape shifting and experimentation? Wait what is this, who wrote this? Am I being paid to be here? I'm not? Well damn.

title: Songs of Silence: Complete Edition
description:
Songs of Silence: Complete Edition
For those who want more than just a battlefield.

The Complete Edition is made for players who don’t just play Songs of Silence — they sink into it. It includes the base game, plus all Expansions, the Original Soundtrack, and the Digital Artbook.

title: Vampire Therapist: Complete Edition
description:
Complete Edition includes:

- Vampire Therapist
- Vampire Therapist - Couples Therapy
- Vampire Therapist - Digital Art Book

title: Johan
description: Johan is a soulslike where you play as a medieval rabbit in a colorful, fantastical medieval world. Use the power of illuminated manuscripts to summon odd creatures of medieval folklore and face off against powerful foes.

title: Formula Legends: Iconic Tracks
description:
Three countries. Decades of racing history. Countless legendary laps.

Expand your Formula Legends experience with the Iconic Tracks Pack. Master Austria across three eras — Vintage, Classic, and Modern. Take on Malaysia in its Classic form, and test your skills on Bahrain, featuring both Classic and Modern variations. Every track has been meticulously recreated to capture the rhythm, challenge, and atmosphere of its era.

Key Features
3 legendary circuits, spanning multiple eras:

Austria – Vintage, Classic, Modern

Malaysia – Classic, Modern

Bahrain – Modern

Era-accurate presentation: Relive the evolution of racing, from historic machines to modern precision.

New career challenges: Push your mastery across decades of motorsport history.

Time Trials & Leaderboards: Compete with the global community for the fastest laps.

Fully integrated: Career and Quick Race modes — history rewards mastery.

title: Formula Legends: Formula E - Electric Evolution
description:
Expand your Formula Legends experience with Formula E: Electric Evolution, the official all-electric championship. Get behind the wheel of cutting-edge Formula E cars and compete on iconic city circuits around the world.

From Berlin to Tokyo, London to São Paulo, Miami to Shanghai, every race demands precision, strategy, and total control. Master the unique challenges of electric racing, where energy management, timing, and racecraft define victory.

Key Features
Official Formula E experience: Compete in the world’s premier all-electric racing series

6 real-world circuits: Berlin, Tokyo, London, São Paulo, Miami, Shanghai

3 generations of cars: Gen 1, Gen 2, and Gen 3 EVO

Authentic Attack Mode: Activate boosted performance through strategic off-line zones, just like real races

Double Header race weekends: Take on two consecutive races on the same circuit, each with its own qualifying session

Manual team selection: Choose which teams compete alongside you on the grid

Fully integrated: Career, Quick Race, and Time Trials

title: Rabanaz
description: A chip-based deckbuilder full of clever tricks to secure your victory. Tinker with your chips, slot in modification tubes, and reshape the scoring to craft your ideal strategy. Can you outwit the Rabanaz machine?

title: Resistance Is Brutal
description: Resistance is Brutal is Vampire Survivors meets Running Man with a bit of Rick and Morty thrown in. Try to survive as you battle the enemy hordes with brutal abilities before going out in a blaze of glory.

title: Toypunk
description: A comedic third-person shooter roguelite where you control customizable puppets armed with an infinite toybox of absurd weaponry. Fight hordes of cotton-stuffed baddies across fantastical biomes with your friends or on your own. Experience crazy synergies and unlock more toys between runs!

title: Chukcha v Bolshom Gorode
description: This is a quest where you and the main character embark on a captivating journey to distant Moscow. Along the way, you'll encounter difficulties, misunderstandings, and the aggressiveness of the world around you. Driven by a noble goal, you'll overcome all obstacles with the help of your mobile phone and emerge victorious from any situation.

title: Contract Cooks
description: We're a staffing agency. We send cooks to kitchens. The cooks are you. Today, a bubble tea kiosk. Tomorrow, an economy flight galley. Contract Cooks is a co-op cooking roguelite where you go where the agency sends you and try not to get fired.

title: Tashio Tempo
description: Explore a world filled with corrupted creatures. Focus your mind to cast spells that affect the environment. Wear different tunics for their magical effects, and master playing the Lute in this top-down Game Boy inspired adventure.

title: Roman Trahtenberg: V poiskah ideal'nogo anekdota
description: A humorous quest that lets you experience a few days in the life of a famous Russian showman of the 2000s.

title: AntiMatcher
description: In this abstract rule-discovery puzzle game, you manipulate bubbles to destroy antibubbles in a series of handcrafted puzzles designed to encourage experimentation.

title: Near-Mage + Gibbous: The Kittehverse
description:
Step into the whimsical, weird, and wonderful world of the Kittehverse with this bundle of base games from Stuck In Attic! Includes:

Near-Mage – a magickal coming-of-age adventure set in Transylvania
Gibbous: A Cthulhu Adventure – a cosmic comedy noir with talking cats

title: Oddsparks: An Automation Adventure - Deluxe Edition
Oddsparks: An Automation Adventure - Deluxe Upgrade
description:
The Oddsparks: An Automation Adventure - Deluxe Upgrade includes optional cosmetic content for our biggest fans. These are ALL the items included in the pack:

Royal Outfit
Royal Cape (Top)
Royal Trousers (Bottom)
Royal Skirt (Bottom)
Royal Boots (Shoes)
Royal Brooch (Brooch)
Supporter Crown (Head Decoration)
Royal Staff (Staff)

Corrupted Aether Outfit
Corrupted Aether Cape (Top)
Corrupted Aether Shorts (Bottom)
Corrupted Aether Slippers (Shoes)
Corrupted Aether Brooch (Brooch)
Corrupted Aether Head Decoration (Head Decoration)
Decorative golden statues of all Sparks

Arty Spark Statue
Boomy Spark Statue
Burning Spark Statue
Carry Spark Statue
Choppy Spark Statue
Crafty Spark Statue
Crashy Spark Statue
Drilly Spark Statue
Freezing Spark Statue
Handy Spark Statue
Hauling Spark Statue
Loamy Spark Statue
Puffy Spark Statue
Rocky Spark Statue
Scouty Spark Statue
Scrubby Spark Statue
Slashy Spark Statue
Stumpy Spark Statue

title: Jötunnslayer: Hordes of Hel - Founders Edition
description:
This exclusive edition includes:

- Odin's Legendary Armor Pack, featuring stunning legendary skins for every character
- Beautifully crafted Digital Artbook
- Epic Official Soundtrack
- The Full Game

Immerse yourself in the mythic chaos and claim the ultimate rewards as one of the game's earliest champions!

title: Warno: Nemesis #3 - Homefront
description: Nemesis - Home Front is the third Nemesis expansion to release for WARNO. This DLC features two brand-new divisions: the Warsaw Pact Soviet defenders of the 157-yaMotostrelkovaya Diviziya and the mixed troops of NATO’s US 6th Infantry Division (Light).

title: Karma: The Dark World - Deluxe Edition
description:
Karma: The Dark World's Deluxe Edition contains the following :

- Full game of KARMA: The Dark World
- The 58 Track Original Soundtrack
- The 5 Track 'Into the Mist' EP
- The 138 Page Artbook

title: Empires of the Undergrowth: Exploding Ants
description: Empires of the Undergrowth: Exploding Ants is a downloadable expansion for Empires of the Undergrowth that introduces explosive ant and termite species inspired by real insects, adding new tactical units capable of self-sacrifice attacks and defensive abilities. The DLC also includes new upgrades, combat mechanics, and additional levels centered on colony warfare and survival.

title: Pilot Brothers 3D: The Case of the garden pests
description: The quest about the adventures of the Pilot Brothers. This time, our heroes are trying to expose the agricultural pests that have ravaged their garden.

title: Jötunnslayer: Hordes of Hel - Conan Edition
description: Conan Edition bundles the acclaimed roguelike survivor Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel with the massive Conan the Barbarian DLC. Play as the legendary Cimmerian , master three brutal sub-classes , and conquer the treacherous Sands of Stygia. With the high-stakes God of Fate system you have everything you need to tread the jeweled thrones of the Earth.

title: Sumire's Secret
description: When Sumire's teacher develops a one-sided obsession with her, her day-to-day becomes a 24/7 horror story without a hero... only victims and villains.

title: Atlantis Fantasy: Reborn
description: Dive into Atlantis Fantasy: Reborn! Rebuild an Atlantean capital amid coral and ancient magic. Manage resources, explore the abyss, and revive a sunken kingdom in this unique marine city builder. The legend awaits you beneath the waves.

title: Labyrinth of Aetheria
description: A grid-based 3D dungeon RPG inspired by classic titles of the 1980s and 1990s, such as Wizardry and Might & Magic. Experience classic dungeon crawler elements, including tense turn-based battles, trapped treasure chests, and the discovery of rare equipment.

title: Chasing Whiskers
description: Catch cats in this cozy adventure game! After falling into Catworld through an interdimensional portal, you must find your missing cat by completing errands for Ponpon, the local Cat Café owner. Chase, catch and collect until you can find your way home! This game is made by students.

title: Just an Ordinary Bike Ride
description: In this adventure horror game you experience nothing but a calm bike ride home, your chauffeur is late and it's starting to rain. You only have a bike but you need to get home, it's a rather empty street aside from some debris. It's just a bike ride home.

title: Drunk or Baby
description: A party game for 2–8 players where you decide: is it a drunk person… or a baby? Players read ridiculous scenarios and must guess whether they describe someone who's drunk or an actual baby. Designed for laughs, surprises, and unforgettable moments with friends.

title: IQ Under Construction
description: Got strong nerves? Reliable friends? Precise jumps? Then this is the place for you. And if not, try it anyway. It'll be fun. Probably.

title: A Lost Man
description: A fully hand-drawn point & click adventure game. 1916. Somewhere deep in the night. War. Death. Play as a lost man, stuck between two front lines. Traverse a desolate countryside, facing unusual encounters, bursts of violence, and mystical surges.

title: Astral Frontier Online
description: An indie anime-style MMORPG in development

title: Minesweeper: Next-Gen
description: This isn’t the Minesweeper you’re used to! In Minesweeper: Next-Gen, you’ll explore boards built from a variety of geometric tessellations. Boundaries can wrap around, tiles can split, and parts of the map can even contain the map itself. Rely on pure logic to gradually uncover all safe areas.

title: The Only Droid
description: Tear enemy robots apart piece by piece in a physics-based action roguelike. Destroy weak points, stack upgrades, and create your unique build as you turn relentless robotic enemy waves into mechanical graveyards.

title: Glass Masquerade 4: Constellations - Celestials
description: "Celestials" puzzle set contains 12 new puzzles representing new constellation "Orion"

title: UviUvi
description:
Point-and-click adventure about finding treasures in a deep ocean

Follow a story of UviUvi - a creature, living in the darkest corner of an infinite ocean. She is also an avid lover of shiny things, and has a humble collection of them, gleaming in her cave. However, one of her treasure-boxes has remained empty for too long. Today she wants to find new treasures to complete it.
Your goal is to get 4 new shiny things for treasure-box, which are gifted to you by other ocean residents.

title: Wúgòu zhī Liàn: Zhànfàng Yú Chūn zhī Huāhǎi
Nosferatu no Otome-tachi
description: “—I am a genius. That is how I have defined myself.” Nosferatu no Otome-tachi is a visual novel set on a rooftop at night. A brilliant girl and a drowsy girl—two complete opposites—find themselves connected by the Nosferatu disease, and through it, they begin to build a genuine friendship.

title: Kingdom Hearts III Light vs. Darkness Edition
description: “Light vs. Darkness Edition” is a fan-made PC mod that fully rebalances the gameplay of KINGDOM HEARTS III, adding depth, mechanics, music and enhancements.

title: Biotype
description: Test the limits of bio-mechanical clone Model 137 a.k.a BIOTYPE in this free, endless bullet hell. Master the Biotype's patented tri-laser and push as far as you can. Will BIOTYPE prove it can make a difference in the fight against the enemy in the real world?

title: String Mace
description: Smash through swarms of enemies by swinging a huge spiked ball on a string! Build absurd combos, crush towering bosses, and chase the highest score you can reach!

title: Sins of Sinister: The Viscera-Eater
description: Sins of Sinister is an episodic horror experience inspired by lore stories. Each chapter delivers a short yet intense descent into fear, folklore, and the unknown. A rural village begins to fall victim to mysterious deaths with no medical explanation. As dark whispers of witchcraft spread.

title: Deep in the Dungeon
description: A roguelike game where players explore a mysterious dungeon. Monsters and items are randomly placed each time, adding unique challenges to every playthrough. Your goal is to find the way out, using your skills and strategy to fight and survive.

title: Zereoton Hauntings 2
description: Zereoton Hauntings 2 is a 2D survival horror game based on the story of a paranormal enthusiast called Mateo who loves to investigate the various haunted locations in the US.

title: Paddler
description: A rhythm-typing bartending game set at a sizzling swim-up bar! Your goal? Serve up tropical drinks by typing their ingredients in rhythm to the music.

title: Tenebrix
description: Descend into a living dungeon where hesitation empowers the darkness. Build your deck, command creatures across tactical lanes, and survive a roguelike descent shaped by fear, strategy, and the echoes of your past failures.

title: Dark Honor
description: Dark Honor is an action-adventure game set in a dark fantasy world where players take on the role of a lone warrior seeking revenge against a ruthless Samurai tribe. Master precise swordplay, navigate treacherous environments, and engage in challenging combat to reclaim your destiny.

title: Waters of Ragnarok
description: Waters of Ragnarök is a tactical naval survival game set after the Norse apocalypse. Navigate cursed seas, explore the lands, scavenge the massive corpses of Jötunns, and lead your crew through tactical battles against survivors and monsters in this Norse survival exploration game.

title: Bassai-Dai
description: Bassai-Dai is a stylized action-adventure blending fluid combat with creative ink mechanics. Wield a legendary brush to shape the world, solve puzzles, draw platforms, and unleash elemental powers. Rescue your family in a vibrant world inspired by Greek and Japanese mythology.

title: Idle Realms: The Eternal Spire
description: Train 18 skills, craft legendary gear, fight monsters across 6 realms, and conquer The Eternal Spire. A deep single-player idle RPG with true offline progression.

title: Mortanum
description: Collect trash in a park at night while pursued by an eerie presence. A short retro horror experience.

title: Perfectdom
description: This is a relaxing and stress-relieving puzzle collection game. Featuring hundreds of carefully designed levels, you’ll organize messy items in cozy settings like homes, cafés, and bedrooms. Simply tap or drag objects to put everything back in its place and clear the level.

title: Chess 432
description: It's the first ever chess battle royale for 32 players! Prove yourself battle after battle in one giant game of chess unlike anything you've played before.

title: Void Fighters
description:
Void Fighters is a multiplayer roguelike where you fight your way through the mysterious Void Dungeon alone or together with friends.

Choose your upgrades carefully, create powerful builds, and collect Void Essence during your runs to unlock cosmetics and characters.

Between dungeon runs, you can return to your overworld hub to customize your base, level up your character, unlock progression systems, and prepare for the next challenge. combining roguelike gameplay with RPG-style progression.

If you want a break from PvE, you can also challenge bots or your friends in fast paced PvP battles.

title: Run Run Iguana!
description: Make the iguana chase the delicious leaf for as long as possible! As the iguana runs after the leaf, you will encounter obstacles that the iguana must avoid. If the iguana catches the leaf, runs into an obstacle, or if you drop the leaf, the run will end!

title: Becoming a Legend: New Advent
description: A choice-driven fantasy visual novel about ambition, forbidden power, and relationships that can shape the fate of the world. Play as one of two protagonists and forge your own legend.

title: Don’t Sleep with the Fishes
description:
How much can you collect before the ship goes under? How will you use what you have? Act fast and make constant choices to escape the sea or become its next victim.

Don't Sleep With The Fishes is a point-and-click survival horror game focused on rapid salvaging, resource management, and surviving day by day at sea.

title: Double Dealers
description: A 3–6 player auction game built around bluffing, deception, and manipulation, where you must outsmart your opponents in tense bidding wars, hide the truth, and turn risky trades into profit. Every round is a battle of mind games where trust is fragile and strategy decides the winner.

title: Xenia is Online
description:
A horror visual novel of a chronically online depressed individual.

One day they recieve a message from a stranger - will this be the end of their dismal routine... or will they push them away?

title: Nature of Dread
description:
A gritty first-person action-horror where you awaken trapped in the cursed settlement of Hellhole—a forsaken place swallowed by the northern wilderness. Fight your way out of this nightmare’s depths and uncover what has been buried under top-secret clearance for centuries.

Caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, you awaken in the classified settlement of Hellhole. Built as humanity’s final bulwark in a war that has raged for over a millennium, it was designed to contain an ancient evil.
Here, in desperate attempts to stop it, people tried to contain it, isolate it, and study it—only for decades of military experiments to bury the truth even deeper.

The borders of the settlement were sealed tight, access was forbidden, and everything that happened—and still happens—within its perimeter remains buried beneath layers of secrecy.

Now, thrust into this centuries-old conflict, you must decide how far you are willing to go to protect what truly matters to you.

Face a nightmare given flesh, fight for your life, and uncover the horrifying truth about the nature of this place.

title: Midnight Watcher: Village
description:
Explore, prepare, and decide - follow the rules or break them for profit. Your actions determine how terrifying the night becomes. Survive until dawn.

Midnight Watcher: Village is a tense survival horror with simulation elements, where everything you do during the day determines whether you survive the night.

You are a shift guard sent to an abandoned village deep in the Siberian taiga. Your job seems simple: keep things in order. But the longer you stay, the clearer it becomes - this place is not as abandoned as it seems.

title: Netherspire
description: Explore the ruins of a colossal tower and fight those who threaten its ancient vault in this short 3D Metroidvania.

title: Hunger Lane
description:
Hunger Lane is a dark atmospheric horror platformer focused on exploration and puzzles, where a young boy tries to uncover the mystery of a nighttime city. Use improvised tools, light your way through the darkness, interact with the environment, and search for safe routes while avoiding creatures that now roam places that once felt familiar.

Use everything you can find in the city: matches, tools, and everyday objects help light your path, clear obstacles, and overcome environmental challenges.

Lights still glow in apartment buildings and behind windows. Explore your surroundings, search for clues, talk to residents, and interact with city devices: enter codes, unlock doors, and activate mechanisms to open new routes and progress deeper into the city.

Climb building facades, jump across obstacles, and search for alternative paths through multi-layered environments. Use parkour elements, ladders, and ledges to avoid threats, discover hidden routes, and reach places that seem inaccessible at first glance.

title: Saturn. Legacy
description: Saturn: Legacy is a first-person sci-fi RPG. Embark on a gripping journey: uncover the secrets of a hidden research facility on Earth, fight in robotic bodies across Saturn’s moons, shape the story through your choices, and reclaim the identity that was taken from you.

title: Abyss of Doom
description: Immerse yourself in a hybrid of psychological horror and immersive adventure, where you will be plunged into a nightmare that drags you into the depths of the abyss. Journey through medieval dungeons and ancient Roman ruins on your path to the goal.

title: City Car Driving 2.0
description: City Car Driving 2.0 is a driving simulator designed to help novice drivers master driving in a setting as close to reality as possible.

title: MeowFactory
description: Welcome to the MEOWFACTORY! Automate production lines and manage limited space to achieve perfection. Connect machines with conveyor lines and minimize hand (well, paw) labour! In the near and depressing future, when the world is on the verge of destruction, ONLY MEOWORKERS can revive production!

title: Devil Gate
description: DEVIL GATE — an Action/RPG Hack & Slash with a West‑Slavic fantasy atmosphere. Choose a character, create your build, and battle demons solo or alongside friends.

title: Cloudpaws
description: CloudPaws is a cozy sky trading adventure where you sail an airship, trade goods, farm, fish, and explore floating islands while helping locals and uncovering their mystery

title: Noema
description: Take your place at the terminal. Follow the procedures, process the records, and read messages never meant for you. Noema is a quiet, unsettling narrative experience about work, obedience, human connection, and what routine teaches us not to see.

title: Mini Lucy
description: Mini Lucy is a 3D platforming adventure where players take control of Lucy, a young girl who has mysteriously been shrunk to only a few centimeters tall after discovering a strange green crystal.

title: The Hand of the Crownbearer
description: “The Hand of the Crown-Bearer” is a character-training adventure game where you develop the protagonist while building relationships with specific characters. With numerous branching paths and a higher difficulty level, your choices shape the story. One playthrough lasts about two hours.

title: The Cat in the Hat: Rainy Day Mayhem
description: Join your favorite Dr. Seuss characters in 18 exciting minigames and challenges. Your house is about to be full of giggles, groans, and glorious mayhem.

title: Soccer Kid Collection
description:
Recover the Stolen World Cup Trophy in this Stylish 16-Bit Action Game!

When an alien collector destroys the World Cup, it’s up to a boy and his soccer ball to save the day. Soccer Kid is a classic platformer that swaps traditional combat for ball skills. Dribble through diverse landscapes, use headers to reach high places, and kick the ball to knock down anyone in your way.

Experience a piece of gaming history with the QUByte Classics edition, featuring two versions of the same game with new features to help you master the most challenging levels!

title: Blossom Voyage
description:
Cherry blossoms fall, hearts race wild.
Fall in love – or fight for your life.
Real Japan, real danger, real romance.

title: Marsupilami 2: Salsa Palombia
description: Help the Marsupilamis save Palombia from the Mummy Queen and her minions in this fast-paced 2D platformer! A strange melody has swept across Palombia… and all the animals have suddenly started dancing, leaving chaos in their wake!

title: Reel it! World Fishing
description:
Embark on a fishing adventure around the world!
Cast your line and reel in fish from across the globe!

title: Xlands
description: This is a virtual world app focused on fashion styling, virtual living experiences, and social interactions. Here, there are no monsters to defeat, no quests to complete—just relaxing gameplay that gives you more time to bond with friends. Of course, you can also host or join events, design outfits, decorate homes, and even build your own brand to create a business empire. You can also create interactive scenes to invite your friends on adventures. Everything is designed to be leisurely and enjoyable.

title: Ragnarok Console Project
description:
Ragnarok Console Project is a new RPG based on the world of Ragnarok, a legendary intellectual property enjoyed by over 100 million players worldwide.

Set in a familiar yet completely reimagined world, players will confront a collapsing reality and the hidden truths buried within it.

Choices and consequences. A journey from which there is no turning back.

title: Valefor II
description: A dark-fantasy roguelike autobattler. Recruit mercenaries, stack distinct race/class synergies, forge relics, claim perks. Take all the time you need to theory-craft your formation. Asynchronous PvP: pure strategy at your own pace.

title: Blacktower
description: Blacktower is a roguelike mini-RPG loosely based on Blackjack. Recruit your party, get buffed and push your luck to conquer the monstrous denizens of the tower.

title: Monster Alchemy
description:
Monster Alchemy is a Monster Collector RPG where instead of catching monsters, you create them using alchemy.
Create unique creatures, use them to gather rare resources, and fuse them into even more powerful beings! This RPG combines classic exploration with a deep crafting system where your monsters are your ultimate tool for looting, combat, and discovery.

title: Wiz Brochure
description: A magical fantasy RPG that weaves a heartwarming story in a world of pixel art displayed on a 240x160 screen. Enjoy a unique experience in a nostalgic-looking setting, using a battle system where turn order is linked to attack range, and a distinctive growth system that uses max HP as a cost. There's also a rabbit at the save points.

title: Boku ha Tomodachi: I Am Not Sweetheart
Papaya Plaza
description:
Welcome Mayor, to Papaya Plaza! This old tourist town isn't what it used to be, it's up to you to rebuild, draw back the visitors (the Beeps!), and bring the community together again.

Papaya Plaza is a snackable slice of life game for you to get lost in. Decorate and improve the town as you see fit, to make a perfect little spot for visitors to wander and enjoy. These beeps aren't picky, they just want to discover the next best-kept-secret!

title: Ornélia
description: A cozy village-builder and benevolent god game where you build freely, guide the Kinous, and spread kindness to bring your valley back to life.

title: Linebound
description: One player navigates. One player creates. Linebound is a 2D asymmetric co-op puzzle platformer where one player navigates the world while the other draws platforms in real time. Progress is only possible through communication.

title: Hold the Core
description: Hold the Core is a roguelite tower defense game about trading safety for power. Draft Risk Cards, shape enemy routes, evolve towers, and survive deadly enemies and bosses.

title: ConOps21: Subversion Protocol
description: Neo-London remembers nothing. The Dominion made certain of it. You are Cipher Reeve — the man their erasure failed to take - and the buried Signal you've touched carries the memory of everyone they erased. A psychological techno-thriller where truth is contraband and every choice is recorded.

title: Thirsty Bird
description: A retro-ish, rhythm-ish game about catching raindrops and dodging hazards with an unusual two-level control scheme. You've got to try it to understand it.

title: Office Manager
description: Build and manage your own office empire. Design buildings, find tenants, negotiate contracts, and keep them happy. Research new technologies, expand your business, and handle unexpected events in a living office world.

title: A Game About Chopping Trees
description: A Game About Chopping Trees is a meditative experience built for those who find peace in simple tasks — wrapped in a chill and relaxing atmosphere where there are no timers, no pressure, and no stress. At its heart, this is a game about the pure joy of chopping trees.

title: NCH: Chronos Rebirth
description: When the war between the Enhanced and ordinary humans shatters the future, turning back time becomes humanity's final gamble. As a life scientist navigating two timelines, you must decide: force genetic equality or embrace natural selection? No matter your choice, someone will pay the price.

title: Burning Tail Banquet
description: This detective interactive game casts you as an officer solving a murder at a remote inn. Freely type to question NPCs, who react dynamically. Uncover the truth or enjoy playful interactions—it’s your call. Immerse yourself in The Ancient unsolved cases！

title: Tetra Dungeon
description: An innovative pigeon fighting game. In dungeon, defeat enemies by placing block cards. Experience new building dynamics around blocks, relics, and hero traits.

title: Waiting on the Finishline
description: 一个讲述少年少女勇敢踏出追梦第一步的青春日常系故事。

title: Dark Leaches
description: You play as a non-functioning alcoholic that’s lost everything and relocated to a cabin in the woods to sustain your constant binge drinking. However, something is off about the cabin. Or maybe you’re just drunk. Either way these monsters need to keep it down so you can crack a cold one.

title: Depthbound Descent
description: Roguelike meets JRPG: You and your party challenge the Cavern of Trials—collect skills, adapt your build, and reach the end boss to escape. Built with the Steam Deck in mind, easy to pick up, hard to master.

title: The Traveller Tale
description: A fully voiced, old-school first-person CRPG where you build your party, explore towns, caves, and dungeons, and face deadly foes in turn-based combat. Take on quests, meet memorable characters, and craft, fish, and mine in a world full of danger and discovery.

title: War Room Football
description: Build a dynasty from the front office. Draft, trade, sign, and develop players across unlimited seasons. Scout prospects, manage the cap, hire coaches, then watch the league evolve around you.

title: Aurora's Awakening
description: In a mysterious castle, sorceress Aurora has been asleep for centuries. Able to summon powerful Elementals to fight by her side, Ever must protect the fortress from monsters and its most‑sought‑after secret while trying to discover who was responsible for Aurora's slumber and find a way to wake her.

title: Pet That VTuber!
description: A brutal and honest look into the reality of petting a cute girl on her head. Enjoy the digital warmth of simulated physical affection. Pet Zen on her head. Try different cute outfits. Having fun is encouraged.

title: The Magical Quest of Molly the Marble
description: A cozy adventure where you tilt the world to guide a marble through cardboard dioramas to find secrets, solve puzzles, and navigate dungeons on a quest to find your lost friends. ASMR audio and multiple accessibility options ensures you will have a relaxing experience.

title: Dungeon Lurker
description: Fight your way into the depths of a cursed dungeon in Dungeon Lurker, a retro action roguelike with a dark twist. Uncover a sinister secret connected to your past as you plunge into a world of dark horror and brutal combat.

title: Ball & Gun
description: Ball & Gun is a genre-bending, Sports-FPS game where you master your jump shot and an evolving arsenal of divine weaponry to hold back the undead. This isn't just about survival; its about becoming a Basketball God in the Ballpocalypse. A ball. A gun. Zombies. This is the new definitive shooter.

title: Spider Lily
description: A Lost Soul rescues a Blind Fish on the shores of the afterlife, binding their fates. With only a drum to guide the way, escort this fragile companion through a vast facility that processes souls toward rebirth — an emotional journey through attachment, dependence, and letting go.

title: Dioxide
description: Dioxide is a high-stakes, tactical FPS with soulslike elements set in a dystopian world ravaged by industrial decay. Shatter neo-antique nightmares, scavenge the scraps of a gasping civilization, and forge the last sanctuary. You will die. You will be reprinted. Will you remain human?

title: Feed It
description: A first-person, PSX-style horror game about living with a monster. Do as you're told... or don't. Just be ready for the consequences.

title: My Otter Friends
description: Explore a flooded island as a small otter. Meet stranded animals, restore nature, and bring warmth back to a world that has grown quiet.

title: MegaGum
description: Play as Uja in this 3D bubble-punk platformer blending action and adventure. Jump, glide, fight, and walk on walls using your Gum-powered abilities. Outsmart the traps of the mysterious Mister Gum and climb floor by floor through a factory filled with secrets, puzzles, and surprises.

title: Heroes of the Underworld
description: An open world party-based RPG with turn-based combat. Heroes of the Underworld is a comfy yet challenging mid-sized adventure in a vast fantasy world, inspired by 90s games and comic books.

title: Miharu: Alto Another Story
description: Features Miharu, who was a secondary character in Alto

title: Custom Romance City 3D3
description: Custom Romance City 3D3 is set to be a new entry in the studio’s “Custom” lineage of games, continuing from the Custom Maid 3D2 and Custom Order Maid 3D2 series. Just like in the previous entries, the player will be able to fully customize their dream girlfriend, but this time, they have the whole open world of Romance City to take her on dates and explore their relationship. Of course, the players will first have to skillfully romance the girl, but once they do, the “paradise city created to liberate people from common sense and reason” will be all theirs.

title: Bracer
description: Grab a buddy and brace for chaos in this 3D Fantasy Shoot Em Up (SHMUP). Face off against a twisted necromancer fueled by a cursed bracer and a bloodlust for destruction. Blast enemies, dodge projectiles, unlock upgrades, and customize your hero with unique weapons, skills, and skins.

title: Theos: Cities of Myth
description: A modern take on classic city-builders, Theos: Cities of Myth lets you develop a thriving metropolis dedicated to one of 7 Greek Deities. Raise an imposing sanctuary, meet your citizens needs, and found a city worthy of the Gods.

title: Neighborhoods
description: Neighborhoods is a cozy city sim where you shape streets to help people thrive, gather, and develop strong opinions about a particular bench. We're reimagining the city builder as a city fixer.

title: Chivalware
description: Chivalware is a frantic tile-matching action roguelite. Challenge your reflexes and coordination in real-time on a grid battlefield: evade attacks, match tiles to charge your weapons, and find the right opportunity to strike.

title: Deadzone Rogue 2
description: Fight as Talon 13-10 in this FPS roguelite adventure set on a fallen Earth. Combine weapons, augments, and elements to forge devastating builds, and blast through Monarch’s endless machines. Grow stronger each run, solo or with friends.

title: Pale Tide
description: A top-down zombie extraction survival game where you and your dog scavenge resources from deadly infected zones. Rescue survivors, and return to a hidden bunker to upgrade your gear, grow your crew, and prepare your escape before the largest horde ever witnessed floods the region, the Pale Tide.

title: Hands Over
description: HANDS OVER is a 5-player co-op horror game where harmless challenges become cruel tests of luck and nerve. Bluff, sabotage your friends, play dirty, and stay at the table longer than anyone else.

title: Five Nights At Pingas
description: Do you think you can survive Sanic, Dr. Robotnik and more scary characters all the 5 nights in this funny Five Nights at Freddys parody game?

title: R.override
description: Explore an alien planet as a fierce little rover on a run-based mission to rescue a lost crew and uncover their secrets.

title: Into The Haunted Land
description: An online co-op horror game for up to 6 players. Team up with your friends to explore ruins, loot cursed items, hide from monsters and extract safely. Do whatever it takes to meet the Guild’s quota.

title: Inherited Shadows
description: Inspired by the classics of the genre, Inherited Shadows weaves a gripping tale about Amanda, a young adult struggling to lead a normal life while haunted by the trauma of her mother's absence, but on an ordinary morning in 1999, everything will change for her forever.

title: Hello Neighbor Pre-Alpha
description: Hello Neighbor Pre-Alpha is an early, 2016 public build of the stealth horror game. Players attempt to sneak into their creepy neighbor's house to uncover a secret in his basement, while an adaptive AI learns from their tactics to set traps and catch them.

title: Parasomnia Verum 2
description: Parasomnia Verum 2 is a psychological horror game about Maddy's repeating nightmares crawling into reality.

title: Slot Machine Gun
description: Slot Machine Gun is a roguelike deckbuilder shooter where you wield an ever changing weapon : The Slot Machine Gun! Every reload spins up a fresh combo of guns and chaotic effects to create game breaking synergies.

title: Where Dolls Hang
description: Where Dolls Hang is a survival psychological horror game where you investigate a place plagued by strange and unsettling events filled with hanging dolls. Explore dangerous locations, gather evidence, uncover hidden secrets, and use your boat to confront the unknown as you search for answers.

title: Minestrike
description: Minestrike - is a multiplayer first-person shooter computer game that combines fast-paced competitive gameplay, a unique atmosphere, and exciting team battles.

title: Snack Factory Together
description: Team up with friends to build a successful snack business. Start with a small room and simple machines, then grow into a massive factory.

title: Farsight
description: Something is very wrong with your eyes. A routine eye exam pulls you into the house inside the machine. Beware. The figures in the image are closer than they appear.

title: War of Reproduction: Evolution
description: A 70-day journey begins. At a speed of 3mm per minute, aiming for 18cm. The smallest human cell embarks on a fierce competition to meet the largest. Only one in 300 million will survive. Attack, obstruct, survive—the war of cells starts now.

title: Raid One: 1 vs 5 Online Boss Battle
description: A thrilling 5 vs 1 PvP showdown. Combine random skills and stats within the time limit to create the perfect play! (In the demo version, you can play the full game except for character selection.)

title: Hardware Simulator
description: Build your hardware empire from scratch! Experience real business with product sourcing, dynamic pricing, online orders, and delivery management. Boost your popularity, expand your store, and become the country's most successful hardware merchant!

title: An Ordinary Top-Down Shooter
description: An Ordinary Top-Down Shooter Game is an ordinary top-down shooter game. In this ordinary top-down shooter game, you'll play as Cassidy the cowgirl, delving deep into ancient ruins in search of legendary treasure.

title: LaVonne's Bouncing Idle
description: A satisfying physics-based idle game where you deploy an army of neon bouncing balls to obliterate geometric blocks. Buy crazy upgraded balls, level up your lab, and watch the numbers scale into infinity.

title: Hot Potato: Tag Out
description: A fast-paced multiplayer party game of tag where players dash, dodge, and pass the explosive potato to avoid being the potato that blows up.

title: Drowning in a Sea of Blue
description: 「drowning in a sea of blue」is a short, linear game made in RPG Maker VX Ace, with some puzzle and exploration elements. Walk around a near-abandoned world, talk to [OCTOPUSES], and attempt to convince Mr. Octopus to rebuild it, together with your friends named [FRIEND], [HALF], and [OTHER HALF].

title: Freddy Hardest: Z Planet
description: Freddy Hardest returns as a lethal weapon to face the zombie apocalypse in New York.

title: Deadly Obsession
description:
"Deadly Obsession" is an intense visual novel where you are the main character. In this game, you awaken in a mysterious, unfamiliar basement, only to realize you've been kidnapped by a dangerously obsessed yandere. His motives are twisted and every interaction teeters on the edge of love and madness.
As the story unfolds, your choices determine your fate: Will you escape? or will his charm and obsession lure you into staying by his side? Each decision shapes the narrative, unraveling dark secrets and emotional depths.
Prepare for a thrilling journey of psychological tension, complex relationships, and a fight for control over your destiny. Some decisions will influence the story, everything has consequences. ENJOY!

title: One of Us
description: One Of Us is a modern real time strategy game featuring new first person style controls, with traditional control methods also available. Temporarily removed from sale on Steam, see the discussions board if you want to play!

title: Cozy Up!
description: Cozy Up! is a relaxing, wholesome game in which you play as a cockatiel finding joy again. Meet quirky animals in a whimsical land. Be inspired by their stories. Enjoy optional quests. Collect and favorite replayable minigames that gently develop memory, perception, and reasoning at your own pace.

title: Risk the Crown
description: A tower defense roguelite where victory means knowing exactly when to run. Draft troops, defend your castle, and escape with your king before it's too late

title: The First Chip
description: Build an illegal gambling empire from scratch. Rig machines, outplay customers, and rise from a shady fair stand to a full-scale casino in this sandbox simulation.

title: Spacebolt
description: What am I? Where am I? Who am I? Spacebolt is a narrative-driven puzzle adventure game where you control a spark of electricity. Traverse walls and ceilings, travel through circuits, and awaken dormant machines as each discovery brings you closer to the truth.

title: The Pale Mimic
description: The Pale Mimic is an atmospheric horror set in the untamed Alaskan wilderness. As a high profile fugitive on the run, it's just you and your dog surviving in the chilling forests, until something else shows up uninvited.

title: Ace Sponge: The Great SquarePants Chronicles
description:
A dark secret lives under the sea. Bikini Bottom is a land where serious crimes are rare, yet something unexpected happened - a murder was committed in the Krusty Krab. In the chaos, Mr. Krabs was arrested, but with his last grasp for resistance, he asks SpongeBob to defend him in court.

Now, SpongeBob will have to face the legal system as a makeshift attorney to defend his boss. Only time can tell whether SpongeBobs' trust is misplaced or not, if Mr. Krabs is truly innocent or guilty.

Join the 5+ hour adventure in an Ace Attorney style trial to find the truth, the truth of what truly happened to Sheldon "Shell" Jhonson!

title: Almazuela Picross
