description: You must complete almazuelas, quilts made from scraps of fabric arranged in geometric patterns. To obtain the scraps, you'll need to solve a Picross by filling in and removing cells based on the clues. You can rotate and move these scraps until you've pieced together the patchwork like a puzzle.

title: Pay to Slay
description: Survive endless hordes of infected in this top-down 2D roguelite inspired by Zombies mode. Weapons, drinks, synergys and bosses that will test you in every run.

title: Greedy
description: A raccoon co-op horror extraction game. Infiltrate procedural ruins, loot everything and extract the relic. Mammon, the Greed Demon, is watching… Stay away from his curse!

title: Pair at Sea
description: Manage your own pirate crew and sail across the sea. Take care of the ship morale, drag your sailors from one room to another and raid other ships as you navigate the seas.

title: Overbit
description: A 4th-Wall-Breaking Pixel Art Horror/Comedy RPG with Rhythm based Bullet Battles happening inside a Retro Operative System

title: Bridgeway to Heaven
description: In this challenging action and strategy game, you will help Mai-K, in charge of the safety of a climbing expedition, to sabotage her own team to keep more loot for herself, all without the foreman discovering you.

title: Gravity Circuit 2
description: A new Ark has risen. Switch between the Gravity and Power Circuit in this action-packed 2D platformer inspired by console classics. Gravity Circuit 2 is the sequel to the critically acclaimed Gravity Circuit

title: The Pines
description: A psychological horror RPG where every choice has consequences. After a failed case, former detective Edward Walker arrives at The Pines, a secluded retreat with therapists on site and the promise of peace. But beneath its carefully constructed calm, something is deeply wrong.

title: Serve or Die
description: In Serve Or Die, you work alone in a small sandwich shop during the night shift. With a VHS-inspired style and an increasingly unsettling atmosphere, survive as simple orders turn into something far more disturbing.

title: Way of the Hunter: Elkcrest Island
description: This isolated and sparsely populated hunting ground is also inhabited by a recent addition, Merriam's wild turkeys, and a shy predator that debuts in Way of the Hunter: the North American cougar.

title: Bus Terminal Simulator
description: Experience an immersive terminal management simulator. Manage passengers, organize schedules, inspect luggage, catch smugglers, and prevent illegal activities. Not every passenger is innocent some will try to trick you or smuggle illegal items. Stay alert and run your terminal efficiently.

title: Slay Goblins
description: Slay Goblins is an arena roguelite where you play a knight fighting off hordes of goblins. Choose from a variety of perks, weapons and items to create unique builds and defend your castle.

title: Mothkeep
description: Mothkeep is a single player moth documenting game where you step into a peaceful nature sanctuary and discover its native moths, one journal entry at a time.

title: OfMiceAndMechs
description: Fight, survive, subjugate and destroy. Build and fortify a base, establish production chains that turn raw scrap into finished steel, and command your workers to keep it all running. Your brain implant knows the way. The rest is up to you.

title: Shattered Delirium
description: Shattered Delirium is a first-person perspective psychological horror game. Explore a dark, atmospheric world that combines realistic visuals with unsettling audio. Interact with items, solve puzzles and riddles, discover collectibles, and learn the truth of the world of Shattered Delirium!

title: The Shade
description: A first-person psychological horror set in rural Finland, where isolation and unsettling encounters slowly turn your housekeeping job into something far more disturbing.

title: Soul Walker
description: A 3v1 asymmetrical multiplayer horror game where sound is deadly. Survive together or betray others for your own safety, uncover hidden roles, and outsmart the Soul Walker that hunts by noise.

title: Meat Eater
description: Meat Eater is a pixel RPG game inspired by ancient Chinese history. In the game, you will play as the Zhu Jve of the game, recruiting soldiers with unique traits to build your own army and unify the world.

title: The Bird of the North
description: In 1921: a kidnapping, a revolution... Investigate and uncover the truth behind a dark, mysterious story.

title: Roughhousing
description:
Roughhousing is a 4-player co-op horror-comedy game set in a 1970s grindhouse aesthetic. Players control teenagers who break into haunted locations to vandalize the environment, loot valuables, and attempt to escape alive.
The game combines physics-based environmental destruction with deduction and betrayal mechanics across three main pillars:
Destruction: Players earn experience points by causing creative, chained, and spectacular damage to the environment, such as smashing furniture and setting fires.
Deduction: Instead of passively gathering evidence, players actively summon entities through specific reckless actions. Players must deduce which combination of behaviors triggers rare entities to fill out the "Spectredex"—a collection-by-summoning bestiary featuring a deterministic gate with a probabilistic unlock system.
Deception: Players can deliberately sabotage their teammates by crafting and distributing identical, tainted items (such as rigged cigarettes or spiked drinks).
The game features a gritty, retro visual style influenced by 1970s exploitation cinema, utilizing crushed shadows, tungsten lighting, and period-accurate grime.

title: Psych Rift
description: Psych Rift is a supernatural action-adventure game where armed with only a telekinetic glove and your wits, you must survive reality-bending nightmare worlds and their monsters to escape a research lab consumed by a dark entity from another dimension.

title: Biosphere Simulator
description: Biosphere Simulator is a planetary god game sandbox in which players guide a barren volcanic world through billions of years of evolution. Players shape the atmosphere, carve oceans, and seed the first microbes, then watch ecosystems, species, and civilizations develop across three eras: Geological, Biological, and Technological. Features include procedural world generation, a DNA and mutation engine spanning 48+ species, ecosystem and atmospheric simulation, emergent civilizations, and god powers such as asteroids, volcanic eruptions, wildfires, and rainstorms.

title: Crow's Requiem
description: A narrative-heavy, comic-infused survival visual novel & puzzle game where you are a licensed body collector navigating a dystopian world of moral dilemmas and resource management; where belief, rebellion, or control will prevail through your choices.

title: A Puzzle Game where you Fold Dice
description:
Fold the dice so that it matches the hint on the left. This is the only video game in existence that relies on your 3D Spatial Reasoning skill.

Drag and rotate the tiles to the center board to create a dice that matches the hints on the left.

title: Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection - Kollector's Edition
description: Step into the arena and choose your fighter! Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection includes all the essential games from Mortal Kombat's early years. The Kollector's Edition includes the full game, an individually numbered premium Kollector's box, a hardcover lore and art book, a Goro controller holder, a Scorpion and Sub-Zero pin set, and a commemorative arcade token.

title: Little Big Backrooms
description: Dive into a different but similar take on the Backrooms Lore and explore little big eerie spaces that tell a story of how its become the way it is. Can you make it to the end?

title: Lucid Dreams
description: You are trapped in a twisted carnival with no memory of how you got there, you must survive a deadly game set by a creepy clown. Solve puzzles, stay hidden, and try to escape.. before he finds you.

title: Frost Ornament
description: Cirno puzzle action game!

title: Nareko The Mineral Appraiser
description:
This mini-game involves sorting the constantly appearing "Wonder Stone" and the "rocks found on the path toTH11SA Stage 1" left and right.

Get high scores by performing consecutive combos or by connecting and sorting Wonder Stone together!

*This game was created for Touhou Game Jam 2026, held in February 2026.

title: Straying Rules
description: Straying Rules is a co-op horror game for 1-4 players. You need to escape from various worlds governed by strange rules within 12 hours by all means. Levels, objectives and dangers are ever-changing every time you enter. You must discover and interpret the rules to find your only hope of survival.

title: No.13813
description:
A time manipulation escape room game.
Piece together the truth behind a viral outbreak
through causality puzzles spanning across different timelines.

title: Rotted: A Brain Rot Simulator
description: Humanity is trapped in an infinite scroll. Your mission: Break the loop and escape the rogue AI controlling your mind. Stack wild powerups and survive the digital prison in this retro PS1-inspired survival roguelite. Shut down the network... or rot.

title: Outblast
description: Outblast is a fast and frantic arcade shooter for flatscreen and VR. You are piloting interceptor C11-28. Your objective: destroy infected constructs, collect data particles, and purge the system before total collapse.

title: Gutspill
description: Gutspill is a brutal horror game where you use a hammer and kicks to destroy and cannibalize your enemies using the environment to your advantage. Survive a descent into madness where everything becomes increasingly surreal and visceral.

title: Maui Pong
description: Dodge obstacles, defeat bosses & collect power-ups in this arcade classic!

title: Geist Heist
description: Geist Heist is a single-player, stealth, puzzle game in which the player must use their wits, creativity, and ghostly powers to enter museum exhibits, sneak past security guards, and reclaim their tethers.

title: Dad’s Gonna Be a Travel Influencer.
description: Identify the truth on the world map! Experience the life of a world-traveling influencer in this geolocation mystery. Explore iconic landmarks, solve historical riddles, and grow your channel. Manage your budget & chat while uncovering the world's long-lost romance!

title: Dread Admiral
description: A turn-based naval roguelite where every ship you lose is gone forever. The Black Fleet hunts you. Your Flagship must survive.

title: Soulscale
description: Soulscale is a narrative roguelike deckbuilding game inspired by ancient Egyptian judgment of the dead. Read the memories and sins of lost souls, then decide their fate: reincarnation, eternal life, or destruction. Each judgment brings you closer to the truth of the underworld.

title: Zenith Drift
description: High risk and online drift races in Zenith Drift. Make a difference with car customization. Show your skill in the arena requiring perfect maneuver and speed. Online racing, modding, and style combined. Dominate the asphalt!

title: Nestify
description: Nestify is a cozy sandbox room design and decorating game where you draw layouts, furnish interiors, and customize objects by adjusting colors, lighting, scale, and rotation. Create a relaxing atmosphere with music, weather, and scenic views. Chill and build your own nest.

title: Haunted Cleaner
description: Haunted Cleaner is a relaxing, light puzzle and narrative game about tidying up and decorating the homes of the deceased. Play as a psychic cleaner, uncover the stories left behind and help lingering ghosts find peace. Remember, every place tells a story, you just need to listen.

title: The Organ Woman
description: A 1–4 player cooperative horror game set in an abandoned hospital in Japan. Work together with your friends, collect boxes containing organs, and escape from the hospital where something lurks!

title: Pibcremental
description: A cozy, chaotic idle-incremental clicker about growing a civilisation of tiny creatures called Pibbles in a giant tree, set in a post-human world. Gather resources, build wacky structures and play mini-games to push your production to its absolute limits!

title: Legacy of Kain: Heart of Darkness Collection
description:
The Heart of Darkness Collection is the ultimate Legacy of Kain experience, bringing together Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered Deluxe Edition and Legacy of Kain: Ascendance in one definitive bundle.
Return to the dark world of Nosgoth and relive the climactic struggle between Kain and Raziel in Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered Deluxe Edition, updated with modern enhancements and exclusive bonus content. Then step into Legacy of Kain: Ascendance, a fast-paced 2D action platformer that brings you Nosgoth in a brand new way.

title: Training Lucie
description:
You play as a man who must take in a young intern, Lucie, as a favor to her best friend, Zoe.

Help Lucie to discover her sexuality, and help your colleague Claire to get out of the clutches of an odious sexual blackmail

Define your loyalty to Lucie and you can discover a personalized ending.

Can you save your girls from the clutches of their new boss Pascal ?

title: Sauve le Shérif
description: Save the Sheriff: 4 to 10 players. Two saloons. One rule: trust no one. Proximity voice chat, face-to-face duels, and a dilemma with every shot: pacify or kill.

title: Serpentes: Anniversary Edition
description: Brainmelting Snake. Crunchy boomer arcade fruit salad. Lightning fast, forget about blinking.

title: The Miki Komori Project
description:
Before the streams…
Before the audience…
Before anyone knew her name…

there was Miki.

Enter a surreal visual novel exploring the hidden lore behind TheMikiKomori, the mysterious angel shark VTuber drifting between loneliness, memory, and the endless pull of the digital sea.

This is the story before the streams, before the audience, and before the name “TheMikiKomori” ever existed. Follow Miki as she navigates loneliness, identity, and the strange events that slowly guide her toward an uncertain future.

Uncover hidden secrets, forge emotional connections, and piece together the origins of a girl who was never meant to be found.

title: Wàngyuè
description: Wang Yue is a new chinese open-world urban gacha game.

title: Orbital Drift
description: Explore drifting wrecks orbiting a dead planet. Master orbital mechanics. Fight zero gravity in space. Gather resources and build modules. Upgrade your ship to travel further. Uncover a civilization’s downfall. Are people on Earth ready to learn its history?

title: Hell Let Loose: Canadian Airborne
description:
Canadian paratroopers fought with distinction across Northwest Europe as part of Allied airborne operations. This pack contains:

Uniforms
Canadian Airborne
Helmets
Net Mk II Airborne
Net and Scrim Mk II Airborne
Canadian Airborne Beret

title: Hell Let Loose: False Front
description:
Pack Includes:

Zeltbahn German Cape for the following roles: Rifleman, Support, Medic, Sniper, Auto Rifleman, Heavy MG, Spotter, Assault, Engineer, Anti-Tank and Officer.

title: True Confession
description:
Dramatic and hardcore pixel art shooter that turns into crossroad of anger, gilt, religion and psychoanalysis

True Confession is a game aimed at fans of action movies 80-00 years (Heat, Training Day, The Wire, The Departured). In visual style resembles POSTAL, Crimsonland, GTA2. So it's oldschool but seasoned with modern mechanics and deep religious and psychological plot.

The game is hardcore, each opponent can pose a fatal threat and gives rise to a healthy sense of rivalry. True Confession is distinguished by its down-to-earthness, the game does not have automatic health regeneration and superpowers, an important distinctive mechanic of the game is "anger".

As the game aims to feel grounded, there are no rocket launchers, flamethrowers, or tanks — this game is about crime in the streets, not the battlefield.

Let's pray/play together!

title: Demon Work Walk: Hello Work Poke Park
Kula Collection
description: Three easy games about a orange ball and his adventures in one simple package

title: Dark Night Endless Tales: Bitter Forest
description: Dark Night: Endless Tales – Bitter Forest A lone girl in a dark forest, surrounded by PS1-style retro graphics. A psychological nightmare between her lost memories and her grandfather’s disappearance.

title: Football Club Manager 26 Live
description: Multiplayer football management built on fair competition. Outsmart rivals with skill and strategy - no random packs, no pay-to-win gameplay. Take charge of your club, build your squad, and prove yourself on the world stage.

title: Robinsons Simulations World
description: Slip into the role of Robinson. You're stranded on a deserted island. Build a boat to get back to the mainland. Can you survive in the city? Work your way up from lumberjack to landowner.

title: Screw That
description: An insanely powerful tower defense game! Build your ultimate dream team and defeat all enemies!

title: Mothership Down
description: 130+ unique goals to achieve in over 50 levels in this physics-based retro puzzle game! Control a fleet of tiny, colorful lunar landers, piloting through puzzling moon caves. Scrape by with scrappy first flights, then re-engineer a perfect solution to earn bonus stars.

title: Rolling Ball: HD Remaster
description: Once classic rolling ball game, now back in HD remaster!

title: Ranman
description: Step into the shoes of Ranman, a clumsy yet brave hero who must fix the chaos in his kingdom! Traverse crazy worlds, collect power-ups, defeat enemies, and uncover secrets to restore order. Can you become a true hero? ✨

title: Floating Life
description: Floating Life - first-person horror You are left alone on a small island, where you have to face the horror lurking in the darkness. Don't let the light go out at all costs and stay alive. Immerse yourself in a truly oppressive atmosphere of horror.

title: Impulse Response
description: Engineer Cadence Quinn is woken from cryo sleep to blaring alarms. Make your way through the ship and discover what happened and solve the mysteries of the ship. An audio only experience.

title: Eldara
description: Eldara is a single-player dark fantasy idle RPG inspired by classic MMORPGs. Train 17 interlocking skills — mining, smithing, fishing, combat, cultivating and more — to hunt monsters across the realm, raid dungeons, and challenge three mythic world bosses. Collect over 100 unique items, complete dozens of achievements, and tame 16 wild pets. Progress continues whether you play actively or step away, with rebirth and prestige systems for the endgame.

title: Kagenazo
description: Kagenazo is a 3D shadow puzzle game built around a simple idea: a shape can look completely different depending on where the light is coming from. It's a game where you build cube shapes, rotate them, and match their silhouettes from multiple angles.

title: Glubtastic Maps
description: 5 awful maps for awful people. Me and my buds love playing stupid left 4 dead campaigns, so I decided to make my own.

title: Terraformers Collection
description:
Includes:
Terraformers
Terraformers: Megastructures
Terraformers: New Frontiers
Terraformers: Independence

title: MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries - Succession Wars Edition
description:
MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries - Succession Wars Edition includes:

MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries
MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries - Heroes of the Inner Sphere
MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries - Legend of the Kestrel Lancers
MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries - Call to Arms
MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries - Rise of Rasalhague
MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries - The Dragon's Gambit
MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries - Solaris Showdown
MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries - Digital Content

title: Engine of Sin
description: Operate a titanic war machine from the perspective of its last surviving crew member in a desperate battle against the otherworldly Kaiju. Balance power levels, craft specialized ammunition, and feed your ever-hungry reactor, yet the greatest horror may already be sealed within your metal coffin.

title: Terraformers: Independence
description: In this Terraformers DLC, Martian factions vie for power over the Red Planet. Will you align with the knowledge-driven Scientists, the profit-focused Industrialists, or the idealistic Humanists striving to build a flourishing second home for humanity? Maintain a careful balance: allow any one faction to dominate, and Mars may slide into autocracy, a dangerous path with far-reaching consequences. How will you shape Martian politics and guide the Red Planet toward independence from Earth?

title: I Love Science!
description:
I Love Science! is an educational science computer game for ages 7 to 11 and is targeted to grade 2 to grade 5 students. Players meet Al Luminium, Mo Mentum, and Rosie Gardener, as they explore physics, chemistry, and biology by playing games and activities as well as trying experiments on the topic of science. There are some running gags in the game which adds an extra effect to the targeted age group. The physics section teaches children about electricity, gravity, and simple machines, while the biology section teaches children about the human body, plant growth, and food chains. The chemistry section teaches children about solids, liquids and gases, heating and cooling, and crystals, and as a bonus, there are some Earth and Space Science topics, which are the water cycle, planets, and the Sun and Moon.

There are over a hundred science experiments and over a thousand science problems included in the game, as well as 60 printable experiments for off-computer use.

title: All the World's Cravings
description: In this darkly comedic retelling of Dante Alighieri's Inferno, you are Dana, a food delivery driver who is guided through the nine circles of Hell. Overcome (or succumb) to desire, deliver meals, and face your own dark secrets as you deliver your way to the deepest layer of Hell.

title: Legion Breaker
description: A short active incremental game about defending from undead hordes. Wield an arsenal of spells, raise a holy army, and fight across ever-expanding battlefields. Start from nothing and progress through a massive skill tree to become the ultimate battlemage.

title: Resident Evil: Barry's Mod
description: Resident Evil (Barry's Mod) is a stand-alone modification to the PC version of Resident Evil and allows you to play through the original game campaign as Barry Burton but with many changes to the game including new item and enemy locations, story and much more.

title: Hank Shaw: Animal Investigator
description: When a pet goes missing, Hank Shaw's the detective to turn to. But when there's been a breakout at the zoo? You're going to need to do more than chat with low down dirty rats and stool pigeons. Call in every favor you got and get your hands dirty as you sniff out clues. It's up to you gumshoe!

title: Toy Story: Retro Roundup!
description: Step back into Andy’s room with Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and more classic characters in Toy Story: Retro Roundup! This five-game collection features four Toy Story titles and A Bug’s Life. All the games have been upgraded with quality-of-life improvements and behind-the-scenes content.

title: John broke his bones
description: Ragdoll physics platformer where you control a scientist to going through different labs with gadgets and hazards to get the medkit

title: For The Cat! Sorcerer's Revenge
description: They killed your cat. Fatal mistake. In this magic-infused bullet-heaven roguelike, develop your wizard, upgrade and evolve spells, collect items, and create unstoppable builds while battling hordes of enemies.

title: Cable City
description: Cable City is a fast 3D platformer about riding power cables through a strange city in the sky. Take odd jobs, repair broken machinery, replace batteries, and master movement routes to earn badges, uncover secrets, and become the skylines most efficient electrician.

title: Pay Your Space Debt
description: An incremental survivor-lite where you must earn your way out of debt by mining entire asteroid fields, upgrading your spaceship and surviving the debt collectors.

title: Big Shark
description:
Big Shark is an exciting fish-eating game filled with challenges! As you progress through each level, you'll discover a diverse array of ocean creatures.

How to Play: Simply tap on the screen to control your shark. Guide it to avoid larger fish and devour smaller ones. Your shark will grow bigger and stronger as it eats enough food.

A vast ocean awaits your discovery, teeming with fascinating creatures like pufferfish, rays, swordfish, whales, killer whales (orcas), sunfish, whale sharks, electric eels, and many more!

title: Autotelic
description: One may use an array of tools and items to complete obstacle courses, and one may also talk to various characters to amass useless information.

title: Bathory: Heritage of Blood
description: Play as Ursula Bathory, the vampire Princess, awakened from a centuries long slumber to claim her throne of blood in this Vampire Soulsvania inspired by Castlevania, Nosferatu and gothic victorian literature classics.

title: Outsiders & Insiders
description: "Outsiders&Insiders" is a suspenseful and romantic visual novel for women, featuring three characters you can pursue. You will take on the role of a noble lady in this game, and in the midst of a complex mystery, uncover the secret of your lost memory...

title: Vem, Exu
description:
Vem, Exu is a narrative adventure game about anger, memory and reconciliation. After losing his kite during a fight with his brother, Exu falls asleep carrying his rage and enters a storm where dreams, memories and imagination merge together.

Players progress through the story by interacting with symbolic environments and completing simple activities such as connecting stars, bursting bubbles and rebuilding objects. Inspired by Brazilian culture, cordel art and Afro-Brazilian symbolism, the game focuses on visual storytelling and emotional progression.

title: Billion Citizens
description: Billion Citizens is a rogue-like deck-building game with city-builder mechanics where you play as a mayor planning how to create the greatest and most populous megalopolis of all times. Manage your deck of buildings and place them wisely to maximize their synergies.

title: Residential Evaluation
description: In Residential Evaluation, you’re an evaluator clicking houses to earn points, which can be spent on upgrades to boost points per second and per click. Unlock achievements as you build up your evaluator empire.

title: Space Warpster
description: A fast-paced retro arcade shooter inspired by classic 1980s side-scrolling space combat. Weave through organic obstacles, survive relentless enemy waves, and defeat powerful end-level bosses in a pure, skill-driven singleplayer experience.

title: Weed Store Simulator
description: In Weed Store Simulator, you manage a legal cannabis store while secretly producing illegal substances. Collaborate with mafias and gangs to earn big money both legally and illegally.

title: Runeward Online
description: Free-to-play online RPG meets relentless bullet hell. Blast, cast, and dodge as you chase rare loot, evolve your class, and bend the rules with game-breaking runes and pets. Squad up with players worldwide while delving into unforgiving dungeons and building your character, one drop at a time.

title: Patched
description: Patched is about a lonely, abandoned doll who awakens in an empty, decrepit factory. In search of answers, they begin to explore the factory and piece themselves back together, encountering other dolls along the way.

title: Toy Story 3: Complete Edition
description: Toy Story 3: Complete Edition brings the definitive version of the game inspired by the Academy Award-winning film to modern platforms for the first time, including previously platform-exclusive content from the PlayStation 3 version and an enhanced experience with upgraded visuals, higher resolutions and improved performance. Toy Story 3 is best known for its groundbreaking Toy Box Mode, a massive, open-world sandbox that allowed customization of the environment and characters and featured non-linear missions that allow players to unlock new toys, vehicles and characters from other Pixar movies.

title: Violet Mansion
description: Violet Mansion is a horror puzzle game where you and your friends must survive against various enemies by using absurd items, finding creative solutions... and pushing people down stairs. Or you alone get to uncover the story of two friends who made a promise.

title: Prettiest Morgue
description: A deckbuilding dress-up game where you run your own morgue fueled beauty agency that uses corpses as models.

title: Cosmic Flesh: Overdrive
description: Defend the galaxy from endless cosmic horrors. Dash and blast with fast, burst-based piloting, unleash powerful overdrives, evolve your ship with each unique run, and push your skills to the limit.

title: With You Forgotten from My Memory
description: A mysterious tale shared with Sujin, the girl only I can see.

title: Rayman Legends Retold
description: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!

title: Bancho the Chef
description: Bancho the Chef is a cooking simulation and adventure game that follows Bancho, a character from Dave the Diver, during his younger days as he travels the road to becoming a sushi master. Players can travel through cities across Asia and experience the joy of cooking firsthand as they follow Bancho’s journey and learn unique local cuisines.

title: Vibe or Dare
description: MoodTrue: Vibe or Dare is a party card game where friends reveal truths, complete dares, vote on outcomes, and compete for the strongest vibe in the room.

title: The End of the End of Evangelion
description: A short experimental walking-sim with low participatory agency and obscure cinematic sequences that hint at the deterministic ending of The End of Evangelion.

title: Stuntman: Hollywood
description:
Become Hollywood's most sought-after stuntman. Perform explosive scenes inspired by blockbuster movies, defy danger, and drift your way to stardom.

Take on iconic stunts inspired by fan favorite Universal Pictures films and NBCUniversal TV shows like Fast & Furious, Back to the Future, Knight Rider, Miami Vice, and Death Race. Stuntman: Hollywood puts you behind the wheel to pull off death-defying stunts - always in style.

title: Vipunk: Shield of Valhalla
description: Take the role of the Vipunk, also known as the shield of Valhalla. It is your job to destroy and fight back against the invading robots sent from the future. Vipunk is a bullet-hell survivor game with a focus on deflecting enemies' attacks. Adapt, evolve, and overcome to drive back the robots!

title: Leafy Greenz
description: Leafy Greenz is a game where you play as Leafy, who gets eaten by a Koala. You must make your way throughout the digestive tract of the Koala, playing through a series of minigames and attempting to achieve a high score.

title: Marathon: Season 2 - Nightfall
description:
Season 2 of Marathon introduces tons of new content for players to discover, while in the dark corners of Tau Ceti IV, new mysteries emerge and the Anomaly stirs.

Shrouded in darkness and cloaked in danger, a new nighttime version of Dire Marsh, Night Marsh offers new challenges and opportunities. Turn the shadows to your advantage, use new tools to navigate the darkness, uncover hidden secrets, and become the monster in the night.

title: Hashi Infinite
description: Hashi is a game that connects all islands with a network of bridges.

title: System 21
description: Manipulate a blackjack game from the inside as a dealer subroutine in this minimalist roguelike deckbuilder. Read the visible card's queue, execute illegal code exploits to alter the upcoming cards, and fleece high-rolling patrons before the system anti-cheat detects your anomaly.

title: My Isekai Hotel
description: Become the manager of your very own hotel from another world! Gather resources, play fun mini-games, expand your establishment, and keep your guests entertained. Build your reputation and create the ultimate otherworldly getaway!

title: Caverns of Evil
description: Battle your way through the levels, search for the gear you need to stay alive, and find the exit to the next level. Explore entirely new procedural levels every time, just to see how many you can get though.

title: Midnight Sin
description: In the wake of a murder, you receive an unexpected offer and find yourself living in a lavish mansion, surrounded by stunning women. Step into a web of lust, temptation, and dark secrets in Faerin’s most seductive game yet.

title: Galaxy Card Game
description: Sci-fi strategy card battler. Build galactic fleets, consume supplies to deploy units, and battle across the stars. Unique supply mechanics break traditional cost limitations - every deployment is a choice between survival and expansion. All cards free, skill determines victory.

title: Degenerate Star
description: Degenerate Star is a surreal sci-fi horror visual novel set on a warped space ship.

title: Sky Realm Idle
description: Sky Realm Idle is a Xianxia RPG combining Spirit Array strategy with estate management. Forge artifacts, cultivate pills, and recruit companions. Ascend from mortal to immortal through deep customization and idle growth.

title: You Are The Monster
description: Ever wanted to be a giant monster rampaging through a city? Experience mindless chaos as you destroy all in your path, earning new abilities, new monsters and new ways to wreak havoc.

title: Neofold
description: The idle creature-collector where each pet is uniquely yours, generated live by your GPU. Hatch endless weirdos, adopt the ones you love, and grow a living sanctuary of species that exist only on your desktop.

title: The Machine Stops
description: A strategic, resource management game where you must make an AI startup succeed within a time limit all while pondering the larger ethical implications of AI and its role in society. Game takes place within a Matrix-style terminal.

title: Latin Shadows: The Visitor
description: This is a short psychological horror experience inspired by Guaraní folklore. After a simple gathering at a friend's house, you soon discover that the night is hiding something watching you from the shadows. What begins as a normal evening turns into an unsettling story where your decisions will shape the ending.

title: Cities In Motion: Design Dreams
description: Rendered in rich detail some of the world's favorite cities await the steady hand of a planner to manage their transportation needs in Cities in Motion.Overseeing the changing needs of people from 1920 to 2020, it's up to you to manage everything from buses, trams and subway trains to maximize profits while pleasing commuters.

title: Earn Your Legacy
description: Earn Your Legacy by yourself or with your friends by slaughtering enemies with flashy combos, finding epic loot and powerful upgrades, parkouring around traps and fighting epic bosses!

title: Neurospasm
description: A weird first person roguelike horde shooter. Hook your brain into your computer, dive into a game inside a game, unbox and stack unique items, use up to 6 weapons at once, kill weird fleshy enemies, and uncover why nothing here makes any sense.

title: Silent Hill: Townfall Deluxe Edition
description:
Silent Hill: Townfall is a full-length, self-contained psychological horror set against the cold, isolated backdrop of Scotland, 1996.

Players can explore St. Amelia, where fog-soaked streets, abandoned communities, and forgotten corners tell their story through atmosphere and history. Reality and delusion subtly intertwine, luring players into the depths of St. Amelia's grounded, tangible world.

The Deluxe Edition contains the following content.

Pre-order bonuses:
- CRTV Style: Rusted
- CRTV Style: Beach Edition
- 48-hour early access

Deluxe Edition contents:
- Full game
- Digital artbook
- Digital soundtrack
- Simon's Outfit: Alternate

title: Ilequ
description: Survive the perpetual winter as a pack of six-legged, egg-laying tardibears.

title: Last Round at the End of the World
description: Dream the riddle. Question the village. Choose who drowns. A poetic folk-horror game about divine messages, guilty villagers, ritual games, and the terrible cost of keeping a place safe.

title: Astral Dive
description: Join Atlas and his companions in Astral Dive, a charming hand-drawn pixel art fantasy RPG. Experience innovative turn-based combat powered by magic cards, explore wondrous worlds beyond the astral portals, and uncover the secrets of the magic academy.

title: Janky Horse
description:
Junkyard Robot Janky Horses racing for glory ... what else do you need to know? An interactive streaming game that integrates with all major streaming platforms.

Part of the Snoodle-Doodle collection of Streaming Games.

title: Come To My Party!
description: Jimin dreams of finally having her first birthday party, but what begins as a childhood wish unravels into social pressure, fragile friendships, family expectations, and consequences that hit closer than you’d like. Join Jimin in this coming-of-age story where every choice carries weight.

title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve - Playable Aircraft: F-14A
description:
Grants Playable Aircraft: F-14A for ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE.

The initial model of the carrier-based fighter series that would later be upgraded to the Super Tomcat.
Its role of using long-range missiles to outrange and eliminate threats to the fleet has remained consistent from its creation. Its nickname is Tomcat.

title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve Deluxe Edition
description: The Deluxe Edition of Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve includes the full game, three days of early access, a Premium Ace Pass Plus Voucher, and the Customizable Cosmetic Set DLC.

title: Headcutter
description: HEADCUTTER is a Sci-fi Spaghetti Western FPS with BRUTAL combat, DESTRUCTIBLE environments, and LOTS O'GORE. You're a space bounty hunter, track targets, explore destroyable maps with multiple routes with CRUNCHY gunplay and cut their heads to get your money. Come on now, go out and GET SOME HEADS!

title: Dysphoric Soymilk Lidocaine
description: You're a therapist in the year 2050. After a worldwide ban on robot lobotomization, you were assigned to help an artificially intelligent man named Mr. Pat overcome his rather severe bout of depression. Dig through the memories of Mr. Pat to uncover his deepest troubles and cure him of his existential sadness.

title: Drained Creatures
description: Drained Creatures is a multiplayer 3D arena brawler for up to 8 players locally. You can choose from 13 characters and 7 arenas with a wide range of equippable weapons and character-specific abilities. Each character can transform into a powerful superform capable of unleashing devastating special attacks.Hunt for magic orbs to get your character into its superform as fast as possible, making matches chaotic, action-packed, and fun.

title: Looking Up I See Only A Ceiling: The Recall
description:
After everything that happened, while sorting through cardboard boxes, you find some old VHS tapes.

They hold your best memories, moments when everything felt simpler.

But…something feels off.

Enjoy this new spin-off short story from “Looking Up I See Only A Ceiling”, made in collaboration with our game “7 Days To Think About It”.

title: Fredbear Runaway
description: FredbearRunaway is a Hello Neighbor Stealth Mod where the Neighbor is replaced by Fast Fredbear.

title: Blackout Jack
description: A blackjack inspired rogue-lite deckbuilder fused with a grimdark murder conspiracy. Gamble your life, build a deck with powerful synergies and combos, and form the perfect plan to kill the dealer before he kills you.

title: Competitive TicTacToe
description: Revolutionize the classic game. In this fast-paced strategy title, your oldest piece disappears once the board is full. No draws, just deep tactical gameplay. Think ahead, trap your opponent, and climb the global ELO leaderboards in a battle where every move counts.

title: Neon Oblivion: Prelude
description: Neon Oblivion: Prelude is a single map utilizing, and launched alongside the TronResource texture pack.

title: HavenCraft
description: A third-person sandbox town building game.

title: The Demon Party
description: The Demon Lord has vanished, and the Demon Lord’s Castle has fallen into chaos. Become Lethe, a demon girl, dominate defeated monsters, form your own Demon Party, and raise a new demon army!

title: Midnight Moments
description: A small, cyberpunk diorama-building game where you create cozy rain-soaked backstreets, glowing apartment blocks, or quiet neighbourhood corners. Decorate your designs with props and place citizens, crafting stories that bring your city to life. At your own pace. No goals. Just vibes.

title: Playful Pursuit
description: Playful Pursuit is a colorful 3D adventure platformer where you jump, climb, solve puzzles, battle goofy enemies, collect VHS tapes, and build friendships with allies in a silly High Desert quest to rescue Eddy’s stolen teddy bear.

title: Super Galaxy Gladiator
description: Super Galaxy Gladiator is a survivor roguelite focused on buildcrafting and inventory management. Fight waves of enemies, buy and upgrade items mid-run, and arrange your gear to create insane builds and synergies in the galactic arena.

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Hero's Journey
description: The 23rd free update for Disney Dreamlight Valley brings new content inspired by Disney's Hercules - including a new Realm and Hercules and Phil as Villagers. It also included new player levels, decoration presets, new rooms for Olaf's Grand Exhibition and started the Godly Glamor Star Path.

title: Empluna
description: Sandbox city building meets automation: Design unique buildings, create vibrant cities, and perfect production chains. Create a civilization that suits your style. Perfect for anyone who loves creativity and strategy!

title: Shapevasion
description: Shapevasion is a top-down, base defense shooter. Warp between arenas as you shoot and upgrade your way through action packed levels while the invading shapes try and steal from your base. Can you survive the Shapevasion?

title: Dream of Remains
description: This game is a deck-building roguelike. Collect randomly presented cards and create the best deck to defeat your enemies. If you are defeated by an enemy, you will be sent back to the first stage, and your strength at that time will not be carried over.

title: Warlocks Nexus
description: In Warlocks Nexus, your medieval realm faces an existential threat: an invasion from beyond. This isn't just about survival; it's about adaptation. Explore a fully destructible, voxel world, scavenge for resources, and craft your way through incursions.

title: Robot Ox
description: Robot Ox This is a 2D action game, a game about the story of a robot. The protagonist is a cow-shaped robot who begins his story in order to protect his homeland.

title: BlackJack Math Trainer
description: Level up your BlackJack mathematic skills along with discovering many secrets, features and challenges!

title: Small World of Golf
description: Chill out and relax with 2 Golf Games in 1.Play 18 holes of Small Golf & 18 holes of Mini Golf, each with 2 game modes, normal play & par or under.Thanks for checking out Small World of Golf.

title: Maveus
description: Join MAVE, the virtual K-pop group, on their journey to stardom! Chat directly with TYRA and witness their rise to fame. Create your own performance video for "PANDORA" using the stage camera. Stay tuned for more updates and exciting new content with MAVE - The Virtual K-Pop Idol Experience.

title: Deadly Dealings
description: Deadly Dealings is a multiplayer strategy card game for 2 to 4 players. Outsmart and outplay your opponents in a surreal, high-stakes arena where only the best strategist survives.

title: Five Nights at Pingas 2
description:
The evil dr. Ivo Robotnik also known as PINGAS has finally been put in jail for his horrible crimes of stealing underwear. You are a night guard in the prison and you have to keep all the criminals out of your office!

Do you think you can beat all the 5 hard nights and the two bonus games?

title: Spooky Market
description: Spooky Market is a co-op shop simulator for 1–4 players set in a world of eternal Halloween. Open your own business, sell a variety of goods, serve vampires, skeletons, and other creatures, hire unusual employees, and gradually grow and expand your store.

title: Rogue Company: Season 2
description: Season 2, based on the theme of Justicar vs. Rogue, was the second season of Rogue Company. It started on May 11, 2021 and ended on August 9, 2021, lasting for 90 days.

title: Escape from Slumberland
description:
Can you escape your worst nightmares?

Escape from Slumberland is an online co-op horror game with up to 4 players. Dodge deadly traps, outwit fiendish monsters, and escape with enough moonbeams to sate an ancient evil’s hunger.

Play as Victorian children delving into hand-drawn dreamscapes and try to survive the nefarious experiments conducted by The Slumberland Institute. Gather toys from the dream realm and grind them into moonbeams while being hunted by your worst nightmares. Will you chicken out while you’re ahead or venture deeper for secrets that could multiply your haul?

Murdered by a shadowy beast? Do not despair! Death is not the end in the dream world. Help your friends from beyond the grave by bestowing powerful blessings and providing important information that could be the difference between certain doom and a miraculous escape.

Befriend the dream dwellers and gain powerful upgrades to help you overcome ever increasing difficulties. Uncover the mysteries of each dream to unlock new worlds to explore, each with their own set of enemies, puzzles, and rewards. But beware, the evil Slumberland Institute will sacrifice anything to control the dream realm, including you! Face your nightmares, uncover the truth, and see if you can truly Escape from Slumberland!

title: Caribbean Frontier
description: Start with your ship and a couple of coins to conquer the caribbean frontier. Use trade, diplomancy or piracy to gather wealth. Control cities, build new ships for you fleet and expand your influence! Or become a well known pirate that every vessel fears.

title: Kosenki
description:
Kosenki is a single player dark fantasy hack and slash with stylish combat, where precision, speed, and mastery define every battle. Easy to learn. Hard to master.

Fight across a war-torn continent powered by the mysterious mineral known as Kosenki.

Play as Hayato, a broken samurai seeking peace in a world that no longer remembers it, and face enemies both on the battlefield and within his own mind.

Endure the war within.

title: Gerphyon: The Ender's Mansion
description: Action-adventure video game with puzzle elements and an exploratory structure divided into rooms and interconnected areas. The player takes control of a lone protagonist, immersed in a world with dark and distinctive atmospheres, where each environment presents different challenges and small puzzles to solve.Character progression occurs through the discovery of permanent upgrades, such as increased maximum health, improved defense, passive bonuses, and many others that allow the game to be replayed with a different approach than previous runs, with increasing difficulty based on the number of playthroughs. The level design rewards observation and curiosity, featuring alternate paths, hidden secrets, and environmental puzzles that break up the pace of the action without compromising its fluidity.The experience doesn't aim for horror or extreme tension, but rather maintains a constant sense of mystery and isolation. It’s a project designed for those seeking a solid and cohesive experience, capable of balancing exploration and puzzle-solving with finesse.

title: Thousand Floors
description: Tower Climbers carry amber light; allies follow through misty pagodas in an endless Eastern tower. Thousands Floors blends side-view pixel art with hands-off combat—summon, upgrade, and let them climb. Grow via allies, floor lockdown, and relics.

title: Soulmine
description: Explore an abandoned mine, escape two entities working together and find a way out. Use your flashlight, search the tunnels and survive the dangers lurking in the depths.

title: Bros of Bench
description: Bros of Bench is a chaotic co-op platformer where two players form a dumbbell connected by an adjustable bar. Alternate between lifting each other and flying with jetpacks while mastering coordination, physics, and timing.

title: Strozowka
description: Operate the gate, let the cars in, and make sure the generator doesn’t die before dawn. People park here because it's cheap, but it’s their fuel that keeps your generator running. No cars means no fuel. No fuel means total darkness and trust me, you don’t want to be here when the lights go out.

title: CoreBreaker: Desktop Swarm
description: A corner screen incremental brick-breaker where bouncing cores destroy endless swarms. Let it run in the corner of your screen while you work or jump into fullscreen and take control yourself. Unlock new Cores, expand your skill tree, survive endless waves.

title: Slipspace Panic
description: A trip through slipspace gone awry. Shoot and evade waves of attackers for your freedom in this twin-stick shooter micro-game!

title: Okurek
description: Tend the farm, the chickens, the grieving jars. The trees murmur while the cancer grows with every passing day. A 90-min folk-horror experience set in the rotting mountains of Czech Switzerland. Preserve what you couldn't save.

title: ImpossibleBosses
description: Team up in online co-op and take on powerful boss raids. Learn attack patterns, survive chaotic battles, and work together to defeat seemingly impossible bosses.

title: Kacha Fruit Cut
description: Welcome to the cyberpunk night market! Kacha Fruit Cut is a fast-paced, casual fruit-slicing game. Manage your futuristic street stall, slice fresh fruits with precision, complete customer orders, and trigger the neon fever mode to become the ultimate midnight fruit master!

title: Micronova
description: In this vast universe, you are a Novi-01, a tiny explorer who jumps, climbs, and carves their way through levels filled with creatures and environments that react to your every move, waiting to be explored and solved in order to advance.

title: G.O.D. Global Orbital Defense
description: Take control of the G.O.D. system, the U.P.A.’s tactical satellite. Orbiting in silence above Vel’Aris, your mission is to protect the planet from every threat. Manage orbital fire. But remember: G.O.D. sees everything... even what you wish remained buried.

title: Dictatorship Simulator
description: Some people call it a democracy; you: an opportunity. Manipulate a political simulation by playing cards, find the cracks in the system, and turn a perfectly fine democracy into your very own dictatorship.

title: A Good Deed On Harris Avenue
description: Untangle a web of wants and wishes from the residents of Harris Avenue in this brief PSX-styled puzzle-adventure game. Bask in the piercing heat of a summer afternoon, explore an intricately hand-crafted environment, and discover what A Good Deed On Harris Avenue has to say.

title: Planks Wars
description: Planks Wars is a fast, irreverent cross-platform PvP card battler where 200-foot-tall sorcerers use kidnapped adventurers as tournament pawns. Build your strategy with CCG-style deckbuilding, command your puppets... I mean, heroes, and climb the ranks.

title: Queueue
description: An abstract, tile-based puzzle game where the moves you make are for turns not-yet done. Dodging through traps you will arrive at 2 turns in the future quickly becomes a mind-bending puzzle as the levels grow more complex. How hard can a level with only 6 tiles be?

title: Fetidity
description: Dive into the mysterious and terrifying world of Fetidity and help Mark solve all the puzzles and discover the secret of this place.

title: Scream You Lose
description: If you get startled, you go back to Number 0. A Japanese-style horror anomaly-spotting game that uses your microphone to detect your reactions. Eerie shrines, schools, and cult-like locations await, filled with all kinds of horror and anomalies.

title: The Moment of Panic
description: Trapped in an underground bunker with your finger on the button, interpret intelligence signals, question unreliable AI advisors, and decide whether to escalate, stand down, or unleash doomsday.

title: Roomrush Racer
description: Race through 20 chaotic rooms with 27 characters in a fast-paced arcade racer. Play solo or with up to 4 players in local split-screen, collect items, master speed classes, and win cups together.

title: Bloodwright
description: Descend through deadly procedural dungeons, claim powerful loot, and decide how deep you're willing to risk it all in this dark fantasy action RPG roguelite.

title: Again: Loop
description: Find anomalies hidden within a repeating hallway. Miss one, or make the wrong choice, and everything resets back to the beginning.

title: Bean Base
description: Bean Base is a survival base building farming game where you are solely responsible for your very own space station. Grow crops, explore the stars, and decorate your base; however you want to, survive the elements of space.

title: Catapulteers
description: A chaotic 1–4 player co-op physics comedy where cursed Catapulteers haul weird ammo, lose their heads, load one giant catapult, and stop a Troll that really hates catapults.

title: Undying Flame
description: Survive a minimalist wave-survival rogue-lite. Keep the fire alive. Read its flame. Defend your fire against creatures that crawl from the dark across endless waves. Every wave survived, the fire grows. Over time, it consumes everything.

title: Rejected Draft
description: Rejected Draft is an incremental auto-battler where you play as a discarded doodle seeking revenge on the Artist who threw you away. Battle rival sketches, absorb their powers, and grow stronger through a deep web of upgrades, skills, and progression systems. Unlike traditional RPGs, you decide which enemies appear in your world, shaping your build by choosing which powers become available. Every enemy is a sketch, and many enemies can appear in multiple alternate interpretations, each offering a different artistic take on the same concept. With strategic progression, long-term growth, and randomized elements that make each run feel different, Rejected Draft blends idle game progression with RPG buildcrafting and auto-battler combat.

title: Flame, Forest & Flood
description: A cozy three-player strategy showdown where simple rules meet surprising depth. Easy to learn, endlessly re-playable, and built so everyone can play, and anyone can win.

title: A Little Age
description: Build and expand a network of settlements, each with its own little economy. Manage the flow of resources between them at your own pace, and watch a civilization emerge in this minimalist settlement builder.

title: Salmon Tower
description: Salmon Tower is a free, momentum-based precision platformer (often described as a "semi-Foddian rage climber") developed by Oolong Studios.

title: Monst
description: Players take on the role of an alien monster, devouring humans on Earth with various transformations, fighting against human armed forces, and annihilating the world.

title: Uncanny Valley: Checkpoint
description: Pass. Quarantine. Kill. Run a Soviet checkpoint together in co-op after a nuclear meltdown unleashes a viral mutagen. Inspect papers, spot lies, and judge twisted bodies while battling radiation, paranoia, and the deadly cost of every mistake.

title: Omvros
description: Experience the deep fusion of rhythm and visuals in this innovative fixed-track rhythm game. Through meticulously designed charts and performance effects, every track presents a unique sensory world for you to explore.

title: Server-Admin Simulator
description: Build your datacenter empire from scratch. Buy hardware, manage contracts, hire staff and outsmart rivals. Face random events, hack the competition and survive the market. Moddable. Multiplayer. No two runs alike.

title: Cat Craft
description: A cozy first-person sim blending Gardening and Alchemy. Grow magical crops and mix ingredients to craft endless unique cats. Manage your Cat Café, find homes for your cats, and bring warmth, colors, and love back to the Gray world. From fluffy tails to quirky personalities, every cat is unique.

title: Rekindled
description: Rekindled: Cozy Tavern Life is a co-op tavern game with a twist - there's no stress! Forage, Fish, Farm and Cook at your own pace, then decorate your dishes and tavern before welcoming your customers in.

title: Where The Road Fades
description:
“Where the Road Fades” is a short psychological indie horror game.
After a sudden accident, you find yourself lost in the woods.
You try to find help in a nearby house.
Inside, nothing feels right.

Explore a creepy house
Choose between different paths and doors
Face what’s haunting you in the darkness
Experience a short but intense horror story (~20 minutes)

Will you find your way out?

title: MMORPG NPC Simulator
description: Play as an NPC in a living MMORPG world. Run your shop, trade with players, give quests, and send raid parties after rare loot. Build your reputation, unlock Game Master abilities, and take control of the server from within.

title: Word Rift
description: A fast-paced word puzzle game featuring handcrafted levels, speedruns, endless mode, and global leaderboards.

title: Project Threshold
description:
You are a participant in Project Threshold, an experiment designed to force people to confront their deepest fears. Pass through sets of blue and red doors, survive what waits beyond them, and reach the end, if escape is even possible.

Project Threshold is a psychological horror and memory-based walking simulator where players must confront the fears and horrors waiting beyond each threshold.

title: MIA: Memory Fragments
description: MIA: Memory Fragments is a story-driven psychological horror adventure where you explore fractured memories, interact with the environment to progress, uncover the story through the world, and escape from MIA's darkest side. Survive the memories… or remain trapped forever in the past.

title: Forbidden Compass
description: A 16 map Partial Conversion based around Eldritch Horror utilizing the BTSX resource pack, and MinichargePlus.

title: Scary 8 Bits
description: A lightweight psychological horror and a walking simulator, where the player needs to carefully observe the surroundings to succesfully flee from this wretched place.

title: Survive the Apocalypse
description: Turn-based roguelite in a post-apocalyptic world where you will have to make meaningful decisions (sounds familiar, capitalist world maybe). Make your way out of this ruined city, with eleven quarters (levels) and countless zones. Eat well, sleep well, decide well.

title: Lek gjemsel med Mummitrollet
description: Edutainment game for smaller kids. Released in scandinavian countries with voices in Norwegian, Danish and Swedish.

title: Stickman 3D Tennis: Deluxe
description: Play tennis matches in a 3D environment with cartoony graphics! Defeat your opponents in either a quick game or tournament mode. Use the Lob, Slice and Volley to win matches! Fully 3D environments for beautiful stick tennis.

title: Bingo Roulette
description: Bingo Roulette is a casual strategy puzzle game where you select slots on a bingo board to earn points and complete bingos to collect bonus scores.

title: Gido Gido: Kaiju Battle Party
description: A chaotic 4v4 party brawl is about to go down! Control your giant cuddly combative creatures in a cozy city you can smash to pieces, and fuse with your teammates into even bigger kaiju you collectively control for more devastation. Unleash the mayhem and let's gooooo!

title: Dead Spin
description: Gamble your way through a deadly abandoned casino in this dark roguelite deckbuilder. Discover broken synergies, outscore your captors, and spin for your freedom.

title: Carpark Hero
description: Every round is an intense race to claim a parking spot before your friends do. There's always one fewer spot than players, so if you don't park your car, you're eliminated. It all builds to a chaotic, high-stakes 1v1 final showdown where only one car can be crowned the winner.

title: Mini Warrior Defense
description: Lead your warriors on an epic adventure to defend your kingdom from invaders - in this action tower defense game, you can use various defense towers, levels, heroes, and many good things to help you destroy enemies!

title: Imouto Paradise! 3
description: A censored port of Imouto Paradise! 3

title: Scratch the Ticket
description: Scratch the Ticket is a first‑person incremental gambling sim where every ticket is a test of nerves. Print tickets, scratch cells, and decide: cash out now or risk it all. The outcome depends only on your choice.

title: Birds of Ascent
description: Birds of Ascent is a hand-drawn pixel-art 2D flight action adventure starring a flock of birds. Soar through the skies, explore the cavern, and fight your way back to the surface!

title: The Sims 4: Silver Screen Style Kit
description: Cut a bold figure in striking styles inspired by the mystique of a classic era with The Sims 4 Silver Screen Style Kit*.

title: The Sims 4: Tea Time Solarium Kit
description: Sip tea in sunlight while surrounded by elegant décor and close friends with The Sims 4 Tea Time Solarium Kit*.

title: The Sims 4: Prairie Dreams
description: Mix charming prairie fashion and vintage pieces with The Sims 4 Prairie Dreams Kit. From rustic to elegant, these looks bring the romance of countryside to wherever your Sims live. This kit is all about mixing rustic and vintage fashion for a timeless aesthetic. With pieces like the short overalls, leather boots, daisy jewelry, and lace-trimmed dresses, the soft and dreamy vibes of prairie life can be part of any Sim’s story. Created by Miiko.

title: The Sims 4: SpongeBob’s House Kit
description: Create your own iconic pineapple home with nautical décor from The Sims 4 SpongeBob's House Kit‡.

title: The Sims 4: SpongeBob Kid’s Room Kit
description: Decorate a bedroom with furniture inspired by the iconic cartoon with The Sims 4 SpongeBob Kid's Room Kit*.

title: The Sims 4: Yard Charm Kit
description: Adding charm to your Sims lawn isn’t about perfection—it’s about personality. Go full yardcore with The Sims 4 Yard Charm Kit! This playful collection turns plain porches and tired lawns into cozy corners bursting with color. Mix and match modern tones, textures, and timeless details to create a handcrafted look for any neighborhood. Your Sims will stay stylish, social, and totally keeping up with the Goths. Created by Ravasheen.

title: The Sims 4: Wonderland Playroom Kit
description: Use fantastical décor to create a whimsical play space with The Sims 4 Wonderland Playroom Kit*.

title: The Sims 4: Lady Bridgerton’s Masquerade Ballroom Kit
The Sims 4: Lady Bridgerton's Masquerade Ball Fashion Kit
Welme
description: We are the first virtual reality streaming platform that improves the relationship between streamers and their audience. We connect streamers with super fans who want to have a more direct, immersive and exclusive relationship than the current one.

title: Trick or Beat
description: Stack your trick pile or beat up your opponent! Trick or Beat is a fair 1v1 battlecards game with a shared draw pile. Can you discover the best strategies? Without any pay to win!

title: Dead Rose
description: Dead Rose is a 2D top-down action-adventure in pixel art, blending the exploration of a metroidvania with the epic adventure of a Zelda-like, in a world that is both gloomy and magical.

title: Sea Salt City
description:
Memories of backflips, headshots, and monoliths.

A first-person shooter in an ocean seascape. Ride the waves, or ride the rails. Perform tricks and shoot enemies. Aim for a high score!

title: MansionDungeon
description: “Mansion Dungeon” is a retro RPG-style adventure where you manage an apartment building while interacting with demons. Venture into dungeons featuring nostalgic 2D graphics, and bring back so many rewards that they won’t all fit on the small screen.

title: Foxfire
description: A top-down sci-fi survivors-like with space physics and a devastating arsenal of evolving weaponry. Customize your ship and tear through alien swarms as routine recon missions descend into bullet hellscapes.

title: Replica Club Route D
description: Welcome to the REPLICA CLUB. Glittering days. Midnight terrors. Immersive storytelling meets the grit of TRPG exploration, battle, and persuasion. Transcend the screen. Experience 'interactive cinema.' This is a cosmic horror adventure that rewrites the rules of visual novels.

title: Komayama Kiri ha Zenbu Yari ni Iku
description: Popular streamer Komayama Kiri stars in a chaotic streaming survival action game! Fall through deadly obstacles, survive endless enemies, go viral across the galaxy, and overcome mysterious cosmic trials with the fox-eared V-streamer Kiri in this wild minigame collection!

title: Meeple Incremental
description: Roll dice to move Meeples around the board and collect money, skill points, and capsule tickets. Unlock unique skills and minigames, powerful collectibles, and automate dice rolls to increase your income.

title: Waiting for an Egg
description: A pixel-art idle game for those "waiting for an egg." Here, your time is your budget. Buy "breeds," start the long "review cycle," and automatically "grind" for inspiration. Collect rare "inspiration eggs," expand your coop, and decorate your farm.

title: Watercolors Sink Beneath the Surface
description: Watercolors Sink Beneath the Surface is a nostalgic pixel-art point-and-click adventure set on Narumi Island, where only an abandoned high school stands. Years later, two girls return to complete a watercolor inspired by their school memories, gathering ideas from the remnants of the past.

title: Raise-a-Wish
description:
A daughter raising visual novel project inspired by titles like Princess Maker and Tamagotchi where you play as an unnamed protagonist to raise a member of Phase Invaders Wish.

Guide Dizzy, Lumi, Jelly, and Ember through their short yet eventful lives, learn their stories, and raise them as if they've always been yours. Don't let them down!

title: Kid Icarus Enlightenment
description: Play as Pit, Palutena or Dark Pit (and as many other unlockable characters) and explore 25+ unique levels with up to 2 local friends. Level up by playing and grow stronger with your favorite character! Defend Skyworld from the evil forces of darkness!

title: Judy's Adventure DX
description: Judy fell asleep beneath a tree having a delightful picnic when a mysterious hand stole her house key! Judy’s Adventure is a retro-inspired platforming quest packed with charm, secrets, and handcrafted challenges.

title: Anomalith: Anomaly Zone Countermeasures DLC Set
Forgotten Blood
description: Drawn by the call of an ancient crystal dagger, you journey into the Forgotten Valley, now ravaged by the Stone Plague. Forgotten Blood is a first-person action RPG inspired by King’s Field and the Souls series. Explore an interconnected world filled with secrets, danger, and hidden paths.

title: Drawn Together
description: Doodle, communicate, and play your own drawing games with friends using your own desktop digital whiteboards!

title: Endless Silent Night
description: An all-ages port of 12 no Tsuki no Eve.

title: Girl & Scarecrow
description: Something rotten roams the night. Venture deep into the woods behind your grandfather's house and track down an aviary lost to time in this fantasy visual novel game set in rural New Zealand.

title: Prince of Egypt
description: Rise from a dying slave to a powerful noble in Ancient Egypt. Survive the desert, master trade, forge alliances, fight or steal your way to influence, and help build monuments that will shape an empire.

title: Echo Pandemic
description: You are a bat, and the aliens are afraid of you. Stalk occupied towns by echolocation, bite a single host, and let the virus do the rest. A stealth game where your weapon is a disease. Engineer strains, manage outbreaks, and stay invisible. The hunt starts at dusk.

title: Moonlight Cradle
description: This is a traditional simulation management and raising game with multiple endings featuring beautiful girls.

title: Witness the Dark #1: Bloody Burger
description: You escaped a serial killer. Now you're hiding in a small town, working night shifts at a burger joint. But the hallucinations won't stop. The customers seem to know you. And in three days, seven people will die. A psychological horror narrative where reality itself cannot be trusted.

title: CS Manager
description: CS Manager is an eSports manager game. The player takes charge of a FPS eSports team, and have to bring them to the top of the circuit. Management decisions such as roster moves, which staff to hire, and which tactics to set form the main gameplay loop. The game also features a match engine, which lets the player see their tactics played out in real time games

title: Invisible War Revised
description: Invisible War Revised is an unofficial mod for Deus Ex, a re-imaging of Deus Ex Invisible war. Being incomplete, the current version contains two missions, New Orleans and Seattle.

title: Realmguard
description: Realmguard is a rogue-like tower defense where every run is a strategic balancing act of expansion and elemental strategy. Expand the map tile by tile, uncover random encounters and hidden rewards, upgrade weapons and combine elemental effects for powerful synergies to survive.

title: Bombanana!
description: Bombanana! is a chaotic, explosively funny co-op multiplayer game for three, where each player has only part of the information - blind monkey, deaf monkey and mute monkey must work together to defuse a bomb, or everyone goes BOOM! Will your friendship survive the ultimate test?

title: Dominus Gladiatus
description: Dominus Gladiatus is a brutal gladiator management simulator where you recruit, train and equip gladiators and make life or death decisions throughout a deadly 160-day tournament against rival Domini.

title: Mail Mares
description: Mail Mares is a single-player/co-op rogue-lite action game. Play as Gale Glacewing or Rosedawn Solace, two up-and-coming members of the Mail Mares. Brave the skies solo or with a team of up to four, soaring through daring battles with pirates, dragons, and treacherous territories on your way.

title: Inversion Day
description: Invert the world around you in this atmospheric pixel-art puzzle platformer. Escape an alien spaceship with your dog using mysterious artifacts that reshape reality, uncover hidden secrets, and solve increasingly difficult handcrafted puzzles.

title: Goblin Museum
description: A chaotic co-op extraction heist game where you play as goblins running a museum. Go on dangerous illegal expeditions to find artifacts for your collection. Scan, dig, loot, and RUN! Outsmart the police, fend off thieves, and get everyone onto the pickup helicopter magnet before time runs out.

title: Minerals: Deep Core Mining
description: Mine the vast underground and collect ores and gemstones—collect! collect! collect like crazy! “Minerals: Deep Core Mining” is an over-the-top mining game with roguelite elements. Use the resources you gather to upgrade your abilities and take on an endless underground that changes with every run!

title: The Omega Reach
description: Reach for the stars, gather their instruments, and curate the best collection in the universe! The Omega Reach is a point-and-click museum simulator (and dungeon crawler) where you are a musical genius.

title: Gendo The Gatherer
description: A cozy life sim where you forage, cook and serve your way through Gendo's journey navigating an abundant, ever changing landscape. After long days of gathering goodies, return to your cozy home to prepare, cook and serve your dishes to the local townsfolk. Join Gendo in his life in the countryside.

title: Boreal Tenebrae Act 0
description: A surreal narrative adventure set on the night Tamarack Narrows collapses into static, fire, and aurora. Follow Sarah, Bree, and the townsfolk as an unknown visitor arrives promising salvation. A lo-fi, analog-horror

title: Loot Frog
description: Loot Frog is an incremental action bullet hell about breaking pots, collecting gems, and fighting an evil cult. Upgrade your gear, unlock new abilities, explore diverse biomes, and push deeper into increasingly chaotic battles.

title: The Book of Prosperity
description: A 2D Action RPG set in a surreal pixel-art world where ancient magic seeps through Hong Kong-inspired streets. Pulled into a parallel dimension ruled by the Circle, Cyrus must master rhythmic combat, rooftop parkour, and forbidden truths to uncover the cost of a world built on false prosperity.

title: Zombuds
description: The zombie apocalypse is here - time to make a profit. Loot, manufacture and distribute shady goods across a zombie-infested sandbox. Hire survivors, brainwash the undead, automate production, and grow your empire in this open-world co-op sim.

title: Thieves and Gold
description: Smash containers, grab the gold, uncover hidden keys, and recruit a crew of thieves in this medieval loot-heist incremental. Race the clock in Heist Mode or play relaxed in Casual Mode.

title: PlanetForge Protocol
description: This is a strategy game that combines automated base construction with real-time tower defense. Land on a harsh alien planet, construct a vast automated industrial assembly line from scratch, and transform it into a formidable front capable of withstanding a massive influx of enemies.

title: Military Battlefield: Enlisted
description: Military Battlefield is a FPS shooter The game is set in a realistic environment. You play as a soldier on either side of the conflict, and must use your shooting skills to defeat the enemy. Will you survive this forever lasting war?

title: Selfie Worm
description: A physics-based puzzle arcade game where players control a quirky, wiggle-happy worm. Navigate through various challenging levels filled with obstacles and traps, stretching and balancing your body to snap the perfect selfie at the key moment. Beyond the comical controls, players will discover a fragmented narrative about the worm's obsession with social media fame.

title: Origin of the Magic Book
description: Live from scratch in a different world, learn magic, make equipment, defeat demons and become the strongest.

title: RPG Plus: Virtual Tabletop
description: RPG Plus is a cross-platform virtual tabletop including chat, character sheet, 2D/3D map maker, and campaign manager for every kind of role-playing game, like D&D and pathfinder. Give your virtual TTRPG adventure a new dimension. Now it's your turn to roll RPG+!

title: I.D.F.K.
description: How long can you survive, and how much money can you make? A land overrun with wildlife and bandits, where you compete against others to survive and gather the resources and money necessary to control the land and build cities. Will you team up with strangers? Or play alone? IDFK - It's your story.

title: Internet Exploring
description: What if the Internet was your escape room? Solve fun riddles whose answers are hidden online. Real people, places, songs, objects, paintings, movies etc. become clues in the biggest escape room there is…the online world.

title: Hop Hop! Donut
description: Strap on balloons and soar through the skies as Donut the corgi in this adorable 2D platformer! Battle evil cats, dodge deadly obstacles, and rescue your kidnapped owner in a whimsical adventure inspired by Balloon Fight.

title: Ball Buster Breakout
description: Grab your balls and get ready to bust! A hyper-kinetic Idle incremental breakout game.

title: Rogue Assault
description: A real-time strategy military game that lets you directly command your units, with no build times and impressive 3D visuals. Set in a post‑apocalyptic Europe - form alliances with other commanders, fight for resources and territory and rise in honor as a war commander.

title: Phasebreak
description: In this turn based strategy game, your tactics are pushed to the limit as you need to consider not one,- but two gameboards. Warp both friend and foe between them, master interdimensional gunfights, and confidently strategize around RNG-free abilities in this FREE student project!

title: Outscratched
description: The scratchcard roguelike deckbuilder. Assemble a unique selection of scratchcards, blessed charms, and magical stickers. Discover endless exciting combos to beat the odds against a diabolical lottery.

title: Nova Strider
description: An indie top-down sci-fi score-attack game about blowing up aliens in the upper atmosphere! Compete against your friends locally and see who can get the highest score on the leaderboard.

title: Cassette Beasts 2002
description: Jump back into the world of beasts in Cassette Beasts 2002, coming to Xbox Series S | X, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC! A follow-up to the critically-acclaimed creature collector, Cassette Beasts, this new journey will have players fuse with over 240 beasts - any two beasts can be combined into over 50,000 combinations, all fully animated!

title: Sadist II: Ostatni Krzyk
description: A two-dimensional retro sandbox-style game in which the player takes on the role of a god. There are no rules or restrictions. A full arsenal of weapons is available: explosives, firearms, melee weapons, and even lasers, a saw, or an anvil.

title: The Last Show
description: A narrative incremental about fireworks that starts as a hobby and becomes an obsession. Grow your arsenal, fire strategically to stack combos, build grand finales, and grow a rabid fanbase. A journey that begins in your backyard and ends somewhere you didn't expect.

title: Ship Happens
description: You and your best mates have embarked upon a noble, but extremely dangerous mission. Spacecrafts throughout the galaxy are calling for help - can your crew take the controls and guide them to safety away from ravenous, ever-expanding black holes?

title: Ornament Tower
description: After getting transformed by a curse for approaching the Ornament Tower, Azulin and Guaraná decide to climb it together in order to recover their original bodies. Solve puzzles, defeat enemies and reach out to each other's heart in this Action-Puzzle adventure.

title: Crosswinds
description: Crosswinds is a romantic adventure set in the skies. After a failed casino heist, two lovers must separate to avoid capture.
