Fly across 1930s Mediterranean coastal towns, follow hidden letters and intimate clues, and reunite with your beloved through a contemplative journey of self discovery.

title: Peer Pressure
description: Pilot a submarine through a maze with your crew — from the inside. Manage systems, repair breakdowns, and survive whatever's out there. No ocean views included.

title: Their Story.
description: Their Story. is a 2D narrative exploration and puzzle adventure about love and connection between two cyclists in the city of Valparaíso. As you uncover their stories and daily lives, a hidden bond between two strangers begins to emerge. Will they ever meet?.

title: Ghostless
description: Lead an uprising against AI in a post-apocalyptic world where you’re never sure who is human and who is machine. Scavenge for resources, find survivors to grow your base, root out android infiltrators and lead the resistance in a unique hybrid of 2.5D action-adventure and colony building.

title: FIFA World Cup: Launch Edition
description: Experience the rush of FIFA World Cup 2026 soccer matches with this fast-paced game for up to four players. Play instantly on your TV or computer.

title: College Quest
description: College Quest is a retro-style point-and-click adventure inspired by classic Sierra and LucasArts games. Set in a 1990s art college, players navigate classes, friendships, campus life, and bizarre situations while solving puzzles and managing their academic performance. Featuring hand-crafted pixel art, humor, multiple endings, and numerous optional activities, College Quest continues the story begun in School Quest.

title: Puzzle Atlas
description: Take on 60 handcrafted puzzles filled with tricky mechanics, clever twists, and challenging logic trials.

title: Polemista
description: Polemista is a tactical action game with stealth elements, set in a cyberpunk Polish coastal city. You are K, an enhanced super-soldier from a defunct corporate program designed to protect Europe. Now abandoned and hunted, you must find a way to clear your name and regain your freedom.

title: Unmixable Syrup
description: I wolf down a cold, lonely meal. Work's wearing me down, and money's shaky. The syrup I pour into my cold coffee never mixes, no matter how much I stir. So I figure I'll just wander around in my dreams.

title: How to Grow Your Sausage
description: Every [key]stroke makes your sausage bigger. Let it sit in the corner of your screen and watch it grow while you use your computer. Feed it different meats, upgrade your butcher, and see the magic happen. Have you ever dreamed of growing your sausage? Now it’s finally possible!

title: Garbage Packer
description: Garbage Packer is a physics-based garbage truck simulator where you experience what it is like to drive a garbage truck!

title: Llamero
description: Run around herding magical llamas, gathering mountains of wool, and upgrading your skills to help a struggling wool village. A cozy, story-rich incremental game about a herder and the responsibility he carries.

title: DigWorld
description: DigWorld is a cozy 2D digging extraction sandbox, where each run is a race against the clock to get the best rewards. Collect as many items as you can before time runs out. Sell. Upgrade. Repeat.

title: Life Sim
description: Life Sim is a text-based life simulation where your choices shape your destiny. Manage careers, control the economy, influence politics, and make decisions that affect the world around you. An immersive experience where every choice matters.

title: Wink Out
description: Wink Out your rivals in this physics-driven 1v1 shooter! Craft clever card synergies, adapt between rounds, and outplay opponents by sending them flying out of the arena.

title: Loop Miner
description: Loop Miner is a mining incremental game where a cute mole miner endlessly digs through mines, gathers resources, collects artifacts, and ventures deeper underground. Experience the satisfaction of growing stronger through endless mining loops.

title: High Frontier 4 All
description: A space exploration game at its best, High Frontier 4 All! The popular boardgame is now going digital.

title: Noxcode
description: Reach the TOP by any means possible. Run, jump, climb, fly, or even fall your way up in this chaotic jump quest platformer. Master crazy movement, discover wild shortcuts, and push your skills to the limit!

title: Click Build Repeat
description: Click Build Repeat is an incremental game about building and collecting model kits.

title: Overtime: Paper Trail
description: Nothing good gets printed at 3 AM. Work the graveyard shift at a rundown copy shop. Smile at the strangers. Copy their files. But when the machine whirs, look deeper. There's a reason they came in the dark. Find out what they're hiding, before they realize you know too much

title: Spaceman's Luck
description: A space 4X game. Colonize planets and annihilate enemy races in an intergalactic war for living space. Designed to be fun, fast, and easy to play.

title: Pick Ball
description: A pinball-incremental mining frenzy! Launch pickaxes, ricochet through swarms of glittering ores, scoop up coins, uncover hidden treasures, and shatter colossal boss rocks. Stronger picks, rarer gems, deeper mines — the shaft never ends.

title: Silent Shark
description: A tactical, map-based WWII submarine sim set in the Pacific Theater: Approach, intercept, strike unseen, withdraw into the deep. With realistic instruments, a Torpedo Data Computer (TDC), and including a full campaign with missions, patrol zones, radio intel, and more.

title: Snuggle Nightmare
description: Snuggle Nightmare is a first-person mascot horror adventure set in an abandoned theme park. The player must solve puzzles, craft tools, avoid a deadly animatronic, and uncover the secrets hidden within Brain World Rots.

title: Woim
description: If you were a woim, could you still solve puzzles? in this rock pushing, egg cracking, woim snipping, puzzle game, you'll use your long, wriggly body to solve brain teasing puzzles, and find your way through the underground world of dirt you call home.

title: Mine Empire
description: In Mine Empire, start with basic mining and expand by gathering resources, upgrading equipment, and deploying machines for full automation. Blast through deep mineral veins with explosives, unlock rebirth upgrades and advanced technology, and build your own powerful mine empire.

title: Croak and Solve
description: Join Burst as he tackles the chaos in Sorrentine the best he can. With your haunches swinging to the rhythm of jazz and a heavy dose of bad luck, you’ll dive into this vibrant pixel-art world with RPG elements to solve your adventures in the style of the most legendary detectives.

title: Super Tacky Astro Ranger: S.T.A.R.
description: Play as the tackiest hero in the galaxy in this fast-paced 3D action roguelite. Battle through chaotic arenas, master various weapons, defeat the Morg Leader, and escape in style. Be bold, be reckless. Be a true S.T.A.R.

title: The Birdsong Tree
description: A cozy building and light simulation game where you observe birds, create custom birdhouses, and help a living urban tree grow. Balance sound, diversity, and neighbor reactions as you shape a calm, reactive environment.

title: Moonlight Pale
description: Juliette follows the ghost of her dead cat into a nightmare where she has to fight and solve puzzles through eerily familiar corridors as she tries to survive and help the rest of the girls trapped inside. Discover the sins buried under St. Birgitta's Female Seminary.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Puppets
description: A physics stickman fighting game, made for the Breakpoint 2007 event. The game is simple, use the arrow keys to move around the blue stickman and hit the enemies (orange stickmans, ninjas) while trying to not get hit.

title: Lake Stillwater
description: You keep returning to the same woodland over and over again, but why? Something that you can't quite remember holds you captive in this cozy, mystery, adventure RPG.

title: They Stop for Gas at Night
description: A first-person horror simulation game. You owe money. So you work nights at a gas station in the middle of nowhere. Serve whoever shows up, and try not to think about what's watching from the dark. Something ancient is watching, and it isn't planning to leave.

title: Sky Flowers
description: Sky Flowers is a platform and puzzle game focused in movement mixing 2D and 3D ambients. You will have to navigate the interiors of the statue that hides lost treasure and uncover the mysteries behind the reason of why you are trapped in this place.

title: Tempus Vitae
description: You are Alex, a time-displaced astronaut unraveling the space station Theia doomed in both the war-torn 2185 and the post-apocalyptic 2385 to find your lost brother. Master an arsenal of time travel abilities and weapons in this sci-fi metroidvania FPS: Tempus Vitae.

title: Hell Clock: Cursed War
description:
Cursed War is the expansion for Hell Clock, plunging players into a grim, dark fantasy reimagining of the Historical Paraguayan War. Serving as a prequel campaign, players will uncover the tragic and haunting origins of Pajeú, one of the game's core characters.

Set across more than 10 grueling new biomes, including blood-soaked rivers and treacherous swamps, players must fight through an onslaught of cursed forces. The expansion completely revamps the endgame with the introduction of Endless Nightmares and unleashes over 80 new Unique items and relics designed to let players break the game with devastating, chaotic new synergies.

title: Warno: Nemesis #5
description: Deploy Nemesis - Southern Flank and gain access in WARNO to two unique, mechanized divisions from the southern reaches of their respective alliances: the NATO’s Spanish División Mecanizada «Guzmán el Bueno» n.º 2 and the Warsaw Pact’s Czechoslovakian 2. Motostřelecká Divize.

title: Gungrave G.O.R.E: Rocket Billy Red Cadillac
description: ROCKET BILLY RED CADILLAC is back. Electrify the enemies with the electric guitar BL20000V.

title: Gungrave G.O.R.E: Harry MacDowell
description: Harry MacDowel shares stats with Grave. Although his shooting speed is slow, it is more powerful. He can break shields with his normal shots.

title: Escort Simulator
description: Escort Simulator is an immersive simulation engine that turns the 'dating sim' on it's ear. Control the look and movements of an intimate couple while you listen to their hilarious responses and improvisation.

title: Alchemy Survivors
description: Alchemy Survivors is a bullet heaven roguelite where you dodge swarms of monsters, unleash screen-filling attacks, and craft brand-new weapons every run. Combine the materials you find into powerful weapons and gear, then use your custom arsenal to survive the endless horde.

title: Clairval
description: Join the pack, enter the pact and impose your law in a game of cunning and suspicion. Here, words are your sharpest weapon or your deadliest weakness. Manipulate, accuse, survive. The truth has never been so elusive.

title: Warlordocracy: Chapter 4
description: After returning to the mainland, gather forces in the scorching heat of the Viridi badlands while fending off the reptilian troglodytes and other dangers that dwell beneath the sand.

title: Warlordocracy: Chapter 5
description: Raise forces in the small logging town of Baskford for the upcoming liberation of Jadenbury, and the final conclusion to the Unwritten Revolution.

title: Warlordocracy: Chapter 6
description: 20 years after the Unwritten Revolution, the wild animals of the frigid Viridi Northlands have begun attacking human settlements, and the krugen are uniting against Frostgate. Lead your aging party through the biting snows on a final journey.

title: Unseal
description: You awaken as Ash: a charred figure with a caged head and a fractured past. Navigate a surreal nightmare world built from your own memories, solve maddening puzzles, and evade the grotesque creatures that hunt you in this atmospheric 3rd-person cosmic horror adventure.

title: MKS: Model Kit Studio
description: A rich and relaxing model-building simulator. Enjoy the meditative flow, meet fellow builders, and unwind to a soothing soundtrack as you build, pose, paint, and display your collection.

title: Idle Bookstore
description: A cozy idle bookstore you grow from a tiny shop into a thriving business — solo or with friends. Co-work together, write books as a group, and sell each other’s books for profit.

title: Rest Stop
description: Abandoned and alone at a highway rest stop in the middle of the Appalachian Mountains, the night breeze begins to caress your cheek. The scent of wet pine whispers that you’re home. The taste of iron in your mouth reminds you that you can’t stay here forever.

title: Tumblebee
description: Captured and lost, you search for your scattered family as you tumble through a hostile cave of silk.

title: Gungrave G.O.R.E: Death Ronin Grave
description: Become the Grim Reaper and mow down your enemies in style with Death Ronin Grave, designed by Ikumi Nakamura. Want to turn back time to 2004 and get yourself an overdose of old-school action? O.D. Grave's got you covered, turning your adventure into a trip down memory lane.

title: Gungrave G.O.R.E: O.D. Grave
description:
Become the Grim Reaper and mow down your enemies in style with Death Ronin Grave, designed by Ikumi Nakamura. Want to turn back time to 2004 and get yourself an overdose of old-school action?
O.D. Grave's got you covered, turning your adventure into a trip down memory lane.

title: BetterGH3
description: BetterGH3 is an all-in-one package that gives you the definitive near-vanilla console experience in one portable, easy-to-install bundle. This is for PC, just extract it and run it! This package includes a portable install of Guitar Hero III, all the DLC (including console exclusives), a custom patch, GH3+ with some new plugins, online play via the Warehouse custom server, as well as some additional fixes including Borderless Windowed mode and automatic FPS capping (or unlimited FPS if you prefer). Also, most guitar controllers are supported!

title: On-Together: Summer Studies
description: On- Together: Summer Studies DLC is the perfect way to bring summer into your workspace! This DLC introduces a new way to focus from the comfort of customisable of floaties! Enjoy a new summer warbrobe, an exclusive beachy playlist, new pets, and more!

title: Gloomy Eater
description: A short and cute touhou fan-game.

title: Tiny Capsule Collector
description: Run a cozy capsule shop at the bottom of your screen. Attract cute animal customers, collect charming capsule toys, and build a relaxing, ambient world in this idle sim bringing you small moments of joy while you work. Make your desktop a place you’d rather be.

title: Forge Shop
description: "Forge Shop" is a business simulation game set in a zombie apocalypse. Rather than focusing on action or combat, the game casts you as a blacksmith who builds and manages a shop to equip survivors.

title: Look Up and Go
description: Wishlist this fast paced, fps, score attack where every run is a risk. Use your points to bet on your own survival or make other players' runs harder. Get combos by stabbing, shooting, and doing tricks. Ascend the tower. Climb the leader board. Wishlist now.

title: Returnless
description: Eyeball Gun is your weapon. Use it to fight shadow enemies, manipulate time, and escape a city consumed by black fog - no pause, no checkpoints. Progress is saved at the end of a run.

title: Hotwife Ashley
description: Enter a seductive visual novel where love meets temptation. Explore hotwife, cuckolding, corruption, NTS and optional NTR paths.

title: Arknights: Endfield - Update 1.3: Sketches of Lost Heirlooms
description:
Version 1.3 of Arknights: Endfield, which includes:
• New Operators: Mi Fu and Camille
• New area: Sword Vault Dale
• New Main Story Content
• New game mode: Contingency Contract
• New events, missions, and rewards
• ...and more!

title: The Bull of Heaven
description: In a city near the mountains the bull of heaven is unleashed, tearing a wound in the world. A vivid action-rhythm game split across eleven intense levels.

title: Infinity Plus
description:
Box Set containing the entirety of KID's "Infinity" series and 12Riven from the "Integral" series.
Includes decoration stickers of the four games and Infinity plus portable and opening movies from the DVD Editions of the four games.

title: Subfault
description: A cat-and-mouse style horror game where you descend into a rundown facility to service faulty subsystems. Exercise caution - you're not alone down there.

title: FeeBay Simulator
description: Flip fake trading cards for real profit in FeeBay Simulator, a comedic marketplace tycoon game. Snipe underpriced cards from clueless and scammy sellers, grade your best pulls, crack open mystery lots, and run your own storefront to build a reselling empire.

title: Air Hockey Roguelike
description: It's a retro roguelike with pixel art graphics mixed with Air hockey and RPG mechanics, with character stats you'll need to improve. Defeat exciting bosses, each with their own special ability, playing Air hockey.

title: MoSimulator
description: MoSimulator is a robotics simulation game with an arcade feel that lets players mod in their own robots. Experience the excitement of competitive student robotics in a fun, accessible format where you can bring your own robot designs to life and compete in simulated matches.

title: GameSyndicates
description: GameSyndicates is about imagination, creativity, and play. Players build worlds with themed tiles, customize skies and environments, add vehicles, actors, enemies. Modular controllers with sequential commands, along with custom textures and sounds, make every creation unique and interactive.

title: Are You a Pilot
description: Are You a Pilot is a free-to-play neon arcade runner about speed, reflexes, and survival. Dodge obstacles, collect plasma, fire lasers, unlock skins, chase high scores, and jump into online squad runs.

title: Defrag Incremental
description: A retro incremental where you optimize messy disks, choose the right algorithm, manage heat and wear, make a living from each job, and reboot for permanent BIOS upgrades.

title: Sword Flinger
description: Throw swords to fight in this roguelite chain-action game. Weapons bounce off walls and enemies, chaining hits from one foe to another. Build damage bonuses with every chain and dive deeper into ever-changing dungeons while collecting swords, spears, axes, staves, shields, and more.

title: ChoreoCraft
description: Your feel-good choreography playground. Pick a song, build a routine, and bring any character to life with dance moves and stages in every vibe. Share your creations, remix the community’s best, and keep evolving your style. Your imagination is the limit!

title: Journey of Destiny
description: A Chinese ancient-style visual novel made with Ren'Py. Two factions fight for a mysterious relic. Your choices unlock multiple endings. The story includes suspense, time travel and soul fusion. Simple mouse and keyboard controls. Enjoy an immersive storytelling experience.

title: The Farm Racing
description: Can you outsmart the dangers of the farm and reunite mother and calf?

title: Hexara
description: Rotate hex tiles, create powerful combos, and chase high scores in this fast-paced puzzle game. Simple to learn, hard to master, with endless replayability and global leaderboards.

title: Astral Ascent: Arven - The Wolf Blade
description: Play as Arven, a Ranger of relentless determination who heard of a group of heroes trapped within an Astral Prison. Fighting alongside the wolf Kat, his hunting companion, this new hero had no other choice but to lend his blade to those fighting for their survival.

title: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight - Mayhem Mode
description: Cause chaos on the streets of Gotham City in the all-new Mayhem Mode, featuring new playable characters The Joker and Harley Quinn.

title: Nightpiercer
description: Nightpiercer is a unique dice-driven, turn-based deckbuilder RPG. Collect materials and cards to forge powerful weapons and build a legendary team. Explore a despair-ridden Holy City, navigate unpredictable events, and confront nightmarish foes.

title: Sandalwood Simulator
description: Sandalwood Simulator is a sandalwood smuggling game where players cut and transport valuable sandalwood to the black market while avoiding constant danger. Outsmart police checkpoints, survive sudden raids, and defend yourself against rival gangs determined to stop, capture, or eliminate you.

title: Hot Shot: Robot Attack
description: Take on missions to fight the robot uprising and bring peace to the world. Chose your targets carefully to build combos and manage your heat level in this retro on-rails shooter. Every shot you make counts!

title: Can I Take Your Order
description: You and your friends play as part time waiters in different restaurants. Use your bare hands to deliver food, taze a raging cowboy who just shot someone and dispose of the body before it starts to stink. Keep your customers happy on your own, or with up to 3 friends in online co-op.

title: Turbo Hatchback Time Attack
description: A turbo-powered hatchback? In this economy? You bet! It does everything you'd expect a car to do like drift, jump and... flip. You know, usual car stuff. Keep the turbo charged and boost your way to the top of the leaderboards!

title: Baby Bananza Races
description: Baby Bananza Races let's up to 50 chatters participate in the interactive BB Arena(200 in Tournament Mode!), earn badges, customize their racers, and more!! Try out Baby Bananza Races today at bb.gmgnrepeat.com

title: Szkeletal
description:
Szkeletal: Estrogen Dracul's Potato Hunger (also known by its original Polish title: SZKELETAL: Ziemniaczkowy Głód Estrogenowego Drakula) is a 2D top-down action roguelite and bullet heaven game heavily inspired by the gameplay loop of titles like Vampire Survivors. It serves as a satirical parody of the Polish internet, specifically targeting the gaming community, local content creators, and self-proclaimed "ludologists".

Set in a vaguely defined, fictionalized location, loosely inspired by the internet lore of personalities fleeing to Romania. Players take control of the titular "Estrogen Dracul". The core gameplay involves collecting potatoes and automatically attacking hordes of meme-based enemies. Key features include the "Destiny Cards" system, which allows players to manually pick up and throw cards to trigger specific tactical effects, as well as a dynamic weather and day/night cycle that actively modifies visibility during runs.

title: Cat Caffeine
description: A cozy idle ASMR cat café that lives on your screen. Serve customers and decorate your café while you work or relax.

title: Paw Loot
description: Striped raccoon needs your help! He just needs a unique style! Every time you press a key, the curious striped raccoon will diligently rub your taskbar with his paws, as if rinsing a new find in water.

title: Fish & Hike
description: Play as the dog, Doctor Shiberson. Catch fish, explore wild trails, and fight friendly monsters. Help the locals, gather treasures, and uncover the secrets of the Eight Lakes Valley. Can you catch the 4 legendary golden fish?

title: Cult Clicker
description: You are a newborn God. Harvest souls, unlock deadly powers and grow your faithful followers by smiting non-believers. Whether by a T-Rex with laser eyes, a blazing inferno or simply a violent sneeze, souls must be sacrificed. Let the harvest begin!

title: I'm Your Host
description: An audio deduction game where you must restore a series of lost podcast episodes. The deeper you dig into corrupted recordings and interview outtakes, the more questions arise: why was the podcast never aired? Who is hiding the truth? And what happened to the host?

title: Tribots
description: Robotic warrior of a mysterious army, you are now stranded on a world unknown. Alone or with other survivors of your battalion, lead a ruthless guerilla and take part in the reconquest of an entire planet. A cooperative experience for up to 5 players.

title: GeckoShop 2
description: Open boxes and collect geckos. Merge them in your lab to create new mutations, then sell or keep 'em. Decorate your new home, and build machines to automate every step.

title: Eden Salvage
description: Journey across a strange, post-apocalyptic world. Salvage relics from the deep. Earn 1,000,000 coins and leave this place. 21 days left.

title: ChessBase 16: Steam Edition
description: ChessBase is a personal, stand-alone chess database that has become the standard throughout the world. Everyone uses ChessBase, from the World Champion to the amateur next door. It is the program of choice for anyone who loves the game and wants to know more about it.

title: The Good Book VN
description: The Good Book VN is a visual novel set in 1980s–90s England. With 50+ pages of crime fiction, it follows a teen dragged into gangs, drugs, and violence. Witness his fall into street life and its harsh price—he lived it, so you don’t have to.

title: Piecewise!: A Daily Puzzle Game!
description: A daily-challenge puzzle game about putting shapes in slots, with new puzzles every day! BET ON YOURSELF with daily wager-based leaderboards!

title: Magic Ganglia
description: This is a CRPG standalone game. It is based on the TRPG battle mode and a sword-and-magic world. This game features customized protagonist, multiple routes and endings, exploration of dungeons which are full of challenges and puzzles, in order to restore the pure pleasure of both CRPG and TRPG.

title: Fear of Reptiles: Chapter 1
description: They have been gone for millions of years, and have returned to reclaim our home! Make your way to emergency bunkers to survive, while avoiding these dangerous creatures, who will find you if you don't move quick!

title: Ax RPG II
description: Endless tactics, shaped entirely by your choices. This is the second entry in a turn-based command RPG series where freedom of strategy defines every battle. With deep skill customization and flexible decision-making, each player forges a completely unique way to fight.

title: La Vida de Andrea
description: Andrea is confined to a small space. Her cyborg status and depleted battery force her to stay close to a rechargeable bed. Every day feels the same. She wonders if anything will ever change.

title: AmaTisMo
description: A visual novel about depression and self-love. Play as Amatista, a young woman trapped in isolation, as she begins a journey she never asked for. Every choice shapes the story. Fully accessible for blind players.

title: Lugubrious
description: This is a shooting game focused on urban nighttime defense.

title: LouLan Kingdom
description: Loulan Kingdom is a city-building survival and real-time strategy game. As the ruler of Loulan, you must build your city amid a perilous desert oasis, grow your power through the Silk Road, and fight to protect your kingdomuntil the very end.

title: Project Roy
description: Project Roy is a fast-paced FPS roguelike where you play as a rogue AI that survives by hijacking enemy robots. Combine abilities, adapt mid combat, and fight your way through a sci-fi facility to escape and defeat a powerful experimental war machine.

title: OrbiTower
description: The hungry Gooper swarm threatens intergalactic peace. Stop them! Build towers around planets and take control over their orbits. Spin them with all youve attached! Collect new towers, powers and upgrades to beat the onslaught of goopers and save the galaxy in this colorful Tower Defense Roguelite!

title: Thrown
description: Roll for survival. Thrown is a roguelike dicebuilder combining turn-based strategy and horror. Trapped in the basement, forced to play a twisted tabletop game against your kidnapper, grow your dice bag and piece together who you are, and why you're here.

title: Zu Xing
description: Zu Xing - A fun Social Simulation game set in a nice forest town with adorable animals to befriend!

title: Pocket Racer Shop Sim
description: Run a Pocket Racer hobby shop by day, then unleash custom built cars on handcrafted tracks during race nights with friends.

title: Vquarium
description: Vquarium is a relaxing incremental-idle game where you grow your own underwater world on your screen overlay with a virtual assistant. Collect rare fish, discover sparkling variants, and decorate your tank while taking care of an adorable assistant!

title: Silverbrook: a Text-Based RPG
description: A retro text-based RPG. The town of Silverbrook is in trouble. Goblins to the east. Undead to the north. A necromancer doing something unspeakable in the old dungeon. And somewhere beyond the mountain pass, something ancient is waking up — something that was sealed away for a reason.

title: Astral Throne II: Age of the Phoenix
description: How many times are you willing to die for revenge? Rise from the ashes to uncover a divine conspiracy in this Roguelite Strategy RPG inspired by the classics. Lead an ever-growing team on a continent-spanning quest, fight tactical turn-based battles, and synergize your skills for decisive victory.

title: Past Due: Midnight
description: Venture through a twisted corporate office in this first-person psychological horror. An ordinary evening of overtime turns into a nightmare. You awaken at midnight, trapped in a place you no longer recognize. Follow clues, find the truth behind the dark. Can you survive the night and escape alive?

title: Kodama: Slumber of the Gods
description: Kodama is a 2D hand-drawn action-adventure set in the world of Japanese folklore. Experience fast-paced platforming, fluid combat, and a mystical journey through a colorful, spirit-filled land.

title: Card Homestead
description: Card Homestead is a roguelike deckbuilder where card placement decides everything. Each day, draft one of three delivered cards and stack them onto your plot, engineering powerful chain reactions. Produce gold with efficient synergies and layouts to survive the ever-rising taxes.

title: War Fantasy
description: The Stanley Parable with a loaded rifle. A psychological horror FPS where a demented commanding officer controls your every move, and the line between war simulation and real war dissolves into impossible, stunning spaces. You are not a soldier. You are being made into one.

title: Valhalla, Vikings, Ragnarok!
description: Valhalla, Vikings, Ragnarok! It's a co-op game about a band of funny Vikings who must raid villages across all nine realms to pay off their debt to Hel and carve their path to Valhalla! Grab the treasure and carry it to the ship! Fight off the weak, hide from the strong, and do it all for the loot!

title: Monologin
description: A directionless night-shift worker clings to a dying MMORPG, a legendary White Unicorn mount, and the belief that old games are more "real" in this short psychological horror visual novel about escapism and being left behind.

title: Craftiny
description: Start your small business of handmade creations. Customize your items with different themes and pay attention to trends and your customers to help your business thrive. Upgrade your shop and workshop to create increasingly ambitious items and build a reputation!

title: Mythologous
description: A persistent online text RPG with dungeon crawling, extraction, tactical combat, deep magic systems, and emergent radiant NPCs. Explore, prepare gear, clear dungeons, incant spells and rituals, interact and command companions naturally, craft and trade. Your avatar lives, with or without you.

title: Shards Of Solitude
description: Immerse yourself in a survival game created by Miyuki, a girl with a split personality. Will you be able to escape, or will you choose a different path?

title: XenoFeels
description: You are a lone space customs officer. Every day, spaceships from different galaxies fly past your tiny asteroid. Tourists, truckers, travelers... Bad news: There are terrorists among them. If you miss even one, your home planet will explode. Good news: You carry a shotgun!

title: Creovia
description: Creovia is a 2D sandbox MMO with RPG elements. Build your own worlds, craft powerful gear, trade with other players, and carve out your place in a persistent, player-driven universe.

title: The Looking Glass Wars: House of Cards
description: We built a solitaire game around a darker version of Alice in Wonderland that you won't put down. Draw cards, build runs and sets across 140+ handcrafted quests. It's the kind of game you play for one more quest at midnight.

title: South of the March
description: South of the March is an RPG that combines visual novel exploration with turn-based combat in a hand-drawn dark fantasy world. Meet the locals and unravel a mystery, equip your party for the dangers ahead, and set out into the unforgiving wilderness.

title: OneStarHotel
description: Run a chaotic one-star hotel with your friends. Cook meals, serve guests, manage the restaurant, and survive the night while hiding the hotel's darkest secret

title: Sex, Sin & Rock'N'Roll
description: Sex, Sin & Rock'N'Roll is a 3D visual novel with side-scroller exploration where a cursed guitar offers fame for a price. Write songs, play rhythm concerts, face adult temptations, and choose between becoming a rock god or saving your soul.

title: Lop: Whitefall
description: A 2D action game redefined through Extreme Destruction. Every impact is physical. Enemies aren't health bars, destroy them outright, or dismantle them until they can't fight back. You'll explore a world fallen silent, navigating its weathered ruins sealed in ice to uncover the secrets it buried.

title: All Out
description:
All Out is a multiplayer gaming platform featuring a variety of online experiences created for players of all ages. Players can join games across multiple genres, including team-based PvP, social deduction, party games, survival challenges, and adventure experiences.

Featured games include Bed Wars, Random Roles, Hide and Seek, Squid Games, Murder Mystery, Fishermon, Backrooms, and many others. Players can play with friends, join public servers, unlock rewards, customize their characters, and participate in regularly updated multiplayer experiences.

Available on web and mobile platforms, All Out supports both casual and competitive gameplay through a growing collection of multiplayer games.

title: Celestial Coffee Quest
description:
You wake up in your crummy apartment.

Your system has an aching need for coffee. There's magic all over the place.

title: Dominocalypse
description: The puzzle roguelike that makes dominoes actually fun! Move, manipulate, and match using absurd tile modifiers, game-changing artifacts, and unique starting loadouts for endless chaos and replayability.

title: Antediluvial: Yalroc Island
description: Antediluvial: Yalroc Island is an isometric action-adventure inspired by 90s classics like Landstalker and Dark Savior, with the looping structure of Majora's Mask. You play a rookie soldier of a cruel empire, sent alone to an island that the waters swallow a little more every hour. Over three days, the tide redraws the map: paths vanish, others open up. Freeze, rewind and fast-forward time to figure out what's really going on, and pick a side.

title: Guild of Three
description: Guild of Three is a turn-based deckbuilding RPG where you command a party of three characters — each with their own deck. Combine different classes, pass relay cards between allies, and position your party across the front and back lines to create your own combat strategy.

title: Gravity Bumpers
description: Gravity Bumpers is a cross-platform multiplayer arena brawler where your only goal is to survive. Control your sphere, use physics to your advantage, and bump your opponents off the platform into the void!

title: Holy Valkyrie Exs-Tia F Parallel Episode 2: Reunion
description:
Several years after the showdown with Naioro, strange news reaches the ears of Yuri Amakubo; the scientist behind the ExS-TIA system.
On a remote island in the middle of nowhere was a woman who was the spitting image of her older sister Kaede, who had previously been defeated in battle.
With Souma in tow, Yuri immediately sets of for this island to ascertain the truth for herself.

title: Litterbox League
description: Welcome to the Litterbox League! Compete with cute animals in this chaotic multiplayer brawler. Shove them all out, be the last one standing, and claim all the fame and glory!

title: Orbita
description: Discover elements, feed the blackhole, automate with physics, complete missions, get better tools and build megafarms!

title: Dark Crescent
description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you recruit your foes on a quest to kill the moon.

title: Bravo
description: A 20‑minute playable thriller that will blow your mind.

title: The Laundry That Won’t Open
description: A short first-person horror game where strange anomalies slowly begin to appear in a laundromat you casually visit. As you return again and again, you move closer to the ending waiting in this place.

title: 007 First Light: Desert Explorer
description: The ‘Desert Explorer' outfit is desert-hardened, effortlessly sharp and built for blazing trails and leaving no trace.

title: 007 First Light: Gleaming Pen
description: This pen gadget skin is elegance in disguise, silent with a sharp edge.

title: 007 First Light: Gleaming Lighter
description: A lighter gadget skin sparking more than flame, being a silent ally in high-stakes moments.

title: 007 First Light: Gentleman Operator
description: An operator outfit designed for precision and confidence.

title: Resident Evil Veronica
description: Claire Redfield returns to the forefront in this remake of the title originally released on the Dreamcast in 2000 and the following year on PlayStation 2. This new version preserves the essence of the original game while introducing modernized gameplay, a reimagined storyline, and vividly detailed graphics.

title: Building 0: Hakuei University
description: I'm a second-year university student in a paranormal club facing disbandment. In a desperate bid for survival, I sneak into the mysterious "Building Zero" — a place campus whispers warn you never to approach. What awaited me there was a terror beyond anything I'd ever encountered.

title: Spell Knight
description: Descend into the dark abyss and wipe out endless hordes of monsters. Wield powerful weapons as a magic knight and enjoy the thrill of rapid growth.

title: Dustin Sunset
description: A post-apocalyptic world, a bastion of hope, the wasteland gangs united to destroy it, and only one man crazy enough to try to save it. Dustin Sunset is a vertical shoot 'em up with a touch of bullet hell and a whole lot of love, made by fans of the genre for fans of the genre.

title: Haex
description: An anomaly has been detected in the sub-arctic north. The science team sent to investigate has gone missing. Survive an alien-scarred wilderness solo or with up to 3 friends. Push back the mist, reshape the world, craft weapons and gear, and fight to unearth what happened.

title: Fortnite: Chapter 7 - Season 3: Runners
description: Find Sprites, rift them out under fire, and build a Collection that powers up every match that follows. Welcome to Fortnite: Runners!

title: Gundam Rogue Orbit
description: Become the pilot you were born to be. Change humanity’s fate in GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT, a high-mobility action game that delivers a bold new take on Gundam, blending a fast-paced cinematic story with intense, hard-hitting combat in an all-new universe.

title: 1666: Amsterdam
description: Every 333 years, something stirs. 1666: Amsterdam is a 3rd person Dark, Story-Led, Action-Adventure where Noa, the Collector, wields witchcraft to uncover demonic entities hiding behind human faces. Investigate by day. Face your demons at night.

title: Guild Wars 3
description: Guild Wars 3 is an action-adventure MMORPG, a modern evolution of the genre that blends rich action-combat, character building, and skill collection. Set in the enchanting frontier of Orr, the world brims with mystery, magic, and wonder. Play solo or form a band of adventurers, forging impactful and enduring bonds with fellow players, a formative cast of memorable NPCs, and the nature spirits that call Orr home.

title: Brightside
description: Suvive a horror-puzzle adventure inside the abandoned Brightside Industries ride manufacturing facility. Solve puzzles, navigate decaying workspaces, and evade the dangers lurking within as you search for a way forward through the forgotten complex.

title: Last Harbor
description: Zombie Apocalypse On A Boat. You’re stranded on a boat during a zombie outbreak in the beautiful San Juan islands of Washington State. How will you survive an open-world archipelago, where the living are just as much of a threat as the dead?

title: Flee, My Elven Ninja! 3D
description: It was just another one of your super secret ninja missions—until you rescued the elven maiden Lizet. Flee from the royal guards hot on your trail as you train her... in more ways than one. Get ready to set out on a romantic adventure that's filled with as many laughs as there are intimate moments!

title: Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor
description: The Man of Honor expansion for Mafia: The Old Country features two new story chapters and added content for Free Ride mode. Players can step into the role of Enzo Favara and work alongside Ennio Salieri, a feared and respected mafioso, as he sets out to settle old scores.

title: Saw: Genesis
description: A century before Jigsaw, survival demanded sacrifice. Experience the thrilling world of SAW first-hand in a new 3v1 multi-player horror game where three Accused must work together to escape a maze of traps, while one Judge orchestrates their rehabilitation.

title: One Possible Future
description: Explore one possible future for humanity in this adult visual novel: a sci-fi world in which humans want for nothing, and engage in secret rendezvous with their robot caretakers...

title: Patience Is a Virtue
description: Something's hiding in the cassette. Rearrange the words of your enemies to investigate a small-town conspiracy in this mystery puzzle game.

title: Crime Simulator: Ashen Creek DLC
description:
Welcome to Ashen Creek. This DLC introduces a brand-new neighborhood packed with fresh opportunities and high-stakes scores.

Features:

New Map: Explore an entire new neighborhood with over 9 unique spots ready to be broken into and looted.

New Targets: Plan your break-ins and hit high-value places, including a local jewelry store and a pharmacy.

New Wheels: Search the area and steal brand-new cars.

Deadly Traps: Watch your step and learn to avoid new security measures, such as pressure floors.

title: Among Us Story: On Guard
description: Live life as a Crewmate in this dangerous narrative adventure through space. As Guard, you're in charge of shipwide security and everything is fine. Until there's a MURDER?! Prove your innocence before the Impostor gets to the rest of the crew... and you.

title: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance
description: Massive expansion, Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance has been announced!

title: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush
description: Jump into a Hot Wheels-sized world with four islands packed with events, challenges and full-throttle mayhem. Collect iconic vehicles, assemble your Rush Squad, build epic tracks, and earn the title of Rush Master.

title: Mr. Records
description: ​Meet George, an old dreamer with an extraordinary gift that lets him transcend through music. After a lifetime of standing still, he breaks free from routine and opens the store he always wished for. ​

title: Sonic Pico Park
description: The co-op action puzzle game series PICO PARK is back... and this time, we're teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog! This collaboration is packed with co-op gameplay that combines the flair of Sonic with the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK! Play locally or online with 2 to 8 players!

title: Attack on Titan 3
description: Experience the story from beginning to end in the ultimate culmination of the Attack on Titan game series. The ODM action has been further refined, delivering the most exhilarating and stylish combat the series has ever seen.

title: The Wolf Among Us Remastered
description: A dark detective thriller where folklore is real, violence is chilling, and every choice has consequences.

title: Street Fighter 6: Year 4 - Yasmine
description: Hailing from the Philippines, Yasmine seeks to slice and dice her opponents in Eskrima, the national martial art of the country.

title: Street Fighter 6: Year 4 - Arjun
description: Like an aggressive bull jumping in the dust of the fields, Arjun moves heaven and earth with his powerful breathing techniques!

title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation
description:
As the world teeters on the brink of annihilation, the final battle against Sephiroth begins.
A meteor mars the sky, monstrous planetary guardians wreak havoc across the globe, and the fires of war rage. Now, Cloud and his companions must stand against this chaos to not only decide the planet's fate, but bring a legendary conflict to its conclusion.

In the final chapter of the FINAL FANTASY VII remake project, the scale has never been larger and the stakes have never been higher. Take to the skies and explore a boundless world, fight alongside a fully assembled party, master strategic and dynamic combat, and prepare yourself for the climactic finale.

A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.

title: Blighthold
description: Blighthold is a 2D city builder set in a Lovecraftian-Dieselpunk world. Reclaim the lost city and its Eldritch Tree. Suffer through moral dilemmas that will shape your society. Defend against abominations and uncover the terrible secret that lies below.

title: Blood Dungeon
description: From the creators of Nidhogg, murder hordes of monsters in this 2D platforming autoshooter with a killer soundtrack. Collect Blood, gold, and bones to increase your powers. Can you survive the Blood Dungeon?

title: Abyss Chamber
description: Fulfill the requests of the abyss entity. Overcome your fears and survive long enough to solve the mystery. Abyss Chamber is a lore-rich, first-person psychological Horror game that takes place in an underground research facility.

title: N Plus Infinity Times Two
description: 5 fresh flavors of world-class online mayhem, from Friendship-Testing Co-op to Friendship-Ending Competitive, plus classic singleplayer. Run around with friends, lure enemies into opponents, make the ultimate sacrifice for teammates, and hunt each other with rockets. Couch-ready/Tournament-worthy.

title: Bub
description: A narrative adventure game about turning your memories into art while you still can. Made with slashes of ink and paint and thousands of cut paper pieces, Bub is a deeply personal, living, breathing game world.

title: Lazy River
description: A co-op adventure at the galaxy's most unregulated waterpark. Some guy peed in the pool, and the pee mixed with the space water and turned everybody into zombies… Except you and your friends. Build a raft, ride down the Lazy River, and escape before you run out of hot dogs!

title: Sudoku Bactron
description: Sudoku Bactron is a logical number-filling game developed by Bactron. The game offers a random mode and an adventure mode. Players can also design their own levels, constantly verifying the unique solution, ensuring that each puzzle has only one answer.

title: Ithaca
description: Ithaca is a narrative road-trip with RPG elements about environmental resistance. You play as Penelope, a young environmental rights lawyer, as she drives towards the most important decision she'll ever have to make.

title: Village 51
description: Village 51 is a survival and farm management game where you must build a farm from the ground up in a hostile world. During the day, you manage animals, produce resources, complete orders, and earn money to expand your village. When night falls, the threats arrive: defend your territory with weapons, structures, turrets, and workers while exploring the map in search of essential materials. Develop your skill tree, upgrade your arsenal, and survive night after night in a living world that never stops testing you.

title: Tartarus: Dice & Blades
description: Venture into a dark dungeon where every choice, every roll of the dice, and every strike can mean glory… or death.

title: Apple Crumble
description: Its your grandmas 84th birthday party and nobody is trying to murder her. Stop suspecting your family members, and dont worry about the strange man in your bedroom. A new creepy-cozy mystery thriller from the creators of Duck Detective.

title: Slap Out of It!
description: A slap-and-solve adventure that stretches your wits and your noodly arms in all directions. Explore impossible towers where every floor is a comedy sandbox of secrets. Meet strange characters and solve (or add to) their problems with a personal touch. The power to change everything is in your hands.

title: Super Yooka-Laylee Kart
description: The most skilful, expressive and explosive racer built around mastery, rivalry, and revenge-fuelled comebacks. Race through a solo campaign, compete against rivals online, or create your own custom race setups and challenge your friends.

title: Trine 6: Together in Time
description: Trine 6: Together in Time is a co-op puzzle platformer for 1-4 players. Wit, timing, and teamwork collide as you solve perplexing puzzles, engage cunning creatures, and traverse perilous paths in the next adventure through Trines iconic fantasy world.

title: PicoCross
description: PicoCross is a nonogram puzzle game for the Pico-8 Fantasy Console.

title: Hitman Classic Trilogy Remastered
description: Step into the origins of the world’s deadliest assassin, faithfully remastered for modern platforms. Follow the evolution of Agent 47 from his creation to his most dangerous assignments across a world defined by deception, power, and consequence.

title: Realmlords
description: Realmlords is a fast‑paced Bullet‑hell / Spell-hell roguelite with 12 distinct classes, each offering unique weapons, abilities, and build paths. Explore 9 dangerous Randomly Generated Elemental Realms filled with unique monsters, hazards, and loot as you fight to survive each run.

title: Off the Vine
description:
Small game jam game made in a week for 7DFPS 2021

Water plants, juice fruit, climb as high as you can.

title: Street Fighter 6: Year 4 Character Pass
description: Year 4 Character Pass - 4 additional characters (Yasmine, Arjun, Tifa, Bosch) - 4 additional characters' colors: Outfit 1 Colors 3-10 - Bonus: 3,000 Drive Tickets

title: Street Fighter 6: Year 4 Ultimate Pass
description: Year 4 Ultimate Pass - 4 additional characters - 4 additional characters' colors: Outfit 1 Colors 3-10 - 4 additional characters' costume: Outfit 2 (including colors 1-10) - 4 additional characters' costume: Outfit 3 (including colors 1-10) - Bonus: 5,800 Drive Tickets

title: Get That Box, Girl!
description: You're just a girl trying to do her job: collecting boxes, solving puzzles, and doing whatever it takes to meet your quota!

title: Waifu Quest
description: Your adorable waifu lives on your taskbar, always by your side as you work, browse, or game. Customize her look with cute accessories and enjoy her calming presence throughout your day.

title: RP2D Virtual Tabletop
description: RP2D is a 2D virtual tabletop for RPGs. Drop maps, move tokens, reveal fog, layer dynamic weather, stream audio, and keep every session flowing online for GMs and players.

title: Entropy Archive
description: Uncover a collapsing machine of endless growth, hidden systems, and recursive resets. Generate energy, unlock expansions, recover corrupted records, and descend deeper into the Archive.

title: Battle Simulator: Counter Terrorist
description: Tactical battle simulator between counter terror and terrorist teams. Create your team for the mission, in later missions you can sometimes use the sniper rifle or rocket launcher to help out.

title: Information Conveyed Information Received
description: You are an AD intern at a TV studio aiming to secure a job offer. During a live talk show, you must give directions using cue cards. Convey information based on the situation to keep things running smoothly, boost audience favorability toward the guest, and earn your offer through your performance.

title: Stoned to Death
description: While trapped in a stunning forested wilderness, engage in brutal hand-to-hand combat with a notorious durg cartel producing dangerous illegal drugs to uncover the mysteries of their crimes.

title: Cannon Dinghies
description: High-stakes PVP boat-on-boat comabt on the high seas centered around fast paced small maps and abilities that can turn the tide of a fight. Cannon Dinghies brings short and engaging combat matches that can easily fit into spare moments or when you don't have much time to play.

title: REMinal
description: REMinal is a non-euclidean, procedurally-generated horror game. Run from your shadows, seek out cursed curios, and build safe spaces in an endlessly sprawling house. Can you escape with your soul intact?

title: Skate Rush: 90s Retro Arcade
description: A fast free-to-play retro arcade skating game where you dodge obstacles, keep your speed, and chase a better score in quick single-player runs inspired by classic 90s energy. Many real life skate tricks included!

title: Metro Trip Simulator
description: You simulate a metro tip here. The opportunity to be in the subway, to experience a digital trip - it is not often possible to meet such a thing in games, but alas, there is no full-fledged metro trip simulator. In the simulator you can sit all the way for more realism, and you can get up and walk around the car, watch how you move through the tonnels.

title: Hex Core
description: Hex Core is a short, incremental clicker-style defense game where you help PeteOS hold back waves of viruses until you can wipe them out for good. Spend resources to unlock a huge spread of upgrades, new mechanics, weapons, and research.

title: Encave
description: Encave is a hybrid FPS-tower-defense game. Build customizable killrooms in a fully destructible environment to eliminate waves of corporate bioweapon rejects! Strategic base construction, and escalating Lovecraftian threats, Encave delivers a unique blend of action, strategy, and dark humor.

title: The Modern Atlas
description: This is an in-progress visual novel from the perspective of Ernest Frankenstein, Victor's younger brother, taking place after the events of Mary Shelley's novel.

title: Generalskie kotly
description: A humorous parody game based on a popular meme. Despite its short length, every single detail in this project has been meticulously thought out.

title: Pulsari
description: Pulsari is a precision rhythm arcade game about pulling sound out of the dark. A rotating nexus hangs in the void while beat rings rush in from four directions — you strike up, down, left, and right not to follow the music but to summon it. Every clean hit builds the track: a bass line emerges at combo 5, an arpeggio at 15, and a full synth pad at 30, until the chart stops feeling like a game and starts feeling like an instrument. Miss, and the layers decay back to silence. Reach full harmonic and the track opens into a trance-like plateau where sound, motion, and timing lock together — 41 hand-designed tracks across five sets, from an 80 BPM tutorial to a 250 BPM hardcore finale, with two play modes, four difficulties, sub-200 ms instant restart, and full controller support.

title: Holy Valkyrie Exs-Tia TS Parallel Episode 3: Twilight Sabre
description: As the ExS-TIA face defeat at the hands of Naioro, Souma Shihou activates the ExS-TIA system and manages to bring him down. But due to some reaction with the device, Souma’s body is transformed into that of a woman’s. With Marina and the others still out of commission, Souma takes it upon himself to battle the remaining monsters.

title: Holy Valkyrie Exs-Tia P Parallel Episode 1: Magical Girl Pastel Marie
description:
By chance, Marina Katsuragi crosses paths with the creature known as Aramaki
and gains the ability to transform into Magical Girl Pastel Marie. A magical girl’s duty is to close up dimensional portals that occasionally appear. However, the miasma that seeps out from these portals also turns human beings into monsters. So begins Marina’s secret war to defeat these monsters and safely close the dimensional rifts.

title: Colorfall
description: Grow your problem-solving skills, fast thinking, pattern recognition and sequence solving. Enjoy thought-provoking fun with addictive puzzle game in accompaniment of relaxing piano sounds which allow you to clear your mind and keep it healthy.

title: Mother Zina
description: Mother Zina is a first-person psychological thriller about a foreign journalist who comes to Russia for a report. He rents an apartment from Zinaida Petrovna in a regular Soviet-era block - and quickly learns that the only “normal” thing here is the sign outside.

title: Backrooms: What's Next
description: Backrooms: What's Next is a Co-op horror game up to 4 players, where you and your friends will explore the game, try to pass the game level using your mind, wit, remembering the places where you were

title: Trapped in the Backrooms
description: Trapped in the Backrooms is a psychological horror experience across unsettling, interconnected levels. Navigate shifting environments, uncover hidden truths, and survive entities that adapt to your movement. Each map brings new rules, new threats, and deeper descent into the unknown.

title: The Zibbo Show
description: Be the star of the most exciting game show on TV! Pick your dice, place your bets, build your combos, and try not to think too hard about what happens when you lose.

title: Team Panic
description: Team Panic is a cinematic online co-op psychological horror game where two players try to escape deadly creatures, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind a mysterious experiment.

title: Rotfront
description: Rotfront is a singleplayer FPS set out in the state of Washington in the year 2034. Infiltrate as a lone Operator, purge infected areas, kill as many Rots as possible and unlock weapons as you level up and grow stronger.

title: Solrend
description: Venture through a beautifully hand-drawn 2D world in your own way. Swap between two siblings with unique abilities to uncover the truth and reclaim what was lost before the Dark consume them all.

title: Sepak U: Sports Fighting Game
description: Smash-Like Volleyball - Fighting Game meets Volleyball and Football with 1-4 players, 21 characters, 21 arenas, with over 10 hours of solo/co-op content, minigames, and epic boss battles. Based on Sepak Takraw, a cultural Asian sport.

title: Aethelgard: Galactic Guardian
description: Command your ship, harvest precious resources, and upgrade your arsenal in a relentless sci-fi universe. Aethelgard: Galactic Guardian is an action-packed space shooter where you must build the ultimate vessel to survive epic battles against elite alien fleets.

title: Greedy Little Kingdoms
description: A short-run roguelike city builder. Gather timber, craft crowbars and magic potions, fulfill demands from frogs, plague doctors, and swamp dragons. Explore the hex map, survive the King's moods, and find the artefacts that break your economy wide open. Repeat.

title: Nafuda Sagashi: Identity Lost
description: “Nafuda Sagashi” is a psychological exploration game set in the liminal spaces of a Japanese school, where you wander through the building searching for lost name tags.

title: Nol
description: NOL is a first-person horror game with visuals inspired by black and white horror manga. You play as Guntur, a young man trapped in a dream world after reading news about the massacre of his childhood friend's family. Since the game focuses on dreams, ANYTHING CAN HAPPEN.

title: Growing My Manhole
description: Consume the universe, grow from Manhole to Black Hole in this insatiable incremental game.

title: Assassin of Monsters 2: Spacenator
description: FPS Shooter game where warrior with space weapon need kill 6 different bosses in 6 different levels and collect items. So be a hero and fight against several different big enemies

title: Assassin Of Spider 2: 2099
description: Assassin of spider 2: 2099 is futuristic third person/first person sci-fi shooter where player mission is to kill space spider and collect skulls

title: Travelling Light
description: Travelling Light is a narrative game about four friends, Lars, Leah, Samson, and Ivy, caught in the turbulence of their early thirties. Inspired by real events, this experience lets you step into each perspective as love, friendship, and heartbreak collide.

title: Dungeon Hotpot
description: Dungeon Hotpot is a cozy narrative game set in a torchlit dungeon, where you comfort weary adventurers with warm, delicious bowls of monster hotpot.

title: Brasília Defense
description: Brasília Defense is a strategy and tower-defense game that turns the landmarks and regions of the Federal District into an epic battlefield. Inspired by local culture, it blends post-apocalyptic fiction, original art, and engaging mechanics.

title: Castle in the Sands
description: Castle in the Sands is a pixel art visual novel set in a world inspired by "One Thousand and One Nights" and North African culture. The adventure begins in the heart of the desert and leads you to fairytale places full of magic and danger.

title: A Line Held Tight
description: Tensions both political and personal are rising at the Brightworld mining colony. In this dynamic sci-fi visual novel you must decide where your heart and loyalties lie if youre to shape the future and save yourself.

title: GigaBash: Ultraman Zero
description: This DLC adds "Ultraman Zero" and "Ultraman Belial", two iconic Ultras who are each other's antithesis, as seen in their 2009 classic "Mega Monster Battle Ultra Galaxy: The Movie" debut forms.

title: Wicked Delights
description: Rhythm your way through a campy and mysterious visual novel in Wicked Delights. Battle hideous monsters, sling drinks at a cafe, play lead in a heavy metal band, and much more as you unravel the secrets of a supernatural VHS tape.

title: Celldom Classic
description: The popular webgame comes to Steam! Celldom is a different type of clicker game where you swipe over a "board" to earn income instead of clicking. Spend money on upgrading your board, upgrade idle earnings, unlock dashers and rebirth to start over again with permanent boosts.

title: Cheongchunhyang Jeon
description: This is a drama with multiple endings where Chunhyang’s destiny is changed by what the player choose. Chunhyang’s destiny will be changed by your choice.

title: Detective Turner: If Looks Could Kill
description: A text-driven noir murder mystery where you literally read the room. Search for clues in the text, photograph evidence, and interrogate suspects to solve the murder of fashion icon Margot Voss.

title: Mobu
description: Play as a monk wielding superpowers in this fast-paced arena shooter with roguelite elements. Survive waves of bouncy enemies raining from the skies as the challenge escalates. Buy upgrades and special abilities to create game-breaking builds and push back the chaos.

title: Deck Collector
description: Deck Collector is the ultimate trading card simulator built for ultra realism! Open booster packs, mystery boxes, and collection boxes, organize your cards in 3D binders, open theme decks, customize your room with decor and objects, and grade cards to earn money toward your dream collection!

title: Evershard: Heroes of Gallan's Landing
description: A fantasy roguelite game where players gather their party of heroes and adventure into dungeons filled with dangerous monsters in order to collect Loot and Exp required to level up their party.

title: GigaBash: Ultraman - Rising DLC
description:
Big Hero, bigger responsibilities!

This DLC adds “Ultraman & Emi” from Ultraman: Rising to the game, featuring iconic abilities from the animated feature film and a unique skill set that combines Ultraman and the newborn kaiju, Emi, as one character.

title: Relief
description: Relief is a deckbuilding roguelike featuring a post-Journey to the West urban legend setting! In a bizarre world of corrupted deities, harness overpowered tech to enhance your deck and forge custom affixes onto your cards. Combine over 1,000 cards and 300 artifacts to create your ultimate OP build!

title: Fight Poker
description: Fight Poker is a turn based poker PvP card game. You try to form the best hand you can in 4 rows with help from the community cards. There is an online global play option, pass and play, and 5 difficulties of bot to fight against.

title: GigaBash: GAMERA -Rebirth- DLC
description:
It's time for a rebirth!

This DLC adds "Gamera" and "Guiron" from the iconic Gamera series in their modern, fully animated incarnations into GigaBash, featuring their own unique skillsets.

title: GigaBash: Final Ascension DLC
description:
The flames of justice burn bright blue!

This DLC adds “Gaya Gigaman" and "Zargorah", 2 of GigaBash's characters given new forms, new abilities, and a whole new story mode chapter for Gigaman.

title: Aim/Flash Trainer
description: Aim/Flash Trainer is a minimal Team Finder aim trainer for Valorant players.

title: Annexation
description: Annexation is a fast-paced real-time strategy game with old-school roots. Build bases, train armies, and outmaneuver your enemy to claim victory. Start by playing the campaign and then challenge yourself in arcade missions, which bring the intensity of multiplayer RTS into a single-player setting.

title: Virtual Driving School
description: Learn to drive at home. Master real‑world road rules in bite‑size lessons, pass your driving test, then take on taxi, delivery, and bus routes across living cities and motorways. Realistic handling, dynamic weather, Left Hand/Right Hand drive, full wheel support.

title: The Queens Gondola
description: Stuck on the Queen’s royal aircraft, you have been trapped in a mystical loop fueled by dark magic. Armed with nothing but your wits, keep an eye out for anomalies, and you might just find an escape.

title: Book Nook
description: Build miniature diorama scenes, piece by piece. Complete beautiful book nooks as you place furniture, decorations, and small details. Relax and enjoy the peaceful satisfaction of every detail falling into place, as you discover more about each moment in time.

title: Tinkernest
description: A crafting colony sim that feels like coming home. A warm campfire, the cutest animal villagers, the curiosity of putting two items together and seeing what comes out. Craft, build, automate, and explore the ancient tunnels down below.

title: In the Drift
description: A game about fixing the internet in space. Travel the asteroid belt and restore connections in a dreamy narrative platformer from one half of the creators of Sable.

title: Hidden Folks 2
description: Search for hidden folks in interactive miniature landscapes. Scare some giraffes, ride a few rides, appreciate some art, and push around some astronauts. Wheeeeeeee!!!

title: The Wandering Village: The Last Leviathan
description: Set out on a new journey with The Wandering Village: The Last Leviathan! Build your settlement on Levi, the all-new marine creature, develop your relationship and take care of its unique needs or advantage of its new resources.

title: The Cinderling
description:
The Cinderling is an immersive, rhythmic blacksmith and shop keeper game.
Complete mini-games and feel the heat of the cracking coals, work the bellows to push the flames and strike the anvil in perfect time.

Stay in sync with the music and lose yourself in the rhythmic ring of hammered iron.
Explore a narrative rich world. Get to know the eccentric customers and the reason behind their weird requests. Uncover the secrets of the forge. And break the curse that binds you!eries of the forge.

title: Romantic Emperor
description: In Romantic Emperor, you will embark on an unprecedented gaming journey. This is a unique game that combines both visual fiction and business construction.

title: Moomin Midsummer Madness
description: Midsummer is right around the corner in Moominvalley, when a sudden flood sets the Moomins adrift! Join Tove Jansson’s beloved Moominfamily and friends on an adventure of mirth and mischief aboard a mysterious floating theatre.

title: Spiriki: Tiny Island
description: Listening to the gentle sound of the waves, take care of three small quirky nature spirits! With their help and some patience, create your own tiny cozy diorama and bring back life to your overgrown island!

title: Waterful
description: A peaceful nature-builder where you dig riverbeds to guide water through tiny desert valleys. Grow a variety of plants and discover all the animals drawn to the new habitats. Complete quests and unlock new contraptions to transform the dry landscape into a lush oasis!

title: Rubber Bird
description: Meet Rub the bird and help him answer the big question: why does he have arms? Jump, stretch, grab, throw, and mess up everything around you in this bite-sized physics-based platformer.

title: Farmnana Defence
description: Defend your farm with magical bananas! Collect and enhance 20+ bananas across 5 tiers, build your farm by day, and survive monster waves by night. Face 5 epic bosses in 25 waves and endless Infinite Mode.

title: Firefly Shelter
description: Step into an eerie silence, a place where childhood dreams have turned into eternal nightmares. You are a paranormal investigator, drawn by dark rumors of an abandoned school built on the ruins of an old orphanage where, decades ago, children died of a mysterious illness and abuse.

title: Hokko Spaces
description: Hokko Spaces is a calm, casual sandbox that gives you fun tools to create beautiful, lively spaces inhabited by adorable characters. Unlock cute residents and watch them hang out, do some gardening, and enjoy the spaces you build for them. No rules, no stress, just cozy dioramas and chill vibes.

title: Darkest Corners
description: Take a journey to the border between light and shadow. Discover the secrets of creation and see the light of the ancient gods.

title: Lord and Maiden
description: "Lord and Maiden" is a fantasy simulation building and girl-raising strategy game. Freely plan the development of your city-state, explore secret realms, challenge powerful enemies, and form alliances of up to 100 players to fight together and create your ideal home.

title: Burn-9
description: A spy thriller where you’re not the spy. Safe behind your screen, guide the last survivor of an elite black-ops team in a desperate attempt to salvage a mission gone horribly wrong. Caught between military command and your agent, information is your greatest weapon.

title: Cue to Fall in Love with You
description: Play as the protagonist – a university student with a "superpowered romance system" who attracts six captivating women. Your choices will shape relationships through a branching storyline, allowing you to choose between loyal love or multiple endings. Experience a transformative romantic journey.

title: Enjoy Amoy & Sisters
description: "Enjoy Amoy & Sisters"‌ is a live-action interactive romance game. You play as an overseas Chinese person who, in response to the invitation from the two female leads, Ah Yin and Xiao Xi, visits Xiamen, the ancestral hometown, for the first time.

title: Memasiki po Classice
description: Remember the days when we'd go to computer clubs, download music for hours, and the coolness of a phone was measured by its polyphonic ringtone?

title: SHE: Seraphim Helix Experiment
description: A unique blend of tactical stealth action and survival horror, inspired by the classics. Trapped in a missile silo with an angelic entity and mutating personnel, new life grows in the belly of the lead researcher, the Sergeant has given you his orders, and an eerie voice sings through the walls.

title: Hole Is Mine
description: Hole Is Mine is an incremental adventure about purifying the Hole. Dive inside and launch your Mini'ohs to mine for you. Extract impurities, upgrade your power, and find hidden secrets to grow the Village, customizing your Mini'ohs with incredible powers. The Hole has spoken!

title: Demonschool: Puzzle Killers
description: A brand new side quest with new environments! 50 puzzle battles with a confounding boss! 2-6 hours of gameplay! New techniques to study! New bad jokes!

title: No Visitors Allowed
description: A minimalist psychological horror game inspired by The Exit 8, where players must escape a looping post-Soviet-era abandoned hospital corridor by detecting anomalies.

title: Backrooms: Blackhole
description: Backrooms: Blackhole is a cooperative psychological horror game for 1-4 players. Somewhere deep within the endless halls, reality begins collapsing into a growing void that consumes light, sound, and everything around it. The deeper you descend, the less the world makes sense — and the harder...

title: Backrooms: The Wrong Door
description: Backrooms: The Wrong Door is a cooperative psychological horror game for 1-4 players. A single wrong door leads you into a shifting nightmare where reality feels broken, familiar places become hostile, and every step forward may bring you closer to something watching from the dark.

title: Sword & Banner
description: Mount & Blade meets Total War with classic RTS controls - brought to life in pixel art. Lead your warband across a living fantasy world, raid settlements, trade goods, and fight large-scale tactical battles with formations, dynamic weather, and an army you build from peasants to knights.

title: Crownbreak
description: Build your army, conquer castles, and dominate tactical battles. Earn gold, upgrade your gear, and defeat powerful elemental bosses.

title: Pistol Cat
description: A cat. A gun. Recoil-powered movement, leg kicks, and a fart thruster. Shoot your way through a living open world town, smash everything in sight, and survive the Blood Moon: all as a small, physics-driven cat with a big pistol.

title: Arizona Sunshine
description: Sharpen your machete and grab your friends. Arizona Sunshine brings its award-winning zombie apocalypse to explosive third-person action, featuring online and split-screen co-op, brutal combat, dark humor, and Buddy, your loyal zombie-chomping canine companion.

title: Voxenvale
description: Voxenvale is a cozy blocky online realm builder where players jump, build, decorate, and visit each other's cubic worlds.

title: Expeditions: Samurai
description: The sun rises on another civil war, as you land in Japan aboard a battered Dutch ship. Thrust into command of its motley crew, you must navigate the politics of Sengoku-era Japan using stealth, diplomacy, or violence in this party-based RPG where every choice matters.

title: BioEden
description: Step into a cozy management journey as a Keeper and bring life back to a world quietly waiting to be healed. Craft the perfect biome for dozens of wonderful animal species and use your ingenuity to restore your planet, one ecosystem at a time.

title: Forever Skies: The Final Echoes Update
Dinghai: The Ocean Pillar
description: Dinghai: The Ocean Pillar is an action RPG-roguelike set in the mythic world of the Classic of Mountains and Seas, where ancient gods, demons, and forgotten powers collide.

title: Cute Patoots
description: An indie, retro-inspired, 2D platform shooter. Jump, shoot, dash, power up, and even collect enemies in this cute game.

title: Blasphemous II: The Third Sin
description: Surprise! The Game Kitchen has been cooking up a surprise update for Blasphemous 2, which shadowdropped during this year's Summer Showcase. Blasphemous 2: The Third Sin is available now on all platforms, ready for you to dive in and explore its new areas — and test your skills against its dastardly enemies.

title: Skatesterre
description: Flip, grab and grind like it's 1999! Skatesterre is a fast-paced arcade skateboarding game inspired by the golden era of classic skate titles.

title: Vampire Survivors: Legacy of the Bloodmoon
description: A cautionary tale, or a story better left untold? Legacy of the Bloodmoon is the darkest expansion to date for Vampire Survivors. Discover the path to ruin that this pack of villains is headed down. Unlock new weapons and characters to find new ways to snowball against relentless hordes of enemies.

title: Into the Dead: Crimson Heights
description: Into the Dead: Crimson Heights is a VR survival horror game set in a confined apartment building at the beginning of a devastating zombie outbreak. Sneak, explore and fight back against the undead in a desperate attempt to survive.

title: The Alters: Last Variable
description: Continue Jan Scientist's story as he stays behind to unlock the planet's secrets. Build an underground base, assemble a crew of specialised Scientist alters, master Terraformation, invent new technologies, and conduct research that could define a legacy.

title: Impermanence
description: A father. A condemned theatre. A son’s voice echoing from the beyond. Step into a narrative horror game about grief, obsession, and the act of holding on as a force older than grief pushes back.

title: Cronos: Lazarus
description: Wield the Warden’s power in this combat‑heavy expansion to Cronos: The New Dawn, pushing the series toward faster, more aggressive action. Teleport, strike, and outrun a relentless hunter using enhanced traversal, decoys, and temporary invisibility as you race to revive a lost Essence before the Collective closes in.

title: My Cannibal Family
description: You are the lurking terror in My Cannibal Family, a gloriously grotesque monster horror sim. Build a twisted theme park, then use traps and stealthy attacks to harvest guests within a deadly sandbox of your own creation!

title: DeadRoot
description: DeadRoot is a barbaric medieval action-adventure set in a bug-sized world of underground dungeons and towering ruins. Splatter bug guts and slay colossal bosses as Kitt, a lone snail warrior, who must draw his sword against overwhelming odds.

title: Freeline!
description: Quick on your paws! Freeline is a frenetic, kinetic, expressive speedrunning platformer about taking down the surveillance state and reclaiming the rooftops.

title: Edwin Earstwhile: Medical Examiner
description: A medical detective game set in the late Victorian era. Uncover the perpetrators behind an assortment of grizzly murders by examining meticulously hand-animated cadavers.

title: Cloudlings
description: Cloudlings is a cute colony sim set amongst the clouds. Guide a small tribe of curious creatures as they build a floating village, merge drifting islands, manage resources, unlock upgrades, and uncover the mysteries hiding beyond the clouds.

title: Gemini X
description: The Heretechs have seized Gemini Colony! Explore, upgrade, and blast your way to victory in Gemini X: a Metroidvania built for fans of classic 32-bit run-and-gun platformers.

title: Bros Survivors
