description: Two players, one body, absolute chaos. Survive enemy hordes in this co-op Survivors-like. Merge with a friend into a giant mech: one controls horizontal movement, the other vertical. Will you coordinate or die trying?

title: Expendabots
description: Expendabots is a 4-player CO-OP horror-extraction game where you and your friends explore ever-changing islands full of danger and secrets. Run, hide, loot abandoned facilities, and extract with your squad before the island is lost.

title: Straycloud
description: An island in the sky, the home of a once majestic people, has fallen to earth, its magic run dry. The youngest member of this line must venture to shore in an effort to restore power to the ancient magical technology that kept the island afloat.

title: Finding Frankie 2
description: Trapped inside a deadly televised game show, you must parkour through a massive obstacle complex. Wall run, rail grind, and vault past twisted traps in the final season. Win the $10 million prize, or die trying. Frankie is waiting for you and he’s not holding back.

title: Toil & Trubble
description: Herbs locate, tonics make, So gas deflates, and aches abate. Brew up some mischief in a witchy life sim with a small but troublesome difference. To keep the people of The Nook happy and healthy, Mistress Toil needs to train a young, easily-distracted pig to find magical ingredients.

title: Toya
description: Toya is a minimalist cube-rolling game that is always bigger than you think...

title: To Kill Eros
description: To Kill Eros is a drama-filled BL Visual Novel exploring the flavors of love and the depth between people who join hands — while also blaming Eros for everything, of course!

title: Radio Decay
description: A 1-6 player co-op survival horror set in a supernatural nuclear apocalypse. Drop-pod into an abandoned city to extract radioactive artifacts while being hunted by giant bug-like monsters. Rebuild your decaying body with prosthetic limbs, arm yourself, and radio your friends for help.

title: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
description: The ultimate Godzilla arena brawler is back, completely remastered. Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through recreated cities and other locations. Face off against your friends and foes in local co-op or new online multiplayer.

title: Hentai Foot Fetish
description: Play puzzles and relax! Collect all the pictures. A great way to spend the evening. Choose your favorite difficulty level and test your attentiveness.

title: Cooking For Ma!
description: Go on an adventure through the spirit world to save your grandma from an evil sea serpent using the power of cooking! Cook dishes for different characters, exploring Korean cuisine in this story about identity, diaspora, and family.

title: Zolana: Girl Galactic
description: Saving Planet Earth, one outfit at a time! Zolana must save the planet Earth from having its fashion taken away, by challenging the Uniforian conquerors to a runway competition! Dress to a new theme each round in order to wow the judges and save the day!

title: The Isle of Lost Bees
description: Welcome to the Isle of Lost Bees, a cozy idle game where you and your collection of Australian bees harvest pollen, research flowers, and uncover the island’s secrets. You're a bee-obsessed researcher on an island devoid of humans. You never seemed to need human contact anyway.

title: Putrid/Sharp
description: Slice your way through the stages of rot and search for someone lost in a world that is waiting to end.

title: A Pocket Full of Slagford
description: Slagford. Some call it The Backbone of the North, most call it proper sh*te. This silly misadventure will take you up monolithic megatowers, down dingy dung pits and beyond. Puzzle your way across the unravelling city by picking up pieces of the world and sticking them where they don't belong.

title: N00b's Guide
description: n00bs guide is a narrative walking sim told through a Youtube playlist. Funny, introspective and painfully earnest, play through a series of bizarre mods and community maps, trying to understand what was really important about the time spent with your friends.

title: Chosen Anyway: Card Game
description: Chosen Anyway is a turn-based roguelite deckbuilder with permanent progression. Build your deck each run, face challenging bosses, and grow stronger as your cards scale with Ryn's RPG stats.

title: UnQuollified
description: A charming Australian point & click detective mystery about a struggling artist investigating the mysterious death of his childhood best friend. Explore the small town of Bridgegully, interrogate quirky locals, & sketch clues to expose the truth. Are you ready to solve a crime years in the making?

title: Touhou Gaiden
description: Touhou Gaiden is an action platformer heavily inspired by the aesthetics and gameplay of classic NES games like Ninja Gaiden and Castlevania, while adding to the mix the beautiful and overwhelming danmaku that Touhou Project is known for in high-octane boss fights.

title: Dice'n'Go
description: Dice’n’Go is a turn-based tactical board game where every roll can change the outcome. Choose your hero, move across a tile-based arena, and use unique abilities to outplay your opponents. Master positioning, timing, and cooldowns to win with both strategy and a bit of luck.

title: Tristan: Curse of The Frog
description: Tristan: Curse of The Frog is an action adventure game currently in development!

title: Wagie Run
description: Wagie Run is a runner game where you play as an employee, running from his neighborhood towards his office. Don't be late for work! Dodge obstacles and keep on the caffeine intakes! Make sure you'll arrive on time!

title: Void Crawlers
description: Void Crawlers is a Top-down Rogue-Lite Incremental Shooter, there are 3 initial games modes, Arcade - Room to room combat, Gauntlet - 30 minute invasion, and Story - A combination of Arcade and Gauntlet mode with a story on top.

title: Cliax Codec
description: It's time for a change in perspective! Explore an adventure full of tricky action and puzzles in this third-person and top-down shooter hybrid!

title: Goblins Can Conquer
description: From a small pack of goblins to a mighty horde: conquer the lands turn by turn! Strategize your expansion, build your village, and collect powerful spells to empower your army. Recruit new goblins and crush your foes: the age of the goblin has begun!

title: Occult: Scarlet Elegy
description: An upcoming horror themed RPG in the molds of Strange Journey and Etrian Odyssey.

title: Hirdrih Technologic
description: Two robot brothers in an adventure!

title: Photon Blade
description: Photon Blade is an extremely challenging, fast-paced 2D character action game that combines elements from fighting games, arcade beat 'em ups, and mid-2000s action games.

title: Bio-Submariner DX
description: You're the captain of a Bio-Submarine! A living submarine that gains power from flesh! Cruise through the Deep Sea and devour your enemies!

title: Cambrian Crawl
description: A dungeon crawler set in the cambrian period.

title: APE
description: Deep within a secret laboratory hidden from the world, scientists are creating artificial life. Trapped inside the facility, you must solve puzzles and evade the creations that roam the halls.

title: Fifrelin
description: A medieval betting roguelike. Each night, repay an angry wizard or finish your life as a wet sock. Hide in a bush and try to guess who's behind it by betting the only thing you have left... your life.

title: Project Goblin
description: Project Goblin is a 3D action adventure game. Inspired by classics such as The Legend of Zelda or Dragon's Dogma, Project Goblin will take you on an adventure through a fantasy world full of dungeons to explore, puzzles to solve and enemies to fight.

title: Peace Incarnate
description: Stop the enigmatic crisis of the disappearing city. Fight or troubleshoot your way across warring factions.

title: Tex Murphy: Killing Moon Rising
description: Enter the virtual REMADE world of Under a Killing Moon, where it is December 2042, and you, as Tex Murphy, must stop the forces of evil before they destroy mankind and rob you of your next unemployment check. This thrilling and hilarious adventure is unlike anything you've seen before.

title: Desk Space: Idle Spacefleet clicker
description: Grow your fleet of space ships in this incremental space game. Extract wealth from the asteroids and stations, unlock upgrades to find synergies, defend against pirates, and unlock [REDACTED]. Pin to your desktop and watch your empire grow while you do "more important" things.

title: Your Party Died Again
description: Fight through evil monsters and demons in this Incremental RPG. Collect loot, unlock upgrades and recruit party members to destroy the Demon King. Use abilities strategically or set them to autocast and enjoy the ride.

title: The Rewind Hero Returns
description: A visual novel, action, puzzle game. The enemies are always much stronger than you, and your goal is to figure out how to beat them by using elements of the environment to your advantage.

title: Spy/Cell
description: An upcoming stealth 2.5D pixelart-ish looking game.

title: Anomalogenos
description: A fishing shooter game where you reel in targets to shoot while dodging enemy bullets! Build diverse strategies using active skills deployable during battle and passive skills that constantly activate!

title: The Guild Manager
description: Recruit your team, forge a legendary guild! In this unique management simulation, you won't play as a lone hero—you'll become a Guild Master, leading a group of flesh-and-blood, distinct personalities from rookies to conquerors of epic raids.

title: MDT: Make It or Die Trying
description: MDT: Make It or Die Trying is a fast-paced side-scroller shooter filled with violence and dread. You don't really know why, but you keep going through hordes of humanoid, and not so much, enemies that inhabit this world. A world that seems both dead and alive at the same time. What for? - It's up to you to decide.

title: Barista Life
description: Run your own coffee shop — craft drinks, serve customers, and grow your business while managing your daily life beyond the café.

title: Kalpa: Cosmic Symphony - Origin Vol. 1
description:
A premium music pack for KALPA, created together with legendary composers.
The first series that opens the door to a new world — Origin Vol. 1.
Now, join the journey with your own performance!

title: High Quality Funkin'
description:
Uh oh! Your tryin to kiss ur hot lady, but her MEAN and GRAND dad is trying to KILL you! He's an ex-rockstar, the only way to get to his heart? The power of high quality video game rips...
This mod contains (almost) every high quality rip of the base game that was released over the years with added features, improvements and optimizations!

title: Star Trek: Shadow Frontier
description: Star Trek: Shadow Frontier is a story-driven, action-adventure set in the expansive Star Trek universe. Step into the fractured mind of former Lieutenant Ro Laren (voiced by Michelle Forbes) as she seeks to rescue an old friend by embarking on a harrowing journey of survival and self-discovery.

title: The Last Voyage of the SS Aurelia
description: An interrogation mystery aboard a 1936 ocean liner. Five suspects. One murder. No dialogue options — every suspect is powered by AI and will remember every word, deflect every question, and only surrender their secrets under pressure. Four voyages. One truth. Break someone.

title: Synapse Chronicles
description: Synapse Chronicles is a gritty, visceral action-adventure game that blends intense cosmic horror with tactical, physics-driven combat. Unravel a cosmic conspiracy at the center of the universe and explore a bleak world filled with danger, secrets, and tense action around every corner.

title: Mini Murder Mysteries
description: Solve cozy, crafty whodunits. Puzzle your way through nine unique investigations – and use your noggin to make intelligent deductions. Explore the evidence, scrutinize statements, and connect the dots.

title: Ultraquarium
description: ULTRAQUARIUM is a casual aquarium sim that lets you create your own fish and decorations. Purchase fish, satisfy their needs and they shall repay you in kind. Want two Gregs? You can't have two Gregs.

title: Brassfang
description: Explore a castle filled with monsters and sinister experiments in this steampunk action RPG metroidvania. Combine vampiric and mechanical powers, face challenging bosses, and create unique builds through randomized upgrade choices.

title: Lost Mind
description: Lost Mind is a psychological roguelite set inside Ashley’s fractured mind. Explore procedural worlds, collect stars, escape collapsing maps, and face symbolic enemies born from trauma, paranoia, and depression. Every death means she got lost again.

title: Layers of Bust
description: A lonely candle suddenly inhabits a spirit: a beautiful and curvaceous woman. With the ability to transform and slow down time, she uses her new body to escape the dangerous dungeon.

title: Meccha Chameleon
description: Paint yourself to blend in! "Meccha Chameleon" is a new-sensation hide-and-seek game where you paint your white body to mimic the stage. Spot, pose, and "artistic skill" are keys to survival. Deceive Seekers with techniques that put chameleons to shame! Supports public matches and streaming.

title: GraveBoy CrowFeet: A Quest for Skulls
description: A spooky fun 2D adventure with focus on exploration and light puzzling. Help GraveBoy to collect 10 rare skulls to save his father from a demon!

title: SCP RP
description: A multiplayer SCP roleplay experience where a living facility is powered by programmable-driven characters, dynamic events, and player choice.

title: Tiny Catcher
description: Tiny Catcher is a fishing game where you can keep it open in a floating window mode, so you can place it wherever you want while doing other things on your PC. The idea is to have something cozy running in the background while you work, study, or just relax.

title: Memesteine Files
description: Secret meme archive. Dusty case files, strange faces, leaked documents, and the old internet that still feels more alive than a lot of people.

title: GoatBrains
description: Goatbrains is a casual trivia game combining quiz challenges, short educational segments, an energetic endless runner, and a pressure-free meditation mode, offering multiple ways to learn, play, and unwind.

title: Car Down
description: Dodge obstacles, collect cars, and build your dream garage in this fast-paced arcade car collection game.

title: Sesquipedalian
description: This is a casual puzzle game centered around the core gameplay of "time-limited item-catching challenges".

title: Keeper's Vigil
description: As the Harbinger, you are the only Keeper who can cast spells. Stop a necromantic plague, uncover an Elven conspiracy, and decide the fate of a dying world! A text-based fantasy novel, 193,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects."

title: 4Mecheros
description: A narrative-rhythm game I made to deal with my things 🚬, about how a predatory contract forces a fragmented band—composed of irreparable broken friendships—to get together for a final show. A coming-of-age story about reverb-punk, playing a real bass and the meaning of (not) loving forever.

title: 1997 Reloaded
description: Three teenagers find a mysterious audio tape recording which turns out to be evidence of a murder. It’s the end of the world as they know it. Immerse yourself in a kinetic novel that encapsulates the essence of the 1990s by completely reinventing its music scene.

title: Ethereal Storm
description: Survive the Ethereal Storm — a thrilling 4-player co-op bullet hell with an FF5-inspired job system, layered building mechanics, and expansive Skyrim-style quests. Play solo or team up for explosive fun!

title: Monster TD
description: This is a classic tower defense game featuring a level mode and an endless mode. Strategically combine your towers to defeat the enemies.

title: Truco Bar
description: Truco Bar is a digital card game for 2 or 4 players in a classic Brazilian Pub. This card game is very famous in Brazil and played by people of all ages and in a lot different places, mainly in pubs. Play with your friends, "truque", raise the stakes, have a nice chat, bluff and mainly: HAVE FUN!

title: Solarflare
description: SOLARFLARE is a byte-sized roguelike auto-battler in a sci-fi dystopia. Fight (and die) to unlock Upgrades, experiment to find broken builds, and obliterate the megacorp's bots.

title: Boto Labo
description: Solve up to 100 Sokoban-Puzzle levels with the help of your robot friends! Arrange them. Move them. Watch 'em go and... reach the flag in your own style! We got cats, dogs and many more!

title: Chef's Dogma
description: Chef’s Dogma is a roguelite turn-based battler where you journey through the 7-layers of bean dip hell. Upgrade your team through stats, items, or ‘entree’s creating even stronger foods. Experience a multitude of play-styles, Enemies, and locations to help the chef ascend into purgatory…

title: Fugaz
description: With only a flute at your disposal, play songs to solve puzzles. Explore a dark place looking for an exit before the darkness grows too dense. In this immersive psychological horror game, knowledge is the key to put the pieces together.

title: A Smithing Game
description: A Smithing Game is an online 2-4 player game where you smith weapons and fight other players with them.

title: Gay Sex Simulator
description: Do you love gay sex? Or imagine you would? Well, enjoy this super realistic real-to-life Gay Sex simulator. It's pretty bad, but you just might enjoy it so much that you become gay yourself. After beta testing this game, I certainly did... Inspired by my best friends Nick, Adam and Stav.

title: Hardcheologist
description: You are an archeologist descending through mysterious and ever-changing ruins using only your weapon's recoil to control the fall. Shoot, try not to touch the ground, reveal secrets and survive. How deep can you go? What lies hidden in the depths of this pyramid?

title: Duskers 2.0
description: What will you'll sacrifice to bring humanity back? Scavenge derelict spacecraft with your drones via a command-line interface, navigating past whatever is still alive in the dark, in order to save what little of humanity is left.

title: Salene
description: Salene is a action-platformer with quick precise combat set in a world ravaged by a war of angels and men. Conquer the Seven Virtues, gain new skills and learn the Songs of Creation to rise up and face the divinity that commands them all!

title: After... Prologue
description: After... This is a survival simulator set in a post-apocalyptic world. Explore the abandoned city, scavenge for supplies, and try to stay alive. Avoid the infected they’re fast, ruthless, and deadly. In this world, the only person you can truly rely on… is yourself.

title: Lots of Bugs
description: Lots of Bugs is currently in early playtest! Dive shell first into a cozy but slightly chaotic beetle world where pickles are legendary, shells are painted, and dung is absolutely involved. Play solo, or better yet, bring some friends!

title: Sea of Thieves: Custom Seas - Season 20
Five Nighs at Fairy's
description: Five Nights at Fairy's is an unofficial fan-made parody combining Five Nights at Freddy's and Zenless Zone Zero. The game replaces all 50 original FNaF characters with characters from ZZZ, while keeping the core survival gameplay intact. It carries a comedic, light-hearted tone and makes no attempt to take itself seriously; it's a passion project made purely for fun by fans of both franchises. This game is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with either Steel Wool Studios, Scott Cawthon, or HoYoverse in any way.

title: Penguin Weapons
description: Penguin Weapons is a dynamic action roguelite about penguins that collect artifacts, creating absurdly crazy weapons, fight monsters and bosses, unlock stylish clothes, and explore increasingly difficult worlds full of unique combinations and unpredictability alone or with friends.

title: Bad Magpie
description: You are a magpie with one wing, a missing flock, and an unhealthy obsession with a fallen star. Steal shiny trinkets, cause chaos, and stick your beak where it doesn’t belong.

title: Dirty Fantasy
description: Dirty Fantasy is an adult visual novel and a journey through famous worlds. Various fetishes are available and even more coming.

title: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember
description: Born from war's flames, a Phoenix ascends. In this dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG from Team NINJA, players use offensive and defensive Chinese martial arts to fight back against mighty demons on the battlefields of the Three Kingdoms.

title: Senua
description: A Celtic warrior is trapped between life and death in a fractured vision of purgatory. In an action‑adventure set in the Hellblade universe, Senua fights to reach the afterlife and reunite with those she loved and lost, battling forces that threaten all she believes in.

title: Worst Shop in Town
description: Run your own cozy corner store: stock shelves, set prices, serve customers, and try not to question why the building feels alive. A chaotic retail simulator with weird physics, suspicious customers, and bugs that are now officially part of the atmosphere.

title: Doom: The Dark Ages - Revelations
description:
HELL FREEZES OVER in DOOM: The Dark Ages | Revelations, an all-new campaign expansion that unleashes a brutal new chapter of the Slayer’s saga.

Wounded and betrayed, the Slayer is thrust into a merciless purgatory only escapable by confronting haunting truths and forging new strength with the help of a mysterious ally. He must ascend from the prison of his mind and fight an abomination of the gods to set his followers on the path to freedom.

title: Age of Empires IV: Raiders of the North
description: A New Age Rises in Age of Empires IV. Raiders of the North introduces two full civilizations, deeper Crucible systems, and more.

title: Wonderful Handhelds
description: Wonderful Handhelds is a game that allows you to collect and play fictional retro LCD games, inspired by classic devices from the 80s and 90s.

title: Hack '95
description: Time travel to 1995 in this card-based computer hacking voyage. Take down an evil tech startup and shadowy government agency to become a god to the freaks and geeks of cyberspace. All while being helped by an incontinent virtual pug.

title: Magicians: The Devil's Deal
description: Magicians: The Devils Deal is a narrative driven FPS where stage magic becomes real. You play as Jacob Menteuro, a fallen illusionist bound by a pact with The Devil and cast into Hell. Master deadly tricks, steal the powers of rival magicians, and escape the infernal world of Theatreland.

title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Season One - Return of the Thieves Guild
Fortune Paradox
description: How much can you increase your money with the upcoming elections? Do you want exactly $900, or $1,000 with a 90% probability? Test it yourself!

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024: World Update 22 - US National Parks
Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024: National Championship Air Races
Pinfinity: Incremental Pinball
description: Hit bumpers to earn money, expand your skilltree, place more bumpers and get rich in this incremental pinball game!

title: Where Winds Meet: Hidden Mountain
description: Where Winds Meet: Hidden Mountain is the third major update for the adventure, adding a new mountainous region built with deep vertical terrain. Exploration is shaped by multi-layered elevations, leading to hidden surprises across the peaks. The expansion also introduces the secretive Mohist sect, bringing fresh mysteries, new martial-arts gameplay mechanics, and narrative twists to continue the journey.

title: Persona 6
description: With over 30 million copies sold worldwide, the Persona series has defined a generation of RPG storytelling. Now, after years of anticipation, the next installment is finally revealed.

title: Spyro: A Realm Beyond
description: Take flight in a brand-new journey through a strange and wondrous realm. When Spyro finds himself stranded, his journey to discover a way home is interrupted by the arrival of a vicious invading force known as the Scavs.

title: Cthulhu Go Teaching
description: Go has never been so 'within tentacle's reach'! With Lord Cthulhu as your teacher, playing Go is no longer boring. Whether you want to learn the basics, improve your skills, or grind Life & Death problems, Lord Cthulhu will accompany you until the end of time!

title: Robosynthesis
description: A solar-powered robot awakens in an abandoned data center. — In this short 3D platformer, your movement, health, and ammo all use precious solar energy. Plan your actions carefully to seek freedom, as every step may be your last.

title: Wild West Miner Simulator: First Gun
description: After a savage animal attack leaves you stripped of everything, you crawl back toward a town that’s already forgotten you. Among dust, suspicion, and long shadows, you fight to reclaim a place in a world that would rather see you buried.

title: Book Organizer
description: Book Organizer is a cozy 3D simulation game where you become a library volunteer to mindfully organize cluttered shelves. Without stress, it delivers a satisfying visual and auditory experience as books snap perfectly into place, offering pure relaxation and deep immersion.

title: Barbie Rewind
description: Decorate the DreamHouse through the decades, while playing classic Barbie games. In Barbie Rewind, Barbie invites you into her cozy, creative world and entrusts you to customize her DreamHouse. Barbie also left you her game collection, so you can revisit your favorite Barbie video games.

title: Auto Empire Tycoon
description: Start in the 1950s with a small factory and one dealership. Research new technologies, design cars, manage production, stock your showrooms and outsell rival brands to build a dominant automotive empire in this isometric tycoon simulation.

title: Rogue Company: Season 5 - Neochrome Battle Pass
The Cycling Games
description: Les Jeux du Cycle turns your Bluetooth FTMS trainer into a cycling party game: sprint, dodge, team up, add bots, and outplay friends across 25+ minigames.

title: Star Trek: Outposts Unknown
description: Lead your crew across strange new worlds in this narrative driven outpost builder! Research, explore, and build as you face a mysterious cosmic force that threatens a new ally. Your adventure awaits, Captain!

title: Busy Bar: World Tour
description:
Serve drinks, survive ridiculous guests, upgrade your bars, and buy out rival moguls — solo or in co-op — in a chill bar empire game where every shift ends in progress.

Survive Ridiculous Guests
Your customers are more than walking orders.

title: Alien Life
description: You just crash landed on a small mining planet, and your ship is broken! Don't worry though, you will make friends to help you recover the ship parts. Advance through different worlds and talk to wacky characters in this stupid RPG.

title: Rogue Company: Season 6 - Covert Ops Battle Pass
description: Season 6, also known as Year 2: Season 2 and based on the theme of Military, was the sixth season of Rogue Company. It started on April 12, 2022 and ended on June 7, 2022, lasting for 56 days.

title: Driver Night Trip
description: Driver Night Trip is a 3D car game. You'll get behind the wheel and reach the finish line as quickly as possible.

title: Turbozod
description: You are an engineered martial arts weapon with no memories and physics defying speed. Escape the lab, explore the galaxy, and hunt your creator in this fast paced, loot heavy RPG. Bend time itself to become the ultimate fighting machine!

title: King of Holo
description: Hololive × Chess × SRPG × Deckbuilding × Roguelike × Strategy Game! Featuring 76 Hololive members! Make your oshi the King!

title: Red Kiss
description: Dispatch a team of vampire spies through the tense and fractured streets of Cold War Berlin. Fulfill your darkest impulses as you tap into their powers, gain their trust, and manipulate your way through this (blood)thirsty Tactical Narrative RPG.

title: All Lanes Must Exit
description: Build a highway interchange to connect all the roads. Don't go over-budget and don't have traffic jams. Can you complete all the levels? Yes, easily, it's not a particularly demanding game.

title: Sated
description: Gurgling messes of flesh live beneath. They seek to be sated. Your cursed fridge beckons: spin the wheel and choose revolting ingredients in this rougelike-inspired cooking course from the very depths of hell. Leave your customers satisfied or become the meal yourself.

title: Company of Heroes: Definitive Edition
description: Company of Heroes – Definitive Edition, features the original Company of Heroes along with the Opposing Fronts and Tales of Valor Expansions, enhanced visuals, quality-of-life gameplay improvements, and 64-bit platform support.

title: Rough Kuts: Night of the Living Dead
description:
A ragtag group of Pennsylvanians barricade themselves in an old farmhouse to remain safe from a horde of flesh-eating ghouls that are ravaging the East Coast of the United States.

This is an interactive version of a classic B&W film with multiple story paths or choices to be made throughout the viewing.
Your choices & actions help create your own version of the film. You're the director now!

title: Vision Quest: A New Ascent
description: Vision Quest: A New Ascent is a twin-stick souls-like shaped by nature. Survive 2-hit death combat with well-timed critical hits that restore your Health and rise above failure with a generous respawn system. The summit is waiting.

title: 2 Fights in 2 Tight Spaces
description: Agent 11 is back. The iconic tactical deck-builder returns, with new tricks up its impeccably tailored sleeves and this time its with friends. Improvise within the space, adapt your deck to the challenges ahead, and overcome a roster of new enemies in stylish, animated, fight sequences.

title: Gone Feral
description: Stalk your victims through 1980s America in this co-op roguelike assassination game. Improvise brutal kills with everyday objects, terrorize your targets, and get revenge solo or with friends. Hunt across iconic horror locations such as a summer camp, small town, farm, and a sprawling mansion.

title: Abiotic Factor: Entropic Break
description: Embark on a new tropical adventure, roaming sun-drenched seas and forgotten islands. Investigate the warped GATE Leaf Test Facility and surrounding isles, confronting a new breed of fanatics, digital disorder, far-flung anomalies, the Flesh Dimension, and more in this world-crossing DLC expansion.

title: Boxing Bastards
description: Plunge into a medieval world where knights brawl with their fists rather than swords! Get creative with physics-based combat as you fight through several thematic biomes full of unique enemies and encounters. Complete quests, buy upgrades, and kill baddies to become the ultimate Boxing Bastard!

title: The Endless Night
description:
The Endless Night is an urban fantasy roguelite deck-builder where modern mages battle cultists, monsters, and creeping darkness across a city on the edge of collapse.

Build a deck of spell cards, chain magical combos, protect civilians, gather allies, and choose which threats to confront before the night spirals out of control. Each run challenges you to balance power, survival, and corruption as dark rituals spread through the city and an Avatar of Darkness waits to be summoned.

title: Plus/Minus Zero
description: As a research android, complete your mission of living a normal student life in this bittersweet slice of life visual novel. Record new experiences, revel in mundanity, and be a strange machine and a strange person.

title: Haligen Zero
description: Find the answer in the incident involving the Professor and unravel the secret of the Awakened.

title: Signal Zero: Dispatch
description: Take control of a sprawling cyberpunk metropolis. Operating from a sleek, asymmetrical command interface, you must manage high-speed vehicle pursuits, deploy tactical units, and survive a grueling 10-level crime escalation. The neon streets are burning, and you are the only voice on the wire.

title: Signal Zero
description: A sci-fi roguelike shooter where aim and movement are unified into one mouse. Pilot a Simuler, command your ship, deploy escorts, and tear through colossal bosses. Easy to grasp, ruthless under pressure.

title: Ctrl+Alt+Defeat Zero Humanity
description: A 2D roguelike survivor where robots face absurd human leaders at the end of the world. Waves, builds, epic bosses, and an infinite mode for those who conquer Antarctica. Chaos never felt this good.

title: Starting a Village from Zero
description: This is your own village-building story — You are a familiar summoned by Lily, an apprentice witch. In her place, gather materials, construct buildings, and create a thriving village. A new kind of miniscape × survival × roguelite simulation.

title: Cargo Crush Zero
description: Push blocks. Crush enemies. Survive the void. Cargo Crush Zero is a roguelite grid-action game set aboard a derelict space station. Outmaneuver alien creatures by sliding cargo blocks across a zero-gravity field — one wrong move and you're cornered.

title: Zero One Protocol
description: No story. No mercy. Just perfect control and instant punishment. Every jump gets you closer, every failure punishes, and every restart dares you to go again. Welcome to Zero One Protocol, a minimalist, merciless, and dangerously satisfying precision platformer.

title: Beatcore Zero
description: Try Beatcore for free! A simple rhythm game where you hit beats as they come down the lanes. This version does not permit access to the workshop.

title: Stronghold 4
description: Wood needed! Return to the green roots of Stronghold in this narrative prequel to the original 'castle sim'. Immerse yourself in a cinematic campaign, hone your siegecraft with new mechanics in skirmish mode and customise your castles with a wide selection of castle pieces and cosmetics.

title: Wardens of Avalon
description: Restore the former glory of a corrupt Camelot in Wardens of Avalon, an Action RPG set in a Dark Arthurian world. As a new member of the Twilight Knights, establish your fiefdom, explore, craft and gear up for thrilling adventures against the fallen Knights of the Round Table, alone or with friends.

title: Umbral Coterie
description: A dark city simulation with procedural generation and emergent storytelling. Observe, befriend, manipulate, and betray hundreds of fully simulated citizens as they live, work, scheme, and die around you. Shape bloodlines across generations and uncover the sinister forces moving beneath the city.

title: Machiavelli
description: Take the role of a monarch who’s made a deal with a demon to become immortal. In return, help them harvest souls by building and destroying countless kingdoms in this rogue-like city builder game.

title: Blackjack: Cheat the House!
description: Blackjack: Cheat the House!! is a blackjack deck-building roguelike where you collect, buy, and upgrade "cheats" to beat the dealer. Create synergistic combos, trick the dealer, and fix the deck to get dealt cards that work with your most overpowered build and reach the goal of winning $1,000,000!

title: Signet City
description: From the creator of Citizen Sleeper, Signet City is a first-person fungalpunk RPG. You are a parasite, in a city where strange technologies and radical ideas are taking root. Grow into and through its inhabitants, uncover and change their stories, and witness the terminal season of the signet city.

title: Teaching Gender-Affirming Care
description: An educational visual training simulation that follows transgender and gender-diverse patients at a primary care clinic. Step into the role of a new provider as you prescribe and optimize hormone therapy, counsel patients around surgical affirmation and navigate care considerations for adolescents.

title: Maximum Thunderness
description: An extreme response to minor problems. MAXIMUM THUNDERNESS is a roguelike sidescrolling co-op action game where you fight a space alien criminal invasion with different skills and abilities.

title: Time Strike
description: TIME STRIKE is a single-player FPS that gives you maximum control: stop time to dodge projectiles, rip down walls, line up a headshot, and flip flying debris into hapless enemies. CONTROL TIME. CONTROL SPACE.

title: Hidden Objects: Items Find
description: Find Hidden Objects – game that takes you on an exciting journey through beautiful 2D locations, where hundreds of hidden items and objects await you! Explore picturesque landscapes, mysterious cities, and magical worlds to find what's hidden!

title: Pipes.exe
description: A first-person co-op horror experience for 1-4 players based on the thing you think its based on. Climb your way through testing environments as a low level QA employee for a Perfectly Legitimate Tech Company. Survive a series of simulated assignments and brutal corporate life.

title: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
description: The shadows are your ally. Return to the city as Garrett, master thief, in this remastered classic by Nightdive Studios. Pickpocket, prowl, and outsmart in a world where trust is a luxury and every stolen secret comes at a price.

title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Eternal Whispers
description: Vampire: The Masquerade - Eternal Whispers is a narrative-driven CRPG set in the World of Darkness. Awaken from decades of torpor into a dark-modern Montreal consumed by political intrigue, buried secrets and personal horror.

title: Little Ghosties
description: Little Ghosties is a cozy idle desktop companion game where adorable ghosts live inside a glass terrarium on your desktop. Hatch, raise, and collect unique ghosts as they grow from eggs into fully grown adult ghosts.

title: El Paso, Elsewhere 2
description: More stakes. More guns. More slow-mo. James Savage returns in this sequel to the hit third-person shooter. Escape the Void. Fight creatures pulled from myth, history, and imagination. Save yourself.

title: Carcass Clad
description: A visceral co-op tank horror game from the creators of MOUTHWASHING. Featuring weighty physical controls, crew the Yksiö with a team of 3. Fuel is limited and ammo is scarce. The city's saint, long since laid to rest, walks again gilded and defiled.

title: Where Stones Sleep
description: A cozy, single-screen puzzle platformer focused on planning, experimentation, and clear cause-and-effect, with no combat or time pressure.

title: Into the Wind
description: Drive, fly, and run deliveries together with your sentient motorcycle-plane, Ermes. Make friends, battle rowdy air pirates, upgrade your bike, decorate your home, explore the islands of Santa Rosa, and solve the mystery of your uncle's disappearance.

title: Moldrise
description: You are a foot fungus that needs to reach the roof. Unfortunately you are attached to a person. Meet strange neighbors. Make bad trades. Every run, you learn what you should have done differently.

title: Chromatide
description: In this first-person surreal adventure set inside a vast underwater station, the experiments of the OCCTech corporation have torn reality open. Descend into the depths. Wield paranormal powers, face abnormal creatures and survive the chromatic tide.

title: Monster Park Tycoon
description: Build and manage the ultimate monster park. From fascinating abominations to world-ending horrors, your park isn't just for show it's the cover of a secret (not very smart) cult. Kidnap visitors, turn them into creatures, and keep everything under control in this darkly comedic tycoon game.

title: My College Life is Very Happy
description: Realistic and touching text games, postgraduate entrance exams, job hunting, revising papers, and graduation travel. In the game, you will play the role of a 2022 college graduate to experience the story of the last 60 days of your senior year.

title: Bergfried
description: Build realistic medieval castles and defend them against rival knights. Bergfried is a strategy game featuring organic castle building and tactical siege battles. Manage your lands, plan your defenses and lead your troops to victory!

title: Dark Deity III
description: The Eternal Order is back! Build your army, customize your units, and conquer challenging tactical battles. Sinister death cults are spreading and now threaten all of Terrazael. Youll have to move heaven and earth to win this war - will your army be up to the task?

title: Poke a Nose
description: You're a severed hand on a mission: Every nose must be poked! Thrust into exploring a hand-drawn black-and-white world, poke bosses, secret passages, and collect toilet paper coins along the way.

title: Moonlords: Tides of Battle
description: Compose your army and outmaneuver the enemy troops on a lane-based map to turn the tides against them. Choose out of many factions, units, upgrades, heroes and spells to gather momentum, push lanes and storm their base in an epic tug of war.

title: Smalland II: Lost Realms
description: The Smallfolk are back with a massively expanded universe in this open-world survival adventure set on a tiny scale! Enjoy up to 10 player co-op where you craft weapons and armor, form companionships with creatures, build encampments, and discover strange new lands.

title: Backrooms: The Savior
description: That's a co-op horror exploration shooter set in the Backrooms. This time, you won’t just hide—grab your weapon and fight back against the entities. Explore classic and original levels, scavenge supplies, rescue survivors, and survive. Ammo is scarce. Noise is deadly. This time, fear goes both ways.

title: Backrooms: The Last Observer
description: Backrooms: The Last Observer is a cooperative horror game. Descend into something that resists understanding, where perception itself begins to fracture. You are here not to fight, but to witness — and sometimes, witnessing is the worst thing you can do.

title: Backrooms: Into the Hole
description: Discover an in-between space inspired by the Backrooms series. Make your way forward by jumping into holes, find alternative paths, and survive in this labyrinthine dimension. Play solo or in co-op mode and choose your path to the exit… if there is one.

title: A Weird Game About Sausage
description: This is a clicker game about a sausage.

title: Basecamp
description: Fight waves of mutated creatures in this roguelite tower defense game. Turrets can be used to defend or to harvest — you decide! How much can you secure before being overrun?

title: Tiny Train Adventures
description: Set off on a tiny train adventure! Build your railway and drive through the mountains in this cozy exploration adventure.

title: Recollage
description: Craft your way through this dark fantasy puzzle adventure. Use your creativity to transform yourself and the world around you. It’s the only way to break free from the shadows of your childhood.

title: The Memphis Chronicles
description: Welcome to Memphis, a city you can only visit once. A place where dreamers and the dead dance. Explore Memphis in the first person, uncover mysteries, and maybe even learn a bit more about yourself. You can’t bring any friends, but everyone you need is already here. This is the trip of a lifetime.

title: Chessfall
description: A roguelite adventure in the chess kingdom – roam the land as a shapeshifter, collect items & loot, trade with merchants, defeat powerful bosses and find the white queen to break the curse of the black wizard!

title: DrillScape
description: Arcade mining under pressure: pilot a fast rover, mine resources, upgrade, fight, and rescue planets before aliens take control over the whole universe.

title: Plant Everywhere
description: Paint your city with plants! In this cosy guerilla gardening game, turn harmful areas into gardens that everyone can use. Use freeform planting to customise your city, and get to know the local residents and their stories.

title: The Named
description:
3,236 years after the Copper Odyssey events, a Very Interesting Person creates a game show for TV where contestants can get a chance at winning a Name in this nameless world. The effects of the Sun and the colors of the Sky are now friends with the humans, or so it seems.

See how this game show plays out, and who will be the winner deserving of a Name.

title: Squid Hunt 1923
description: Experience a unique flow that echoes the early icons of the shooter genre. Captivated by grotesque atmosphere, driven by ever-growing numbers you plunge into portals, eliminate aliens, collect loot and gather experience. At a pace you set yourself.

title: No Man Can Deny
description: Isolated on the open sea, equipped with a rusty lantern and a tape recorder. Endure the pain or drown like the rest in this short resource-management horror game.

title: Mach Brutale
description: Mach Brutale is a vicious, high-octane, speed-climbing platformer. Tear through the districts of Hyper America, using your foes themselves as your weapon.

title: Lost Arsenal
description: Lost Arsenal is a movement-heavy melee action game. Stylishly maneuver through areas by teleporting to your thrown weapons, and use each weapon's unique power to carve your way through a summoner's invasion.

title: Tengu Rumei Race
description:
TENGU RUMEI RACE is a touhou fangame with a cute pixelart.
The main character is Sanae Kochiya, she races against Marisa Kirisame on the 2D Platformer game.

title: Cube Runner 3D
description: Cube Runner 3D challenges you by making you dodge oncoming cubes that will destroy you as soon as you touch them. Survive as long as you can in this randomly generated world.

title: Coloring Game 5.4
description:
An additional set of images for Coloring Game 5.

Size: 20 images / 550,000 px.

Duration: 15 hours (Pen Mode) / 8 hours (Fill Mode)

title: Posthumors
description: Have you ever wondered what happens to people after they die? We created “Posthumors,” an online project that allows you to experience death and communicate with the afterlife through words. Now then — take up your pen, and face death.

title: Whispered Legends: Tales of Middleport
description: A darkness has fallen over the once-sleepy seaside town of Middleport, and townspeople are mysteriously disappearing at an alarming rate! Reports of monster sightings, ghastly galleons and possessed artifacts have made their way to London; newspapers claim the town is haunted by an ancient curse! You've been summoned from London as an Inspector from the Royal Society of Skeptics to dispel the rumors that dark magic is afoot in Middleport. Uncover the true cause of the disturbances and track down the disappeared townspeople before darkness falls on Middleport forever!

title: RushGirl Luca
description: RushGirl LUCA is a fast-paced 2D action shooter roguelite. With nothing but a mouse, weave between bullet heaven and bullet hell by your own hand, hold back the alien assault, upgrade a wide arsenal of weapons and parts, and push the counterattack all the way out into space!

title: Lola’s Familiars: Prison of Argnoh
description: Escape a demonic underworld prison in this stunning anime inspired lite-vania adventure. Explore mysterious magical realms, forge pacts with powerful Familiar bosses, uncover dark secrets, and guide Lola through an emotional journey of growth in a haunting dark fantasy world.

title: Atmospheric Titan
description: In the 798th parallel universe, there's a gaseous planet, code-named "Atmospheric Titan," which is entirely gaseous without any land. It is composed of various elemental gases, including metal elements and dust floating in the air left by meteorites tearing through the atmosphere

title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
- MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls
- Year 1 Characters and Stage Pass (Includes set of result screen character poses, four characters and one stage post-launch)
- Howard the Duck (Lobby Avatar)
- Cosmo (Lobby Pet)

title: Voxotron
description: A psychedelic hyper-speed racer with no speed limit. Pilot a spaceship around a spinning cosmic cylinder. No brakes. Thread impossible patterns and find the hyperfocus your brain was built for. Short runs. Instant death. Easy to learn, with insane skill ceiling. Pure flow state.

title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - Ultimate Edition
description:
The Ultimate Edition includes:
- MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls
- Year 1 Characters and Stage Pass (Includes set of result screen character poses, four characters and one stage post-launch)
- Howard the Duck (Lobby Avatar)
- Cosmo (Lobby Pet)
- Spider-Man “Advanced Suit 2.0” Costume
- Storm Punk Rock Costume
- Iron Man Classic Costume
- Captain America Classic Costume
- Doctor Doom Supreme Ruler Costume
- Animated Chromatic color unlock for all 20 launch characters

title: Bloody Grids
description: A single move to carve a path through blood.Use the information on the grid to avoid, fight, and devour unseen enemies in this Minesweeper-style puzzle adventure.

title: Magical Thief Silky
description: Shoot and slash your way through a perilous urban underbelly to save kidnapped magical fish! Swap between Silky-sama and her oddball friend to fell enemies with swords, guns, and a plethora of stolen skills in this quirky 2D action platformer with dramatic finishing moves!

title: Hypercut
description: In Hypercut, dice through hordes of enemies with agile swordplay, lightning fast movement, instant-kill combat and immeasurable gore.

title: Nebulae
description:
Collectively govern a galaxy, or watch it burn. Build Empires, Forge Alliances. Outwit a million rivals. And save your world - or not.
Govern Planets, outmanoeuvre your competition. Shape a galaxy with a million other players.
Your political ideas, tested against reality!

It’s called Nebulae. And you can make it a reality.

title: Unshelved
description: Unshelved is an up to 4-player co-op Work-Life Horror Sim where you manage a cursed library. By day, shop book requests and earn an honest living. But as night falls, you must return books to their shelves and survive the horrors that haunt the halls!

title: Dawn Bell
description: She wakes up in a mysterious castle. "Dawn Bell" is a side-scrolling 2D horror adventure where a girl with no memory explores the castle. Use items and clues to solve puzzles and uncover her lost past. Your choices shape the story's multiple endings. What truth awaits beyond the doors of memory?

title: The Ballad of a True Thug
description:
The Ballad of a True Thug is a crime ballad written in lead and blood. Your story of revenge begins at the bottom—in the dark alleys of Europe and the neon traps of '90s America. To reach those who took everything, you must rise from a small-time crook to a living legend of the criminal underworld.

Here, every fight is a dance on the edge of a knife. Slow down time to find the right move, dodge bullets with a desperate slide, and use everything from cheap alcohol to a heavy gun to gain an advantage. One false step, one miss, and this ballad will end forever.

Destiny awaits your move. Make it.

title: Fable: Order of the Hero
description:
Write the next chapter of your legend in Fable: Order of the Hero, a story‑driven expansion (coming post-launch) that draws you into the secrets of a dark, ancient cult hidden deep within the perilous beauty of Albion.

Fable: Order of the Hero features a brand-new region that brims with danger, wonder, and whispers of long buried power. As you explore, your deeds earn the cultist’s admiration, and you rise to become their latest (and greatest) celebrity overseer.

With your newfound authority, you’ll guide their rituals and shape the cult into your own heroic vision, whether noble, nasty or just plain weird. But becoming the new boss does beg a darker question. If the cult has a vacancy for a new Heroic leader…

…what happened to the last one?

title: Money Laundering Raccoon
description: Manage a laundromat for your raccoons to wash dirty money.

title: Eluminage Original
description: Inheriting the fun of classic dungeon RPGs Eluminage ORIGINAL, a popular title that inherits the fun of classical dungeon RPG finally appeared on Steam. The hack-slash gameplay is challenging and and a high degree of freedom in character creation, Once you start playing, you won't be able to stop.

title: Warehouse
description: Warehouse is a short action psychological horror game, developed by a solo developer, set in a decaying Hong Kong industrial building. Armed with a VHS camcorder and a handgun, uncover buried guilt and survive the horrors that lurk in the dark as past sins claw their way into the present.

title: Adventure Diary
description: Minimalist turn based battle game with a world view of West Fantasy Sword and Magic. The game features simple textual expression but contains a lot of hidden content and information. There are eight major professions to choose from, including 16 basic job transfers and dozens of hidden job transfers

title: Beat for Speed
description:
Experience the next generation of rhythm-racing. Upload any music to generate deadly tracks using our self-developed engine trained on thousands of hand-crafted levels. Featuring intense multiplayer racing, a powerful level editor, and full Steam Workshop support for endless custom content.

Move beyond simple randomization. We built our own algorithm, the level generation is powered by a custom algorithm we trained strictly on deep learning from hundreds of our own professional, hand-crafted levels. It accurately identifies the rhythmic logic of various genres—including Pop, Kpop, HipHop, Rock, Phonk, EDM, etc—seamlessly converting audio into challenging and aesthetically structured tracks.

title: Damp Southern Days
description: A narrative-driven visual novel blending storytelling experimentation with coffee brewing:Master water flow and extraction timing to achieve the golden standard of pour-over perfection.Unlock whispered confessions from five unique characters, their secrets clinking like coffee cups.

title: Barely Breathing
description: Spill and splash away, make your own path! Go on an adventure in this 3D Platformer with fun physics interactions and smooth controls!

title: Fendershot
description: Intense street racing with some outrageous Race Tech Inspired by Blur, Midnight Club and NFS:U. Split-Screen local multiplayer. Test drive the demo on PC, Mac and SteamOS (Proton)!

title: Radio Heart: Lofi Hours
description: Radio Heart: Lofi Hours is a cozy interactive focus companion where Suzume works alongside you in real time. Customize your space, music, and atmosphere while she studies beside you. Stay present, build habits, and share quiet moments between sessions.

title: Septurian Might
description: Combat, choices, and comedy collide in Septurian Might, a hand-drawn action RPG set in the alien world of Septura. Outsmart bizarre aliens, steal their intellect, and survive demanding combat as you unravel a heartfelt story about finding your way home.

title: Project Foxx
description: Step into the boots of Officer Foxx — a fearless, ever-optimistic law-enforcer in a utopian sci-fi world under siege by mechanical invaders. In this fast-paced hack-and-shoot action packed adventure, you’ll slash, blast, dash, and conquer your way through challenging, handcrafted levels.

title: Ghatika
description: Ghatika is a 2D side-scrolling action-adventure set in a fantasy world with ancient kingdoms, ruthless polity and mysterious tribes. Explore dense jungles, boulder fields and mountain ranges as you desperately try to secure the safety of your people.

title: The Three Kingdoms Era in China 2000 Years Ago
description: This is a Chinese historical story game that chronicles the dusty past of the Sima Yi family during the late Han Dynasty and the Three Kingdoms period - the unification of the Three Kingdoms.

title: Malhaar
description: A musical slice-of-life RPG where you play as a musician and luthier who has just arrived in the mystical city that lives and breathes music. Befriend locals, solve puzzles and unravel the mysterious stories of the lingering musical spirits that only appear during the season of the fireflies.

title: The Misadventures of Spaceman Biff
description: Help Biff, the unluckiest pilot in the galaxy, get home after he crash lands on an alien rock in this punishing platformer. Use his trusty jetpack to climb up mountains, the remains of his ship, and into the many secrets of this strange alien world - slip once and tumble for eternity.

title: The Gate of Front: Monster Auction
description: A fun party board game that supports 5 people to play online! Auction animals, make secret deals, get the ultimate victory!During the course of the game, you and four other players will find new monsters each turn, auction them off, and earn gold. And use the gold to buy new monsters.

title: False Frights
description: False Frights is a Five Nights at Freddy's fangame by @bikewithnoseat that adds many rumored "Hoax" characters in a roguelike structure. Pick and choose what animatronics you add to your office before facing off against a boss, in a classic office defense gameplay loop with many unique mechanics and twists.

title: The Last Knight Hawk
description: A hack-n-slash title, featuring aerial acrobatic swordplay, epic bosses and a character-driven story.

title: Juggling Cup
description: This idle game brings a soccer ball to your desktop, ready whenever you want a quick distraction. Work, pause, and kick the ball around for a moment of fun, ideal for a break or even for use in your live streams.

title: EEP 12
description: EEP eisenbahn.exe is the most diverse, most realistic and most frequently sold construction and control simulation program for PC. Developed and constantly improved by train fans for train fans, EEP offers unique game depth, unrivalled attention to detail and countless possibilities to design your virtual train world.

title: Five Nights with Firearms
description: In this FPS Five Nights at Freedys fan game, get your revenge on the animatronics who haunted your dreams for so long!

title: Iceland South Coast
description: Explore the recreated south coast of Iceland in this virtual walking experience. Hike through the landscape and discover the unique moss lava field, black sand beach, church, and crater that is iconic of Iceland. Experience the beautiful soundtracks and ambient sounds of the ocean waves, waterfall, and river throughout your discovery.

title: Karaoke Joysound for Steam
description: 160,000 songs of unlimited karaoke!

title: Grotesk
description: Battle Grotesk spawns of a melting world and discover its secrets as one of the three characters, each with a unique playstyle, in this fantasy retro FPS inspired by 90s games.

title: Rogue Company: Season 7 - Wasteland Wilds Battle Pass
description: Season 7, also known as Year 2: Season 3 and based on the theme of Wastelands, was the seventh season of Rogue Company. It started on June 8, 2022 and ended on September 6, 2022, lasting for 90 days.

title: Orb Breaker
description: An incremental bullet hell about shooting orbs at enemies, collecting resources, and becoming powerful!

title: Just Keep Fishing
description: A short incremental game about catching a lot fish.

title: Mining and Dwarves
description: An incremental game where you mine rocks, gather ore, and recruit dwarves. Play actively for maximum gains, or idle and let the dwarves do the work.

title: Hearing Voices
description: Hearing Voices is a unique indie short horror experience where you will need to put your listening and deduction skills to the test to solve puzzles. Mistakes have consequences.

title: Monkey Tales
description: Developed by leading educational publisher DieKeure and Larian Studios through four years of close collaboration with teachers, schools, and universities, Monkey Tales Games is a series of engrossing video games with a robust learning component tailored to every child.

title: Ghost Milf
description: Ghost Milf is a fast-paced 2D Hentai game where you explore a haunted apartment while a seductive, mommy-kink Ghost Milf constantly teases, tempts, and distracts you.

title: The Detractor
description: Enter a dark fantasy world consumed by the King of Hatred in The Detractor: Rise of the Exiled! Step into the role of The Detractor, an exiled hero seeking vengeance and redemption in this gripping roguelike adventure. Explore three epic chapters filled with peril and mystery as you challenge the tyrannical ruler who cast you down.

title: Bottled by Bears
description: Join a family of bears and run the buzziest little honey farm! Collect and discover rare bees, bottle honey jars, expand your farm, and watch your flowery field bloom in this cozy idle management game.

title: Sunset Survival: Miami
description: Gear up, get out, and survive the neon-soaked apocalypse. Sunset Survival: Miami is a top-down PvE extraction shooter. Raid a mutant-infested Miami for vital supplies, blast your way through enemy hordes, upgrade your base, and unlock powerful skills. Can you make it out alive?

title: Tilt It! Golf
description: Mini-golf with a twist, all for the price of a coffee! Tilt the entire golf course to guide your ball into the hole, dodge tricky obstacles, and beat the clock to earn star ratings across 300 progressively challenging courses.

title: Flock Off!
description: Flock Off! is a first-person action adventure game for 1–4 players. Team up with friends to survive a strange and woolly uprising in the remote Scottish Highlands. Improvise with oddball weapons to fend off zombified sheep and uncover unexpected twists. Will you survive the Sheepocalypse?

title: Girls Eliminate
description: "Girls Eliminate" is a casual puzzle game. As long as you find 3 identical girls and move them in a straight line, you can eliminate them. If you reach the points required by the level, you can pass the level.

title: Jump Jump
description: 'Jump Jump' is a casual game. Play by jumping with the help of the operator. Jumping onto the box counts as 1 point, and jumping into the middle of the box counts as 2 points.

title: Burnstation
description:
Deck-burning. Score-chasing. Roguelike in stile plinko.
As a runner, you aim your 4 marbles, trigger retro cartridges, and chain explosive combos to push your score higher and higher. But push your deck too far, and it burns out.

title: Blood Storm
description: Blood Storm is a fast-paced TPS action game. Levels can be traversed on foot or completed using a biomech. The gameplay is focused on fast-paced action — we have activatable abilities, such as bullet-time slow motion, and we can also dodge enemy projectiles with quick slides.

title: We’re In Trouble
description: A CO-OP stealth game about a problem that can’t wait until morning. ️‍♂️ An empty office, a body, and absolute silence. Work together, avoid guards and cameras, handle unpredictable physics, and escape unnoticed. One mistake can ruin everything.

title: Fractured Universe
description: A Turn based RPG with a focus on team building and character development. Explore the Fractured Universe, and what life would be like if the multiverse was destroyed. Featured various art styles and aesthetics.

title: Haparoot
description: Step into a dream world. Become the sole source of light in the darkness and Explore an authentic handcrafted landscape in third-person. Solve layered environmental puzzles, discuss some familiar issues and uncover secrets shaping the journey toward balance.

title: Roadhouse Simulator: Prologue
description: Experience the uncle’s story before the events of Roadhouse Simulator and explore his humble beginnings while trying your skill as a bouncer at a roadhouse or Route 66.

title: Spacero: Origins
description:
Spacero: Origins is an exploration driven space adventure focused on discovery, progression, and freedom. Travel across a universe filled with unique civilizations, dangerous enemies, valuable resources, powerful abilities, and colossal galaxy ruling bosses.

Begin your journey with a modest spacecraft and grow into a force capable of crossing entire galaxies. Battle hostile fleets, mine rare resources, earn credits, level up, and continuously improve your ship through upgrades, modules, and advanced technology.

Every galaxy contains its own planets, species, ships, resources, and challenges. As you grow stronger, you will encounter increasingly dangerous civilizations and powerful rulers that control access to the next frontier. Defeat these galaxy bosses to obtain the technology required to travel beyond known space and discover entirely new regions of the universe.

title: Aftereffect
description: Vanessa is a young employee working a dead-end job, but in a twist of fate, she is sent on a company mission to go to an abandoned factory. It’s up to her to explore the secrets within and unravel the mysteries of Fazbear Entertainment in this narrative-driven game.

title: Just Eat Sushi!
description: "Just Eat Sushi!" is a simulator where you can enjoy the world of revolving sushi as much as you like. Relax and watch the plates go by, eat until you're stuffed, or just hang out and chat with friends. Try your luck with the familiar "Plate Gacha," use your own images to customize your face for a hilarious dining experience, and challenge or compete with others in various modes!

title: Dearbnb
description:
Dearbnb is a cozy management game where you build a real estate empire one room at a time.

Start your journey by renting a small apartment in a modest neighborhood. Carefully decorate rooms, place furniture freely, set prices, and welcome tenants and customers. As you gain experience and reputation, unlock new zones — from poor districts to luxury neighborhoods and expand into residences, shops, and massive commercial properties.

Every room matters.
Every decision shapes your path to becoming a true property tycoon.

title: Neko-Mimi Sweet Housemates Vol. 2
description: Mint and her friends return in Neko-Mimi Sweet Housemates 2! In order to save her family, a girl will defy fate itself and become the personification of miracles...

title: The 11th Power
description:
Combine powers of 2 to unleash attacks and devastating combos as you fight your way through a dungeon full of evil cultists, disgusting slimes, and unspeakable horrors from another dimension!

The 11th Power is a deckbuilding roguelike unlike any you've ever played before. It takes the gameplay of the classic game 2048 and adds special powers to the tiles that are activated when you combine them with other tiles, and then merge into something even more powerful!

Play as the Barbarian, the Archer, or the Mage, each with their own special set of tiles to suit your playstyle.

Unlock devastating power as you reach toward the 11th power of 2: 2048!

title: Buns, Kefir and Rock 'n' Roll
description:
Just when the hero has settled into camp, a new disaster strikes: the closing concert is in jeopardy, and it's all his fault. The band needs a new bassist, and the music club makes Semyon an offer he can't refuse. And he wouldn't want to, either, because Miku will personally be training him.

The story is funny, sometimes humorous, lighthearted, and musical, just like Miku herself. But be prepared for both breathtaking moments and a touch of sadness in this wonderful story.

You'll find:

Lots of new content;

New events and characters;

Summer, pioneer romance, and music.

Even though the story focuses on one talkative pioneer girl, fans of the other girls won't feel left out—quite the contrary.

title: Rally Car Mechanic Simulator
description: Take your opportunity as a real Rally Mechanic. Overcome all the obstacles that the reckless racers throw at you - including unrepairable parts, time limitations and more. Take good care of your rally cars so that on the next special they will perform as good as if they came out of the factory.

title: Bench Simulator
description: You are not the hero. You are the bench. Witness lives, one moment at a time.

title: Wuthering Waves: The Dream Not Dreamed
description:
Version 3.4 of Wuthering Waves includes:
The Cyberpunk: Edgerunners collaboration event
New Resonators: Lucy, Rebecca, and Lucilla
New Region: Night City
New Main Story and Quests
New Events, and Rewards

title: Paper Strike
description: Paper Strike is a competitive party game, a tactical, fast-paced 3v3 game. Play as a Warrior Mage, wielding powerful magic and deadly weapons. Team up with 2 friends and seize control of the arena to unleash the devastating power of Armageddon in an ever-evolving battlefield.

title: Halo: Campaign Evolved - Premium Edition
description:
Halo: Campaign Evolved is a faithful yet modernized remake of Halo: Combat Evolved’s campaign. Experience the original story rebuilt with high-definition visuals, updated cinematics, refined controls, plus a brand-new three-mission adventure featuring the Master Chief and Sgt. Johnson. A broader arsenal of weapons, vehicles, enemies, and gameplay-modifying “Skulls” – optional modifiers that change combat in fun and challenging ways – add fresh tactics and endless replayability.

Premium Edition Includes:
• Halo: Campaign Evolved game
• Alpha Halo Armory Pack, featuring 5 Master Chief Armor skins & 6 weapon skins
• Art of Halo: Campaign Evolved Digital Artbook
• Halo: Hungry Buzzards Digital Short Story
• Digital Game Manual

title: Zuma's Revenge!: Adventure
description: A release of Zuma's Revenge with just Adventure Mode.

title: Table 9
description: Deliver coffee to 9 tables in a looping European-style specialty cafe, spot the anomalies creeping in and reach Table 9.

title: Spyder: Agent 8
description: Save the world as Agent 8, a robot spider superspy! Crawl across walls, ceilings, and floors, and use built-in gadgets to solve fun environmental puzzles in this brand-new, family-friendly adventure from the BAFTA Award-winning studio Sumo Digital.

title: Mommy Simulator
description: Mommy Simulator is a unique and engaging game that simulates the experience of being a mother. As the player, you take on the role of a mother who must take care of her child, ensuring that they are well-fed, rested, and happy.

title: Dream Affection: Sleepy Planet
description: Welcome to earth, gaia, terra, ur home.... Maybe ur already familiar? it is sick and having bad dreams .it is ALWAYS dreaming, can u imagine??

title: Sperm Runner
description: Adulth themed endless runner game. 4 different types of endless runner minigames where player character is super sperm. Mission is to avoid different deathly objects like poops, herpes simplex virus and chlamydia viruses.

title: Legend of Heroes
description: This is an idle MMO game. You need to choose a profession, put on equipment and go to the adventure continent to fight against evil monsters.

title: Damn Exam
description: Defend your school from the unrelenting mass of cheating students. Can you survive exam week without getting fired, or will your students outsmart you? Fail those cheating, pesky students!

title: LA Soul
description: Think you've got what it takes to lowride? Dive into LA Soul, a captivating game that immerses you in the vibrant world of lowrider culture. Forget simple tapping - this is about feeling the rhythm and mastering the art of bumping!

title: Number 1!
description: "Number 1!" is an exciting and action-packed game that challenges you to run, jump and dive your way to the finish line. In this game, you must compete against other characters in a running competition, but there's a twist - the race takes place above the earth on a series of platforms.

title: My Parkour
description: This is a simple text parkour game, in which you need to control "我" through the input box to move and jump to avoid obstacles.

title: 007 First Light: Deluxe Edition
description:
007 First Light: Deluxe Edition is a single‑player action shooter featuring stealth, cover‑based gunplay, and melee combat. Play as a young secret agent navigating tense missions and cinematic set pieces, with enhanced weapons and extras included in the deluxe package.

This edition includes:

4 outfits:
• Day of the Dead
• Desert Explorer
• Silent Anchor
• Gentleman Operator

Weapon skin:
• Agent’s Mark

Gleaming Pack, including 4 gadget skins:
• Gleaming Lighter
• Gleaming Earphones
• Gleaming Phone
• Gleaming Pen

title: Dragon's Dogma II: Dark Arisen Expansion
description:
Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen enriches the dynamic fantasy world and expansive adventures of Dragon's Dogma 2 with unforgettable new tales and thrilling encounters.

Based on feedback we received after the initial release of Dragon's Dogma 2, we established three goals for ourselves when we set out to update and expand the game:
Enhanced gameplay. Expanded adventures. Enticing value.

title: Idle Keep
description:
Wyverns have stolen the Kingdom's Light! Rebuild the Keep, grow stronger and gear up to defeat the Wyvern Queen and restore magic to the Kingdom.

Idle Keep is an Casual Idle game where you set your own path to defeat the mighty Wyvern Queen - best played as a second monitor game!

title: One Piece: Grand Gourmet
description: Hop aboard a delectable management sim in the world of ONE PIECE! Work alongside the Straw Hat Crew to build the greatest floating restaurant of the seas. Collect ingredients, dream up dishes, and decorate to have familiar faces lining up for more!

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton
description: Survive, Exorcise, Change the game JUJUTSU KAISEN RUMBLE: SURVIVATON is a survivors royale where you battle cursed spirits and rival sorcerers, growing stronger throughout the match. Outscore your rivals and fight to be the last player standing victorious.

title: Muramasa: Revenant Blades
description: Vanillaware x Marvelous present an action RPG for the ages. Hack and slash your way through a world of restless spirits and Demon Blades. The tales of six fabled protagonists of Japan's Genroku era, each with their own unique fighting style, are about to unfold.

title: Final Fantasy Resonance
description: Return to the pixelart world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

title: Pikuniku 2
description: Absurd puzzle-exploration adventure Pikuniku 2 brings the whimsy! Wander, solve, and gossip your way through a weird and wonderful world where not everything is as happy as it seems. Protect the potato!

title: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories
description: Atelier Karia tells the story of Karia, who has no memories, as she faces her past. New features add to the strategy of battles and depth of alchemy. Synthesized items take on new roles during exploration, and ingredients can be eaten to gain effects.

title: Tales of Eternia: Remastered
description: Tales of Eternia returns as a remastered edition! As the threat of world destruction looms, an epic journey begins to determine the fate of two worlds: Inferia and Celestia.

title: Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil
description: Dodge the barrage, defeat enemies, and brave the Scarlet Mist incident. The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil returns with fresh music and graphics.You control the shrine maiden Reimu and the magician Marisa, dodge barrages and shoot at enemies. The background music features complete rearrangements by ZUN.

title: Save the Princess? Save a Fart!
Broken Voyage
description: Broken Voyage is a detective-focused horror game that takes place on an whaling boat gone silent where the player will solve murders, unweave the strings behind a grander mystery, and resist the allure of a lovecraftian monster!

title: 20 Floors
description: You are left alone on the top floor of an apartment. Your only goal is to reach the ground. But as you descend, the corridor you once knew begins to warp into something grotesque. There's no telling what horror awaits. Just don't stop. Keep going down.

title: Store Simulator 2018
description: Store Simulator 2018 is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by StarSystemStudios, which was released in 2018.

title: To the Home
description: In To the Home, you take control of AX-40-BM, a resilient robot tasked with an urgent mission.

title: Asuka x Redline Reverie
description: Enter Asuka’s world of intense street races across Japan’s iconic mountains. Tune and personalize JDM cars as you face fierce rivals, uncover secrets, and forge alliances. Follow a manga-inspired story filled with mystery where nothing is as it seems, until the very end.

title: Ripple Park
description: A meticulously crafted Metroidbrainia game. You find yourself lost in a vast maze filled with pools, where secrets lie beneath their calm and gentle surfaces. Various traps and mechanisms hinder your progress, and unknown entities instill fear in your heart. Search for specific items and leverage the behaviors of unknown creatures. You will unravel the puzzles, uncover your past, and ultimately make your escape. Inspired by poolcore.

title: Idol Kingdom
description: Idol Kingdom is a Strategy RPG Love Live! doujin fangame made by disfact.

title: Plant Game
description: Run-based plant survival and growth game about learning the world through imperfect senses. Grow leaves, roots, and resilience, unlock biological “sensors” as UI progression, and earn your reveal when you bloom or die.

title: Corrupted Dice
description: Corrupted Dice is a dice-based roguelite where every die eventually breaks. Build a pool of unique dice, reach escalating score targets, discover new unlocks, play risky betting minigames, and push Heat and Corruption to the limit.

title: Nova Impact
description: Nova Impact puts you in command of your ship as an elite Zenith pilot. Fight in the arena, earn credits, optimize your build in this fast-paced SSRPG (Space Shooter RPG). Survive the swarm, once at the top of the ranks, face rival pilots in unique 1-on-1 duels to claim your spot as the #1 champion !

title: Payrates
description: Embark on an online co-op pirate game with physics-based gameplay, where you can play with up to 4 players. Find different islands and engage the creatures that live there. Fight, plunder and explore the different environments to satisfy the captain's need for treasure.

title: Guilds of Mountgate
description: A living online RPG where economy, progression and world events shape your journey. Build your character, trade, craft and explore a persistent world that evolves over time — whether you are online or not.

title: Textures Not Found
description: Explore a mysterious facility where colors have vanished. Restore the world piece by piece, uncover hidden secrets, and navigate unique environments guided by a sarcastic AI companion in this atmospheric narrative experience.

title: Broom Racer
description: Broom Racer is a first person, multiplayer party racing game on flying brooms. Race your friends or players world wide through mountains, tight tunnels, forests and more.
